summary: This paper presents an end-to-end LLM-based agentic exploration system for an indoor shopping task, evaluated in both Gazebo simulation and a corresponding real-world corridor layout. The robot incrementally builds a lightweight semantic map by detecting signboards at junctions and storing direction-to-POI relations together with estimated junction poses, while AprilTags provide repeatable anchors for approach and alignment. Given a natural-language shopping request, an LLM produces a constrained discrete action at each junction (direction and whether to enter a store), and a ROS finite-state main controller executes the decision by gating modular motion primitives, including local-costmap-based obstacle avoidance, AprilTag approaching, store entry, and grasping. Qualitative results show that the integrated stack can perform end-to-end task execution from user instruction to multi-store navigation and object retrieval, while remaining modular and debuggable through its text-based map and logged decision history.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于端到端LLM（大型语言模型）的代理式探索系统，用于室内购物任务，并在Gazebo仿真以及相应的真实走廊布局中进行了评估。机器人通过检测路口处的标牌，并将指向目标地点的方向关系和估计的路口姿态一起存储，来增量构建轻量级语义地图；AprilTag则为接近和对齐提供可重复的锚点。给定自然语言购物请求，LLM在每个路口产生一个受约束的离散动作（方向以及是否进入商店），而ROS有限状态主控制器通过门控模块化运动原语来执行该决策，这些原语包括基于局部代价地图的避障、AprilTag接近、商店进入和抓取。定性结果表明，集成的堆栈可以执行从用户指令到多店导航和对象检索的端到端任务执行，同时通过其基于文本的地图和记录的决策历史保持模块化和可调试性。
tldr: This paper presents an LLM-based agentic robotic system for indoor shopping, using a semantic map and modular motion primitives to navigate stores and retrieve objects based on natural language requests. The system is demonstrated in simulation and a real-world corridor.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的自主机器人系统，用于室内购物任务。该系统利用语义地图和模块化运动原语，根据自然语言请求导航商店并检索物品。该系统在模拟和真实世界的走廊中进行了演示。

title: Stochastic Actor-Critic: Mitigating Overestimation via Temporal Aleatoric Uncertainty
summary: Off-policy actor-critic methods in reinforcement learning train a critic with temporal-difference updates and use it as a learning signal for the policy (actor). This design typically achieves higher sample efficiency than purely on-policy methods. However, critic networks tend to overestimate value estimates systematically. This is often addressed by introducing a pessimistic bias based on uncertainty estimates. Current methods employ ensembling to quantify the critic's epistemic uncertainty-uncertainty due to limited data and model ambiguity-to scale pessimistic updates. In this work, we propose a new algorithm called Stochastic Actor-Critic (STAC) that incorporates temporal (one-step) aleatoric uncertainty-uncertainty arising from stochastic transitions, rewards, and policy-induced variability in Bellman targets-to scale pessimistic bias in temporal-difference updates, rather than relying on epistemic uncertainty. STAC uses a single distributional critic network to model the temporal return uncertainty, and applies dropout to both the critic and actor networks for regularization. Our results show that pessimism based on a distributional critic alone suffices to mitigate overestimation, and naturally leads to risk-averse behavior in stochastic environments. Introducing dropout further improves training stability and performance by means of regularization. With this design, STAC achieves improved computational efficiency using a single distributional critic network.
summary_zh: 强化学习中的离策略Actor-Critic方法通过时序差分更新训练评论家（critic），并将其作为策略（actor）的学习信号。这种设计通常比纯粹的在策略方法具有更高的样本效率。然而，评论家网络往往会系统性地高估价值估计。通常通过引入基于不确定性估计的悲观偏差来解决这个问题。目前的方法采用集成来量化评论家的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty），即由于有限的数据和模型歧义产生的不确定性，从而调整悲观更新的幅度。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种名为随机Actor-Critic (STAC)的新算法，该算法结合了时间（单步）偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），即源于随机转移、奖励以及贝尔曼目标中策略引起的变异性的不确定性，来调整时序差分更新中的悲观偏差，而不是依赖于认知不确定性。STAC使用单个分布式的评论家网络来建模时间回报的不确定性，并对评论家和演员网络都应用dropout以进行正则化。我们的结果表明，仅基于分布式评论家的悲观主义足以减轻高估，并自然地导致随机环境中的风险规避行为。通过正则化引入dropout进一步提高了训练的稳定性和性能。通过这种设计，STAC能够使用单个分布式的评论家网络实现更高的计算效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Stochastic Actor-Critic (STAC), a new off-policy actor-critic algorithm that leverages temporal aleatoric uncertainty, modeled using a single distributional critic network, to mitigate overestimation in value estimates and improve training stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的随机Actor-Critic（STAC）算法，该算法利用时间上的偶然不确定性（使用单一分布评论家网络建模）来减轻价值估计中的过度估计并提高训练的稳定性。

title: A Vision-and-Knowledge Enhanced Large Language Model for Generalizable Pedestrian Crossing Behavior Inference
summary: Existing paradigms for inferring pedestrian crossing behavior, ranging from statistical models to supervised learning methods, demonstrate limited generalizability and perform inadequately on new sites. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a shift from numerical pattern fitting to semantic, context-aware behavioral reasoning, yet existing LLM applications lack domain-specific adaptation and visual context. This study introduces Pedestrian Crossing LLM (PedX-LLM), a vision-and-knowledge enhanced framework designed to transform pedestrian crossing inference from site-specific pattern recognition to generalizable behavioral reasoning. By integrating LLaVA-extracted visual features with textual data and transportation domain knowledge, PedX-LLM fine-tunes a LLaMA-2-7B foundation model via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to infer crossing decisions. PedX-LLM achieves 82.0% balanced accuracy, outperforming the best statistical and supervised learning methods. Results demonstrate that the vision-augmented module contributes a 2.9% performance gain by capturing the built environment and integrating domain knowledge yields an additional 4.1% improvement. To evaluate generalizability across unseen environments, cross-site validation was conducted using site-based partitioning. The zero-shot PedX-LLM configuration achieves 66.9% balanced accuracy on five unseen test sites, outperforming the baseline data-driven methods by at least 18 percentage points. Incorporating just five validation examples via few-shot learning to PedX-LLM further elevates the balanced accuracy to 72.2%. PedX-LLM demonstrates strong generalizability to unseen scenarios, confirming that vision-and-knowledge-enhanced reasoning enables the model to mimic human-like decision logic and overcome the limitations of purely data-driven methods.
summary_zh: 现有行人过街行为推断范式，从统计模型到监督学习方法，都表现出有限的泛化能力，在新地点表现不佳。 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使人们能够从数值模式拟合转向语义化的、具有上下文感知能力的推理论证，但现有的 LLM 应用缺乏领域特定的适应性和视觉上下文。 本研究提出了一种行人过街 LLM（PedX-LLM），这是一个视觉和知识增强的框架，旨在将行人过街推断从特定地点的模式识别转变为可泛化的行为推理。 通过将 LLaVA 提取的视觉特征与文本数据和交通领域知识相结合，PedX-LLM 通过低秩自适应（LoRA）微调 LLaMA-2-7B 基础模型，以推断过街决策。 PedX-LLM 实现了 82.0% 的平衡准确率，优于最佳的统计和监督学习方法。 结果表明，视觉增强模块通过捕捉建筑环境贡献了 2.9% 的性能增益，而整合领域知识则带来了额外的 4.1% 的改进。 为了评估在未见环境中的泛化能力，使用基于地点的划分进行了跨站点验证。 零样本PedX-LLM 配置在五个未见测试站点上实现了 66.9% 的平衡准确率，至少比基准数据驱动方法高出 18 个百分点。 通过少量样本学习将仅五个验证案例纳入 PedX-LLM 进一步将平衡准确率提升至 72.2%。 PedX-LLM 表现出对未见场景的强大泛化能力，证实了视觉和知识增强的推理使该模型能够模仿类似人类的决策逻辑，并克服纯数据驱动方法的局限性。
tldr: This paper introduces PedX-LLM, a vision-and-knowledge enhanced LLM for pedestrian crossing behavior inference, demonstrating improved generalizability across unseen environments compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PedX-LLM，一个视觉和知识增强的LLM，用于行人过马路行为推断，与现有方法相比，在未见环境下表现出更好的泛化能力。

title: AlignUSER: Human-Aligned LLM Agents via World Models for Recommender System Evaluation
summary: Evaluating recommender systems remains challenging due to the gap between offline metrics and real user behavior, as well as the scarcity of interaction data. Recent work explores large language model (LLM) agents as synthetic users, yet they typically rely on few-shot prompting, which yields a shallow understanding of the environment and limits their ability to faithfully reproduce user actions. We introduce AlignUSER, a framework that learns world-model-driven agents from human interactions. Given rollout sequences of actions and states, we formalize world modeling as a next state prediction task that helps the agent internalize the environment. To align actions with human personas, we generate counterfactual trajectories around demonstrations and prompt the LLM to compare its decisions with human choices, identify suboptimal actions, and extract lessons. The learned policy is then used to drive agent interactions with the recommender system. We evaluate AlignUSER across multiple datasets and demonstrate closer alignment with genuine humans than prior work, both at the micro and macro levels.
summary_zh: 评估推荐系统仍然面临挑战，这源于离线指标与真实用户行为之间的差距，以及交互数据的稀缺性。近期的研究探索了大型语言模型（LLM）代理作为合成用户，然而它们通常依赖于少样本提示，这导致对环境的浅薄理解，并限制了其忠实再现用户行为的能力。我们提出了 AlignUSER，一个从人类交互中学习世界模型驱动代理的框架。给定行动和状态的展开序列，我们将世界建模形式化为下一个状态预测任务，以帮助代理内化环境。为了将行动与人类角色对齐，我们围绕演示生成反事实轨迹，并提示 LLM 将其决策与人类选择进行比较，识别次优行动，并提取经验教训。然后，学习到的策略被用于驱动代理与推荐系统交互。我们在多个数据集上评估了 AlignUSER，并证明无论是在微观还是宏观层面，它都比先前的工作更接近真实人类。
tldr: AlignUSER learns world-model-driven LLM agents from human interactions for recommender system evaluation, improving alignment with real user behavior. It uses next state prediction and counterfactual trajectory analysis to refine the agent's decision-making process.
tldr_zh: AlignUSER 学习基于世界模型的 LLM 智能体，通过人类交互来评估推荐系统，从而更好地与真实用户行为对齐。它使用下一状态预测和反事实轨迹分析来改进智能体的决策过程。

title: Trajectory Guard -- A Lightweight, Sequence-Aware Model for Real-Time Anomaly Detection in Agentic AI
summary: Autonomous LLM agents generate multi-step action plans that can fail due to contextual misalignment or structural incoherence. Existing anomaly detection methods are ill-suited for this challenge: mean-pooling embeddings dilutes anomalous steps, while contrastive-only approaches ignore sequential structure. Standard unsupervised methods on pre-trained embeddings achieve F1-scores no higher than 0.69. We introduce Trajectory Guard, a Siamese Recurrent Autoencoder with a hybrid loss function that jointly learns task-trajectory alignment via contrastive learning and sequential validity via reconstruction. This dual objective enables unified detection of both "wrong plan for this task" and "malformed plan structure." On benchmarks spanning synthetic perturbations and real-world failures from security audits (RAS-Eval) and multi-agent systems (Who\&When), we achieve F1-scores of 0.88-0.94 on balanced sets and recall of 0.86-0.92 on imbalanced external benchmarks. At 32 ms inference latency, our approach runs 17-27$\times$ faster than LLM Judge baselines, enabling real-time safety verification in production deployments.
summary_zh: 自主LLM智能体生成的多步行动计划可能因上下文失调或结构不连贯而失败。现有的异常检测方法不适用于此挑战：平均池化嵌入会稀释异常步骤，而仅使用对比学习的方法则忽略了序列结构。在预训练嵌入上进行的标准无监督方法获得的F1分数不超过0.69。我们引入了轨迹守卫（Trajectory Guard），这是一个具有混合损失函数的孪生递归自编码器，它通过对比学习联合学习任务-轨迹对齐，并通过重建学习序列有效性。这种双重目标能够统一检测“错误的针对此任务的计划”和“结构畸形的计划”。在涵盖合成扰动以及来自安全审计（RAS-Eval）和多智能体系统（Who\&When）的真实世界故障的基准测试中，我们在平衡数据集上实现了0.88-0.94的F1分数，在不平衡的外部基准测试上实现了0.86-0.92的召回率。在32毫秒的推理延迟下，我们的方法比LLM Judge基线快17-27倍，从而可以在生产部署中实现实时安全验证。
tldr: The paper introduces Trajectory Guard, a fast and accurate anomaly detection method for LLM agents that leverages a Siamese Recurrent Autoencoder with a hybrid loss function to identify contextual misalignments and structural incoherence in action plans.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了Trajectory Guard，一种快速准确的LLM代理异常检测方法，它利用具有混合损失函数的Siamese循环自动编码器来识别动作计划中的上下文错位和结构不连贯。

title: Semantic Event Graphs for Long-Form Video Question Answering
summary: Long-form video question answering remains challenging for modern vision-language models, which struggle to reason over hour-scale footage without exceeding practical token and compute budgets. Existing systems typically downsample frames or feed dense visual embeddings to large-context language models, trading off temporal coverage against cost. We propose Semantic Event Graphs (SEG), a lightweight symbolic interface between video and language that replaces raw frames with compact temporal interaction logs. Our pipeline detects and tracks objects with YOLOv11, converts proximity patterns into START/END human-object events, and organizes them into a Temporal Scene Graph (TSG). At inference time, a query-aware pruning module identifies anchor entities and lexically relevant events, returning only a small subgraph which is verbalized and passed to Gemini 2.5 Flash for answer generation. On five YouTube videos (300-500 interactions each) and 120 automatically generated long-horizon questions, SEG achieves 65.0% accuracy using only 3.47k tokens per query, closely matching a full-log baseline (62.5% at 40.39k tokens) while reducing token usage by 91.4%. A short-context baseline restricted to the last 30 seconds collapses to 2.5% accuracy, underscoring the need for explicit temporal memory. These results show that symbolic temporal graphs can serve as an effective, plug-and-play memory layer for off-the-shelf vision-language models, preserving long-range reasoning ability while making long-form video question answering substantially more token- and cost-efficient. Code, logs, and event-extraction tools will be released for reproducibility.
summary_zh: 长时视频问答对现代视觉-语言模型仍然具有挑战性，因为它们难以在不超出实际 token 和计算预算的情况下推理长达数小时的视频片段。现有系统通常会下采样帧或将密集的视觉嵌入输入到大上下文语言模型中，从而在时间覆盖范围和成本之间进行权衡。我们提出了语义事件图 (SEG)，这是一种视频和语言之间的轻量级符号接口，它用紧凑的时间交互日志取代原始帧。我们的流水线使用 YOLOv11 检测和跟踪对象，将邻近模式转换为 START/END 人-物事件，并将其组织成一个时间场景图 (TSG)。在推理时，一个查询感知修剪模块识别锚点实体和词法相关的事件，只返回一个小的子图，该子图被口头化并传递给 Gemini 2.5 Flash 以生成答案。在五个 YouTube 视频（每个视频包含 300-500 次交互）和 120 个自动生成的长时程问题上，SEG 仅使用每个查询 3.47k 个 token 实现了 65.0% 的准确率，与完整的日志基线（40.39k 个 token 时为 62.5%）紧密匹配，同时减少了 91.4% 的 token 使用量。一个限制在最后 30 秒的短上下文基线崩溃至 2.5% 的准确率，突显了明确的时间记忆的必要性。这些结果表明，符号时间图可以作为现成的视觉-语言模型的有效即插即用记忆层，在保持远程推理能力的同时，使长时视频问答在 token 和成本效率方面得到显著提高。代码、日志和事件提取工具将发布，以确保可重复性。
tldr: This paper presents Semantic Event Graphs (SEG), a method for long-form video question answering that uses symbolic representations of temporal interactions to significantly reduce token usage and improve efficiency compared to feeding raw video data to large language models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于长视频问答的语义事件图 (SEG) 方法，该方法使用时间交互的符号表示来显著减少 token 的使用，并提高效率，而无需像传统方法那样直接将原始视频数据输入大型语言模型。

title: MotionPhysics: Learnable Motion Distillation for Text-Guided Simulation
summary: Accurately simulating existing 3D objects and a wide variety of materials often demands expert knowledge and time-consuming physical parameter tuning to achieve the desired dynamic behavior. We introduce MotionPhysics, an end-to-end differentiable framework that infers plausible physical parameters from a user-provided natural language prompt for a chosen 3D scene of interest, removing the need for guidance from ground-truth trajectories or annotated videos. Our approach first utilizes a multimodal large language model to estimate material parameter values, which are constrained to lie within plausible ranges. We further propose a learnable motion distillation loss that extracts robust motion priors from pretrained video diffusion models while minimizing appearance and geometry inductive biases to guide the simulation. We evaluate MotionPhysics across more than thirty scenarios, including real-world, human-designed, and AI-generated 3D objects, spanning a wide range of materials such as elastic solids, metals, foams, sand, and both Newtonian and non-Newtonian fluids. We demonstrate that MotionPhysics produces visually realistic dynamic simulations guided by natural language, surpassing the state of the art while automatically determining physically plausible parameters. The code and project page are available at: https://wangmiaowei.github.io/MotionPhysics.github.io/.
summary_zh: 准确地模拟现有3D物体和各种各样的材料通常需要专业的知识，以及耗时的物理参数调整，才能达到期望的动态行为。我们介绍MotionPhysics，这是一个端到端的可微框架，它从用户提供的自然语言提示中推断所选3D场景中合理的物理参数，无需从真实轨迹或带注释的视频中获得指导。我们的方法首先利用多模态大型语言模型来估计材料参数值，这些参数被限制在合理的范围内。我们进一步提出了一种可学习的运动提炼损失，它从预训练的视频扩散模型中提取鲁棒的运动先验，同时最小化外观和几何归纳偏置来引导模拟。我们在超过三十个场景中评估MotionPhysics，包括真实世界、人为设计和AI生成的3D物体，涵盖了广泛的材料，如弹性固体、金属、泡沫、沙子以及牛顿流体和非牛顿流体。我们证明，MotionPhysics在自然语言的引导下，产生了视觉上逼真的动态模拟，超越了最先进的技术，同时自动确定了物理上合理的参数。代码和项目页面可在以下网址获取：https://wangmiaowei.github.io/MotionPhysics.github.io/。
tldr: MotionPhysics introduces a framework for generating realistic 3D simulations from natural language prompts by inferring physical parameters and using motion distillation from video diffusion models. It eliminates the need for manual parameter tuning and ground-truth trajectories.
tldr_zh: MotionPhysics 提出了一个框架，通过从自然语言提示推断物理参数并利用视频扩散模型的运动提炼来生成逼真的 3D 模拟，从而无需手动参数调整和真实轨迹。

title: Pixel-to-4D: Camera-Controlled Image-to-Video Generation with Dynamic 3D Gaussians
summary: Humans excel at forecasting the future dynamics of a scene given just a single image. Video generation models that can mimic this ability are an essential component for intelligent systems. Recent approaches have improved temporal coherence and 3D consistency in single-image-conditioned video generation. However, these methods often lack robust user controllability, such as modifying the camera path, limiting their applicability in real-world applications. Most existing camera-controlled image-to-video models struggle with accurately modeling camera motion, maintaining temporal consistency, and preserving geometric integrity. Leveraging explicit intermediate 3D representations offers a promising solution by enabling coherent video generation aligned with a given camera trajectory. Although these methods often use 3D point clouds to render scenes and introduce object motion in a later stage, this two-step process still falls short in achieving full temporal consistency, despite allowing precise control over camera movement. We propose a novel framework that constructs a 3D Gaussian scene representation and samples plausible object motion, given a single image in a single forward pass. This enables fast, camera-guided video generation without the need for iterative denoising to inject object motion into render frames. Extensive experiments on the KITTI, Waymo, RealEstate10K and DL3DV-10K datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art video quality and inference efficiency. The project page is available at https://melonienimasha.github.io/Pixel-to-4D-Website.
summary_zh: 人类擅长仅凭一张图像预测场景未来的动态变化。能够模仿这种能力的视频生成模型是智能系统的重要组成部分。最近的方法提高了单图像条件视频生成中的时间连贯性和3D一致性。然而，这些方法通常缺乏强大的用户可控性，例如修改相机路径，限制了它们在现实世界应用中的适用性。大多数现有的相机控制图像到视频模型难以准确建模相机运动、维持时间一致性以及保持几何完整性。利用显式的中间3D表示提供了一个有希望的解决方案，它能够生成与给定相机轨迹对齐的连贯视频。尽管这些方法通常使用3D点云来渲染场景，并在后续阶段引入物体运动，但这个两步过程在实现完全时间一致性方面仍然不足，尽管它允许对相机运动进行精确控制。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架构建一个3D高斯场景表示，并在单次前向传播中采样合理的物体运动（object motion），从而实现快速的、相机引导的视频生成，而无需迭代去噪以将物体运动注入到渲染帧中。在KITTI、Waymo、RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的视频质量和推理效率。项目主页见https://melonienimasha.github.io/Pixel-to-4D-Website。
tldr: This paper presents a novel framework for camera-controlled image-to-video generation using dynamic 3D Gaussians, achieving state-of-the-art video quality and inference efficiency without iterative denoising.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用动态 3D 高斯进行相机控制的图像到视频生成的新框架，无需迭代去噪即可实现最先进的视频质量和推理效率。

title: CPPO: Contrastive Perception for Vision Language Policy Optimization
summary: We introduce CPPO, a Contrastive Perception Policy Optimization method for finetuning vision-language models (VLMs). While reinforcement learning (RL) has advanced reasoning in language models, extending it to multimodal reasoning requires improving both the perception and reasoning aspects. Prior works tackle this challenge mainly with explicit perception rewards, but disentangling perception tokens from reasoning tokens is difficult, requiring extra LLMs, ground-truth data, forced separation of perception from reasoning by policy model, or applying rewards indiscriminately to all output tokens. CPPO addresses this problem by detecting perception tokens via entropy shifts in the model outputs under perturbed input images. CPPO then extends the RL objective function with a Contrastive Perception Loss (CPL) that enforces consistency under information-preserving perturbations and sensitivity under information-removing ones. Experiments show that CPPO surpasses previous perception-rewarding methods, while avoiding extra models, making training more efficient and scalable.
summary_zh: 我们提出了CPPO，一种用于微调视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的对比感知策略优化方法。虽然强化学习（RL）已经提升了语言模型的推理能力，但将其扩展到多模态推理需要同时改进感知和推理两方面。以往的研究主要通过显式的感知奖励来应对这一挑战，但将感知标记从推理标记中分离出来是困难的，需要额外的LLM、真实数据、策略模型强制分离感知与推理，或者将奖励不加区分地应用于所有输出标记。CPPO通过检测模型输出在扰动输入图像下的熵变来解决这个问题，从而识别感知标记。然后，CPPO使用对比感知损失（CPL）扩展了RL目标函数，该损失强制模型在信息保持扰动下保持一致性，并在信息移除扰动下保持敏感性。实验表明，CPPO超越了以往的感知奖励方法，同时避免了额外的模型，使得训练更加高效和可扩展。
tldr: CPPO introduces a Contrastive Perception Policy Optimization method to improve the perception capabilities of vision-language models using entropy shifts and a contrastive loss, achieving better performance and scalability compared to prior perception-rewarding methods.
tldr_zh: CPPO 提出了一种对比感知策略优化方法，利用熵变化和对比损失来提高视觉语言模型的感知能力，与先前的感知奖励方法相比，实现了更好的性能和可扩展性。

title: When Small Models Are Right for Wrong Reasons: Process Verification for Trustworthy Agents
summary: Deploying small language models (7-9B parameters) as autonomous agents requires trust in their reasoning, not just their outputs. We reveal a critical reliability crisis: 50-69\% of correct answers from these models contain fundamentally flawed reasoning -- a ``Right-for-Wrong-Reasons'' phenomenon invisible to standard accuracy metrics. Through analysis of 10,734 reasoning traces across three models and diverse tasks, we introduce the Reasoning Integrity Score (RIS), a process-based metric validated with substantial inter-rater agreement ($κ=0.657$). Conventional practices are challenged by our findings: while retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) significantly improves reasoning integrity (Cohen's $d=0.23$--$0.93$), meta-cognitive interventions like self-critique often harm performance ($d=-0.14$ to $-0.33$) in small models on the evaluated tasks. Mechanistic analysis reveals RAG succeeds by grounding calculations in external evidence, reducing errors by 7.6\%, while meta-cognition amplifies confusion without sufficient model capacity. To enable deployment, verification capabilities are distilled into a neural classifier achieving 0.86 F1-score with 100$\times$ speedup. These results underscore the necessity of process-based verification for trustworthy agents: accuracy alone is dangerously insufficient when models can be right for entirely wrong reasons.
summary_zh: 将小型语言模型（70亿至90亿参数）部署为自主Agent需要对其推理过程的信任，而不仅是输出结果。我们揭示了一个关键的可靠性危机：这些模型给出的正确答案中，有50%到69%的推理过程存在根本性缺陷——一种“因错误的原因而正确”的现象，这对于标准准确率指标来说是不可见的。通过分析三个模型在不同任务上的10734条推理轨迹，我们引入了推理完整性评分（RIS），这是一种基于过程的指标，并通过大量的评分者间一致性（$κ=0.657$）验证了其有效性。我们的发现对传统实践提出了挑战：尽管检索增强生成（RAG）显著提高了推理完整性（Cohen's $d=0.23$--$0.93$），但在评估的任务中，诸如自我批判之类的元认知干预通常会损害小型模型的性能（$d=-0.14$ to $-0.33$）。机理分析表明，RAG的成功在于将计算建立在外部证据的基础上，从而减少了7.6%的错误，而元认知在模型容量不足的情况下会加剧混淆。为了实现部署，我们将验证能力提炼成一个神经分类器，该分类器实现了0.86的F1分数，并且速度提高了100倍。这些结果强调了基于过程的验证对于可信Agent的必要性：当模型可能因为完全错误的原因而得出正确答案时，仅凭准确率是危险地不够的。
tldr: This paper highlights the 'Right-for-Wrong-Reasons' phenomenon in small language models used as agents and introduces the Reasoning Integrity Score (RIS) to evaluate reasoning quality, finding that RAG improves reasoning while self-critique may harm it.
tldr_zh: 该论文强调了小型语言模型作为agent使用时存在的“因错误原因而正确”的现象，并引入了推理完整性评分（RIS）来评估推理质量，发现RAG提高了推理能力，而自我批判可能会损害推理能力。

title: Bayesian Inverse Games with High-Dimensional Multi-Modal Observations
summary: Many multi-agent interaction scenarios can be naturally modeled as noncooperative games, where each agent's decisions depend on others' future actions. However, deploying game-theoretic planners for autonomous decision-making requires a specification of all agents' objectives. To circumvent this practical difficulty, recent work develops maximum likelihood techniques for solving inverse games that can identify unknown agent objectives from interaction data. Unfortunately, these methods only infer point estimates and do not quantify estimator uncertainty; correspondingly, downstream planning decisions can overconfidently commit to unsafe actions. We present an approximate Bayesian inference approach for solving the inverse game problem, which can incorporate observation data from multiple modalities and be used to generate samples from the Bayesian posterior over the hidden agent objectives given limited sensor observations in real time. Concretely, the proposed Bayesian inverse game framework trains a structured variational autoencoder with an embedded differentiable Nash game solver on interaction datasets and does not require labels of agents' true objectives. Extensive experiments show that our framework successfully learns prior and posterior distributions, improves inference quality over maximum likelihood estimation-based inverse game approaches, and enables safer downstream decision-making without sacrificing efficiency. When trajectory information is uninformative or unavailable, multimodal inference further reduces uncertainty by exploiting additional observation modalities.
summary_zh: 许多多智能体交互场景可以自然地建模为非合作博弈，其中每个智能体的决策取决于其他智能体未来的行为。然而，部署博弈论规划器进行自主决策需要明确所有智能体的目标。为了规避这一实际困难，最近的研究开发了最大似然方法来解决逆博弈问题，该方法可以从交互数据中识别未知的智能体目标。不幸的是，这些方法仅推断点估计值，且无法量化估计器的不确定性；相应地，下游的规划决策可能会过度自信地致力于不安全的行为。我们提出了一种近似贝叶斯推断方法来解决逆博弈问题，该方法可以整合来自多种模态的观测数据，并可用于从贝叶斯后验中生成样本，该后验是在给定有限的传感器观测的情况下，关于隐藏智能体目标的后验分布。具体而言，所提出的贝叶斯逆博弈框架训练了一个结构化的变分自编码器，该自编码器嵌入了一个可微分的纳什博弈求解器，训练数据是交互数据集，且不需要智能体真实目标的标签。大量的实验表明，我们的框架成功地学习了先验和后验分布，改善了基于最大似然估计的逆博弈方法的推断质量，并在不牺牲效率的前提下实现了更安全的下游决策。当轨迹信息不具信息量或不可用时，多模态推断通过利用额外的观测模态进一步降低不确定性。
tldr: This paper introduces a Bayesian inverse game framework that uses a structured variational autoencoder with a differentiable Nash game solver to infer agent objectives from multi-modal interaction data, improving over maximum likelihood estimation and enabling safer decision-making.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种贝叶斯逆向博弈框架，该框架使用带有可微纳什博弈求解器的结构化变分自动编码器，从多模态交互数据中推断智能体目标，优于最大似然估计，并实现更安全的决策。

title: NMPC-Augmented Visual Navigation and Safe Learning Control for Large-Scale Mobile Robots
summary: A large-scale mobile robot (LSMR) is a high-order multibody system that often operates on loose, unconsolidated terrain, which reduces traction. This paper presents a comprehensive navigation and control framework for an LSMR that ensures stability and safety-defined performance, delivering robust operation on slip-prone terrain by jointly leveraging high-performance techniques. The proposed architecture comprises four main modules: (1) a visual pose-estimation module that fuses onboard sensors and stereo cameras to provide an accurate, low-latency robot pose, (2) a high-level nonlinear model predictive control that updates the wheel motion commands to correct robot drift from the robot reference pose on slip-prone terrain, (3) a low-level deep neural network control policy that approximates the complex behavior of the wheel-driven actuation mechanism in LSMRs, augmented with robust adaptive control to handle out-of-distribution disturbances, ensuring that the wheels accurately track the updated commands issued by high-level control module, and (4) a logarithmic safety module to monitor the entire robot stack and guarantees safe operation. The proposed low-level control framework guarantees uniform exponential stability of the actuation subsystem, while the safety module ensures the whole system-level safety during operation. Comparative experiments on a 6,000 kg LSMR actuated by two complex electro-hydrostatic drives, while synchronizing modules operating at different frequencies.
summary_zh: 大型移动机器人(LSMR)是一个高阶多体系统，通常在松散、未压实的地面上运行，这会降低牵引力。本文提出了一种面向LSMR的全面导航和控制框架，该框架通过联合利用高性能技术，确保稳定性和满足安全定义的性能，在易滑地面上实现稳健运行。所提出的架构包含四个主要模块：（1）视觉位姿估计模块，融合了车载传感器和立体相机，以提供准确、低延迟的机器人位姿；（2）高层非线性模型预测控制，更新轮式运动指令，以校正机器人在易滑地面上偏离参考位姿的漂移；（3）底层深度神经网络控制策略，近似模拟LSMR中轮式驱动执行机构的复杂行为，并辅以鲁棒自适应控制以处理分布外扰动，确保车轮准确跟踪由高层控制模块发出的更新指令；以及（4）对数安全模块，监控整个机器人堆栈并保证安全运行。所提出的底层控制框架保证了执行子系统的一致指数稳定性，而安全模块确保了整个系统级在运行过程中的安全性。在重达6000公斤的LSMR上进行了对比实验，该LSMR由两个复杂的电液静力驱动装置驱动，同时同步运行不同频率的模块。
tldr: This paper presents a navigation and control framework for large-scale mobile robots (LSMRs) operating on slip-prone terrain, using a combination of visual pose estimation, nonlinear model predictive control, deep neural network control, and a safety module to ensure stable and safe operation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于在易滑地形上运行的大型移动机器人（LSMR）的导航和控制框架，该框架结合了视觉姿态估计、非线性模型预测控制、深度神经网络控制和一个安全模块，以确保稳定和安全的操作。

title: Priority-Aware Multi-Robot Coverage Path Planning
summary: Multi-robot systems are widely used for coverage tasks that require efficient coordination across large environments. In Multi-Robot Coverage Path Planning (MCPP), the objective is typically to minimize the makespan by generating non-overlapping paths for full-area coverage. However, most existing methods assume uniform importance across regions, limiting their effectiveness in scenarios where some zones require faster attention. We introduce the Priority-Aware MCPP (PA-MCPP) problem, where a subset of the environment is designated as prioritized zones with associated weights. The goal is to minimize, in lexicographic order, the total priority-weighted latency of zone coverage and the overall makespan. To address this, we propose a scalable two-phase framework combining (1) greedy zone assignment with local search, spanning-tree-based path planning, and (2) Steiner-tree-guided residual coverage. Experiments across diverse scenarios demonstrate that our method significantly reduces priority-weighted latency compared to standard MCPP baselines, while maintaining competitive makespan. Sensitivity analyses further show that the method scales well with the number of robots and that zone coverage behavior can be effectively controlled by adjusting priority weights.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统被广泛应用于大规模环境下的覆盖任务，其需要高效的协调。在多机器人覆盖路径规划（MCPP）中，目标通常是通过生成非重叠路径以实现全区域覆盖，从而最小化完工时间。然而，大多数现有方法假设区域的重要性是均匀的，这限制了它们在某些区域需要更快关注的场景中的有效性。我们引入了优先级感知MCPP（PA-MCPP）问题，其中环境的子集被指定为具有相关权重的优先级区域。目标是以字典序最小化区域覆盖的总优先级加权延迟和整体完工时间。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种可扩展的两阶段框架，该框架结合了（1）带有局部搜索的贪婪区域分配、基于生成树的路径规划，以及（2）Steiner树引导的残余覆盖。在不同场景下的实验表明，与标准MCPP基线相比，我们的方法显著降低了优先级加权延迟，同时保持了具有竞争力的完工时间。敏感性分析进一步表明，该方法可以很好地随着机器人数量扩展，并且可以通过调整优先级权重来有效地控制区域覆盖行为。
tldr: This paper introduces a priority-aware multi-robot coverage path planning (PA-MCPP) framework that minimizes priority-weighted latency of zone coverage and overall makespan, outperforming standard MCPP baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种优先级感知的多机器人覆盖路径规划（PA-MCPP）框架，旨在最小化区域覆盖的优先级加权延迟和整体完成时间，性能优于标准的MCPP基线。

title: Analyzing the Shopping Journey: Computing Shelf Browsing Visits in a Physical Retail Store
summary: Motivated by recent challenges in the deployment of robots into customer-facing roles within retail, this work introduces a study of customer activity in physical stores as a step toward autonomous understanding of shopper intent. We introduce an algorithm that computes shoppers' ``shelf visits'' -- capturing their browsing behavior in the store. Shelf visits are extracted from trajectories obtained via machine vision-based 3D tracking and overhead cameras. We perform two independent calibrations of the shelf visit algorithm, using distinct sets of trajectories (consisting of 8138 and 15129 trajectories), collected in different stores and labeled by human reviewers. The calibrated models are then evaluated on trajectories held out of the calibration process both from the same store on which calibration was performed and from the other store. An analysis of the results shows that the algorithm can recognize customers' browsing activity when evaluated in an environment different from the one on which calibration was performed. We then use the model to analyze the customers' ``browsing patterns'' on a large set of trajectories and their relation to actual purchases in the stores. Finally, we discuss how shelf browsing information could be used for retail planning and in the domain of human-robot interaction scenarios.
summary_zh: 受近期零售业在客户互动场景中部署机器人所面临挑战的驱动，本研究旨在探索客户在实体店内的活动，以此作为自主理解购物者意图的第一步。我们提出了一种算法来计算购物者的“货架访问”——捕捉他们在商店中的浏览行为。货架访问是从基于机器视觉的3D跟踪和顶置摄像头获得的轨迹中提取的。我们使用不同集合的轨迹（分别包含8138和15129条轨迹）对货架访问算法进行了两次独立的校准，这些轨迹是在不同的商店中收集并由人工审核员标记的。然后，我们对从校准过程中保留的轨迹进行评估，这些轨迹既来自执行校准的同一家商店，也来自另一家商店。结果分析表明，该算法在与校准环境不同的环境中进行评估时，能够识别客户的浏览活动。然后，我们使用该模型分析大量轨迹上客户的“浏览模式”及其与店内实际购买行为的关系。最后，我们讨论了货架浏览信息如何应用于零售规划和人机交互场景领域。
tldr: This paper introduces an algorithm to detect customer shelf browsing behavior from video trajectories in retail stores, demonstrating its generalization across different store environments and potential applications in retail planning and human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种算法，通过零售商店中的视频轨迹检测顾客的货架浏览行为，展示了其在不同商店环境中的泛化能力，以及在零售规划和人机交互方面的潜在应用。

title: IRPM: Intergroup Relative Preference Modeling for Pointwise Generative Reward Models
summary: Generative Reward Models (GRMs) have demonstrated strong performance in reward modeling, due to their interpretability and potential for refinement through reinforcement learning (RL). However, widely used pairwise GRMs create a computational bottleneck in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), when calibrating or aggregating preference signals over n candidates, often incurring O(n^2) pairwise judgments. To address this issue, we propose Intergroup Relative Preference Modeling (IRPM), an RL-based method that extends the Bradley--Terry preference-learning paradigm via intergroup comparisons to train pointwise GRMs from pairwise preference data. IRPM derives pointwise reward for each response by contrasting groups of chosen vs. rejected samples, enabling pointwise scores comparable across candidate sets and O(n) reward evaluation for a variable number of candidates during RL training, while preserving interpretability and scalability. Experiments show that IRPM achieves state-of-the-art performance among pointwise GRMs on RM-Bench, JudgeBench and RewardBench, and approaches the performance of leading pairwise GRMs. In addition, IRPM achieves substantial gains in post-training evaluations, demonstrating its effectiveness.
summary_zh: 生成式奖励模型 (GRMs) 因其可解释性以及通过强化学习 (RL) 改进的潜力，在奖励建模中展现出强大的性能。然而，广泛使用的成对 GRMs 在基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）中产生计算瓶颈，在对 n 个候选者的偏好信号进行校准或聚合时，通常需要 O(n^2) 的成对判断。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的方法，名为组间相对偏好建模（IRPM），它通过组间比较扩展了 Bradley--Terry 偏好学习范式，从而从成对偏好数据中训练点式 GRM。IRPM 通过对比选择样本组和拒绝样本组，为每个响应导出点式奖励，从而实现跨候选集的可比点式分数，并在 RL 训练期间对可变数量的候选者进行 O(n) 的奖励评估，同时保持可解释性和可扩展性。实验表明，IRPM 在 RM-Bench、JudgeBench 和 RewardBench 上实现了点式 GRM 中的最佳性能，并接近领先的成对 GRM 的性能。此外，IRPM 在训练后的评估中取得了显著的提升，证明了其有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces Intergroup Relative Preference Modeling (IRPM), a method that uses intergroup comparisons to train pointwise generative reward models, achieving state-of-the-art performance and scalability while preserving interpretability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Intergroup Relative Preference Modeling (IRPM)，这是一种使用组间比较来训练逐点生成奖励模型的方法，在保持可解释性的同时，实现了最先进的性能和可扩展性。

title: Modality Dominance-Aware Optimization for Embodied RGB-Infrared Perception
summary: RGB-Infrared (RGB-IR) multimodal perception is fundamental to embodied multimedia systems operating in complex physical environments. Although recent cross-modal fusion methods have advanced RGB-IR detection, the optimization dynamics caused by asymmetric modality characteristics remain underexplored. In practice, disparities in information density and feature quality introduce persistent optimization bias, leading training to overemphasize a dominant modality and hindering effective fusion. To quantify this phenomenon, we propose the Modality Dominance Index (MDI), which measures modality dominance by jointly modeling feature entropy and gradient contribution. Based on MDI, we develop a Modality Dominance-Aware Cross-modal Learning (MDACL) framework that regulates cross-modal optimization. MDACL incorporates Hierarchical Cross-modal Guidance (HCG) to enhance feature alignment and Adversarial Equilibrium Regularization (AER) to balance optimization dynamics during fusion. Extensive experiments on three RGB-IR benchmarks demonstrate that MDACL effectively mitigates optimization bias and achieves SOTA performance.
summary_zh: RGB-红外 (RGB-IR) 多模态感知是运行于复杂物理环境中的具身多媒体系统的基础。尽管最近的跨模态融合方法推进了 RGB-IR 检测，但由非对称模态特性引起的优化动态变化仍未得到充分探索。实际上，信息密度和特征质量的差异会引入持续存在的优化偏差，导致训练过度强调主导模态，阻碍有效融合。为了量化这种现象，我们提出了模态主导性指数 (MDI)，它通过联合建模特征熵和梯度贡献来衡量模态主导性。基于 MDI，我们开发了一种模态主导性感知跨模态学习 (MDACL) 框架，用于调节跨模态优化。MDACL 融合了分层跨模态引导 (HCG) 以增强特征对齐，以及对抗均衡正则化 (AER) 以平衡融合期间的优化动态。在三个 RGB-IR 基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MDACL 有效地减轻了优化偏差，并实现了 SOTA 性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a Modality Dominance-Aware Cross-modal Learning (MDACL) framework to address the optimization bias in RGB-Infrared fusion, achieving state-of-the-art performance on RGB-IR benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个模态主导感知跨模态学习框架（MDACL），旨在解决RGB-红外融合中的优化偏差问题，并在RGB-红外基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: SafeMo: Linguistically Grounded Unlearning for Trustworthy Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion (T2M) generation with diffusion backbones achieves strong realism and alignment. Safety concerns in T2M methods have been raised in recent years; existing methods replace discrete VQ-VAE codebook entries to steer the model away from unsafe behaviors. However, discrete codebook replacement-based methods have two critical flaws: firstly, replacing codebook entries which are reused by benign prompts leads to drifts on everyday tasks, degrading the model's benign performance; secondly, discrete token-based methods introduce quantization and smoothness loss, resulting in artifacts and jerky transitions. Moreover, existing text-to-motion datasets naturally contain unsafe intents and corresponding motions, making them unsuitable for safety-driven machine learning. To address these challenges, we propose SafeMo, a trustworthy motion generative framework integrating Minimal Motion Unlearning (MMU), a two-stage machine unlearning strategy, enabling safe human motion generation in continuous space, preserving continuous kinematics without codebook loss and delivering strong safety-utility trade-offs compared to current baselines. Additionally, we present the first safe text-to-motion dataset SafeMoVAE-29K integrating rewritten safe text prompts and continuous refined motion for trustworthy human motion unlearning. Built upon DiP, SafeMo efficiently generates safe human motions with natural transitions. Experiments demonstrate effective unlearning performance of SafeMo by showing strengthened forgetting on unsafe prompts, reaching 2.5x and 14.4x higher forget-set FID on HumanML3D and Motion-X respectively, compared to the previous SOTA human motion unlearning method LCR, with benign performance on safe prompts being better or comparable. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/SafeMo. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/SafeMo.
summary_zh: 基于扩散模型的文本到动作(T2M)生成在真实性和对齐性方面表现出色。近年来，T2M方法中的安全性问题日益受到关注；现有方法通过替换离散VQ-VAE码本条目来引导模型远离不安全行为。然而，基于离散码本替换的方法存在两个关键缺陷：首先，替换被良性提示复用的码本条目会导致日常任务的漂移，降低模型在良性任务上的性能；其次，基于离散令牌的方法会引入量化和光滑度损失，从而导致伪影和生硬的转换。此外，现有的文本到动作数据集自然包含不安全的意图和相应的动作，使其不适合安全驱动的机器学习。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SafeMo，一个值得信赖的动作生成框架，集成了最小动作反学习(MMU)，一种两阶段机器反学习策略，能够在连续空间中安全地生成人体运动，在没有码本损失的情况下保持连续运动学，并与当前基线相比实现强大的安全-效用权衡。此外，我们提出了第一个安全的文本到动作数据集SafeMoVAE-29K，集成了重写后的安全文本提示和连续精炼的动作，用于值得信赖的人体动作反学习。基于DiP，SafeMo可以有效地生成具有自然过渡的安全人体动作。实验表明，SafeMo具有有效的反学习性能，能够加强对不安全提示的遗忘，在HumanML3D和Motion-X上分别达到比之前的SOTA人体动作反学习方法LCR高2.5倍和14.4倍的forget-set FID，同时在安全提示上的良性性能更好或相当。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/SafeMo。 网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/SafeMo。
tldr: The paper introduces SafeMo, a framework for safe text-to-motion generation utilizing a novel minimal motion unlearning strategy and a safe text-to-motion dataset, addressing safety concerns and artifacts in existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为SafeMo的安全文本到动作生成框架，它使用了一种新的最小动作逆学习策略和一个安全的文本到动作数据集，解决了现有方法中的安全问题和伪影。

title: ARISE: Adaptive Reinforcement Integrated with Swarm Exploration
summary: Effective exploration remains a key challenge in RL, especially with non-stationary rewards or high-dimensional policies. We introduce ARISE, a lightweight framework that enhances reinforcement learning by augmenting standard policy-gradient methods with a compact swarm-based exploration layer. ARISE blends policy actions with particle-driven proposals, where each particle represents a candidate policy trajectory sampled in the action space, and modulates exploration adaptively using reward-variance cues. While easy benchmarks exhibit only slight improvements (e.g., +0.7% on CartPole-v1), ARISE yields substantial gains on more challenging tasks, including +46% on LunarLander-v3 and +22% on Hopper-v4, while preserving stability on Walker2d and Ant. Under non-stationary reward shifts, ARISE provides marked robustness advantages, outperforming PPO by +75 points on CartPole and improving LunarLander accordingly. Ablation studies confirm that both the swarm component and the adaptive mechanism contribute to the performance. Overall, ARISE offers a simple, architecture-agnostic route to more exploratory and resilient RL agents without altering core algorithmic structures.
summary_zh: 有效探索仍然是强化学习中的一个关键挑战，尤其是在非平稳奖励或高维策略的情况下。我们引入 ARISE，这是一个轻量级框架，通过使用基于紧凑型群体的探索层来增强标准的策略梯度方法，从而提升强化学习性能。ARISE 将策略动作与粒子驱动的提议融合，其中每个粒子代表在动作空间中采样的候选策略轨迹，并使用奖励方差线索自适应地调节探索。虽然在简单的基准测试中仅表现出略微的改进（例如，在 CartPole-v1 上 +0.7%），但 ARISE 在更具挑战性的任务中产生了显著的收益，包括在 LunarLander-v3 上 +46% 以及在 Hopper-v4 上 +22%，同时保持了在 Walker2d 和 Ant 上的稳定性。在非平稳奖励转移的情况下，ARISE 提供了显著的鲁棒性优势，在 CartPole 上优于 PPO +75 个点，并相应地改进了 LunarLander。消融研究证实，群体组件和自适应机制都对性能有所贡献。总而言之，ARISE 提供了一种简单、架构不可知的途径，无需改变核心算法结构，即可实现更具探索性和弹性的强化学习智能体。
tldr: The paper introduces ARISE, a swarm-based exploration method for RL that adaptively enhances policy-gradient methods, showing significant improvements on challenging tasks and robustness to non-stationary rewards.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ARISE，一种基于群体探索的强化学习方法，能自适应地增强策略梯度方法，在具有挑战性的任务上表现出显著的改进，并且对非平稳奖励具有鲁棒性。

title: Imitation from Observations with Trajectory-Level Generative Embeddings
summary: We consider the offline imitation learning from observations (LfO) where the expert demonstrations are scarce and the available offline suboptimal data are far from the expert behavior. Many existing distribution-matching approaches struggle in this regime because they impose strict support constraints and rely on brittle one-step models, making it hard to extract useful signal from imperfect data. To tackle this challenge, we propose TGE, a trajectory-level generative embedding for offline LfO that constructs a dense, smooth surrogate reward by estimating expert state density in the latent space of a temporal diffusion model trained on offline trajectory data. By leveraging the smooth geometry of the learned diffusion embedding, TGE captures long-horizon temporal dynamics and effectively bridges the gap between disjoint supports, ensuring a robust learning signal even when offline data is distributionally distinct from the expert. Empirically, the proposed approach consistently matches or outperforms prior offline LfO methods across a range of D4RL locomotion and manipulation benchmarks.
summary_zh: 我们考虑观测数据下的离线模仿学习(LfO)，其中专家演示数据稀缺，且可用的离线次优数据与专家行为相差甚远。许多现有的分布匹配方法在这种情况下表现不佳，因为它们施加严格的支持约束并依赖于脆弱的单步模型，难以从不完善的数据中提取有用的信号。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出TGE，一种用于离线LfO的轨迹级生成式嵌入，它通过估计基于离线轨迹数据训练的时序扩散模型潜在空间中的专家状态密度，来构建密集的、平滑的代理奖励。通过利用学习到的扩散嵌入的平滑几何结构，TGE能够捕捉长程时序动态，并有效弥合不相交支持集之间的差距，即使离线数据与专家数据在分布上不同，也能确保稳健的学习信号。在经验上，所提出的方法在一系列D4RL运动和操控基准测试中始终与先前的离线LfO方法相匹配或超越。
tldr: This paper introduces TGE, a trajectory-level generative embedding method for offline imitation learning from observations. It trains a temporal diffusion model to create a smooth, dense surrogate reward function, improving performance in scenarios with scarce expert data and distribution shift.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 TGE，一种用于离线观察模仿学习的轨迹级生成嵌入方法。它训练了一个时间扩散模型以创建平滑、密集的替代奖励函数，从而在专家数据稀缺和分布偏移的情况下提高性能。

title: Optimal Transport-Based Decentralized Multi-Agent Distribution Matching
summary: This paper presents a decentralized control framework for distribution matching in multi-agent systems (MAS), where agents collectively achieve a prescribed terminal spatial distribution. The problem is formulated using optimal transport (Wasserstein distance), which provides a principled measure of distributional discrepancy and serves as the basis for the control design. To avoid solving the global optimal transport problem directly, the distribution-matching objective is reformulated into a tractable per-agent decision process, enabling each agent to identify its desired terminal locations using only locally available information. A sequential weight-update rule is introduced to construct feasible local transport plans, and a memory-based correction mechanism is incorporated to maintain reliable operation under intermittent and range-limited communication. Convergence guarantees are established, showing cycle-wise improvement of a surrogate transport cost under both linear and nonlinear agent dynamics. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves effective and scalable distribution matching while operating fully in a decentralized manner.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多智能体系统（MAS）中分布匹配的去中心化控制框架，该框架使得智能体能够集体实现预定的终端空间分布。该问题采用最优传输（Wasserstein距离）进行建模，它提供了一种原则性的分布差异度量，并作为控制设计的基础。为了避免直接求解全局最优传输问题，将分布匹配目标重新表述为一个可处理的针对每个智能体的决策过程，使得每个智能体仅使用局部可用信息就能确定其期望的终端位置。引入了一种顺序权重更新规则来构建可行的局部传输方案，并结合了一种基于记忆的修正机制，以在间歇性和范围受限的通信条件下维持可靠运行。建立了收敛性保证，表明在线性与非线性智能体动力学下，代用传输代价均能逐周期改善。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架能够在完全去中心化的方式下实现有效且可扩展的分布匹配。
tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized, optimal transport-based framework to solve the distribution matching problem in multi-agent systems, enabling agents to achieve a prescribed spatial distribution using only local information and communication.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于最优传输的去中心化框架，用于解决多智能体系统中的分布匹配问题，使智能体仅使用本地信息和通信即可达到预定的空间分布。

title: Avatar Forcing: Real-Time Interactive Head Avatar Generation for Natural Conversation
summary: Talking head generation creates lifelike avatars from static portraits for virtual communication and content creation. However, current models do not yet convey the feeling of truly interactive communication, often generating one-way responses that lack emotional engagement. We identify two key challenges toward truly interactive avatars: generating motion in real-time under causal constraints and learning expressive, vibrant reactions without additional labeled data. To address these challenges, we propose Avatar Forcing, a new framework for interactive head avatar generation that models real-time user-avatar interactions through diffusion forcing. This design allows the avatar to process real-time multimodal inputs, including the user's audio and motion, with low latency for instant reactions to both verbal and non-verbal cues such as speech, nods, and laughter. Furthermore, we introduce a direct preference optimization method that leverages synthetic losing samples constructed by dropping user conditions, enabling label-free learning of expressive interaction. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework enables real-time interaction with low latency (approximately 500ms), achieving 6.8X speedup compared to the baseline, and produces reactive and expressive avatar motion, which is preferred over 80% against the baseline.
summary_zh: 会说话的头部生成技术利用静态肖像创建逼真的虚拟化身，用于虚拟通信和内容创作。然而，当前的模型尚未传达真正互动通信的感觉，通常生成缺乏情感参与的单向回应。我们识别出实现真正交互式化身的两个关键挑战：在因果约束下实时生成运动，以及在没有额外标记数据的情况下学习富有表现力、充满活力的反应。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出 Avatar Forcing，这是一种用于交互式头部化身生成的新框架，通过扩散强制建模实时用户-化身交互。这种设计使化身能够以低延迟处理实时多模态输入，包括用户的音频和运动，从而对诸如语音、点头和笑声等口头和非口头线索做出即时反应。此外，我们引入了一种直接偏好优化方法，该方法利用通过丢弃用户条件构建的合成失败样本，从而实现无需标签的表现力交互学习。实验结果表明，我们的框架支持低延迟（约 500 毫秒）的实时交互，与基线相比实现了 6.8 倍的加速，并生成了反应灵敏且富有表现力的化身运动，其偏好程度超过基线 80% 以上。
tldr: This paper introduces "Avatar Forcing," a framework for generating real-time, interactive talking head avatars that react to multimodal user input with low latency and expressive motions using diffusion forcing and direct preference optimization with synthetic losing samples.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为“Avatar Forcing”的框架，用于生成实时的、交互式的说话头像，它能够通过扩散强制和使用合成失败样本的直接偏好优化，以低延迟和富有表现力的动作对多模态用户输入做出反应。

title: Progressive Ideation using an Agentic AI Framework for Human-AI Co-Creation
summary: The generation of truly novel and diverse ideas is important for contemporary engineering design, yet it remains a significant cognitive challenge for novice designers. Current 'single-spurt' AI systems exacerbate this challenge by producing a high volume of semantically clustered ideas. We propose MIDAS (Meta-cognitive Ideation through Distributed Agentic AI System), a novel framework that replaces the single-AI paradigm with a distributed 'team' of specialized AI agents designed to emulate the human meta-cognitive ideation workflow. This agentic system progressively refines ideas and assesses each one for both global novelty (against existing solutions) and local novelty (against previously generated ideas). MIDAS, therefore, demonstrates a viable and progressive paradigm for true human-AI co-creation, elevating the human designer from a passive filterer to a participatory, active, collaborative partner.
summary_zh: 产生真正新颖且多样化的想法对于当代工程设计至关重要，但这对于新手设计师来说仍然是一项重大的认知挑战。当前“单脉冲”人工智能系统通过产生大量语义聚类的想法加剧了这一挑战。我们提出MIDAS（通过分布式代理人工智能系统进行元认知构思），这是一个新颖的框架，它用由专门AI代理组成的分布式“团队”取代了单一AI范式，旨在模拟人类的元认知构思工作流程。这个代理系统逐步改进想法，并评估每个想法的全局新颖性（相对于现有解决方案）和局部新颖性（相对于先前产生的想法）。因此，MIDAS展示了一种可行且进步的范式，用于真正的人机协同创造，将人类设计师从被动的筛选者提升为参与式的、积极的、协作的伙伴。
tldr: The paper introduces MIDAS, a distributed agentic AI system for human-AI co-creation in design, aiming for more novel and diverse idea generation compared to single-AI approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MIDAS，一个用于人机协同设计的分布式智能体AI系统。该系统旨在生成比单一AI方法更具创新性和多样性的想法。

title: E-GRPO: High Entropy Steps Drive Effective Reinforcement Learning for Flow Models
summary: Recent reinforcement learning has enhanced the flow matching models on human preference alignment. While stochastic sampling enables the exploration of denoising directions, existing methods which optimize over multiple denoising steps suffer from sparse and ambiguous reward signals. We observe that the high entropy steps enable more efficient and effective exploration while the low entropy steps result in undistinguished roll-outs. To this end, we propose E-GRPO, an entropy aware Group Relative Policy Optimization to increase the entropy of SDE sampling steps. Since the integration of stochastic differential equations suffer from ambiguous reward signals due to stochasticity from multiple steps, we specifically merge consecutive low entropy steps to formulate one high entropy step for SDE sampling, while applying ODE sampling on other steps. Building upon this, we introduce multi-step group normalized advantage, which computes group-relative advantages within samples sharing the same consolidated SDE denoising step. Experimental results on different reward settings have demonstrated the effectiveness of our methods.
summary_zh: 近期的强化学习已经提升了人类偏好对齐上的流匹配模型。随机采样能够探索去噪方向，而现有的优化多个去噪步骤的方法受到稀疏且模糊的奖励信号的困扰。我们观察到高熵步骤能够实现更高效和有效的探索，而低熵步骤会导致难以区分的轨迹。为此，我们提出了E-GRPO，一种熵感知的组相对策略优化方法，用于提高SDE采样步骤的熵。由于随机微分方程的积分受到多步骤随机性导致的模糊奖励信号影响，我们专门合并连续的低熵步骤以形成一个高熵步骤用于SDE采样，而对其他步骤应用ODE采样。在此基础上，我们引入了多步组归一化优势，其在共享相同合并后的SDE去噪步骤的样本中计算组相对优势。在不同奖励设置下的实验结果证明了我们方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces E-GRPO, a reinforcement learning method that enhances flow matching models by strategically increasing the entropy of important SDE sampling steps, addressing the issue of sparse reward signals in multi-step denoising processes. It achieves this by merging low entropy steps and applying a group-relative advantage calculation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为E-GRPO的强化学习方法，该方法通过策略性地增加重要SDE采样步骤的熵来增强流匹配模型，从而解决了多步去噪过程中奖励信号稀疏的问题。它通过合并低熵步骤并应用组相对优势计算来实现这一点。

title: Precision Autotuning for Linear Solvers via Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for adaptive precision tuning of linear solvers, and can be extended to general algorithms. The framework is formulated as a contextual bandit problem and solved using incremental action-value estimation with a discretized state space to select optimal precision configurations for computational steps, balancing precision and computational efficiency. To verify its effectiveness, we apply the framework to iterative refinement for solving linear systems $Ax = b$. In this application, our approach dynamically chooses precisions based on calculated features from the system. In detail, a Q-table maps discretized features (e.g., approximate condition number and matrix norm)to actions (chosen precision configurations for specific steps), optimized via an epsilon-greedy strategy to maximize a multi-objective reward balancing accuracy and computational cost. Empirical results demonstrate effective precision selection, reducing computational cost while maintaining accuracy comparable to double-precision baselines. The framework generalizes to diverse out-of-sample data and offers insight into utilizing RL precision selection for other numerical algorithms, advancing mixed-precision numerical methods in scientific computing. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work on precision autotuning with RL and verified on unseen datasets.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于强化学习 (RL) 的线性求解器自适应精度调优框架，该框架可以扩展到通用算法。该框架被构建为一个上下文老虎机问题，并通过增量式动作值估计与离散化状态空间相结合来解决，从而为计算步骤选择最优的精度配置，在精度和计算效率之间取得平衡。为了验证其有效性，我们将该框架应用于求解线性系统 $Ax = b$ 的迭代改进。在此应用中，我们的方法基于从系统中计算出的特征动态选择精度。具体而言，一个 Q-表格将离散化的特征（例如，近似条件数和矩阵范数）映射到动作（针对特定步骤选择的精度配置），并通过 ε-贪婪策略进行优化，以最大化一个在准确性和计算成本之间取得平衡的多目标奖励。实验结果表明了有效的精度选择，在保持与双精度基线相当的准确性的同时，降低了计算成本。该框架可以推广到各种样本外数据，并为利用 RL 精度选择进行其他数值算法的研究提供了见解，从而推动了科学计算中混合精度数值方法的发展。据我们所知，这是第一个使用 RL 进行精度自动调优并在未见数据集上进行验证的工作。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for adaptive precision tuning in linear solvers, demonstrating reduced computational cost with maintained accuracy. It uses a contextual bandit approach tested on iterative refinement with unseen data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用强化学习（RL）框架自适应调整线性求解器精度的方案，实验表明该方案在保持精度的同时降低了计算成本。它使用上下文bandit方法，并在迭代细化中进行了测试，使用了之前未见过的数据。

title: Traffic-Aware Optimal Taxi Placement Using Graph Neural Network-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: In the context of smart city transportation, efficient matching of taxi supply with passenger demand requires real-time integration of urban traffic network data and mobility patterns. Conventional taxi hotspot prediction models often rely solely on historical demand, overlooking dynamic influences such as traffic congestion, road incidents, and public events. This paper presents a traffic-aware, graph-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework for optimal taxi placement in metropolitan environments. The urban road network is modeled as a graph where intersections represent nodes, road segments serve as edges, and node attributes capture historical demand, event proximity, and real-time congestion scores obtained from live traffic APIs. Graph Neural Network (GNN) embeddings are employed to encode spatial-temporal dependencies within the traffic network, which are then used by a Q-learning agent to recommend optimal taxi hotspots. The reward mechanism jointly optimizes passenger waiting time, driver travel distance, and congestion avoidance. Experiments on a simulated Delhi taxi dataset, generated using real geospatial boundaries and historic ride-hailing request patterns, demonstrate that the proposed model reduced passenger waiting time by about 56% and reduced travel distance by 38% compared to baseline stochastic selection. The proposed approach is adaptable to multi-modal transport systems and can be integrated into smart city platforms for real-time urban mobility optimization.
summary_zh: 在智慧城市交通背景下，出租车供给与乘客需求的有效匹配需要实时整合城市交通网络数据和出行模式。传统的出租车热点预测模型通常仅依赖历史需求，忽略了交通拥堵、道路事件和公共活动等动态影响。本文提出了一种交通感知的、基于图的强化学习（RL）框架，用于城市环境中出租车的最佳部署。城市道路网络被建模成一个图，其中交叉口代表节点，路段代表边，节点属性捕捉历史需求、事件邻近度和从实时交通API获得的实时拥堵评分。图神经网络（GNN）嵌入被用于编码交通网络中的时空依赖性，然后这些嵌入被Q-学习代理使用，以推荐最佳出租车热点。奖励机制联合优化乘客等待时间、司机行驶距离和拥堵规避。基于真实地理边界和历史网约车请求模式生成的模拟德里出租车数据集的实验表明，与基线随机选择相比，提出的模型将乘客等待时间减少了约56%，将行驶距离减少了38%。该方法适用于多模式交通系统，可以集成到智慧城市平台中，以实现实时城市出行优化。
tldr: This paper proposes a graph neural network-based reinforcement learning framework for optimizing taxi placement by considering real-time traffic conditions, demonstrating significant improvements in passenger waiting time and driver travel distance in a simulated environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的强化学习框架，通过考虑实时交通状况来优化出租车位置，并在模拟环境中显著减少了乘客等待时间和司机行驶距离。

title: DefVINS: Visual-Inertial Odometry for Deformable Scenes
summary: Deformable scenes violate the rigidity assumptions underpinning classical visual-inertial odometry (VIO), often leading to over-fitting to local non-rigid motion or severe drift when deformation dominates visual parallax. We introduce DefVINS, a visual-inertial odometry framework that explicitly separates a rigid, IMU-anchored state from a non--rigid warp represented by an embedded deformation graph. The system is initialized using a standard VIO procedure that fixes gravity, velocity, and IMU biases, after which non-rigid degrees of freedom are activated progressively as the estimation becomes well conditioned. An observability analysis is included to characterize how inertial measurements constrain the rigid motion and render otherwise unobservable modes identifiable in the presence of deformation. This analysis motivates the use of IMU anchoring and informs a conditioning-based activation strategy that prevents ill-posed updates under poor excitation. Ablation studies demonstrate the benefits of combining inertial constraints with observability-aware deformation activation, resulting in improved robustness under non-rigid environments.
summary_zh: 可变形场景违背了经典视觉惯性里程计(VIO)所基于的刚性假设，通常会导致过度拟合局部非刚性运动，或者在形变主导视觉视差时产生严重漂移。我们提出了DefVINS，一个视觉惯性里程计框架，它显式地将一个刚性的、IMU锚定的状态从一个由嵌入式形变图表示的非刚性弯曲中分离出来。该系统使用标准的VIO流程初始化，该流程固定重力、速度和IMU偏差，之后，随着估计变为良态，非刚性自由度逐渐激活。我们包含了一个可观测性分析，以表征惯性测量如何约束刚性运动，并在存在形变的情况下使得原本不可观测的模式可识别。此分析驱动了IMU锚定的使用，并启发了基于条件数的激活策略，以防止在弱激励下的病态更新。消融研究证明了将惯性约束与可观测性感知的形变激活相结合的优势，从而提高了在非刚性环境下的鲁棒性。
tldr: DefVINS introduces a visual-inertial odometry framework that explicitly models and separates rigid and non-rigid motion in deformable scenes, using an embedded deformation graph and an observability-aware activation strategy to improve robustness.
tldr_zh: DefVINS提出了一种视觉惯性里程计框架，通过显式建模和分离可变形场景中的刚性和非刚性运动，使用嵌入式变形图和可观测性感知激活策略来提高鲁棒性。

title: Space Debris Removal using Nano-Satellites controlled by Low-Power Autonomous Agents
summary: Space debris is an ever-increasing problem in space travel. There are already many old, no longer functional spacecraft and debris orbiting the earth, which endanger both the safe operation of satellites and space travel. Small nano-satellite swarms can address this problem by autonomously de-orbiting debris safely into the Earth's atmosphere. This work builds on the recent advances of autonomous agents deployed in resource-constrained platforms and shows a first simplified approach how such intelligent and autonomous nano-satellite swarms can be realized. We implement our autonomous agent software on wireless microcontrollers and perform experiments on a specialized test-bed to show the feasibility and overall energy efficiency of our approach.
summary_zh: 空间碎片是太空旅行中日益严重的问题。已经有许多老旧、不再运作的航天器和碎片在地球轨道上运行，这危及着卫星的安全运行和太空旅行。小型纳米卫星群可以通过自主地将碎片安全地离轨进入地球大气层来解决这个问题。这项工作建立在最近在资源受限平台上部署的自主代理的进展之上，并展示了如何实现这种智能自主纳米卫星群的第一个简化方法。我们在无线微控制器上实现了我们的自主代理软件，并在一个专门的测试平台上进行了实验，以展示我们方法的可行性和总体能源效率。
tldr: This paper explores using autonomous nano-satellite swarms for space debris removal, demonstrating a simplified approach with energy-efficient autonomous agents on wireless microcontrollers within a specialized test-bed.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用自主纳米卫星群清除太空碎片的问题，通过在专用测试平台上使用无线微控制器的节能自主代理，展示了一种简化的方法。

title: Parametrized Sharing for Multi-Agent Hybrid DRL for Multiple Multi-Functional RISs-Aided Downlink NOMA Networks
summary: Multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surface (MF-RIS) is conceived to address the communication efficiency thanks to its extended signal coverage from its active RIS capability and self-sustainability from energy harvesting (EH). We investigate the architecture of multi-MF-RISs to assist non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) downlink networks. We formulate an energy efficiency (EE) maximization problem by optimizing power allocation, transmit beamforming and MF-RIS configurations of amplitudes, phase-shifts and EH ratios, as well as the position of MF-RISs, while satisfying constraints of available power, user rate requirements, and self-sustainability property. We design a parametrized sharing scheme for multi-agent hybrid deep reinforcement learning (PMHRL), where the multi-agent proximal policy optimization (PPO) and deep-Q network (DQN) handle continuous and discrete variables, respectively. The simulation results have demonstrated that proposed PMHRL has the highest EE compared to other benchmarks, including cases without parametrized sharing, pure PPO and DQN. Moreover, the proposed multi-MF-RISs-aided downlink NOMA achieves the highest EE compared to scenarios of no-EH/amplification, traditional RISs, and deployment without RISs/MF-RISs under different multiple access.
summary_zh: 多功能可重构智能表面(MF-RIS)旨在通过其有源RIS能力扩展信号覆盖范围及能量收集(EH)实现自持性，从而提高通信效率。我们研究了多MF-RIS辅助的非正交多址(NOMA)下行链路网络架构。我们通过优化功率分配、发射波束赋形、MF-RIS的幅度、相移和EH比率配置以及MF-RIS的位置，制定了能量效率(EE)最大化问题，同时满足可用功率、用户速率要求和自持性约束。我们设计了一种用于多智能体混合深度强化学习(PMHRL)的参数化共享方案，其中多智能体近端策略优化(PPO)和深度Q网络(DQN)分别处理连续变量和离散变量。仿真结果表明，与包括无参数化共享、纯PPO和DQN的其他基准方法相比，提出的PMHRL具有最高的EE。此外，与在不同的多址接入方式下，无EH/放大、传统RIS、未部署RIS/MF-RIS的场景相比，提出的多MF-RIS辅助下行链路NOMA实现了最高的EE。
tldr: This paper proposes a parametrized sharing multi-agent hybrid DRL (PMHRL) approach using PPO and DQN for optimizing energy efficiency in multi-functional RIS-aided NOMA networks, demonstrating improved performance over benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种参数化共享的多智能体混合深度强化学习（PMHRL）方法，利用PPO和DQN来优化多功能RIS辅助的NOMA网络中的能源效率，并证明其性能优于基准方法。

title: Can Semantic Methods Enhance Team Sports Tactics? A Methodology for Football with Broader Applications
summary: This paper explores how semantic-space reasoning, traditionally used in computational linguistics, can be extended to tactical decision-making in team sports. Building on the analogy between texts and teams -- where players act as words and collective play conveys meaning -- the proposed methodology models tactical configurations as compositional semantic structures. Each player is represented as a multidimensional vector integrating technical, physical, and psychological attributes; team profiles are aggregated through contextual weighting into a higher-level semantic representation. Within this shared vector space, tactical templates such as high press, counterattack, or possession build-up are encoded analogously to linguistic concepts. Their alignment with team profiles is evaluated using vector-distance metrics, enabling the computation of tactical ``fit'' and opponent-exploitation potential. A Python-based prototype demonstrates how these methods can generate interpretable, dynamically adaptive strategy recommendations, accompanied by fine-grained diagnostic insights at the attribute level. Beyond football, the approach offers a generalizable framework for collective decision-making and performance optimization in team-based domains -- ranging from basketball and hockey to cooperative robotics and human-AI coordination systems. The paper concludes by outlining future directions toward real-world data integration, predictive simulation, and hybrid human-machine tactical intelligence.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了如何将语义空间推理（一种传统应用于计算语言学的技术）扩展到团队运动中的战术决策。基于文本与团队之间的类比关系（其中球员充当单词，集体配合传达意义），所提出的方法将战术配置建模为组合式语义结构。每个球员被表示为整合了技术、身体和心理属性的多维向量；团队概况通过上下文加权被聚合为更高层次的语义表示。在这个共享的向量空间内，高位逼抢、反击或控球组织等战术模板被类似地编码为语言概念。它们与团队概况的对齐程度使用向量距离度量进行评估，从而能够计算战术“契合度”和对手可利用的潜力。一个基于Python的原型演示了这些方法如何生成可解释的、动态自适应的策略建议，并伴随有属性层面的细粒度诊断洞察。除了足球，该方法还提供了一个通用的框架，用于团队协作领域中的集体决策和性能优化，范围从篮球和曲棍球到合作机器人和人机协同系统。本文最后概述了未来方向，包括真实世界的数据集成、预测性模拟以及混合人机战术智能。
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic-space approach to model team sports tactics, representing players and tactics as vectors to compute tactical fit and generate recommendations. It aims for broad applications in team-based domains, including robotics and human-AI coordination.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于语义空间的方法来建模团队运动战术，将球员和战术表示为向量，以计算战术匹配度并生成建议。它旨在广泛应用于基于团队的领域，包括机器人技术和人机协作。

title: Learning to Segment Liquids in Real-world Images
summary: Different types of liquids such as water, wine and medicine appear in all aspects of daily life. However, limited attention has been given to the task, hindering the ability of robots to avoid or interact with liquids safely. The segmentation of liquids is difficult because liquids come in diverse appearances and shapes; moreover, they can be both transparent or reflective, taking on arbitrary objects and scenes from the background or surroundings. To take on this challenge, we construct a large-scale dataset of liquids named LQDS consisting of 5000 real-world images annotated into 14 distinct classes, and design a novel liquid detection model named LQDM, which leverages cross-attention between a dedicated boundary branch and the main segmentation branch to enhance segmentation predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of LQDM on the test set of LQDS, outperforming state-of-the-art methods and establishing a strong baseline for the semantic segmentation of liquids.
summary_zh: 水、酒和药物等不同类型的液体出现在日常生活的各个方面。然而，该任务受到的关注有限，阻碍了机器人安全地避开或与液体交互的能力。液体的分割颇具挑战性，因为液体具有多样化的外观和形状；此外，它们可以是透明的或反射性的，呈现出背景或周围环境中任意的物体和场景。为了应对这一挑战，我们构建了一个名为LQDS的大规模液体数据集，包含5000张真实世界的图像，并标注成14个不同的类别。此外，我们设计了一个名为LQDM的新型液体检测模型，该模型利用专用边界分支和主分割分支之间的交叉注意力来增强分割预测。大量实验表明，LQDM在LQDS的测试集上表现出色，优于最先进的方法，并为液体的语义分割建立了一个强大的基线。
tldr: The paper introduces LQDS, a large-scale dataset for liquid segmentation, and LQDM, a novel liquid detection model using cross-attention, demonstrating superior performance in real-world liquid segmentation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LQDS，一个用于液体分割的大型数据集，以及LQDM，一种使用交叉注意的新型液体检测模型，展示了在现实世界液体分割中的卓越性能。

title: RePose: A Real-Time 3D Human Pose Estimation and Biomechanical Analysis Framework for Rehabilitation
summary: We propose a real-time 3D human pose estimation and motion analysis method termed RePose for rehabilitation training. It is capable of real-time monitoring and evaluation of patients'motion during rehabilitation, providing immediate feedback and guidance to assist patients in executing rehabilitation exercises correctly. Firstly, we introduce a unified pipeline for end-to-end real-time human pose estimation and motion analysis using RGB video input from multiple cameras which can be applied to the field of rehabilitation training. The pipeline can help to monitor and correct patients'actions, thus aiding them in regaining muscle strength and motor functions. Secondly, we propose a fast tracking method for medical rehabilitation scenarios with multiple-person interference, which requires less than 1ms for tracking for a single frame. Additionally, we modify SmoothNet for real-time posture estimation, effectively reducing pose estimation errors and restoring the patient's true motion state, making it visually smoother. Finally, we use Unity platform for real-time monitoring and evaluation of patients' motion during rehabilitation, and to display the muscle stress conditions to assist patients with their rehabilitation training.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种名为RePose的实时3D人体姿态估计和运动分析方法，用于康复训练。该方法能够实时监控和评估患者在康复过程中的运动，提供即时反馈和指导，以帮助患者正确地执行康复练习。首先，我们引入了一个统一的流水线，利用来自多个摄像头的RGB视频输入，进行端到端的实时人体姿态估计和运动分析，该流水线可应用于康复训练领域。该流水线有助于监控和纠正患者的动作，从而帮助他们恢复肌肉力量和运动功能。其次，我们提出了一种快速跟踪方法，用于多人干扰的医疗康复场景，对单帧的跟踪耗时小于1毫秒。此外，我们改进了SmoothNet以进行实时姿态估计，有效地减少了姿态估计误差，并恢复患者的真实运动状态，使其在视觉上更加流畅。最后，我们使用Unity平台进行实时监控和评估患者在康复过程中的运动，并显示肌肉应力状况，以辅助患者进行康复训练。
tldr: The paper introduces RePose, a real-time multi-camera 3D human pose estimation and biomechanical analysis framework for rehabilitation, focusing on fast tracking and pose estimation accuracy using a modified SmoothNet, visualized through Unity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RePose，一个用于康复的实时多摄像头3D人体姿态估计和生物力学分析框架，重点是使用改进的SmoothNet进行快速跟踪和姿态估计精度，并通过Unity进行可视化。

title: Three factor delay learning rules for spiking neural networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are dynamical systems that operate on spatiotemporal data, yet their learnable parameters are often limited to synaptic weights, contributing little to temporal pattern recognition. Learnable parameters that delay spike times can improve classification performance in temporal tasks, but existing methods rely on large networks and offline learning, making them unsuitable for real-time operation in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we introduce synaptic and axonal delays to leaky integrate and fire (LIF)-based feedforward and recurrent SNNs, and propose three-factor learning rules to simultaneously learn delay parameters online. We employ a smooth Gaussian surrogate to approximate spike derivatives exclusively for the eligibility trace calculation, and together with a top-down error signal determine parameter updates. Our experiments show that incorporating delays improves accuracy by up to 20% over a weights-only baseline, and for networks with similar parameter counts, jointly learning weights and delays yields up to 14% higher accuracy. On the SHD speech recognition dataset, our method achieves similar accuracy to offline backpropagation-based approaches. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, it reduces model size by 6.6x and inference latency by 67%, with only a 2.4% drop in classification accuracy. Our findings benefit the design of power and area-constrained neuromorphic processors by enabling on-device learning and lowering memory requirements.
summary_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）是处理时空数据的动力系统，然而其可学习的参数通常仅限于突触权重，对时间模式识别贡献甚微。延迟脉冲时间的 learnable 参数可以提高时间任务中的分类性能，但现有方法依赖于大型网络和离线学习，使其不适用于资源受限环境中的实时操作。在本文中，我们将突触和轴突延迟引入到基于漏电积分放电（LIF）的前馈和循环 SNN 中，并提出三因子学习规则来同时在线学习延迟参数。我们采用平滑的高斯替代函数来近似脉冲导数，专门用于资格迹的计算，并与自顶向下的误差信号共同决定参数更新。 我们的实验表明，与仅权重基线相比，整合延迟可将准确率提高多达 20%，并且对于参数数量相似的网络，联合学习权重和延迟可产生高达 14% 的更高准确率。在 SHD 语音识别数据集上，我们的方法实现了与基于离线反向传播的方法相似的准确率。与最先进的方法相比，它将模型大小减少了 6.6 倍，推理延迟减少了 67%，分类准确率仅下降了 2.4%。我们的发现通过实现片上学习和降低内存需求，有利于功耗和面积受限的神经形态处理器的设计。
tldr: The paper introduces novel three-factor learning rules for Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) that enable online learning of synaptic and axonal delays, demonstrating improved accuracy and reduced model size/latency compared to existing methods on temporal tasks like speech recognition.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的新型三因子学习规则，该规则能够在线学习突触和轴突延迟，与现有方法相比，在诸如语音识别等时间任务上表现出更高的准确性和更小的模型大小/延迟。

title: Calling for Backup: How Children Navigate Successive Robot Communication Failures
summary: How do children respond to repeated robot errors? While prior research has examined adult reactions to successive robot errors, children's responses remain largely unexplored. In this study, we explore children's reactions to robot social errors and performance errors. For the latter, this study reproduces the successive robot failure paradigm of Liu et al. with child participants (N=59, ages 8-10) to examine how young users respond to repeated robot conversational errors. Participants interacted with a robot that failed to understand their prompts three times in succession, with their behavioral responses video-recorded and analyzed. We found both similarities and differences compared to adult responses from the original study. Like adults, children adjusted their prompts, modified their verbal tone, and exhibited increasingly emotional non-verbal responses throughout successive errors. However, children demonstrated more disengagement behaviors, including temporarily ignoring the robot or actively seeking an adult. Errors did not affect participants' perception of the robot, suggesting more flexible conversational expectations in children. These findings inform the design of more effective and developmentally appropriate human-robot interaction systems for young users.
summary_zh: 儿童如何应对重复的机器人错误？虽然之前的研究已经考察了成年人对连续机器人错误的反应，但儿童的反应在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本研究中，我们探讨了儿童对机器人社交错误和性能错误的反应。对于后者，本研究通过招募儿童参与者（N=59，年龄8-10岁）来重现刘等人关于连续机器人失败的范例，以考察年轻用户如何应对重复的机器人对话错误。参与者与一个机器人互动，该机器人连续三次未能理解他们的提示，他们的行为反应被录像并进行分析。我们发现了与原始研究中成年人反应的相似之处和不同之处。与成年人一样，儿童调整了他们的提示，改变了他们的语气，并且在连续错误中表现出越来越情绪化的非语言反应。然而，儿童表现出更多的脱离互动行为，包括暂时忽略机器人或积极寻求成年人的帮助。错误并没有影响参与者对机器人的感知，这表明儿童在对话方面有更灵活的期望。这些发现为设计针对年轻用户的更有效和具有发展适应性的人机交互系统提供了信息。
tldr: This paper investigates how children respond to repeated conversational failures of a robot, finding that they adjust their prompts and exhibit emotional responses, but also disengage and seek adult help, while maintaining positive robot perception.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了儿童如何应对机器人重复的对话失败，发现他们会调整提示语并表现出情绪反应，但也会脱离互动并寻求成人帮助，同时保持对机器人的积极看法。

title: Variable Elimination in Hybrid Factor Graphs for Discrete-Continuous Inference & Estimation
summary: Many hybrid problems in robotics involve both continuous and discrete components, and modeling them together for estimation tasks has been a long standing and difficult problem. Hybrid Factor Graphs give us a mathematical framework to model these types of problems, however existing approaches for solving them are based on approximations. In this work, we propose an efficient Hybrid Factor Graph framework alongwith a variable elimination algorithm to produce a hybrid Bayes network, which can then be used for exact Maximum A Posteriori estimation and marginalization over both sets of variables. Our approach first develops a novel hybrid Gaussian factor which can connect to both discrete and continuous variables, and a hybrid conditional which can represent multiple continuous hypotheses conditioned on the discrete variables. Using these representations, we derive the process of hybrid variable elimination under the Conditional Linear Gaussian scheme, giving us exact posteriors as hybrid Bayes network. To bound the number of discrete hypotheses, we use a tree-structured representation of the factors coupled with a simple pruning and probabilistic assignment scheme, which allows for tractable inference. We demonstrate the applicability of our framework on a SLAM dataset with ambiguous measurements, where discrete choices for the most likely measurement have to be made. Our demonstrated results showcase the accuracy, generality, and simplicity of our hybrid factor graph framework.
summary_zh: 机器人领域的许多混合问题都涉及连续和离散两种成分，将它们统一建模以进行估计任务一直以来都是一个充满挑战性的问题。混合因子图为我们提供了一个数学框架来对这类问题进行建模，然而，现有的求解方法都是基于近似的。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个高效的混合因子图框架，以及一种变量消元算法，以生成一个混合贝叶斯网络，该网络可用于在两组变量上进行精确的最大后验概率估计和边缘化。我们的方法首先开发了一种新型的混合高斯因子，它可以连接到离散和连续变量，以及一个混合条件，它可以表示基于离散变量的多个连续假设。利用这些表示，我们在条件线性高斯方案下推导了混合变量消元的过程，从而可以得到精确的后验概率，作为混合贝叶斯网络。为了限制离散假设的数量，我们使用因子树状结构表示，并结合一个简单的剪枝和概率分配方案，从而实现易于处理的推理。我们在一个具有模糊测量的SLAM数据集上展示了我们框架的适用性，其中必须对最可能的测量结果进行离散选择。我们的实验结果展示了我们混合因子图框架的准确性、通用性和简洁性。
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid factor graph framework with a variable elimination algorithm for exact MAP estimation and marginalization in problems with both continuous and discrete variables, applied to a SLAM dataset with ambiguous measurements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合因子图框架，采用变量消元算法，用于解决同时包含连续和离散变量的问题中的精确MAP估计和边缘化问题，应用于具有模糊测量的SLAM数据集。

title: Probability-Aware Parking Selection
summary: Current navigation systems conflate time-to-drive with the true time-to-arrive by ignoring parking search duration and the final walking leg. Such underestimation can significantly affect user experience, mode choice, congestion, and emissions. To address this issue, this paper introduces the probability-aware parking selection problem, which aims to direct drivers to the best parking location rather than straight to their destination. An adaptable dynamic programming framework is proposed that leverages probabilistic, lot-level availability to minimize the expected time-to-arrive. Closed-form analysis determines when it is optimal to target a specific parking lot or explore alternatives, as well as the expected time cost. Sensitivity analysis and three illustrative cases are examined, demonstrating the model's ability to account for the dynamic nature of parking availability. Given the high cost of permanent sensing infrastructure, we assess the error rates of using stochastic observations to estimate availability. Experiments with real-world data from the US city of Seattle indicate this approach's viability, with mean absolute error decreasing from 7% to below 2% as observation frequency increases. In data-based simulations, probability-aware strategies demonstrate time savings up to 66% relative to probability-unaware baselines, yet still take up to 123% longer than time-to-drive estimates.
summary_zh: 当前的导航系统将行驶时间与真实到达时间混淆，因为它们忽略了停车搜索时长和最后的步行路程。这种低估会显著影响用户体验、出行方式选择、交通拥堵和排放。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了概率感知的停车位选择问题，旨在引导驾驶员前往最佳停车位置，而不是直接前往目的地。我们提出了一个适应性强的动态规划框架，该框架利用基于概率的、停车场级别的可用性信息，以最小化预期到达时间。闭式解分析确定了何时优化目标为特定停车场或探索替代方案，以及预期的时间成本。通过敏感性分析和三个例证性案例，展示了该模型处理停车可用性动态性的能力。考虑到永久性传感基础设施的高成本，我们评估了使用随机观测估计可用性的误差率。使用来自美国西雅图市的真实数据进行的实验表明，该方法可行，随着观测频率的增加，平均绝对误差从7%降低到2%以下。在基于数据的模拟中，相对于概率盲基线，概率感知策略显示出高达66%的时间节省，但仍然比行驶时间估计长达123%。
tldr: The paper introduces a probability-aware parking selection method using dynamic programming and stochastic observations to minimize expected arrival time considering parking search duration and walking distance, demonstrating significant time savings in simulations compared to naive approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种概率感知的停车选择方法，该方法利用动态规划和随机观测来最小化预计到达时间，考虑了停车搜索时间和步行距离，并且与简单的停车方法相比，在模拟中显示出显著的节省时间。

title: Robust Assembly Progress Estimation via Deep Metric Learning
summary: In recent years, the advancement of AI technologies has accelerated the development of smart factories. In particular, the automatic monitoring of product assembly progress is crucial for improving operational efficiency, minimizing the cost of discarded parts, and maximizing factory productivity. However, in cases where assembly tasks are performed manually over multiple days, implementing smart factory systems remains a challenge. Previous work has proposed Anomaly Triplet-Net, which estimates assembly progress by applying deep metric learning to the visual features of products. Nevertheless, when visual changes between consecutive tasks are subtle, misclassification often occurs. To address this issue, this paper proposes a robust system for estimating assembly progress, even in cases of occlusion or minimal visual change, using a small-scale dataset. Our method leverages a Quadruplet Loss-based learning approach for anomaly images and introduces a custom data loader that strategically selects training samples to enhance estimation accuracy. We evaluated our approach using a image datasets: captured during desktop PC assembly. The proposed Anomaly Quadruplet-Net outperformed existing methods on the dataset. Specifically, it improved the estimation accuracy by 1.3% and reduced misclassification between adjacent tasks by 1.9% in the desktop PC dataset and demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
summary_zh:
摘要：
近年来，人工智能技术的进步加速了智能工厂的发展。尤其是产品装配进度的自动监控，对于提高运营效率、最大限度减少废弃零件的成本以及最大化工厂生产力至关重要。然而，在人工耗时数天完成装配任务的情况下，实施智能工厂系统仍然是一个挑战。先前的工作提出了异常三元组网络（Anomaly Triplet-Net），它通过将深度度量学习应用于产品的视觉特征来估计装配进度。然而，当连续任务之间的视觉变化细微时，经常发生错误分类。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种鲁棒的系统，即使在遮挡或最小视觉变化的情况下，也能使用小规模数据集来估计装配进度。我们的方法利用基于四元组损失（Quadruplet Loss）的学习方法来处理异常图像，并引入了一种定制的数据加载器，该加载器策略性地选择训练样本以提高估计精度。我们使用在台式电脑组装过程中捕获的图像数据集评估了我们的方法。所提出的异常四元组网络（Anomaly Quadruplet-Net）在数据集上优于现有方法。具体而言，它在台式电脑数据集上的估计准确率提高了1.3%，相邻任务之间的错误分类减少了1.9%，证明了所提出方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces an Anomaly Quadruplet-Net using Quadruplet Loss and a custom data loader to improve assembly progress estimation in smart factories, especially when visual changes are subtle, achieving improvements in accuracy compared to previous methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种Anomaly Quadruplet-Net，它使用四元组损失和自定义数据加载器来提高智能工厂中的装配进度估计，特别是在视觉变化细微的情况下，与以前的方法相比，实现了准确性的提高。

title: From 2D to 3D terrain-following area coverage path planning
summary: An algorithm for 3D terrain-following area coverage path planning is presented. Multiple adjacent paths are generated that are (i) locally apart from each other by a distance equal to the working width of a machinery, while (ii) simultaneously floating at a projection distance equal to a specific working height above the terrain. The complexities of the algorithm in comparison to its 2D equivalent are highlighted. These include uniformly spaced elevation data generation using an Inverse Distance Weighting-approach and a local search. Area coverage path planning results for real-world 3D data within an agricultural context are presented to validate the algorithm.
