summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于三维地形跟踪区域覆盖路径规划的算法。该算法生成多条相邻路径，这些路径 (i) 在局部彼此间隔的距离等于机械的工作宽度，同时 (ii) 悬浮在高于地形的某一特定工作高度的投影距离处。文中重点阐述了该算法与二维算法相比复杂度增加之处，包括利用反距离权重法生成的均匀间隔高程数据以及局部搜索。为验证该算法，本文展示了在农业背景下对真实世界三维数据进行区域覆盖路径规划的结果。
tldr: This paper presents a 3D terrain-following area coverage path planning algorithm, generating paths with specific working height and spacing, and validates it with agricultural data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种3D地形跟随区域覆盖路径规划算法，该算法生成的路径具有特定的工作高度和间距，并通过农业数据进行了验证。

title: Cost Optimization in Production Line Using Genetic Algorithm
summary: This paper presents a genetic algorithm (GA) approach to cost-optimal task scheduling in a production line. The system consists of a set of serial processing tasks, each with a given duration, unit execution cost, and precedence constraints, which must be assigned to an unlimited number of stations subject to a per-station duration bound. The objective is to minimize the total production cost, modeled as a station-wise function of task costs and the duration bound, while strictly satisfying all prerequisite and capacity constraints. Two chromosome encoding strategies are investigated: a station-based representation implemented using the JGAP library with SuperGene validity checks, and a task-based representation in which genes encode station assignments directly. For each encoding, standard GA operators (crossover, mutation, selection, and replacement) are adapted to preserve feasibility and drive the population toward lower-cost schedules. Experimental results on three classes of precedence structures-tightly coupled, loosely coupled, and uncoupled-demonstrate that the task-based encoding yields smoother convergence and more reliable cost minimization than the station-based encoding, particularly when the number of valid schedules is large. The study highlights the advantages of GA over gradient-based and analytical methods for combinatorial scheduling problems, especially in the presence of complex constraints and non-differentiable cost landscapes.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于遗传算法（GA）的方法，用于生产线中成本最优的任务调度。系统由一系列串行处理任务组成，每个任务具有给定的持续时间、单位执行成本和优先级约束，这些任务必须分配给数量不限的工位，并受到每个工位的持续时间限制。目标是在严格满足所有先决条件和容量约束的同时，最小化总生产成本，该成本被建模为任务成本和持续时间限制的工位级函数。研究了两种染色体编码策略：一种是使用JGAP库和SuperGene有效性检查实现的基于工位的表示，另一种是基于任务的表示，其中基因直接编码工位分配。对于每种编码，标准的GA算子（交叉、变异、选择和替换）都经过调整，以保持可行性并驱动种群向低成本的调度方案演化。在三种优先结构类型——紧耦合、松耦合和非耦合——上的实验结果表明，与基于工位的编码相比，基于任务的编码能够产生更平滑的收敛，并实现更可靠的成本最小化，尤其是在有效调度方案数量庞大的情况下。该研究强调了GA在组合调度问题上优于基于梯度和解析方法的优势，尤其是在存在复杂约束和不可微成本函数的情况下。
tldr: This paper explores the use of genetic algorithms (GA) for cost-optimal task scheduling in production lines, comparing station-based and task-based encoding strategies. Results suggest task-based encoding offers superior performance, especially with complex constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用遗传算法（GA）优化生产线中的成本最优任务调度，比较了基于站点的和基于任务的编码策略。结果表明，基于任务的编码策略表现更优，尤其是在复杂约束条件下。

title: DrivingGen: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Generative Video World Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Video generation models, as one form of world models, have emerged as one of the most exciting frontiers in AI, promising agents the ability to imagine the future by modeling the temporal evolution of complex scenes. In autonomous driving, this vision gives rise to driving world models: generative simulators that imagine ego and agent futures, enabling scalable simulation, safe testing of corner cases, and rich synthetic data generation. Yet, despite fast-growing research activity, the field lacks a rigorous benchmark to measure progress and guide priorities. Existing evaluations remain limited: generic video metrics overlook safety-critical imaging factors; trajectory plausibility is rarely quantified; temporal and agent-level consistency is neglected; and controllability with respect to ego conditioning is ignored. Moreover, current datasets fail to cover the diversity of conditions required for real-world deployment. To address these gaps, we present DrivingGen, the first comprehensive benchmark for generative driving world models. DrivingGen combines a diverse evaluation dataset curated from both driving datasets and internet-scale video sources, spanning varied weather, time of day, geographic regions, and complex maneuvers, with a suite of new metrics that jointly assess visual realism, trajectory plausibility, temporal coherence, and controllability. Benchmarking 14 state-of-the-art models reveals clear trade-offs: general models look better but break physics, while driving-specific ones capture motion realistically but lag in visual quality. DrivingGen offers a unified evaluation framework to foster reliable, controllable, and deployable driving world models, enabling scalable simulation, planning, and data-driven decision-making.
summary_zh: 视频生成模型作为世界模型的一种形式，已成为人工智能领域中最令人兴奋的前沿领域之一，它有望通过对复杂场景的时间演化进行建模，赋予智能体想象未来的能力。在自动驾驶领域，这种愿景催生了驾驶世界模型：生成式模拟器，能够想象自我车辆和智能体的未来，从而实现可扩展的仿真、安全地测试极端情况以及生成丰富的合成数据。然而，尽管研究活动快速增长，但该领域缺乏一个严格的基准来衡量进展和指导优先级。现有的评估仍然有限：通用的视频指标忽略了安全关键的图像因素；轨迹合理性很少被量化；时间和智能体级别的连贯性被忽略；并且关于自我车辆条件的控制性也被忽略。此外，当前的数据集未能覆盖现实世界部署所需的各种条件。为了解决这些差距，我们提出了DrivingGen，这是第一个针对生成式驾驶世界模型的综合基准。DrivingGen结合了一个多样化的评估数据集，该数据集从驾驶数据集和互联网规模的视频源中精心挑选，涵盖了不同的天气、一天中的时间、地理区域和复杂的机动动作，以及一套新的指标，这些指标共同评估视觉真实性、轨迹合理性、时间连贯性和可控性。对14个最先进的模型进行基准测试揭示了明显的权衡：通用模型看起来更好，但违反了物理定律，而驾驶专用模型可以真实地捕捉运动，但在视觉质量方面滞后。DrivingGen提供了一个统一的评估框架，以促进可靠、可控和可部署的驾驶世界模型，从而实现可扩展的仿真、规划和数据驱动的决策。
tldr: The paper introduces DrivingGen, a comprehensive benchmark for generative driving world models, addressing limitations in existing evaluation methods and datasets, and benchmarks 14 SOTA models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 DrivingGen，一个全面的生成式驾驶世界模型基准，旨在解决现有评估方法和数据集的局限性，并对14个最先进的模型进行了基准测试。

title: AirSpatialBot: A Spatially-Aware Aerial Agent for Fine-Grained Vehicle Attribute Recognization and Retrieval
summary: Despite notable advancements in remote sensing vision-language models (VLMs), existing models often struggle with spatial understanding, limiting their effectiveness in real-world applications. To push the boundaries of VLMs in remote sensing, we specifically address vehicle imagery captured by drones and introduce a spatially-aware dataset AirSpatial, which comprises over 206K instructions and introduces two novel tasks: Spatial Grounding and Spatial Question Answering. It is also the first remote sensing grounding dataset to provide 3DBB. To effectively leverage existing image understanding of VLMs to spatial domains, we adopt a two-stage training strategy comprising Image Understanding Pre-training and Spatial Understanding Fine-tuning. Utilizing this trained spatially-aware VLM, we develop an aerial agent, AirSpatialBot, which is capable of fine-grained vehicle attribute recognition and retrieval. By dynamically integrating task planning, image understanding, spatial understanding, and task execution capabilities, AirSpatialBot adapts to diverse query requirements. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of our approach, revealing the spatial limitations of existing VLMs while providing valuable insights. The model, code, and datasets will be released at https://github.com/VisionXLab/AirSpatialBot
summary_zh: 尽管遥感视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 取得了显著进展，但现有模型通常在空间理解方面存在不足，限制了其在实际应用中的有效性。为了推动遥感领域 VLM 的发展，我们专门针对无人机拍摄的车辆图像，并引入了一个空间感知数据集 AirSpatial，其中包含超过 20.6 万条指令，并提出了两个新颖的任务：空间定位和空间问答。它也是首个提供 3D 边界框的遥感定位数据集。为了有效地将现有 VLM 的图像理解能力应用到空间领域，我们采用了一种两阶段训练策略，包括图像理解预训练和空间理解微调。利用这种经过训练的空间感知 VLM，我们开发了一个空中代理 AirSpatialBot，它能够进行细粒度的车辆属性识别和检索。通过动态集成任务规划、图像理解、空间理解和任务执行能力，AirSpatialBot 能够适应各种查询需求。实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性，揭示了现有 VLM 的空间局限性，并提供了有价值的见解。模型、代码和数据集将在 https://github.com/VisionXLab/AirSpatialBot 发布。
tldr: The paper introduces AirSpatialBot, a spatially-aware aerial agent leveraging a novel dataset (AirSpatial) and a two-stage training strategy to improve VLMs' performance in fine-grained vehicle attribute recognition and retrieval from drone imagery, addressing the spatial understanding limitations of existing VLMs. The authors also introduce two novel tasks: Spatial Grounding and Spatial Question Answering.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AirSpatialBot，一个空间感知的空中智能体，它利用一个新的数据集（AirSpatial）和一个两阶段训练策略来提高VLM在无人机图像中进行细粒度车辆属性识别和检索的性能，解决了现有VLM在空间理解方面的局限性。作者还提出了两个新的任务：空间定位和空间问答。

title: Action-Sketcher: From Reasoning to Action via Visual Sketches for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation is increasingly important for real-world deployment, requiring spatial disambiguation in complex layouts and temporal resilience under dynamic interaction. However, existing end-to-end and hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely on text-only cues while keeping plan intent latent, which undermines referential grounding in cluttered or underspecified scenes, impedes effective task decomposition of long-horizon goals with close-loop interaction, and limits causal explanation by obscuring the rationale behind action choices. To address these issues, we first introduce Visual Sketch, an implausible visual intermediate that renders points, boxes, arrows, and typed relations in the robot's current views to externalize spatial intent, connect language to scene geometry. Building on Visual Sketch, we present Action-Sketcher, a VLA framework that operates in a cyclic See-Think-Sketch-Act workflow coordinated by adaptive token-gated strategy for reasoning triggers, sketch revision, and action issuance, thereby supporting reactive corrections and human interaction while preserving real-time action prediction. To enable scalable training and evaluation, we curate diverse corpus with interleaved images, text, Visual Sketch supervision, and action sequences, and train Action-Sketcher with a multi-stage curriculum recipe that combines interleaved sequence alignment for modality unification, language-to-sketch consistency for precise linguistic grounding, and imitation learning augmented with sketch-to-action reinforcement for robustness. Extensive experiments on cluttered scenes and multi-object tasks, in simulation and on real-world tasks, show improved long-horizon success, stronger robustness to dynamic scene changes, and enhanced interpretability via editable sketches and step-wise plans. Project website: https://action-sketcher.github.io
summary_zh: 长时程机器人操作对于现实世界的部署越来越重要，需要在复杂布局中进行空间消歧，并在动态交互下保持时间上的弹性。然而，现有的端到端和分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常依赖于纯文本线索，并将计划意图保持潜在状态，这削弱了在杂乱或欠指定场景中的指称接地，阻碍了具有闭环交互的长时程目标进行有效的任务分解，并通过模糊动作选择背后的原理限制了因果解释。为了解决这些问题，我们首先引入了视觉草图（Visual Sketch），这是一种非真实的视觉中间表示，可在机器人当前视图中渲染点、框、箭头和类型化关系，以呈现外部空间意图，并将语言连接到场景几何。基于视觉草图，我们提出了动作草图师（Action-Sketcher），一个VLA框架，该框架在一个循环的“观察-思考-草绘-行动”工作流程中运行，并通过自适应令牌门控策略进行协调，以实现推理触发、草图修改和动作发布，从而支持反应性更正和人机交互，同时保持实时行动预测。为了实现可扩展的训练和评估，我们整理了一个包含交错图像、文本、视觉草图监督和行动序列的多样化语料库，并使用多阶段课程配方训练动作草图师，该配方结合了用于模态统一的交错序列对齐、用于精确定位语言接地的语言到草图一致性，以及通过草图到动作强化学习增强的模仿学习，以实现鲁棒性。在模拟和真实世界任务中，针对杂乱场景和多目标任务的大量实验表明，长时程成功率得到提高，对动态场景变化的鲁棒性更强，并通过可编辑草图和逐步计划增强了解释性。项目网站：https://action-sketcher.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces Action-Sketcher, a Vision-Language-Action framework that uses visual sketches as an intermediate representation to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation by enhancing grounding, task decomposition, and explainability. It also introduces a new dataset with sketch supervision and a curriculum learning recipe to train the model.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Action-Sketcher，一个视觉-语言-动作框架，使用视觉草图作为中间表示，通过增强基础、任务分解和可解释性来改进长时程机器人操作。 它还引入了一个带有草图监督的新数据集和一个课程学习方案来训练模型。

title: HanoiWorld : A Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture BasedWorld Model for Autonomous Vehicle Controller
summary: Current attempts of Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Controller are data-demanding while the results are under-performed, unstable, and unable to grasp and anchor on the concept of safety, and over-concentrating on noise features due to the nature of pixel reconstruction. While current Self-Supervised Learningapproachs that learning on high-dimensional representations by leveraging the JointEmbedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are interesting and an effective alternative, as the idea mimics the natural ability of the human brain in acquiring new skill usingimagination and minimal samples of observations. This study introduces Hanoi-World, a JEPA-based world model that using recurrent neural network (RNN) formaking longterm horizontal planning with effective inference time. Experimentsconducted on the Highway-Env package with difference enviroment showcase the effective capability of making a driving plan while safety-awareness, with considerablecollision rate in comparison with SOTA baselines
summary_zh: 目前针对自主控制器的强化学习方法的尝试存在数据需求量大、结果表现不佳、不稳定、无法掌握和锚定安全概念，以及由于像素重建的本质而过度关注噪声特征的问题。而目前利用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在高维表征上进行学习的自监督学习方法，因其模仿人类大脑利用想象力和最少量的观察样本来获得新技能的自然能力，是一种有趣且有效的替代方案。本研究引入了Hanoi-World，一个基于JEPA的世界模型，它使用循环神经网络（RNN）进行长期横向规划，并具有高效的推理时间。在不同环境下的Highway-Env软件包上进行的实验表明，该模型具有有效的驾驶规划能力和安全意识，与SOTA基线相比，碰撞率显著降低。
tldr: The paper introduces Hanoi-World, a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based world model for autonomous vehicle control, aiming to improve safety and reduce data requirements compared to traditional RL approaches. It uses a recurrent neural network for long-term planning and demonstrates promising results in a highway driving environment.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA) 的世界模型 Hanoi-World，用于自动驾驶车辆控制，旨在提高安全性并减少与传统强化学习方法相比的数据需求。它使用循环神经网络进行长期规划，并在高速公路驾驶环境中展示了有希望的结果。

title: PyBatchRender: A Python Library for Batched 3D Rendering at Up to One Million FPS
summary: Reinforcement learning from pixels is often bottlenecked by the performance and complexity of 3D rendered environments. Researchers face a trade-off between high-speed, low-level engines and slower, more accessible Python frameworks. To address this, we introduce PyBatchRender, a Python library for high-throughput, batched 3D rendering that achieves over 1 million FPS on simple scenes. Built on the Panda3D game engine, it utilizes its mature ecosystem while enhancing performance through optimized batched rendering for up to 1000X speedups. Designed as a physics-agnostic renderer for reinforcement learning from pixels, PyBatchRender offers greater flexibility than dedicated libraries, simpler setup than typical game-engine wrappers, and speeds rivaling state-of-the-art C++ engines like Madrona. Users can create custom scenes entirely in Python with tens of lines of code, enabling rapid prototyping for scalable AI training. Open-source and easy to integrate, it serves to democratize high-performance 3D simulation for researchers and developers. The library is available at https://github.com/dolphin-in-a-coma/PyBatchRender.
summary_zh: 从像素强化学习常常受制于3D渲染环境的性能和复杂度。研究人员面临着高速、低级引擎和速度较慢、更易使用的Python框架之间的权衡。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了PyBatchRender，一个用于高吞吐量、批量3D渲染的Python库，它在简单场景下可以达到超过100万FPS。它构建于Panda3D游戏引擎之上，利用了其成熟的生态系统，并通过优化的批量渲染实现了高达1000倍的加速，从而提升了性能。PyBatchRender被设计为用于像素强化学习的物理无关的渲染器，它提供了比专用库更大的灵活性，比典型的游戏引擎封装器更简单的设置，以及与最先进的C++引擎（如Madrona）相媲美的速度。用户可以用几十行Python代码完全自定义场景，从而为可扩展的AI训练实现快速原型设计。该库开源且易于集成，旨在普及面向研究人员和开发者的高性能3D仿真。该库可在https://github.com/dolphin-in-a-coma/PyBatchRender 获取。
tldr: PyBatchRender is a Python library that achieves over 1 million FPS for batched 3D rendering, offering a high-speed and accessible solution for reinforcement learning from pixels.
tldr_zh: PyBatchRender是一个Python库，可实现超过100万FPS的批量3D渲染，为像素强化学习提供了一种高速且易于使用的解决方案。

title: CaveAgent: Transforming LLMs into Stateful Runtime Operators
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly capable of complex task execution, yet current agentic systems remain constrained by text-centric paradigms. Traditional approaches rely on procedural JSON-based function calling, which often struggles with long-horizon tasks due to fragile multi-turn dependencies and context drift. In this paper, we present CaveAgent, a framework that transforms the paradigm from "LLM-as-Text-Generator" to "LLM-as-Runtime-Operator." We introduce a Dual-stream Context Architecture that decouples state management into a lightweight semantic stream for reasoning and a persistent, deterministic Python Runtime stream for execution. In addition to leveraging code generation to efficiently resolve interdependent sub-tasks (e.g., loops, conditionals) in a single step, we introduce \textit{Stateful Runtime Management} in CaveAgent. Distinct from existing code-based approaches that remain text-bound and lack the support for external object injection and retrieval, CaveAgent injects, manipulates, and retrieves complex Python objects (e.g., DataFrames, database connections) that persist across turns. This persistence mechanism acts as a high-fidelity external memory to eliminate context drift, avoid catastrophic forgetting, while ensuring that processed data flows losslessly to downstream applications. Comprehensive evaluations on Tau$^2$-bench, BFCL and various case studies across representative SOTA LLMs demonstrate CaveAgent's superiority. Specifically, our framework achieves a 10.5\% success rate improvement on retail tasks and reduces total token consumption by 28.4\% in multi-turn scenarios. On data-intensive tasks, direct variable storage and retrieval reduces token consumption by 59\%, allowing CaveAgent to handle large-scale data that causes context overflow failures in both JSON-based and Code-based agents.
summary_zh: 基于 LLM 的智能体日益具备执行复杂任务的能力，但当前的智能体系统仍然受到以文本为中心的范式的限制。传统方法依赖于基于过程的 JSON 函数调用，由于脆弱的多轮依赖关系和上下文漂移，通常难以应对长周期任务。在本文中，我们提出了 CaveAgent，一个将范式从“LLM 作为文本生成器”转变为“LLM 作为运行时操作员”的框架。我们引入了双流上下文架构，将状态管理解耦为用于推理的轻量级语义流，以及用于执行的持久性、确定性 Python 运行时流。除了利用代码生成来高效地一步解决相互依赖的子任务（例如，循环、条件语句）之外，我们还在 CaveAgent 中引入了 \textit{有状态运行时管理}。与现有的仍然受文本约束且缺乏对外部对象注入和检索支持的基于代码的方法不同，CaveAgent 注入、操作和检索复杂 Python 对象（例如，DataFrames、数据库连接），这些对象在多轮交互中保持持久性。这种持久性机制充当高保真外部存储器，以消除上下文漂移，避免灾难性遗忘，同时确保处理后的数据无损地流向下游应用程序。在 Tau$^2$-bench、BFCL 和跨越代表性 SOTA LLM 的各种案例研究中的全面评估表明了 CaveAgent 的优越性。具体而言，我们的框架在零售任务上的成功率提高了 10.5％，并在多轮场景中将总令牌消耗量降低了 28.4％。在数据密集型任务中，直接的变量存储和检索将令牌消耗量减少了 59％，从而使 CaveAgent 能够处理大规模数据，而这些数据会导致基于 JSON 和基于代码的智能体中出现上下文溢出故障。
tldr: CaveAgent introduces a dual-stream architecture for LLM agents, using a semantic stream for reasoning and a Python runtime stream for persistent state management, improving performance and reducing token consumption in long-horizon tasks and data-intensive applications.
tldr_zh: CaveAgent引入了一种用于LLM Agent的双流架构，使用语义流进行推理，并使用Python运行时流进行持久状态管理，从而提高了性能并降低了长程任务和数据密集型应用中的token消耗。

title: EscherVerse: An Open World Benchmark and Dataset for Teleo-Spatial Intelligence with Physical-Dynamic and Intent-Driven Understanding
summary: The ability to reason about spatial dynamics is a cornerstone of intelligence, yet current research overlooks the human intent behind spatial changes. To address these limitations, we introduce Teleo-Spatial Intelligence (TSI), a new paradigm that unifies two critical pillars: Physical-Dynamic Reasoning--understanding the physical principles of object interactions--and Intent-Driven Reasoning--inferring the human goals behind these actions. To catalyze research in TSI, we present EscherVerse, consisting of a large-scale, open-world benchmark (Escher-Bench), a dataset (Escher-35k), and models (Escher series). Derived from real-world videos, EscherVerse moves beyond constrained settings to explicitly evaluate an agent's ability to reason about object permanence, state transitions, and trajectory prediction in dynamic, human-centric scenarios. Crucially, it is the first benchmark to systematically assess Intent-Driven Reasoning, challenging models to connect physical events to their underlying human purposes. Our work, including a novel data curation pipeline, provides a foundational resource to advance spatial intelligence from passive scene description toward a holistic, purpose-driven understanding of the world.
summary_zh: 空间动态推理是智能的基石，然而，当前的研究忽略了空间变化背后的人类意图。为了弥补这些局限性，我们引入了目的-空间智能(TSI)这一新范式，它统一了两个关键支柱：物理-动态推理——理解物体交互的物理原理——和意图驱动的推理——推断这些行为背后的人类目标。为了促进TSI领域的研究，我们推出了EscherVerse，它包含一个大规模、开放世界的基准测试(Escher-Bench)、一个数据集(Escher-35k)和一个模型系列(Escher系列)。EscherVerse源于真实世界的视频，超越了受限环境，明确地评估了智能体在动态、以人为中心的场景中进行物体永存性、状态转换和轨迹预测推理的能力。至关重要的是，它是首个系统性评估意图驱动推理的基准测试，挑战模型将物理事件与其底层的人类目的联系起来。我们的工作，包括一种新颖的数据管理流程，提供了一个基础性资源，以推动空间智能从被动的场景描述转向对世界整体的、目的驱动的理解。
tldr: The paper introduces EscherVerse, a new benchmark and dataset designed to evaluate Teleo-Spatial Intelligence, which combines physical-dynamic reasoning with intent-driven reasoning in human-centric environments, using real-world videos.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EscherVerse，一个新的基准和数据集，旨在评估远程空间智能。它结合物理动态推理与意图驱动推理，在以人为中心的环境中使用真实世界的视频。

title: Bayesian Orchestration of Multi-LLM Agents for Cost-Aware Sequential Decision-Making
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous decision agents in settings with asymmetric error costs: hiring (missed talent vs wasted interviews), medical triage (missed emergencies vs unnecessary escalation), and fraud detection (approved fraud vs declined legitimate payments). The dominant design queries a single LLM for a posterior over states, thresholds "confidence," and acts; we prove this is inadequate for sequential decisions with costs. We propose a Bayesian, cost-aware multi-LLM orchestration framework that treats LLMs as approximate likelihood models rather than classifiers. For each candidate state, we elicit likelihoods via contrastive prompting, aggregate across diverse models with robust statistics, and update beliefs with Bayes rule under explicit priors as new evidence arrives. This enables coherent belief updating, expected-cost action selection, principled information gathering via value of information, and fairness gains via ensemble bias mitigation. In resume screening with costs of 40000 USD per missed hire, 2500 USD per interview, and 150 USD per phone screen, experiments on 1000 resumes using five LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Gemini Pro, Grok, DeepSeek) reduce total cost by 294000 USD (34 percent) versus the best single-LLM baseline and improve demographic parity by 45 percent (max group gap 22 to 5 percentage points). Ablations attribute 51 percent of savings to multi-LLM aggregation, 43 percent to sequential updating, and 20 percent to disagreement-triggered information gathering, consistent with the theoretical benefits of correct probabilistic foundations.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为具有非对称误差成本的自主决策代理，比如：招聘（错失人才与浪费面试机会），医疗分诊（错失紧急情况与不必要的升级），以及欺诈检测（批准欺诈与拒绝合法支付）。目前主流的设计是查询单个LLM以获得状态的后验概率，并根据“置信度”设置阈值进行行动；我们证明这种方法不足以应对具有成本的序贯决策。我们提出了一个贝叶斯、成本敏感的多LLM编排框架，将LLM视为近似似然模型，而非分类器。对于每个候选状态，我们通过对比提示引出似然性，利用稳健统计方法聚合来自不同模型的信息，并在显式先验下通过贝叶斯规则更新信念，随着新证据的出现。这使得连贯的信念更新、预期成本行动选择、通过信息价值进行的原则性信息收集，以及通过集成偏见缓解实现公平性提升成为可能。在使用五个LLM（GPT-4o、Claude 4.5 Sonnet、Gemini Pro、Grok、DeepSeek）对1000份简历进行的简历筛选实验中，假设每次错失招聘的成本为40000美元，每次面试的成本为2500美元，每次电话筛选的成本为150美元，我们的方法相比于最佳单LLM基线降低了294000美元（34%）的总成本，并将人口统计均等性提高了45%（最大群体差距从22个百分点降至5个百分点）。消融实验表明，51%的节省归功于多LLM聚合，43%归功于序贯更新，20%归功于由分歧触发的信息收集，这与正确概率基础的理论优势相一致。
tldr: This paper proposes a Bayesian, cost-aware multi-LLM orchestration framework for sequential decision making in settings with asymmetric error costs, demonstrating significant cost reductions and fairness improvements in resume screening compared to single-LLM baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于贝叶斯、成本感知的多LLM编排框架，用于在具有不对称误差成本的环境中进行顺序决策。实验表明，在简历筛选中，与单LLM基线相比，该框架显著降低了成本并提高了公平性。

title: Digital Twin AI: Opportunities and Challenges from Large Language Models to World Models
summary: Digital twins, as precise digital representations of physical systems, have evolved from passive simulation tools into intelligent and autonomous entities through the integration of artificial intelligence technologies. This paper presents a unified four-stage framework that systematically characterizes AI integration across the digital twin lifecycle, spanning modeling, mirroring, intervention, and autonomous management. By synthesizing existing technologies and practices, we distill a unified four-stage framework that systematically characterizes how AI methodologies are embedded across the digital twin lifecycle: (1) modeling the physical twin through physics-based and physics-informed AI approaches, (2) mirroring the physical system into a digital twin with real-time synchronization, (3) intervening in the physical twin through predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and optimization strategies, and (4) achieving autonomous management through large language models, foundation models, and intelligent agents. We analyze the synergy between physics-based modeling and data-driven learning, highlighting the shift from traditional numerical solvers to physics-informed and foundation models for physical systems. Furthermore, we examine how generative AI technologies, including large language models and generative world models, transform digital twins into proactive and self-improving cognitive systems capable of reasoning, communication, and creative scenario generation. Through a cross-domain review spanning eleven application domains, including healthcare, aerospace, smart manufacturing, robotics, and smart cities, we identify common challenges related to scalability, explainability, and trustworthiness, and outline directions for responsible AI-driven digital twin systems.
summary_zh: 数字孪生作为物理系统的精确数字表示，已通过人工智能技术的集成，从被动的模拟工具演变为智能和自主的实体。本文提出了一个统一的四阶段框架，系统地描述了人工智能在数字孪生生命周期中的集成，涵盖建模、镜像、干预和自主管理。通过综合现有技术和实践，我们提炼出一个统一的四阶段框架，系统地描述了人工智能方法如何嵌入到数字孪生生命周期中：（1）通过基于物理和物理信息人工智能的方法对物理孪生进行建模，（2）通过实时同步将物理系统镜像到数字孪生中，（3）通过预测建模、异常检测和优化策略干预物理孪生，以及（4）通过大型语言模型、基础模型和智能体实现自主管理。我们分析了基于物理的建模和数据驱动学习之间的协同作用，强调了从传统数值求解器到物理信息和基础模型的转变。此外，我们研究了生成式人工智能技术，包括大型语言模型和生成式世界模型，如何将数字孪生转变为具有推理、沟通和创造性场景生成能力的主动和自我改进的认知系统。通过跨越医疗保健、航空航天、智能制造、机器人和智慧城市等11个应用领域的跨领域综述，我们识别出与可扩展性、可解释性和可信赖性相关的常见挑战，并概述了负责任的人工智能驱动的数字孪生系统的发展方向。
tldr: This paper proposes a four-stage framework for AI-integrated digital twins, leveraging large language models and world models, and discusses opportunities and challenges across various application domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个AI集成数字孪生的四阶段框架，利用大型语言模型和世界模型，并讨论了跨多个应用领域的机遇与挑战。

title: Warp-Cortex: An Asynchronous, Memory-Efficient Architecture for Million-Agent Cognitive Scaling on Consumer Hardware
summary: Current multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) frameworks suffer from linear memory scaling, rendering "System 2" parallel reasoning impractical on consumer hardware. We present Warp Cortex, an asynchronous architecture that theoretically enables million-agent cognitive scaling by decoupling agent logic from physical memory. Through Singleton Weight Sharing and a novel Topological Synapse--inspired by hybrid landmarking techniques from Topological Data Analysis (TDA)--we reduce memory complexity from O(N * L) to O(1) for weights and O(N * k) for context, where k << L. By treating the KV-cache as a point cloud in latent space, we apply witness-complex-inspired sparsification to preserve persistent homological features of the context manifold. On a single NVIDIA RTX 4090, we empirically demonstrate 100 concurrent agents at 2.2 GB total VRAM, with theoretical capacity exceeding 1,000 agents before compute latency becomes the bottleneck. We further introduce Referential Injection, a non-intrusive KV-cache update mechanism that allows asynchronous sub-agents to influence primary generation without stream disruption.
summary_zh: 当前的多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）框架存在线性内存扩展问题，导致“系统2”并行推理在消费级硬件上无法实际应用。我们提出了Warp Cortex，一种异步架构，通过将智能体逻辑与物理内存解耦，理论上能够实现百万级智能体的认知扩展。通过单例权重共享和一种受拓扑数据分析（TDA）中混合地标技术启发的拓扑突触，我们将权重内存复杂度从O(N * L)降低到O(1)，将上下文内存复杂度降低到O(N * k)，其中k << L。通过将KV-缓存视为潜在空间中的点云，我们应用了受见证复形启发的稀疏化方法，以保留上下文流形的持久同调特征。在单个NVIDIA RTX 4090上，我们通过实验证明了在2.2 GB总VRAM下可并发运行100个智能体，理论容量可超过1,000个智能体，之后计算延迟将成为瓶颈。我们进一步引入了引用注入，一种非侵入式的KV-缓存更新机制，允许异步子智能体在不中断流的情况下影响主要生成。
tldr: Warp-Cortex is a novel architecture for scaling multi-agent LLM systems on consumer hardware by reducing memory complexity using Topological Data Analysis-inspired techniques and asynchronous updates. They demonstrate a system capable of running 100 concurrent agents on a single RTX 4090.
tldr_zh: Warp-Cortex 是一种新颖的架构，通过使用拓扑数据分析技术和异步更新来降低内存复杂性，从而在消费级硬件上扩展多代理 LLM 系统。他们的演示系统能够在单个 RTX 4090 上运行 100 个并发代理。

title: Unified Generation and Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models via Advantage Decoupled Preference Optimization
summary: Parallel test-time scaling typically trains separate generation and verification models, incurring high training and inference costs. We propose Advantage Decoupled Preference Optimization (ADPO), a unified reinforcement learning framework that jointly learns answer generation and self-verification within a single policy. ADPO introduces two innovations: a preference verification reward improving verification capability and a decoupled optimization mechanism enabling synergistic optimization of generation and verification. Specifically, the preference verification reward computes mean verification scores from positive and negative samples as decision thresholds, providing positive feedback when prediction correctness aligns with answer correctness. Meanwhile, the advantage decoupled optimization computes separate advantages for generation and verification, applies token masks to isolate gradients, and combines masked GRPO objectives, preserving generation quality while calibrating verification scores. ADPO achieves up to +34.1% higher verification AUC and -53.5% lower inference time, with significant gains of +2.8%/+1.4% accuracy on MathVista/MMMU, +1.9 cIoU on ReasonSeg, and +1.7%/+1.0% step success rate on AndroidControl/GUI Odyssey.
summary_zh: 并行测试时缩放通常训练分离的生成和验证模型，导致高昂的训练和推理成本。我们提出优势解耦偏好优化（ADPO），一种统一的强化学习框架，在单个策略中联合学习答案生成和自验证。ADPO引入了两项创新：一种提高验证能力的偏好验证奖励，以及一种实现生成和验证协同优化的解耦优化机制。具体而言，偏好验证奖励计算来自正样本和负样本的平均验证分数作为决策阈值，当预测正确性与答案正确性一致时提供正向反馈。同时，优势解耦优化计算生成和验证的独立优势，应用token掩码来隔离梯度，并结合掩码的GRPO目标，在校准验证分数的同时保持生成质量。ADPO实现了高达+34.1%的验证AUC提升和-53.5%的推理时间降低，并在MathVista/MMMU上取得了+2.8%/+1.4%的显著准确率提升，在ReasonSeg上取得了+1.9 cIoU的提升，在AndroidControl/GUI Odyssey上取得了+1.7%/+1.0%的步骤成功率提升。
tldr: This paper introduces Advantage Decoupled Preference Optimization (ADPO), a reinforcement learning framework for jointly training answer generation and self-verification in vision-language models, achieving improved performance and reduced inference time.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了优势解耦偏好优化（ADPO），一个用于在视觉-语言模型中联合训练答案生成和自我验证的强化学习框架，实现了性能提升并减少了推理时间。

title: Online Estimation and Manipulation of Articulated Objects
summary: From refrigerators to kitchen drawers, humans interact with articulated objects effortlessly every day while completing household chores. For automating these tasks, service robots must be capable of manipulating arbitrary articulated objects. Recent deep learning methods have been shown to predict valuable priors on the affordance of articulated objects from vision. In contrast, many other works estimate object articulations by observing the articulation motion, but this requires the robot to already be capable of manipulating the object. In this article, we propose a novel approach combining these methods by using a factor graph for online estimation of articulation which fuses learned visual priors and proprioceptive sensing during interaction into an analytical model of articulation based on Screw Theory. With our method, a robotic system makes an initial prediction of articulation from vision before touching the object, and then quickly updates the estimate from kinematic and force sensing during manipulation. We evaluate our method extensively in both simulations and real-world robotic manipulation experiments. We demonstrate several closed-loop estimation and manipulation experiments in which the robot was capable of opening previously unseen drawers. In real hardware experiments, the robot achieved a 75% success rate for autonomous opening of unknown articulated objects.
summary_zh: 从冰箱到厨房抽屉，人类每天在完成家务时都能毫不费力地与铰接物体互动。为了实现这些任务的自动化，服务机器人必须能够操纵任意铰接物体。最近的深度学习方法已被证明可以从视觉预测铰接物体在可供性方面有价值的先验信息。相比之下，许多其他工作通过观察铰接运动来估计物体铰接，但这要求机器人已经能够操纵该物体。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，该方法结合了这些方法，使用因子图在线估计铰接，将学习到的视觉先验和交互期间的本体感觉融合到基于螺旋理论的铰接解析模型中。通过我们的方法，机器人系统可以在接触物体之前，从视觉初始预测铰接，然后在操纵过程中，从运动学和力觉快速更新估计。我们在仿真和真实世界的机器人操纵实验中广泛评估了我们的方法。我们展示了几个闭环估计和操纵实验，其中机器人能够打开以前未见过的抽屉。在真实硬件实验中，机器人实现了自主打开未知铰接物体75%的成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel approach that combines visual priors and proprioceptive sensing for online estimation and manipulation of articulated objects, enabling robots to interact with and manipulate unseen objects like drawers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法，结合视觉先验和本体感受感应，用于在线估计和操作铰接物体，使机器人能够与未见过的物体（如抽屉）进行交互和操作。

title: SAHA: Supervised Autonomous HArvester for selective forest thinning
summary: Forestry plays a vital role in our society, creating significant ecological, economic, and recreational value. Efficient forest management involves labor-intensive and complex operations. One essential task for maintaining forest health and productivity is selective thinning, which requires skilled operators to remove specific trees to create optimal growing conditions for the remaining ones. In this work, we present a solution based on a small-scale robotic harvester (SAHA) designed for executing this task with supervised autonomy. We build on a 4.5-ton harvester platform and implement key hardware modifications for perception and automatic control. We implement learning- and model-based approaches for precise control of hydraulic actuators, accurate navigation through cluttered environments, robust state estimation, and reliable semantic estimation of terrain traversability. Integrating state-of-the-art techniques in perception, planning, and control, our robotic harvester can autonomously navigate forest environments and reach targeted trees for selective thinning. We present experimental results from extensive field trials over kilometer-long autonomous missions in northern European forests, demonstrating the harvester's ability to operate in real forests. We analyze the performance and provide the lessons learned for advancing robotic forest management.
summary_zh: 林业在我们的社会中发挥着至关重要的作用，创造了重要的生态、经济和娱乐价值。高效的森林管理涉及劳动密集型且复杂的操作。保持森林健康和生产力的一项重要任务是选择性疏伐，这需要熟练的操作人员移除特定的树木，从而为剩余的树木创造最佳生长条件。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于小型机器人采伐机（SAHA）的解决方案，该机器人采伐机旨在通过监督自主执行此任务。我们基于一个4.5吨的采伐机平台，并实施了用于感知和自动控制的关键硬件改造。我们实施了基于学习和基于模型的方法来实现液压执行器的精确控制，在杂乱环境中准确导航，鲁棒的状态估计以及地形可穿越性的可靠语义估计。通过集成感知、规划和控制领域中最先进的技术，我们的机器人采伐机可以自主导航森林环境并到达目标树木进行选择性疏伐。 我们展示了在北欧森林中进行的公里级自主任务的大量现场试验的实验结果，证明了采伐机在真实森林中运行的能力。 我们分析了性能，并为推进机器人森林管理提供了经验教训。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic harvester (SAHA) designed for autonomous selective forest thinning, integrating perception, planning, and control techniques and demonstrating its performance in real-world forest environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于自主选择性森林疏伐的机器人收割机 (SAHA)，它集成了感知、规划和控制技术，并在真实的森林环境中展示了其性能。

title: From Theory of Mind to Theory of Environment: Counterfactual Simulation of Latent Environmental Dynamics
summary: The vertebrate motor system employs dimensionality-reducing strategies to limit the complexity of movement coordination, for efficient motor control. But when environments are dense with hidden action-outcome contingencies, movement complexity can promote behavioral innovation. Humans, perhaps uniquely, may infer the presence of hidden environmental dynamics from social cues, by drawing upon computational mechanisms shared with Theory of Mind. This proposed "Theory of Environment" supports behavioral innovation by expanding the dimensionality of motor exploration.
summary_zh: 脊椎动物运动系统采用降维策略来限制运动协调的复杂性，从而实现高效的运动控制。然而，当环境中充斥着隐藏的行动-结果偶发事件时，运动复杂性可以促进行为创新。人类，或许是独一无二的，可以通过借鉴与心智理论共享的计算机制，从社会线索中推断出隐藏的环境动态。这种被称为“环境理论”的构想通过扩展运动探索的维度来支持行为创新。
tldr: The paper proposes a "Theory of Environment" which is analogous to Theory of Mind, suggesting humans infer hidden environment dynamics from social cues, thereby expanding motor exploration for behavioral innovation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种与心理理论相似的“环境理论”，认为人类可以通过社会线索推断隐藏的环境动态，从而扩展运动探索以实现行为创新。

title: ParkGaussian: Surround-view 3D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Parking
summary: Parking is a critical task for autonomous driving systems (ADS), with unique challenges in crowded parking slots and GPS-denied environments. However, existing works focus on 2D parking slot perception, mapping, and localization, 3D reconstruction remains underexplored, which is crucial for capturing complex spatial geometry in parking scenarios. Naively improving the visual quality of reconstructed parking scenes does not directly benefit autonomous parking, as the key entry point for parking is the slots perception module. To address these limitations, we curate the first benchmark named ParkRecon3D, specifically designed for parking scene reconstruction. It includes sensor data from four surround-view fisheye cameras with calibrated extrinsics and dense parking slot annotations. We then propose ParkGaussian, the first framework that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for parking scene reconstruction. To further improve the alignment between reconstruction and downstream parking slot detection, we introduce a slot-aware reconstruction strategy that leverages existing parking perception methods to enhance the synthesis quality of slot regions. Experiments on ParkRecon3D demonstrate that ParkGaussian achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and better preserves perception consistency for downstream tasks. The code and dataset will be released at: https://github.com/wm-research/ParkGaussian
summary_zh: 泊车是自动驾驶系统（ADS）的一项关键任务，在拥挤的停车位和无GPS环境中面临着独特的挑战。然而，现有工作主要集中于2D停车位感知、地图构建和定位，而3D重建仍有待进一步研究，这对于捕获泊车场景中复杂的空间几何结构至关重要。简单地提高重建泊车场景的视觉质量并不能直接有益于自动泊车，因为泊车的关键入口点是车位感知模块。为了解决这些局限性，我们策划了首个专门为泊车场景重建设计的基准数据集，名为ParkRecon3D。它包括来自四个环视鱼眼摄像头的数据，这些摄像头具有校准的外参和密集的停车位标注。然后，我们提出了ParkGaussian，这是第一个整合了3D高斯溅射（3DGS）用于泊车场景重建的框架。为了进一步改善重建与下游停车位检测之间的一致性，我们引入了一种车位感知重建策略，该策略利用现有的停车感知方法来增强车位区域的合成质量。在ParkRecon3D上的实验表明，ParkGaussian实现了最先进的重建质量，并更好地保持了下游任务的感知一致性。代码和数据集将在以下网址发布：https://github.com/wm-research/ParkGaussian
tldr: The paper introduces ParkGaussian, a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for parking scene reconstruction, along with a new benchmark dataset, ParkRecon3D, designed to improve perception consistency for autonomous parking systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ParkGaussian，一个用于停车场景重建的3D高斯溅射框架，并提出了一个新的基准数据集ParkRecon3D，旨在提高自动泊车系统的感知一致性。

title: KGCE: Knowledge-Augmented Dual-Graph Evaluator for Cross-Platform Educational Agent Benchmarking with Multimodal Language Models
summary: With the rapid adoption of multimodal large language models (MLMs) in autonomous agents, cross-platform task execution capabilities in educational settings have garnered significant attention. However, existing benchmark frameworks still exhibit notable deficiencies in supporting cross-platform tasks in educational contexts, especially when dealing with school-specific software (such as XiaoYa Intelligent Assistant, HuaShi XiaZi, etc.), where the efficiency of agents often significantly decreases due to a lack of understanding of the structural specifics of these private-domain software. Additionally, current evaluation methods heavily rely on coarse-grained metrics like goal orientation or trajectory matching, making it challenging to capture the detailed execution and efficiency of agents in complex tasks. To address these issues, we propose KGCE (Knowledge-Augmented Dual-Graph Evaluator for Cross-Platform Educational Agent Benchmarking with Multimodal Language Models), a novel benchmarking platform that integrates knowledge base enhancement and a dual-graph evaluation framework. We first constructed a dataset comprising 104 education-related tasks, covering Windows, Android, and cross-platform collaborative tasks. KGCE introduces a dual-graph evaluation framework that decomposes tasks into multiple sub-goals and verifies their completion status, providing fine-grained evaluation metrics. To overcome the execution bottlenecks of existing agents in private-domain tasks, we developed an enhanced agent system incorporating a knowledge base specific to school-specific software. The code can be found at https://github.com/Kinginlife/KGCE.
summary_zh: 随着多模态大型语言模型(MLMs)在自主代理中的快速应用，教育场景下的跨平台任务执行能力受到了广泛关注。然而，现有的基准测试框架在支持教育环境下的跨平台任务方面仍然存在显著不足，尤其是在处理学校专用软件（如小雅智能助手、华师匣子等）时，由于缺乏对这些私有领域软件结构具体情况的理解，代理的效率常常大幅降低。此外，目前的评估方法严重依赖于粗粒度的指标，如目标导向或轨迹匹配，使得捕获代理在复杂任务中的详细执行情况和效率具有挑战性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了KGCE（基于知识增强的双图评估器，用于使用多模态语言模型对跨平台教育代理进行基准测试），这是一个集成了知识库增强和双图评估框架的新型基准测试平台。我们首先构建了一个包含104个教育相关任务的数据集，涵盖Windows、Android和跨平台协作任务。KGCE引入了一个双图评估框架，将任务分解为多个子目标，并验证其完成状态，从而提供细粒度的评估指标。为了克服现有代理在私有领域任务中的执行瓶颈，我们开发了一个增强的代理系统，该系统集成了特定于学校专用软件的知识库。代码可在https://github.com/Kinginlife/KGCE找到。
tldr: The paper introduces KGCE, a new benchmarking platform for educational agents that uses a knowledge base and dual-graph evaluation to assess agent performance in cross-platform, school-specific software tasks. It also includes a dataset of 104 education-related tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为KGCE的新型教育智能体基准测试平台，该平台利用知识库和双图评估来评估智能体在跨平台、特定学校软件任务中的性能。它还包括一个包含104个教育相关任务的数据集。

title: Accelerating Monte-Carlo Tree Search with Optimized Posterior Policies
summary:
We introduce a recursive AlphaZero-style Monte--Carlo tree search algorithm, "RMCTS". The advantage of RMCTS over AlphaZero's MCTS-UCB is speed. In RMCTS, the search tree is explored in a breadth-first manner, so that network inferences naturally occur in large batches. This significantly reduces the GPU latency cost. We find that RMCTS is often more than 40 times faster than MCTS-UCB when searching a single root state, and about 3 times faster when searching a large batch of root states.
  The recursion in RMCTS is based on computing optimized posterior policies at each game state in the search tree, starting from the leaves and working back up to the root. Here we use the posterior policy explored in "Monte--Carlo tree search as regularized policy optimization" (Grill, et al.) Their posterior policy is the unique policy which maximizes the expected reward given estimated action rewards minus a penalty for diverging from the prior policy.
  The tree explored by RMCTS is not defined in an adaptive manner, as it is in MCTS-UCB. Instead, the RMCTS tree is defined by following prior network policies at each node. This is a disadvantage, but the speedup advantage is more significant, and in practice we find that RMCTS-trained networks match the quality of MCTS-UCB-trained networks in roughly one-third of the training time. We include timing and quality comparisons of RMCTS vs. MCTS-UCB for three games: Connect-4, Dots-and-Boxes, and Othello.
summary_zh:
我们介绍了一种递归 AlphaZero 风格的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，"RMCTS"。相比于 AlphaZero 的 MCTS-UCB，RMCTS 的优势在于速度。在 RMCTS 中，搜索树以广度优先的方式进行探索，因此网络推断自然地以大批量的方式发生，从而显著降低了 GPU 的延迟成本。我们发现，在搜索单个根状态时，RMCTS 通常比 MCTS-UCB 快 40 倍以上，在搜索大量根状态时，则快大约 3 倍。

RMCTS 中的递归基于计算搜索树中每个游戏状态的优化后验策略，从叶节点开始，向上回溯至根节点。这里我们使用了在“蒙特卡洛树搜索作为正则化策略优化”（Grill 等人）中探索的后验策略。他们的后验策略是唯一一种能够最大化预期奖励的策略，其计算方法为：在给定的估计动作奖励的基础上，减去偏离先验策略的惩罚。

RMCTS 探索的树不是像 MCTS-UCB 那样以自适应的方式定义的。相反，RMCTS 树是通过在每个节点遵循先验网络策略来定义的。这是一个缺点，但速度上的优势更为显著。在实践中，我们发现 RMCTS 训练的网络在约三分之一的训练时间内就能达到 MCTS-UCB 训练网络的质量。我们包含了 RMCTS 与 MCTS-UCB 在三种游戏（四子棋、点格棋和黑白棋）上的计时和质量比较。
tldr: This paper introduces RMCTS, a faster Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm that uses optimized posterior policies and breadth-first search for improved training efficiency in games, achieving comparable network quality to AlphaZero's MCTS-UCB in less time.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种更快的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法RMCTS，它使用优化的后验策略和广度优先搜索，从而提高了在游戏中的训练效率，并且在更短的时间内实现了与AlphaZero的MCTS-UCB相当的网络质量。

title: Language as Prior, Vision as Calibration: Metric Scale Recovery for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Relative-depth foundation models transfer well, yet monocular metric depth remains ill-posed due to unidentifiable global scale and heightened domain-shift sensitivity. Under a frozen-backbone calibration setting, we recover metric depth via an image-specific affine transform in inverse depth and train only lightweight calibration heads while keeping the relative-depth backbone and the CLIP text encoder fixed. Since captions provide coarse but noisy scale cues that vary with phrasing and missing objects, we use language to predict an uncertainty-aware envelope that bounds feasible calibration parameters in an unconstrained space, rather than committing to a text-only point estimate. We then use pooled multi-scale frozen visual features to select an image-specific calibration within this envelope. During training, a closed-form least-squares oracle in inverse depth provides per-image supervision for learning the envelope and the selected calibration. Experiments on NYUv2 and KITTI improve in-domain accuracy, while zero-shot transfer to SUN-RGBD and DDAD demonstrates improved robustness over strong language-only baselines.
summary_zh: 相对深度基础模型具有良好的迁移性，但单目度量深度仍然是不适定的，因为存在无法识别的全局尺度以及对领域转移的高度敏感性。在冻结主干网络的校准设置下，我们在逆深度空间中通过图像特定的仿射变换恢复度量深度，并且仅训练轻量级的校准头，同时保持相对深度主干网络和CLIP文本编码器固定。由于文本描述提供粗糙但有噪声的尺度线索，它们会随着措辞和缺失对象而变化，因此我们使用语言来预测一个不确定性感知的包络，该包络在无约束空间中限定可行的校准参数，而不是仅依赖文本的点估计。然后，我们使用池化的多尺度冻结视觉特征在这个包络内选择图像特定的校准。在训练过程中，逆深度空间中的闭合形式最小二乘预言机为包络和选定的校准的学习提供逐图像的监督。在NYUv2和KITTI上的实验提高了域内精度，而零样本迁移到SUN-RGBD和DDAD则证明了相对于仅使用语言的强大基线，鲁棒性得到了提高。
tldr: The paper presents a method to recover metric depth from monocular images by using language and visual cues to calibrate relative-depth foundation models, improving accuracy and robustness in both in-domain and zero-shot settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过使用语言和视觉线索校准相对深度基础模型，从单目图像中恢复度量深度的方法，从而提高了领域内和零样本设置中的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Towards LLM-enabled autonomous combustion research: A literature-aware agent for self-corrective modeling workflows
summary: The rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs) is transforming artificial intelligence into autonomous research partners, yet a critical gap persists in complex scientific domains such as combustion modeling. Here, practical AI assistance requires the seamless integration of domain literature knowledge with robust execution capabilities for expertise-intensive tools such as computational fluid dynamics (CFD) codes. To bridge this gap, we introduce FlamePilot, an LLM agent designed to empower combustion modeling research through automated and self-corrective CFD workflows. FlamePilot differentiates itself through an architecture that leverages atomic tools to ensure the robust setup and execution of complex simulations in both OpenFOAM and extended frameworks such as DeepFlame. The system is also capable of learning from scientific articles, extracting key information to guide the simulation from initial setup to optimized results. Validation on a public benchmark shows FlamePilot achieved a perfect 1.0 executability score and a 0.438 success rate, surpassing the prior best reported agent scores of 0.625 and 0.250, respectively. Furthermore, a detailed case study on Moderate or Intense Low-oxygen Dilution (MILD) combustion simulation demonstrates its efficacy as a collaborative research copilot, where FlamePilot autonomously translated a research paper into a configured simulation, conducted the simulation, post-processed the results, proposed evidence-based refinements, and managed a multi-step parameter study to convergence under minimal human intervention. By adopting a transparent and interpretable paradigm, FlamePilot establishes a foundational framework for AI-empowered combustion modeling, fostering a collaborative partnership where the agent manages workflow orchestration, freeing the researcher for high-level analysis.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的快速发展正在将人工智能转变为自主研究伙伴，但在燃烧建模等复杂的科学领域，仍然存在一个关键缺口。在这里，实用的人工智能辅助需要将领域文献知识与计算流体动力学 (CFD) 代码等专业密集型工具的强大执行能力无缝集成。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了 FlamePilot，一款 LLM 代理，旨在通过自动化和自我纠正的 CFD 工作流程来增强燃烧建模研究。FlamePilot 的独特之处在于其架构，该架构利用原子工具来确保在 OpenFOAM 和 DeepFlame 等扩展框架中稳健地设置和执行复杂模拟。该系统还能够从科学文章中学习，提取关键信息，从初始设置到优化结果指导模拟。在一个公共基准上的验证表明，FlamePilot 达到了完美的 1.0 可执行性得分和 0.438 的成功率，超过了之前报告的最佳代理得分，分别为 0.625 和 0.250。此外，对中度或强度低氧稀释 (MILD) 燃烧模拟的详细案例研究表明了其作为协作研究副驾驶的有效性，其中 FlamePilot 在最少的人工干预下，自主地将一篇研究论文转化为配置好的模拟，进行模拟，对结果进行后处理，提出基于证据的优化建议，并管理一个多步骤的参数研究直至收敛。通过采用透明且可解释的范式，FlamePilot 为人工智能赋能的燃烧建模建立了一个基础框架，促进了一种协作伙伴关系，其中代理管理工作流程的编排，使研究人员能够专注于高层次的分析。
tldr: The paper introduces FlamePilot, an LLM agent that automates and self-corrects CFD workflows for combustion modeling, achieving superior performance on benchmark tasks and demonstrating its efficacy in MILD combustion simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为FlamePilot的LLM agent，它可以自动化和自我纠正燃烧建模的CFD工作流程，在基准测试任务上取得了优异的性能，并展示了其在MILD燃烧模拟中的有效性。

title: Sampling Strategy Design for Model Predictive Path Integral Control on Legged Robot Locomotion
summary: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control has emerged as a powerful sampling-based optimal control method for complex, nonlinear, and high-dimensional systems. However, directly applying MPPI to legged robotic systems presents several challenges. This paper systematically investigates the role of sampling strategy design within the MPPI framework for legged robot locomotion. Based upon the idea of structured control parameterization, we explore and compare multiple sampling strategies within the framework, including both unstructured and spline-based approaches. Through extensive simulations on a quadruped robot platform, we evaluate how different sampling strategies affect control smoothness, task performance, robustness, and sample efficiency. The results provide new insights into the practical implications of sampling design for deploying MPPI on complex legged systems.
summary_zh: 模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制已成为一种强大的基于采样的最优控制方法，适用于复杂、非线性和高维系统。然而，直接将MPPI应用于腿式机器人系统面临若干挑战。本文系统性地研究了在MPPI框架下采样策略设计对腿式机器人运动的作用。基于结构化控制参数化的思想，我们在框架内探索并比较了多种采样策略，包括非结构化和基于样条的方法。通过在四足机器人平台上的大量仿真，我们评估了不同的采样策略如何影响控制平滑性、任务性能、鲁棒性和采样效率。结果为采样设计在复杂腿式系统上部署MPPI的实际意义提供了新的见解。
tldr: This paper explores different sampling strategies within the Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control framework for legged robot locomotion, evaluating their impact on control smoothness, performance, robustness, and sample efficiency through simulations. It provides insights into the practical implications of sampling design for MPPI on complex legged systems.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制框架中不同的采样策略，用于腿式机器人运动，并通过仿真评估它们对控制平滑度、性能、鲁棒性和采样效率的影响。 该研究为复杂腿式系统中MPPI的采样设计提供了实践指导。

title: Rethinking Multimodal Few-Shot 3D Point Cloud Segmentation: From Fused Refinement to Decoupled Arbitration
summary: In this paper, we revisit multimodal few-shot 3D point cloud semantic segmentation (FS-PCS), identifying a conflict in "Fuse-then-Refine" paradigms: the "Plasticity-Stability Dilemma." In addition, CLIP's inter-class confusion can result in semantic blindness. To address these issues, we present the Decoupled-experts Arbitration Few-Shot SegNet (DA-FSS), a model that effectively distinguishes between semantic and geometric paths and mutually regularizes their gradients to achieve better generalization. DA-FSS employs the same backbone and pre-trained text encoder as MM-FSS to generate text embeddings, which can increase free modalities' utilization rate and better leverage each modality's information space. To achieve this, we propose a Parallel Expert Refinement module to generate each modal correlation. We also propose a Stacked Arbitration Module (SAM) to perform convolutional fusion and arbitrate correlations for each modality pathway. The Parallel Experts decouple two paths: a Geometric Expert maintains plasticity, and a Semantic Expert ensures stability. They are coordinated via a Decoupled Alignment Module (DAM) that transfers knowledge without propagating confusion. Experiments on popular datasets (S3DIS, ScanNet) demonstrate the superiority of DA-FSS over MM-FSS. Meanwhile, geometric boundaries, completeness, and texture differentiation are all superior to the baseline. The code is available at: https://github.com/MoWenQAQ/DA-FSS.
summary_zh: 本文重新审视了多模态少样本3D点云语义分割(FS-PCS)问题，并识别出“融合-细化”范式中的一个冲突：“可塑性-稳定性困境”。此外，CLIP 的类间混淆可能导致语义盲视。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了解耦专家仲裁少样本分割网络(DA-FSS)，该模型有效地区分了语义和几何路径，并相互正则化它们的梯度，以实现更好的泛化能力。 DA-FSS 采用与 MM-FSS 相同的骨干网络和预训练文本编码器来生成文本嵌入，这可以提高自由模态的利用率，并更好地利用每个模态的信息空间。为此，我们提出了一种并行专家细化模块，用于生成每个模态的相关性。我们还提出了一种堆叠仲裁模块 (SAM)，用于执行卷积融合和仲裁每个模态路径的相关性。并行专家解耦了两个路径：几何专家维持可塑性，而语义专家确保稳定性。 它们通过解耦对齐模块（DAM）进行协调，该模块传递知识而不传播混淆。 在流行数据集（S3DIS、ScanNet）上的实验表明，DA-FSS 优于 MM-FSS。 同时，几何边界、完整性和纹理区分都优于基线。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/MoWenQAQ/DA-FSS。
tldr: The paper introduces DA-FSS, a novel architecture for multimodal few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation that decouples semantic and geometric pathways to address the "Plasticity-Stability Dilemma" and inter-class confusion, demonstrating improved performance on standard datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为DA-FSS的新型多模态少样本3D点云分割架构，该架构解耦了语义和几何路径，以解决“可塑性-稳定性困境”和类别间的混淆，并在标准数据集上展示了改进的性能。

title: AIMS: An Adaptive Integration of Multi-Sensor Measurements for Quadrupedal Robot Localization
summary: This paper addresses the problem of accurate localization for quadrupedal robots operating in narrow tunnel-like environments. Due to the long and homogeneous characteristics of such scenarios, LiDAR measurements often provide weak geometric constraints, making traditional sensor fusion methods susceptible to accumulated motion estimation errors. To address these challenges, we propose AIMS, an adaptive LiDAR-IMU-leg odometry fusion method for robust quadrupedal robot localization in degenerate environments. The proposed method is formulated within an error-state Kalman filtering framework, where LiDAR and leg odometry measurements are integrated with IMU-based state prediction, and measurement noise covariance matrices are adaptively adjusted based on online degeneracy-aware reliability assessment. Experimental results obtained in narrow corridor environments demonstrate that the proposed method improves localization accuracy and robustness compared with state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_zh: 本文旨在解决四足机器人于狭长的隧道状环境中进行精确定位的问题。由于该类场景具有细长且同质的特征，激光雷达测量通常提供较弱的几何约束，使得传统的传感器融合方法容易受到累积运动估计误差的影响。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种自适应的激光雷达-IMU-腿部里程计融合方法AIMS，用于增强退化环境中四足机器人的鲁棒定位能力。 该方法构建于误差状态卡尔曼滤波框架内，集成了激光雷达和腿部里程计测量结果与基于IMU的状态预测，并基于在线的退化感知可靠性评估自适应地调整测量噪声协方差矩阵。在狭窄走廊环境中获得的实验结果表明，与最先进的方法相比，所提出的方法提高了定位精度和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces AIMS, an adaptive LiDAR-IMU-leg odometry fusion method, using an error-state Kalman filter with adaptive noise covariance adjustment for robust quadrupedal robot localization in challenging, degenerate environments like tunnels.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为AIMS的自适应激光雷达-IMU-腿部里程计融合方法，使用误差状态卡尔曼滤波器和自适应噪声协方差调整，用于在隧道等退化环境中实现鲁棒的四足机器人定位。

title: Sim2Real SAR Image Restoration: Metadata-Driven Models for Joint Despeckling and Sidelobes Reduction
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) provides valuable information about the Earth's surface under all weather and illumination conditions. However, the inherent phenomenon of speckle and the presence of sidelobes around bright targets pose challenges for accurate interpretation of SAR imagery. Most existing SAR image restoration methods address despeckling and sidelobes reduction as separate tasks. In this paper, we propose a unified framework that jointly performs both tasks using neural networks (NNs) trained on a realistic SAR simulated dataset generated with MOCEM. Inference can then be performed on real SAR images, demonstrating effective simulation to real (Sim2Real) transferability. Additionally, we incorporate acquisition metadata as auxiliary input to the NNs, demonstrating improved restoration performance.
summary_zh: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）能够提供在所有天气和光照条件下关于地球表面的宝贵信息。但固有存在的相干斑噪声以及明亮目标周围的旁瓣给SAR图像的精确解读带来了挑战。现有的大多数SAR图像复原方法将去相干斑和旁瓣抑制作为独立的任务来处理。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的框架，该框架利用在用MOCEM生成的逼真SAR模拟数据集上训练的神经网络（NNs）来联合执行这两个任务。随后可在真实的SAR图像上进行推理，展示了有效的从仿真到真实（Sim2Real）的迁移能力。此外，我们将采集元数据作为辅助输入融入到神经网络中，从而证明了复原性能的提升。
tldr: This paper introduces a Sim2Real framework for joint despeckling and sidelobe reduction in SAR images using metadata-driven neural networks, trained on a realistic simulated dataset. It demonstrates improved restoration performance by incorporating acquisition metadata.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种Sim2Real框架，通过使用元数据驱动的神经网络，在逼真的模拟数据集上训练，用于合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像的联合去斑和旁瓣减少。它展示了通过结合采集元数据来提高图像恢复性能。

title: Garment Inertial Denoiser (GID): Endowing Accurate Motion Capture via Loose IMU Denoiser
summary: Wearable inertial motion capture (MoCap) provides a portable, occlusion-free, and privacy-preserving alternative to camera-based systems, but its accuracy depends on tightly attached sensors - an intrusive and uncomfortable requirement for daily use. Embedding IMUs into loose-fitting garments is a desirable alternative, yet sensor-body displacement introduces severe, structured, and location-dependent corruption that breaks standard inertial pipelines. We propose GID (Garment Inertial Denoiser), a lightweight, plug-and-play Transformer that factorizes loose-wear MoCap into three stages: (i) location-specific denoising, (ii) adaptive cross-wear fusion, and (iii) general pose prediction. GID uses a location-aware expert architecture, where a shared spatio-temporal backbone models global motion while per-IMU expert heads specialize in local garment dynamics, and a lightweight fusion module ensures cross-part consistency. This inductive bias enables stable training and effective learning from limited paired loose-tight IMU data. We also introduce GarMoCap, a combined public and newly collected dataset covering diverse users, motions, and garments. Experiments show that GID enables accurate, real-time denoising from single-user training and generalizes across unseen users, motions, and garment types, consistently improving state-of-the-art inertial MoCap methods when used as a drop-in module.
summary_zh: 可穿戴惯性运动捕捉(MoCap)系统提供了一种便携、无遮挡且保护隐私的替代方案，相比于基于摄像头的系统，但其精度依赖于紧密贴合的传感器——这对于日常使用来说是一种侵入式且不舒适的要求。将IMU嵌入到宽松的服装中是一种理想的替代方案，然而，传感器与身体的位移会引入严重的、结构化的且位置相关的噪声，这破坏了标准的惯性流程。我们提出GID（服装惯性去噪器），一个轻量级的、即插即用的Transformer，它将宽松服装的MoCap分解为三个阶段: (i) 位置特定的去噪，(ii) 自适应的跨服装融合，以及 (iii) 通用姿态预测。GID使用了一种位置感知的专家架构，其中共享的时空主干网络对全局运动进行建模，而每个IMU的专家头专注于局部服装动力学，并且一个轻量级的融合模块确保了跨部件的一致性。这种归纳偏置能够实现稳定的训练，并能从有限的松紧IMU配对数据中进行有效的学习。我们还引入了GarMoCap，一个结合了公开和新收集的数据集，涵盖了不同的用户、运动和服装。实验表明，GID能够从单用户训练中实现准确的实时去噪，并推广到未见过的用户、运动和服装类型，在作为即插即用模块使用时，持续改进最先进的惯性MoCap方法。
tldr: The paper introduces GID, a Transformer-based method for denoising inertial motion capture data from loose-fitting garments, enabling more comfortable and accurate motion tracking in wearable devices. It also presents a new dataset, GarMoCap.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GID，一种基于Transformer的方法，用于消除来自宽松服装的惯性运动捕捉数据中的噪声，从而在可穿戴设备中实现更舒适和准确的运动跟踪。它还提出了一个新的数据集GarMoCap。

title: CONSENT: A Negotiation Framework for Leveraging User Flexibility in Vehicle-to-Building Charging under Uncertainty
summary: The growth of Electric Vehicles (EVs) creates a conflict in vehicle-to-building (V2B) settings between building operators, who face high energy costs from uncoordinated charging, and drivers, who prioritize convenience and a full charge. To resolve this, we propose a negotiation-based framework that, by design, guarantees voluntary participation, strategy-proofness, and budget feasibility. It transforms EV charging into a strategic resource by offering drivers a range of incentive-backed options for modest flexibility in their departure time or requested state of charge (SoC). Our framework is calibrated with user survey data and validated using real operational data from a commercial building and an EV manufacturer. Simulations show that our negotiation protocol creates a mutually beneficial outcome: lowering the building operator's costs by over 3.5\% compared to an optimized, non-negotiating smart charging policy, while simultaneously reducing user charging expenses by 22\% below the utility's retail energy rate. By aligning operator and EV user objectives, our framework provides a strategic bridge between energy and mobility systems, transforming EV charging from a source of operational friction into a platform for collaboration and shared savings.
summary_zh: 电动汽车的增长在车-楼互动（V2B）场景中造成了建筑运营商（面临由无协调充电导致的高能源成本）和车主（优先考虑便利性和完全充电）之间的冲突。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于协商的框架，该框架设计上保证了自愿参与、策略免疫性和预算可行性。它通过为车主提供一系列基于激励的选择，以换取其出发时间或所需充电状态（SoC）的适度灵活性，将电动汽车充电转变为一种战略资源。我们的框架通过用户调查数据进行校准，并使用来自商业建筑和电动汽车制造商的真实运营数据进行验证。仿真结果表明，我们的协商协议创造了一个互惠互利的结果：与优化的非协商智能充电策略相比，建筑运营商的成本降低了 3.5% 以上，同时用户充电费用也比公用事业公司的零售能源价格降低了 22%。通过协调运营商和电动汽车用户的目标，我们的框架在能源和交通系统之间架起了一座战略桥梁，将电动汽车充电从运营摩擦的来源转变为协作和共享节约的平台。
tldr: The paper introduces a negotiation framework called CONSENT to optimize EV charging in V2B settings by incentivizing users to be flexible with charging times, leading to cost savings for both building operators and EV users.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为CONSENT的协商框架，通过激励用户灵活安排充电时间，优化V2B环境中的电动汽车充电，从而为建筑物运营商和电动汽车用户节省成本。

title: A Novel Deep Learning Method for Segmenting the Left Ventricle in Cardiac Cine MRI
summary: This research aims to develop a novel deep learning network, GBU-Net, utilizing a group-batch-normalized U-Net framework, specifically designed for the precise semantic segmentation of the left ventricle in short-axis cine MRI scans. The methodology includes a down-sampling pathway for feature extraction and an up-sampling pathway for detail restoration, enhanced for medical imaging. Key modifications include techniques for better contextual understanding crucial in cardiac MRI segmentation. The dataset consists of 805 left ventricular MRI scans from 45 patients, with comparative analysis using established metrics such as the dice coefficient and mean perpendicular distance. GBU-Net significantly improves the accuracy of left ventricle segmentation in cine MRI scans. Its innovative design outperforms existing methods in tests, surpassing standard metrics like the dice coefficient and mean perpendicular distance. The approach is unique in its ability to capture contextual information, often missed in traditional CNN-based segmentation. An ensemble of the GBU-Net attains a 97% dice score on the SunnyBrook testing dataset. GBU-Net offers enhanced precision and contextual understanding in left ventricle segmentation for surgical robotics and medical analysis.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在开发一种新型深度学习网络GBU-Net，该网络采用组批归一化U-Net框架，专门设计用于短轴电影MRI扫描图像中左心室的精确语义分割。该方法包括用于特征提取的下采样路径和用于细节恢复的上采样路径，并针对医学影像进行了增强。关键修改包括用于更好地理解心脏MRI分割中关键上下文的技术。数据集包含来自45名患者的805例左心室MRI扫描图像，并使用诸如Dice系数和平均垂直距离等既定指标进行比较分析。GBU-Net显著提高了电影MRI扫描图像中左心室分割的准确性。其创新设计在测试中优于现有方法，超越了诸如Dice系数和平均垂直距离等标准指标。该方法的独特之处在于其能够捕获传统基于CNN的分割经常遗漏的上下文信息。GBU-Net的集成在SunnyBrook测试数据集上获得了97%的Dice系数。GBU-Net为外科机器人和医学分析提供了增强的左心室分割精度和上下文理解能力。
tldr: The paper introduces GBU-Net, a novel deep learning architecture for precise left ventricle segmentation in cardiac cine MRI, achieving high accuracy and contextual understanding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GBU-Net的新型深度学习架构，用于精确分割心脏电影MRI中的左心室，实现了高精度和上下文理解。

title: Unsupervised SE(3) Disentanglement for in situ Macromolecular Morphology Identification from Cryo-Electron Tomography
summary: Cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) provides direct 3D visualization of macromolecules inside the cell, enabling analysis of their in situ morphology. This morphology can be regarded as an SE(3)-invariant, denoised volumetric representation of subvolumes extracted from tomograms. Inferring morphology is therefore an inverse problem of estimating both a template morphology and its SE(3) transformation. Existing expectation-maximization based solution to this problem often misses rare but important morphologies and requires extensive manual hyperparameter tuning. Addressing this issue, we present a disentangled deep representation learning framework that separates SE(3) transformations from morphological content in the representation space. The framework includes a novel multi-choice learning module that enables this disentanglement for highly noisy cryo-ET data, and the learned morphological content is used to generate template morphologies. Experiments on simulated and real cryo-ET datasets demonstrate clear improvements over prior methods, including the discovery of previously unidentified macromolecular morphologies.
summary_zh: 冷冻电镜断层扫描（cryo-ET）能够直接对细胞内的大分子进行3D可视化，从而分析它们的体内形态。这种形态可以被视为从断层扫描图中提取的子体积的SE(3)不变、去噪的体积表示。因此，推断形态是一个反问题，即估计模板形态及其SE(3)变换。现有的基于期望最大化（expectation-maximization）的解决方案通常会遗漏罕见但重要的形态，并且需要大量的人工超参数调整。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种解耦的深度表示学习框架，将SE(3)变换与表示空间中的形态内容分离开来。该框架包含一种新颖的多选学习模块，能够为高度嘈杂的cryo-ET数据实现这种解耦，并且学习到的形态内容用于生成模板形态。在模拟和真实的cryo-ET数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法相对于先前的方法有明显的改进，包括发现了以前未鉴定的大分子形态。
tldr: This paper introduces a disentangled deep learning framework for identifying macromolecular morphologies from cryo-ET data by separating SE(3) transformations from morphological content, demonstrating improvements over existing methods and discovering previously unidentified morphologies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种解耦的深度学习框架，用于从冷冻电镜数据中识别大分子形态，通过将SE(3)转换与形态内容分离，该方法优于现有方法，并发现了以前未识别的形态。

title: An Energy-Efficient Smart Bus Transport Management System with Blind-Spot Collision Detection Ability
summary: Public bus transport systems in developing countries often suffer from a lack of real-time location updates and for users, making commuting inconvenient and unreliable for passengers. Furthermore, stopping at undesired locations rather than designated bus stops creates safety risks and contributes to roadblocks, often causing traffic congestion. Additionally, issues such as blind spots, along with a lack of following traffic laws, increase the chances of accidents. In this work, we address these challenges by proposing a smart public bus system along with intelligent bus stops that enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability. Our approach includes a deep learning-based blind-spot warning system to help drivers avoid accidents with automated bus-stop detection to accurately identify bus stops, improving transit efficiency. We also introduce IoT-based solar-powered smart bus stops that show real-time passenger counts, along with an RFID-based card system to track where passengers board and exit. A smart door system ensures safer and more organised boarding, while real-time bus tracking keeps passengers informed. To connect all these features, we use an HTTP-based server for seamless communication between the interconnected network systems. Our proposed system demonstrated approximately 99% efficiency in real-time blind spot detection while stopping precisely at the bus stops. Furthermore, the server showed real-time location updates both to the users and at the bus stops, enhancing commuting efficiency. The proposed energy-efficient bus stop demonstrated 12.71kWh energy saving, promoting sustainable architecture. Full implementation and source code are available at: https://github.com/sadman-adib/MoveMe-IoT
summary_zh: 发展中国家的公共汽车运输系统常常缺乏实时定位更新，这使得乘客的通勤不便且不可靠。此外，在非指定公交站点停车会带来安全风险，并导致道路堵塞，进而引发交通拥堵。同时，盲点以及不遵守交通规则亦增加了事故发生的可能性。本文旨在解决上述挑战，并提出一种结合智能公交站点和智能公共汽车系统的方法，以提高安全性、效率和可持续性。我们的方案包括一个基于深度学习的盲点预警系统，以帮助驾驶员避免事故，以及用于精确识别公交站点的自动化站点检测，从而提高运输效率。我们还引入了基于物联网的太阳能智能公交站点，该站点可显示实时乘客数量，并采用基于RFID的卡片系统来追踪乘客的上下车位置。一个智能车门系统确保了更安全、更有序的乘车，而实时公交车追踪则能让乘客随时掌握信息。为了连接所有这些功能，我们使用基于HTTP的服务器来实现互连网络系统之间的无缝通信。我们的系统在盲点实时检测方面表现出约99%的效率，并且能够精确地在公交站点停车。此外，该服务器能够向用户和公交站点同时显示实时位置更新，从而提高通勤效率。所提出的节能型公交站点经证明可节省12.71千瓦时的能量，从而促进可持续建筑的发展。完整的实施和源代码可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/sadman-adib/MoveMe-IoT
tldr: This paper proposes a smart public bus system with features like blind-spot detection, automated bus-stop detection, solar-powered smart bus stops, and real-time tracking to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability. The system achieves high accuracy in blind spot and bus stop detection and improves energy efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种智能公共汽车系统，具有盲点检测、自动站点检测、太阳能智能公交站和实时跟踪等功能，旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性。该系统在盲点和公交站点检测方面实现了高精度，并提高了能源效率。

title: Robust Ship Detection and Tracking Using Modified ViBe and Backwash Cancellation Algorithm
summary: In this paper, we propose a robust real time detection and tracking method for detecting ships in a coastal video sequences. Since coastal scenarios are unpredictable and scenes have dynamic properties it is essential to apply detection methods that are robust to these conditions. This paper presents modified ViBe for moving object detection which detects ships and backwash. In the modified ViBe the probability of losing ships is decreased in comparison with the original ViBe. It is robust to natural sea waves and variation of lights and is capable of quickly updating the background. Based on geometrical properties of ship and some concepts such as brightness distortion, a new method for backwash cancellation is proposed. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed strategy and methods have outstanding performance in ship detection and tracking. These results also illustrate real time and precise performance of the proposed strategy.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的实时检测和跟踪方法，用于检测沿海视频序列中的船舶。由于沿海场景具有不可预测性和动态特性，因此应用对这些条件具有鲁棒性的检测方法至关重要。本文提出了一种改进的ViBe算法用于运动目标检测，可以检测船舶和回浪。与原始ViBe相比，改进的ViBe降低了丢失船舶的概率。它对自然海浪和光线变化具有鲁棒性，并能够快速更新背景。基于船舶的几何属性和一些概念，如亮度畸变，本文提出了一种新的回浪消除方法。实验结果表明，所提出的策略和方法在船舶检测和跟踪方面具有优异的性能。这些结果也证明了所提出的策略具有实时性和精确性。
tldr: This paper proposes a robust method for real-time ship detection and tracking in coastal videos using a modified ViBe algorithm and a backwash cancellation technique, claiming improved performance in dynamic coastal environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的实时船舶检测与跟踪方法，用于在沿海视频中检测船舶。该方法使用改进的ViBe算法和回浪消除技术，声称在动态沿海环境中具有更好的性能。

title: CycleVLA: Proactive Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Models via Subtask Backtracking and Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
summary: Current work on robot failure detection and correction typically operate in a post hoc manner, analyzing errors and applying corrections only after failures occur. This work introduces CycleVLA, a system that equips Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) with proactive self-correction, the capability to anticipate incipient failures and recover before they fully manifest during execution. CycleVLA achieves this by integrating a progress-aware VLA that flags critical subtask transition points where failures most frequently occur, a VLM-based failure predictor and planner that triggers subtask backtracking upon predicted failure, and a test-time scaling strategy based on Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding to improve retry success after backtracking. Extensive experiments show that CycleVLA improves performance for both well-trained and under-trained VLAs, and that MBR serves as an effective zero-shot test-time scaling strategy for VLAs. Project Page: https://dannymcy.github.io/cyclevla/
summary_zh: 目前关于机器人故障检测和纠正的研究通常以事后方式进行，即在故障发生后才分析错误并应用纠正措施。本文介绍 CycleVLA，一个为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）配备了主动自纠正能力的系统，使其能够预测早期故障并在执行过程中完全显现之前恢复。CycleVLA通过整合以下组件实现此目标：一个感知进度的VLA，标记出故障最常发生的关键子任务转换点；一个基于VLM的故障预测器和规划器，在预测到故障时触发子任务的回溯；以及一种基于最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码的测试时缩放策略，以提高回溯后的重试成功率。大量实验表明，CycleVLA提高了训练良好和训练不足的VLAs的性能，并且MBR作为VLAs的有效零样本测试时缩放策略。项目页面：https://dannymcy.github.io/cyclevla/
tldr: CycleVLA introduces a proactive failure correction system for Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) that anticipates failures, backtracks to critical subtasks, and uses Minimum Bayes Risk decoding to improve success rates. This improves the performance of VLAs, even when undertrained.
tldr_zh: CycleVLA 引入了一个主动的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）失败纠正系统，该系统可以预测失败，回溯到关键子任务，并使用最小贝叶斯风险解码来提高成功率。 即使在训练不足的情况下，也能提高 VLA 的性能。

title: Genie Sim 3.0 : A High-Fidelity Comprehensive Simulation Platform for Humanoid Robot
summary: The development of robust and generalizable robot learning models is critically contingent upon the availability of large-scale, diverse training data and reliable evaluation benchmarks. Collecting data in the physical world poses prohibitive costs and scalability challenges, and prevailing simulation benchmarks frequently suffer from fragmentation, narrow scope, or insufficient fidelity to enable effective sim-to-real transfer. To address these challenges, we introduce Genie Sim 3.0, a unified simulation platform for robotic manipulation. We present Genie Sim Generator, a large language model (LLM)-powered tool that constructs high-fidelity scenes from natural language instructions. Its principal strength resides in rapid and multi-dimensional generalization, facilitating the synthesis of diverse environments to support scalable data collection and robust policy evaluation. We introduce the first benchmark that pioneers the application of LLM for automated evaluation. It leverages LLM to mass-generate evaluation scenarios and employs Vision-Language Model (VLM) to establish an automated assessment pipeline. We also release an open-source dataset comprising more than 10,000 hours of synthetic data across over 200 tasks. Through systematic experimentation, we validate the robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer capability of our open-source dataset, demonstrating that synthetic data can server as an effective substitute for real-world data under controlled conditions for scalable policy training. For code and dataset details, please refer to: https://github.com/AgibotTech/genie_sim.
summary_zh: 稳健且具有泛化能力的机器人学习模型的开发，关键在于大规模、多样化的训练数据和可靠的评估基准。 在物理世界中收集数据面临着高昂的成本和可扩展性挑战，而目前流行的模拟基准通常存在碎片化、范围狭窄或保真度不足等问题，无法实现有效的由模拟到现实的迁移。 为了解决这些挑战，我们推出了Genie Sim 3.0，一个用于机器人操作的统一模拟平台。 我们展示了Genie Sim Generator，一个由大型语言模型(LLM)驱动的工具，可以从自然语言指令构建高保真的场景。 它的主要优势在于快速和多维度的泛化能力，能够促进多样化环境的合成，从而支持可扩展的数据收集和稳健的策略评估。 我们推出了首个利用LLM进行自动化评估的基准。 该基准利用LLM大规模生成评估场景，并采用视觉语言模型(VLM)建立自动评估流程。 我们还发布了一个包含超过200项任务的、超过1万小时合成数据的开源数据集。 通过系统的实验，我们验证了我们开源数据集强大的零样本由模拟到现实的迁移能力，表明在受控条件下，合成数据可以作为真实世界数据的有效替代品，从而可用于可扩展的策略训练。 代码和数据集详情请参考：https://github.com/AgibotTech/genie_sim。
tldr: The paper introduces Genie Sim 3.0, a novel simulation platform for robotics that leverages LLMs for scene generation and automated evaluation, and demonstrates promising sim-to-real transfer with a large, open-source synthetic dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Genie Sim 3.0，这是一个新颖的机器人仿真平台，利用 LLM 进行场景生成和自动评估，并通过大型开源合成数据集展示了有前景的 sim-to-real 迁移。

title: MMP-A*: Multimodal Perception Enhanced Incremental Heuristic Search on Path Planning
summary:
Autonomous path planning requires a synergy between global reasoning and geometric precision, especially in complex or cluttered environments. While classical A* is valued for its optimality, it incurs prohibitive computational and memory costs in large-scale scenarios. Recent attempts to mitigate these limitations by using Large Language Models for waypoint guidance remain insufficient, as they rely only on text-based reasoning without spatial grounding. As a result, such models often produce incorrect waypoints in topologically complex environments with dead ends, and lack the perceptual capacity to interpret ambiguous physical boundaries. These inconsistencies lead to costly corrective expansions and undermine the intended computational efficiency.
  We introduce MMP-A*, a multimodal framework that integrates the spatial grounding capabilities of vision-language models with a novel adaptive decay mechanism. By anchoring high-level reasoning in physical geometry, the framework produces coherent waypoint guidance that addresses the limitations of text-only planners. The adaptive decay mechanism dynamically regulates the influence of uncertain waypoints within the heuristic, ensuring geometric validity while substantially reducing memory overhead. To evaluate robustness, we test the framework in challenging environments characterized by severe clutter and topological complexity. Experimental results show that MMP-A* achieves near-optimal trajectories with significantly reduced operational costs, demonstrating its potential as a perception-grounded and computationally efficient paradigm for autonomous navigation.
summary_zh:
自主路径规划需要全局推理和几何精度之间的协同作用，尤其是在复杂或杂乱的环境中。经典A*算法因其最优性而备受重视，但在大规模场景中会产生过高的计算和内存成本。最近尝试利用大型语言模型进行航路点引导以缓解这些限制的方法仍然不够充分，因为它们仅依赖于基于文本的推理，而缺乏空间基础。因此，此类模型通常会在具有死胡同的拓扑复杂环境中产生错误的航路点，并且缺乏感知能力来解释模棱两可的物理边界。这些不一致性导致了代价高昂的校正性扩展，并破坏了预期的计算效率。

我们介绍了一种多模态框架MMP-A*，该框架将视觉语言模型的空间基础能力与一种新颖的自适应衰减机制相结合。通过将高层推理锚定在物理几何结构中，该框架产生连贯的航路点引导，解决了纯文本规划器的局限性。自适应衰减机制动态调节启发式搜索中不确定航路点的影响，确保几何有效性的同时显著降低内存开销。为了评估鲁棒性，我们在以严重杂乱和拓扑复杂性为特征的挑战性环境中测试了该框架。实验结果表明，MMP-A*以显著降低的运营成本实现了接近最优的轨迹，证明了其作为一种基于感知且计算高效的自主导航范例的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces MMP-A*, a multimodal path planning framework that integrates vision-language models with an adaptive decay mechanism to improve waypoint guidance and reduce computational costs in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种多模态路径规划框架MMP-A*，该框架集成了视觉语言模型和自适应衰减机制，以改善航点引导并降低复杂环境中的计算成本。

title: Learning Diffusion Policy from Primitive Skills for Robot Manipulation
summary: Diffusion policies (DP) have recently shown great promise for generating actions in robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches often rely on global instructions to produce short-term control signals, which can result in misalignment in action generation. We conjecture that the primitive skills, referred to as fine-grained, short-horizon manipulations, such as ``move up'' and ``open the gripper'', provide a more intuitive and effective interface for robot learning. To bridge this gap, we propose SDP, a skill-conditioned DP that integrates interpretable skill learning with conditional action planning. SDP abstracts eight reusable primitive skills across tasks and employs a vision-language model to extract discrete representations from visual observations and language instructions. Based on them, a lightweight router network is designed to assign a desired primitive skill for each state, which helps construct a single-skill policy to generate skill-aligned actions. By decomposing complex tasks into a sequence of primitive skills and selecting a single-skill policy, SDP ensures skill-consistent behavior across diverse tasks. Extensive experiments on two challenging simulation benchmarks and real-world robot deployments demonstrate that SDP consistently outperforms SOTA methods, providing a new paradigm for skill-based robot learning with diffusion policies.
summary_zh: 扩散策略（DP）最近在生成机器人操作动作方面表现出巨大潜力。然而，现有的方法通常依赖全局指令来产生短期控制信号，这可能导致动作生成中的不对齐。我们推测，诸如“向上移动”和“打开夹爪”等原始技能，即细粒度的、短视距的操作，为机器人学习提供了一个更直观和有效的接口。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 SDP，一种技能条件扩散策略，它将可解释的技能学习与条件动作规划相结合。SDP 抽象出跨任务的八种可重用原始技能，并采用视觉-语言模型从视觉观测和语言指令中提取离散表示。基于这些，我们设计了一个轻量级路由网络，用于为每个状态分配一个期望的原始技能，这有助于构建一个单技能策略以生成技能对齐的动作。通过将复杂任务分解为一系列原始技能并选择单技能策略，SDP 确保了跨不同任务的技能一致性行为。在两个具有挑战性的模拟基准和真实世界机器人部署上的大量实验表明，SDP 始终优于 SOTA 方法，为基于技能的扩散策略机器人学习提供了一种新的范式。
tldr: The paper introduces Skill-conditioned Diffusion Policy (SDP), which integrates interpretable skill learning with conditional action planning for robot manipulation, achieving SOTA results by decomposing complex tasks into primitive skills.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Skill-conditioned Diffusion Policy (SDP)，它将可解释的技能学习与条件动作规划相结合，用于机器人操作，通过将复杂任务分解为基础技能，实现了SOTA水平的结果。

title: CausalNav: A Long-term Embodied Navigation System for Autonomous Mobile Robots in Dynamic Outdoor Scenarios
summary: Autonomous language-guided navigation in large-scale outdoor environments remains a key challenge in mobile robotics, due to difficulties in semantic reasoning, dynamic conditions, and long-term stability. We propose CausalNav, the first scene graph-based semantic navigation framework tailored for dynamic outdoor environments. We construct a multi-level semantic scene graph using LLMs, referred to as the Embodied Graph, that hierarchically integrates coarse-grained map data with fine-grained object entities. The constructed graph serves as a retrievable knowledge base for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enabling semantic navigation and long-range planning under open-vocabulary queries. By fusing real-time perception with offline map data, the Embodied Graph supports robust navigation across varying spatial granularities in dynamic outdoor environments. Dynamic objects are explicitly handled in both the scene graph construction and hierarchical planning modules. The Embodied Graph is continuously updated within a temporal window to reflect environmental changes and support real-time semantic navigation. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate superior robustness and efficiency.
summary_zh: 大规模室外环境中基于语言引导的自主导航仍然是移动机器人领域的一项关键挑战，其难点在于语义推理、动态环境条件以及长期稳定性。我们提出了CausalNav，这是首个专门为动态室外环境设计的基于场景图的语义导航框架。我们利用大型语言模型（LLM）构建了一个多层次语义场景图，称为具身图（Embodied Graph），它将粗粒度的地图数据与细粒度的物体实体分层整合。构建的图作为检索增强生成（RAG）的可检索知识库，支持开放词汇查询下的语义导航和远距离规划。通过将实时感知与离线地图数据融合，具身图支持在动态室外环境中跨多种空间粒度的稳健导航。在场景图构建和分层规划模块中，都专门处理了动态物体。具身图在一个时间窗口内持续更新，以反映环境变化并支持实时语义导航。在仿真和真实世界环境中的大量实验表明，该方法具有卓越的鲁棒性和效率。
tldr: CausalNav introduces a scene graph-based semantic navigation framework called the Embodied Graph, leveraging LLMs and RAG for robust long-term autonomous robot navigation in dynamic outdoor settings by fusing real-time perception with offline map data.
