tldr_zh: CausalNav 提出了一个基于场景图的语义导航框架，名为 Embodied Graph，它利用 LLM 和 RAG，通过融合实时感知和离线地图数据，实现动态户外环境中鲁棒的长期自主机器人导航。

title: AlignDrive: Aligned Lateral-Longitudinal Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has rapidly progressed, enabling joint perception and planning in complex environments. In the planning stage, state-of-the-art (SOTA) end-to-end autonomous driving models decouple planning into parallel lateral and longitudinal predictions. While effective, this parallel design can lead to i) coordination failures between the planned path and speed, and ii) underutilization of the drive path as a prior for longitudinal planning, thus redundantly encoding static information. To address this, we propose a novel cascaded framework that explicitly conditions longitudinal planning on the drive path, enabling coordinated and collision-aware lateral and longitudinal planning. Specifically, we introduce a path-conditioned formulation that explicitly incorporates the drive path into longitudinal planning. Building on this, the model predicts longitudinal displacements along the drive path rather than full 2D trajectory waypoints. This design simplifies longitudinal reasoning and more tightly couples it with lateral planning. Additionally, we introduce a planning-oriented data augmentation strategy that simulates rare safety-critical events, such as vehicle cut-ins, by adding agents and relabeling longitudinal targets to avoid collision. Evaluated on the challenging Bench2Drive benchmark, our method sets a new SOTA, achieving a driving score of 89.07 and a success rate of 73.18%, demonstrating significantly improved coordination and safety
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶技术已取得快速进展，实现了在复杂环境中感知和规划的联合进行。在规划阶段，最先进的（SOTA）端到端自动驾驶模型将规划解耦为并行的横向和纵向预测。虽然这种并行设计有效，但可能导致 i) 规划路径和速度之间的协调失败，以及 ii) 驾驶路径作为纵向规划先验信息的利用不足，从而冗余地编码静态信息。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的级联框架，该框架明确地将纵向规划建立在驾驶路径的条件下，从而实现协调且具备碰撞意识的横向和纵向规划。具体而言，我们引入了一种路径条件公式，将驾驶路径显式地纳入纵向规划中。在此基础上，该模型预测沿驾驶路径的纵向位移，而不是完整的二维轨迹航路点。这种设计简化了纵向推理，并使其与横向规划更紧密地结合。此外，我们引入了一种面向规划的数据增强策略，该策略通过添加智能体并重新标记纵向目标以避免碰撞来模拟罕见的、安全关键事件，例如车辆切入。在具有挑战性的Bench2Drive基准测试中进行评估，我们的方法创造了新的SOTA，实现了89.07的驾驶评分和73.18%的成功率，表明协调性和安全性得到了显著提高。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel cascaded framework called AlignDrive for end-to-end autonomous driving that explicitly conditions longitudinal planning on the drive path, achieving state-of-the-art results on the Bench2Drive benchmark by addressing coordination failures between lateral and longitudinal planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为AlignDrive的端到端自动驾驶级联框架，该框架显式地将纵向规划建立在驾驶路径之上，通过解决横向和纵向规划之间的协调失败问题，在Bench2Drive基准测试上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Explicit World Models for Reliable Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This paper addresses the topic of robustness under sensing noise, ambiguous instructions, and human-robot interaction. We take a radically different tack to the issue of reliable embodied AI: instead of focusing on formal verification methods aimed at achieving model predictability and robustness, we emphasise the dynamic, ambiguous and subjective nature of human-robot interactions that requires embodied AI systems to perceive, interpret, and respond to human intentions in a manner that is consistent, comprehensible and aligned with human expectations. We argue that when embodied agents operate in human environments that are inherently social, multimodal, and fluid, reliability is contextually determined and only has meaning in relation to the goals and expectations of humans involved in the interaction. This calls for a fundamentally different approach to achieving reliable embodied AI that is centred on building and updating an accessible "explicit world model" representing the common ground between human and AI, that is used to align robot behaviours with human expectations.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了在感知噪声、模糊指令以及人机交互下的鲁棒性问题。我们对可靠的具身人工智能问题采取了一种截然不同的策略：我们没有侧重于旨在实现模型可预测性和鲁棒性的形式化验证方法，而是强调人机交互的动态性、模糊性和主观性，这要求具身人工智能系统能够以连贯、易理解且符合人类期望的方式感知、解释和响应人类意图。我们认为，当具身智能体在本质上是社会性的、多模态且流动的的人类环境中运行时，可靠性是情境决定的，并且只有在与参与交互的人类的目标和期望相关的语境中才有意义。这需要一种根本不同的方法来实现可靠的具身人工智能，该方法以构建和更新可访问的“显式世界模型”为中心，该模型代表了人与人工智能之间的共同基础，并用于使机器人行为与人类期望保持一致。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel approach to reliable human-robot collaboration by focusing on building and updating an "explicit world model" to align robot behaviors with human expectations in dynamic and ambiguous environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的人机协作方法，通过构建和更新一个“显式世界模型”，使机器人的行为与动态和模糊环境中人类的期望相一致，从而实现可靠的人机协作。

title: DemoBot: Efficient Learning of Bimanual Manipulation with Dexterous Hands From Third-Person Human Videos
summary: This work presents DemoBot, a learning framework that enables a dual-arm, multi-finger robotic system to acquire complex manipulation skills from a single unannotated RGB-D video demonstration. The method extracts structured motion trajectories of both hands and objects from raw video data. These trajectories serve as motion priors for a novel reinforcement learning (RL) pipeline that learns to refine them through contact-rich interactions, thereby eliminating the need to learn from scratch. To address the challenge of learning long-horizon manipulation skills, we introduce: (1) Temporal-segment based RL to enforce temporal alignment of the current state with demonstrations; (2) Success-Gated Reset strategy to balance the refinement of readily acquired skills and the exploration of subsequent task stages; and (3) Event-Driven Reward curriculum with adaptive thresholding to guide the RL learning of high-precision manipulation. The novel video processing and RL framework successfully achieved long-horizon synchronous and asynchronous bimanual assembly tasks, offering a scalable approach for direct skill acquisition from human videos.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种名为DemoBot的学习框架，使双臂多指机器人系统能够从单个未标注的RGB-D视频演示中获取复杂的操控技能。该方法从原始视频数据中提取双手和物体的结构化运动轨迹。这些轨迹作为一种运动先验，用于一种新型的强化学习(RL)流程，该流程通过富接触交互学习来优化这些轨迹，从而消除了从头开始学习的需求。为了应对学习长时程操控技能的挑战，我们引入了：(1)基于时间段的强化学习，以强制当前状态与演示之间的时间对齐；(2)成功门控重置策略，以平衡已轻易获得的技能的优化以及后续任务阶段的探索；以及(3)具有自适应阈值的事件驱动奖励课程，以指导高精度操控的RL学习。这种新颖的视频处理和强化学习框架成功实现了长时程同步和异步双手动装配任务，为直接从人类视频中获取技能提供了一种可扩展的方法。
tldr: DemoBot uses unannotated RGB-D videos of humans to teach bimanual manipulation to robots via a novel reinforcement learning pipeline with temporal segmentation, success-gated resets, and event-driven rewards.
tldr_zh: DemoBot利用人类的无标注RGB-D视频，通过一种新颖的强化学习流程（包括时间分割、成功门控重置和事件驱动奖励）来教导机器人进行双手动操作。

title: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-term interactive agents, yet their limited context windows make it difficult to sustain coherent behavior over extended interactions. Existing memory systems often store isolated records and retrieve fragments, limiting their ability to consolidate evolving user states and resolve conflicts. We introduce EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory. Episodic Trace Formation converts dialogue streams into MemCells that capture episodic traces, atomic facts, and time-bounded Foresight signals. Semantic Consolidation organizes MemCells into thematic MemScenes, distilling stable semantic structures and updating user profiles. Reconstructive Recollection performs MemScene-guided agentic retrieval to compose the necessary and sufficient context for downstream reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that EverMemOS achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-augmented reasoning tasks. We further report a profile study on PersonaMem v2 and qualitative case studies illustrating chat-oriented capabilities such as user profiling and Foresight. Code is available at https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为长期交互式智能体，然而其有限的上下文窗口使其难以在长时间交互中维持连贯行为。现有的记忆系统通常存储孤立的记录并检索片段，限制了它们整合不断演变的用户状态并解决冲突的能力。我们引入 EverMemOS，一种自组织记忆操作系统，它为计算记忆实现了一种受印迹启发的生命周期。情节痕迹形成将对话流转换为 MemCell，捕获情节痕迹、原子事实和有时效性的远见信号。语义巩固将 MemCell 组织成主题性的 MemScene，提炼出稳定的语义结构并更新用户画像。重构性回忆执行 MemScene 指导的智能体式检索，以组合下游推理所需的充分且必要上下文。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上的实验表明，EverMemOS 在记忆增强型推理任务上实现了最先进的性能。我们进一步报告了 PersonaMem v2 上的用户画像研究，以及说明面向聊天功能的定性案例研究，例如用户属性分析和远见。代码已发布在 https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS。
tldr: EverMemOS is a memory operating system that addresses the limitations of LLMs' context windows for long-horizon reasoning by implementing a self-organizing, engram-inspired memory system, showing state-of-the-art results on memory-augmented reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: EverMemOS是一个内存操作系统，通过实现一个自组织的、受印迹启发的内存系统，解决了LLM在长程推理中的上下文窗口限制，并在内存增强的推理任务中表现出最先进的结果。

title: CogFlow: Bridging Perception and Reasoning through Knowledge Internalization for Visual Mathematical Problem Solving
summary: Despite significant progress, multimodal large language models continue to struggle with visual mathematical problem solving. Some recent works recognize that visual perception is a bottleneck in visual mathematical reasoning, but their solutions are limited to improving the extraction and interpretation of visual inputs. Notably, they all ignore the key issue of whether the extracted visual cues are faithfully integrated and properly utilized in subsequent reasoning. Motivated by this, we present CogFlow, a novel cognitive-inspired three-stage framework that incorporates a knowledge internalization stage, explicitly simulating the hierarchical flow of human reasoning: perception$\Rightarrow$internalization$\Rightarrow$reasoning. Inline with this hierarchical flow, we holistically enhance all its stages. We devise Synergistic Visual Rewards to boost perception capabilities in parametric and semantic spaces, jointly improving visual information extraction from symbols and diagrams. To guarantee faithful integration of extracted visual cues into subsequent reasoning, we introduce a Knowledge Internalization Reward model in the internalization stage, bridging perception and reasoning. Moreover, we design a Visual-Gated Policy Optimization algorithm to further enforce the reasoning is grounded with the visual knowledge, preventing models seeking shortcuts that appear coherent but are visually ungrounded reasoning chains. Moreover, we contribute a new dataset MathCog for model training, which contains samples with over 120K high-quality perception-reasoning aligned annotations. Comprehensive experiments and analysis on commonly used visual mathematical reasoning benchmarks validate the superiority of the proposed CogFlow.
summary_zh: 尽管已取得显著进展，多模态大型语言模型在视觉数学问题求解方面仍然面临挑战。一些最近的研究工作认识到视觉感知是视觉数学推理的瓶颈，但它们的解决方案仅限于改进视觉输入的提取和解释。值得注意的是，它们都忽略了一个关键问题，即提取的视觉线索是否被忠实地整合并在后续推理中得到恰当利用。受此启发，我们提出了CogFlow，一种新颖的认知启发式三阶段框架，它包含一个知识内化阶段，显式模拟了人类推理的层次化流程：感知$\Rightarrow$内化$\Rightarrow$推理。与这种层次化流程一致，我们整体性地增强了所有阶段。我们设计了协同视觉奖励，以增强参数化和语义空间中的感知能力，共同改进从符号和图表中提取视觉信息的过程。为了保证提取的视觉线索能够忠实地整合到后续推理中，我们在内化阶段引入了一个知识内化奖励模型，从而连接了感知和推理。此外，我们设计了一种视觉门控策略优化算法，以进一步确保推理立足于视觉知识，防止模型寻求看似连贯但视觉上无根的推理链的捷径。此外，我们贡献了一个新的数据集MathCog用于模型训练，其中包含超过12万个高质量的感知-推理对齐标注样本。在常用视觉数学推理基准上的综合实验和分析验证了所提出的CogFlow的优越性。
tldr: The paper introduces CogFlow, a cognitive-inspired framework enhancing visual mathematical problem-solving in LLMs by explicitly modeling perception, knowledge internalization, and reasoning stages, achieving state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CogFlow，一个认知启发式框架，通过显式地建模感知、知识内化和推理阶段，来增强LLM在视觉数学问题求解方面的能力，并在标准基准测试上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Jenius Agent: Towards Experience-Driven Accuracy Optimization in Real-World Scenarios
summary: As agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) advance, improving the task performance of an autonomous agent, especially in context understanding, tool usage, and response generation, has become increasingly critical. Although prior studies have advanced the overall design of LLM-based agents, systematic optimization of their internal reasoning and tool-use pipelines remains underexplored. This paper introduces an agent framework grounded in real-world practical experience, with three key innovations: (1) an adaptive prompt generation strategy that aligns with the agent's state and task goals to improve reliability and robustness; (2) a context-aware tool orchestration module that performs tool categorization, semantic retrieval, and adaptive invocation based on user intent and context; and (3) a layered memory mechanism that integrates session memory, task history, and external summaries to improve relevance and efficiency through dynamic summarization and compression. An end-to-end framework named Jenius-Agent has been integrated with three key optimizations, including tools based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), file input/output (I/O), and execution feedback. The experiments show a 20 percent improvement in task accuracy, along with a reduced token cost, response latency, and invocation failures. The framework is already deployed in Jenius (https://www.jenius.cn), providing a lightweight and scalable solution for robust, protocol-compatible autonomous agents.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型(LLM)驱动的智能体系统不断发展，提高自主智能体的任务性能，尤其是在上下文理解、工具使用和响应生成方面，变得日益关键。尽管先前的研究已经推动了基于LLM的智能体的整体设计，但对其内部推理和工具使用流程的系统优化仍有待深入探索。本文介绍了一个基于实际应用经验的智能体框架，具有三项关键创新：(1) 一种自适应提示生成策略，该策略与智能体的状态和任务目标相一致，以提高可靠性和鲁棒性；(2) 一个上下文感知的工具编排模块，该模块基于用户意图和上下文执行工具分类、语义检索和自适应调用；(3) 一个分层记忆机制，该机制整合了会话记忆、任务历史和外部摘要，通过动态摘要和压缩来提高相关性和效率。一个名为Jenius-Agent的端到端框架已集成了三项关键优化，包括基于模型上下文协议(MCP)的工具、文件输入/输出(I/O)和执行反馈。实验表明，任务准确率提高了20%，同时降低了token成本、响应延迟和调用失败率。该框架已部署在Jenius（https://www.jenius.cn）中，为稳健、协议兼容的自主智能体提供了一种轻量级且可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces Jenius-Agent, an LLM-based agent framework optimized for real-world task performance through adaptive prompting, context-aware tool orchestration, and a layered memory mechanism, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Jenius-Agent，一个基于LLM的代理框架，通过自适应提示、上下文感知的工具编排和分层记忆机制优化了现实世界的任务性能，并展示了准确性和效率的提高。

title: Sparse Threats, Focused Defense: Criticality-Aware Robust Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown considerable potential in autonomous driving (AD), yet its vulnerability to perturbations remains a critical barrier to real-world deployment. As a primary countermeasure, adversarial training improves policy robustness by training the AD agent in the presence of an adversary that deliberately introduces perturbations. Existing approaches typically model the interaction as a zero-sum game with continuous attacks. However, such designs overlook the inherent asymmetry between the agent and the adversary and then fail to reflect the sparsity of safety-critical risks, rendering the achieved robustness inadequate for practical AD scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce criticality-aware robust RL (CARRL), a novel adversarial training approach for handling sparse, safety-critical risks in autonomous driving. CARRL consists of two interacting components: a risk exposure adversary (REA) and a risk-targeted robust agent (RTRA). We model the interaction between the REA and RTRA as a general-sum game, allowing the REA to focus on exposing safety-critical failures (e.g., collisions) while the RTRA learns to balance safety with driving efficiency. The REA employs a decoupled optimization mechanism to better identify and exploit sparse safety-critical moments under a constrained budget. However, such focused attacks inevitably result in a scarcity of adversarial data. The RTRA copes with this scarcity by jointly leveraging benign and adversarial experiences via a dual replay buffer and enforces policy consistency under perturbations to stabilize behavior. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach reduces the collision rate by at least 22.66\% across all cases compared to state-of-the-art baseline methods.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）在自动驾驶（AD）领域展现出巨大的潜力，但其对扰动的脆弱性仍然是实际部署的关键障碍。作为一种主要的对策，对抗训练通过在存在故意引入扰动的对抗者的环境中训练AD智能体，来提高策略的鲁棒性。现有的方法通常将这种交互建模为具有连续攻击的零和博弈。然而，这种设计忽略了智能体和对抗者之间固有的不对称性，并且不能反映安全攸关风险的稀疏性，导致所获得的鲁棒性不足以满足实际的AD场景。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了临界性感知鲁棒强化学习（CARRL），这是一种用于处理自动驾驶中稀疏、安全攸关风险的新型对抗训练方法。CARRL由两个相互作用的组件组成：风险暴露对抗者（REA）和风险目标鲁棒智能体（RTRA）。我们将REA和RTRA之间的交互建模为一般和博弈，允许REA专注于暴露安全攸关的故障（如碰撞），而RTRA学习在安全性和驾驶效率之间取得平衡。REA采用解耦的优化机制，以便在受限预算下更好地识别和利用稀疏的安全攸关时刻。然而，这种集中的攻击不可避免地导致对抗数据的稀缺。RTRA通过双重回放缓冲区联合利用良性和对抗性经验，并通过在扰动下强制执行策略一致性来稳定行为，从而应对这种稀缺性。实验结果表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，我们的方法在所有情况下至少降低了22.66\%的碰撞率。
tldr: This paper introduces Criticality-Aware Robust Reinforcement Learning (CARRL), a novel adversarial training method for autonomous driving that addresses the sparsity of safety-critical risks by using a risk exposure adversary and a risk-targeted robust agent, achieving improved safety.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为临界感知鲁棒强化学习（CARRL）的新型对抗训练方法，用于自动驾驶。该方法通过使用风险暴露对抗者和风险目标鲁棒智能体来解决安全关键风险的稀疏性问题，从而提高安全性。

title: Crafting Adversarial Inputs for Large Vision-Language Models Using Black-Box Optimization
summary: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown groundbreaking capabilities across diverse multimodal tasks. However, these models remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks, where adversaries craft subtle perturbations to bypass safety mechanisms and trigger harmful outputs. Existing white-box attacks methods require full model accessibility, suffer from computing costs and exhibit insufficient adversarial transferability, making them impractical for real-world, black-box settings. To address these limitations, we propose a black-box jailbreak attack on LVLMs via Zeroth-Order optimization using Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (ZO-SPSA). ZO-SPSA provides three key advantages: (i) gradient-free approximation by input-output interactions without requiring model knowledge, (ii) model-agnostic optimization without the surrogate model and (iii) lower resource requirements with reduced GPU memory consumption. We evaluate ZO-SPSA on three LVLMs, including InstructBLIP, LLaVA and MiniGPT-4, achieving the highest jailbreak success rate of 83.0% on InstructBLIP, while maintaining imperceptible perturbations comparable to white-box methods. Moreover, adversarial examples generated from MiniGPT-4 exhibit strong transferability to other LVLMs, with ASR reaching 64.18%. These findings underscore the real-world feasibility of black-box jailbreaks and expose critical weaknesses in the safety mechanisms of current LVLMs
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的最新进展已在各种多模态任务中展现出突破性的能力。然而，这些模型仍然容易受到对抗性越狱攻击，攻击者通过精心设计的细微扰动绕过安全机制并触发有害输出。现有的白盒攻击方法需要完全的模型可访问性，计算成本高昂，且对抗迁移性不足，这使得它们在真实的黑盒环境中不切实际。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种针对 LVLMs 的黑盒越狱攻击，该攻击通过使用同步扰动随机逼近 (ZO-SPSA) 的零阶优化实现。ZO-SPSA 提供了三个关键优势：（i）通过输入-输出交互进行无梯度近似，无需模型知识，（ii）无需代理模型的模型无关优化，以及（iii）降低资源需求，减少 GPU 内存消耗。我们在三个 LVLMs 上评估了 ZO-SPSA，包括 InstructBLIP、LLaVA 和 MiniGPT-4，在 InstructBLIP 上实现了 83.0% 的最高越狱成功率，同时保持了与白盒方法相当的难以察觉的扰动。此外，由 MiniGPT-4 生成的对抗样本对其他 LVLMs 表现出强大的迁移性，攻击成功率 (ASR) 达到 64.18%。这些发现强调了黑盒越狱在现实世界中的可行性，并暴露了当前 LVLMs 安全机制中的关键弱点。
tldr: This paper introduces a black-box adversarial attack (ZO-SPSA) on LVLMs that achieves high jailbreak success rates with imperceptible perturbations and strong transferability, highlighting vulnerabilities in current LVLM safety mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种针对 LVLM 的黑盒对抗攻击 (ZO-SPSA)，该攻击以难以察觉的扰动和强大的可迁移性实现了高越狱成功率，揭示了当前 LVLM 安全机制中的漏洞。

title: AI Agent Systems: Architectures, Applications, and Evaluation
summary: AI agents -- systems that combine foundation models with reasoning, planning, memory, and tool use -- are rapidly becoming a practical interface between natural-language intent and real-world computation. This survey synthesizes the emerging landscape of AI agent architectures across: (i) deliberation and reasoning (e.g., chain-of-thought-style decomposition, self-reflection and verification, and constraint-aware decision making), (ii) planning and control (from reactive policies to hierarchical and multi-step planners), and (iii) tool calling and environment interaction (retrieval, code execution, APIs, and multimodal perception). We organize prior work into a unified taxonomy spanning agent components (policy/LLM core, memory, world models, planners, tool routers, and critics), orchestration patterns (single-agent vs.\ multi-agent; centralized vs.\ decentralized coordination), and deployment settings (offline analysis vs.\ online interactive assistance; safety-critical vs.\ open-ended tasks). We discuss key design trade-offs -- latency vs.\ accuracy, autonomy vs.\ controllability, and capability vs.\ reliability -- and highlight how evaluation is complicated by non-determinism, long-horizon credit assignment, tool and environment variability, and hidden costs such as retries and context growth. Finally, we summarize measurement and benchmarking practices (task suites, human preference and utility metrics, success under constraints, robustness and security) and identify open challenges including verification and guardrails for tool actions, scalable memory and context management, interpretability of agent decisions, and reproducible evaluation under realistic workloads.
summary_zh: AI 智能体——结合了基础模型与推理、规划、记忆和工具使用的系统——正迅速成为自然语言意图和现实世界计算之间的一种实用接口。 该综述整合了新兴的 AI 智能体架构领域，涵盖：(i) 审议和推理（例如，思维链式分解、自我反思和验证，以及约束感知决策）；(ii) 规划和控制（从反应式策略到分层和多步规划器）；以及 (iii) 工具调用和环境交互（检索、代码执行、API和多模态感知）。 我们将先前的工作组织成一个统一的分类法，涵盖智能体组件（策略/LLM核心、记忆、世界模型、规划器、工具路由器和评论器）、编排模式（单智能体 vs. 多智能体；集中式 vs. 分布式协调）和部署设置（离线分析 vs. 在线交互式辅助；安全关键 vs. 开放式任务）。 我们讨论了关键的设计权衡——延迟 vs. 准确性、自主性 vs. 可控性、以及能力 vs. 可靠性——并强调了由于非确定性、长时程信用分配、工具和环境可变性以及诸如重试和上下文增长等隐藏成本，评估变得复杂。 最后，我们总结了度量和基准测试实践（任务集、人类偏好和效用指标、约束下的成功、鲁棒性和安全性），并确定了开放性挑战，包括工具动作的验证和护栏、可扩展的记忆和上下文管理、智能体决策的可解释性，以及在真实工作负载下可重现的评估。
tldr: This paper surveys the landscape of AI agent architectures, focusing on components like deliberation, planning, and tool use, and discussing design trade-offs, evaluation methods, and open challenges. It provides a taxonomy and discusses benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了AI Agent架构的现状，重点关注推理、规划和工具使用等组件，并讨论了设计权衡、评估方法和未解决的挑战。文章提供了一个分类法并讨论了基准测试。

title: CORE: Code-based Inverse Self-Training Framework with Graph Expansion for Virtual Agents
summary: The development of Multimodal Virtual Agents has made significant progress through the integration of Multimodal Large Language Models. However, mainstream training paradigms face key challenges: Behavior Cloning is simple and effective through imitation but suffers from low behavioral diversity, while Reinforcement Learning is capable of discovering novel strategies through exploration but heavily relies on manually designed reward functions. To address the conflict between these two methods, we present CORE, a Code-based Inverse Self-Training Framework with Graph Expansion that bridges imitation and exploration, offering a novel training framework that promotes behavioral diversity while eliminating the reliance on manually reward design. Specifically, we introduce Semantic Code Abstraction to automatically infers reward functions from expert demonstrations without manual design. The inferred reward function, referred to as the Label Function, is executable code that verifies one key step within a task. Building on this, we propose Strategy Graph Expansion to enhance in-domain behavioral diversity, which constructs a multi-path graph called Strategy Graph that captures diverse valid solutions beyond expert demonstrations. Furthermore, we introduce Trajectory-Guided Extrapolation, which enriches out-of-domain behavioral diversity by utilizing both successful and failed trajectories to expand the task space. Experiments on Web and Android platforms demonstrate that CORE significantly improves both overall performance and generalization, highlighting its potential as a robust and generalizable training paradigm for building powerful virtual agents.
summary_zh: 多模态虚拟代理的开发通过整合多模态大型语言模型取得了显著进展。然而，主流训练范式面临着关键挑战：行为克隆通过模仿简单有效，但行为多样性较低；强化学习能够通过探索发现新的策略，但严重依赖于手动设计的奖励函数。为了解决这两种方法之间的冲突，我们提出了 CORE，一个基于代码的、带有图扩展的逆自训练框架，它连接了模仿和探索，提供了一个新颖的训练框架，在提升行为多样性的同时，消除了对手动奖励设计的依赖。具体来说，我们引入了语义代码抽象，以自动从专家演示中推断奖励函数，而无需手动设计。推断出的奖励函数，称为标签函数，是可执行代码，用于验证任务中的一个关键步骤。在此基础上，我们提出了策略图扩展，以增强领域内行为多样性，它构建了一个名为策略图的多路径图，用于捕获超出专家演示之外的各种有效解决方案。此外，我们引入了轨迹引导的外推法，利用成功和失败的轨迹来扩展任务空间，从而丰富了领域外的行为多样性。在 Web 和 Android 平台上的实验表明，CORE 显著提高了整体性能和泛化能力，突显了其作为构建强大虚拟代理的强大且可泛化的训练范式的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces CORE, a novel framework for training virtual agents that combines imitation and exploration by automatically inferring reward functions and expanding the solution space to promote diverse and generalizable behaviors, achieving better performance on Web and Android platforms.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为CORE的新型虚拟代理训练框架，该框架结合了模仿和探索，通过自动推断奖励函数并扩展解决方案空间来促进多样化和可泛化的行为。CORE在Web和Android平台上的表现更佳。

title: Leveraging 2D-VLM for Label-Free 3D Segmentation in Large-Scale Outdoor Scene Understanding
summary: This paper presents a novel 3D semantic segmentation method for large-scale point cloud data that does not require annotated 3D training data or paired RGB images. The proposed approach projects 3D point clouds onto 2D images using virtual cameras and performs semantic segmentation via a foundation 2D model guided by natural language prompts. 3D segmentation is achieved by aggregating predictions from multiple viewpoints through weighted voting. Our method outperforms existing training-free approaches and achieves segmentation accuracy comparable to supervised methods. Moreover, it supports open-vocabulary recognition, enabling users to detect objects using arbitrary text queries, thus overcoming the limitations of traditional supervised approaches.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对大规模点云数据的全新3D语义分割方法，该方法无需标注的3D训练数据或配对的RGB图像。所提出的方法使用虚拟相机将3D点云投影到2D图像上，并通过自然语言提示引导的基础2D模型执行语义分割。3D分割通过加权投票聚合来自多个视角的预测来实现。我们的方法优于现有的免训练方法，并达到了可与监督方法相媲美的分割精度。此外，它支持开放词汇识别，使用户能够通过任意文本查询检测物体，从而克服了传统监督方法的局限性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel label-free 3D semantic segmentation method for large-scale point clouds, leveraging 2D vision-language models (VLMs) with natural language prompts and multi-view aggregation, achieving performance comparable to supervised methods with open-vocabulary recognition.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的无需标签的3D语义分割方法，用于大规模点云数据。该方法利用2D视觉语言模型（VLM）和自然语言提示，结合多视角聚合，实现了与监督学习方法相当的性能，并支持开放词汇识别。

title: Thinking with Blueprints: Assisting Vision-Language Models in Spatial Reasoning via Structured Object Representation
summary: Spatial reasoning -- the ability to perceive and reason about relationships in space -- advances vision-language models (VLMs) from visual perception toward spatial semantic understanding. Existing approaches either revisit local image patches, improving fine-grained perception but weakening global spatial awareness, or mark isolated coordinates, which capture object locations but overlook their overall organization. In this work, we integrate the cognitive concept of an object-centric blueprint into VLMs to enhance spatial reasoning. Given an image and a question, the model first constructs a JSON-style blueprint that records the positions, sizes, and attributes of relevant objects, and then reasons over this structured representation to produce the final answer. To achieve this, we introduce three key techniques: (1) blueprint-embedded reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning to elicit basic reasoning skills; (2) blueprint-aware rewards in reinforcement learning to encourage the blueprint to include an appropriate number of objects and to align final answers with this causal reasoning; and (3) anti-shortcut data augmentation that applies targeted perturbations to images and questions, discouraging reliance on superficial visual or linguistic cues. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms existing VLMs and specialized spatial reasoning models.
summary_zh: 空间推理——感知和推断空间关系的能力——将视觉-语言模型(VLMs)从视觉感知提升到空间语义理解。现有方法要么重新审视局部图像块，提升了细粒度感知，但削弱了全局空间意识，要么标记孤立的坐标，捕捉了物体位置，但忽略了它们的整体组织。在这项工作中，我们将以物体为中心的蓝图这种认知概念整合到VLMs中，以增强空间推理。给定一张图像和一个问题，模型首先构建一个JSON风格的蓝图，记录相关物体的位置、大小和属性，然后基于这个结构化表示进行推理，以生成最终答案。为了实现这一点，我们引入了三个关键技术：（1）蓝图嵌入的推理轨迹，用于有监督的微调，以激发基本的推理技能；（2）强化学习中的蓝图感知奖励，鼓励蓝图包含适当数量的物体，并使最终答案与这种因果推理对齐；以及（3）反捷径数据增强，对图像和问题应用有针对性的扰动，以抑制对表面视觉或语言线索的依赖。实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有的VLMs和专门的空间推理模型。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to improve spatial reasoning in VLMs by incorporating a structured, object-centric blueprint representation, showing improved performance through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and data augmentation techniques.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过结合结构化的、以对象为中心的蓝图表征来提高视觉语言模型空间推理能力的方法。通过监督微调、强化学习和数据增强技术，实验结果表明该方法性能有所提升。

title: WebGym: Scaling Training Environments for Visual Web Agents with Realistic Tasks
summary: We present WebGym, the largest-to-date open-source environment for training realistic visual web agents. Real websites are non-stationary and diverse, making artificial or small-scale task sets insufficient for robust policy learning. WebGym contains nearly 300,000 tasks with rubric-based evaluations across diverse, real-world websites and difficulty levels. We train agents with a simple reinforcement learning (RL) recipe, which trains on the agent's own interaction traces (rollouts), using task rewards as feedback to guide learning. To enable scaling RL, we speed up sampling of trajectories in WebGym by developing a high-throughput asynchronous rollout system, designed specifically for web agents. Our system achieves a 4-5x rollout speedup compared to naive implementations. Second, we scale the task set breadth, depth, and size, which results in continued performance improvement. Fine-tuning a strong base vision-language model, Qwen-3-VL-8B-Instruct, on WebGym results in an improvement in success rate on an out-of-distribution test set from 26.2% to 42.9%, significantly outperforming agents based on proprietary models such as GPT-4o and GPT-5-Thinking that achieve 27.1% and 29.8%, respectively. This improvement is substantial because our test set consists only of tasks on websites never seen during training, unlike many other prior works on training visual web agents.
summary_zh: 我们提出了WebGym，这是迄今为止最大的开源环境，用于训练逼真的视觉网络代理。真实的网站是非平稳且多样化的，使得人工或小规模任务集不足以支持稳健的策略学习。WebGym包含近30万个任务，这些任务基于评估标准，覆盖了多样化的、真实的网站和难度级别。我们使用简单的强化学习（RL）方法训练代理，该方法基于代理自身的交互轨迹（rollout）进行训练，并使用任务奖励作为反馈来指导学习。为了实现强化学习的扩展，我们开发了一个高吞吐量的异步rollout系统，专门为网络代理设计，从而加快了WebGym中轨迹的采样速度。与朴素的实现相比，我们的系统实现了4-5倍的rollout速度提升。其次，我们扩展了任务集的广度、深度和大小，从而实现了持续的性能提升。通过在WebGym上微调一个强大的基础视觉-语言模型Qwen-3-VL-8B-Instruct，在分布外的测试集上成功率从26.2%提高到42.9%，显著优于基于专有模型的代理，如GPT-4o和GPT-5-Thinking，它们分别达到27.1%和29.8%。这一改进是显著的，因为与许多其他关于训练视觉网络代理的先前工作不同，我们的测试集仅包含在训练期间从未见过的网站上的任务。
tldr: WebGym is a large-scale, open-source environment for training visual web agents using RL, achieving state-of-the-art performance by scaling the task set and leveraging a high-throughput rollout system. It outperforms GPT-4o and GPT-5-Thinking on out-of-distribution tasks.
tldr_zh: WebGym是一个大规模的开源环境，用于训练视觉Web代理，通过扩展任务集并利用高吞吐量 rollout 系统实现了最先进的性能。在分布外的任务上，其性能优于GPT-4o和GPT-5-Thinking。

title: Agentic AI in Remote Sensing: Foundations, Taxonomy, and Emerging Systems
summary: The paradigm of Earth Observation analysis is shifting from static deep learning models to autonomous agentic AI. Although recent vision foundation models and multimodal large language models advance representation learning, they often lack the sequential planning and active tool orchestration required for complex geospatial workflows. This survey presents the first comprehensive review of agentic AI in remote sensing. We introduce a unified taxonomy distinguishing between single-agent copilots and multi-agent systems while analyzing architectural foundations such as planning mechanisms, retrieval-augmented generation, and memory structures. Furthermore, we review emerging benchmarks that move the evaluation from pixel-level accuracy to trajectory-aware reasoning correctness. By critically examining limitations in grounding, safety, and orchestration, this work outlines a strategic roadmap for the development of robust, autonomous geospatial intelligence.
summary_zh: 地球观测分析的范式正从静态深度学习模型向自主主体人工智能转变。尽管近期的视觉基础模型和多模态大型语言模型在表征学习方面有所进展，但它们通常缺乏复杂地理空间工作流程所需的序列规划和主动工具编排能力。本综述首次对遥感领域的主体人工智能进行了全面的回顾。我们引入了一种统一的分类法，区分了单主体副驾驶和多主体系统，并分析了架构基础，例如规划机制、检索增强生成和记忆结构。此外，我们回顾了新兴的基准测试，这些基准测试将评估从像素级精度转移到轨迹感知推理正确性。通过批判性地考察在基础、安全性和编排方面的局限性，这项工作为开发稳健、自主的地理空间情报提出了战略路线图。
tldr: This survey paper reviews the emerging field of agentic AI in remote sensing, presenting a taxonomy for single and multi-agent systems and outlining a roadmap for future development, focusing on planning, grounding, safety, and orchestration.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述论文回顾了遥感领域中新兴的 Agentic AI，提出了单智能体和多智能体系统的分类，并概述了未来发展的路线图，重点关注规划、基础、安全和编排。

title: Robust Egocentric Visual Attention Prediction Through Language-guided Scene Context-aware Learning
summary: As the demand for analyzing egocentric videos grows, egocentric visual attention prediction, anticipating where a camera wearer will attend, has garnered increasing attention. However, it remains challenging due to the inherent complexity and ambiguity of dynamic egocentric scenes. Motivated by evidence that scene contextual information plays a crucial role in modulating human attention, in this paper, we present a language-guided scene context-aware learning framework for robust egocentric visual attention prediction. We first design a context perceiver which is guided to summarize the egocentric video based on a language-based scene description, generating context-aware video representations. We then introduce two training objectives that: 1) encourage the framework to focus on the target point-of-interest regions and 2) suppress distractions from irrelevant regions which are less likely to attract first-person attention. Extensive experiments on Ego4D and Aria Everyday Activities (AEA) datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance and enhanced robustness across diverse, dynamic egocentric scenarios.
summary_zh: 随着对以自我为中心的视频分析需求增长，以自我为中心的视觉注意力预测（即预测相机佩戴者将会关注哪里）受到了越来越多的关注。然而，由于动态的以自我为中心的场景固有的复杂性和模糊性，这项任务仍然充满挑战。受到场景上下文信息在调节人类注意力中起关键作用的证据启发，本文提出了一种语言引导的场景上下文感知学习框架，用于鲁棒的以自我为中心的视觉注意力预测。我们首先设计了一个上下文感知器，该感知器被引导根据基于语言的场景描述来总结以自我为中心的视频，从而生成上下文感知的视频表示。然后，我们引入了两个训练目标，其目的在于：1) 鼓励框架专注于目标感兴趣区域；2) 抑制来自不太可能吸引第一人称注意力的无关区域的干扰。在 Ego4D 和 Aria Everyday Activities (AEA) 数据集上的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性，实现了最先进的性能，并在各种动态的以自我为中心的场景中增强了鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper introduces a language-guided, scene context-aware learning framework for robust egocentric visual attention prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results on Ego4D and AEA datasets.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种语言引导的、场景上下文感知的学习框架，用于鲁棒的以自我为中心的视觉注意力预测，并在Ego4D和AEA数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: LabelAny3D: Label Any Object 3D in the Wild
summary: Detecting objects in 3D space from monocular input is crucial for applications ranging from robotics to scene understanding. Despite advanced performance in the indoor and autonomous driving domains, existing monocular 3D detection models struggle with in-the-wild images due to the lack of 3D in-the-wild datasets and the challenges of 3D annotation. We introduce LabelAny3D, an \emph{analysis-by-synthesis} framework that reconstructs holistic 3D scenes from 2D images to efficiently produce high-quality 3D bounding box annotations. Built on this pipeline, we present COCO3D, a new benchmark for open-vocabulary monocular 3D detection, derived from the MS-COCO dataset and covering a wide range of object categories absent from existing 3D datasets. Experiments show that annotations generated by LabelAny3D improve monocular 3D detection performance across multiple benchmarks, outperforming prior auto-labeling approaches in quality. These results demonstrate the promise of foundation-model-driven annotation for scaling up 3D recognition in realistic, open-world settings.
summary_zh: 从单目输入检测3D空间中的物体对于从机器人技术到场景理解等应用至关重要。 尽管在室内和自动驾驶领域取得了先进的性能，但由于缺乏野外3D数据集以及3D标注的挑战，现有的单目3D检测模型在处理野外图像时表现不佳。 我们引入了LabelAny3D，这是一种 \emph{分析-综合} 框架，可从2D图像重建整体3D场景，从而高效地生成高质量的3D边界框标注。 基于此流程，我们提出了COCO3D，这是一个新的开放词汇单目3D检测基准，它源自MS-COCO数据集，并涵盖了现有3D数据集中没有的各种物体类别。 实验表明，LabelAny3D生成的标注提高了多个基准测试中单目3D检测的性能，在质量上优于先前的自动标注方法。 这些结果证明了基础模型驱动的标注在扩展现实开放世界场景中的3D识别方面的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces LabelAny3D, an analysis-by-synthesis framework for generating 3D bounding box annotations from 2D images, and COCO3D, a new benchmark derived from MS-COCO for open-vocabulary monocular 3D detection, demonstrating improved performance in realistic settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LabelAny3D，一种通过综合分析框架，从2D图像生成3D bounding box标注；以及COCO3D，一个从MS-COCO衍生的新benchmark，用于开放词汇单目3D检测，并在真实场景中展示了性能的提升。

title: Vision-Based Early Fault Diagnosis and Self-Recovery for Strawberry Harvesting Robots
summary: Strawberry harvesting robots faced persistent challenges such as low integration of visual perception, fruit-gripper misalignment, empty grasping, and strawberry slippage from the gripper due to insufficient gripping force, all of which compromised harvesting stability and efficiency in orchard environments. To overcome these issues, this paper proposed a visual fault diagnosis and self-recovery framework that integrated multi-task perception with corrective control strategies. At the core of this framework was SRR-Net, an end-to-end multi-task perception model that simultaneously performed strawberry detection, segmentation, and ripeness estimation, thereby unifying visual perception with fault diagnosis. Based on this integrated perception, a relative error compensation method based on the simultaneous target-gripper detection was designed to address positional misalignment, correcting deviations when error exceeded the tolerance threshold. To mitigate empty grasping and fruit-slippage faults, an early abort strategy was implemented. A micro-optical camera embedded in the end-effector provided real-time visual feedback, enabling grasp detection during the deflating stage and strawberry slip prediction during snap-off through MobileNet V3-Small classifier and a time-series LSTM classifier. Experiments demonstrated that SRR-Net maintained high perception accuracy. For detection, it achieved a precision of 0.895 and recall of 0.813 on strawberries, and 0.972/0.958 on hands. In segmentation, it yielded a precision of 0.887 and recall of 0.747 for strawberries, and 0.974/0.947 for hands. For ripeness estimation, SRR-Net attained a mean absolute error of 0.035, while simultaneously supporting multi-task perception and sustaining a competitive inference speed of 163.35 FPS.
summary_zh: 草莓采摘机器人面临着诸多持续性挑战，如视觉感知集成度低、果实-夹爪不对准、空抓以及因夹持力不足导致的草莓从夹爪中滑落等问题，这些都损害了果园环境下的采摘稳定性和效率。为了克服这些问题，本文提出了一种视觉故障诊断与自恢复框架，该框架将多任务感知与纠正性控制策略相结合。该框架的核心是SRR-Net，这是一个端到端的多任务感知模型，它同时执行草莓检测、分割和成熟度估计，从而将视觉感知与故障诊断统一起来。基于这种集成的感知，设计了一种基于同步目标-夹爪检测的相对误差补偿方法，以解决位置不对准问题，并在误差超过容差阈值时校正偏差。为了减轻空抓和果实滑落故障，实施了一种提前终止策略。嵌入在末端执行器中的微型光学相机提供了实时视觉反馈，使得能在泄气阶段进行抓取检测，以及在折断阶段通过MobileNet V3-Small分类器和时间序列LSTM分类器进行草莓滑落预测。实验表明，SRR-Net保持了较高的感知精度。在检测方面，它在草莓上的精度为0.895，召回率为0.813，在手上的精度/召回率为0.972/0.958。在分割方面，它在草莓上的精度为0.887，召回率为0.747，在手上的精度/召回率为0.974/0.947。对于成熟度估计，SRR-Net获得了0.035的平均绝对误差，同时支持多任务感知并维持了163.35 FPS的具有竞争力的推理速度。
tldr: This paper presents a vision-based fault diagnosis and self-recovery system for strawberry harvesting robots, integrating a multi-task perception model (SRR-Net) and corrective control strategies to improve harvesting stability and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的草莓采摘机器人故障诊断和自恢复系统，集成了多任务感知模型 (SRR-Net) 和纠正控制策略，以提高采摘的稳定性和效率。

title: Realistic adversarial scenario generation via human-like pedestrian model for autonomous vehicle control parameter optimisation
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are rapidly advancing and are expected to play a central role in future mobility. Ensuring their safe deployment requires reliable interaction with other road users, not least pedestrians. Direct testing on public roads is costly and unsafe for rare but critical interactions, making simulation a practical alternative. Within simulation-based testing, adversarial scenarios are widely used to probe safety limits, but many prioritise difficulty over realism, producing exaggerated behaviours which may result in AV controllers that are overly conservative. We propose an alternative method, instead using a cognitively inspired pedestrian model featuring both inter-individual and intra-individual variability to generate behaviourally plausible adversarial scenarios. We provide a proof of concept demonstration of this method's potential for AV control optimisation, in closed-loop testing and tuning of an AV controller. Our results show that replacing the rule-based CARLA pedestrian with the human-like model yields more realistic gap acceptance patterns and smoother vehicle decelerations. Unsafe interactions occur only for certain pedestrian individuals and conditions, underscoring the importance of human variability in AV testing. Adversarial scenarios generated by this model can be used to optimise AV control towards safer and more efficient behaviour. Overall, this work illustrates how incorporating human-like road user models into simulation-based adversarial testing can enhance the credibility of AV evaluation and provide a practical basis to behaviourally informed controller optimisation.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆（AVs）正迅速发展，并有望在未来交通中发挥核心作用。确保其安全部署需要与其他道路使用者（尤其是行人）进行可靠的交互。在公共道路上进行直接测试对于罕见但关键的交互而言成本高昂且不安全，因此仿真成为一种可行的替代方案。在基于仿真的测试中，对抗性场景被广泛用于探测安全极限，但许多场景优先考虑难度而非真实性，从而产生夸张的行为，可能导致自动驾驶车辆控制器过于保守。我们提出了一种替代方法，而是采用一种受认知启发的行人模型，该模型具有个体之间和个体内部的变异性，以生成行为上合理的对抗性场景。我们提供了一个概念验证演示，展示了该方法在自动驾驶车辆控制优化、闭环测试和自动驾驶车辆控制器调整方面的潜力。我们的结果表明，用类人模型取代基于规则的 CARLA 行人模型，可以产生更真实的间隙接受模式和更平稳的车辆减速。不安全的交互仅发生在某些行人和特定条件下，突显了人类变异性在自动驾驶车辆测试中的重要性。由该模型生成的对抗性场景可用于优化自动驾驶车辆控制，使其实现更安全、更高效的行为。总而言之，这项工作说明了将类人道路使用者模型融入基于仿真的对抗性测试如何提高自动驾驶车辆评估的可信度，并为基于行为信息的控制器优化提供实际基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a cognitively inspired pedestrian model for generating realistic adversarial scenarios in autonomous vehicle simulation, showing improved realism and safer AV controller optimization compared to rule-based pedestrian models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个认知启发的行人模型，用于在自动驾驶车辆仿真中生成逼真的对抗场景，与基于规则的行人模型相比，展示了改进的真实性和更安全的自动驾驶车辆控制器优化。

title: Deep Robust Koopman Learning from Noisy Data
summary: Koopman operator theory has emerged as a leading data-driven approach that relies on a judicious choice of observable functions to realize global linear representations of nonlinear systems in the lifted observable space. However, real-world data is often noisy, making it difficult to obtain an accurate and unbiased approximation of the Koopman operator. The Koopman operator generated from noisy datasets is typically corrupted by noise-induced bias that severely degrades prediction and downstream tracking performance. In order to address this drawback, this paper proposes a novel autoencoder-based neural architecture to jointly learn the appropriate lifting functions and the reduced-bias Koopman operator from noisy data. The architecture initially learns the Koopman basis functions that are consistent for both the forward and backward temporal dynamics of the system. Subsequently, by utilizing the learned forward and backward temporal dynamics, the Koopman operator is synthesized with a reduced bias making the method more robust to noise compared to existing techniques. Theoretical analysis is used to demonstrate significant bias reduction in the presence of training noise. Dynamics prediction and tracking control simulations are conducted for multiple serial manipulator arms, including performance comparisons with leading alternative designs, to demonstrate its robustness under various noise levels. Experimental studies with the Franka FR3 7-DoF manipulator arm are further used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in a practical setting.
summary_zh: Koopman算子理论已成为一种领先的数据驱动方法，它依赖于可观测函数的合理选择，以在提升的可观测空间中实现非线性系统的全局线性表示。然而，真实世界的数据通常带有噪声，这使得获取Koopman算子的精确且无偏近似变得困难。从噪声数据集生成的Koopman算子通常会被噪声引起的偏差所破坏，从而严重降低预测和下游跟踪性能。为了解决这个缺点，本文提出了一种新颖的基于自编码器的神经架构，以从噪声数据中联合学习合适的提升函数和降低偏差的Koopman算子。该架构首先学习对于系统的前向和后向时间动力学都一致的Koopman基函数。随后，通过利用学习到的前向和后向时间动力学，合成具有降低偏差的Koopman算子，这使得该方法与现有技术相比，对噪声更具鲁棒性。理论分析用于证明在存在训练噪声的情况下，偏差显著降低。针对多个串行机械臂进行了动力学预测和跟踪控制仿真，包括与领先的替代设计的性能比较，以证明其在各种噪声水平下的鲁棒性。使用Franka FR3 7自由度机械臂的实验研究进一步用于证明所提方法在实际应用中的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel autoencoder-based architecture for learning a robust Koopman operator from noisy data by jointly learning lifting functions and reducing bias, demonstrating effectiveness on robot manipulator tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于自编码器的新型架构，通过联合学习提升函数和降低偏差，从噪声数据中学习鲁棒的Koopman算子，并在机器人机械臂任务中展示了其有效性。

title: What you reward is what you learn: Comparing rewards for online speech policy optimization in public HRI
summary: Designing policies that are both efficient and acceptable for conversational service robots in open and diverse environments is non-trivial. Unlike fixed, hand-tuned parameters, online learning can adapt to non-stationary conditions. In this paper, we study how to adapt a social robot's speech policy in the wild. During a 12-day in-situ deployment with over 1,400 public encounters, we cast online policy optimization as a multi-armed bandit problem and use Thompson sampling to select among six actions defined by speech rate (slow/normal/fast) and verbosity (concise/detailed). We compare three complementary binary rewards--Ru (user rating), Rc (conversation closure), and Rt (>=2 turns)--and show that each induces distinct arm distributions and interaction behaviors. We complement the online results with offline evaluations that analyze contextual factors (e.g., crowd level, group size) using video-annotated data. Taken together, we distill ready-to-use design lessons for deploying online optimization of speech policies in real public HRI settings.
summary_zh: 设计在开放和多元环境中对会话服务机器人而言既高效又可接受的策略并非易事。与固定的、手动调整的参数不同，在线学习可以适应非平稳条件。在本文中，我们研究如何在实际环境中调整社交机器人的语音策略。在为期12天的现场部署中，经历了超过1400次公共互动，我们将在线策略优化转化为一个多臂老虎机问题，并使用汤普森采样在六个由语速（慢/正常/快）和冗余度（简洁/详细）定义的动作中进行选择。我们比较了三种互补的二元奖励——Ru（用户评分）、Rc（对话结束）和Rt（>=2轮），并展示了每一种奖励都会导致独特的臂分布和交互行为。我们补充了在线结果，使用视频标注数据分析了情境因素（例如，人群密度、群体规模）进行离线评估。总而言之，我们提炼出可直接使用的设计经验，用于在真实的公共人机交互环境中部署语音策略的在线优化。
tldr: This paper explores online optimization of a social robot's speech policy in a public HRI setting using Thompson sampling and compares different binary reward functions, providing design lessons for real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文探讨了在公共人机交互环境下，使用 Thompson 采样对社交机器人语音策略进行在线优化，并比较了不同的二元奖励函数，为实际部署提供了设计经验。

title: VisuoTactile 6D Pose Estimation of an In-Hand Object using Vision and Tactile Sensor Data
summary: Knowledge of the 6D pose of an object can benefit in-hand object manipulation. In-hand 6D object pose estimation is challenging because of heavy occlusion produced by the robot's grippers, which can have an adverse effect on methods that rely on vision data only. Many robots are equipped with tactile sensors at their fingertips that could be used to complement vision data. In this paper, we present a method that uses both tactile and vision data to estimate the pose of an object grasped in a robot's hand. To address challenges like lack of standard representation for tactile data and sensor fusion, we propose the use of point clouds to represent object surfaces in contact with the tactile sensor and present a network architecture based on pixel-wise dense fusion. We also extend NVIDIA's Deep Learning Dataset Synthesizer to produce synthetic photo-realistic vision data and corresponding tactile point clouds. Results suggest that using tactile data in addition to vision data improves the 6D pose estimate, and our network generalizes successfully from synthetic training to real physical robots.
summary_zh: 6D 对象姿态的知识有助于灵巧手操作。手持 6D 对象姿态估计具有挑战性，因为机器人夹爪会产生严重的遮挡，这对仅依赖视觉数据的方法产生不利影响。许多机器人在指尖配备了触觉传感器，可用于补充视觉数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种使用触觉和视觉数据来估计机器人手中抓取物体的姿态的方法。为了解决触觉数据缺乏标准表示以及传感器融合等挑战，我们提出使用点云来表示与触觉传感器接触的物体表面，并提出了一种基于像素级密集融合的网络架构。我们还扩展了 NVIDIA 的深度学习数据集合成器，以生成合成逼真的视觉数据和相应的触觉点云。结果表明，除了视觉数据外，使用触觉数据可以改善 6D 姿态估计，并且我们的网络可以成功地从合成训练推广到真实的物理机器人。
tldr: This paper presents a method for 6D object pose estimation using both vision and tactile data, fusing point cloud representations via a deep learning network and demonstrating successful generalization from synthetic to real-world robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用视觉和触觉数据进行6D物体姿态估计的方法，通过深度学习网络融合点云表示，并展示了从合成数据到真实机器人的成功泛化。

title: Higher-Order Action Regularization in Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Continuous Control to Building Energy Management
summary: Deep reinforcement learning agents often exhibit erratic, high-frequency control behaviors that hinder real-world deployment due to excessive energy consumption and mechanical wear. We systematically investigate action smoothness regularization through higher-order derivative penalties, progressing from theoretical understanding in continuous control benchmarks to practical validation in building energy management. Our comprehensive evaluation across four continuous control environments demonstrates that third-order derivative penalties (jerk minimization) consistently achieve superior smoothness while maintaining competitive performance. We extend these findings to HVAC control systems where smooth policies reduce equipment switching by 60%, translating to significant operational benefits. Our work establishes higher-order action regularization as an effective bridge between RL optimization and operational constraints in energy-critical applications.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习智能体通常表现出不稳定、高频的控制行为，这会因过度能量消耗和机械磨损而阻碍其在现实世界的部署。我们系统地研究了通过高阶导数惩罚实现动作平滑正则化，从连续控制基准中的理论理解到建筑能源管理中的实际验证。我们对四个连续控制环境的全面评估表明，三阶导数惩罚（加加速度最小化）在保持具有竞争力的性能的同时，始终如一地实现卓越的平滑度。我们将这些发现扩展到暖通空调（HVAC）控制系统，其中平滑策略可减少60%的设备切换，从而转化为显著的运营效益。我们的工作确立了高阶动作正则化作为强化学习优化和能源关键应用中的运营约束之间有效的桥梁。
tldr: The paper introduces higher-order action regularization (specifically jerk minimization) in deep RL, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving action smoothness and reducing energy consumption in continuous control tasks and building energy management.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了深度强化学习中的高阶动作正则化（特别是急动度最小化），证明了其在提高动作平滑度和降低连续控制任务和建筑能源管理中的能源消耗方面的有效性。

title: OpenSocInt: A Multi-modal Training Environment for Human-Aware Social Navigation
summary: In this paper, we introduce OpenSocInt, an open-source software package providing a simulator for multi-modal social interactions and a modular architecture to train social agents. We described the software package and showcased its interest via an experimental protocol based on the task of social navigation. Our framework allows for exploring the use of different perceptual features, their encoding and fusion, as well as the use of different agents. The software is already publicly available under GPL at https://gitlab.inria.fr/robotlearn/OpenSocInt/.
summary_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍 OpenSocInt，一个开源软件包，它提供了一个用于多模态社会交互的模拟器，以及一个用于训练社会智能体的模块化架构。我们描述了该软件包，并通过基于社会导航任务的实验规程展示了其价值。我们的框架允许探索使用不同的感知特征、它们的编码和融合，以及使用不同的智能体。该软件已通过 GPL 协议在 https://gitlab.inria.fr/robotlearn/OpenSocInt/ 公开提供。
tldr: This paper introduces OpenSocInt, an open-source simulator for multi-modal social interactions, designed for training social agents in tasks like social navigation, allowing for exploration of perceptual features and agent architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍OpenSocInt，一个用于多模态社交互动和训练社交智能体的开源模拟器，适用于社交导航等任务，并允许探索感知特征和智能体架构。

title: Moments Matter:Stabilizing Policy Optimization using Return Distributions
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often learn policies that achieve the same episodic return yet behave very differently, due to a combination of environmental (random transitions, initial conditions, reward noise) and algorithmic (minibatch selection, exploration noise) factors. In continuous control tasks, even small parameter shifts can produce unstable gaits, complicating both algorithm comparison and real-world transfer. Previous work has shown that such instability arises when policy updates traverse noisy neighborhoods and that the spread of post-update return distribution $R(θ)$, obtained by repeatedly sampling minibatches, updating $θ$, and measuring final returns, is a useful indicator of this noise. Although explicitly constraining the policy to maintain a narrow $R(θ)$ can improve stability, directly estimating $R(θ)$ is computationally expensive in high-dimensional settings. We propose an alternative that takes advantage of environmental stochasticity to mitigate update-induced variability. Specifically, we model state-action return distribution through a distributional critic and then bias the advantage function of PPO using higher-order moments (skewness and kurtosis) of this distribution. By penalizing extreme tail behaviors, our method discourages policies from entering parameter regimes prone to instability. We hypothesize that in environments where post-update critic values align poorly with post-update returns, standard PPO struggles to produce a narrow $R(θ)$. In such cases, our moment-based correction narrows $R(θ)$, improving stability by up to 75% in Walker2D, while preserving comparable evaluation returns.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（RL）智能体常常学到具有相同片段回报但行为迥异的策略，这归因于环境（随机转移、初始条件、奖励噪声）和算法（小批量选择、探索噪声）因素的结合。在连续控制任务中，即使是微小的参数变化也可能产生不稳定的步态，从而使算法比较和现实世界迁移变得复杂。先前的工作表明，当策略更新遍历噪声邻域时，就会出现这种不稳定性，并且通过重复采样小批量、更新θ并测量最终回报，获得的更新后回报分布 $R(θ)$ 的 spread 是这种噪声的有用指标。虽然显式地约束策略以维持一个狭窄的 $R(θ)$ 可以提高稳定性，但在高维 setting 中直接估计 $R(θ)$ 在计算上是昂贵的。我们提出了一种利用环境随机性来减轻更新引起的变异性的替代方案。具体而言，我们通过一个分布式的评论家（critic）来建模 state-action 回报分布，然后使用该分布的高阶矩（偏度和峰度）来 bias PPO 的优势函数。通过惩罚极端的尾部行为，我们的方法阻止策略进入易于产生不稳定性的参数 regime。我们假设，在更新后的评论家值与更新后的回报对齐不佳的环境中，标准 PPO 难以产生一个狭窄的 $R(θ)$。在这种情况下，我们基于矩的校正缩小了 $R(θ)$，从而在 Walker2D 中将稳定性提高了最多 75%，同时保留了相当的评估回报。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to stabilize policy optimization in Deep RL by biasing the PPO advantage function with higher-order moments of the return distribution, improving stability in continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种稳定深度强化学习中策略优化的方法，通过使用回报分布的更高阶矩来偏置PPO优势函数，从而提高连续控制任务中的稳定性。

title: 360DVO: Deep Visual Odometry for Monocular 360-Degree Camera
summary: Monocular omnidirectional visual odometry (OVO) systems leverage 360-degree cameras to overcome field-of-view limitations of perspective VO systems. However, existing methods, reliant on handcrafted features or photometric objectives, often lack robustness in challenging scenarios, such as aggressive motion and varying illumination. To address this, we present 360DVO, the first deep learning-based OVO framework. Our approach introduces a distortion-aware spherical feature extractor (DAS-Feat) that adaptively learns distortion-resistant features from 360-degree images. These sparse feature patches are then used to establish constraints for effective pose estimation within a novel omnidirectional differentiable bundle adjustment (ODBA) module. To facilitate evaluation in realistic settings, we also contribute a new real-world OVO benchmark. Extensive experiments on this benchmark and public synthetic datasets (TartanAir V2 and 360VO) demonstrate that 360DVO surpasses state-of-the-art baselines (including 360VO and OpenVSLAM), improving robustness by 50% and accuracy by 37.5%. Homepage: https://chris1004336379.github.io/360DVO-homepage
summary_zh: 单目全向视觉里程计（OVO）系统利用360度相机克服了透视视觉里程计系统的视场限制。然而，现有方法依赖于手工设计的特征或光度目标，在具有挑战性的场景中，如剧烈运动和多变光照下，通常缺乏鲁棒性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了360DVO，第一个基于深度学习的OVO框架。我们的方法引入了一种失真感知球形特征提取器（DAS-Feat），能够自适应地从360度图像中学习抵抗失真的特征。然后，这些稀疏的特征块被用于建立约束，以便在一个新的全向可微捆绑调整（ODBA）模块中进行有效的姿态估计。为了方便在真实场景中进行评估，我们还贡献了一个新的真实世界OVO基准。在这个基准和公开的合成数据集（TartanAir V2和360VO）上的大量实验表明，360DVO超越了最先进的基线方法（包括360VO和OpenVSLAM），鲁棒性提高了50%，精度提高了37.5%。主页：https://chris1004336379.github.io/360DVO-homepage
tldr: 360DVO is a novel deep learning-based omnidirectional visual odometry framework that improves robustness and accuracy by using a distortion-aware feature extractor and differentiable bundle adjustment, outperforming existing methods on a new real-world benchmark and other datasets.
tldr_zh: 360DVO是一个新颖的基于深度学习的全向视觉里程计框架，通过使用具有失真感知能力的特征提取器和可微分的捆绑调整，提高了鲁棒性和准确性，并在新的真实世界基准测试和其他数据集上优于现有方法。

title: VAR RL Done Right: Tackling Asynchronous Policy Conflicts in Visual Autoregressive Generation
summary: Visual generation is dominated by three paradigms: AutoRegressive (AR), diffusion, and Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) models. Unlike AR and diffusion, VARs operate on heterogeneous input structures across their generation steps, which creates severe asynchronous policy conflicts. This issue becomes particularly acute in reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios, leading to unstable training and suboptimal alignment. To resolve this, we propose a novel framework to enhance Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) by explicitly managing these conflicts. Our method integrates three synergistic components: 1) a stabilizing intermediate reward to guide early-stage generation; 2) a dynamic time-step reweighting scheme for precise credit assignment; and 3) a novel mask propagation algorithm, derived from principles of Reward Feedback Learning (ReFL), designed to isolate optimization effects both spatially and temporally. Our approach demonstrates significant improvements in sample quality and objective alignment over the vanilla GRPO baseline, enabling robust and effective optimization for VAR models.
summary_zh: 视觉生成领域主要由三种范式主导：自回归（AR）、扩散模型和视觉自回归（VAR）模型。与AR和扩散模型不同，VAR模型在其生成步骤中操作异构输入结构，这导致严重的异步策略冲突。这个问题在强化学习（RL）场景中尤为突出，导致训练不稳定和次优对齐。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的框架，通过显式地管理这些冲突来增强群体相对策略优化（GRPO）。我们的方法整合了三个协同组件：1）一种稳定中间奖励，用于指导早期生成阶段；2）一种动态时间步重加权方案，用于精确的信用分配；以及3）一种新的掩码传播算法，源自奖励反馈学习（ReFL）的原理，旨在空间和时间上隔离优化效果。我们的方法在样本质量和目标对齐方面都显示出优于原始GRPO基线的显著改进，从而为VAR模型实现了稳健有效的优化。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel reinforcement learning framework for Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models to address asynchronous policy conflicts, achieving improved sample quality and objective alignment through intermediate rewards, dynamic reweighting, and a novel mask propagation algorithm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的视觉自回归（VAR）模型强化学习框架，通过中间奖励、动态重加权和一种新的掩码传播算法来解决异步策略冲突，从而提高了样本质量和目标对齐。

title: 360-GeoGS: Geometrically Consistent Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction for 360 Images
summary: 3D scene reconstruction is fundamental for spatial intelligence applications such as AR, robotics, and digital twins. Traditional multi-view stereo struggles with sparse viewpoints or low-texture regions, while neural rendering approaches, though capable of producing high-quality results, require per-scene optimization and lack real-time efficiency. Explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient rendering, but most feed-forward variants focus on visual quality rather than geometric consistency, limiting accurate surface reconstruction and overall reliability in spatial perception tasks. This paper presents a novel feed-forward 3DGS framework for 360 images, capable of generating geometrically consistent Gaussian primitives while maintaining high rendering quality. A Depth-Normal geometric regularization is introduced to couple rendered depth gradients with normal information, supervising Gaussian rotation, scale, and position to improve point cloud and surface accuracy. Experimental results show that the proposed method maintains high rendering quality while significantly improving geometric consistency, providing an effective solution for 3D reconstruction in spatial perception tasks.
summary_zh: 三维场景重建是增强现实、机器人和数字孪生等空间智能应用的基础。传统的多视图立体视觉在稀疏视点或低纹理区域表现不佳，而神经渲染方法虽然能够产生高质量的结果，但需要针对每个场景进行优化，并且缺乏实时的效率。显式三维高斯溅射(3DGS)能够实现高效渲染，但大多数前馈变体侧重于视觉质量而非几何一致性，限制了精确的表面重建以及在空间感知任务中的整体可靠性。本文提出了一种新颖的针对360度图像的前馈3DGS框架，该框架能够在保持高渲染质量的同时，生成几何一致的高斯图元。引入了一种深度-法向量几何正则化方法，将渲染的深度梯度与法向量信息耦合，监督高斯旋转、尺度和位置，以提高点云和表面精度。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在保持高渲染质量的同时，显著提高了几何一致性，为空间感知任务中的三维重建提供了一种有效的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for 360 images that enhances geometric consistency using Depth-Normal regularization, improving surface reconstruction and spatial perception tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于360度图像的前馈3D高斯溅射框架，利用深度-法线几何正则化来增强几何一致性，从而提高表面重建和空间感知任务的性能。

title: Adapting Depth Anything to Adverse Imaging Conditions with Events
summary: Robust depth estimation under dynamic and adverse lighting conditions is essential for robotic systems. Currently, depth foundation models, such as Depth Anything, achieve great success in ideal scenes but remain challenging under adverse imaging conditions such as extreme illumination and motion blur. These degradations corrupt the visual signals of frame cameras, weakening the discriminative features of frame-based depths across the spatial and temporal dimensions. Typically, existing approaches incorporate event cameras to leverage their high dynamic range and temporal resolution, aiming to compensate for corrupted frame features. However, such specialized fusion models are predominantly trained from scratch on domain-specific datasets, thereby failing to inherit the open-world knowledge and robust generalization inherent to foundation models. In this work, we propose ADAE, an event-guided spatiotemporal fusion framework for Depth Anything in degraded scenes. Our design is guided by two key insights: 1) Entropy-Aware Spatial Fusion. We adaptively merge frame-based and event-based features using an information entropy strategy to indicate illumination-induced degradation. 2) Motion-Guided Temporal Correction. We resort to the event-based motion cue to recalibrate ambiguous features in blurred regions. Under our unified framework, the two components are complementary to each other and jointly enhance Depth Anything under adverse imaging conditions. Extensive experiments have been performed to verify the superiority of the proposed method. Our code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 在动态和不利光照条件下实现鲁棒的深度估计对于机器人系统至关重要。目前，深度基础模型（如Depth Anything）在理想场景下取得了巨大成功，但在极端光照和运动模糊等不利成像条件下仍然面临挑战。这些退化会破坏帧相机的视觉信号，削弱基于帧的深度在空间和时间维度上的判别性特征。通常，现有方法会结合事件相机，利用其高动态范围和时间分辨率，旨在补偿损坏的帧特征。然而，这种专门的融合模型主要在特定领域的数据集上从头开始训练，因此未能继承基础模型固有的开放世界知识和鲁棒的泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们提出ADAE，一种事件引导的时空融合框架，用于在退化场景中增强Depth Anything。我们的设计基于两个关键见解：1) 熵感知空间融合。我们利用信息熵策略自适应地融合基于帧和基于事件的特征，以指示光照引起退化。2) 运动引导的时间校正。我们借助基于事件的运动线索来重新校准模糊区域中的模糊特征。在我们的统一框架下，这两个组件相互补充，共同增强Depth Anything在不利成像条件下的表现。我们进行了广泛的实验来验证所提出方法的优越性。我们的代码将在接收后发布。
tldr: This paper introduces ADAE, a framework that enhances Depth Anything by fusing frame-based and event-based data to improve depth estimation in adverse lighting and motion blur conditions, leveraging entropy-aware spatial fusion and motion-guided temporal correction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ADAE，一个通过融合基于帧和基于事件的数据来增强Depth Anything的框架，从而改善恶劣光照和运动模糊条件下的深度估计，利用熵感知空间融合和运动引导的时间校正。

title: ACDZero: Graph-Embedding-Based Tree Search for Mastering Automated Cyber Defense
summary: Automated cyber defense (ACD) seeks to protect computer networks with minimal or no human intervention, reacting to intrusions by taking corrective actions such as isolating hosts, resetting services, deploying decoys, or updating access controls. However, existing approaches for ACD, such as deep reinforcement learning (RL), often face difficult exploration in complex networks with large decision/state spaces and thus require an expensive amount of samples. Inspired by the need to learn sample-efficient defense policies, we frame ACD in CAGE Challenge 4 (CAGE-4 / CC4) as a context-based partially observable Markov decision problem and propose a planning-centric defense policy based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). It explicitly models the exploration-exploitation tradeoff in ACD and uses statistical sampling to guide exploration and decision making. We make novel use of graph neural networks (GNNs) to embed observations from the network as attributed graphs, to enable permutation-invariant reasoning over hosts and their relationships. To make our solution practical in complex search spaces, we guide MCTS with learned graph embeddings and priors over graph-edit actions, combining model-free generalization and policy distillation with look-ahead planning. We evaluate the resulting agent on CC4 scenarios involving diverse network structures and adversary behaviors, and show that our search-guided, graph-embedding-based planning improves defense reward and robustness relative to state-of-the-art RL baselines.
summary_zh: 自动化网络防御(ACD)旨在以最小或无人为干预的方式保护计算机网络，通过采取隔离主机、重置服务、部署诱饵或更新访问控制等纠正措施来对入侵做出反应。然而，现有的ACD方法，例如深度强化学习(RL)，通常在具有大型决策/状态空间的复杂网络中面临着困难的探索，因此需要大量的样本。受到学习样本高效的防御策略需求的启发，我们将CAGE挑战4 (CAGE-4 / CC4)中的ACD构建为基于上下文的部分可观测马尔可夫决策问题，并提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的以规划为中心的防御策略。它在ACD中显式地建模了探索-利用的权衡，并使用统计抽样来指导探索和决策。我们创新性地使用图神经网络(GNNs)将来自网络的观测结果嵌入为属性图，以实现对主机及其关系的置换不变推理。为了使我们的解决方案在复杂的搜索空间中切实可行，我们利用学习到的图嵌入和图编辑动作的先验知识来指导MCTS，从而将无模型泛化和策略蒸馏与前瞻性规划相结合。我们评估了所获得的Agent在涉及不同网络结构和对抗行为的CC4场景中的表现，并表明相对于最先进的RL基线，我们基于搜索引导的、基于图嵌入的规划提高了防御奖励和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces ACDZero, a graph-embedding-based Monte Carlo Tree Search method for automated cyber defense in complex networks, demonstrating improved reward and robustness compared to RL baselines on the CAGE-4 challenge.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ACDZero，一种基于图嵌入的蒙特卡洛树搜索方法，用于复杂网络中的自动化网络防御。结果表明，与CAGE-4挑战中的强化学习基线相比，ACDZero提高了奖励和鲁棒性。

title: Distorted Distributional Policy Evaluation for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: While Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DRL) methods have demonstrated strong performance in online settings, its success in offline scenarios remains limited. We hypothesize that a key limitation of existing offline DRL methods lies in their approach to uniformly underestimate return quantiles. This uniform pessimism can lead to overly conservative value estimates, ultimately hindering generalization and performance. To address this, we introduce a novel concept called quantile distortion, which enables non-uniform pessimism by adjusting the degree of conservatism based on the availability of supporting data. Our approach is grounded in theoretical analysis and empirically validated, demonstrating improved performance over uniform pessimism.
summary_zh: 分配强化学习（DRL）方法在在线环境中表现出了强大的性能，但其在离线场景中的成功仍然有限。我们假设现有离线DRL方法的一个关键限制在于它们统一低估回报分位数的方法。这种统一的悲观主义可能导致过于保守的价值估计，最终阻碍泛化和性能。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个名为分位数扭曲的新概念，它通过基于支持数据的可用性调整保守程度来实现非均匀的悲观主义。我们的方法基于理论分析并经过实证验证，证明其性能优于均匀悲观主义。
tldr: This paper introduces 'quantile distortion' for offline distributional RL, aiming to improve generalization and performance by adjusting the level of pessimism based on data availability, overcoming the limitations of uniform pessimism.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了离线分布强化学习中的“分位数扭曲”概念，旨在通过根据数据可用性调整悲观程度，克服均匀悲观的局限性，从而提高泛化性和性能。

title: Physical Transformer
summary: Digital AI systems spanning large language models, vision models, and generative architectures that operate primarily in symbolic, linguistic, or pixel domains. They have achieved striking progress, but almost all of this progress lives in virtual spaces. These systems transform embeddings and tokens, yet do not themselves touch the world and rarely admit a physical interpretation. In this work we propose a physical transformer that couples modern transformer style computation with geometric representation and physical dynamics. At the micro level, attention heads, and feed-forward blocks are modeled as interacting spins governed by effective Hamiltonians plus non-Hamiltonian bath terms. At the meso level, their aggregated state evolves on a learned Neural Differential Manifold (NDM) under Hamiltonian flows and Hamilton, Jacobi, Bellman (HJB) optimal control, discretized by symplectic layers that approximately preserve geometric and energetic invariants. At the macro level, the model maintains a generative semantic workspace and a two-dimensional information-phase portrait that tracks uncertainty and information gain over a reasoning trajectory. Within this hierarchy, reasoning tasks are formulated as controlled information flows on the manifold, with solutions corresponding to low cost trajectories that satisfy geometric, energetic, and workspace-consistency constraints. On simple toy problems involving numerical integration and dynamical systems, the physical transformer outperforms naive baselines in stability and long-horizon accuracy, highlighting the benefits of respecting underlying geometric and Hamiltonian structure. More broadly, the framework suggests a path toward physical AI that unify digital reasoning with physically grounded manifolds, opening a route to more interpretable and potentially unified models of reasoning, control, and interaction with the real world.
summary_zh: 数字人工智能系统涵盖了大型语言模型、视觉模型和主要在符号、语言或像素域中运行的生成架构。它们取得了显著进展，但几乎所有这些进展都存在于虚拟空间中。这些系统转换嵌入和标记，但它们自身不触及现实世界，并且很少允许物理解释。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种物理Transformer，它将现代Transformer风格的计算与几何表示和物理动力学相结合。在微观层面，注意力头和前馈模块被建模为受有效哈密顿量加上非哈密顿浴项支配的相互作用的自旋。在中观层面，它们的聚合状态在学习到的神经微分流形（NDM）上，在哈密顿流和哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）最优控制下演化，并由近似保留几何和能量不变性的辛层离散化。在宏观层面，该模型维护一个生成语义工作空间和一个二维信息-相位像图，用于跟踪推理轨迹上的不确定性和信息增益。在这个层次结构中，推理任务被表述为流形上的受控信息流，其解对应于满足几何、能量和工作空间一致性约束的低成本轨迹。在涉及数值积分和动力系统的简单玩具问题上，物理Transformer在稳定性和长时程精度方面优于朴素基线，突出了尊重底层几何和哈密顿结构的好处。更广泛地说，该框架为物理人工智能提出了一条路径，将数字推理与物理基础流形统一起来，为更具可解释性的、潜在统一的推理、控制和与现实世界交互的模型开辟了道路。
tldr: The paper introduces a "Physical Transformer" that integrates transformer-style computation with geometric representation and physical dynamics to achieve more stable and accurate reasoning, particularly in dynamical systems, suggesting a path towards physically grounded AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种“物理Transformer”，它将transformer风格的计算与几何表示和物理动力学相结合，以实现更稳定和精确的推理，尤其是在动力学系统中，从而为物理基础人工智能指明了方向。

title: FormuLLA: A Large Language Model Approach to Generating Novel 3D Printable Formulations
summary: Pharmaceutical three-dimensional (3D) printing is an advanced fabrication technology with the potential to enable truly personalised dosage forms. Recent studies have integrated artificial intelligence (AI) to accelerate formulation and process development, drastically transforming current approaches to pharmaceutical 3D printing. To date, most AI-driven efforts remain narrowly focused, while failing to account for the broader formulation challenges inherent to the technology. Recent advances in AI have introduced artificial general intelligence concepts, wherein systems extend beyond conventional predictive modelling toward more generalised, human-like reasoning. In this work, we investigate the application of large language models (LLMs), fine-tuned on a fused deposition modelling (FDM) dataset comprising over 1400 formulations, to recommend suitable excipients based on active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) dose, and predict filament mechanical properties. Four LLM architectures were fine-tuned, with systematic evaluation of both fine-tuning and generative parameter configurations. Our results demonstrate that Llama2 was best suited for recommending excipients for FDM formulations. Additionally, model selection and parameterisation significantly influence performance, with smaller LLMs exhibiting instances of catastrophic forgetting. Furthermore, we demonstrate: (i) even with relatively small dataset of over 1400 formulations, it can lead to model catastrophic forgetting; (ii) standard LLM metrics only evaluate linguistic performance but not formulation processability; and (iii) LLMs trained on biomedically-related data do not always produce the best results. Addressing these challenges is essential to advancing LLMs beyond linguistic proficiency and toward reliable systems for pharmaceutical formulation development.
summary_zh: 药物三维(3D)打印是一种先进的制造技术，具有实现真正个性化剂型的潜力。近期的研究已将人工智能(AI)融入其中，以加速处方和工艺开发，从而极大地改变了当前药物3D打印的方法。 迄今为止，大多数AI驱动的努力仍然聚焦于狭隘的领域，未能充分考虑该技术固有的更广泛的处方挑战。 人工智能的最新进展引入了通用人工智能的概念，其中系统超越了传统的预测建模，朝着更通用、类人的推理方向发展。 在这项工作中，我们研究了大型语言模型(LLM)的应用，该模型基于包含超过1400种配方的熔融沉积成型(FDM)数据集进行微调，以根据活性药物成分(API)剂量推荐合适的辅料，并预测丝材的机械性能。 我们对四种LLM架构进行了微调，并系统地评估了微调和生成参数配置。 我们的结果表明，Llama2最适合推荐用于FDM制剂的辅料。 此外，模型选择和参数化会显影响性能，较小的LLM会表现出灾难性遗忘的实例。 此外，我们还证明了：(i)即使是相对较小的超过1400种配方的数据集，也可能导致模型发生灾难性遗忘；(ii)标准的LLM指标仅评估语言性能，而不评估处方工艺性；以及(iii)在生物医学相关数据上训练的LLM并不总能产生最佳结果。 解决这些挑战对于推动LLM超越语言能力，并使其成为可靠的药物配方开发系统至关重要。
tldr: This paper explores using fine-tuned Large Language Models, specifically Llama2, to generate novel 3D printable pharmaceutical formulations, highlighting the challenges of dataset size, evaluation metrics, and transfer learning from general biomedical data.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用微调的大型语言模型（特别是Llama2）生成新型3D可打印药物配方，强调了数据集大小、评估指标以及从通用生物医学数据进行迁移学习的挑战。

title: Evaluating Feature Dependent Noise in Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Learning from Preferences in Reinforcement Learning (PbRL) has gained attention recently, as it serves as a natural fit for complicated tasks where the reward function is not easily available. However, preferences often come with uncertainty and noise if they are not from perfect teachers. Much prior literature aimed to detect noise, but with limited types of noise and most being uniformly distributed with no connection to observations. In this work, we formalize the notion of targeted feature-dependent noise and propose several variants like trajectory feature noise, trajectory similarity noise, uncertainty-aware noise, and Language Model noise.
  We evaluate feature-dependent noise, where noise is correlated with certain features in complex continuous control tasks from DMControl and Meta-world. Our experiments show that in some feature-dependent noise settings, the state-of-the-art noise-robust PbRL method's learning performance is significantly deteriorated, while PbRL method with no explicit denoising can surprisingly outperform noise-robust PbRL in majority settings.
  We also find language model's noise exhibits similar characteristics to feature-dependent noise, thereby simulating realistic humans and call for further study in learning with feature-dependent noise robustly.
summary_zh:
偏好强化学习（PbRL）近年来备受关注，因为它非常适合奖励函数不易获得的复杂任务。然而，如果偏好并非来自完美的教师，往往伴随着不确定性和噪声。以往许多文献旨在检测噪声，但其噪声类型有限，且大多数为均匀分布，与观测值无关。在这项工作中，我们形式化了目标特征相关的噪声概念，并提出了几种变体，如轨迹特征噪声、轨迹相似性噪声、不确定性感知噪声和语言模型噪声。

我们评估了特征相关噪声，即噪声与来自DMControl和Meta-world的复杂连续控制任务中的某些特征相关。我们的实验表明，在某些特征相关噪声设置中，最先进的抗噪声PbRL方法的学习性能显著下降，而在大多数设置中，没有显式去噪的PbRL方法竟然可以优于抗噪声PbRL。

我们还发现语言模型的噪声表现出与特征相关噪声相似的特征，从而模拟了真实的人类，并呼吁进一步研究在存在特征相关噪声的情况下进行稳健学习。
tldr: This paper formalizes and evaluates feature-dependent noise in preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL), showing that existing noise-robust methods can be outperformed by simpler PbRL in such noisy environments, and that language model noise exhibits similar characteristics.
tldr_zh: 该论文形式化并评估了基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）中依赖于特征的噪声，表明在这些噪声环境中，现有的噪声鲁棒方法可能不如更简单的PbRL，并且语言模型的噪声表现出与依赖于特征的噪声相似的特征。

title: Animated 3DGS Avatars in Diverse Scenes with Consistent Lighting and Shadows
summary: We present a method for consistent lighting and shadows when animated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatars interact with 3DGS scenes or with dynamic objects inserted into otherwise static scenes. Our key contribution is Deep Gaussian Shadow Maps (DGSM), a modern analogue of the classical shadow mapping algorithm tailored to the volumetric 3DGS representation. Building on the classic deep shadow mapping idea, we show that 3DGS admits closed form light accumulation along light rays, enabling volumetric shadow computation without meshing. For each estimated light, we tabulate transmittance over concentric radial shells and store them in octahedral atlases, which modern GPUs can sample in real time per query to attenuate affected scene Gaussians and thus cast and receive shadows consistently. To relight moving avatars, we approximate the local environment illumination with HDRI probes represented in a spherical harmonic (SH) basis and apply a fast per Gaussian radiance transfer, avoiding explicit BRDF estimation or offline optimization. We demonstrate environment consistent lighting for avatars from AvatarX and ActorsHQ, composited into ScanNet++, DL3DV, and SuperSplat scenes, and show interactions with inserted objects. Across single and multi avatar settings, DGSM and SH relighting operate fully in the volumetric 3DGS representation, yielding coherent shadows and relighting while avoiding meshing.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种方法，用于在动画3D高斯溅射（3DGS）化身与3DGS场景或插入到静态场景中的动态对象进行交互时，实现一致的光照和阴影效果。 我们的主要贡献是深度高斯阴影图（DGSM），这是经典阴影贴图算法的现代类似物，专门为体渲染3DGS表示定制。 基于经典的深度阴影贴图思想，我们证明了3DGS允许沿光线进行闭式光累积，从而能够在无需网格划分的情况下进行体阴影计算。 对于每个估计的光源，我们对同心径向壳上的透射率进行列表格化，并将它们存储在八面体图集中，现代GPU可以实时地对每个查询进行采样，以衰减受影响的场景高斯体，从而一致地投射和接收阴影。 为了重新照亮移动的化身，我们使用球谐函数（SH）基表示的HDRI探针来近似局部环境光照，并应用快速的逐高斯辐射传递，避免了显式的BRDF估计或离线优化。 我们展示了来自AvatarX和ActorsHQ的化身与环境一致的光照，这些化身被合成到ScanNet ++，DL3DV和SuperSplat场景中，并展示了与插入对象的交互。 在单化身和多化身设置中，DGSM和SH重照明完全在体渲染3DGS表示中运行，从而在避免网格划分的同时产生连贯的阴影和重照明效果。
tldr: This paper introduces Deep Gaussian Shadow Maps (DGSM) for consistent lighting and shadow rendering of animated 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars interacting with different scenes and dynamic objects, using closed-form light accumulation and spherical harmonic relighting.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了深度高斯阴影图（DGSM），用于对动画3D高斯溅射头像与不同场景和动态对象交互时进行一致的光照和阴影渲染，使用闭式光累积和球谐光照重打。

title: RealPDEBench: A Benchmark for Complex Physical Systems with Real-World Data
summary: Predicting the evolution of complex physical systems remains a central problem in science and engineering. Despite rapid progress in scientific Machine Learning (ML) models, a critical bottleneck is the lack of expensive real-world data, resulting in most current models being trained and validated on simulated data. Beyond limiting the development and evaluation of scientific ML, this gap also hinders research into essential tasks such as sim-to-real transfer. We introduce RealPDEBench, the first benchmark for scientific ML that integrates real-world measurements with paired numerical simulations. RealPDEBench consists of five datasets, three tasks, eight metrics, and ten baselines. We first present five real-world measured datasets with paired simulated datasets across different complex physical systems. We further define three tasks, which allow comparisons between real-world and simulated data, and facilitate the development of methods to bridge the two. Moreover, we design eight evaluation metrics, spanning data-oriented and physics-oriented metrics, and finally benchmark ten representative baselines, including state-of-the-art models, pretrained PDE foundation models, and a traditional method. Experiments reveal significant discrepancies between simulated and real-world data, while showing that pretraining with simulated data consistently improves both accuracy and convergence. In this work, we hope to provide insights from real-world data, advancing scientific ML toward bridging the sim-to-real gap and real-world deployment. Our benchmark, datasets, and instructions are available at https://realpdebench.github.io/.
summary_zh: 预测复杂物理系统的演化仍然是科学和工程领域的核心问题。尽管科学机器学习（ML）模型取得了快速进展，但一个关键瓶颈是缺乏昂贵的真实世界数据，导致目前大多数模型都在模拟数据上进行训练和验证。这种差距不仅限制了科学机器学习的开发和评估，还阻碍了对诸如模拟到真实（sim-to-real）迁移等关键任务的研究。我们推出了 RealPDEBench，这是首个科学机器学习基准，它将真实世界测量数据与配对的数值模拟相结合。RealPDEBench 包含五个数据集、三个任务、八个指标和十个基线。我们首先介绍了五个具有配对模拟数据集的真实世界测量数据集，涵盖不同的复杂物理系统。我们进一步定义了三个任务，允许对真实世界数据和模拟数据进行比较，并促进弥合两者之间差距的方法的开发。此外，我们设计了八个评估指标，涵盖面向数据的指标和面向物理的指标，最后对十个代表性基线进行了基准测试，包括最先进的模型、预训练的 PDE 基础模型以及传统方法。实验表明，模拟数据和真实世界数据之间存在显著差异，同时表明使用模拟数据进行预训练始终可以提高准确性和收敛性。在这项工作中，我们希望提供来自真实世界数据的见解，从而推动科学机器学习朝着弥合模拟到真实的差距和真实世界部署的方向发展。我们的基准、数据集和说明可在 https://realpdebench.github.io/ 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces RealPDEBench, a new benchmark for scientific ML that integrates real-world measurements with paired numerical simulations across five datasets and defines tasks and metrics to facilitate sim-to-real transfer research. Experiments reveal discrepancies and the benefit of pretraining, suggesting real-world data is crucial for advancing scientific ML.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RealPDEBench，这是一个新的科学机器学习基准，它整合了真实世界的测量数据和配对的数值模拟数据，涵盖五个数据集，并定义了任务和指标以促进sim-to-real迁移的研究。实验表明真实数据与模拟数据之间存在差异，且预训练具有优势，这表明真实世界的数据对于推进科学机器学习至关重要。

title: SingingBot: An Avatar-Driven System for Robotic Face Singing Performance
summary: Equipping robotic faces with singing capabilities is crucial for empathetic Human-Robot Interaction. However, existing robotic face driving research primarily focuses on conversations or mimicking static expressions, struggling to meet the high demands for continuous emotional expression and coherence in singing. To address this, we propose a novel avatar-driven framework for appealing robotic singing. We first leverage portrait video generation models embedded with extensive human priors to synthesize vivid singing avatars, providing reliable expression and emotion guidance. Subsequently, these facial features are transferred to the robot via semantic-oriented mapping functions that span a wide expression space.
