Furthermore, to quantitatively evaluate the emotional richness of robotic singing, we propose the Emotion Dynamic Range metric to measure the emotional breadth within the Valence-Arousal space, revealing that a broad emotional spectrum is crucial for appealing performances. Comprehensive experiments prove that our method achieves rich emotional expressions while maintaining lip-audio synchronization, significantly outperforming existing approaches.
summary_zh: 为使机器人面部具备歌唱能力对于共情的人机交互至关重要。然而，现有的机器人面部驱动研究主要集中于对话或模仿静态表情，难以满足歌唱中对持续情感表达和连贯性的高要求。为解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的头像驱动框架来实现引人入胜的机器人歌唱。我们首先利用嵌入了丰富人类先验知识的人像视频生成模型来合成生动的歌唱头像，从而提供可靠的表情和情感指导。随后，这些面部特征通过跨越广阔表情空间的语义导向映射函数传递到机器人。此外，为了定量评估机器人歌唱的情感丰富度，我们提出了一种情感动态范围指标，用于衡量Valence-Arousal空间内的情感广度，揭示了广泛的情感频谱对于引人入胜的表演至关重要。综合实验证明，我们的方法在保持唇音同步的同时实现了丰富的情感表达，显著优于现有方法。
tldr: The paper introduces an avatar-driven framework for robotic face singing, utilizing portrait video generation models and semantic mapping to achieve rich emotional expressions and lip-audio synchronization. They evaluate emotional richness using a novel "Emotion Dynamic Range" metric.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于人物头像驱动的机器人人脸唱歌框架，利用肖像视频生成模型和语义映射来实现丰富的情感表达和唇音同步。他们使用一种新的 "情感动态范围" 指标来评估情感丰富度。

title: VIT-Ped: Visionary Intention Transformer for Pedestrian Behavior Analysis
summary: Pedestrian Intention prediction is one of the key technologies in the transition from level 3 to level 4 autonomous driving. To understand pedestrian crossing behaviour, several elements and features should be taken into consideration to make the roads of tomorrow safer for everybody. We introduce a transformer / video vision transformer based algorithm of different sizes which uses different data modalities .We evaluated our algorithms on popular pedestrian behaviour dataset, JAAD, and have reached SOTA performance and passed the SOTA in metrics like Accuracy, AUC and F1-score. The advantages brought by different model design choices are investigated via extensive ablation studies.
summary_zh: 行人意图预测是从L3级到L4级自动驾驶过渡的关键技术之一。要理解行人的穿越行为，需要考虑多个要素和特征，以使未来的道路对所有人而言都更加安全。我们介绍了一种基于Transformer/视频视觉Transformer的不同规模算法，该算法利用了不同的数据模态。我们在流行的行人行为数据集JAAD上评估了我们的算法，并在准确率、AUC和F1分数等指标上达到了SOTA性能并超越了SOTA。通过广泛的消融研究，我们调查了不同模型设计选择所带来的优势。
tldr: The paper introduces a Vision Transformer-based model (VIT-Ped) for pedestrian intention prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results on the JAAD dataset. It explores various model design choices through ablation studies.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于视觉Transformer的模型(VIT-Ped)，用于行人意图预测，并在JAAD数据集上实现了最先进的结果。它通过消融研究探索了不同的模型设计选择。

title: From Metrics to Meaning: Insights from a Mixed-Methods Field Experiment on Retail Robot Deployment
summary:
We report a mixed-methods field experiment of a conversational service robot deployed under everyday staffing discretion in a live bedding store. Over 12 days we alternated three conditions--Baseline (no robot), Robot-only, and Robot+Fixture--and video-annotated the service funnel from passersby to purchase. An explanatory sequential design then used six post-experiment staff interviews to interpret the quantitative patterns.
  Quantitatively, the robot increased stopping per passerby (highest with the fixture), yet clerk-led downstream steps per stopper--clerk approach, store entry, assisted experience, and purchase--decreased. Interviews explained this divergence: clerks avoided interrupting ongoing robot-customer talk, struggled with ambiguous timing amid conversational latency, and noted child-centered attraction that often satisfied curiosity at the doorway. The fixture amplified visibility but also anchored encounters at the threshold, creating a well-defined micro-space where needs could ``close'' without moving inside.
  We synthesize these strands into an integrative account from the initial show of interest on the part of a customer to their entering the store and derive actionable guidance. The results advance the understanding of interactions between customers, staff members, and the robot and offer practical recommendations for deploying service robots in high-touch retail.
summary_zh:
我们报告了一项混合方法实地实验，该实验在一个真实的床上用品商店中，在日常员工自主权下部署了一个会话式服务机器人。在为期12天的时间里，我们交替进行了三种条件设置——基线（无机器人）、仅机器人和机器人+展示架——并对从路人到购买的服务漏斗进行了视频标注。然后，一个解释性顺序设计使用了六次实验后的员工访谈来解释这些定量模式。

在定量方面，机器人增加了每个路人的停留人数（在有展示架的情况下最高），但店员主导的下游步骤——店员接近、进入商店、辅助体验和购买——却减少了。访谈解释了这种差异：店员避免打断正在进行的机器人-顾客对话，在对话延迟中难以确定适当的时机，并注意到以儿童为中心的吸引力通常在门口就满足了好奇心。展示架增强了可见性，但也将互动锚定在门口，创造了一个定义明确的微空间，在那里需求可以在不进入内部的情况下“结束”。

我们将这些线索整合为一个综合解释，从顾客最初表现出的兴趣到他们进入商店，并从中得出可操作的指导。该结果提升了对顾客、员工和机器人之间互动关系的理解，并为在高接触零售中部署服务机器人提供了实用的建议。
tldr: This paper presents a mixed-methods field experiment on deploying a conversational robot in a bedding store, finding that while the robot attracts attention, it negatively impacts clerk engagement and downstream customer interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个在床上用品商店部署对话机器人的混合方法现场实验，发现虽然机器人吸引了注意力，但它对店员参与和下游客户互动产生了负面影响。

title: DisCo-FLoc: Using Dual-Level Visual-Geometric Contrasts to Disambiguate Depth-Aware Visual Floorplan Localization
summary: Since floorplan data is readily available, long-term persistent, and robust to changes in visual appearance, visual Floorplan Localization (FLoc) has garnered significant attention. Existing methods either ingeniously match geometric priors or utilize sparse semantics to reduce FLoc uncertainty. However, they still suffer from ambiguous FLoc caused by repetitive structures within minimalist floorplans. Moreover, expensive but limited semantic annotations restrict their applicability. To address these issues, we propose DisCo-FLoc, which utilizes dual-level visual-geometric Contrasts to Disambiguate depth-aware visual Floc, without requiring additional semantic labels. Our solution begins with a ray regression predictor tailored for ray-casting-based FLoc, predicting a series of FLoc candidates using depth estimation expertise. In addition, a novel contrastive learning method with position-level and orientation-level constraints is proposed to strictly match depth-aware visual features with the corresponding geometric structures in the floorplan. Such matches can effectively eliminate FLoc ambiguity and select the optimal imaging pose from FLoc candidates. Exhaustive comparative studies on two standard visual Floc benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic-based method, achieving significant improvements in both robustness and accuracy.
summary_zh: 视觉平面图定位（FLoc）因其平面图数据易于获取、长期持久且对视觉外观变化具有鲁棒性而备受关注。现有方法要么巧妙地匹配几何先验，要么利用稀疏语义来降低FLoc的不确定性。然而，它们仍然受到极简平面图内重复结构引起的FLoc歧义性的困扰。此外，昂贵但有限的语义标注限制了其适用性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出DisCo-FLoc，它利用双层视觉-几何对比来消除深度感知视觉FLoc的歧义性，而无需额外的语义标签。我们的解决方案从一个为基于光线投射的FLoc量身定制的光线回归预测器开始，利用深度估计专业知识预测一系列FLoc候选位置。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的具有位置级别和方向级别约束的对比学习方法，以严格匹配深度感知的视觉特征与平面图中相应的几何结构。这种匹配可以有效地消除FLoc歧义性，并从FLoc候选位置中选择最佳成像姿态。在两个标准视觉FLoc基准测试上的详尽对比研究表明，我们的方法优于最先进的基于语义的方法，在鲁棒性和准确性方面均取得了显著的提升。
tldr: The paper introduces DisCo-FLoc, a novel approach for visual floorplan localization that leverages dual-level visual-geometric contrasts and contrastive learning to overcome ambiguities caused by repetitive structures, achieving state-of-the-art performance without semantic labels.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的视觉平面图定位方法 DisCo-FLoc，该方法利用双层视觉-几何对比和对比学习来克服由重复结构引起的歧义，无需语义标签即可实现最先进的性能。

title: Simulations and Advancements in MRI-Guided Power-Driven Ferric Tools for Wireless Therapeutic Interventions
summary: Designing a robotic system that functions effectively within the specific environment of a Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scanner requires solving numerous technical issues, such as maintaining the robot's precision and stability under strong magnetic fields. This research focuses on enhancing MRI's role in medical imaging, especially in its application to guide intravascular interventions using robot-assisted devices. A newly developed computational system is introduced, designed for seamless integration with the MRI scanner, including a computational unit and user interface. This system processes MR images to delineate the vascular network, establishing virtual paths and boundaries within vessels to prevent procedural damage. Key findings reveal the system's capability to create tailored magnetic field gradient patterns for device control, considering the vessel's geometry and safety norms, and adapting to different blood flow characteristics for finer navigation. Additionally, the system's modeling aspect assesses the safety and feasibility of navigating pre-set vascular paths. Conclusively, this system, based on the Qt framework and C/C++, with specialized software modules, represents a major step forward in merging imaging technology with robotic aid, significantly enhancing precision and safety in intravascular procedures.
summary_zh: 设计能在磁共振成像（MRI）扫描仪特定环境中有效运行的机器人系统需要解决众多技术问题，例如在强磁场下保持机器人的精度和稳定性。本研究侧重于增强MRI在医学成像中的作用，尤其是在其利用机器人辅助设备引导血管内介入治疗的应用中。本文介绍了一种新开发的计算系统，该系统旨在与MRI扫描仪无缝集成，包括计算单元和用户界面。该系统处理MR图像以勾画血管网络，在血管内建立虚拟路径和边界以防止手术损伤。主要研究结果揭示了该系统能够创建用于设备控制的定制磁场梯度模式，同时考虑血管几何形状和安全规范，并适应不同的血流特性以实现更精细的导航。此外，系统的建模部分评估了导航预设血管路径的安全性和可行性。总之，该系统基于Qt框架和C/C++，具有专门的软件模块，代表着将成像技术与机器人辅助相结合的一大进步，显著提高了血管内手术的精度和安全性。
tldr: This paper presents a computational system that integrates with MRI scanners to guide robotic intravascular interventions, enhancing precision and safety by creating tailored magnetic field gradient patterns based on vessel geometry and blood flow characteristics. The system uses a Qt/C++ framework.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种与MRI扫描仪集成的计算系统，以指导机器人血管内介入，通过基于血管几何形状和血流特征创建定制的磁场梯度模式来提高精度和安全性。该系统使用Qt/C++框架。

title: LLM-Empowered Functional Safety and Security by Design in Automotive Systems
summary: This paper presents LLM-empowered workflow to support Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) software development, covering the aspects of security-aware system topology design, as well as event-driven decision-making code analysis. For code analysis we adopt event chains model which provides formal foundations to systematic validation of functional safety, taking into account the semantic validity of messages exchanged between key components, including both CAN and Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS). Analysis of security aspects for topology relies on synergy with Model-Driven Engineering (MDE) approach and Object Constraint Language (OCL) rules. Both locally deployable and proprietary solution are taken into account for evaluation within Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS)-related scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种由大型语言模型（LLM）赋能的工作流，以支持软件定义汽车（SDV）的软件开发，涵盖了安全感知的系统拓扑设计，以及事件驱动决策代码分析等方面。对于代码分析，我们采用事件链模型，该模型为功能安全的系统化验证提供了形式化基础，并考虑了关键组件之间交换消息的语义有效性，包括CAN总线和车辆信号规范（VSS）。拓扑安全方面的分析依赖于与模型驱动工程（MDE）方法和对象约束语言（OCL）规则的协同作用。在高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）相关场景中，对本地可部署和专有解决方案进行了评估。
tldr: This paper proposes using LLMs to improve functional safety and security in Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) development, focusing on system topology design and event-driven code analysis for ADAS. It uses event chains for safety validation and MDE/OCL rules for security.
tldr_zh: 本文提出利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 改进软件定义汽车 (SDV) 开发中的功能安全和安全性，重点关注 ADAS 的系统拓扑设计和事件驱动的代码分析。它使用事件链进行安全验证，并使用 MDE/OCL 规则进行安全性验证。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Zooming in the Dark with Event Cameras
summary: This paper addresses low-light video super-resolution (LVSR), aiming to restore high-resolution videos from low-light, low-resolution (LR) inputs. Existing LVSR methods often struggle to recover fine details due to limited contrast and insufficient high-frequency information. To overcome these challenges, we present RetinexEVSR, the first event-driven LVSR framework that leverages high-contrast event signals and Retinex-inspired priors to enhance video quality under low-light scenarios. Unlike previous approaches that directly fuse degraded signals, RetinexEVSR introduces a novel bidirectional cross-modal fusion strategy to extract and integrate meaningful cues from noisy event data and degraded RGB frames. Specifically, an illumination-guided event enhancement module is designed to progressively refine event features using illumination maps derived from the Retinex model, thereby suppressing low-light artifacts while preserving high-contrast details. Furthermore, we propose an event-guided reflectance enhancement module that utilizes the enhanced event features to dynamically recover reflectance details via a multi-scale fusion mechanism. Experimental results show that our RetinexEVSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on three datasets. Notably, on the SDSD benchmark, our method can get up to 2.95 dB gain while reducing runtime by 65% compared to prior event-based methods. Code: https://github.com/DachunKai/RetinexEVSR.
summary_zh: 本文研究低光照视频超分辨率 (LVSR) 问题，旨在从低光照、低分辨率 (LR) 输入中恢复高分辨率视频。现有的 LVSR 方法通常难以恢复精细细节，因为对比度有限且高频信息不足。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了 RetinexEVSR，这是第一个事件驱动的 LVSR 框架，它利用高对比度事件信号和 Retinex 启发的先验知识来增强低光照场景下的视频质量。与直接融合退化信号的先前方法不同，RetinexEVSR 引入了一种新颖的双向跨模态融合策略，以从噪声事件数据和退化的 RGB 帧中提取和整合有意义的线索。具体而言，我们设计了一个光照引导的事件增强模块，利用从 Retinex 模型获得的光照图来逐步细化事件特征，从而抑制低光照伪影，同时保留高对比度细节。此外，我们提出了一种事件引导的反射增强模块，该模块利用增强的事件特征，通过多尺度融合机制动态地恢复反射细节。实验结果表明，我们的 RetinexEVSR 在三个数据集上实现了最先进的性能。特别是在 SDSD 基准测试中，与之前的基于事件的方法相比，我们的方法可以获得高达 2.95 dB 的增益，同时运行时间减少 65%。代码：https://github.com/DachunKai/RetinexEVSR.
tldr: The paper proposes RetinexEVSR, a novel event-driven low-light video super-resolution framework that fuses event data and RGB frames using a bidirectional cross-modal fusion strategy to enhance video quality in low-light conditions, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 RetinexEVSR，一种新颖的事件驱动的弱光视频超分辨率框架，它使用双向跨模态融合策略融合事件数据和 RGB 帧，以提高弱光条件下的视频质量，并取得了最先进的结果。

title: Admissibility Alignment
summary:
This paper introduces Admissibility Alignment: a reframing of AI alignment as a property of admissible action and decision selection over distributions of outcomes under uncertainty, evaluated through the behavior of candidate policies. We present MAP-AI (Monte Carlo Alignment for Policy) as a canonical system architecture for operationalizing admissibility alignment, formalizing alignment as a probabilistic, decision-theoretic property rather than a static or binary condition.
  MAP-AI, a new control-plane system architecture for aligned decision-making under uncertainty, enforces alignment through Monte Carlo estimation of outcome distributions and admissibility-controlled policy selection rather than static model-level constraints. The framework evaluates decision policies across ensembles of plausible futures, explicitly modeling uncertainty, intervention effects, value ambiguity, and governance constraints. Alignment is assessed through distributional properties including expected utility, variance, tail risk, and probability of misalignment rather than accuracy or ranking performance. This approach distinguishes probabilistic prediction from decision reasoning under uncertainty and provides an executable methodology for evaluating trust and alignment in enterprise and institutional AI systems. The result is a practical foundation for governing AI systems whose impact is determined not by individual forecasts, but by policy behavior across distributions and tail events. Finally, we show how distributional alignment evaluation can be integrated into decision-making itself, yielding an admissibility-controlled action selection mechanism that alters policy behavior under uncertainty without retraining or modifying underlying models.
summary_zh:
本文介绍了可容许性对齐：将人工智能对齐重新定义为在不确定性下行动和决策选择的可容许性，通过候选策略的行为来评估结果分布。我们提出了MAP-AI（策略的蒙特卡洛对齐）作为一种用于操作化可容许性对齐的规范系统架构，将对齐形式化为一个概率的、决策理论的性质，而不是一种静态或二元条件。

MAP-AI是一种新的控制平面系统架构，用于不确定性下的对齐决策制定，它通过对结果分布的蒙特卡洛估计和可容许性控制的策略选择来强制执行对齐，而不是静态的模型层面的约束。该框架评估跨越一组合理未来情景的决策策略，显式地建模不确定性、干预效果、价值歧义和治理约束。 对齐通过包括期望效用、方差、尾部风险和未对齐概率在内的分布属性来评估，而不是准确性或排名性能。 这种方法区分了概率预测和不确定性下的决策推理，并为评估企业和机构人工智能系统中的信任和对齐提供了一种可执行的方法。 其结果是为治理人工智能系统奠定了一个实践基础，这些系统的影响不是由单个预测决定的，而是由跨分布和尾部事件的策略行为决定的。 最后，我们展示了如何将分布对齐评估整合到决策制定本身中，从而产生一种可容许性控制的行动选择机制，该机制可以在不确定性下改变策略行为，而无需重新训练或修改底层模型。
tldr: The paper proposes 'Admissibility Alignment' and a system architecture called MAP-AI for aligning AI policies under uncertainty, evaluating alignment through distributional properties of outcomes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了“可容许性对齐”（Admissibility Alignment）和一个名为MAP-AI的系统架构，用于在不确定性下对齐AI策略，并通过结果的分布特性评估对齐情况。

title: Adversarial Instance Generation and Robust Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Multiple Objectives
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has shown great promise in addressing multi-objective combinatorial optimization problems (MOCOPs). Nevertheless, the robustness of these learning-based solvers has remained insufficiently explored, especially across diverse and complex problem distributions. In this paper, we propose a unified robustness-oriented framework for preference-conditioned DRL solvers for MOCOPs. Within this framework, we develop a preference-based adversarial attack to generate hard instances that expose solver weaknesses, and quantify the attack impact by the resulting degradation on Pareto-front quality. We further introduce a defense strategy that integrates hardness-aware preference selection into adversarial training to reduce overfitting to restricted preference regions and improve out-of-distribution performance. The experimental results on multi-objective traveling salesman problem (MOTSP), multi-objective capacitated vehicle routing problem (MOCVRP), and multi-objective knapsack problem (MOKP) verify that our attack method successfully learns hard instances for different solvers. Furthermore, our defense method significantly strengthens the robustness and generalizability of neural solvers, delivering superior performance on hard or out-of-distribution instances.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（DRL）在解决多目标组合优化问题（MOCOPs）方面展现出巨大的潜力。然而，这些基于学习的求解器的鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索，尤其是在多样且复杂的问题分布中。在本文中，我们提出了一个统一的面向鲁棒性的框架，用于解决MOCOP的基于偏好的条件深度强化学习求解器。在该框架内，我们开发了一种基于偏好的对抗性攻击，以生成暴露求解器弱点的难样本，并通过Pareto前沿质量的下降来量化攻击的影响。我们进一步引入了一种防御策略，该策略将感知难度的偏好选择集成到对抗性训练中，以减少对有限偏好区域的过拟合，并提高分布外性能。在多目标旅行商问题（MOTSP）、多目标带容量车辆路径问题（MOCVRP）和多目标背包问题（MOKP）上的实验结果表明，我们的攻击方法成功地为不同的求解器学习了难样本。此外，我们的防御方法显著增强了神经求解器的鲁棒性和泛化能力，从而在难样本或分布外样本上实现了卓越的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces an adversarial training framework for preference-conditioned Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) solvers applied to multi-objective combinatorial optimization problems (MOCOPs), enhancing their robustness and generalizability by generating hard instances and improving training strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种对抗训练框架，用于偏好条件下的深度强化学习（DRL）求解器，应用于多目标组合优化问题（MOCOPs）。通过生成困难样本并改进训练策略，增强了求解器的鲁棒性和泛化性。

title: SortWaste: A Densely Annotated Dataset for Object Detection in Industrial Waste Sorting
summary: The increasing production of waste, driven by population growth, has created challenges in managing and recycling materials effectively. Manual waste sorting is a common practice; however, it remains inefficient for handling large-scale waste streams and presents health risks for workers. On the other hand, existing automated sorting approaches still struggle with the high variability, clutter, and visual complexity of real-world waste streams. The lack of real-world datasets for waste sorting is a major reason automated systems for this problem are underdeveloped. Accordingly, we introduce SortWaste, a densely annotated object detection dataset collected from a Material Recovery Facility. Additionally, we contribute to standardizing waste detection in sorting lines by proposing ClutterScore, an objective metric that gauges the scene's hardness level using a set of proxies that affect visual complexity (e.g., object count, class and size entropy, and spatial overlap). In addition to these contributions, we provide an extensive benchmark of state-of-the-art object detection models, detailing their results with respect to the hardness level assessed by the proposed metric. Despite achieving promising results (mAP of 59.7% in the plastic-only detection task), performance significantly decreases in highly cluttered scenes. This highlights the need for novel and more challenging datasets on the topic.
summary_zh: 人口增长驱动了废物产量的不断增加，这给有效管理和回收材料带来了挑战。人工垃圾分拣是一种常见的做法；然而，对于处理大规模的废物流来说，它仍然效率低下，并且对工人存在健康风险。另一方面，现有的自动化分拣方法仍然难以应对真实世界废物流的高度可变性、杂乱性和视觉复杂性。缺乏用于垃圾分拣的真实世界数据集是导致该问题的自动化系统欠发达的主要原因。因此，我们推出了SortWaste，这是一个从材料回收设施收集的密集标注的目标检测数据集。此外，我们通过提出ClutterScore来促进分拣线上废物检测的标准化，ClutterScore是一种客观指标，它使用一套影响视觉复杂性的代理变量（例如，对象计数、类别和大小熵以及空间重叠）来衡量场景的难度级别。除了这些贡献，我们还提供了最先进的目标检测模型的广泛基准测试，详细说明了它们在由所提出指标评估的难度级别方面的结果。尽管取得了有希望的结果（在仅塑料检测任务中mAP为59.7%），但在高度杂乱的场景中，性能会显著下降。这突出了对该主题的新颖且更具挑战性的数据集的需求。
tldr: The paper introduces a densely annotated object detection dataset (SortWaste) for industrial waste sorting and a new metric, ClutterScore, for quantifying scene complexity. The authors benchmark state-of-the-art object detection models on the dataset, highlighting performance degradation in cluttered scenes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个用于工业垃圾分类的密集注释目标检测数据集 (SortWaste) 和一个新的度量标准 ClutterScore，用于量化场景的复杂性。作者在数据集上对最先进的目标检测模型进行了基准测试，突出了在杂乱场景中的性能下降。

title: DiffProxy: Multi-View Human Mesh Recovery via Diffusion-Generated Dense Proxies
summary: Human mesh recovery from multi-view images faces a fundamental challenge: real-world datasets contain imperfect ground-truth annotations that bias the models' training, while synthetic data with precise supervision suffers from domain gap. In this paper, we propose DiffProxy, a novel framework that generates multi-view consistent human proxies for mesh recovery. Central to DiffProxy is leveraging the diffusion-based generative priors to bridge the synthetic training and real-world generalization. Its key innovations include: (1) a multi-conditional mechanism for generating multi-view consistent, pixel-aligned human proxies; (2) a hand refinement module that incorporates flexible visual prompts to enhance local details; and (3) an uncertainty-aware test-time scaling method that increases robustness to challenging cases during optimization. These designs ensure that the mesh recovery process effectively benefits from the precise synthetic ground truth and generative advantages of the diffusion-based pipeline. Trained entirely on synthetic data, DiffProxy achieves state-of-the-art performance across five real-world benchmarks, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization particularly on challenging scenarios with occlusions and partial views. Project page: https://wrk226.github.io/DiffProxy.html
summary_zh: 从多视角图像中进行人体网格重建面临一个根本性的挑战：真实世界数据集包含不完善的真值标注，这会偏置模型的训练；而具有精确监督的合成数据则存在领域差异。在本文中，我们提出 DiffProxy，一种用于生成多视角一致人体代理网格重建的新颖框架。DiffProxy 的核心是利用基于扩散的生成先验来弥合合成训练数据和真实世界泛化之间的差距。其关键创新包括：(1) 一种用于生成多视角一致、像素对齐的人体代理网格的多条件机制；(2) 一个手部细化模块，该模块结合了灵活的视觉提示以增强局部细节；以及 (3) 一种不确定性感知的测试时缩放方法，该方法提高了优化过程中对具有挑战性情况的鲁棒性。这些设计确保了网格重建过程能够有效地受益于精确的合成真值和基于扩散的管道的生成优势。DiffProxy 完全在合成数据上进行训练，在五个真实世界基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，展示了强大的零样本泛化能力，尤其是在具有遮挡和部分视角的挑战性场景中。项目主页：https://wrk226.github.io/DiffProxy.html
tldr: The paper introduces DiffProxy, a diffusion-based framework for multi-view human mesh recovery that aims to bridge the gap between synthetic training data and real-world generalization by generating consistent and refined human proxies, achieving SOTA zero-shot performance on real-world benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DiffProxy，一个基于扩散的多视图人体网格恢复框架，旨在通过生成一致和精细化的人体代理来弥合合成训练数据和真实世界泛化之间的差距，并在真实世界基准上实现了SOTA零样本性能。

title: PhysSFI-Net: Physics-informed Geometric Learning of Skeletal and Facial Interactions for Orthognathic Surgical Outcome Prediction
summary: Orthognathic surgery repositions jaw bones to restore occlusion and enhance facial aesthetics. Accurate simulation of postoperative facial morphology is essential for preoperative planning. However, traditional biomechanical models are computationally expensive, while geometric deep learning approaches often lack interpretability. In this study, we develop and validate a physics-informed geometric deep learning framework named PhysSFI-Net for precise prediction of soft tissue deformation following orthognathic surgery. PhysSFI-Net consists of three components: a hierarchical graph module with craniofacial and surgical plan encoders combined with attention mechanisms to extract skeletal-facial interaction features; a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)-based sequential predictor for incremental soft tissue deformation; and a biomechanics-inspired module for high-resolution facial surface reconstruction. Model performance was assessed using point cloud shape error (Hausdorff distance), surface deviation error, and landmark localization error (Euclidean distances of craniomaxillofacial landmarks) between predicted facial shapes and corresponding ground truths. A total of 135 patients who underwent combined orthodontic and orthognathic treatment were included for model training and validation. Quantitative analysis demonstrated that PhysSFI-Net achieved a point cloud shape error of 1.070 +/- 0.088 mm, a surface deviation error of 1.296 +/- 0.349 mm, and a landmark localization error of 2.445 +/- 1.326 mm. Comparative experiments indicated that PhysSFI-Net outperformed the state-of-the-art method ACMT-Net in prediction accuracy. In conclusion, PhysSFI-Net enables interpretable, high-resolution prediction of postoperative facial morphology with superior accuracy, showing strong potential for clinical application in orthognathic surgical planning and simulation.
summary_zh: 正颌外科手术通过重新定位颌骨来恢复咬合关系并改善面部美观。术后面部形态的精确模拟对于术前计划至关重要。然而，传统的生物力学模型计算成本高昂，而几何深度学习方法通常缺乏可解释性。在本研究中，我们开发并验证了一个名为PhysSFI-Net的、基于物理信息的几何深度学习框架，用于精确预测正颌外科手术后的软组织变形。PhysSFI-Net由三个部分组成：一个包含颅面和手术计划编码器并结合注意力机制的分层图模块，用于提取骨骼-面部交互特征；一个基于长短期记忆网络(LSTM)的序列预测器，用于增量式软组织变形预测；以及一个受生物力学启发的模块，用于高分辨率面部表面重建。采用点云形状误差（豪斯多夫距离）、表面偏差误差和地标定位误差（颅颌面地标的欧几里得距离）评估模型性能，对比预测的面部形状和相应的真实值。共纳入135例接受正畸和正颌联合治疗的患者进行模型训练和验证。定量分析表明，PhysSFI-Net实现了1.070 +/- 0.088 mm的点云形状误差、1.296 +/- 0.349 mm的表面偏差误差和2.445 +/- 1.326 mm的地标定位误差。对比实验表明，PhysSFI-Net在预测精度方面优于最先进的方法ACMT-Net。 综上所述，PhysSFI-Net能够以更高的精度实现术后面部形态的解释性、高分辨率预测，在正颌外科手术计划和模拟中显示出强大的临床应用潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces PhysSFI-Net, a physics-informed geometric deep learning framework for predicting soft tissue deformation after orthognathic surgery, achieving superior accuracy compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于物理信息的几何深度学习框架PhysSFI-Net，用于预测正颌手术后的软组织变形，并且比现有方法具有更高的精度。

title: ESGaussianFace: Emotional and Stylized Audio-Driven Facial Animation via 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Most current audio-driven facial animation research primarily focuses on generating videos with neutral emotions. While some studies have addressed the generation of facial videos driven by emotional audio, efficiently generating high-quality talking head videos that integrate both emotional expressions and style features remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we propose ESGaussianFace, an innovative framework for emotional and stylized audio-driven facial animation. Our approach leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct 3D scenes and render videos, ensuring efficient generation of 3D consistent results. We propose an emotion-audio-guided spatial attention method that effectively integrates emotion features with audio content features. Through emotion-guided attention, the model is able to reconstruct facial details across different emotional states more accurately. To achieve emotional and stylized deformations of the 3D Gaussian points through emotion and style features, we introduce two 3D Gaussian deformation predictors. Futhermore, we propose a multi-stage training strategy, enabling the step-by-step learning of the character's lip movements, emotional variations, and style features. Our generated results exhibit high efficiency, high quality, and 3D consistency. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art techniques in terms of lip movement accuracy, expression variation, and style feature expressiveness.
summary_zh: 目前大多数音频驱动的面部动画研究主要集中于生成具有中性情绪的视频。虽然一些研究已经涉及由情感音频驱动的面部视频生成，但高效生成高质量的融合情感表达和风格特征的说话头视频仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了 ESGaussianFace，一个用于情感和风格化音频驱动面部动画的创新框架。我们的方法利用 3D 高斯溅射来重建 3D 场景并渲染视频，从而确保高效生成 3D 一致的结果。我们提出了一种情感-音频引导的空间注意力方法，该方法有效地将情感特征与音频内容特征相结合。通过情感引导的注意力，该模型能够更准确地重建不同情绪状态下的面部细节。为了通过情感和风格特征实现 3D 高斯点的情感和风格化变形，我们引入了两个 3D 高斯变形预测器。此外，我们提出了一种多阶段训练策略，从而实现对人物的嘴唇运动、情感变化和风格特征的逐步学习。我们生成的结果展现出高效率、高质量和 3D 一致性。大量实验结果表明，我们的方法在唇部运动准确性、表情变化和风格特征表现力方面优于现有最先进技术。
tldr: The paper presents ESGaussianFace, a novel approach for generating emotional and stylized audio-driven facial animation using 3D Gaussian Splatting, achieving high-quality, 3D consistent results with improved lip movement accuracy, expression variation, and style feature expressiveness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为ESGaussianFace的新方法，使用3D高斯溅射生成情感化和风格化的音频驱动面部动画，实现了高质量、3D一致的结果，并提高了唇部运动精度、表情变化和风格特征表现力。

title: MANGO:Natural Multi-speaker 3D Talking Head Generation via 2D-Lifted Enhancement
summary: Current audio-driven 3D head generation methods mainly focus on single-speaker scenarios, lacking natural, bidirectional listen-and-speak interaction. Achieving seamless conversational behavior, where speaking and listening states transition fluidly remains a key challenge. Existing 3D conversational avatar approaches rely on error-prone pseudo-3D labels that fail to capture fine-grained facial dynamics. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel two-stage framework MANGO, which leveraging pure image-level supervision by alternately training to mitigate the noise introduced by pseudo-3D labels, thereby achieving better alignment with real-world conversational behaviors. Specifically, in the first stage, a diffusion-based transformer with a dual-audio interaction module models natural 3D motion from multi-speaker audio. In the second stage, we use a fast 3D Gaussian Renderer to generate high-fidelity images and provide 2D-level photometric supervision for the 3D motions through alternate training. Additionally, we introduce MANGO-Dialog, a high-quality dataset with over 50 hours of aligned 2D-3D conversational data across 500+ identities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves exceptional accuracy and realism in modeling two-person 3D dialogue motion, significantly advancing the fidelity and controllability of audio-driven talking heads.
summary_zh: 当前音频驱动的3D头部生成方法主要集中于单说话人场景，缺乏自然的、双向的听说交互。实现无缝的会话行为，即说话和倾听状态之间的流畅过渡，仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的3D会话头像方法依赖于易出错的伪3D标签，无法捕捉细粒度的面部动态。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段框架MANGO，它通过交替训练利用纯图像级别的监督来减轻伪3D标签带来的噪声，从而更好地与真实世界的会话行为对齐。具体来说，在第一阶段，一个带有双音频交互模块的基于扩散的Transformer模型从多说话人音频中建模自然的三维运动。在第二阶段，我们使用快速3D高斯渲染器生成高保真图像，并通过交替训练为三维运动提供2D级别的光度监督。此外，我们还引入了MANGO-Dialog，一个高质量数据集，包含超过50小时的、跨越500+个身份的对齐的2D-3D会话数据。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在建模双人3D对话运动方面实现了卓越的准确性和真实感，显著提高了音频驱动的头部说话人的保真度和可控性。
tldr: MANGO is a novel two-stage framework for generating realistic 3D talking heads from multi-speaker audio, introducing a new high-quality dataset (MANGO-Dialog) and achieving state-of-the-art results in conversational avatar fidelity and controllability.
tldr_zh: MANGO是一个新颖的两阶段框架，用于从多说话人音频生成逼真的3D说话头像，并引入了一个新的高质量数据集(MANGO-Dialog)，在对话头像的保真度和可控性方面达到了最先进的结果。

title: Learnability-Driven Submodular Optimization for Active Roadside 3D Detection
summary: Roadside perception datasets are typically constructed via cooperative labeling between synchronized vehicle and roadside frame pairs. However, real deployment often requires annotation of roadside-only data due to hardware and privacy constraints. Even human experts struggle to produce accurate labels without vehicle-side data (image, LIDAR), which not only increases annotation difficulty and cost, but also reveals a fundamental learnability problem: many roadside-only scenes contain distant, blurred, or occluded objects whose 3D properties are ambiguous from a single view and can only be reliably annotated by cross-checking paired vehicle--roadside frames. We refer to such cases as inherently ambiguous samples. To reduce wasted annotation effort on inherently ambiguous samples while still obtaining high-performing models, we turn to active learning. This work focuses on active learning for roadside monocular 3D object detection and proposes a learnability-driven framework that selects scenes which are both informative and reliably labelable, suppressing inherently ambiguous samples while ensuring coverage. Experiments demonstrate that our method, LH3D, achieves 86.06%, 67.32%, and 78.67% of full-performance for vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists respectively, using only 25% of the annotation budget on DAIR-V2X-I, significantly outperforming uncertainty-based baselines. This confirms that learnability, not uncertainty, matters for roadside 3D perception.
summary_zh: 道路感知数据集通常通过同步车辆和路侧图像帧对之间的协同标注来构建。然而，实际部署往往需要在仅有路侧数据的情况下进行标注，这是因为硬件和隐私方面的限制。即使是人类专家，在没有车辆侧数据（图像、激光雷达）的情况下，也很难生成准确的标签，这不仅增加了标注的难度和成本，还暴露了一个根本性的可学习性问题：许多仅有路侧的场景中包含遥远、模糊或被遮挡的物体，这些物体的3D属性从单一视角来看是模糊不清的，只有通过交叉检查配对的车辆-路侧图像帧才能可靠地标注。我们将此类情况称为固有模糊样本。为了减少在固有模糊样本上浪费的标注精力，同时仍然获得高性能的模型，我们转向主动学习。这项工作专注于路侧单目3D目标检测的主动学习，并提出了一个由可学习性驱动的框架，该框架选择既具有信息性又可以可靠标注的场景，抑制固有模糊样本，同时确保覆盖率。实验表明，我们的方法LH3D在DAIR-V2X-I数据集上，仅使用25%的标注预算，就能分别达到车辆、行人和自行车完整性能的86.06%、67.32%和78.67%，显著优于基于不确定性的基线方法。这证实了对于路侧3D感知而言，可学习性比不确定性更重要。
tldr: This paper introduces an active learning framework for roadside monocular 3D object detection that selects reliably labelable and informative scenes, outperforming uncertainty-based methods by focusing on learnability rather than uncertainty.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于路侧单目3D目标检测的主动学习框架，该框架选择可靠标注且信息丰富的场景。通过关注可学习性而非不确定性，该方法优于基于不确定性的方法。

title: Differential Barometric Altimetry for Submeter Vertical Localization and Floor Recognition Indoors
summary: Accurate altitude estimation and reliable floor recognition are critical for mobile robot localization and navigation within complex multi-storey environments. In this paper, we present a robust, low-cost vertical estimation framework leveraging differential barometric sensing integrated within a fully ROS-compliant software package. Our system simultaneously publishes real-time altitude data from both a stationary base station and a mobile sensor, enabling precise and drift-free vertical localization. Empirical evaluations conducted in challenging scenarios -- such as fully enclosed stairwells and elevators, demonstrate that our proposed barometric pipeline achieves sub-meter vertical accuracy (RMSE: 0.29 m) and perfect (100%) floor-level identification. In contrast, our results confirm that standalone height estimates, obtained solely from visual- or LiDAR-based SLAM odometry, are insufficient for reliable vertical localization. The proposed ROS-compatible barometric module thus provides a practical and cost-effective solution for robust vertical awareness in real-world robotic deployments. The implementation of our method is released as open source at https://github.com/witsir/differential-barometric.
summary_zh: 在复杂的多层环境中，精确的高度估计和可靠的楼层识别对于移动机器人的定位和导航至关重要。本文提出了一种鲁棒、低成本的垂直估计框架，该框架利用差分气压传感，并集成在一个完全符合ROS的软件包中。我们的系统同时发布来自固定基站和移动传感器的实时高度数据，从而实现精确且无漂移的垂直定位。在具有挑战性的场景中（例如完全封闭的楼梯间和电梯）进行的实证评估表明，我们提出的气压管道实现了亚米级的垂直精度（RMSE：0.29米）和完美的（100%）楼层识别。相比之下，我们的结果证实，仅从基于视觉或激光雷达的SLAM里程计获得的独立高度估计不足以实现可靠的垂直定位。因此，所提出的ROS兼容气压模块为现实世界中的机器人部署提供了一种实用且经济高效的鲁棒垂直感知解决方案。我们的方法的实现已作为开源发布在https://github.com/witsir/differential-barometric。
tldr: This paper presents a ROS-compatible, low-cost, differential barometric altimetry system for sub-meter vertical localization and perfect floor recognition indoors, outperforming visual/LiDAR SLAM alone. The method is open-sourced.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种兼容ROS的低成本差分气压测高系统，用于室内亚米级垂直定位和完美楼层识别，优于单独的视觉/激光雷达SLAM。 该方法已开源。

title: Real-Time Lane Detection via Efficient Feature Alignment and Covariance Optimization for Low-Power Embedded Systems
summary: Real-time lane detection in embedded systems encounters significant challenges due to subtle and sparse visual signals in RGB images, often constrained by limited computational resources and power consumption. Although deep learning models for lane detection categorized into segmentation-based, anchor-based, and curve-based methods there remains a scarcity of universally applicable optimization techniques tailored for low-power embedded environments. To overcome this, we propose an innovative Covariance Distribution Optimization (CDO) module specifically designed for efficient, real-time applications. The CDO module aligns lane feature distributions closely with ground-truth labels, significantly enhancing detection accuracy without increasing computational complexity. Evaluations were conducted on six diverse models across all three method categories, including two optimized for real-time applications and four state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, tested comprehensively on three major datasets: CULane, TuSimple, and LLAMAS. Experimental results demonstrate accuracy improvements ranging from 0.01% to 1.5%. The proposed CDO module is characterized by ease of integration into existing systems without structural modifications and utilizes existing model parameters to facilitate ongoing training, thus offering substantial benefits in performance, power efficiency, and operational flexibility in embedded systems.
summary_zh: 在嵌入式系统中进行实时车道线检测面临着严峻的挑战，原因在于RGB图像中细微而稀疏的视觉信号，且通常受到有限的计算资源和功耗的约束。尽管用于车道线检测的深度学习模型可分为基于分割、基于锚框和基于曲线的方法，但针对低功耗嵌入式环境的通用优化技术仍然匮乏。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种创新的协方差分布优化（CDO）模块，专门为高效、实时应用而设计。CDO模块使车道线特征分布与真实标签紧密对齐，从而显著提高检测精度，且不增加计算复杂度。我们对跨所有三种方法类别的六个不同模型进行了评估，包括两个针对实时应用优化的模型和四个最先进（SOTA）的模型，并在CULane、TuSimple和LLAMAS三个主要数据集上进行了全面测试。实验结果表明，精度提升范围为0.01% 到 1.5%。所提出的CDO模块的特点是易于集成到现有系统中，无需结构修改，并利用现有模型参数来促进持续训练，从而在嵌入式系统的性能、功率效率和操作灵活性方面提供了显著的优势。
tldr: This paper introduces a Covariance Distribution Optimization (CDO) module for real-time lane detection in low-power embedded systems, improving accuracy across various models without increasing computational complexity. The CDO module enhances lane feature alignment with ground truth labels.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于低功耗嵌入式系统中实时车道检测的协方差分布优化（CDO）模块，可在不增加计算复杂性的情况下提高各种模型的准确性。CDO模块增强了车道特征与真实标签的对齐。

title: Digital Twin-Driven Communication-Efficient Federated Anomaly Detection for Industrial IoT
summary: Anomaly detection is increasingly becoming crucial for maintaining the safety, reliability, and efficiency of industrial systems. Recently, with the advent of digital twins and data-driven decision-making, several statistical and machine-learning methods have been proposed. However, these methods face several challenges, such as dependence on only real sensor datasets, limited labeled data, high false alarm rates, and privacy concerns. To address these problems, we propose a suite of digital twin-integrated federated learning (DTFL) methods that enhance global model performance while preserving data privacy and communication efficiency. Specifically, we present five novel approaches: Digital Twin-Based Meta-Learning (DTML), Federated Parameter Fusion (FPF), Layer-wise Parameter Exchange (LPE), Cyclic Weight Adaptation (CWA), and Digital Twin Knowledge Distillation (DTKD). Each method introduces a unique mechanism to combine synthetic and real-world knowledge, balancing generalization with communication overhead. We conduct an extensive experiment using a publicly available cyber-physical anomaly detection dataset. For a target accuracy of 80%, CWA reaches the target in 33 rounds, FPF in 41 rounds, LPE in 48 rounds, and DTML in 87 rounds, whereas the standard FedAvg baseline and DTKD do not reach the target within 100 rounds. These results highlight substantial communication-efficiency gains (up to 62% fewer rounds than DTML and 31% fewer than LPE) and demonstrate that integrating DT knowledge into FL accelerates convergence to operationally meaningful accuracy thresholds for IIoT anomaly detection.
summary_zh: 异常检测正日益成为维护工业系统安全性、可靠性和效率的关键。近年来，随着数字孪生和数据驱动决策的出现，许多统计和机器学习方法被提出。然而，这些方法面临着诸如仅依赖真实传感器数据集、标记数据有限、误报率高以及隐私问题等挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一套集成了数字孪生的联邦学习（DTFL）方法，以在保护数据隐私和通信效率的同时，提高全局模型性能。具体而言，我们提出了五种新方法：基于数字孪生的元学习（DTML）、联邦参数融合（FPF）、分层参数交换（LPE）、循环权重自适应（CWA）和数字孪生知识蒸馏（DTKD）。每种方法都引入了一种独特的机制来结合合成和真实世界的知识，从而在泛化性和通信开销之间取得平衡。我们使用公开的网络物理异常检测数据集进行了广泛的实验。对于80%的目标精度，CWA在33轮内达到目标，FPF在41轮内达到目标，LPE在48轮内达到目标，DTML在87轮内达到目标，而标准FedAvg基线和DTKD在100轮内均未达到目标。这些结果突出了显著的通信效率提升（比DTML减少高达62%的轮次，比LPE减少31%），并表明将DT知识集成到FL中加速了工业物联网异常检测的收敛，使其达到具有实际意义的精度阈值。
tldr: This paper proposes a digital twin-integrated federated learning (DTFL) approach with five novel methods to enhance anomaly detection in Industrial IoT, focusing on communication efficiency and privacy preservation. The approach demonstrates faster convergence compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种数字孪生集成的联邦学习（DTFL）方法，包含五种新颖的方法，旨在提高工业物联网中的异常检测能力，重点在于通信效率和隐私保护。实验表明，与基线方法相比，该方法的收敛速度更快。

title: Car Drag Coefficient Prediction from 3D Point Clouds Using a Slice-Based Surrogate Model
summary: The automotive industry's pursuit of enhanced fuel economy and performance necessitates efficient aerodynamic design. However, traditional evaluation methods such as computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and wind tunnel testing are resource intensive, hindering rapid iteration in the early design stages. Machine learning-based surrogate models offer a promising alternative, yet many existing approaches suffer from high computational complexity, limited interpretability, or insufficient accuracy for detailed geometric inputs. This paper introduces a novel lightweight surrogate model for the prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd) based on a sequential slice-wise processing of the geometry of the 3D vehicle. Inspired by medical imaging, 3D point clouds of vehicles are decomposed into an ordered sequence of 2D cross-sectional slices along the stream-wise axis. Each slice is encoded by a lightweight PointNet2D module, and the sequence of slice embeddings is processed by a bidirectional LSTM to capture longitudinal geometric evolution. The model, trained and evaluated on the DrivAerNet++ dataset, achieves a high coefficient of determination (R^2 > 0.9528) and a low mean absolute error (MAE approx 6.046 x 10^{-3}) in Cd prediction. With an inference time of approximately 0.025 seconds per sample on a consumer-grade GPU, our approach provides fast, accurate, and interpretable aerodynamic feedback, facilitating more agile and informed automotive design exploration.
summary_zh: 汽车工业对提高燃油经济性和性能的追求，需要高效的空气动力学设计。然而，传统的评估方法，如计算流体动力学（CFD）和风洞试验，资源耗费巨大，阻碍了早期设计阶段的快速迭代。基于机器学习的代理模型提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但许多现有方法存在计算复杂度高、可解释性有限或对详细几何输入精度不足等问题。本文提出了一种新型的轻量级代理模型，用于预测空气动力学阻力系数（Cd），该模型基于对3D车辆几何形状的顺序切片处理。受医学成像的启发，车辆的3D点云被分解为沿流向轴的有序的2D横截面切片序列。每个切片都由一个轻量级的PointNet2D模块编码，并且切片嵌入序列由一个双向LSTM处理，以捕获纵向几何演化。该模型在DrivAerNet++数据集上进行训练和评估，在Cd预测中实现了较高的决定系数(R^2 > 0.9528)和较低的平均绝对误差(MAE约为 6.046 x 10^{-3})。在消费级GPU上，每个样本的推理时间约为0.025秒，我们的方法提供了快速、准确且可解释的空气动力学反馈，从而促进更敏捷和更明智的汽车设计探索。
tldr: This paper presents a fast and accurate machine learning model for predicting car drag coefficients from 3D point clouds by processing sequential 2D slices. The model uses a PointNet2D module for encoding each slice and a bidirectional LSTM to capture the longitudinal geometric evolution, achieving high accuracy with rapid inference.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种快速准确的机器学习模型，通过处理连续的 2D 切片，从 3D 点云预测汽车的阻力系数。该模型使用 PointNet2D 模块对每个切片进行编码，并使用双向 LSTM 来捕获纵向几何演化，从而以快速的推理速度实现高精度。

title: Dancing Points: Synthesizing Ballroom Dancing with Three-Point Inputs
summary: Ballroom dancing is a structured yet expressive motion category. Its highly diverse movement and complex interactions between leader and follower dancers make the understanding and synthesis challenging. We demonstrate that the three-point trajectory available from a virtual reality (VR) device can effectively serve as a dancer's motion descriptor, simplifying the modeling and synthesis of interplay between dancers' full-body motions down to sparse trajectories. Thanks to the low dimensionality, we can employ an efficient MLP network to predict the follower's three-point trajectory directly from the leader's three-point input for certain types of ballroom dancing, addressing the challenge of modeling high-dimensional full-body interaction. It also prevents our method from overfitting thanks to its compact yet explicit representation. By leveraging the inherent structure of the movements and carefully planning the autoregressive procedure, we show a deterministic neural network is able to translate three-point trajectories into a virtual embodied avatar, which is typically considered under-constrained and requires generative models for common motions. In addition, we demonstrate this deterministic approach generalizes beyond small, structured datasets like ballroom dancing, and performs robustly on larger, more diverse datasets such as LaFAN. Our method provides a computationally- and data-efficient solution, opening new possibilities for immersive paired dancing applications. Code and pre-trained models for this paper are available at https://peizhuoli.github.io/dancing-points.
summary_zh: 交谊舞是一种结构化的，但又具有表现力的运动类型。其高度多样化的动作以及领舞和跟舞者之间复杂的互动，使得对其的理解和合成充满挑战。我们证明了来自虚拟现实(VR)设备的三点轨迹可以有效地作为舞者的运动描述符，将舞者全身运动之间相互作用的建模和合成简化为稀疏轨迹。得益于低维度，我们可以使用高效的MLP网络，直接从领舞者的三点输入预测跟舞者的三点轨迹，从而应对建模高维度全身交互的挑战。其紧凑但显式的表示也避免了我们的方法过拟合。通过利用运动的内在结构并仔细规划自回归过程，我们展示了一个确定性的神经网络能够将三点轨迹转化为虚拟化身，而这通常被认为是欠约束的，并且需要生成模型来实现常见的运动。此外，我们证明了这种确定性方法可以推广到像交谊舞这样的小型结构化数据集之外，并在更大、更多样化的数据集（如LaFAN）上表现出稳健性。我们的方法提供了一种计算和数据高效的解决方案，为沉浸式配对舞蹈应用开辟了新的可能性。本文的代码和预训练模型可在https://peizhuoli.github.io/dancing-points获取。
tldr: The paper presents a method using three-point VR trajectory data and a deterministic neural network to synthesize ballroom dancing motions between virtual avatars, demonstrating computational efficiency and generalizability to larger datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，使用三点VR轨迹数据和确定性神经网络来合成虚拟形象之间的交谊舞动作， 证明了计算效率和对大型数据集的泛化能力。

title: SketchRodGS: Sketch-based Extraction of Slender Geometries for Animating Gaussian Splatting Scenes
summary: Physics simulation of slender elastic objects often requires discretization as a polyline. However, constructing a polyline from Gaussian splatting is challenging as Gaussian splatting lacks connectivity information and the configuration of Gaussian primitives contains much noise. This paper presents a method to extract a polyline representation of the slender part of the objects in a Gaussian splatting scene from the user's sketching input. Our method robustly constructs a polyline mesh that represents the slender parts using the screen-space shortest path analysis that can be efficiently solved using dynamic programming. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in several in-the-wild examples.
summary_zh: 细长弹性物体的物理仿真通常需要离散化为折线。然而，从高斯溅射构建折线是一项挑战，因为高斯溅射缺乏连通性信息，且高斯基元的配置包含大量噪声。本文提出了一种方法，从用户的手绘草图中，在高斯溅射场景中提取物体细长部分的折线表示。我们的方法稳健地构建了一个表示细长部分的折线网格，该网格利用了屏幕空间最短路径分析，此分析可以通过动态规划高效求解。我们在多个真实案例中验证了我们方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces a method (SketchRodGS) to extract a polyline representation of slender objects from Gaussian splatting scenes based on user sketches, enabling physics simulation. It leverages screen-space shortest path analysis and dynamic programming.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SketchRodGS的方法，该方法基于用户草图从高斯溅射场景中提取细长物体的折线表示，从而实现物理模拟。该方法利用屏幕空间最短路径分析和动态规划。

title: SOP: A Scalable Online Post-Training System for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong generalization through large-scale pre-training, but real-world deployment requires expert-level task proficiency in addition to broad generality. Existing post-training approaches for VLA models are typically offline, single-robot, or task-specific, limiting effective on-policy adaptation and scalable learning from real-world interaction. We introduce a Scalable Online Post-training (SOP) system that enables online, distributed, multi-task post-training of generalist VLA models directly in the physical world. SOP tightly couples execution and learning through a closed-loop architecture in which a fleet of robots continuously streams on-policy experience and human intervention signals to a centralized cloud learner, and asynchronously receives updated policies. This design supports prompt on-policy correction, scales experience collection through parallel deployment, and preserves generality during adaptation. SOP is agnostic to the choice of post-training algorithm; we instantiate it with both interactive imitation learning (HG-DAgger) and reinforcement learning (RECAP). Across a range of real-world manipulation tasks including cloth folding, box assembly, and grocery restocking, we show that SOP substantially improves the performance of large pretrained VLA models while maintaining a single shared policy across tasks. Effective post-training can be achieved within hours of real-world interaction, and performance scales near-linearly with the number of robots in the fleet. These results suggest that tightly coupling online learning with fleet-scale deployment is instrumental to enabling efficient, reliable, and scalable post-training of generalist robot policies in the physical world.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型通过大规模预训练实现了强大的泛化能力，但现实世界的部署除了广泛的通用性外，还需要专家级的任务熟练度。现有VLA模型的后训练方法通常是离线的、单机器人或特定于任务的，这限制了有效的在线策略适应和从现实世界交互中的可扩展学习。我们介绍了一种可扩展的在线后训练 (SOP) 系统，该系统能够直接在物理世界中对通用VLA模型进行在线、分布式、多任务的后训练。SOP通过闭环架构紧密结合执行和学习，在该架构中，机器人集群不断地将在线策略经验和人工干预信号流式传输到集中的云学习器，并异步接收更新后的策略。这种设计支持及时的在线策略纠正，通过并行部署扩展经验收集，并在适应过程中保持通用性。SOP与后训练算法的选择无关；我们使用交互式模仿学习 (HG-DAgger) 和强化学习 (RECAP) 对其进行了实例化。在一系列现实世界的操作任务中，包括衣物折叠、盒子组装和杂货补货，我们表明SOP大幅提高了大型预训练VLA模型的性能，同时在所有任务中保持单一共享策略。有效的后训练可以在数小时的现实世界交互内实现，并且性能与机器人集群中的机器人数量呈近线性比例扩展。这些结果表明，将在线学习与集群规模部署紧密结合，对于实现物理世界中通用机器人策略的高效、可靠和可扩展的后训练至关重要。
tldr: This paper introduces SOP, a scalable online post-training system for VLA models, which enables robots to continuously learn and adapt to real-world manipulation tasks through on-policy experience and human intervention.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种可扩展的在线VLA模型后训练系统SOP，该系统使机器人能够通过在线经验和人工干预，持续学习并适应现实世界中的操作任务。

title: InternVLA-A1: Unifying Understanding, Generation and Action for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Prevalent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically built upon Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and demonstrate exceptional proficiency in semantic understanding, but they inherently lack the capability to deduce physical world dynamics. Consequently, recent approaches have shifted toward World Models, typically formulated via video prediction; however, these methods often suffer from a lack of semantic grounding and exhibit brittleness when handling prediction errors. To synergize semantic understanding with dynamic predictive capabilities, we present InternVLA-A1. This model employs a unified Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, coordinating three experts for scene understanding, visual foresight generation, and action execution. These components interact seamlessly through a unified masked self-attention mechanism. Building upon InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL, we instantiate InternVLA-A1 at 2B and 3B parameter scales. We pre-train these models on hybrid synthetic-real datasets spanning InternData-A1 and Agibot-World, covering over 533M frames. This hybrid training strategy effectively harnesses the diversity of synthetic simulation data while minimizing the sim-to-real gap. We evaluated InternVLA-A1 across 12 real-world robotic tasks and simulation benchmark. It significantly outperforms leading models like pi0 and GR00T N1.5, achieving a 14.5\% improvement in daily tasks and a 40\%-73.3\% boost in dynamic settings, such as conveyor belt sorting.
summary_zh: 目前流行的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常构建于多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）之上，并在语义理解方面表现出卓越的能力，但它们本质上缺乏推断物理世界动态的能力。因此，最近的研究方向转向了世界模型，通常通过视频预测来实现；然而，这些方法常常缺乏语义基础，并且在处理预测错误时表现出脆弱性。为了将语义理解与动态预测能力相结合，我们提出了InternVLA-A1。该模型采用统一的混合Transformer架构，协调三个专家模块，分别负责场景理解、视觉远见生成和动作执行。这些组件通过统一的掩码自注意力机制无缝交互。基于InternVL3和Qwen3-VL，我们分别以2B和3B参数规模实例化了InternVLA-A1。我们在包含InternData-A1和Agibot-World的混合合成-真实数据集上预训练这些模型，覆盖超过5.33亿帧。这种混合训练策略有效地利用了合成仿真数据的多样性，同时最小化了模拟到真实的差距。我们在12项真实世界的机器人任务和仿真基准测试中评估了InternVLA-A1。它显著优于pi0和GR00T N1.5等领先模型，在日常任务中实现了14.5%的改进，并在诸如传送带分拣等动态环境中实现了40%-73.3%的提升。
tldr: InternVLA-A1 unifies scene understanding, visual foresight, and action execution in a robotic manipulation model, outperforming existing methods on real-world and simulated tasks by combining MLLMs with a dynamic predictive capability trained on synthetic-real hybrid datasets.
tldr_zh: InternVLA-A1将场景理解、视觉预测和动作执行统一到一个机器人操作模型中，通过结合 MLLM 和在合成-真实混合数据集上训练的动态预测能力，在真实世界和模拟任务上优于现有方法。

title: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents
summary: LLM agents can reason and use tools, but they often break down on long-horizon tasks due to unbounded context growth and accumulated errors. Common remedies such as context compression or retrieval-augmented prompting introduce trade-offs between information fidelity and reasoning stability. We present InfiAgent, a general-purpose framework that keeps the agent's reasoning context strictly bounded regardless of task duration by externalizing persistent state into a file-centric state abstraction. At each step, the agent reconstructs context from a workspace state snapshot plus a fixed window of recent actions. Experiments on DeepResearch and an 80-paper literature review task show that, without task-specific fine-tuning, InfiAgent with a 20B open-source model is competitive with larger proprietary systems and maintains substantially higher long-horizon coverage than context-centric baselines. These results support explicit state externalization as a practical foundation for stable long-horizon agents. Github Repo:https://github.com/ChenglinPoly/infiAgent
summary_zh: LLM Agent虽然能够推理和使用工具，但由于无限制的上下文增长和累积误差，它们在长程任务中常常失效。常见的补救措施，如上下文压缩或检索增强提示，在信息保真度和推理稳定性之间引入了权衡。我们提出了InfiAgent，一个通用框架，通过将持久状态外部化到以文件为中心的的状态抽象中，使Agent的推理上下文保持严格的边界，而与任务持续时间无关。在每个步骤中，Agent从工作区状态快照加上最近动作的固定窗口来重建上下文。在DeepResearch和一项80篇论文的文献综述任务上的实验表明，在没有特定任务微调的情况下，拥有20B开源模型的InfiAgent与更大的专有系统具有竞争力，并且比以上下文为中心的基线保持了更高的长程覆盖率。这些结果支持将显式状态外部化作为稳定长程Agent的实用基础。Github Repo:https://github.com/ChenglinPoly/infiAgent
tldr: InfiAgent addresses the long-horizon limitations of LLM agents by externalizing state into files, maintaining bounded context, and demonstrating competitive performance with larger models in long-term reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: InfiAgent通过将状态外部化到文件中来解决LLM Agent的长时程限制，保持有界的上下文，并在长期推理任务中展示了与更大模型相比具有竞争力的性能。

title: MiMo-V2-Flash Technical Report
summary: We present MiMo-V2-Flash, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 309B total parameters and 15B active parameters, designed for fast, strong reasoning and agentic capabilities. MiMo-V2-Flash adopts a hybrid attention architecture that interleaves Sliding Window Attention (SWA) with global attention, with a 128-token sliding window under a 5:1 hybrid ratio. The model is pre-trained on 27 trillion tokens with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), employing a native 32k context length and subsequently extended to 256k. To efficiently scale post-training compute, MiMo-V2-Flash introduces a novel Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) paradigm. In this framework, domain-specialized teachers (e.g., trained via large-scale reinforcement learning) provide dense and token-level reward, enabling the student model to perfectly master teacher expertise. MiMo-V2-Flash rivals top-tier open-weight models such as DeepSeek-V3.2 and Kimi-K2, despite using only 1/2 and 1/3 of their total parameters, respectively. During inference, by repurposing MTP as a draft model for speculative decoding, MiMo-V2-Flash achieves up to 3.6 acceptance length and 2.6x decoding speedup with three MTP layers. We open-source both the model weights and the three-layer MTP weights to foster open research and community collaboration.
summary_zh: 我们提出了MiMo-V2-Flash，一个总参数量为3090亿、激活参数量为150亿的混合专家（MoE）模型，旨在实现快速、强大的推理和智能体能力。MiMo-V2-Flash采用了一种混合注意力架构，该架构交替使用滑动窗口注意力（SWA）和全局注意力，在5:1的混合比例下使用128个token的滑动窗口。该模型在27万亿token上使用多token预测（MTP）进行预训练，采用原生32k上下文长度，随后扩展至256k。为了高效扩展后训练计算，MiMo-V2-Flash引入了一种新颖的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）范式。在该框架中，领域专家教师（例如，通过大规模强化学习训练）提供密集且token级别的奖励，使学生模型能够完美掌握教师的专业知识。MiMo-V2-Flash可以媲美顶级的开源权重模型，如DeepSeek-V3.2和Kimi-K2，尽管它仅使用了它们总参数量的1/2和1/3。在推理过程中，通过将MTP重新用作推测解码的草稿模型，MiMo-V2-Flash实现了高达3.6的接受长度和2.6倍的解码加速，使用了三个MTP层。我们开源了模型权重和三层MTP权重，以促进开放研究和社区协作。
tldr: MiMo-V2-Flash is a 309B parameter MoE model achieving strong reasoning and agentic capabilities via a hybrid attention architecture and a novel Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) paradigm. It rivals top open-weight models with fewer parameters and introduces speedups via speculative decoding using MTP as a draft model, with model weights released.
tldr_zh: MiMo-V2-Flash是一个309B参数的MoE模型，通过混合注意力架构和新颖的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）范式实现了强大的推理和智能体能力。它以更少的参数与顶级开源模型竞争，并通过使用MTP作为草稿模型的推测性解码引入了加速，模型权重已发布。

title: A High-Fidelity Digital Twin for Robotic Manipulation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Developing high-fidelity, interactive digital twins is crucial for enabling closed-loop motion planning and reliable real-world robot execution, which are essential to advancing sim-to-real transfer. However, existing approaches often suffer from slow reconstruction, limited visual fidelity, and difficulties in converting photorealistic models into planning-ready collision geometry. We present a practical framework that constructs high-quality digital twins within minutes from sparse RGB inputs. Our system employs 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for fast, photorealistic reconstruction as a unified scene representation. We enhance 3DGS with visibility-aware semantic fusion for accurate 3D labelling and introduce an efficient, filter-based geometry conversion method to produce collision-ready models seamlessly integrated with a Unity-ROS2-MoveIt physics engine. In experiments with a Franka Emika Panda robot performing pick-and-place tasks, we demonstrate that this enhanced geometric accuracy effectively supports robust manipulation in real-world trials. These results demonstrate that 3DGS-based digital twins, enriched with semantic and geometric consistency, offer a fast, reliable, and scalable path from perception to manipulation in unstructured environments.
summary_zh: 开发高保真、交互式数字孪生体对于实现闭环运动规划和可靠的真实世界机器人执行至关重要，这两者也是推进仿真到现实迁移的关键。然而，现有方法通常面临重建速度慢、视觉保真度有限以及将逼真模型转换为可用于规划的碰撞几何体的困难。我们提出了一种实用的框架，能够在几分钟内从稀疏RGB输入构建高质量的数字孪生体。我们的系统采用3D高斯溅射(3DGS) 作为统一的场景表示，以实现快速、逼真的重建。我们通过可见性感知的语义融合来增强3DGS，以实现精准的3D标注，并引入了一种高效的、基于滤波的几何体转换方法，以生成与Unity-ROS2-MoveIt物理引擎无缝集成的、可用于碰撞检测的模型。在使用Franka Emika Panda机器人执行抓取放置任务的实验中，我们证明了这种增强的几何精度有效地支持了真实世界试验中的鲁棒操作。这些结果表明，基于3DGS的数字孪生体，通过语义和几何一致性增强，为在非结构化环境中从感知到操作提供了一条快速、可靠且可扩展的路径。
tldr: This paper introduces a fast method using 3D Gaussian Splatting to create high-fidelity digital twins for robotic manipulation, enabling robust sim-to-real transfer in unstructured environments by enhancing geometric accuracy and semantic consistency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种使用 3D Gaussian Splatting 快速创建用于机器人操作的高保真数字孪生的方法，通过增强几何精度和语义一致性，从而能够在非结构化环境中实现强大的 sim-to-real 迁移。

title: Limited Linguistic Diversity in Embodied AI Datasets
summary: Language plays a critical role in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, yet the linguistic characteristics of the datasets used to train and evaluate these systems remain poorly documented. In this work, we present a systematic dataset audit of several widely used VLA corpora, aiming to characterize what kinds of instructions these datasets actually contain and how much linguistic variety they provide. We quantify instruction language along complementary dimensions-including lexical variety, duplication and overlap, semantic similarity, and syntactic complexity. Our analysis shows that many datasets rely on highly repetitive, template-like commands with limited structural variation, yielding a narrow distribution of instruction forms. We position these findings as descriptive documentation of the language signal available in current VLA training and evaluation data, intended to support more detailed dataset reporting, more principled dataset selection, and targeted curation or augmentation strategies that broaden language coverage.
summary_zh: 语言在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中起着关键作用，但用于训练和评估这些系统的数据集的语言特征却鲜有记录。在这项工作中，我们对几个广泛使用的VLA语料库进行了系统的性数据集审核，旨在描述这些数据集实际包含哪些类型的指令，以及它们提供了多少语言多样性。我们沿着互补的维度量化指令语言，包括词汇多样性、重复和重叠、语义相似性和句法复杂度。我们的分析表明，许多数据集依赖于高度重复、类似模板的命令，结构变化有限，从而导致指令形式的分布范围较窄。我们将这些发现定位为对当前VLA训练和评估数据中可用语言信号的描述性文件，旨在支持更详细的数据集报告、更具原则性的数据集选择，以及旨在扩大语言覆盖范围的有针对性的标注或增强策略。
tldr: This paper audits several Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets, revealing limited linguistic diversity and reliance on repetitive commands. The authors suggest this finding underscores the need for improved dataset reporting and augmentation strategies to broaden language coverage.
tldr_zh: 该论文审计了多个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）数据集，揭示了语言多样性的局限性和对重复命令的依赖。作者认为，这一发现强调了需要改进数据集报告和扩充策略，以扩大语言覆盖范围。

title: Learning to Act Robustly with View-Invariant Latent Actions
summary: Vision-based robotic policies often struggle with even minor viewpoint changes, underscoring the need for view-invariant visual representations. This challenge becomes more pronounced in real-world settings, where viewpoint variability is unavoidable and can significantly disrupt policy performance. Existing methods typically learn invariance from multi-view observations at the scene level, but such approaches rely on visual appearance and fail to incorporate the physical dynamics essential for robust generalization. We propose View-Invariant Latent Action (VILA), which models a latent action capturing transition patterns across trajectories to learn view-invariant representations grounded in physical dynamics. VILA aligns these latent actions across viewpoints using an action-guided objective based on ground-truth action sequences. Experiments in both simulation and the real world show that VILA-based policies generalize effectively to unseen viewpoints and transfer well to new tasks, establishing VILA as a strong pretraining framework that improves robustness and downstream learning performance.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的机器人策略通常难以应对即使是微小的视角变化，这突出了视角不变视觉表征的必要性。在现实世界环境中，这一挑战变得更加突出，因为视角变化是不可避免的，并且会显著扰乱策略性能。现有方法通常从场景级别的多视角观测中学习不变性，但这些方法依赖于视觉外观，并且未能纳入对鲁棒泛化至关重要的物理动力学。我们提出了视角不变潜在动作（VILA），它对捕捉轨迹间转移模式的潜在动作进行建模，以学习基于物理动力学的视角不变表征。VILA使用基于真实动作序列的动作引导目标，在不同视角之间对齐这些潜在动作。在模拟和真实世界的实验表明，基于VILA的策略能够有效地泛化到未见过的视角，并能很好地迁移到新的任务，从而确立了VILA作为一个强大的预训练框架，可以提高鲁棒性和下游学习性能。
tldr: This paper introduces View-Invariant Latent Action (VILA), a method for learning vision-based robotic policies robust to viewpoint changes by modeling latent actions grounded in physical dynamics, demonstrating improved generalization and transfer learning in both simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 View-Invariant Latent Action (VILA), 一种通过对基于物理动力学的潜在动作进行建模来学习对视角变化具有鲁棒性的基于视觉的机器人策略的方法，并在模拟和现实环境中展示了改进的泛化和迁移学习能力。

title: LOST-3DSG: Lightweight Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs with Semantic Tracking in Dynamic Environments
summary: Tracking objects that move within dynamic environments is a core challenge in robotics. Recent research has advanced this topic significantly; however, many existing approaches remain inefficient due to their reliance on heavy foundation models. To address this limitation, we propose LOST-3DSG, a lightweight open-vocabulary 3D scene graph designed to track dynamic objects in real-world environments. Our method adopts a semantic approach to entity tracking based on word2vec and sentence embeddings, enabling an open-vocabulary representation while avoiding the necessity of storing dense CLIP visual features. As a result, LOST-3DSG achieves superior performance compared to approaches that rely on high-dimensional visual embeddings. We evaluate our method through qualitative and quantitative experiments conducted in a real 3D environment using a TIAGo robot. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LOST-3DSG in dynamic object tracking. Code and supplementary material are publicly available on the project website at https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/lost-3dsg/.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中跟踪移动物体是机器人技术的核心挑战。 近期研究在此领域取得了显著进展；然而，许多现有方法由于依赖于大型基础模型而效率低下。 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了LOST-3DSG，一种轻量级的开放词汇3D场景图，旨在跟踪真实世界环境中动态物体。 我们的方法采用基于word2vec和句子嵌入的语义实体跟踪方法，从而实现开放词汇表示，同时避免了存储密集的CLIP视觉特征的需求。 因此，LOST-3DSG 相比于依赖高维视觉嵌入的方法，实现了更优越的性能。 我们使用TIAGo机器人在真实的3D环境中，通过定性和定量实验评估了我们的方法。 结果表明LOST-3DSG在动态物体跟踪方面的有效性和效率。 代码和补充材料可在项目网站https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/lost-3dsg/上公开获取。
tldr: LOST-3DSG is a lightweight open-vocabulary 3D scene graph for tracking dynamic objects in real-world environments using semantic embeddings, achieving superior performance compared to methods relying on dense visual features.
tldr_zh: LOST-3DSG 是一种轻量级的开放词汇3D场景图，它使用语义嵌入来跟踪现实环境中的动态对象，与依赖密集视觉特征的方法相比，实现了卓越的性能。

title: Warm-Starting Collision-Free Model Predictive Control With Object-Centric Diffusion
summary: Acting in cluttered environments requires predicting and avoiding collisions while still achieving precise control. Conventional optimization-based controllers can enforce physical constraints, but they struggle to produce feasible solutions quickly when many obstacles are present. Diffusion models can generate diverse trajectories around obstacles, yet prior approaches lacked a general and efficient way to condition them on scene structure. In this paper, we show that combining diffusion-based warm-starting conditioned with a latent object-centric representation of the scene and with a collision-aware model predictive controller (MPC) yields reliable and efficient motion generation under strict time limits. Our approach conditions a diffusion transformer on the system state, task, and surroundings, using an object-centric slot attention mechanism to provide a compact obstacle representation suitable for control. The sampled trajectories are refined by an optimal control problem that enforces rigid-body dynamics and signed-distance collision constraints, producing feasible motions in real time. On benchmark tasks, this hybrid method achieved markedly higher success rates and lower latency than sampling-based planners or either component alone. Real-robot experiments with a torque-controlled Panda confirm reliable and safe execution with MPC.
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中行动既需要预测和避免碰撞，又需要实现精确控制。传统的基于优化的控制器可以强制执行物理约束，但当存在大量障碍物时，难以快速产生可行的解决方案。扩散模型可以在障碍物周围生成多样化的轨迹，但以往的方法缺乏一种通用且高效的方式来将其条件化于场景结构。在本文中，我们表明，结合基于扩散的暖启动（以场景的潜在的、以对象为中心的表征进行条件化）以及碰撞感知模型预测控制器（MPC），可以在严格的时间限制下产生可靠且高效的运动。我们的方法使用对象中心槽注意力机制，将扩散Transformer条件化于系统状态、任务和周围环境，从而提供适用于控制的紧凑障碍物表示。采样的轨迹通过最优控制问题进行优化，该问题强制执行刚体动力学和有符号距离碰撞约束，从而实时产生可行的运动。在基准测试任务中，这种混合方法比基于采样的规划器或单独的任何一个组件都实现了显著更高的成功率和更低的延迟。 使用扭矩控制的Panda机器人的真实机器人实验证实了采用MPC的可靠和安全执行。
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid method combining diffusion-based warm-starting with object-centric scene representation and collision-aware MPC for efficient and reliable robot motion planning in cluttered environments, demonstrating superior performance compared to other methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合方法，结合了基于扩散的温启动与以对象为中心的场景表示和碰撞感知的 MPC，用于在杂乱环境中进行高效可靠的机器人运动规划，并证明了优于其他方法的性能。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Follow-the-Leader Robotic Endoscopic Navigation via Synthetic Data
summary: Autonomous navigation is crucial for both medical and industrial endoscopic robots, enabling safe and efficient exploration of narrow tubular environments without continuous human intervention, where avoiding contact with the inner walls has been a longstanding challenge for prior approaches. We present a follow-the-leader endoscopic robot based on a flexible continuum structure designed to minimize contact between the endoscope body and intestinal walls, thereby reducing patient discomfort. To achieve this objective, we propose a vision-based deep reinforcement learning framework guided by monocular depth estimation. A realistic intestinal simulation environment was constructed in \textit{NVIDIA Omniverse} to train and evaluate autonomous navigation strategies. Furthermore, thousands of synthetic intraluminal images were generated using NVIDIA Replicator to fine-tune the Depth Anything model, enabling dense three-dimensional perception of the intestinal environment with a single monocular camera. Subsequently, we introduce a geometry-aware reward and penalty mechanism to enable accurate lumen tracking. Compared with the original Depth Anything model, our method improves $δ_{1}$ depth accuracy by 39.2% and reduces the navigation J-index by 0.67 relative to the second-best method, demonstrating the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 自主导航对于医疗和工业内窥镜机器人至关重要，它能够在狭窄的管状环境中实现安全高效的探索，而无需持续的人工干预。避免与内壁接触一直是先前方法面临的长期挑战。我们提出了一种基于柔性连续体结构的“跟随者”式内窥镜机器人，旨在最大程度地减少内窥镜主体与肠壁之间的接触，从而减轻患者的不适。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了一种基于视觉的深度强化学习框架，该框架由单目深度估计引导。在\textit{NVIDIA Omniverse}中构建了一个逼真的肠道模拟环境，用于训练和评估自主导航策略。此外，使用 NVIDIA Replicator 生成了数千张合成管腔内图像，用于微调 Depth Anything 模型，从而能够通过单个单目相机实现对肠道环境的密集三维感知。随后，我们引入了一种几何感知奖励和惩罚机制，以实现精确的管腔跟踪。与原始 Depth Anything 模型相比，我们的方法将 $δ_{1}$ 深度精度提高了 39.2%，并且相对于第二好的方法，导航 J 指数降低了 0.67，证明了所提出方法的鲁棒性和有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous endoscopic navigation using synthetic data and a modified Depth Anything model, achieving improved depth accuracy and navigation performance in a simulated intestinal environment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的自主内窥镜导航框架，利用合成数据和改进的 Depth Anything 模型，在模拟肠道环境中实现了更高的深度准确度和导航性能。

title: Closing the Reality Gap: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Deployment for Dexterous Force-Based Grasping and Manipulation
summary: Human-like dexterous hands with multiple fingers offer human-level manipulation capabilities, but training control policies that can directly deploy on real hardware remains difficult due to contact-rich physics and imperfect actuation. We close this gap with a practical sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) framework that utilizes dense tactile feedback combined with joint torque sensing to explicitly regulate physical interactions. To enable effective sim-to-real transfer, we introduce (i) a computationally fast tactile simulation that computes distances between dense virtual tactile units and the object via parallel forward kinematics, providing high-rate, high-resolution touch signals needed by RL; (ii) a current-to-torque calibration that eliminates the need for torque sensors on dexterous hands by mapping motor current to joint torque; and (iii) actuator dynamics modeling to bridge the actuation gaps with randomization of non-ideal effects such as backlash, torque-speed saturation. Using an asymmetric actor-critic PPO pipeline trained entirely in simulation, our policies deploy directly to a five-finger hand. The resulting policies demonstrated two essential skills: (1) command-based, controllable grasp force tracking, and (2) reorientation of objects in the hand, both of which were robustly executed without fine-tuning on the robot. By combining tactile and torque in the observation space with effective sensing/actuation modeling, our system provides a practical solution to achieve reliable dexterous manipulation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of controllable grasping on a multi-finger dexterous hand trained entirely in simulation and transferred zero-shot on real hardware.
summary_zh: 具备多根手指的类人灵巧手提供了人类水平的操控能力，但由于富含接触的物理特性和不完善的驱动，训练可以直接部署在真实硬件上的控制策略仍然困难。我们通过一种实用的模拟到真实强化学习 (RL) 框架弥合了这一差距，该框架利用密集触觉反馈结合关节力矩感应来显式地调节物理交互。为了实现有效的模拟到真实迁移，我们引入了 (i) 一种计算快速的触觉模拟，通过并行正向运动学计算密集虚拟触觉单元与物体之间的距离，从而提供 RL 所需的高速率、高分辨率触觉信号；(ii) 电流到力矩的校准，通过将电机电流映射到关节力矩，消除了对灵巧手力矩传感器的需求；以及 (iii) 驱动器动力学建模，通过对反冲、转矩-速度饱和等非理想效果进行随机化，来弥合驱动方面的差距。使用完全在模拟中训练的非对称 actor-critic PPO 流程，我们的策略可以直接部署到五指手上。生成的策略展示了两个关键技能：（1）基于指令的可控抓取力跟踪，以及（2）手中物体的重新定向，两者都在没有在机器人上进行微调的情况下鲁棒地执行。通过将触觉和力矩结合在观测空间中，并配合有效的传感/驱动建模，我们的系统提供了一种实现可靠灵巧操作的实用解决方案。据我们所知，这是首次完全在模拟中训练并在真实硬件上零样本迁移的多指灵巧手上的可控抓取演示。
tldr: This paper presents a sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework for dexterous hand control using tactile and torque feedback, achieving zero-shot transfer to a real robotic hand for grasping and object reorientation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于触觉和扭矩反馈的灵巧手控制的模拟到真实强化学习框架，实现了零样本迁移到真实机器人手中的抓取和物体重新定向任务。

title: UltraLogic: Enhancing LLM Reasoning through Large-Scale Data Synthesis and Bipolar Float Reward
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in natural language processing , complex general-purpose reasoning requiring multi-step logic, planning, and verification remains a critical bottleneck. Although Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has succeeded in specific domains , the field lacks large-scale, high-quality, and difficulty-calibrated data for general reasoning. To address this, we propose UltraLogic, a framework that decouples the logical core of a problem from its natural language expression through a Code-based Solving methodology to automate high-quality data production. The framework comprises hundreds of unique task types and an automated calibration pipeline across ten difficulty levels. Furthermore, to mitigate binary reward sparsity and the Non-negative Reward Trap, we introduce the Bipolar Float Reward (BFR) mechanism, utilizing graded penalties to effectively distinguish perfect responses from those with logical flaws. Our experiments demonstrate that task diversity is the primary driver for reasoning enhancement , and that BFR, combined with a difficulty matching strategy, significantly improves training efficiency, guiding models toward global logical optima.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)在自然语言处理领域已展现出巨大潜力，但需要多步逻辑、规划和验证的复杂通用推理仍然是一个关键瓶颈。虽然基于可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)在特定领域取得了成功，但该领域缺乏大规模、高质量且难度校准的通用推理数据。为解决这个问题，我们提出了UltraLogic，一个通过基于代码的求解方法将问题的逻辑核心与其自然语言表达解耦的框架，从而自动化高质量数据的生成。该框架包含数百种独特的任务类型和一个跨越十个难度级别的自动化校准流水线。此外，为了缓解二元奖励的稀疏性和非负奖励陷阱，我们引入了双极浮点奖励(BFR)机制，利用分级惩罚来有效区分完美答案和存在逻辑缺陷的答案。我们的实验表明，任务多样性是推理能力增强的主要驱动力，并且BFR与难度匹配策略相结合可以显著提高训练效率，引导模型逼近全局逻辑最优解。
tldr: The paper introduces UltraLogic, a framework for enhancing LLM reasoning through large-scale data synthesis and a novel Bipolar Float Reward (BFR) mechanism, demonstrating improved reasoning and training efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了UltraLogic，一个通过大规模数据合成和新型双极浮点奖励（BFR）机制来增强LLM推理的框架，展示了改进的推理和训练效率。

title: IBISAgent: Reinforcing Pixel-Level Visual Reasoning in MLLMs for Universal Biomedical Object Referring and Segmentation
summary: Recent research on medical MLLMs has gradually shifted its focus from image-level understanding to fine-grained, pixel-level comprehension. Although segmentation serves as the foundation for pixel-level understanding, existing approaches face two major challenges. First, they introduce implicit segmentation tokens and require simultaneous fine-tuning of both the MLLM and external pixel decoders, which increases the risk of catastrophic forgetting and limits generalization to out-of-domain scenarios. Second, most methods rely on single-pass reasoning and lack the capability to iteratively refine segmentation results, leading to suboptimal performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel agentic MLLM, named IBISAgent, that reformulates segmentation as a vision-centric, multi-step decision-making process. IBISAgent enables MLLMs to generate interleaved reasoning and text-based click actions, invoke segmentation tools, and produce high-quality masks without architectural modifications. By iteratively performing multi-step visual reasoning on masked image features, IBISAgent naturally supports mask refinement and promotes the development of pixel-level visual reasoning capabilities. We further design a two-stage training framework consisting of cold-start supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning with tailored, fine-grained rewards, enhancing the model's robustness in complex medical referring and reasoning segmentation tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IBISAgent consistently outperforms both closed-source and open-source SOTA methods. All datasets, code, and trained models will be released publicly.
summary_zh: 对医学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的最新研究已逐渐将其重点从图像级理解转向精细的像素级理解。尽管分割是像素级理解的基础，但现有方法面临两个主要挑战。首先，它们引入隐式分割token并需要同时微调MLLM和外部像素解码器，这增加了灾难性遗忘的风险，并限制了对领域外场景的泛化能力。其次，大多数方法依赖于单次推理，缺乏迭代优化分割结果的能力，导致性能欠佳。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种新型的代理式MLLM，名为IBISAgent，它将分割重新定义为以视觉为中心的、多步骤的决策过程。IBISAgent使MLLM能够生成交错的推理和基于文本的点击动作，调用分割工具，并生成高质量的掩码，而无需架构修改。通过在掩码图像特征上迭代执行多步骤视觉推理，IBISAgent自然地支持掩码优化，并促进像素级视觉推理能力的开发。我们进一步设计了一个两阶段训练框架，包括冷启动监督微调和具有定制的、细粒度奖励的代理式强化学习，增强了模型在复杂的医学指代和推理分割任务中的鲁棒性。大量实验表明，IBISAgent始终优于闭源和开源的最先进（SOTA）方法。所有数据集、代码和训练好的模型都将公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces IBISAgent, an agentic MLLM that uses reinforcement learning and iterative visual reasoning to improve pixel-level biomedical object referring and segmentation without architectural modifications to the MLLM.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为IBISAgent的智能MLLM，它使用强化学习和迭代视觉推理来改进像素级别的生物医学对象指代和分割，而无需对MLLM进行结构修改。

title: Aligning Findings with Diagnosis: A Self-Consistent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Trustworthy Radiology Reporting
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for radiology report generation, yet their clinical translation is hindered by architectural heterogeneity and the prevalence of factual hallucinations. Standard supervised fine-tuning often fails to strictly align linguistic outputs with visual evidence, while existing reinforcement learning approaches struggle with either prohibitive computational costs or limited exploration. To address these challenges, we propose a comprehensive framework for self-consistent radiology report generation. First, we conduct a systematic evaluation to identify optimal vision encoder and LLM backbone configurations for medical imaging. Building on this foundation, we introduce a novel "Reason-then-Summarize" architecture optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). This framework restructures generation into two distinct components: a think block for detailed findings and an answer block for structured disease labels. By utilizing a multi-dimensional composite reward function, we explicitly penalize logical discrepancies between the generated narrative and the final diagnosis. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in clinical efficacy metrics and significantly reduces hallucinations compared to strong supervised baselines.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）在放射科报告生成方面展现出强大的潜力，但它们在临床转化方面受到架构异构性和事实性幻觉普遍存在的阻碍。标准的监督式微调常常无法严格地将语言输出与视觉证据对齐，而现有的强化学习方法则面临着计算成本过高或探索能力有限的困境。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个用于自洽放射科报告生成的综合框架。首先，我们进行系统的评估，以确定用于医学影像的最佳视觉编码器和LLM主干配置。在此基础上，我们引入了一种新颖的“推理-然后-总结”架构，并通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化。该框架将生成过程重构为两个不同的组成部分：用于详细发现的“思考”块和用于结构化疾病标签的“回答”块。通过采用多维复合奖励函数，我们明确地惩罚生成叙述与最终诊断之间的逻辑差异。在MIMIC-CXR基准上的大量实验表明，与强大的监督基线相比，我们的方法在临床疗效指标上取得了最先进的性能，并显著减少了幻觉。
tldr: This paper introduces a self-consistent reinforcement learning framework (Reason-then-Summarize + GRPO) for radiology report generation, aiming to improve alignment between visual evidence and text while reducing factual hallucinations in MLLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个自洽的强化学习框架（Reason-then-Summarize + GRPO）用于生成放射学报告，旨在提高视觉证据和文本之间的一致性，同时减少 MLLM 中的事实幻觉。

title: Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization for Efficient LLM Fine-tuning
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning (RL), particularly Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has become the dominant paradigm for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs). While policy ratio clipping stabilizes training, this heuristic hard constraint incurs a fundamental cost: it indiscriminately truncates gradients from high-return yet high-divergence actions, suppressing rare but highly informative "eureka moments" in complex reasoning. Moreover, once data becomes slightly stale, hard clipping renders it unusable, leading to severe sample inefficiency. In this work, we revisit the trust-region objective in policy optimization and show that explicitly constraining the \emph{variance (second central moment) of the policy ratio} provides a principled and smooth relaxation of hard clipping. This distributional constraint stabilizes policy updates while preserving gradient signals from valuable trajectories. Building on this insight, we propose $R^2VPO$ (Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization), a novel primal-dual framework that supports stable on-policy learning and enables principled off-policy data reuse by dynamically reweighting stale samples rather than discarding them. We extensively evaluate $R^2VPO$ on fine-tuning state-of-the-art LLMs, including DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and the openPangu-Embedded series (1B and 7B), across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
