Across diverse agentic and visual question answering tasks, we observe that some agents rarely invoke simulation (fewer than 1%), frequently misuse predicted rollouts (approximately 15%), and often exhibit inconsistent or even degraded performance (up to 5%) when simulation is available or enforced. Attribution analysis further indicates that the primary bottleneck lies in the agents' capacity to decide when to simulate, how to interpret predicted outcomes, and how to integrate foresight into downstream reasoning. These findings underscore the need for mechanisms that foster calibrated, strategic interaction with world models, paving the way toward more reliable anticipatory cognition in future agent systems.
summary_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型构建的智能体越来越多地面临需要预测未来状态的任务，而非依赖于短时推理。生成式世界模型提供了一种有前景的解决方案：智能体可以使用它们作为外部模拟器来预测行动的结果。本文实证研究了当前的智能体是否能够利用这些世界模型作为工具来增强其认知能力。在各种智能体和视觉问答任务中，我们观察到一些智能体很少调用模拟（少于1%），经常误用预测的展开（约15%），并且在模拟可用或强制执行时，常常表现出不一致甚至下降的性能（高达5%）。归因分析进一步表明，主要瓶颈在于智能体决定何时进行模拟、如何解释预测结果以及如何将预测整合到下游推理中的能力。这些发现强调了对能够促进与世界模型进行校准的、战略性交互的机制的需求，从而为未来智能体系统中更可靠的预期认知铺平道路。
tldr: This paper investigates current agents' ability to effectively use world models for foresight, finding deficiencies in simulation invocation, interpretation, and integration, suggesting the need for improved mechanisms for strategic world model interaction.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了当前智能体利用世界模型进行预测的能力，发现智能体在模拟调用、解释和整合方面存在不足，表明需要改进的机制以实现与世界模型的战略性互动。

title: Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO: Ensuring Bounded Ratios for Stable and Generalizable Training
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a popular algorithm for reinforcement learning with large language models (LLMs). However, upon analyzing its clipping mechanism, we argue that it is suboptimal in certain scenarios. With appropriate modifications, GRPO can be significantly enhanced to improve both flexibility and generalization. To this end, we propose Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO (ABC-GRPO), an asymmetric and adaptive refinement of the original GRPO framework. We demonstrate that ABC-GRPO achieves superior performance over standard GRPO on mathematical reasoning tasks using the Qwen3 LLMs. Moreover, ABC-GRPO maintains substantially higher entropy throughout training, thereby preserving the model's exploration capacity and mitigating premature convergence. The implementation code is available online to ease reproducibility https://github.com/chi2liu/ABC-GRPO.
summary_zh: 群体相对策略优化 (GRPO) 已经成为一种流行的基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的强化学习算法。 然而，通过分析其裁剪机制，我们认为它在某些情况下并非最优。 通过适当的修改，GRPO 可以得到显著增强，从而提高灵活性和泛化性。 为此，我们提出自适应边界裁剪 GRPO (ABC-GRPO)，它是原始 GRPO 框架的非对称和自适应改进。 我们证明了在使用 Qwen3 LLM 的数学推理任务中，ABC-GRPO 比标准 GRPO 取得了更优越的性能。 此外，ABC-GRPO 在整个训练过程中保持了显著更高的熵，从而保留了模型的探索能力并缓解了过早收敛。 实现代码已在线提供，以便于重现 https://github.com/chi2liu/ABC-GRPO。
tldr: The paper introduces Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO (ABC-GRPO), an improved variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for reinforcement learning with LLMs, showing superior performance on mathematical reasoning and maintaining higher entropy during training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了自适应边界裁剪GRPO（ABC-GRPO），它是群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的一种改进变体，用于LLM的强化学习，在数学推理方面表现出卓越的性能，并在训练过程中保持更高的熵。

title: R$^3$L: Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification
summary: Reinforcement learning drives recent advances in LLM reasoning and agentic capabilities, yet current approaches struggle with both exploration and exploitation. Exploration suffers from low success rates on difficult tasks and high costs of repeated rollouts from scratch. Exploitation suffers from coarse credit assignment and training instability: Trajectory-level rewards penalize valid prefixes for later errors, and failure-dominated groups overwhelm the few positive signals, leaving optimization without constructive direction. To this end, we propose R$^3$L, Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification. To synthesize high-quality trajectories, R$^3$L shifts from stochastic sampling to active synthesis via reflect-then-retry, leveraging language feedback to diagnose errors, transform failed attempts into successful ones, and reduce rollout costs by restarting from identified failure points. With errors diagnosed and localized, Pivotal Credit Assignment updates only the diverging suffix where contrastive signals exist, excluding the shared prefix from gradient update. Since failures dominate on difficult tasks and reflect-then-retry produces off-policy data, risking training instability, Positive Amplification upweights successful trajectories to ensure positive signals guide the optimization process. Experiments on agentic and reasoning tasks demonstrate 5\% to 52\% relative improvements over baselines while maintaining training stability. Our code is released at https://github.com/shiweijiezero/R3L.
summary_zh: 强化学习推动了LLM推理和代理能力方面的最新进展，但现有方法在探索和利用方面都面临挑战。探索受到高难度任务成功率低以及从零开始重复试验带来的高成本所困扰。利用则受到粗糙的信用分配和训练不稳定性的影响：轨迹级别的奖励会因后续的错误而惩罚有效的前缀，而失败主导的群体会淹没少数积极信号，导致优化缺乏建设性方向。为此，我们提出了R$^3$L，即基于语言引导探索、关键性信用和正向增强的反射-重试强化学习。为了合成高质量的轨迹，R$^3$L从随机采样转向通过反射-重试进行主动合成，利用语言反馈来诊断错误，将失败的尝试转化为成功的尝试，并通过从确定的失败点重新启动来降低试验成本。在诊断并定位错误后，关键性信用分配仅更新存在对比信号的发散后缀，并将共享的前缀排除在梯度更新之外。由于失败在高难度任务中占据主导地位，且反射-重试会产生非策略数据，从而带来训练不稳定性的风险，因此正向增强会提高成功轨迹的权重，以确保积极信号引导优化过程。在代理和推理任务上的实验表明，与基线相比，相对改进幅度为5%至52%，同时保持了训练稳定性。我们的代码已在https://github.com/shiweijiezero/R3L上发布。
tldr: The paper introduces R$^3$L, a Reinforcement Learning method that uses language feedback for exploration and pivotal credit assignment with positive amplification to improve performance on challenging agentic and reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了R$^3$L，一种强化学习方法，它利用语言反馈进行探索，并采用关键信用分配和积极放大，以提高在具有挑战性的智能体和推理任务中的性能。

title: Towards Compositional Generalization of LLMs via Skill Taxonomy Guided Data Synthesis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and agent-based systems often struggle with compositional generalization due to a data bottleneck in which complex skill combinations follow a long-tailed, power-law distribution, limiting both instruction-following performance and generalization in agent-centric tasks. To address this challenge, we propose STEPS, a Skill Taxonomy guided Entropy-based Post-training data Synthesis framework for generating compositionally challenging data. STEPS explicitly targets compositional generalization by uncovering latent relationships among skills and organizing them into an interpretable, hierarchical skill taxonomy using structural information theory. Building on this taxonomy, we formulate data synthesis as a constrained information maximization problem, selecting skill combinations that maximize marginal structural information within the hierarchy while preserving semantic coherence. Experiments on challenging instruction-following benchmarks show that STEPS outperforms existing data synthesis baselines, while also yielding improved compositional generalization in downstream agent-based evaluations.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和基于Agent的系统通常在组合泛化方面存在困难，这主要是由于数据瓶颈所致，其中复杂技能组合遵循长尾的幂律分布，从而限制了指令跟随的性能和以Agent为中心任务中的泛化能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了STEPS，一种技能分类指导的基于熵的后训练数据合成框架，用于生成具有组合挑战性的数据。STEPS通过挖掘技能之间的潜在关系，并使用结构信息理论将其组织成一个可解释的层级技能分类，从而显式地针对组合泛化。在此分类的基础上，我们将数据合成公式化为一个受约束的信息最大化问题，选择最大化层级内部边缘结构信息的技能组合，同时保持语义一致性。在具有挑战性的指令跟随基准测试上的实验表明，STEPS优于现有的数据合成基线，同时在下游基于Agent的评估中也产生了改进的组合泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces STEPS, a framework for synthesizing compositionally challenging data for LLMs by using a skill taxonomy to improve instruction-following and generalization in agent-based tasks, outperforming existing baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为STEPS的框架，通过使用技能分类法为LLM合成具有组合挑战性的数据，以提高指令遵循能力和基于代理的任务中的泛化能力，并且优于现有的基线方法。

title: AMIR-GRPO: Inducing Implicit Preference Signals into GRPO
summary:
Reinforcement learning has become the primary paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, with group relative policy optimization (GRPO) widely used in large-scale post-training. However, GRPO faces structural limitations in reasoning-heavy settings: sequence-level advantage normalization introduces systematic length bias, penalties for low-quality trajectories are diluted, and the scalar objective discards rich pairwise preference information embedded in within-group reward rankings. As a result, valuable supervision from costly rollouts remains underutilized.
  We propose AMIR-GRPO, which augments GRPO with an implicit DPO-style contrastive regularizer constructed directly from intra-group reward rankings, requiring no additional annotations. This mechanism amplifies suppression of low-reward trajectories, attenuates response-level length bias, and transforms each rollout group into a denser set of supervision constraints. Across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AMIR-GRPO consistently outperforms strong GRPO baselines, yields clearer separation between correct and incorrect reasoning chains, and delivers broader coverage gains beyond the subset of instances solved by standard GRPO.
summary_zh:
强化学习已成为对齐大型语言模型（LLM）以解决复杂推理任务的主要范式，其中群体相对策略优化（GRPO）被广泛应用于大规模后训练中。然而，GRPO在重推理设置中面临结构性限制：序列级优势归一化引入了系统性的长度偏差，对低质量轨迹的惩罚被稀释，并且标量目标丢弃了蕴含在群体内部奖励排序中的丰富的成对偏好信息。因此，来自高成本 rollout 的有价值的监督信息仍未得到充分利用。

我们提出AMIR-GRPO，通过直接从群体内部奖励排序构建的隐式DPO风格对比正则化器来增强GRPO，无需额外的标注。这种机制放大了对低奖励轨迹的抑制，减弱了响应级的长度偏差，并将每个 rollout 群体转化为更密集的监督约束集合。在多个数学推理基准测试中，AMIR-GRPO始终优于强大的GRPO基线，产生了更清晰的正确和错误推理链分离，并实现了超出标准GRPO所解决实例子集的更广泛的覆盖增益。
tldr: AMIR-GRPO improves GRPO for LLM alignment in reasoning tasks by using implicit pairwise preference information from reward rankings within rollout groups, leading to improved performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: AMIR-GRPO通过利用rollout组内奖励排名的隐式成对偏好信息改进了GRPO在LLM对齐推理任务中的表现，从而在数学推理基准测试中实现了更好的性能。

title: Policy-Guided Search on Tree-of-Thoughts for Efficient Problem Solving with Bounded Language Model Queries
summary: Recent studies explored integrating state-space search algorithms with Language Models (LM) to perform look-ahead on the token generation process, the ''Tree-of-Thoughts'' (ToT), generated by LMs, thereby improving performance on problem-solving tasks. However, the affiliated search algorithms often overlook the significant computational costs associated with LM inference, particularly in scenarios with constrained computational budgets. Consequently, we address the problem of improving LM performance on problem-solving tasks under limited computational budgets. We demonstrate how the probabilities assigned to thoughts by LMs can serve as a heuristic to guide search within the ToT framework, thereby reducing the number of thought evaluations. Building on this insight, we adapt a heuristic search algorithm, Levin Tree Search (LTS), to the ToT framework, which leverages LMs as policies to guide the tree exploration efficiently. We extend the theoretical results of LTS by showing that, for ToT (a pruned tree), LTS guarantees a bound on the number of states expanded, and consequently, on the number of thoughts generated. Additionally, we analyze the sensitivity of this bound to the temperature values commonly used in the final softmax layer of the LM. Empirical evaluation under a fixed LM query budget demonstrates that LTS consistently achieves comparable or higher accuracy than baseline search algorithms within the ToT framework, across three domains (Blocksworld, PrOntoQA, Array Sorting) and four distinct LMs. These findings highlight the efficacy of LTS on ToT, particularly in enabling cost-effective and time-efficient problem-solving, making it well-suited for latency-critical and resource-constrained applications.
summary_zh: 近期研究探索了将状态空间搜索算法与语言模型(LM)结合，以对语言模型生成的"思维树"(ToT)的token生成过程进行前瞻，从而提高解决问题的性能。然而，相关的搜索算法常常忽视与LM推理相关的显著计算成本，尤其是在计算预算受限的情况下。因此，我们致力于在有限计算预算下提高LM在解决问题任务上的性能。我们证明了LM分配给思维的概率可以用作启发式算法来指导ToT框架内的搜索，从而减少思维评估的数量。基于这一洞察，我们将启发式搜索算法Levin树搜索(LTS)应用于ToT框架，该算法利用LM作为策略来有效地指导树的探索。我们扩展了LTS的理论结果，表明对于ToT(一个剪枝树)，LTS保证了扩展状态数量的界限，从而保证了生成的思维数量的界限。此外，我们分析了该界限对LM最终softmax层中常用的温度值的敏感性。在固定LM查询预算下的实证评估表明，在三个领域(Blocksworld, PrOntoQA, 数组排序)和四个不同的LM中，LTS始终在ToT框架内实现了与基线搜索算法相当或更高的准确率。这些发现突显了LTS在ToT上的有效性，特别是在实现具有成本效益和时间效率的问题解决方面，使其非常适合对延迟敏感和资源受限的应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a policy-guided search method (Levin Tree Search adapted for Tree-of-Thoughts) that improves the efficiency of language model-based problem-solving under computational constraints, demonstrating improved accuracy across various domains.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种策略引导搜索方法（Levin Tree Search，适用于Tree-of-Thoughts），它提高了在计算约束下基于语言模型的问题解决效率，并在多个领域中展示了更高的准确性。

title: Can LLMs See Without Pixels? Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence from Textual Descriptions
summary: Recent advancements in Spatial Intelligence (SI) have predominantly relied on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet a critical question remains: does spatial understanding originate from visual encoders or the fundamental reasoning backbone? Inspired by this question, we introduce SiT-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the SI performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without pixel-level input, comprises over 3,800 expert-annotated items across five primary categories and 17 subtasks, ranging from egocentric navigation and perspective transformation to fine-grained robotic manipulation. By converting single/multi-view scenes into high-fidelity, coordinate-aware textual descriptions, we challenge LLMs to perform symbolic textual reasoning rather than visual pattern matching. Evaluation results of state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs reveals that while models achieve proficiency in localized semantic tasks, a significant "spatial gap" remains in global consistency. Notably, we find that explicit spatial reasoning significantly boosts performance, suggesting that LLMs possess latent world-modeling potential. Our proposed dataset SiT-Bench serves as a foundational resource to foster the development of spatially-grounded LLM backbones for future VLMs and embodied agents. Our code and benchmark will be released at https://github.com/binisalegend/SiT-Bench .
summary_zh: 空间智能(SI)领域的最新进展主要依赖于视觉-语言模型(VLM)，但仍存在一个关键问题：空间理解究竟源于视觉编码器还是根本性的推理主干？受此启发，我们推出了SiT-Bench，这是一个新颖的基准，旨在评估大型语言模型(LLM)在没有像素级输入情况下的SI性能。该基准包含超过3800个专家标注条目，涵盖五个主要类别和17个子任务，范围从以自我为中心的导航、透视变换到细粒度的机器人操作。通过将单/多视图场景转换为高保真、坐标感知的文本描述，我们挑战LLM进行符号化文本推理，而非视觉模式匹配。对当前最佳(SOTA) LLM的评估结果表明，虽然模型在局部语义任务中表现出色，但在全局一致性方面仍然存在显著的“空间差距”。值得注意的是，我们发现显式的空间推理能够显著提升性能，表明LLM具有潜在的世界建模能力。我们提出的数据集SiT-Bench可作为基础资源，以促进未来VLM和具身代理的空间定位LLM主干的开发。我们的代码和基准测试将在https://github.com/binisalegend/SiT-Bench发布。
tldr: This paper introduces SiT-Bench, a novel benchmark for evaluating spatial intelligence in LLMs without visual input, revealing a "spatial gap" and highlighting the potential of explicit spatial reasoning to improve LLM performance for embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SiT-Bench，一个用于评估LLM在没有视觉输入情况下的空间智能的新基准。研究揭示了一个“空间差距”，并强调了显式空间推理在提高LLM对具身智能体性能方面的潜力。

title: SCRIBE: Structured Mid-Level Supervision for Tool-Using Language Models
summary:
Training reliable tool-augmented agents remains a significant challenge, largely due to the difficulty of credit assignment in multi-step reasoning. While process-level reward models offer a promising direction, existing LLM-based judges often produce noisy and inconsistent signals because they lack fine-grained, task-specific rubrics to distinguish high-level planning from low-level execution. In this work, we introduce SCRIBE (Skill-Conditioned Reward with Intermediate Behavioral Evaluation), a reinforcement learning framework that intervenes at a novel mid-level abstraction. SCRIBE grounds reward modeling in a curated library of skill prototypes, transforming open-ended LLM evaluation into a constrained verification problem. By routing each subgoal to a corresponding prototype, the reward model is equipped with precise, structured rubrics that substantially reduce reward variance.
  Experimental results show that SCRIBE achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of reasoning and tool-use benchmarks. In particular, it improves the AIME25 accuracy of a Qwen3-4B model from 43.3% to 63.3%, and significantly increases success rates in complex multi-turn tool interactions.
  Further analysis of training dynamics reveals a co-evolution across abstraction levels, where mastery of mid-level skills consistently precedes the emergence of effective high-level planning behaviors. Finally, we demonstrate that SCRIBE is additive to low-level tool optimizations, providing a scalable and complementary pathway toward more autonomous and reliable tool-using agents.
summary_zh:
训练可靠的工具增强型智能体仍然是一项重大挑战，这主要是由于多步推理中的信用分配非常困难。虽然过程级奖励模型提供了一个有前景的方向，但现有的基于LLM的裁判通常会产生噪声和不一致的信号，因为它们缺乏细粒度的、特定于任务的评价标准，以区分高层规划和低层执行。在这项工作中，我们提出了SCRIBE（技能条件奖励与中间行为评估），这是一个在一种新型的中层抽象层次上进行干预的强化学习框架。SCRIBE将奖励建模建立在精心策划的技能原型库的基础上，从而将开放式的LLM评估转化为一个受约束的验证问题。通过将每个子目标路由到相应的原型，奖励模型配备了精确的、结构化的评价标准，从而大大降低了奖励方差。
实验结果表明，SCRIBE在一系列推理和工具使用基准测试中均实现了最先进的性能。特别是，它将Qwen3-4B模型在AIME25上的准确率从43.3%提高到63.3%，并显著提高了复杂的多轮工具交互中的成功率。
对训练动态的进一步分析揭示了跨抽象层次的共同进化，其中对中层技能的掌握始终先于有效的高层规划行为的出现。最后，我们证明了SCRIBE可以叠加到低层工具优化上，从而为构建更自主和可靠的工具使用智能体提供了一种可扩展和互补的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces SCRIBE, a reinforcement learning framework using structured mid-level supervision to improve tool-augmented language models by providing precise, skill-specific rubrics for reward modeling, leading to state-of-the-art performance in tool-use benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SCRIBE，一个强化学习框架，它使用结构化的中层监督来改进工具增强的语言模型，通过为奖励建模提供精确的、特定于技能的准则，从而在工具使用基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is a critical capability for multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents, particularly in conversational settings where information accumulates and evolves over time. However, existing benchmarks either evaluate multi-session memory in text-only conversations or assess multimodal understanding within localized contexts, failing to evaluate how multimodal memory is preserved, organized, and evolved across long-term conversational trajectories. Thus, we introduce Mem-Gallery, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents. Mem-Gallery features high-quality multi-session conversations grounded in both visual and textual information, with long interaction horizons and rich multimodal dependencies. Building on this dataset, we propose a systematic evaluation framework that assesses key memory capabilities along three functional dimensions: memory extraction and test-time adaptation, memory reasoning, and memory knowledge management. Extensive benchmarking across thirteen memory systems reveals several key findings, highlighting the necessity of explicit multimodal information retention and memory organization, the persistent limitations in memory reasoning and knowledge management, as well as the efficiency bottleneck of current models.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）代理的一个关键能力是长期记忆，尤其是在信息随时间积累和演变的对话环境中。然而，现有的基准测试要么评估纯文本对话中的多会话记忆，要么评估局部环境中的多模态理解，未能评估多模态记忆如何在长期对话轨迹中被保存、组织和演变。因此，我们引入了Mem-Gallery，这是一个新的基准，用于评估MLLM代理中的多模态长期对话记忆。Mem-Gallery具有基于视觉和文本信息的高质量多会话对话，具有较长的交互范围和丰富的多模态依赖关系。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一个系统的评估框架，该框架从三个功能维度评估关键的记忆能力：记忆提取和测试时适应、记忆推理以及记忆知识管理。对十三个记忆系统进行的大量基准测试揭示了几个关键发现，突出了显式多模态信息保留和记忆组织的重要性，记忆推理和知识管理方面存在的持续局限性，以及当前模型的效率瓶颈。
tldr: The paper introduces Mem-Gallery, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents, revealing limitations in memory reasoning, knowledge management, and efficiency of current models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Mem-Gallery，这是一个用于评估 MLLM 智能体中多模态长期对话记忆的新基准，揭示了当前模型在记忆推理、知识管理和效率方面的局限性。

title: Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks
summary: We study continual skill acquisition in open-ended embodied environments where an agent must construct, refine, and reuse an expanding library of executable skills. We introduce the Programmatic Skill Network (PSN), a framework in which skills are executable symbolic programs forming a compositional network that evolves through experience. PSN defines three core mechanisms instantiated via large language models: (1)REFLECT for structured fault localization over skill compositions, (2) progressive optimization with maturity-aware update gating that stabilizes reliable skills while maintaining plasticity for uncertain ones, and (3) canonical structural refactoring under rollback validation that maintains network compactness. We further show that PSN's learning dynamics exhibit structural parallels to neural network training. Experiments on MineDojo and Crafter demonstrate robust skill reuse, rapid adaptation, and strong generalization across open-ended task distributions.\footnote{We plan to open-source the code.
summary_zh: 我们研究了在开放式具身环境中持续技能学习的问题，其中智能体必须构建、完善和复用一个不断扩展的可执行技能库。我们引入了程序化技能网络（PSN），一个技能是可执行符号程序并形成组合网络的框架，该网络通过经验不断演化。PSN定义了三个通过大型语言模型实例化的核心机制：（1） REFLECT，用于在技能组合中进行结构化的故障定位；（2）采用成熟度感知更新门限的渐进优化，以稳定可靠的技能，同时保持不确定技能的可塑性；（3）在回滚验证下的规范化结构重构，以保持网络的紧凑性。我们进一步证明了PSN的学习动态表现出与神经网络训练相似的结构。在MineDojo和Crafter上的实验表明，PSN在开放式任务分布中具有强大的技能复用、快速适应和泛化能力。\footnote{我们计划开源代码。
tldr: The paper introduces Programmatic Skill Networks (PSN), a framework using LLMs for continual skill acquisition in embodied environments. It demonstrates skill reuse, adaptation, and generalization on MineDojo and Crafter.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了程序化技能网络 (PSN)，一种利用大型语言模型在具身环境中持续获取技能的框架。它在 MineDojo 和 Crafter 上展示了技能重用、适应和泛化能力。

title: SDCD: Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate significant progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet object hallucination remains a critical challenge. While existing research focuses on mitigating language priors or high-level statistical biases, they often overlook the internal complexities of the visual encoding process. We identify that visual statistical bias, arising from the inherent Bag-of-Patches behavior of Vision Encoders under weak structural supervision, acts as a contributing factor of object hallucinations. Under this bias, models prioritize local texture features within individual patches over holistic geometric structures. This tendency may induce spurious visual confidence and result in hallucinations. To address this, we introduce a training-free algorithm called Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding (SDCD), which performs contrastive calibration of the output distribution by introducing a shuffled structure-disrupted view. By penalizing tokens that maintain high confidence under this structure-less view, SDCD effectively suppresses the texture-driven bias. Experimental results demonstrate that SDCD significantly mitigates hallucinations across multiple benchmarks and enhances the overall multimodal capabilities of LVLMs.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态理解和推理方面取得了显著进展，但物体幻觉仍然是一个关键挑战。 现有研究侧重于缓解语言先验或高层统计偏差，但往往忽略了视觉编码过程的内部复杂性。 我们发现，视觉统计偏差——源于视觉编码器在弱结构监督下的固有词袋（Bag-of-Patches）行为——是物体幻觉的一个促成因素。 在此偏差下，模型将局部纹理特征置于单个图像块内，而非整体几何结构之上。 这种倾向可能诱发虚假的视觉置信度，导致幻觉。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种无需训练的算法，名为结构扰乱对比解码（SDCD），它通过引入一个洗牌的、结构扰乱的视图，对输出分布执行对比校准。 通过惩罚在结构缺失视图下仍保持高置信度的令牌，SDCD有效地抑制了纹理驱动的偏差。 实验结果表明，SDCD显著减轻了多个基准测试中的幻觉，并增强了LVLMs的整体多模态能力。
tldr: This paper introduces Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding (SDCD), a training-free algorithm to mitigate object hallucination in LVLMs by addressing visual statistical bias arising from the bag-of-patches behavior of vision encoders.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了结构扰动对比解码 (SDCD)，这是一种无需训练的算法，通过解决视觉编码器包块行为产生的视觉统计偏差来减轻 LVLM 中的对象幻觉。

title: FROST-Drive: Scalable and Efficient End-to-End Driving with a Frozen Vision Encoder
summary: End-to-end (E2E) models in autonomous driving aim to directly map sensor inputs to control commands, but their ability to generalize to novel and complex scenarios remains a key challenge. The common practice of fully fine-tuning the vision encoder on driving datasets potentially limits its generalization by causing the model to specialize too heavily in the training data. This work challenges the necessity of this training paradigm. We propose FROST-Drive, a novel E2E architecture designed to preserve and leverage the powerful generalization capabilities of a pretrained vision encoder from a Vision-Language Model (VLM). By keeping the encoder's weights frozen, our approach directly transfers the rich, generalized world knowledge from the VLM to the driving task. Our model architecture combines this frozen encoder with a transformer-based adapter for multimodal fusion and a GRU-based decoder for smooth waypoint generation. Furthermore, we introduce a custom loss function designed to directly optimize for Rater Feedback Score (RFS), a metric that prioritizes robust trajectory planning. We conduct extensive experiments on Waymo Open E2E Dataset, a large-scale datasets deliberately curated to capture the long-tail scenarios, demonstrating that our frozen-encoder approach significantly outperforms models that employ full fine-tuning. Our results provide substantial evidence that preserving the broad knowledge of a capable VLM is a more effective strategy for achieving robust, generalizable driving performance than intensive domain-specific adaptation. This offers a new pathway for developing vision-based models that can better handle the complexities of real-world application domains.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶中的端到端（E2E）模型旨在直接将传感器输入映射到控制指令，但它们泛化到新颖且复杂场景的能力仍是一个关键挑战。在驾驶数据集上完全微调视觉编码器的常见做法可能会限制其泛化能力，因为这会导致模型过度专门化于训练数据。本文对这种训练范式的必要性提出了质疑。我们提出了FROST-Drive，一种新型E2E架构，旨在保持并利用来自视觉-语言模型（VLM）的预训练视觉编码器的强大泛化能力。通过保持编码器的权重冻结，我们的方法将VLM中丰富的、普遍的常识知识直接转移到驾驶任务中。我们的模型架构将这个冻结的编码器与一个基于Transformer的适配器相结合，用于多模态融合，并与一个基于GRU的解码器相结合，用于平滑航路点生成。此外，我们引入了一个定制的损失函数，旨在直接优化评估者反馈得分（RFS），这是一个优先考虑鲁棒轨迹规划的指标。我们在Waymo Open E2E数据集（一个经过精心设计以捕获长尾场景的大规模数据集）上进行了广泛的实验，证明了我们的冻结编码器方法显著优于采用完全微调的模型。我们的结果提供了充分的证据，表明保持有能力的VLM的广泛知识，比进行密集的特定领域适应，是实现稳健、可泛化的驾驶性能的更有效策略。这为开发能够更好地处理现实世界应用领域复杂性的基于视觉的模型提供了新的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces FROST-Drive, an end-to-end driving model that leverages a frozen vision encoder pretrained on VLMs and demonstrates improved generalization on the Waymo Open E2E Dataset compared to fine-tuning approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FROST-Drive，一种端到端驾驶模型，利用冻结的视觉编码器（预训练于视觉语言模型）并展示了在Waymo Open E2E 数据集上比微调方法更好的泛化能力。

title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
summary: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends Large Language Models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning tasks.
summary_zh: 基于记忆增强的生成（MAG）通过外部记忆扩展大型语言模型，以支持长上下文推理，但现有方法主要依赖于对单片记忆存储的语义相似性，将时间、因果和实体信息纠缠在一起。 这种设计限制了解释性以及查询意图和检索到的证据之间的对齐，导致次优的推理准确性。 在本文中，我们提出了 MAGMA，一种多图代理记忆架构，它通过正交的语义、时间、因果和实体图表示每个记忆项目。 MAGMA 将检索公式化为策略引导的遍历这些关系视图，从而实现查询自适应选择和结构化上下文构建。 通过将记忆表示与检索逻辑分离，MAGMA 提供了透明的推理路径和对检索的细粒度控制。 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上的实验表明，MAGMA 在长程推理任务中始终优于最先进的代理记忆系统。
tldr: MAGMA is a novel memory architecture for LLMs that utilizes multiple graphs (semantic, temporal, causal, entity) for query-adaptive retrieval, improving long-horizon reasoning. It surpasses state-of-the-art agentic memory systems.
tldr_zh: MAGMA是一种新颖的LLM内存架构，它利用多个图（语义、时间、因果、实体）进行查询自适应检索，从而提高长时程推理能力。它超越了最先进的代理记忆系统。

title: GeoReason: Aligning Thinking And Answering In Remote Sensing Vision-Language Models Via Logical Consistency Reinforcement Learning
summary: The evolution of Remote Sensing Vision-Language Models(RS-VLMs) emphasizes the importance of transitioning from perception-centric recognition toward high-level deductive reasoning to enhance cognitive reliability in complex spatial tasks. However, current models often suffer from logical hallucinations, where correct answers are derived from flawed reasoning chains or rely on positional shortcuts rather than spatial logic. This decoupling undermines reliability in strategic spatial decision-making. To address this, we present GeoReason, a framework designed to synchronize internal thinking with final decisions. We first construct GeoReason-Bench, a logic-driven dataset containing 4,000 reasoning trajectories synthesized from geometric primitives and expert knowledge. We then formulate a two-stage training strategy: (1) Supervised Knowledge Initialization to equip the model with reasoning syntax and domain expertise, and (2) Consistency-Aware Reinforcement Learning to refine deductive reliability. This second stage integrates a novel Logical Consistency Reward, which penalizes logical drift via an option permutation strategy to anchor decisions in verifiable reasoning traces. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the cognitive reliability and interpretability of RS-VLMs, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared to other advanced methods.
summary_zh: 遥感视觉-语言模型(RS-VLMs)的发展强调了从以感知为中心的识别向高层次演绎推理过渡的重要性，以增强复杂空间任务中的认知可靠性。然而，当前的模型经常遭受逻辑幻觉的困扰，即从有缺陷的推理链中得出正确的答案，或者依赖于位置捷径而非空间逻辑。这种脱节削弱了战略性空间决策中的可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GeoReason，一个旨在同步内部思考与最终决策的框架。我们首先构建GeoReason-Bench，一个逻辑驱动的数据集，包含从几何基元和专家知识中合成的4000条推理轨迹。然后，我们制定了一个两阶段的训练策略：（1）监督知识初始化，使模型具备推理语法和领域专业知识，以及（2）一致性感知强化学习，以提高演绎可靠性。第二阶段整合了一种新的逻辑一致性奖励，通过选项排列策略惩罚逻辑漂移，从而将决策锚定在可验证的推理轨迹中。实验结果表明，我们的框架显著提高了RS-VLMs的认知可靠性和可解释性，与其它先进方法相比，实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces GeoReason, a framework using reinforcement learning to improve the logical consistency of Remote Sensing Vision-Language Models, addressing issues of logical hallucinations and unreliable spatial reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了GeoReason，一个使用强化学习来提高遥感视觉语言模型逻辑一致性的框架，解决逻辑幻觉和不可靠空间推理的问题。

title: TIR-Flow: Active Video Search and Reasoning with Frozen VLMs
summary: While Large Video-Language Models (Video-LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in perception, their reasoning capabilities remain a bottleneck. Existing solutions typically resort to a heavy "data engineering" paradigm-synthesizing large-scale Chain-of-Thought (CoT) datasets followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). This pipeline primarily optimizes probability sampling efficiency and aligns output distributions, but fails to activate the intrinsic intelligence required for dynamic visual exploration. In this work, we propose TIR-Flow, a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from passive processing to active video searching and reasoning without additional data or parameter updating. Concretely, our framework operates through three synergistic modules: HDD decomposes complex queries into a set of verifiable sub-tasks; HAP actively directs visual attention to gather high-resolution evidence for hypothesis validation; EBA maintains a persistent workspace to accumulate and update the discovered clues for logical reasoning. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that TIR-Flow significantly outperforms recent strong baselines, delivering an average performance boost of 5.9%, with gains reaching 10.5% on Egoschema. Our analysis confirms that empowering frozen VLMs with System-2-like active perception is a scalable path toward solving long-horizon video reasoning.
summary_zh: 大型视频语言模型（Video-LLMs）在感知方面取得了显著进展，但其推理能力仍是一个瓶颈。现有的解决方案通常采用一种繁重的“数据工程”范式——合成大规模思维链（CoT）数据集，然后进行监督式微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。该流程主要优化概率抽样效率并对齐输出分布，但未能激活动态视觉探索所需的内在智能。在这项工作中，我们提出了TIR-Flow，一种新颖的框架，将范式从被动处理转变为主动视频搜索和推理，而无需额外的数据或参数更新。具体来说，我们的框架通过三个协同模块运行：HDD将复杂查询分解为一组可验证的子任务；HAP主动引导视觉注意力，以收集用于假设验证的高分辨率证据；EBA维护一个持久的工作空间，以积累和更新发现的线索，从而进行逻辑推理。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TIR-Flow显著优于最近的强大基线，平均性能提升了5.9%，在Egoschema上更是达到了10.5%。我们的分析证实，为冻结的VLM配备类似系统2的主动感知能力，是解决长时程视频推理的一种可扩展途径。
tldr: The paper introduces TIR-Flow, a novel framework that enhances the reasoning capabilities of frozen Video-LLMs by enabling active video searching and reasoning through hypothesis decomposition, active perception, and persistent workspace utilization, achieving significant performance improvements on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TIR-Flow，一种通过假设分解、主动感知和持久工作空间利用来增强冻结视频-LLM推理能力的新框架，从而在多个基准测试中实现了显著的性能提升，通过主动视频搜索和推理来解决现有Video-LLMs推理能力不足的问题。

title: MVP: Enhancing Video Large Language Models via Self-supervised Masked Video Prediction
summary: Reinforcement learning based post-training paradigms for Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved significant success by optimizing for visual-semantic tasks such as captioning or VideoQA. However, while these approaches effectively enhance perception abilities, they primarily target holistic content understanding, often lacking explicit supervision for intrinsic temporal coherence and inter-frame correlations. This tendency limits the models' ability to capture intricate dynamics and fine-grained visual causality. To explicitly bridge this gap, we propose a novel post-training objective: Masked Video Prediction (MVP). By requiring the model to reconstruct a masked continuous segment from a set of challenging distractors, MVP forces the model to attend to the sequential logic and temporal context of events. To support scalable training, we introduce a scalable data synthesis pipeline capable of transforming arbitrary video corpora into MVP training samples, and further employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a fine-grained reward function to enhance the model's understanding of video context and temporal properties. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that MVP enhances video reasoning capabilities by directly reinforcing temporal reasoning and causal understanding.
summary_zh: 基于强化学习的视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）后训练范式，通过优化视觉-语义任务（如视频字幕生成或视频问答），已取得了显著的成功。然而，尽管这些方法有效地增强了感知能力，但它们主要针对整体内容理解，通常缺乏对内在时间连贯性和帧间相关性的显式监督。这种倾向限制了模型捕获复杂动态和细粒度视觉因果关系的能力。为了明确弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种新的后训练目标：掩码视频预测（MVP）。通过要求模型从一组具有挑战性的干扰项中重建被掩盖的连续片段，MVP迫使模型关注事件的顺序逻辑和时间上下文。为了支持可扩展的训练，我们引入了一个可扩展的数据合成流程，能够将任意视频语料库转换为 MVP 训练样本，并进一步采用具有细粒度奖励函数的群体相对策略优化（GRPO），以增强模型对视频上下文和时间属性的理解。全面的评估表明，MVP 通过直接加强时间推理和因果理解，提升了视频推理能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Masked Video Prediction (MVP) as a post-training objective for VideoLLMs to improve their temporal coherence and causal understanding by reconstructing masked video segments, enhancing video reasoning capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了掩码视频预测 (MVP) 作为 VideoLLM 的后训练目标，通过重建掩码视频片段来提高其时间一致性和因果理解，从而增强视频推理能力。

title: I2E: From Image Pixels to Actionable Interactive Environments for Text-Guided Image Editing
summary: Existing text-guided image editing methods primarily rely on end-to-end pixel-level inpainting paradigm. Despite its success in simple scenarios, this paradigm still significantly struggles with compositional editing tasks that require precise local control and complex multi-object spatial reasoning. This paradigm is severely limited by 1) the implicit coupling of planning and execution, 2) the lack of object-level control granularity, and 3) the reliance on unstructured, pixel-centric modeling. To address these limitations, we propose I2E, a novel "Decompose-then-Action" paradigm that revisits image editing as an actionable interaction process within a structured environment. I2E utilizes a Decomposer to transform unstructured images into discrete, manipulable object layers and then introduces a physics-aware Vision-Language-Action Agent to parse complex instructions into a series of atomic actions via Chain-of-Thought reasoning. Further, we also construct I2E-Bench, a benchmark designed for multi-instance spatial reasoning and high-precision editing. Experimental results on I2E-Bench and multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that I2E significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in handling complex compositional instructions, maintaining physical plausibility, and ensuring multi-turn editing stability.
summary_zh: 现有文本引导的图像编辑方法主要依赖于端到端的像素级图像修复范式。尽管这种范式在简单场景中取得了成功，但在需要精确局部控制和复杂多对象空间推理的组合编辑任务中仍然面临显著挑战。这种范式受到以下因素的严重限制：1) 规划和执行的隐式耦合，2) 缺乏对象级别的控制粒度，以及 3) 依赖于非结构化的、以像素为中心的建模。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的“分解-然后-行动”范式 I2E，它将图像编辑重新审视为结构化环境中可操作的交互过程。I2E 利用一个分解器将非结构化图像转换为离散的、可操作的对象层，然后引入一个具有物理感知能力的视觉-语言-行动智能体，通过思维链推理将复杂的指令解析为一系列原子动作。 此外，我们还构建了 I2E-Bench，这是一个专为多实例空间推理和高精度编辑设计的基准。在 I2E-Bench 和多个公共基准上的实验结果表明，I2E 在处理复杂的组合指令、保持物理合理性以及确保多轮编辑稳定性方面显著优于最先进的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces I2E, a new paradigm for text-guided image editing that decomposes images into manipulable object layers and uses a Vision-Language-Action Agent to perform edits based on complex instructions, addressing limitations of pixel-level inpainting methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了I2E，一种新的文本引导图像编辑范式，它将图像分解为可操作的对象层，并使用视觉-语言-动作代理根据复杂的指令执行编辑，从而解决了像素级图像修复方法的局限性。

title: BREATH-VL: Vision-Language-Guided 6-DoF Bronchoscopy Localization via Semantic-Geometric Fusion
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown remarkable performance in navigation and localization tasks by leveraging large-scale pretraining for semantic understanding. However, applying VLMs to 6-DoF endoscopic camera localization presents several challenges: 1) the lack of large-scale, high-quality, densely annotated, and localization-oriented vision-language datasets in real-world medical settings; 2) limited capability for fine-grained pose regression; and 3) high computational latency when extracting temporal features from past frames. To address these issues, we first construct BREATH dataset, the largest in-vivo endoscopic localization dataset to date, collected in the complex human airway. Building on this dataset, we propose BREATH-VL, a hybrid framework that integrates semantic cues from VLMs with geometric information from vision-based registration methods for accurate 6-DoF pose estimation. Our motivation lies in the complementary strengths of both approaches: VLMs offer generalizable semantic understanding, while registration methods provide precise geometric alignment. To further enhance the VLM's ability to capture temporal context, we introduce a lightweight context-learning mechanism that encodes motion history as linguistic prompts, enabling efficient temporal reasoning without expensive video-level computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the vision-language module delivers robust semantic localization in challenging surgical scenes. Building on this, our BREATH-VL outperforms state-of-the-art vision-only localization methods in both accuracy and generalization, reducing translational error by 25.5% compared with the best-performing baseline, while achieving competitive computational latency.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 近来在导航和定位任务中表现出卓越的性能，这得益于大规模的预训练对语义理解的提升。然而，将 VLMs 应用于 6-DoF 内窥镜相机定位面临着多个挑战：1) 缺乏现实世界医疗环境中大规模、高质量、密集标注且面向定位的视觉-语言数据集；2) 精细姿态回归的能力有限；以及 3) 从过去帧中提取时间特征时存在较高的计算延迟。为了解决这些问题，我们首先构建了迄今为止最大的体内内窥镜定位数据集 BREATH 数据集，该数据集是在复杂的人体气道中收集的。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一种混合框架 BREATH-VL，该框架集成了来自 VLMs 的语义线索和来自基于视觉的配准方法的几何信息，以实现精确的 6-DoF 姿态估计。我们的动机在于这两种方法的互补优势：VLMs 提供可泛化的语义理解，而配准方法提供精确的几何对齐。为了进一步提升 VLM 捕捉时间上下文的能力，我们引入了一种轻量级的上下文学习机制，将运动历史编码为语言提示，从而实现高效的时间推理，而无需昂贵的视频级计算。 广泛的实验表明，视觉-语言模块在具有挑战性的手术场景中提供了稳健的语义定位。 在此基础上，我们的 BREATH-VL 在准确性和泛化性方面均优于最先进的纯视觉定位方法，与性能最佳的基线相比，平移误差降低了 25.5%，同时实现了具有竞争力的计算延迟。
tldr: The paper introduces BREATH-VL, a vision-language-guided framework for 6-DoF bronchoscopy localization, along with the BREATH dataset, addressing challenges in applying VLMs to endoscopic pose estimation by fusing semantic and geometric information and using a lightweight temporal context learning mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BREATH-VL，一个用于6自由度支气管镜定位的视觉语言引导框架，以及BREATH数据集。该框架通过融合语义和几何信息，以及使用轻量级的时间上下文学习机制，解决了将视觉语言模型应用于内窥镜姿态估计的挑战。

title: SpatiaLoc: Leveraging Multi-Level Spatial Enhanced Descriptors for Cross-Modal Localization
summary: Cross-modal localization using text and point clouds enables robots to localize themselves via natural language descriptions, with applications in autonomous navigation and interaction between humans and robots. In this task, objects often recur across text and point clouds, making spatial relationships the most discriminative cues for localization. Given this characteristic, we present SpatiaLoc, a framework utilizing a coarse-to-fine strategy that emphasizes spatial relationships at both the instance and global levels. In the coarse stage, we introduce a Bezier Enhanced Object Spatial Encoder (BEOSE) that models spatial relationships at the instance level using quadratic Bezier curves. Additionally, a Frequency Aware Encoder (FAE) generates spatial representations in the frequency domain at the global level. In the fine stage, an Uncertainty Aware Gaussian Fine Localizer (UGFL) regresses 2D positions by modeling predictions as Gaussian distributions with a loss function aware of uncertainty. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose demonstrate that SpatiaLoc significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.
summary_zh: 使用文本和点云进行跨模态定位使机器人能够通过自然语言描述进行自定位，从而应用于自主导航以及人与机器人之间的交互。在该任务中，物体经常在文本和点云中重复出现，这使得空间关系成为定位最具区分性的线索。 鉴于这一特性，我们提出SpatiaLoc，一个利用粗到细策略的框架，该框架在实例和全局层面上都强调空间关系。 在粗略阶段，我们引入了Bezier增强物体空间编码器（BEOSE），它使用二次Bezier曲线在实例层面建模空间关系。此外，频率感知编码器（FAE）在全局层面在频域中生成空间表示。 在精细阶段，不确定性感知高斯精细定位器（UGFL）通过将预测建模为具有不确定性感知损失函数的高斯分布来回归2D位置。 在KITTI360Pose上的大量实验表明，SpatiaLoc显著优于现有的最先进（SOTA）方法。
tldr: The paper introduces SpatiaLoc, a novel framework for cross-modal localization using text and point clouds, leveraging multi-level spatial relationships with a coarse-to-fine strategy that outperforms SOTA methods on KITTI360Pose.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SpatiaLoc，一个用于文本和点云跨模态定位的新框架，利用多层次空间关系，采用由粗到精的策略，在KITTI360Pose上优于现有的SOTA方法。

title: Semantic Belief-State World Model for 3D Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction has traditionally been framed as a sequence regression problem where models extrapolate future joint coordinates from observed pose histories. While effective over short horizons this approach does not separate observation reconstruction with dynamics modeling and offers no explicit representation of the latent causes governing motion. As a result, existing methods exhibit compounding drift, mean-pose collapse, and poorly calibrated uncertainty when rolled forward beyond the training regime. Here we propose a Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) that reframes human motion prediction as latent dynamical simulation on the human body manifold. Rather than predicting poses directly, SBWM maintains a recurrent probabilistic belief state whose evolution is learned independently of pose reconstruction and explicitly aligned with the SMPL-X anatomical parameterization. This alignment imposes a structural information bottleneck that prevents the latent state from encoding static geometry or sensor noise, forcing it to capture motion dynamics, intent, and control-relevant structure. Inspired by belief-state world models developed for model-based reinforcement learning, SBWM adapts stochastic latent transitions and rollout-centric training to the domain of human motion. In contrast to RSSM-based, transformer, and diffusion approaches optimized for reconstruction fidelity, SBWM prioritizes stable forward simulation. We demonstrate coherent long-horizon rollouts, and competitive accuracy at substantially lower computational cost. These results suggest that treating the human body as part of the world models state space rather than its output fundamentally changes how motion is simulated, and predicted.
summary_zh: 人体运动预测传统上被定义为序列回归问题，即模型从观察到的姿势历史中推断未来的关节坐标。虽然这种方法在短时间内有效，但它没有将观测重建与动态建模分离，并且没有对控制运动的潜在原因进行明确表示。因此，现有方法在超出训练范围之外进行推演时，会表现出累积漂移、均值姿势坍塌和不确定性校准不良等问题。在此，我们提出了一种语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM），它将人体运动预测重新定义为在人体流形上的潜在动态模拟。SBWM不是直接预测姿势，而是维护一个循环概率信念状态，其演化是独立于姿势重建学习的，并与SMPL-X解剖参数化显式对齐。这种对齐施加了一个结构性信息瓶颈，阻止了潜在状态编码静态几何或传感器噪声，迫使其捕获运动动力学、意图和控制相关的结构。受到为基于模型的强化学习开发的信念状态世界模型的启发，SBWM将随机潜在转移和以推演为中心的训练应用于人体运动领域。与为重建保真度优化的基于RSSM、Transformer和扩散的方法不同，SBWM优先考虑稳定的前向模拟。我们展示了连贯的长期推演，以及具有竞争力的准确性，同时计算成本大大降低。这些结果表明，将人体视为世界模型状态空间的一部分，而不是其输出，从根本上改变了运动的模拟和预测方式。
tldr: This paper introduces a Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) for human motion prediction, which uses a latent dynamical simulation on the human body manifold and prioritizes stable forward simulation over reconstruction fidelity, leading to more coherent long-horizon predictions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于人体运动预测的语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM），该模型在人体流形上使用潜在的动力学模拟，并优先考虑稳定的前向模拟而非重建保真度，从而实现更连贯的长期预测。

title: Understanding Reward Hacking in Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard approach for post-training large language models and, more recently, for improving image generation models, which uses reward functions to enhance generation quality and human preference alignment. However, existing reward designs are often imperfect proxies for true human judgment, making models prone to reward hacking--producing unrealistic or low-quality images that nevertheless achieve high reward scores. In this work, we systematically analyze reward hacking behaviors in text-to-image (T2I) RL post-training. We investigate how both aesthetic/human preference rewards and prompt-image consistency rewards individually contribute to reward hacking and further show that ensembling multiple rewards can only partially mitigate this issue. Across diverse reward models, we identify a common failure mode: the generation of artifact-prone images. To address this, we propose a lightweight and adaptive artifact reward model, trained on a small curated dataset of artifact-free and artifact-containing samples. This model can be integrated into existing RL pipelines as an effective regularizer for commonly used reward models. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating our artifact reward significantly improves visual realism and reduces reward hacking across multiple T2I RL setups, demonstrating the effectiveness of lightweight reward augment serving as a safeguard against reward hacking.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为对大型语言模型进行后训练的标准方法，并且最近也被用于改进图像生成模型，它利用奖励函数来提高生成质量和与人类偏好的对齐。然而，现有的奖励设计往往是人类真实判断的不完美代理，这使得模型容易出现奖励破解——产生不真实或低质量的图像，但却能获得很高的奖励分数。在这项工作中，我们系统地分析了文本到图像（T2I）RL后训练中的奖励破解行为。我们研究了美学/人类偏好奖励和提示-图像一致性奖励如何分别导致奖励破解，并进一步表明，集成多个奖励只能部分缓解这个问题。在不同的奖励模型中，我们识别出一个常见的失效模式：容易生成包含伪影的图像。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种轻量级且自适应的伪影奖励模型，该模型在一小部分精选的无伪影和含伪影样本数据集上进行训练。该模型可以作为常用的奖励模型的有效正则化项，集成到现有的RL流程中。实验表明，将我们的伪影奖励纳入其中可以显著提高视觉逼真度，并减少多种T2I RL设置中的奖励破解，证明了轻量级奖励增强作为防止奖励破解的保障的有效性。
tldr: This paper analyzes reward hacking in text-to-image reinforcement learning, identifies a common failure mode of artifact-prone images, and proposes a lightweight artifact reward model to regularize existing RL pipelines.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了文本到图像强化学习中的奖励黑客行为，发现了一种常见的artifact易发图像的失败模式，并提出了一种轻量级的artifact奖励模型，用于规范现有的RL流程。

title: ThinkRL-Edit: Thinking in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning-Centric Image Editing
summary: Instruction-driven image editing with unified multimodal generative models has advanced rapidly, yet their underlying visual reasoning remains limited, leading to suboptimal performance on reasoning-centric edits. Reinforcement learning (RL) has been investigated for improving the quality of image editing, but it faces three key challenges: (1) limited reasoning exploration confined to denoising stochasticity, (2) biased reward fusion, and (3) unstable VLM-based instruction rewards. In this work, we propose ThinkRL-Edit, a reasoning-centric RL framework that decouples visual reasoning from image synthesis and expands reasoning exploration beyond denoising. To the end, we introduce Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-based reasoning sampling with planning and reflection stages prior to generation in online sampling, compelling the model to explore multiple semantic hypotheses and validate their plausibility before committing to a visual outcome. To avoid the failures of weighted aggregation, we propose an unbiased chain preference grouping strategy across multiple reward dimensions. Moreover, we replace interval-based VLM scores with a binary checklist, yielding more precise, lower-variance, and interpretable rewards for complex reasoning. Experiments show our method significantly outperforms prior work on reasoning-centric image editing, producing instruction-faithful, visually coherent, and semantically grounded edits.
summary_zh: 借助统一多模态生成模型的指令驱动图像编辑技术发展迅速，但其潜在的视觉推理能力仍然有限，导致以推理为中心的编辑任务表现欠佳。 强化学习（RL）已被用于提升图像编辑质量，但面临三大挑战：（1）受限于去噪随机性的有限推理探索；（2）有偏的奖励融合；（3）基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的不稳定指令奖励。在本文中，我们提出了 ThinkRL-Edit，这是一个以推理为中心的强化学习框架，它将视觉推理与图像合成解耦，并将推理探索扩展到去噪之外。为此，我们引入了基于思维链（CoT）的推理采样方法，在在线采样中的生成阶段之前增加规划和反思阶段，从而迫使模型探索多个语义假设，并在确定视觉结果之前验证其合理性。为了避免加权聚合的失效，我们提出了一种在多个奖励维度上进行无偏链偏好分组策略。此外，我们用二元检查表取代基于区间的视觉语言模型评分，从而为复杂的推理产生更精确、更低方差和更易于解释的奖励。实验表明，我们的方法在以推理为中心的图像编辑方面显著优于现有工作，能够生成指令忠实、视觉连贯且语义扎实的编辑结果。
tldr: The paper introduces ThinkRL-Edit, a reinforcement learning framework that focuses on improving reasoning in instruction-driven image editing by using Chain-of-Thought reasoning, unbiased chain preference grouping, and a binary checklist for reward definition.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 ThinkRL-Edit，一个强化学习框架，通过使用思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理、无偏链偏好分组和二元清单奖励定义，专注于提高指令驱动图像编辑中的推理能力。

title: RiskCueBench: Benchmarking Anticipatory Reasoning from Early Risk Cues in Video-Language Models
summary: With the rapid growth of video centered social media, the ability to anticipate risky events from visual data is a promising direction for ensuring public safety and preventing real world accidents. Prior work has extensively studied supervised video risk assessment across domains such as driving, protests, and natural disasters. However, many existing datasets provide models with access to the full video sequence, including the accident itself, which substantially reduces the difficulty of the task. To better reflect real world conditions, we introduce a new video understanding benchmark RiskCueBench in which videos are carefully annotated to identify a risk signal clip, defined as the earliest moment that indicates a potential safety concern. Experimental results reveal a significant gap in current systems ability to interpret evolving situations and anticipate future risky events from early visual signals, highlighting important challenges for deploying video risk prediction models in practice.
summary_zh: 随着以视频为中心的社交媒体的快速增长，从视觉数据中预测风险事件的能力成为确保公共安全和预防现实世界事故的一个有前景的方向。此前的工作已经广泛研究了驾驶、抗议和自然灾害等领域中的监督式视频风险评估。然而，许多现有的数据集为模型提供了访问完整视频序列（包括事故本身）的机会，这大大降低了任务难度。为了更好地反映现实世界的条件，我们引入了一个新的视频理解基准RiskCueBench，其中视频经过精心标注，以识别风险信号片段，该片段被定义为指示潜在安全问题的最早时刻。实验结果表明，当前系统在解释演变情况和从早期视觉信号预测未来风险事件的能力方面存在显著差距，突显了在实践中部署视频风险预测模型的重要挑战。
tldr: The paper introduces RiskCueBench, a new video benchmark focusing on early risk cue detection to evaluate video-language models' ability to anticipate risky events, finding current systems lacking in this capability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RiskCueBench，一个新的视频基准测试，专注于早期风险线索检测，用于评估视频语言模型预测风险事件的能力，并发现当前系统在这方面存在不足。

title: State Backdoor: Towards Stealthy Real-world Poisoning Attack on Vision-Language-Action Model in State Space
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are widely deployed in safety-critical embodied AI applications such as robotics. However, their complex multimodal interactions also expose new security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we investigate a backdoor threat in VLA models, where malicious inputs cause targeted misbehavior while preserving performance on clean data. Existing backdoor methods predominantly rely on inserting visible triggers into visual modality, which suffer from poor robustness and low insusceptibility in real-world settings due to environmental variability. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the State Backdoor, a novel and practical backdoor attack that leverages the robot arm's initial state as the trigger. To optimize trigger for insusceptibility and effectiveness, we design a Preference-guided Genetic Algorithm (PGA) that efficiently searches the state space for minimal yet potent triggers. Extensive experiments on five representative VLA models and five real-world tasks show that our method achieves over 90% attack success rate without affecting benign task performance, revealing an underexplored vulnerability in embodied AI systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型被广泛部署于机器人等安全攸关的具身人工智能应用中。然而，其复杂的多模态交互也带来了新的安全漏洞。本文研究了 VLA 模型中的后门威胁，即恶意输入导致目标错误行为，同时保持清洁数据上的性能。现有的后门方法主要依赖于在视觉模态中插入可见触发器，但由于环境变化，这些方法在真实环境中鲁棒性差，且不易察觉。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖且实用的后门攻击方法：状态后门，它利用机器人手臂的初始状态作为触发器。为了优化触发器的隐蔽性和有效性，我们设计了一种偏好引导的遗传算法（PGA），该算法能够高效地在状态空间中搜索最小但最具效力的触发器。在五种代表性的 VLA 模型和五种真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了超过 90% 的攻击成功率，且不影响良性任务的性能，从而揭示了具身人工智能系统中一个未被充分探索的漏洞。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel 'State Backdoor' attack on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, using the robot arm's initial state as a trigger to induce targeted misbehavior, achieving high success rates while maintaining clean data performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的“状态后门”攻击，使用机器人手臂的初始状态作为触发器来诱导目标错误行为，在保持干净数据性能的同时实现了高攻击成功率。

title: Sensor to Pixels: Decentralized Swarm Gathering via Image-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: This study highlights the potential of image-based reinforcement learning methods for addressing swarm-related tasks. In multi-agent reinforcement learning, effective policy learning depends on how agents sense, interpret, and process inputs. Traditional approaches often rely on handcrafted feature extraction or raw vector-based representations, which limit the scalability and efficiency of learned policies concerning input order and size. In this work we propose an image-based reinforcement learning method for decentralized control of a multi-agent system, where observations are encoded as structured visual inputs that can be processed by Neural Networks, extracting its spatial features and producing novel decentralized motion control rules. We evaluate our approach on a multi-agent convergence task of agents with limited-range and bearing-only sensing that aim to keep the swarm cohesive during the aggregation. The algorithm's performance is evaluated against two benchmarks: an analytical solution proposed by Bellaiche and Bruckstein, which ensures convergence but progresses slowly, and VariAntNet, a neural network-based framework that converges much faster but shows medium success rates in hard constellations. Our method achieves high convergence, with a pace nearly matching that of VariAntNet. In some scenarios, it serves as the only practical alternative.
summary_zh: 本研究强调了基于图像的强化学习方法在解决群体相关任务中的潜力。在多智能体强化学习中，有效的策略学习取决于智能体如何感知、解释和处理输入。传统方法通常依赖于手工设计的特征提取或原始的基于向量的表示，这限制了学习到的策略在输入顺序和大小方面的可扩展性和效率。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于图像的强化学习方法，用于多智能体系统的去中心化控制，其中观测被编码为结构化的视觉输入，可以通过神经网络进行处理，提取其空间特征，并产生新的去中心化运动控制规则。我们通过一项多智能体收敛任务来评估我们的方法，该任务要求具有有限范围和方位角传感的智能体在聚合过程中保持群体凝聚力。该算法的性能与两个基准进行比较：Bellaiche和Bruckstein提出的解析解，该方法确保收敛但进展缓慢；以及VariAntNet，一种基于神经网络的框架，该框架收敛速度更快，但在困难的构型下显示出中等的成功率。我们的方法实现了高收敛率，其速度几乎与VariAntNet相当。在某些情况下，它是唯一可行的替代方案。
tldr: This paper proposes an image-based reinforcement learning method for decentralized control of multi-agent systems, demonstrating high convergence in a swarm aggregation task, surpassing analytical methods and matching the speed of a neural network baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图像的强化学习方法，用于多智能体系统的分散控制。在集群聚集任务中，该方法表现出高收敛性，超越了分析方法，并与神经网络基线的速度相匹配。

title: Online Action-Stacking Improves Reinforcement Learning Performance for Air Traffic Control
summary: We introduce online action-stacking, an inference-time wrapper for reinforcement learning policies that produces realistic air traffic control commands while allowing training on a much smaller discrete action space. Policies are trained with simple incremental heading or level adjustments, together with an action-damping penalty that reduces instruction frequency and leads agents to issue commands in short bursts. At inference, online action-stacking compiles these bursts of primitive actions into domain-appropriate compound clearances. Using Proximal Policy Optimisation and the BluebirdDT digital twin platform, we train agents to navigate aircraft along lateral routes, manage climb and descent to target flight levels, and perform two-aircraft collision avoidance under a minimum separation constraint. In our lateral navigation experiments, action stacking greatly reduces the number of issued instructions relative to a damped baseline and achieves comparable performance to a policy trained with a 37-dimensional action space, despite operating with only five actions. These results indicate that online action-stacking helps bridge a key gap between standard reinforcement learning formulations and operational ATC requirements, and provides a simple mechanism for scaling to more complex control scenarios.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了一种在线动作堆叠方法，这是一种强化学习策略的推理时包装器，它能产生逼真的空中交通管制指令，同时允许在更小的离散动作空间上进行训练。策略通过简单的增量航向或高度调整进行训练，并伴随一个动作阻尼惩罚，以降低指令频率并引导智能体以短促的突发形式发出指令。在推理时，在线动作堆叠将这些原始动作的突发编译成适合领域的复合许可。我们使用近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimisation）和BluebirdDT数字孪生平台，训练智能体沿横向航线引导飞机，管理爬升和下降至目标飞行高度，并在最小间隔约束下执行双机避撞。在我们的横向导航实验中，相对于阻尼基线，动作堆叠大大减少了指令的发布数量，并实现了与使用37维动作空间训练的策略相当的性能，尽管只使用五个动作。这些结果表明，在线动作堆叠有助于弥合标准强化学习公式与实际ATC要求之间的一个关键差距，并提供了一个简单的机制来扩展到更复杂的控制场景。
tldr: The paper introduces 'online action-stacking,' a method to translate simple RL actions into realistic ATC commands, enabling training on smaller action spaces while achieving performance comparable to larger, more complex action spaces. It shows promising results in air traffic control scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“在线动作堆叠”的方法，将简单的强化学习动作转化为真实的空中交通管制指令，从而能够在更小的动作空间上进行训练，同时达到与更大、更复杂的动作空间相当的性能。它在空中交通管制场景中显示出很有希望的结果。

title: An Event-Based Opto-Tactile Skin
summary: This paper presents a neuromorphic, event-driven tactile sensing system for soft, large-area skin, based on the Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) integrated with a flexible silicone optical waveguide skin. Instead of repetitively scanning embedded photoreceivers, this design uses a stereo vision setup comprising two DVS cameras looking sideways through the skin. Such a design produces events as changes in brightness are detected, and estimates press positions on the 2D skin surface through triangulation, utilizing Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to find the center of mass of contact events resulting from pressing actions. The system is evaluated over a 4620 mm2 probed area of the skin using a meander raster scan. Across 95 % of the presses visible to both cameras, the press localization achieved a Root-Mean-Squared Error (RMSE) of 4.66 mm. The results highlight the potential of this approach for wide-area flexible and responsive tactile sensors in soft robotics and interactive environments. Moreover, we examined how the system performs when the amount of event data is strongly reduced. Using stochastic down-sampling, the event stream was reduced to 1/1024 of its original size. Under this extreme reduction, the average localization error increased only slightly (from 4.66 mm to 9.33 mm), and the system still produced valid press localizations for 85 % of the trials. This reduction in pass rate is expected, as some presses no longer produce enough events to form a reliable cluster for triangulation. These results show that the sensing approach remains functional even with very sparse event data, which is promising for reducing power consumption and computational load in future implementations. The system exhibits a detection latency distribution with a characteristic width of 31 ms.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于动态视觉传感器(DVS)和柔性硅胶光波导皮肤的神经形态、事件驱动型触觉传感系统，用于软性、大面积皮肤。该设计并非重复扫描嵌入式光接收器，而是采用包含两个DVS相机的立体视觉装置，侧向观察皮肤。这种设计在检测到亮度变化时产生事件，并通过三角测量估计2D皮肤表面上的按压位置，并利用基于密度的噪声应用空间聚类(DBSCAN)算法寻找由按压动作产生的接触事件的质心。该系统在一个4620 mm2的皮肤探测区域上使用蜿蜒光栅扫描进行评估。在95%被两个相机都可见的按压事件中，按压定位达到的均方根误差(RMSE)为4.66 mm。结果突显了该方法在软体机器人和交互环境中用于宽幅柔性且响应迅速的触觉传感器的潜力。此外，我们还研究了当事件数据量大幅减少时系统的性能。通过随机降采样，事件流减少到原始大小的1/1024。在这种极端的减少下，平均定位误差仅略有增加（从4.66 mm增至9.33 mm），并且系统仍然为85%的试验产生了有效的按压定位。通过率的降低是可以预期的，因为某些按压不再产生足够的事件来形成可靠的聚类以进行三角测量。这些结果表明，即使在非常稀疏的事件数据下，该传感方法仍然有效，这有望降低未来实现中的功耗和计算负载。该系统表现出检测延迟分布，其特征宽度为31 ms。
tldr: This paper introduces an event-driven, large-area tactile sensing system using Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) and a flexible optical waveguide, achieving good press localization with sparse event data, showing potential for applications in soft robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种事件驱动的大面积触觉传感系统，该系统使用动态视觉传感器（DVS）和柔性光波导，实现了在稀疏事件数据下良好的按压定位，显示出在软体机器人中应用的潜力。

title: Bayesian Monocular Depth Refinement via Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Monocular depth estimation has applications in many fields, such as autonomous navigation and extended reality, making it an essential computer vision task. However, current methods often produce smooth depth maps that lack the fine geometric detail needed for accurate scene understanding. We propose MDENeRF, an iterative framework that refines monocular depth estimates using depth information from Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs). MDENeRF consists of three components: (1) an initial monocular estimate for global structure, (2) a NeRF trained on perturbed viewpoints, with per-pixel uncertainty, and (3) Bayesian fusion of the noisy monocular and NeRF depths. We derive NeRF uncertainty from the volume rendering process to iteratively inject high-frequency fine details. Meanwhile, our monocular prior maintains global structure. We demonstrate improvements on key metrics and experiments using indoor scenes from the SUN RGB-D dataset.
summary_zh: 单目深度估计在自动导航和扩展现实等诸多领域有应用，使其成为一项至关重要的计算机视觉任务。然而，当前的方法通常生成平滑的深度图，缺乏精确场景理解所需的精细几何细节。我们提出了MDENeRF，一个迭代框架，利用神经辐射场（NeRFs）的深度信息来精细化单目深度估计。MDENeRF由三个部分组成：（1）用于全局结构的初始单目估计，（2）在扰动视点上训练的NeRF，具有逐像素的不确定性，以及（3）带噪声的单目深度和NeRF深度的贝叶斯融合。我们从体渲染过程中推导出NeRF不确定性，以迭代地注入高频精细细节。同时，我们的单目先验保持全局结构。我们使用SUN RGB-D数据集中的室内场景，在关键指标和实验中展示了改进。
tldr: The paper introduces MDENeRF, an iterative framework that refines monocular depth estimates by fusing them with uncertainty-aware depth information from Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs), demonstrating improved depth map accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MDENeRF，一个迭代框架，通过将单目深度估计与来自神经辐射场（NeRFs）的不确定性感知深度信息融合，来改进单目深度估计，并展示了深度图精度的提高。

title: Correcting Autonomous Driving Object Detection Misclassifications with Automated Commonsense Reasoning
summary: Autonomous Vehicle (AV) technology has been heavily researched and sought after, yet there are no SAE Level 5 AVs available today in the marketplace. We contend that over-reliance on machine learning technology is the main reason. Use of automated commonsense reasoning technology, we believe, can help achieve SAE Level 5 autonomy. In this paper, we show how automated common-sense reasoning technology can be deployed in situations where there are not enough data samples available to train a deep learning-based AV model that can handle certain abnormal road scenarios. Specifically, we consider two situations where (i) a traffic signal is malfunctioning at an intersection and (ii) all the cars ahead are slowing down and steering away due to an unexpected obstruction (e.g., animals on the road). We show that in such situations, our commonsense reasoning-based solution accurately detects traffic light colors and obstacles not correctly captured by the AV's perception model. We also provide a pathway for efficiently invoking commonsense reasoning by measuring uncertainty in the computer vision model and using commonsense reasoning to handle uncertain scenarios. We describe our experiments conducted using the CARLA simulator and the results obtained. The main contribution of our research is to show that automated commonsense reasoning effectively corrects AV-based object detection misclassifications and that hybrid models provide an effective pathway to improving AV perception.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶汽车（AV）技术已被大量研究和追捧，然而目前市场上还没有SAE五级自动驾驶汽车。我们认为，过度依赖机器学习技术是主要原因。我们相信，使用自动常识推理技术可以帮助实现SAE五级自动驾驶。在本文中，我们将展示如何部署自动常识推理技术，以应对没有足够数据样本来训练基于深度学习的AV模型，从而处理某些异常道路场景的情况。具体而言，我们考虑两种情况：（i）交通信号灯在十字路口出现故障；（ii）由于意外障碍物（例如，道路上的动物），前方所有车辆都在减速和避让。我们表明，在这种情况下，我们基于常识推理的解决方案能够准确地检测到AV感知模型未正确捕获的交通信号灯颜色和障碍物。我们还提供了一种通过测量计算机视觉模型中的不确定性，并使用常识推理来处理不确定场景，从而有效调用常识推理的途径。我们描述了使用CARLA模拟器进行的实验以及获得的结果。我们研究的主要贡献是表明，自动常识推理能够有效地纠正基于AV的目标检测错误分类，并且混合模型提供了一条提高AV感知能力的有效途径。
tldr: This paper proposes using automated commonsense reasoning to correct object detection misclassifications in autonomous vehicles, particularly in scenarios where deep learning models lack sufficient training data. The hybrid approach leverages uncertainty in the vision model to trigger the commonsense reasoning module.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用自动常识推理来纠正自动驾驶汽车中的物体检测错误分类，特别是在深度学习模型缺乏足够训练数据的情况下。该混合方法利用视觉模型中的不确定性来触发常识推理模块。

title: Integrating Sample Inheritance into Bayesian Optimization for Evolutionary Robotics
summary: In evolutionary robotics, robot morphologies are designed automatically using evolutionary algorithms. This creates a body-brain optimization problem, where both morphology and control must be optimized together. A common approach is to include controller optimization for each morphology, but starting from scratch for every new body may require a high controller learning budget. We address this by using Bayesian optimization for controller optimization, exploiting its sample efficiency and strong exploration capabilities, and using sample inheritance as a form of Lamarckian inheritance. Under a deliberately low controller learning budget for each morphology, we investigate two types of sample inheritance: (1) transferring all the parent's samples to the offspring to be used as prior without evaluating them, and (2) reevaluating the parent's best samples on the offspring. Both are compared to a baseline without inheritance. Our results show that reevaluation performs best, with prior-based inheritance also outperforming no inheritance. Analysis reveals that while the learning budget is too low for a single morphology, generational inheritance compensates for this by accumulating learned adaptations across generations. Furthermore, inheritance mainly benefits offspring morphologies that are similar to their parents. Finally, we demonstrate the critical role of the environment, with more challenging environments resulting in more stable walking gaits. Our findings highlight that inheritance mechanisms can boost performance in evolutionary robotics without needing large learning budgets, offering an efficient path toward more capable robot design.
summary_zh: 在进化机器人学中，机器人形态是通过进化算法自动设计的。这产生了一个形体-大脑协同优化问题，即形态和控制都必须一起优化。一种常见的方法是为每个形态包含控制器优化，但是对于每个新的形体从头开始，可能需要很高的控制器学习预算。我们通过使用贝叶斯优化进行控制器优化来解决这个问题，利用其样本效率和强大的探索能力，并将样本继承作为一种拉马克式遗传的形式。在为每个形态有意设置较低的控制器学习预算的情况下，我们研究了两种类型的样本继承：（1）将父代的所有样本转移给子代，作为先验使用而不进行评估，以及（2）在子代上重新评估父代的最佳样本。这两种方法都与没有继承的基线进行比较。我们的结果表明，重新评估表现最佳，基于先验的继承也优于没有继承。分析表明，虽然学习预算对于单个形态来说过于低，但世代继承通过跨世代积累学习到的适应性来弥补这一点。此外，继承主要有利于与其父母相似的子代形态。最后，我们展示了环境的关键作用，更具挑战性的环境会导致更稳定的行走步态。我们的研究结果强调，继承机制可以在不需要大量学习预算的情况下提高进化机器人学中的性能，为实现更强大的机器人设计提供了一条有效的途径。
tldr: This paper explores integrating Bayesian optimization with sample inheritance for controller optimization in evolutionary robotics, showing that re-evaluating parent's best samples on offspring benefits performance, especially for similar morphologies and in challenging environments.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了将贝叶斯优化与样本继承相结合用于进化机器人控制器优化，结果表明，在后代上重新评估父代的最佳样本能提高性能，尤其是在相似的形态和具有挑战性的环境中。

title: Dual-Attention Heterogeneous GNN for Multi-robot Collaborative Area Search via Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: In multi-robot collaborative area search, a key challenge is to dynamically balance the two objectives of exploring unknown areas and covering specific targets to be rescued. Existing methods are often constrained by homogeneous graph representations, thus failing to model and balance these distinct tasks. To address this problem, we propose a Dual-Attention Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (DA-HGNN) trained using deep reinforcement learning. Our method constructs a heterogeneous graph that incorporates three entity types: robot nodes, frontier nodes, and interesting nodes, as well as their historical states. The dual-attention mechanism comprises the relational-aware attention and type-aware attention operations. The relational-aware attention captures the complex spatio-temporal relationships among robots and candidate goals. Building on this relational-aware heterogeneous graph, the type-aware attention separately computes the relevance between robots and each goal type (frontiers vs. points of interest), thereby decoupling the exploration and coverage from the unified tasks. Extensive experiments conducted in interactive 3D scenarios within the iGibson simulator, leveraging the Gibson and MatterPort3D datasets, validate the superior scalability and generalization capability of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 在多机器人协同区域搜索中，一个关键挑战在于动态平衡探索未知区域和覆盖特定待救援目标这两个目标。现有方法通常受限于同质图表示，因此无法建模和平衡这些不同的任务。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种使用深度强化学习训练的双重注意力异构图神经网络（DA-HGNN）。我们的方法构建了一个异构图，其中包含三种实体类型：机器人节点、前沿节点和兴趣点节点，以及它们的历史状态。双重注意力机制包括关系感知注意力和类型感知注意力操作。关系感知注意力捕捉机器人和候选目标之间复杂的时空关系。基于这种关系感知的异构图，类型感知注意力分别计算机器人与每种目标类型（前沿点 vs. 兴趣点）之间的相关性，从而将探索和覆盖从统一的任务中解耦。在 iGibson 模拟器中，利用 Gibson 和 MatterPort3D 数据集，在交互式 3D 场景中进行的大量实验验证了所提出方法的卓越可扩展性和泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a Dual-Attention Heterogeneous GNN (DA-HGNN) trained with reinforcement learning for multi-robot collaborative area search, using a heterogeneous graph to balance exploration and coverage tasks. Experiments in iGibson demonstrate improved scalability and generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双注意力异构图神经网络（DA-HGNN），通过强化学习进行训练，用于多机器人协同区域搜索。该方法使用异构图来平衡探索和覆盖任务。在iGibson中的实验表明，该方法具有更好的可扩展性和泛化能力。

title: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Model for Mapping and Goal-Directed Navigation Using Multiscale Place Fields
summary: Autonomous navigation in complex and partially observable environments remains a central challenge in robotics. Several bio-inspired models of mapping and navigation based on place cells in the mammalian hippocampus have been proposed. This paper introduces a new robust model that employs parallel layers of place fields at multiple spatial scales, a replay-based reward mechanism, and dynamic scale fusion. Simulations show that the model improves path efficiency and accelerates learning compared to single-scale baselines, highlighting the value of multiscale spatial representations for adaptive robot navigation.
summary_zh: 在复杂且部分可观测环境中进行自主导航仍然是机器人领域的核心挑战。人们已经提出了若干基于哺乳动物海马体中位置细胞的生物启发式建模与导航方法。本文介绍了一种新的鲁棒模型，该模型采用多尺度空间上位置场并行层、基于回放的奖励机制以及动态尺度融合。仿真结果表明，与单尺度基线模型相比，该模型能提高路径效率并加速学习，突出了多尺度空间表征对于自适应机器人导航的价值。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning model for robot navigation that uses multiscale place fields and demonstrates improved path efficiency and learning speed compared to single-scale approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个基于多尺度位置场的机器人导航强化学习模型，并表明与单尺度方法相比，该模型提高了路径效率和学习速度。

title: ComfySearch: Autonomous Exploration and Reasoning for ComfyUI Workflows
summary: AI-generated content has progressed from monolithic models to modular workflows, especially on platforms like ComfyUI, allowing users to customize complex creative pipelines. However, the large number of components in ComfyUI and the difficulty of maintaining long-horizon structural consistency under strict graph constraints frequently lead to low pass rates and workflows of limited quality. To tackle these limitations, we present ComfySearch, an agentic framework that can effectively explore the component space and generate functional ComfyUI pipelines via validation-guided workflow construction. Experiments demonstrate that ComfySearch substantially outperforms existing methods on complex and creative tasks, achieving higher executability (pass) rates, higher solution rates, and stronger generalization.
summary_zh: 人工智能生成内容已经从单体模型发展到模块化工作流，尤其是在像ComfyUI这样的平台上，用户可以自定义复杂的创意流程。然而，ComfyUI中大量的组件以及在严格图约束下维持长时程结构一致性的困难，经常导致较低的通过率和质量有限的工作流。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了ComfySearch，一个代理框架，它可以通过验证引导的工作流构建有效地探索组件空间，并生成功能性的ComfyUI流程。实验表明，ComfySearch在复杂和创造性任务上显著优于现有方法，实现了更高的可执行性（通过）率、更高的解决方案生成率和更强的泛化能力。
tldr: ComfySearch is an agentic framework that autonomously explores and generates functional ComfyUI workflows, outperforming existing methods in executability, solution rates, and generalization on complex creative tasks.
tldr_zh: ComfySearch是一个自主探索和生成功能性ComfyUI工作流程的智能框架，在复杂创意任务的可执行性、解决方案和泛化方面优于现有方法。

title: Trade-R1: Bridging Verifiable Rewards to Stochastic Environments via Process-Level Reasoning Verification
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to achieve remarkable reasoning in domains like mathematics and coding, where verifiable rewards provide clear signals. However, extending this paradigm to financial decision is challenged by the market's stochastic nature: rewards are verifiable but inherently noisy, causing standard RL to degenerate into reward hacking. To address this, we propose Trade-R1, a model training framework that bridges verifiable rewards to stochastic environments via process-level reasoning verification. Our key innovation is a verification method that transforms the problem of evaluating reasoning over lengthy financial documents into a structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) task. We construct a triangular consistency metric, assessing pairwise alignment between retrieved evidence, reasoning chains, and decisions to serve as a validity filter for noisy market returns. We explore two reward integration strategies: Fixed-effect Semantic Reward (FSR) for stable alignment signals, and Dynamic-effect Semantic Reward (DSR) for coupled magnitude optimization. Experiments on different country asset selection demonstrate that our paradigm reduces reward hacking, with DSR achieving superior cross-market generalization while maintaining the highest reasoning consistency.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)已助力大型语言模型(LLMs)在数学和编程等领域实现卓越的推理能力，这些领域的可验证奖励提供了明确的信号。然而，将此范式扩展到金融决策面临市场随机性的挑战：奖励是可验证的，但本质上是嘈杂的，导致标准RL退化为奖励利用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Trade-R1，一个模型训练框架，通过过程级推理验证将可验证奖励与随机环境连接起来。我们的关键创新是一种验证方法，将评估对冗长金融文档的推理问题转化为结构化的检索增强生成(RAG)任务。我们构建了一个三角一致性度量，评估检索到的证据、推理链和决策之间的成对对齐，以作为噪声市场回报的有效性过滤器。我们探索了两种奖励整合策略：用于稳定对齐信号的固定效应语义奖励(FSR)和用于耦合幅度优化的动态效应语义奖励(DSR)。在不同国家资产选择上的实验表明，我们的范式减少了奖励利用，其中DSR在保持最高推理一致性的同时，实现了卓越的跨市场泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Trade-R1, a framework using process-level reasoning verification and RAG to improve RL-based financial decision-making by mitigating reward hacking in stochastic markets. They show superior cross-market generalization compared to standard RL.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 Trade-R1 框架，它使用过程级别的推理验证和 RAG 来改进基于 RL 的金融决策，通过减少随机市场中的奖励利用（reward hacking）。实验表明，与标准 RL 相比，该方法具有更好的跨市场泛化能力。

title: When Numbers Start Talking: Implicit Numerical Coordination Among LLM-Based Agents
summary: LLMs-based agents increasingly operate in multi-agent environments where strategic interaction and coordination are required. While existing work has largely focused on individual agents or on interacting agents sharing explicit communication, less is known about how interacting agents coordinate implicitly. In particular, agents may engage in covert communication, relying on indirect or non-linguistic signals embedded in their actions rather than on explicit messages. This paper presents a game-theoretic study of covert communication in LLM-driven multi-agent systems. We analyse interactions across four canonical game-theoretic settings under different communication regimes, including explicit, restricted, and absent communication. Considering heterogeneous agent personalities and both one-shot and repeated games, we characterise when covert signals emerge and how they shape coordination and strategic outcomes.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地在需要战略互动和协作的多智能体环境中运行。虽然现有工作主要集中于单个智能体或共享显式通信的交互智能体，但关于交互智能体如何隐式协作的了解相对较少。特别是，智能体可能进行隐蔽通信，依赖于嵌入在其行动中的间接或非语言信号，而不是显式消息。本文对LLM驱动的多智能体系统中隐蔽通信进行了博弈论研究。我们分析了在不同通信机制（包括显式通信、受限通信和无通信）下，四种典型的博弈论场景中的交互。考虑到异构的智能体性格以及单次博弈和重复博弈，我们刻画了隐蔽信号何时出现，以及它们如何塑造协作和战略结果。
tldr: This paper investigates covert communication strategies employed by LLM-based agents in game-theoretic scenarios, revealing how they coordinate implicitly through actions when explicit communication is limited or absent.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于LLM的智能体在博弈论场景中使用的隐蔽通信策略，揭示了当显式通信受到限制或缺失时，它们如何通过行动进行隐式协调。

title: VeRPO: Verifiable Dense Reward Policy Optimization for Code Generation
summary: Effective reward design is a central challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for code generation. Mainstream pass/fail outcome rewards enforce functional correctness via executing unit tests, but the resulting sparsity limits potential performance gains. While recent work has explored external Reward Models (RM) to generate richer, continuous rewards, the learned RMs suffer from reward misalignment and prohibitive computational cost. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{VeRPO} (\textbf{V}erifiable D\textbf{e}nse \textbf{R}eward \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization), a novel RL framework for code generation that synthesizes \textit{robust and dense rewards fully grounded in verifiable execution feedback}. The core idea of VeRPO is constructing dense rewards from weighted partial success: by dynamically estimating the difficulty weight of each unit test based on the execution statistics during training, a dense reward is derived from the sum of weights of the passed unit tests. To solidify the consistency between partial success and end-to-end functional correctness, VeRPO further integrates the dense signal with global execution outcomes, establishing a robust and dense reward paradigm relying solely on verifiable execution feedback. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and settings demonstrate that VeRPO consistently outperforms outcome-driven and RM-based baselines, achieving up to +8.83\% gain in pass@1 with negligible time cost (< 0.02\%) and zero GPU memory overhead.
summary_zh: 代码生成强化学习 (RL) 的核心挑战在于有效的奖励设计。主流的通过/失败结果奖励通过执行单元测试来保证功能正确性，但由此产生的稀疏性限制了潜在的性能提升。虽然最近的工作探索了外部奖励模型 (RM) 以生成更丰富、连续的奖励，但学习到的 RM 存在奖励不一致和高昂的计算成本。在本文中，我们介绍了一种名为 \textbf{VeRPO} (\textbf{V}erifiable D\textbf{e}nse \textbf{R}eward \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization，可验证的密集奖励策略优化) 的新型代码生成 RL 框架，该框架合成了\textit{完全基于可验证执行反馈的稳健且密集的奖励}。VeRPO 的核心思想是从加权的部分成功构建密集奖励：通过在训练期间基于执行统计动态估计每个单元测试的难度权重，从通过的单元测试的权重之和中推导出密集奖励。为了巩固部分成功和端到端功能正确性之间的一致性，VeRPO 进一步将密集信号与全局执行结果相结合，从而建立一种仅依赖于可验证执行反馈的稳健且密集的奖励范例。在各种基准和设置下进行的大量实验表明，VeRPO 始终优于结果驱动型和基于 RM 的基线，在 pass@1 中实现了高达 +8.83\% 的增益，且时间成本可忽略不计（< 0.02\%），GPU 内存开销为零。
tldr: The paper introduces VeRPO, a novel RL framework for code generation that synthesizes dense, robust rewards from weighted partial success signals based on unit test execution statistics, outperforming existing methods while being computationally efficient.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的代码生成强化学习框架 VeRPO，它基于单元测试执行统计信息，从加权的部分成功信号中合成密集、稳健的奖励，优于现有方法，并且计算效率高。

title: Bootstrapping Code Translation with Weighted Multilanguage Exploration
summary: Code translation across multiple programming languages is essential yet challenging due to two vital obstacles: scarcity of parallel data paired with executable test oracles, and optimization imbalance when handling diverse language pairs. We propose BootTrans, a bootstrapping method that resolves both obstacles. Its key idea is to leverage the functional invariance and cross-lingual portability of test suites, adapting abundant pivot-language unit tests to serve as universal verification oracles for multilingual RL training. Our method introduces a dual-pool architecture with seed and exploration pools to progressively expand training data via execution-guided experience collection. Furthermore, we design a language-aware weighting mechanism that dynamically prioritizes harder translation directions based on relative performance across sibling languages, mitigating optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on the HumanEval-X and TransCoder-Test benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline LLMs across all translation directions, with ablations validating the effectiveness of both bootstrapping and weighting components.
