We show that the use of the wavelet transform to separate structural details and reduce spatial redundancy as well as efficient feature conditioning on the depth information are essential ingredients in developing a low-complexity model. Experimental results show competitive image quality against recent state-of-the-art models while reducing complexity by up to two orders of magnitude.
summary_zh: 图像去模糊是成像领域一个具有挑战性的问题，因为它具有高度的病态性。深度学习模型在解决这个问题上表现出巨大成功，但对最佳图像质量的追求推高了它们的计算复杂度，使得它们在除强大服务器之外的任何设备上都难以实际应用。与此同时，最近的研究表明，移动激光雷达可以提供深度图形式的补充信息，从而提高去模糊质量。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于深度引导图像去模糊的新型低复杂度神经网络。我们证明了使用小波变换来分离结构细节并减少空间冗余，以及对深度信息进行高效的特征条件化，是开发低复杂度模型的关键要素。实验结果表明，该模型在图像质量上与最新的最先进模型相比具有竞争力，同时将复杂度降低了高达两个数量级。
tldr: This paper introduces a low-complexity neural network for depth-guided image deblurring using wavelet transform and efficient feature conditioning, achieving competitive image quality with significantly reduced computational cost.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低复杂度的深度引导图像去模糊神经网络，该网络利用小波变换和高效的特征条件化，在显著降低计算成本的同时，实现了具有竞争力的图像质量。

title: A Comparative Study of 3D Model Acquisition Methods for Synthetic Data Generation of Agricultural Products
summary: In the manufacturing industry, computer vision systems based on artificial intelligence (AI) are widely used to reduce costs and increase production. Training these AI models requires a large amount of training data that is costly to acquire and annotate, especially in high-variance, low-volume manufacturing environments. A popular approach to reduce the need for real data is the use of synthetic data that is generated by leveraging computer-aided design (CAD) models available in the industry. However, in the agricultural industry these models are not readily available, increasing the difficulty in leveraging synthetic data. In this paper, we present different techniques for substituting CAD files to create synthetic datasets. We measure their relative performance when used to train an AI object detection model to separate stones and potatoes in a bin picking environment. We demonstrate that using highly representative 3D models acquired by scanning or using image-to-3D approaches can be used to generate synthetic data for training object detection models. Finetuning on a small real dataset can significantly improve the performance of the models and even get similar performance when less representative models are used.
summary_zh: 在制造业中，基于人工智能（AI）的计算机视觉系统被广泛应用于降低成本和提高产量。训练这些AI模型需要大量的训练数据，而获取和标注这些数据成本高昂，尤其是在高方差、低产量制造环境中。一种流行的减少对真实数据需求的方法是使用合成数据，这些合成数据通过利用行业中可用的计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型生成。然而，在农业领域，这些模型不易获得，增加了利用合成数据的难度。本文提出了一些替代CAD文件以创建合成数据集的技术。我们衡量了它们在训练AI目标检测模型以在料箱拣选环境中分离石头和马铃薯时，各自的性能表现。我们证明了使用通过扫描或图像到3D方法获取的、具有高度代表性的3D模型可以用于生成合成数据，以训练目标检测模型。在一个小型真实数据集上进行微调可以显著提高模型的性能，甚至在使用代表性较差的模型时也能获得相似的性能。
tldr: The paper explores methods for generating synthetic data for agricultural object detection, specifically differentiating stones and potatoes, by using 3D model acquisition techniques when CAD models are unavailable. They find that high-quality 3D models created from scans or image-to-3D approaches, coupled with fine-tuning on real data, yields effective object detection models.
tldr_zh: 该论文探讨了在农业领域生成合成数据以进行目标检测的方法，特别是在无法获得CAD模型的情况下，通过使用3D模型获取技术来区分石块和土豆。他们发现，通过扫描或图像到3D方法创建的高质量3D模型，结合真实数据的微调，可以产生有效的物体检测模型。

title: Towards Real-world Lens Active Alignment with Unlabeled Data via Domain Adaptation
summary: Active Alignment (AA) is a key technology for the large-scale automated assembly of high-precision optical systems. Compared with labor-intensive per-model on-device calibration, a digital-twin pipeline built on optical simulation offers a substantial advantage in generating large-scale labeled data. However, complex imaging conditions induce a domain gap between simulation and real-world images, limiting the generalization of simulation-trained models. To address this, we propose augmenting a simulation baseline with minimal unlabeled real-world images captured at random misalignment positions, mitigating the gap from a domain adaptation perspective. We introduce Domain Adaptive Active Alignment (DA3), which utilizes an autoregressive domain transformation generator and an adversarial-based feature alignment strategy to distill real-world domain information via self-supervised learning. This enables the extraction of domain-invariant image degradation features to facilitate robust misalignment prediction. Experiments on two lens types reveal that DA3 improves accuracy by 46% over a purely simulation pipeline. Notably, it approaches the performance achieved with precisely labeled real-world data collected on 3 lens samples, while reducing on-device data collection time by 98.7%. The results demonstrate that domain adaptation effectively endows simulation-trained models with robust real-world performance, validating the digital-twin pipeline as a practical solution to significantly enhance the efficiency of large-scale optical assembly.
summary_zh: 主动对准（AA）是高精度光学系统大规模自动化装配的关键技术。与劳动密集型的逐模型现场校准相比，基于光学仿真的数字孪生管道在生成大规模标注数据方面具有显著优势。然而，复杂的成像条件导致仿真图像与真实图像之间存在领域差异，限制了仿真训练模型的泛化能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出通过使用在随机未对准位置捕获的少量未标注真实图像来增强仿真基线，从而从领域自适应的角度缩小差异。我们引入了领域自适应主动对准（DA3），它利用自回归领域转换生成器和基于对抗的特征对齐策略，通过自监督学习提取真实世界领域信息。这使得提取领域不变的图像退化特征，从而促进稳健的未对准预测成为可能。在两种镜头类型上的实验表明，DA3比纯仿真管道提高了46%的精度。值得注意的是，它的性能接近于在3个镜头样本上收集的精确标注真实数据所达到的性能，同时将现场数据收集时间减少了98.7%。结果表明，领域自适应能够有效地赋予仿真训练模型强大的真实世界性能，验证了数字孪生管道作为一种切实可行的解决方案，可以显著提高大规模光学装配的效率。
tldr: This paper introduces Domain Adaptive Active Alignment (DA3), a method that uses domain adaptation to improve the accuracy of active alignment systems in optical assembly by mitigating the domain gap between simulation and real-world images, achieving near real-world labeled data performance with minimal real data collection.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为DA3的域自适应主动对准方法，该方法通过域自适应来弥合仿真和真实世界图像之间的域差距，从而提高光学装配中主动对准系统的精度，以最少的真实数据采集达到接近真实世界标记数据的性能。

title: Physics-Constrained Cross-Resolution Enhancement Network for Optics-Guided Thermal UAV Image Super-Resolution
summary: Optics-guided thermal UAV image super-resolution has attracted significant research interest due to its potential in all-weather monitoring applications. However, existing methods typically compress optical features to match thermal feature dimensions for cross-modal alignment and fusion, which not only causes the loss of high-frequency information that is beneficial for thermal super-resolution, but also introduces physically inconsistent artifacts such as texture distortions and edge blurring by overlooking differences in the imaging physics between modalities. To address these challenges, we propose PCNet to achieve cross-resolution mutual enhancement between optical and thermal modalities, while physically constraining the optical guidance process via thermal conduction to enable robust thermal UAV image super-resolution. In particular, we design a Cross-Resolution Mutual Enhancement Module (CRME) to jointly optimize thermal image super-resolution and optical-to-thermal modality conversion, facilitating effective bidirectional feature interaction across resolutions while preserving high-frequency optical priors. Moreover, we propose a Physics-Driven Thermal Conduction Module (PDTM) that incorporates two-dimensional heat conduction into optical guidance, modeling spatially-varying heat conduction properties to prevent inconsistent artifacts. In addition, we introduce a temperature consistency loss that enforces regional distribution consistency and boundary gradient smoothness to ensure generated thermal images align with real-world thermal radiation principles. Extensive experiments on VGTSR2.0 and DroneVehicle datasets demonstrate that PCNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both reconstruction quality and downstream tasks including semantic segmentation and object detection.
summary_zh: 光学引导的热成像无人机图像超分辨率技术因其在全天候监控应用中的潜力而引起了广泛的研究兴趣。然而，现有方法通常会压缩光学特征以匹配热成像特征的维度，从而进行跨模态对齐和融合，这不仅会导致对热成像超分辨率有益的高频信息损失，还会因忽略模态间成像物理差异而引入物理上不一致的伪影，例如纹理失真和边缘模糊。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了PCNet，旨在实现光学和热成像模态之间的跨分辨率相互增强，同时通过热传导对光学引导过程进行物理约束，从而实现鲁棒的热成像无人机图像超分辨率。具体而言，我们设计了一个跨分辨率相互增强模块（CRME），以联合优化热成像图像超分辨率和光学到热成像模态转换，从而促进跨分辨率的有效双向特征交互，同时保留高频光学先验。此外，我们提出了一种物理驱动的热传导模块（PDTM），该模块将二维热传导纳入光学引导中，对空间变化的导热特性进行建模，以防止不一致的伪影。此外，我们引入了温度一致性损失，该损失强制区域分布一致性和边界梯度平滑性，以确保生成的热成像图像与真实世界的热辐射原理对齐。在VGTSR2.0和DroneVehicle数据集上的大量实验表明，PCNet在重建质量以及语义分割和目标检测等下游任务上均显著优于最先进的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces PCNet, a physics-constrained cross-resolution enhancement network for thermal UAV image super-resolution, addressing limitations of existing methods by preserving high-frequency information and ensuring physical consistency through thermal conduction modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PCNet，一种物理约束的跨分辨率增强网络，用于热成像无人机图像超分辨率。该方法通过保留高频信息和利用热传导建模确保物理一致性，解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: GeoDiff-SAR: A Geometric Prior Guided Diffusion Model for SAR Image Generation
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging results are highly sensitive to observation geometries and the geometric parameters of targets. However, existing generative methods primarily operate within the image domain, neglecting explicit geometric information. This limitation often leads to unsatisfactory generation quality and the inability to precisely control critical parameters such as azimuth angles. To address these challenges, we propose GeoDiff-SAR, a geometric prior guided diffusion model for high-fidelity SAR image generation. Specifically, GeoDiff-SAR first efficiently simulates the geometric structures and scattering relationships inherent in real SAR imaging by calculating SAR point clouds at specific azimuths, which serves as a robust physical guidance. Secondly, to effectively fuse multi-modal information, we employ a feature fusion gating network based on Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) to dynamically regulate the weight distribution of 3D physical information, image control parameters, and textual description parameters. Thirdly, we utilize the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) architecture to perform lightweight fine-tuning on the advanced Stable Diffusion 3.5 (SD3.5) model, enabling it to rapidly adapt to the distribution characteristics of the SAR domain. To validate the effectiveness of GeoDiff-SAR, extensive comparative experiments were conducted on real-world SAR datasets. The results demonstrate that data generated by GeoDiff-SAR exhibits high fidelity and effectively enhances the accuracy of downstream classification tasks. In particular, it significantly improves recognition performance across different azimuth angles, thereby underscoring the superiority of physics-guided generation.
summary_zh: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）成像结果对观测几何条件和目标的几何参数高度敏感。然而，现有的生成方法主要在图像域内操作，忽略了显式的几何信息。这种局限性通常导致不尽人意的生成质量，并且无法精确控制诸如方位角等关键参数。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种几何先验引导的扩散模型GeoDiff-SAR，用于高保真度的SAR图像生成。 具体而言，GeoDiff-SAR首先通过计算特定方位角的SAR点云，高效地模拟真实SAR成像中固有的几何结构和散射关系，从而提供强大的物理引导。 其次，为了有效地融合多模态信息，我们采用了一种基于特征线性调制（FiLM）的特征融合门控网络，以动态调节3D物理信息、图像控制参数和文本描述参数的权重分布。 第三，我们利用低秩适配（LoRA）架构对先进的Stable Diffusion 3.5 (SD3.5) 模型进行轻量级微调，使其能够快速适应SAR领域的分布特征。 为了验证GeoDiff-SAR的有效性，我们在真实世界的SAR数据集上进行了广泛的对比实验。 结果表明，GeoDiff-SAR生成的数据具有高保真度，并能有效提高下游分类任务的准确性。 特别是，它显著提高了不同方位角下的识别性能，从而突出了物理引导生成的优越性。
tldr: GeoDiff-SAR is a diffusion model that leverages geometric priors to generate high-fidelity SAR images, outperforming existing methods by explicitly incorporating geometry and enabling control over parameters like azimuth angles.
tldr_zh: GeoDiff-SAR是一个利用几何先验生成高保真SAR图像的扩散模型，通过显式结合几何信息并支持对方位角等参数的控制，优于现有方法。

title: Enhancing Robustness of Asynchronous EEG-Based Movement Prediction using Classifier Ensembles
summary: Objective: Stroke is one of the leading causes of disabilities. One promising approach is to extend the rehabilitation with self-initiated robot-assisted movement therapy. To enable this, it is required to detect the patient's intention to move to trigger the assistance of a robotic device. This intention to move can be detected from human surface electroencephalography (EEG) signals; however, it is particularly challenging to decode when classifications are performed online and asynchronously. In this work, the effectiveness of classifier ensembles and a sliding-window postprocessing technique was investigated to enhance the robustness of such asynchronous classification. Approach: To investigate the effectiveness of classifier ensembles and a sliding-window postprocessing, two EEG datasets with 14 healthy subjects who performed self-initiated arm movements were analyzed. Offline and pseudo-online evaluations were conducted to compare ensemble combinations of the support vector machine (SVM), multilayer perceptron (MLP), and EEGNet classification models. Results: The results of the pseudo-online evaluation show that the two model ensembles significantly outperformed the best single model for the optimal number of postprocessing windows. In particular, for single models, an increased number of postprocessing windows significantly improved classification performances. Interestingly, we found no significant improvements between performances of the best single model and classifier ensembles in the offline evaluation. Significance: We demonstrated that classifier ensembles and appropriate postprocessing methods effectively enhance the asynchronous detection of movement intentions from EEG signals. In particular, the classifier ensemble approach yields greater improvements in online classification than in offline classification, and reduces false detections, i.e., early false positives.
summary_zh:
摘要：
目的：卒中是导致残疾的主要原因之一。一种有前景的方法是通过自主启动的机器人辅助运动疗法来延长康复时间。为实现这一目标，需要检测患者的运动意图，以触发机器人设备的辅助。这种运动意图可以从人体表面脑电图（EEG）信号中检测出来；然而，当分类在线和异步执行时，解码尤其具有挑战性。本文研究了分类器集成和滑动窗口后处理技术的有效性，以增强这种异步分类的鲁棒性。方法：为了研究分类器集成和滑动窗口后处理的有效性，分析了两个包含14名进行自主手臂运动的健康受试者的脑电图数据集。进行了离线和伪在线评估，以比较支持向量机（SVM）、多层感知器（MLP）和EEGNet分类模型的集成组合。结果：伪在线评估结果表明，对于最佳数量的后处理窗口，两种模型集成方法明显优于最佳单一模型。特别是，对于单一模型，增加后处理窗口的数量显著提高了分类性能。有趣的是，我们发现离线评估中最佳单一模型和分类器集成的性能之间没有显著改进。意义：我们证明了分类器集成和适当的后处理方法有效地增强了从脑电图信号中异步检测运动意图的能力。特别是，分类器集成方法在在线分类中比在离线分类中产生更大的改进，并减少了误检，即提早的假阳性。
tldr: This paper explores using classifier ensembles and sliding-window postprocessing to improve the robustness of asynchronous EEG-based movement prediction for robot-assisted stroke rehabilitation, finding that ensembles particularly enhance online classification and reduce false positives.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用分类器集成和滑动窗口后处理来提高基于异步脑电图的运动预测的鲁棒性，用于机器人辅助中风康复，发现集成方法尤其能增强在线分类并减少误报。

title: Making Tunable Parameters State-Dependent in Weather and Climate Models with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Weather and climate models rely on parametrisations to represent unresolved sub-grid processes. Traditional schemes rely on fixed coefficients that are weakly constrained and tuned offline, contributing to persistent biases that limit their ability to adapt to the underlying physics. This study presents a framework that learns components of parametrisation schemes online as a function of the evolving model state using reinforcement learning (RL) and evaluates the resulting RL-driven parameter updates across a hierarchy of idealised testbeds spanning a simple climate bias correction (SCBC), a radiative-convective equilibrium (RCE), and a zonal mean energy balance model (EBM) with both single-agent and federated multi-agent settings. Across nine RL algorithms, Truncated Quantile Critics (TQC), Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3) achieved the highest skill and the most stable convergence across configurations, with performance assessed against a static baseline using area-weighted RMSE, temperature profile and pressure-level diagnostics. For the EBM, single-agent RL outperformed static parameter tuning with the strongest gains in tropical and mid-latitude bands, while federated RL on multi-agent setups enabled geographically specialised control and faster convergence, with a six-agent DDPG configuration using frequent aggregation yielding the lowest area-weighted RMSE across the tropics and mid-latitudes. The learnt corrections were also physically meaningful as agents modulated EBM radiative parameters to reduce meridional biases, adjusted RCE lapse rates to match vertical temperature errors, and stabilised SCBC heating increments to limit drift. Overall, results highlight RL to deliver skilful state-dependent, and regime-aware parametrisations, offering a scalable pathway for online learning within numerical models.
summary_zh: 天气和气候模型依赖于参数化来表示未解析的亚网格过程。传统的方案依赖于弱约束的固定系数，并进行离线调整，这导致了持续的偏差，限制了其适应底层物理过程的能力。本研究提出了一个框架，该框架利用强化学习（RL）在线学习参数化方案的组成部分，将其作为演化模型状态的函数，并在一系列理想化测试平台上评估由此产生的RL驱动的参数更新，这些测试平台涵盖了一个简单的气候偏差校正（SCBC）、辐射-对流平衡（RCE）和一个带状平均能量平衡模型（EBM）， 包含单智能体设置和联邦多智能体设置。在九种RL算法中，截断分位数评论家（TQC）、深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）和双延迟DDPG（TD3）在各种配置中获得了最高的技能和最稳定的收敛性，性能评估是基于使用面积加权的RMSE，温度剖面和气压面诊断与静态基线进行的比较。对于EBM，单智能体RL优于静态参数调整，在热带和中纬度区域的增益最为显著，而多智能体设置上的联邦RL实现了地域专业化的控制和更快的收敛速度，其中采用频繁聚合的六智能体DDPG配置在热带和中纬度区域获得了最低的面积加权RMSE。学习到的修正也具有物理意义，因为智能体调节了EBM辐射参数以减少经向偏差，调整了RCE递减率以匹配垂直温度误差，并稳定了SCBC加热增量以限制漂移。总而言之，结果表明强化学习能够提供熟练的状态相关和状态敏感的参数化，为数值模型中的在线学习提供了一条可扩展的途径。
tldr: This paper explores using Reinforcement Learning to learn state-dependent parametrizations in weather and climate models, demonstrating improved performance across several idealized testbeds compared to static parameter tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用强化学习在天气和气候模型中学习状态相关的参数化方法，并在几个理想化的测试平台中展示了相对于静态参数调整的性能提升。

title: Accounting for Optimal Control in the Sizing of Isolated Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems Using Imitation Learning
summary: Decarbonization of isolated or off-grid energy systems through phase-in of large shares of intermittent solar or wind generation requires co-installation of energy storage or continued use of existing fossil dispatchable power sources to balance supply and demand. The effective CO2 emission reduction depends on the relative capacity of the energy storage and renewable sources, the stochasticity of the renewable generation, and the optimal control or dispatch of the isolated energy system. While the operations of the energy storage and dispatchable sources may impact the optimal sizing of the system, it is challenging to account for the effect of finite horizon, optimal control at the stage of system sizing. Here, we present a flexible and computationally efficient sizing framework for energy storage and renewable capacity in isolated energy systems, accounting for uncertainty in the renewable generation and the optimal feedback control. To this end, we implement an imitation learning approach to stochastic neural model predictive control (MPC) which allows us to relate the battery storage and wind peak capacities to the emissions reduction and investment costs while accounting for finite horizon, optimal control. Through this approach, decision makers can evaluate the effective emission reduction and costs of different storage and wind capacities at any price point while accounting for uncertainty in the renewable generation with limited foresight. We evaluate the proposed sizing framework on a case study of an offshore energy system with a gas turbine, a wind farm and a battery energy storage system (BESS). In this case, we find a nonlinear, nontrivial relationship between the investment costs and reduction in gas usage relative to the wind and BESS capacities, emphasizing the complexity and importance of accounting for optimal control in the design of isolated energy systems.
summary_zh: 通过逐步引入大量间歇性太阳能或风能发电，实现孤立或离网能源系统的脱碳需要共同安装储能系统或继续使用现有的化石燃料可调度电源来平衡供需。有效的二氧化碳减排量取决于储能和可再生能源的相对容量、可再生能源发电的随机性以及孤立能源系统的优化控制或调度。尽管储能和可调度电源的运行可能影响系统的最佳规模，但在系统规模确定阶段考虑有限时间范围内的最优控制效果具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种灵活且计算高效的孤立能源系统中储能和可再生能源容量的规模确定框架，该框架考虑了可再生能源发电的不确定性和最优反馈控制。为此，我们采用模仿学习方法，来实现随机神经模型预测控制（MPC），这使我们能够在考虑有限时间范围内的最优控制的同时，将电池储能和风力峰值容量与排放减少和投资成本联系起来。通过这种方法，决策者可以评估在任何价格点下，不同储能和风力容量在可再生能源发电不确定性且有限预测能力的情况下的有效减排量和成本。我们通过一个海上能源系统的案例研究来评估所提出的规模确定框架，该系统包含燃气轮机、风电场和电池储能系统（BESS）。在该案例中，我们发现了投资成本与相对于风力和BESS容量的燃气用量减少之间的非线性、非平凡关系，强调了在孤立能源系统设计中考虑最优控制的复杂性和重要性。
tldr: This paper presents a computationally efficient framework for sizing energy storage and renewable capacity in isolated energy systems, using imitation learning to approximate stochastic model predictive control and optimize for cost and emission reduction. The framework is applied to an offshore energy system with wind, battery storage and gas turbine.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种计算高效的框架，用于确定独立能源系统中储能和可再生能源容量的大小，使用模仿学习来近似随机模型预测控制，并优化成本和减排。该框架应用于一个包含风能、电池储能和燃气轮机的海上能源系统。

title: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality of Ground Motion Data for Early Detection of Complex Catastrophic Slope Failure
summary: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID) has shown strong potential for identifying anomalies and outliers in high-dimensional data across a wide range of real-world applications, including landslide failure detection in granular media. Early and accurate identification of failure zones in landslide-prone areas is crucial for effective geohazard mitigation. While existing approaches typically rely on surface displacement data analyzed through statistical or machine learning techniques, they often fall short in capturing both the spatial correlations and temporal dynamics that are inherent in such data. To address this gap, we focus on ground-monitored landslides and introduce a novel approach that jointly incorporates spatial and temporal information, enabling the detection of complex landslides and including multiple successive failures occurring in distinct areas of the same slope. To be specific, our method builds upon an existing LID-based technique, known as sLID. We extend its capabilities in three key ways. (1) Kinematic enhancement: we incorporate velocity into the sLID computation to better capture short-term temporal dependencies and deformation rate relationships. (2) Spatial fusion: we apply Bayesian estimation to aggregate sLID values across spatial neighborhoods, effectively embedding spatial correlations into the LID scores. (3) Temporal modeling: we introduce a temporal variant, tLID, that learns long-term dynamics from time series data, providing a robust temporal representation of displacement behavior. Finally, we integrate both components into a unified framework, referred to as spatiotemporal LID (stLID), to identify samples that are anomalous in either or both dimensions. Extensive experiments show that stLID consistently outperforms existing methods in failure detection precision and lead-time.
summary_zh: 局部固有维度 (LID) 已显示出在识别高维数据中的异常值和离群点方面的强大潜力，并已应用于广泛的现实世界应用中，包括颗粒介质中的滑坡破坏检测。及早准确地识别滑坡易发区的破坏区域对于有效的地质灾害减缓至关重要。虽然现有方法通常依赖于通过统计或机器学习技术分析的地表位移数据，但它们往往无法捕捉到此类数据中固有的空间相关性和时间动态。为了弥补这一不足，我们专注于地面监测的滑坡，并引入一种新颖的方法，该方法联合结合了空间和时间信息，从而能够检测复杂的滑坡，包括发生在同一斜坡的不同区域的多次连续破坏。具体而言，我们的方法建立在现有基于 LID 的技术 sLID 之上。我们通过三个关键方式扩展了它的能力。（1）运动学增强：我们将速度纳入 sLID 计算中，以更好地捕捉短期时间依赖性和变形速率关系。（2）空间融合：我们应用贝叶斯估计来聚合空间邻域内的 sLID 值，从而有效地将空间相关性嵌入到 LID 分数中。（3）时间建模：我们引入了一个时间变体 tLID，它可以从时间序列数据中学习长期动态，从而提供位移行为的稳健时间表示。最后，我们将这两个组件集成到一个统一的框架中，称为时空 LID (stLID)，以识别在空间或时间维度上或两者兼而有之的异常样本。大量实验表明，stLID 在破坏检测精度和提前期方面始终优于现有方法。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel spatiotemporal Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (stLID) method for early detection of complex landslide failures by incorporating velocity, spatial correlations, and temporal dynamics into LID scores, outperforming existing methods in precision and lead-time.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新颖的时空局部内禀维度 (stLID) 方法，通过将速度、空间相关性和时间动态结合到 LID 分数中，用于早期检测复杂滑坡，并在精度和提前期方面优于现有方法。

title: SCALER:Synthetic Scalable Adaptive Learning Environment for Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a principled way to enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models, yet its effectiveness hinges on training signals that remain informative as models evolve. In practice, RL progress often slows when task difficulty becomes poorly aligned with model capability, or when training is dominated by a narrow set of recurring problem patterns. To jointly address these issues, we propose SCALER (Synthetic sCalable Adaptive Learning Environment for Reasoning), a framework that sustains effective learning signals through adaptive environment design. SCALER introduces a scalable synthesis pipeline that converts real-world programming problems into verifiable reasoning environments with controllable difficulty and unbounded instance generation, enabling RL training beyond finite datasets while preserving strong correctness guarantees. Building on this, SCALER further employs an adaptive multi-environment RL strategy that dynamically adjusts instance difficulty and curates the active set of environments to track the model's capability frontier and maintain distributional diversity. This co-adaptation prevents reward sparsity, mitigates overfitting to narrow task patterns, and supports sustained improvement throughout training. Extensive experiments show that SCALER consistently outperforms dataset-based RL baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks and exhibits more stable, long-horizon training dynamics.
summary_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 提供了一种原则性的方法来增强大型语言模型的推理能力，但其有效性取决于随着模型演进而保持信息丰富的训练信号。在实践中，当任务难度与模型能力严重不匹配，或训练被狭隘的重复问题模式所主导时，强化学习的进展往往会减缓。为了共同解决这些问题，我们提出了 SCALER (用于推理的合成可扩展自适应学习环境)，该框架通过自适应环境设计来维持有效的学习信号。SCALER 引入了一个可扩展的合成管道，将真实世界的编程问题转换为具有可控难度和无限实例生成的、可验证的推理环境，从而能够在有限数据集之外进行强化学习训练，同时保留强大的正确性保证。在此基础上，SCALER 进一步采用了一种自适应多环境强化学习策略，动态调整实例难度并管理活跃环境集，以追踪模型的能力前沿并维持分布多样性。这种协同自适应防止了奖励稀疏性，减轻了对狭隘任务模式的过度拟合，并支持整个训练过程中的持续改进。大量实验表明，在各种推理基准测试中，SCALER 始终优于基于数据集的强化学习基线，并表现出更稳定、更长期的训练动态。
tldr: The paper introduces SCALER, a framework that uses adaptive environment design to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models through reinforcement learning by creating synthetic, scalable reasoning environments with verifiable correctness guarantees and dynamic difficulty.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SCALER，一个利用自适应环境设计来提高大型语言模型通过强化学习进行推理能力的框架。它通过创建具有可验证正确性保证和动态难度的合成、可扩展的推理环境来实现这一目标。

title: UniDrive-WM: Unified Understanding, Planning and Generation World Model For Autonomous Driving
summary: World models have become central to autonomous driving, where accurate scene understanding and future prediction are crucial for safe control. Recent work has explored using vision-language models (VLMs) for planning, yet existing approaches typically treat perception, prediction, and planning as separate modules. We propose UniDrive-WM, a unified VLM-based world model that jointly performs driving-scene understanding, trajectory planning, and trajectory-conditioned future image generation within a single architecture. UniDrive-WM's trajectory planner predicts a future trajectory, which conditions a VLM-based image generator to produce plausible future frames. These predictions provide additional supervisory signals that enhance scene understanding and iteratively refine trajectory generation. We further compare discrete and continuous output representations for future image prediction, analyzing their influence on downstream driving performance. Experiments on the challenging Bench2Drive benchmark show that UniDrive-WM produces high-fidelity future images and improves planning performance by 5.9% in L2 trajectory error and 9.2% in collision rate over the previous best method. These results demonstrate the advantages of tightly integrating VLM-driven reasoning, planning, and generative world modeling for autonomous driving. The project page is available at https://unidrive-wm.github.io/UniDrive-WM .
summary_zh: 世界模型已成为自动驾驶的核心，其中准确的场景理解和未来预测对于安全控制至关重要。最近的研究探索了使用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 进行规划，但现有方法通常将感知、预测和规划视为独立的模块。我们提出了 UniDrive-WM，一种统一的基于 VLM 的世界模型，它在单个架构中联合执行驾驶场景理解、轨迹规划和轨迹条件下的未来图像生成。 UniDrive-WM 的轨迹规划器预测未来轨迹，用于调节基于 VLM 的图像生成器以生成合理的未来帧。这些预测提供了额外的监督信号，增强了场景理解并迭代地改进轨迹生成。我们进一步比较了未来图像预测的离散和连续输出表示，分析了它们对下游驾驶性能的影响。在具有挑战性的 Bench2Drive 基准测试上的实验表明，UniDrive-WM 生成了高保真度的未来图像，并且在 L2 轨迹误差方面将规划性能提高了 5.9%，在碰撞率方面比之前的最佳方法提高了 9.2%。这些结果表明，紧密集成 VLM 驱动的推理、规划和生成式世界建模对于自动驾驶的优势。项目页面位于 https://unidrive-wm.github.io/UniDrive-WM 。
tldr: UniDrive-WM is a unified VLM-based world model for autonomous driving that integrates scene understanding, trajectory planning, and future image generation, demonstrating improved planning performance on the Bench2Drive benchmark.
tldr_zh: UniDrive-WM是一个统一的基于视觉-语言模型的世界模型，用于自动驾驶，集成了场景理解、轨迹规划和未来图像生成，并在Bench2Drive基准测试中展示了改进的规划性能。

title: Not All Steps are Informative: On the Linearity of LLMs' RLVR Training
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a central component of large language model (LLM) post-training. Unlike supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RLVR lets an LLM generate multiple candidate solutions and reinforces those that lead to a verifiably correct final answer. However, in practice, RLVR often requires thousands of training steps to reach strong performance, incurring substantial computation largely attributed to prolonged exploration. In this work, we make a surprising observation: during RLVR, LLMs evolve in a strongly linear manner. Specifically, both model weights and model output log-probabilities exhibit strong linear correlations with RL training steps. This suggests that RLVR predominantly amplifies trends that emerge early in training, rather than continuously discovering new behaviors throughout the entire optimization trajectory. Motivated by this linearity, we investigate whether future model states can be predicted from intermediate checkpoints via extrapolation, avoiding continued expensive training. We show that Weight Extrapolation produces models with performance comparable to standard RL training while requiring significantly less computation. Moreover, Logits Extrapolation consistently outperforms continued RL training on all four benchmarks by extrapolating beyond the step range where RL training remains stable.
summary_zh:
以下是翻译结果：

具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为大型语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心组成部分。与监督式微调（SFT）不同，RLVR允许LLM生成多个候选解决方案，并强化那些能产生可验证的正确最终答案的方案。然而，在实践中，RLVR通常需要数千个训练步骤才能达到良好的性能，这导致了大量的计算开销，主要归因于长时间的探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个令人惊讶的观察：在RLVR期间，LLM以一种强线性的方式演化。具体而言，模型权重和模型输出的对数概率均表现出与RL训练步骤的强线性相关性。这表明RLVR主要放大在训练早期出现的趋势，而不是在整个优化过程中持续发现新的行为。受这种线性性的启发，我们研究了是否可以通过外推法从中间检查点预测未来的模型状态，从而避免持续的高成本训练。我们表明，权重外推法产生的模型性能与标准RL训练相当，同时显著减少了计算量。此外，在所有四个基准测试中，对数几率外推法始终优于持续的RL训练，其外推范围甚至超过了RL训练保持稳定的步骤范围。
tldr: This paper finds that LLMs evolve linearly during RLVR training, suggesting extrapolation can replace expensive continued training. They show weight and logits extrapolation can match or outperform standard RL training with less computation.
tldr_zh: 本文发现LLM在RLVR训练期间线性演化，表明外推法可以替代昂贵的持续训练。作者证明权重和logits外推法可以以更少的计算量达到甚至超过标准RL训练的性能。

title: Precision over Diversity: High-Precision Reward Generalizes to Robust Instruction Following
summary: A central belief in scaling reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for instruction following (IF) tasks is that, a diverse mixture of verifiable hard and unverifiable soft constraints is essential for generalizing to unseen instructions. In this work, we challenge this prevailing consensus through a systematic empirical investigation. Counter-intuitively, we find that models trained on hard-only constraints consistently outperform those trained on mixed datasets. Extensive experiments reveal that reward precision, rather than constraint diversity, is the primary driver of effective alignment. The LLM judge suffers from a low recall rate in detecting false response, which leads to severe reward hacking, thereby undermining the benefits of diversity. Furthermore, analysis of the attention mechanism reveals that high-precision rewards develop a transferable meta-skill for IF. Motivated by these insights, we propose a simple yet effective data-centric refinement strategy that prioritizes reward precision. Evaluated on five benchmarks, our approach outperforms competitive baselines by 13.4\% in performance while achieving a 58\% reduction in training time, maintaining strong generalization beyond instruction following. Our findings advocate for a paradigm shift: moving away from the indiscriminate pursuit of data diversity toward high-precision rewards.
summary_zh: 在利用可验证奖励缩放强化学习以进行指令跟随（IF）任务中，一个核心信念是，多样化的可验证硬约束和不可验证软约束的混合对于泛化到未见指令至关重要。在这项工作中，我们通过系统的实证研究挑战了这一普遍共识。与直觉相反，我们发现仅在硬约束上训练的模型始终优于在混合数据集上训练的模型。大量实验表明，奖励精度而非约束多样性是有效对齐的主要驱动因素。大型语言模型（LLM）判别器在检测错误响应方面存在低召回率，这导致严重的奖励黑客行为，从而破坏了多样性的优势。此外，对注意力机制的分析表明，高精度奖励发展了一种可转移的指令跟随元技能。受这些洞察的启发，我们提出了一种简单而有效的数据中心精炼策略，该策略优先考虑奖励精度。在五个基准上的评估表明，我们的方法在性能方面优于竞争基线13.4％，同时训练时间减少了58％，并且在指令跟随之外保持了强大的泛化能力。我们的发现倡导一种范式转变：从不加选择地追求数据多样性转向高精度奖励。
tldr: This paper argues against the conventional wisdom of diverse verifiable rewards in instruction following RL, demonstrating that high-precision rewards lead to better generalization and faster training, and proposing a data-centric refinement strategy to improve reward precision.
tldr_zh: 该论文挑战了指令跟随强化学习中多样化可验证奖励的传统观点，证明了高精度奖励能带来更好的泛化能力和更快的训练速度，并提出了一种以数据为中心的优化策略来提高奖励精度。

title: Driving on Registers
summary: We present DrivoR, a simple and efficient transformer-based architecture for end-to-end autonomous driving. Our approach builds on pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) and introduces camera-aware register tokens that compress multi-camera features into a compact scene representation, significantly reducing downstream computation without sacrificing accuracy. These tokens drive two lightweight transformer decoders that generate and then score candidate trajectories. The scoring decoder learns to mimic an oracle and predicts interpretable sub-scores representing aspects such as safety, comfort, and efficiency, enabling behavior-conditioned driving at inference. Despite its minimal design, DrivoR outperforms or matches strong contemporary baselines across NAVSIM-v1, NAVSIM-v2, and the photorealistic closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark. Our results show that a pure-transformer architecture, combined with targeted token compression, is sufficient for accurate, efficient, and adaptive end-to-end driving. Code and checkpoints will be made available via the project page.
summary_zh: 我们提出了DrivoR，一种简单而高效的基于Transformer的端到端自动驾驶架构。我们的方法构建在预训练的视觉Transformer（ViT）之上，并引入了相机感知的注册令牌，将多摄像头特征压缩成紧凑的场景表示，在不牺牲准确性的前提下显著减少了下游计算量。这些令牌驱动两个轻量级的Transformer解码器，分别用于生成并对候选轨迹进行评分。评分解码器学习模仿预言机（oracle），并预测代表安全性、舒适性和效率等方面的可解释的子评分，从而在推理时实现行为条件驾驶。尽管设计简洁，DrivoR在NAVSIM-v1、NAVSIM-v2和照片级真实感的闭环HUGSIM基准测试中，性能优于或与强大的当代基线模型相匹配。我们的结果表明，纯Transformer架构与有针对性的令牌压缩相结合，足以实现准确、高效和自适应的端到端驾驶。代码和检查点将通过项目页面提供。
tldr: DrivoR is a transformer-based autonomous driving architecture that uses camera-aware register tokens to compress multi-camera features, achieving state-of-the-art performance with a minimal design.
tldr_zh: DrivoR 是一种基于Transformer的自动驾驶架构，它使用相机感知的注册令牌来压缩多相机特征，以最小的设计实现了最先进的性能。

title: The RoboSense Challenge: Sense Anything, Navigate Anywhere, Adapt Across Platforms
summary: Autonomous systems are increasingly deployed in open and dynamic environments -- from city streets to aerial and indoor spaces -- where perception models must remain reliable under sensor noise, environmental variation, and platform shifts. However, even state-of-the-art methods often degrade under unseen conditions, highlighting the need for robust and generalizable robot sensing. The RoboSense 2025 Challenge is designed to advance robustness and adaptability in robot perception across diverse sensing scenarios. It unifies five complementary research tracks spanning language-grounded decision making, socially compliant navigation, sensor configuration generalization, cross-view and cross-modal correspondence, and cross-platform 3D perception. Together, these tasks form a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating real-world sensing reliability under domain shifts, sensor failures, and platform discrepancies. RoboSense 2025 provides standardized datasets, baseline models, and unified evaluation protocols, enabling large-scale and reproducible comparison of robust perception methods. The challenge attracted 143 teams from 85 institutions across 16 countries, reflecting broad community engagement. By consolidating insights from 23 winning solutions, this report highlights emerging methodological trends, shared design principles, and open challenges across all tracks, marking a step toward building robots that can sense reliably, act robustly, and adapt across platforms in real-world environments.
summary_zh: 自主系统正日益被部署在开放且动态的环境中，从城市街道到空中和室内空间，在这些环境中，感知模型必须在传感器噪声、环境变化和平台转移的情况下保持可靠性。然而，即使是最先进的方法也经常在未见过的条件下性能下降，突显了对鲁棒和可泛化机器人感知的需求。“RoboSense 2025挑战赛”旨在提升机器人感知在各种传感场景中的鲁棒性和适应性。它整合了五个互补的研究方向，涵盖了语言基础决策、社交礼仪导航、传感器配置泛化、跨视角和跨模态对应以及跨平台3D感知。这些任务共同构成了对真实世界中在领域偏移、传感器故障和平台差异下感知可靠性进行评估的综合基准。RoboSense 2025提供标准化的数据集、基线模型和统一的评估协议，从而能够对鲁棒感知方法进行大规模和可复现的比较。该挑战赛吸引了来自16个国家85个机构的143支队伍，反映了广泛的社区参与。通过整合23个获奖解决方案的见解，本报告重点介绍了所有方向上涌现的方法论趋势、共享的设计原则和未解决的挑战，标志着朝着构建能够在真实世界环境中可靠感知、稳健行动和跨平台适应的机器人迈出了一步。
tldr: The RoboSense 2025 Challenge provides a benchmark for evaluating robust robot perception across diverse tasks and environments, attracting significant community engagement and highlighting key trends in addressing real-world robotic challenges.
tldr_zh: RoboSense 2025挑战赛提供了一个基准，用于评估在各种任务和环境中稳健的机器人感知能力，吸引了广泛的社区参与，并突出了解决现实世界机器人挑战的关键趋势。

title: When to Act: Calibrated Confidence for Reliable Human Intention Prediction in Assistive Robotics
summary: Assistive devices must determine both what a user intends to do and how reliable that prediction is before providing support. We introduce a safety-critical triggering framework based on calibrated probabilities for multimodal next-action prediction in Activities of Daily Living. Raw model confidence often fails to reflect true correctness, posing a safety risk. Post-hoc calibration aligns predicted confidence with empirical reliability and reduces miscalibration by about an order of magnitude without affecting accuracy. The calibrated confidence drives a simple ACT/HOLD rule that acts only when reliability is high and withholds assistance otherwise. This turns the confidence threshold into a quantitative safety parameter for assisted actions and enables verifiable behavior in an assistive control loop.
summary_zh: 辅助设备必须在提供支持之前确定用户的意图以及预测的可靠性。我们介绍了一种基于校准概率的安全关键触发框架，用于日常生活活动中的多模态下一步动作预测。原始模型置信度往往无法反映真实的正确性，从而构成安全风险。事后校准将预测的置信度与经验可靠性对齐，并在不影响准确性的前提下将失准度降低约一个数量级。校准后的置信度驱动一个简单的ACT/HOLD规则，该规则仅在可靠性较高时采取行动，否则则保持辅助。 这将置信度阈值转变为辅助动作的定量安全参数，并能够在辅助控制环路中实现可验证的行为。
tldr: This paper presents a calibrated confidence framework for predicting human intentions in assistive robotics, improving safety by ensuring reliability before triggering assistance by reducing miscalibration of model confidence.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种校准置信度框架，用于预测辅助机器人领域中人类的意图，通过降低模型置信度的误校准，确保在触发辅助之前的可靠性，从而提高安全性。

title: SeqWalker: Sequential-Horizon Vision-and-Language Navigation with Hierarchical Planning
summary: Sequential-Horizon Vision-and-Language Navigation (SH-VLN) presents a challenging scenario where agents should sequentially execute multi-task navigation guided by complex, long-horizon language instructions. Current vision-and-language navigation models exhibit significant performance degradation with such multi-task instructions, as information overload impairs the agent's ability to attend to observationally relevant details. To address this problem, we propose SeqWalker, a navigation model built on a hierarchical planning framework. Our SeqWalker features: i) A High-Level Planner that dynamically selects global instructions into contextually relevant sub-instructions based on the agent's current visual observations, thus reducing cognitive load; ii) A Low-Level Planner incorporating an Exploration-Verification strategy that leverages the inherent logical structure of instructions for trajectory error correction. To evaluate SH-VLN performance, we also extend the IVLN dataset and establish a new benchmark. Extensive experiments are performed to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed SeqWalker.
summary_zh: 序列视界视觉-语言导航 (SH-VLN) 提出了一个具有挑战性的场景，其中智能体应在复杂、长视距的语言指令引导下，按顺序执行多任务导航。当前的视觉-语言导航模型在面对此类多任务指令时，表现出显著的性能下降，因为信息过载削弱了智能体关注观察相关细节的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 SeqWalker，一个基于分层规划框架的导航模型。我们的 SeqWalker 具有：i) 一个高层规划器，它基于智能体当前的视觉观测，动态地将全局指令选择为上下文相关的子指令，从而降低认知负荷；ii) 一个低层规划器，该规划器结合了一种探索-验证策略，利用指令固有的逻辑结构进行轨迹误差修正。为了评估 SH-VLN 性能，我们还扩展了 IVLN 数据集并建立了一个新的基准。大量的实验表明了所提出的 SeqWalker 的优越性。
tldr: The paper introduces SeqWalker, a hierarchical planning model for Sequential-Horizon Vision-and-Language Navigation (SH-VLN) that addresses performance degradation with long-horizon instructions by dynamically selecting sub-instructions and incorporating an exploration-verification strategy. They also extend the IVLN dataset to create a new benchmark for SH-VLN.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SeqWalker，一种用于序列视野视觉语言导航（SH-VLN）的分层规划模型，通过动态选择子指令并结合探索-验证策略来解决长视野指令下的性能下降问题。他们还扩展了IVLN数据集，为SH-VLN创建了一个新的基准。

title: Nightmare Dreamer: Dreaming About Unsafe States And Planning Ahead
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown remarkable success in real-world applications, particularly in robotics control. However, RL adoption remains limited due to insufficient safety guarantees. We introduce Nightmare Dreamer, a model-based Safe RL algorithm that addresses safety concerns by leveraging a learned world model to predict potential safety violations and plan actions accordingly. Nightmare Dreamer achieves nearly zero safety violations while maximizing rewards. Nightmare Dreamer outperforms model-free baselines on Safety Gymnasium tasks using only image observations, achieving nearly a 20x improvement in efficiency.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已在现实世界应用中取得了显著成功，尤其是在机器人控制领域。然而，由于缺乏足够的安全保障，RL的应用仍然受到限制。我们引入了 Nightmare Dreamer，一种基于模型的安全RL算法，它通过利用学习到的世界模型来预测潜在的安全违规行为并相应地规划动作，从而解决安全问题。 Nightmare Dreamer 在最大化奖励的同时，几乎实现了零安全违规。 Nightmare Dreamer 在 Safety Gymnasium 任务中使用图像观测结果的表现优于无模型基线，效率提高了近 20 倍。
tldr: Nightmare Dreamer is a model-based Safe RL algorithm that learns a world model to predict safety violations and improve safety in robotic control tasks, achieving significant efficiency gains over model-free methods.
tldr_zh: Nightmare Dreamer是一种基于模型的安全强化学习算法，它学习一个世界模型来预测安全违规行为，并提高机器人控制任务中的安全性，与无模型方法相比实现了显着的效率提升。

title: Multiagent Reinforcement Learning with Neighbor Action Estimation
summary: Multiagent reinforcement learning, as a prominent intelligent paradigm, enables collaborative decision-making within complex systems. However, existing approaches often rely on explicit action exchange between agents to evaluate action value functions, which is frequently impractical in real-world engineering environments due to communication constraints, latency, energy consumption, and reliability requirements. From an artificial intelligence perspective, this paper proposes an enhanced multiagent reinforcement learning framework that employs action estimation neural networks to infer agent behaviors. By integrating a lightweight action estimation module, each agent infers neighboring agents' behaviors using only locally observable information, enabling collaborative policy learning without explicit action sharing. This approach is fully compatible with standard TD3 algorithms and scalable to larger multiagent systems. At the engineering application level, this framework has been implemented and validated in dual-arm robotic manipulation tasks: two robotic arms collaboratively lift objects. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach significantly enhances the robustness and deployment feasibility of real-world robotic systems while reducing dependence on information infrastructure. Overall, this research advances the development of decentralized multiagent artificial intelligence systems while enabling AI to operate effectively in dynamic, information-constrained real-world environments.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习作为一种重要的智能范式，能够实现复杂系统内的协同决策。然而，现有方法通常依赖于智能体之间显式的动作交换来评估动作价值函数，这在现实工程环境中由于通信约束、延迟、能量消耗以及可靠性要求，常常是不切实际的。从人工智能的角度出发，本文提出了一种增强的多智能体强化学习框架，该框架采用动作估计神经网络来推断智能体的行为。通过集成轻量级的动作估计模块，每个智能体仅使用局部可观察信息就可以推断相邻智能体的行为，从而在无需显式动作共享的情况下实现协同策略学习。该方法与标准TD3算法完全兼容，并可扩展到更大的多智能体系统。在工程应用层面，该框架已在双臂机器人操作任务中得到实施和验证：两个机械臂协同举起物体。实验结果表明，该方法显著提高了现实世界机器人系统的鲁棒性和可部署性，同时降低了对信息基础设施的依赖。总而言之，这项研究推进了去中心化多智能体人工智能系统的发展，并使人工智能能够在动态的、信息受限的现实环境中有效运行。
tldr: This paper introduces a multiagent reinforcement learning framework that uses action estimation neural networks to infer the behaviors of neighboring agents, allowing for collaborative policy learning without direct communication. It is validated on dual-arm robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多智能体强化学习框架，该框架使用动作估计神经网络来推断相邻智能体的行为，从而无需直接通信即可进行协作策略学习。该方法已在双臂机器人操作任务中得到验证。

title: UNIC: Learning Unified Multimodal Extrinsic Contact Estimation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires reliable estimation of extrinsic contacts-the interactions between a grasped object and its environment which provide essential contextual information for planning, control, and policy learning. However, existing approaches often rely on restrictive assumptions, such as predefined contact types, fixed grasp configurations, or camera calibration, that hinder generalization to novel objects and deployment in unstructured environments. In this paper, we present UNIC, a unified multimodal framework for extrinsic contact estimation that operates without any prior knowledge or camera calibration. UNIC directly encodes visual observations in the camera frame and integrates them with proprioceptive and tactile modalities in a fully data-driven manner. It introduces a unified contact representation based on scene affordance maps that captures diverse contact formations and employs a multimodal fusion mechanism with random masking, enabling robust multimodal representation learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UNIC performs reliably. It achieves a 9.6 mm average Chamfer distance error on unseen contact locations, performs well on unseen objects, remains robust under missing modalities, and adapts to dynamic camera viewpoints. These results establish extrinsic contact estimation as a practical and versatile capability for contact-rich manipulation.
summary_zh: 富接触操作需要对外在接触进行可靠的估计，即被抓取物体和环境之间的交互作用，它为规划、控制和策略学习提供必要的上下文信息。然而，现有方法通常依赖于诸如预定义的接触类型、固定的抓取配置或相机标定等限制性假设，这阻碍了其对新物体的泛化以及在非结构化环境中的部署。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的多模态框架UNIC，用于外在接触估计，它在没有任何先验知识或相机标定的情况下工作。UNIC直接在相机坐标系中编码视觉观测，并将它们与本体感觉和触觉模态以完全数据驱动的方式进行集成。它引入了一种基于场景可供性地图的统一接触表示，该表示捕捉了多样化的接触形态，并采用了一种带有随机掩码的多模态融合机制，从而实现了稳健的多模态表示学习。大量的实验表明UNIC表现可靠。在未见过的接触位置上，它实现了9.6毫米的平均倒角距离误差，在新物体上表现良好，在模态缺失的情况下保持稳健性，并且可以适应动态的相机视角。这些结果确立了外在接触估计作为一种实用且通用的富接触操作能力。
tldr: UNIC is a unified multimodal framework for estimating extrinsic contacts without prior object knowledge or camera calibration, using vision, proprioception, and tactile sensing to create scene affordance maps. It shows promising results for contact-rich manipulation.
tldr_zh: UNIC是一个统一的多模态框架，用于在没有先验物体知识或相机校准的情况下估计外部触点，使用视觉、本体感觉和触觉来创建场景可供性图。它在接触丰富的操作方面显示出很有前景的结果。

title: Autonomous Reasoning for Spacecraft Control: A Large Language Model Framework with Group Relative Policy Optimization
summary: This paper presents a learning-based guidance-and-control approach that couples a reasoning-enabled Large Language Model (LLM) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). A two-stage procedure consisting of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to learn formatting and control primitives, followed by GRPO for interaction-driven policy improvement, trains controllers for each environment. The framework is demonstrated on four control problems spanning a gradient of dynamical complexity, from canonical linear systems through nonlinear oscillatory dynamics to three-dimensional spacecraft attitude control with gyroscopic coupling and thrust constraints. Results demonstrate that an LLM with explicit reasoning, optimized via GRPO, can synthesize feasible stabilizing policies under consistent training settings across both linear and nonlinear systems. The two-stage training methodology enables models to generate control sequences while providing human-readable explanations of their decision-making process. This work establishes a foundation for applying GRPO-based reasoning to autonomous control systems, with potential applications in aerospace and other safety-critical domains.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的引导与控制方法，该方法将推理增强的大语言模型（LLM）与群体相对策略优化(GRPO)相结合。 通过一个两阶段的过程训练每个环境的控制器：首先进行监督微调（SFT），学习格式化和控制原语，然后进行GRPO，以进行交互驱动的策略改进。该框架在四个控制问题上进行了演示，这些问题涵盖了动态复杂性的一个梯度，从典型的线性系统到非线性振荡动力学，再到具有陀螺耦合和推力约束的三维航天器姿态控制。结果表明，通过GRPO优化的具有显式推理功能的LLM，可以在一致的训练设置下，为线性系统和非线性系统综合出可行的稳定策略。两阶段训练方法使模型能够在生成控制序列的同时，提供其决策过程的人工可读解释。 这项工作为将基于GRPO的推理应用于自主控制系统奠定了基础，并具有在航空航天和其他安全关键领域中的潜在应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework that combines a reasoning-enabled LLM with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for autonomous control, demonstrating its effectiveness in synthesizing stabilizing policies for linear and nonlinear systems, including spacecraft control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种框架，将支持推理的大型语言模型（LLM）与群体相对策略优化（GRPO）相结合，用于自主控制，并展示了其在合成线性和非线性系统（包括航天器控制）的稳定策略方面的有效性。

title: CoV: Chain-of-View Prompting for Spatial Reasoning
summary:
Embodied question answering (EQA) in 3D environments often requires collecting context that is distributed across multiple viewpoints and partially occluded. However, most recent vision--language models (VLMs) are constrained to a fixed and finite set of input views, which limits their ability to acquire question-relevant context at inference time and hinders complex spatial reasoning. We propose Chain-of-View (CoV) prompting, a training-free, test-time reasoning framework that transforms a VLM into an active viewpoint reasoner through a coarse-to-fine exploration process. CoV first employs a View Selection agent to filter redundant frames and identify question-aligned anchor views. It then performs fine-grained view adjustment by interleaving iterative reasoning with discrete camera actions, obtaining new observations from the underlying 3D scene representation until sufficient context is gathered or a step budget is reached.
  We evaluate CoV on OpenEQA across four mainstream VLMs and obtain an average +11.56\% improvement in LLM-Match, with a maximum gain of +13.62\% on Qwen3-VL-Flash. CoV further exhibits test-time scaling: increasing the minimum action budget yields an additional +2.51\% average improvement, peaking at +3.73\% on Gemini-2.5-Flash. On ScanQA and SQA3D, CoV delivers strong performance (e.g., 116 CIDEr / 31.9 EM@1 on ScanQA and 51.1 EM@1 on SQA3D). Overall, these results suggest that question-aligned view selection coupled with open-view search is an effective, model-agnostic strategy for improving spatial reasoning in 3D EQA without additional training.
summary_zh:
在3D环境中，具身问答(EQA)通常需要在多个视角收集分散且部分遮挡的上下文信息。然而，最近大多数视觉-语言模型(VLM)被局限于固定且有限的输入视角集合，这限制了它们在推理时获取与问题相关的上下文信息的能力，并阻碍了复杂的空间推理。我们提出了一种链式视角(CoV)提示方法，这是一个无需训练、测试时推理的框架，它通过粗到精的探索过程将VLM转变为一个主动视角推理器。CoV首先使用视角选择代理来过滤冗余帧并识别与问题对齐的锚点视图。 然后，它通过迭代推理与离散相机动作交错执行细粒度的视角调整，从底层3D场景表示中获取新的观察结果，直到收集到足够的上下文信息或达到步数预算。
我们在 OpenEQA 上评估了 CoV，针对四种主流 VLM 获得了平均+11.56% 的 LLM-Match 提升，在 Qwen3-VL-Flash 上达到了 +13.62% 的最大增益。 CoV 还展现出测试时可扩展性：增加最小行动预算会带来额外的 +2.51% 的平均提升，在 Gemini-2.5-Flash 上达到 +3.73% 的峰值。在ScanQA 和 SQA3D 上，CoV 表现出强大的性能（例如，在 ScanQA 上获得 116 CIDEr / 31.9 EM@1，在 SQA3D 上获得 51.1 EM@1）。 总体而言，这些结果表明，与问题对齐的视角选择与开放视角搜索相结合，是一种有效且模型无关的策略，可以在无需额外训练的情况下提高 3D EQA 中的空间推理能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Chain-of-View (CoV) prompting, a training-free method for improving spatial reasoning in embodied question answering by enabling VLMs to actively select and adjust viewpoints for better context acquisition in 3D environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Chain-of-View (CoV) prompting，一种无需训练的方法，通过使VLM能够主动选择和调整视角，以在3D环境中更好地获取上下文，从而提高具身问题回答中的空间推理能力。

title: SmartSearch: Process Reward-Guided Query Refinement for Search Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents have proven promising for addressing knowledge-intensive problems by incorporating information retrieval capabilities. Existing works largely focus on optimizing the reasoning paradigms of search agents, yet the quality of intermediate search queries during reasoning remains overlooked. As a result, the generated queries often remain inaccurate, leading to unexpected retrieval results and ultimately limiting search agents' overall effectiveness. To mitigate this issue, we introduce SmartSearch, a framework built upon two key mechanisms: (1) Process rewards, which provide fine-grained supervision for the quality of each intermediate search query through Dual-Level Credit Assessment. (2) Query refinement, which promotes the optimization of query generation by selectively refining low-quality search queries and regenerating subsequent search rounds based on these refinements. To enable the search agent to progressively internalize the ability to improve query quality under the guidance of process rewards, we design a three-stage curriculum learning framework. This framework guides the agent through a progression from imitation, to alignment, and ultimately to generalization. Experimental results show that SmartSearch consistently surpasses existing baselines, and additional quantitative analyses further confirm its significant gains in both search efficiency and query quality. The code is available at https://github.com/MYVAE/SmartSearch.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的搜索代理在解决知识密集型问题方面展现出潜力，这得益于它们结合了信息检索能力。现有工作主要侧重于优化搜索代理的推理范式，然而推理过程中中间搜索查询的质量却被忽视。因此，生成的查询通常不够准确，导致出现意想不到的检索结果，最终限制了搜索代理的整体有效性。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了SmartSearch，一个构建于两个关键机制之上的框架：（1）过程奖励，通过双层信用评估为每个中间搜索查询的质量提供细粒度的监督。（2）查询精炼，通过选择性地改进低质量的搜索查询，并基于这些改进重新生成后续的搜索轮次，从而促进查询生成的优化。为了使搜索代理在过程奖励的指导下逐步内化提高查询质量的能力，我们设计了一个三阶段课程学习框架。该框架引导代理经历从模仿到对齐，最终到泛化的过程。实验结果表明，SmartSearch始终优于现有的基线模型，额外的定量分析进一步证实了其在搜索效率和查询质量方面的显著提升。代码可在https://github.com/MYVAE/SmartSearch获取。
tldr: SmartSearch improves LLM-based search agents by using process rewards to refine search queries, leading to better search efficiency and query quality through a curriculum learning approach.
tldr_zh: SmartSearch通过使用过程奖励来优化搜索查询，从而改进基于LLM的搜索代理，并通过课程学习方法提高搜索效率和查询质量。

title: Thinking-Based Non-Thinking: Solving the Reward Hacking Problem in Training Hybrid Reasoning Models via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have attracted much attention due to their exceptional performance. However, their performance mainly stems from thinking, a long Chain of Thought (CoT), which significantly increase computational overhead. To address this overthinking problem, existing work focuses on using reinforcement learning (RL) to train hybrid reasoning models that automatically decide whether to engage in thinking or not based on the complexity of the query. Unfortunately, using RL will suffer the the reward hacking problem, e.g., the model engages in thinking but is judged as not doing so, resulting in incorrect rewards. To mitigate this problem, existing works either employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which incurs high computational costs, or enforce uniform token limits on non-thinking responses, which yields limited mitigation of the problem. In this paper, we propose Thinking-Based Non-Thinking (TNT). It does not employ SFT, and sets different maximum token usage for responses not using thinking across various queries by leveraging information from the solution component of the responses using thinking. Experiments on five mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that TNT reduces token usage by around 50% compared to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B and DeepScaleR-1.5B, while significantly improving accuracy. In fact, TNT achieves the optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency among all tested methods. Additionally, the probability of reward hacking problem in TNT's responses, which are classified as not using thinking, remains below 10% across all tested datasets.
summary_zh: 大型推理模型(LRM)因其卓越的性能而备受关注。然而，它们的性能主要源于思考，即一条长长的思维链(CoT)，这显著增加了计算开销。为了解决这种过度思考问题，现有工作侧重于使用强化学习(RL)来训练混合推理模型，使其能够根据查询的复杂性自动决定是否进行思考。不幸的是，使用强化学习会遭遇奖励利用(reward hacking)问题，例如，模型进行了思考但被判断为没有思考，从而导致不正确的奖励。为了缓解这个问题，现有工作要么采用监督微调(SFT)，这会产生很高的计算成本，要么对非思考响应强制执行统一的token限制，但这对问题的缓解效果有限。在本文中，我们提出了基于思考的非思考(TNT)。它不采用监督微调，而是利用来自使用思考的响应的解决方案组件的信息，为不同查询的非思考响应设置不同的最大token使用量。在五个数学基准测试上的实验表明，与DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B和DeepScaleR-1.5B相比，TNT减少了约50%的token使用量，同时显著提高了准确性。事实上，在所有测试方法中，TNT实现了准确性和效率之间的最佳权衡。此外，在所有测试数据集中，TNT被归类为不使用思考的响应中，奖励利用问题的概率始终低于10%。
tldr: The paper introduces Thinking-Based Non-Thinking (TNT), a reinforcement learning approach to train hybrid reasoning models by reducing computational cost and reward hacking, achieving a better accuracy/efficiency trade-off on mathematical benchmarks compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了基于思考的非思考（TNT）方法，这是一种使用强化学习训练混合推理模型的方法，通过减少计算成本和奖励欺骗，在数学基准测试上实现了比现有方法更好的准确性/效率权衡。

title: Defense Against Indirect Prompt Injection via Tool Result Parsing
summary: As LLM agents transition from digital assistants to physical controllers in autonomous systems and robotics, they face an escalating threat from indirect prompt injection. By embedding adversarial instructions into the results of tool calls, attackers can hijack the agent's decision-making process to execute unauthorized actions. This vulnerability poses a significant risk as agents gain more direct control over physical environments. Existing defense mechanisms against Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) generally fall into two categories. The first involves training dedicated detection models; however, this approach entails high computational overhead for both training and inference, and requires frequent updates to keep pace with evolving attack vectors. Alternatively, prompt-based methods leverage the inherent capabilities of LLMs to detect or ignore malicious instructions via prompt engineering. Despite their flexibility, most current prompt-based defenses suffer from high Attack Success Rates (ASR), demonstrating limited robustness against sophisticated injection attacks. In this paper, we propose a novel method that provides LLMs with precise data via tool result parsing while effectively filtering out injected malicious code. Our approach achieves competitive Utility under Attack (UA) while maintaining the lowest Attack Success Rate (ASR) to date, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code is available at GitHub.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体从数字助手过渡到自主系统和机器人领域的物理控制器，它们面临着间接提示注入日益严峻的威胁。通过将对抗性指令嵌入到工具调用结果中，攻击者可以劫持智能体的决策过程，从而执行未经授权的操作。随着智能体获得对物理环境的更多直接控制权，这种漏洞构成了重大风险。现有的针对间接提示注入（IPI）的防御机制通常分为两类。第一类涉及训练专用检测模型；然而，这种方法需要很高的训练和推理计算开销，并且需要频繁更新以跟上不断演变的攻击向量。另一种方法是基于提示的方法，利用LLM固有的能力，通过提示工程来检测或忽略恶意指令。尽管它们具有灵活性，但目前大多数基于提示的防御措施都存在较高的攻击成功率（ASR），表明其对抗复杂注入攻击的鲁棒性有限。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，该方法通过工具结果解析为LLM提供精确的数据，同时有效地过滤掉注入的恶意代码。我们的方法在攻击下的可用性（UA）方面具有竞争力，同时保持了迄今为止最低的攻击成功率（ASR），显著优于现有方法。代码已在GitHub上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel defense mechanism against indirect prompt injection attacks on LLM agents by parsing tool results to filter out malicious code, achieving a low attack success rate and competitive utility.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对LLM代理间接提示注入攻击的新型防御机制，通过解析工具结果来过滤恶意代码，实现了较低的攻击成功率和有竞争力的效用。

title: APEX: Academic Poster Editing Agentic Expert
summary: Designing academic posters is a labor-intensive process requiring the precise balance of high-density content and sophisticated layout. While existing paper-to-poster generation methods automate initial drafting, they are typically single-pass and non-interactive, often fail to align with complex, subjective user intent. To bridge this gap, we propose APEX (Academic Poster Editing agentic eXpert), the first agentic framework for interactive academic poster editing, supporting fine-grained control with robust multi-level API-based editing and a review-and-adjustment Mechanism. In addition, we introduce APEX-Bench, the first systematic benchmark comprising 514 academic poster editing instructions, categorized by a multi-dimensional taxonomy including operation type, difficulty, and abstraction level, constructed via reference-guided and reference-free strategies to ensure realism and diversity. We further establish a multi-dimensional VLM-as-a-judge evaluation protocol to assess instruction fulfillment, modification scope, and visual consistency & harmony. Experimental results demonstrate that APEX significantly outperforms baseline methods. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Breesiu/APEX.
summary_zh: 设计学术海报是一项劳动密集型的工作，需要精确平衡高密度内容和精巧的版面布局。虽然现有的论文到海报生成方法可以自动进行初步起草，但它们通常是单次性的且非交互式的，常常无法与复杂、主观的用户意图对齐。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了APEX（学术海报编辑Agent式专家），这是首个用于交互式学术海报编辑的Agent式框架，通过稳健的基于多层API的编辑和审核-调整机制，支持细粒度的控制。此外，我们引入了APEX-Bench，这是首个系统性的基准测试，包含514条学术海报编辑指令，通过一种包括操作类型、难度和抽象级别的多维度分类法进行分类，并采用参考引导和无参考策略构建，以确保真实性和多样性。我们进一步建立了一个多维度VLM-作为-评判者的评估协议，以评估指令完成度、修改范围以及视觉一致性与和谐性。实验结果表明，APEX显著优于基线方法。我们的实现可在https://github.com/Breesiu/APEX获取。
tldr: The paper introduces APEX, an agentic framework for interactive academic poster editing, along with a new benchmark (APEX-Bench) and VLM-based evaluation protocol, demonstrating significant performance improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了APEX，一个交互式学术海报编辑的agentic框架，以及一个新的基准测试(APEX-Bench)和基于VLM的评估协议，展示了相对于现有方法的显著性能改进。

title: AgentOCR: Reimagining Agent History via Optical Self-Compression
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable agentic systems trained with reinforcement learning (RL) over multi-turn interaction trajectories, but practical deployment is bottlenecked by rapidly growing textual histories that inflate token budgets and memory usage. We introduce AgentOCR, a framework that exploits the superior information density of visual tokens by representing the accumulated observation-action history as a compact rendered image. To make multi-turn rollouts scalable, AgentOCR proposes segment optical caching. By decomposing history into hashable segments and maintaining a visual cache, this mechanism eliminates redundant re-rendering. Beyond fixed rendering, AgentOCR introduces agentic self-compression, where the agent actively emits a compression rate and is trained with compression-aware reward to adaptively balance task success and token efficiency. We conduct extensive experiments on challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and search-based QA. Remarkably, results demonstrate that AgentOCR preserves over 95\% of text-based agent performance while substantially reducing token consumption (>50\%), yielding consistent token and memory efficiency. Our further analysis validates a 20x rendering speedup from segment optical caching and the effective strategic balancing of self-compression.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得能够通过强化学习（RL）训练基于多轮交互轨迹的代理系统成为可能，但实际部署受限于快速增长的文本历史，这会膨胀 Token 预算和内存使用。我们介绍了 AgentOCR，一个框架，它通过将累积的观察-行动历史表示为紧凑的渲染图像，从而利用视觉 Token 的优越信息密度。为了使多轮训练可扩展，AgentOCR 提出了分段光学缓存。通过将历史分解为可哈希的片段并维护视觉缓存，该机制消除了冗余的重新渲染。除了固定渲染之外，AgentOCR 还引入了代理自压缩，其中代理主动发出压缩率，并使用压缩感知奖励进行训练，以自适应地平衡任务成功率和 Token 效率。我们在具有挑战性的代理基准测试 ALFWorld 和基于搜索的 QA 上进行了广泛的实验。值得注意的是，结果表明 AgentOCR 在大幅降低 Token 消耗（>50%）的同时，保留了超过 95% 的基于文本的代理性能，从而实现了持续的 Token 和内存效率。我们的进一步分析验证了分段光学缓存带来的 20 倍渲染加速以及自压缩的有效策略性平衡。
tldr: AgentOCR compresses LLM agent history by rendering it into an image, using optical caching and adaptive self-compression to reduce token consumption while preserving performance.
tldr_zh: AgentOCR通过将LLM智能体的历史记录渲染成图像来压缩token，使用光学缓存和自适应自压缩来减少token消耗，同时保持性能。

title: CounterVid: Counterfactual Video Generation for Mitigating Action and Temporal Hallucinations in Video-Language Models
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) achieve strong multimodal understanding but remain prone to hallucinations, especially when reasoning about actions and temporal order. Existing mitigation strategies, such as textual filtering or random video perturbations, often fail to address the root cause: over-reliance on language priors rather than fine-grained visual dynamics. We propose a scalable framework for counterfactual video generation that synthesizes videos differing only in actions or temporal structure while preserving scene context. Our pipeline combines multimodal LLMs for action proposal and editing guidance with diffusion-based image and video models to generate semantic hard negatives at scale. Using this framework, we build CounterVid, a synthetic dataset of ~26k preference pairs targeting action recognition and temporal reasoning. We further introduce MixDPO, a unified Direct Preference Optimization approach that jointly leverages textual and visual preferences. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL with MixDPO yields consistent improvements, notably in temporal ordering, and transfers effectively to standard video hallucination benchmarks. Code and models will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 视频-语言模型(VLMs)在多模态理解方面取得了显著进展，但仍然容易产生幻觉，尤其是在推理行为和时间顺序时。现有的缓解策略，例如文本过滤或随机视频扰动，往往无法解决根本原因：过度依赖语言先验，而不是细粒度的视觉动态。我们提出了一个可扩展的反事实视频生成框架，该框架合成仅在动作或时间结构上存在差异，但保留场景上下文的视频。我们的流程结合了多模态LLM用于动作提议和编辑指导，以及基于扩散的图像和视频模型，以大规模生成语义硬负样本。利用该框架，我们构建了CounterVid，一个包含约2.6万个偏好对的合成数据集，专门针对动作识别和时间推理。此外，我们引入了MixDPO，一种统一的直接偏好优化方法，该方法联合利用文本和视觉偏好。使用MixDPO微调Qwen2.5-VL产生了持续的改进，尤其是在时间排序方面，并有效地转移到标准视频幻觉基准测试中。代码和模型将公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces CounterVid, a framework for generating counterfactual videos to mitigate action and temporal hallucinations in video-language models, along with MixDPO, a preference optimization approach that improves temporal ordering and reduces hallucinations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CounterVid，一个用于生成反事实视频的框架，旨在减轻视频-语言模型中的动作和时间幻觉；同时提出了MixDPO，一种偏好优化方法，能够改善时间排序并减少幻觉。

title: GeM-VG: Towards Generalized Multi-image Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive progress in single-image grounding and general multi-image understanding. Recently, some methods begin to address multi-image grounding. However, they are constrained by single-target localization and limited types of practical tasks, due to the lack of unified modeling for generalized grounding tasks. Therefore, we propose GeM-VG, an MLLM capable of Generalized Multi-image Visual Grounding. To support this, we systematically categorize and organize existing multi-image grounding tasks according to their reliance of cross-image cues and reasoning, and introduce the MG-Data-240K dataset, addressing the limitations of existing datasets regarding target quantity and image relation. To tackle the challenges of robustly handling diverse multi-image grounding tasks, we further propose a hybrid reinforcement finetuning strategy that integrates chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and direct answering, considering their complementary strengths. This strategy adopts an R1-like algorithm guided by a carefully designed rule-based reward, effectively enhancing the model's overall perception and reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior generalized grounding capabilities of our model. For multi-image grounding, it outperforms the previous leading MLLMs by 2.0% and 9.7% on MIG-Bench and MC-Bench, respectively. In single-image grounding, it achieves a 9.1% improvement over the base model on ODINW. Furthermore, our model retains strong capabilities in general multi-image understanding.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在单图指代和通用多图理解方面展现了令人瞩目的进展。最近，一些方法开始解决多图指代问题。然而，由于缺乏针对通用指代任务的统一建模，它们受到单目标定位和有限类型的实际任务的限制。因此，我们提出了GeM-VG，一种能够进行通用多图视觉指代的MLLM。为支持这一点，我们根据现有多图指代任务对跨图线索和推理的依赖程度，系统地对它们进行了分类和组织，并引入了MG-Data-240K数据集，解决了现有数据集在目标数量和图像关系方面的局限性。为了应对稳健处理各种多图指代任务的挑战，我们进一步提出了一种混合强化微调策略，该策略整合了思维链（CoT）推理和直接回答，考虑到它们的互补优势。该策略采用类似R1的算法，并由精心设计的基于规则的奖励引导，有效地增强了模型整体的感知和推理能力。大量实验证明了我们模型卓越的通用指代能力。在多图指代方面，它在MIG-Bench和MC-Bench上分别超过了之前领先的MLLMs 2.0%和9.7%。在单图指代方面，它在ODINW上比基础模型提高了9.1%。此外，我们的模型保留了强大的通用多图理解能力。
tldr: The paper introduces GeM-VG, a Multimodal Large Language Model for Generalized Multi-image Visual Grounding, along with a new dataset (MG-Data-240K) and a hybrid reinforcement finetuning strategy, achieving state-of-the-art results on multi-image and single-image grounding benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GeM-VG，一个用于广义多图像视觉定位的多模态大型语言模型，以及一个新的数据集(MG-Data-240K)和一个混合强化微调策略，在多图像和单图像定位基准测试上取得了最先进的结果。

title: AT$^2$PO: Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization via Tree Search
summary: LLM agents have emerged as powerful systems for tackling multi-turn tasks by interleaving internal reasoning and external tool interactions. Agentic Reinforcement Learning has recently drawn significant research attention as a critical post-training paradigm to further refine these capabilities. In this paper, we present AT$^2$PO (Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization via Tree Search), a unified framework for multi-turn agentic RL that addresses three core challenges: limited exploration diversity, sparse credit assignment, and misaligned policy optimization. AT$^2$PO introduces a turn-level tree structure that jointly enables Entropy-Guided Tree Expansion for strategic exploration and Turn-wise Credit Assignment for fine-grained reward propagation from sparse outcomes. Complementing this, we propose Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization, a turn-level learning objective that aligns policy updates with the natural decision granularity of agentic interactions. ATPO is orthogonal to tree search and can be readily integrated into any multi-turn RL pipeline. Experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 1.84 percentage points in average, with ablation studies validating the effectiveness of each component. Our code is available at https://github.com/zzfoutofspace/ATPO.
summary_zh: LLM智能体作为强大的系统，通过交错的内部推理和外部工具交互来解决多轮任务，已崭露头角。智能体强化学习近来受到了显著的研究关注，被认为是一种进一步完善这些能力的关键性后训练范式。在本文中，我们提出了AT$^2$PO（基于树搜索的智能体回合制策略优化），一个用于多轮智能体强化学习的统一框架，旨在解决三个核心挑战：有限的探索多样性、稀疏的信用分配和错位的策略优化。AT$^2$PO引入了一种回合级别的树状结构，该结构共同实现了用于战略性探索的熵引导树扩展以及用于从稀疏结果中进行细粒度奖励传播的回合式信用分配。作为补充，我们提出了智能体回合制策略优化，一种回合级别的学习目标，该目标将策略更新与智能体交互的自然决策粒度对齐。ATPO与树搜索正交，可以很容易地集成到任何多轮强化学习流程中。在七个基准测试上的实验表明，平均性能比最先进的基线提高了 1.84 个百分点，并且消融研究验证了每个组件的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zzfoutofspace/ATPO 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces AT$^2$PO, a reinforcement learning framework for LLM agents tackling multi-turn tasks, which uses tree search to improve exploration and credit assignment, leading to better performance on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AT$^2$PO，一种用于解决多轮任务的LLM代理的强化学习框架，该框架使用树搜索来改进探索和信用分配， 从而提高了在多个基准测试上的性能。

title: When Single-Agent with Skills Replace Multi-Agent Systems and When They Fail
summary:
Multi-agent AI systems have proven effective for complex reasoning. These systems are compounded by specialized agents, which collaborate through explicit communication, but incur substantial computational overhead. A natural question arises: can we achieve similar modularity benefits with a single agent that selects from a library of skills? We explore this question by viewing skills as internalized agent behaviors. From this perspective, a multi-agent system can be compiled into an equivalent single-agent system, trading inter-agent communication for skill selection. Our preliminary experiments suggest this approach can substantially reduce token usage and latency while maintaining competitive accuracy on reasoning benchmarks. However, this efficiency raises a deeper question that has received little attention: how does skill selection scale as libraries grow?
  Drawing on principles from cognitive science, we propose that LLM skill selection exhibits bounded capacity analogous to human decision-making. We investigate the scaling behavior of skill selection and observe a striking pattern. Rather than degrading gradually, selection accuracy remains stable up to a critical library size, then drops sharply, indicating a phase transition reminiscent of capacity limits in human cognition. Furthermore, we find evidence that semantic confusability among similar skills, rather than library size alone, plays a central role in this degradation. This perspective suggests that hierarchical organization, which has long helped humans manage complex choices, may similarly benefit AI systems. Our initial results with hierarchical routing support this hypothesis. This work opens new questions about the fundamental limits of semantic-based skill selection in LLMs and offers a cognitive-grounded framework and practical guidelines for designing scalable skill-based agents.
summary_zh:
多智能体人工智能系统已被证明在复杂推理方面卓有成效。这些系统由专门的智能体组成，通过显式通信进行协作，但会产生巨大的计算开销。一个自然而然的问题是：我们能否通过单个智能体从技能库中选择技能，从而获得类似的模块化优势？我们通过将技能视为内化的智能体行为来探索这个问题。从这个角度来看，多智能体系统可以被编译为等效的单智能体系统，从而用技能选择来替代智能体间的通信。我们的初步实验表明，这种方法可以显著降低令牌使用量和延迟，同时在推理基准测试中保持有竞争力的准确性。然而，这种效率引发了一个更深层次的问题，这个问题很少受到关注：随着技能库的增长，技能选择如何扩展？
  借鉴认知科学的原理，我们提出LLM技能选择表现出与人类决策相似的有界容量。我们研究了技能选择的扩展行为，并观察到一个显著的模式。选择准确率并非逐渐下降，而是在达到一个临界库大小之前保持稳定，然后急剧下降，这表明存在类似于人类认知中的容量限制的相变。此外，我们发现相似技能之间的语义混淆性，而非仅仅是库的大小，在这一退化中起着核心作用。这种观点表明，长期以来帮助人类管理复杂选择的分层组织，可能同样有益于人工智能系统。我们使用分层路由的初步结果支持了这一假设。这项工作引出了关于LLM中基于语义的技能选择的根本限制的新问题，并为设计可扩展的基于技能的智能体提供了认知驱动的框架和实用指南。
tldr: The paper explores replacing multi-agent systems with skill-based single agents using LLMs, finding efficiency gains but also a capacity limit in skill selection, which can be mitigated with hierarchical organization.
tldr_zh: 该论文探讨了使用大型语言模型以基于技能的单智能体取代多智能体系统，发现效率提升，但也发现技能选择存在容量限制，可以通过分层组织来缓解。

title: Miner:Mining Intrinsic Mastery for Data-Efficient RL in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Current critic-free RL methods for large reasoning models suffer from severe inefficiency when training on positive homogeneous prompts (where all rollouts are correct), resulting in waste of rollouts due to zero advantage estimates. We introduce a radically simple yet powerful solution to \uline{M}ine \uline{in}trinsic mast\uline{er}y (Miner), that repurposes the policy's intrinsic uncertainty as a self-supervised reward signal, with no external supervision, auxiliary models, or additional inference cost. Our method pioneers two key innovations: (1) a token-level focal credit assignment mechanism that dynamically amplifies gradients on critical uncertain tokens while suppressing overconfident ones, and (2) adaptive advantage calibration to seamlessly integrate intrinsic and verifiable rewards. Evaluated across six reasoning benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B base models, Miner achieves state-of-the-art performance among the other four algorithms, yielding up to \textbf{4.58} absolute gains in Pass@1 and \textbf{6.66} gains in Pass@K compared to GRPO. Comparison with other methods targeted at exploration enhancement further discloses the superiority of the two newly proposed innovations. This demonstrates that latent uncertainty exploitation is both necessary and sufficient for efficient and scalable RL training of reasoning models.
summary_zh: 当前用于大型推理模型的免批判强化学习方法在正向同质提示上训练时（即所有轨迹都是正确的）效率低下，导致零优势估计，造成轨迹浪费。我们引入了一个极其简单却强大的解决方案——\uline{M}ine \uline{in}trinsic mast\uline{er}y (Miner)，即“挖掘内在精通”，它将策略的内在不确定性重新用于自监督奖励信号，无需外部监督、辅助模型或额外的推理成本。我们的方法首创了两项关键创新：（1）一种令牌级别的焦点信用分配机制，动态放大关键不确定令牌上的梯度，同时抑制过度自信的令牌；（2）自适应优势校准，用于无缝集成内在奖励和可验证奖励。在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B基础模型上，我们对六个推理基准进行了评估，结果表明，与其他四种算法相比，Miner实现了最先进的性能，Pass@1指标绝对提升高达\textbf{4.58}，Pass@K指标提升高达\textbf{6.66}，与GRPO相比。与其他针对探索增强的方法进行比较进一步揭示了这两项新提出的创新的优越性。这表明，利用潜在不确定性对于推理模型的高效且可扩展的强化学习训练是必要且充分的。
tldr: The paper introduces Miner, a critic-free RL method that leverages intrinsic uncertainty as a reward signal for data-efficient training of large reasoning models. It achieves state-of-the-art performance by using token-level focal credit assignment and adaptive advantage calibration.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Miner的无批评家强化学习方法，该方法利用内在不确定性作为奖励信号，以实现大型推理模型的数据高效训练。通过使用token级别的焦点信用分配和自适应优势校准，该方法实现了最先进的性能。

title: Memory Matters More: Event-Centric Memory as a Logic Map for Agent Searching and Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as intelligent agents that reason, plan, and interact with their environments. To effectively scale to long-horizon scenarios, a key capability for such agents is a memory mechanism that can retain, organize, and retrieve past experiences to support downstream decision-making. However, most existing approaches organize and store memories in a flat manner and rely on simple similarity-based retrieval techniques. Even when structured memory is introduced, existing methods often struggle to explicitly capture the logical relationships among experiences or memory units. Moreover, memory access is largely detached from the constructed structure and still depends on shallow semantic retrieval, preventing agents from reasoning logically over long-horizon dependencies. In this work, we propose CompassMem, an event-centric memory framework inspired by Event Segmentation Theory. CompassMem organizes memory as an Event Graph by incrementally segmenting experiences into events and linking them through explicit logical relations. This graph serves as a logic map, enabling agents to perform structured and goal-directed navigation over memory beyond superficial retrieval, progressively gathering valuable memories to support long-horizon reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and NarrativeQA demonstrate that CompassMem consistently improves both retrieval and reasoning performance across multiple backbone models.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为具备推理、规划并与环境互动的智能体。为了有效地扩展到长程场景，此类智能体的关键能力是一种记忆机制，该机制能够保留、组织和检索历史经验，以支持下游决策。然而，大多数现有方法以扁平方式组织和存储记忆，并依赖于简单的基于相似性的检索技术。即使引入了结构化记忆，现有方法通常难以明确捕获经验或记忆单元之间的逻辑关系。此外，记忆访问在很大程度上与构建的结构脱节，仍然依赖于浅层语义检索，从而阻碍了智能体在长程依赖关系上进行逻辑推理。在这项工作中，我们提出 CompassMem，一个受事件分割理论启发的以事件为中心的记忆框架。CompassMem 通过将经验增量分割成事件并通过显式逻辑关系将它们链接起来，从而将记忆组织为事件图。该图充当逻辑地图，使智能体能够超越表面检索，在记忆上执行结构化和目标导向的导航，逐步收集有价值的记忆以支持长程推理。在 LoCoMo 和 NarrativeQA 上的实验表明，CompassMem 在多个骨干模型中始终如一地提高检索和推理性能。
tldr: The paper introduces CompassMem, an event-centric memory framework utilizing an Event Graph to help LLM agents reason and navigate memory more effectively for long-horizon tasks, showing performance improvements on LoCoMo and NarrativeQA.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CompassMem，一个以事件为中心的记忆框架，它使用事件图来帮助LLM智能体更有效地推理和导航记忆，以完成长时任务，并在LoCoMo和NarrativeQA上显示出性能提升。

title: ThinkDrive: Chain-of-Thought Guided Progressive Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Autonomous Driving
summary: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) technologies, their application in the domain of autonomous driving has become increasingly widespread. However, existing methods suffer from unstructured reasoning, poor generalization, and misalignment with human driving intent. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning enhances decision transparency, conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fails to fully exploit its potential, and reinforcement learning (RL) approaches face instability and suboptimal reasoning depth. We propose ThinkDrive, a CoT guided progressive RL fine-tuning framework for autonomous driving that synergizes explicit reasoning with difficulty-aware adaptive policy optimization. Our method employs a two-stage training strategy. First, we perform SFT using CoT explanations. Then, we apply progressive RL with a difficulty-aware adaptive policy optimizer that dynamically adjusts learning intensity based on sample complexity. We evaluate our approach on a public dataset. The results show that ThinkDrive outperforms strong RL baselines by 1.45%, 1.95%, and 1.01% on exam, easy-exam, and accuracy, respectively. Moreover, a 2B-parameter model trained with our method surpasses the much larger GPT-4o by 3.28% on the exam metric.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）技术的快速发展，其在自动驾驶领域的应用日益广泛。然而，现有方法存在推理非结构化、泛化能力差以及与人类驾驶意图不一致等问题。尽管思维链（CoT）推理增强了决策透明度，但传统的监督式微调（SFT）未能充分发挥其潜力，而强化学习（RL）方法则面临不稳定性以及次优推理深度。我们提出了ThinkDrive，一种CoT引导的渐进式RL微调框架，用于自动驾驶，该框架将显式推理与基于难度感知的自适应策略优化相结合。我们的方法采用两阶段训练策略。首先，我们使用CoT解释执行SFT。然后，我们应用渐进式RL，并结合基于难度感知的自适应策略优化器，该优化器根据样本复杂度动态调整学习强度。我们在公共数据集上评估了我们的方法。结果表明，ThinkDrive在exam、easy-exam和accuracy指标上分别比强大的RL基线提高了1.45%、1.95%和1.01%。此外，使用我们的方法训练的20亿参数模型在exam指标上超过了更大的GPT-4o，提升了3.28%。
tldr: The paper presents ThinkDrive, a Chain-of-Thought guided progressive reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework for autonomous driving that outperforms existing RL baselines and even surpasses GPT-4o on a benchmark dataset. It leverages a two-stage training strategy incorporating SFT with CoT explanations and difficulty-aware progressive RL.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ThinkDrive，一种链式思考引导的渐进式强化学习微调框架，用于自动驾驶。该框架在基准数据集上优于现有的强化学习基线，甚至超越了GPT-4o。 它利用了两阶段训练策略，包括基于CoT解释的SFT以及难度感知的渐进式强化学习。

title: Beyond Monolithic Architectures: A Multi-Agent Search and Knowledge Optimization Framework for Agentic Search
summary: Agentic search has emerged as a promising paradigm for complex information seeking by enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to interleave reasoning with tool use.
