Existing approaches either simplify policy learning by assuming independence across sub-actions, which often yields incoherent or invalid actions, or attempt to learn action structure and control jointly, which is slow and unstable. We introduce Structured Policy Initialization (SPIN), a two-stage framework that first pre-trains an Action Structure Model (ASM) to capture the manifold of valid actions, then freezes this representation and trains lightweight policy heads for control. On challenging discrete DM Control benchmarks, SPIN improves average return by up to 39% over the state of the art while reducing time to convergence by up to 12.8$\times$.
summary_zh: 离散组合动作空间中的强化学习需要在指数级增长的联合动作空间中搜索，以同时选择形成连贯组合的多个子动作。现有方法要么通过假设子动作之间的独立性来简化策略学习，这通常会产生不连贯或无效的动作，要么尝试联合学习动作结构和控制，这会导致速度慢且不稳定。我们引入了结构化策略初始化(SPIN)，这是一种两阶段框架，它首先预训练一个动作结构模型(ASM)来捕获有效动作的流形，然后冻结该表示并训练轻量级的策略头来进行控制。在具有挑战性的离散DM Control基准测试中，SPIN将平均回报提高了高达39%，同时将收敛时间缩短了高达12.8倍。
tldr: The paper introduces SPIN, a two-stage offline RL framework that pre-trains an Action Structure Model (ASM) to learn valid action manifolds, then trains lightweight policy heads, achieving significant performance and speed improvements on discrete DM Control tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SPIN的两阶段离线强化学习框架，该框架首先预训练一个动作结构模型（ASM）来学习有效动作流形，然后训练轻量级策略头，在离散DM Control任务上实现了显著的性能和速度提升。

title: Agentic Rubrics as Contextual Verifiers for SWE Agents
summary: Verification is critical for improving agents: it provides the reward signal for Reinforcement Learning and enables inference-time gains through Test-Time Scaling (TTS). Despite its importance, verification in software engineering (SWE) agent settings often relies on code execution, which can be difficult to scale due to environment setup overhead. Scalable alternatives such as patch classifiers and heuristic methods exist, but they are less grounded in codebase context and harder to interpret. To this end, we explore Agentic Rubrics: an expert agent interacts with the repository to create a context-grounded rubric checklist, and candidate patches are then scored against it without requiring test execution. On SWE-Bench Verified under parallel TTS evaluation, Agentic Rubrics achieve a score of 54.2% on Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B and 40.6% on Qwen3-32B, with at least a +3.5 percentage-point gain over the strongest baseline in our comparison set. We further analyze rubric behavior, showing that rubric scores are consistent with ground-truth tests while also flagging issues that tests do not capture. Our ablations show that agentic context gathering is essential for producing codebase-specific, unambiguous criteria. Together, these results suggest that Agentic Rubrics provide an efficient, scalable, and granular verification signal for SWE agents.
summary_zh: 验证对于改进智能体至关重要：它为强化学习提供奖励信号，并通过测试时缩放（TTS）实现推理时性能提升。尽管验证很重要，但软件工程（SWE）智能体环境下的验证通常依赖于代码执行，这可能因环境搭建开销而难以扩展。存在诸如补丁分类器和启发式方法等可扩展的替代方案，但它们与代码库上下文的关联性较弱，且更难解释。为此，我们探索了智能体规则：一个专家智能体与代码仓库交互，以创建基于上下文的规则清单，然后根据该清单对候选补丁进行评分，而无需执行测试。在并行 TTS 评估下的 SWE-Bench Verified 上，智能体规则在 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 上获得了 54.2% 的分数，在 Qwen3-32B 上获得了 40.6% 的分数，与我们的对比集中最强的基线相比，至少提高了 3.5 个百分点。我们进一步分析了规则行为，表明规则分数与真实测试一致，同时也标记了测试未捕获的问题。我们的消融实验表明，智能体上下文收集对于生成特定于代码库的、明确的标准至关重要。总之，这些结果表明，智能体规则为 SWE 智能体提供了一种高效、可扩展且精细的验证信号。
tldr: This paper introduces Agentic Rubrics, a method for verifying software engineering agents by using an expert agent to create context-grounded rubric checklists, avoiding the need for direct code execution. Results show improved performance over baselines on SWE-Bench Verified.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 Agentic Rubrics 的方法，用于通过使用专家代理创建基于上下文的 rubric 检查表来验证软件工程代理，从而避免了直接代码执行的需求。结果表明，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，性能优于基线。

title: Data-Driven Terramechanics Approach Towards a Realistic Real-Time Simulator for Lunar Rovers
summary: High-fidelity simulators for the lunar surface provide a digital environment for extensive testing of rover operations and mission planning. However, current simulators focus on either visual realism or physical accuracy, which limits their capability to replicate lunar conditions comprehensively. This work addresses that gap by combining high visual fidelity with realistic terrain interaction for a realistic representation of rovers on the lunar surface. Because direct simulation of wheel-soil interactions is computationally expensive, a data-driven approach was adopted, using regression models for slip and sinkage from data collected in both full-rover and single-wheel experiments and simulations. The resulting regression-based terramechanics model accurately reproduced steady-state and dynamic slip, as well as sinkage behavior, on flat terrain and slopes up to 20 degrees, with validation against field test results. Additionally, improvements were made to enhance the realism of terrain deformation and wheel trace visualization. This method supports real-time applications that require physically plausible terrain response alongside high visual fidelity.
summary_zh: 月球表面高保真模拟器为漫游车运行和任务规划的广泛测试提供了一个数字环境。然而，当前的模拟器主要关注视觉真实性或物理精确性，限制了其全面复制月球环境的能力。本文通过结合高视觉保真度和真实的 terrain 相互作用，以实现月球表面漫游车的逼真呈现，从而弥补了这一差距。由于直接模拟轮-土相互作用的计算成本很高，因此采用了一种数据驱动的方法，使用回归模型来处理从整车和单轮实验及仿真中收集的数据，用于预测滑移和沉陷。由此产生的基于回归的土力学模型准确地再现了在平坦地形和高达 20 度坡度上的稳态和动态滑移以及沉陷行为，并通过现场测试结果进行了验证。此外，还进行了改进，以增强 terrain 形变和车辙可视化的真实感。该方法支持需要物理上合理的 terrain 响应以及高视觉保真度的实时应用程序。
tldr: This paper introduces a data-driven terramechanics model for real-time lunar rover simulation, combining high visual fidelity with realistic terrain interaction using regression models for slip and sinkage.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于实时月球车仿真的数据驱动型土壤-机械模型，该模型结合了高视觉逼真度和逼真的地形交互，使用回归模型来模拟滑移和沉陷。

title: Enhanced-FQL($λ$), an Efficient and Interpretable RL with novel Fuzzy Eligibility Traces and Segmented Experience Replay
summary: This paper introduces a fuzzy reinforcement learning framework, Enhanced-FQL($λ$), that integrates novel Fuzzified Eligibility Traces (FET) and Segmented Experience Replay (SER) into fuzzy Q-learning with Fuzzified Bellman Equation (FBE) for continuous control tasks. The proposed approach employs an interpretable fuzzy rule base instead of complex neural architectures, while maintaining competitive performance through two key innovations: a fuzzified Bellman equation with eligibility traces for stable multi-step credit assignment, and a memory-efficient segment-based experience replay mechanism for enhanced sample efficiency. Theoretical analysis proves the proposed method convergence under standard assumptions. Extensive evaluations in continuous control domains demonstrate that Enhanced-FQL($λ$) achieves superior sample efficiency and reduced variance compared to n-step fuzzy TD and fuzzy SARSA($λ$) baselines, while maintaining substantially lower computational complexity than deep RL alternatives such as DDPG. The framework's inherent interpretability, combined with its computational efficiency and theoretical convergence guarantees, makes it particularly suitable for safety-critical applications where transparency and resource constraints are essential.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种模糊强化学习框架，增强型FQL($λ$)，该框架将新颖的模糊化资格迹（FET）和分段经验回放（SER）集成到具有模糊化贝尔曼方程（FBE）的模糊Q学习中，用于连续控制任务。所提出的方法采用可解释的模糊规则库代替复杂的神经架构，并通过两个关键创新保持具有竞争力的性能：具有资格迹的模糊化贝尔曼方程，用于稳定的多步信用分配；以及一种节省内存的分段经验回放机制，用于提高样本效率。理论分析证明了所提出的方法在标准假设下收敛。在连续控制领域进行的大量评估表明，与n步模糊TD和模糊SARSA($λ$)基线相比，增强型FQL($λ$)实现了卓越的样本效率和降低的方差，同时保持远低于诸如DDPG等深度强化学习替代方案的计算复杂度。该框架固有的可解释性，结合其计算效率和理论收敛保证，使其特别适用于透明性和资源约束至关重要的安全关键型应用。
tldr: The paper introduces Enhanced-FQL($λ$), a fuzzy reinforcement learning framework that integrates fuzzy eligibility traces and segmented experience replay for continuous control, achieving better sample efficiency, lower variance, and higher interpretability compared to baseline fuzzy RL methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Enhanced-FQL($λ$)，一个模糊强化学习框架，集成了模糊资格迹和分段经验回放，用于连续控制，与基线模糊强化学习方法相比，实现了更好的样本效率、更低的方差和更高的可解释性。

title: ImLoc: Revisiting Visual Localization with Image-based Representation
summary: Existing visual localization methods are typically either 2D image-based, which are easy to build and maintain but limited in effective geometric reasoning, or 3D structure-based, which achieve high accuracy but require a centralized reconstruction and are difficult to update. In this work, we revisit visual localization with a 2D image-based representation and propose to augment each image with estimated depth maps to capture the geometric structure. Supported by the effective use of dense matchers, this representation is not only easy to build and maintain, but achieves highest accuracy in challenging conditions. With compact compression and a GPU-accelerated LO-RANSAC implementation, the whole pipeline is efficient in both storage and computation and allows for a flexible trade-off between accuracy and highest memory efficiency. Our method achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy on various standard benchmarks and outperforms existing memory-efficient methods at comparable map sizes. Code will be available at https://github.com/cvg/Hierarchical-Localization.
summary_zh: 现有的视觉定位方法通常是基于2D图像的，易于构建和维护，但有效几何推理能力有限；或是基于3D结构的，精度很高但需要集中重建，并且难以更新。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了使用2D图像表示的视觉定位，并提出利用估计的深度图来增强每个图像，以捕获几何结构。凭借密集匹配器的有效使用，这种表示不仅易于构建和维护，而且在具有挑战性的条件下实现了最高的精度。通过紧凑压缩和GPU加速的LO-RANSAC实现，整个流程在存储和计算上都很高效，并允许在精度和最高内存效率之间进行灵活的权衡。我们的方法在各种标准基准上实现了新的最先进的精度，并且在可比的地图大小下优于现有的内存高效方法。代码将在https://github.com/cvg/Hierarchical-Localization上提供。
tldr: The paper presents ImLoc, a novel image-based visual localization method that augments images with estimated depth maps, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with efficient storage and computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ImLoc，一种新颖的基于图像的视觉定位方法，通过增加估计的深度图来增强图像，从而以高效的存储和计算实现最先进的精度。

title: Survival Dynamics of Neural and Programmatic Policies in Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning
summary: In evolutionary reinforcement learning tasks (ERL), agent policies are often encoded as small artificial neural networks (NERL). Such representations lack explicit modular structure, limiting behavioral interpretation. We investigate whether programmatic policies (PERL), implemented as soft, differentiable decision lists (SDDL), can match the performance of NERL. To support reproducible evaluation, we provide the first fully specified and open-source reimplementation of the classic 1992 Artificial Life (ALife) ERL testbed. We conduct a rigorous survival analysis across 4000 independent trials utilizing Kaplan-Meier curves and Restricted Mean Survival Time (RMST) metrics absent in the original study. We find a statistically significant difference in survival probability between PERL and NERL. PERL agents survive on average 201.69 steps longer than NERL agents. Moreover, SDDL agents using learning alone (no evolution) survive on average 73.67 steps longer than neural agents using both learning and evaluation. These results demonstrate that programmatic policies can exceed the survival performance of neural policies in ALife.
summary_zh: 在演化强化学习任务（ERL）中，智能体策略通常被编码为小型人工神经网络（NERL）。这类表示缺乏明确的模块化结构，限制了行为解释性。我们研究了可编程策略（PERL），即以软、可微决策列表（SDDL）实现，是否能与NERL的性能相媲美。为了支持可复现的评估，我们提供了经典的1992年人工生命（ALife）ERL测试平台的首个完全指定且开源的重新实现。我们利用Kaplan-Meier曲线和限制平均生存时间（RMST）指标，在4000次独立试验中进行了严格的生存分析，而原始研究中并未采用这些指标。我们发现PERL和NERL之间的生存概率存在统计学上的显著差异。PERL智能体平均比NERL智能体多存活201.69步。此外，仅使用学习（不进行演化）的SDDL智能体平均比同时使用学习和演化的神经智能体多存活73.67步。这些结果表明，在人工生命中，可编程策略可以超过神经策略的生存性能。
tldr: This paper compares the survival performance of neural and programmatic policies in an evolutionary reinforcement learning environment, finding that programmatic policies outperform neural policies in a reimplementation of a classic ALife testbed. It provides a fully specified and open-source reimplementation of the testbed.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了进化强化学习环境中神经策略和程序策略的生存性能，发现程序策略在经典ALife测试平台的重新实现中优于神经策略。同时，它提供了一个完全指定的开源测试平台。

title: Model of Spatial Human-Agent Interaction with Consideration for Others
summary: Communication robots often need to initiate conversations with people in public spaces. At the same time, such robots must not disturb pedestrians. To handle these two requirements, an agent needs to estimate the communication desires of others based on their behavior and then adjust its own communication activities accordingly. In this study, we construct a computational spatial interaction model that considers others. Consideration is expressed as a quantitative parameter: the amount of adjustment of one's internal state to the estimated internal state of the other. To validate the model, we experimented with a human and a virtual robot interacting in a VR environment. The results show that when the participant moves to the target, a virtual robot with a low consideration value inhibits the participant's movement, while a robot with a higher consideration value did not inhibit the participant's movement. When the participant approached the robot, the robot also exhibited approaching behavior, regardless of the consideration value, thus decreasing the participant's movement. These results appear to verify the proposed model's ability to clarify interactions with consideration for others.
summary_zh: 沟通机器人常常需要在公共空间发起与人的对话。与此同时，此类机器人又不能打扰行人。为了满足这两个要求，智能体需要根据他人的行为估计其交流意愿，并据此调整自身的交流活动。在本研究中，我们构建了一个考虑他人的计算空间交互模型。这里的“考虑”被表达为一个量化参数：即个体调整自身内部状态以适应他人估计内部状态的程度。为了验证该模型，我们进行了一项实验，让一个人和一个虚拟机器人在VR环境中互动。结果表明，当参与者向目标移动时，低“考虑”值的虚拟机器人会抑制参与者的移动，而高“考虑”值的机器人则不会。当参与者靠近机器人时，无论“考虑”值如何，机器人都会表现出靠近的行为，从而减少参与者的移动。这些结果似乎验证了所提出的模型在阐明考虑他人的交互方面的能力。
tldr: This paper presents a spatial interaction model for robots that factors in human consideration by adjusting the robot's behavior based on estimations of a person's desires. VR experiments suggest the model can differentiate between considerate and inconsiderate robot behaviors.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个空间交互模型，机器人可以通过评估人类的意愿来调整自身行为，从而考虑到人类的感受。虚拟现实实验表明，该模型可以区分周到和不周到的机器人行为。

title: Design and Development of Modular Limbs for Reconfigurable Robots on the Moon
summary: In this paper, we present the development of 4-DOF robot limbs, which we call Moonbots, designed to connect in various configurations with each other and wheel modules, enabling adaptation to different environments and tasks. These modular components are intended primarily for robotic systems in space exploration and construction on the Moon in our Moonshot project. Such modular robots add flexibility and versatility for space missions where resources are constrained. Each module is driven by a common actuator characterized by a high torque-to-speed ratio, supporting both precise control and dynamic motion when required. This unified actuator design simplifies development and maintenance across the different module types. The paper describes the hardware implementation, the mechanical design of the modules, and the overall software architecture used to control and coordinate them. Additionally, we evaluate the control performance of the actuator under various load conditions to characterize its suitability for modular robot applications. To demonstrate the adaptability of the system, we introduce nine functional configurations assembled from the same set of modules: 4DOF-limb, 8DOF-limb, vehicle, dragon, minimal, quadruped, cargo, cargo-minimal, and bike. These configurations reflect different locomotion strategies and task-specific behaviors, offering a practical foundation for further research in reconfigurable robotic systems.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了4自由度机器人肢体的开发，我们称之为Moonbots。该机器人肢体可以彼此以及与轮式模块以多种配置连接，从而适应不同的环境和任务。这些模块化组件主要用于我们的登月计划中，用于月球上的太空探索和建造的机器人系统。这种模块化机器人为资源受限的太空任务增加了灵活性和多功能性。每个模块由具有高力矩-转速比的通用执行器驱动，可在需要时支持精确控制和动态运动。这种统一的执行器设计简化了不同模块类型的开发和维护。本文描述了硬件实现、模块的机械设计以及用于控制和协调它们的整体软件架构。此外，我们评估了执行器在各种负载条件下的控制性能，以表征其对模块化机器人应用的适用性。为了证明系统的适应性，我们介绍了由同一组模块组装的九种功能配置：4自由度肢体、8自由度肢体、车辆、龙、极简、四足、货物、货物-极简和自行车。这些配置反映了不同的运动策略和特定于任务的行为，为可重构机器人系统的进一步研究提供了实践基础。
tldr: This paper presents the design and development of modular robot limbs (Moonbots) for space exploration, showcasing their adaptability through various configurations for different tasks and environments on the Moon. The modularity and unified actuator design aim to improve flexibility and versatility in resource-constrained space missions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了为太空探索而设计的模块化机器人肢体 (Moonbots) 的设计和开发，展示了其在月球上适应不同任务和环境的多种配置。模块化设计和统一的驱动器旨在提高资源受限的太空任务的灵活性和通用性。

title: Fast Continuum Robot Shape and External Load State Estimation on SE(3)
summary: Previous on-manifold approaches to continuum robot state estimation have typically adopted simplified Cosserat rod models, which cannot directly account for actuation inputs or external loads. We introduce a general framework that incorporates uncertainty models for actuation (e.g., tendon tensions), applied forces and moments, process noise, boundary conditions, and arbitrary backbone measurements. By adding temporal priors across time steps, our method additionally performs joint estimation in both the spatial (arclength) and temporal domains, enabling full \textit{spacetime} state estimation. Discretizing the arclength domain yields a factor graph representation of the continuum robot model, which can be exploited for fast batch sparse nonlinear optimization in the style of SLAM. The framework is general and applies to a broad class of continuum robots; as illustrative cases, we show (i) tendon-driven robots in simulation, where we demonstrate real-time kinematics with uncertainty, tip force sensing from position feedback, and distributed load estimation from backbone strain, and (ii) a surgical concentric tube robot in experiment, where we validate accurate kinematics and tip force estimation, highlighting potential for surgical palpation.
summary_zh: 先前在流形上的连续体机器人状态估计方法通常采用简化的Cosserat杆模型，无法直接考虑驱动输入或外部负载。我们引入了一个通用框架，该框架结合了驱动（例如，肌腱张力）、施加的力和力矩、过程噪声、边界条件和任意主链测量的 Uncertainty 模型。通过添加跨时间步的时间先验，我们的方法还可以在空间（弧长）和时间域中进行联合估计，从而实现完整的 \textit{时空}状态估计。离散化弧长域会产生连续体机器人模型的因子图表示，该表示可以用于类似 SLAM 的快速批量稀疏非线性优化。该框架具有通用性，适用于广泛的连续体机器人；作为示例，我们展示了 (i) 模拟中的肌腱驱动机器人，我们演示了具有uncertainty的实时运动学、从位置反馈进行末端力传感，以及从主链应变进行分布式载荷估计，以及 (ii) 实验中的外科同心管机器人，我们验证了精确的运动学和末端力估计，突出了手术触诊的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a novel framework for fast and accurate state estimation of continuum robots, incorporating actuation inputs, external loads, and arbitrary backbone measurements using a factor graph representation for efficient optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的框架，用于快速准确地估计连续体机器人的状态，该框架结合了驱动输入、外部载荷和任意骨干测量，并使用因子图表示进行高效优化。

title: Embedding Autonomous Agents in Resource-Constrained Robotic Platforms
summary: Many embedded devices operate under resource constraints and in dynamic environments, requiring local decision-making capabilities. Enabling devices to make independent decisions in such environments can improve the responsiveness of the system and reduce the dependence on constant external control. In this work, we integrate an autonomous agent, programmed using AgentSpeak, with a small two-wheeled robot that explores a maze using its own decision-making and sensor data. Experimental results show that the agent successfully solved the maze in 59 seconds using 287 reasoning cycles, with decision phases taking less than one millisecond. These results indicate that the reasoning process is efficient enough for real-time execution on resource-constrained hardware. This integration demonstrates how high-level agent-based control can be applied to resource-constrained embedded systems for autonomous operation.
summary_zh: 许多嵌入式设备在资源受限且动态的环境中运行，需要本地决策能力。使设备能够在这样的环境中做出自主决策可以提高系统的响应速度，并降低对持续外部控制的依赖性。在这项工作中，我们集成了一个使用AgentSpeak编程的自主代理，以及一个通过自身决策和传感器数据探索迷宫的小型两轮机器人。实验结果表明，该代理成功地在59秒内利用287个推理周期解决了迷宫问题，决策阶段耗时不到一毫秒。这些结果表明，推理过程足够高效，可以在资源受限的硬件上进行实时执行。这种集成展示了如何将高级的基于代理的控制应用于资源受限的嵌入式系统以实现自主运行。
tldr: This paper demonstrates the successful integration of an AgentSpeak-programmed autonomous agent on a resource-constrained two-wheeled robot, enabling independent navigation in a maze with efficient real-time reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文展示了在资源受限的双轮机器人上成功集成了一个基于AgentSpeak编程的自主代理，使其能够在迷宫中独立导航，并具有高效的实时推理能力。

title: Driver-Intention Prediction with Deep Learning: Real-Time Brain-to-Vehicle Communication
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) allow direct communication between the brain and electronics without the need for speech or physical movement. Such interfaces can be particularly beneficial in applications requiring rapid response times, such as driving, where a vehicle's advanced driving assistance systems could benefit from immediate understanding of a driver's intentions. This study presents a novel method for predicting a driver's intention to steer using electroencephalography (EEG) signals through deep learning. A driving simulator created a controlled environment in which participants imagined controlling a vehicle during various driving scenarios, including left and right turns, as well as straight driving. A convolutional neural network (CNN) classified the detected EEG data with minimal pre-processing. Our model achieved an accuracy of 83.7% in distinguishing between the three steering intentions and demonstrated the ability of CNNs to process raw EEG data effectively. The classification accuracy was highest for right-turn segments, which suggests a potential spatial bias in brain activity. This study lays the foundation for more intuitive brain-to-vehicle communication systems.
summary_zh: 脑机接口(BCI)允许大脑与电子设备之间进行直接通信，无需言语或肢体运动。这种接口在需要快速响应的应用中尤其有益，比如驾驶，其中车辆的先进驾驶辅助系统可以从对驾驶员意图的立即理解中受益。本研究提出了一种新方法，通过深度学习利用脑电图(EEG)信号来预测驾驶员的转向意图。驾驶模拟器创建了一个受控环境，参与者在各种驾驶场景中想象控制车辆，包括左转和右转以及直线行驶。卷积神经网络(CNN)对检测到的脑电数据进行分类，且仅需最少的预处理。我们的模型在区分三种转向意图时达到了83.7%的准确率，并证明了CNN有效处理原始脑电数据的能力。右转路段的分类准确率最高，这表明大脑活动可能存在空间偏差。本研究为更直观的脑-车通信系统奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper explores using a CNN to predict driver steering intentions from EEG data in a driving simulator, achieving 83.7% accuracy in classifying left, right, and straight intentions, demonstrating the feasibility of brain-to-vehicle communication.
tldr_zh: 本文探索使用卷积神经网络（CNN）从驾驶模拟器中的脑电图（EEG）数据预测驾驶员的转向意图，在分类左转、右转和直行意图方面实现了 83.7% 的准确率，证明了脑-车通信的可行性。

title: Precomputing Multi-Agent Path Replanning using Temporal Flexibility: A Case Study on the Dutch Railway Network
summary: Executing a multi-agent plan can be challenging when an agent is delayed, because this typically creates conflicts with other agents. So, we need to quickly find a new safe plan. Replanning only the delayed agent often does not result in an efficient plan, and sometimes cannot even yield a feasible plan. On the other hand, replanning other agents may lead to a cascade of changes and delays. We show how to efficiently replan by tracking and using the temporal flexibility of other agents while avoiding cascading delays. This flexibility is the maximum delay an agent can take without changing the order of or further delaying more agents. Our algorithm, FlexSIPP, precomputes all possible plans for the delayed agent, also returning the changes for the other agents, for any single-agent delay within the given scenario. We demonstrate our method in a real-world case study of replanning trains in the densely-used Dutch railway network. Our experiments show that FlexSIPP provides effective solutions, relevant to real-world adjustments, and within a reasonable timeframe.
summary_zh: 当一个智能体延迟时，执行多智能体计划可能会面临挑战，因为这通常会导致与其他智能体发生冲突。因此，我们需要快速找到一个新的安全计划。仅对延迟的智能体进行重规划通常无法产生高效的计划，有时甚至无法产生可行的计划。另一方面，对其他智能体进行重规划可能会导致级联的变化和延迟。我们展示了如何通过跟踪和利用其他智能体的时间灵活性来高效地进行重规划，同时避免级联延迟。这种灵活性是指智能体在不改变其他更多智能体的顺序或进一步延迟它们的情况下可以承受的最大延迟。我们的算法 FlexSIPP 预先计算延迟智能体的所有可能计划，并且返回给定场景中任何单个智能体延迟时，其他智能体的更改。我们在一个实际案例研究中展示了我们的方法，即在高度密集的荷兰铁路网络中对火车进行重规划。我们的实验表明，FlexSIPP 提供了有效的解决方案，与现实世界的调整相关，并且在合理的时间范围内完成。
tldr: The paper introduces FlexSIPP, an algorithm that precomputes multi-agent path replanning solutions leveraging temporal flexibility to address delays, tested on the Dutch railway network.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为FlexSIPP的算法，该算法利用时间灵活性预先计算多智能体路径重规划解决方案，以解决延误问题，并在荷兰铁路网络上进行了测试。

title: Personalized Model-Based Design of Human Centric AI enabled CPS for Long term usage
summary: Human centric critical systems are increasingly involving artificial intelligence to enable knowledge extraction from sensor collected data. Examples include medical monitoring and control systems, gesture based human computer interaction systems, and autonomous cars. Such systems are intended to operate for a long term potentially for a lifetime in many scenarios such as closed loop blood glucose control for Type 1 diabetics, self-driving cars, and monitoting systems for stroke diagnosis, and rehabilitation. Long term operation of such AI enabled human centric applications can expose them to corner cases for which their operation is may be uncertain. This can be due to many reasons such as inherent flaws in the design, limited resources for testing, inherent computational limitations of the testing methodology, or unknown use cases resulting from human interaction with the system. Such untested corner cases or cases for which the system performance is uncertain can lead to violations in the safety, sustainability, and security requirements of the system. In this paper, we analyze the existing techniques for safety, sustainability, and security analysis of an AI enabled human centric control system and discuss their limitations for testing the system for long term use in practice. We then propose personalized model based solutions for potentially eliminating such limitations.
summary_zh: 以人为中心的关键系统越来越多地采用人工智能技术，以实现从传感器收集的数据中提取知识。例如，医疗监控和控制系统、基于手势的人机交互系统和自动驾驶汽车。此类系统旨在长期运行，在许多场景中甚至可能终身运行，例如针对1型糖尿病患者的闭环血糖控制、自动驾驶汽车以及用于中风诊断和康复的监控系统。基于人工智能的以人为中心的应用的长期运行可能会使其暴露于边缘案例，在这些案例中，其运行可能是不确定的。这可能是由于多种原因造成的，例如设计中固有的缺陷、有限的测试资源、测试方法固有的计算限制，或由于人与系统交互而产生的未知用例。这些未经测试的边缘案例或系统性能不确定的案例可能会导致系统在安全性、可持续性和安全方面的要求受到违反。在本文中，我们分析了现有的针对基于人工智能的以人为中心控制系统的安全性、可持续性和安全性分析技术，并讨论了它们在测试系统以供长期实际使用方面的局限性。然后，我们提出了基于个性化模型的解决方案，以潜在地消除这些局限性。
tldr: This paper discusses the limitations of current safety, sustainability, and security analysis techniques for long-term AI-enabled human-centric systems and proposes personalized model-based solutions to address these limitations.
tldr_zh: 该论文讨论了当前针对长期人工智能赋能的人为中心系统的安全性、可持续性和安全性分析技术的局限性，并提出了个性化的基于模型解决方案以解决这些问题。

title: Paradoxical noise preference in RNNs
summary: In recurrent neural networks (RNNs) used to model biological neural networks, noise is typically introduced during training to emulate biological variability and regularize learning. The expectation is that removing the noise at test time should preserve or improve performance. Contrary to this intuition, we find that continuous-time recurrent neural networks (CTRNNs) often perform best at a nonzero noise level, specifically, the same level used during training. This noise preference typically arises when noise is injected inside the neural activation function; networks trained with noise injected outside the activation function perform best with zero noise. Through analyses of simple function approximation, maze navigation, and single neuron regulator tasks, we show that the phenomenon stems from noise-induced shifts of fixed points (stationary distributions) in the underlying stochastic dynamics of the RNNs. These fixed point shifts are noise-level dependent and bias the network outputs when the noise is removed, degrading performance. Analytical and numerical results show that the bias arises when neural states operate near activation function nonlinearities, where noise is asymmetrically attenuated, and that performance optimization incentivizes operation near these nonlinearities. Thus, networks can overfit to the stochastic training environment itself rather than just to the input-output data. The phenomenon is distinct from stochastic resonance, wherein nonzero noise enhances signal processing. Our findings reveal that training noise can become an integral part of the computation learned by recurrent networks, with implications for understanding neural population dynamics and for the design of robust artificial RNNs.
summary_zh: 在用于模拟生物神经网络的循环神经网络（RNN）中，通常在训练期间引入噪声，以模拟生物变异并正则化学习。人们期望在测试时消除噪声应保持或提高性能。与这种直觉相反，我们发现连续时间循环神经网络（CTRNN）通常在非零噪声水平下表现最佳，具体来说，是训练期间使用的相同水平。这种噪声偏好通常出现在噪声被注入到神经元激活函数内部时；使用注入在激活函数外部的噪声训练的网络在零噪声下表现最佳。通过对简单函数逼近、迷宫导航和单神经元调节器任务的分析，我们表明这种现象源于RNN底层随机动力学中不动点（平稳分布）的噪声诱导偏移。这些不动点偏移与噪声水平相关，并在噪声消除时偏置网络输出，从而降低性能。分析和数值结果表明，当神经元状态在激活函数的非线性区域附近运行时，会产生偏差，此时噪声被不对称地衰减，并且性能优化激励在这些非线性区域附近运行。因此，网络可能会过度拟合到随机训练环境本身，而不仅仅是输入-输出数据。这种现象与随机共振不同，后者的非零噪声增强了信号处理。我们的发现表明，训练噪声可能成为循环网络学习到的计算不可分割的一部分，这对理解神经种群动力学和设计鲁棒的人工RNN具有重要意义。
tldr: The paper demonstrates that recurrent neural networks (RNNs) can exhibit paradoxical noise preference, where performance is optimal at a non-zero noise level matching the training noise. This is attributed to noise-induced fixed point shifts and overfitting to the stochastic training environment.
tldr_zh: 该论文表明，循环神经网络(RNNs)可能表现出反常的噪声偏好，即在与训练噪声相匹配的非零噪声水平下，性能达到最佳。这归因于噪声引起的固定点漂移以及对随机训练环境的过度拟合。

title: TSSR: Two-Stage Swap-Reward-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Character-Level SMILES Generation
summary: The design of reliable, valid, and diverse molecules is fundamental to modern drug discovery, as improved molecular generation supports efficient exploration of the chemical space for potential drug candidates and reduces the cost of early design efforts. Despite these needs, current chemical language models that generate molecules as SMILES strings are vulnerable to compounding token errors: many samples are unparseable or chemically implausible, and hard constraints meant to prevent failure can restrict exploration. To address this gap, we introduce TSSR, a Two-Stage, Swap-Reward-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework for character-level SMILES generation. Stage one rewards local token swaps that repair syntax, promoting transitions from invalid to parseable strings. Stage two provides chemistry-aware feedback from RDKit diagnostics, rewarding reductions in valence, aromaticity, and connectivity issues. The reward decomposes into interpretable terms (swap efficiency, error reduction, distance to validity), is model agnostic, and requires no task-specific labels or hand-crafted grammars. We evaluated TSSR on the MOSES benchmark using a GRU policy trained with PPO in both pure RL (P-RL) from random initialization and fine-tuning RL (F-RL) starting from a pretrained chemical language model, assessing 10,000 generated SMILES per run. In P-RL, TSSR significantly improves syntactic validity, chemical validity, and novelty. In F-RL, TSSR preserves drug-likeness and synthesizability while increasing validity and novelty. Token-level analysis shows that syntax edits and chemistry fixes act jointly to reduce RDKit detected errors. TSSR converts a sparse terminal objective into a denser and more interpretable reward, improving both syntactic and chemical quality without reducing diversity. TSSR is dataset-agnostic and can be adapted to various reinforcement learning approaches.
summary_zh: 可靠、有效且多样化的分子设计是现代药物发现的基础，因为改进的分子生成有助于高效探索化学空间以寻找潜在的候选药物，并降低早期设计工作的成本。尽管有这些需求，但当前将分子生成为SMILES字符串的化学语言模型容易出现复合式的token错误：许多样本无法解析或在化学上不可信，而旨在防止失败的硬约束可能会限制探索。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了TSSR，一个用于字符级SMILES生成的双阶段、交换奖励驱动的强化学习（RL）框架。第一阶段奖励修复语法的局部token交换，从而促进从无效字符串到可解析字符串的转换。第二阶段提供来自RDKit诊断程序的化学感知反馈，奖励效价、芳香性和连接性问题的减少。该奖励分解为可解释的项（交换效率、错误减少、与有效性的距离），与模型无关，并且不需要特定于任务的标签或手工制作的语法。我们使用在MOSES基准上进行评估，使用在纯强化学习（P-RL）中从随机初始化训练以及在从预训练化学语言模型开始进行微调强化学习（F-RL）中训练的PPO GRU策略，每次运行评估10,000个生成的SMILES。在P-RL中，TSSR显著提高了句法有效性、化学有效性和新颖性。在F-RL中，TSSR在提高有效性和新颖性的同时，保持了类药性和可合成性。Token级别的分析表明，语法编辑和化学修复共同作用以减少RDKit检测到的错误。TSSR将稀疏的终端目标转化为更密集且更可解释的奖励，从而在不降低多样性的前提下，提高句法和化学质量。TSSR与数据集无关，可以适应各种强化学习方法。
tldr: The paper introduces TSSR, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework using token swaps and RDKit diagnostics to improve the validity and novelty of generated SMILES strings for drug discovery, outperforming existing methods. It addresses problems with chemical language models by introducing reward decomposing and error reduction mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 TSSR，一个两阶段强化学习框架，使用 token 交换和 RDKit 诊断来提高生成 SMILES 字符串的有效性和新颖性，优于现有方法。它通过引入奖励分解和减少错误机制来解决化学语言模型的问题。

title: Higher-Order Adversarial Patches for Real-Time Object Detectors
summary: Higher-order adversarial attacks can directly be considered the result of a cat-and-mouse game -- an elaborate action involving constant pursuit, near captures, and repeated escapes. This idiom describes the enduring circular training of adversarial attack patterns and adversarial training the best. The following work investigates the impact of higher-order adversarial attacks on object detectors by successively training attack patterns and hardening object detectors with adversarial training. The YOLOv10 object detector is chosen as a representative, and adversarial patches are used in an evasion attack manner. Our results indicate that higher-order adversarial patches are not only affecting the object detector directly trained on but rather provide a stronger generalization capacity compared to lower-order adversarial patches. Moreover, the results highlight that solely adversarial training is not sufficient to harden an object detector efficiently against this kind of adversarial attack. Code: https://github.com/JensBayer/HigherOrder
summary_zh: 高阶对抗攻击可以直接被视为一种猫鼠游戏的结果——一种涉及持续追踪、险些捕获和反复逃脱的精心行动。这个习语最能描述对抗攻击模式和对抗训练两者之间持久的循环训练。本文研究了高阶对抗攻击对目标检测器的影响，方法是通过连续训练攻击模式并使用对抗训练来强化目标检测器。我们选择YOLOv10目标检测器作为代表，并以规避攻击的方式使用对抗补丁。我们的结果表明，高阶对抗补丁不仅影响直接训练的目标检测器，而且与低阶对抗补丁相比，提供了更强的泛化能力。此外，结果还强调仅靠对抗训练不足以有效地强化目标检测器，使其免受此类对抗攻击。代码：https://github.com/JensBayer/HigherOrder
tldr: This paper explores the effectiveness of higher-order adversarial patches in evading YOLOv10 object detectors and finds they generalize better than lower-order patches while highlighting the limitations of standard adversarial training against such attacks.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了高阶对抗补丁在规避 YOLOv10 目标检测器方面的有效性，发现它们比低阶补丁具有更好的泛化能力，并强调了标准对抗训练在对抗此类攻击方面的局限性。

title: OceanSplat: Object-aware Gaussian Splatting with Trinocular View Consistency for Underwater Scene Reconstruction
summary: We introduce OceanSplat, a novel 3D Gaussian Splatting-based approach for accurately representing 3D geometry in underwater scenes. To overcome multi-view inconsistencies caused by underwater optical degradation, our method enforces trinocular view consistency by rendering horizontally and vertically translated camera views relative to each input view and aligning them via inverse warping. Furthermore, these translated camera views are used to derive a synthetic epipolar depth prior through triangulation, which serves as a self-supervised depth regularizer. These geometric constraints facilitate the spatial optimization of 3D Gaussians and preserve scene structure in underwater environments. We also propose a depth-aware alpha adjustment that modulates the opacity of 3D Gaussians during early training based on their $z$-component and viewing direction, deterring the formation of medium-induced primitives. With our contributions, 3D Gaussians are disentangled from the scattering medium, enabling robust representation of object geometry and significantly reducing floating artifacts in reconstructed underwater scenes. Experiments on real-world underwater and simulated scenes demonstrate that OceanSplat substantially outperforms existing methods for both scene reconstruction and restoration in scattering media.
summary_zh: 我们介绍 OceanSplat，一种新颖的基于 3D 高斯 Splatting 的方法，用于精确地表示水下场景中的 3D 几何结构。为了克服水下光学退化导致的多视图不一致性，我们的方法通过渲染相对于每个输入视图水平和垂直平移的相机视图，并通过逆向扭曲对齐它们，从而强制执行三目视图一致性。此外，这些平移后的相机视图被用来通过三角测量导出合成的极线深度先验，作为自监督深度正则化器。这些几何约束有助于 3D 高斯体的空间优化，并在水下环境中保持场景结构。我们还提出了一种深度感知的 Alpha 调整，该调整在早期训练期间基于 3D 高斯体的 $z$ 分量和视角方向来调节 3D 高斯体的不透明度，从而阻止介质诱导的基元的形成。通过我们的贡献，3D 高斯体与散射介质分离，从而能够稳健地表示物体几何结构，并显著减少重建的水下场景中的漂浮伪影。在真实水下和模拟场景上的实验表明，OceanSplat 在散射介质中的场景重建和恢复方面，显著优于现有方法。
tldr: OceanSplat introduces a novel Gaussian Splatting approach for underwater scene reconstruction, addressing inconsistencies caused by optical degradation via trinocular view consistency and a synthetic epipolar depth prior.
tldr_zh: OceanSplat 提出了一种新的基于高斯溅射的水下场景重建方法，通过三目视图一致性和合成的极线深度先验来解决光学退化引起的不一致性。

title: SparseLaneSTP: Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Priors with Sparse Transformers for 3D Lane Detection
summary: 3D lane detection has emerged as a critical challenge in autonomous driving, encompassing identification and localization of lane markings and the 3D road surface. Conventional 3D methods detect lanes from dense birds-eye-viewed (BEV) features, though erroneous transformations often result in a poor feature representation misaligned with the true 3D road surface. While recent sparse lane detectors have surpassed dense BEV approaches, they completely disregard valuable lane-specific priors. Furthermore, existing methods fail to utilize historic lane observations, which yield the potential to resolve ambiguities in situations of poor visibility. To address these challenges, we present SparseLaneSTP, a novel method that integrates both geometric properties of the lane structure and temporal information into a sparse lane transformer. It introduces a new lane-specific spatio-temporal attention mechanism, a continuous lane representation tailored for sparse architectures as well as temporal regularization. Identifying weaknesses of existing 3D lane datasets, we also introduce a precise and consistent 3D lane dataset using a simple yet effective auto-labeling strategy. Our experimental section proves the benefits of our contributions and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across all detection and error metrics on existing 3D lane detection benchmarks as well as on our novel dataset.
summary_zh: 3D车道线检测已成为自动驾驶领域的一项关键挑战，其包括车道线标记和3D路面识别与定位。传统的3D方法通常从密集的鸟瞰图（BEV）特征中检测车道线，但错误的变换往往导致特征表示不良，与真实的3D路面错位。虽然最近的稀疏车道线检测器已经超越了密集的BEV方法，但它们完全忽略了有价值的车道线特有先验知识。此外，现有方法未能利用历史车道线观测，这能够解决在低能见度情况下的歧义性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出SparseLaneSTP，一种将车道线结构的几何属性和时间信息集成到稀疏车道线Transformer中的新方法。它引入了一种新的车道线特有的时空注意力机制、一种为稀疏架构定制化的连续车道线表示以及时间正则化。针对现有3D车道线数据集的缺陷，我们还引入了一种使用简单而有效的自动标注策略构建的精确且一致的3D车道线数据集。我们的实验部分证明了我们贡献的优势，并展示了在现有3D车道线检测基准以及我们新数据集上的所有检测和误差指标方面的最先进性能。
tldr: This paper introduces SparseLaneSTP, a novel 3D lane detection method using sparse transformers with spatio-temporal priors. It also introduces a new 3D lane dataset with an auto-labeling strategy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SparseLaneSTP，一种使用具有时空先验的稀疏Transformer的新型3D车道检测方法。它还引入了一个使用自动标注策略的新的3D车道数据集。

title: DivAS: Interactive 3D Segmentation of NeRFs via Depth-Weighted Voxel Aggregation
summary: Existing methods for segmenting Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) are often optimization-based, requiring slow per-scene training that sacrifices the zero-shot capabilities of 2D foundation models. We introduce DivAS (Depth-interactive Voxel Aggregation Segmentation), an optimization-free, fully interactive framework that addresses these limitations. Our method operates via a fast GUI-based workflow where 2D SAM masks, generated from user point prompts, are refined using NeRF-derived depth priors to improve geometric accuracy and foreground-background separation. The core of our contribution is a custom CUDA kernel that aggregates these refined multi-view masks into a unified 3D voxel grid in under 200ms, enabling real-time visual feedback. This optimization-free design eliminates the need for per-scene training. Experiments on Mip-NeRF 360° and LLFF show that DivAS achieves segmentation quality comparable to optimization-based methods, while being 2-2.5x faster end-to-end, and up to an order of magnitude faster when excluding user prompting time.
summary_zh: 用于分割神经辐射场（NeRFs）的现有方法通常基于优化，需要缓慢的单场景训练，从而牺牲了2D基础模型的零样本能力。我们提出了DivAS（深度交互体素聚合分割），一个无需优化、完全交互式的框架，旨在解决这些局限性。我们的方法通过快速的基于GUI的工作流程运作，其中从用户点提示生成的2D SAM掩码，通过使用NeRF衍生的深度先验进行细化，以提高几何精度和前景-背景分离。我们的核心贡献是一个定制的CUDA内核，可在200毫秒内将这些精细化的多视角掩码聚合到一个统一的3D体素网格中，从而实现实时的视觉反馈。这种无需优化的设计消除了对单场景训练的需求。在Mip-NeRF 360°和LLFF上的实验表明，DivAS的分割质量可与基于优化的方法相媲美，同时端到端的速度快2-2.5倍，如果在不包括用户提示时间的情况下，速度可快一个数量级。
tldr: The paper introduces DivAS, a novel, optimization-free interactive 3D segmentation framework for NeRFs using depth-weighted voxel aggregation achieving comparable segmentation quality to optimization-based methods with significant speed improvements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DivAS，一种新颖的、无需优化的交互式NeRFs 3D分割框架，通过深度加权体素聚合实现。该方法在显著提高速度的同时，达到了与基于优化的方法相当的分割质量。

title: Detection of Deployment Operational Deviations for Safety and Security of AI-Enabled Human-Centric Cyber Physical Systems
summary:
In recent years, Human-centric cyber-physical systems have increasingly involved artificial intelligence to enable knowledge extraction from sensor-collected data. Examples include medical monitoring and control systems, as well as autonomous cars. Such systems are intended to operate according to the protocols and guidelines for regular system operations. However, in many scenarios, such as closed-loop blood glucose control for Type 1 diabetics, self-driving cars, and monitoring systems for stroke diagnosis. The operations of such AI-enabled human-centric applications can expose them to cases for which their operational mode may be uncertain, for instance, resulting from the interactions with a human with the system. Such cases, in which the system is in uncertain conditions, can violate the system's safety and security requirements. 
  This paper will discuss operational deviations that can lead these systems to operate in unknown conditions. We will then create a framework to evaluate different strategies for ensuring the safety and security of AI-enabled human-centric cyber-physical systems in operation deployment. Then, as an example, we show a personalized image-based novel technique for detecting the non-announcement of meals in closed-loop blood glucose control for Type 1 diabetics.
summary_zh:
近年来，以人为中心的网络物理系统越来越多地采用人工智能技术，以便从传感器收集的数据中提取知识。例如，医疗监控和控制系统以及自动驾驶汽车。这些系统旨在根据常规系统操作的协议和指南运行。然而，在许多场景中，例如1型糖尿病的闭环血糖控制、自动驾驶汽车以及卒中诊断的监控系统，这些AI驱动的以人为中心的应用程序的操作可能会使其面临工作模式不确定的情况，例如由于与系统中的人交互而导致的情况。这些系统处于不确定条件下的情况可能会违反系统的安全和保障要求。

本文将探讨可能导致这些系统在未知条件下运行的操作偏差。然后，我们将创建一个框架来评估在运营部署中确保AI驱动的以人为中心的网络物理系统的安全和保障的不同策略。然后，作为一个例子，我们展示了一种个性化的基于图像的新型技术，用于检测1型糖尿病闭环血糖控制中未宣布的用餐。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework to detect operational deviations in AI-enabled human-centric cyber-physical systems, exemplified by a novel technique for meal detection in closed-loop blood glucose control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种框架，用于检测人工智能人本网络物理系统中操作偏差，并以闭环血糖控制中膳食检测的新技术为例。

title: A zone-based training approach for last-mile routing using Graph Neural Networks and Pointer Networks
summary:
Rapid e-commerce growth has pushed last-mile delivery networks to their limits, where small routing gains translate into lower costs, faster service, and fewer emissions. Classical heuristics struggle to adapt when travel times are highly asymmetric (e.g., one-way streets, congestion). A deep learning-based approach to the last-mile routing problem is presented to generate geographical zones composed of stop sequences to minimize last-mile delivery times.
  The presented approach is an encoder-decoder architecture. Each route is represented as a complete directed graph whose nodes are stops and whose edge weights are asymmetric travel times. A Graph Neural Network encoder produces node embeddings that captures the spatial relationships between stops. A Pointer Network decoder then takes the embeddings and the route's start node to sequentially select the next stops, assigning a probability to each unvisited node as the next destination.
  Cells of a Discrete Global Grid System which contain route stops in the training data are obtained and clustered to generate geographical zones of similar size in which the process of training and inference are divided. Subsequently, a different instance of the model is trained per zone only considering the stops of the training routes which are included in that zone.
  This approach is evaluated using the Los Angeles routes from the 2021 Amazon Last Mile Routing Challenge. Results from general and zone-based training are compared, showing a reduction in the average predicted route length in the zone-based training compared to the general training. The performance improvement of the zone-based approach becomes more pronounced as the number of stops per route increases.
summary_zh:
快速增长的电子商务已经将末端配送网络推向极限，在此背景下，小幅的路径优化都可能转化为更低的成本、更快的服务和更少的排放。当通行时间高度不对称（例如，单行道、拥堵）时，经典的启发式算法难以适应。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的末端路由问题解决方法，该方法生成由停靠点序列组成地理区域，以最大限度地减少末端配送时间。

提出的方法是一种编码器-解码器架构。每条路径都被表示为一个完整的有向图，其节点为停靠点，边权重为不对称通行时间。图神经网络编码器产生节点嵌入，捕捉停靠点之间的空间关系。然后，指针网络解码器利用这些嵌入和路径的起始节点，顺序地选择下一个停靠点，为每个未访问的节点分配一个作为下一个目的地的概率。

获取训练数据中包含路径停靠点的离散全局网格系统的单元格，并通过聚类生成大小相似的地理区域，并在这些区域中进行训练和推理。 随后，针对每个区域训练一个不同的模型实例，仅考虑包含在该区域的训练路径的停靠点。

该方法使用2021年亚马逊末端路由挑战赛中的洛杉矶路径数据进行评估。对通用训练和基于区域的训练结果进行了比较，显示基于区域的训练相比于通用训练，平均预测路径长度有所减少。随着每条路径停靠点数量的增加，基于区域的方法的性能改进变得更加显著。
tldr: This paper presents a zone-based training approach using Graph Neural Networks and Pointer Networks for last-mile routing, showing improved route length prediction on the Amazon Last Mile Routing Challenge dataset compared to general training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于区域的训练方法，使用图神经网络和指针网络进行最后一英里路线规划。结果表明，与一般训练相比，该方法在 Amazon Last Mile Routing Challenge 数据集上提高了路线长度预测的准确性。

title: Timeliness-Oriented Scheduling and Resource Allocation in Multi-Region Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception (CP) is a critical technology in applications like autonomous driving and smart cities. It involves the sharing and fusion of information among sensors to overcome the limitations of individual perception, such as blind spots and range limitations. However, CP faces two primary challenges. First, due to the dynamic nature of the environment, the timeliness of the transmitted information is critical to perception performance. Second, with limited computational power at the sensors and constrained wireless bandwidth, the communication volume must be carefully designed to ensure feature representations are both effective and sufficient. This work studies the dynamic scheduling problem in a multi-region CP scenario, and presents a Timeliness-Aware Multi-region Prioritized (TAMP) scheduling algorithm to trade-off perception accuracy and communication resource usage. Timeliness reflects the utility of information that decays as time elapses, which is manifested by the perception performance in CP tasks. We propose an empirical penalty function that maps the joint impact of Age of Information (AoI) and communication volume to perception performance. Aiming to minimize this timeliness-oriented penalty in the long-term, and recognizing that scheduling decisions have a cumulative effect on subsequent system states, we propose the TAMP scheduling algorithm. TAMP is a Lyapunov-based optimization policy that decomposes the long-term average objective into a per-slot prioritization problem, balancing the scheduling worth against resource cost. We validate our algorithm in both intersection and corridor scenarios with the real-world Roadside Cooperative perception (RCooper) dataset. Extensive simulations demonstrate that TAMP outperforms the best-performing baseline, achieving an Average Precision (AP) improvement of up to 27% across various configurations.
summary_zh: 协同感知（CP）是自动驾驶和智慧城市等应用中的一项关键技术。它涉及传感器之间信息的共享和融合，以克服个体感知的局限性，例如盲点和范围限制。然而，CP面临两个主要挑战。首先，由于环境的动态性，传输信息的时效性对于感知性能至关重要。其次，由于传感器端计算能力有限以及无线带宽受限，通信量必须经过仔细设计，以确保特征表示既有效又充分。本文研究了多区域CP场景中的动态调度问题，并提出了一种时效性感知的多区域优先级（TAMP）调度算法，以权衡感知精度和通信资源的使用。时效性反映了信息随着时间推移而衰减的效用，这体现在CP任务中的感知性能上。我们提出了一个经验惩罚函数，将信息年龄（AoI）和通信量的联合影响映射到感知性能。为了最大限度地减少这种面向时效性的长期惩罚，并认识到调度决策对后续系统状态具有累积效应，我们提出了TAMP调度算法。TAMP是一种基于李雅普诺夫优化的策略，它将长期平均目标分解为每个时隙的优先级问题，从而平衡调度价值和资源成本。我们使用真实世界的路侧协同感知（RCooper）数据集在交叉路口和走廊场景中验证了我们的算法。大量的仿真结果表明，TAMP优于性能最佳的基线，在各种配置下实现了高达27%的平均精度（AP）提升。
tldr: This paper addresses the problem of dynamic scheduling and resource allocation in multi-region collaborative perception to improve timeliness and accuracy, presenting a Lyapunov-based algorithm (TAMP) that outperforms existing baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文解决了多区域协同感知中动态调度和资源分配问题，旨在提高及时性和准确性。论文提出了一种基于Lyapunov的算法（TAMP），优于现有基线。

title: Phasor Agents: Oscillatory Graphs with Three-Factor Plasticity and Sleep-Staged Learning
summary:
Phasor Agents are dynamical systems whose internal state is a Phasor Graph: a weighted graph of coupled Stuart-Landau oscillators. A Stuart-Landau oscillator is a minimal stable "rhythm generator" (the normal form near a Hopf bifurcation); each oscillator is treated as an abstract computational unit (inspired by, but not claiming to model, biological oscillatory populations). In this interpretation, oscillator phase tracks relative timing (coherence), while amplitude tracks local gain or activity. Relative phase structure serves as a representational medium; coupling weights are learned via three-factor local plasticity - eligibility traces gated by sparse global modulators and oscillation-timed write windows - without backpropagation.
  A central challenge in oscillatory substrates is stability: online weight updates can drive the network into unwanted regimes (e.g., global synchrony), collapsing representational diversity. We therefore separate wake tagging from offline consolidation, inspired by synaptic tagging-and-capture and sleep-stage dynamics: deep-sleep-like gated capture commits tagged changes safely, while REM-like replay reconstructs and perturbs experience for planning.
  A staged experiment suite validates each mechanism with ablations and falsifiers: eligibility traces preserve credit under delayed modulation; compression-progress signals pass timestamp-shuffle controls; phase-coherent retrieval reaches 4x diffusive baselines under noise; wake/sleep separation expands stable learning by 67 percent under matched weight-norm budgets; REM replay improves maze success rate by +45.5 percentage points; and a Tolman-style latent-learning signature - immediate competence and detour advantage after unrewarded exploration, consistent with an internal model - emerges from replay (Tolman, 1948).
  The codebase and all artifacts are open-source.
summary_zh:
相位代理（Phasor Agents）是动态系统，其内部状态是一个相位图：一个由耦合的斯图亚特-朗道振荡器组成的加权图。斯图亚特-朗道振荡器是一个最小的稳定“节奏发生器”（霍普夫分岔附近的标准型）；每个振荡器被视为一个抽象的计算单元（灵感来自生物振荡群体，但并非声称对其进行建模）。在这种解释中，振荡器相位追踪相对时间（相干性），而振幅追踪局部增益或活动。相对相位结构充当一种表征媒介；耦合权重通过三因子局部可塑性学习——资格迹通过稀疏的全局调制器和振荡定时写入窗口门控——无需反向传播。

振荡基质的一个核心挑战是稳定性：在线的权重更新可能将网络驱动到不想要的模式（例如，全局同步），导致表征多样性的崩溃。因此，我们受到突触标记和捕获以及睡眠阶段动态的启发，将清醒标记与离线巩固分离：类似深度睡眠的门控捕获安全地提交标记的更改，而类似快速眼动睡眠的重播重建和扰动经验以进行规划。

一个分阶段的实验套件通过消融和证伪验证了每个机制：资格迹在延迟调制下保留信用；压缩进度信号通过时间戳洗牌控制；相位相干检索在噪声下达到扩散基线的4倍；在匹配的权重范数预算下，清醒/睡眠分离将稳定学习扩展了67%；快速眼动睡眠重播将迷宫成功率提高了+45.5个百分点；并且来自重播（Tolman，1948）出现了一个托尔曼式的潜在学习签名——在无奖励探索之后立即具备能力和绕道优势，这与内部模型一致。

代码库和所有工件都是开源的。
tldr: The paper introduces 'Phasor Agents,' a novel dynamical system using coupled Stuart-Landau oscillators with three-factor plasticity and sleep-staged learning to address stability challenges in oscillatory substrates, demonstrating improved performance on tasks like maze solving through REM replay.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了“Phasor Agents”，一种新颖的动态系统，它使用耦合的 Stuart-Landau 振荡器以及三因素可塑性和睡眠阶段的学习，来解决振荡基质中的稳定性挑战，并通过 REM 重放证明了其在迷宫求解等任务中的性能提升。

title: Lightweight Test-Time Adaptation for EMG-Based Gesture Recognition
summary: Reliable long-term decoding of surface electromyography (EMG) is hindered by signal drift caused by electrode shifts, muscle fatigue, and posture changes. While state-of-the-art models achieve high intra-session accuracy, their performance often degrades sharply. Existing solutions typically demand large datasets or high-compute pipelines that are impractical for energy-efficient wearables. We propose a lightweight framework for Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) backbone. We introduce three deployment-ready strategies: (i) causal adaptive batch normalization for real-time statistical alignment; (ii) a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) alignment with experience replay to prevent forgetting; and (iii) meta-learning for rapid, few-shot calibration. Evaluated on the NinaPro DB6 multi-session dataset, our framework significantly bridges the inter-session accuracy gap with minimal overhead. Our results show that experience-replay updates yield superior stability under limited data, while meta-learning achieves competitive performance in one- and two-shot regimes using only a fraction of the data required by current benchmarks. This work establishes a path toward robust, "plug-and-play" myoelectric control for long-term prosthetic use.
summary_zh: 表面肌电（EMG）可靠的长期解码受到电极移位、肌肉疲劳和姿势变化引起的信号漂移的阻碍。虽然目前最先进的模型能够实现较高的会话内精度，但它们的性能通常会急剧下降。现有的解决方案通常需要大型数据集或高算力管道，这对于节能型可穿戴设备来说是不切实际的。我们提出了一种轻量级的测试时自适应（TTA）框架，使用时间卷积网络（TCN）作为主干。我们引入了三种可部署的策略：（i）用于实时统计对齐的因果自适应批归一化；（ii）采用经验回放的高斯混合模型（GMM）对齐以防止遗忘；以及（iii）用于快速、少样本校准的元学习。在NinaPro DB6多会话数据集上的评估表明，我们的框架以最小的开销显著缩小了会话间的精度差距。我们的结果表明，经验回放更新在有限数据下产生优异的稳定性，而元学习仅使用当前基准所需数据的一小部分，就能在单次和两次学习体制中实现具有竞争力的性能。这项工作为长期假肢使用的稳健、“即插即用”的肌电控制奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight test-time adaptation framework for EMG-based gesture recognition to address signal drift, using techniques like adaptive batch normalization, GMM alignment with experience replay, and meta-learning, achieving improved inter-session accuracy with minimal overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级的肌电信号手势识别测试时自适应框架，通过自适应批归一化、带经验回放的GMM对齐和元学习等技术，解决了信号漂移问题，并以最小的开销提高了会话间准确性。

title: Compensation Effect Amplification Control (CEAC): A movement-based approach for coordinated position and velocity control of the elbow of upper-limb prostheses
summary: Despite advances in upper-limb (UL) prosthetic design, achieving intuitive control of intermediate joints - such as the wrist and elbow - remains challenging, particularly for continuous and velocity-modulated movements. We introduce a novel movement-based control paradigm entitled Compensation Effect Amplification Control (CEAC) that leverages users' trunk flexion and extension as input for controlling prosthetic elbow velocity. Considering that the trunk can be both a functional and compensatory joint when performing upper-limb actions, CEAC amplifies the natural coupling between trunk and prosthesis while introducing a controlled delay that allows users to modulate both the position and velocity of the prosthetic joint. We evaluated CEAC in a generic drawing task performed by twelve able-bodied participants using a supernumerary prosthesis with an active elbow. Additionally a multiple-target-reaching task was performed by a subset of ten participants. Results demonstrate task performances comparable to those obtained with natural arm movements, even when gesture velocity or drawing size were varied, while maintaining ergonomic trunk postures. Analysis revealed that CEAC effectively restores joint coordinated action, distributes movement effort between trunk and elbow, enabling intuitive trajectory control without requiring extreme compensatory movements. Overall, CEAC offers a promising control strategy for intermediate joints of UL prostheses, particularly in tasks requiring continuous and precise coordination.
summary_zh: 尽管上肢（UL）假肢设计取得了进展，但实现对中间关节（如腕关节和肘关节）的直观控制仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在连续且速度调制的运动中。我们引入了一种名为“补偿效应放大控制（CEAC）”的新型基于运动的控制范式，该范式利用用户的躯干屈曲和伸展作为控制假肢肘关节速度的输入。考虑到躯干在进行上肢动作时既可以是功能性关节，也可以是代偿性关节，CEAC放大了躯干和假肢之间的自然耦合，同时引入了可控的延迟，使用户能够调节假肢关节的位置和速度。我们通过一项通用绘图任务评估了CEAC，该任务由十二名健全参与者使用具有主动肘部的超量假肢执行。此外，十名参与者中的一个子集执行了一项多目标到达任务。结果表明，即使在手势速度或绘图尺寸发生变化时，任务表现也能与自然手臂运动的表现相媲美，同时保持符合人体工程学的躯干姿势。分析表明，CEAC有效地恢复了关节协调运动，在躯干和肘关节之间分配了运动负荷，从而实现了直观的轨迹控制，而无需极端的代偿性运动。总体而言，CEAC为上肢假肢的中间关节提供了一种有前景的控制策略，尤其是在需要连续且精确协调的任务中。
tldr: This paper introduces Compensation Effect Amplification Control (CEAC), a novel method for controlling prosthetic elbow velocity using trunk movements, demonstrating improved performance and intuitive control in drawing and reaching tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为补偿效应放大控制（CEAC）的新方法，该方法利用躯干运动来控制假肢肘部速度，并在绘画和抓取任务中展示了改进的性能和直观的控制。

title: DAVOS: An Autonomous Vehicle Operating System in the Vehicle Computing Era
summary: Vehicle computing represents a fundamental shift in how autonomous vehicles are designed and deployed, transforming them from isolated transportation systems into mobile computing platforms that support both safety-critical, real-time driving and data-centric services. In this setting, vehicles simultaneously support real-time driving pipelines and a growing set of data-driven applications, placing increased responsibility on the vehicle operating system to coordinate computation, data movement, storage, and access. These demands highlight recurring system considerations related to predictable execution, data and execution protection, efficient handling of high-rate sensor data, and long-term system evolvability, commonly summarized as Safety, Security, Efficiency, and Extensibility (SSEE). Existing vehicle operating systems and runtimes address these concerns in isolation, resulting in fragmented software stacks that limit coordination between autonomy workloads and vehicle data services. This paper presents DAVOS, the Delaware Autonomous Vehicle Operating System, a unified vehicle operating system architecture designed for the vehicle computing context. DAVOS provides a cohesive operating system foundation that supports both real-time autonomy and extensible vehicle computing within a single system framework.
summary_zh: 车辆计算代表了自动驾驶汽车设计和部署方式的根本性转变，将它们从孤立的交通运输系统转变为移动计算平台，既支持安全关键的实时驾驶，又支持以数据为中心的服务。在这种背景下，车辆同时支持实时驾驶流程和日益增长的数据驱动型应用程序，这使得车辆操作系统承担了更大的责任，需要协调计算、数据移动、存储和访问。这些需求突出了与可预测执行、数据和执行保护、高效处理高速率传感器数据以及长期系统可演化性相关的反复出现的系统考量，通常概括为安全性、安全性、效率和可扩展性 (SSEE)。现有的车辆操作系统和运行时分别孤立地解决这些问题，导致软件堆栈碎片化，限制了自动驾驶工作负载和车辆数据服务之间的协调。本文介绍了 DAVOS，即特拉华自动驾驶汽车操作系统，这是一种为车辆计算环境设计的统一车辆操作系统架构。 DAVOS 提供了一个有凝聚力的操作系统基础，在一个单一的系统框架内支持实时自动驾驶和可扩展的车载计算。
tldr: The paper introduces DAVOS, a unified vehicle operating system designed to support both real-time autonomous driving and data-driven vehicle computing by addressing the SSEE concerns (Safety, Security, Efficiency, and Extensibility).
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DAVOS，一个统一的车辆操作系统，旨在通过解决SSEE (安全、安全、效率和可扩展性) 问题，来支持实时自动驾驶和数据驱动的车辆计算。

title: Zero Wrench Control via Wrench Disturbance Observer for Learning-free Peg-in-hole Assembly
summary: This paper proposes a Dynamic Wrench Disturbance Observer (DW-DOB) designed to achieve highly sensitive zero-wrench control in contact-rich manipulation. By embedding task-space inertia into the observer nominal model, DW-DOB cleanly separates intrinsic dynamic reactions from true external wrenches. This preserves sensitivity to small forces and moments while ensuring robust regulation of contact wrenches. A passivity-based analysis further demonstrates that DW-DOB guarantees stable interactions under dynamic conditions, addressing the shortcomings of conventional observers that fail to compensate for inertial effects. Peg-in-hole experiments at industrial tolerances (H7/h6) validate the approach, yielding deeper and more compliant insertions with minimal residual wrenches and outperforming a conventional wrench disturbance observer and a PD baseline. These results highlight DW-DOB as a practical learning-free solution for high-precision zero-wrench control in contact-rich tasks.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种动态力/力矩扰动观测器(DW-DOB), 旨在实现接触丰富的操作中高灵敏度的零力/力矩控制。通过将任务空间惯性嵌入观测器的标称模型中，DW-DOB清晰地分离了固有动态反作用力与真正的外部力/力矩。这既保留了对微小作用力/力矩的灵敏度，又确保了对接触力/力矩的鲁棒调节。基于无源性的分析进一步表明，DW-DOB保证了动态条件下的稳定交互，解决了传统观测器无法补偿惯性效应的缺点。在工业公差标准(H7/h6)下的销钉插入孔实验验证了该方法，实现了更深且更顺滑的插入，具有最小的残余力/力矩，并且优于传统的力/力矩扰动观测器和PD基线方法。这些结果表明，DW-DOB是一种实用的、无需学习的解决方案，适用于接触丰富的任务中的高精度零力/力矩控制。
tldr: The paper introduces a Dynamic Wrench Disturbance Observer (DW-DOB) for precise zero-wrench control in contact-rich manipulation tasks like peg-in-hole assembly, demonstrating improved performance over existing methods without requiring learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种动态力/力矩扰动观测器（DW-DOB），用于在诸如销钉孔装配等接触丰富的操作任务中实现精确的零力/力矩控制，展示了优于现有方法且无需学习的性能。

title: Discrete Fourier Transform-based Point Cloud Compression for Efficient SLAM in Featureless Terrain
summary: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is an essential technology for the efficiency and reliability of unmanned robotic exploration missions. While the onboard computational capability and communication bandwidth are critically limited, the point cloud data handled by SLAM is large in size, attracting attention to data compression methods. To address such a problem, in this paper, we propose a new method for compressing point cloud maps by exploiting the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). The proposed technique converts the Digital Elevation Model (DEM) to the frequency-domain 2D image and omits its high-frequency components, focusing on the exploration of gradual terrains such as planets and deserts. Unlike terrains with detailed structures such as artificial environments, high-frequency components contribute little to the representation of gradual terrains. Thus, this method is effective in compressing data size without significant degradation of the point cloud. We evaluated the method in terms of compression rate and accuracy using camera sequences of two terrains with different elevation profiles.
summary_zh: 同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）是无人机器人探索任务效率和可靠性的关键技术。 尽管机载计算能力和通信带宽受到严格限制，但SLAM处理的点云数据规模庞大，这使得数据压缩方法备受关注。 为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种利用离散傅里叶变换（DFT）压缩点云地图的新方法。 该技术将数字高程模型（DEM）转换为频域2D图像，并忽略其高频成分，专注于探索行星和沙漠等渐变地形。 与人工环境等具有精细结构的地形不同，高频成分对渐变地形的表示贡献较小。 因此，该方法能够有效地压缩数据大小，而不会显著降低点云的质量。 我们使用具有不同高程剖面的两种地形的相机序列，从压缩率和精度方面评估了该方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a point cloud compression method based on Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) for efficient SLAM in featureless terrains, applicable to resource-constrained robotic exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的点云压缩方法，用于在无特征地形中实现高效的SLAM，适用于资源受限的机器人探索。

title: Combining facial videos and biosignals for stress estimation during driving
summary: Reliable stress recognition from facial videos is challenging due to stress's subjective nature and voluntary facial control. While most methods rely on Facial Action Units, the role of disentangled 3D facial geometry remains underexplored. We address this by analyzing stress during distracted driving using EMOCA-derived 3D expression and pose coefficients. Paired hypothesis tests between baseline and stressor phases reveal that 41 of 56 coefficients show consistent, phase-specific stress responses comparable to physiological markers. Building on this, we propose a Transformer-based temporal modeling framework and assess unimodal, early-fusion, and cross-modal attention strategies. Cross-Modal Attention fusion of EMOCA and physiological signals achieves best performance (AUROC 92\%, Accuracy 86.7\%), with EMOCA-gaze fusion also competitive (AUROC 91.8\%). This highlights the effectiveness of temporal modeling and cross-modal attention for stress recognition.
summary_zh: 从面部视频中可靠地识别压力具有挑战性，这是由于压力的主观性和自愿的面部控制。尽管大多数方法依赖于面部动作单元，但解耦的3D面部几何结构的作用仍未得到充分探索。我们通过分析分散注意力驾驶期间的压力来解决这个问题，方法是使用EMOCA导出的3D表情和姿态系数。基线阶段和压力源阶段之间的配对假设检验表明，56个系数中有41个表现出与生理指标相当的始终如一的、阶段特异性的压力反应。在此基础上，我们提出了一个基于Transformer的时间建模框架，并评估了单模态、早期融合和跨模态注意力策略。EMOCA和生理信号的跨模态注意力融合实现了最佳性能（AUROC 92\%，准确率 86.7\%），而EMOCA-注视融合也具有竞争力（AUROC 91.8\%）。这突显了时间建模和跨模态注意力对压力识别的有效性。
tldr: This paper explores stress recognition during distracted driving by analyzing 3D facial geometry derived from facial videos and physiological signals, achieving high accuracy through a Transformer-based temporal modeling framework with cross-modal attention.
tldr_zh: 本文通过分析面部视频和生理信号导出的3D面部几何结构，探索了在分心驾驶期间的压力识别，通过基于Transformer的时间建模框架和跨模态注意力实现了高精度。

title: LaST$_{0}$: Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought for Robotic Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently demonstrated strong generalization capabilities in robotic manipulation. Some existing VLA approaches attempt to improve action accuracy by explicitly generating linguistic reasoning traces or future visual observations before action execution. However, explicit reasoning typically incurs non-negligible inference latency, which constrains the temporal resolution required for robotic manipulation. Moreover, such reasoning is confined to the linguistic space, imposing a representational bottleneck that struggles to faithfully capture ineffable physical attributes. To mitigate these limitations, we propose LaST$_0$, a framework that enables efficient reasoning before acting through a Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought (CoT), capturing fine-grained physical and robotic dynamics that are often difficult to verbalize. Specifically, we introduce a token-efficient latent CoT space that models future visual dynamics, 3D structural information, and robot proprioceptive states, and further extends these representations across time to enable temporally consistent implicit reasoning trajectories. Furthermore, LaST$_0$ adopts a dual-system architecture implemented via a Mixture-of-Transformers design, where a reasoning expert conducts low-frequency latent inference and an acting expert generates high-frequency actions conditioned on robotics-oriented latent representations. To facilitate coordination, LaST$_0$ is trained with heterogeneous operation frequencies, enabling adaptive switching between reasoning and action inference rates during deployment. Across ten simulated and six real-world manipulation tasks, LaST$_0$ improves mean success rates by 8% and 13% over prior VLA methods, respectively, while achieving substantially faster inference. Project website: https://sites.google.com/view/last0
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型最近在机器人操作中展现出强大的泛化能力。现有的一些VLA方法试图通过在执行动作之前显式地生成语言推理轨迹或未来的视觉观测来提高动作的准确性。然而，显式推理通常会带来不可忽视的推理延迟，这限制了机器人操作所需的时间分辨率。此外，这种推理被限制在语言空间中，施加了一种表征瓶颈，难以忠实地捕捉难以言表的物理属性。为了缓解这些限制，我们提出了 LaST$_0$，这是一个框架，通过潜在时空思维链 (CoT) 实现动作前的高效推理，捕捉通常难以用语言表达的细粒度物理和机器人动力学。具体来说，我们引入了一种令牌高效的潜在 CoT 空间，用于建模未来的视觉动态、3D 结构信息和机器人本体感受状态，并将这些表征按时间跨度扩展，以实现时间上一致的隐式推理轨迹。此外，LaST$_0$ 采用通过混合Transformer设计实现的双系统架构，其中推理专家进行低频潜在推理，而动作专家根据面向机器人的潜在表征生成高频动作。为了方便协调，LaST$_0$ 采用异构操作频率进行训练，从而能够在部署期间自适应地切换推理和动作的推理速率。在十个模拟和六个真实世界操作任务中，LaST$_0$ 相对于先前的 VLA 方法，分别将平均成功率提高了 8% 和 13%，同时实现了显著更快的推理速度。项目网站：https://sites.google.com/view/last0
tldr: The paper introduces LaST$_0$, a Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought framework for robotic VLA models that improves performance and reduces inference latency by using a latent space for reasoning about visual dynamics, 3D structure, and proprioception.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LaST$_0$，一个用于机器人VLA模型的潜在时空链式思考框架，通过使用潜在空间来推理视觉动力学、3D结构和本体感觉，从而提高了性能并降低了推理延迟。

title: RoboVIP: Multi-View Video Generation with Visual Identity Prompting Augments Robot Manipulation
summary: The diversity, quantity, and quality of manipulation data are critical for training effective robot policies. However, due to hardware and physical setup constraints, collecting large-scale real-world manipulation data remains difficult to scale across diverse environments. Recent work uses text-prompt conditioned image diffusion models to augment manipulation data by altering the backgrounds and tabletop objects in the visual observations. However, these approaches often overlook the practical need for multi-view and temporally coherent observations required by state-of-the-art policy models. Further, text prompts alone cannot reliably specify the scene setup. To provide the diffusion model with explicit visual guidance, we introduce visual identity prompting, which supplies exemplar images as conditioning inputs to guide the generation of the desired scene setup. To this end, we also build a scalable pipeline to curate a visual identity pool from large robotics datasets. Using our augmented manipulation data to train downstream vision-language-action and visuomotor policy models yields consistent performance gains in both simulation and real-robot settings.
summary_zh: 操控数据的多样性、数量和质量对于训练有效的机器人策略至关重要。然而，由于硬件和物理设置的限制，收集大规模的真实世界操控数据在多样化的环境中仍然难以扩展。最近的研究使用文本提示条件下的图像扩散模型，通过改变视觉观察中的背景和桌面物体来增强操控数据。然而，这些方法通常忽略了最先进的策略模型所需的、具有多视角和时间一致性的观察数据的实际需求。此外，仅靠文本提示无法可靠地指定场景设置。为了给扩散模型提供明确的视觉指导，我们引入视觉身份提示，提供示例图像作为条件输入，以指导生成期望的场景设置。为此，我们还构建了一个可扩展的流水线，从大型机器人数据集中整理一个视觉身份池。使用我们增强的操控数据来训练下游的视觉-语言-动作和视觉运动策略模型，在仿真和真实机器人环境中均取得了持续的性能提升。
tldr: This paper introduces RoboVIP, a multi-view video generation technique using visual identity prompting to augment robot manipulation data, addressing the need for diverse and coherent visual observations for training robot policies and showing performance gains in simulation and real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RoboVIP，一种使用视觉身份提示的多视角视频生成技术，用于增强机器人操作数据。它旨在解决训练机器人策略对多样化和连贯视觉观察的需求，并在模拟和真实场景中都展示了性能提升。

title: Learning Latent Action World Models In The Wild
summary: Agents capable of reasoning and planning in the real world require the ability of predicting the consequences of their actions. While world models possess this capability, they most often require action labels, that can be complex to obtain at scale. This motivates the learning of latent action models, that can learn an action space from videos alone. Our work addresses the problem of learning latent actions world models on in-the-wild videos, expanding the scope of existing works that focus on simple robotics simulations, video games, or manipulation data. While this allows us to capture richer actions, it also introduces challenges stemming from the video diversity, such as environmental noise, or the lack of a common embodiment across videos. To address some of the challenges, we discuss properties that actions should follow as well as relevant architectural choices and evaluations. We find that continuous, but constrained, latent actions are able to capture the complexity of actions from in-the-wild videos, something that the common vector quantization does not. We for example find that changes in the environment coming from agents, such as humans entering the room, can be transferred across videos. This highlights the capability of learning actions that are specific to in-the-wild videos. In the absence of a common embodiment across videos, we are mainly able to learn latent actions that become localized in space, relative to the camera. Nonetheless, we are able to train a controller that maps known actions to latent ones, allowing us to use latent actions as a universal interface and solve planning tasks with our world model with similar performance as action-conditioned baselines. Our analyses and experiments provide a step towards scaling latent action models to the real world.
summary_zh: 能够进行推理和规划的智能体需要在现实世界中预测其行为的后果。世界模型具备这种能力，但通常需要动作标签，而大规模获取动作标签可能非常复杂。这促使人们研究隐式动作模型，这种模型可以仅从视频中学习动作空间。我们的工作致力于在真实场景视频中学习隐式动作世界模型，扩展了现有工作主要集中在简单机器人仿真、电子游戏或操控数据的范围。虽然这使我们能够捕捉更丰富的动作，但也引入了来自视频多样性的挑战，例如环境噪声或视频间缺乏共同的embodiment。为了应对这些挑战，我们讨论了动作应该遵循的属性，以及相关的架构选择和评估。我们发现，连续但受约束的隐式动作能够捕捉真实场景视频中动作的复杂性，而常见的向量量化则无法做到这一点。例如，我们发现来自智能体（如人进入房间）的环境变化可以在视频间传递。这突出了学习特定于真实场景视频的动作的能力。在视频间缺乏共同的embodiment的情况下，我们主要能够学习到相对于相机在空间中定位的隐式动作。尽管如此，我们还是能够训练出一个控制器，将已知的动作映射到隐式动作，从而使我们能够将隐式动作用作通用接口，并使用我们的世界模型解决规划任务，其性能与以动作为条件的基线相似。我们的分析和实验为将隐式动作模型扩展到现实世界迈出了一步。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for learning latent action world models from in-the-wild videos, addressing the challenge of learning action representations without explicit action labels and demonstrating the ability to capture complex environment changes and transfer them across videos.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从真实场景视频中学习潜在动作世界模型的方法，解决了在没有明确动作标签的情况下学习动作表征的挑战，并展示了捕捉复杂环境变化并在视频之间转移变化的能力。

title: MineNPC-Task: Task Suite for Memory-Aware Minecraft Agents
summary:
We present \textsc{MineNPC-Task}, a user-authored benchmark and evaluation harness for testing memory-aware, mixed-initiative LLM agents in open-world \emph{Minecraft}. Rather than relying on synthetic prompts, tasks are elicited from formative and summative co-play with expert players, normalized into parametric templates with explicit preconditions and dependency structure, and paired with machine-checkable validators under a bounded-knowledge policy that forbids out-of-world shortcuts. The harness captures plan/act/memory events-including plan previews, targeted clarifications, memory reads and writes, precondition checks, and repair attempts and reports outcomes relative to the total number of attempted subtasks, derived from in-world evidence.
  As an initial snapshot, we instantiate the framework with GPT-4o and evaluate \textbf{216} subtasks across \textbf{8} experienced players. We observe recurring breakdown patterns in code execution, inventory/tool handling, referencing, and navigation, alongside recoveries supported by mixed-initiative clarifications and lightweight memory. Participants rated interaction quality and interface usability positively, while highlighting the need for stronger memory persistence across tasks. We release the complete task suite, validators, logs, and harness to support transparent, reproducible evaluation of future memory-aware embodied agents.
summary_zh:
我们提出了\textsc{MineNPC-Task}，一个用户创作的基准测试和评估工具，用于在开放世界\emph{Minecraft}中测试具有记忆功能的、混合主动式的大型语言模型代理。任务并非依赖于合成提示，而是通过与专家玩家的形成性和总结性协同游戏获取，被规范化为具有明确前提条件和依赖结构的参数化模板，并与在有界知识策略下的机器可校验验证器配对，该策略禁止利用世界之外的捷径。该工具捕获计划/行动/记忆事件——包括计划预览、目标明确的澄清、记忆读取和写入、前提条件检查以及修复尝试——并基于尝试的子任务总数报告结果，这些子任务总数是从游戏世界内的证据中推导出来的。

作为一个初步快照，我们用GPT-4o实例化了这个框架，并评估了\textbf{8}位经验丰富的玩家所涉及的\textbf{216}个子任务。我们观察到代码执行、库存/工具处理、引用和导航方面反复出现的崩溃模式，以及混合主动式澄清和轻量级记忆所支持的恢复情况。参与者对交互质量和界面可用性评价积极，同时也强调了跨任务更强的记忆持久性的需求。我们发布完整的任务套件、验证器、日志和工具，以支持对未来具有记忆功能的具身代理进行透明且可复现的评估。
tldr: The paper introduces MineNPC-Task, a Minecraft benchmark for evaluating memory-aware LLM agents through user-authored tasks with explicit preconditions and validators, revealing breakdown patterns and the need for stronger memory persistence.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MineNPC-Task，一个Minecraft基准测试，用于评估具有记忆感知能力的大语言模型智能体。通过用户创作的任务，及显式的前提条件和验证器，揭示了崩溃模式以及对更强记忆持久性的需求。

title: Internal Representations as Indicators of Hallucinations in Agent Tool Selection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in tool calling and tool usage, but suffer from hallucinations where they choose incorrect tools, provide malformed parameters and exhibit 'tool bypass' behavior by performing simulations and generating outputs instead of invoking specialized tools or external systems. This undermines the reliability of LLM based agents in production systems as it leads to inconsistent results, and bypasses security and audit controls. Such hallucinations in agent tool selection require early detection and error handling. Unlike existing hallucination detection methods that require multiple forward passes or external validation, we present a computationally efficient framework that detects tool-calling hallucinations in real-time by leveraging LLMs' internal representations during the same forward pass used for generation. We evaluate this approach on reasoning tasks across multiple domains, demonstrating strong detection performance (up to 86.4\% accuracy) while maintaining real-time inference capabilities with minimal computational overhead, particularly excelling at detecting parameter-level hallucinations and inappropriate tool selections, critical for reliable agent deployment.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)在工具调用和工具使用方面展现出卓越能力，但也存在幻觉问题，例如选择不正确的工具、提供格式错误的参数，以及表现出"工具绕过"行为，即进行模拟并生成输出，而不是调用专门的工具或外部系统。这损害了基于LLM的代理在生产系统中的可靠性，因为它会导致结果不一致，并绕过安全和审计控制。代理工具选择中的此类幻觉需要及早检测和错误处理。与需要多次正向传递或外部验证的现有幻觉检测方法不同，我们提出了一个计算效率高的框架，通过利用LLM在生成过程中同一正向传递期间的内部表示，实时检测工具调用幻觉。我们在多个领域的推理任务上评估了这种方法，展示了强大的检测性能（高达86.4％的准确率），同时保持了具有最小计算开销的实时推理能力，尤其擅长检测参数级别的幻觉和不适当的工具选择，这对于可靠的代理部署至关重要。
tldr: This paper introduces a real-time method for detecting tool-calling hallucinations in LLM agents by analyzing internal representations during inference, achieving high accuracy with minimal overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种实时检测LLM代理中工具调用幻觉的方法，通过在推理过程中分析内部表示来实现，具有高精度和最小的开销。

title: SimuAgent: An LLM-Based Simulink Modeling Assistant Enhanced with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized text-based code automation, but their potential in graph-oriented engineering workflows remains under-explored. We introduce SimuAgent, an LLM-powered modeling and simulation agent tailored for Simulink. SimuAgent replaces verbose XML with a concise, dictionary-style Python representation, dramatically cutting token counts, improving interpretability, and enabling fast, in-process simulation. A lightweight plan-execute architecture, trained in two stages, equips the agent with both low-level tool skills and high-level design reasoning. To tackle sparse rewards in long-horizon tasks, we propose Reflection-GRPO (ReGRPO), which augments Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with self-reflection traces that supply rich intermediate feedback, accelerating convergence and boosting robustness. Experiments on SimuBench, our newly released benchmark comprising 5300 multi-domain modeling tasks, show that a Qwen2.5-7B model fine-tuned with SimuAgent converges faster and achieves higher modeling accuracy than standard RL baselines, and even surpasses GPT-4o when evaluated with few-shot prompting on the same benchmark. Ablations confirm that the two-stage curriculum and abstract-reconstruct data augmentation further enhance generalization. SimuAgent trains and runs entirely on-premise with modest hardware, delivering a privacy-preserving, cost-effective solution for industrial model-driven engineering. SimuAgent bridges the gap between LLMs and graphical modeling environments, offering a practical solution for AI-assisted engineering design in industrial settings.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经彻底改变了基于文本的代码自动化，但它们在面向图的工程工作流中的潜力仍未得到充分探索。我们推出了SimuAgent，一种专为Simulink量身定制的、基于LLM的建模与仿真代理。SimuAgent用简洁的字典式Python表示替代了冗长的XML，显著减少了token数量，提高了可解释性，并实现了快速的进程内仿真。通过两阶段训练的轻量级计划-执行架构为代理赋予了低级工具技能和高级设计推理能力。为了解决长时程任务中的稀疏奖励问题，我们提出了Reflection-GRPO（ReGRPO），它利用自反思轨迹来丰富中间反馈，从而增强了组相对策略优化（GRPO），加速了收敛并提高了鲁棒性。在SimuBench（我们新发布的包含5300个多领域建模任务的基准）上的实验表明，使用SimuAgent微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型比标准RL基线收敛更快，实现了更高的建模精度，甚至在使用相同基准进行少样本提示评估时超越了GPT-4o。消融实验证实，两阶段课程学习和抽象-重构数据增强进一步提升了泛化能力。SimuAgent完全在本地进行训练和运行，硬件要求不高，为工业模型驱动工程提供了一种保护隐私、经济高效的解决方案。SimuAgent弥合了LLM与图形建模环境之间的差距，为工业环境中的AI辅助工程设计提供了一种实用的解决方案。
tldr: SimuAgent uses LLMs and reinforcement learning with a novel Reflection-GRPO algorithm to improve Simulink modeling, showing superior performance compared to standard RL baselines and even GPT-4o on a new benchmark.
tldr_zh: SimuAgent使用LLM和强化学习，结合一种新颖的Reflection-GRPO算法来改进Simulink建模。在新的基准测试中，SimuAgent的性能优于标准强化学习基线，甚至超过了GPT-4o。

title: Pixel-Perfect Visual Geometry Estimation
summary: Recovering clean and accurate geometry from images is essential for robotics and augmented reality. However, existing geometry foundation models still suffer severely from flying pixels and the loss of fine details. In this paper, we present pixel-perfect visual geometry models that can predict high-quality, flying-pixel-free point clouds by leveraging generative modeling in the pixel space. We first introduce Pixel-Perfect Depth (PPD), a monocular depth foundation model built upon pixel-space diffusion transformers (DiT). To address the high computational complexity associated with pixel-space diffusion, we propose two key designs: 1) Semantics-Prompted DiT, which incorporates semantic representations from vision foundation models to prompt the diffusion process, preserving global semantics while enhancing fine-grained visual details; and 2) Cascade DiT architecture that progressively increases the number of image tokens, improving both efficiency and accuracy. To further extend PPD to video (PPVD), we introduce a new Semantics-Consistent DiT, which extracts temporally consistent semantics from a multi-view geometry foundation model. We then perform reference-guided token propagation within the DiT to maintain temporal coherence with minimal computational and memory overhead. Our models achieve the best performance among all generative monocular and video depth estimation models and produce significantly cleaner point clouds than all other models.
summary_zh: 从图像中恢复干净、精确的几何信息对于机器人技术和增强现实至关重要。然而，现有的几何基础模型仍然严重受到飞点和精细细节丢失的困扰。在本文中，我们提出了像素级完美视觉几何模型，该模型可以通过利用像素空间中的生成建模来预测高质量、无飞点的点云。我们首先介绍了像素级完美深度（PPD），这是一种基于像素空间扩散Transformer（DiT）构建的单目深度基础模型。为了解决与像素空间扩散相关的高计算复杂度，我们提出了两项关键设计：1）语义提示DiT，它结合了来自视觉基础模型的语义表示来提示扩散过程，在保留全局语义的同时增强精细的视觉细节；以及 2）级联DiT架构，逐步增加图像token的数量，从而提高效率和准确性。为了进一步将PPD扩展到视频（PPVD），我们引入了一种新的语义一致性DiT，它从多视图几何基础模型中提取时间上一致的语义信息。然后，我们在DiT内执行参考引导的token传播，以保持时间连贯性，同时最大限度地减少计算和内存开销。我们的模型在所有生成式单目和视频深度估计模型中实现了最佳性能，并产生了比所有其他模型都明显更干净的点云。
tldr: The paper introduces pixel-perfect visual geometry models using diffusion transformers for monocular and video depth estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance with cleaner point clouds.
