tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了像素完美的视觉几何模型，利用扩散 Transformer 进行单目和视频深度估计，实现了最先进的性能，并生成更清晰的点云。

title: ObjectForesight: Predicting Future 3D Object Trajectories from Human Videos
summary: Humans can effortlessly anticipate how objects might move or change through interaction--imagining a cup being lifted, a knife slicing, or a lid being closed. We aim to endow computational systems with a similar ability to predict plausible future object motions directly from passive visual observation. We introduce ObjectForesight, a 3D object-centric dynamics model that predicts future 6-DoF poses and trajectories of rigid objects from short egocentric video sequences. Unlike conventional world or dynamics models that operate in pixel or latent space, ObjectForesight represents the world explicitly in 3D at the object level, enabling geometrically grounded and temporally coherent predictions that capture object affordances and trajectories. To train such a model at scale, we leverage recent advances in segmentation, mesh reconstruction, and 3D pose estimation to curate a dataset of 2 million plus short clips with pseudo-ground-truth 3D object trajectories. Through extensive experiments, we show that ObjectForesight achieves significant gains in accuracy, geometric consistency, and generalization to unseen objects and scenes, establishing a scalable framework for learning physically grounded, object-centric dynamics models directly from observation. objectforesight.github.io
summary_zh: 人类可以毫不费力地预测物体在交互过程中可能如何移动或变化——想象着杯子被拿起、刀在切割、或盖子被关闭。我们的目标是赋予计算系统类似的能力，直接从被动的视觉观察中预测合理的未来物体运动。我们引入ObjectForesight，一个以3D物体为中心的动力学模型，它可以从短期的以自我为中心的视频序列中预测刚性物体的未来6-DoF位姿和轨迹。与在像素或潜在空间中操作的传统世界或动力学模型不同，ObjectForesight在物体层面上以3D显式地表示世界，从而实现几何上可靠且时间上连贯的预测，捕捉物体的可供性和轨迹。为了大规模地训练这种模型，我们利用了分割、网格重建和3D位姿估计方面的最新进展，构建了一个包含超过200万段短视频片段的数据集，并带有伪标签的3D物体轨迹。通过大量的实验，我们表明ObjectForesight在准确性、几何一致性以及对未见物体和场景的泛化方面取得了显著的提升，从而建立了一个可扩展的框架，可以直接从观察中学习具有物理基础的、以物体为中心的动力学模型。 objectforesight.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces ObjectForesight, a 3D object-centric dynamics model trained on a large dataset to predict future object poses and trajectories from egocentric video, demonstrating improved accuracy and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ObjectForesight，一个基于3D物体中心的动力学模型，通过大型数据集训练，用于预测来自自我中心视频的未来物体姿态和轨迹，并展示了更高的准确性和泛化能力。

title: Cutting AI Research Costs: How Task-Aware Compression Makes Large Language Model Agents Affordable
summary: When researchers deploy large language models for autonomous tasks like reviewing literature or generating hypotheses, the computational bills add up quickly. A single research session using a 70-billion parameter model can cost around $127 in cloud fees, putting these tools out of reach for many academic labs. We developed AgentCompress to tackle this problem head-on. The core idea came from a simple observation during our own work: writing a novel hypothesis clearly demands more from the model than reformatting a bibliography. Why should both tasks run at full precision? Our system uses a small neural network to gauge how hard each incoming task will be, based only on its opening words, then routes it to a suitably compressed model variant. The decision happens in under a millisecond. Testing across 500 research workflows in four scientific fields, we cut compute costs by 68.3% while keeping 96.2% of the original success rate. For labs watching their budgets, this could mean the difference between running experiments and sitting on the sidelines
summary_zh: 当研究人员部署大型语言模型来执行诸如文献综述或生成假设等自主任务时，计算费用会迅速累积。仅仅使用一个700亿参数的模型进行一次研究会话，就可能产生约127美元的云费用，这使得许多学术实验室难以负担这些工具。我们开发了AgentCompress来直接解决这个问题。其核心思想来自于我们在自身工作中的一个简单观察：清楚地撰写一个新颖的假设，比重新格式化参考文献需要模型付出更多努力。为什么这两个任务都必须以全精度运行？我们的系统使用一个小型神经网络，仅根据输入任务的开头几个词来评估任务的复杂度，然后将其路由到合适的、经过压缩的模型变体。决策过程在不到一毫秒内完成。在四个科学领域的500个研究工作流程中进行测试，我们降低了68.3%的计算成本，同时保持了96.2%的原始成功率。对于关注预算的实验室来说，这可能意味着能够进行实验与只能袖手旁观之间的差别。
tldr: The paper introduces AgentCompress, a system that reduces the computational cost of using large language models for research tasks by dynamically compressing the model based on task difficulty, achieving significant cost savings with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgentCompress，一种通过根据任务难度动态压缩模型来降低大型语言模型在研究任务中计算成本的系统，在性能损失最小的情况下实现了显著的成本节约。

title: VideoAuto-R1: Video Auto Reasoning via Thinking Once, Answering Twice
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as a powerful tool for multimodal large language models on video understanding tasks. However, its necessity and advantages over direct answering remain underexplored. In this paper, we first demonstrate that for RL-trained video models, direct answering often matches or even surpasses CoT performance, despite CoT producing step-by-step analyses at a higher computational cost. Motivated by this, we propose VideoAuto-R1, a video understanding framework that adopts a reason-when-necessary strategy. During training, our approach follows a Thinking Once, Answering Twice paradigm: the model first generates an initial answer, then performs reasoning, and finally outputs a reviewed answer. Both answers are supervised via verifiable rewards. During inference, the model uses the confidence score of the initial answer to determine whether to proceed with reasoning. Across video QA and grounding benchmarks, VideoAuto-R1 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly improved efficiency, reducing the average response length by ~3.3x, e.g., from 149 to just 44 tokens. Moreover, we observe a low rate of thinking-mode activation on perception-oriented tasks, but a higher rate on reasoning-intensive tasks. This suggests that explicit language-based reasoning is generally beneficial but not always necessary.
summary_zh: 思维链(CoT)推理已成为多模态大型语言模型在视频理解任务中一种强大的工具。然而，其必要性以及相对于直接回答的优势仍有待进一步探索。在本文中，我们首先证明了对于强化学习训练的视频模型，直接回答通常能匹配甚至超过CoT的性能，尽管CoT以更高的计算成本产生逐步分析。受此启发，我们提出VideoAuto-R1，一种采用“按需推理”策略的视频理解框架。在训练期间，我们的方法遵循“思考一次，回答两次”的范式：模型首先生成一个初始答案，然后进行推理，最后输出一个经过审查的答案。两个答案都通过可验证的回报进行监督。在推理过程中，模型利用初始答案的置信度来决定是否继续进行推理。在视频问答和定位基准测试中，VideoAuto-R1实现了最先进的准确率，并显著提高了效率，将平均回复长度降低了约3.3倍，例如，从149个token减少到只有44个token。此外，我们观察到在感知导向的任务上，思考模式的激活率较低，而在推理密集型任务上，激活率较高。这表明，基于显式语言的推理通常是有益的，但并非总是必要的。
tldr: The paper introduces VideoAuto-R1, a video understanding framework that uses a 'reason-when-necessary' strategy, showing comparable or superior performance to chain-of-thought methods with increased efficiency by selectively applying reasoning only when the model is uncertain.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VideoAuto-R1，一个视频理解框架，它采用“按需推理”策略，通过仅在模型不确定时选择性地应用推理，展示了与思维链方法相当或更优越的性能，同时提高了效率。

title: Generate, Transfer, Adapt: Learning Functional Dexterous Grasping from a Single Human Demonstration
summary: Functional grasping with dexterous robotic hands is a key capability for enabling tool use and complex manipulation, yet progress has been constrained by two persistent bottlenecks: the scarcity of large-scale datasets and the absence of integrated semantic and geometric reasoning in learned models. In this work, we present CorDex, a framework that robustly learns dexterous functional grasps of novel objects from synthetic data generated from just a single human demonstration. At the core of our approach is a correspondence-based data engine that generates diverse, high-quality training data in simulation. Based on the human demonstration, our data engine generates diverse object instances of the same category, transfers the expert grasp to the generated objects through correspondence estimation, and adapts the grasp through optimization. Building on the generated data, we introduce a multimodal prediction network that integrates visual and geometric information. By devising a local-global fusion module and an importance-aware sampling mechanism, we enable robust and computationally efficient prediction of functional dexterous grasps. Through extensive experiments across various object categories, we demonstrate that CorDex generalizes well to unseen object instances and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 使用灵巧机械手进行功能性抓取是实现工具使用和复杂操控的关键能力，但其进展一直受到两个持续性瓶颈的制约：大规模数据集的稀缺以及学习型模型中缺乏集成的语义和几何推理。在本文中，我们提出了 CorDex，一个可以仅从单次人类演示生成的合成数据中，稳健地学习新颖物体的灵巧功能性抓取的框架。我们方法的核心是一个基于对应关系的数据引擎，它可以在仿真中生成多样化、高质量的训练数据。基于人类演示，我们的数据引擎生成同一类别的多样化物体实例，通过对应关系估计将专家抓取转移到生成的物体上，并通过优化来调整抓取。在生成的数据的基础上，我们引入了一个集成视觉和几何信息的多模态预测网络。通过设计一个局部-全局融合模块和一种重要性感知采样机制，我们实现了对功能性灵巧抓取的稳健和计算高效的预测。通过跨多个物体类别的广泛实验，我们证明了 CorDex 可以很好地泛化到未见过的物体实例，并且显著优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces CorDex, a framework for learning functional dexterous grasps from a single human demonstration by generating synthetic data and using a multimodal prediction network. It claims to outperform existing methods in generalizing to unseen object instances.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 CorDex 的框架，该框架通过生成合成数据和使用多模态预测网络，从单个人类演示中学习功能性灵巧抓取。 它声称在泛化到未见过的对象实例方面优于现有方法。

title: RL-AWB: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Auto White Balance Correction in Low-Light Night-time Scenes
summary: Nighttime color constancy remains a challenging problem in computational photography due to low-light noise and complex illumination conditions. We present RL-AWB, a novel framework combining statistical methods with deep reinforcement learning for nighttime white balance. Our method begins with a statistical algorithm tailored for nighttime scenes, integrating salient gray pixel detection with novel illumination estimation. Building on this foundation, we develop the first deep reinforcement learning approach for color constancy that leverages the statistical algorithm as its core, mimicking professional AWB tuning experts by dynamically optimizing parameters for each image. To facilitate cross-sensor evaluation, we introduce the first multi-sensor nighttime dataset. Experiment results demonstrate that our method achieves superior generalization capability across low-light and well-illuminated images. Project page: https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/rl-awb/
summary_zh: 夜间色彩恒常性由于低光噪声和复杂的光照条件，仍然是计算摄影学中的一个挑战性问题。我们提出了一种名为RL-AWB的新框架，它将统计方法与深度强化学习相结合，用于夜间白平衡。 我们的方法首先采用一种专为夜间场景定制的统计算法，该算法集成了显著灰像素检测与新的照明估计。 在此基础上，我们开发了第一个用于色彩恒常性的深度强化学习方法，它利用统计算法作为其核心，通过动态优化每个图像的参数来模仿专业的AWB调优专家。 为了方便跨传感器评估，我们引入了首个多传感器夜间数据集。实验结果表明，我们的方法在低光和良好照明图像中均实现了卓越的泛化能力。 项目页面：https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/rl-awb/
tldr: The paper introduces RL-AWB, a deep reinforcement learning framework for auto white balance (AWB) correction in low-light nighttime scenes, combining statistical methods with RL and introducing a new multi-sensor nighttime dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RL-AWB，一个用于低光夜间场景中自动白平衡(AWB)校正的深度强化学习框架，结合了统计方法和强化学习，并引入了一个新的多传感器夜间数据集。

title: Plenoptic Video Generation
summary: Camera-controlled generative video re-rendering methods, such as ReCamMaster, have achieved remarkable progress. However, despite their success in single-view setting, these works often struggle to maintain consistency across multi-view scenarios. Ensuring spatio-temporal coherence in hallucinated regions remains challenging due to the inherent stochasticity of generative models. To address it, we introduce PlenopticDreamer, a framework that synchronizes generative hallucinations to maintain spatio-temporal memory. The core idea is to train a multi-in-single-out video-conditioned model in an autoregressive manner, aided by a camera-guided video retrieval strategy that adaptively selects salient videos from previous generations as conditional inputs. In addition, Our training incorporates progressive context-scaling to improve convergence, self-conditioning to enhance robustness against long-range visual degradation caused by error accumulation, and a long-video conditioning mechanism to support extended video generation. Extensive experiments on the Basic and Agibot benchmarks demonstrate that PlenopticDreamer achieves state-of-the-art video re-rendering, delivering superior view synchronization, high-fidelity visuals, accurate camera control, and diverse view transformations (e.g., third-person to third-person, and head-view to gripper-view in robotic manipulation). Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/plenopticdreamer/
summary_zh: 相机控制的生成式视频重渲染方法，例如ReCamMaster，已经取得了显著进展。然而，尽管它们在单视角设置中获得了成功，但在多视角场景中，这些方法往往难以保持一致性。由于生成模型的固有随机性，确保幻觉区域的时空连贯性仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PlenopticDreamer，一个同步生成幻觉以保持时空记忆的框架。其核心思想是以自回归方式训练一个多输入单输出的视频条件模型，并采用一种相机引导的视频检索策略，自适应地从先前生成的结果中选择显著视频作为条件输入。此外，我们的训练结合了渐进式上下文缩放来提高收敛性，自条件化来增强对误差累积造成的长程视觉退化的鲁棒性，以及长视频条件机制来支持更长的视频生成。在Basic和Agibot基准测试上的大量实验表明，PlenopticDreamer实现了最先进的视频重渲染，提供了卓越的视角同步、高保真视觉效果、精确的相机控制以及多样化的视角转换（例如，在机器人操作中，从第三人称视角到第三人称视角，以及从头部视角到机械臂视角）。项目主页：https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/plenopticdreamer/
tldr: PlenopticDreamer synchronizes generative hallucinations in video re-rendering to maintain spatio-temporal consistency across multiple views. It utilizes a camera-guided video retrieval strategy and several training mechanisms to achieve state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: PlenopticDreamer通过同步生成式视频重渲染中的幻觉，以维持多视角的时空一致性。它利用相机引导的视频检索策略和多种训练机制，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Mesh4D: 4D Mesh Reconstruction and Tracking from Monocular Video
summary: We propose Mesh4D, a feed-forward model for monocular 4D mesh reconstruction. Given a monocular video of a dynamic object, our model reconstructs the object's complete 3D shape and motion, represented as a deformation field. Our key contribution is a compact latent space that encodes the entire animation sequence in a single pass. This latent space is learned by an autoencoder that, during training, is guided by the skeletal structure of the training objects, providing strong priors on plausible deformations. Crucially, skeletal information is not required at inference time. The encoder employs spatio-temporal attention, yielding a more stable representation of the object's overall deformation. Building on this representation, we train a latent diffusion model that, conditioned on the input video and the mesh reconstructed from the first frame, predicts the full animation in one shot. We evaluate Mesh4D on reconstruction and novel view synthesis benchmarks, outperforming prior methods in recovering accurate 3D shape and deformation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Mesh4D，一个用于单目4D网格重建的前馈模型。给定动态物体的单目视频，我们的模型重建物体完整的3D形状和运动，并将其表示为一个形变场。我们的主要贡献是一个紧凑的潜在空间，它以单次传递的方式编码整个动画序列。该潜在空间由一个自编码器学习，在训练过程中，自编码器由训练对象的骨骼结构引导，从而为合理的形变提供强先验。至关重要的是，在推理时不需要骨骼信息。编码器采用时空注意力机制，从而产生物体整体形变的更稳定的表示。基于这种表示，我们训练了一个潜在扩散模型，该模型以输入的视频和从第一帧重建的网格为条件，一次性预测完整的动画。我们在重建和新视角合成基准上评估Mesh4D，在恢复准确的3D形状和形变方面优于现有方法。
tldr: Mesh4D reconstructs and tracks 4D meshes from monocular video using a novel latent space learned with skeletal priors guiding a diffusion model for single-pass animation prediction, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: Mesh4D通过单目视频重建和跟踪4D网格，利用骨骼先验引导的潜在空间学习和一个扩散模型进行单次动画预测，性能优于现有方法。

title: EARL: Energy-Aware Optimization of Liquid State Machines for Pervasive AI
summary: Pervasive AI increasingly depends on on-device learning systems that deliver low-latency and energy-efficient computation under strict resource constraints. Liquid State Machines (LSMs) offer a promising approach for low-power temporal processing in pervasive and neuromorphic systems, but their deployment remains challenging due to high hyperparameter sensitivity and the computational cost of traditional optimization methods that ignore energy constraints. This work presents EARL, an energy-aware reinforcement learning framework that integrates Bayesian optimization with an adaptive reinforcement learning based selection policy to jointly optimize accuracy and energy consumption. EARL employs surrogate modeling for global exploration, reinforcement learning for dynamic candidate prioritization, and an early termination mechanism to eliminate redundant evaluations, substantially reducing computational overhead. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that EARL achieves 6 to 15 percent higher accuracy, 60 to 80 percent lower energy consumption, and up to an order of magnitude reduction in optimization time compared to leading hyperparameter tuning frameworks. These results highlight the effectiveness of energy-aware adaptive search in improving the efficiency and scalability of LSMs for resource-constrained on-device AI applications.
summary_zh: 普适人工智能越来越依赖于设备端学习系统，这些系统需要在严格的资源约束下提供低延迟和高能效的计算。液态机（LSM）为普适和神经形态系统中的低功耗时序处理提供了一种有前景的方法，但由于其对超参数的高度敏感性以及忽略能量约束的传统优化方法产生的计算成本，其部署仍然具有挑战性。这项工作提出了EARL，一个能量感知的强化学习框架，它集成了贝叶斯优化和一个基于自适应强化学习的选择策略，以联合优化准确性和能耗。EARL采用代理建模进行全局探索，采用强化学习进行动态候选优先级排序，并采用早期终止机制来消除冗余评估，从而大幅降低计算开销。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，与领先的超参数调优框架相比，EARL实现了6%到15%更高的准确率，60%到80%更低的能耗，以及高达一个数量级的优化时间缩短。这些结果突出了能量感知的自适应搜索在提高LSM针对资源受限的设备端人工智能应用的效率和可扩展性方面的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces EARL, an energy-aware reinforcement learning framework for optimizing Liquid State Machines (LSMs) that achieves higher accuracy, lower energy consumption, and faster optimization compared to existing methods for resource-constrained on-device AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为EARL的节能强化学习框架，用于优化液态机（LSM）。与现有的资源受限的片上AI方法相比，该框架可实现更高的准确性、更低的能耗和更快的优化。

title: CAOS: Conformal Aggregation of One-Shot Predictors
summary: One-shot prediction enables rapid adaptation of pretrained foundation models to new tasks using only one labeled example, but lacks principled uncertainty quantification. While conformal prediction provides finite-sample coverage guarantees, standard split conformal methods are inefficient in the one-shot setting due to data splitting and reliance on a single predictor. We propose Conformal Aggregation of One-Shot Predictors (CAOS), a conformal framework that adaptively aggregates multiple one-shot predictors and uses a leave-one-out calibration scheme to fully exploit scarce labeled data. Despite violating classical exchangeability assumptions, we prove that CAOS achieves valid marginal coverage using a monotonicity-based argument. Experiments on one-shot facial landmarking and RAFT text classification tasks show that CAOS produces substantially smaller prediction sets than split conformal baselines while maintaining reliable coverage.
summary_zh: 单样本预测使得预训练的基础模型仅利用一个带标签的样本就能快速适应新任务，但缺乏有原则的不确定性量化。虽然保真正则预测提供有限样本的覆盖保证，但由于数据分割和对单个预测器的依赖，标准的分割保真正则方法在单样本设置中效率低下。 我们提出单样本预测器的保真聚合（CAOS），这是一个保真的框架，能够自适应地聚合多个单样本预测器，并使用留一法校准方案来充分利用稀缺的带标签数据。虽然违反了经典的交换性假设，但我们证明了CAOS使用基于单调性的论证实现了有效的边际覆盖率。 在单样本面部地标定位和RAFT文本分类任务上的实验表明，CAOS产生比分割保真正则基线显著更小的预测集，同时保持可靠的覆盖率。
tldr: The paper introduces CAOS, a conformal prediction framework for one-shot learning that aggregates multiple predictors and uses leave-one-out calibration to improve prediction set size while maintaining valid coverage, even when exchangeability is violated.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CAOS，一种用于单样本学习的共形预测框架，它聚合了多个预测器并使用留一法校准来改善预测集大小，同时保持有效的覆盖率，即使在违反可交换性的情况下也是如此。

title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instruction Ambiguity Detection
summary: In safety-critical domains, linguistic ambiguity can have severe consequences; a vague command like "Pass me the vial" in a surgical setting could lead to catastrophic errors. Yet, most embodied AI research overlooks this, assuming instructions are clear and focusing on execution rather than confirmation. To address this critical safety gap, we are the first to define Open-Vocabulary 3D Instruction Ambiguity Detection, a fundamental new task where a model must determine if a command has a single, unambiguous meaning within a given 3D scene. To support this research, we build Ambi3D, the large-scale benchmark for this task, featuring over 700 diverse 3D scenes and around 22k instructions. Our analysis reveals a surprising limitation: state-of-the-art 3D Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to reliably determine if an instruction is ambiguous. To address this challenge, we propose AmbiVer, a two-stage framework that collects explicit visual evidence from multiple views and uses it to guide an vision-language model (VLM) in judging instruction ambiguity. Extensive experiments demonstrate the challenge of our task and the effectiveness of AmbiVer, paving the way for safer and more trustworthy embodied AI. Code and dataset available at https://jiayuding031020.github.io/ambi3d/.
summary_zh: 在安全攸关领域，语言歧义可能导致严重后果；在外科手术环境中，诸如“把小瓶递给我”这样含糊不清的指令可能会酿成灾难性错误。然而，大多数具身人工智能研究忽略了这一点，假设指令清晰明确，并且侧重于执行而非确认。为了弥补这一关键的安全漏洞，我们率先定义了开放词汇3D指令歧义检测，这是一项全新的基础任务，要求模型判断指令在给定的3D场景中是否具有单一、明确的含义。为了支持这项研究，我们构建了Ambi3D，一个大规模的基准数据集，其中包含700多个不同的3D场景和大约2.2万条指令。我们的分析揭示了一个令人惊讶的局限性：最先进的3D大型语言模型（LLM）难以可靠地判断指令是否具有歧义。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了AmbiVer，一个两阶段框架，该框架从多个视角收集显式的视觉证据，并使用这些证据来引导视觉-语言模型（VLM）判断指令歧义。大量的实验证明了我们任务的挑战性和AmbiVer的有效性，为更安全、更值得信赖的具身人工智能铺平了道路。代码和数据集可在https://jiayuding031020.github.io/ambi3d/获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a new task, Open-Vocabulary 3D Instruction Ambiguity Detection, and a benchmark dataset (Ambi3D) to address the problem of instruction ambiguity in embodied AI, finding that existing 3D LLMs struggle with this task, and proposes AmbiVer to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个新的任务：开放词汇3D指令歧义检测，并创建了一个基准数据集 (Ambi3D)，旨在解决具身智能中指令歧义的问题。研究发现现有的3D LLM在此任务上表现不佳，并提出了AmbiVer来提高性能。

title: On-the-Fly VLA Adaptation via Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for general-purpose robot learning, enabling agents to map visual observations and natural-language instructions into executable robotic actions. Though popular, they are primarily trained via supervised fine-tuning or training-time reinforcement learning, requiring explicit fine-tuning phases, human interventions, or controlled data collection. Consequently, existing methods remain unsuitable for challenging simulated- or physical-world deployments, where robots must respond autonomously and flexibly to evolving environments. To address this limitation, we introduce a Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for VLAs (TT-VLA), a framework that enables on-the-fly policy adaptation during inference. TT-VLA formulates a dense reward mechanism that leverages step-by-step task-progress signals to refine action policies during test time while preserving the SFT/RL-trained priors, making it an effective supplement to current VLA models. Empirical results show that our approach enhances overall adaptability, stability, and task success in dynamic, previously unseen scenarios under simulated and real-world settings. We believe TT-VLA offers a principled step toward self-improving, deployment-ready VLAs.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型近期已成为一种强大的通用机器人学习范式，能够使智能体将视觉观测和自然语言指令映射为可执行的机器人动作。尽管它们很受欢迎，但主要还是通过监督微调或训练时强化学习进行训练，需要显式的微调阶段、人工干预或受控的数据收集。因此，现有方法仍然不适用于具有挑战性的模拟或物理世界部署，在这些部署中，机器人必须自主且灵活地响应不断变化的环境。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了针对视觉-语言-动作模型的测试时强化学习（TT-VLA），该框架能够在推理过程中实现即时策略适应。TT-VLA设计了一种密集奖励机制，利用逐步任务进程信号在测试时优化动作策略，同时保留经过监督微调/强化学习训练的先验知识，使其成为当前视觉-语言-动作模型的有效补充。经验结果表明，我们的方法增强了在模拟和现实世界环境中，动态的、先前未见场景中的整体适应性、稳定性和任务成功率。我们相信TT-VLA为实现自我改进、可部署的视觉-语言-动作模型迈出了有原则的一步。
tldr: This paper introduces TT-VLA, a test-time reinforcement learning framework for Vision-Language-Action models, enabling on-the-fly policy adaptation in dynamic environments by leveraging task-progress signals.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TT-VLA，一个用于视觉-语言-动作模型的测试时强化学习框架，通过利用任务进度信号，实现在动态环境中即时调整策略。

title: SpatialNav: Leveraging Spatial Scene Graphs for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Although learning-based vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents can learn spatial knowledge implicitly from large-scale training data, zero-shot VLN agents lack this process, relying primarily on local observations for navigation, which leads to inefficient exploration and a significant performance gap. To deal with the problem, we consider a zero-shot VLN setting that agents are allowed to fully explore the environment before task execution. Then, we construct the Spatial Scene Graph (SSG) to explicitly capture global spatial structure and semantics in the explored environment. Based on the SSG, we introduce SpatialNav, a zero-shot VLN agent that integrates an agent-centric spatial map, a compass-aligned visual representation, and a remote object localization strategy for efficient navigation. Comprehensive experiments in both discrete and continuous environments demonstrate that SpatialNav significantly outperforms existing zero-shot agents and clearly narrows the gap with state-of-the-art learning-based methods. Such results highlight the importance of global spatial representations for generalizable navigation.
summary_zh: 尽管基于学习的视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体可以从大规模训练数据中隐式地学习空间知识，但零样本VLN智能体缺乏这一过程，主要依赖于局部观察进行导航，导致探索效率低下和显著的性能差距。为了解决这个问题，我们考虑了一种零样本VLN设置，允许智能体在任务执行之前充分探索环境。然后，我们构建空间场景图（SSG）来显式地捕获已探索环境中的全局空间结构和语义。基于SSG，我们引入 SpatialNav，一种零样本VLN智能体，它集成了以智能体为中心的空间地图、指南针校准的视觉表示和远程对象定位策略，以实现高效导航。在离散和连续环境中的全面实验表明，SpatialNav 显著优于现有的零样本智能体，并明显缩小了与最先进的基于学习的方法之间的差距。这些结果突出了全局空间表示对于可泛化的导航的重要性。
tldr: The paper introduces SpatialNav, a zero-shot VLN agent that leverages Spatial Scene Graphs (SSG) to overcome the limitations of relying on local observations. It demonstrates improved performance compared to existing zero-shot methods, approaching state-of-the-art learning-based approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍SpatialNav，一种零样本VLN智能体，它利用空间场景图（SSG）来克服依赖局部观察的局限性。实验表明，与现有的零样本方法相比，性能有所提高，并接近最先进的基于学习的方法的性能。

title: Follow the Signs: Using Textual Cues and LLMs to Guide Efficient Robot Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation in unfamiliar environments often relies on geometric mapping and planning strategies that overlook rich semantic cues such as signs, room numbers, and textual labels. We propose a novel semantic navigation framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to infer patterns from partial observations and predict regions where the goal is most likely located. Our method combines local perceptual inputs with frontier-based exploration and periodic LLM queries, which extract symbolic patterns (e.g., room numbering schemes and building layout structures) and update a confidence grid used to guide exploration. This enables robots to move efficiently toward goal locations labeled with textual identifiers (e.g., "room 8") even before direct observation. We demonstrate that this approach enables more efficient navigation in sparse, partially observable grid environments by exploiting symbolic patterns. Experiments across environments modeled after real floor plans show that our approach consistently achieves near-optimal paths and outperforms baselines by over 25% in Success weighted by Path Length.
summary_zh: 在陌生环境中进行自主导航通常依赖于几何地图构建和路径规划策略，而忽略了丰富的语义线索，例如标志、房间号码和文本标签。 我们提出了一种新颖的语义导航框架，该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）从部分观测中推断模式，并预测目标最有可能位于的区域。 我们的方法结合了局部感知输入、基于边缘的探索和周期性的LLM查询，LLM提取符号模式（例如，房间编号方案和建筑布局结构）并更新用于引导探索的置信度网格。 这使得机器人即使在直接观察之前，也能有效地朝着带有文本标识符（例如，“房间8”）标记的目标位置移动。 我们证明了该方法通过利用符号模式，能够在稀疏、部分可观测的网格环境中实现更高效的导航。 在模拟真实楼层平面环境的实验中表明，我们的方法始终实现近优路径，并且在路径长度加权成功率上优于基线超过25%。
tldr: This paper presents a novel semantic navigation framework using LLMs to infer patterns from partial observations (like room numbers) to guide robot exploration in unfamiliar environments, achieving more efficient navigation toward textually labeled goals.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的语义导航框架，该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）从局部观测（如房间号）中推断模式，以指导机器人在陌生环境中进行探索，从而更有效地导航到具有文本标签的目标。

title: Watching, Reasoning, and Searching: A Video Deep Research Benchmark on Open Web for Agentic Video Reasoning
summary: In real-world video question answering scenarios, videos often provide only localized visual cues, while verifiable answers are distributed across the open web; models therefore need to jointly perform cross-frame clue extraction, iterative retrieval, and multi-hop reasoning-based verification. To bridge this gap, we construct the first video deep research benchmark, VideoDR. VideoDR centers on video-conditioned open-domain video question answering, requiring cross-frame visual anchor extraction, interactive web retrieval, and multi-hop reasoning over joint video-web evidence; through rigorous human annotation and quality control, we obtain high-quality video deep research samples spanning six semantic domains. We evaluate multiple closed-source and open-source multimodal large language models under both the Workflow and Agentic paradigms, and the results show that Agentic is not consistently superior to Workflow: its gains depend on a model's ability to maintain the initial video anchors over long retrieval chains. Further analysis indicates that goal drift and long-horizon consistency are the core bottlenecks. In sum, VideoDR provides a systematic benchmark for studying video agents in open-web settings and reveals the key challenges for next-generation video deep research agents.
summary_zh: 在现实世界的视频问答场景中，视频通常只提供局部视觉线索，而可验证的答案则分布在开放网络中；因此，模型需要联合执行跨帧线索提取、迭代检索以及基于多跳推理的验证。为了弥合这一差距，我们构建了首个视频深度研究基准，VideoDR。VideoDR 专注于视频条件下的开放域视频问答，需要进行跨帧视觉锚点提取、交互式网络检索以及基于联合视频-网络证据的多跳推理；通过严格的人工标注和质量控制，我们获得了高质量的视频深度研究样本，涵盖六个语义领域。我们评估了多个闭源和开源的多模态大型语言模型在工作流范式和代理范式下的表现，结果表明代理范式并不总是优于工作流范式：其增益取决于模型在长检索链中维持初始视频锚点的能力。进一步的分析表明，目标漂移和长程一致性是核心瓶颈。总而言之，VideoDR 提供了一个用于研究开放网络环境中视频代理的系统基准，并揭示了下一代视频深度研究代理的关键挑战。
tldr: The paper introduces VideoDR, a new video question answering benchmark requiring models to extract visual anchors, interactively retrieve information from the web, and perform multi-hop reasoning over video and web evidence. It also evaluates several models and highlights challenges of long-horizon consistency and goal drift in agentic video reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍VideoDR，一个新的视频问答基准，要求模型提取视觉锚点，从网络交互检索信息，并对视频和网络证据进行多跳推理。它还评估了几种模型，并强调了在agentic视频推理中长期一致性和目标漂移的挑战。

title: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models
summary: Language model families exhibit striking disparity in their capacity to benefit from reinforcement learning: under identical training, models like Qwen achieve substantial gains, while others like Llama yield limited improvements. Complementing data-centric approaches, we reveal that this disparity reflects a hidden structural property: \textbf{distributional clarity} in probability space. Through a three-stage analysis-from phenomenon to mechanism to interpretation-we uncover that RL-friendly models exhibit intra-class compactness and inter-class separation in their probability assignments to correct vs. incorrect responses. We quantify this clarity using the \textbf{Silhouette Coefficient} ($S$) and demonstrate that (1) high $S$ correlates strongly with RL performance; (2) low $S$ is associated with severe logic errors and reasoning instability. To confirm this property, we introduce a Silhouette-Aware Reweighting strategy that prioritizes low-$S$ samples during training. Experiments across six mathematical benchmarks show consistent improvements across all model families, with gains up to 5.9 points on AIME24. Our work establishes distributional clarity as a fundamental, trainable property underlying RL-Friendliness.
summary_zh: 语言模型家族在从强化学习中获益的能力方面表现出显著的差异：在相同的训练条件下，像Qwen这样的模型能够获得显著提升，而像Llama这样的模型提升有限。作为对以数据为中心的方法的补充，我们揭示了这种差异反映了一种隐藏的结构属性：概率空间中的\textbf{分布清晰度}。通过一个三阶段的分析——从现象到机制再到解释——我们发现易于强化学习的模型在其对正确与错误回答的概率分配中表现出类内紧凑性和类间分离性。我们使用\textbf{轮廓系数}（$S$）来量化这种清晰度，并证明了（1）高$S$值与强化学习性能高度相关；（2）低$S$值与严重的逻辑错误和推理不稳定性相关。为了验证这一属性，我们引入了一种轮廓感知重加权策略，该策略在训练期间优先考虑低$S$值的样本。在六个数学基准测试上的实验表明，所有模型家族都取得了持续的改进，在AIME24上最多提升了5.9个百分点。我们的工作确立了分布清晰度作为强化学习友好性的一个基本的、可训练的属性。
tldr: This paper identifies 'distributional clarity' in LLMs, measured by the Silhouette Coefficient, as a key factor affecting RL performance and proposes a reweighting strategy to improve it, demonstrably enhancing performance across several math benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文发现，大语言模型中的“分布清晰度”（通过轮廓系数衡量）是影响强化学习性能的关键因素，并提出了一种重加权策略来提高清晰度，从而在多个数学基准测试中显著提高性能。

title: Code Evolution for Control: Synthesizing Policies via LLM-Driven Evolutionary Search
summary: Designing effective control policies for autonomous systems remains a fundamental challenge, traditionally addressed through reinforcement learning or manual engineering. While reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success, it often suffers from high sample complexity, reward shaping difficulties, and produces opaque neural network policies that are hard to interpret or verify. Manual design, on the other hand, requires substantial domain expertise and struggles to scale across diverse tasks. In this work, we demonstrate that LLM-driven evolutionary search can effectively synthesize interpretable control policies in the form of executable code. By treating policy synthesis as a code evolution problem, we harness the LLM's prior knowledge of programming patterns and control heuristics while employing evolutionary search to explore the solution space systematically. We implement our approach using EvoToolkit, a framework that seamlessly integrates LLM-driven evolution with customizable fitness evaluation. Our method iteratively evolves populations of candidate policy programs, evaluating them against task-specific objectives and selecting superior individuals for reproduction. This process yields compact, human-readable control policies that can be directly inspected, modified, and formally verified. This work highlights the potential of combining foundation models with evolutionary computation for synthesizing trustworthy control policies in autonomous systems. Code is available at https://github.com/pgg3/EvoControl.
summary_zh: 为自主系统设计有效的控制策略仍然是一项根本性挑战，传统上通过强化学习或手动工程来实现。虽然强化学习取得了显著的成功，但它通常面临着样本复杂度高、奖励塑造困难以及生成难以解释或验证的不透明神经网络策略等问题。另一方面，手动设计需要大量的领域专业知识，并且难以扩展到不同的任务。在这项工作中，我们证明了LLM驱动的进化搜索可以有效地合成可解释的、可执行代码形式的控制策略。通过将策略合成视为一个代码进化问题，我们在系统性地探索解空间的同时，利用LLM关于编程模式和控制启发式的先验知识。我们使用EvoToolkit实现了我们的方法，这是一个将LLM驱动的进化与可定制的适应度评估无缝集成的框架。我们的方法迭代地进化候选策略程序的种群，根据特定任务的目标评估它们，并选择优秀的个体进行繁殖。这个过程产生紧凑、人类可读的控制策略，可以直接检查、修改和形式化验证。这项工作突出了将基础模型与进化计算相结合，在自主系统中合成可信控制策略的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/pgg3/EvoControl获取。
tldr: This paper introduces an LLM-driven evolutionary search method (EvoControl) to synthesize interpretable control policies as executable code, offering an alternative to traditional reinforcement learning and manual design.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于LLM驱动的进化搜索方法 (EvoControl)，用于将可解释的控制策略合成为可执行代码，为传统的强化学习和手动设计提供了一种替代方案。

title: Thinking with Deltas: Incentivizing Reinforcement Learning via Differential Visual Reasoning Policy
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models. However, adapting RLVR to multimodal domains suffers from a critical \textit{perception-reasoning decoupling}. Existing paradigms, driven by text-centric outcome rewards, reasoning in language medium, inadvertently encourage models to bypass visual perception. We empirically validate this through blind experiments: state-of-the-art policies maintain or surprisingly improve performance even when visual inputs are entirely removed. This reveals that these models degenerate into \textit{blind reasoners}, exploiting linguistic priors to generate plausible answers instead of attending to visual evidence. In response, we propose \textbf{Thinking with Deltas}, a framework driven by a \textbf{Differential Visual Reasoning Policy (DVRP)}. DVRP introduces intrinsic supervision via visual triplets, comprising original, masked, and perturbed inputs. It optimizes the model to maximize reasoning divergence from masked inputs (enforcing \textit{visual sensitivity}) while minimizing divergence from perturbed inputs (ensuring \textit{visual robustness}). By aligning reasoning variations strictly with the \textit{Delta} of visual information, DVRP inherently bolsters visual understanding capabilities and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both general and medical benchmarks, without requiring external annotations or auxiliary tools.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了大型语言模型中的推理能力。然而，将RLVR应用于多模态领域时，存在一个关键的\textit{感知-推理解耦}问题。现有的范式以文本为中心的输出奖励驱动，并在语言媒介中进行推理，这无意中鼓励模型绕过视觉感知。我们通过盲测实验实证性地验证了这一点：即使完全移除视觉输入，最先进的策略仍然保持甚至出人意料地提高了性能。这表明这些模型退化成了\textit{盲推理器}，利用语言先验来生成貌似合理的答案，而没有关注视觉证据。为了应对这个问题，我们提出了一个名为\textbf{基于差异的思考}的框架，该框架由\textbf{差异化视觉推理策略（DVRP）}驱动。DVRP通过视觉三元组（包括原始输入、掩码输入和扰动输入）引入了内在监督。它优化模型，使其最大化与掩码输入之间的推理差异（强制\textit{视觉敏感性}），同时最小化与扰动输入之间的差异（确保\textit{视觉鲁棒性}）。通过将推理变化严格与视觉信息的\textit{差异}对齐，DVRP固有地增强了视觉理解能力，并在通用和医疗基准测试上都显著优于最先进的方法，无需外部标注或辅助工具。
tldr: The paper introduces a Differential Visual Reasoning Policy (DVRP) to address the perception-reasoning decoupling issue in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) in multimodal domains, forcing the model to attend more to visual information, thereby improving performance on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种差分视觉推理策略(DVRP)，旨在解决多模态领域中基于可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)中存在的感知-推理解耦问题，从而迫使模型更多地关注视觉信息，提升模型在各种基准上的性能。

title: No More Stale Feedback: Co-Evolving Critics for Open-World Agent Learning
summary: Critique-guided reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training LLM agents by augmenting sparse outcome rewards with natural-language feedback. However, current methods often rely on static or offline critic models, which fail to adapt as the policy evolves. In on-policy RL, the agent's error patterns shift over time, causing stationary critics to become stale and providing feedback of diminishing utility. To address this, we introduce ECHO (Evolving Critic for Hindsight-Guided Optimization)}, a framework that jointly optimizes the policy and critic through a synchronized co-evolutionary loop. ECHO utilizes a cascaded rollout mechanism where the critic generates multiple diagnoses for an initial trajectory, followed by policy refinement to enable group-structured advantage estimation. We address the challenge of learning plateaus via a saturation-aware gain shaping objective, which rewards the critic for inducing incremental improvements in high-performing trajectories. By employing dual-track GRPO updates, ECHO ensures the critic's feedback stays synchronized with the evolving policy. Experimental results show that ECHO yields more stable training and higher long-horizon task success across open-world environments.
summary_zh: 批判指导的强化学习（RL）已经成为训练LLM智能体的一种强大范式，它通过自然语言反馈增强稀疏的结果奖励。然而，当前的方法通常依赖于静态或离线的评论模型，这些模型无法随着策略的演进而适应。在在线策略强化学习中，智能体的错误模式会随时间推移而改变，导致静止的评论模型变得过时，并提供效用递减的反馈。为了解决这个问题，我们引入ECHO（用于后见之明引导优化的进化型评论模型），该框架通过同步的协同进化循环联合优化策略和评论模型。ECHO利用级联展开机制，评论模型为初始轨迹生成多个诊断结果，然后进行策略改进，从而实现组结构优势估计。我们通过饱和度感知增益塑形目标来解决学习高原的挑战，该目标奖励评论模型在高性能轨迹中诱导增量改进。通过采用双轨GRPO更新，ECHO确保评论模型的反馈与不断演进的策略保持同步。实验结果表明，ECHO在开放世界环境中能够实现更稳定的训练和更高的长时程任务成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces ECHO, a framework for co-evolving critics and policies in reinforcement learning to address the issue of stale feedback from static critics, leading to more stable training and higher task success in open-world environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ECHO，一个用于共同进化评论家和策略的强化学习框架，旨在解决静态评论家反馈陈旧的问题，从而在开放世界环境中实现更稳定的训练和更高的任务成功率。

title: IDRBench: Interactive Deep Research Benchmark
summary: Deep research agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform multi-step reasoning, web exploration, and long-form report generation. However, most existing systems operate in an autonomous manner, assuming fully specified user intent and evaluating only final outputs. In practice, research goals are often underspecified and evolve during exploration, making sustained interaction essential for robust alignment. Despite its importance, interaction remains largely invisible to existing deep research benchmarks, which neither model dynamic user feedback nor quantify its costs. We introduce IDRBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating interactive deep research. IDRBench combines a modular multi-agent research framework with on-demand interaction, a scalable reference-grounded user simulator, and an interaction-aware evaluation suite that jointly measures interaction benefits (quality and alignment) and costs (turns and tokens). Experiments across seven state-of-the-art LLMs show that interaction consistently improves research quality and robustness, often outweighing differences in model capacity, while revealing substantial trade-offs in interaction efficiency.
summary_zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的深度研究智能体能够执行多步骤推理、网络探索以及长篇报告生成。然而，大多数现有系统以自主方式运行，假设用户意图完全明确，并且仅评估最终输出结果。在实践中，研究目标通常未充分明确，并在探索过程中演变，因此持续交互对于稳健的对齐至关重要。尽管交互很重要，但它在现有的深度研究基准测试中仍然基本上不可见，这些基准既不建模动态用户反馈，也不量化其成本。我们推出了IDRBench，这是首个用于系统性评估交互式深度研究的基准。IDRBench结合了一个模块化多智能体研究框架、按需交互、一个可扩展的参考接地用户模拟器，以及一个交互感知的评估套件，该套件联合衡量交互收益（质量和对齐）和成本（轮数和token数）。对七个最先进的LLM进行的实验表明，交互能够持续提高研究质量和稳健性，通常超过模型容量的差异，同时揭示了交互效率方面的重大权衡。
tldr: The paper introduces IDRBench, a novel benchmark for evaluating interactive deep research agents, highlighting the importance of user interaction in improving research quality and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了IDRBench，这是一个用于评估交互式深度研究代理的新基准，强调了用户交互在提高研究质量和鲁棒性方面的重要性。

title: SafePro: Evaluating the Safety of Professional-Level AI Agents
summary: Large language model-based agents are rapidly evolving from simple conversational assistants into autonomous systems capable of performing complex, professional-level tasks in various domains. While these advancements promise significant productivity gains, they also introduce critical safety risks that remain under-explored. Existing safety evaluations primarily focus on simple, daily assistance tasks, failing to capture the intricate decision-making processes and potential consequences of misaligned behaviors in professional settings. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{SafePro}, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety alignment of AI agents performing professional activities. SafePro features a dataset of high-complexity tasks across diverse professional domains with safety risks, developed through a rigorous iterative creation and review process. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art AI models reveals significant safety vulnerabilities and uncovers new unsafe behaviors in professional contexts. We further show that these models exhibit both insufficient safety judgment and weak safety alignment when executing complex professional tasks. In addition, we investigate safety mitigation strategies for improving agent safety in these scenarios and observe encouraging improvements. Together, our findings highlight the urgent need for robust safety mechanisms tailored to the next generation of professional AI agents.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型的智能体正迅速从简单的对话助手演变为能够执行各个领域复杂、专业级别任务的自主系统。虽然这些进展有望带来显著的生产力提升，但也引入了尚未充分探索的关键安全风险。现有的安全评估主要集中在简单的日常辅助任务上，未能捕捉到专业环境中复杂决策过程和行为不端带来的潜在后果。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了\textbf{SafePro}，这是一个旨在评估执行专业活动的AI智能体的安全对齐的综合基准。SafePro包含一个在安全风险多样的专业领域中，通过严格的迭代创建和审查过程开发而成的高复杂度任务数据集。我们对最先进的AI模型的评估揭示了显著的安全漏洞，并发现了专业环境中新的不安全行为。我们进一步表明，这些模型在执行复杂的专业任务时，表现出安全判断不足和安全对齐薄弱。此外，我们还研究了在这些场景中提高智能体安全性的安全缓解策略，并观察到令人鼓舞的改进。总之，我们的发现强调了针对下一代专业AI智能体量身定制的稳健安全机制的迫切需求。
tldr: This paper introduces SafePro, a benchmark for evaluating the safety of AI agents performing complex professional tasks, revealing significant safety vulnerabilities in current models and suggesting the need for improved safety mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SafePro，一个用于评估执行复杂专业任务的AI代理安全性的基准。它揭示了当前模型中存在的重大安全漏洞，并表明需要改进安全机制。

title: MVGGT: Multimodal Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer for Multiview 3D Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Most existing 3D referring expression segmentation (3DRES) methods rely on dense, high-quality point clouds, while real-world agents such as robots and mobile phones operate with only a few sparse RGB views and strict latency constraints. We introduce Multi-view 3D Referring Expression Segmentation (MV-3DRES), where the model must recover scene structure and segment the referred object directly from sparse multi-view images. Traditional two-stage pipelines, which first reconstruct a point cloud and then perform segmentation, often yield low-quality geometry, produce coarse or degraded target regions, and run slowly. We propose the Multimodal Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (MVGGT), an efficient end-to-end framework that integrates language information into sparse-view geometric reasoning through a dual-branch design. Training in this setting exposes a critical optimization barrier, termed Foreground Gradient Dilution (FGD), where sparse 3D signals lead to weak supervision. To resolve this, we introduce Per-view No-target Suppression Optimization (PVSO), which provides stronger and more balanced gradients across views, enabling stable and efficient learning. To support consistent evaluation, we build MVRefer, a benchmark that defines standardized settings and metrics for MV-3DRES. Experiments show that MVGGT establishes the first strong baseline and achieves both high accuracy and fast inference, outperforming existing alternatives. Code and models are publicly available at https://mvggt.github.io.
summary_zh: 大多数现有的3D指代表达式分割（3DRES）方法依赖于密集、高质量的点云，而现实世界中的智能体，如机器人和移动电话，仅在严格的延迟约束下使用少量稀疏的RGB视图进行操作。我们引入了多视图3D指代表达式分割（MV-3DRES），在这种情况下，模型必须从稀疏的多视图图像中直接恢复场景结构并分割所指对象。传统的两阶段流程，即首先重建点云，然后执行分割，通常会产生低质量的几何形状，产生粗糙或退化的目标区域，并且运行缓慢。我们提出了多模态视觉几何引导Transformer（MVGGT），这是一个高效的端到端框架，通过双分支设计将语言信息集成到稀疏视图几何推理中。在这种设置下训练会暴露一个关键的优化障碍，称为前景梯度稀释（FGD），其中稀疏的3D信号会导致弱监督。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了基于视角的无目标抑制优化（PVSO），它在不同的视图中提供更强和更平衡的梯度，从而实现稳定和高效的学习。为了支持一致的评估，我们构建了MVRefer，这是一个为MV-3DRES定义标准化设置和指标的基准。实验表明，MVGGT建立了第一个强大的基线，并在高精度和快速推理方面均表现出色，优于现有的替代方案。代码和模型可在 https://mvggt.github.io 公开获取。
tldr: The paper introduces MV-3DRES, a new task of 3D referring expression segmentation from sparse multi-view images, and proposes MVGGT, an end-to-end transformer-based framework to solve it, along with a new benchmark dataset MVRefer.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的任务MV-3DRES，即从稀疏多视图图像中进行3D指代表达式分割，并提出了MVGGT，一个基于Transformer的端到端框架来解决该问题，以及一个新的基准数据集MVRefer。

title: Speak While Watching: Unleashing TRUE Real-Time Video Understanding Capability of Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance across many tasks, yet most systems remain limited to offline inference, requiring complete inputs before generating outputs. Recent streaming methods reduce latency by interleaving perception and generation, but still enforce a sequential perception-generation cycle, limiting real-time interaction. In this work, we target a fundamental bottleneck that arises when extending MLLMs to real-time video understanding: the global positional continuity constraint imposed by standard positional encoding schemes. While natural in offline inference, this constraint tightly couples perception and generation, preventing effective input-output parallelism. To address this limitation, we propose a parallel streaming framework that relaxes positional continuity through three designs: Overlapped, Group-Decoupled, and Gap-Isolated. These designs enable simultaneous perception and generation, allowing the model to process incoming inputs while producing responses in real time. Extensive experiments reveal that Group-Decoupled achieves the best efficiency-performance balance, maintaining high fluency and accuracy while significantly reducing latency. We further show that the proposed framework yields up to 2x acceleration under balanced perception-generation workloads, establishing a principled pathway toward speak-while-watching real-time systems. We make all our code publicly available: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Speak-While-Watching.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)在许多任务中取得了强大的性能，但大多数系统仍局限于离线推理，需要在生成输出之前提供完整的输入。最近的流式方法通过交错感知和生成来降低延迟，但仍然强制执行串行感知-生成循环，从而限制了实时交互。在这项工作中，我们针对将MLLM扩展到实时视频理解时出现的一个根本瓶颈：标准位置编码方案施加的全局位置连续性约束。虽然在离线推理中很自然，但这种约束紧密地耦合了感知和生成，阻碍了有效的输入-输出并行性。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一个并行流式框架，通过以下三种设计来放松位置连续性：重叠式、组解耦式和间隙隔离式。这些设计能够实现同步感知和生成，允许模型在实时生成响应的同时处理传入的输入。大量实验表明，组解耦式实现了最佳的效率-性能平衡，保持了高度的流畅性和准确性，同时显著降低了延迟。我们进一步证明，所提出的框架在均衡的感知-生成工作负载下，速度可以提升高达2倍，从而为实现“边看边说”的实时系统奠定了原则性的途径。我们公开了所有代码：https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Speak-While-Watching。
tldr: This paper introduces a parallel streaming framework for MLLMs that relaxes positional continuity constraints, enabling simultaneous perception and generation for real-time video understanding, achieving up to 2x acceleration under balanced workloads.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于MLLM的并行流框架，该框架放宽了位置连续性约束，从而能够同时进行感知和生成，以实现实时视频理解，并在平衡工作负载下实现高达2倍的加速。

title: ObjSplat: Geometry-Aware Gaussian Surfels for Active Object Reconstruction
summary: Autonomous high-fidelity object reconstruction is fundamental for creating digital assets and bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in robotics. We present ObjSplat, an active reconstruction framework that leverages Gaussian surfels as a unified representation to progressively reconstruct unknown objects with both photorealistic appearance and accurate geometry. Addressing the limitations of conventional opacity or depth-based cues, we introduce a geometry-aware viewpoint evaluation pipeline that explicitly models back-face visibility and occlusion-aware multi-view covisibility, reliably identifying under-reconstructed regions even on geometrically complex objects. Furthermore, to overcome the limitations of greedy planning strategies, ObjSplat employs a next-best-path (NBP) planner that performs multi-step lookahead on a dynamically constructed spatial graph. By jointly optimizing information gain and movement cost, this planner generates globally efficient trajectories. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world cultural artifacts demonstrate that ObjSplat produces physically consistent models within minutes, achieving superior reconstruction fidelity and surface completeness while significantly reducing scan time and path length compared to state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://li-yuetao.github.io/ObjSplat-page/ .
summary_zh: 自主高保真物体重建是创建数字资产和弥合机器人学中仿真与现实差距的基础。我们提出了ObjSplat，一个主动重建框架，它利用高斯表面元素作为统一表示，逐步重建具有照片级真实外观和精确几何形状的未知物体。为了解决传统不透明度或基于深度的线索的局限性，我们引入了一个几何感知视点评估流程，该流程显式地建模了背面可见性和考虑遮挡的多视角共视性，从而可靠地识别出即使在几何形状复杂的物体上也能存在的欠重建区域。此外，为了克服贪婪规划策略的局限性，ObjSplat采用了一种最优路径规划器（NBP），该规划器在动态构建的空间图上执行多步骤前瞻。通过联合优化信息增益和移动成本，该规划器生成全局高效的轨迹。在模拟和真实世界文化遗产上的大量实验表明，ObjSplat可在几分钟内生成物理上一致的模型，与最先进的方法相比，显著减少了扫描时间和路径长度，同时实现了卓越的重建保真度和表面完整性。项目主页：https://li-yuetao.github.io/ObjSplat-page/ 。
tldr: ObjSplat is an active object reconstruction framework using Gaussian surfels and a geometry-aware next-best-path planner to achieve superior reconstruction fidelity and reduce scan time.
tldr_zh: ObjSplat是一个主动对象重建框架，它使用高斯冲浪元和几何感知的下一个最佳路径规划器，以实现卓越的重建保真度并减少扫描时间。

title: VISTA: Knowledge-Driven Interpretable Vessel Trajectory Imputation via Large Language Models
summary: The Automatic Identification System provides critical information for maritime navigation and safety, yet its trajectories are often incomplete due to signal loss or deliberate tampering. Existing imputation methods emphasize trajectory recovery, paying limited attention to interpretability and failing to provide underlying knowledge that benefits downstream tasks such as anomaly detection and route planning. We propose knowledge-driven interpretable vessel trajectory imputation (VISTA), the first trajectory imputation framework that offers interpretability while simultaneously providing underlying knowledge to support downstream analysis. Specifically, we first define underlying knowledge as a combination of Structured Data-derived Knowledge (SDK) distilled from AIS data and Implicit LLM Knowledge acquired from large-scale Internet corpora. Second, to manage and leverage the SDK effectively at scale, we develop a data-knowledge-data loop that employs a Structured Data-derived Knowledge Graph for SDK extraction and knowledge-driven trajectory imputation. Third, to efficiently process large-scale AIS data, we introduce a workflow management layer that coordinates the end-to-end pipeline, enabling parallel knowledge extraction and trajectory imputation with anomaly handling and redundancy elimination. Experiments on two large AIS datasets show that VISTA is capable of state-of-the-art imputation accuracy and computational efficiency, improving over state-of-the-art baselines by 5%-94% and reducing time cost by 51%-93%, while producing interpretable knowledge cues that benefit downstream tasks. The source code and implementation details of VISTA are publicly available.
summary_zh: 自动识别系统为海上导航和安全提供了关键信息，但其轨迹常常因信号丢失或蓄意篡改而不完整。现有的插补方法侧重于轨迹恢复，对可解释性的关注有限，无法提供有利于下游任务（如异常检测和航线规划）的底层知识。我们提出了知识驱动的可解释船舶轨迹插补（VISTA），这是第一个提供可解释性，同时提供底层知识以支持下游分析的轨迹插补框架。具体来说，我们首先将底层知识定义为结构化数据派生的知识（SDK）（从AIS数据中提取）和从大规模互联网语料库中获得的隐式LLM知识的组合。其次，为了大规模地管理和利用SDK，我们开发了一个数据-知识-数据循环，该循环采用结构化数据派生的知识图谱进行SDK提取和知识驱动的轨迹插补。第三，为了高效处理大规模AIS数据，我们引入了一个工作流管理层，负责协调端到端流程，从而实现并行知识提取和轨迹插补，并具有异常处理和冗余消除功能。在两个大型AIS数据集上的实验表明，VISTA能够实现最先进的插补精度和计算效率，比最先进的基线提高了5%-94%，时间成本降低了51%-93%，同时生成了有利于下游任务的可解释知识线索。VISTA的源代码和实现细节已公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces VISTA, a knowledge-driven framework leveraging large language models and knowledge graphs for interpretable vessel trajectory imputation, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency compared to existing methods while providing knowledge cues for downstream tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VISTA，一个知识驱动的框架，利用大型语言模型和知识图谱进行可解释的船舶轨迹插补，与现有方法相比，展示了更高的准确性和效率，同时为下游任务提供知识线索。

title: V2P: Visual Attention Calibration for GUI Grounding via Background Suppression and Center Peaking
summary: Precise localization of GUI elements is crucial for the development of GUI agents. Traditional methods rely on bounding box or center-point regression, neglecting spatial interaction uncertainty and visual-semantic hierarchies. Recent methods incorporate attention mechanisms but still face two key issues: (1) ignoring processing background regions causes attention drift from the desired area, and (2) uniform modeling the target UI element fails to distinguish between its center and edges, leading to click imprecision. Inspired by how humans visually process and interact with GUI elements, we propose the Valley-to-Peak (V2P) method to address these issues. To mitigate background distractions, V2P introduces a suppression attention mechanism that minimizes the model's focus on irrelevant regions to highlight the intended region. For the issue of center-edge distinction, V2P applies a Fitts' Law-inspired approach by modeling GUI interactions as 2D Gaussian heatmaps where the weight gradually decreases from the center towards the edges. The weight distribution follows a Gaussian function, with the variance determined by the target's size. Consequently, V2P effectively isolates the target area and teaches the model to concentrate on the most essential point of the UI element. The model trained by V2P achieves the performance with 92.4\% and 52.5\% on two benchmarks ScreenSpot-v2 and ScreenSpot-Pro (see Fig.~\ref{fig:main_results_charts}). Ablations further confirm each component's contribution, underscoring V2P's generalizability in precise GUI grounding tasks and its potential for real-world deployment in future GUI agents.
summary_zh: GUI元素的精确定位对于GUI代理的开发至关重要。传统方法依赖于边界框或中心点回归，忽略了空间交互不确定性和视觉语义层级结构。最近的方法融合了注意力机制，但仍面临两个关键问题：（1）忽略背景区域的处理导致注意力从目标区域漂移，以及（2）对目标UI元素进行统一建模未能区分其中心和边缘，导致点击不精确。受到人类视觉处理和与GUI元素交互方式的启发，我们提出了一种Valley-to-Peak (V2P)方法来解决这些问题。为了减轻背景干扰，V2P引入了一种抑制注意力机制，该机制最小化模型对无关区域的关注，从而突出预期区域。对于中心-边缘区分的问题，V2P采用了一种受Fitts定律启发的策略，通过将GUI交互建模为2D高斯热图来解决，其中权重从中心向边缘逐渐减小。权重分布遵循高斯函数，其方差由目标的大小决定。因此，V2P有效地隔离了目标区域，并引导模型专注于UI元素的最关键点。经过V2P训练的模型在两个基准测试ScreenSpot-v2和ScreenSpot-Pro上分别实现了92.4%和52.5%的性能（参见图~\ref{fig:main_results_charts}）。消融实验进一步证实了每个组件的贡献，突显了V2P在精确GUI grounding任务中的通用性以及其在未来GUI代理中实际部署的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces V2P, a novel method for precise GUI element localization using background suppression and a Fitts' Law-inspired approach to model attention as a Gaussian heatmap, achieving state-of-the-art performance on GUI grounding benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为V2P的新方法，用于精确定位GUI元素。该方法利用背景抑制和受Fitts' Law启发的策略，将注意力建模为高斯热图，并在GUI grounding基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: MixRI: Mixing Features of Reference Images for Novel Object Pose Estimation
summary: We present MixRI, a lightweight network that solves the CAD-based novel object pose estimation problem in RGB images. It can be instantly applied to a novel object at test time without finetuning. We design our network to meet the demands of real-world applications, emphasizing reduced memory requirements and fast inference time. Unlike existing works that utilize many reference images and have large network parameters, we directly match points based on the multi-view information between the query and reference images with a lightweight network. Thanks to our reference image fusion strategy, we significantly decrease the number of reference images, thus decreasing the time needed to process these images and the memory required to store them. Furthermore, with our lightweight network, our method requires less inference time. Though with fewer reference images, experiments on seven core datasets in the BOP challenge show that our method achieves comparable results with other methods that require more reference images and larger network parameters.
summary_zh: 我们提出了MixRI，一种轻量级网络，用于解决基于CAD的RGB图像中新物体姿态估计问题。它可以在测试时立即应用于新物体，无需微调。 我们将网络设计为满足实际应用的需求，强调降低内存需求和加快推理速度。 与现有方法不同，现有方法利用大量参考图像并具有较大的网络参数，我们直接基于查询图像和参考图像之间的多视角信息，利用轻量级网络进行点匹配。 感谢我们的参考图像融合策略，我们显著减少了参考图像的数量，从而减少了处理这些图像所需的时间以及存储它们所需的内存。 此外，借助我们的轻量级网络，我们的方法需要更少的推理时间。 尽管使用的参考图像较少，但在BOP挑战赛的七个核心数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法与其他需要更多参考图像和更大网络参数的方法相比，取得了相当的结果。
tldr: MixRI is a lightweight network for novel object pose estimation using a reference image fusion strategy to reduce memory requirements and inference time while achieving comparable results to methods requiring more resources.
tldr_zh: MixRI 是一种轻量级网络，用于新颖物体姿态估计。它使用参考图像融合策略来降低内存需求和推理时间，同时达到与其他需要更多资源的方法相当的效果。

title: ET-Agent: Incentivizing Effective Tool-Integrated Reasoning Agent via Behavior Calibration
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can extend their parameter knowledge limits by adopting the Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) paradigm. However, existing LLM-based agent training framework often focuses on answers' accuracy, overlooking specific alignment for behavior patterns. Consequently, agent often exhibits ineffective actions during TIR tasks, such as redundant and insufficient tool calls. How to calibrate erroneous behavioral patterns when executing TIR tasks, thereby exploring effective trajectories, remains an open-ended problem. In this paper, we propose ET-Agent, a training framework for calibrating agent's tool-use behavior through two synergistic perspectives: Self-evolving Data Flywheel and Behavior Calibration Training. Specifically, we introduce a self-evolutionary data flywheel to generate enhanced data, used to fine-tune LLM to improve its exploration ability. Based on this, we implement an two-phases behavior-calibration training framework. It is designed to progressively calibrate erroneous behavioral patterns to optimal behaviors. Further in-depth experiments confirm the superiority of \ourmodel{} across multiple dimensions, including correctness, efficiency, reasoning conciseness, and tool execution accuracy. Our ET-Agent framework provides practical insights for research in the TIR field. Codes can be found in https://github.com/asilverlight/ET-Agent
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过采用工具集成推理（TIR）范式来扩展其参数知识的限制。然而，现有的基于LLM的智能体训练框架通常侧重于答案的准确性，而忽略了对行为模式的特定对齐。因此，智能体在执行TIR任务时经常表现出无效行为，例如冗余和不足的工具调用。如何校准执行TIR任务时的错误行为模式，从而探索有效的轨迹，仍然是一个开放性问题。在本文中，我们提出了ET-Agent，一个训练框架，通过两个协同的视角来校准智能体的工具使用行为：自进化数据飞轮和行为校准训练。具体而言，我们引入了一个自进化数据飞轮来生成增强数据，用于微调LLM以提高其探索能力。在此基础上，我们实现了一个两阶段行为校准训练框架。该框架旨在逐步将错误的行动模式校准到最佳行为。进一步的深入实验证实了\ourmodel{}在多个维度上的优越性，包括正确性、效率、推理简洁性和工具执行准确性。我们的ET-Agent框架为TIR领域的研究提供了实践性的见解。代码可在https://github.com/asilverlight/ET-Agent找到。
tldr: The paper introduces ET-Agent, a framework to improve the tool-use behavior of LLM-based agents in Tool-Integrated Reasoning tasks by calibrating erroneous patterns through a self-evolving data flywheel and a two-phase behavior calibration training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ET-Agent，一个通过自我进化数据飞轮和两阶段行为校准训练，来改进基于LLM的Agent在工具集成推理任务中工具使用行为的框架，旨在校准错误的模式。

title: MemGovern: Enhancing Code Agents through Learning from Governed Human Experiences
summary: While autonomous software engineering (SWE) agents are reshaping programming paradigms, they currently suffer from a "closed-world" limitation: they attempt to fix bugs from scratch or solely using local context, ignoring the immense historical human experience available on platforms like GitHub. Accessing this open-world experience is hindered by the unstructured and fragmented nature of real-world issue-tracking data. In this paper, we introduce MemGovern, a framework designed to govern and transform raw GitHub data into actionable experiential memory for agents. MemGovern employs experience governance to convert human experience into agent-friendly experience cards and introduces an agentic experience search strategy that enables logic-driven retrieval of human expertise. By producing 135K governed experience cards, MemGovern achieves a significant performance boost, improving resolution rates on the SWE-bench Verified by 4.65%. As a plug-in approach, MemGovern provides a solution for agent-friendly memory infrastructure.
summary_zh: 自动软件工程（SWE）智能体正在重塑编程范式，但它们目前面临一个“封闭世界”的局限性：它们试图从零开始或仅利用局部上下文来修复缺陷，而忽略了GitHub等平台上可用的海量历史人类经验。访问这种开放世界经验受到现实世界问题跟踪数据非结构化和碎片化性质的阻碍。在本文中，我们介绍MemGovern，一个旨在管理并将原始GitHub数据转化为智能体可操作的经验记忆的框架。MemGovern采用经验治理将人类经验转化为智能体友好的经验卡片，并引入了一种智能体驱动的经验搜索策略，从而可以实现逻辑驱动的人类专业知识检索。通过生成13.5万张由治理的经验卡片，MemGovern实现了显著的性能提升，在SWE-bench Verified上的问题解决率提高了4.65%。作为一种插件式方法，MemGovern为智能体友好的记忆基础设施提供了一种解决方案。
tldr: MemGovern addresses the 'closed-world' limitation of software engineering agents by transforming unstructured GitHub data into actionable experiential memory, leading to improved bug resolution.
tldr_zh: MemGovern通过将非结构化的GitHub数据转化为可操作的经验记忆的方式，解决了软件工程智能体的“封闭世界”局限，从而提高了bug修复效率。

title: Observability-Enhanced Target Motion Estimation via Bearing-Box: Theory and MAV Applications
summary: Monocular vision-based target motion estimation is a fundamental challenge in numerous applications. This work introduces a novel bearing-box approach that fully leverages modern 3D detection measurements that are widely available nowadays but have not been well explored for motion estimation so far. Unlike existing methods that rely on restrictive assumptions such as isotropic target shape and lateral motion, our bearing-box estimator can estimate both the target's motion and its physical size without these assumptions by exploiting the information buried in a 3D bounding box. When applied to multi-rotor micro aerial vehicles (MAVs), the estimator yields an interesting advantage: it further removes the need for higher-order motion assumptions by exploiting the unique coupling between MAV's acceleration and thrust. This is particularly significant, as higher-order motion assumptions are widely believed to be necessary in state-of-the-art bearing-based estimators. We support our claims with rigorous observability analyses and extensive experimental validation, demonstrating the estimator's superior performance in real-world scenarios.
summary_zh: 基于单目视觉的目标运动估计是众多应用中的一个根本挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的bearing-box方法，该方法充分利用了现代3D检测测量结果，这些测量结果目前已广泛应用，但迄今为止尚未在运动估计中得到充分探索。与依赖于各向同性目标形状和横向运动等限制性假设的现有方法不同，我们的bearing-box估计器可以通过利用隐藏在3D边界框中的信息，在没有这些假设的情况下估计目标的运动及其物理尺寸。当应用于多旋翼微型飞行器（MAV）时，该估计器产生了一个有趣的优势：它进一步消除了对高阶运动假设的需求，因为它利用了MAV的加速度和推力之间的独特耦合。这一点尤其重要，因为人们普遍认为高阶运动假设在最先进的基于bearing的估计器中是必要的。我们通过严格的可观测性分析和广泛的实验验证来支持我们的主张，证明了该估计器在真实场景中的优越性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel bearing-box approach for monocular vision-based target motion estimation, leveraging 3D bounding boxes to estimate both target motion and size without restrictive assumptions, particularly benefiting MAV applications by removing higher-order motion assumptions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于单目视觉的目标运动估计方法，称为bearing-box方法。该方法利用3D边界框来估计目标的运动和大小，无需进行限制性假设。该方法尤其适用于多旋翼飞行器（MAV），因为它消除了高阶运动假设。

title: GDEPO: Group Dual-dynamic and Equal-right-advantage Policy Optimization with Enhanced Training Data Utilization for Sample-Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Automated Theorem Proving (ATP) represents a fundamental challenge in Artificial Intelligence (AI), requiring the construction of machine-verifiable proofs in formal languages such as Lean to evaluate AI reasoning capabilities. Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly the high-performance Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm, has emerged as a mainstream approach for this task. However, in ATP scenarios, GRPO faces two critical issues: when composite rewards are used, its relative advantage estimation may conflict with the binary feedback from the formal verifier; meanwhile, its static sampling strategy may discard entire batches of data if no valid proof is found, resulting in zero contribution to model updates and significant data waste. To address these limitations, we propose Group Dual-dynamic and Equal-right-advantage Policy Optimization (GDEPO), a method incorporating three core mechanisms: 1) dynamic additional sampling, which resamples invalid batches until a valid proof is discovered; 2) equal-right advantage, decoupling the sign of the advantage function (based on correctness) from its magnitude (modulated by auxiliary rewards) to ensure stable and correct policy updates; and 3) dynamic additional iterations, applying extra gradient steps to initially failed but eventually successful samples to accelerate learning on challenging cases. Experiments conducted on three datasets of varying difficulty (MinF2F-test, MathOlympiadBench, PutnamBench) confirm the effectiveness of GDEPO, while ablation studies validate the necessity of its synergistic components. The proposed method enhances data utilization and optimization efficiency, offering a novel training paradigm for ATP.
summary_zh: 自动定理证明 (ATP) 代表了人工智能 (AI) 领域的一项根本性挑战，它需要构建机器可验证的、采用如 Lean 等形式化语言的证明，以便评估 AI 的推理能力。强化学习 (RL)，特别是高性能的群组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 算法，已经成为完成这项任务的主流方法。然而，在 ATP 场景下，GRPO 面临两个关键问题：当使用复合奖励时，其相对优势估计可能与形式化验证器的二元反馈相冲突；同时，其静态采样策略可能会丢弃整个批次的数据 (如果未找到有效证明)，导致对模型更新的零贡献和显著的数据浪费。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种群组双动态和等权优势策略优化 (GDEPO) 方法，它包含三个核心机制：1) 动态附加采样，对无效批次进行重采样，直到发现有效证明；2) 等权优势，将优势函数的符号（基于正确性）与其幅度（受辅助奖励调制）解耦，以确保稳定和正确的策略更新；3) 动态附加迭代，对最初失败但最终成功的样本应用额外的梯度步，以加速对具有挑战性的案例的学习。在三个不同难度的数据集（MinF2F-test, MathOlympiadBench, PutnamBench）上进行的实验证实了 GDEPO 的有效性，而消融研究验证了其协同组成部分的必要性。该方法提高了数据利用率和优化效率，为 ATP 提供了一种新颖的训练范式。
tldr: The paper introduces GDEPO, a reinforcement learning method designed to improve data utilization and policy optimization efficiency in Automated Theorem Proving (ATP), addressing limitations of existing approaches like GRPO.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GDEPO，一种强化学习方法，旨在提高自动定理证明（ATP）中的数据利用率和策略优化效率，解决了现有方法（如GRPO）的局限性。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Dynamic Multi-Graph Fusion for Evacuation Traffic Prediction
summary: Real-time traffic prediction is critical for managing transportation systems during hurricane evacuations. Although data-driven graph-learning models have demonstrated strong capabilities in capturing the complex spatiotemporal dynamics of evacuation traffic at a network level, they mostly consider a single dimension (e.g., travel-time or distance) to construct the underlying graph. Furthermore, these models often lack interpretability, offering little insight into which input variables contribute most to their predictive performance. To overcome these limitations, we develop a novel Reinforcement Learning-guided Dynamic Multi-Graph Fusion (RL-DMF) framework for evacuation traffic prediction. We construct multiple dynamic graphs at each time step to represent heterogeneous spatiotemporal relationships between traffic detectors. A dynamic multi-graph fusion (DMF) module is employed to adaptively learn and combine information from these graphs. To enhance model interpretability, we introduce RL-based intelligent feature selection and ranking (RL-IFSR) method that learns to mask irrelevant features during model training. The model is evaluated using a real-world dataset of 12 hurricanes affecting Florida from 2016 to 2024. For an unseen hurricane (Milton, 2024), the model achieves a 95% accuracy (RMSE = 293.9) for predicting the next 1-hour traffic flow. Moreover, the model can forecast traffic flow for up to next 6 hours with 90% accuracy (RMSE = 426.4). The RL-DMF framework outperforms several state-of-the-art traffic prediction models. Furthermore, ablation experiments confirm the effectiveness of dynamic multi-graph fusion and RL-IFSR approaches for improving model performance. This research provides a generalized and interpretable model for real-time evacuation traffic forecasting, with significant implications for evacuation traffic management.
summary_zh: 实时交通预测对于飓风疏散期间的交通系统管理至关重要。虽然数据驱动的图学习模型已展现出强大的能力，能够捕捉网络层面疏散交通复杂的时空动态，但它们大多只考虑单一维度（例如，行程时间或距离）来构建底层图结构。此外，这些模型通常缺乏可解释性，未能深入了解哪些输入变量对预测性能贡献最大。为了克服这些局限性，我们开发了一种新颖的强化学习引导的动态多图融合（RL-DMF）框架，用于疏散交通预测。我们在每个时间步构建多个动态图，以表示交通检测器之间不同的时空关系。采用动态多图融合（DMF）模块来自适应地学习和融合来自这些图的信息。为了增强模型的可解释性，我们引入了基于强化学习的智能特征选择和排序（RL-IFSR）方法，该方法学习在模型训练过程中屏蔽不相关的特征。该模型使用来自2016年至2024年影响佛罗里达州的12个飓风的真实世界数据集进行评估。对于一个未知的飓风（Milton，2024），该模型在预测未来1小时的交通流量时达到了95%的准确率（RMSE = 293.9）。此外，该模型能够以90%的准确率（RMSE = 426.4）预测未来长达6小时的交通流量。RL-DMF框架优于几种最先进的交通预测模型。此外，消融实验证实了动态多图融合和RL-IFSR方法在提高模型性能方面的有效性。这项研究提供了一个通用且可解释的实时疏散交通预测模型，对于疏散交通管理具有重要意义。
tldr: The paper introduces a Reinforcement Learning-guided Dynamic Multi-Graph Fusion (RL-DMF) framework for evacuation traffic prediction, enhancing accuracy and interpretability using real-world hurricane data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于强化学习的动态多图融合（RL-DMF）框架，用于疏散交通预测，通过使用真实飓风数据来提高准确性和可解释性。

title: Benchmarking Autonomy in Scientific Experiments: A Hierarchical Taxonomy for Autonomous Large-Scale Facilities
summary: The transition from automated data collection to fully autonomous discovery requires a shared vocabulary to benchmark progress. While the automotive industry relies on the SAE J3016 standard, current taxonomies for autonomous science presuppose an owner-operator model that is incompatible with the operational rigidities of Large-Scale User Facilities. Here, we propose the Benchmarking Autonomy in Scientific Experiments (BASE) Scale, a 6-level taxonomy (Levels 0-5) specifically adapted for these unique constraints. Unlike owner-operator models, User Facilities require zero-shot deployment where agents must operate immediately without extensive training periods. We define the specific technical requirements for each tier, identifying the Inference Barrier (Level 3) as the critical latency threshold where decisions shift from scalar feedback to semantic digital twins. Fundamentally, this level extends the decision manifold from spatial exploration to temporal gating, enabling the agent to synchronise acquisition with the onset of transient physical events. By establishing these operational definitions, the BASE Scale provides facility directors, funding bodies, and beamline scientists with a standardised metric to assess risk, define liability, and quantify the intelligence of experimental workflows.
summary_zh: 从自动化数据收集到完全自主发现的过渡需要一个共享的词汇表来衡量进展。尽管汽车工业依赖SAE J3016标准，但目前用于自主科学的分类法预设了一个所有者-操作者模型，该模型与大型用户设施的操作刚性不兼容。在此，我们提出了科学实验自主性基准（BASE）量表，这是一种专门为这些独特约束条件而设计的6级分类法（0-5级）。与所有者-操作者模型不同，用户设施需要零样本部署，即智能体必须立即运行而无需大量的训练周期。我们定义了每个级别的具体技术要求，并将推理障碍（第3级）确定为关键的延迟阈值，在该阈值处，决策从标量反馈转变为语义数字孪生。从根本上说，这一级别将决策流形从空间探索扩展到时间门控，使智能体能够将采集与瞬态物理事件的发生同步。通过建立这些操作定义，BASE量表为设施主管、资助机构和光束线科学家提供了一个标准化的指标，以评估风险、界定责任并量化实验工作流程的智能化程度。
tldr: This paper introduces the BASE Scale, a novel 6-level taxonomy for benchmarking autonomy in scientific experiments at Large-Scale User Facilities, addressing the need for standardized metrics to assess autonomy levels and facilitate the transition to fully autonomous discovery.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 BASE 量表，一种新型的六级分类法，用于评估大型用户设施中科学实验的自主性，旨在解决对标准化指标的需求，以评估自主性水平并促进向完全自主发现的过渡。

title: SPINE Gripper: A Twisted Underactuated Mechanism-based Passive Mode-Transition Gripper
summary: This paper presents a single-actuator passive gripper that achieves both stable grasping and continuous bidirectional in-hand rotation through mechanically encoded power transmission logic. Unlike conventional multifunctional grippers that require multiple actuators, sensors, or control-based switching, the proposed gripper transitions between grasping and rotation solely according to the magnitude of the applied input torque. The key enabler of this behavior is a Twisted Underactuated Mechanism (TUM), which generates non-coplanar motions, namely axial contraction and rotation, from a single rotational input while producing identical contraction regardless of rotation direction. A friction generator mechanically defines torque thresholds that govern passive mode switching, enabling stable grasp establishment before autonomously transitioning to in-hand rotation without sensing or active control. Analytical models describing the kinematics, elastic force generation, and torque transmission of the TUM are derived and experimentally validated. The fabricated gripper is evaluated through quantitative experiments on grasp success, friction-based grasp force regulation, and bidirectional rotation performance. System-level demonstrations, including bolt manipulation, object reorientation, and manipulator-integrated tasks driven solely by wrist torque, confirm reliable grasp to rotate transitions in both rotational directions. These results demonstrate that non-coplanar multifunctional manipulation can be realized through mechanical design alone, establishing mechanically encoded power transmission logic as a robust alternative to actuator and control intensive gripper architectures.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种单驱动器被动夹爪，通过机械编码的动力传输逻辑，实现了稳定的抓取和连续的双向手内旋转。与需要多个驱动器、传感器或基于控制的切换的传统多功能夹爪不同，所提出的夹爪仅根据施加的输入扭矩的大小在抓取和旋转之间转换。实现这种行为的关键在于一种扭曲欠驱动机构（TUM），该机构从单个旋转输入产生非共面运动，即轴向收缩和旋转，同时产生与旋转方向无关的相同收缩。摩擦发生器以机械方式定义扭矩阈值，控制被动模式切换，从而在自主过渡到手内旋转之前建立稳定抓取，无需传感或主动控制。推导并实验验证了描述TUM运动学、弹性力生成和扭矩传递的分析模型。通过关于抓取成功率、基于摩擦的抓取力调节和双向旋转性能的定量实验对所制造的夹爪进行了评估。系统级演示，包括螺栓操作、物体重新定向以及完全由腕部扭矩驱动的集成机械臂任务，证实了在两个旋转方向上都能可靠地实现从抓取到旋转的转换。这些结果表明，可以通过纯机械设计来实现非共面多功能操作，从而将机械编码的动力传输逻辑确立为一种稳健的替代方案，以替代驱动器和控制密集型的夹爪架构。
tldr: This paper presents a single-actuator gripper using a Twisted Underactuated Mechanism (TUM) for passive grasping and in-hand rotation, achieving mode transitions based on applied torque without sensors or active control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于扭转欠驱动机制（TUM）的单驱动器夹爪，用于被动抓取和手中旋转，通过施加的扭矩实现模式转换，无需传感器或主动控制。

title: Robust Evacuation for Multi-Drone Failure in Drone Light Shows
summary: Drone light shows have emerged as a popular form of entertainment in recent years. However, several high-profile incidents involving large-scale drone failures -- where multiple drones simultaneously fall from the sky -- have raised safety and reliability concerns. To ensure robustness, we propose a drone parking algorithm designed specifically for multiple drone failures in drone light shows, aimed at mitigating the risk of cascading collisions by drone evacuation and enabling rapid recovery from failures by leveraging strategically placed hidden drones. Our algorithm integrates a Social LSTM model with attention mechanisms to predict the trajectories of failing drones and compute near-optimal evacuation paths that minimize the likelihood of surviving drones being hit by fallen drones. In the recovery node, our system deploys hidden drones (operating with their LED lights turned off) to replace failed drones so that the drone light show can continue. Our experiments showed that our approach can greatly increase the robustness of a multi-drone system by leveraging deep learning to predict the trajectories of fallen drones.
summary_zh: 无人机灯光秀近年来成为一种流行的娱乐形式。然而，几起涉及大规模无人机故障的引人注目的事件——即多架无人机同时从空中坠落——引发了安全性和可靠性方面的担忧。为了确保稳健性，我们提出了一种专为无人机灯光秀中的多无人机故障设计的无人机避障算法，旨在通过无人机疏散来降低级联碰撞的风险，并通过利用战略性放置的隐藏无人机来实现从故障中的快速恢复。我们的算法集成了带有注意力机制的 Social LSTM 模型，以预测故障无人机的轨迹，并计算出近乎最优的疏散路径，从而最大限度地减少幸存无人机被坠落无人机击中的可能性。在恢复节点，我们的系统部署隐藏的无人机（关闭其 LED 灯运行），以替换故障的无人机，从而使无人机灯光秀能够继续进行。我们的实验表明，通过利用深度学习预测坠落无人机的轨迹，我们的方法可以大大提高多无人机系统的稳健性。
tldr: This paper presents a drone parking and recovery algorithm for drone light shows that aims to mitigate the risk of cascading collisions due to multiple drone failures by predicting falling drone trajectories and deploying hidden drones for replacement.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无人机灯光秀的无人机停放和恢复算法，旨在通过预测坠落无人机的轨迹和部署隐藏无人机进行替换，来降低因多次无人机故障引起的级联碰撞的风险。

title: Logic-Driven Semantic Communication for Resilient Multi-Agent Systems
summary: The advent of 6G networks is accelerating autonomy and intelligence in large-scale, decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS). While this evolution enables adaptive behavior, it also heightens vulnerability to stressors such as environmental changes and adversarial behavior. Existing literature on resilience in decentralized MAS largely focuses on isolated aspects, such as fault tolerance, without offering a principled unified definition of multi-agent resilience. This gap limits the ability to design systems that can continuously sense, adapt, and recover under dynamic conditions. This article proposes a formal definition of MAS resilience grounded in two complementary dimensions: epistemic resilience, wherein agents recover and sustain accurate knowledge of the environment, and action resilience, wherein agents leverage that knowledge to coordinate and sustain goals under disruptions. We formalize resilience via temporal epistemic logic and quantify it using recoverability time (how quickly desired properties are re-established after a disturbance) and durability time (how long accurate beliefs and goal-directed behavior are sustained after recovery). We design an agent architecture and develop decentralized algorithms to achieve both epistemic and action resilience. We provide formal verification guarantees, showing that our specifications are sound with respect to the metric bounds and admit finite-horizon verification, enabling design-time certification and lightweight runtime monitoring. Through a case study on distributed multi-agent decision-making under stressors, we show that our approach outperforms baseline methods. Our formal verification analysis and simulation results highlight that the proposed framework enables resilient, knowledge-driven decision-making and sustained operation, laying the groundwork for resilient decentralized MAS in next-generation communication systems.
summary_zh: 6G网络的出现正在加速大规模去中心化多智能体系统（MAS）中的自主性和智能化。虽然这种演进实现了自适应行为，但也加剧了系统对环境变化和对抗行为等压力的脆弱性。现有关于去中心化MAS韧性的文献主要关注孤立的方面，例如容错性，而没有提供多智能体韧性的原则性统一定义。这个差距限制了设计能够在动态条件下持续感知、适应和恢复的系统的能力。本文提出了一个MAS韧性的形式化定义，该定义基于两个互补维度：认知韧性，其中智能体恢复并维持对环境的准确知识；以及行动韧性，其中智能体利用该知识在干扰下协调和维持目标。我们通过时序认知逻辑将韧性形式化，并使用可恢复时间（扰动后重新建立所需属性的速度）和持久时间（恢复后准确的信念和目标导向行为持续的时间）对其进行量化。我们设计了一种智能体架构，并开发了去中心化算法来实现认知和行动韧性。我们提供了形式化验证保证，表明我们的规范对于度量边界是可靠的，并且允许有限视界的验证，从而实现设计时认证和轻量级的运行时监控。通过一个在压力下进行分布式多智能体决策的案例研究，我们表明我们的方法优于基线方法。我们的形式化验证分析和仿真结果表明，所提出的框架能够实现具有韧性的、知识驱动的决策制定和持续运行，为下一代通信系统中具有韧性的去中心化MAS奠定基础。
tldr: This paper proposes a logic-driven approach to enhance resilience in multi-agent systems by formalizing epistemic and action resilience using temporal epistemic logic, leading to provably resilient decentralized algorithms applicable to next-generation communication systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种逻辑驱动的方法，通过使用时间认知逻辑形式化认知和行动弹性来增强多智能体系统的弹性，从而产生可证明的弹性分布式算法，适用于下一代通信系统。

title: eSkiTB: A Synthetic Event-based Dataset for Tracking Skiers
summary: Tracking skiers in RGB broadcast footage is challenging due to motion blur, static overlays, and clutter that obscure the fast-moving athlete. Event cameras, with their asynchronous contrast sensing, offer natural robustness to such artifacts, yet a controlled benchmark for winter-sport tracking has been missing. We introduce event SkiTB (eSkiTB), a synthetic event-based ski tracking dataset generated from SkiTB using direct video-to-event conversion without neural interpolation, enabling an iso-informational comparison between RGB and event modalities. Benchmarking SDTrack (spiking transformer) against STARK (RGB transformer), we find that event-based tracking is substantially resilient to broadcast clutter in scenes dominated by static overlays, achieving 0.685 IoU, outperforming RGB by +20.0 points. Across the dataset, SDTrack attains a mean IoU of 0.711, demonstrating that temporal contrast is a reliable cue for tracking ballistic motion in visually congested environments. eSkiTB establishes the first controlled setting for event-based tracking in winter sports and highlights the promise of event cameras for ski tracking. The dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/eventbasedvision/eSkiTB.
