tldr: WebTrap Park is an automated platform for systematically evaluating web agent security by observing how they interact with live web pages, revealing security differences across frameworks.
tldr_zh: WebTrap Park是一个自动化的平台，通过观察Web Agent与真实网页的交互来系统评估其安全性，揭示了不同框架之间的安全差异。

title: An Axiomatic Approach to General Intelligence: SANC(E3) -- Self-organizing Active Network of Concepts with Energy E3
summary: General intelligence must reorganize experience into internal structures that enable prediction and action under finite resources. Existing systems implicitly presuppose fixed primitive units -- tokens, subwords, pixels, or predefined sensor channels -- thereby bypassing the question of how representational units themselves emerge and stabilize. This paper proposes SANC(E3), an axiomatic framework in which representational units are not given a priori but instead arise as stable outcomes of competitive selection, reconstruction, and compression under finite activation capacity, governed by the explicit minimization of an energy functional E3. SANC(E3) draws a principled distinction between system tokens -- structural anchors such as {here, now, I} and sensory sources -- and tokens that emerge through self-organization during co-occurring events. Five core axioms formalize finite capacity, association from co-occurrence, similarity-based competition, confidence-based stabilization, and the reconstruction-compression-update trade-off. A key feature is a pseudo-memory-mapped I/O mechanism, through which internally replayed Gestalts are processed via the same axiomatic pathway as external sensory input. As a result, perception, imagination, prediction, planning, and action are unified within a single representational and energetic process. From the axioms, twelve propositions are derived, showing that category formation, hierarchical organization, unsupervised learning, and high-level cognitive activities can all be understood as instances of Gestalt completion under E3 minimization.
summary_zh: 通用智能必须将经验重组为内部结构，从而在有限资源下实现预测和行动。现有系统隐式地预设了固定的基本单元——如token、子词、像素或预定义的传感器通道——从而绕过了表征单元本身如何涌现和稳定这一问题。本文提出了SANC(E3)，一个公理化框架，其中表征单元并非先验给定，而是作为竞争选择、重构和压缩在有限激活能力下的稳定结果涌现，并由能量泛函E3的显式最小化所支配。SANC(E3)对系统token（例如{这里，现在，我}）和感觉源，以及在共现事件期间通过自组织涌现的token进行了原则性的区分。五个核心公理形式化了有限容量、共现关联、基于相似性的竞争、基于置信度的稳定化以及重构-压缩-更新的权衡。一个关键特征是伪内存映射的I/O机制，通过它，内部重放的格式塔（Gestalt）通过与外部感觉输入相同的公理化路径进行处理。因此，感知、想象、预测、计划和行动被统一在单一的表征和能量过程中。从这些公理中，推导出了十二个命题，表明类别形成、层级组织、无监督学习和高层次认知活动都可以被理解为E3最小化下的格式塔补全的实例。
tldr: The paper proposes a self-organizing framework, SANC(E3), for general intelligence based on axiomatic principles and energy minimization, aiming to unify perception, imagination, prediction, planning, and action within a single process.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于公理和能量最小化的通用智能自组织框架SANC(E3)，旨在将感知、想象、预测、计划和行动统一在一个过程中。

title: How vehicles change lanes after encountering crashes: Empirical analysis and modeling
summary: When a traffic crash occurs, following vehicles need to change lanes to bypass the obstruction. We define these maneuvers as post crash lane changes. In such scenarios, vehicles in the target lane may refuse to yield even after the lane change has already begun, increasing the complexity and crash risk of post crash LCs. However, the behavioral characteristics and motion patterns of post crash LCs remain unknown. To address this gap, we construct a post crash LC dataset by extracting vehicle trajectories from drone videos captured after crashes. Our empirical analysis reveals that, compared to mandatory LCs (MLCs) and discretionary LCs (DLCs), post crash LCs exhibit longer durations, lower insertion speeds, and higher crash risks. Notably, 79.4% of post crash LCs involve at least one instance of non yielding behavior from the new follower, compared to 21.7% for DLCs and 28.6% for MLCs. Building on these findings, we develop a novel trajectory prediction framework for post crash LCs. At its core is a graph based attention module that explicitly models yielding behavior as an auxiliary interaction aware task. This module is designed to guide both a conditional variational autoencoder and a Transformer based decoder to predict the lane changer's trajectory. By incorporating the interaction aware module, our model outperforms existing baselines in trajectory prediction performance by more than 10% in both average displacement error and final displacement error across different prediction horizons. Moreover, our model provides more reliable crash risk analysis by reducing false crash rates and improving conflict prediction accuracy. Finally, we validate the model's transferability using additional post crash LC datasets collected from different sites.
summary_zh: 当发生交通事故时，后续车辆需要变换车道以绕过障碍物。我们将这些操作定义为事故后变道。在这种情况下，目标车道上的车辆可能会拒绝让行，即使变道已经开始，从而增加了事故后变道的复杂性和碰撞风险。然而，事故后变道的行为特征和运动模式仍然未知。为了弥补这一空白，我们通过提取无人机在事故后拍摄的视频中的车辆轨迹，构建了一个事故后变道数据集。我们的实证分析表明，与强制变道（MLCs）和自主变道（DLCs）相比，事故后变道表现出更长的持续时间、更低的插入速度和更高的碰撞风险。值得注意的是，79.4%的事故后变道至少涉及一次来自新后方车辆的拒不让行行为，而自主变道和强制变道分别为21.7%和28.6%。基于这些发现，我们开发了一个新的事故后变道轨迹预测框架。其核心是一个基于图的注意力模块，该模块将让行行为明确地建模为一个辅助的交互感知任务。该模块旨在引导条件变分自编码器和基于 Transformer 的解码器来预测变道车辆的轨迹。通过整合交互感知模块，我们的模型在不同预测范围内的平均位移误差和最终位移误差方面，轨迹预测性能均优于现有基线 10% 以上。此外，我们的模型通过降低虚警率和提高冲突预测准确性，提供了更可靠的碰撞风险分析。最后，我们使用从不同地点收集的额外事故后变道数据集验证了模型的迁移性。
tldr: This paper analyzes vehicle lane changes after crashes using drone footage, identifying unique behavioral characteristics and developing a trajectory prediction model that incorporates yielding behavior, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文利用无人机拍摄的录像分析了车辆在撞车后变道的情况，识别出独特的行为特征，并开发了一种包含避让行为的轨迹预测模型，其性能优于现有方法。

title: A New Strategy for Verifying Reach-Avoid Specifications in Neural Feedback Systems
summary: Forward reachability analysis is the predominant approach for verifying reach-avoid properties in neural feedback systems (dynamical systems controlled by neural networks). This dominance stems from the limited scalability of existing backward reachability methods. In this work, we introduce new algorithms that compute both over- and under-approximations of backward reachable sets for such systems. We further integrate these backward algorithms with established forward analysis techniques to yield a unified verification framework for neural feedback systems.
summary_zh: 前向可达性分析是验证神经反馈系统（由神经网络控制的动力系统）中可达-避免性质的主要方法。这种主导地位源于现有后向可达性方法的可扩展性有限。在这项工作中，我们引入了新的算法，用于计算此类系统后向可达集的过度逼近和欠逼近。我们进一步将这些后向算法与已建立的前向分析技术相结合，从而为神经反馈系统提供了一个统一的验证框架。
tldr: This paper introduces new backward reachability analysis algorithms for neural feedback systems and integrates them with forward analysis for improved verification of reach-avoid properties.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的神经网络反馈系统的后向可达性分析算法，并将其与前向分析相结合，以改进对到达-避免属性的验证效果。

title: Forecast Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Electricity Load Scheduling in Dairy Farms
summary: Dairy farming is an energy intensive sector that relies heavily on grid electricity. With increasing renewable energy integration, sustainable energy management has become essential for reducing grid dependence and supporting the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 7 on affordable and clean energy. However, the intermittent nature of renewables poses challenges in balancing supply and demand in real time. Intelligent load scheduling is therefore crucial to minimize operational costs while maintaining reliability. Reinforcement Learning has shown promise in improving energy efficiency and reducing costs. However, most RL-based scheduling methods assume complete knowledge of future prices or generation, which is unrealistic in dynamic environments. Moreover, standard PPO variants rely on fixed clipping or KL divergence thresholds, often leading to unstable training under variable tariffs. To address these challenges, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning framework for efficient load scheduling in dairy farms, focusing on battery storage and water heating under realistic operational constraints. The proposed Forecast Aware PPO incorporates short term forecasts of demand and renewable generation using hour of day and month based residual calibration, while the PID KL PPO variant employs a proportional integral derivative controller to regulate KL divergence for stable policy updates adaptively. Trained on real world dairy farm data, the method achieves up to 1% lower electricity cost than PPO, 4.8% than DQN, and 1.5% than SAC. For battery scheduling, PPO reduces grid imports by 13.1%, demonstrating scalability and effectiveness for sustainable energy management in modern dairy farming.
summary_zh: 奶牛养殖业是一个能源密集型行业，严重依赖电网电力。随着可再生能源整合的不断增加，可持续能源管理对于减少对电网的依赖以及支持联合国可持续发展目标7（经济适用的清洁能源）至关重要。然而，可再生能源的间歇性给实时平衡供需带来了挑战。因此，智能负荷调度对于在维持可靠性的同时最大限度地降低运营成本至关重要。强化学习已显示出在提高能源效率和降低成本方面的潜力。然而，大多数基于强化学习的调度方法都假设完全了解未来价格或发电量，这在动态环境中是不现实的。此外，标准的近端策略优化(PPO)变体依赖于固定的裁剪或KL散度阈值，这通常会导致可变电价下训练不稳定。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种深度强化学习框架，用于奶牛场的高效负荷调度，重点关注在实际运行约束下的电池储能和水加热。所提出的基于预测的PPO算法利用基于时段和月份的残差校准方法，纳入了需求和可再生能源发电的短期预测，而PID KL PPO变体则采用比例积分微分控制器来调节KL散度，以实现自适应的稳定策略更新。该方法在真实世界的奶牛场数据上进行训练，实现了比PPO低达1%的电力成本，比DQN低4.8%，比SAC低1.5%。对于电池调度，PPO减少了13.1%的电网进口，证明了其在现代奶牛养殖业中可持续能源管理的可扩展性和有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a forecast-aware deep reinforcement learning framework with a PID-controlled KL divergence PPO variant for efficient electricity load scheduling in dairy farms, demonstrating cost savings compared to other RL methods and reduced grid imports.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有预测感知能力的深度强化学习框架，该框架采用PID控制的KL散度PPO变体，用于奶牛场高效的电力负荷调度。结果表明，与其它强化学习方法相比，该方法能够降低成本并减少电网进口。

title: Reinforcement Learning Methods for Neighborhood Selection in Local Search
summary: Reinforcement learning has recently gained traction as a means to improve combinatorial optimization methods, yet its effectiveness within local search metaheuristics specifically remains comparatively underexamined. In this study, we evaluate a range of reinforcement learning-based neighborhood selection strategies -- multi-armed bandits (upper confidence bound, $ε$-greedy) and deep reinforcement learning methods (proximal policy optimization, double deep $Q$-network) -- and compare them against multiple baselines across three different problems: the traveling salesman problem, the pickup and delivery problem with time windows, and the car sequencing problem. We show how search-specific characteristics, particularly large variations in cost due to constraint violation penalties, necessitate carefully designed reward functions to provide stable and informative learning signals. Our extensive experiments reveal that algorithm performance varies substantially across problems, although that $ε$-greedy consistently ranks among the best performers. In contrast, the computational overhead of deep reinforcement learning approaches only makes them competitive with a substantially longer runtime. These findings highlight both the promise and the practical limitations of deep reinforcement learning in local search.
summary_zh: 强化学习近来作为改进组合优化方法的一种手段备受关注，然而，其在局部搜索元启发式算法中的有效性却相对缺乏研究。在本研究中，我们评估了一系列基于强化学习的邻域选择策略——多臂老虎机（上限置信区间，ε-贪婪）和深度强化学习方法（近端策略优化，双重深度Q网络），并将它们与三种不同问题中的多个基线进行比较：旅行商问题、带时间窗的取送货问题和汽车排序问题。我们展示了搜索的具体特征，特别是由于违反约束惩罚而导致的成本大幅变化，如何需要精心设计的奖励函数，以提供稳定且信息丰富的学习信号。我们广泛的实验表明，算法性能在不同问题中差异很大，尽管ε-贪婪始终名列前茅。相比之下，深度强化学习方法的计算开销使其仅在显著更长的运行时间内才具有竞争力。这些发现突出了深度强化学习在局部搜索中的希望和实际局限性。
tldr: This paper explores reinforcement learning (RL) for neighborhood selection in local search metaheuristics, finding that simpler methods like ε-greedy often outperform deep RL, especially considering computational cost, across combinatorial optimization problems.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了强化学习(RL)在局部搜索元启发式算法中用于邻域选择的方法。研究发现，在组合优化问题中，考虑到计算成本，像ε-greedy这样的简单方法通常优于深度强化学习。

title: REVNET: Rotation-Equivariant Point Cloud Completion via Vector Neuron Anchor Transformer
summary: Incomplete point clouds captured by 3D sensors often result in the loss of both geometric and semantic information. Most existing point cloud completion methods are built on rotation-variant frameworks trained with data in canonical poses, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. While data augmentation with random rotations can partially mitigate this issue, it significantly increases the learning burden and still fails to guarantee robust performance under arbitrary poses. To address this challenge, we propose the Rotation-Equivariant Anchor Transformer (REVNET), a novel framework built upon the Vector Neuron (VN) network for robust point cloud completion under arbitrary rotations. To preserve local details, we represent partial point clouds as sets of equivariant anchors and design a VN Missing Anchor Transformer to predict the positions and features of missing anchors. Furthermore, we extend VN networks with a rotation-equivariant bias formulation and a ZCA-based layer normalization to improve feature expressiveness. Leveraging the flexible conversion between equivariant and invariant VN features, our model can generate point coordinates with greater stability. Experimental results show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on the synthetic MVP dataset in the equivariant setting. On the real-world KITTI dataset, REVNET delivers competitive results compared to non-equivariant networks, without requiring input pose alignment. The source code will be released on GitHub under URL: https://github.com/nizhf/REVNET.
summary_zh: 由3D传感器捕获的不完整点云经常导致几何和语义信息的丢失。现有的大多数点云补全方法都建立在旋转变体的框架之上，这些框架使用规范姿态的数据进行训练，限制了它们在真实场景中的适用性。虽然使用随机旋转的数据增强可以在一定程度上缓解这个问题，但它显著增加了学习负担，仍然无法保证在任意姿态下的鲁棒性能。为了解决这个挑战，我们提出了旋转等变锚点Transformer (REVNET)，这是一个建立在向量神经元(VN)网络之上的新颖框架，用于在任意旋转下进行鲁棒的点云补全。为了保留局部细节，我们将部分点云表示为一组等变锚点，并设计了一个VN缺失锚点Transformer来预测缺失锚点的位置和特征。此外，我们通过旋转等变偏差公式和基于ZCA的层归一化来扩展VN网络，以提高特征表达能力。利用等变和不变VN特征之间的灵活转换，我们的模型能够以更高的稳定性生成点坐标。实验结果表明，我们的方法在等变设置下，在合成MVP数据集上优于最先进的方法。在真实世界的KITTI数据集上，REVNET在不需要输入姿态对齐的情况下，与非等变网络相比，提供了具有竞争力的结果。源代码将在GitHub上发布，网址为：https://github.com/nizhf/REVNET。
tldr: The paper introduces REVNET, a rotation-equivariant point cloud completion framework using a Vector Neuron Anchor Transformer, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in rotation-equivariant settings and achieving competitive results on real-world datasets without pose alignment.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了REVNET，一个使用向量神经元锚点变换器的旋转等变点云补全框架，在旋转等变设置中优于最先进的方法，并在真实世界数据集中取得了具有竞争力的结果，而无需姿势对齐。

title: Modality-Decoupled RGB-Thermal Object Detector via Query Fusion
summary: The advantage of RGB-Thermal (RGB-T) detection lies in its ability to perform modality fusion and integrate cross-modality complementary information, enabling robust detection under diverse illumination and weather conditions. However, under extreme conditions where one modality exhibits poor quality and disturbs detection, modality separation is necessary to mitigate the impact of noise. To address this problem, we propose a Modality-Decoupled RGB-T detection framework with Query Fusion (MDQF) to balance modality complementation and separation. In this framework, DETR-like detectors are employed as separate branches for the RGB and TIR images, with query fusion interspersed between the two branches in each refinement stage. Herein, query fusion is performed by feeding the high-quality queries from one branch to the other one after query selection and adaptation. This design effectively excludes the degraded modality and corrects the predictions using high-quality queries. Moreover, the decoupled framework allows us to optimize each individual branch with unpaired RGB or TIR images, eliminating the need for paired RGB-T data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach delivers superior performance to existing RGB-T detectors and achieves better modality independence.
summary_zh: RGB-T检测的优势在于其能够进行模态融合并整合跨模态互补信息，从而在各种光照和天气条件下实现稳健检测。然而，在一种模态质量较差并干扰检测的极端条件下，模态分离对于减轻噪声的影响是必要的。为解决这个问题，我们提出了一种具有查询融合的模态解耦RGB-T检测框架（MDQF），以平衡模态互补和分离。在该框架中，类DETR的检测器被用作RGB和TIR图像的独立分支，并在每个细化阶段在两个分支之间穿插查询融合。在此，查询融合通过在查询选择和适配后，将来自一个分支的高质量查询馈送到另一个分支来执行。这种设计有效地排除了降级模态，并使用高质量查询来纠正预测。此外，解耦框架允许我们使用不成对的RGB或TIR图像来优化每个独立分支，从而消除了对成对RGB-T数据的需求。大量实验表明，我们的方法比现有的RGB-T检测器表现出更优越的性能，并实现了更好的模态独立性。
tldr: This paper introduces a Modality-Decoupled RGB-T object detection framework (MDQF) with query fusion to improve robustness in RGB-Thermal detection under varying conditions by balancing modality complementation and separation, even with unpaired data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种具有查询融合的解耦RGB-T对象检测框架（MDQF），通过平衡模态互补和分离，提高RGB-Thermal检测在各种条件下的鲁棒性，即使使用非配对数据也能有效工作。

title: YOLOBirDrone: Dataset for Bird vs Drone Detection and Classification and a YOLO based enhanced learning architecture
summary: The use of aerial drones for commercial and defense applications has benefited in many ways and is therefore utilized in several different application domains. However, they are also increasingly used for targeted attacks, posing a significant safety challenge and necessitating the development of drone detection systems. Vision-based drone detection systems currently have an accuracy limitation and struggle to distinguish between drones and birds, particularly when the birds are small in size. This research work proposes a novel YOLOBirDrone architecture that improves the detection and classification accuracy of birds and drones. YOLOBirDrone has different components, including an adaptive and extended layer aggregation (AELAN), a multi-scale progressive dual attention module (MPDA), and a reverse MPDA (RMPDA) to preserve shape information and enrich features with local and global spatial and channel information. A large-scale dataset, BirDrone, is also introduced in this article, which includes small and challenging objects for robust aerial object identification. Experimental results demonstrate an improvement in performance metrics through the proposed YOLOBirDrone architecture compared to other state-of-the-art algorithms, with detection accuracy reaching approximately 85% across various scenarios.
summary_zh: 无人机在商业和国防领域的应用受益匪浅，因此被广泛应用于多个不同的应用领域。然而，它们也日益被用于定向攻击，构成了重大的安全挑战，并迫切需要开发无人机检测系统。目前，基于视觉的无人机检测系统存在准确率限制，并且难以区分无人机和鸟类，尤其是在鸟类体型较小的情况下。本研究提出了一种新型YOLOBirDrone架构，以提高鸟类和无人机的检测和分类准确率。YOLOBirDrone包含不同的组件，包括自适应拓展层聚合(AELAN)、多尺度渐进式双重注意力模块(MPDA)和反向MPDA(RMPDA)，以保留形状信息并利用局部和全局空间和通道信息来丰富特征。本文还引入了一个大型数据集BirDrone，其中包含小型和具有挑战性的目标，以实现稳健的空中目标识别。实验结果表明，与其它最先进的算法相比，所提出的YOLOBirDrone架构在性能指标方面有所提高，并且在各种场景下的检测准确率达到约85%。
tldr: The paper introduces a new dataset (BirDrone) and a YOLO-based architecture (YOLOBirDrone) for improved bird vs. drone detection and classification, claiming increased accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的数据集 (BirDrone) 和一个基于 YOLO 的架构 (YOLOBirDrone)，用于改进鸟类与无人机的检测和分类，并声称提高了准确性。

title: An Efficient Additive Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer for Point-Level Maize Localization in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Imagery
summary:
High-resolution UAV photogrammetry has become a key technology for precision agriculture, enabling centimeter-level crop monitoring and point-level plant localization. However, point-level maize localization in UAV imagery remains challenging due to (1) extremely small object-to-pixel ratios, typically less than 0.1%, (2) prohibitive computational costs of quadratic attention on ultra-high-resolution images larger than 3000 x 4000 pixels, and (3) agricultural scene-specific complexities such as sparse object distribution and environmental variability that are poorly handled by general-purpose vision models.
  To address these challenges, we propose the Additive Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer (AKT), which replaces conventional multilayer perceptrons with Pade Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (PKAN) modules to enhance functional expressivity for small-object feature extraction, and introduces PKAN Additive Attention (PAA) to model multiscale spatial dependencies with reduced computational complexity. In addition, we present the Point-based Maize Localization (PML) dataset, consisting of 1,928 high-resolution UAV images with approximately 501,000 point annotations collected under real field conditions.
  Extensive experiments show that AKT achieves an average F1-score of 62.8%, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 4.2%, while reducing FLOPs by 12.6% and improving inference throughput by 20.7%. For downstream tasks, AKT attains a mean absolute error of 7.1 in stand counting and a root mean square error of 1.95-1.97 cm in interplant spacing estimation. These results demonstrate that integrating Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theory with efficient attention mechanisms offers an effective framework for high-resolution agricultural remote sensing.
summary_zh:
高分辨率无人机摄影测量已成为精准农业的关键技术，能够实现厘米级的作物监测和点级的植物定位。然而，由于以下原因，在无人机影像中进行点级玉米定位仍然具有挑战性：(1)极小的目标像素比，通常小于0.1%；(2)在大于3000 x 4000像素的超高分辨率图像上进行二次注意力计算的高昂算力成本；(3)农业场景的特殊复杂性，例如稀疏的目标分布和环境可变性，这些问题难以被通用视觉模型有效处理。

为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了加性柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德变换器（AKT），它使用帕德-柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（PKAN）模块替换传统的多层感知机，以增强小目标特征提取的功能表达性，并引入PKAN加性注意力（PAA）来建模具有降低计算复杂度的多尺度空间依赖性。此外，我们提出了基于点的玉米定位（PML）数据集，该数据集由1,928张高分辨率无人机图像组成，包含在真实田间条件下采集的约501,000个点标注。

大量的实验表明，AKT实现了62.8%的平均F1分数，比最先进的方法高出4.2%，同时降低了12.6%的 FLOPs，并将推理吞吐量提高了20.7%。对于下游任务，AKT在株数计数中实现了7.1的平均绝对误差，在株间距估计中实现了1.95-1.97厘米的均方根误差。这些结果表明，将柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示理论与高效的注意力机制相结合，为高分辨率农业遥感提供了一个有效的框架。
tldr: The paper introduces the Additive Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer (AKT) for point-level maize localization in UAV imagery, achieving improved F1-score and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods. They also introduce a large dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于无人机图像中玉米点级定位的加性柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德变换器 (AKT)，与最先进的方法相比，F1 分数和效率均有所提高。 并介绍了一个大型数据集。

title: A Hybrid Model-based and Data-based Approach Developed for a Prosthetic Hand Wrist
summary: The incorporation of advanced control algorithms into prosthetic hands significantly enhances their ability to replicate the intricate motions of a human hand. This work introduces a model-based controller that combines an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) approach with a Sliding Mode Controller (SMC) designed for a tendon-driven soft continuum wrist integrated into a prosthetic hand known as "PRISMA HAND II". Our research focuses on developing a controller that provides a fast dynamic response with reduced computational effort during wrist motions. The proposed controller consists of an ANN for computing bending angles together with an SMC to regulate tendon forces. Kinematic and dynamic models of the wrist are formulated using the Piece-wise Constant Curvature (PCC) hypothesis. The performance of the proposed controller is compared with other control strategies developed for the same wrist. Simulation studies and experimental validations of the fabricated wrist using the controller are included in the paper.
summary_zh: 将先进控制算法融入假肢手能够显著增强其复制人手复杂运动的能力。本文介绍了一种基于模型的控制器，该控制器结合了人工神经网络（ANN）方法和滑模控制器（SMC），专为集成到名为“PRISMA HAND II”的假肢手中的腱驱动软体连续体腕关节而设计。 我们的研究重点是开发一种控制器，在腕关节运动期间提供快速的动态响应并降低计算量。 所提出的控制器由用于计算弯曲角度的ANN和用于调节肌腱力的SMC组成。 使用分段恒定曲率（PCC）假设建立了腕关节的运动学和动力学模型。 将所提出的控制器的性能与为同一腕关节开发的其他控制策略进行了比较。 论文中包含了使用该控制器对所制造腕关节进行的仿真研究和实验验证。
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid ANN and Sliding Mode Controller (SMC) for a prosthetic hand wrist, aiming for faster dynamic response and reduced computational effort, validated through simulations and experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合人工神经网络（ANN）和滑模控制器（SMC）用于假肢手腕，旨在实现更快的动态响应和更低的计算量，并通过仿真和实验进行了验证。

title: QP-Based Control of an Underactuated Aerial Manipulator under Constraints
summary: This paper presents a constraint-aware control framework for underactuated aerial manipulators, enabling accurate end-effector trajectory tracking while explicitly accounting for safety and feasibility constraints. The control problem is formulated as a quadratic program that computes dynamically consistent generalized accelerations subject to underactuation, actuator bounds, and system constraints. To enhance robustness against disturbances, modeling uncertainties, and steady-state errors, a passivity-based integral action is incorporated at the torque level without compromising feasibility. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through high-fidelity physics-based simulations, which include parameter perturbations, viscous joint friction, and realistic sensing and state-estimation effects. This demonstrates accurate tracking, smooth control inputs, and reliable constraint satisfaction under realistic operating conditions.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种约束感知控制框架，用于欠驱动空中机械臂，能够在显式考虑安全性和可行性约束的同时，实现精确的末端执行器轨迹跟踪。该控制问题被构建为一个二次规划，计算动态一致的广义加速度，其满足欠驱动、执行器边界和系统约束。为了增强对扰动、建模不确定性和稳态误差的鲁棒性，在不影响可行性的前提下，在力矩层面上引入了基于无源性的积分作用。通过高保真物理仿真验证了所提出方法的有效性，仿真包含参数扰动、粘性关节摩擦以及真实的传感和状态估计影响。结果表明在实际运行条件下，该方法能够实现精确跟踪、平滑的控制输入以及可靠的约束满足。
tldr: This paper presents a quadratic programming (QP)-based control framework for underactuated aerial manipulators, incorporating constraints and passivity-based integral action for robust and accurate trajectory tracking. High-fidelity simulations validate its effectiveness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于二次规划（QP）的欠驱动空中机械臂控制框架，该框架结合了约束和基于被动性的积分作用，以实现鲁棒和精确的轨迹跟踪。高保真仿真验证了其有效性。

title: Keyframe-based Dense Mapping with the Graph of View-Dependent Local Maps
summary: In this article, we propose a new keyframe-based mapping system. The proposed method updates local Normal Distribution Transform maps (NDT) using data from an RGB-D sensor. The cells of the NDT are stored in 2D view-dependent structures to better utilize the properties and uncertainty model of RGB-D cameras. This method naturally represents an object closer to the camera origin with higher precision. The local maps are stored in the pose graph which allows correcting global map after loop closure detection. We also propose a procedure that allows merging and filtering local maps to obtain a global map of the environment. Finally, we compare our method with Octomap and NDT-OM and provide example applications of the proposed mapping method.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于关键帧的地图构建系统。该方法利用来自RGB-D传感器的数据更新局部正态分布变换(NDT)地图。NDT的单元格存储在二维视角相关的结构中，以更好地利用RGB-D相机的特性和不确定性模型。这种方法自然地能够以更高的精度表示更靠近相机原点的物体。局部地图存储在姿态图中，这允许在闭环检测后校正全局地图。我们还提出了一种程序，该程序允许合并和过滤局部地图以获得环境的全局地图。最后，我们将提出的方法与Octomap和NDT-OM进行了比较，并提供了所提出地图构建方法的示例应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a keyframe-based dense mapping system using RGB-D data and view-dependent NDT maps within a pose graph for loop closure correction and global map generation, comparing its performance against Octomap and NDT-OM.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于关键帧的稠密地图构建系统，该系统利用RGB-D数据和视点相关的NDT地图，并在姿态图中进行回环闭合校正和全局地图生成，并将其性能与Octomap和NDT-OM进行了比较。

title: Contact-aware Path Planning for Autonomous Neuroendovascular Navigation
summary: We propose a deterministic and time-efficient contact-aware path planner for neurovascular navigation. The algorithm leverages information from pre- and intra-operative images of the vessels to navigate pre-bent passive tools, by intelligently predicting and exploiting interactions with the anatomy. A kinematic model is derived and employed by the sampling-based planner for tree expansion that utilizes simplified motion primitives. This approach enables fast computation of the feasible path, with negligible loss in accuracy, as demonstrated in diverse and representative anatomies of the vessels. In these anatomical demonstrators, the algorithm shows a 100% convergence rate within 22.8s in the worst case, with sub-millimeter tracking errors (less than 0.64 mm), and is found effective on anatomical phantoms representative of around 94% of patients.
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们提出了一种确定性的、时间高效的、具有接触感知的神经血管导航路径规划器。该算法利用血管的术前和术中图像信息，通过智能预测和利用与解剖结构的交互，来导航预弯的被动工具。推导了一个运动学模型，并由基于采样的规划器在树扩展中使用该模型，该规划器利用简化的运动原语。这种方法能够快速计算可行路径，且精度损失可忽略不计，这已在血管的各种代表性解剖结构中得到证明。在这些解剖结构验证中，该算法在最坏情况下显示出100%的收敛率，耗时22.8秒，具有亚毫米级的跟踪误差（小于0.64毫米），并且发现其在代表约94%患者的解剖模型上有效。
tldr: The paper presents a contact-aware path planning algorithm for autonomous neuroendovascular navigation using pre- and intra-operative images, demonstrating fast computation and high convergence rates in simulated and phantom anatomies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于术前和术中图像的接触感知路径规划算法，用于自主神经血管内导航，并在模拟和体模解剖结构中展示了快速计算和高收敛率。

title: Grid-Aware Charging and Operational Optimization for Mixed-Fleet Public Transit
summary: The rapid growth of urban populations and the increasing need for sustainable transportation solutions have prompted a shift towards electric buses in public transit systems. However, the effective management of mixed fleets consisting of both electric and diesel buses poses significant operational challenges. One major challenge is coping with dynamic electricity pricing, where charging costs vary throughout the day. Transit agencies must optimize charging assignments in response to such dynamism while accounting for secondary considerations such as seating constraints. This paper presents a comprehensive mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model to address these challenges by jointly optimizing charging schedules and trip assignments for mixed (electric and diesel bus) fleets while considering factors such as dynamic electricity pricing, vehicle capacity, and route constraints. We address the potential computational intractability of the MILP formulation, which can arise even with relatively small fleets, by employing a hierarchical approach tailored to the fleet composition. By using real-world data from the city of Chattanooga, Tennessee, USA, we show that our approach can result in significant savings in the operating costs of the mixed transit fleets.
summary_zh: 城市人口的快速增长和对可持续交通解决方案日益增长的需求促使公共交通系统向电动公交车转型。然而，对包含电动公交车和柴油公交车的混合车队进行有效管理带来了显著的运营挑战。其中一个主要挑战是应对动态电价，即充电成本全天都在变化。公交运输机构必须在考虑到座位限制等次要因素的同时，优化充电分配以应对这种动态性。 本文提出了一种综合性的混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 模型，通过联合优化混合（电动和柴油公交车）车队的充电计划和行程分配，同时考虑动态电价、车辆容量和路线约束等因素，来应对这些挑战。我们采用针对车队组成的层级方法，解决了MILP公式可能存在的计算复杂性问题，即使对于相对较小的车队也可能出现这种复杂性。通过使用来自美国田纳西州查塔努加市的真实数据，我们证明我们的方法可以显著节省混合公交车队的运营成本。
tldr: The paper proposes a mixed-integer linear programming model to optimize charging schedules and trip assignments for mixed electric and diesel bus fleets, considering dynamic electricity pricing and fleet composition, demonstrated with real-world data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合整数线性规划模型，用于优化混合电动和柴油公交车队的充电计划和行程分配，考虑了动态电价和车队组成，并使用真实世界的数据进行了演示。

title: VGG Induced Deep Hand Sign Language Detection
summary: Hand gesture recognition is an important aspect of human-computer interaction. It forms the basis of sign language for the visually impaired people. This work proposes a novel hand gesture recognizing system for the differently-abled persons. The model uses a convolutional neural network, known as VGG-16 net, for building a trained model on a widely used image dataset by employing Python and Keras libraries. Furthermore, the result is validated by the NUS dataset, consisting of 10 classes of hand gestures, fed to the model as the validation set. Afterwards, a testing dataset of 10 classes is built by employing Google's open source Application Programming Interface (API) that captures different gestures of human hand and the efficacy is then measured by carrying out experiments. The experimental results show that by combining a transfer learning mechanism together with the image data augmentation, the VGG-16 net produced around 98% accuracy.
summary_zh: 手势识别是人机交互的重要组成部分，也是视障人士手语的基础。本研究提出了一种面向残障人士的新型手势识别系统。该模型使用卷积神经网络，即VGG-16网络，通过Python和Keras库在一个广泛使用的图像数据集上构建训练模型。此外，使用包含10类手势的NUS数据集作为验证集，对结果进行验证。之后，利用谷歌的开源应用程序编程接口（API）建立一个包含10类手势的测试数据集，该API可以捕捉人手的不同手势，并通过实验测量其有效性。实验结果表明，将迁移学习机制与图像数据增强相结合，VGG-16网络产生了约98%的准确率。
tldr: This paper proposes a hand gesture recognition system for sign language using a VGG-16-based convolutional neural network, achieving 98% accuracy through transfer learning and data augmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于VGG-16卷积神经网络的手势识别系统，用于手语识别，通过迁移学习和数据增强实现了98%的准确率。

title: DiffMM: Efficient Method for Accurate Noisy and Sparse Trajectory Map Matching via One Step Diffusion
summary: Map matching for sparse trajectories is a fundamental problem for many trajectory-based applications, e.g., traffic scheduling and traffic flow analysis. Existing methods for map matching are generally based on Hidden Markov Model (HMM) or encoder-decoder framework. However, these methods continue to face significant challenges when handling noisy or sparsely sampled GPS trajectories. To address these limitations, we propose DiffMM, an encoder-diffusion-based map matching framework that produces effective yet efficient matching results through a one-step diffusion process. We first introduce a road segment-aware trajectory encoder that jointly embeds the input trajectory and its surrounding candidate road segments into a shared latent space through an attention mechanism. Next, we propose a one step diffusion method to realize map matching through a shortcut model by leveraging the joint embedding of the trajectory and candidate road segments as conditioning context. We conduct extensive experiments on large-scale trajectory datasets, demonstrating that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art map matching methods in terms of both accuracy and efficiency, particularly for sparse trajectories and complex road network topologies.
summary_zh: 稀疏轨迹地图匹配是许多基于轨迹的应用（如交通调度和交通流分析）中的一个基本问题。现有的地图匹配方法通常基于隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)或编码器-解码器框架。然而，在处理噪声或稀疏采样的GPS轨迹时，这些方法仍然面临着严峻的挑战。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出DiffMM，一个基于编码器-扩散的地图匹配框架，通过一步扩散过程产生有效且高效的匹配结果。我们首先引入一个道路路段感知的轨迹编码器，通过注意力机制将输入轨迹及其周围的候选道路路段联合嵌入到一个共享的潜在空间中。接下来，我们提出一种一步扩散方法，通过利用轨迹和候选道路路段的联合嵌入作为条件上下文，通过捷径模型实现地图匹配。我们在大规模轨迹数据集上进行了广泛的实验，结果表明，我们的方法在准确性和效率方面始终优于最先进的地图匹配方法，尤其是在稀疏轨迹和复杂路网拓扑结构下。
tldr: This paper introduces DiffMM, an encoder-diffusion based map matching framework that uses a one-step diffusion process for accurate and efficient map matching, especially for noisy and sparse GPS trajectories. The approach outperforms existing methods in accuracy and speed on large-scale datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为DiffMM的基于编码器-扩散的地图匹配框架，该框架使用单步扩散过程进行准确高效的地图匹配，尤其适用于噪声大和稀疏的GPS轨迹。该方法在大型数据集上的准确性和速度均优于现有方法。

title: A Hardware-Algorithm Co-Designed Framework for HDR Imaging and Dehazing in Extreme Rocket Launch Environments
summary: Quantitative optical measurement of critical mechanical parameters -- such as plume flow fields, shock wave structures, and nozzle oscillations -- during rocket launch faces severe challenges due to extreme imaging conditions. Intense combustion creates dense particulate haze and luminance variations exceeding 120 dB, degrading image data and undermining subsequent photogrammetric and velocimetric analyses. To address these issues, we propose a hardware-algorithm co-design framework that combines a custom Spatially Varying Exposure (SVE) sensor with a physics-aware dehazing algorithm. The SVE sensor acquires multi-exposure data in a single shot, enabling robust haze assessment without relying on idealized atmospheric models. Our approach dynamically estimates haze density, performs region-adaptive illumination optimization, and applies multi-scale entropy-constrained fusion to effectively separate haze from scene radiance. Validated on real launch imagery and controlled experiments, the framework demonstrates superior performance in recovering physically accurate visual information of the plume and engine region. This offers a reliable image basis for extracting key mechanical parameters, including particle velocity, flow instability frequency, and structural vibration, thereby supporting precise quantitative analysis in extreme aerospace environments.
summary_zh: 火箭发射过程中，对关键机械参数（如羽流流场、激波结构和喷管振荡）进行定量光学测量，因极端的成像条件面临严峻挑战。剧烈的燃烧会产生高密度颗粒雾霾和超过120 dB的亮度变化，从而降低图像数据质量，并破坏后续的摄影测量和速度测量分析。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种硬件-算法协同设计框架，该框架将定制的空间变化曝光 (SVE) 传感器与物理感知去雾算法相结合。SVE传感器在单次拍摄中获取多重曝光数据，从而无需依赖理想化的大气模型即可进行稳健的雾霾评估。我们的方法动态估计雾霾密度，执行区域自适应照明优化，并应用多尺度熵约束融合来有效地将雾霾与场景辐射分离。在真实发射图像和受控实验中的验证表明，该框架在恢复羽流和发动机区域的物理精确视觉信息方面表现出卓越的性能。这为提取关键机械参数（包括粒子速度、流动不稳定性频率和结构振动）提供了可靠的图像基础，从而支持在极端的航空航天环境中进行精确的定量分析。
tldr: The paper presents a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework for HDR imaging and dehazing in extreme rocket launch environments, combining a custom SVE sensor with a physics-aware dehazing algorithm to improve quantitative optical measurements.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于极端火箭发射环境中的HDR成像和去雾的硬件-算法协同设计框架，结合了定制的SVE传感器和物理感知的去雾算法，以提高定量光学测量的精度。

title: Beyond the Next Port: A Multi-Task Transformer for Forecasting Future Voyage Segment Durations
summary: Accurate forecasts of segment-level sailing durations are fundamental to enhancing maritime schedule reliability and optimizing long-term port operations. However, conventional estimated time of arrival (ETA) models are primarily designed for the immediate next port of call and rely heavily on real-time automatic identification system (AIS) data, which is inherently unavailable for future voyage segments. To address this gap, the study reformulates future-port ETA prediction as a segment-level time-series forecasting problem. We develop a transformer-based architecture that integrates historical sailing durations, destination port congestion proxies, and static vessel descriptors. The proposed framework employs a causally masked attention mechanism to capture long-range temporal dependencies and a multi-task learning head to jointly predict segment sailing durations and port congestion states, leveraging shared latent signals to mitigate high uncertainty. Evaluation on a real-world global dataset from 2021 demonstrates the proposed model consistently outperforms a comprehensive suite of competitive baselines. The result shows a relative reduction of 4.85% in mean absolute error (MAE) and 4.95% in mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) compared with sequence baseline models. The relative reductions with gradient boosting machines are 9.39% in MAE and 52.97% in MAPE. Case studies for the major destination port further illustrate the model's superior accuracy.
summary_zh: 准确预测分段航程所需时间对于提高海上运输的准班率和优化长期港口运营至关重要。然而，传统的预计到达时间（ETA）模型主要针对下一个停靠港设计，并且严重依赖实时自动识别系统（AIS）数据，而这些数据本质上无法用于未来的航程分段。为了解决这一差距，本研究将未来港口ETA预测重新定义为分段级别的时间序列预测问题。我们开发了一种基于Transformer的架构，该架构整合了历史航程时长、目的港拥堵代理指标和静态船舶描述符。所提出的框架采用因果掩码注意力机制来捕获长程时间依赖性，并采用多任务学习头来联合预测分段航程时长和港口拥堵状态，从而利用共享的潜在信号来缓解高不确定性。对来自2021年的真实世界全球数据集的评估表明，所提出的模型始终优于一系列具有竞争力的基线模型。结果显示，与序列基线模型相比，平均绝对误差（MAE）相对降低4.85%，平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）相对降低4.95%。与梯度提升机的相对降低幅度分别为MAE 9.39%和MAPE 52.97%。主要目的港的案例研究进一步说明了该模型卓越的准确性。
tldr: This paper presents a transformer-based multi-task learning model to forecast future voyage segment durations, significantly outperforming baselines by integrating vessel descriptors, historical data, and port congestion proxies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的多任务学习模型，用于预测未来航程段的持续时间，通过整合船舶描述符、历史数据和港口拥堵代理，显著优于基线方法。

title: A Qualitative Model to Reason about Object Rotations (QOR) applied to solve the Cube Comparison Test (CCT)
summary: This paper presents a Qualitative model for Reasoning about Object Rotations (QOR) which is applied to solve the Cube Comparison Test (CCT) by Ekstrom et al. (1976). A conceptual neighborhood graph relating the Rotation movement to the Location change and the Orientation change (CNGRLO) of the features on the cube sides has been built and it produces composition tables to calculate inferences for reasoning about rotations.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于推理物体旋转的定性模型（QOR），并将其应用于解决Ekstrom等人（1976）提出的立方体比较测试（CCT）。建立了一个概念邻域图，该图将旋转运动与立方体侧面特征的位置变化和方向变化相关联（CNGRLO），并生成组合表以计算推理，从而进行旋转推理。
tldr: This paper introduces a qualitative model (QOR) for reasoning about object rotations, which is then applied to solve the Cube Comparison Test (CCT) using a conceptual neighborhood graph.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于推理物体旋转的定性模型（QOR），并将其应用于使用概念邻域图来解决立方体比较测试（CCT）。

title: An IoT-Enabled Smart Aquarium System for Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring and Automated Feeding
summary: Maintaining optimal water quality in aquariums is critical for aquatic health but remains challenging due to the need for continuous monitoring of multiple parameters. Traditional manual methods are inefficient, labor-intensive, and prone to human error, often leading to suboptimal aquatic conditions. This paper presents an IoT-based smart aquarium system that addresses these limitations by integrating an ESP32 microcontroller with multiple sensors (pH, TDS, temperature, turbidity) and actuators (servo feeder, water pump) for comprehensive real-time water quality monitoring and automated control. The system architecture incorporates edge processing capabilities, cloud connectivity via Blynk IoT platform, and an intelligent alert mechanism with configurable cooldown periods to prevent notification fatigue. Experimental evaluation in a 10-liter aquarium environment demonstrated the system's effectiveness, achieving 96\% average sensor accuracy and 1.2-second response time for anomaly detection. The automated feeding and water circulation modules maintained 97\% operational reliability throughout extended testing, significantly reducing manual intervention while ensuring stable aquatic conditions. This research demonstrates that cost-effective IoT solutions can revolutionize aquarium maintenance, making aquatic ecosystem management more accessible, reliable, and efficient for both residential and commercial applications.
authors: A. S. M. Ahsanul Sarkar Akib
summary_zh: 水族箱中维持最佳水质对水生生物的健康至关重要，但这仍然具有挑战性，因为需要持续监测多个参数。传统的手动方法效率低下、劳动强度大且容易出现人为错误，通常导致水生环境不佳。本文提出了一种基于物联网的智能水族箱系统，该系统通过将 ESP32 微控制器与多个传感器（pH、TDS、温度、浊度）和执行器（伺服喂食器、水泵）集成，以实现全面的实时水质监测和自动控制，从而解决了这些局限性。系统架构融合了边缘处理能力、通过 Blynk IoT 平台的云连接以及具有可配置冷却周期的智能警报机制，以防止通知疲劳。 在 10 升水族箱环境中的实验评估证明了该系统的有效性，实现了 96% 的平均传感器精度和 1.2 秒的异常检测响应时间。 自动喂食和水循环模块在整个扩展测试中保持了 97% 的运行可靠性，显著减少了手动干预，同时确保了稳定的水生条件。 这项研究表明，具有成本效益的物联网解决方案可以彻底改变水族箱维护，使住宅和商业应用的水生生态系统管理更加易于使用、可靠和高效。
tldr: This paper introduces an IoT-based smart aquarium system for real-time water quality monitoring and automated feeding using an ESP32 microcontroller, various sensors, and the Blynk IoT platform, achieving high accuracy and reliability in experimental settings.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于物联网的智能水族箱系统，该系统利用 ESP32 微控制器、各种传感器和 Blynk IoT 平台进行实时水质监测和自动喂食，在实验环境中实现了高精度和可靠性。

title: Design and Development of a Low-Cost Scalable GSM-IoT Smart Pet Feeder with a Remote Mobile Application
summary: Pet ownership is increasingly common in modern households, yet maintaining a consistent feeding schedule remains challenging for the owners particularly those who live in cities and have busy lifestyles. This paper presents the design, development, and validation of a low-cost, scalable GSM-IoT smart pet feeder that enables remote monitoring and control through cellular communication. The device combines with an Arduino microcontroller, a SIM800L GSM module for communication, an ultrasonic sensor for real-time food-level assessment, and a servo mechanism for accurate portion dispensing. A dedicated mobile application was developed using MIT App Inventor which allows owners to send feeding commands and receive real-time status updates. Experimental results demonstrate a 98\% SMS command success rate, consistent portion dispensing with $\pm 2.67$\% variance, and reliable autonomous operation. Its modular, energy-efficient design makes it easy to use in a wide range of households, including those with limited resources. This work pushes forward the field of accessible pet care technology by providing a practical, scalable, and completely internet-independent solution for personalized pet feeding. In doing so, it sets a new benchmark for low-cost, GSM-powered automation in smart pet products.
authors: A. S. M. Ahsanul Sarkar Akib
summary_zh: 宠物饲养在现代家庭中日益普及，但对于居住在城市且生活节奏快的主人来说，维持规律的喂食计划仍然具有挑战性。本文介绍了一种低成本、可扩展的GSM-IoT智能宠物喂食器，该喂食器通过蜂窝通信实现远程监控和控制的设计、开发和验证。该设备结合了Arduino微控制器、用于通信的SIM800L GSM模块、用于实时评估食物量的超声波传感器以及用于精确分配份量的伺服机构。使用MIT App Inventor开发了一个专门的移动应用程序，允许主人发送喂食指令并接收实时状态更新。实验结果表明，短信指令成功率达98%，份量分配的方差为$\pm 2.67$\%，且自主运行可靠。其模块化、节能的设计使其易于在广泛的家庭中使用，包括那些资源有限的家庭。这项工作通过为个性化宠物喂养提供一种实用、可扩展且完全独立于互联网的解决方案，推动了可访问宠物护理技术领域的发展。通过这样做，它为低成本、GSM供电的智能宠物产品自动化设定了新的基准。
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost, scalable GSM-IoT smart pet feeder with a mobile application for remote monitoring and control, validated with experimental results.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低成本、可扩展的GSM-IoT智能宠物喂食器，配备移动应用程序，用于远程监控和控制，并通过实验结果进行了验证。

title: Disentangling History and Propagation Dependencies in Cross-Subject Knee Contact Stress Prediction Using a Shared MeshGraphNet Backbone
summary: Background:Subject-specific finite element analysis accurately characterizes knee joint mechanics but is computationally expensive. Deep surrogate models provide a rapid alternative, yet their generalization across subjects under limited pose and load inputs remains unclear. It remains unclear whether the dominant source of prediction uncertainty arises from temporal history dependence or spatial propagation dependence. Methods:To disentangle these factors, we employed a shared MGN backbone with a fixed mesh topology. A dataset of running trials from nine subjects was constructed using an OpenSim-FEBio workflow. We developed four model variants to isolate specific dependencies: (1) a baseline MGN; (2) CT-MGN, incorporating a Control Transformer to encode short-horizon history; (3) MsgModMGN, applying state-conditioned modulation to message passing for adaptive propagation; (4) CT-MsgModMGN, combining both mechanisms. Models were evaluated using a rigorous grouped 3-fold cross-validation on unseen subjects.Results:The models incorporating history encoding significantly outperformed the baseline MGN and MsgModMGN in global accuracy and spatial consistency. Crucially, the CT module effectively mitigated the peak-shaving defect common in deep surrogates, significantly reducing peak stress prediction errors. In contrast, the spatial propagation modulation alone yielded no significant improvement over the baseline, and combining it with CT provided no additional benefit.Conclusion:Temporal history dependence, rather than spatial propagation modulation, is the primary driver of prediction uncertainty in cross-subject knee contact mechanics. Explicitly encoding short-horizon driver sequences enables the surrogate model to recover implicit phase information, thereby achieving superior fidelity in peak-stress capture and high-risk localization compared to purely state-based approaches.
summary_zh: 背景：个体化的有限元分析能准确描述膝关节力学，但计算成本高昂。深度代理模型提供了一种快速的替代方案，但其在有限的姿态和载荷输入下跨个体的泛化能力仍不明确。预测不确定性的主要来源是时间历史依赖性还是空间传播依赖性，也尚不清楚。方法：为了解开这些因素，我们采用了一个共享的 MGN 主干网络，并使用固定的网格拓扑。利用 OpenSim-FEBio 工作流程构建了一个来自九个受试者的跑步试验数据集。我们开发了四种模型变体，以分离特定的依赖性：（1）基线 MGN；（2）CT-MGN，包含一个控制变换器（Control Transformer）来编码短时程历史；（3）MsgModMGN，将状态条件调制应用于消息传递，以实现自适应传播；（4）CT-MsgModMGN，结合了这两种机制。使用严格的分组3折交叉验证对未见过的受试者进行模型评估。结果：在全局准确性和空间一致性方面，包含历史编码的模型显著优于基线 MGN 和 MsgModMGN。至关重要的是，CT 模块有效地缓解了深度代理模型中常见的峰值削减缺陷，显著降低了峰值应力预测误差。相比之下，单独的空间传播调制未对基线产生显著改善，且与 CT 结合使用也未提供额外的益处。结论：时间历史依赖性，而非空间传播调制，是跨个体膝关节接触力学预测不确定性的主要驱动因素。显式编码短时程驱动序列使代理模型能够恢复隐式的相位信息，从而与纯粹基于状态的方法相比，在峰值应力捕获和高风险区域定位方面实现了卓越的保真度。
tldr: This paper investigates the relative importance of temporal history and spatial propagation in predicting knee contact stress using a MeshGraphNet, finding that encoding short-horizon history significantly improves accuracy and peak stress prediction compared to spatial propagation modulation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了使用MeshGraphNet预测膝关节接触应力时，时间历史和空间传播的相对重要性，发现相比于空间传播调制，对短期历史进行编码可以显著提高准确性和峰值应力预测。

title: STEP3-VL-10B Technical Report
summary: We present STEP3-VL-10B, a lightweight open-source foundation model designed to redefine the trade-off between compact efficiency and frontier-level multimodal intelligence. STEP3-VL-10B is realized through two strategic shifts: first, a unified, fully unfrozen pre-training strategy on 1.2T multimodal tokens that integrates a language-aligned Perception Encoder with a Qwen3-8B decoder to establish intrinsic vision-language synergy; and second, a scaled post-training pipeline featuring over 1k iterations of reinforcement learning. Crucially, we implement Parallel Coordinated Reasoning (PaCoRe) to scale test-time compute, allocating resources to scalable perceptual reasoning that explores and synthesizes diverse visual hypotheses. Consequently, despite its compact 10B footprint, STEP3-VL-10B rivals or surpasses models 10$\times$-20$\times$ larger (e.g., GLM-4.6V-106B, Qwen3-VL-235B) and top-tier proprietary flagships like Gemini 2.5 Pro and Seed-1.5-VL. Delivering best-in-class performance, it records 92.2% on MMBench and 80.11% on MMMU, while excelling in complex reasoning with 94.43% on AIME2025 and 75.95% on MathVision. We release the full model suite to provide the community with a powerful, efficient, and reproducible baseline.
summary_zh: 我们提出了STEP3-VL-10B，一个轻量级的开源基础模型，旨在重新定义紧凑效率与前沿水平的多模态智能之间的权衡。STEP3-VL-10B的实现归功于两项战略性转变：首先，在1.2T多模态tokens上采用统一的、完全解冻式的预训练策略，将语言对齐的感知编码器与Qwen3-8B解码器集成，以建立固有的视觉-语言协同作用；其次，采用大规模的后训练流水线，包含超过1k次迭代的强化学习。至关重要的是，我们实施了并行协同推理（PaCoRe）来扩展测试时的计算量，将资源分配给可扩展的感知推理，以探索和综合多样化的视觉假设。因此，尽管STEP3-VL-10B只有10B的紧凑规模，但它能与规模大10倍-20倍的模型（例如，GLM-4.6V-106B、Qwen3-VL-235B）以及顶级的专有旗舰模型（如Gemini 2.5 Pro和Seed-1.5-VL）相媲美甚至超越。它提供了一流的性能，在MMBench上记录了92.2%，在MMMU上记录了80.11%，同时在复杂的推理方面表现出色，在AIME2025上达到94.43%，在MathVision上达到75.95%。我们发布了完整的模型套件，为社区提供一个强大、高效且可复现的基线。
tldr: STEP3-VL-10B is a new, efficient open-source vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks, rivaling much larger models using a novel training strategy and a Parallel Coordinated Reasoning scaling method.
tldr_zh: STEP3-VL-10B是一个新的、高效的开源视觉语言模型，它在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，通过一种新的训练策略和平行协调推理扩展方法，可与更大的模型相媲美。

title: Sim2real Image Translation Enables Viewpoint-Robust Policies from Fixed-Camera Datasets
summary: Vision-based policies for robot manipulation have achieved significant recent success, but are still brittle to distribution shifts such as camera viewpoint variations. Robot demonstration data is scarce and often lacks appropriate variation in camera viewpoints. Simulation offers a way to collect robot demonstrations at scale with comprehensive coverage of different viewpoints, but presents a visual sim2real challenge. To bridge this gap, we propose MANGO -- an unpaired image translation method with a novel segmentation-conditioned InfoNCE loss, a highly-regularized discriminator design, and a modified PatchNCE loss. We find that these elements are crucial for maintaining viewpoint consistency during sim2real translation. When training MANGO, we only require a small amount of fixed-camera data from the real world, but show that our method can generate diverse unseen viewpoints by translating simulated observations. In this domain, MANGO outperforms all other image translation methods we tested. Imitation-learning policies trained on data augmented by MANGO are able to achieve success rates as high as 60\% on views that the non-augmented policy fails completely on.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的机器人操作策略近年来取得了显著成功，但对于诸如相机视角变化等分布偏移仍然非常脆弱。机器人示教数据稀缺，而且通常缺乏适当的相机视角变化。仿真提供了一种大规模收集机器人示教数据的方法，能够全面覆盖不同的视角，但也带来了视觉上的Sim2Real挑战。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种名为MANGO的非配对图像转换方法，该方法具有新颖的分割条件InfoNCE损失、高度正则化的判别器设计以及改进的PatchNCE损失。我们发现这些元素对于在Sim2Real转换过程中保持视角一致性至关重要。在训练MANGO时，我们只需要少量来自真实世界的固定相机数据，但结果表明，我们的方法可以通过转换模拟观测结果来生成各种未见过的视角。在这个领域中，MANGO优于我们测试的所有其他图像转换方法。通过MANGO增强的数据训练的模仿学习策略，在非增强策略完全失败的视角上，能够达到高达60%的成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces MANGO, an unpaired image translation method for sim2real transfer in robot manipulation, addressing the problem of viewpoint variations by generating diverse unseen viewpoints from simulation using a novel segmentation-conditioned InfoNCE loss and other regularization techniques. Imitation learning policies trained on MANGO-augmented data significantly outperform those trained without augmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为MANGO的非配对图像转换方法，用于机器人操作中的sim2real迁移，通过使用一种新颖的分割条件InfoNCE损失和其他正则化技术，从模拟中生成各种未见过的视点，从而解决视点变化的问题。在MANGO增强数据上训练的模仿学习策略显著优于未增强的训练策略。

title: Learning Whole-Body Human-Humanoid Interaction from Human-Human Demonstrations
summary: Enabling humanoid robots to physically interact with humans is a critical frontier, but progress is hindered by the scarcity of high-quality Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHoI) data. While leveraging abundant Human-Human Interaction (HHI) data presents a scalable alternative, we first demonstrate that standard retargeting fails by breaking the essential contacts. We address this with PAIR (Physics-Aware Interaction Retargeting), a contact-centric, two-stage pipeline that preserves contact semantics across morphology differences to generate physically consistent HHoI data. This high-quality data, however, exposes a second failure: conventional imitation learning policies merely mimic trajectories and lack interactive understanding. We therefore introduce D-STAR (Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Action Reasoner), a hierarchical policy that disentangles when to act from where to act. In D-STAR, Phase Attention (when) and a Multi-Scale Spatial module (where) are fused by the diffusion head to produce synchronized whole-body behaviors beyond mimicry. By decoupling these reasoning streams, our model learns robust temporal phases without being distracted by spatial noise, leading to responsive, synchronized collaboration. We validate our framework through extensive and rigorous simulations, demonstrating significant performance gains over baseline approaches and a complete, effective pipeline for learning complex whole-body interactions from HHI data.
summary_zh: 使能人形机器人与人类进行物理交互是一个关键的前沿领域，但高质量人-人形机器人交互 (HHoI) 数据的匮乏阻碍了进展。虽然利用丰富的人-人交互 (HHI) 数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但我们首先证明了标准重定向会因破坏关键接触而失败。我们通过PAIR (物理感知交互重定向) 来解决这个问题，这是一个以接触为中心的、两阶段的流程，它保留了跨形态差异的接触语义，从而生成物理上一致的HHoI数据。然而，这种高质量的数据揭示了第二个失败：传统的模仿学习策略仅仅模仿轨迹，缺乏交互理解。因此，我们引入了 D-STAR (解耦时空动作推理器)，一种分层策略，它将何时行动与何地行动解耦。在 D-STAR 中，相位注意力（何时）和多尺度空间模块（何地）通过扩散头融合，以产生超越模仿的同步全身行为。通过解耦这些推理流，我们的模型可以学习鲁棒的时间相位，而不会被空间噪声分散注意力，从而实现响应迅速、同步的协作。我们通过广泛而严格的模拟验证了我们的框架，展示了相对于基线方法显著的性能提升，以及一个用于从 HHI 数据中学习复杂全身交互的完整有效的流程。
tldr: The paper introduces a two-stage pipeline, PAIR, for retargeting Human-Human Interaction (HHI) data to Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHoI) and D-STAR, a hierarchical policy, to learn interactive behaviors, achieving significant performance gains in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段流程 PAIR，用于将人与人交互 (HHI) 数据重新定位到人与类人机器人交互 (HHoI)，并提出了一个分层策略 D-STAR，用于学习交互行为，在仿真中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: CLARE: Continual Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models via Autonomous Adapter Routing and Expansion
summary: To teach robots complex manipulation tasks, it is now a common practice to fine-tune a pre-trained vision-language-action model (VLA) on task-specific data. However, since this recipe updates existing representations, it is unsuitable for long-term operation in the real world, where robots must continually adapt to new tasks and environments while retaining the knowledge they have already acquired. Existing continual learning methods for robotics commonly require storing previous data (exemplars), struggle with long task sequences, or rely on task identifiers for deployment. To address these limitations, we propose CLARE, a general, parameter-efficient framework for exemplar-free continual learning with VLAs. CLARE introduces lightweight modular adapters into selected feedforward layers and autonomously expands the model only where necessary when learning a new task, guided by layer-wise feature similarity. During deployment, an autoencoder-based routing mechanism dynamically activates the most relevant adapters without requiring task labels. Through extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, we show that CLARE achieves high performance on new tasks without catastrophic forgetting of earlier tasks, significantly outperforming even exemplar-based methods. Code and data are available at https://tum-lsy.github.io/clare.
summary_zh: 为了教导机器人执行复杂的操控任务，目前常见的做法是在特定任务的数据上微调预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)。然而，由于这种方法会更新现有的表征，因此不适用于现实世界中的长期运行，在现实世界中，机器人必须不断适应新的任务和环境，同时保留它们已经获得的知识。现有的机器人持续学习方法通常需要存储先前的数据（示例），难以处理长任务序列，或者依赖于部署时的任务标识符。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CLARE，一个通用的、参数高效的无示例持续学习框架，用于VLA。CLARE在选定的前馈层中引入了轻量级的模块化适配器，并且在学习新任务时，仅在必要时，在逐层特征相似性的指导下自主扩展模型。在部署期间，一种基于自编码器的路由机制会动态激活最相关的适配器，而无需任务标签。通过在LIBERO基准测试上进行的大量实验，我们表明，CLARE可以在新任务上实现高性能，而不会发生对早期任务的灾难性遗忘，甚至显著优于基于示例的方法。代码和数据可在 https://tum-lsy.github.io/clare 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces CLARE, a parameter-efficient, exemplar-free continual learning framework for Vision-Language-Action models that autonomously routes and expands adapters for effective learning without catastrophic forgetting on robotics tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CLARE，一种参数高效、无范例的视觉-语言-动作模型持续学习框架，它自主路由和扩展适配器，从而有效学习，避免在机器人任务中出现灾难性遗忘。

title: Data Scaling for Navigation in Unknown Environments
summary:
Generalization of imitation-learned navigation policies to environments unseen in training remains a major challenge. We address this by conducting the first large-scale study of how data quantity and data diversity affect real-world generalization in end-to-end, map-free visual navigation. Using a curated 4,565-hour crowd-sourced dataset collected across 161 locations in 35 countries, we train policies for point goal navigation and evaluate their closed-loop control performance on sidewalk robots operating in four countries, covering 125 km of autonomous driving.
  Our results show that large-scale training data enables zero-shot navigation in unknown environments, approaching the performance of policies trained with environment-specific demonstrations. Critically, we find that data diversity is far more important than data quantity. Doubling the number of geographical locations in a training set decreases navigation errors by ~15%, while performance benefit from adding data from existing locations saturates with very little data. We also observe that, with noisy crowd-sourced data, simple regression-based models outperform generative and sequence-based architectures. We release our policies, evaluation setup and example videos on the project page.
summary_zh:
模仿学习得到的导航策略泛化到训练中未见过的环境仍然是一项重大挑战。我们通过首次大规模研究数据数量和数据多样性如何在端到端、无地图视觉导航中影响真实世界的泛化能力来解决这个问题。我们使用一个精选的、由众包收集的、跨越35个国家161个地点、总计4565小时的数据集，训练用于点目标导航的策略，并评估其在人行道机器人上运行的闭环控制性能，这些机器人在四个国家自主行驶了125公里。

我们的结果表明，大规模的训练数据能够实现未知环境中的零样本导航，其性能接近于使用特定于环境的示范数据训练的策略。至关重要的是，我们发现数据多样性远比数据数量更重要。训练集中地理位置的数量翻倍会使导航误差降低约15%，而从现有位置添加数据所带来的性能提升在很小的数据量下就会达到饱和。我们还观察到，在使用嘈杂的众包数据时，基于简单回归的模型优于生成式和基于序列的架构。我们在项目页面上发布我们的策略、评估设置和示例视频。
tldr: This paper studies the effects of data quantity and diversity on zero-shot visual navigation, finding diversity to be more important and simple regression models to be effective with noisy data.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了数据数量和多样性对零样本视觉导航的影响，发现多样性更为重要，且简单回归模型在处理噪声数据时效果良好。

title: Vision-Conditioned Variational Bayesian Last Layer Dynamics Models
summary: Agile control of robotic systems often requires anticipating how the environment affects system behavior. For example, a driver must perceive the road ahead to anticipate available friction and plan actions accordingly. Achieving such proactive adaptation within autonomous frameworks remains a challenge, particularly under rapidly changing conditions. Traditional modeling approaches often struggle to capture abrupt variations in system behavior, while adaptive methods are inherently reactive and may adapt too late to ensure safety. We propose a vision-conditioned variational Bayesian last-layer dynamics model that leverages visual context to anticipate changes in the environment. The model first learns nominal vehicle dynamics and is then fine-tuned with feature-wise affine transformations of latent features, enabling context-aware dynamics prediction. The resulting model is integrated into an optimal controller for vehicle racing. We validate our method on a Lexus LC500 racing through water puddles. With vision-conditioning, the system completed all 12 attempted laps under varying conditions. In contrast, all baselines without visual context consistently lost control, demonstrating the importance of proactive dynamics adaptation in high-performance applications.
summary_zh: 机器人系统的敏捷控制通常需要预测环境如何影响系统行为。例如，驾驶员必须感知前方道路以预测可用的摩擦力并相应地规划动作。在自主框架内实现这种前瞻性的自适应仍然是一个挑战，尤其是在快速变化的环境下。传统的建模方法通常难以捕捉系统行为的突变，而自适应方法本质上是被动的，并且可能适应得太晚以确保安全。我们提出了一种基于视觉条件变分贝叶斯最后一层动态模型，该模型利用视觉上下文来预测环境的变化。该模型首先学习标称车辆动力学，然后使用潜在特征的特征式仿射变换进行微调，从而实现上下文感知的动力学预测。最终的模型被集成到用于车辆竞速的最优控制器中。我们在雷克萨斯LC500赛车穿过水坑的场景中验证了我们的方法。在视觉条件作用下，该系统在不同条件下完成了所有12圈的尝试。相比之下，所有没有视觉上下文的基线模型都始终无法控制，这表明了前瞻性动力学自适应在高性能应用中的重要性。
tldr: This paper introduces a vision-conditioned variational Bayesian last-layer dynamics model for anticipatory control of robotic systems, specifically demonstrated on a racing vehicle navigating varying conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉条件变分贝叶斯最后一层动力学模型，用于机器人系统的预测控制，并在赛车导航不同条件下的场景中进行了演示。

title: CEI: A Unified Interface for Cross-Embodiment Visuomotor Policy Learning in 3D Space
summary: Robotic foundation models trained on large-scale manipulation datasets have shown promise in learning generalist policies, but they often overfit to specific viewpoints, robot arms, and especially parallel-jaw grippers due to dataset biases. To address this limitation, we propose Cross-Embodiment Interface (\CEI), a framework for cross-embodiment learning that enables the transfer of demonstrations across different robot arm and end-effector morphologies. \CEI introduces the concept of \textit{functional similarity}, which is quantified using Directional Chamfer Distance. Then it aligns robot trajectories through gradient-based optimization, followed by synthesizing observations and actions for unseen robot arms and end-effectors. In experiments, \CEI transfers data and policies from a Franka Panda robot to \textbf{16} different embodiments across \textbf{3} tasks in simulation, and supports bidirectional transfer between a UR5+AG95 gripper robot and a UR5+Xhand robot across \textbf{6} real-world tasks, achieving an average transfer ratio of 82.4\%. Finally, we demonstrate that \CEI can also be extended with spatial generalization and multimodal motion generation capabilities using our proposed techniques. Project website: https://cross-embodiment-interface.github.io/
summary_zh: 基于大规模操作数据集训练的机器人基础模型在学习通用策略方面展现出潜力，但由于数据集偏差，它们通常会过度拟合特定视角、机器人手臂，尤其是平行爪夹爪。为了解决这个局限性，我们提出了跨具身接口（Cross-Embodiment Interface, \CEI），这是一个跨具身学习的框架，能够实现不同机器人手臂和末端执行器形态之间的演示迁移。\CEI引入了\textit{功能相似性}的概念，并使用定向Chamfer距离进行量化。然后，它通过基于梯度的优化来对齐机器人轨迹，随后为未见过的机器人手臂和末端执行器合成观测和动作。在实验中，\CEI将数据和策略从Franka Panda机器人迁移到仿真环境中的 \textbf{16} 种不同具身机器人上，涵盖 \textbf{3} 个任务，并支持UR5+AG95夹爪机器人和UR5+Xhand机器人之间在 \textbf{6} 个真实世界任务中的双向迁移，实现了平均82.4%的迁移率。最后，我们证明了\CEI可以使用我们提出的技术进行扩展，从而具备空间泛化和多模态运动生成能力。项目网站：https://cross-embodiment-interface.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces Cross-Embodiment Interface (CEI), a framework enabling transfer of visuomotor policies across different robot embodiments using functional similarity and trajectory alignment, demonstrated through simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了跨具身界面(CEI)，一个框架，它通过功能相似性和轨迹对齐，实现了跨不同机器人具身形态的视觉运动策略迁移，并通过仿真和真实世界的实验进行了演示。

title: Generalizable Geometric Prior and Recurrent Spiking Feature Learning for Humanoid Robot Manipulation
summary: Humanoid robot manipulation is a crucial research area for executing diverse human-level tasks, involving high-level semantic reasoning and low-level action generation. However, precise scene understanding and sample-efficient learning from human demonstrations remain critical challenges, severely hindering the applicability and generalizability of existing frameworks. This paper presents a novel RGMP-S, Recurrent Geometric-prior Multimodal Policy with Spiking features, facilitating both high-level skill reasoning and data-efficient motion synthesis. To ground high-level reasoning in physical reality, we leverage lightweight 2D geometric inductive biases to enable precise 3D scene understanding within the vision-language model. Specifically, we construct a Long-horizon Geometric Prior Skill Selector that effectively aligns the semantic instructions with spatial constraints, ultimately achieving robust generalization in unseen environments. For the data efficiency issue in robotic action generation, we introduce a Recursive Adaptive Spiking Network. We parameterize robot-object interactions via recursive spiking for spatiotemporal consistency, fully distilling long-horizon dynamic features while mitigating the overfitting issue in sparse demonstration scenarios. Extensive experiments are conducted across the Maniskill simulation benchmark and three heterogeneous real-world robotic systems, encompassing a custom-developed humanoid, a desktop manipulator, and a commercial robotic platform. Empirical results substantiate the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art baselines and validate the efficacy of the proposed modules in diverse generalization scenarios. To facilitate reproducibility, the source code and video demonstrations are publicly available at https://github.com/xtli12/RGMP-S.git.
summary_zh: 人形机器人操作是执行各种人类水平任务的关键研究领域，涉及高层次语义推理和低层次动作生成。然而，精确的场景理解和从人类演示中进行样本高效学习仍然是关键挑战，严重阻碍了现有框架的适用性和泛化能力。本文提出了一种新型的RGMP-S，具有脉冲特征的递归几何先验多模态策略，促进了高层次技能推理和数据高效的运动合成。为了将高层次推理建立在物理现实的基础上，我们利用轻量级2D几何归纳偏置，在视觉-语言模型中实现精确的3D场景理解。具体来说，我们构建了一个长时程几何先验技能选择器，有效地将语义指令与空间约束对齐，最终在未见环境中实现鲁棒的泛化。针对机器人动作生成中的数据效率问题，我们引入了一个递归自适应脉冲网络。我们通过递归脉冲对机器人-物体交互进行参数化，以实现时空一致性，充分提取长时程动态特征，同时减轻稀疏演示场景中的过拟合问题。我们跨越Maniskill模拟基准和三个异构的真实世界机器人系统（包括定制开发的人形机器人、桌面机械臂和商业机器人平台）进行了广泛的实验。实验结果证明了我们的方法优于最先进的基线方法，并验证了所提出的模块在各种泛化场景中的有效性。为了便于重现结果，源代码和视频演示已在https://github.com/xtli12/RGMP-S.git上公开。
tldr: The paper introduces RGMP-S, a framework that combines geometric priors with recurrent spiking features for high-level reasoning and data-efficient motion synthesis in humanoid robot manipulation, demonstrating superior performance on simulation and real-world robotic systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为RGMP-S的框架，它结合了几何先验和循环脉冲特征，用于类人机器人操作中的高级推理和数据高效的运动合成，并在模拟和真实机器人系统中表现出卓越的性能。

title: CogRail: Benchmarking VLMs in Cognitive Intrusion Perception for Intelligent Railway Transportation Systems
summary: Accurate and early perception of potential intrusion targets is essential for ensuring the safety of railway transportation systems. However, most existing systems focus narrowly on object classification within fixed visual scopes and apply rule-based heuristics to determine intrusion status, often overlooking targets that pose latent intrusion risks. Anticipating such risks requires the cognition of spatial context and temporal dynamics for the object of interest (OOI), which presents challenges for conventional visual models. To facilitate deep intrusion perception, we introduce a novel benchmark, CogRail, which integrates curated open-source datasets with cognitively driven question-answer annotations to support spatio-temporal reasoning and prediction. Building upon this benchmark, we conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art visual-language models (VLMs) using multimodal prompts to identify their strengths and limitations in this domain. Furthermore, we fine-tune VLMs for better performance and propose a joint fine-tuning framework that integrates three core tasks, position perception, movement prediction, and threat analysis, facilitating effective adaptation of general-purpose foundation models into specialized models tailored for cognitive intrusion perception. Extensive experiments reveal that current large-scale multimodal models struggle with the complex spatial-temporal reasoning required by the cognitive intrusion perception task, underscoring the limitations of existing foundation models in this safety-critical domain. In contrast, our proposed joint fine-tuning framework significantly enhances model performance by enabling targeted adaptation to domain-specific reasoning demands, highlighting the advantages of structured multi-task learning in improving both accuracy and interpretability. Code will be available at https://github.com/Hub-Tian/CogRail.
summary_zh: 准确且及早地感知潜在的入侵目标对于确保铁路运输系统的安全至关重要。然而，大多数现有系统仅狭隘地关注固定视觉范围内的目标分类，并应用基于规则的启发式方法来确定入侵状态，常常忽略了构成潜在入侵风险的目标。预测此类风险需要对关注目标（OOI）的时空语境和时间动态进行认知，这对传统视觉模型提出了挑战。为了促进深度入侵感知，我们引入了一个新的基准，CogRail，它整合了精心策划的开源数据集以及认知驱动的问答标注，以支持时空推理和预测。在此基准的基础上，我们利用多模态提示对最先进的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）进行了系统评估，以识别它们在该领域的优势和局限性。此外，我们对VLMs进行了微调以获得更好的性能，并提出了一个联合微调框架，该框架集成了三个核心任务：位置感知、运动预测和威胁分析，从而促进了通用基础模型有效地适应为专门针对认知入侵感知而定制的专业模型。大量实验表明，目前的大规模多模态模型难以应对认知入侵感知任务所需的复杂时空推理，凸显了现有基础模型在这个安全关键领域中的局限性。相比之下，我们提出的联合微调框架通过实现对领域特定推理需求的有针对性适应，显著提高了模型性能，突出了结构化多任务学习在提高准确性和可解释性方面的优势。代码将在 https://github.com/Hub-Tian/CogRail 提供。
tldr: The paper introduces CogRail, a new benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in cognitive intrusion perception for railway transportation, and proposes a joint fine-tuning framework to improve VLM performance on spatial-temporal reasoning tasks in this safety-critical domain.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了CogRail，这是一个新的基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在铁路运输认知入侵感知方面的能力。此外，该文还提出了一个联合微调框架，旨在提升VLM在安全关键领域中空间-时间推理任务上的性能。

title: GUI-Eyes: Tool-Augmented Perception for Visual Grounding in GUI Agents
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) and reinforcement learning (RL) have driven progress in GUI automation. However, most existing methods rely on static, one-shot visual inputs and passive perception, lacking the ability to adaptively determine when, whether, and how to observe the interface. We present GUI-Eyes, a reinforcement learning framework for active visual perception in GUI tasks. To acquire more informative observations, the agent learns to make strategic decisions on both whether and how to invoke visual tools, such as cropping or zooming, within a two-stage reasoning process. To support this behavior, we introduce a progressive perception strategy that decomposes decision-making into coarse exploration and fine-grained grounding, coordinated by a two-level policy. In addition, we design a spatially continuous reward function tailored to tool usage, which integrates both location proximity and region overlap to provide dense supervision and alleviate the reward sparsity common in GUI environments. On the ScreenSpot-Pro benchmark, GUI-Eyes-3B achieves 44.8% grounding accuracy using only 3k labeled samples, significantly outperforming both supervised and RL-based baselines. These results highlight that tool-aware active perception, enabled by staged policy reasoning and fine-grained reward feedback, is critical for building robust and data-efficient GUI agents.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 和强化学习 (RL) 的最新进展推动了 GUI 自动化领域的进步。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于静态的、一次性的视觉输入和被动感知，缺乏自适应地决定何时、是否以及如何观察界面的能力。我们提出了 GUI-Eyes，一个用于 GUI 任务中主动视觉感知的强化学习框架。为了获取更具信息量的观察，智能体学习在两阶段推理过程中对是否以及如何调用视觉工具（例如裁剪或缩放）做出策略性决策。为了支持这种行为，我们引入了一种渐进式感知策略，将决策分解为粗略探索和精细定位，并由一个两级策略进行协调。此外，我们设计了一个针对工具使用的空间连续奖励函数，该函数集成了位置邻近度和区域重叠，以提供密集的监督，并缓解 GUI 环境中常见的奖励稀疏性问题。在 ScreenSpot-Pro 基准测试中，GUI-Eyes-3B 仅使用 3k 个标记样本就实现了 44.8% 的定位准确率，显著优于基于监督学习和基于强化学习的基线方法。这些结果表明，由分阶段策略推理和细粒度奖励反馈支持的工具感知主动感知对于构建稳健且数据高效的 GUI 智能体至关重要。
tldr: GUI-Eyes is a reinforcement learning framework that enables GUI agents to actively perceive the interface by strategically using visual tools like cropping and zooming, achieving state-of-the-art grounding accuracy on the ScreenSpot-Pro benchmark with improved data efficiency.
tldr_zh: GUI-Eyes是一个强化学习框架，使GUI代理能够通过策略性地使用裁剪和缩放等视觉工具来主动感知界面，在ScreenSpot-Pro基准测试中实现了最先进的接地元准确率，并提高了数据效率。

title: What Do LLM Agents Know About Their World? Task2Quiz: A Paradigm for Studying Environment Understanding
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex decision-making and tool-use tasks, yet their ability to generalize across varying environments remains a under-examined concern. Current evaluation paradigms predominantly rely on trajectory-based metrics that measure task success, while failing to assess whether agents possess a grounded, transferable model of the environment. To address this gap, we propose Task-to-Quiz (T2Q), a deterministic and automated evaluation paradigm designed to decouple task execution from world-state understanding. We instantiate this paradigm in T2QBench, a suite comprising 30 environments and 1,967 grounded QA pairs across multiple difficulty levels. Our extensive experiments reveal that task success is often a poor proxy for environment understanding, and that current memory machanism can not effectively help agents acquire a grounded model of the environment. These findings identify proactive exploration and fine-grained state representation as primary bottlenecks, offering a robust foundation for developing more generalizable autonomous agents.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)智能体在复杂的决策制定和工具使用任务中展现了卓越的能力，然而，它们在不同环境中泛化的能力仍然是一个未被充分考察的问题。当前评估范式主要依赖于衡量任务成功的基于轨迹的指标，而未能评估智能体是否拥有扎根的、可迁移的环境模型。为了弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了Task-to-Quiz (T2Q)，一种确定性的、自动化的评估范式，旨在将任务执行与世界状态理解解耦。我们在T2QBench中实例化了这一范式，T2QBench包含30个环境和1,967个跨越多个难度等级的扎根QA对。我们的大量实验表明，任务成功通常是环境理解的一个糟糕的代理指标，并且当前的记忆机制无法有效地帮助智能体获得扎根的环境模型。这些发现将主动探索和细粒度的状态表示确定为主要瓶颈，为开发更具泛化能力的自主智能体提供了稳固的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces Task-to-Quiz (T2Q), a new evaluation paradigm and benchmark to assess the environment understanding capabilities of LLM agents, revealing that task success doesn't guarantee a grounded world model and identifying exploration/state representation as key bottlenecks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的评估范式Task-to-Quiz（T2Q）和基准，用于评估LLM智能体的环境理解能力，揭示了任务成功并不能保证一个有基础的世界模型，并确定了探索/状态表示作为关键瓶颈。

title: Long-term Task-oriented Agent: Proactive Long-term Intent Maintenance in Dynamic Environments
summary: Current large language model agents predominantly operate under a reactive paradigm, responding only to immediate user queries within short-term sessions. This limitation hinders their ability to maintain long-term user's intents and dynamically adapt to evolving external environments. In this paper, we propose a novel interaction paradigm for proactive Task-oriented Agents capable of bridging the gap between relatively static user's needs and a dynamic environment. We formalize proactivity through two key capabilities, (i) Intent-Conditioned Monitoring: The agent autonomously formulates trigger conditions based on dialog history; (ii) Event-Triggered Follow-up: The agent actively engages the user upon detecting useful environmental updates. We introduce a high-quality data synthesis pipeline to construct complex, multi-turn dialog data in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, we attempt to address the lack of evaluation criteria of task-oriented interaction in a dynamic environment by proposing a new benchmark, namely ChronosBench. We evaluated some leading close-source and open-source models at present and revealed their flaws in long-term task-oriented interaction. Furthermore, our fine-tuned model trained using synthetic data for supervised learning achieves a task completion rate of 85.19% for complex tasks including shifts in user intent, outperforming other models under test. And the result validated the effectiveness of our data-driven strategy.
summary_zh: 当前的大型语言模型 Agent 主要在一种被动的范式下运行，仅仅在短期会话中响应用户的即时查询。这种局限性阻碍了它们维持用户长期意图以及动态适应不断变化外部环境的能力。本文中，我们提出了一种新型的交互范式，适用于能够弥合相对静态的用户需求与动态环境之间差距的主动式面向任务 Agent。我们通过两种关键能力来形式化主动性，(i) 意图条件监控：Agent 基于对话历史自主制定触发条件；(ii) 事件触发跟进：Agent 在检测到有用的环境更新时主动与用户交互。我们引入了一种高质量的数据合成流程，以构建在动态环境中复杂的多轮对话数据。此外，我们尝试通过提出一个新的基准测试 ChronosBench 来解决动态环境中面向任务交互缺乏评估标准的问题。我们评估了一些领先的闭源和开源模型，并揭示了它们在长期面向任务交互方面的缺陷。此外，我们使用合成数据进行监督学习微调后的模型，在包括用户意图转变等复杂任务中实现了 85.19% 的任务完成率，优于测试中的其他模型。结果验证了我们数据驱动策略的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces a proactive task-oriented agent paradigm that maintains long-term user intents in dynamic environments, proposing a new data synthesis pipeline, benchmark (ChronosBench), and a fine-tuned model achieving improved task completion rates.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种主动任务型代理范式，可以在动态环境中维持长期用户意图。论文提出了新的数据合成流程、基准测试 (ChronosBench)，以及一个微调模型，显著提高了任务完成率。

title: GeoRA: Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is crucial for advancing large-scale reasoning models. However, existing parameter-efficient methods, such as PiSSA and MiLoRA, are designed for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and do not account for the distinct optimization dynamics and geometric structures of RLVR. Applying these methods directly leads to spectral collapse and optimization instability, which severely limit model performance. Meanwhile, alternative approaches that leverage update sparsity encounter significant efficiency bottlenecks on modern hardware due to unstructured computations. To address these challenges, we propose GeoRA (Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation), which exploits the anisotropic and compressible nature of RL update subspaces. GeoRA initializes adapters by extracting principal directions via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) within a geometrically constrained subspace while freezing the residual components. This method preserves the pre-trained geometric structure and enables efficient GPU computation through dense operators. Experiments on Qwen and Llama demonstrate that GeoRA mitigates optimization bottlenecks caused by geometric misalignment. It consistently outperforms established low-rank baselines on key mathematical benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. Moreover, GeoRA shows superior generalization and resilience to catastrophic forgetting in out-of-domain tasks.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对于推进大规模推理模型至关重要。然而，现有的参数高效方法，如PiSSA和MiLoRA，是为监督微调（SFT）设计的，并未考虑RLVR独特的优化动态和几何结构。直接应用这些方法会导致谱崩溃和优化不稳定性，从而严重限制模型性能。同时，利用更新稀疏性的替代方法由于非结构化计算而在现代硬件上遇到显著的效率瓶颈。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出GeoRA（几何感知低秩自适应），它利用了RL更新子空间的各向异性和可压缩性。GeoRA通过在几何约束子空间内进行奇异值分解（SVD）来提取主方向，以此初始化适配器，同时冻结残余分量。该方法保留了预训练的几何结构，并通过密集算子实现高效的GPU计算。在Qwen和Llama上的实验表明，GeoRA减轻了由几何错位引起的优化瓶颈。在关键的数学基准测试中，它始终优于已建立的低秩基线，实现了最先进（SOTA）的结果。此外，GeoRA在领域外任务中表现出卓越的泛化能力和对灾难性遗忘的抵抗力。
tldr: The paper introduces GeoRA, a geometry-aware low-rank adaptation method for RLVR, which addresses spectral collapse and optimization instability issues of existing parameter-efficient methods, achieving SOTA results on mathematical benchmarks and demonstrating superior generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GeoRA，一种几何感知低秩适应方法，用于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。该方法解决了现有参数高效方法的谱崩溃和优化不稳定问题，在数学基准测试上取得了SOTA结果，并表现出卓越的泛化性。

title: M$^3$Searcher: Modular Multimodal Information Seeking Agency with Retrieval-Oriented Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in DeepResearch-style agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in autonomous information acquisition and synthesize from real-world web environments. However, existing approaches remain fundamentally limited to text modality. Extending autonomous information-seeking agents to multimodal settings introduces critical challenges: the specialization-generalization trade-off that emerges when training models for multimodal tool-use at scale, and the severe scarcity of training data capturing complex, multi-step multimodal search trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose M$^3$Searcher, a modular multimodal information-seeking agent that explicitly decouples information acquisition from answer derivation. M$^3$Searcher is optimized with a retrieval-oriented multi-objective reward that jointly encourages factual accuracy, reasoning soundness, and retrieval fidelity. In addition, we develop MMSearchVQA, a multimodal multi-hop dataset to support retrieval centric RL training. Experimental results demonstrate that M$^3$Searcher outperforms existing approaches, exhibits strong transfer adaptability and effective reasoning in complex multimodal tasks.
summary_zh: 深度研究型代理最近的进展表明了其在从真实世界Web环境中自主获取和综合信息方面的强大能力。然而，现有方法仍然主要局限于文本模态。将自主信息搜索代理扩展到多模态设置引入了关键挑战：在训练用于大规模多模态工具使用的模型时出现的专业化-泛化权衡，以及捕捉复杂、多步骤多模态搜索轨迹的训练数据的严重稀缺。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了M$^3$Searcher，一种模块化的多模态信息搜索代理，它将信息获取与答案推导显式地解耦。M$^3$Searcher通过面向检索的多目标奖励进行优化，该奖励共同鼓励事实准确性、推理合理性和检索保真度。此外，我们开发了MMSearchVQA，一个多模态多跳数据集，以支持以检索为中心的强化学习训练。实验结果表明，M$^3$Searcher优于现有方法，在复杂的多模态任务中表现出强大的迁移适应性和有效的推理能力。
tldr: The paper introduces M$^3$Searcher, a modular multimodal information-seeking agent addressing the challenges of tool-use and data scarcity in multimodal settings by decoupling information acquisition from answer derivation and using a retrieval-oriented multi-objective reward. They also introduce a new dataset, MMSearchVQA.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了M$^3$Searcher，一个模块化的多模态信息搜寻agent，通过分离信息获取和答案推导，并使用面向检索的多目标奖励，解决在多模态环境中工具使用和数据稀缺的挑战。他们还提出了一个新的数据集，MMSearchVQA。

title: RISER: Orchestrating Latent Reasoning Skills for Adaptive Activation Steering
summary: Recent work on domain-specific reasoning with large language models (LLMs) often relies on training-intensive approaches that require parameter updates. While activation steering has emerged as a parameter efficient alternative, existing methods apply static, manual interventions that fail to adapt to the dynamic nature of complex reasoning.
