第三，我们设计了一个轻量级超网络，该网络动态地调节扩散模型的去噪过程，以响应控制图和高级缺陷描述符，从而在生成保真度和可控性之间实现灵活的平衡。

在真实变电站仪表数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有的增强和生成基线。它将Frechet Inception Distance (FID)降低了32.7%，提高了多样性指标，并且最重要的是，当使用增强数据进行训练时，下游缺陷检测器的mAP提高了15.3%。该框架为缺陷样本稀缺的工业检测系统提供了一种实用的、高质量的数据合成解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a novel few-shot image generation method for substation meter defects by integrating knowledge embedding and hypernetwork-guided conditional control into a Stable Diffusion pipeline, demonstrating improved performance in data augmentation and downstream defect detection.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的少样本图像生成方法，用于生成变电站仪表缺陷图像，通过将知识嵌入和超网络引导的条件控制集成到Stable Diffusion流程中，展示了在数据增强和下游缺陷检测方面的性能提升。

title: Preliminary Tests of the Anticipatory Classifier System with Hindsight Experience Replay
summary: This paper introduces ACS2HER, a novel integration of the Anticipatory Classifier System (ACS2) with the Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) mechanism. While ACS2 is highly effective at building cognitive maps through latent learning, its performance often stagnates in environments characterized by sparse rewards. We propose a specific architectural variant that triggers hindsight learning when the agent fails to reach its primary goal, re-labeling visited states as virtual goals to densify the learning signal. The proposed model was evaluated on two benchmarks: the deterministic \texttt{Maze 6} and the stochastic \texttt{FrozenLake}. The results demonstrate that ACS2HER significantly accelerates knowledge acquisition and environmental mastery compared to the standard ACS2. However, this efficiency gain is accompanied by increased computational overhead and a substantial expansion in classifier numerosity. This work provides the first analysis of combining anticipatory mechanisms with retrospective goal-relabeling in Learning Classifier Systems.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型集成方案ACS2HER，该方案将前瞻性分类器系统（ACS2）与后见之明经验回放（HER）机制相结合。尽管ACS2在通过潜在学习构建认知地图方面非常有效，但其性能在以稀疏奖励为特征的环境中通常会停滞不前。我们提出了一种特定的架构变体，当智能体未能达到其主要目标时，该变体会触发后见之明学习，将访问过的状态重新标记为虚拟目标，从而密集化学习信号。所提出的模型在两个基准测试上进行了评估：确定性的\texttt{Maze 6}和随机性的\texttt{FrozenLake}。结果表明，与标准ACS2相比，ACS2HER显著加速了知识获取和环境熟练度。然而，效率的提高伴随着计算开销的增加和分类器数量的显著扩展。这项工作提供了在学习分类器系统中将前瞻性机制与回顾性目标重标记相结合的首次分析。
tldr: The paper introduces ACS2HER, which combines the Anticipatory Classifier System (ACS2) with Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) to improve performance in sparse reward environments, showing faster learning but increased computational cost.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ACS2HER，它结合了预期分类器系统(ACS2)和后见之明经验回放(HER)，以提高在稀疏奖励环境中的性能，显示出更快的学习速度，但计算成本增加。

title: Feedback-Based Mobile Robot Navigation in 3-D Environments Using Artificial Potential Functions Technical Report
summary: This technical report presents the construction and analysis of polynomial navigation functions for motion planning in 3-D workspaces populated by spherical and cylindrical obstacles. The workspace is modeled as a bounded spherical region, and obstacles are encoded using smooth polynomial implicit functions. We establish conditions under which the proposed navigation functions admit a unique non-degenerate minimum at the target while avoiding local minima, including in the presence of pairwise intersecting obstacles. Gradient and Hessian analyses are provided, and the theoretical results are validated through numerical simulations in obstacle rich 3-D environments.
summary_zh: 该技术报告介绍了针对三维工作空间中的运动规划的多项式导航函数的构建和分析，其中工作空间中分布着球形和圆柱形障碍物。工作空间被建模为一个有界的球形区域，障碍物使用平滑的多项式隐函数进行编码。我们确立了在以下条件下，所提出的导航函数在目标点处存在唯一的非退化最小值，同时避免局部最小值，包括在成对相交的障碍物存在的情况下。报告提供了梯度和 Hessian 分析，并通过在障碍物密集的 3D 环境中的数值模拟验证了理论结果。
tldr: This paper introduces polynomial navigation functions for 3D robot motion planning, ensuring a unique global minimum at the target and avoiding local minima even with intersecting spherical and cylindrical obstacles. The method is validated through numerical simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于多项式导航函数的三维机器人运动规划方法，旨在确保目标位置存在唯一的全局最小值，并避免局部最小值，即使在球形和圆柱形障碍物相交的情况下也是如此。该方法通过数值模拟进行了验证。

title: GlovEgo-HOI: Bridging the Synthetic-to-Real Gap for Industrial Egocentric Human-Object Interaction Detection
summary: Egocentric Human-Object Interaction (EHOI) analysis is crucial for industrial safety, yet the development of robust models is hindered by the scarcity of annotated domain-specific data. We address this challenge by introducing a data generation framework that combines synthetic data with a diffusion-based process to augment real-world images with realistic Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). We present GlovEgo-HOI, a new benchmark dataset for industrial EHOI, and GlovEgo-Net, a model integrating Glove-Head and Keypoint- Head modules to leverage hand pose information for enhanced interaction detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed data generation framework and GlovEgo-Net. To foster further research, we release the GlovEgo-HOI dataset, augmentation pipeline, and pre-trained models at: GitHub project.
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人-物交互(EHOI)分析对于工业安全至关重要，但由于缺乏带标注的特定领域数据，鲁棒模型的开发受到阻碍。我们通过引入一种数据生成框架来应对这一挑战，该框架结合了合成数据和一个基于扩散的过程，以使用逼真的个人防护装备(PPE)来增强真实世界的图像。我们提出了GlovEgo-HOI，一个针对工业EHOI的新基准数据集，以及GlovEgo-Net，一个整合了 Glove-Head 和 Keypoint-Head 模块的模型，以利用手部姿势信息来增强交互检测。 广泛的实验证明了所提出的数据生成框架和 GlovEgo-Net 的有效性。 为了促进进一步的研究，我们在 GitHub 项目中发布了 GlovEgo-HOI 数据集、增强流程和预训练模型。
tldr: The paper introduces GlovEgo-HOI, a new benchmark dataset and model (GlovEgo-Net) for egocentric human-object interaction detection in industrial settings, addressing the data scarcity issue by using a synthetic data generation framework with realistic PPE augmentation. They release the dataset, pipeline, and pre-trained models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GlovEgo-HOI，这是一个新的基准数据集和模型（GlovEgo-Net），用于工业环境中以自我为中心的人-物交互检测。它通过使用合成数据生成框架和逼真的PPE增强来解决数据稀缺问题。他们发布了数据集、流程和预训练模型。

title: V-DPM: 4D Video Reconstruction with Dynamic Point Maps
summary: Powerful 3D representations such as DUSt3R invariant point maps, which encode 3D shape and camera parameters, have significantly advanced feed forward 3D reconstruction. While point maps assume static scenes, Dynamic Point Maps (DPMs) extend this concept to dynamic 3D content by additionally representing scene motion. However, existing DPMs are limited to image pairs and, like DUSt3R, require post processing via optimization when more than two views are involved. We argue that DPMs are more useful when applied to videos and introduce V-DPM to demonstrate this. First, we show how to formulate DPMs for video input in a way that maximizes representational power, facilitates neural prediction, and enables reuse of pretrained models. Second, we implement these ideas on top of VGGT, a recent and powerful 3D reconstructor. Although VGGT was trained on static scenes, we show that a modest amount of synthetic data is sufficient to adapt it into an effective V-DPM predictor. Our approach achieves state of the art performance in 3D and 4D reconstruction for dynamic scenes. In particular, unlike recent dynamic extensions of VGGT such as P3, DPMs recover not only dynamic depth but also the full 3D motion of every point in the scene.
summary_zh: 诸如编码了3D形状和相机参数的 DUSt3R 不变点云图之类的强大3D表示方法，已显著推进了前馈3D重建技术的发展。虽然点云图假定场景是静态的，但动态点云图 (DPM) 通过额外表示场景运动，将这一概念扩展到动态3D内容。 然而，现有的DPM仅限于图像对，并且与DUSt3R一样，当涉及两个以上的视角时，需要通过优化进行后处理。我们认为，DPM应用于视频时更有用，并引入V-DPM来证明这一点。首先，我们展示了如何针对视频输入制定DPM，以便最大化表示能力，促进神经预测，并支持重用预训练模型。其次，我们在VGGT（一种最新的、功能强大的3D重建器）的基础上实现了这些想法。尽管VGGT是在静态场景上训练的，但我们表明，少量合成数据就足以将其改编为有效的V-DPM预测器。我们的方法在动态场景的3D和4D重建中实现了最先进的性能。 特别是，与最近的VGGT动态扩展（如P3）不同，DPM不仅可以恢复动态深度，还可以恢复场景中每个点的完整3D运动。
tldr: The paper introduces V-DPM, an extension of Dynamic Point Maps (DPMs) for 4D video reconstruction, leveraging VGGT and synthetic data to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic scene reconstruction, including 3D motion recovery.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了V-DPM，一种用于4D视频重建的动态点图（DPMs）扩展方法，利用VGGT和合成数据在动态场景重建中实现了最先进的性能，包括3D运动恢复。

title: GaussianFluent: Gaussian Simulation for Dynamic Scenes with Mixed Materials
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a prominent 3D representation for high-fidelity and real-time rendering. Prior work has coupled physics simulation with Gaussians, but predominantly targets soft, deformable materials, leaving brittle fracture largely unresolved. This stems from two key obstacles: the lack of volumetric interiors with coherent textures in GS representation, and the absence of fracture-aware simulation methods for Gaussians. To address these challenges, we introduce GaussianFluent, a unified framework for realistic simulation and rendering of dynamic object states. First, it synthesizes photorealistic interiors by densifying internal Gaussians guided by generative models. Second, it integrates an optimized Continuum Damage Material Point Method (CD-MPM) to enable brittle fracture simulation at remarkably high speed. Our approach handles complex scenarios including mixed-material objects and multi-stage fracture propagation, achieving results infeasible with previous methods. Experiments clearly demonstrate GaussianFluent's capability for photo-realistic, real-time rendering with structurally consistent interiors, highlighting its potential for downstream application, such as VR and Robotics.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)已成为高保真和实时渲染的一种突出的3D表达方式。先前的工作已将物理模拟与高斯函数相结合，但主要针对柔软、可变形材料，而脆性断裂在很大程度上仍未解决。这源于两个关键障碍：GS表示中缺乏具有连贯纹理的体积内部，以及缺乏针对高斯函数的考虑断裂的模拟方法。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GaussianFluent，一个用于动态对象状态的真实模拟和渲染的统一框架。首先，它通过生成模型引导的内部高斯函数的稠密化，来合成逼真的内部。其次，它集成了优化的连续损伤材料点法(CD-MPM)，从而能够以极高的速度进行脆性断裂模拟。我们的方法可以处理包括混合材料对象和多阶段断裂传播在内的复杂场景，实现了以前的方法无法实现的结果。实验清楚地表明了GaussianFluent具有结构一致的内部的逼真、实时渲染能力，突出了其在下游应用中的潜力，例如VR和机器人技术。
tldr: GaussianFluent introduces a method to simulate and render dynamic scenes with mixed materials, specifically addressing brittle fracture in 3D Gaussian Splatting through interior synthesis and an optimized CD-MPM, enabling realistic real-time rendering.
tldr_zh: GaussianFluent 提出了一种模拟和渲染具有混合材料的动态场景的方法，通过内部合成和优化的 CD-MPM 解决了 3D 高斯溅射中的脆性断裂问题，从而实现了逼真的实时渲染。

title: DeTracker: Motion-decoupled Vehicle Detection and Tracking in Unstabilized Satellite Videos
summary: Satellite videos provide continuous observations of surface dynamics but pose significant challenges for multi-object tracking (MOT), especially under unstabilized conditions where platform jitter and the weak appearance of tiny objects jointly degrade tracking performance. To address this problem, we propose DeTracker, a joint detection-and-tracking framework tailored for unstabilized satellite videos. DeTracker introduces a Global--Local Motion Decoupling (GLMD) module that explicitly separates satellite platform motion from true object motion through global alignment and local refinement, leading to improved trajectory stability and motion estimation accuracy. In addition, a Temporal Dependency Feature Pyramid (TDFP) module is developed to perform cross-frame temporal feature fusion, enhancing the continuity and discriminability of tiny-object representations. We further construct a new benchmark dataset, SDM-Car-SU, which simulates multi-directional and multi-speed platform motions to enable systematic evaluation of tracking robustness under varying motion perturbations. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real unstabilized satellite videos demonstrate that DeTracker significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving 61.1% MOTA on SDM-Car-SU and 47.3% MOTA on real satellite video data.
summary_zh: 卫星视频提供对地表动态的连续观测，但对多目标跟踪(MOT)提出了严峻挑战，尤其是在非稳态条件下，平台抖动和微小目标的弱外观共同降低了跟踪性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出DeTracker，一个为非稳态卫星视频定制的联合检测和跟踪框架。DeTracker引入了全局-局部运动解耦(GLMD)模块，通过全局对齐和局部精细化，显式地将卫星平台运动从真实物体运动中分离出来，从而提高了轨迹稳定性和运动估计精度。此外，我们还开发了一个时间依赖特征金字塔(TDFP)模块，以执行跨帧时间特征融合，增强微小目标表征的连续性和区分度。我们进一步构建了一个新的基准数据集SDM-Car-SU，模拟多方向和多速度的平台运动，以实现对不同运动扰动下跟踪鲁棒性的系统评估。在模拟和真实非稳态卫星视频上进行的大量实验表明，DeTracker显著优于现有方法，在SDM-Car-SU上达到61.1%的MOTA，在真实卫星视频数据上达到47.3%的MOTA。
tldr: The paper introduces DeTracker, a new framework for vehicle detection and tracking in unstabilized satellite videos, using motion decoupling and temporal feature fusion to improve accuracy, and proposes a new benchmark dataset for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DeTracker，一个用于不稳定的卫星视频中车辆检测和跟踪的新框架。它采用运动解耦和时间特征融合来提高准确性，并提出了一个新的基准数据集用于评估。

title: From Snow to Rain: Evaluating Robustness, Calibration, and Complexity of Model-Based Robust Training
summary: Robustness to natural corruptions remains a critical challenge for reliable deep learning, particularly in safety-sensitive domains. We study a family of model-based training approaches that leverage a learned nuisance variation model to generate realistic corruptions, as well as new hybrid strategies that combine random coverage with adversarial refinement in nuisance space. Using the Challenging Unreal and Real Environments for Traffic Sign Recognition dataset (CURE-TSR), with Snow and Rain corruptions, we evaluate accuracy, calibration, and training complexity across corruption severities. Our results show that model-based methods consistently outperform baselines Vanilla, Adversarial Training, and AugMix baselines, with model-based adversarial training providing the strongest robustness under across all corruptions but at the expense of higher computation and model-based data augmentation achieving comparable robustness with $T$ less computational complexity without incurring a statistically significant drop in performance. These findings highlight the importance of learned nuisance models for capturing natural variability, and suggest a promising path toward more resilient and calibrated models under challenging conditions.
summary_zh: 针对自然扰动的鲁棒性仍然是可靠深度学习面临的关键挑战，尤其是在安全攸关的领域。我们研究了一系列基于模型的训练方法，这些方法利用学习到的干扰变化模型来生成逼真的扰动，以及将随机覆盖与干扰空间中的对抗性细化相结合的新型混合策略。我们使用交通标志识别挑战性真实和非真实环境数据集（CURE-TSR），其中包含雪和雨扰动，评估了在不同扰动程度下的准确率、校准性和训练复杂度。我们的结果表明，基于模型的方法始终优于基线方法 Vanilla、对抗训练和 AugMix，其中基于模型的对抗训练在所有扰动下提供最强的鲁棒性，但代价是更高的计算成本；而基于模型的数据增强实现了相当的鲁棒性，同时计算复杂度降低了 $T$ 倍，且性能上没有出现统计意义上的显著下降。这些发现突出了学习到的干扰模型在捕捉自然可变性方面的重要性，并为在具有挑战性的条件下构建更具弹性和校准性的模型提供了一条有希望的途径。
tldr: This paper explores model-based training methods that use learned nuisance variation models to enhance the robustness and calibration of deep learning models against natural corruptions like snow and rain in traffic sign recognition, showing improved performance over baseline methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文探索了基于模型的训练方法，该方法利用学习到的干扰变化模型来增强深度学习模型在交通标志识别中对雪和雨等自然损坏的鲁棒性和校准，结果表明性能优于基线方法。

title: SAM-pose2seg: Pose-Guided Human Instance Segmentation in Crowds
summary: Segment Anything (SAM) provides an unprecedented foundation for human segmentation, but may struggle under occlusion, where keypoints may be partially or fully invisible. We adapt SAM 2.1 for pose-guided segmentation with minimal encoder modifications, retaining its strong generalization. Using a fine-tuning strategy called PoseMaskRefine, we incorporate pose keypoints with high visibility into the iterative correction process originally employed by SAM, yielding improved robustness and accuracy across multiple datasets. During inference, we simplify prompting by selecting only the three keypoints with the highest visibility. This strategy reduces sensitivity to common errors, such as missing body parts or misclassified clothing, and allows accurate mask prediction from as few as a single keypoint. Our results demonstrate that pose-guided fine-tuning of SAM enables effective, occlusion-aware human segmentation while preserving the generalization capabilities of the original model. The code and pretrained models will be available at https://mirapurkrabek.github.io/BBox-MaskPose.
summary_zh: 分割一切模型（SAM）为人体分割提供了一个前所未有的基础，但在遮挡情况下可能会遇到困难，因为关键点可能部分或完全不可见。我们对SAM 2.1进行了适配，使其能够进行姿态引导的分割，并对编码器进行了最小的修改，从而保留了其强大的泛化能力。通过一种名为PoseMaskRefine的微调策略，我们将具有高可见性的姿态关键点整合到SAM原有的迭代校正过程中，从而提高了多个数据集上的鲁棒性和准确性。在推理过程中，我们仅选择三个可见性最高的关键点来简化提示。这种策略降低了对常见错误的敏感性，例如身体部位缺失或服装分类错误，并允许仅从单个关键点进行准确的掩码预测。我们的结果表明，对SAM进行姿态引导的微调能够实现有效的、具有遮挡感知的人体分割，同时保留原始模型的泛化能力。代码和预训练模型将在https://mirapurkrabek.github.io/BBox-MaskPose 上提供。
tldr: This paper presents a pose-guided fine-tuning method (PoseMaskRefine) for SAM to improve human instance segmentation in crowded scenes, especially under occlusion, by incorporating pose keypoints with high visibility. They simplified prompting by selecting only the three keypoints with highest visibility leading to more robust and accurate mask predictions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于姿态引导的SAM微调方法 (PoseMaskRefine)，通过整合高可见度的姿态关键点，以提高在拥挤场景中，尤其是在遮挡情况下的人体实例分割性能。他们通过只选择三个可见性最高的关键点来简化提示，从而实现更强大、更准确的掩码预测。

title: Terminally constrained flow-based generative models from an optimal control perspective
summary: We address the problem of sampling from terminally constrained distributions with pre-trained flow-based generative models through an optimal control formulation. Theoretically, we characterize the value function by a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation and derive the optimal feedback control as the minimizer of the associated Hamiltonian. We show that as the control penalty increases, the controlled process recovers the reference distribution, while as the penalty vanishes, the terminal law converges to a generalized Wasserstein projection onto the constraint manifold. Algorithmically, we introduce Terminal Optimal Control with Flow-based models (TOCFlow), a geometry-aware sampling-time guidance method for pre-trained flows. Solving the control problem in a terminal co-moving frame that tracks reference trajectories yields a closed-form scalar damping factor along the Riemannian gradient, capturing second-order curvature effects without matrix inversions. TOCFlow therefore matches the geometric consistency of Gauss-Newton updates at the computational cost of standard gradient guidance. We evaluate TOCFlow on three high-dimensional scientific tasks spanning equality, inequality, and global statistical constraints, namely Darcy flow, constrained trajectory planning, and turbulence snapshot generation with Kolmogorov spectral scaling. Across all settings, TOCFlow improves constraint satisfaction over Euclidean guidance and projection baselines while preserving the reference model's generative quality.
summary_zh: 我们通过最优控制框架，解决了使用预训练的基于流的生成模型从终端约束分布中采样的问题。理论上，我们用Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程刻画了价值函数，并推导出最优反馈控制为相关哈密顿量的极小值。我们证明，随着控制惩罚的增加，受控过程恢复参考分布；而当惩罚消失时，终端定律收敛到约束流形上的广义Wasserstein投影。在算法上，我们引入了基于流模型具有终端最优控制（TOCFlow）的算法，这是一种用于预训练流的几何感知采样时间引导方法。在跟踪参考轨迹的终端随动框架中求解控制问题，会产生一个沿黎曼梯度的闭合形式标量阻尼因子，在不进行矩阵求逆的情况下捕获二阶曲率效应。因此，TOCFlow在标准梯度引导的计算成本下，实现了与Gauss-Newton更新方法一致的几何一致性。我们在三个高维科学任务中评估了TOCFlow，这些任务涵盖了等式、不等式和全局统计约束，即Darcy流、约束轨迹规划以及具有Kolmogorov谱尺度的湍流快照生成。在所有设置中，TOCFlow相对于欧几里得引导和投影基线，提高了约束满足度，同时保留了参考模型的生成质量。
tldr: The paper introduces TOCFlow, a novel method to sample from terminally constrained distributions using flow-based generative models and optimal control, showing improved performance across several scientific tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了TOCFlow，一种新颖的方法，利用基于流的生成模型和最优控制从终端约束分布中进行采样，并在多个科学任务中表现出更好的性能。

title: Draw it like Euclid: Teaching transformer models to generate CAD profiles using ruler and compass construction steps
summary: We introduce a new method of generating Computer Aided Design (CAD) profiles via a sequence of simple geometric constructions including curve offsetting, rotations and intersections. These sequences start with geometry provided by a designer and build up the points and curves of the final profile step by step. We demonstrate that adding construction steps between the designer's input geometry and the final profile improves generation quality in a similar way to the introduction of a chain of thought in language models. Similar to the constraints in a parametric CAD model, the construction sequences reduce the degrees of freedom in the modeled shape to a small set of parameter values which can be adjusted by the designer, allowing parametric editing with the constructed geometry evaluated to floating point precision. In addition we show that applying reinforcement learning to the construction sequences gives further improvements over a wide range of metrics, including some which were not explicitly optimized.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了一种生成计算机辅助设计（CAD）轮廓的新方法，该方法通过一系列简单的几何构造实现，包括曲线偏移、旋转和相交。这些序列以设计师提供的几何图形为起点，逐步构建最终轮廓的点和曲线。我们证明，在设计师的输入几何图形和最终轮廓之间添加构造步骤可以提高生成质量，类似于在语言模型中引入思维链。与参数化CAD模型中的约束类似，构造序列将建模形状的自由度降低到一小部分参数值，设计师可以调整这些参数值，从而实现参数化编辑，并以浮点精度评估构造的几何图形。此外，我们还表明，将强化学习应用于构造序列，可以在包括一些未明确优化的指标在内的广泛指标上获得进一步的改进。
tldr: The paper introduces a method for generating CAD profiles using geometric construction sequences learned by transformer models, enhanced with reinforcement learning, to improve generation quality and enable parametric editing.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种使用几何构造序列生成CAD轮廓的方法，该序列由transformer模型学习，并通过强化学习增强，从而提高生成质量并实现参数化编辑。

title: Design Methodology of Hydraulically-driven Soft Robotic Gripper for a Large and Heavy Object
summary: This paper presents a design methodology of a hydraulically-driven soft robotic gripper for grasping a large and heavy object -- approximately 10 - 20 kg with 20 - 30 cm diameter. Most existing soft grippers are pneumatically actuated with several hundred kPa pressure, and cannot generate output force sufficient for such a large and heavy object. Instead of pneumatic actuation, hydraulic actuation has a potential to generate much larger power by several MPa pressure. In this study, we develop a hydraulically-driven soft gripper, in which its basic design parameters are determined based on a mathematical model that represents the relationship among the driving pressure, bending angle, object mass and grasping force. Moreover, we selected materials suitable for grasping a heavier object, based on the finite element analysis result of the detailed design. We report experimental results on a 20 kg object grasping and closed-loop control of the finger bending angle.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种液压驱动软体机器人夹持器的设计方法，用于抓取大型重物——约10-20公斤，直径20-30厘米。现有的大多数软体夹持器采用气动驱动，压力为数百千帕，无法产生足够大的输出力来抓取如此大型重物。与气动驱动不同，液压驱动有潜力通过数兆帕的压力产生更大的功率。在本研究中，我们开发了一种液压驱动的软体夹持器，其基本设计参数基于一个数学模型确定，该模型表示了驱动压力、弯曲角度、物体质量和夹持力之间的关系。此外，我们基于详细设计的有限元分析结果，选择了适合抓取更重物体的材料。我们报告了关于抓取20公斤物体的实验结果，以及手指弯曲角度的闭环控制结果。
tldr: This paper presents a hydraulically-actuated soft robotic gripper designed to grasp large, heavy objects (10-20kg), using mathematical modeling and FEA for design and material selection, demonstrating successful grasping and closed-loop control.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种液压驱动的软体机器人夹爪，旨在抓取大型重物（10-20公斤）。该设计采用数学建模和有限元分析进行设计和材料选择，实验结果展示了成功的抓取和闭环控制。

title: HGATSolver: A Heterogeneous Graph Attention Solver for Fluid-Structure Interaction
summary: Fluid-structure interaction (FSI) systems involve distinct physical domains, fluid and solid, governed by different partial differential equations and coupled at a dynamic interface. While learning-based solvers offer a promising alternative to costly numerical simulations, existing methods struggle to capture the heterogeneous dynamics of FSI within a unified framework. This challenge is further exacerbated by inconsistencies in response across domains due to interface coupling and by disparities in learning difficulty across fluid and solid regions, leading to instability during prediction. To address these challenges, we propose the Heterogeneous Graph Attention Solver (HGATSolver). HGATSolver encodes the system as a heterogeneous graph, embedding physical structure directly into the model via distinct node and edge types for fluid, solid, and interface regions. This enables specialized message-passing mechanisms tailored to each physical domain. To stabilize explicit time stepping, we introduce a novel physics-conditioned gating mechanism that serves as a learnable, adaptive relaxation factor. Furthermore, an Inter-domain Gradient-Balancing Loss dynamically balances the optimization objectives across domains based on predictive uncertainty. Extensive experiments on two constructed FSI benchmarks and a public dataset demonstrate that HGATSolver achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing an effective framework for surrogate modeling of coupled multi-physics systems.
summary_zh: 流固耦合 (FSI) 系统涉及截然不同的物理域，即流体和固体，分别由不同的偏微分方程控制，并在动态界面处耦合。虽然基于学习的求解器为替代昂贵的数值模拟提供了一个有希望的方案，但现有方法难以在统一框架内捕获流固耦合的异构动力学特性。由于界面耦合导致不同域之间的响应不一致，以及流体和固体区域学习难度差异，使得这一挑战进一步加剧，从而导致预测期间的不稳定性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了异构图注意力求解器 (HGATSolver)。HGATSolver 将系统编码为异构图，通过为流体、固体和界面区域设置不同的节点和边类型，将物理结构直接嵌入模型中。这使得能够针对每个物理域定制专门的消息传递机制。为了稳定显式时间步进，我们引入了一种新颖的物理条件门控机制，该机制充当可学习的、自适应的松弛因子。此外，域间梯度平衡损失根据预测不确定性动态平衡不同域的优化目标。在两个构建的流固耦合基准和一个公共数据集上的大量实验表明，HGATSolver 实现了最先进的性能，为耦合多物理场系统的代理建模建立了一个有效的框架。
tldr: The paper introduces HGATSolver, a novel heterogeneous graph attention network-based solver for Fluid-Structure Interaction (FSI) problems, addressing challenges in capturing heterogeneous dynamics and instability through specialized message passing and gradient balancing.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HGATSolver，一种新颖的基于异构图注意力网络的流固耦合（FSI）问题求解器，通过专门的消息传递和梯度平衡来解决捕获异构动力学和不稳定性的挑战。

title: Thermo-LIO: A Novel Multi-Sensor Integrated System for Structural Health Monitoring
summary: Traditional two-dimensional thermography, despite being non-invasive and useful for defect detection in the construction field, is limited in effectively assessing complex geometries, inaccessible areas, and subsurface defects. This paper introduces Thermo-LIO, a novel multi-sensor system that can enhance Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) by fusing thermal imaging with high-resolution LiDAR. To achieve this, the study first develops a multimodal fusion method combining thermal imaging and LiDAR, enabling precise calibration and synchronization of multimodal data streams to create accurate representations of temperature distributions in buildings. Second, it integrates this fusion approach with LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO), enabling full coverage of large-scale structures and allowing for detailed monitoring of temperature variations and defect detection across inspection cycles. Experimental validations, including case studies on a bridge and a hall building, demonstrate that Thermo-LIO can detect detailed thermal anomalies and structural defects more accurately than traditional methods. The system enhances diagnostic precision, enables real-time processing, and expands inspection coverage, highlighting the crucial role of multimodal sensor integration in advancing SHM methodologies for large-scale civil infrastructure.
summary_zh: 传统二维热成像技术，尽管具有非侵入性且在建筑领域中可用于缺陷检测，但在有效评估复杂几何形状、难以进入的区域以及次表面缺陷方面存在局限性。本文介绍了一种新型多传感器系统Thermo-LIO，它可以通过融合热成像和高分辨率激光雷达来增强结构健康监测（SHM）。为了实现这一点，该研究首先开发了一种多模态融合方法，将热成像和激光雷达相结合，从而能够精确校准和同步多模态数据流，以创建建筑物中温度分布的精确表示。其次，它将这种融合方法与激光雷达惯性里程计（LIO）相结合，从而能够全面覆盖大型结构，并允许在整个检测周期内对温度变化和缺陷检测进行详细监测。包括桥梁和一个大厅建筑的案例研究在内的实验验证表明，Thermo-LIO可以比传统方法更准确地检测到详细的热异常和结构缺陷。该系统提高了诊断精度，实现了实时处理，并扩大了检测范围，突出了多模态传感器集成在推进大型土木基础设施结构健康监测方法论中的关键作用。
tldr: The paper introduces Thermo-LIO, a multi-sensor system fusing thermal imaging and LiDAR with LIO for Structural Health Monitoring of large-scale infrastructure, demonstrating improved defect detection accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Thermo-LIO的多传感器系统，该系统融合了热成像和激光雷达与LIO，用于大型基础设施的结构健康监测，并展示了改进的缺陷检测精度。

title: Comprehensive Machine Learning Benchmarking for Fringe Projection Profilometry with Photorealistic Synthetic Data
summary: Machine learning approaches for fringe projection profilometry (FPP) are hindered by the lack of large, diverse datasets and comprehensive benchmarking protocols. This paper introduces the first open-source, photorealistic synthetic dataset for FPP, generated using NVIDIA Isaac Sim with 15,600 fringe images and 300 depth reconstructions across 50 diverse objects. We benchmark four neural network architectures (UNet, Hformer, ResUNet, Pix2Pix) on single-shot depth reconstruction, revealing that all models achieve similar performance (58-77 mm RMSE) despite substantial architectural differences. Our results demonstrate fundamental limitations of direct fringe-to-depth mapping without explicit phase information, with reconstruction errors approaching 75-95\% of the typical object depth range. This resource provides standardized evaluation protocols enabling systematic comparison and development of learning-based FPP approaches.
summary_zh: 条纹投影轮廓术（FPP）的机器学习方法受限于大型、多样化数据集和全面基准测试协议的缺乏。本文介绍了首个开源、照片级真实感 FPP 合成数据集，该数据集使用 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 生成，包含 15,600 张条纹图像和 50 个不同物体的 300 次深度重建。我们对四种神经网络架构（UNet、Hformer、ResUNet、Pix2Pix）进行了单次拍摄深度重建的基准测试，结果表明，尽管架构差异很大，但所有模型都达到了相似的性能（58-77 毫米 RMSE）。我们的结果表明，在没有明确相位信息的情况下，直接条纹到深度映射存在根本性局限，重建误差接近典型物体深度范围的 75-95％。该资源提供了标准化评估协议，能够对基于学习的 FPP 方法进行系统比较和开发。
tldr: This paper introduces a photorealistic synthetic dataset for Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) and benchmarks several neural network architectures for single-shot depth reconstruction, finding limitations in direct fringe-to-depth mapping.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个用于条纹投影三维测量(FPP)的光真实感合成数据集，并对几种用于单次深度重建的神经网络架构进行了基准测试，发现直接从条纹到深度映射存在局限性。

title: High-fidelity lunar topographic reconstruction across diverse terrain and illumination environments using deep learning
summary: Topographic models are essential for characterizing planetary surfaces and for inferring underlying geological processes. Nevertheless, meter-scale topographic data remain limited, which constrains detailed planetary investigations, even for the Moon, where extensive high-resolution orbital images are available. Recent advances in deep learning (DL) exploit single-view imagery, constrained by low-resolution topography, for fast and flexible reconstruction of fine-scale topography. However, their robustness and general applicability across diverse lunar landforms and illumination conditions remain insufficiently explored. In this study, we build upon our previously proposed DL framework by incorporating a more robust scale recovery scheme and extending the model to polar regions under low solar illumination conditions. We demonstrate that, compared with single-view shape-from-shading methods, the proposed DL approach exhibits greater robustness to varying illumination and achieves more consistent and accurate topographic reconstructions. Furthermore, it reliably reconstructs topography across lunar features of diverse scales, morphologies, and geological ages. High-quality topographic models are also produced for the lunar south polar areas, including permanently shadowed regions, demonstrating the method's capability in reconstructing complex and low-illumination terrain. These findings suggest that DL-based approaches have the potential to leverage extensive lunar datasets to support advanced exploration missions and enable investigations of the Moon at unprecedented topographic resolution.
summary_zh: 地形模型对于表征行星表面特征和推断潜在的地质过程至关重要。然而，米级地形数据仍然有限，这制约了详细的行星研究，即使是在拥有大量高分辨率轨道图像的月球也不例外。深度学习（DL）的最新进展利用单视图像，并受低分辨率地形的约束，实现了对精细尺度地形的快速和灵活重建。然而，它们在不同月球地貌和光照条件下的鲁棒性和通用适用性仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们建立在我们先前提出的深度学习框架的基础上，通过引入更鲁棒的尺度恢复方案并将模型扩展到低太阳光照条件下的极地区域。我们证明，与单视角阴影恢复形状方法相比，所提出的深度学习方法对不同光照表现出更强的鲁棒性，并实现了更一致和准确的地形重建。此外，它可以可靠地重建不同尺度、形态和地质年龄的月球特征的地形。针对月球南极区域（包括永久阴影区）也生成了高质量的地形模型，证明了该方法在重建复杂和低光照地形方面的能力。这些发现表明，基于深度学习的方法具有利用大量月球数据集来支持高级探测任务并以前所未有的地形分辨率进行月球研究的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a deep learning approach for high-fidelity lunar topographic reconstruction from single-view imagery, demonstrating robustness across diverse terrain and illumination conditions, including permanently shadowed regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的月球高保真地形重建方法，该方法利用单视图图像，在各种地形和光照条件下（包括永久阴影区域）表现出鲁棒性。

title: Older Adults' Preferences for Feedback Cadence from an Exercise Coach Robot
summary: People can respond to feedback and guidance in different ways, and it is important for robots to personalize their interactions and utilize verbal and nonverbal communication cues. We aim to understand how older adults respond to different cadences of verbal and nonverbal feedback of a robot exercise coach. We conducted an online study of older adults, where participants evaluated videos of the robot giving feedback at different cadences for each modality. The results indicate that changing the cadence of one modality affects the perception of both it and the other modality. We can use the results from this study to better design the frequency of the robot coach's feedback during an exercise session with this population.
summary_zh: 人们对反馈和指导的反应各不相同，因此机器人个性化交互并利用语言和非语言沟通线索至关重要。我们的目标是了解老年人如何对机器人运动教练提供的不同节奏的语言和非语言反馈作出反应。 我们进行了一项针对老年人的在线研究，参与者评估了机器人在每种模态下以不同节奏给出反馈的视频。 结果表明，改变一种模态的节奏会影响对该模态以及另一种模态的感知。 我们可以利用这项研究的结果，更好地设计机器人在与该人群进行运动期间反馈的频率。
tldr: This paper investigates older adults' preferences for verbal and nonverbal feedback cadence from an exercise coach robot, finding that cadence in one modality affects perception of both modalities. The study aims to improve robot coach feedback design for this population.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了老年人对运动教练机器人提供的口头和非口头反馈节奏的偏好，发现一种方式的节奏会影响对两种方式的认知。该研究旨在改进针对老年人群体的机器人教练的反馈设计。

title: FastStair: Learning to Run Up Stairs with Humanoid Robots
summary: Running up stairs is effortless for humans but remains extremely challenging for humanoid robots due to the simultaneous requirements of high agility and strict stability. Model-free reinforcement learning (RL) can generate dynamic locomotion, yet implicit stability rewards and heavy reliance on task-specific reward shaping tend to result in unsafe behaviors, especially on stairs; conversely, model-based foothold planners encode contact feasibility and stability structure, but enforcing their hard constraints often induces conservative motion that limits speed. We present FastStair, a planner-guided, multi-stage learning framework that reconciles these complementary strengths to achieve fast and stable stair ascent. FastStair integrates a parallel model-based foothold planner into the RL training loop to bias exploration toward dynamically feasible contacts and to pretrain a safety-focused base policy. To mitigate planner-induced conservatism and the discrepancy between low- and high-speed action distributions, the base policy was fine-tuned into speed-specialized experts and then integrated via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to enable smooth operation across the full commanded-speed range. We deploy the resulting controller on the Oli humanoid robot, achieving stable stair ascent at commanded speeds up to 1.65 m/s and traversing a 33-step spiral staircase (17 cm rise per step) in 12 s, demonstrating robust high-speed performance on long staircases. Notably, the proposed approach served as the champion solution in the Canton Tower Robot Run Up Competition.
summary_zh: 攀爬楼梯对人类来说毫不费力，但由于同时需要高敏捷性和严格的稳定性，对于人形机器人来说仍然极具挑战性。无模型强化学习(RL)可以生成动态运动，但隐式的稳定性奖励和对特定任务的奖励塑形的高度依赖往往会导致不安全的行为，尤其是在楼梯上；相反，基于模型的落脚点规划器编码了接触可行性和稳定性结构，但执行其硬约束通常会诱导保守的运动，从而限制速度。我们提出了FastStair，一种规划器引导的多阶段学习框架，它协调了这些互补优势，以实现快速且稳定的楼梯攀登。FastStair将一个并行的基于模型的落脚点规划器集成到RL训练循环中，从而引导探索朝向动态上可行的接触，并预训练一个以安全为重点的基础策略。为了减轻规划器诱导的保守性以及低速和高速动作分布之间的差异，我们将基础策略微调成速度专业化的专家策略，然后通过低秩自适应(LoRA)进行集成，以实现整个指令速度范围内的平稳运行。我们将生成的控制器部署在Oli人形机器人上，实现了在高达1.65米/秒指令速度下的稳定楼梯攀登，并在12秒内穿越了一个33步的螺旋楼梯（每步17厘米高），展示了在长楼梯上稳健的高速性能。值得注意的是，所提出的方法是广州塔机器人登高赛的冠军解决方案。
tldr: The paper presents FastStair, a novel planner-guided reinforcement learning framework for humanoid robots that enables fast and stable stair ascent, achieving state-of-the-art performance and winning a robot competition.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 FastStair，一种新型的规划器引导的强化学习框架，用于人形机器人，能够快速稳定地上楼梯，实现了最先进的性能并赢得了机器人竞赛。

title: Fast-ThinkAct: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Reasoning via Verbalizable Latent Planning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) tasks require reasoning over complex visual scenes and executing adaptive actions in dynamic environments. While recent studies on reasoning VLAs show that explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) can improve generalization, they suffer from high inference latency due to lengthy reasoning traces. We propose Fast-ThinkAct, an efficient reasoning framework that achieves compact yet performant planning through verbalizable latent reasoning. Fast-ThinkAct learns to reason efficiently with latent CoTs by distilling from a teacher, driven by a preference-guided objective to align manipulation trajectories that transfers both linguistic and visual planning capabilities for embodied control. This enables reasoning-enhanced policy learning that effectively connects compact reasoning to action execution. Extensive experiments across diverse embodied manipulation and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Fast-ThinkAct achieves strong performance with up to 89.3\% reduced inference latency over state-of-the-art reasoning VLAs, while maintaining effective long-horizon planning, few-shot adaptation, and failure recovery.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 任务需要在复杂视觉场景中进行推理，并在动态环境中执行自适应动作。虽然最近关于推理 VLA 的研究表明显式的思维链 (CoT) 可以提高泛化能力，但它们因冗长的推理轨迹而导致较高的推理延迟。我们提出了 Fast-ThinkAct，一种高效的推理框架，通过可 verbalize 的潜在推理实现紧凑但高性能的规划。Fast-ThinkAct 通过从教师模型中提炼，学习使用潜在 CoT 进行高效推理，并由偏好引导的目标驱动，对齐操作轨迹，从而迁移具身控制的语言和视觉规划能力。这实现了推理增强的策略学习，有效地将紧凑的推理连接到动作执行。在各种具身操作和推理基准测试中进行的大量实验表明，Fast-ThinkAct 实现了强大的性能，与最先进的推理 VLA 相比，推理延迟最多降低了 89.3\%，同时保持了有效的长程规划、少样本适应和故障恢复能力。
tldr: Fast-ThinkAct proposes an efficient reasoning framework for VLA tasks using verbalizable latent reasoning distilled from a teacher model. It achieves significant speedup compared to chain-of-thought methods while maintaining strong performance on embodied manipulation and reasoning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Fast-ThinkAct提出了一种高效的VLA任务推理框架，该框架使用从教师模型中提炼的可表达潜在推理。与思维链方法相比，它实现了显著的加速，同时在具身操作和推理基准测试中保持了强大的性能。

title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
summary: Today's strongest video-language models (VLMs) remain proprietary. The strongest open-weight models either rely on synthetic data from proprietary VLMs, effectively distilling from them, or do not disclose their training data or recipe. As a result, the open-source community lacks the foundations needed to improve on the state-of-the-art video (and image) language models. Crucially, many downstream applications require more than just high-level video understanding; they require grounding -- either by pointing or by tracking in pixels. Even proprietary models lack this capability. We present Molmo2, a new family of VLMs that are state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrate exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks. Our key contribution is a collection of 7 new video datasets and 2 multi-image datasets, including a dataset of highly detailed video captions for pre-training, a free-form video Q&A dataset for fine-tuning, a new object tracking dataset with complex queries, and an innovative new video pointing dataset, all collected without the use of closed VLMs. We also present a training recipe for this data utilizing an efficient packing and message-tree encoding scheme, and show bi-directional attention on vision tokens and a novel token-weight strategy improves performance. Our best-in-class 8B model outperforms others in the class of open weight and data models on short videos, counting, and captioning, and is competitive on long-videos. On video-grounding Molmo2 significantly outperforms existing open-weight models like Qwen3-VL (35.5 vs 29.6 accuracy on video counting) and surpasses proprietary models like Gemini 3 Pro on some tasks (38.4 vs 20.0 F1 on video pointing and 56.2 vs 41.1 J&F on video tracking).
summary_zh: 目前最强大的视频-语言模型（VLMs）仍然是专有的。最强的开源权重模型要么依赖于专有VLMs产生的合成数据，实际上是在对其进行蒸馏，要么不公开其训练数据或方案。因此，开源社区缺乏改进最先进视频（和图像）语言模型所需的基础。至关重要的是，许多下游应用需要的不仅仅是高层次的视频理解，还需要定位——通过指向或在像素中跟踪。即使是专有模型也缺乏这种能力。我们提出了Molmo2，一个新型的VLM系列，在开源模型中处于领先地位，并在单图像、多图像和视频任务中的点驱动定位方面展示了卓越的新能力。我们的主要贡献是收集了7个新的视频数据集和2个多图像数据集，包括用于预训练的高度详细的视频字幕数据集、用于微调的自由形式视频问答数据集、具有复杂查询的新对象跟踪数据集，以及一个创新的新视频指向数据集，所有这些数据集均在未使用封闭VLM的情况下收集。我们还提出了一种利用高效打包和消息树编码方案的训练方案，并表明视觉标记上的双向注意力和一种新的标记权重策略可提高性能。我们一流的8B模型在短视频、计数和字幕方面优于同类其他开源权重和数据模型，并且在长视频方面具有竞争力。在视频定位方面，Molmo2明显优于现有的开源权重模型，如Qwen3-VL（视频计数精度为35.5 vs 29.6），并在某些任务上超过了Gemini 3 Pro等专有模型（视频指向F1为38.4 vs 20.0，视频跟踪J&F为56.2 vs 41.1）。
tldr: Molmo2 introduces a new family of open-weight VLMs with video understanding and grounding capabilities, along with new video and multi-image datasets and a novel training recipe, outperforming existing open-weight models and even surpassing proprietary models on some video grounding tasks.
tldr_zh: Molmo2 推出了一系列新的开源 VLM，具有视频理解和定位能力，以及新的视频和多图像数据集和新型训练方法，在视频定位任务上优于现有的开源模型，甚至超过了某些专有模型。

title: SurgGoal: Rethinking Surgical Planning Evaluation via Goal-Satisfiability
summary: Surgical planning integrates visual perception, long-horizon reasoning, and procedural knowledge, yet it remains unclear whether current evaluation protocols reliably assess vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings. Motivated by a goal-oriented view of surgical planning, we define planning correctness via phase-goal satisfiability, where plan validity is determined by expert-defined surgical rules. Based on this definition, we introduce a multicentric meta-evaluation benchmark with valid procedural variations and invalid plans containing order and content errors. Using this benchmark, we show that sequence similarity metrics systematically misjudge planning quality, penalizing valid plans while failing to identify invalid ones. We therefore adopt a rule-based goal-satisfiability metric as a high-precision meta-evaluation reference to assess Video-LLMs under progressively constrained settings, revealing failures due to perception errors and under-constrained reasoning. Structural knowledge consistently improves performance, whereas semantic guidance alone is unreliable and benefits larger models only when combined with structural constraints.
summary_zh: 外科手术规划整合了视觉感知、长程推理和程序性知识，但目前的评估方案能否可靠地评估视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 在安全攸关环境下的表现尚不清楚。受手术规划目标导向观点的启发，我们通过阶段-目标可满足性来定义规划的正确性，其中计划的有效性由专家定义的手术规则决定。基于此定义，我们引入了一个多中心元评估基准，包含有效的程序变体和包含顺序及内容错误的无效计划。使用该基准，我们表明序列相似性度量系统性地误判规划质量，惩罚有效计划却未能识别无效计划。因此，我们采用基于规则的目标-可满足性度量作为高精度元评估参考，以评估视频-LLM在逐步约束的设置下的表现，从而揭示由感知错误和约束不足的推理导致的失败。结构化知识持续提高性能，而单凭语义指导是不可靠的，并且只有在与结构化约束相结合时才能使更大的模型受益。
tldr: This paper introduces a new benchmark and evaluation metric, SurgGoal, for surgical planning that uses goal-satisfiability based on expert-defined surgical rules, revealing weaknesses in existing sequence similarity metrics when evaluating vision-language models.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一个新的手术规划基准和评估指标SurgGoal，它使用基于专家定义的手术规则的目标可满足性，揭示了在评估视觉语言模型时，现有序列相似性指标的弱点。

title: CHORAL: Traversal-Aware Planning for Safe and Efficient Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Routing
summary: Monitoring large, unknown, and complex environments with autonomous robots poses significant navigation challenges, where deploying teams of heterogeneous robots with complementary capabilities can substantially improve both mission performance and feasibility. However, effectively modeling how different robotic platforms interact with the environment requires rich, semantic scene understanding. Despite this, existing approaches often assume homogeneous robot teams or focus on discrete task compatibility rather than continuous routing. Consequently, scene understanding is not fully integrated into routing decisions, limiting their ability to adapt to the environment and to leverage each robot's strengths. In this paper, we propose an integrated semantic-aware framework for coordinating heterogeneous robots. Starting from a reconnaissance flight, we build a metric-semantic map using open-vocabulary vision models and use it to identify regions requiring closer inspection and capability-aware paths for each platform to reach them. These are then incorporated into a heterogeneous vehicle routing formulation that jointly assigns inspection tasks and computes robot trajectories. Experiments in simulation and in a real inspection mission with three robotic platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in planning safer and more efficient routes by explicitly accounting for each platform's navigation capabilities. We release our framework, CHORAL, as open source to support reproducibility and deployment of diverse robot teams.
summary_zh: 使用自主机器人监测大型、未知且复杂的环境带来了显著的导航挑战，部署具有互补能力的异构机器人团队可以显著提高任务性能和可行性。然而，有效建模不同机器人平台与环境的交互需要丰富的、语义的场景理解。尽管如此，现有方法通常假设同构机器人团队或侧重于离散的任务兼容性，而非连续的路径规划。因此，场景理解并未完全集成到路径规划决策中，限制了它们适应环境和利用每个机器人优势的能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种集成的语义感知框架，用于协调异构机器人。从侦察飞行开始，我们使用开放词汇视觉模型构建度量-语义地图，并利用它来识别需要更仔细检查的区域，以及每种平台到达这些区域的能力感知路径。然后，这些信息被纳入到一个异构车辆路径规划公式中，该公式联合分配检查任务并计算机器人轨迹。在仿真和真实检查任务(包含三个机器人平台)中的实验证明了我们的方法在规划更安全、更高效的路径方面的有效性，这得益于显式地考虑了每个平台的导航能力。我们开源了我们的框架CHORAL，以支持可重复性和各种机器人团队的部署。
tldr: This paper presents CHORAL, a semantic-aware framework for coordinating heterogeneous robots in complex environments. It integrates metric-semantic mapping with capability-aware routing to improve safety and efficiency in multi-robot missions, validated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为CHORAL的语义感知框架，用于协调复杂环境中的异构机器人。它集成了度量语义地图构建和能力感知路由，从而提高多机器人任务的安全性与效率，并通过仿真和实际实验验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Terrain-Adaptive Mobile 3D Printing with Hierarchical Control
summary: Mobile 3D printing on unstructured terrain remains challenging due to the conflict between platform mobility and deposition precision. Existing gantry-based systems achieve high accuracy but lack mobility, while mobile platforms struggle to maintain print quality on uneven ground. We present a framework that tightly integrates AI-driven disturbance prediction with multi-modal sensor fusion and hierarchical hardware control, forming a closed-loop perception-learning-actuation system. The AI module learns terrain-to-perturbation mappings from IMU, vision, and depth sensors, enabling proactive compensation rather than reactive correction. This intelligence is embedded into a three-layer control architecture: path planning, predictive chassis-manipulator coordination, and precision hardware execution. Through outdoor experiments on terrain with slopes and surface irregularities, we demonstrate sub-centimeter printing accuracy while maintaining full platform mobility. This AI-hardware integration establishes a practical foundation for autonomous construction in unstructured environments.
summary_zh: 在非结构化地形上的移动3D打印仍然面临挑战，原因在于平台移动性和沉积精度之间的冲突。现有的基于龙门架的系统实现了高精度，但缺乏移动性，而移动平台则难以在不平整的地面上保持打印质量。我们提出了一种框架，该框架将人工智能驱动的扰动预测与多模态传感器融合和分层硬件控制紧密集成，形成一个闭环感知-学习-执行系统。 人工智能模块从IMU、视觉和深度传感器中学习地形到扰动的映射关系，从而实现主动补偿而非被动校正。 这种智能被嵌入到一个三层控制架构中：路径规划、预测性底盘-机械臂协调和精密硬件执行。 通过在具有坡度和表面不规则性的地形上进行的户外实验，我们证明了在保持平台完全移动性的同时，可以实现亚厘米级的打印精度。 这种人工智能-硬件集成为在非结构化环境中进行自主建造奠定了坚实的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces an AI-driven, closed-loop system for mobile 3D printing on unstructured terrain, achieving sub-centimeter accuracy through predictive disturbance compensation and hierarchical control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于非结构化地形上的移动3D打印的AI驱动闭环系统，通过预测性扰动补偿和分层控制实现了亚厘米级的精度。

title: RAG-3DSG: Enhancing 3D Scene Graphs with Re-Shot Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) generation can enhance various downstream tasks in robotics, such as manipulation and navigation, by leveraging structured semantic representations. A 3DSG is constructed from multiple images of a scene, where objects are represented as nodes and relationships as edges. However, existing works for open-vocabulary 3DSG generation suffer from both low object-level recognition accuracy and speed, mainly due to constrained viewpoints, occlusions, and redundant surface density. To address these challenges, we propose RAG-3DSG to mitigate aggregation noise through re-shot guided uncertainty estimation and support object-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) via reliable low-uncertainty objects. Furthermore, we propose a dynamic downsample-mapping strategy to accelerate cross-image object aggregation with adaptive granularity. Experiments on Replica dataset demonstrate that RAG-3DSG significantly improves node captioning accuracy in 3DSG generation while reducing the mapping time by two-thirds compared to the vanilla version.
summary_zh: 开放词汇3D场景图（3DSG）生成能够通过利用结构化的语义表示来增强机器人技术中的各种下游任务，例如操作和导航。3DSG由场景的多张图像构建而成，其中对象表示为节点，关系表示为边。然而，现有的开放词汇3DSG生成工作在对象级识别准确性和速度方面都存在不足，这主要是由于受限的视角、遮挡和冗余的表面密度造成的。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了RAG-3DSG，通过重拍引导的不确定性估计来缓解聚合噪声，并通过可靠的低不确定性对象来支持对象级检索增强生成（RAG）。此外，我们提出了一种动态下采样映射策略，以自适应粒度加速跨图像对象聚合。在Replica数据集上的实验表明，与原始版本相比，RAG-3DSG显著提高了3DSG生成中的节点字幕准确率，同时减少了三分之二的映射时间。
tldr: The paper introduces RAG-3DSG, a novel approach to improve open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation by using re-shot guided uncertainty estimation and retrieval-augmented generation, significantly improving accuracy and reducing mapping time.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RAG-3DSG，一种新的方法，通过使用重拍引导的不确定性估计和检索增强生成来改进开放词汇3D场景图生成，显著提高了准确率并减少了映射时间。

title: CoCoPlan: Adaptive Coordination and Communication for Multi-robot Systems in Dynamic and Unknown Environments
summary: Multi-robot systems can greatly enhance efficiency through coordination and collaboration, yet in practice, full-time communication is rarely available and interactions are constrained to close-range exchanges. Existing methods either maintain all-time connectivity, rely on fixed schedules, or adopt pairwise protocols, but none adapt effectively to dynamic spatio-temporal task distributions under limited communication, resulting in suboptimal coordination. To address this gap, we propose CoCoPlan, a unified framework that co-optimizes collaborative task planning and team-wise intermittent communication. Our approach integrates a branch-and-bound architecture that jointly encodes task assignments and communication events, an adaptive objective function that balances task efficiency against communication latency, and a communication event optimization module that strategically determines when, where and how the global connectivity should be re-established. Extensive experiments demonstrate that it outperforms state-of-the-art methods by achieving a 22.4% higher task completion rate, reducing communication overhead by 58.6%, and improving the scalability by supporting up to 100 robots in dynamic environments. Hardware experiments include the complex 2D office environment and large-scale 3D disaster-response scenario.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统能通过协同与合作显著提高效率，但在实践中，全时通信很少可用，交互被限制在近距离交换中。现有方法要么维持全时连接，要么依赖固定调度，要么采用两两协议，但都无法在有限通信下有效地适应动态的时空任务分布，导致次优的协同。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CoCoPlan，一个统一的框架，用于协同优化协作式任务规划和团队式间歇通信。我们的方法整合了一个分支定界架构，该架构联合编码了任务分配和通信事件，一个自适应目标函数，该函数平衡了任务效率与通信延迟，以及一个通信事件优化模块，该模块战略性地决定何时、何地以及如何重新建立全局连接。大量实验表明，该方法优于最先进的方法，任务完成率提高了22.4%，通信开销降低了58.6%，并通过支持动态环境中多达100个机器人，提高了可扩展性。硬件实验包括复杂的2D办公环境和大规模3D灾难响应场景。
tldr: CoCoPlan is a novel multi-robot coordination framework that adaptively optimizes task planning and communication in dynamic environments, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in task completion rate, communication overhead, and scalability.
tldr_zh: CoCoPlan是一种新颖的多机器人协调框架，它能在动态环境中自适应地优化任务规划和通信，并在任务完成率、通信开销和可扩展性方面优于最先进的方法。

title: In-the-Wild Compliant Manipulation with UMI-FT
summary: Many manipulation tasks require careful force modulation. With insufficient force the task may fail, while excessive force could cause damage. The high cost, bulky size and fragility of commercial force/torque (F/T) sensors have limited large-scale, force-aware policy learning. We introduce UMI-FT, a handheld data-collection platform that mounts compact, six-axis force/torque sensors on each finger, enabling finger-level wrench measurements alongside RGB, depth, and pose. Using the multimodal data collected from this device, we train an adaptive compliance policy that predicts position targets, grasp force, and stiffness for execution on standard compliance controllers. In evaluations on three contact-rich, force-sensitive tasks (whiteboard wiping, skewering zucchini, and lightbulb insertion), UMI-FT enables policies that reliably regulate external contact forces and internal grasp forces, outperforming baselines that lack compliance or force sensing. UMI-FT offers a scalable path to learning compliant manipulation from in-the-wild demonstrations. We open-source the hardware and software to facilitate broader adoption at:https://umi-ft.github.io/.
summary_zh: 许多操作任务需要精细的力调整。力不足可能导致任务失败，而力过大可能造成损害。商业力/扭矩 (F/T) 传感器的高成本、庞大体积和脆弱性限制了大规模的力感知策略学习。我们推出 UMI-FT，一个手持数据采集平台，在每个手指上安装了紧凑型的六轴力/扭矩传感器，从而能够获取指尖级别的扳手力测量值，同时获取 RGB、深度和姿态信息。利用该设备采集的多模态数据，我们训练了一个自适应柔顺策略，用于预测位置目标、抓取力和刚度，以便在标准柔顺控制器上执行。在三个接触密集、力敏感的任务（白板擦拭、串烤西葫芦和灯泡插入）的评估中，UMI-FT 使策略能够可靠地调节外部接触力和内部抓取力，优于缺乏柔顺性或力传感的基线方法。UMI-FT 为从真实环境演示中学习柔顺操作提供了一条可扩展的路径。我们开源了硬件和软件，以促进更广泛的应用：https://umi-ft.github.io/。
tldr: The paper introduces UMI-FT, a low-cost, finger-mounted F/T sensor system for collecting multimodal data and learning compliant manipulation policies, demonstrating its effectiveness on several force-sensitive tasks. The hardware and software are open-sourced.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 UMI-FT，一种低成本的指尖力/扭矩传感器系统，用于收集多模态数据并学习顺应性操作策略，并在多个力敏感任务上证明了其有效性。该硬件和软件已开源。

title: Toward Ultra-Long-Horizon Agentic Science: Cognitive Accumulation for Machine Learning Engineering
summary: The advancement of artificial intelligence toward agentic science is currently bottlenecked by the challenge of ultra-long-horizon autonomy, the ability to sustain strategic coherence and iterative correction over experimental cycles spanning days or weeks. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated prowess in short-horizon reasoning, they are easily overwhelmed by execution details in the high-dimensional, delayed-feedback environments of real-world research, failing to consolidate sparse feedback into coherent long-term guidance. Here, we present ML-Master 2.0, an autonomous agent that masters ultra-long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) which is a representative microcosm of scientific discovery. By reframing context management as a process of cognitive accumulation, our approach introduces Hierarchical Cognitive Caching (HCC), a multi-tiered architecture inspired by computer systems that enables the structural differentiation of experience over time. By dynamically distilling transient execution traces into stable knowledge and cross-task wisdom, HCC allows agents to decouple immediate execution from long-term experimental strategy, effectively overcoming the scaling limits of static context windows. In evaluations on OpenAI's MLE-Bench under 24-hour budgets, ML-Master 2.0 achieves a state-of-the-art medal rate of 56.44%. Our findings demonstrate that ultra-long-horizon autonomy provides a scalable blueprint for AI capable of autonomous exploration beyond human-precedent complexities.
summary_zh: 人工智能向自主科学发展的进程目前受限于超长时程自主性的挑战，即在跨越数天或数周的实验周期中维持战略连贯性和迭代修正的能力。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）已经在短时程推理方面展现出卓越的能力，但它们很容易被现实世界研究的高维、延迟反馈环境中的执行细节压倒，无法将稀疏的反馈信息整合为连贯的长期指导。本文提出了ML-Master 2.0，一种能够掌握超长时程机器学习工程（MLE）的自主智能体，而机器学习工程是科学发现的代表性缩影。通过将上下文管理重新定义为认知积累的过程，我们的方法引入了层级认知缓存（HCC），这是一种受计算机系统启发的、多层架构，能够随着时间的推移对经验进行结构化区分。通过动态地将瞬时执行轨迹提炼为稳定的知识和跨任务智慧，HCC使智能体能够将即时执行与长期实验策略解耦，从而有效地克服了静态上下文窗口的扩展限制。在OpenAI的MLE-Bench上以24小时为预算的评估中，ML-Master 2.0实现了56.44%的最先进奖牌率。我们的研究结果表明，超长时程自主性为能够自主探索超出人类先例复杂性的AI提供了一个可扩展的蓝图。
tldr: The paper introduces ML-Master 2.0, an autonomous agent using Hierarchical Cognitive Caching (HCC) to address ultra-long-horizon challenges in machine learning engineering, achieving state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's MLE-Bench.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ML-Master 2.0，一个使用分层认知缓存（HCC）来解决机器学习工程中超长时程挑战的自主代理，并在OpenAI的MLE-Bench上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Evidence-Augmented Policy Optimization with Reward Co-Evolution for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has advanced LLM reasoning, applying it to long-context scenarios is hindered by sparsity of outcome rewards. This limitation fails to penalize ungrounded "lucky guesses," leaving the critical process of needle-in-a-haystack evidence retrieval largely unsupervised. To address this, we propose EAPO (Evidence-Augmented Policy Optimization). We first establish the Evidence-Augmented Reasoning paradigm, validating via Tree-Structured Evidence Sampling that precise evidence extraction is the decisive bottleneck for long-context reasoning. Guided by this insight, EAPO introduces a specialized RL algorithm where a reward model computes a Group-Relative Evidence Reward, providing dense process supervision to explicitly improve evidence quality. To sustain accurate supervision throughout training, we further incorporate an Adaptive Reward-Policy Co-Evolution mechanism. This mechanism iteratively refines the reward model using outcome-consistent rollouts, sharpening its discriminative capability to ensure precise process guidance. Comprehensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO significantly enhances long-context reasoning performance compared to SOTA baselines.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)虽然提升了大语言模型(LLM)的推理能力，但将其应用于长文本场景时，受限于结果奖励的稀疏性。这种局限性无法惩罚无根据的“幸运猜测”，导致在海量信息中检索关键证据这一过程在很大程度上缺乏监督。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了证据增强策略优化(EAPO)。我们首先建立了证据增强推理范式，并通过树状结构的证据采样验证了精准的证据提取是长文本推理的关键瓶颈。基于这一洞见，EAPO引入了一种专门的RL算法，其中奖励模型计算组相对证据奖励，提供密集的流程监督，从而明确提升证据质量。为了在整个训练过程中维持准确的监督，我们进一步整合了一种自适应奖励-策略协同进化机制。该机制使用结果一致的展开(rollout)迭代地精炼奖励模型，增强其区分能力，以确保精准的过程指导。在八个基准数据集上进行的全面评估表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，EAPO显著提高了长文本推理性能。
tldr: This paper introduces Evidence-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO), a novel RL algorithm that addresses the challenge of sparse rewards in long-context reasoning by incorporating dense process supervision for evidence extraction, significantly improving performance on long-context tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了证据增强策略优化 (EAPO)，这是一种新的 RL 算法，通过结合密集的证据提取过程监督来解决长上下文推理中稀疏奖励的挑战，从而显著提高长上下文任务的性能。

title: HOMURA: Taming the Sand-Glass for Time-Constrained LLM Translation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable strides in multilingual translation but are hindered by a systemic cross-lingual verbosity bias, rendering them unsuitable for strict time-constrained tasks like subtitling and dubbing. Current prompt-engineering approaches struggle to resolve this conflict between semantic fidelity and rigid temporal feasibility. To bridge this gap, we first introduce Sand-Glass, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate translation under syllable-level duration constraints. Furthermore, we propose HOMURA, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes the trade-off between semantic preservation and temporal compliance. By employing a KL-regularized objective with a novel dynamic syllable-ratio reward, HOMURA effectively "tames" the output length. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms strong LLM baselines, achieving precise length control that respects linguistic density hierarchies without compromising semantic adequacy.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在多语言翻译方面取得了显著进展，但受到系统性跨语言冗余偏差的阻碍，导致它们不适用于字幕和配音等严格时间约束的任务。当前的提示工程方法难以解决语义保真度和严格时间可行性之间的冲突。为了弥合这一差距，我们首先推出了Sand-Glass，一个专门用于评估音节级时长约束下翻译的基准。此外，我们提出HOMURA，一个强化学习框架，它明确地优化语义保留和时间符合性之间的折衷。通过采用带有新的动态音节比率奖励的KL正则化目标，HOMURA有效地“驯服”了输出长度。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于强大的LLM基线，实现了精确的长度控制，在不损害语义充分性的前提下，尊重了语言密度等级。
tldr: The paper introduces HOMURA, a reinforcement learning framework, and Sand-Glass, a benchmark, to address the cross-lingual verbosity bias in LLM translation under time constraints, achieving precise length control without sacrificing semantic adequacy. It is relevant to my interest in Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个强化学习框架 HOMURA 和一个名为 Sand-Glass 的基准，用于解决大型语言模型翻译中跨语言冗长偏差问题，在时间限制下实现精确的长度控制，且不牺牲语义充分性。 这与我对强化学习和大型语言模型的研究兴趣相关。

title: DecisionLLM: Large Language Models for Long Sequence Decision Exploration
summary: Long-sequence decision-making, which is usually addressed through reinforcement learning (RL), is a critical component for optimizing strategic operations in dynamic environments, such as real-time bidding in computational advertising. The Decision Transformer (DT) introduced a powerful paradigm by framing RL as an autoregressive sequence modeling problem. Concurrently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning and planning tasks. This inspires us whether LLMs, which share the same Transformer foundation, but operate at a much larger scale, can unlock new levels of performance in long-horizon sequential decision-making problem. This work investigates the application of LLMs to offline decision making tasks. A fundamental challenge in this domain is the LLMs' inherent inability to interpret continuous values, as they lack a native understanding of numerical magnitude and order when values are represented as text strings. To address this, we propose treating trajectories as a distinct modality. By learning to align trajectory data with natural language task descriptions, our model can autoregressively predict future decisions within a cohesive framework we term DecisionLLM. We establish a set of scaling laws governing this paradigm, demonstrating that performance hinges on three factors: model scale, data volume, and data quality. In offline experimental benchmarks and bidding scenarios, DecisionLLM achieves strong performance. Specifically, DecisionLLM-3B outperforms the traditional Decision Transformer (DT) by 69.4 on Maze2D umaze-v1 and by 0.085 on AuctionNet. It extends the AIGB paradigm and points to promising directions for future exploration in online bidding.
summary_zh: 基于强化学习（RL）的长序列决策是优化动态环境中战略运营的关键组成部分，例如计算广告中的实时竞价。Decision Transformer (DT) 通过将强化学习建模为自回归序列建模问题，引入了一种强大的范式。同时，大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂的推理和规划任务中表现出了卓越的成功。这启发我们，共享相同 Transformer 基础架构，但规模更大的 LLMs 是否可以在长时程序列决策问题中解锁新的性能水平。本文研究了 LLMs 在离线决策任务中的应用。该领域的一个根本挑战是 LLMs 固有的无法解释连续值，因为当值以文本字符串表示时，它们缺乏对数值大小和顺序的固有理解。为了解决这个问题，我们建议将轨迹视为一种不同的模态。通过学习将轨迹数据与自然语言任务描述对齐，我们的模型可以在一个我们称之为 DecisionLLM 的内聚框架内自回归地预测未来的决策。我们建立了一组控制该范式的缩放定律，表明性能取决于三个因素：模型规模、数据量和数据质量。在离线实验基准测试和竞价场景中，DecisionLLM 取得了优异的性能。具体来说，DecisionLLM-3B 在 Maze2D umaze-v1 上优于传统的 Decision Transformer (DT) 69.4，在 AuctionNet 上优于 0.085。它扩展了 AIGB 范式，并为未来在线竞价的探索指明了有希望的方向。
tldr: The paper introduces DecisionLLM, a method for applying Large Language Models to long-sequence offline decision-making by aligning trajectory data with natural language tasks, achieving improved performance over Decision Transformer in certain benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DecisionLLM，一种将大型语言模型应用于长序列离线决策的方法，通过将轨迹数据与自然语言任务对齐，在某些基准测试中实现了优于Decision Transformer的性能。

title: FlowAct-R1: Towards Interactive Humanoid Video Generation
summary: Interactive humanoid video generation aims to synthesize lifelike visual agents that can engage with humans through continuous and responsive video. Despite recent advances in video synthesis, existing methods often grapple with the trade-off between high-fidelity synthesis and real-time interaction requirements. In this paper, we propose FlowAct-R1, a framework specifically designed for real-time interactive humanoid video generation. Built upon a MMDiT architecture, FlowAct-R1 enables the streaming synthesis of video with arbitrary durations while maintaining low-latency responsiveness. We introduce a chunkwise diffusion forcing strategy, complemented by a novel self-forcing variant, to alleviate error accumulation and ensure long-term temporal consistency during continuous interaction. By leveraging efficient distillation and system-level optimizations, our framework achieves a stable 25fps at 480p resolution with a time-to-first-frame (TTFF) of only around 1.5 seconds. The proposed method provides holistic and fine-grained full-body control, enabling the agent to transition naturally between diverse behavioral states in interactive scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that FlowAct-R1 achieves exceptional behavioral vividness and perceptual realism, while maintaining robust generalization across diverse character styles.
summary_zh: 交互式人形视频生成旨在合成栩栩如生的视觉智能体，这些智能体可以通过连续且响应迅速的视频与人类互动。尽管视频合成方面取得了最新进展，但现有方法通常难以兼顾高保真合成和实时交互需求。在本文中，我们提出FlowAct-R1，一个专门为实时交互式人形视频生成而设计的框架。FlowAct-R1构建于MMDiT架构之上，能够对任意时长的视频进行流式合成，同时保持低延迟的响应性。我们引入了一种分块式扩散强制策略，并辅以一种新颖的自强制变体，以缓解误差累积，并确保在连续交互过程中的长期时间一致性。通过利用高效的蒸馏和系统级优化，我们的框架在480p分辨率下实现了稳定的25fps，且首帧显示时间（TTFF）仅约1.5秒。所提出的方法提供了整体且细粒度的全身控制，使智能体能够在交互场景中于不同的行为状态之间自然过渡。实验结果表明，FlowAct-R1实现了卓越的行为生动性和感知真实感，同时在不同角色风格中保持了强大的泛化性。
tldr: FlowAct-R1 is a new framework for real-time interactive humanoid video generation, leveraging a MMDiT architecture and chunkwise diffusion forcing to achieve high-fidelity, low-latency, and controllable video synthesis at 25fps.
tldr_zh: FlowAct-R1是一个用于实时交互式类人视频生成的新框架，它利用MMDiT架构和分块扩散机制，以25fps实现高保真、低延迟和可控的视频合成。

title: V-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Reasoning with Zero Annotation
summary: Recent advances in multimodal learning have significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs). However, state-of-the-art approaches rely heavily on large-scale human-annotated datasets, which are costly and time-consuming to acquire. To overcome this limitation, we introduce V-Zero, a general post-training framework that facilitates self-improvement using exclusively unlabeled images. V-Zero establishes a co-evolutionary loop by instantiating two distinct roles: a Questioner and a Solver. The Questioner learns to synthesize high-quality, challenging questions by leveraging a dual-track reasoning reward that contrasts intuitive guesses with reasoned results. The Solver is optimized using pseudo-labels derived from majority voting over its own sampled responses. Both roles are trained iteratively via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), driving a cycle of mutual enhancement. Remarkably, without a single human annotation, V-Zero achieves consistent performance gains on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, improving visual mathematical reasoning by +1.7 and general vision-centric by +2.6, demonstrating the potential of self-improvement in multimodal systems. Code is available at https://github.com/SatonoDia/V-Zero
summary_zh: 多模态学习的最新进展显著增强了视觉-语言模型（VLM）的推理能力。然而，最先进的方法严重依赖于大规模的人工标注数据集，获取成本高昂且耗时。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了V-Zero，一个通用的后训练框架，它仅使用未标注的图像来促进自我提升。V-Zero通过实例化两种不同的角色：提问者和解答者，建立了一个协同进化循环。提问者通过利用双轨推理奖励来学习合成高质量、具有挑战性的问题，该奖励将直觉猜测与理性推理的结果进行对比。解答者则使用从其自身采样响应中通过多数票投票获得的伪标签进行优化。两种角色都通过群组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行迭代训练，从而驱动一个相互提升的周期。值得注意的是，在没有任何人工标注的情况下，V-Zero在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上取得了持续的性能提升，在视觉数学推理方面提高了+1.7，在以视觉为中心的通用视觉方面提高了+2.6，证明了多模态系统中自我提升的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/SatonoDia/V-Zero获取。
tldr: V-Zero is a post-training framework that leverages unlabeled images to improve vision-language models through a co-evolutionary loop between a Questioner and a Solver, achieving performance gains without human annotations.
tldr_zh: V-Zero是一个后训练框架，利用未标记的图像，通过提问者和解答者之间的协同进化循环来改进视觉语言模型，无需人工标注即可实现性能提升。

title: Sparse-RL: Breaking the Memory Wall in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Stable Sparse Rollouts
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become essential for eliciting complex reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the substantial memory overhead of storing Key-Value (KV) caches during long-horizon rollouts acts as a critical bottleneck, often prohibiting efficient training on limited hardware. While existing KV compression techniques offer a remedy for inference, directly applying them to RL training induces a severe policy mismatch, leading to catastrophic performance collapse. To address this, we introduce Sparse-RL empowers stable RL training under sparse rollouts. We show that instability arises from a fundamental policy mismatch among the dense old policy, the sparse sampler policy, and the learner policy. To mitigate this issue, Sparse-RL incorporates Sparsity-Aware Rejection Sampling and Importance-based Reweighting to correct the off-policy bias introduced by compression-induced information loss. Experimental results show that Sparse-RL reduces rollout overhead compared to dense baselines while preserving the performance. Furthermore, Sparse-RL inherently implements sparsity-aware training, significantly enhancing model robustness during sparse inference deployment.
summary_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 已成为激发大型语言模型 (LLMs) 中复杂推理能力的关键。然而，在长时间跨度展开过程中存储键值 (KV) 缓存所带来的巨大内存开销构成了一个关键瓶颈，常常限制了在有限硬件上的高效训练。虽然现有的 KV 压缩技术为推理提供了一种补救方案，但直接将其应用于 RL 训练会导致严重的策略不匹配，从而导致灾难性的性能崩溃。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Sparse-RL， 使得在稀疏展开下进行稳定的 RL 训练成为可能。我们表明，不稳定源于密集旧策略、稀疏采样器策略和学习器策略之间根本的策略不匹配。为了缓解这个问题，Sparse-RL 结合了稀疏感知拒绝采样和基于重要性的重加权，以纠正由压缩引起的信息丢失所带来的离策略偏差。实验结果表明，与密集型基线相比，Sparse-RL 减少了展开开销，同时保持了性能。此外，Sparse-RL 本质上实现了稀疏感知训练，显著增强了模型在稀疏推理部署期间的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper introduces Sparse-RL, a method to address the memory bottleneck in LLM reinforcement learning by enabling stable training with sparse rollouts, mitigating policy mismatch and improving robustness during sparse inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Sparse-RL，一种通过稳定稀疏rollout训练来解决LLM强化学习中内存瓶颈的方法，缓解了策略不匹配并提高了稀疏推理期间的鲁棒性。

title: Continuum Memory Architectures for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become the default strategy for providing large language model (LLM) agents with contextual knowledge. Yet RAG treats memory as a stateless lookup table: information persists indefinitely, retrieval is read-only, and temporal continuity is absent. We define the \textit{Continuum Memory Architecture} (CMA), a class of systems that maintain and update internal state across interactions through persistent storage, selective retention, associative routing, temporal chaining, and consolidation into higher-order abstractions. Rather than disclosing implementation specifics, we specify the architectural requirements CMA imposes and show consistent behavioral advantages on tasks that expose RAG's structural inability to accumulate, mutate, or disambiguate memory. The empirical probes (knowledge updates, temporal association, associative recall, contextual disambiguation) demonstrate that CMA is a necessary architectural primitive for long-horizon agents while highlighting open challenges around latency, drift, and interpretability.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为为大型语言模型（LLM）代理提供上下文知识的默认策略。然而，RAG将记忆视为一种无状态的查找表：信息无限期地持久存在，检索是只读的，并且缺乏时间连续性。我们定义了\textit{连续统记忆架构}(CMA)，这是一类系统，通过持久化存储、选择性保留、联想路由、时间链式和整合到更高阶的抽象中，在交互过程中维护和更新内部状态。我们并未披露具体的实现细节，而是指定了CMA所施加的架构要求，并展示了在暴露RAG在累积、突变或消除记忆歧义方面结构性不足的任务上，CMA具有一致的行为优势。这些实证探针（知识更新、时间关联、联想回忆、上下文消除歧义）表明，CMA是长程代理所必需的架构基元，同时也突出了围绕延迟、漂移和可解释性的开放性挑战。
tldr: The paper introduces Continuum Memory Architectures (CMA) as a necessary component for long-horizon LLM agents, addressing the limitations of RAG in handling persistent, temporal, and mutable memory. It specifies architectural requirements and demonstrates behavioral advantages in knowledge accumulation and disambiguation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了连续记忆架构（CMA），作为长时程LLM智能体的一个必要组成部分，解决了RAG在处理持久、时间性和可变记忆方面的局限性。它指定了架构要求，并在知识积累和消除歧义方面展示了行为优势。

title: MedVL-SAM2: A unified 3D medical vision-language model for multimodal reasoning and prompt-driven segmentation
summary: Recent progress in medical vision-language models (VLMs) has achieved strong performance on image-level text-centric tasks such as report generation and visual question answering (VQA). However, achieving fine-grained visual grounding and volumetric spatial reasoning in 3D medical VLMs remains challenging, particularly when aiming to unify these capabilities within a single, generalizable framework. To address this challenge, we proposed MedVL-SAM2, a unified 3D medical multimodal model that concurrently supports report generation, VQA, and multi-paradigm segmentation, including semantic, referring, and interactive segmentation. MedVL-SAM2 integrates image-level reasoning and pixel-level perception through a cohesive architecture tailored for 3D medical imaging, and incorporates a SAM2-based volumetric segmentation module to enable precise multi-granular spatial reasoning. The model is trained in a multi-stage pipeline: it is first pre-trained on a large-scale corpus of 3D CT image-text pairs to align volumetric visual features with radiology-language embeddings. It is then jointly optimized with both language-understanding and segmentation objectives using a comprehensive 3D CT segmentation dataset. This joint training enables flexible interaction via language, point, or box prompts, thereby unifying high-level visual reasoning with spatially precise localization. Our unified architecture delivers state-of-the-art performance across report generation, VQA, and multiple 3D segmentation tasks. Extensive analyses further show that the model provides reliable 3D visual grounding, controllable interactive segmentation, and robust cross-modal reasoning, demonstrating that high-level semantic reasoning and precise 3D localization can be jointly achieved within a unified 3D medical VLM.
summary_zh: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展已在图像层面、以文本为中心的任务（如报告生成和视觉问答（VQA））上取得了显著成果。然而，在3D医学VLMs中实现精细的视觉定位和体积空间推理仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在试图将这些能力统一于一个单一、可泛化的框架内时。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了MedVL-SAM2，这是一个统一的3D医学多模态模型，能够同时支持报告生成、VQA以及多范式分割，包括语义分割、指代表达分割和交互式分割。MedVL-SAM2通过一个为3D医学影像定制的统一架构整合了图像层面的推理和像素层面的感知，并结合了一个基于SAM2的体积分割模块，以实现精准的多粒度空间推理。该模型在一个多阶段的流程中进行训练：首先，在大规模的3D CT图像-文本对语料库上进行预训练，以将体积视觉特征与放射学语言嵌入对齐。然后，使用一个全面的3D CT分割数据集，通过语言理解和分割目标对其进行联合优化。这种联合训练实现了通过语言、点或框提示的灵活交互，从而将高层视觉推理与空间上精确的定位相结合。我们的统一架构在报告生成、VQA和多个3D分割任务中均实现了最先进的性能。广泛的分析进一步表明，该模型提供了可靠的3D视觉定位、可控的交互式分割和稳健的跨模态推理，证明了可以在一个统一的3D医学VLM中共同实现高层语义推理和精确的3D定位。
tldr: MedVL-SAM2 is a unified 3D medical vision-language model that integrates image-level reasoning with pixel-level perception for report generation, VQA, and multi-paradigm 3D segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: MedVL-SAM2是一个统一的3D医学视觉语言模型，它将图像级推理与像素级感知相结合，用于报告生成、VQA和多范式3D分割，并取得了最先进的结果。

title: Inference-time Physics Alignment of Video Generative Models with Latent World Models
summary: State-of-the-art video generative models produce promising visual content yet often violate basic physics principles, limiting their utility. While some attribute this deficiency to insufficient physics understanding from pre-training, we find that the shortfall in physics plausibility also stems from suboptimal inference strategies. We therefore introduce WMReward and treat improving physics plausibility of video generation as an inference-time alignment problem. In particular, we leverage the strong physics prior of a latent world model (here, VJEPA-2) as a reward to search and steer multiple candidate denoising trajectories, enabling scaling test-time compute for better generation performance. Empirically, our approach substantially improves physics plausibility across image-conditioned, multiframe-conditioned, and text-conditioned generation settings, with validation from human preference study. Notably, in the ICCV 2025 Perception Test PhysicsIQ Challenge, we achieve a final score of 62.64%, winning first place and outperforming the previous state of the art by 7.42%. Our work demonstrates the viability of using latent world models to improve physics plausibility of video generation, beyond this specific instantiation or parameterization.
summary_zh: 最先进的视频生成模型可以产生有前景的视觉内容，但往往违反基本的物理原理，限制了其效用。虽然有人将这种缺陷归因于预训练中对物理的理解不足，但我们发现物理合理性的不足也源于次优的推理策略。因此，我们引入了WMReward，并将提高视频生成物理合理性视为一个推理时对齐问题。具体来说，我们利用潜在世界模型（此处为VJEPA-2）的强大物理先验作为奖励，来搜索和引导多个候选去噪轨迹，从而能够在测试时扩展计算以获得更好的生成性能。 实验表明，我们的方法在图像条件、多帧条件和文本条件生成设置下显著提高了物理合理性，并通过人工偏好研究得到了验证。 值得注意的是，在ICCV 2025感知测试PhysicsIQ挑战赛中，我们取得了62.64%的最终得分，获得第一名，并超越了之前的最先进水平7.42%。 我们的工作证明了利用潜在世界模型来提高视频生成的物理合理性的可行性，超越了这种特定的实例化或参数化。
tldr: The paper addresses the problem of video generative models violating physics principles by introducing WMReward, an inference-time alignment method using latent world models to improve physics plausibility during video generation, achieving state-of-the-art results in the PhysicsIQ Challenge.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过引入WMReward，一种利用潜在世界模型在推理时对齐的方法，解决了视频生成模型违反物理规律的问题，从而提高视频生成过程中物理规律的合理性，并在PhysicsIQ挑战赛中取得了最先进的成果。

title: Unleashing the Capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models for Intelligent Perception of Roadside Infrastructure
summary: Automated perception of urban roadside infrastructure is crucial for smart city management, yet general-purpose models often struggle to capture the necessary fine-grained attributes and domain rules. While Large Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel at open-world recognition, they often struggle to accurately interpret complex facility states in compliance with engineering standards, leading to unreliable performance in real-world applications. To address this, we propose a domain-adapted framework that transforms VLMs into specialized agents for intelligent infrastructure analysis. Our approach integrates a data-efficient fine-tuning strategy with a knowledge-grounded reasoning mechanism. Specifically, we leverage open-vocabulary fine-tuning on Grounding DINO to robustly localize diverse assets with minimal supervision, followed by LoRA-based adaptation on Qwen-VL for deep semantic attribute reasoning. To mitigate hallucinations and enforce professional compliance, we introduce a dual-modality Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) module that dynamically retrieves authoritative industry standards and visual exemplars during inference. Evaluated on a comprehensive new dataset of urban roadside scenes, our framework achieves a detection performance of 58.9 mAP and an attribute recognition accuracy of 95.5%, demonstrating a robust solution for intelligent infrastructure monitoring.
summary_zh: 城市道路基础设施的自动感知对于智慧城市管理至关重要，然而通用模型通常难以捕捉到必需的细粒度属性及领域规则。虽然大型视觉语言模型(VLM)擅长开放世界识别，但它们往往难以准确解释符合工程标准的复杂设施状态，导致在实际应用中性能不可靠。为解决此问题，我们提出一种领域自适应框架，将VLM转换成用于智能基础设施分析的专用智能体。我们的方法整合了数据高效的微调策略和知识导向的推理机制。具体而言，我们利用 Grounding DINO 上的开放词汇微调，以最小的监督稳健地定位各种资产，随后在 Qwen-VL 上进行基于 LoRA 的适配，以实现深度语义属性推理。为了减轻幻觉并强制执行专业合规性，我们引入了一个双模态检索增强生成 (RAG) 模块，该模块在推理期间动态检索权威行业标准和视觉范例。在一个新的城市道路场景综合数据集上进行评估，我们的框架实现了 58.9 mAP 的检测性能和 95.5% 的属性识别准确率，证明了其作为智能基础设施监测的稳健解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a domain-adapted framework leveraging VLMs for intelligent roadside infrastructure analysis, incorporating fine-tuning, knowledge-grounded reasoning, and retrieval-augmented generation to achieve robust detection and attribute recognition while adhering to industry standards.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种领域自适应框架，利用视觉语言模型进行智能路边基础设施分析。该框架结合了微调、知识驱动的推理和检索增强生成技术，实现了鲁棒的检测和属性识别，同时符合行业标准。

title: SVII-3D: Advancing Roadside Infrastructure Inventory with Decimeter-level 3D Localization and Comprehension from Sparse Street Imagery
summary: The automated creation of digital twins and precise asset inventories is a critical task in smart city construction and facility lifecycle management. However, utilizing cost-effective sparse imagery remains challenging due to limited robustness, inaccurate localization, and a lack of fine-grained state understanding. To address these limitations, SVII-3D, a unified framework for holistic asset digitization, is proposed. First, LoRA fine-tuned open-set detection is fused with a spatial-attention matching network to robustly associate observations across sparse views. Second, a geometry-guided refinement mechanism is introduced to resolve structural errors, achieving precise decimeter-level 3D localization. Third, transcending static geometric mapping, a Vision-Language Model agent leveraging multi-modal prompting is incorporated to automatically diagnose fine-grained operational states. Experiments demonstrate that SVII-3D significantly improves identification accuracy and minimizes localization errors. Consequently, this framework offers a scalable, cost-effective solution for high-fidelity infrastructure digitization, effectively bridging the gap between sparse perception and automated intelligent maintenance.
summary_zh: 在智慧城市建设和设施生命周期管理中，自动创建数字孪生模型和精确的资产清单是一项关键任务。然而，由于鲁棒性有限、定位不准确以及缺乏细粒度的状态理解，利用经济高效的稀疏图像仍然面临挑战。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种用于整体资产数字化的统一框架SVII-3D。首先，将LoRA微调的开放集检测与空间注意力匹配网络融合，以稳健地关联稀疏视角下的观测结果。其次，引入了一种几何引导的细化机制来解决结构性误差，实现精确到分米级的3D定位。第三，超越静态几何映射，集成了一个利用多模态提示的视觉-语言模型智能体，以自动诊断细粒度的运行状态。实验表明，SVII-3D显著提高了识别精度并最大限度地减少了定位误差。因此，该框架为高保真基础设施数字化提供了一种可扩展、经济高效的解决方案，有效地弥合了稀疏感知和自动智能维护之间的差距。
tldr: The paper introduces SVII-3D, a framework leveraging sparse street imagery and vision-language models for automated roadside infrastructure inventory and precise 3D localization with fine-grained operational state understanding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SVII-3D，一个利用稀疏街景图像和视觉语言模型自动进行路边基础设施盘点和精确3D定位的框架，并能进行细粒度的运营状态理解。

title: ROMA: Real-time Omni-Multimodal Assistant with Interactive Streaming Understanding
summary: Recent Omni-multimodal Large Language Models show promise in unified audio, vision, and text modeling. However, streaming audio-video understanding remains challenging, as existing approaches suffer from disjointed capabilities: they typically exhibit incomplete modality support or lack autonomous proactive monitoring. To address this, we present ROMA, a real-time omni-multimodal assistant for unified reactive and proactive interaction.
