Extensive experiments demonstrate that our FilDeep consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance and can be efficiently deployed in manufacturing.
summary_zh: 弹性-塑性固体的大变形科学计算在各种制造应用中至关重要。传统的数值方法存在一些固有的局限性，这促使深度学习（DL）成为一种有前景的替代方案。目前深度学习技术的有效性通常取决于大量且高精度数据集的可用性，但在大变形问题中，这些数据集仍然难以获得。在数据集构建过程中，数据量与数据精度之间存在两难困境，导致深度学习模型的性能欠佳。为了应对这一挑战，我们专注于一个具有代表性的大变形应用，即拉伸弯曲问题，并提出了FilDeep，一种基于保真度的深度学习框架，用于弹性-塑性固体的大变形问题。我们的FilDeep旨在通过同时训练低保真度和高保真度数据来解决量与精度之间的两难困境，其中前者提供更大的数据量但精度较低，而后者提供更高的精度但数量较少。在FilDeep中，我们为实际的大变形问题提供了细致的设计。特别地，我们提出了基于注意力机制的跨保真度模块，以有效地捕捉多保真度数据中的长程物理相互作用。据我们所知，我们的FilDeep是第一个使用多保真度数据解决大变形问题的深度学习框架。大量的实验表明，我们的FilDeep始终能达到最先进的性能，并可以高效地部署在制造业中。
tldr: The paper introduces FilDeep, a deep learning framework for simulating large deformations in elastic-plastic solids using multi-fidelity data (low quantity/high accuracy and high quantity/low accuracy) to overcome limitations of traditional numerical methods and DL methods relying on large, accurate datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FilDeep，一个深度学习框架，用于使用多精度数据（低数量/高精度和高数量/低精度）模拟弹塑性固体中的大变形，克服了传统数值方法和依赖于大型精确数据集的深度学习方法的局限性。

title: Learning to Decode in Parallel: Self-Coordinating Neural Network for Real-Time Quantum Error Correction
summary:
Fast, reliable decoders are pivotal components for enabling fault-tolerant quantum computation (FTQC). Neural network decoders like AlphaQubit have demonstrated potential, achieving higher accuracy than traditional human-designed decoding algorithms. However, existing implementations of neural network decoders lack the parallelism required to decode the syndrome stream generated by a superconducting logical qubit in real time. Moreover, integrating AlphaQubit with sliding window-based parallel decoding schemes presents non-trivial challenges: AlphaQubit is trained solely to output a single bit corresponding to the global logical correction for an entire memory experiment, rather than local physical corrections that can be easily integrated. We address this issue by training a recurrent, transformer-based neural network specifically tailored for parallel window decoding. While it still outputs a single bit, we derive training labels from a consistent set of local corrections and train on various types of decoding windows simultaneously. This approach enables the network to self-coordinate across neighboring windows, facilitating high-accuracy parallel decoding of arbitrarily long memory experiments.
  As a result, we overcome the throughput bottleneck that previously precluded the use of AlphaQubit-type decoders in FTQC. Our work presents the first scalable, neural-network-based parallel decoding framework that simultaneously achieves SOTA accuracy and the stringent throughput required for real-time quantum error correction. Using an end-to-end experimental workflow, we benchmark our decoder on the Zuchongzhi 3.2 superconducting quantum processor on surface codes with distances up to 7, demonstrating its superior accuracy. Moreover, we demonstrate that, using our approach, a single TPU v6e is capable of decoding surface codes with distances up to 25 within 1us per decoding round.
summary_zh:
快速、可靠的译码器是实现容错量子计算(FTQC)的关键组件。诸如AlphaQubit之类的神经网络译码器已展现出潜力，实现了比传统人工设计的译码算法更高的精度。然而，现有的神经网络译码器实现缺乏并行性，无法实时解码超导逻辑量子比特产生的症候群流。此外，将AlphaQubit与基于滑动窗口的并行解码方案集成存在非凡的挑战：AlphaQubit仅被训练用于输出单个比特，对应于整个存储实验的全局逻辑校正，而不是可以轻松集成的局部物理校正。我们通过训练一种专门为并行窗口解码量身定制的基于循环神经网络的Transformer来解决这个问题。 尽管它仍然输出单个比特，但我们从一致的局部校正集导出训练标签，并同时训练各种类型的解码窗口。 这种方法使网络能够在相邻窗口之间进行自我协调，从而促进任意长度存储实验的高精度并行解码。
  因此，我们克服了之前阻止在FTQC中使用AlphaQubit类译码器的吞吐量瓶颈。 我们的工作提出了第一个可扩展的、基于神经网络的并行解码框架，该框架同时实现了SOTA精度和实时量子纠错所需的严格吞吐量。 使用端到端实验工作流程，我们对使用距离高达 7 的表面码在祖冲之 3.2 超导量子处理器上对我们的译码器进行基准测试，证明了它卓越的精度。 此外，我们证明了，使用我们的方法，单个 TPU v6e 能够在一微秒每轮解码的时间内解码距离高达 25 的表面码。
tldr: This paper introduces a parallelizable, transformer-based neural network decoder for real-time quantum error correction, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and throughput on superconducting quantum processors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的可并行化神经网络解码器，用于实时量子纠错，在超导量子处理器上实现了最先进的精度和吞吐量。

title: RSATalker: Realistic Socially-Aware Talking Head Generation for Multi-Turn Conversation
summary: Talking head generation is increasingly important in virtual reality (VR), especially for social scenarios involving multi-turn conversation. Existing approaches face notable limitations: mesh-based 3D methods can model dual-person dialogue but lack realistic textures, while large-model-based 2D methods produce natural appearances but incur prohibitive computational costs. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) based methods achieve efficient and realistic rendering but remain speaker-only and ignore social relationships. We introduce RSATalker, the first framework that leverages 3DGS for realistic and socially-aware talking head generation with support for multi-turn conversation. Our method first drives mesh-based 3D facial motion from speech, then binds 3D Gaussians to mesh facets to render high-fidelity 2D avatar videos. To capture interpersonal dynamics, we propose a socially-aware module that encodes social relationships, including blood and non-blood as well as equal and unequal, into high-level embeddings through a learnable query mechanism. We design a three-stage training paradigm and construct the RSATalker dataset with speech-mesh-image triplets annotated with social relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSATalker achieves state-of-the-art performance in both realism and social awareness. The code and dataset will be released.
summary_zh: 说话头生成在虚拟现实(VR)中日益重要，尤其是在涉及多轮对话的社交场景中。现有方法面临显著局限性：基于网格的3D方法可以建模双人对话，但缺乏逼真的纹理；而基于大型模型的2D方法产生自然的视觉效果，但计算成本过高。最近，基于3D高斯溅射(3DGS)的方法实现了高效逼真的渲染，但仍然仅限于单个说话者并忽略了社交关系。我们提出了RSATalker， 这是第一个利用3DGS进行逼真且具有社交意识的说话头生成的框架，它支持多轮对话。我们的方法首先从语音驱动基于网格的3D面部运动，然后将3D高斯绑定到网格面片以渲染高保真度的2D虚拟化身视频。为了捕捉人际动态，我们提出了一个具有社交意识的模块，该模块通过可学习的查询机制将包括血缘和非血缘、平等和不平等在内的社交关系编码为高级嵌入。我们设计了一个三阶段训练范式，并构建了带有社交关系标注的语音-网格-图像三元组的RSATalker数据集。大量实验表明，RSATalker在真实感和社交感知方面都实现了最先进的性能。代码和数据集将被发布。
tldr: RSATalker is a novel framework using 3D Gaussian Splatting for generating realistic and socially-aware talking heads in multi-turn conversations, incorporating social relationships into the rendering process.
tldr_zh: RSATalker是一个新颖的框架，它使用3D高斯溅射技术来生成逼真且具有社会意识的会说话的头像，用于多轮对话，并将社会关系融入到渲染过程中。

title: Enhancing the quality of gauge images captured in smoke and haze scenes through deep learning
summary: Images captured in hazy and smoky environments suffer from reduced visibility, posing a challenge when monitoring infrastructures and hindering emergency services during critical situations. The proposed work investigates the use of the deep learning models to enhance the automatic, machine-based readability of gauge in smoky environments, with accurate gauge data interpretation serving as a valuable tool for first responders. The study utilizes two deep learning architectures, FFA-Net and AECR-Net, to improve the visibility of gauge images, corrupted with light up to dense haze and smoke. Since benchmark datasets of analog gauge images are unavailable, a new synthetic dataset, containing over 14,000 images, was generated using the Unreal Engine. The models were trained with an 80\% train, 10\% validation, and 10\% test split for the haze and smoke dataset, respectively. For the synthetic haze dataset, the SSIM and PSNR metrics are about 0.98 and 43\,dB, respectively, comparing well to state-of-the art results. Additionally, more robust results are retrieved from the AECR-Net, when compared to the FFA-Net. Although the results from the synthetic smoke dataset are poorer, the trained models achieve interesting results. In general, imaging in the presence of smoke are more difficult to enhance given the inhomogeneity and high density. Secondly, FFA-Net and AECR-Net are implemented to dehaze and not to desmoke images. This work shows that use of deep learning architectures can improve the quality of analog gauge images captured in smoke and haze scenes immensely. Finally, the enhanced output images can be successfully post-processed for automatic autonomous reading of gauges
summary_zh: 在雾霾和烟雾环境中捕获的图像可见度降低，这给基础设施的监控带来了挑战，并在紧急情况下阻碍了应急服务。本文探讨了利用深度学习模型来增强烟雾环境中仪表自动化的、基于机器的可读性，准确的仪表数据解读可为第一响应者提供有价值的工具。本研究使用两种深度学习架构，FFA-Net和AECR-Net，以提高受轻度到重度雾霾和烟雾影响的仪表图像的可见度。由于没有模拟仪表图像的基准数据集，我们使用Unreal Engine生成了一个包含超过14,000张图像的新的合成数据集。对于雾霾和烟雾数据集，模型分别采用80%的训练集、10%的验证集和10%的测试集进行训练。对于合成雾霾数据集，SSIM和PSNR指标分别约为0.98和43 dB，与最先进的结果相比表现良好。此外，与FFA-Net相比，AECR-Net获得了更稳健的结果。尽管合成烟雾数据集的结果较差，但训练后的模型实现了有趣的结果。一般来说，在烟雾存在的情况下成像更难增强，因为烟雾的不均匀性和高密度。其次，FFA-Net和AECR-Net被设计用于去雾而不是去烟。这项工作表明，使用深度学习架构可以极大地提高在烟雾和雾霾场景中捕获的模拟仪表图像的质量。最后，增强后的输出图像可以成功地进行后处理，以实现仪表的自动自主读取。
tldr: This paper explores using deep learning (FFA-Net and AECR-Net) to enhance the readability of gauge images captured in hazy and smoky environments, creating a synthetic dataset since real-world data is scarce.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用深度学习 (FFA-Net 和 AECR-Net) 来提高在雾霾和烟雾环境中捕获的仪表图像的可读性，并创建了一个合成数据集，因为真实世界的数据稀缺。

title: See Less, Drive Better: Generalizable End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Foundation Models Stochastic Patch Selection
summary: Recent advances in end-to-end autonomous driving show that policies trained on patch-aligned features extracted from foundation models generalize better to Out-of-Distribution (OOD). We hypothesize that due to the self-attention mechanism, each patch feature implicitly embeds/contains information from all other patches, represented in a different way and intensity, making these descriptors highly redundant. We quantify redundancy in such (BLIP2) features via PCA and cross-patch similarity: $90$% of variance is captured by $17/64$ principal components, and strong inter-token correlations are pervasive. Training on such overlapping information leads the policy to overfit spurious correlations, hurting OOD robustness. We present Stochastic-Patch-Selection (SPS), a simple yet effective approach for learning policies that are more robust, generalizable, and efficient. For every frame, SPS randomly masks a fraction of patch descriptors, not feeding them to the policy model, while preserving the spatial layout of the remaining patches. Thus, the policy is provided with different stochastic but complete views of the (same) scene: every random subset of patches acts like a different, yet still sensible, coherent projection of the world. The policy thus bases its decisions on features that are invariant to which specific tokens survive. Extensive experiments confirm that across all OOD scenarios, our method outperforms the state of the art (SOTA), achieving a $6.2$% average improvement and up to $20.4$% in closed-loop simulations, while being $2.4\times$ faster. We conduct ablations over masking rates and patch-feature reorganization, training and evaluating 9 systems, with 8 of them surpassing prior SOTA. Finally, we show that the same learned policy transfers to a physical, real-world car without any tuning.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶的最新进展表明，在从基础模型提取的对齐块特征上训练的策略，能更好地泛化到分布外(OOD)场景。我们假设，由于自注意力机制，每个块特征隐式地嵌入/包含来自所有其他块的信息，以不同的方式和强度表示，从而使这些描述符高度冗余。我们通过PCA和跨块相似性来量化此类(BLIP2)特征中的冗余性：$90$%的方差由$17/64$个主成分捕获，并且普遍存在强大的token间相关性。基于这种重叠信息的训练会导致策略过度拟合虚假相关性，从而损害OOD鲁棒性。我们提出了随机块选择(SPS)，这是一种简单而有效的方法，用于学习更稳健、更具泛化性和更高效的策略。对于每一帧，SPS随机屏蔽一部分块描述符，不将其馈送到策略模型，同时保持剩余块的空间布局。因此，策略获得对（相同）场景的不同随机但完整的视角：每个随机的块子集都像一个不同的、但仍然合理的、连贯的世界投影。因此，该策略基于对哪些特定token存活不变的特征做出决策。大量实验证实，在所有OOD场景中，我们的方法优于现有技术(SOTA)，在闭环仿真中实现了平均$6.2$%的改进，最高可达$20.4$%，同时速度提高了$2.4\times$。我们对屏蔽率和块特征重组进行了消融实验，训练和评估了9个系统，其中8个系统超过了之前的SOTA。最后，我们表明，相同的学习策略无需任何调整即可转移到物理的真实车辆上。
tldr: The paper introduces Stochastic-Patch-Selection (SPS) to improve the robustness and generalizability of end-to-end autonomous driving policies by randomly masking redundant patch descriptors from vision foundation models, achieving state-of-the-art performance and real-world transferability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种随机块选择 (SPS) 方法，通过随机屏蔽视觉基础模型中冗余的块描述符，以提高端到端自动驾驶策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力，实现了最先进的性能和现实世界的迁移能力。

title: MatchTIR: Fine-Grained Supervision for Tool-Integrated Reasoning via Bipartite Matching
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) empowers large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex tasks by interleaving reasoning steps with external tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods typically rely on outcome- or trajectory-level rewards, assigning uniform advantages to all steps within a trajectory. This coarse-grained credit assignment fails to distinguish effective tool calls from redundant or erroneous ones, particularly in long-horizon multi-turn scenarios. To address this, we propose MatchTIR, a framework that introduces fine-grained supervision via bipartite matching-based turn-level reward assignment and dual-level advantage estimation. Specifically, we formulate credit assignment as a bipartite matching problem between predicted and ground-truth traces, utilizing two assignment strategies to derive dense turn-level rewards. Furthermore, to balance local step precision with global task success, we introduce a dual-level advantage estimation scheme that integrates turn-level and trajectory-level signals, assigning distinct advantage values to individual interaction turns. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of MatchTIR. Notably, our 4B model surpasses the majority of 8B competitors, particularly in long-horizon and multi-turn tasks. Our codes are available at https://github.com/quchangle1/MatchTIR.
summary_zh: 工具集成推理(TIR)赋能大型语言模型(LLM)，使其能够通过将推理步骤与外部工具交互交错使用来处理复杂任务。然而，现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于结果级别或轨迹级别的奖励，将统一的优势分配给轨迹中的所有步骤。这种粗粒度的信用分配无法区分有效的工具调用与冗余的或错误的工具调用，尤其是在长程多轮场景中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MatchTIR，一个框架，通过基于二分匹配的回合级别奖励分配和双层优势估计，引入细粒度的监督。具体而言，我们将信用分配表述为预测轨迹和真实轨迹之间的二分匹配问题，利用两种分配策略来导出密集的的回合级别奖励。此外，为了平衡局部步骤精度与全局任务成功，我们引入了一种双层优势估计方案，该方案集成了回合级别和轨迹级别的信号，为各个交互回合分配不同的优势值。在三个基准测试上的大量实验表明了MatchTIR的优越性。值得注意的是，我们的4B模型超越了大多数8B竞争者，尤其是在长程和多轮任务中。我们的代码可在https://github.com/quchangle1/MatchTIR获取。
tldr: MatchTIR addresses the coarse-grained credit assignment problem in tool-integrated reasoning by using bipartite matching to provide fine-grained, turn-level rewards and dual-level advantage estimation, leading to improved performance, especially in long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: MatchTIR通过使用二分匹配来提供细粒度的、turn级别的奖励和双层优势估计，解决了工具集成推理中粗粒度的信用分配问题，从而提高了性能，尤其是在长程任务中。

title: Grounding Agent Memory in Contextual Intent
summary:
Deploying large language models in long-horizon, goal-oriented interactions remains challenging because similar entities and facts recur under different latent goals and constraints, causing memory systems to retrieve context-mismatched evidence. We propose STITCH (Structured Intent Tracking in Contextual History), an agentic memory system that indexes each trajectory step with a structured retrieval cue, contextual intent, and retrieves history by matching the current step's intent. Contextual intent provides compact signals that disambiguate repeated mentions and reduce interference: (1) the current latent goal defining a thematic segment, (2) the action type, and (3) the salient entity types anchoring which attributes matter. During inference, STITCH filters and prioritizes memory snippets by intent compatibility, suppressing semantically similar but context-incompatible history.
  For evaluation, we introduce CAME-Bench, a benchmark for context-aware retrieval in realistic, dynamic, goal-oriented trajectories. Across CAME-Bench and LongMemEval, STITCH achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by 35.6%, with the largest gains as trajectory length increases. Our analysis shows that intent indexing substantially reduces retrieval noise, supporting intent-aware memory for robust long-horizon reasoning.
summary_zh:
在长时程、目标导向的交互中部署大型语言模型仍然具有挑战性，因为相似的实体和事实会在不同的潜在目标和约束下重复出现，导致记忆系统检索到上下文不匹配的证据。我们提出 STITCH（上下文历史中的结构化意图追踪），一个代理式的记忆系统，它使用结构化的检索提示、上下文意图来索引每个轨迹步骤，并通过匹配当前步骤的意图来检索历史。上下文意图提供了紧凑的信号来消除重复提及的歧义并减少干扰：（1）定义主题段的当前潜在目标，（2）动作类型，以及（3）锚定哪些属性重要的显著实体类型。在推理期间，STITCH 通过意图兼容性来过滤和优先排序记忆片段，抑制语义相似但上下文不兼容的历史。
  为了评估，我们引入了 CAME-Bench，一个用于在真实的、动态的、目标导向的轨迹中进行上下文感知检索的基准。在 CAME-Bench 和 LongMemEval 上，STITCH 取得了最先进的性能，优于最强的基线 35.6%，并且随着轨迹长度的增加，收益最大。我们的分析表明，意图索引显著降低了检索噪声，从而支持用于稳健长时程推理的意图感知记忆。
tldr: The paper introduces STITCH, an agentic memory system that indexes trajectory steps with contextual intent for long-horizon reasoning using LLMs, demonstrated on a new benchmark (CAME-Bench) showing significant performance gains over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为STITCH的智能体记忆系统，该系统使用上下文意图索引轨迹步骤，以用于LLM的长期推理。该系统在一个新的基准（CAME-Bench）上进行了演示，结果显示与现有方法相比性能有显著提升。

title: PACEvolve: Enabling Long-Horizon Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful operators for evolutionary search, yet the design of efficient search scaffolds remains ad hoc. While promising, current LLM-in-the-loop systems lack a systematic approach to managing the evolutionary process. We identify three distinct failure modes: Context Pollution, where experiment history biases future candidate generation; Mode Collapse, where agents stagnate in local minima due to poor exploration-exploitation balance; and Weak Collaboration, where rigid crossover strategies fail to leverage parallel search trajectories effectively. We introduce Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution (PACEvolve), a framework designed to robustly govern the agent's context and search dynamics, to address these challenges. PACEvolve combines hierarchical context management (HCM) with pruning to address context pollution; momentum-based backtracking (MBB) to escape local minima; and a self-adaptive sampling policy that unifies backtracking and crossover for dynamic search coordination (CE), allowing agents to balance internal refinement with cross-trajectory collaboration. We demonstrate that PACEvolve provides a systematic path to consistent, long-horizon self-improvement, achieving state-of-the-art results on LLM-SR and KernelBench, while discovering solutions surpassing the record on Modded NanoGPT.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已经成为进化搜索的强大算子，但高效搜索框架的设计仍然是临时性的。尽管当前循环内使用LLM的系统充满希望，但它们缺乏管理进化过程的系统方法。我们识别了三个明显的失效模式：上下文污染，即实验历史会偏置未来的候选生成；模式崩溃，即由于不良的探索-利用平衡，Agent在局部最小值处停滞不前；以及弱协同，即僵化的交叉策略无法有效利用并行搜索轨迹。我们引入了进度感知一致进化（PACEvolve），这是一个旨在稳健地控制Agent的上下文和搜索动态的框架，以应对这些挑战。PACEvolve结合了分层上下文管理（HCM）与剪枝来解决上下文污染；基于动量的回溯（MBB）来逃脱局部最小值；以及一种自适应抽样策略，它统一了用于动态搜索协调的回溯和交叉（CE），从而使Agent能够在内部改进与跨轨迹协同之间实现平衡。 我们证明了PACEvolve为一致的、长期的自我改进提供了一条系统化的路径，在LLM-SR和KernelBench上取得了最先进的结果，同时发现了超越Modded NanoGPT记录的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces PACEvolve, a framework for improving LLM-driven evolutionary search by addressing context pollution, mode collapse, and weak collaboration through hierarchical context management, momentum-based backtracking, and self-adaptive sampling. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PACEvolve，一个通过分层上下文管理、基于动量的回溯和自适应采样来解决上下文污染、模式崩溃和弱协作问题的LLM驱动的进化搜索框架。它在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: ShapeR: Robust Conditional 3D Shape Generation from Casual Captures
summary: Recent advances in 3D shape generation have achieved impressive results, but most existing methods rely on clean, unoccluded, and well-segmented inputs. Such conditions are rarely met in real-world scenarios. We present ShapeR, a novel approach for conditional 3D object shape generation from casually captured sequences. Given an image sequence, we leverage off-the-shelf visual-inertial SLAM, 3D detection algorithms, and vision-language models to extract, for each object, a set of sparse SLAM points, posed multi-view images, and machine-generated captions. A rectified flow transformer trained to effectively condition on these modalities then generates high-fidelity metric 3D shapes. To ensure robustness to the challenges of casually captured data, we employ a range of techniques including on-the-fly compositional augmentations, a curriculum training scheme spanning object- and scene-level datasets, and strategies to handle background clutter. Additionally, we introduce a new evaluation benchmark comprising 178 in-the-wild objects across 7 real-world scenes with geometry annotations. Experiments show that ShapeR significantly outperforms existing approaches in this challenging setting, achieving an improvement of 2.7x in Chamfer distance compared to state of the art.
summary_zh: 3D形状生成领域的最新进展已取得显著成果，但现有方法大多依赖于干净、无遮挡且分割良好的输入。这些条件在实际场景中很少能满足。我们提出一种名为ShapeR的新颖方法，用于从随意拍摄的序列中进行条件式3D物体形状生成。给定一个图像序列，我们利用现成的视觉惯性SLAM、3D检测算法和视觉语言模型来为每个物体提取一组稀疏的SLAM点、带位姿的多视角图像以及机器生成的描述。一个经过训练，能有效利用这些模态信息的校正流变换器会生成高保真度的度量3D形状。为了确保对随意拍摄数据所带来的挑战的鲁棒性，我们采用了一系列技术，包括即时组合增强、跨越物体和场景级别数据集的课程学习方案以及处理背景杂乱的策略。此外，我们引入了一个新的评估基准，包含7个真实世界场景中的178个带有几何标注的野外物体。实验表明，在这种具有挑战性的环境中，ShapeR显著优于现有方法，与当前最佳方法相比，在倒角距离上取得了2.7倍的提升。
tldr: ShapeR generates high-fidelity 3D shapes from casually captured image sequences by leveraging SLAM, 3D detection, and vision-language models, demonstrating significant improvement over existing methods in real-world settings.
tldr_zh: ShapeR利用SLAM、3D检测和视觉-语言模型，从随意拍摄的图像序列中生成高保真的3D形状。在真实世界场景中，该方法比现有方法有了显著的改进。

title: ReScene4D: Temporally Consistent Semantic Instance Segmentation of Evolving Indoor 3D Scenes
summary: Indoor environments evolve as objects move, appear, or disappear. Capturing these dynamics requires maintaining temporally consistent instance identities across intermittently captured 3D scans, even when changes are unobserved. We introduce and formalize the task of temporally sparse 4D indoor semantic instance segmentation (SIS), which jointly segments, identifies, and temporally associates object instances. This setting poses a challenge for existing 3DSIS methods, which require a discrete matching step due to their lack of temporal reasoning, and for 4D LiDAR approaches, which perform poorly due to their reliance on high-frequency temporal measurements that are uncommon in the longer-horizon evolution of indoor environments. We propose ReScene4D, a novel method that adapts 3DSIS architectures for 4DSIS without needing dense observations. It explores strategies to share information across observations, demonstrating that this shared context not only enables consistent instance tracking but also improves standard 3DSIS quality. To evaluate this task, we define a new metric, t-mAP, that extends mAP to reward temporal identity consistency. ReScene4D achieves state-of-the-art performance on the 3RScan dataset, establishing a new benchmark for understanding evolving indoor scenes.
summary_zh: 室内环境随着物体的移动、出现或消失而演变。捕捉这些动态变化需要跨越间断捕获的3D扫描，维持时间上一致的实例身份，即使在未观测到变化的情况下也是如此。我们引入并形式化了时间稀疏的4D室内语义实例分割（SIS）任务，该任务联合分割、识别和按时间关联对象实例。这种设置对现有的3DSIS方法提出了挑战，因为它们缺乏时间推理，需要离散的匹配步骤；而对于4D LiDAR方法，其性能不佳，因为它们依赖于高频的时间测量，这在室内环境的长期演变中并不常见。我们提出了ReScene4D，这是一种新方法，它调整了3DSIS架构以适应4DSIS，而无需密集的观测。它探索了跨观测共享信息的策略，表明这种共享上下文不仅能够实现一致的实例跟踪，而且还提高了标准3DSIS的质量。为了评估这项任务，我们定义了一个新的指标t-mAP，它扩展了mAP来奖励时间身份一致性。ReScene4D在3RScan数据集上取得了最先进的性能，为理解不断演变的室内场景建立了一个新的基准。
tldr: The paper introduces ReScene4D, a novel method for temporally consistent semantic instance segmentation of evolving indoor 3D scenes from sparse 4D data, outperforming existing 3DSIS and 4D LiDAR approaches and establishing a new benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 ReScene4D，一种新的方法，用于从稀疏的 4D 数据中对不断变化的室内 3D 场景进行时间一致的语义实例分割，优于现有的 3DSIS 和 4D LiDAR 方法，并建立了一个新的基准。

title: BoxMind: Closed-loop AI strategy optimization for elite boxing validated in the 2024 Olympics
summary: Competitive sports require sophisticated tactical analysis, yet combat disciplines like boxing remain underdeveloped in AI-driven analytics due to the complexity of action dynamics and the lack of structured tactical representations. To address this, we present BoxMind, a closed-loop AI expert system validated in elite boxing competition. By defining atomic punch events with precise temporal boundaries and spatial and technical attributes, we parse match footage into 18 hierarchical technical-tactical indicators. We then propose a graph-based predictive model that fuses these explicit technical-tactical profiles with learnable, time-variant latent embeddings to capture the dynamics of boxer matchups. Modeling match outcome as a differentiable function of technical-tactical indicators, we turn winning probability gradients into executable tactical adjustments. Experiments show that the outcome prediction model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 69.8% accuracy on BoxerGraph test set and 87.5% on Olympic matches. Using this predictive model as a foundation, the system generates strategic recommendations that demonstrate proficiency comparable to human experts. BoxMind is validated through a closed-loop deployment during the 2024 Paris Olympics, directly contributing to the Chinese National Team's historic achievement of three gold and two silver medals. BoxMind establishes a replicable paradigm for transforming unstructured video data into strategic intelligence, bridging the gap between computer vision and decision support in competitive sports.
summary_zh: 竞争性体育需要精妙的战术分析，然而，由于动作动态的复杂性和缺乏结构化的战术表示，诸如拳击之类的格斗项目在人工智能驱动的分析方面仍然不发达。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BoxMind，一个在精英拳击比赛中验证过的闭环人工智能专家系统。通过定义具有精确时间边界以及空间和技术属性的原子性出拳事件，我们将比赛录像解析成18个层级的技术-战术指标。然后，我们提出一种基于图的预测模型，该模型融合了这些显式的技术-战术概况与可学习的时变隐变量嵌入，以捕捉拳击手对决的动态性。将比赛结果建模为技术-战术指标的可微函数，我们将获胜概率梯度转化为可执行的战术调整。实验表明，结果预测模型取得了最先进的性能，在BoxerGraph测试集上准确率为69.8%，在奥运会比赛中准确率为87.5%。该系统以这个预测模型为基础，生成了战略建议，其熟练程度与人类专家相当。BoxMind通过 2024 年巴黎奥运会期间的闭环部署得到验证，直接促成了中国国家队取得三枚金牌和两枚银牌的历史性成就。BoxMind建立了一个可复制的范例，将非结构化视频数据转化为战略情报，弥合了计算机视觉和竞争性体育决策支持之间的差距。
tldr: BoxMind is a closed-loop AI system for boxing strategy optimization, validated in the 2024 Olympics, that converts unstructured video data into actionable tactical adjustments, demonstrating strong outcome prediction accuracy and contributing to medal wins.
tldr_zh: BoxMind是一个用于拳击策略优化的闭环AI系统，已在2024年奥运会中验证。它将非结构化的视频数据转化为可执行的战术调整，展示了强大的结果预测准确性，并为奖牌的获得做出了贡献。

title: Language-Based Swarm Perception: Decentralized Person Re-Identification via Natural Language Descriptions
summary: We introduce a method for decentralized person re-identification in robot swarms that leverages natural language as the primary representational modality. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on opaque visual embeddings -- high-dimensional feature vectors extracted from images -- the proposed method uses human-readable language to represent observations. Each robot locally detects and describes individuals using a vision-language model (VLM), producing textual descriptions of appearance instead of feature vectors. These descriptions are compared and clustered across the swarm without centralized coordination, allowing robots to collaboratively group observations of the same individual. Each cluster is distilled into a representative description by a language model, providing an interpretable, concise summary of the swarm's collective perception. This approach enables natural-language querying, enhances transparency, and supports explainable swarm behavior. Preliminary experiments demonstrate competitive performance in identity consistency and interpretability compared to embedding-based methods, despite current limitations in text similarity and computational load. Ongoing work explores refined similarity metrics, semantic navigation, and the extension of language-based perception to environmental elements. This work prioritizes decentralized perception and communication, while active navigation remains an open direction for future study.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于机器人集群中去中心化行人重识别的方法，该方法利用自然语言作为主要的表示模态。与依赖于不透明视觉嵌入（从图像中提取的高维特征向量）的传统方法不同，所提出的方法使用人类可读的语言来表示观测结果。每个机器人在本地使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）检测并描述个体，生成外观的文本描述，而不是特征向量。这些描述在集群中进行比较和聚类，无需集中式协调，从而使机器人能够协同地对同一人的观测结果进行分组。每个集群通过语言模型被提炼成一个代表性的描述，从而提供集群集体感知的可解释、简洁的摘要。此方法支持自然语言查询，增强了透明度，并支持可解释的集群行为。初步实验表明，尽管在文本相似性和计算负载方面存在当前的局限性，但与基于嵌入的方法相比，在身份一致性和可解释性方面具有竞争力的性能。目前的工作正在探索精细的相似性度量、语义导航，以及将基于语言的感知扩展到环境要素。这项工作优先考虑去中心化的感知和通信，而主动导航仍然是未来研究的一个开放方向。
tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized person re-identification method for robot swarms using natural language descriptions instead of visual embeddings, enabling interpretability and natural language querying.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于机器人集群的分散式行人重识别方法，该方法使用自然语言描述而不是视觉嵌入，从而实现了可解释性和自然语言查询。

title: ReWorld: Multi-Dimensional Reward Modeling for Embodied World Models
summary: Recently, video-based world models that learn to simulate the dynamics have gained increasing attention in robot learning. However, current approaches primarily emphasize visual generative quality while overlooking physical fidelity, dynamic consistency, and task logic, especially for contact-rich manipulation tasks, which limits their applicability to downstream tasks. To this end, we introduce ReWorld, a framework aimed to employ reinforcement learning to align the video-based embodied world models with physical realism, task completion capability, embodiment plausibility and visual quality. Specifically, we first construct a large-scale (~235K) video preference dataset and employ it to train a hierarchical reward model designed to capture multi-dimensional reward consistent with human preferences. We further propose a practical alignment algorithm that post-trains flow-based world models using this reward through a computationally efficient PPO-style algorithm. Comprehensive experiments and theoretical analysis demonstrate that ReWorld significantly improves the physical fidelity, logical coherence, embodiment and visual quality of generated rollouts, outperforming previous methods.
summary_zh: 近年来，基于视频的世界模型因其能够学习模拟动力学而在机器人学习领域受到越来越多的关注。然而，当前的方法主要强调视觉生成质量，而忽略了物理逼真度、动态一致性和任务逻辑，尤其是在涉及大量接触的操纵任务中，这限制了它们在下游任务中的应用。为此，我们引入ReWorld，一个旨在利用强化学习使基于视频的具身世界模型与物理真实性、任务完成能力、具身合理性和视觉质量相一致的框架。具体来说，我们首先构建一个大规模（~23.5万）视频偏好数据集，并利用它来训练一个分层奖励模型，该模型旨在捕获与人类偏好相一致的多维度奖励。我们进一步提出了一种实用的对齐算法，该算法通过一种计算高效的PPO风格算法，并利用该奖励对基于流的世界模型进行后训练。全面的实验和理论分析表明，ReWorld显著提高了生成轨迹的物理逼真度、逻辑连贯性、具身性和视觉质量，优于以往的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces ReWorld, a framework that uses reinforcement learning and a multi-dimensional reward model trained on a large video preference dataset to improve the physical fidelity, task completion, embodiment plausibility, and visual quality of video-based embodied world models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ReWorld，一个框架，使用强化学习和在一个大型视频偏好数据集上训练的多维奖励模型，来提高基于视频的具身世界模型的物理保真度、任务完成能力、具身合理性和视觉质量。

title: Learning Diverse Skills for Behavior Models with Mixture of Experts
summary: Imitation learning has demonstrated strong performance in robotic manipulation by learning from large-scale human demonstrations. While existing models excel at single-task learning, it is observed in practical applications that their performance degrades in the multi-task setting, where interference across tasks leads to an averaging effect. To address this issue, we propose to learn diverse skills for behavior models with Mixture of Experts, referred to as Di-BM. Di-BM associates each expert with a distinct observation distribution, enabling experts to specialize in sub-regions of the observation space. Specifically, we employ energy-based models to represent expert-specific observation distributions and jointly train them alongside the corresponding action models. Our approach is plug-and-play and can be seamlessly integrated into standard imitation learning methods. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that Di-BM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, fine-tuning the pretrained Di-BM on novel tasks exhibits superior data efficiency and the reusable of expert-learned knowledge. Code is available at https://github.com/robotnav-bot/Di-BM.
summary_zh: 模仿学习通过学习大规模人类演示，在机器人操作领域展现了强大的性能。然而，尽管现有的模型在单任务学习中表现出色，但在实际应用中观察到，它们在多任务设置下的性能会降低，这是因为任务间的干扰会导致平均化效应。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种通过混合专家模型学习行为模型中多样化技能的方法，称为 Di-BM。Di-BM 将每个专家与不同的观测分布相关联，使得专家能够专注于观测空间的子区域。具体来说，我们采用基于能量的模型来表示特定专家的观测分布，并将其与相应的动作模型联合训练。我们的方法是即插即用的，可以无缝集成到标准的模仿学习方法中。在多个真实世界的机器人操作任务上进行的大量实验表明，Di-BM 显著优于最先进的基线方法。此外，在新任务上对预训练的 Di-BM 进行微调，展现出卓越的数据效率以及专家学习知识的可重用性。代码可在 https://github.com/robotnav-bot/Di-BM 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Di-BM, a Mixture of Experts approach for imitation learning in robotic manipulation, addressing performance degradation in multi-task settings by allowing experts to specialize in observation space regions. Experiments show it outperforms baselines and exhibits better data efficiency in fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于混合专家模型的模仿学习方法Di-BM，用于机器人操作。该方法通过允许专家专注于观察空间的不同区域，解决了多任务设置中的性能下降问题。实验表明，该方法优于现有基线，并在微调中表现出更好的数据效率。

title: From Prompts to Pavement: LMMs-based Agentic Behavior-Tree Generation Framework for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) require adaptive behavior planners to navigate unpredictable, real-world environments safely. Traditional behavior trees (BTs) offer structured decision logic but are inherently static and demand labor-intensive manual tuning, limiting their applicability at SAE Level 5 autonomy. This paper presents an agentic framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and multi-modal vision models (LVMs) to generate and adapt BTs on the fly. A specialized Descriptor agent applies chain-of-symbols prompting to assess scene criticality, a Planner agent constructs high-level sub-goals via in-context learning, and a Generator agent synthesizes executable BT sub-trees in XML format. Integrated into a CARLA+Nav2 simulation, our system triggers only upon baseline BT failure, demonstrating successful navigation around unexpected obstacles (e.g., street blockage) with no human intervention. Compared to a static BT baseline, this approach is a proof-of-concept that extends to diverse driving scenarios.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆(AVs)需要自适应行为规划器，以安全地在不可预测的真实环境中导航。传统的行为树(BTs)提供结构化的决策逻辑，但本质上是静态的，并且需要劳动密集型的手动调整，从而限制了它们在SAE Level 5自动驾驶中的适用性。本文提出了一个基于代理的框架，该框架利用大型语言模型(LLMs)和多模态视觉模型(LVMs)来即时生成和调整BTs。一个专门的描述符代理应用符号链提示(CHAIN-OF-SYMBOLS PROMPTING)来评估场景的严重性，一个规划器代理通过上下文学习构建高层子目标，以及一个生成器代理以XML格式合成可执行的BT子树。集成到CARLA+Nav2模拟中，我们的系统仅在基线BT失败时触发，展示了在没有人工干预的情况下成功绕过意外障碍物（例如，街道封锁）的导航。与静态BT基线相比，这种方法是一个概念验证，可以扩展到不同的驾驶场景。
tldr: This paper proposes an LLM/LVM-based agentic framework to dynamically generate and adapt behavior trees for autonomous vehicles, demonstrated in CARLA simulation to handle unexpected obstacles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LLM/LVM的代理框架，用于动态生成和调整自动驾驶汽车的行为树，并在CARLA模拟中展示了其处理意外障碍的能力。

title: OpenNavMap: Structure-Free Topometric Mapping via Large-Scale Collaborative Localization
summary: Scalable and maintainable map representations are fundamental to enabling large-scale visual navigation and facilitating the deployment of robots in real-world environments. While collaborative localization across multi-session mapping enhances efficiency, traditional structure-based methods struggle with high maintenance costs and fail in feature-less environments or under significant viewpoint changes typical of crowd-sourced data. To address this, we propose OPENNAVMAP, a lightweight, structure-free topometric system leveraging 3D geometric foundation models for on-demand reconstruction. Our method unifies dynamic programming-based sequence matching, geometric verification, and confidence-calibrated optimization to robust, coarse-to-fine submap alignment without requiring pre-built 3D models. Evaluations on the Map-Free benchmark demonstrate superior accuracy over structure-from-motion and regression baselines, achieving an average translation error of 0.62m. Furthermore, the system maintains global consistency across 15km of multi-session data with an absolute trajectory error below 3m for map merging. Finally, we validate practical utility through 12 successful autonomous image-goal navigation tasks on simulated and physical robots. Code and datasets will be publicly available in https://rpl-cs-ucl.github.io/OpenNavMap_page.
summary_zh: 可伸缩且可维护的地图表示对于实现大规模视觉导航以及促进机器人在实际环境中的部署至关重要。虽然跨多会话建图的协同定位提高了效率，但传统的基于结构的方法在高维护成本方面存在困难，并且在无特征环境或人群来源数据中典型的显著视点变换下会失效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了OPENNAVMAP，一个轻量级的、无结构的拓扑度量系统，利用3D几何基础模型进行按需重建。我们的方法统一了基于动态规划的序列匹配、几何验证和置信度校准优化，以实现鲁棒的、由粗到精的子地图对齐，而无需预先构建的3D模型。在Map-Free基准上的评估表明，我们的方法优于基于运动恢复结构和回归的基线方法，实现了0.62米的平均平移误差。此外，该系统在15公里的多会话数据中保持了全局一致性，地图合并的绝对轨迹误差低于3米。最后，我们通过在模拟和物理机器人上进行的12次成功的自主图像目标导航任务验证了其实用价值。代码和数据集将在https://rpl-cs-ucl.github.io/OpenNavMap_page上公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces OpenNavMap, a structure-free topometric mapping system using 3D geometric foundation models and coarse-to-fine submap alignment for large-scale collaborative localization, demonstrating superior accuracy and global consistency compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OpenNavMap，一个无结构的拓扑度量地图系统，它使用3D几何基础模型和由粗到精的子图对齐来进行大规模协作定位。与现有方法相比，该系统表现出更高的精度和全局一致性。

title: An Efficient and Multi-Modal Navigation System with One-Step World Model
summary: Navigation is a fundamental capability for mobile robots. While the current trend is to use learning-based approaches to replace traditional geometry-based methods, existing end-to-end learning-based policies often struggle with 3D spatial reasoning and lack a comprehensive understanding of physical world dynamics. Integrating world models-which predict future observations conditioned on given actions-with iterative optimization planning offers a promising solution due to their capacity for imagination and flexibility. However, current navigation world models, typically built on pure transformer architectures, often rely on multi-step diffusion processes and autoregressive frame-by-frame generation. These mechanisms result in prohibitive computational latency, rendering real-time deployment impossible. To address this bottleneck, we propose a lightweight navigation world model that adopts a one-step generation paradigm and a 3D U-Net backbone equipped with efficient spatial-temporal attention. This design drastically reduces inference latency, enabling high-frequency control while achieving superior predictive performance. We also integrate this model into an optimization-based planning framework utilizing anchor-based initialization to handle multi-modal goal navigation tasks. Extensive closed-loop experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate our system's superior efficiency and robustness compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 导航是移动机器人的基本能力。 然而，当前趋势是用基于学习的方法取代传统的基于几何的方法，现有的端到端学习策略通常难以进行3D空间推理，并且缺乏对物理世界动态的全面理解。 将世界模型（根据给定的动作预测未来观测结果）与迭代优化规划相结合，由于其想象力和灵活性，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。 然而，当前通常构建于纯 Transformer 架构之上的导航世界模型，通常依赖于多步扩散过程和自回归逐帧生成。 这些机制导致了过高的计算延迟，从而无法进行实时部署。 为了解决这个瓶颈，我们提出了一种轻量级的导航世界模型，该模型采用一步生成范式和一个配备有高效时空注意力的3D U-Net骨干网络。 这种设计大大降低了推理延迟，在实现卓越预测性能的同时，实现了高频率控制。 我们还将此模型集成到一个基于优化的规划框架中，该框架利用基于锚点的初始化来处理多模态目标导航任务。 在仿真和真实世界环境中进行的大量闭环实验表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，我们的系统具有更高的效率和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper proposes a lightweight, one-step generation world model for robot navigation, using a 3D U-Net backbone and efficient spatial-temporal attention, enabling real-time performance in multi-modal navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人导航的轻量级、单步生成的世界模型，该模型采用 3D U-Net 主干网络和高效的时空注意力机制，从而在多模态导航任务中实现实时性能。

title: Learning Legged MPC with Smooth Neural Surrogates
summary: Deep learning and model predictive control (MPC) can play complementary roles in legged robotics. However, integrating learned models with online planning remains challenging. When dynamics are learned with neural networks, three key difficulties arise: (1) stiff transitions from contact events may be inherited from the data; (2) additional non-physical local nonsmoothness can occur; and (3) training datasets can induce non-Gaussian model errors due to rapid state changes. We address (1) and (2) by introducing the smooth neural surrogate, a neural network with tunable smoothness designed to provide informative predictions and derivatives for trajectory optimization through contact. To address (3), we train these models using a heavy-tailed likelihood that better matches the empirical error distributions observed in legged-robot dynamics. Together, these design choices substantially improve the reliability, scalability, and generalizability of learned legged MPC. Across zero-shot locomotion tasks of increasing difficulty, smooth neural surrogates with robust learning yield consistent reductions in cumulative cost on simple, well-conditioned behaviors (typically 10-50%), while providing substantially larger gains in regimes where standard neural dynamics often fail outright. In these regimes, smoothing enables reliable execution (from 0/5 to 5/5 success) and produces about 2-50x lower cumulative cost, reflecting orders-of-magnitude absolute improvements in robustness rather than incremental performance gains.
summary_zh: 深度学习和模型预测控制(MPC)可以在腿式机器人中发挥互补作用。然而，将学习到的模型与在线规划相结合仍然具有挑战性。 当动力学使用神经网络进行学习时，会出现三个关键难题：（1）来自接触事件的刚性转换可能会从数据中继承；（2）可能出现额外的非物理局部非光滑性；（3）由于快速状态变化，训练数据集可能导致非高斯模型误差。 我们通过引入平滑神经代理来解决（1）和（2），这是一种具有可调平滑度的神经网络，旨在为通过接触的轨迹优化提供信息丰富的预测和导数。 为了解决（3），我们使用重尾似然来训练这些模型，该似然能更好地匹配在腿式机器人动力学中观察到的经验误差分布。 总之，这些设计选择大大提高了学习到的腿式MPC的可靠性、可扩展性和泛化能力。 在难度不断增加的零样本步态任务中，具有鲁棒学习能力的平滑神经代理在简单、良态的行为中始终如一地降低累积成本（通常为10-50%），同时在标准神经动力学经常完全失效的情况下提供更大的收益。 在这些情况下，平滑处理能够实现可靠的执行（成功率从0/5到5/5），并产生大约2-50倍更低的累积成本，反映了鲁棒性方面的数量级绝对改进，而不是增量性能提升。
tldr: This paper introduces a "smooth neural surrogate" method for learning legged robot dynamics, addressing issues of non-smoothness and non-Gaussian errors in standard neural network approaches, leading to improved reliability and performance in model predictive control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于学习腿式机器人动力学的“平滑神经替代”方法，解决标准神经网络方法中非平滑性和非高斯误差的问题，从而提高了模型预测控制的可靠性和性能。

title: Neural Process-Based Reactive Controller for Autonomous Racing
summary: Attention-based neural architectures have become central to state-of-the-art methods in real-time nonlinear control. As these data-driven models continue to be integrated into increasingly safety-critical domains, ensuring statistically grounded and provably safe decision-making becomes essential. This paper introduces a novel reactive control framework for gap-based navigation using the Attentive Neural Process (AttNP) and a physics-informed extension, the PI-AttNP. Both models are evaluated in a simulated F1TENTH-style Ackermann steering racecar environment, chosen as a fast-paced proxy for safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios. The PI-AttNP augments the AttNP architecture with approximate model-based priors to inject physical inductive bias, enabling faster convergence and improved prediction accuracy suited for real-time control. To further ensure safety, we derive and implement a control barrier function (CBF)-based filtering mechanism that analytically enforces collision avoidance constraints. This CBF formulation is fully compatible with the learned AttNP controller and generalizes across a wide range of racing scenarios, providing a lightweight and certifiable safety layer. Our results demonstrate competitive closed-loop performance while ensuring real-time constraint satisfaction.
summary_zh: 基于注意力机制的神经网络架构已成为实时非线性控制领域最先进方法的核心。随着这些数据驱动模型不断集成到日益关键的安全领域，确保具有统计基础和可证明安全的决策制定变得至关重要。本文介绍了一种新颖的基于间隙导航的反应式控制框架，该框架利用注意力神经过程（AttNP）及其物理信息扩展模型PI-AttNP。这两个模型都在模拟的F1TENTH型阿克曼转向赛车环境中进行了评估，该环境被选为安全关键型自动驾驶场景的快节奏代理。PI-AttNP通过近似的基于模型的先验知识增强了AttNP架构，注入物理归纳偏置，从而实现更快的收敛速度和更佳的预测精度，适合实时控制。为了进一步确保安全，我们推导并实现了一种基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的过滤机制，该机制以分析方式强制执行避碰约束。这种CBF公式与学习到的AttNP控制器完全兼容，并可推广到各种赛车场景，从而提供了一个轻量级且可认证的安全层。我们的结果表明，在确保实时约束满足的同时，实现了具有竞争力的闭环性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a neural process-based reactive controller with a control barrier function for safety, evaluated in autonomous racing, incorporating physics-informed inductive bias for improved performance and safety.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于神经过程的反应式控制器，具有用于安全的控制障碍函数，在自动驾驶赛车中进行了评估，并结合了物理信息归纳偏置，以提高性能和安全性。

title: Listen, Look, Drive: Coupling Audio Instructions for User-aware VLA-based Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models promise an open-vocabulary interface that can translate perceptual ambiguity into semantically grounded driving decisions, yet they still treat language as a static prior fixed at inference time. As a result, the model must infer continuously shifting objectives from pixels alone, yielding delayed or overly conservative maneuvers. We argue that effective VLAs for autonomous driving need an online channel in which users can influence driving with specific intentions. To this end, we present EchoVLA, a user-aware VLA that couples camera streams with in situ audio instructions. We augment the nuScenes dataset with temporally aligned, intent-specific speech commands generated by converting ego-motion descriptions into synthetic audios. Further, we compose emotional speech-trajectory pairs into a multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) for fine-tuning a Multimodal Large Model (MLM) based on Qwen2.5-Omni. Specifically, we synthesize the audio-augmented dataset with different emotion types paired with corresponding driving behaviors, leveraging the emotional cues embedded in tone, pitch, and speech tempo to reflect varying user states, such as urgent or hesitant intentions, thus enabling our EchoVLA to interpret not only the semantic content but also the emotional context of audio commands for more nuanced and emotionally adaptive driving behavior. In open-loop benchmarks, our approach reduces the average L2 error by $59.4\%$ and the collision rate by $74.4\%$ compared to the baseline of vision-only perception. More experiments on nuScenes dataset validate that EchoVLA not only steers the trajectory through audio instructions, but also modulates driving behavior in response to the emotions detected in the user's speech.
summary_zh: 视觉语言行为（VLA）模型有望提供一种开放词汇表接口，将感知模糊性转化为语义接地的驾驶决策，但它们仍然将语言视为推理时固定的静态先验。因此，模型必须仅从像素推断不断变化的目标，导致延迟或过于保守的操作。我们认为，用于自动驾驶的有效VLA需要一个在线通道，用户可以通过该通道以特定意图影响驾驶。为此，我们提出了EchoVLA，一种用户感知的VLA，将摄像头流与原位音频指令相结合。我们通过将自我运动描述转换为合成音频，用时间对齐的、意图导向的语音指令增强了nuScenes数据集。此外，我们将情感语音-轨迹对组合成一个多模态思维链（CoT），用于微调基于Qwen2.5-Omni的多模态大型模型（MLM）。具体来说，我们合成了具有不同情感类型的音频增强数据集，这些情感类型与相应的驾驶行为配对，利用嵌入在音调、音高和语速中的情感线索来反映不同的用户状态，例如紧急或犹豫的意图，从而使我们的EchoVLA不仅能够解释语义内容，还能解释音频指令的情感背景，以实现更细致和情感自适应的驾驶行为。在开放循环基准测试中，与纯视觉感知的基线相比，我们的方法将平均L2误差降低了59.4%，碰撞率降低了74.4%。在nuScenes数据集上的更多实验验证了EchoVLA不仅可以通过音频指令引导轨迹，还可以调节驾驶行为以响应用户语音中检测到的情绪。
tldr: The paper introduces EchoVLA, a VLA model for autonomous driving that incorporates audio instructions with emotional cues alongside visual input, demonstrating significant improvements in driving performance and behavioral adaptation compared to vision-only baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为EchoVLA的VLA模型，用于自动驾驶，该模型将带有情感提示的音频指令与视觉输入相结合，与仅基于视觉的基线相比，在驾驶性能和行为适应方面表现出显著改进。

title: AgenTRIM: Tool Risk Mitigation for Agentic AI
summary: AI agents are autonomous systems that combine LLMs with external tools to solve complex tasks. While such tools extend capability, improper tool permissions introduce security risks such as indirect prompt injection and tool misuse. We characterize these failures as unbalanced tool-driven agency. Agents may retain unnecessary permissions (excessive agency) or fail to invoke required tools (insufficient agency), amplifying the attack surface and reducing performance. We introduce AgenTRIM, a framework for detecting and mitigating tool-driven agency risks without altering an agent's internal reasoning. AgenTRIM addresses these risks through complementary offline and online phases. Offline, AgenTRIM reconstructs and verifies the agent's tool interface from code and execution traces. At runtime, it enforces per-step least-privilege tool access through adaptive filtering and status-aware validation of tool calls. Evaluating on the AgentDojo benchmark, AgenTRIM substantially reduces attack success while maintaining high task performance. Additional experiments show robustness to description-based attacks and effective enforcement of explicit safety policies. Together, these results demonstrate that AgenTRIM provides a practical, capability-preserving approach to safer tool use in LLM-based agents.
summary_zh: AI智能体是结合LLM与外部工具来解决复杂任务的自主系统。虽然这些工具扩展了能力，但不恰当的工具权限会引入安全风险，例如间接提示注入和工具滥用。我们将这些故障定义为工具驱动代理的不平衡。智能体可能保留不必要的权限（过度代理）或未能调用所需的工具（代理不足），从而扩大攻击面并降低性能。我们介绍AgenTRIM，一个用于检测和缓解工具驱动代理风险的框架，且无需更改智能体的内部推理方式。AgenTRIM通过互补的离线和在线阶段来解决这些风险。离线阶段，AgenTRIM从代码和执行跟踪中重构并验证智能体的工具接口。在运行时，它通过自适应过滤和状态感知的工具调用验证，来强制执行每一步的最小权限工具访问。在AgentDojo基准测试上的评估表明，AgenTRIM在保持高任务性能的同时，大幅降低了攻击成功率。额外的实验表明，该框架对基于描述的攻击具有鲁棒性，并能有效执行显式安全策略。总而言之，这些结果表明，AgenTRIM为基于LLM的智能体中更安全的工具使用提供了一种实用且能保持能力的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces AgenTRIM, a framework for mitigating security risks associated with AI agents using external tools by enforcing least-privilege tool access and validating tool calls, showing improved security without sacrificing performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为AgenTRIM的框架，用于缓解AI智能体使用外部工具相关的安全风险。它通过强制执行最小权限的工具访问和验证工具调用来实现，展示了在不牺牲性能的情况下提高安全性的效果。

title: Zero-Permission Manipulation: Can We Trust Large Multimodal Model Powered GUI Agents?
summary:
Large multimodal model powered GUI agents are emerging as high-privilege operators on mobile platforms, entrusted with perceiving screen content and injecting inputs. However, their design operates under the implicit assumption of Visual Atomicity: that the UI state remains invariant between observation and action. We demonstrate that this assumption is fundamentally invalid in Android, creating a critical attack surface.
  We present Action Rebinding, a novel attack that allows a seemingly-benign app with zero dangerous permissions to rebind an agent's execution. By exploiting the inevitable observation-to-action gap inherent in the agent's reasoning pipeline, the attacker triggers foreground transitions to rebind the agent's planned action toward the target app. We weaponize the agent's task-recovery logic and Android's UI state preservation to orchestrate programmable, multi-step attack chains. Furthermore, we introduce an Intent Alignment Strategy (IAS) that manipulates the agent's reasoning process to rationalize UI states, enabling it to bypass verification gates (e.g., confirmation dialogs) that would otherwise be rejected.
  We evaluate Action Rebinding Attacks on six widely-used Android GUI agents across 15 tasks. Our results demonstrate a 100% success rate for atomic action rebinding and the ability to reliably orchestrate multi-step attack chains. With IAS, the success rate in bypassing verification gates increases (from 0% to up to 100%). Notably, the attacker application requires no sensitive permissions and contains no privileged API calls, achieving a 0% detection rate across malware scanners (e.g., VirusTotal). Our findings reveal a fundamental architectural flaw in current agent-OS integration and provide critical insights for the secure design of future agent systems. To access experimental logs and demonstration videos, please contact yi_qian@smail.nju.edu.cn.
summary_zh:
基于大型多模态模型的GUI代理正在移动平台上崛起，成为具有高权限的操作者，被授权感知屏幕内容并注入输入。然而，它们的设计是在视觉原子性的一个隐式假设下进行的：即UI状态在观察和行动之间保持不变。我们证明，该假设在Android中从根本上是无效的，从而创造了一个关键的攻击面。

我们提出了一种名为行动重绑定的新型攻击，该攻击允许一个表面上无害且权限为零的应用程序重新绑定代理的执行。通过利用代理推理流程中固有的、不可避免的观察到行动的间隔，攻击者触发前台转换，以将代理计划的操作重定向到目标应用程序。我们利用代理的任务恢复逻辑和Android的UI状态保持机制来编排可编程的多步攻击链。此外，我们引入了一种意图对齐策略（IAS），该策略操纵代理的推理过程，使其合理化UI状态，从而使其绕过验证关卡（例如，确认对话框），否则这些关卡将被拒绝。

我们评估了行动重绑定攻击在六个被广泛使用的Android GUI代理上的15项任务中的表现。我们的结果表明原子行动重绑定的成功率为100%，并且能够可靠地编排多步攻击链。借助IAS，绕过验证门槛的成功率得到了提高（从0%提高到高达100%）。值得注意的是，攻击者应用程序不需要任何敏感权限，也不包含任何特权API调用，在恶意软件扫描器（例如，VirusTotal）中的检测率为0%。我们的研究结果揭示了当前代理-操作系统集成中的一个基本架构缺陷，并为未来代理系统的安全设计提供了关键见解。要访问实验日志和演示视频，请联系yi_qian@smail.nju.edu.cn。
tldr: This paper demonstrates a novel attack, Action Rebinding, on Large Multimodal Model (LMM) powered GUI agents in Android, exploiting the observation-to-action gap to manipulate agent behavior and bypass security measures without requiring any permissions.
tldr_zh: 该论文展示了一种针对安卓系统中由大型多模态模型驱动的GUI代理的新型攻击方法，名为Action Rebinding。该攻击利用观察到行动之间的延迟漏洞，在无需任何权限的情况下操纵代理的行为并绕过安全措施。

title: ToolPRMBench: Evaluating and Advancing Process Reward Models for Tool-using Agents
summary: Reward-guided search methods have demonstrated strong potential in enhancing tool-using agents by effectively guiding sampling and exploration over complex action spaces. As a core design, those search methods utilize process reward models (PRMs) to provide step-level rewards, enabling more fine-grained monitoring. However, there is a lack of systematic and reliable evaluation benchmarks for PRMs in tool-using settings. In this paper, we introduce ToolPRMBench, a large-scale benchmark specifically designed to evaluate PRMs for tool-using agents. ToolPRMBench is built on top of several representative tool-using benchmarks and converts agent trajectories into step-level test cases. Each case contains the interaction history, a correct action, a plausible but incorrect alternative, and relevant tool metadata. We respectively utilize offline sampling to isolate local single-step errors and online sampling to capture realistic multi-step failures from full agent rollouts. A multi-LLM verification pipeline is proposed to reduce label noise and ensure data quality. We conduct extensive experiments across large language models, general PRMs, and tool-specialized PRMs on ToolPRMBench. The results reveal clear differences in PRM effectiveness and highlight the potential of specialized PRMs for tool-using. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/David-Li0406/ToolPRMBench.
summary_zh: 奖励引导搜索方法在增强工具使用代理方面展现出强大的潜力，它能有效引导复杂动作空间中的采样和探索。作为核心设计，这些搜索方法利用过程奖励模型 (PRM) 来提供步级奖励，从而实现更细粒度的监控。然而，目前缺乏针对工具使用环境中 PRM 的系统性和可靠性评估基准。在本文中，我们引入 ToolPRMBench，一个专门为评估工具使用代理的 PRM 而设计的大规模基准。ToolPRMBench 构建在几个代表性的工具使用基准之上，并将代理轨迹转换为步级测试用例。每个用例包含交互历史、一个正确的动作、一个看似合理但错误的替代方案，以及相关的工具元数据。我们分别使用离线采样来隔离局部单步错误，并使用在线采样来捕获来自完整代理展开的真实多步故障。我们提出了一种多大型语言模型验证流水线，以减少标签噪声并确保数据质量。我们在 ToolPRMBench 上对大型语言模型、通用 PRM 和工具专用 PRM 进行了广泛的实验。结果揭示了 PRM 效能方面的明显差异，并突出了专用 PRM 在工具使用方面的潜力。代码和数据将在 https://github.com/David-Li0406/ToolPRMBench 上发布。
tldr: The paper introduces ToolPRMBench, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating process reward models (PRMs) used in tool-using agents, and presents experimental results highlighting differences in PRM effectiveness and the potential of specialized PRMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ToolPRMBench，一个大规模的基准测试，用于评估工具使用代理中使用的过程奖励模型（PRM），并展示了实验结果，强调了PRM有效性的差异以及专用PRM的潜力。

title: Less is More: Label-Guided Summarization of Procedural and Instructional Videos
summary: Video summarization helps turn long videos into clear, concise representations that are easier to review, document, and analyze, especially in high-stakes domains like surgical training. Prior work has progressed from using basic visual features like color, motion, and structural changes to using pre-trained vision-language models that can better understand what's happening in the video (semantics) and capture temporal flow, resulting in more context-aware video summarization. We propose a three-stage framework, PRISM: Procedural Representation via Integrated Semantic and Multimodal analysis, that produces semantically grounded video summaries. PRISM combines adaptive visual sampling, label-driven keyframe anchoring, and contextual validation using a large language model (LLM). Our method ensures that selected frames reflect meaningful and procedural transitions while filtering out generic or hallucinated content, resulting in contextually coherent summaries across both domain-specific and instructional videos. We evaluate our method on instructional and activity datasets, using reference summaries for instructional videos. Despite sampling fewer than 5% of the original frames, our summaries retain 84% semantic content while improving over baselines by as much as 33%. Our approach generalizes across procedural and domain-specific video tasks, achieving strong performance with both semantic alignment and precision.
summary_zh: 视频摘要有助于将冗长的视频转化为清晰简洁的表示，从而更易于回顾、整理和分析，尤其是在诸如外科手术培训等高风险领域。以往的研究已经从使用基本的视觉特征（如颜色、运动和结构变化）发展到使用预训练的视觉-语言模型，这些模型可以更好地理解视频中发生的事情（语义）并捕捉时间流，从而实现更具上下文感知的视频摘要。我们提出一个三阶段框架，PRISM：通过集成语义和多模态分析的程序表示，该框架生成语义基础的视频摘要。PRISM结合了自适应视觉采样、标签驱动的关键帧锚定，以及使用大型语言模型（LLM）的上下文验证。我们的方法确保所选帧反映有意义的程序性过渡，同时过滤掉通用或幻觉内容，从而在领域特定和教学视频中产生上下文连贯的摘要。我们在教学和活动数据集上评估了我们的方法，对教学视频使用参考摘要。尽管采样帧数少于原始帧的5%，但我们的摘要保留了84%的语义内容，同时比基线方法提高了高达33%。我们的方法可以推广到各种程序性和领域特定的视频任务，在语义对齐和精度方面都取得了优异的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces PRISM, a three-stage framework utilizing adaptive visual sampling, label-driven keyframe anchoring, and LLMs for semantically grounded video summarization of procedural and instructional videos. It achieves high semantic content retention with low frame sampling.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PRISM，一个三阶段框架，利用自适应视觉采样、标签驱动的关键帧锚定和LLM，用于对程序性和指导性视频进行语义化的视频摘要。它在低帧采样下实现了高的语义内容保留。

title: Where It Moves, It Matters: Referring Surgical Instrument Segmentation via Motion
summary: Enabling intuitive, language-driven interaction with surgical scenes is a critical step toward intelligent operating rooms and autonomous surgical robotic assistance. However, the task of referring segmentation, localizing surgical instruments based on natural language descriptions, remains underexplored in surgical videos, with existing approaches struggling to generalize due to reliance on static visual cues and predefined instrument names. In this work, we introduce SurgRef, a novel motion-guided framework that grounds free-form language expressions in instrument motion, capturing how tools move and interact across time, rather than what they look like. This allows models to understand and segment instruments even under occlusion, ambiguity, or unfamiliar terminology. To train and evaluate SurgRef, we present Ref-IMotion, a diverse, multi-institutional video dataset with dense spatiotemporal masks and rich motion-centric expressions. SurgRef achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and generalization across surgical procedures, setting a new benchmark for robust, language-driven surgical video segmentation.
summary_zh:
摘要：
实现与手术场景进行直观的、语言驱动的交互是迈向智能手术室和自主手术机器人辅助的关键一步。然而，参照分割任务，即基于自然语言描述定位手术器械，在手术视频中仍未被充分探索，现有方法由于依赖静态视觉线索和预定义的器械名称而难以泛化。在这项工作中，我们引入了SurgRef，一种新颖的运动引导框架，其将自由形式的语言表达与器械运动相结合，捕捉工具如何随时间移动和交互，而不是它们的外观。这使得模型即使在遮挡、模糊或不熟悉的术语下也能理解和分割器械。为了训练和评估SurgRef，我们提出了Ref-IMotion，一个多样化的、多机构视频数据集，其具有密集的时空掩码和以运动为中心的丰富表达。SurgRef在各种外科手术中实现了最先进的准确性和泛化能力，为稳健的、语言驱动的外科手术视频分割设定了新的基准。
tldr: This paper introduces SurgRef, a motion-guided framework and dataset (Ref-IMotion) for referring surgical instrument segmentation in videos, enabling more robust language-driven interaction by focusing on instrument motion rather than static visual cues.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SurgRef，一个基于运动引导的框架和数据集（Ref-IMotion），用于视频中外科手术器械的指代分割，通过关注器械运动而非静态视觉线索，实现更强大的语言驱动交互。

title: DriveSafe: A Hierarchical Risk Taxonomy for Safety-Critical LLM-Based Driving Assistants
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into vehicle-based digital assistants, where unsafe, ambiguous, or legally incorrect responses can lead to serious safety, ethical, and regulatory consequences. Despite growing interest in LLM safety, existing taxonomies and evaluation frameworks remain largely general-purpose and fail to capture the domain-specific risks inherent to real-world driving scenarios. In this paper, we introduce DriveSafe, a hierarchical, four-level risk taxonomy designed to systematically characterize safety-critical failure modes of LLM-based driving assistants. The taxonomy comprises 129 fine-grained atomic risk categories spanning technical, legal, societal, and ethical dimensions, grounded in real-world driving regulations and safety principles and reviewed by domain experts. To validate the safety relevance and realism of the constructed prompts, we evaluate their refusal behavior across six widely deployed LLMs. Our analysis shows that the evaluated models often fail to appropriately refuse unsafe or non-compliant driving-related queries, underscoring the limitations of general-purpose safety alignment in driving contexts.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益集成到车载数字助手之中，而不安全、模棱两可或法律上不正确的响应可能导致严重的安全、伦理和监管后果。 尽管人们对LLM安全性的兴趣日益浓厚，但现有的分类法和评估框架在很大程度上仍然是通用目的的，并且未能捕捉到现实世界驾驶场景中固有的领域特定风险。 在本文中，我们介绍了DriveSafe，这是一个分层的、四级风险分类法，旨在系统地描述基于LLM的驾驶助手的安全关键失效模式。该分类法包含129个细粒度的原子风险类别，涵盖技术、法律、社会和伦理维度，以真实世界的驾驶法规和安全原则为基础，并经过领域专家的审查。为了验证构建提示的安全相关性和真实性，我们评估了六个广泛部署的LLM对这些提示的拒绝行为。我们的分析表明，被评估的模型常常未能适当地拒绝不安全或不符合规范的驾驶相关查询，突显了通用安全对齐在驾驶环境中的局限性。
tldr: The paper introduces DriveSafe, a hierarchical risk taxonomy for evaluating the safety of LLM-based driving assistants, highlighting the limitations of general-purpose LLMs in handling domain-specific driving scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍DriveSafe，一个用于评估基于LLM的驾驶助手安全性的分层风险分类法，强调了通用LLM在处理特定驾驶场景时的局限性。

title: RAPTOR-AI for Disaster OODA Loop: Hierarchical Multimodal RAG with Experience-Driven Agentic Decision-Making
summary: Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) operations demand rapid synthesis of multimodal information for time-critical decision-making under extreme uncertainty. Traditional information systems struggle with the fragmented, multimodal nature of disaster data and lack adaptive reasoning capabilities essential for dynamic emergency contexts. This work introduces RAPTOR-AI, an agentic multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework that advances beyond conventional static knowledge bases by implementing dynamic, experience-driven decision support for disaster response. The system addresses HADR requirements across initial rescue, recovery, and reconstruction phases through three key innovations: hierarchical multimodal knowledge construction from diverse sources (textual reports, aerial imagery, historical documentation), entropy-aware agentic control that dynamically selects optimal retrieval strategies based on situational context, and experiential knowledge integration using LoRA adaptation for both expert and non-expert responders. The framework constructs hierarchical knowledge trees from 46 tsunami-related PDFs (2,378 pages) using BLIP-based image understanding, ColVBERT embeddings, and long-context summarization within the OODA loop (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act) tactical framework. Experiments demonstrate significant improvements over existing approaches: 23\% improvement in retrieval precision, 31\% better situational grounding, and 27\% enhanced task decomposition accuracy, with efficient scaling up to 3,000 document chunks.
summary_zh: 人道主义援助与灾害救援（HADR）行动需要在极端不确定性下快速整合多模态信息，以进行时间紧迫的决策。传统信息系统难以应对灾害数据的碎片化、多模态特性，并且缺乏动态应急环境所需的自适应推理能力。本文介绍RAPTOR-AI，一种代理式多模态检索增强生成（RAG）框架，它通过为灾害响应实施动态、经验驱动的决策支持，超越了传统的静态知识库。该系统通过以下三项关键创新，满足了初始救援、恢复和重建阶段的 HADR 需求：从各种来源（文本报告、航拍图像、历史文档）构建分层多模态知识；基于情境动态选择最佳检索策略的熵感知代理控制；以及使用 LoRA 适配将经验知识集成到专家和非专家响应者中。该框架使用基于 BLIP 的图像理解、ColVBERT 嵌入和 OODA 循环（观察、判断、决策、行动）战术框架内的长文本总结，从 46 个与海啸相关的 PDF（2,378 页）构建分层知识树。实验表明，与现有方法相比，该框架在多方面实现了显著改进：检索精度提高 23％，情境理解提升 31％，任务分解准确率提高 27％，并可高效扩展到 3,000 个文档块。
tldr: RAPTOR-AI is an agentic multimodal RAG framework for disaster response that utilizes hierarchical knowledge construction and experience-driven decision-making within the OODA loop, demonstrating significant performance improvements over existing approaches.
tldr_zh: RAPTOR-AI是一个用于灾难响应的Agentic多模态RAG框架，它利用分层知识构建和经验驱动的决策制定在OODA循环中，展示了相对于现有方法的显著性能提升。

title: XR$^3$: An Extended Reality Platform for Social-Physical Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Social-physical human-robot interaction (spHRI) is difficult to study: building and programming robots that integrate multiple interaction modalities is costly and slow, while VR-based prototypes often lack physical contact, breaking users' visuo-tactile expectations. We present XR$^3$, a co-located dual-VR-headset platform for HRI research in which an attendee and a hidden operator share the same physical space while experiencing different virtual embodiments. The attendee sees an expressive virtual robot that interacts face-to-face in a shared virtual environment. In real time, the robot's upper-body motion, head and gaze behavior, and facial expressions are mapped from the operator's tracked limbs and face signals. Because the operator is co-present and calibrated in the same coordinate frame, the operator can also touch the attendee, enabling perceived robot touch synchronized with the robot's visible hands. Finger and hand motion is mapped to the robot avatar using inverse kinematics to support precise contact. Beyond motion retargeting, XR$^3$ supports social retargeting of multiple nonverbal cues that can be experimentally varied while keeping physical interaction constant. We detail the system design and calibration, and demonstrate the platform in a touch-based Wizard-of-Oz study, lowering the barrier to prototyping and evaluating embodied, contact-based robot behaviors.
summary_zh: 社会-物理人机交互（spHRI）的研究颇具难度：构建和编程整合多种交互模式的机器人既耗资又耗时，而基于VR的原型通常缺乏物理接触，打破了用户的视觉-触觉期望。我们提出了XR$^3$，一个用于HRI研究的共址双VR头显平台，其中一位与会者和一个隐藏的操作员共享同一物理空间，同时体验不同的虚拟化身。与会者看到一个富有表现力的虚拟机器人，该机器人在共享的虚拟环境中进行面对面互动。实时地，机器人的上半身动作、头部和视线行为以及面部表情都被映射自操作员被跟踪的肢体和面部信号。由于操作员共处一地且在相同的坐标系中校准，操作员也可以触摸与会者，从而实现感知的机器人触摸与机器人可见的手的同步。手指和手的运动使用逆运动学映射到机器人化身，以支持精确的接触。除了运动重定向之外，XR$^3$还支持多种非语言线索的社交重定向，这些线索可以在实验中改变，同时保持物理交互恒定。我们详细介绍了系统设计和校准，并在一个基于触摸的绿野仙踪（Wizard-of-Oz）研究中演示了该平台，从而降低了具身、基于接触的机器人行为的原型设计和评估的门槛。
tldr: The paper introduces XR$^3$, a dual-VR-headset platform for studying social-physical human-robot interaction, allowing for realistic touch-based interactions with a virtual robot controlled by a hidden operator.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为XR$^3$的双VR头显平台，用于研究社交-物理人机交互，允许与隐藏操作员控制的虚拟机器人进行真实的基于触摸的交互。

title: CD-TWINSAFE: A ROS-enabled Digital Twin for Scene Understanding and Safety Emerging V2I Technology
summary: In this paper, the CD-TWINSAFE is introduced, a V2I-based digital twin for Autonomous Vehicles. The proposed architecture is composed of two stacks running simultaneously, an on-board driving stack that includes a stereo camera for scene understanding, and a digital twin stack that runs an Unreal Engine 5 replica of the scene viewed by the camera as well as returning safety alerts to the cockpit. The on-board stack is implemented on the vehicle side including 2 main autonomous modules; localization and perception. The position and orientation of the ego vehicle are obtained using on-board sensors. Furthermore, the perception module is responsible for processing 20-fps images from stereo camera and understands the scene through two complementary pipelines. The pipeline are working on object detection and feature extraction including object velocity, yaw and the safety metrics time-to-collision and time-headway. The collected data form the driving stack are sent to the infrastructure side through the ROS-enabled architecture in the form of custom ROS2 messages and sent over UDP links that ride a 4G modem for V2I communication. The environment is monitored via the digital twin through the shared messages which update the information of the spawned ego vehicle and detected objects based on the real-time localization and perception data. Several tests with different driving scenarios to confirm the validity and real-time response of the proposed architecture.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于V2I（车对基础设施）的自动驾驶车辆数字孪生系统CD-TWINSAFE。所提出的架构由两个同时运行的堆栈组成：一个车载驾驶堆栈，包括用于场景理解的立体相机；以及一个数字孪生堆栈，该堆栈运行着一个基于Unreal Engine 5的场景副本，该副本与相机所见场景一致，并向驾驶舱返回安全警报。车载堆栈在车辆端实现，包括两个主要的自动驾驶模块：定位和感知。自车的位置和方向通过车载传感器获取。此外，感知模块负责处理来自立体相机的20帧/秒图像，并通过两个互补的管线理解场景。这两个管线分别进行目标检测和特征提取，包括目标速度、偏航角以及安全指标：碰撞时间和车头时距。驾驶堆栈采集的数据以自定义ROS2消息的形式，通过基于ROS的架构发送到基础设施端，并通过基于4G调制解调器的UDP链路进行V2I通信。通过共享消息，环境由数字孪生进行监控，这些消息根据实时定位和感知数据更新生成的自车和检测到的物体的信息。我们进行了多项不同驾驶场景的测试，以验证所提出架构的有效性和实时响应能力。
tldr: The paper introduces CD-TWINSAFE, a ROS-enabled digital twin architecture for autonomous vehicles that utilizes V2I communication to enhance scene understanding and safety by simulating the environment in Unreal Engine 5 and providing safety alerts.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CD-TWINSAFE，一个基于ROS的自动驾驶汽车数字孪生架构，它利用V2I通信通过Unreal Engine 5模拟环境并提供安全警报，从而增强场景理解和安全性。

title: Survival is the Only Reward: Sustainable Self-Training Through Environment-Mediated Selection
summary:
Self-training systems often degenerate due to the lack of an external criterion for judging data quality, leading to reward hacking and semantic drift. This paper provides a proof-of-concept system architecture for stable self-training under sparse external feedback and bounded memory, and empirically characterises its learning dynamics and failure modes.
  We introduce a self-training architecture in which learning is mediated exclusively by environmental viability, rather than by reward, objective functions, or externally defined fitness criteria. Candidate behaviours are executed under real resource constraints, and only those whose environmental effects both persist and preserve the possibility of future interaction are propagated. The environment does not provide semantic feedback, dense rewards, or task-specific supervision; selection operates solely through differential survival of behaviours as world-altering events, making proxy optimisation impossible and rendering reward-hacking evolutionarily unstable.
  Analysis of semantic dynamics shows that improvement arises primarily through the persistence of effective and repeatable strategies under a regime of consolidation and pruning, a paradigm we refer to as negative-space learning (NSL), and that models develop meta-learning strategies (such as deliberate experimental failure in order to elicit informative error messages) without explicit instruction. This work establishes that environment-grounded selection enables sustainable open-ended self-improvement, offering a viable path toward more robust and generalisable autonomous systems without reliance on human-curated data or complex reward shaping.
summary_zh:
自训练系统常常因缺乏外部标准来判断数据质量而退化，导致奖励利用和语义漂移。本文提供了一个在稀疏外部反馈和有限内存条件下实现稳定自训练的概念验证系统架构，并从经验上描述了其学习动态和失效模式。

我们引入了一种自训练架构，其中学习完全通过环境可行性来调节，而不是通过奖励、目标函数或外部定义的适应度标准。候选行为在真实的资源约束下执行，只有那些其环境效应既持久存在又保留了未来交互可能性的行为才会被传播。环境不提供语义反馈、密集奖励或特定任务监督；选择仅通过行为作为改变世界的事件的差异化生存来实现，从而使得代理优化成为不可能，并使得奖励利用在进化上不稳定。

对语义动态的分析表明，改进主要来源于有效且可重复的策略在巩固和修剪机制下的持久存在，我们称之为负空间学习（NSL），并且模型在没有明确指令的情况下发展出了元学习策略（例如，为了引出带有信息的错误消息而进行有意的实验性失败）。这项工作确定了环境驱动的选择可以实现可持续的开放式自我改进，为构建更具鲁棒性和泛化能力的自主系统提供了一条可行的途径，而无需依赖人工策划的数据或复杂的奖励塑造。
tldr: This paper presents a self-training architecture where learning is based on environmental viability, showing sustainable self-improvement through a 'negative-space learning' paradigm without relying on human labeling or reward shaping.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一个基于环境可行性的自训练架构，展示了通过"负空间学习"范式实现可持续的自我提升，无需依赖人工标注或奖励塑造。

title: NeuralFur: Animal Fur Reconstruction From Multi-View Images
summary: Reconstructing realistic animal fur geometry from images is a challenging task due to the fine-scale details, self-occlusion, and view-dependent appearance of fur. In contrast to human hairstyle reconstruction, there are also no datasets that can be leveraged to learn a fur prior for different animals. In this work, we present a first multi-view-based method for high-fidelity 3D fur modeling of animals using a strand-based representation, leveraging the general knowledge of a vision language model. Given multi-view RGB images, we first reconstruct a coarse surface geometry using traditional multi-view stereo techniques. We then use a vision language model (VLM) system to retrieve information about the realistic length structure of the fur for each part of the body. We use this knowledge to construct the animal's furless geometry and grow strands atop it. The fur reconstruction is supervised with both geometric and photometric losses computed from multi-view images. To mitigate orientation ambiguities stemming from the Gabor filters that are applied to the input images, we additionally utilize the VLM to guide the strands' growth direction and their relation to the gravity vector that we incorporate as a loss. With this new schema of using a VLM to guide 3D reconstruction from multi-view inputs, we show generalization across a variety of animals with different fur types. For additional results and code, please refer to https://neuralfur.is.tue.mpg.de.
summary_zh: 由于动物毛发的精细尺度细节、自遮挡以及与视角相关的外观，从图像重建出逼真的动物毛发几何结构是一项极具挑战性的任务。与人类发型重建不同，目前还没有可用于学习不同动物毛发先验知识的数据集。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种首创的基于多视角的动物高保真3D毛发建模方法，使用基于毛发的表示，并利用了视觉语言模型的通用知识。给定多视角的RGB图像，我们首先使用传统的多视点立体视觉技术重建出一个粗糙的表面几何结构。然后，我们使用视觉语言模型（VLM）系统来检索关于身体每个部位毛发真实长度结构的信息。我们利用这些知识来构建动物的无毛几何结构，并在其上生长毛发。毛发重建通过从多视角图像计算得到的几何和光度损失进行监督。为了减轻应用于输入图像的Gabor滤波器所带来的方向模糊性，我们额外地利用VLM来指导毛发的生长方向以及它们与我们作为损失项引入的重力矢量的关系。凭借这种使用VLM来指导从多视角输入进行3D重建的新方案，我们展示了对各种具有不同毛发类型的动物的泛化能力。更多结果和代码请访问https://neuralfur.is.tue.mpg.de。
tldr: The paper presents a multi-view based approach called NeuralFur for reconstructing realistic 3D animal fur using a strand-based representation and guidance from a Vision Language Model (VLM). It addresses the lack of fur priors and leverages VLMs to guide fur reconstruction with geometric and photometric losses.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为NeuralFur的基于多视图的方法，利用基于链的表示和视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的指导，来重建逼真的3D动物毛发。它解决了缺少毛发先验的问题，并利用VLM通过几何和光度损失来指导毛发重建。

title: Cross-reality Location Privacy Protection in 6G-enabled Vehicular Metaverses: An LLM-enhanced Hybrid Generative Diffusion Model-based Approach
summary: The emergence of 6G-enabled vehicular metaverses enables Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) to operate across physical and virtual spaces through space-air-ground-sea integrated networks. The AVs can deploy AI agents powered by large AI models as personalized assistants, on edge servers to support intelligent driving decision making and enhanced on-board experiences. However, such cross-reality interactions may cause serious location privacy risks, as adversaries can infer AV trajectories by correlating the location reported when AVs request LBS in reality with the location of the edge servers on which their corresponding AI agents are deployed in virtuality. To address this challenge, we design a cross-reality location privacy protection framework based on hybrid actions, including continuous location perturbation in reality and discrete privacy-aware AI agent migration in virtuality. In this framework, a new privacy metric, termed cross-reality location entropy, is proposed to effectively quantify the privacy levels of AVs. Based on this metric, we formulate an optimization problem to optimize the hybrid action, focusing on achieving a balance between location protection, service latency reduction, and quality of service maintenance. To solve the complex mixed-integer problem, we develop a novel LLM-enhanced Hybrid Diffusion Proximal Policy Optimization (LHDPPO) algorithm, which integrates LLM-driven informative reward design to enhance environment understanding with double Generative Diffusion Models-based policy exploration to handle high-dimensional action spaces, thereby enabling reliable determination of optimal hybrid actions. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively mitigates cross-reality location privacy leakage for AVs while maintaining strong user immersion within 6G-enabled vehicular metaverse scenarios.
summary_zh: 基于6G的车载元宇宙的出现使得自动驾驶车辆(AVs)能够通过空天地海一体化网络在物理和虚拟空间中运行。自动驾驶车辆可以在边缘服务器上部署由大型人工智能模型驱动的AI代理作为个性化助手，以支持智能驾驶决策并增强车载体验。然而，这种跨现实交互可能会导致严重的定位隐私风险，因为攻击者可以通过关联自动驾驶车辆在现实中请求LBS时报告的位置与虚拟环境中部署的相应AI代理所在的边缘服务器的位置来推断自动驾驶车辆的轨迹。为了应对这一挑战，我们设计了一种基于混合动作的跨现实定位隐私保护框架，包括现实中的连续位置扰动和虚拟环境中的离散隐私感知型AI代理迁移。在该框架中，我们提出了一种新的隐私度量，称为跨现实定位熵，以有效量化自动驾驶车辆的隐私级别。基于该度量，我们构建了一个优化问题来优化混合动作，重点是在定位保护、服务延迟降低和服务质量维护之间取得平衡。为了解决复杂的混合整数问题，我们开发了一种新型的LLM增强型混合扩散近端策略优化（LHDPPO）算法，该算法集成了LLM驱动的信息性奖励设计，以增强环境理解，并结合基于双生成扩散模型的策略探索来处理高维动作空间，从而可靠地确定最佳混合动作。在真实世界数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提出的框架有效地缓解了自动驾驶车辆的跨现实定位隐私泄露，同时保持了用户在基于6G的车载元宇宙场景中的强大沉浸感。
tldr: This paper proposes an LLM-enhanced hybrid generative diffusion model to protect location privacy in 6G-enabled vehicular metaverses by optimizing continuous location perturbation and discrete AI agent migration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LLM增强的混合生成扩散模型，通过优化连续位置扰动和离散AI代理迁移，在6G车辆元宇宙中保护位置隐私。

title: KILO-EKF: Koopman-Inspired Learned Observations Extended Kalman Filter
summary: We present the Koopman-Inspired Learned Observations Extended Kalman Filter (KILO-EKF), which combines a standard EKF prediction step with a correction step based on a Koopman-inspired measurement model learned from data. By lifting measurements into a feature space where they are linear in the state, KILO-EKF enables flexible modeling of complex or poorly calibrated sensors while retaining the structure and efficiency of recursive filtering. The resulting linear-Gaussian measurement model is learned in closed form from groundtruth training data, without iterative optimization or reliance on an explicit parametric sensor model. At inference, KILO-EKF performs a standard EKF update using Jacobians obtained via the learned lifting. We validate the approach on a real-world quadrotor localization task using an IMU, ultra-wideband (UWB) sensors, and a downward-facing laser. We compare against multiple EKF baselines with varying levels of sensor calibration. KILO-EKF achieves better accuracy and consistency compared to data-calibrated baselines, and significantly outperforms EKFs that rely on imperfect geometric models, while maintaining real-time inference and fast training. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Koopman-inspired measurement learning as a scalable alternative to traditional model-based calibration.
summary_zh: 我们提出了基于柯尔莫哥洛夫观测量学习的扩展卡尔曼滤波器(KILO-EKF)，它将标准的EKF预测步骤与基于从数据中学习的柯尔莫哥洛夫启发的测量模型校正步骤相结合。通过将测量值提升到特征空间，在那里它们在状态中是线性的， KILO-EKF能够灵活地对复杂或校准不良的传感器进行建模，同时保留递归滤波的结构和效率。由此产生的线性高斯测量模型可以从真实的训练数据中以闭合形式学习，无需迭代优化或依赖显式的参数化传感器模型。在推断时，KILO-EKF使用通过学习到的提升获得的雅可比矩阵执行标准的EKF更新。我们使用IMU、超宽带(UWB)传感器和朝下的激光在真实世界的四旋翼定位任务中验证了该方法。我们与具有不同传感器校准级别的多个EKF基线进行比较。与数据校准的基线相比，KILO-EKF实现了更好的准确性和一致性，并且显著优于依赖于不完善的几何模型的EKF，同时保持了实时推断和快速训练。这些结果表明，柯尔莫哥洛夫启发的测量学习作为传统基于模型的校准的可扩展替代方案的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces KILO-EKF, a novel EKF variant that uses a Koopman-inspired learned measurement model for improved sensor calibration, achieving better accuracy and consistency in a quadrotor localization task compared to traditional EKFs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了KILO-EKF，一种新颖的EKF变体，它使用受Koopman理论启发的学习测量模型来改进传感器校准，与传统的EKF相比，在四旋翼定位任务中实现了更高的精度和一致性。

title: TIDE: A Trace-Informed Depth-First Exploration for Planning with Temporally Extended Goals
summary: Task planning with temporally extended goals (TEGs) is a critical challenge in AI and robotics, enabling agents to achieve complex sequences of objectives over time rather than addressing isolated, immediate tasks. Linear Temporal Logic on finite traces (LTLf ) provides a robust formalism for encoding these temporal goals. Traditional LTLf task planning approaches often transform the temporal planning problem into a classical planning problem with reachability goals, which are then solved using off-the-shelf planners. However, these methods often lack informed heuristics to provide a guided search for temporal goals. We introduce TIDE (Trace-Informed Depth-first Exploration), a novel approach that addresses this limitation by decomposing a temporal problem into a sequence of smaller, manageable reach-avoid sub-problems, each solvable using an off-the-shelf planner. TIDE identifies and prioritizes promising automaton traces within the domain graph, using cost-driven heuristics to guide exploration. Its adaptive backtracking mechanism systematically recovers from failed plans by recalculating costs and penalizing infeasible transitions, ensuring completeness and efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that TIDE achieves promising performance and is a valuable addition to the portfolio of planning methods for temporally extended goals.
summary_zh: 具有时间扩展目标（TEG）的任务规划是人工智能和机器人领域的一项关键挑战，它使智能体能够随时间实现复杂的目标序列，而不是处理孤立的、即时的任务。有限轨迹线性时序逻辑（LTLf）为编码这些时间目标提供了一个鲁棒的形式体系。传统的LTLf任务规划方法通常将时间规划问题转换为具有可达性目标的经典规划问题，然后使用现成的规划器进行求解。然而，这些方法往往缺乏知情的启发式方法来为时间目标的引导搜索提供支持。我们引入了TIDE（轨迹知情深度优先探索），这是一种通过将时间问题分解为一系列更小、易于管理的可达性-规避子问题来解决该局限性的新方法，每个子问题都可以使用现成的规划器解决。TIDE在领域图中识别并优先处理有希望的状态机轨迹，使用成本驱动的启发式方法来指导探索。其自适应回溯机制通过重新计算成本并惩罚不可行的转换来系统地从失败的计划中恢复，从而确保完整性和效率。实验结果表明，TIDE取得了令人鼓舞的性能，并且是用于时间扩展目标规划方法组合中的一个有价值的补充。
tldr: The paper introduces TIDE, a new planning approach that decomposes temporally extended goal problems into smaller reach-avoid sub-problems solvable by off-the-shelf planners, using trace-informed heuristics to guide the search.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的规划方法TIDE，它将时间扩展目标问题分解为更小的可达-避免子问题，这些子问题可以使用现成的规划器解决，并使用轨迹信息启发式方法指导搜索。

title: Video Individual Counting and Tracking from Moving Drones: A Benchmark and Methods
