Existing solutions including safety-critical scenario generation and closed-loop learning often rely on rule-based heuristics, resampling methods and generative models learned from offline datasets, limiting their ability to produce diverse and novel challenges. While recent works leverage Vision Language Models (VLMs) to produce scene descriptions that guide a separate, downstream model in generating hazardous trajectories for agents, such two-stage framework constrains the generative potential of VLMs, as the diversity of the final trajectories is ultimately limited by the generalization ceiling of the downstream algorithm. To overcome these limitations, we introduce VILTA (VLM-In-the-Loop Trajectory Adversary), a novel framework that integrates a VLM into the closed-loop training of AD agents. Unlike prior works, VILTA actively participates in the training loop by comprehending the dynamic driving environment and strategically generating challenging scenarios through direct, fine-grained editing of surrounding agents' future trajectories. This direct-editing approach fully leverages the VLM's powerful generalization capabilities to create a diverse curriculum of plausible yet challenging scenarios that extend beyond the scope of traditional methods. We demonstrate that our approach substantially enhances the safety and robustness of the resulting AD policy, particularly in its ability to navigate critical long-tail events.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶（AD）系统的安全部署根本上受到长尾问题的阻碍，即现实世界数据中罕见但至关重要的驾驶场景严重不足。包括安全关键场景生成和闭环学习在内的现有解决方案通常依赖于基于规则的启发式方法、重采样方法以及从离线数据集学习的生成模型，限制了它们产生多样化和新颖挑战的能力。虽然最近的研究利用视觉语言模型（VLMs）生成场景描述，以此指导一个独立的下游模型生成智能体的危险轨迹，但这种两阶段框架约束了VLMs的生成潜力，因为最终轨迹的多样性最终受到下游算法泛化上限的限制。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种名为VILTA（环路中的VLM轨迹对抗者）的新型框架，该框架将VLM集成到AD智能体的闭环训练中。与先前的工作不同，VILTA通过理解动态驾驶环境并通过直接、细粒度地编辑周围智能体未来的轨迹来战略性地生成具有挑战性的场景，从而积极参与到训练循环中。这种直接编辑方法充分利用了VLM强大的泛化能力，从而创建了一系列合理但具有挑战性的多样化课程，这些课程超出了传统方法的范围。我们证明了我们的方法大大提高了生成的AD策略的安全性和鲁棒性，尤其是在应对关键的长尾事件的能力方面。
tldr: The paper introduces VILTA, a framework that integrates a Vision-Language Model (VLM) into the closed-loop training of autonomous driving (AD) agents to generate challenging and diverse scenarios, leading to enhanced robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 VILTA 的框架，该框架将视觉语言模型 (VLM) 集成到自动驾驶 (AD) 智能体的闭环训练中，以生成具有挑战性和多样性的场景，从而提高鲁棒性。

title: MetaToolAgent: Towards Generalizable Tool Usage in LLMs through Meta-Learning
summary: Tool learning is increasingly important for large language models (LLMs) to effectively coordinate and utilize a diverse set of tools in order to solve complex real-world tasks. By selecting and integrating appropriate tools, LLMs extend their capabilities beyond pure language understanding to perform specialized functions. However, existing methods for tool selection often focus on limited tool sets and struggle to generalize to novel tools encountered in practical deployments. To address these challenges, we introduce a comprehensive dataset spanning 7 domains, containing 155 tools and 9,377 question-answer pairs, which simulates realistic integration scenarios. Additionally, we propose MetaToolAgent (MTA), a meta-learning approach designed to improve cross-tool generalization. Experimental results show that MTA significantly outperforms baseline methods on unseen tools, demonstrating its promise for building flexible and scalable systems that require dynamic tool coordination.
summary_zh: 工具学习对于大型语言模型（LLM）有效协调和利用各种工具来解决复杂的现实世界任务变得越来越重要。通过选择和整合适当的工具，LLM将其能力扩展到纯粹的语言理解之外，从而执行专门的功能。然而，现有的工具选择方法通常侧重于有限的工具集，并且难以推广到实际部署中遇到的新型工具。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一个涵盖7个领域、包含155个工具和9377个问答对的综合数据集，该数据集模拟了真实的集成场景。此外，我们提出MetaToolAgent（MTA），一种旨在提高跨工具泛化能力的元学习方法。实验结果表明，MTA在未见过的工具上显著优于基线方法，证明了其在构建需要动态工具协调的灵活、可扩展系统方面的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces MetaToolAgent (MTA), a meta-learning approach for LLMs to improve generalization across a diverse set of tools, along with a new dataset for realistic tool integration scenarios, demonstrating superior performance on unseen tools.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MetaToolAgent (MTA)，一种用于LLM的元学习方法，旨在提高其在各种工具上的泛化能力。同时，论文构建了一个新的数据集，用于模拟真实的工具集成场景，并展示了MTA在未见过的工具上的卓越性能。

title: Autonomous Navigation at the Nano-Scale: Algorithms, Architectures, and Constraints
summary: Autonomous navigation for nano-scale unmanned aerial vehicles (nano-UAVs) is governed by extreme Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints (with the weight < 50 g and sub-100 mW onboard processor), distinguishing it fundamentally from standard robotic paradigms. This review synthesizes the state-of-the-art in sensing, computing, and control architectures designed specifically for these sub- 100mW computational envelopes. We critically analyse the transition from classical geometry-based methods to emerging "Edge AI" paradigms, including quantized deep neural networks deployed on ultra-low-power System-on-Chips (SoCs) and neuromorphic event-based control. Beyond algorithms, we evaluate the hardware-software co-design requisite for autonomy, covering advancements in dense optical flow, optimized Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), and learning-based flight control. While significant progress has been observed in visual navigation and relative pose estimation, our analysis reveals persistent gaps in long-term endurance, robust obstacle avoidance in dynamic environments, and the "Sim-to-Real" transfer of reinforcement learning policies. This survey provides a roadmap for bridging these gaps, advocating for hybrid architectures that fuse lightweight classical control with data-driven perception to enable fully autonomous, agile nano-UAVs in GPS-denied environments.
summary_zh: 纳米无人机(nano-UAVs)的自主导航受到极端的尺寸、重量和功耗(SWaP)约束(重量<50克，板载处理器功耗低于100毫瓦)的限制，这使其与标准机器人范式有着根本的区别。 本综述总结了专为这些低于100毫瓦计算包络设计的传感、计算和控制架构的最新进展。 我们 критически 分析了 从 经典的 基于 几何 的 方法 向 新兴 的 “边缘 AI” 范式 的 过渡, 包括 部署 在 超 低 功耗 片上 系统 (SoCs) 和 基于 神经 形态 事件 的 控制 上 的 量化 深度 神经 网络。 除了 算法 之外, 我们 还 评估 了 自主 性 所 需 的 软硬件 协同 设计 方案, 涵盖 了 密集 光 流、优化 的 同时 定位 和 映射 (SLAM) 以及 基于 学习 的 飞行 控制 方面 的 进展。 虽然 在 视觉 导航 和 相对 姿态 估计 方面 已经 观察 到 显着 的 进展, 但 我们 的 分析 显示, 在 长期 续航 能力、动态 环境 中 的 鲁棒 避障 以及 强化 学习 策略 的 "仿真到现实" 迁移 方面 仍然 存在 差距。 本 调研 为 弥合 这些 差距 提供 了 路线图, 提倡 将 轻量级 经典 控制 与 数据 驱动 的 感知 相 融合 的 混合 架构, 以 实现 在 无 GPS 环境 中 完全 自主、灵活 的 纳米 UAV。
tldr: This paper reviews the state-of-the-art in algorithms and architectures for autonomous nano-UAV navigation under extreme SWaP constraints, highlighting gaps in endurance, obstacle avoidance, and Sim-to-Real transfer, and advocating for hybrid control architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了在极端尺寸、重量和功耗约束下自主纳米无人机导航的算法和架构，强调了在续航、避障和从仿真到实际的转移方面的差距，并提倡混合控制架构。

title: Diffusion-based Inverse Model of a Distributed Tactile Sensor for Object Pose Estimation
summary: Tactile sensing provides a promising sensing modality for object pose estimation in manipulation settings where visual information is limited due to occlusion or environmental effects. However, efficiently leveraging tactile data for estimation remains a challenge due to partial observability, with single observations corresponding to multiple possible contact configurations. This limits conventional estimation approaches largely tailored to vision. We propose to address these challenges by learning an inverse tactile sensor model using denoising diffusion. The model is conditioned on tactile observations from a distributed tactile sensor and trained in simulation using a geometric sensor model based on signed distance fields. Contact constraints are enforced during inference through single-step projection using distance and gradient information from the signed distance field. For online pose estimation, we integrate the inverse model with a particle filter through a proposal scheme that combines generated hypotheses with particles from the prior belief. Our approach is validated in simulated and real-world planar pose estimation settings, without access to visual data or tight initial pose priors. We further evaluate robustness to unmodeled contact and sensor dynamics for pose tracking in a box-pushing scenario. Compared to local sampling baselines, the inverse sensor model improves sampling efficiency and estimation accuracy while preserving multimodal beliefs across objects with varying tactile discriminability.
summary_zh: 触觉感知为物体重建提供了一种有前景的传感方式，特别是在操作环境中，由于遮挡或环境影响，视觉信息受到限制的情况下。然而，由于局部可观测性导致仅凭单一观测对应多种可能的接触配置，因此有效利用触觉数据进行估计仍然是一个挑战。这限制了主要为视觉定制的传统估计方法。我们建议通过学习使用去噪扩散模型的逆触觉传感器模型来解决这些挑战。该模型以来自分布式触觉传感器的触觉观测为条件，并使用基于符号距离场的几何传感器模型在仿真中进行训练。在推理过程中，通过使用来自符号距离场的距离和梯度信息的单步投影来强制执行接触约束。对于在线姿态估计，我们将逆模型与粒子滤波器集成，通过一种提案方案，将生成的假设与来自先验置信度的粒子相结合。我们的方法在模拟和真实世界的平面姿态估计环境中进行了验证，无需访问视觉数据或严格的初始姿态先验。我们进一步评估了在箱子推动场景中，姿态跟踪对未建模的接触和传感器动态的鲁棒性。与局部采样基线相比，该逆传感器模型提高了采样效率和估计精度，同时保留了具有不同触觉可辨别性物体的多模态置信度。
tldr: The paper proposes a diffusion-based inverse model for distributed tactile sensors to estimate object pose in situations with limited vision, integrated with a particle filter for online estimation, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于扩散的逆模型，用于分布式触觉传感器，以估计视觉受限情况下的物体姿态。该模型与粒子滤波器集成用于在线估计，并在模拟和实际实验中进行了验证。

title: Static Is Not Enough: A Comparative Study of VR and SpaceMouse in Static and Dynamic Teleoperation Tasks
summary: Imitation learning relies on high-quality demonstrations, and teleoperation is a primary way to collect them, making teleoperation interface choice crucial for the data. Prior work mainly focused on static tasks, i.e., discrete, segmented motions, yet demonstrations also include dynamic tasks requiring reactive control. As dynamic tasks impose fundamentally different interface demands, insights from static-task evaluations cannot generalize. To address this gap, we conduct a within-subjects study comparing a VR controller and a SpaceMouse across two static and two dynamic tasks ($N=25$). We assess success rate, task duration, cumulative success, alongside NASA-TLX, SUS, and open-ended feedback. Results show statistically significant advantages for VR: higher success rates, particularly on dynamic tasks, shorter successful execution times across tasks, and earlier successes across attempts, with significantly lower workload and higher usability. As existing VR teleoperation systems are rarely open-source or suited for dynamic tasks, we release our VR interface to fill this gap.
summary_zh: 模仿学习依赖于高质量的演示数据，而遥操作是收集这些数据的主要方式，因此遥操作界面的选择对数据至关重要。 现有的研究主要集中在静态任务上，即离散的、分段的运动，但演示数据也包括需要反应式控制的动态任务。由于动态任务对界面提出了根本上不同的要求，因此静态任务评估的结论无法推广。为了弥补这一差距，我们进行了一项被试内研究，比较了VR控制器和SpaceMouse在两个静态和两个动态任务中的表现（N=25）。我们评估了成功率、任务时长、累计成功次数，以及NASA-TLX、SUS和开放式反馈。结果表明VR具有统计学意义上的优势：更高的成功率，尤其是在动态任务中，更短的成功执行时间（跨任务），以及在尝试中更早的成功，同时显著降低了工作负荷并提高了可用性。由于现有的VR遥操作系统很少开源或适用于动态任务，我们发布了我们的VR界面，以填补这一空白。
tldr: This paper compares VR and SpaceMouse interfaces for teleoperation in both static and dynamic robotic tasks, finding VR to be superior, especially for dynamic tasks. They also release their VR interface.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了VR和SpaceMouse界面在静态和动态机器人遥操作任务中的表现，发现VR更优，尤其是在动态任务中。他们还开源了他们的VR界面。

title: Imitation learning-based spacecraft rendezvous and docking method with Expert Demonstration
summary: Existing spacecraft rendezvous and docking control methods largely rely on predefined dynamic models and often exhibit limited robustness in realistic on-orbit environments. To address this issue, this paper proposes an Imitation Learning-based spacecraft rendezvous and docking control framework (IL-SRD) that directly learns control policies from expert demonstrations, thereby reducing dependence on accurate modeling. We propose an anchored decoder target mechanism, which conditions the decoder queries on state-related anchors to explicitly constrain the control generation process. This mechanism enforces physically consistent control evolution and effectively suppresses implausible action deviations in sequential prediction, enabling reliable six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) rendezvous and docking control. To further enhance stability, a temporal aggregation mechanism is incorporated to mitigate error accumulation caused by the sequential prediction nature of Transformer-based models, where small inaccuracies at each time step can propagate and amplify over long horizons. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed IL-SRD framework achieves accurate and energy-efficient model-free rendezvous and docking control. Robustness evaluations further confirm its capability to maintain competitive performance under significant unknown disturbances. The source code is available at https://github.com/Dongzhou-1996/IL-SRD.
summary_zh: 现有航天器交会对接控制方法在很大程度上依赖于预定义的动力学模型，并且在真实的在轨环境中通常表现出有限的鲁棒性。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种基于模仿学习的航天器交会对接控制框架（IL-SRD），该框架直接从专家演示中学习控制策略，从而降低了对精确建模的依赖性。我们提出了一种锚定解码器目标机制，该机制将解码器查询置于与状态相关的锚点之上，以显式地约束控制生成过程。这种机制强制执行物理上一致的控制演化，并有效地抑制序列预测中不合理的动作偏差，从而实现可靠的六自由度（6-DOF）交会对接控制。为了进一步提高稳定性，我们还纳入了一种时间聚合机制，以减轻基于Transformer模型的连续预测特性所引起的误差累积，在这种特性中，每个时间步的微小偏差可能会在长期预测中传播和放大。大量的仿真结果表明，所提出的IL-SRD框架能够实现精确且节能的无模型交会对接控制。鲁棒性评估进一步证实了其在显著未知干扰下保持竞争性能的能力。源代码可在https://github.com/Dongzhou-1996/IL-SRD获取。
tldr: This paper proposes an Imitation Learning (IL) approach, IL-SRD, for spacecraft rendezvous and docking, incorporating mechanisms to ensure physically consistent control and mitigate error accumulation, demonstrating robustness in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模仿学习（IL）的航天器交会对接方法 IL-SRD，该方法结合了确保物理一致性控制和减少误差累积的机制，并在仿真中展示了鲁棒性。

title: Active Inference-Driven World Modeling for Adaptive UAV Swarm Trajectory Design
summary: This paper proposes an Active Inference-based framework for autonomous trajectory design in UAV swarms. The method integrates probabilistic reasoning and self-learning to enable distributed mission allocation, route ordering, and motion planning. Expert trajectories generated using a Genetic Algorithm with Repulsion Forces (GA-RF) are employed to train a hierarchical World Model capturing swarm behavior across mission, route, and motion levels. During online operation, UAVs infer actions by minimizing divergence between current beliefs and model-predicted states, enabling adaptive responses to dynamic environments. Simulation results show faster convergence, higher stability, and safer navigation than Q-Learning, demonstrating the scalability and cognitive grounding of the proposed framework for intelligent UAV swarm control.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于主动推断的无人机蜂群自主轨迹设计框架。该方法融合了概率推理和自学习，以实现分布式任务分配、航线排序和运动规划。利用一种带有斥力的遗传算法（GA-RF）生成的专家轨迹来训练一个分层世界模型，该模型捕捉了蜂群在任务、航线和运动层面的行为。在在线运行期间，无人机通过最小化当前信念与模型预测状态之间的差异来推断行动，从而实现对动态环境的自适应响应。仿真结果表明，与Q学习相比，该方法具有更快的收敛速度、更高的稳定性和更安全的导航性能，证实了该框架在智能无人机蜂群控制方面的可扩展性和认知基础。
tldr: This paper presents an Active Inference framework utilizing a hierarchical World Model for autonomous and adaptive UAV swarm trajectory design, outperforming Q-Learning in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于主动推理的框架，该框架利用分层世界模型进行自主和自适应的无人机群轨迹设计，在仿真中优于Q-Learning。

title: PlannerRFT: Reinforcing Diffusion Planners through Closed-Loop and Sample-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Diffusion-based planners have emerged as a promising approach for human-like trajectory generation in autonomous driving. Recent works incorporate reinforcement fine-tuning to enhance the robustness of diffusion planners through reward-oriented optimization in a generation-evaluation loop. However, they struggle to generate multi-modal, scenario-adaptive trajectories, hindering the exploitation efficiency of informative rewards during fine-tuning. To resolve this, we propose PlannerRFT, a sample-efficient reinforcement fine-tuning framework for diffusion-based planners. PlannerRFT adopts a dual-branch optimization that simultaneously refines the trajectory distribution and adaptively guides the denoising process toward more promising exploration, without altering the original inference pipeline. To support parallel learning at scale, we develop nuMax, an optimized simulator that achieves 10 times faster rollout compared to native nuPlan. Extensive experiments shows that PlannerRFT yields state-of-the-art performance with distinct behaviors emerging during the learning process.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的规划器已成为自动驾驶中生成类人轨迹的一种有前景的方法。 近期工作将强化微调融入其中，通过生成-评估循环中的奖励导向优化来增强扩散规划器的鲁棒性。 然而，它们难以生成多模态、场景自适应的轨迹，从而阻碍了微调期间信息性奖励的利用效率。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PlannerRFT，一种面向基于扩散的规划器的样本高效强化微调框架。 PlannerRFT 采用双分支优化，在不改变原始推理流程的情况下，同时细化轨迹分布并自适应地引导去噪过程，使其朝着更有希望的探索方向发展。 为了支持大规模并行学习，我们开发了 nuMax，一个优化的模拟器，与原生 nuPlan 相比，实现了 10 倍的 rollout 速度提升。 大量实验表明，PlannerRFT 产生了最先进的性能，并在学习过程中涌现出独特的行为。
tldr: PlannerRFT is a sample-efficient reinforcement fine-tuning framework for diffusion-based planners, using a dual-branch optimization to refine trajectory distribution and guide the denoising process in autonomous driving scenarios. They also introduce nuMax, an optimized simulator achieving 10x faster rollouts.
tldr_zh: PlannerRFT是一个用于基于扩散的规划器的样本高效强化微调框架，它采用双分支优化来细化轨迹分布并指导自主驾驶场景中的去噪过程。他们还引入了nuMax，一个实现了10倍更快rollout的优化模拟器。

title: DC-VLAQ: Query-Residual Aggregation for Robust Visual Place Recognition
summary: One of the central challenges in visual place recognition (VPR) is learning a robust global representation that remains discriminative under large viewpoint changes, illumination variations, and severe domain shifts. While visual foundation models (VFMs) provide strong local features, most existing methods rely on a single model, overlooking the complementary cues offered by different VFMs. However, exploiting such complementary information inevitably alters token distributions, which challenges the stability of existing query-based global aggregation schemes. To address these challenges, we propose DC-VLAQ, a representation-centric framework that integrates the fusion of complementary VFMs and robust global aggregation. Specifically, we first introduce a lightweight residual-guided complementary fusion that anchors representations in the DINOv2 feature space while injecting complementary semantics from CLIP through a learned residual correction. In addition, we propose the Vector of Local Aggregated Queries (VLAQ), a query--residual global aggregation scheme that encodes local tokens by their residual responses to learnable queries, resulting in improved stability and the preservation of fine-grained discriminative cues. Extensive experiments on standard VPR benchmarks, including Pitts30k, Tokyo24/7, MSLS, Nordland, SPED, and AmsterTime, demonstrate that DC-VLAQ consistently outperforms strong baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly under challenging domain shifts and long-term appearance changes.
summary_zh: 视觉场景识别（VPR）的核心挑战之一是学习一种鲁棒的全局表示，该表示在大的视角变化、光照变化和严重的域偏移下仍具有区分性。虽然视觉基础模型（VFMs）提供了强大的局部特征，但大多数现有方法依赖于单一模型，忽略了不同VFMs提供的互补线索。 然而，利用这种互补信息不可避免地会改变token分布，这对现有基于查询的全局聚合方案的稳定性提出了挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DC-VLAQ，这是一个以表示为中心的框架，集成了互补VFMs的融合和鲁棒的全局聚合。 具体来说，我们首先引入一个轻量级的残差引导互补融合，它将表示锚定在DINOv2特征空间中，同时通过学习到的残差校正注入来自CLIP的互补语义。 此外，我们提出了局部聚合查询向量（VLAQ），一种查询-残差全局聚合方案，该方案通过局部token对其可学习查询的残差响应进行编码，从而提高了稳定性和细粒度判别线索的保留。 在标准VPR基准测试（包括Pitts30k、Tokyo24/7、MSLS、Nordland、SPED和AmsterTime）上的大量实验表明，DC-VLAQ始终优于强大的基线，并实现了最先进的性能，尤其是在具有挑战性的领域偏移和长期外观变化下。
tldr: The paper introduces DC-VLAQ, a novel framework for visual place recognition that fuses information from multiple visual foundation models using a residual-guided approach and a new query-residual global aggregation scheme. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard VPR benchmarks, especially under domain shifts and appearance changes.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种名为DC-VLAQ的新型视觉场景识别框架，它使用残差引导方法融合来自多个视觉基础模型的信息，并采用了一种新的查询-残差全局聚合方案。在标准的VPR基准测试中，尤其是在域偏移和外观变化的情况下，该方法实现了最先进的性能。

title: RPT*: Global Planning with Probabilistic Terminals for Target Search in Complex Environments
summary: Routing problems such as Hamiltonian Path Problem (HPP), seeks a path to visit all the vertices in a graph while minimizing the path cost. This paper studies a variant, HPP with Probabilistic Terminals (HPP-PT), where each vertex has a probability representing the likelihood that the robot's path terminates there, and the objective is to minimize the expected path cost. HPP-PT arises in target object search, where a mobile robot must visit all candidate locations to find an object, and prior knowledge of the object's location is expressed as vertex probabilities. While routing problems have been studied for decades, few of them consider uncertainty as required in this work. The challenge lies not only in optimally ordering the vertices, as in standard HPP, but also in handling history dependency: the expected path cost depends on the order in which vertices were previously visited. This makes many existing methods inefficient or inapplicable. To address the challenge, we propose a search-based approach RPT* with solution optimality guarantees, which leverages dynamic programming in a new state space to bypass the history dependency and novel heuristics to speed up the computation. Building on RPT*, we design a Hierarchical Autonomous Target Search (HATS) system that combines RPT* with either Bayesian filtering for lifelong target search with noisy sensors, or autonomous exploration to find targets in unknown environments. Experiments in both simulation and real robot show that our approach can naturally balance between exploitation and exploration, thereby finding targets more quickly on average than baseline methods.
summary_zh: 哈密尔顿路径问题（HPP）等路径规划问题旨在寻找一条访问图中所有顶点的路径，同时最小化路径成本。本文研究了HPP的一个变体，即具有概率终止顶点的哈密尔顿路径问题（HPP-PT），其中每个顶点都有一个概率值，表示机器人路径在该处终止的可能性，目标是最小化期望路径成本。HPP-PT出现在目标对象搜索中，在该场景中，移动机器人必须访问所有候选位置才能找到目标对象，并且对象位置的先验知识被表示为顶点概率。尽管路径规划问题已被研究数十年，但很少有研究像本文一样考虑不确定性。该挑战不仅在于像标准HPP一样优化顶点顺序，还在于处理历史依赖性：期望路径成本取决于先前访问顶点的顺序。这使得许多现有方法效率低下或不适用。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于搜索的方法RPT*，它具有解的最优性保证，该方法利用新的状态空间中的动态规划来绕过历史依赖性，并利用新颖的启发式方法来加速计算。在RPT*的基础上，我们设计了一种分层自主目标搜索（HATS）系统，该系统将RPT*与用于有噪声传感器的终身目标搜索的贝叶斯滤波或用于在未知环境中寻找目标的自主探索相结合。在模拟和真实机器人中的实验表明，我们的方法可以自然地在利用和探索之间取得平衡，因此与基线方法相比，平均而言可以更快地找到目标。
tldr: The paper introduces RPT*, a search-based algorithm for solving the Hamiltonian Path Problem with Probabilistic Terminals (HPP-PT), motivated by robotic target search, and demonstrates its effectiveness in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于搜索的算法RPT*，用于解决具有概率终端的哈密顿路径问题（HPP-PT），该问题源于机器人目标搜索，并在仿真和真实机器人上展示了其有效性。

title: MagicGUI-RMS: A Multi-Agent Reward Model System for Self-Evolving GUI Agents via Automated Feedback Reflux
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are rapidly progressing toward autonomous interaction and reliable task execution across diverse applications. However, two central challenges remain unresolved: automating the evaluation of agent trajectories and generating high-quality training data at scale to enable continual improvement. Existing approaches often depend on manual annotation or static rule-based verification, which restricts scalability and limits adaptability in dynamic environments. We present MagicGUI-RMS, a multi-agent reward model system that delivers adaptive trajectory evaluation, corrective feedback, and self-evolving learning capabilities. MagicGUI-RMS integrates a Domain-Specific Reward Model (DS-RM) with a General-Purpose Reward Model (GP-RM), enabling fine-grained action assessment and robust generalization across heterogeneous GUI tasks. To support reward learning at scale, we design a structured data construction pipeline that automatically produces balanced and diverse reward datasets, effectively reducing annotation costs while maintaining sample fidelity. During execution, the reward model system identifies erroneous actions, proposes refined alternatives, and continuously enhances agent behavior through an automated data-reflux mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MagicGUI-RMS yields substantial gains in task accuracy, behavioral robustness. These results establish MagicGUI-RMS as a principled and effective foundation for building self-improving GUI agents driven by reward-based adaptation.
summary_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）代理正迅速朝着自主交互和跨各种应用可靠的任务执行方向发展。然而，仍然存在两个尚未解决的核心挑战：自动评估代理轨迹以及大规模生成高质量的训练数据，从而实现持续改进。现有的方法通常依赖于手动标注或基于静态规则的验证，这限制了可扩展性并降低了在动态环境中的适应性。我们提出了 MagicGUI-RMS，一种多代理奖励模型系统，它提供自适应轨迹评估、纠正性反馈和自我演进的学习能力。MagicGUI-RMS 将领域特定奖励模型 (DS-RM) 与通用奖励模型 (GP-RM) 相结合，从而实现细粒度的动作评估和跨异构 GUI 任务的稳健泛化。为了支持大规模的奖励学习，我们设计了一个结构化的数据构建流程，该流程可以自动生成平衡且多样化的奖励数据集，从而有效降低标注成本，同时保持样本的保真度。在执行过程中，奖励模型系统识别错误的操作，提出改进的替代方案，并通过自动化的数据回流机制持续增强代理行为。大量实验表明，MagicGUI-RMS 能够显著提高任务准确性和行为鲁棒性。这些结果确立了 MagicGUI-RMS 作为构建由基于奖励的自适应驱动的自改进 GUI 代理的原则性且有效的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces MagicGUI-RMS, a multi-agent reward model system for self-evolving GUI agents, which automates the evaluation of agent trajectories and generates high-quality training data. It demonstrates improved task accuracy and robustness through a novel reward-based adaptation mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MagicGUI-RMS，一个用于自进化 GUI 代理的多代理奖励模型系统，能够自动评估代理轨迹并生成高质量的训练数据。通过一种新颖的基于奖励的适应机制，该系统展示了任务准确性和鲁棒性的提升。

title: Primate-like perceptual decision making emerges through deep recurrent reinforcement learning
summary: Progress has led to a detailed understanding of the neural mechanisms that underlie decision making in primates. However, less is known about why such mechanisms are present in the first place. Theory suggests that primate decision making mechanisms, and their resultant behavioral abilities, emerged to maximize reward in the face of noisy, temporally evolving information. To test this theory, we trained an end-to-end deep recurrent neural network using reinforcement learning on a noisy perceptual discrimination task. Networks learned several key abilities of primate-like decision making including trading off speed for accuracy, and flexibly changing their mind in the face of new information. Internal dynamics of these networks suggest that these abilities were supported by similar decision mechanisms as those observed in primate neurophysiological studies. These results provide experimental support for key pressures that gave rise to the primate ability to make flexible decisions.
summary_zh: 进展使得我们对灵长类动物决策背后的神经机制有了深入的理解。然而，人们对这些机制最初为何存在所知甚少。理论表明，灵长类动物的决策机制及其产生的行为能力是在面对嘈杂、时间演化的信息时，为了最大化奖励而出现的。为了验证这一理论，我们使用强化学习在嘈杂的感知判别任务上训练了一个端到端的深度递归神经网络。网络学习了灵长类动物决策的几个关键能力，包括权衡速度和准确性，并在面对新信息时灵活地改变主意。这些网络的内部动力学表明，这些能力得到了与灵长类动物神经生理学研究中观察到的类似决策机制的支持。这些结果为产生灵长类动物进行灵活决策能力的关键压力提供了实验支持。
tldr: This paper trains a deep recurrent neural network using reinforcement learning on a perceptual discrimination task and finds that the network develops primate-like decision-making abilities, suggesting an evolutionary advantage to these mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 本文使用强化学习在一个感知辨别任务上训练了一个深度循环神经网络，发现该网络发展出类似灵长类动物的决策能力，这表明这些机制具有进化优势。

title: Cooperative Multi-agent RL with Communication Constraints
summary: Cooperative MARL often assumes frequent access to global information in a data buffer, such as team rewards or other agents' actions, which is typically unrealistic in decentralized MARL systems due to high communication costs. When communication is limited, agents must rely on outdated information to estimate gradients and update their policies. A common approach to handle missing data is called importance sampling, in which we reweigh old data from a base policy to estimate gradients for the current policy. However, it quickly becomes unstable when the communication is limited (i.e. missing data probability is high), so that the base policy in importance sampling is outdated. To address this issue, we propose a technique called base policy prediction, which utilizes old gradients to predict the policy update and collect samples for a sequence of base policies, which reduces the gap between the base policy and the current policy. This approach enables effective learning with significantly fewer communication rounds, since the samples of predicted base policies could be collected within one communication round. Theoretically, we show that our algorithm converges to an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium in potential games with only $O(\varepsilon^{-3/4})$ communication rounds and $O(poly(\max_i |A_i|)\varepsilon^{-11/4})$ samples, improving existing state-of-the-art results in communication cost, as well as sample complexity without the exponential dependence on the joint action space size. We also extend these results to general Markov Cooperative Games to find an agent-wise local maximum. Empirically, we test the base policy prediction algorithm in both simulated games and MAPPO for complex environments.
summary_zh: 合作多智能体强化学习通常假设能够频繁访问数据缓冲区中的全局信息，例如团队奖励或其他智能体的动作，这在去中心化多智能体强化学习系统中通常是不现实的，因为通信成本很高。当通信受限时，智能体必须依靠过时的信息来估计梯度并更新其策略。处理缺失数据的一种常见方法是重要性采样，其中我们对来自基础策略的旧数据进行重新加权，以估计当前策略的梯度。然而，当通信受限时（即，缺失数据概率很高），它会迅速变得不稳定，因为重要性采样中的基础策略已经过时。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种称为基础策略预测的技术，该技术利用旧梯度来预测策略更新，并为一系列基础策略收集样本，从而减少了基础策略和当前策略之间的差距。这种方法能够以明显更少的通信轮次实现有效的学习，因为预测基础策略的样本可以在一轮通信中收集。理论上，我们证明了我们的算法在势博弈中收敛到 $\varepsilon$-纳什均衡只需要 $O(\varepsilon^{-3/4})$ 轮通信和 $O(poly(\max_i |A_i|)\varepsilon^{-11/4})$ 个样本，在通信成本以及样本复杂度方面改进了现有的最优结果，且避免了对联合动作空间大小的指数依赖。我们还将这些结果推广到一般的马尔可夫合作博弈，以找到智能体层面的局部最大值。在实验上，我们分别在模拟博弈和用于复杂环境的 MAPPO 中测试了基础策略预测算法。
tldr: This paper proposes a base policy prediction technique for cooperative multi-agent RL with communication constraints, which improves upon importance sampling by predicting policy updates and reduces communication rounds while achieving convergence guarantees.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于具有通信约束的合作多智能体强化学习的基策略预测技术，通过预测策略更新来改进重要性采样，减少了通信轮数并实现了收敛性保证。

title: ObjectVisA-120: Object-based Visual Attention Prediction in Interactive Street-crossing Environments
summary: The object-based nature of human visual attention is well-known in cognitive science, but has only played a minor role in computational visual attention models so far. This is mainly due to a lack of suitable datasets and evaluation metrics for object-based attention. To address these limitations, we present \dataset~ -- a novel 120-participant dataset of spatial street-crossing navigation in virtual reality specifically geared to object-based attention evaluations. The uniqueness of the presented dataset lies in the ethical and safety affiliated challenges that make collecting comparable data in real-world environments highly difficult. \dataset~ not only features accurate gaze data and a complete state-space representation of objects in the virtual environment, but it also offers variable scenario complexities and rich annotations, including panoptic segmentation, depth information, and vehicle keypoints. We further propose object-based similarity (oSIM) as a novel metric to evaluate the performance of object-based visual attention models, a previously unexplored performance characteristic. Our evaluations show that explicitly optimising for object-based attention not only improves oSIM performance but also leads to an improved model performance on common metrics. In addition, we present SUMGraph, a Mamba U-Net-based model, which explicitly encodes critical scene objects (vehicles) in a graph representation, leading to further performance improvements over several state-of-the-art visual attention prediction methods. The dataset, code and models will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 人类视觉注意的基于对象的本质在认知科学领域广为人知，但迄今为止在计算视觉注意模型中仅发挥了较小的作用。这主要是由于缺乏适合于基于对象的注意的数据集和评估指标。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 \dataset~ —— 一个包含120名参与者的新型数据集，该数据集专注于虚拟现实中的空间街道穿越导航，专门用于基于对象的注意评估。所提出数据集的独特性在于其伦理和安全相关的挑战，使得在现实世界环境中收集可比较的数据非常困难。\dataset~ 不仅具有精确的注视数据和虚拟环境中对象的完整状态空间表示，而且还提供可变的场景复杂性和丰富的注释，包括全景分割、深度信息和车辆关键点。我们进一步提出了基于对象的相似性（oSIM）作为一种新的度量标准，以评估基于对象的视觉注意模型的性能，这是一个以前未被探索的性能特征。我们的评估表明，显式地优化基于对象的注意不仅提高了oSIM性能，而且还提高了模型在通用指标上的性能。此外，我们提出了一种基于Mamba U-Net的模型SUMGraph，该模型在图表示中显式地编码了关键的场景对象（车辆），从而进一步提高了优于几种最先进的视觉注意预测方法的性能。数据集、代码和模型将公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces ObjectVisA-120, a novel VR dataset for object-based visual attention prediction in street-crossing scenarios, along with a new evaluation metric and an advanced model (SUMGraph) that outperforms existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为ObjectVisA-120的新型VR数据集，用于街道穿越场景中基于对象的视觉注意力预测。同时，它还提出了一个新的评估指标和一个名为SUMGraph的先进模型，该模型优于现有方法。

title: Moaw: Unleashing Motion Awareness for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video diffusion models, trained on large-scale datasets, naturally capture correspondences of shared features across frames. Recent works have exploited this property for tasks such as optical flow prediction and tracking in a zero-shot setting. Motivated by these findings, we investigate whether supervised training can more fully harness the tracking capability of video diffusion models. To this end, we propose Moaw, a framework that unleashes motion awareness for video diffusion models and leverages it to facilitate motion transfer. Specifically, we train a diffusion model for motion perception, shifting its modality from image-to-video generation to video-to-dense-tracking. We then construct a motion-labeled dataset to identify features that encode the strongest motion information, and inject them into a structurally identical video generation model. Owing to the homogeneity between the two networks, these features can be naturally adapted in a zero-shot manner, enabling motion transfer without additional adapters. Our work provides a new paradigm for bridging generative modeling and motion understanding, paving the way for more unified and controllable video learning frameworks.
summary_zh: 视频扩散模型在大型数据集上训练后，自然地捕捉到跨帧共享特征的对应关系。最近的研究已利用此特性在零样本设置下执行诸如光流预测和跟踪等任务。受这些发现的启发，我们研究了监督训练是否能更充分地利用视频扩散模型的跟踪能力。为此，我们提出了Moaw，一个释放视频扩散模型运动感知能力并利用其促进运动迁移的框架。具体而言，我们训练了一个用于运动感知的扩散模型，将其模态从图像到视频的生成转变到视频到稠密跟踪。然后，我们构建了一个运动标记数据集，以识别编码最强运动信息的特征，并将它们注入到结构相同的视频生成模型中。由于两个网络之间的同质性，这些特征可以在零样本的方式下自然地适应，从而在没有额外适配器的情况下实现运动迁移。我们的工作为连接生成建模和运动理解提供了一种新的范式，为更统一和可控的视频学习框架铺平了道路。
tldr: The paper introduces Moaw, a framework that enhances video diffusion models by supervised training for motion perception and transfer, achieving zero-shot motion transfer by injecting motion-labeled features from a tracking model into a video generation model.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Moaw，一个通过有监督训练增强视频扩散模型以实现运动感知和转移的框架。它通过将来自跟踪模型的运动标记特征注入到视频生成模型中来实现零样本运动转移。

title: Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition for Robot Manipulator Tasks
summary: This paper proposes a novel approach to recognizing dynamic hand gestures facilitating seamless interaction between humans and robots. Here, each robot manipulator task is assigned a specific gesture. There may be several such tasks, hence, several gestures. These gestures may be prone to several dynamic variations. All such variations for different gestures shown to the robot are accurately recognized in real-time using the proposed unsupervised model based on the Gaussian Mixture model. The accuracy during training and real-time testing prove the efficacy of this methodology.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种识别动态手势的新方法，旨在促进人与机器人之间的无缝互动。其中，每个机器人机械臂任务都被分配一个特定的手势。可能存在多个此类任务，因此对应多个手势。这些手势可能容易受到若干动态变化的影响。利用所提出的基于高斯混合模型的无监督模型，可以实时准确地识别向机器人展示的不同手势的所有此类变化。训练和实时测试期间的准确性证明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces an unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model for real-time dynamic hand gesture recognition to control robot manipulators, with positive results in training and testing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高斯混合模型的无监督动态手势识别方法，用于实时控制机器人机械臂，并在训练和测试中取得了积极成果。

title: Communication Methods in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning is a promising research area that extends established reinforcement learning approaches to problems formulated as multi-agent systems. Recently, a multitude of communication methods have been introduced to this field to address problems such as partially observable environments, non-stationarity, and exponentially growing action spaces. Communication further enables efficient cooperation among all agents interacting in an environment. This work aims at providing an overview of communication techniques in multi-agent reinforcement learning. By an in-depth analysis of 29 publications on this topic, the strengths and weaknesses of explicit, implicit, attention-based, graph-based, and hierarchical/role-based communication are evaluated. The results of this comparison show that there is no general, optimal communication framework for every problem. On the contrary, the choice of communication depends heavily on the problem at hand. The comparison also highlights the importance of communication methods with low computational overhead to enable scalability to environments where many agents interact. Finally, the paper discusses current research gaps, emphasizing the need for standardized benchmarking of system-level metrics and improved robustness under realistic communication conditions to enhance the real-world applicability of these approaches.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习是一个极具前景的研究领域，它将已有的强化学习方法扩展到被建模为多智能体系统的问题中。近年来，该领域引入了大量的通信方法，以解决诸如部分可观测环境、非平稳性和指数级增长的动作空间等问题。通信进一步促进了环境中所有交互智能体之间的高效合作。本工作旨在概述多智能体强化学习中的通信技术。通过对该主题的29篇出版物进行深入分析，评估了显式通信、隐式通信、基于注意力机制的通信、基于图的通信以及基于层级/角色的通信的优势和劣势。比较结果表明，对于任何问题而言，不存在通用的、最优的通信框架。相反，通信方式的选择在很大程度上取决于手头的问题。该比较还强调了低计算开销的通信方法的重要性，以便能够扩展到许多智能体交互的环境中。最后，本文讨论了当前的研究差距，强调了对系统级指标进行标准化基准测试以及提高在真实通信条件下鲁棒性的必要性，从而增强这些方法在实际应用中的适用性。
tldr: This paper surveys communication methods in multi-agent reinforcement learning, analyzing the strengths and weaknesses of different approaches and highlighting the need for standardized benchmarks and robustness in realistic conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了多智能体强化学习中的通信方法，分析了不同方法的优点和缺点，并强调了在实际条件下进行标准化基准测试和提高鲁棒性的必要性。

title: NeuroShield: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adversarial Robustness
summary: Adversarial vulnerability and lack of interpretability are critical limitations of deep neural networks, especially in safety-sensitive settings such as autonomous driving. We introduce \DesignII, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates symbolic rule supervision into neural networks to enhance both adversarial robustness and explainability. Domain knowledge is encoded as logical constraints over appearance attributes such as shape and color, and enforced through semantic and symbolic logic losses applied during training. Using the GTSRB dataset, we evaluate robustness against FGSM and PGD attacks at a standard $\ell_\infty$ perturbation budget of $\varepsilon = 8/255$. Relative to clean training, standard adversarial training provides modest improvements in robustness ($\sim$10 percentage points). Conversely, our FGSM-Neuro-Symbolic and PGD-Neuro-Symbolic models achieve substantially larger gains, improving adversarial accuracy by 18.1\% and 17.35\% over their corresponding adversarial-training baselines, representing roughly a three-fold larger robustness gain than standard adversarial training provides when both are measured relative to the same clean-training baseline, without reducing clean-sample accuracy. Compared to transformer-based defenses such as LNL-MoEx, which require heavy architectures and extensive data augmentation, our PGD-Neuro-Symbolic variant attains comparable or superior robustness using a ResNet18 backbone trained for 10 epochs. These results show that symbolic reasoning offers an effective path to robust and interpretable AI.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络的对抗脆弱性和缺乏可解释性是其关键局限，尤其是在自动驾驶等安全攸关的场景中。我们引入 \DesignII，一种神经符号框架，它将符号规则监督集成到神经网络中，以增强对抗鲁棒性和可解释性。领域知识被编码为关于形状和颜色等外观属性的逻辑约束，并通过在训练期间应用的语义和符号逻辑损失来强制执行。我们使用GTSRB数据集，在标准的 $\ell_\infty$ 扰动预算下 ($\varepsilon = 8/255$)，评估针对FGSM和PGD攻击的鲁棒性。相对于干净训练，标准对抗训练在鲁棒性方面提供了适度的改进（约10个百分点）。相反，我们的FGSM-Neuro-Symbolic和PGD-Neuro-Symbolic模型实现了更大的收益，相对于其对应的对抗训练基线，对抗精度分别提高了18.1％和17.35％，这大约是标准对抗训练所能提供的鲁棒性增益的三倍，且两者都相对于相同的干净训练基线进行测量，同时不降低干净样本的准确率。与基于Transformer的防御方法（如LNL-MoEx）相比，这些方法需要大量的架构和广泛的数据增强，我们的PGD-Neuro-Symbolic变体仅使用一个训练了10个epoch的ResNet18骨干网络，便获得了相当或更高的鲁棒性。这些结果表明，符号推理为实现鲁棒且可解释的AI提供了一条有效的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces NeuroShield, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates symbolic rule supervision into neural networks, demonstrating enhanced adversarial robustness and explainability on the GTSRB dataset compared to standard adversarial training and transformer-based defenses.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了NeuroShield，一个神经符号框架，它将符号规则监督集成到神经网络中，并在GTSRB数据集上展示了优于标准对抗训练和基于Transformer防御的对抗鲁棒性和可解释性。

title: OFA-MAS: One-for-All Multi-Agent System Topology Design based on Mixture-of-Experts Graph Generative Models
summary: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer a powerful paradigm for solving complex problems, yet their performance is critically dependent on the design of their underlying collaboration topology. As MAS become increasingly deployed in web services (e.g., search engines), designing adaptive topologies for diverse cross-domain user queries becomes essential. Current graph learning-based design methodologies often adhere to a "one-for-one" paradigm, where a specialized model is trained for each specific task domain. This approach suffers from poor generalization to unseen domains and fails to leverage shared structural knowledge across different tasks. To address this, we propose OFA-TAD, a one-for-all framework that generates adaptive collaboration graphs for any task described in natural language through a single universal model. Our approach integrates a Task-Aware Graph State Encoder (TAGSE) that filters task-relevant node information via sparse gating, and a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that dynamically selects specialized sub-networks to drive node and edge prediction. We employ a three-stage training strategy: unconditional pre-training on canonical topologies for structural priors, large-scale conditional pre-training on LLM-generated datasets for task-topology mappings, and supervised fine-tuning on empirically validated graphs. Experiments across six diverse benchmarks show that OFA-TAD significantly outperforms specialized one-for-one models, generating highly adaptive MAS topologies. Code: https://github.com/Shiy-Li/OFA-MAS.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统(MAS)为解决复杂问题提供了一个强大的范例，但其性能关键取决于底层协作拓扑的设计。随着MAS越来越多地部署在Web服务中（例如，搜索引擎），为解决各种跨领域用户查询设计自适应拓扑变得至关重要。当前基于图学习的设计方法通常遵循“一对一”的范例，即为每个特定的任务领域训练一个专门的模型。这种方法泛化到未见领域的效果较差，并且无法利用不同任务之间共享的结构知识。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了OFA-TAD，一个“多合一”框架，它通过一个单一的通用模型，为任何用自然语言描述的任务生成自适应协作图。我们的方法集成了任务感知图状态编码器(TAGSE)，该编码器通过稀疏门控过滤任务相关的节点信息，以及一种混合专家(MoE)架构，该架构动态选择专门的子网络来驱动节点和边的预测。我们采用了一个三阶段的训练策略：在规范拓扑上进行无条件预训练以获取结构先验知识，在LLM生成的数据集上进行大规模条件预训练以学习任务-拓扑映射关系，以及在经验证的图上进行监督微调。在六个不同的基准上的实验表明，OFA-TAD显著优于专门的“一对一”模型，生成了高度自适应的MAS拓扑。代码：https://github.com/Shiy-Li/OFA-MAS。
tldr: The paper introduces OFA-MAS, a one-for-all framework employing Mixture-of-Experts graph generative models for designing adaptive multi-agent system topologies based on natural language task descriptions, demonstrating superior performance over task-specific models across diverse benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OFA-MAS，一个“一体化”框架，采用混合专家图生成模型，基于自然语言任务描述设计自适应多智能体系统拓扑，并在多个基准测试中表现优于特定任务模型。

title: Decoding Rewards in Competitive Games: Inverse Game Theory with Entropy Regularization
summary: Estimating the unknown reward functions driving agents' behaviors is of central interest in inverse reinforcement learning and game theory. To tackle this problem, we develop a unified framework for reward function recovery in two-player zero-sum matrix games and Markov games with entropy regularization, where we aim to reconstruct the underlying reward functions given observed players' strategies and actions. This task is challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of inverse problems, the non-uniqueness of feasible rewards, and limited observational data coverage. To address these challenges, we establish the reward function's identifiability using the quantal response equilibrium (QRE) under linear assumptions. Building upon this theoretical foundation, we propose a novel algorithm to learn reward functions from observed actions. Our algorithm works in both static and dynamic settings and is adaptable to incorporate different methods, such as Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). We provide strong theoretical guarantees for the reliability and sample efficiency of our algorithm. Further, we conduct extensive numerical studies to demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed framework, offering new insights into decision-making in competitive environments.
summary_zh: 估计驱动智能体行为的未知奖励函数是逆强化学习和博弈论的核心问题。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于在两人零和矩阵博弈和带熵正则化的马尔可夫博弈中进行奖励函数恢复，我们的目标是在给定观察到的玩家策略和行动的前提下，重构潜在的奖励函数。由于逆问题固有的模糊性、可行奖励的非唯一性以及有限的观测数据覆盖范围，这项任务极具挑战性。为了应对这些挑战，在线性假设下，我们使用量化响应均衡（QRE）建立了奖励函数的可辨识性。基于这一理论基础，我们提出了一种从观察到的行动中学习奖励函数的新算法。我们的算法既适用于静态环境，也适用于动态环境，并且可以灵活地整合不同的方法，例如极大似然估计（MLE）。我们为算法的可靠性和样本效率提供了强有力的理论保证。此外，我们进行了大量的数值研究，以证明所提出的框架在实践中的有效性，从而为竞争环境中的决策提供了新的见解。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for recovering reward functions in competitive games using inverse game theory with entropy regularization, offering a novel algorithm with theoretical guarantees and demonstrating practical effectiveness in static and dynamic settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于通过具有熵正则化的逆博弈论来恢复竞争性博弈中的奖励函数，提供了一种具有理论保证的新颖算法，并在静态和动态环境中展示了实际有效性。

title: Resource-Conscious RL Algorithms for Deep Brain Stimulation
summary:
Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) has proven to be a promising treatment of Parkinson's Disease (PD). DBS involves stimulating specific regions of the brain's Basal Ganglia (BG) using electric impulses to alleviate symptoms of PD such as tremors, rigidity, and bradykinesia. Although most clinical DBS approaches today use a fixed frequency and amplitude, they suffer from side effects (such as slurring of speech) and shortened battery life of the implant. Reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have been used in recent research to perform DBS in a more adaptive manner to improve overall patient outcome. These RL algorithms are, however, too complex to be trained in vivo due to their long convergence time and requirement of high computational resources.
  We propose a new Time & Threshold-Triggered Multi-Armed Bandit (T3P MAB) RL approach for DBS that is more effective than existing algorithms. Further, our T3P agent is lightweight enough to be deployed in the implant, unlike current deep-RL strategies, and even forgoes the need for an offline training phase. Additionally, most existing RL approaches have focused on modulating only frequency or amplitude, and the possibility of tuning them together remains greatly unexplored in the literature. Our RL agent can tune both frequency and amplitude of DBS signals to the brain with better sample efficiency and requires minimal time to converge. We implement an MAB agent for DBS for the first time on hardware to report energy measurements and prove its suitability for resource-constrained platforms. Our T3P MAB algorithm is deployed on a variety of microcontroller unit (MCU) setups to show its efficiency in terms of power consumption as opposed to other existing RL approaches used in recent work.
summary_zh:
深部脑刺激 (DBS) 已被证明是治疗帕金森病 (PD) 的一种颇具前景的方法。DBS 通过使用电脉冲刺激大脑基底神经节 (BG) 的特定区域，来缓解 PD 的症状，如震颤、僵直和运动迟缓。尽管目前大多数临床 DBS 方法都使用固定的频率和幅度，但它们会产生副作用（如言语不清）并缩短植入设备的电池寿命。强化学习 (RL) 方法已在最近的研究中被用于以更具适应性的方式执行 DBS，以改善患者的总体治疗效果。然而，这些 RL 算法过于复杂，无法在体内进行训练，因为它们收敛时间长，并且需要大量的计算资源。

我们提出了一种新的时间和阈值触发多臂赌博机 (T3P MAB) RL 方法用于 DBS，该方法比现有算法更有效。此外，与当前的深度 RL 策略不同，我们的 T3P 智能体足够轻量级，可以部署在植入设备中，甚至不需要离线训练阶段。此外，大多数现有的 RL 方法都只专注于调节频率或幅度，而同时调整频率和幅度的可能性在文献中仍未得到充分探索。我们的 RL 智能体可以调整脑部 DBS 信号的频率和幅度，具有更好的样本效率，并且需要最少的收敛时间。我们首次在硬件上实现了用于 DBS 的 MAB 智能体，以报告能量测量值，并证明其适用于资源受限的平台。我们的 T3P MAB 算法部署在各种微控制器单元 (MCU) 设置上，以显示其在功耗方面的效率，与近期工作中使用的其他现有 RL 方法相比。
tldr: This paper introduces a resource-conscious Multi-Armed Bandit RL approach for Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) that can tune both frequency and amplitude of DBS signals, suitable for deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种资源节约型的多臂老虎机RL方法，用于深度脑刺激（DBS），它可以调整DBS信号的频率和幅度，适用于在资源受限的微控制器上部署。

title: Decentralized Learning Strategies for Estimation Error Minimization with Graph Neural Networks
summary: We address real-time sampling and estimation of autoregressive Markovian sources in dynamic yet structurally similar multi-hop wireless networks. Each node caches samples from others and communicates over wireless collision channels, aiming to minimize time-average estimation error via decentralized policies. Due to the high dimensionality of action spaces and complexity of network topologies, deriving optimal policies analytically is intractable. To address this, we propose a graphical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for policy optimization. Theoretically, we demonstrate that our proposed policies are transferable, allowing a policy trained on one graph to be effectively applied to structurally similar graphs. Numerical experiments demonstrate that (i) our proposed policy outperforms state-of-the-art baselines; (ii) the trained policies are transferable to larger networks, with performance gains increasing with the number of agents; (iii) the graphical training procedure withstands non-stationarity, even when using independent learning techniques; and (iv) recurrence is pivotal in both independent learning and centralized training and decentralized execution, and improves the resilience to non-stationarity.
summary_zh: 我们研究了动态但结构相似的多跳无线网络中自回归马尔可夫源的实时采样和估计问题。每个节点缓存来自其他节点的样本，并通过无线冲突信道进行通信，旨在通过去中心化策略最小化时间平均估计误差。由于动作空间的高维度和网络拓扑的复杂性，分析上推导最优策略是不可行的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个用于策略优化的图多智能体强化学习框架。从理论上讲，我们证明了我们提出的策略是可迁移的，允许在一种图上训练的策略有效地应用于结构相似的图。数值实验表明：（i）我们提出的策略优于最先进的基线；（ii）训练好的策略可以迁移到更大的网络，性能增益随着智能体数量的增加而增加；（iii）即使在使用独立学习技术时，图形化训练过程也能承受非平稳性；以及（iv）循环机制在独立学习和集中训练去中心化执行中都至关重要，并提高了对非平稳性的抵抗力。
tldr: This paper introduces a graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for decentralized policy optimization in wireless networks, demonstrating policy transferability and resilience to non-stationarity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于图的多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 框架，用于无线网络中的分散策略优化，展示了策略的可转移性和对非平稳性的弹性。

title: Beyond Softmax and Entropy: Improving Convergence Guarantees of Policy Gradients by f-SoftArgmax Parameterization with Coupled Regularization
summary: Policy gradient methods are known to be highly sensitive to the choice of policy parameterization. In particular, the widely used softmax parameterization can induce ill-conditioned optimization landscapes and lead to exponentially slow convergence. Although this can be mitigated by preconditioning, this solution is often computationally expensive. Instead, we propose replacing the softmax with an alternative family of policy parameterizations based on the generalized f-softargmax. We further advocate coupling this parameterization with a regularizer induced by the same f-divergence, which improves the optimization landscape and ensures that the resulting regularized objective satisfies a Polyak-Lojasiewicz inequality. Leveraging this structure, we establish the first explicit non-asymptotic last-iterate convergence guarantees for stochastic policy gradient methods for finite MDPs without any form of preconditioning. We also derive sample-complexity bounds for the unregularized problem and show that f-PG, with Tsallis divergences achieves polynomial sample complexity in contrast to the exponential complexity incurred by the standard softmax parameterization.
summary_zh: 策略梯度方法因其对策略参数化选择的高度敏感性而闻名。 特别是，被广泛使用的softmax参数化可能导致病态的优化局面，并导致指数级别的缓慢收敛。 虽然可以通过预处理来缓解这个问题，但这种方法通常计算成本很高。 相反，我们建议用基于广义f-softargmax的策略参数化的替代族来代替softmax。我们进一步提倡将这种参数化与由相同的f-散度引起的正则化项耦合，这改善了优化局面，并确保得到的正则化目标满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz不等式。 基于这种结构，我们首次为有限马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的随机策略梯度方法建立了显式的非渐近最后迭代收敛保证，且无需任何形式的预处理。 我们还推导出未正则化问题的样本复杂度界限，并表明使用Tsallis散度的f-PG实现了多项式样本复杂度，这与标准softmax参数化所带来的指数复杂度形成对比。
tldr: This paper proposes a new policy parameterization using f-softargmax with coupled regularization for policy gradient methods, achieving non-asymptotic convergence guarantees and polynomial sample complexity in finite MDPs without preconditioning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的策略参数化方法，采用f-softargmax与耦合正则化，用于策略梯度方法，实现了有限MDP中非渐近收敛保证和多项式样本复杂度，无需预处理。

title: Active Informative Planning for UAV-based Weed Mapping using Discrete Gaussian Process Representations
summary: Accurate agricultural weed mapping using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is crucial for precision farming. While traditional methods rely on rigid, pre-defined flight paths and intensive offline processing, informative path planning (IPP) offers a way to collect data adaptively where it is most needed. Gaussian process (GP) mapping provides a continuous model of weed distribution with built-in uncertainty. However, GPs must be discretised for practical use in autonomous planning. Many discretisation techniques exist, but the impact of discrete representation choice remains poorly understood. This paper investigates how different discrete GP representations influence both mapping quality and mission-level performance in UAV-based weed mapping. Considering a UAV equipped with a downward-facing camera, we implement a receding-horizon IPP strategy that selects sampling locations based on the map uncertainty, travel cost, and coverage penalties. We investigate multiple discretisation strategies for representing the GP posterior and use their induced map partitions to generate candidate viewpoints for planning. Experiments on real-world weed distributions show that representation choice significantly affects exploration behaviour and efficiency. Overall, our results demonstrate that discretisation is not only a representational detail but a key design choice that shapes planning dynamics, coverage efficiency, and computational load in online UAV weed mapping.
summary_zh: 使用无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）进行精准的农业杂草测绘对于精准农业至关重要。传统的测绘方法依赖于固定的、预先规划好的飞行路径和大量的离线处理，而信息路径规划（IPP）提供了一种自适应的数据采集方式，可在最需要的地方采集数据。高斯过程（GP）测绘提供了一个具有内在不确定性的杂草分布的连续模型。然而，为了在自主规划中实际应用，必须对高斯过程进行离散化。存在多种离散化技术，但离散化表示选择的影响仍然知之甚少。本文研究了不同的离散化高斯过程表示如何影响基于无人机的杂草测绘中的测绘质量和任务层面的性能。考虑到配备向下摄像头的无人机，我们实施了一种基于后退视界的信息路径规划策略，该策略根据地图的不确定性、行驶成本和覆盖惩罚来选择采样位置。我们研究了多种离散化策略来表示高斯过程后验，并使用它们诱导的地图分区来生成用于规划的候选视点。在真实杂草分布上的实验表明，表示选择显著影响探索行为和效率。总的来说，我们的结果表明，离散化不仅是一个表示细节，而且是在线无人机杂草测绘中影响规划动态、覆盖效率和计算负载的关键设计选择。
tldr: This paper explores the impact of different discrete Gaussian Process (GP) representations on UAV-based weed mapping performance using informative path planning. Results show that discretisation choice significantly affects exploration, efficiency, and computational load.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了不同离散高斯过程(GP)表示对基于无人机的杂草测绘性能的影响，使用信息路径规划。结果表明，离散化选择会显著影响探索、效率和计算负载。

title: Helical Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot with Programmable Follow-the-Leader Operation
summary: Spinal cord stimulation (SCS) is primarily utilized for pain management and has recently demonstrated efficacy in promoting functional recovery in patients with spinal cord injury. Effective stimulation of motor neurons ideally requires the placement of SCS leads in the ventral or lateral epidural space where the corticospinal and rubrospinal motor fibers are located. This poses significant challenges with the current standard of manual steering. In this study, we present a static modeling approach for the ExoNav, a steerable robotic tool designed to facilitate precise navigation to the ventral and lateral epidural space. Cosserat rod framework is employed to establish the relationship between tendon actuation forces and the robot's overall shape. The effects of gravity, as an example of an external load, are investigated and implemented in the model and simulation. The experimental results indicate RMSE values of 1.76mm, 2.33mm, 2.18mm, and 1.33mm across four tested prototypes. Based on the helical shape of the ExoNav upon actuation, it is capable of performing follow-the-leader (FTL) motion by adding insertion and rotation DoFs to this robotic system, which is shown in simulation and experimentally. The proposed simulation has the capability to calculate optimum tendon tensions to follow the desired FTL paths while gravity-induced robot deformations are present. Three FTL experimental trials are conducted and the end-effector position showed repeatable alignments with the desired path with maximum RMSE value of 3.75mm. Ultimately, a phantom model demonstration is conducted where the teleoperated robot successfully navigated to the lateral and ventral spinal cord targets. Additionally, the user was able to navigate to the dorsal root ganglia, illustrating ExoNav's potential in both motor function recovery and pain management.
summary_zh: 脊髓刺激（SCS）主要用于疼痛管理，并且最近已证明在促进脊髓损伤患者的功能恢复方面具有疗效。对运动神经元的有效刺激理想情况下需要将SCS电极导线放置在皮质脊髓和红核脊髓运动纤维所在的腹侧或外侧硬膜外腔。 这对目前的手动引导标准提出了重大挑战。 在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于ExoNav的静态建模方法，ExoNav是一种可转向的机器人工具，旨在促进精确导航到腹侧和外侧硬膜外腔。 采用Cosserat杆框架来建立肌腱驱动力与机器人整体形状之间的关系。研究并模拟了重力作为一种外部载荷的影响。实验结果表明，在四个测试原型中，RMSE值分别为1.76mm、2.33mm、2.18mm和1.33mm。 基于ExoNav在驱动时的螺旋形状，通过向该机器人系统添加插入和旋转自由度，使其能够执行跟随者（FTL）运动，这在仿真和实验中均已展示。所提出的仿真能够计算出最佳肌腱张力，以在存在重力引起的机器人变形的情况下，遵循所需的FTL路径。进行了三次FTL实验试验，末端执行器的位置显示出与所需路径的可重复对准，最大RMSE值为3.75mm。最终，进行了一个幻影模型演示，其中远程操作的机器人成功导航到外侧和腹侧脊髓靶点。此外，用户还能够导航到背根神经节，这表明ExoNav在运动功能恢复和疼痛管理方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a helical tendon-driven continuum robot (ExoNav) for precise navigation in spinal cord stimulation, demonstrating its capability for follow-the-leader motion and successful navigation to target locations in a phantom model, indicating potential for applications in both motor function recovery and pain management.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于脊髓刺激的螺旋式腱驱动连续体机器人 (ExoNav)，展示了其 follow-the-leader 运动能力，并在体模中成功导航至目标位置，表明其在运动功能恢复和疼痛管理方面具有潜在应用。

title: Exploiting Light To Enhance The Endurance and Navigation of Lighter-Than-Air Micro-Drones
summary:
Micro-Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are rapidly expanding into tasks from inventory to environmental sensing, yet their short endurance and unreliable navigation in GPS-denied spaces limit deployment. Lighter-Than-Air (LTA) drones offer an energy-efficient alternative: they use a helium envelope to provide buoyancy, which enables near-zero-power drain during hovering and much longer operation. LTAs are promising, but their design is complex, and they lack integrated solutions to enable sustained autonomous operations and navigation with simple, low-infrastructure.
  We propose a compact, self-sustaining LTA drone that uses light for both energy harvesting and navigation. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a high-fidelity simulation framework to analyze LTA aerodynamics and select a stable, efficient configuration; (ii) a framework to integrate solar cells on the envelope to provide net-positive energy; and (iii) a point-and-go navigation system with three light-seeking algorithms operating on a single light beacon.
  Our LTA-analysis, together with the integrated solar panels, not only saves energy while flying, but also enables sustainable operation: providing 1 minute of flying time for every 4 minutes of energy harvesting, under illuminations of 80klux. We also demonstrate robust single-beacon navigation towards a light source that can be up to 7m away, in indoor and outdoor environments, even with moderate winds. The resulting system indicates a plausible path toward persistent, autonomous operation for indoor and outdoor monitoring. More broadly, this work provides a practical pathway for translating the promise of LTA drones into a persistent, self-sustaining aerial system.
summary_zh:
微型无人机（UAV）正迅速扩展到从库存管理到环境感知等任务中，但其续航时间短和在无GPS环境下不可靠的导航限制了部署。轻于空气（LTA）无人机提供了一种节能的替代方案：它们使用氦气囊提供浮力，从而在悬停期间实现接近零功耗，并实现更长的运行时间。LTA无人机前景广阔，但其设计复杂，并且缺乏集成解决方案，以实现具有简单、低基础设施的可持续自主运行和导航。

我们提出了一种紧凑的、自给自足的LTA无人机，它利用光进行能量收集和导航。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）一个高保真仿真框架，用于分析LTA空气动力学并选择稳定、高效的配置；（ii）一个用于在气囊上集成太阳能电池以提供净正能量的框架；以及（iii）一个基于单个光信标，运行三种寻光算法的指点即走导航系统。

我们的LTA分析，以及集成的太阳能板，不仅在飞行时节省能源，而且实现了可持续运行：在80千勒克斯照度下，每能量收集4分钟，即可提供1分钟的飞行时间。我们还展示了在室内和室外环境中，即使在适度风力下，也能稳定地进行单信标导航，朝向最远7米的光源。由此产生的系统表明，为室内和室外监控实现持久、自主运行存在一条可行的途径。更广泛地说，这项工作为将LTA无人机的潜力转化为持久、自给自足的空中系统提供了一条切实可行的途径。
tldr: This paper presents a self-sustaining lighter-than-air micro drone that uses light for both energy harvesting and navigation, demonstrating persistent autonomous operation for indoor and outdoor monitoring.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自持式轻于空气的微型无人机，该无人机利用光进行能量收集和导航，展示了在室内和室外环境进行持久自主运行的能力。

title: Enabling High-Curvature Navigation in Eversion Robots through Buckle-Inducing Constrictive Bands
summary: Tip-growing eversion robots are renowned for their ability to access remote spaces through narrow passages. However, achieving reliable navigation remains a significant challenge. Existing solutions often rely on artificial muscles integrated into the robot body or active tip-steering mechanisms. While effective, these additions introduce structural complexity and compromise the defining advantages of eversion robots: their inherent softness and compliance. In this paper, we propose a passive approach to reduce bending stiffness by purposefully introducing buckling points along the robot's outer wall. We achieve this by integrating inextensible diameter-reducing circumferential bands at regular intervals along the robot body facilitating forward motion through tortuous, obstacle cluttered paths. Rather than relying on active steering, our approach leverages the robot's natural interaction with the environment, allowing for smooth, compliant navigation. We present a Cosserat rod-based mathematical model to quantify this behavior, capturing the local stiffness reductions caused by the constricting bands and their impact on global bending mechanics. Experimental results demonstrate that these bands reduce the robot's stiffness when bent at the tip by up to 91 percent, enabling consistent traversal of 180 degree bends with a bending radius of as low as 25 mm-notably lower than the 35 mm achievable by standard eversion robots under identical conditions. The feasibility of the proposed method is further demonstrated through a case study in a colon phantom. By significantly improving maneuverability without sacrificing softness or increasing mechanical complexity, this approach expands the applicability of eversion robots in highly curved pathways, whether in relation to pipe inspection or medical procedures such as colonoscopy.
summary_zh: 顶端生长外翻机器人因其能够通过狭窄通道进入偏远空间而闻名。然而，实现可靠导航仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的解决方案通常依赖于集成到机器人机身中的人造肌肉或主动顶端转向机制。虽然这些方法有效，但同时也引入了结构复杂性，并影响了外翻机器人最主要的优势：其固有的柔软性和顺应性。在本文中，我们提出了一种被动方法，通过在机器人外壁上有目的地引入屈曲点来降低弯曲刚度。我们通过沿机器人机身以规则间隔集成不可伸缩的直径减小环形带来实现这一目的，从而促进在蜿蜒的、障碍物杂乱的路径中向前运动。我们的方法不依赖于主动转向，而是利用机器人与环境的自然交互，实现平稳、顺应的导航。我们提出了一个基于Cosserat杆的数学模型来量化这种行为，捕捉由收缩带引起的局部刚度降低及其对全局弯曲力学的影响。实验结果表明，这些环形带在顶端弯曲时可将机器人的刚度降低高达91%，从而能够在半径低至25毫米的180度弯曲处稳定通过，明显低于标准外翻机器人在相同条件下可实现的35毫米。通过在结肠模型中的案例研究，进一步验证了所提出方法的可行性。通过在不牺牲柔软度或增加机械复杂性的情况下显著提高机动性，这种方法扩展了外翻机器人在高度弯曲路径中的适用性，无论是在管道检测还是结肠镜检查等医疗程序方面。
tldr: The paper introduces a passive method using constrictive bands to improve the navigation of eversion robots in high-curvature environments by reducing bending stiffness, demonstrating improved maneuverability without compromising softness or increasing complexity.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种被动方法，通过使用收缩带降低弯曲刚度，从而提高翻转机器人在高曲率环境中的导航能力。实验表明，这种方法在不牺牲柔性和增加复杂性的前提下，提高了机器人的机动性。

title: Cognition spaces: natural, artificial, and hybrid
summary: Cognitive processes are realized across an extraordinary range of natural, artificial, and hybrid systems, yet there is no unified framework for comparing their forms, limits, and unrealized possibilities. Here, we propose a cognition space approach that replaces narrow, substrate-dependent definitions with a comparative representation based on organizational and informational dimensions. Within this framework, cognition is treated as a graded capacity to sense, process, and act upon information, allowing systems as diverse as cells, brains, artificial agents, and human-AI collectives to be analyzed within a common conceptual landscape. We introduce and examine three cognition spaces -- basal aneural, neural, and human-AI hybrid -- and show that their occupation is highly uneven, with clusters of realized systems separated by large unoccupied regions. We argue that these voids are not accidental but reflect evolutionary contingencies, physical constraints, and design limitations. By focusing on the structure of cognition spaces rather than on categorical definitions, this approach clarifies the diversity of existing cognitive systems and highlights hybrid cognition as a promising frontier for exploring novel forms of complexity beyond those produced by biological evolution.
summary_zh: 认知过程存在于范围广泛的自然、人工和混合系统中，但目前缺乏统一的框架来比较它们的形式、局限性和未实现的潜力。本文提出一种认知空间方法，用基于组织和信息维度的比较性表征取代狭隘的、依赖于基质的定义。在这个框架内，认知被视为一种分级的能力，即感知、处理信息并采取行动，从而允许对诸如细胞、大脑、人工智能体和人机协作等不同系统在共同的概念图景中进行分析。我们介绍并检验了三种认知空间——基础性的无神经认知空间、神经认知空间和人机混合认知空间，并表明它们的使用高度不均匀，已实现的系统集群被大量未占据的区域所分隔。我们认为，这些空白并非偶然，而是反映了进化偶然性、物理约束和设计限制。通过关注认知空间的结构，而不是绝对的定义，这种方法阐明了现有认知系统的多样性，并强调混合认知是探索超越生物进化所产生的新型复杂性的一个有希望的前沿领域。
tldr: The paper proposes a 'cognition space' framework for comparing cognitive systems across natural, artificial, and hybrid domains, aiming to identify unrealized cognitive possibilities and highlight the potential of hybrid cognition.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个“认知空间”框架，用于比较自然、人工和混合领域的认知系统，旨在识别未实现的认知可能性并强调混合认知的潜力。

title: Empowering All-in-Loop Health Management of Spacecraft Power System in the Mega-Constellation Era via Human-AI Collaboration
summary: It is foreseeable that the number of spacecraft will increase exponentially, ushering in an era dominated by satellite mega-constellations (SMC). This necessitates a focus on energy in space: spacecraft power systems (SPS), especially their health management (HM), given their role in power supply and high failure rates. Providing health management for dozens of SPS and for thousands of SPS represents two fundamentally different paradigms. Therefore, to adapt the health management in the SMC era, this work proposes a principle of aligning underlying capabilities (AUC principle) and develops SpaceHMchat, an open-source Human-AI collaboration (HAIC) framework for all-in-loop health management (AIL HM). SpaceHMchat serves across the entire loop of work condition recognition, anomaly detection, fault localization, and maintenance decision making, achieving goals such as conversational task completion, adaptive human-in-the-loop learning, personnel structure optimization, knowledge sharing, efficiency enhancement, as well as transparent reasoning and improved interpretability. Meanwhile, to validate this exploration, a hardware-realistic fault injection experimental platform is established, and its simulation model is built and open-sourced, both fully replicating the real SPS. The corresponding experimental results demonstrate that SpaceHMchat achieves excellent performance across 23 quantitative metrics, such as 100% conclusion accuracy in logical reasoning of work condition recognition, over 99% success rate in anomaly detection tool invocation, over 90% precision in fault localization, and knowledge base search time under 3 minutes in maintenance decision-making. Another contribution of this work is the release of the first-ever AIL HM dataset of SPS. This dataset contains four sub-datasets, involving 4 types of AIL HM sub-tasks, 17 types of faults, and over 700,000 timestamps.
summary_zh: 可以预见的是，航天器数量将呈指数级增长，迎来一个卫星巨型星座（SMC）主导的时代。这使得人们必须关注太空中的能量：航天器电源系统（SPS），尤其是它们的健康管理（HM），考虑到它们在电力供应中的作用以及较高的故障率。为数十个SPS提供健康管理和为数千个SPS提供健康管理代表着两种根本不同的范式。因此，为了适应SMC时代的健康管理，这项工作提出了一种对齐底层能力（AUC原则）的原则，并开发了SpaceHMchat，一个用于全环路健康管理（AIL HM）的开源人机协作（HAIC）框架。SpaceHMchat服务于工作状态识别、异常检测、故障定位和维护决策的整个环路，实现了诸如会话式任务完成、自适应人机循环学习、人员结构优化、知识共享、效率提升，以及透明推理和提高可解释性等目标。同时，为了验证这项探索，建立了一个硬件真实的故障注入实验平台，并构建并开源了其仿真模型，两者都完全复制了真实的SPS。相应的实验结果表明，SpaceHMchat在23个定量指标上取得了优异的性能，例如在工作状态识别的逻辑推理中达到100%的结论准确率，在异常检测工具调用中超过99%的成功率，在故障定位中超过90%的精度，以及在维护决策中知识库搜索时间低于3分钟。这项工作的另一项贡献是发布了首个SPS的AIL HM数据集。该数据集包含四个子数据集，涉及4种AIL HM子任务、17种故障和超过70万个时间戳。
tldr: This paper introduces SpaceHMchat, a Human-AI collaboration framework for all-in-loop health management of spacecraft power systems, validated with a realistic experimental platform and a new dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍SpaceHMchat，一个用于航天器电力系统全闭环健康管理的人工智能协同框架，并通过真实的实验平台和新数据集进行了验证。

title: ICo3D: An Interactive Conversational 3D Virtual Human
summary: This work presents Interactive Conversational 3D Virtual Human (ICo3D), a method for generating an interactive, conversational, and photorealistic 3D human avatar. Based on multi-view captures of a subject, we create an animatable 3D face model and a dynamic 3D body model, both rendered by splatting Gaussian primitives. Once merged together, they represent a lifelike virtual human avatar suitable for real-time user interactions. We equip our avatar with an LLM for conversational ability. During conversation, the audio speech of the avatar is used as a driving signal to animate the face model, enabling precise synchronization. We describe improvements to our dynamic Gaussian models that enhance photorealism: SWinGS++ for body reconstruction and HeadGaS++ for face reconstruction, and provide as well a solution to merge the separate face and body models without artifacts. We also present a demo of the complete system, showcasing several use cases of real-time conversation with the 3D avatar. Our approach offers a fully integrated virtual avatar experience, supporting both oral and written form interactions in immersive environments. ICo3D is applicable to a wide range of fields, including gaming, virtual assistance, and personalized education, among others. Project page: https://ico3d.github.io/
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种交互式对话式3D虚拟人(ICo3D)方法，用于生成一个交互式的、对话式的、以及照片级真实的3D人类化身。基于对象的多视角捕捉，我们创建了一个可动画的3D面部模型和一个动态的3D身体模型，两者都通过splatting高斯基元进行渲染。一旦合并，它们就代表了一个逼真的虚拟人类化身，适用于实时用户交互。我们为化身配备了一个LLM以实现对话能力。在对话过程中，化身语音被用作驱动信号，用于对面部模型进行动画处理，实现精确同步。我们描述了对动态高斯模型的改进，以增强照片真实感：用于身体重建的SWinGS++和用于面部重建的HeadGaS++，并提供了一种解决方案，可以无伪影地合并单独的面部和身体模型。我们还展示了完整系统的演示，展示了与3D化身进行实时对话的几种用例。我们的方法提供了一种完全集成的虚拟化身体验，支持沉浸式环境中口头和书面形式的交互。ICo3D适用于广泛的领域，包括游戏、虚拟助手和个性化教育等。项目页面：https://ico3d.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces ICo3D, a method for creating interactive, conversational, photorealistic 3D human avatars using Gaussian primitives, LLMs, and audio-driven facial animation, offering a fully integrated virtual avatar experience.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 ICo3D，一种使用高斯基元、LLM和音频驱动的面部动画创建交互式、对话式、逼真的 3D 人体头像的方法，提供完全集成的虚拟头像体验。

title: AsyncBEV: Cross-modal Flow Alignment in Asynchronous 3D Object Detection
summary: In autonomous driving, multi-modal perception tasks like 3D object detection typically rely on well-synchronized sensors, both at training and inference. However, despite the use of hardware- or software-based synchronization algorithms, perfect synchrony is rarely guaranteed: Sensors may operate at different frequencies, and real-world factors such as network latency, hardware failures, or processing bottlenecks often introduce time offsets between sensors. Such asynchrony degrades perception performance, especially for dynamic objects. To address this challenge, we propose AsyncBEV, a trainable lightweight and generic module to improve the robustness of 3D Birds' Eye View (BEV) object detection models against sensor asynchrony. Inspired by scene flow estimation, AsyncBEV first estimates the 2D flow from the BEV features of two different sensor modalities, taking into account the known time offset between these sensor measurements. The predicted feature flow is then used to warp and spatially align the feature maps, which we show can easily be integrated into different current BEV detector architectures (e.g., BEV grid-based and token-based). Extensive experiments demonstrate AsyncBEV improves robustness against both small and large asynchrony between LiDAR or camera sensors in both the token-based CMT and grid-based UniBEV, especially for dynamic objects. We significantly outperform the ego motion compensated CMT and UniBEV baselines, notably by $16.6$ % and $11.9$ % NDS on dynamic objects in the worst-case scenario of a $0.5 s$ time offset. Code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶中，诸如3D目标检测等的多模态感知任务通常依赖于训练和推理阶段都良好同步的传感器。然而，尽管使用了基于硬件或软件的同步算法，但完美的同步很少能得到保证：传感器可能以不同的频率运行，并且诸如网络延迟、硬件故障或处理瓶颈等现实因素通常会在传感器之间引入时间偏移。这种异步性会降低感知性能，特别是对于动态目标。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种可训练的轻量级通用模块AsyncBEV，以提高3D鸟瞰图（BEV）目标检测模型对传感器异步性的鲁棒性。受到场景流估计的启发，AsyncBEV首先估计来自两种不同传感器模态的BEV特征的2D光流，同时考虑了这些传感器测量之间已知的时间偏移。预测的特征光流随后被用于扭曲和空间对齐特征图，我们展示了它可以很容易地集成到不同的现有BEV检测器架构中（例如，基于BEV网格和基于token的架构）。大量的实验表明，AsyncBEV提高了基于token的CMT和基于网格的UniBEV对LiDAR或相机传感器之间小到大异步性的鲁棒性，特别是对于动态目标。我们显著优于自我运动补偿的CMT和UniBEV基线，尤其是在0.5秒时间偏移的最坏情况下，动态目标的NDS分别提高了16.6%和11.9%。代码将在录用后发布。
tldr: AsyncBEV addresses performance degradation in 3D object detection caused by sensor asynchrony by introducing a trainable module that estimates and warps feature flows between modalities, demonstrating significant improvements over baselines, especially for dynamic objects.
tldr_zh: AsyncBEV 提出了一种可训练的模块AsyncBEV，通过估计和扭曲不同模态之间的特征流来解决传感器异步导致的三维物体检测性能下降问题，并在动态物体上表现出显著的改进。

title: Near-Light Color Photometric Stereo for mono-Chromaticity non-lambertian surface
summary: Color photometric stereo enables single-shot surface reconstruction, extending conventional photometric stereo that requires multiple images of a static scene under varying illumination to dynamic scenarios. However, most existing approaches assume ideal distant lighting and Lambertian reflectance, leaving more practical near-light conditions and non-Lambertian surfaces underexplored. To overcome this limitation, we propose a framework that leverages neural implicit representations for depth and BRDF modeling under the assumption of mono-chromaticity (uniform chromaticity and homogeneous material), which alleviates the inherent ill-posedness of color photometric stereo and allows for detailed surface recovery from just one image. Furthermore, we design a compact optical tactile sensor to validate our approach. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method achieves accurate and robust surface reconstruction.
summary_zh: 彩色光度立体视觉实现了单幅图像的表面重建，扩展了传统光度立体视觉的应用范围，使之能从需要多幅不同光照下静态场景图像的重建转化为动态场景下的重建。 然而，大多数现有方法都假设理想的远场照明和Lambertian反射模型，使得更实用的近场光照条件和非Lambertian表面未被充分探索。 为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了一种框架，该框架利用神经隐式表示来进行深度和BRDF建模，并假设单色性（均匀色度和均质材料），从而减轻了彩色光度立体视觉固有的不适定性， 并允许仅从一张图像中恢复详细的表面信息。此外，我们设计了一个紧凑型光学触觉传感器来验证我们的方法。在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法实现了精确且鲁棒的表面重建。
tldr: This paper introduces a neural implicit representation framework for single-shot surface reconstruction under near-light conditions and non-Lambertian surfaces, using a compact optical tactile sensor for validation. It advances color photometric stereo by addressing limitations of ideal distant lighting and Lambertian reflectance assumptions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个神经隐式表示框架，用于在近距离光照和非朗伯表面下进行单次拍摄的表面重建，并使用紧凑的光学触觉传感器进行验证。它通过解决理想远距离光照和朗伯反射假设的局限性，推进了彩色光度立体技术。

title: HERMES: A Unified Open-Source Framework for Realtime Multimodal Physiological Sensing, Edge AI, and Intervention in Closed-Loop Smart Healthcare Applications
summary: Intelligent assistive technologies are increasingly recognized as critical daily-use enablers for people with disabilities and age-related functional decline. Longitudinal studies, curation of quality datasets, live monitoring in activities of daily living, and intelligent intervention devices, share the largely unsolved need in reliable high-throughput multimodal sensing and processing. Streaming large heterogeneous data from distributed sensors, historically closed-source environments, and limited prior works on realtime closed-loop AI methodologies, inhibit such applications. To accelerate the emergence of clinical deployments, we deliver HERMES - an open-source high-performance Python framework for continuous multimodal sensing and AI processing at the edge. It enables synchronized data collection, and realtime streaming inference with user PyTorch models, on commodity computing devices. HERMES is applicable to fixed-lab and free-living environments, of distributed commercial and custom sensors. It is the first work to offer a holistic methodology that bridges cross-disciplinary gaps in real-world implementation strategies, and guides downstream AI model development. Its application on the closed-loop intelligent prosthesis use case illustrates the process of suitable AI model development from the generated constraints and trade-offs. Validation on the use case, with 4 synchronized hosts cooperatively capturing 18 wearable and off-body modalities, demonstrates performance and relevance of HERMES to the trajectory of the intelligent healthcare domain.
summary_zh: 智能辅助技术正日益被认为是残疾人和与年龄相关的机能衰退人群日常生活中至关重要的赋能工具。纵向研究、高质量数据集的管理、日常生活活动中的实时监测以及智能干预设备，都面临着一个尚未解决的共同需求：可靠的高通量多模态传感和处理。来自分布式传感器的大型异构数据流、历史上的封闭源代码环境以及关于实时闭环人工智能方法论的有限先前工作，阻碍了此类应用。为加速临床部署的出现，我们发布HERMES——一个开源的高性能Python框架，用于边缘端的连续多模态传感和人工智能处理。它能够在商用计算设备上实现同步数据采集，以及利用用户PyTorch模型进行实时流式推理。HERMES适用于固定实验室和自由生活环境，可支持分布式商业和定制传感器。它是首个提供整体方法论的工作，弥合了现实实施策略中的跨学科差距，并指导下游人工智能模型的开发。在闭环智能假肢用例中的应用，展示了从生成的约束和权衡中开发合适人工智能模型的过程。在该用例上的验证，通过4个同步主机协同捕获18种可穿戴和离体模态的数据，证明了HERMES在智能医疗保健领域的发展轨迹上的性能和相关性。
tldr: The paper introduces HERMES, an open-source Python framework for real-time multimodal sensing and edge AI processing in smart healthcare, designed to accelerate clinical deployments of intelligent assistive technologies.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为HERMES的开源Python框架，用于智能医疗保健中的实时多模态传感和边缘AI处理，旨在加速智能辅助技术的临床部署。

title: Press Start to Charge: Videogaming the Online Centralized Charging Scheduling Problem
summary: We study the online centralized charging scheduling problem (OCCSP). In this problem, a central authority must decide, in real time, when to charge dynamically arriving electric vehicles (EVs), subject to capacity limits, with the objective of balancing load across a finite planning horizon. To solve the problem, we first gamify it; that is, we model it as a game where charging blocks are placed within temporal and capacity constraints on a grid. We design heuristic policies, train learning agents with expert demonstrations, and improve them using Dataset Aggregation (DAgger). From a theoretical standpoint, we show that gamification reduces model complexity and yields tighter generalization bounds than vector-based formulations. Experiments across multiple EV arrival patterns confirm that gamified learning enhances load balancing. In particular, the image-to-movement model trained with DAgger consistently outperforms heuristic baselines, vector-based approaches, and supervised learning agents, while also demonstrating robustness in sensitivity analyses. These operational gains translate into tangible economic value. In a real-world case study for the Greater Montréal Area (Québec, Canada) using utility cost data, the proposed methods lower system costs by tens of millions of dollars per year over the prevailing practice and show clear potential to delay costly grid upgrades.
summary_zh: 我们研究在线集中式充电调度问题（OCCSP）。在该问题中，中央机构必须实时决定何时为动态到达的电动汽车（EV）充电，同时受到容量限制，目标是在有限的规划范围内平衡负荷。为解决该问题，我们首先对其进行博弈化；也就是说，我们将其建模为一个博弈，其中充电块在网格的时域和容量约束内放置。我们设计启发式策略，利用专家演示训练学习代理，并使用数据集聚合（DAgger）改进它们。从理论角度来看，我们证明了博弈化能够降低模型复杂度，并产生比基于向量的公式更紧密的泛化界限。跨多种电动汽车到达模式的实验证实，博弈化学习能够增强负荷平衡。特别是，使用DAgger训练的图像到动作模型始终优于启发式基线、基于向量的方法和监督学习代理，同时在敏感性分析中也表现出稳健性。这些运营收益转化为切实的经济价值。在大蒙特利尔地区（加拿大魁北克省）使用公用事业成本数据的真实案例研究中，所提出的方法比当前实践每年降低数千万美元的系统成本，并显示出延迟昂贵电网升级的明显潜力。
tldr: This paper tackles the online electric vehicle charging scheduling problem by gamifying it and training reinforcement learning agents with expert demonstrations, achieving significant cost savings in a real-world case study.
tldr_zh: 本文通过游戏化方法并用专家演示训练强化学习智能体，解决了在线电动汽车充电调度问题，并在实际案例研究中实现了显著的成本节省。

title: Learning Relativistic Geodesics and Chaotic Dynamics via Stabilized Lagrangian Neural Networks
summary: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) can learn arbitrary Lagrangians from trajectory data, but their unusual optimization objective leads to significant training instabilities that limit their application to complex systems. We propose several improvements that address these fundamental challenges, namely, a Hessian regularization scheme that penalizes unphysical signatures in the Lagrangian's second derivatives with respect to velocities, preventing the network from learning unstable dynamics, activation functions that are better suited to the problem of learning Lagrangians, and a physics-aware coordinate scaling that improves stability. We systematically evaluate these techniques alongside previously proposed methods for improving stability. Our improved architecture successfully trains on systems of unprecedented complexity, including triple pendulums, and achieved 96.6\% lower validation loss value and 90.68\% better stability than baseline LNNs in double pendulum systems. With the improved framework, we show that our LNNs can learn Lagrangians representing geodesic motion in both non-relativistic and general relativistic settings.
