To deal with the relativistic setting, we extended our regularization to penalize violations of Lorentzian signatures, which allowed us to predict a geodesic Lagrangian under AdS\textsubscript{4} spacetime metric directly from trajectory data, which to our knowledge has not been done in the literature before. This opens new possibilities for automated discovery of geometric structures in physics, including extraction of spacetime metric tensor components from geodesic trajectories. While our approach inherits some limitations of the original LNN framework, particularly the requirement for invertible Hessians, it significantly expands the practical applicability of LNNs for scientific discovery tasks.
summary_zh: 拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）可以从轨迹数据中学习任意拉格朗日量，但其不寻常的优化目标会导致显著的训练不稳定性，从而限制了它们在复杂系统中的应用。我们提出了几个改进方案来解决这些根本性的挑战，即：一种Hessian正则化方案，用于惩罚拉格朗日量关于速度的二阶导数中不符合物理规律的特征，从而防止网络学习不稳定的动力学；更适合于学习拉格朗日量的激活函数；以及一种提高稳定性的物理感知坐标缩放。我们系统地评估了这些技术，以及先前提出的用于提高稳定性的方法。改进后的架构成功地训练了前所未有的复杂系统，包括三重摆，并在双摆系统中实现了比基线LNN低96.6%的验证损失值和高90.68%的稳定性。借助改进的框架，我们表明我们的LNN可以学习表示非相对论和广义相对论环境中测地运动的拉格朗日量。为了处理相对论环境，我们扩展了我们的正则化以惩罚Lorentzian特征的违反，这使我们能够直接从轨迹数据中预测AdS\textsubscript{4}时空度规下的测地线拉格朗日量，据我们所知，这在文献中是前所未有的。这为物理学中几何结构的自动发现开辟了新的可能性，包括从测地线轨迹中提取时空度规张量分量。虽然我们的方法继承了原始LNN框架的一些限制，特别是对可逆Hessian矩阵的要求，但它极大地扩展了LNNs在科学发现任务中的实际适用性。
tldr: The paper presents improvements to Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) to address training instabilities, enabling them to learn Lagrangians for complex systems, including relativistic geodesics, opening possibilities for discovering geometric structures in physics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出对拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）的改进，以解决训练不稳定性问题，使其能够学习复杂系统的拉格朗日量，包括相对论测地线，为发现物理学中的几何结构开辟了可能性。

title: From Design to Deorbit: A Solar-Electric Autonomous Module for Multi-Debris Remediation
summary: The escalating accumulation of orbital debris threatens the sustainability of space operations, necessitating active removal solutions that overcome the limitations of current fuel-dependent methods. To address this, this study introduces a novel remediation architecture that integrates a mechanical clamping system for secure capture with a high-efficiency, solar-powered NASA Evolutionary Xenon Thruster (NEXT) and autonomous navigation protocols. High-fidelity simulations validate the architecture's capabilities, demonstrating a successful retrograde deorbit from 800 km to 100 km, <10m position Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) via radar-based Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) navigation, and a 93\% data delivery efficiency within 1 second using Delay/Disruption Tolerant Network (DTN) protocols. This approach significantly advances orbital management by establishing a benchmark for renewable solar propulsion that minimizes reliance on conventional fuels and extends mission longevity for multi-target removal.
summary_zh: 轨道碎片日益积累对空间活动的可持续性构成威胁，因此迫切需要主动移除方案来克服当前依赖燃料方法的局限性。为了解决这个问题，本研究提出了一种新颖的移除架构，该架构集成了用于安全捕获的机械夹紧系统、高效的太阳能驱动的NASA进化型氙气推进器 (NEXT) 以及自主导航协议。高保真度的仿真验证了该架构的能力，证明了其成功实现了从800公里到100公里的逆行轨道降低，通过基于雷达的扩展卡尔曼滤波 (EKF) 导航实现小于10米的位置均方根误差 (RMSE)，以及使用延迟/中断容忍网络 (DTN) 协议在1秒内达到93%的数据传输效率。这种方法通过建立可再生太阳能推进的基准，最大限度地减少对传统燃料的依赖，延长多目标移除的任务寿命，从而显著推进了轨道管理。
tldr: This paper introduces an autonomous, solar-electric powered module for multi-debris removal, demonstrating its capabilities via high-fidelity simulations and achieving successful deorbiting and navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种自主的太阳能电力驱动模块，用于清除多个轨道碎片。 通过高保真仿真展示了其能力，并成功实现了脱轨和导航。

title: TinyML-Enabled IoT for Sustainable Precision Irrigation
summary: Small-scale farming communities are disproportionately affected by water scarcity, erratic climate patterns, and a lack of access to advanced, affordable agricultural technologies. To address these challenges, this paper presents a novel, edge-first IoT framework that integrates Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) for intelligent, offline-capable precision irrigation. The proposed four-layer architecture leverages low-cost hardware, an ESP32 microcontroller as an edge inference node, and a Raspberry Pi as a local edge server to enable autonomous decision-making without cloud dependency. The system utilizes capacitive soil moisture, temperature, humidity, pH, and ambient light sensors for environmental monitoring. A rigorous comparative analysis of ensemble models identified gradient boosting as superior, achieving an R^2 score of 0.9973 and a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 0.99%, outperforming a random forest model (R^2 = 0.9916, MAPE = 1.81%). This optimized model was converted and deployed as a lightweight TinyML inference engine on the ESP32 and predicts irrigation needs with exceptional accuracy (MAPE < 1%). Local communication is facilitated by an MQTT-based LAN protocol, ensuring reliable operation in areas with limited or no internet connectivity. Experimental validation in a controlled environment demonstrated a significant reduction in water usage compared to traditional methods, while the system's low-power design and offline functionality confirm its viability for sustainable, scalable deployment in resource-constrained rural settings. This work provides a practical, cost-effective blueprint for bridging the technological divide in agriculture and enhancing water-use efficiency through on-device artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 小规模农业社区不成比例地受到缺水、不稳定气候模式以及缺乏先进且经济实惠的农业技术的影响。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种新型的、边缘优先的物联网框架，该框架集成了微型机器学习（TinyML），用于智能的、离线能力的精准灌溉。所提出的四层架构利用低成本硬件、以ESP32微控制器作为边缘推理节点，以及以Raspberry Pi作为本地边缘服务器，从而能够在无需云依赖的情况下实现自主决策。该系统利用电容式土壤湿度、温度、湿度、pH和环境光传感器进行环境监测。对集成模型进行严格的比较分析表明，梯度提升算法表现更优，实现了0.9973的R^2评分和0.99%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），优于随机森林模型（R^2 = 0.9916，MAPE = 1.81%）。该优化模型被转换并部署为ESP32上的轻量级TinyML推理引擎，并以极高的精度预测灌溉需求（MAPE < 1%）。本地通信由基于MQTT的局域网协议提供支持，确保在互联网连接有限或没有互联网连接的区域可靠运行。在受控环境中的实验验证表明，与传统方法相比，用水量显著减少，同时该系统的低功耗设计和离线功能证实了其在资源受限的农村环境中进行可持续、可扩展部署的可行性。这项工作为弥合农业领域的技术鸿沟并提高用水效率提供了一个实用、经济高效的蓝图，通过设备端的人工智能来实现。
tldr: This paper presents a TinyML-enabled IoT system for precision irrigation in small-scale farming, demonstrating significant water reduction and offline capability. It uses edge computing with ESP32 and Raspberry Pi, validated with gradient boosting achieving high accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于TinyML的物联网系统，用于小规模农业的精准灌溉，展示了显著的节水效果和离线能力。该系统采用ESP32和树莓派进行边缘计算，并通过梯度提升验证实现了高精度。

title: RSOD: Reliability-Guided Sonar Image Object Detection with Extremely Limited Labels
summary: Object detection in sonar images is a key technology in underwater detection systems. Compared to natural images, sonar images contain fewer texture details and are more susceptible to noise, making it difficult for non-experts to distinguish subtle differences between classes. This leads to their inability to provide precise annotation data for sonar images. Therefore, designing effective object detection methods for sonar images with extremely limited labels is particularly important. To address this, we propose a teacher-student framework called RSOD, which aims to fully learn the characteristics of sonar images and develop a pseudo-label strategy suitable for these images to mitigate the impact of limited labels. First, RSOD calculates a reliability score by assessing the consistency of the teacher's predictions across different views. To leverage this score, we introduce an object mixed pseudo-label method to tackle the shortage of labeled data in sonar images. Finally, we optimize the performance of the student by implementing a reliability-guided adaptive constraint. By taking full advantage of unlabeled data, the student can perform well even in situations with extremely limited labels. Notably, on the UATD dataset, our method, using only 5% of labeled data, achieves results that can compete against those of our baseline algorithm trained on 100% labeled data. We also collected a new dataset to provide more valuable data for research in the field of sonar.
summary_zh: 声呐图像中的目标检测是水下探测系统的关键技术。与自然图像相比，声呐图像包含较少的纹理细节，且更容易受到噪声的影响，这使得非专业人士难以区分不同类别之间的细微差异，从而导致他们无法为声呐图像提供精确的标注数据。因此，为标签极度受限的声呐图像设计有效的目标检测方法尤为重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为RSOD的教师-学生框架，其旨在充分学习声呐图像的特征，并开发一种适合这些图像的伪标签策略，以减轻标签有限带来的影响。首先，RSOD通过评估教师在不同视角下的预测一致性来计算可靠性得分。为了利用这个得分，我们引入了一种目标混合伪标签方法，以解决声呐图像中标注数据不足的问题。最后，我们通过实施可靠性引导的自适应约束来优化学生的性能。通过充分利用未标注数据，学生即便在标签极度受限的情况下也能表现良好。值得注意的是，在UATD数据集上，我们的方法仅使用5%的标注数据，就能达到与使用100%标注数据训练的基线算法相媲美的结果。我们还收集了一个新的数据集，为声呐领域的研究提供更有价值的数据。
tldr: The paper presents RSOD, a teacher-student framework for object detection in sonar images with limited labels, using a reliability-guided pseudo-labeling strategy. It achieves competitive performance compared to fully supervised baselines on the UATD dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了RSOD，一个用于在标签有限的情况下进行声呐图像目标检测的师生框架，它使用了一种可靠性引导的伪标签策略。在UATD数据集上，它的性能与完全监督的基线方法相比具有竞争力。

title: Mixed Precision PointPillars for Efficient 3D Object Detection with TensorRT
summary: LIDAR 3D object detection is one of the important tasks for autonomous vehicles. Ensuring that this task operates in real-time is crucial. Toward this, model quantization can be used to accelerate the runtime. However, directly applying model quantization often leads to performance degradation due to LIDAR's wide numerical distributions and extreme outliers. To address the wide numerical distribution, we proposed a mixed precision framework designed for PointPillars. Our framework first searches for sensitive layers with post-training quantization (PTQ) by quantizing one layer at a time to 8-bit integer (INT8) and evaluating each model for average precision (AP). The top-k most sensitive layers are assigned as floating point (FP). Combinations of these layers are greedily searched to produce candidate mixed precision models, which are finalized with either PTQ or quantization-aware training (QAT). Furthermore, to handle outliers, we observe that using a very small number of calibration data reduces the likelihood of encountering outliers, thereby improving PTQ performance. Our methods provides mixed precision models without training in the PTQ pipeline, while our QAT pipeline achieves the performance competitive to FP models. With TensorRT deployment, our models offer less latency and sizes by up to 2.35 and 2.26 times, respectively.
summary_zh: 激光雷达三维物体检测是自动驾驶汽车的重要任务之一。确保该任务实时运行至关重要。为此，模型量化可以用来加速运行时间。然而，由于激光雷达宽泛的数值分布和极端异常值，直接应用模型量化通常会导致性能下降。为了解决宽泛的数值分布问题，我们提出了一种专为PointPillars设计的混合精度框架。我们的框架首先通过逐层量化为8位整数（INT8）并评估每个模型的平均精度（AP），利用后训练量化（PTQ）搜索敏感层。前k个最敏感的层被指定为浮点数（FP）。这些层的组合被贪婪地搜索，以生成候选的混合精度模型，并使用PTQ或量化感知训练（QAT）进行最终确定。此外，为了处理异常值，我们观察到使用极少量校准数据可以降低遇到异常值的可能性，从而提高PTQ性能。我们的方法在PTQ流程中提供了无需训练的混合精度模型，而我们的QAT流程实现了与FP模型具有竞争力的性能。通过TensorRT部署，我们的模型在延迟和尺寸方面分别降低了高达2.35倍和2.26倍。
tldr: The paper proposes a mixed-precision quantization framework for PointPillars, a LIDAR 3D object detection model, using post-training quantization and quantization-aware training to improve efficiency and reduce latency when deployed with TensorRT.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合精度量化框架，用于PointPillars这一LiDAR 3D目标检测模型。该框架利用训练后量化和量化感知训练来提高效率，并减少在TensorRT部署时的延迟。

title: Deep Learning for Semantic Segmentation of 3D Ultrasound Data
summary: Developing cost-efficient and reliable perception systems remains a central challenge for automated vehicles. LiDAR and camera-based systems dominate, yet they present trade-offs in cost, robustness and performance under adverse conditions. This work introduces a novel framework for learning-based 3D semantic segmentation using Calyo Pulse, a modular, solid-state 3D ultrasound sensor system for use in harsh and cluttered environments. A 3D U-Net architecture is introduced and trained on the spatial ultrasound data for volumetric segmentation. Results demonstrate robust segmentation performance from Calyo Pulse sensors, with potential for further improvement through larger datasets, refined ground truth, and weighted loss functions. Importantly, this study highlights 3D ultrasound sensing as a promising complementary modality for reliable autonomy.
summary_zh: 经济高效且可靠的感知系统的开发仍然是自动驾驶汽车面临的核心挑战。基于激光雷达和摄像头的系统占据主导地位，但它们在成本、鲁棒性和恶劣条件下的性能方面存在权衡。本研究介绍了一种新型框架，用于使用Calyo Pulse（一种模块化、固态3D超声传感器系统，适用于恶劣和杂乱环境）进行基于学习的3D语义分割。引入了3D U-Net架构并在空间超声数据上进行训练，用于体积分割。结果表明Calyo Pulse传感器具有强大的分割性能，并有可能通过更大的数据集、精细化的Ground Truth和加权损失函数进一步改进。重要的是，本研究强调了3D超声传感作为可靠自主驾驶一种有前景的互补模态。
tldr: This paper presents a 3D U-Net architecture for semantic segmentation of 3D ultrasound data acquired from a novel solid-state sensor, demonstrating robust segmentation performance in harsh environments, positioning it as a complementary modality for autonomous systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种3D U-Net架构，用于对新型固态传感器获取的3D超声数据进行语义分割，展示了在恶劣环境中的稳健分割性能，并将其定位为自主系统的补充方式。

title: GridNet-HD: A High-Resolution Multi-Modal Dataset for LiDAR-Image Fusion on Power Line Infrastructure
summary: This paper presents GridNet-HD, a multi-modal dataset for 3D semantic segmentation of overhead electrical infrastructures, pairing high-density LiDAR with high-resolution oblique imagery. The dataset comprises 7,694 images and 2.5 billion points annotated into 11 classes, with predefined splits and mIoU metrics. Unimodal (LiDAR-only, image-only) and multi-modal fusion baselines are provided. On GridNet-HD, fusion models outperform the best unimodal baseline by +5.55 mIoU, highlighting the complementarity of geometry and appearance. As reviewed in Sec. 2, no public dataset jointly provides high-density LiDAR and high-resolution oblique imagery with 3D semantic labels for power-line assets. Dataset, baselines, and codes are available: https://huggingface.co/collections/heig-vd-geo/gridnet-hd.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了GridNet-HD，这是一个用于架空电力基础设施三维语义分割的多模态数据集，它将高密度激光雷达数据与高分辨率倾斜影像配对。该数据集包含7694张图像和25亿个点，标注为11个类别，并包含预定义的分割方式和mIoU指标。提供了单模态（仅激光雷达、仅图像）和多模态融合的基线模型。在GridNet-HD上，融合模型的性能优于最佳单模态基线模型，提升了+5.55 mIoU，突出了几何信息和外观信息的互补性。正如第二节中所回顾的那样，目前没有公开数据集同时提供高密度激光雷达和高分辨率倾斜影像，并带有电力线路资产的三维语义标签。数据集、基线和代码可在以下网址获取：https://huggingface.co/collections/heig-vd-geo/gridnet-hd。
tldr: The paper introduces GridNet-HD, a new high-resolution multi-modal dataset of power line infrastructure with LiDAR and imagery data, and provides baseline results showing the benefit of sensor fusion.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GridNet-HD，一个关于电力线基础设施的高分辨率多模态数据集，包含激光雷达和图像数据，并提供了基线结果，展示了传感器融合的优势。

title: TreeDGS: Aerial Gaussian Splatting for Distant DBH Measurement
summary: Aerial remote sensing enables efficient large-area surveying, but accurate direct object-level measurement remains difficult in complex natural scenes. Recent advancements in 3D vision, particularly learned radiance-field representations such as NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting, have begun to raise the ceiling on reconstruction fidelity and densifiable geometry from posed imagery. Nevertheless, direct aerial measurement of important natural attributes such as tree diameter at breast height (DBH) remains challenging. Trunks in aerial forest scans are distant and sparsely observed in image views: at typical operating altitudes, stems may span only a few pixels. With these constraints, conventional reconstruction methods leave breast-height trunk geometry weakly constrained. We present TreeDGS, an aerial image reconstruction method that leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a continuous, densifiable scene representation for trunk measurement. After SfM-MVS initialization and Gaussian optimization, we extract a dense point set from the Gaussian field using RaDe-GS's depth-aware cumulative-opacity integration and associate each sample with a multi-view opacity reliability score. We then estimate DBH from trunk-isolated points using opacity-weighted solid-circle fitting. Evaluated on 10 plots with field-measured DBH, TreeDGS reaches 4.79,cm RMSE (about 2.6 pixels at this GSD) and outperforms a state-of-the-art LiDAR baseline (7.91,cm RMSE), demonstrating that densified splat-based geometry can enable accurate, low-cost aerial DBH measurement.
summary_zh: 空中遥感能够实现高效的大面积测绘，但在复杂的自然场景中，精确的直接对象级测量仍然困难。3D视觉领域的最新进展，特别是像NeRF和3D高斯溅射等学习到的辐射场表示，已开始提高从带有姿态的图像中重建保真度和可密集几何体的上限。然而，直接从空中测量重要的自然属性，如胸径（DBH）仍然具有挑战性。在空中森林扫描中，树干距离较远，图像视图中稀疏观测到：在典型的飞行高度下，树干可能只跨越几个像素。在这种约束下，传统的重建方法对胸高处的树干几何形状约束较弱。我们提出了一种名为TreeDGS的空中图像重建方法，该方法利用3D高斯溅射作为连续的、可密集的场景表示来进行树干测量。在SfM-MVS初始化和高斯优化之后，我们使用RaDe-GS的深度感知累积不透明度积分从高斯场中提取一个密集的点集，并将每个样本与多视角不透明度可靠性评分相关联。然后，我们使用不透明度加权实心圆拟合从树干隔离的点中估计DBH。在10个带有现场测量的DBH的地块上进行评估，TreeDGS达到了4.79厘米的RMSE（约为此GSD下的2.6像素），并优于最先进的LiDAR基线（7.91厘米RMSE），表明基于密集飞溅几何体（densified splat-based geometry）可以实现准确且低成本的空中DBH测量。
tldr: The paper introduces TreeDGS, a 3D Gaussian Splatting-based method for accurate aerial measurement of tree diameter at breast height (DBH), demonstrating superior performance compared to LiDAR.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TreeDGS，一种基于3D高斯溅射的方法，用于精确地进行胸径（DBH）的航空测量，并展示了优于激光雷达的性能。

title: Fusion-Restoration Image Processing Algorithm to Improve the High-Temperature Deformation Measurement
summary: In the deformation measurement of high-temperature structures, image degradation caused by thermal radiation and random errors introduced by heat haze restrict the accuracy and effectiveness of deformation measurement. To suppress thermal radiation and heat haze using fusion-restoration image processing methods, thereby improving the accuracy and effectiveness of DIC in the measurement of high-temperature deformation. For image degradation caused by thermal radiation, based on the image layered representation, the image is decomposed into positive and negative channels for parallel processing, and then optimized for quality by multi-exposure image fusion. To counteract the high-frequency, random errors introduced by heat haze, we adopt the FSIM as the objective function to guide the iterative optimization of model parameters, and the grayscale average algorithm is applied to equalize anomalous gray values, thereby reducing measurement error. The proposed multi-exposure image fusion algorithm effectively suppresses image degradation caused by complex illumination conditions, boosting the effective computation area from 26% to 50% for under-exposed images and from 32% to 40% for over-exposed images without degrading measurement accuracy in the experiment. Meanwhile, the image restoration combined with the grayscale average algorithm reduces static thermal deformation measurement errors. The error in ε_xx is reduced by 85.3%, while the errors in ε_yy and γ_xy are reduced by 36.0% and 36.4%, respectively. We present image processing methods to suppress the interference of thermal radiation and heat haze in high-temperature deformation measurement using DIC. The experimental results verify that the proposed method can effectively improve image quality, reduce deformation measurement errors, and has potential application value in thermal deformation measurement.
summary_zh:
以下是中文翻译：

在高温结构的变形测量中，热辐射导致的图像退化以及热雾引入的随机误差限制了变形测量的精度和有效性。为了利用融合-复原图像处理方法抑制热辐射和热雾，从而提高数字图像相关（DIC）技术在高温变形测量中的精度和有效性。针对热辐射导致的图像退化，基于图像分层表示，将图像分解为正负通道进行并行处理，然后通过多曝光图像融合优化图像质量。为了抵消热雾引入的高频随机误差，我们采用特征相似度（FSIM）作为目标函数来指导模型参数的迭代优化，并应用灰度平均算法均衡异常灰度值，从而降低测量误差。所提出的多曝光图像融合算法能够有效地抑制复杂光照条件导致的图像退化，在实验中，对于欠曝光图像，有效计算区域从26%提升至50%，对于过曝光图像，从32%提升至40%，且不降低测量精度。同时，图像复原结合灰度平均算法降低了静态热变形测量误差。ε_xx的误差降低了85.3%，而ε_yy和γ_xy的误差分别降低了36.0%和36.4%。我们提出了图像处理方法来抑制热辐射和热雾对DIC高温变形测量的干扰。实验结果验证了所提出的方法能够有效提高图像质量、降低变形测量误差，并在热变形测量中具有潜在的应用价值。
tldr: This paper presents a fusion-restoration image processing algorithm to improve the accuracy of high-temperature deformation measurement by mitigating the effects of thermal radiation and heat haze on image quality. The algorithm combines multi-exposure image fusion with a grayscale average algorithm to reduce measurement errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种融合恢复图像处理算法，通过减轻热辐射和热雾对图像质量的影响，提高高温变形测量的精度。 该算法将多重曝光图像融合与灰度平均算法相结合，以减少测量误差。

title: Camera Pose Revisited
summary: Estimating the position and orientation of a camera with respect to an observed scene is one of the central problems in computer vision, particularly in the context of camera calibration and multi-sensor systems. This paper addresses the planar Perspective--$n$--Point problem, with special emphasis on the initial estimation of the pose of a calibration object. As a solution, we propose the \texttt{PnP-ProCay78} algorithm, which combines the classical quadratic formulation of the reconstruction error with a Cayley parameterization of rotations and least-squares optimization. The key component of the method is a deterministic selection of starting points based on an analysis of the reconstruction error for two canonical vectors, allowing costly solution-space search procedures to be avoided. Experimental validation is performed using data acquired also from high-resolution RGB cameras and very low-resolution thermal cameras in an integrated RGB--IR setup. The results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves practically the same projection accuracy as optimal \texttt{SQPnP} and slightly higher than \texttt{IPPE}, both prominent \texttt{PnP-OpenCV} procedures. However, \texttt{PnP-ProCay78} maintains a significantly simpler algorithmic structure. Moreover, the analysis of optimization trajectories in Cayley space provides an intuitive insight into the convergence process, making the method attractive also from a didactic perspective. Unlike existing PnP solvers, the proposed \texttt{PnP-ProCay78} algorithm combines projection error minimization with an analytically eliminated reconstruction-error surrogate for translation, yielding a hybrid cost formulation that is both geometrically transparent and computationally efficient.
summary_zh: 估计相机相对于观测场景的位置和姿态是计算机视觉中的核心问题之一，尤其是在相机标定和多传感器系统领域。本文探讨了平面透视--$n$--点（Perspective--$n$--Point）问题，特别强调校准对象姿态的初始估计。为此，我们提出了一种名为 \texttt{PnP-ProCay78} 的算法，该算法将重建误差的经典二次公式与旋转的 Cayley 参数化和最小二乘优化相结合。该方法的关键组成部分是基于对两个规范向量的重建误差分析进行起始点的确定性选择，从而避免了耗时的解空间搜索过程。实验验证使用了从高分辨率 RGB 相机和集成 RGB--IR 设置中的极低分辨率热成像相机采集的数据。结果表明，所提出的算法实现了与最佳 \texttt{SQPnP} 实际上相同的投影精度，略高于 \texttt{IPPE}，这两者都是著名的 \texttt{PnP-OpenCV} 程序。然而，\texttt{PnP-ProCay78} 保持了显著更简单的算法结构。此外，Cayley 空间中优化轨迹的分析提供了对收敛过程的直观理解，使得该方法也具有教学上的吸引力。与现有的 PnP 求解器不同，所提出的 \texttt{PnP-ProCay78} 算法将投影误差最小化与解析消除的用于平移的重建误差替代相结合，产生了一种混合代价公式，既具有几何上的透明性，又具有计算上的高效性。
tldr: This paper presents a new algorithm, PnP-ProCay78, for solving the planar Perspective-n-Point (PnP) problem in camera pose estimation, achieving comparable accuracy to existing methods but with a simpler structure and improved computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的算法 PnP-ProCay78，用于解决相机姿态估计中的平面透视 n 点（PnP）问题，与现有方法相比，该算法具有相当的精度，但结构更简单，计算效率更高。

title: BlocksecRT-DETR: Decentralized Privacy-Preserving and Token-Efficient Federated Transformer Learning for Secure Real-Time Object Detection in ITS
summary: Federated real-time object detection using transformers in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) faces three major challenges: (1) missing-class non-IID data heterogeneity from geographically diverse traffic environments, (2) latency constraints on edge hardware for high-capacity transformer models, and (3) privacy and security risks from untrusted client updates and centralized aggregation. We propose BlockSecRT-DETR, a BLOCKchain-SECured Real-Time Object DEtection TRansformer framework for ITS that provides a decentralized, token-efficient, and privacy-preserving federated training solution using RT-DETR transformer, incorporating a blockchain-secured update validation mechanism for trustworthy aggregation. In this framework, challenges (1) and (2) are jointly addressed through a unified client-side design that integrates RT-DETR training with a Token Engineering Module (TEM). TEM prunes low-utility tokens, reducing encoder complexity and latency on edge hardware, while aggregated updates mitigate non-IID data heterogeneity across clients. To address challenge (3), BlockSecRT-DETR incorporates a decentralized blockchain-secured update validation mechanism that enables tamper-proof, privacy-preserving, and trust-free authenticated model aggregation without relying on a central server. We evaluated the proposed framework under a missing-class Non-IID partition of the KITTI dataset and conducted a blockchain case study to quantify security overhead. TEM improves inference latency by 17.2% and reduces encoder FLOPs by 47.8%, while maintaining global detection accuracy (89.20% mAP@0.5). The blockchain integration adds 400 ms per round, and the ledger size remains under 12 KB due to metadata-only on-chain storage.
summary_zh: 在智能交通系统 (ITS) 中，使用 Transformer 的联邦实时目标检测面临三大挑战：（1）来自地理位置分散的交通环境的缺失类别非独立同分布 (non-IID) 数据异构性，（2）边缘硬件上高容量 Transformer 模型的延迟约束，以及（3）来自不受信任的客户端更新和集中式聚合的隐私和安全风险。我们提出了 BlockSecRT-DETR，一个区块链安全实时目标检测 Transformer 框架，用于 ITS，它提供了一个去中心化、代币高效且保护隐私的联邦训练解决方案，该方案使用 RT-DETR Transformer，并结合了用于可信聚合的区块链安全更新验证机制。在该框架中，挑战 (1) 和 (2) 通过一个统一的客户端设计共同解决，该设计将 RT-DETR 训练与代币工程模块 (TEM) 集成。TEM 剪枝低效用代币，降低了编码器复杂度和边缘硬件上的延迟，同时聚合更新缓解了跨客户端的非独立同分布数据异构性。为了解决挑战 (3)，BlockSecRT-DETR 融入了一个去中心化的区块链安全更新验证机制，该机制实现了防篡改、保护隐私和免信任的认证模型聚合，而无需依赖中央服务器。我们评估了所提出的框架在 KITTI 数据集的缺失类别非独立同分布分区下的性能，并进行了一个区块链案例研究来量化安全开销。TEM 将推理延迟提高了 17.2%，并将编码器 FLOPs 降低了 47.8%，同时保持了全局检测精度（89.20% mAP@0.5）。区块链集成每轮增加了 400 毫秒，并且由于链上仅存储元数据，账本大小保持在 12 KB 以下。
tldr: This paper introduces BlockSecRT-DETR, a blockchain-secured federated learning framework for real-time object detection in ITS, addressing challenges of data heterogeneity, latency, and privacy using RT-DETR, token pruning, and blockchain for secure aggregation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BlockSecRT-DETR，一个基于区块链的安全联邦学习框架，用于智能交通系统中的实时目标检测。该框架使用RT-DETR、令牌剪枝和区块链来解决数据异构、延迟和隐私等挑战，以实现安全聚合。

title: TwinBrainVLA: Unleashing the Potential of Generalist VLMs for Embodied Tasks via Asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers
summary: Standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically fine-tune a monolithic Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone explicitly for robotic control. However, this approach creates a critical tension between maintaining high-level general semantic understanding and learning low-level, fine-grained sensorimotor skills, often leading to "catastrophic forgetting" of the model's open-world capabilities. To resolve this conflict, we introduce TwinBrainVLA, a novel architecture that coordinates a generalist VLM retaining universal semantic understanding and a specialist VLM dedicated to embodied proprioception for joint robotic control. TwinBrainVLA synergizes a frozen "Left Brain", which retains robust general visual reasoning, with a trainable "Right Brain", specialized for embodied perception, via a novel Asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (AsyMoT) mechanism. This design allows the Right Brain to dynamically query semantic knowledge from the frozen Left Brain and fuse it with proprioceptive states, providing rich conditioning for a Flow-Matching Action Expert to generate precise continuous controls. Extensive experiments on SimplerEnv and RoboCasa benchmarks demonstrate that TwinBrainVLA achieves superior manipulation performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines while explicitly preserving the comprehensive visual understanding capabilities of the pre-trained VLM, offering a promising direction for building general-purpose robots that simultaneously achieve high-level semantic understanding and low-level physical dexterity.
summary_zh: 标准的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型通常针对机器人控制对一个单体视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 主干进行显式微调。然而，这种方法在维持高层次的通用语义理解和学习低层次、细粒度的感觉运动技能之间造成了关键的矛盾，常常导致模型“灾难性地遗忘”其开放世界能力。为了解决这一冲突，我们引入了 TwinBrainVLA，一种新颖的架构，它协调一个保持通用语义理解的通用VLM和一个专注于体现本体感觉的专业VLM，以进行联合机器人控制。TwinBrainVLA 通过一种新颖的非对称混合Transformer (AsyMoT) 机制，将保留了强大的通用视觉推理能力的冻结的“左脑”与专门用于体现感知的可训练的“右脑”协同起来。这种设计允许右脑动态地从冻结的左脑查询语义知识，并将其与本体感受状态融合，从而为流匹配动作专家提供丰富的条件信息，以生成精确的连续控制。在 SimplerEnv 和 RoboCasa 基准上的大量实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，TwinBrainVLA 实现了卓越的操作性能，同时显式地保留了预训练 VLM 的全面视觉理解能力，为构建同时实现高层次语义理解和低层次物理灵巧性的通用机器人提供了一个有希望的方向。
tldr: TwinBrainVLA introduces an asymmetric mixture-of-transformers architecture to address catastrophic forgetting in VLA models, using a frozen generalist VLM alongside a trainable specialist VLM for improved robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: TwinBrainVLA 引入了一种非对称混合Transformer架构，旨在解决VLA模型中的灾难性遗忘问题，通过结合一个冻结的通用VLM和一个可训练的专用VLM，从而提高机器人操作的性能。

title: FantasyVLN: Unified Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Achieving human-level performance in Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to jointly understand multimodal instructions and visual-spatial context while reasoning over long action sequences. Recent works, such as NavCoT and NavGPT-2, demonstrate the potential of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning for improving interpretability and long-horizon planning. Moreover, multimodal extensions like OctoNav-R1 and CoT-VLA further validate CoT as a promising pathway toward human-like navigation reasoning. However, existing approaches face critical drawbacks: purely textual CoTs lack spatial grounding and easily overfit to sparse annotated reasoning steps, while multimodal CoTs incur severe token inflation by generating imagined visual observations, making real-time navigation impractical. In this work, we propose FantasyVLN, a unified implicit reasoning framework that preserves the benefits of CoT reasoning without explicit token overhead. Specifically, imagined visual tokens are encoded into a compact latent space using a pretrained Visual AutoRegressor (VAR) during CoT reasoning training, and the model jointly learns from textual, visual, and multimodal CoT modes under a unified multi-CoT strategy. At inference, our model performs direct instruction-to-action mapping while still enjoying reasoning-aware representations. Extensive experiments on LH-VLN show that our approach achieves reasoning-aware yet real-time navigation, improving success rates and efficiency while reducing inference latency by an order of magnitude compared to explicit CoT methods.
summary_zh: 在视觉与语言导航（VLN）任务中达到人类水平的表现，需要具身智能体能够联合理解多模态指令和视觉-空间环境，同时对长时序动作序列进行推理。最近的研究，如NavCoT和NavGPT-2，展示了思维链（CoT）推理在提高可解释性和长程规划方面的潜力。此外，诸如OctoNav-R1和CoT-VLA等模态扩展进一步验证了CoT作为实现类人导航推理的有希望的途径。然而，现有方法面临着关键缺陷：纯文本CoT缺乏空间基础，容易过度拟合到稀疏标注的推理步骤，而多模态CoT通过生成臆想的视觉观察，导致严重的token膨胀，使得实时导航不切实际。在这项工作中，我们提出了FantasyVLN，一个统一的隐式推理框架，它保留了CoT推理的优势，而没有显式的token开销。具体来说，在CoT推理训练期间，使用预训练的视觉自回归器（VAR）将臆想的视觉token编码到紧凑的潜在空间中，并且该模型在统一的多CoT策略下，联合学习文本、视觉和多模态CoT模式。在推理时，我们的模型执行直接的指令-动作映射，同时仍然享有推理感知的表示。在LH-VLN上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了推理感知且实时的导航，提高了成功率和效率，同时与显式CoT方法相比，推理延迟降低了一个数量级。
tldr: FantasyVLN introduces a unified implicit reasoning framework for VLN that encodes imagined visual tokens into a compact latent space using a pretrained Visual AutoRegressor (VAR), achieving reasoning-aware and real-time navigation with improved performance and efficiency.
tldr_zh: FantasyVLN 提出了一种用于 VLN 的统一隐式推理框架，该框架使用预训练的视觉自回归器 (VAR) 将想象的视觉 tokens 编码到紧凑的潜在空间中，从而实现具有推理意识和实时性的导航，并提高了性能和效率。

title: SilentDrift: Exploiting Action Chunking for Stealthy Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly deployed in safety-critical robotic applications, yet their security vulnerabilities remain underexplored. We identify a fundamental security flaw in modern VLA systems: the combination of action chunking and delta pose representations creates an intra-chunk visual open-loop. This mechanism forces the robot to execute K-step action sequences, allowing per-step perturbations to accumulate through integration. We propose SILENTDRIFT, a stealthy black-box backdoor attack exploiting this vulnerability. Our method employs the Smootherstep function to construct perturbations with guaranteed C2 continuity, ensuring zero velocity and acceleration at trajectory boundaries to satisfy strict kinematic consistency constraints. Furthermore, our keyframe attack strategy selectively poisons only the critical approach phase, maximizing impact while minimizing trigger exposure. The resulting poisoned trajectories are visually indistinguishable from successful demonstrations. Evaluated on the LIBERO, SILENTDRIFT achieves a 93.2% Attack Success Rate with a poisoning rate under 2%, while maintaining a 95.3% Clean Task Success Rate.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型越来越多地应用于安全攸关的机器人应用中，但其安全漏洞仍未得到充分探索。我们发现现代 VLA 系统中存在一个根本性的安全缺陷：动作分块和增量姿态表示的结合会产生块内的视觉开环。这种机制迫使机器人执行 K 步动作序列，允许每一步扰动通过积分累积。我们提出了 SILENTDRIFT，一种隐蔽的黑盒后门攻击，旨在利用此漏洞。我们的方法采用 Smootherstep 函数构建保证 C2 连续性的扰动，确保轨迹边界处速度和加速度为零，从而满足严格的运动学一致性约束。此外，我们的关键帧攻击策略有选择性地仅对关键的接近阶段进行投毒，从而在最大限度地发挥影响的同时，最大限度地减少触发暴露。生成的投毒轨迹与成功的演示在视觉上无法区分。在 LIBERO 上进行评估，SILENTDRIFT 在投毒率低于 2% 的情况下，实现了 93.2% 的攻击成功率，同时保持了 95.3% 的清洁任务成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces SilentDrift, a novel stealthy black-box backdoor attack on Vision-Language-Action models that exploits action chunking and delta pose representations to induce failures while maintaining high performance on clean tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SilentDrift的新型隐蔽黑盒后门攻击，该攻击利用视觉-语言-动作模型中的动作分块和增量姿态表示，在保持清洁任务高性能的同时诱导故障。

title: RoboBrain 2.5: Depth in Sight, Time in Mind
summary: We introduce RoboBrain 2.5, a next-generation embodied AI foundation model that advances general perception, spatial reasoning, and temporal modeling through extensive training on high-quality spatiotemporal supervision. Building upon its predecessor, RoboBrain 2.5 introduces two major capability upgrades. Specifically, it unlocks Precise 3D Spatial Reasoning by shifting from 2D pixel-relative grounding to depth-aware coordinate prediction and absolute metric constraint comprehension, generating complete 3D manipulation traces as ordered keypoint sequences under physical constraints. Complementing this spatial precision, the model establishes Dense Temporal Value Estimation that provides dense, step-aware progress prediction and execution state understanding across varying viewpoints, producing stable feedback signals for downstream learning. Together, these upgrades extend the framework toward more physically grounded and execution-aware embodied intelligence for complex, fine-grained manipulation. The code and checkpoints are available at project website: https://superrobobrain.github.io
summary_zh: 我们介绍了RoboBrain 2.5，一种下一代具身人工智能基础模型，它通过在高品质时空监督数据上的广泛训练，提升了通用感知、空间推理和时间建模能力。在上一代模型的基础上，RoboBrain 2.5引入了两项主要的能力升级。具体来说，它通过从2D像素相对定位转移到深度感知的坐标预测和绝对尺度约束理解，从而解锁了精确的3D空间推理，并生成完整的3D操作轨迹，表现为物理约束下的有序关键点序列。为了补充这种空间精度，该模型建立了密集的时序值估计，提供了密集的、步进感知的进度预测，以及在不同视角下的执行状态理解，从而为下游学习产生稳定的反馈信号。这些升级共同扩展了该框架，使其更适用于复杂、细粒度的操作，从而实现更具物理依据和执行感知的具身智能。代码和检查点可在项目网站上获取：https://superrobobrain.github.io
tldr: RoboBrain 2.5 is a new embodied AI foundation model with improved 3D spatial reasoning via depth-aware coordinate prediction and dense temporal value estimation for step-aware progress prediction, enabling more physically grounded manipulation.
tldr_zh: RoboBrain 2.5是一个新的具身AI基础模型，通过深度感知的坐标预测改进了3D空间推理，并通过密集的时序值估计进行步进感知的进度预测，从而实现了更强的物理基础操作。

title: Diffusion-Guided Backdoor Attacks in Real-World Reinforcement Learning
summary: Backdoor attacks embed hidden malicious behaviors in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and activate them using triggers at test time. Most existing attacks are validated only in simulation, while their effectiveness in real-world robotic systems remains unclear. In physical deployment, safety-constrained control pipelines such as velocity limiting, action smoothing, and collision avoidance suppress abnormal actions, causing strong attenuation of conventional backdoor attacks. We study this previously overlooked problem and propose a diffusion-guided backdoor attack framework (DGBA) for real-world RL. We design small printable visual patch triggers placed on the floor and generate them using a conditional diffusion model that produces diverse patch appearances under real-world visual variations. We treat the robot control stack as a black-box system. We further introduce an advantage-based poisoning strategy that injects triggers only at decision-critical training states. We evaluate our method on a TurtleBot3 mobile robot and demonstrate reliable activation of targeted attacks while preserving normal task performance. Demo videos and code are available in the supplementary material.
summary_zh: 后门攻击将隐藏的恶意行为嵌入到强化学习（RL）策略中，并在测试时使用触发器激活它们。目前大多数攻击仅在模拟环境中进行验证，其在真实世界机器人系统中的有效性尚不明确。在物理部署中，诸如速度限制、动作平滑和碰撞避免等安全约束控制管道会抑制异常动作，导致传统后门攻击的强烈衰减。我们研究了这一先前被忽略的问题，并提出了一种用于真实世界RL的扩散引导后门攻击框架（DGBA）。我们设计了放置在地板上的小型可打印视觉补丁触发器，并使用条件扩散模型生成这些触发器，该模型可以在真实世界的视觉变化下产生多样化的补丁外观。我们将机器人控制堆栈视为一个黑盒系统。我们进一步引入了一种基于优势的投毒策略，仅在决策关键的训练状态下注入触发器。我们在一款TurtleBot3移动机器人上评估了我们的方法，并展示了在保持正常任务性能的同时，可靠地激活目标攻击。演示视频和代码可在补充材料中找到。
tldr: This paper introduces a diffusion-guided backdoor attack framework (DGBA) tailored for real-world reinforcement learning, addressing the attenuation of conventional attacks in physical deployments. It uses printable visual patches as triggers generated by a conditional diffusion model and an advantage-based poisoning strategy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种针对真实世界强化学习的扩散引导后门攻击框架(DGBA)，解决了传统攻击在物理部署中的衰减问题。它使用可打印的视觉补丁作为触发器，这些触发器由条件扩散模型生成，并结合了一种基于优势的投毒策略。

title: Zero-shot adaptable task planning for autonomous construction robots: a comparative study of lightweight single and multi-AI agent systems
summary: Robots are expected to play a major role in the future construction industry but face challenges due to high costs and difficulty adapting to dynamic tasks. This study explores the potential of foundation models to enhance the adaptability and generalizability of task planning in construction robots. Four models are proposed and implemented using lightweight, open-source large language models (LLMs) and vision language models (VLMs). These models include one single agent and three multi-agent teams that collaborate to create robot action plans. The models are evaluated across three construction roles: Painter, Safety Inspector, and Floor Tiling. Results show that the four-agent team outperforms the state-of-the-art GPT-4o in most metrics while being ten times more cost-effective. Additionally, teams with three and four agents demonstrate the improved generalizability. By discussing how agent behaviors influence outputs, this study enhances the understanding of AI teams and supports future research in diverse unstructured environments beyond construction.
summary_zh: 机器人有望在未来的建筑行业中发挥重要作用，但由于高昂的成本和难以适应动态任务等问题而面临挑战。本研究探讨了基础模型在提高建筑机器人任务规划的适应性和泛化能力方面的潜力。该研究提出并实现了四个模型，它们基于轻量级开源大型语言模型 (LLM) 和视觉语言模型 (VLM)。这些模型包括一个单智能体和三个协同创建机器人行动计划的多智能体团队。这些模型在三种建筑角色中进行了评估：油漆工、安全检查员和地板铺贴工。结果表明，四智能体团队在大多数指标上都优于最先进的 GPT-4o，且成本效益提高了十倍。此外，拥有三个和四个智能体的团队展示了更好的泛化能力。通过讨论智能体行为如何影响输出，本研究加深了对人工智能团队的理解，并支持未来在建筑之外的各种非结构化环境中进行研究。
tldr: This paper explores the use of lightweight LLMs and VLMs in single and multi-agent systems for adaptable task planning in construction robots, demonstrating improved performance and cost-effectiveness compared to GPT-4o.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了轻量级LLM和VLM在单智能体和多智能体系统中用于建筑机器人自适应任务规划的应用，结果表明与GPT-4o相比，性能更高且成本效益更好。

title: DroneVLA: VLA based Aerial Manipulation
summary: As aerial platforms evolve from passive observers to active manipulators, the challenge shifts toward designing intuitive interfaces that allow non-expert users to command these systems naturally. This work introduces a novel concept of autonomous aerial manipulation system capable of interpreting high-level natural language commands to retrieve objects and deliver them to a human user. The system is intended to integrate a MediaPipe based on Grounding DINO and a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with a custom-built drone equipped with a 1-DOF gripper and an Intel RealSense RGB-D camera. VLA performs semantic reasoning to interpret the intent of a user prompt and generates a prioritized task queue for grasping of relevant objects in the scene. Grounding DINO and dynamic A* planning algorithm are used to navigate and safely relocate the object. To ensure safe and natural interaction during the handover phase, the system employs a human-centric controller driven by MediaPipe. This module provides real-time human pose estimation, allowing the drone to employ visual servoing to maintain a stable, distinct position directly in front of the user, facilitating a comfortable handover. We demonstrate the system's efficacy through real-world experiments for localization and navigation, which resulted in a 0.164m, 0.070m, and 0.084m of max, mean euclidean, and root-mean squared errors, respectively, highlighting the feasibility of VLA for aerial manipulation operations.
summary_zh: 随着空中平台从被动观察者演变为主动操控者，挑战也随之转向设计直观的界面，从而让非专业用户能够自然地指挥这些系统。本文介绍了一种新型的自主空中操控系统概念，该系统能够解释高级自然语言指令，以检索物体并将它们交付给人类用户。该系统旨在集成一个基于 Grounding DINO 的 MediaPipe 和一个视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，以及一个配备单自由度夹爪和 Intel RealSense RGB-D 相机的定制无人机。VLA 执行语义推理，以解释用户提示的意图，并生成一个用于抓取场景中相关物体的优先级任务队列。 Grounding DINO 和动态 A* 规划算法用于导航并安全地重新定位物体。为了确保在交接阶段的安全自然交互，该系统采用了一个由 MediaPipe 驱动的以人为中心的控制器。该模块提供实时人体姿态估计，使无人机能够采用视觉伺服来保持一个稳定、清晰的位置，直接位于用户前方，从而方便舒适的交接。我们通过现实世界的定位和导航实验证明了该系统的有效性，实验结果的最大、平均欧几里得和均方根误差分别为 0.164m、0.070m 和 0.084m，突出了 VLA 在空中操控操作中的可行性。
tldr: This paper introduces DroneVLA, an aerial manipulation system enabling non-expert users to command object retrieval via natural language, integrating vision-language models with a drone equipped with RGB-D sensing and a gripper.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍 DroneVLA，一种空中操作平台，让非专业用户可以通过自然语言命令来完成物体检索，集成了视觉-语言模型和一个配备 RGB-D 传感器和夹具的无人机。

title: A General One-Shot Multimodal Active Perception Framework for Robotic Manipulation: Learning to Predict Optimal Viewpoint
summary: Active perception in vision-based robotic manipulation aims to move the camera toward more informative observation viewpoints, thereby providing high-quality perceptual inputs for downstream tasks. Most existing active perception methods rely on iterative optimization, leading to high time and motion costs, and are tightly coupled with task-specific objectives, which limits their transferability. In this paper, we propose a general one-shot multimodal active perception framework for robotic manipulation. The framework enables direct inference of optimal viewpoints and comprises a data collection pipeline and an optimal viewpoint prediction network. Specifically, the framework decouples viewpoint quality evaluation from the overall architecture, supporting heterogeneous task requirements. Optimal viewpoints are defined through systematic sampling and evaluation of candidate viewpoints, after which large-scale training datasets are constructed via domain randomization. Moreover, a multimodal optimal viewpoint prediction network is developed, leveraging cross-attention to align and fuse multimodal features and directly predict camera pose adjustments. The proposed framework is instantiated in robotic grasping under viewpoint-constrained environments. Experimental results demonstrate that active perception guided by the framework significantly improves grasp success rates. Notably, real-world evaluations achieve nearly double the grasp success rate and enable seamless sim-to-real transfer without additional fine-tuning, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的机器人操作中的主动感知旨在将相机移动到信息量更大的观测视点，从而为下游任务提供高质量的感知输入。现有的大多数主动感知方法依赖于迭代优化，导致高时间成本和运动成本，并且与特定任务目标紧密耦合，从而限制了其泛化能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于机器人操作的通用单次多模态主动感知框架。该框架能够直接推断最佳视点，并包含一个数据收集流程和一个最佳视点预测网络。具体来说，该框架将视点质量评估与整体架构解耦，支持异构的任务需求。最佳视点通过对候选视点进行系统采样和评估来定义，之后通过域随机化构建大规模训练数据集。此外，开发了一个多模态最佳视点预测网络，利用交叉注意力来对齐和融合多模态特征，并直接预测相机姿态调整。所提出的框架被实例化在视角受限环境下的机器人抓取中。实验结果表明，由该框架引导的主动感知显著提高了抓取成功率。值得注意的是，真实世界的评估达到了近乎两倍的抓取成功率，并实现了无缝的从模拟到现实的迁移，无需额外的微调，证明了所提出框架的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a one-shot multimodal active perception framework for robotic manipulation that learns to predict optimal camera viewpoints for grasping tasks, achieving significant improvements in grasp success rates and demonstrating sim-to-real transferability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人操作的单次多模态主动感知框架，该框架学习预测最佳相机视角以完成抓取任务，从而显著提高了抓取成功率并展示了从仿真到真实的迁移能力。

title: Learning Fine-Grained Correspondence with Cross-Perspective Perception for Open-Vocabulary 6D Object Pose Estimation
summary: Open-vocabulary 6D object pose estimation empowers robots to manipulate arbitrary unseen objects guided solely by natural language. However, a critical limitation of existing approaches is their reliance on unconstrained global matching strategies. In open-world scenarios, trying to match anchor features against the entire query image space introduces excessive ambiguity, as target features are easily confused with background distractors. To resolve this, we propose Fine-grained Correspondence Pose Estimation (FiCoP), a framework that transitions from noise-prone global matching to spatially-constrained patch-level correspondence. Our core innovation lies in leveraging a patch-to-patch correlation matrix as a structural prior to narrowing the matching scope, effectively filtering out irrelevant clutter to prevent it from degrading pose estimation. Firstly, we introduce an object-centric disentanglement preprocessing to isolate the semantic target from environmental noise. Secondly, a Cross-Perspective Global Perception (CPGP) module is proposed to fuse dual-view features, establishing structural consensus through explicit context reasoning. Finally, we design a Patch Correlation Predictor (PCP) that generates a precise block-wise association map, acting as a spatial filter to enforce fine-grained, noise-resilient matching. Experiments on the REAL275 and Toyota-Light datasets demonstrate that FiCoP improves Average Recall by 8.0% and 6.1%, respectively, compared to the state-of-the-art method, highlighting its capability to deliver robust and generalized perception for robotic agents operating in complex, unconstrained open-world environments. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/zjjqinyu/FiCoP.
summary_zh: 开放词汇的6D物体姿态估计使机器人能够在自然语言的引导下操作任意未见过的物体。然而，现有方法的一个关键局限性在于它们依赖于无约束的全局匹配策略。在开放世界场景中，试图将锚点特征与整个查询图像空间进行匹配会引入过度的歧义，因为目标特征很容易与背景干扰物混淆。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种细粒度对应姿态估计（FiCoP）框架，该框架从易受噪声影响的全局匹配过渡到空间约束的块级对应关系。我们的核心创新在于利用块到块的相关矩阵作为结构先验来缩小匹配范围，有效地过滤掉不相关的杂乱信息，从而防止其降低姿态估计的性能。首先，我们引入了一种以物体为中心的解耦预处理方法，以将语义目标与环境噪声隔离。其次，提出了一个跨视角全局感知（CPGP）模块来融合双视图特征，通过显式的上下文推理建立结构共识。最后，我们设计了一个块相关性预测器（PCP），它生成一个精确的块状关联图，作为空间滤波器来强制执行细粒度、抗噪声的匹配。在REAL275和Toyota-Light数据集上的实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，FiCoP分别提高了8.0%和6.1%的平均召回率，突显了其为在复杂、无约束的开放世界环境中运行的机器人智能体提供稳健和通用感知的能力。源代码将在https://github.com/zjjqinyu/FiCoP上公开提供。
tldr: This paper introduces FiCoP, a new framework for open-vocabulary 6D object pose estimation that uses spatially-constrained patch-level correspondence to improve robustness against background distractors, demonstrating improved performance on REAL275 and Toyota-Light datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了FiCoP，一种用于开放词汇 6D 物体姿态估计的新框架，它利用空间约束的块级对应关系来提高对背景干扰的鲁棒性，并在REAL275和Toyota-Light数据集上表现出改进的性能。

title: LogicEnvGen: Task-Logic Driven Generation of Diverse Simulated Environments for Embodied AI
summary: Simulated environments play an essential role in embodied AI, functionally analogous to test cases in software engineering. However, existing environment generation methods often emphasize visual realism (e.g., object diversity and layout coherence), overlooking a crucial aspect: logical diversity from the testing perspective. This limits the comprehensive evaluation of agent adaptability and planning robustness in distinct simulated environments. To bridge this gap, we propose LogicEnvGen, a novel method driven by Large Language Models (LLMs) that adopts a top-down paradigm to generate logically diverse simulated environments as test cases for agents. Given an agent task, LogicEnvGen first analyzes its execution logic to construct decision-tree-structured behavior plans and then synthesizes a set of logical trajectories. Subsequently, it adopts a heuristic algorithm to refine the trajectory set, reducing redundant simulation. For each logical trajectory, which represents a potential task situation, LogicEnvGen correspondingly instantiates a concrete environment. Notably, it employs constraint solving for physical plausibility. Furthermore, we introduce LogicEnvEval, a novel benchmark comprising four quantitative metrics for environment evaluation. Experimental results verify the lack of logical diversity in baselines and demonstrate that LogicEnvGen achieves 1.04-2.61x greater diversity, significantly improving the performance in revealing agent faults by 4.00%-68.00%.
summary_zh: 模拟环境在具身人工智能中扮演着至关重要的角色，其功能类似于软件工程中的测试用例。然而，现有的环境生成方法通常强调视觉真实感（例如，对象多样性和布局一致性），而忽略了一个关键方面：从测试角度来看的逻辑多样性。这限制了对智能体在不同模拟环境中适应性和规划鲁棒性的全面评估。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种名为 LogicEnvGen 的新颖方法，该方法由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动，采用自顶向下的范式来生成逻辑上多样化的模拟环境，作为智能体的测试用例。给定一个智能体任务，LogicEnvGen 首先分析其执行逻辑，构建决策树结构的动作计划，然后合成一组逻辑轨迹。随后，它采用一种启发式算法来优化轨迹集，减少冗余模拟。对于每条逻辑轨迹，它代表了一种潜在的任务情境，LogicEnvGen 相应地实例化一个具体的环境。值得注意的是，它采用约束求解来保证物理合理性。此外，我们引入了 LogicEnvEval，这是一个包含四个定量指标的新型环境评估基准。实验结果验证了基线方法缺乏逻辑多样性，并表明 LogicEnvGen 实现了 1.04-2.61 倍更高的多样性，从而显著提高了揭示智能体缺陷的性能，提升幅度为 4.00%-68.00%。
tldr: The paper introduces LogicEnvGen, an LLM-driven method to generate diverse simulated environments based on task logic for embodied AI, improving agent fault detection compared to existing methods that prioritize visual realism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为LogicEnvGen的方法，该方法利用大型语言模型根据任务逻辑生成多样化的具身人工智能模拟环境，与现有侧重视觉真实感的方法相比，提高了智能体故障检测能力。

title: CityCube: Benchmarking Cross-view Spatial Reasoning on Vision-Language Models in Urban Environments
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning is essential for embodied AI, underpinning spatial understanding, mental simulation and planning in complex environments. Existing benchmarks primarily emphasize indoor or street settings, overlooking the unique challenges of open-ended urban spaces characterized by rich semantics, complex geometries, and view variations. To address this, we introduce CityCube, a systematic benchmark designed to probe cross-view reasoning capabilities of current VLMs in urban settings. CityCube integrates four viewpoint dynamics to mimic camera movements and spans a wide spectrum of perspectives from multiple platforms, e.g., vehicles, drones and satellites. For a comprehensive assessment, it features 5,022 meticulously annotated multi-view QA pairs categorized into five cognitive dimensions and three spatial relation expressions. A comprehensive evaluation of 33 VLMs reveals a significant performance disparity with humans: even large-scale models struggle to exceed 54.1% accuracy, remaining 34.2% below human performance. By contrast, small-scale fine-tuned VLMs achieve over 60.0% accuracy, highlighting the necessity of our benchmark. Further analyses indicate the task correlations and fundamental cognitive disparity between VLMs and human-like reasoning.
summary_zh: 跨视角空间推理对于具身人工智能至关重要，它支撑着复杂环境中的空间理解、心智模拟和规划。现有的基准测试主要侧重于室内或街道环境，而忽略了开阔城市空间所带来的独特挑战，这些空间具有丰富的语义、复杂的几何结构和视角变化。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 CityCube，这是一个旨在探测当前视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在城市环境中跨视角推理能力的系统性基准测试。CityCube 集成了四种视点动态，以模拟相机运动，并涵盖了来自多个平台 (例如车辆、无人机和卫星) 的广泛视角。为了进行全面评估，它包含了 5,022 个精心标注的多视角问答对，这些问答对被分为五个认知维度和三种空间关系表达。对 33 个 VLM 的全面评估揭示了与人类之间显著的性能差距：即使是大型模型也很难超过 54.1% 的准确率，比人类表现低 34.2%。相比之下，小规模微调的 VLM 实现了超过 60.0% 的准确率，突显了我们基准测试的必要性。进一步的分析表明了任务相关性以及 VLM 与类人推理之间存在的根本认知差异。
tldr: The paper introduces CityCube, a new benchmark for evaluating cross-view spatial reasoning capabilities of VLMs in complex urban environments, revealing a performance gap between current VLMs and humans.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 CityCube，一个新的基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在复杂城市环境中跨视角空间推理能力，揭示了当前视觉语言模型与人类之间的性能差距。

title: Glance-or-Gaze: Incentivizing LMMs to Adaptively Focus Search via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success in visual understanding, yet they struggle with knowledge-intensive queries involving long-tail entities or evolving information due to static parametric knowledge. Recent search-augmented approaches attempt to address this limitation, but existing methods rely on indiscriminate whole-image retrieval that introduces substantial visual redundancy and noise, and lack deep iterative reflection, limiting their effectiveness on complex visual queries. To overcome these challenges, we propose Glance-or-Gaze (GoG), a fully autonomous framework that shifts from passive perception to active visual planning. GoG introduces a Selective Gaze mechanism that dynamically chooses whether to glance at global context or gaze into high-value regions, filtering irrelevant information before retrieval. We design a dual-stage training strategy: Reflective GoG Behavior Alignment via supervised fine-tuning instills the fundamental GoG paradigm, while Complexity-Adaptive Reinforcement Learning further enhances the model's capability to handle complex queries through iterative reasoning. Experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. Ablation studies confirm that both Selective Gaze and complexity-adaptive RL are essential for effective visual search. We will release our data and models for further exploration soon.
summary_zh: 大型多模态模型(LMMs)在视觉理解方面取得了显著成功，但由于静态参数知识的限制，它们在处理涉及长尾实体或不断演变的信息的知识密集型查询时表现欠佳。最近的搜索增强方法尝试解决这一局限性，但现有方法依赖于不加区分的整图检索，引入了大量的视觉冗余和噪声，且缺乏深度迭代反思，限制了其在复杂视觉查询上的有效性。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种完全自主的框架 Glance-or-Gaze (GoG)，该框架将被动感知转变为主动视觉规划。GoG 引入了一种选择性凝视机制，该机制动态地选择是概览全局上下文还是凝视高价值区域，从而在检索之前过滤掉无关信息。我们设计了一种双阶段训练策略：通过监督微调实现的反射式GoG行为对齐，灌输了基本的GoG范式，而复杂度自适应强化学习进一步增强了模型通过迭代推理处理复杂查询的能力。在六个基准测试上的实验证明了最先进的性能。消融研究证实，选择性凝视和复杂度自适应强化学习对于有效的视觉搜索至关重要。我们将很快发布我们的数据和模型，供进一步探索。
tldr: The paper introduces Glance-or-Gaze (GoG), a reinforcement learning-based framework for search-augmented LMMs that adaptively focuses visual search, achieving state-of-the-art performance on knowledge-intensive visual understanding tasks by dynamically choosing between global context and high-value regions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Glance-or-Gaze (GoG)，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于增强搜索的大型多模态模型（LMMs），通过动态地选择全局上下文和高价值区域来自适应地聚焦视觉搜索，在知识密集型视觉理解任务上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Reasoning is a Modality
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) provides a compact laboratory for studying abstract reasoning, an ability central to human intelligence. Modern AI systems, including LLMs and ViTs, largely operate as sequence-of-behavior prediction machines: they match observable behaviors by modeling token statistics without a persistent, readable mental state. This creates a gap with human-like behavior: humans can explain an action by decoding internal state, while AI systems can produce fluent post-hoc rationalizations that are not grounded in such a state. We hypothesize that reasoning is a modality: reasoning should exist as a distinct channel separate from the low-level workspace on which rules are applied. To test this hypothesis, on solving ARC tasks as a visual reasoning problem, we designed a novel role-separated transformer block that splits global controller tokens from grid workspace tokens, enabling iterative rule execution. Trained and evaluated within the VARC vision-centric protocol, our method achieved 62.6% accuracy on ARC-1, surpassing average human performance (60.2%) and outperforming prior methods significantly. Qualitatively, our models exhibit more coherent rule-application structure than the dense ViT baseline, consistent with a shift away from plausible probability blobs toward controller-driven reasoning.
summary_zh: 抽象与推理语料库（ARC）为研究抽象推理提供了一个紧凑的实验室，抽象推理是人类智能的核心能力。包括LLM和ViT在内的现代人工智能系统，主要作为行为序列预测机器运行：它们通过建模token统计量来匹配可观察的行为，而没有持久、可读的心理状态。这造成了与类人行为之间的差距：人类可以通过解码内部状态来解释一个行动，而人工智能系统可以生成流畅的事后合理化，这些合理化并非基于这样的状态。我们假设推理是一种模态：推理应该作为一种与规则应用的底层工作空间分离的独特通道而存在。为了验证这一假设，在将解决ARC任务视为视觉推理问题时，我们设计了一种新型的角色分离transformer模块，该模块将全局控制器token与网格工作空间token分离，从而实现迭代规则执行。在VARC以视觉为中心的协议中进行训练和评估后，我们的方法在ARC-1上实现了62.6%的准确率，超过了平均人类表现（60.2%），并显著优于之前的各种方法。定性地，我们的模型比密集的ViT基线表现出更连贯的规则应用结构，这与从似是而非的概率团块向控制器驱动的推理转变相一致。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel transformer architecture with separated controller and workspace tokens to solve ARC tasks, achieving human-level performance and demonstrating more coherent rule application compared to standard ViTs, positing reasoning as a distinct modality.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型Transformer架构，通过分离控制器和工作空间令牌来解决ARC任务，达到了人类水平的性能，并展示了比标准ViT更连贯的规则应用，将推理视为一种独立的模式。

title: Reasoning or Pattern Matching? Probing Large Vision-Language Models with Visual Puzzles
summary: Puzzles have long served as compact and revealing probes of human cognition, isolating abstraction, rule discovery, and systematic reasoning with minimal reliance on prior knowledge. Leveraging these properties, visual puzzles have recently emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for evaluating the reasoning abilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), offering controlled, verifiable alternatives to open-ended multimodal benchmarks. This survey provides a unified perspective of visual puzzle reasoning in LVLMs. We frame visual puzzles through a common abstraction and organize existing benchmarks by the reasoning mechanisms they target (inductive, analogical, algorithmic, deductive, and geometric/spatial), thereby linking puzzle design to the cognitive operations required for solving. Synthesizing empirical evidence across these categories, we identify consistent limitations in current models, including brittle generalization, tight entanglement between perception and reasoning, and a persistent gap between fluent explanations and faithful execution. By framing visual puzzles as diagnostic instruments rather than task formats, this survey elaborates on the state of LVLM reasoning and outlines key directions for future benchmarks and reasoning-aware multimodal systems.
summary_zh: 谜题长期以来都被视为探索人类认知的精简且具有启发性的手段，能够以对先验知识的最小依赖，分离出抽象、规则发现和系统推理能力。利用这些特性，视觉谜题最近作为一种强大的诊断工具崭露头角，用于评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的推理能力，为开放式的多模态基准测试提供了一种可控、可验证的替代方案。本文综述对 LVLMs 中视觉谜题推理提供了一个统一的视角。我们通过一个通用的抽象概念来构建视觉谜题，并根据它们所针对的推理机制（归纳、类比、算法、演绎以及几何/空间）来组织现有的基准测试，从而将谜题设计与解决问题所需的认知操作联系起来。通过综合各个类别中的经验证据，我们发现了当前模型中普遍存在的局限性，包括脆弱的泛化能力、感知与推理之间的紧密耦合，以及流畅的解释和忠实执行之间持续存在的差距。通过将视觉谜题定义为诊断工具而非任务形式，本文综述阐述了 LVLM 推理的现状，并概述了未来基准测试和推理感知的多模态系统的关键方向。
tldr: This survey analyzes how Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) perform on visual puzzles designed to test different reasoning abilities, highlighting current limitations and future directions for research and benchmark development.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述分析了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在测试不同推理能力的视觉谜题上的表现，突出了当前的局限性以及未来研究和基准开发的走向。

title: Scaling Test-time Inference for Visual Grounding
summary: Visual grounding is an essential capability of Visual Language Models (VLMs) to understand the real physical world. Previous state-of-the-art grounding visual language models usually have large model sizes, making them heavy for deployment and slow for inference. However, we notice that the sizes of visual encoders are nearly the same for small and large VLMs and the major difference is the sizes of the language models. Small VLMs fall behind larger VLMs in grounding because of the difference in language understanding capability rather than visual information handling. To mitigate the gap, we introduce 'Efficient visual Grounding language Models' (EGM): a method to scale the test-time computation (#generated tokens). Scaling the test-time computation of a small model is deployment-friendly, and yields better end-to-end latency as the cost of each token is much cheaper compared to directly running a large model. On the RefCOCO benchmark, our EGM-Qwen3-VL-8B demonstrates 91.4 IoU with an average of 737ms (5.9x faster) latency while Qwen3-VL-235B demands 4,320ms to achieve 90.5 IoU. To validate our approach's generality, we further set up a new amodal grounding setting that requires the model to predict both the visible and occluded parts of the objects. Experiments show our method can consistently and significantly improve the vanilla grounding and amodal grounding capabilities of small models to be on par with or outperform the larger models, thereby improving the efficiency for visual grounding.
summary_zh: 视觉定位是视觉语言模型（VLMs）理解真实物理世界的一项关键能力。以往最先进的定位视觉语言模型通常具有较大的模型规模，导致部署困难且推理速度慢。然而，我们注意到，小型和大型VLM 的视觉编码器大小几乎相同，主要差异在于语言模型的大小。小型VLM 在定位方面的性能落后于大型VLM，并非由于视觉信息处理能力的差异，而是由于语言理解能力的差异。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了“高效视觉定位语言模型”（EGM）：一种扩展测试时计算量（#生成的token）的方法。扩展小型模型的测试时计算量对部署来说很友好，并且由于每个token 的成本远低于直接运行大型模型，因此可以实现更好的端到端延迟。在RefCOCO 基准测试中，我们的EGM-Qwen3-VL-8B 在平均737 毫秒（快5.9 倍）的延迟下，展示了91.4 的IoU，而Qwen3-VL-235B 则需要4,320 毫秒才能达到90.5 的IoU。为了验证我们方法的通用性，我们进一步设置了一种新的非模态定位场景，要求模型预测物体的可见和遮挡部分。实验表明，我们的方法可以持续且显著地提高小型模型的原始定位和非模态定位能力，使其与大型模型相当甚至超过大型模型，从而提高视觉定位的效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Efficient visual Grounding language Models (EGM), a method that scales test-time computation for smaller vision-language models, achieving comparable or better grounding performance than larger models with significantly reduced latency by scaling the number of generated tokens.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了高效视觉定位语言模型 (EGM)，它通过扩展测试时计算来提升小型视觉语言模型，通过扩展生成的 token 数量，实现了与大型模型相当甚至更好的定位性能，并显著降低了延迟。

title: CausalSpatial: A Benchmark for Object-Centric Causal Spatial Reasoning
summary: Humans can look at a static scene and instantly predict what happens next -- will moving this object cause a collision? We call this ability Causal Spatial Reasoning. However, current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot do this, as they remain largely restricted to static spatial perception, struggling to answer "what-if" questions in a 3D scene. We introduce CausalSpatial, a diagnostic benchmark evaluating whether models can anticipate consequences of object motions across four tasks: Collision, Compatibility, Occlusion, and Trajectory. Results expose a severe gap: humans score 84% while GPT-5 achieves only 54%. Why do MLLMs fail? Our analysis uncovers a fundamental deficiency: models over-rely on textual chain-of-thought reasoning that drifts from visual evidence, producing fluent but spatially ungrounded hallucinations. To address this, we propose the Causal Object World model (COW), a framework that externalizes the simulation process by generating videos of hypothetical dynamics. With explicit visual cues of causality, COW enables models to ground their reasoning in physical reality rather than linguistic priors. We make the dataset and code publicly available here: https://github.com/CausalSpatial/CausalSpatial
summary_zh: 人类可以观察静态场景并立刻预测接下来会发生什么——移动这个物体会导致碰撞吗？我们将这种能力称为因果空间推理。然而，目前的多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）无法做到这一点，因为它们仍然主要局限于静态空间感知，难以回答3D场景中的“假设……会怎样”的问题。我们引入 CausalSpatial，这是一个诊断性基准，用于评估模型是否能够预测物体运动在四个任务中的后果：碰撞、兼容性、遮挡和轨迹。结果揭示了一个严重的差距：人类的得分是84%，而GPT-5只达到了54%。为什么 MLLM 会失败？我们的分析发现了一个根本缺陷：模型过度依赖于文本思维链推理，而这种推理会偏离视觉证据，从而产生流畅但空间上缺乏依据的幻觉。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了因果物体世界模型（COW），该框架通过生成假设动态的视频来将模拟过程外部化。借助明确的因果视觉提示，COW使模型能够将推理建立在物理现实之上，而不是语言先验。我们在此处公开发布数据集和代码：https://github.com/CausalSpatial/CausalSpatial
tldr: The paper introduces CausalSpatial, a benchmark for evaluating causal spatial reasoning in MLLMs, revealing their deficiencies in grounding reasoning in visual evidence. They propose Causal Object World model (COW) to address this issue by generating videos of hypothetical dynamics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CausalSpatial，一个用于评估多模态大型语言模型中因果空间推理能力的基准，揭示了它们在视觉证据方面推理的不足。他们提出了因果物体世界模型（COW），通过生成假设动态的视频来解决这个问题。

title: Behavior Knowledge Merge in Reinforced Agentic Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is central to post-training, particularly for agentic models that require specialized reasoning behaviors. In this setting, model merging offers a practical mechanism for integrating multiple RL-trained agents from different tasks into a single generalist model. However, existing merging methods are designed for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and they are suboptimal to preserve task-specific capabilities on RL-trained agentic models. The root is a task-vector mismatch between RL and SFT: on-policy RL induces task vectors that are highly sparse and heterogeneous, whereas SFT-style merging implicitly assumes dense and globally comparable task vectors. When standard global averaging is applied under this mismatch, RL's non-overlapping task vectors that encode critical task-specific behaviors are reduced and parameter updates are diluted. To address this issue, we propose Reinforced Agent Merging (RAM), a distribution-aware merging framework explicitly designed for RL-trained agentic models. RAM disentangles shared and task-specific unique parameter updates, averaging shared components while selectively preserving and rescaling unique ones to counteract parameter update dilution. Experiments across multiple agent domains and model architectures demonstrate that RAM not only surpasses merging baselines, but also unlocks synergistic potential among agents to achieve performance superior to that of specialized agents in their domains.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）是后训练的核心，特别是对于需要专门推理行为的主动模型而言。在这种背景下，模型合并提供了一种实用的机制，可以将来自不同任务的多个经过RL训练的智能体整合到一个通用模型中。然而，现有的合并方法是为监督微调（SFT）设计的，因此在保留经过RL训练的主动模型的任务特定能力方面欠佳。其根本原因是RL和SFT之间的任务向量不匹配：在线策略RL会产生高度稀疏且异构的任务向量，而SFT风格的合并则隐式地假设密集且全局可比较的任务向量。当在此不匹配情况下应用标准的全局平均时，RL的非重叠任务向量（编码关键的任务特定行为）会被减少，参数更新会被稀释。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了强化智能体合并（RAM），这是一个专门为经过RL训练的主动模型设计的、具有分布意识的合并框架。RAM解耦了共享参数更新和任务特定的独特参数更新，平均共享组件，同时选择性地保留和重新缩放独特的组件，以抵消参数更新的稀释。跨多个智能体领域和模型架构的实验表明，RAM不仅超越了合并基线，而且还释放了智能体之间的协同潜力，从而实现了优于其领域内专用智能体的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Reinforced Agent Merging (RAM), a novel merging framework tailored for RL-trained agentic models, addressing the limitations of standard merging methods by selectively preserving task-specific parameter updates and unlocking synergistic potential among agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了强化代理合并 (RAM)，这是一种为强化学习训练的代理模型量身定制的新型合并框架。它通过选择性地保留特定于任务的参数更新并释放代理之间的协同潜力，解决了标准合并方法的局限性。

title: Balancing Classification and Calibration Performance in Decision-Making LLMs via Calibration Aware Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in decision-making tasks, where not only accuracy but also reliable confidence estimates are essential. Well-calibrated confidence enables downstream systems to decide when to trust a model and when to defer to fallback mechanisms. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of calibration in two widely used fine-tuning paradigms: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We show that while RLVR improves task performance, it produces extremely overconfident models, whereas SFT yields substantially better calibration, even under distribution shift, though with smaller performance gains. Through targeted experiments, we diagnose RLVR's failure, showing that decision tokens act as extraction steps of the decision in reasoning traces and do not carry confidence information, which prevents reinforcement learning from surfacing calibrated alternatives. Based on this insight, we propose a calibration-aware reinforcement learning formulation that directly adjusts decision-token probabilities. Our method preserves RLVR's accuracy level while mitigating overconfidence, reducing ECE scores up to 9 points.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被部署于决策制定任务中，在这些任务中，不仅准确率，而且可靠的置信度估计至关重要。良好校准的置信度能使下游系统决定何时信任模型，以及何时求助于后备机制。在这项工作中，我们对两种广泛使用的微调范式中的校准进行了系统研究：监督微调(SFT)和具有可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)。我们表明，虽然RLVR提高了任务性能，但它产生了过度自信的模型，而SFT产生了明显更好的校准，即使在分布偏移下也是如此，尽管性能提升较小。通过有针对性的实验，我们诊断了RLVR的失败，表明决策标记充当推理轨迹中决策的提取步骤，并且不携带置信度信息，这阻止了强化学习呈现出校准良好的替代方案。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种校准感知强化学习公式，该公式直接调整决策标记概率。我们的方法在保留RLVR准确率水平的同时，减轻了过度自信，使预期校准误差(ECE)降低了高达9个点。
tldr: This paper investigates the calibration issues in decision-making LLMs, particularly the overconfidence introduced by RLVR compared to SFT, and proposes a calibration-aware RL method to address this problem, improving calibration while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了决策LLM中的校准问题，特别是RLVR相比SFT引入的过度自信，并提出了一种校准感知强化学习方法来解决这个问题，从而在保持准确性的同时提高校准效果。

title: Group-Invariant Unsupervised Skill Discovery: Symmetry-aware Skill Representations for Generalizable Behavior
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery aims to acquire behavior primitives that improve exploration and accelerate downstream task learning. However, existing approaches often ignore the geometric symmetries of physical environments, leading to redundant behaviors and sample inefficiency. To address this, we introduce Group-Invariant Skill Discovery (GISD), a framework that explicitly embeds group structure into the skill discovery objective. Our approach is grounded in a theoretical guarantee: we prove that in group-symmetric environments, the standard Wasserstein dependency measure admits a globally optimal solution comprised of an equivariant policy and a group-invariant scoring function. Motivated by this, we formulate the Group-Invariant Wasserstein dependency measure, which restricts the optimization to this symmetry-aware subspace without loss of optimality. Practically, we parameterize the scoring function using a group Fourier representation and define the intrinsic reward via the alignment of equivariant latent features, ensuring that the discovered skills generalize systematically under group transformations. Experiments on state-based and pixel-based locomotion benchmarks demonstrate that GISD achieves broader state-space coverage and improved efficiency in downstream task learning compared to a strong baseline.
summary_zh: 无监督技能发现旨在获取行为基元，以改善探索并加速下游任务学习。然而，现有方法通常忽略物理环境中的几何对称性，导致冗余行为和样本低效。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了群不变技能发现（GISD），一个明确将群结构嵌入到技能发现目标中的框架。我们的方法基于一个理论保证：我们证明在群对称环境中，标准的Wasserstein依赖性度量存在一个全局最优解，该解由一个等变策略和一个群不变评分函数组成。受此启发，我们提出了群不变Wasserstein依赖性度量，该度量将优化限制在这个具有对称性意识的子空间中，而不会损失最优性。在实践中，我们使用群傅里叶表示来参数化评分函数，并通过等变隐空间特征的对齐来定义内在奖励，确保所发现的技能在群变换下进行系统地泛化。在基于状态和基于像素的运动基准测试中进行的实验表明，与强大的基线方法相比，GISD实现了更广泛的状态空间覆盖，并在下游任务学习中提高了效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Group-Invariant Skill Discovery (GISD), a framework that leverages geometric symmetries in environments to discover skills more efficiently and generalize better, particularly in locomotion tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了群不变技能发现（GISD），该框架利用环境中几何对称性来更有效地发现技能并更好地泛化，尤其是在运动任务中。

title: Active Cross-Modal Visuo-Tactile Perception of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: This paper presents a novel cross-modal visuo-tactile perception framework for the 3D shape reconstruction of deformable linear objects (DLOs), with a specific focus on cables subject to severe visual occlusions. Unlike existing methods relying predominantly on vision, whose performance degrades under varying illumination, background clutter, or partial visibility, the proposed approach integrates foundation-model-based visual perception with adaptive tactile exploration. The visual pipeline exploits SAM for instance segmentation and Florence for semantic refinement, followed by skeletonization, endpoint detection, and point-cloud extraction. Occluded cable segments are autonomously identified and explored with a tactile sensor, which provides local point clouds that are merged with the visual data through Euclidean clustering and topology-preserving fusion. A B-spline interpolation driven by endpoint-guided point sorting yields a smooth and complete reconstruction of the cable shape. Experimental validation using a robotic manipulator equipped with an RGB-D camera and a tactile pad demonstrates that the proposed framework accurately reconstructs both simple and highly curved single or multiple cable configurations, even when large portions are occluded. These results highlight the potential of foundation-model-enhanced cross-modal perception for advancing robotic manipulation of deformable objects.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的跨模态视觉-触觉感知框架，用于可变形线性物体(DLOs)的三维形状重建，尤其侧重于受到严重视觉遮挡的线缆。与主要依赖视觉的现有方法不同（这些方法在光照变化、背景杂乱或部分可见的情况下性能下降），该方法集成了基于基础模型的视觉感知和自适应触觉探索。视觉流程利用SAM进行实例分割，Florence进行语义精细化，然后进行骨骼化、端点检测和点云提取。遮挡的线缆段被自主识别并使用触觉传感器进行探索，触觉传感器提供局部点云，通过欧几里得聚类和拓扑保持融合将其与视觉数据合并。由端点引导的点排序驱动的B样条插值产生了线缆形状的光滑而完整的重建。使用配备RGB-D相机和触觉垫的机器人机械臂进行的实验验证表明，所提出的框架能够准确地重建简单和高度弯曲的单个或多个线缆配置，即使大部被遮挡。这些结果突出了基础模型增强的跨模态感知在推进可变形物体机器人操作方面的潜力。
tldr: The paper presents a cross-modal visuo-tactile perception framework using foundation models and tactile sensing for 3D shape reconstruction of deformable linear objects (DLOs) like cables, even with significant visual occlusion, demonstrating improved accuracy via robotic manipulation experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于基础模型和触觉传感的跨模态视觉触觉感知框架，用于3D形状重建可变形线性物体（DLO），如电缆。即使存在显著的视觉遮挡，该方法也能通过机器人操作实验展现出更高的重构精度。

title: Efficient Coordination with the System-Level Shared State: An Embodied-AI Native Modular Framework
summary: As Embodied AI systems move from research prototypes to real world deployments, they tend to evolve rapidly while remaining reliable under workload changes and partial failures. In practice, many deployments are only partially decoupled: middleware moves messages, but shared context and feedback semantics are implicit, causing interface drift, cross-module interference, and brittle recovery at scale. We present ANCHOR, a modular framework that makes decoupling and robustness explicit system-level primitives. ANCHOR separates (i) Canonical Records, an evolvable contract for the standardized shared state, from (ii) a communication bus for many-to-many dissemination and feedback-oriented coordination, forming an inspectable end-to-end loop. We validate closed-loop feasibility on a de-identified workflow instantiation, characterize latency distributions under varying payload sizes and publish rates, and demonstrate automatic stream resumption after hard crashes and restarts even with shared-memory loss. Overall, ANCHOR turns ad-hoc integration glue into explicit contracts, enabling controlled degradation under load and self-healing recovery for scalable deployment of closed-loop AI systems.
summary_zh: 随着具身人工智能系统从研究原型走向真实世界的部署，它们往往会快速演进，同时在工作负载变化和局部失效的情况下保持可靠性。但在实践中，许多部署仅实现了部分解耦：中间件负责传递消息，而共享上下文和反馈语义则是隐式的，这会导致接口漂移、跨模块干扰以及大规模下的脆弱恢复。我们提出了ANCHOR，一个模块化框架，将解耦和鲁棒性作为显式的系统级原语。ANCHOR将（i）规范记录（用于标准化共享状态的可演进合约）与（ii）用于多对多传播和面向反馈的协调的通信总线分离，形成一个可检查的端到端闭环。我们在一个去标识化工作流实例上验证了闭环的可行性，表征了不同有效负载大小和发布速率下的延迟分布，并演示了即使在共享内存丢失的情况下，也能在硬崩溃和重启后自动恢复流。总的来说，ANCHOR将临时集成的“胶水代码”转化为显式合约，从而能够在负载下实现受控降级，并实现闭环人工智能系统可扩展部署的自愈恢复。
tldr: The paper introduces ANCHOR, a modular framework for embodied AI systems that aims to improve decoupling and robustness in real-world deployments by explicitly managing shared state and communication.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为ANCHOR的模块化框架，旨在通过显式管理共享状态和通信，提高现实世界部署中具身人工智能系统的解耦性和鲁棒性。

title: HoverAI: An Embodied Aerial Agent for Natural Human-Drone Interaction
summary: Drones operating in human-occupied spaces suffer from insufficient communication mechanisms that create uncertainty about their intentions. We present HoverAI, an embodied aerial agent that integrates drone mobility, infrastructure-independent visual projection, and real-time conversational AI into a unified platform. Equipped with a MEMS laser projector, onboard semi-rigid screen, and RGB camera, HoverAI perceives users through vision and voice, responding via lip-synced avatars that adapt appearance to user demographics. The system employs a multimodal pipeline combining VAD, ASR (Whisper), LLM-based intent classification, RAG for dialogue, face analysis for personalization, and voice synthesis (XTTS v2). Evaluation demonstrates high accuracy in command recognition (F1: 0.90), demographic estimation (gender F1: 0.89, age MAE: 5.14 years), and speech transcription (WER: 0.181). By uniting aerial robotics with adaptive conversational AI and self-contained visual output, HoverAI introduces a new class of spatially-aware, socially responsive embodied agents for applications in guidance, assistance, and human-centered interaction.
summary_zh: 在人类活动空间中运行的无人机，其通信机制不足会导致对其意图的不确定性。我们提出了HoverAI，一个具身空中代理，它将无人机移动性、独立于基础设施的可视化投影和实时对话式人工智能集成到一个统一的平台中。HoverAI配备了MEMS激光投影仪、机载半刚性屏幕和RGB摄像头，通过视觉和语音感知用户，并通过唇形同步的头像进行响应，这些头像的外观会根据用户的人口统计特征进行调整。该系统采用多模态流水线，结合了VAD、ASR (Whisper)、基于LLM的意图分类、用于对话的RAG、用于个性化的人脸分析以及语音合成 (XTTS v2)。评估表明，在命令识别（F1：0.90）、人口统计估计（性别F1：0.89，年龄MAE：5.14岁）和语音转录（WER：0.181）方面具有较高的准确性。通过将空中机器人技术与自适应对话式人工智能和独立的视觉输出相结合，HoverAI引入了一种新型的空间感知、社会响应型具身代理，适用于引导、协助和以人为中心的交互等应用。
tldr: The paper presents HoverAI, an embodied aerial robot that interacts with humans via visual projections and natural language, using a multimodal pipeline for perception, intent classification, and personalized dialogue.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HoverAI，一个通过视觉投影和自然语言与人类交互的具身空中机器人，使用多模态流水线进行感知、意图分类和个性化对话。

title: Communication-Free Collective Navigation for a Swarm of UAVs via LiDAR-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based controller for collective navigation of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in communication-denied environments, enabling robust operation in complex, obstacle-rich environments. Inspired by biological swarms where informed individuals guide groups without explicit communication, we employ an implicit leader-follower framework. In this paradigm, only the leader possesses goal information, while follower UAVs learn robust policies using only onboard LiDAR sensing, without requiring any inter-agent communication or leader identification. Our system utilizes LiDAR point clustering and an extended Kalman filter for stable neighbor tracking, providing reliable perception independent of external positioning systems. The core of our approach is a DRL controller, trained in GPU-accelerated Nvidia Isaac Sim, that enables followers to learn complex emergent behaviors - balancing flocking and obstacle avoidance - using only local perception. This allows the swarm to implicitly follow the leader while robustly addressing perceptual challenges such as occlusion and limited field-of-view. The robustness and sim-to-real transfer of our approach are confirmed through extensive simulations and challenging real-world experiments with a swarm of five UAVs, which successfully demonstrated collective navigation across diverse indoor and outdoor environments without any communication or external localization.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习(DRL)的控制器，用于在通信受限环境中实现无人机(UAV)集群的集体导航，从而在复杂、障碍物丰富的环境中实现稳健运行。受到生物集群的启发，在这种集群中，知情个体在没有显式通信的情况下引导群体，我们采用了一种隐式领导者-追随者框架。在该范例中，只有领导者拥有目标信息，而追随者无人机仅使用机载激光雷达传感学习稳健的策略，无需任何智能体间通信或领导者识别。我们的系统利用激光雷达点云聚类和扩展卡尔曼滤波器进行稳定的邻居跟踪，从而提供独立于外部定位系统的可靠感知。我们方法的核心是一个DRL控制器，该控制器在GPU加速的Nvidia Isaac Sim中进行训练，使追随者能够仅使用局部感知来学习复杂的涌现行为——平衡集群行为和避障。这使得集群能够隐式地跟随领导者，同时稳健地解决诸如遮挡和有限视场等感知挑战。通过广泛的模拟和具有挑战性的真实世界实验，使用五个无人机的集群，证实了我们方法的鲁棒性和从仿真到真实世界的迁移能力，该集群成功地展示了在没有任何通信或外部定位的情况下，跨越各种室内和室外环境的集体导航。
tldr: This paper presents a communication-free UAV swarm navigation system using LiDAR-based DRL, demonstrating successful sim-to-real transfer for collective navigation in complex environments without communication or external localization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于激光雷达的深度强化学习无人机群通信自由导航系统，展示了在复杂环境中无需通信或外部定位即可成功实现集群导航的仿真到真实迁移。

title: Highly Deformable Proprioceptive Membrane for Real-Time 3D Shape Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing the three-dimensional (3D) geometry of object surfaces is essential for robot perception, yet vision-based approaches are generally unreliable under low illumination or occlusion. This limitation motivates the design of a proprioceptive membrane that conforms to the surface of interest and infers 3D geometry by reconstructing its own deformation. Conventional shape-aware membranes typically rely on resistive, capacitive, or magneto-sensitive mechanisms. However, these methods often encounter challenges such as structural complexity, limited compliance during large-scale deformation, and susceptibility to electromagnetic interference. This work presents a soft, flexible, and stretchable proprioceptive silicone membrane based on optical waveguide sensing. The membrane sensor integrates edge-mounted LEDs and centrally distributed photodiodes (PDs), interconnected via liquid-metal traces embedded within a multilayer elastomeric composite. Rich deformation-dependent light intensity signals are decoded by a data-driven model to recover the membrane geometry as a 3D point cloud. On a customized 140 mm square membrane, real-time reconstruction of large-scale out-of-plane deformation is achieved at 90 Hz with an average reconstruction error of 1.3 mm, measured by Chamfer distance, while maintaining accuracy for indentations up to 25 mm. The proposed framework provides a scalable, robust, and low-profile solution for global shape perception in deformable robotic systems.
summary_zh: 重建物体表面的三维 (3D) 几何结构对于机器人感知至关重要，然而基于视觉的方法在低照度或遮挡条件下通常不可靠。这种局限性促使人们设计一种本体感受膜，该膜贴合感兴趣的表面，并通过重建自身的变形来推断 3D 几何结构。传统的形状感知膜通常依赖于电阻、电容或磁敏感机制。然而，这些方法常常面临结构复杂、大规模变形时的顺应性有限以及易受电磁干扰等挑战。本工作提出了一种基于光波导传感的柔软、灵活且可拉伸的本体感受硅胶膜。该膜传感器集成了边缘安装的 LED 和中心分布的光电二极管 (PD)，它们通过嵌入在多层弹性体复合材料内的液态金属走线互连。丰富且依赖于变形的光强度信号通过数据驱动模型进行解码，以将膜几何结构恢复为 3D 点云。在一个定制的 140 毫米方形膜上，以 90 赫兹的频率实现了大规模的离面变形的实时重建，并通过 Chamfer 距离测得的平均重建误差为 1.3 毫米，同时保持了高达 25 毫米压痕的精度。所提出的框架为可变形机器人系统中的全局形状感知提供了一种可扩展、鲁棒且低剖面的解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a soft, proprioceptive membrane using optical waveguide sensing for real-time 3D shape reconstruction, achieving high accuracy and speed in large-scale deformation scenarios, offering a robust solution for shape perception in deformable robotic systems.
