summary_zh: 驾驶员分心仍然是导致机动车碰撞的主要原因之一，因此需要对新型车载技术进行严格评估。本研究评估了先进的大型语言模型（LLM）对话代理（Gemini Live）在实际道路驾驶中产生的视觉和认知负荷，并将其与免提电话、视觉逐向导航（低负荷基线）以及操作跨度（OSPAN）任务（高负荷锚点）进行了比较。三十二名持证驾驶员在完成五个次要任务的同时，通过检测反应任务（DRT）测量认知负荷，通过眼动追踪测量视觉注意力，并通过主观工作负荷评定量表测量主观工作负荷。结果表明，Gemini Live互动（包括单轮和多轮）和免提电话的认知负荷水平相似，均介于视觉逐向导航和OSPAN任务之间。探索性分析表明，认知负荷在较长的多轮对话中保持稳定。所有任务的平均注视时长均远低于既定的2秒安全阈值，证实了较低的视觉负荷。此外，在完成任务期间，驾驶员在短暂注视道路之外设备后，会始终将更长的注视时间分配给道路，尤其是在基于语音的互动中，这使得较长的总视线离开道路时间的发现变得不那么重要。主观评定与客观数据相符，参与者报告Gemini Live的任务努力程度、需求和感知到的分心程度均较低。这些发现表明，先进的LLM对话代理在通过语音界面实施时，产生的认知和视觉负荷与已建立的、低风险的免提标准相当，支持它们在驾驶环境中安全部署。
tldr: This study evaluates the visual and cognitive demands of an in-vehicle LLM conversational agent (Gemini Live) during driving, finding it comparable to hands-free phone calls and posing low visual demand.
tldr_zh: 该研究评估了在驾驶过程中车载LLM对话代理(Gemini Live)的视觉和认知需求，发现其与免提电话相当，且视觉需求较低。

title: Beyond Error-Based Optimization: Experience-Driven Symbolic Regression with Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Symbolic Regression aims to automatically identify compact and interpretable mathematical expressions that model the functional relationship between input and output variables. Most existing search-based symbolic regression methods typically rely on the fitting error to inform the search process. However, in the vast expression space, numerous candidate expressions may exhibit similar error values while differing substantially in structure, leading to ambiguous search directions and hindering convergence to the underlying true function. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework named EGRL-SR (Experience-driven Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Regression). In contrast to traditional error-driven approaches, EGRL-SR introduces a new perspective: leveraging precise historical trajectories and optimizing the action-value network to proactively guide the search process, thereby achieving a more robust expression search. Specifically, we formulate symbolic regression as a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning problem and incorporate hindsight experience replay, allowing the action-value network to generalize common mapping patterns from diverse input-output pairs. Moreover, we design an all-point satisfaction binary reward function that encourages the action-value network to focus on structural patterns rather than low-error expressions, and concurrently propose a structure-guided heuristic exploration strategy to enhance search diversity and space coverage. Experiments on public benchmarks show that EGRL-SR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in recovery rate and robustness, and can recover more complex expressions under the same search budget. Ablation results validate that the action-value network effectively guides the search, with both the reward function and the exploration strategy playing critical roles.
summary_zh: 符号回归旨在自动识别简洁且可解释的数学表达式，用于建模输入和输出变量之间的函数关系。大多数现有的基于搜索的符号回归方法通常依赖于拟合误差来指导搜索过程。然而，在广阔的表达式空间中，大量候选表达式可能表现出相似的误差值，但结构差异很大，导致模糊的搜索方向并阻碍收敛到潜在的真实函数。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种名为EGRL-SR（基于经验的目标条件强化学习符号回归）的新框架。与传统的误差驱动方法不同，EGRL-SR引入了一个新的视角：利用精确的历史轨迹并优化动作价值网络，从而主动指导搜索过程，实现更稳健的表达式搜索。具体而言，我们将符号回归问题形式化为一个目标条件强化学习问题，并结合追溯经验回放，使动作价值网络能够泛化来自各种输入-输出对的常见映射模式。此外，我们设计了一个全点满足二元奖励函数，鼓励动作价值网络专注于结构模式而不是低误差表达式，并同时提出了一种结构引导的启发式探索策略，以增强搜索多样性和空间覆盖率。在公共基准上的实验表明，EGRL-SR在恢复率和鲁棒性方面始终优于最先进的方法，并且可以在相同的搜索预算下恢复更复杂的表达式。消融实验结果验证了动作价值网络有效地指导了搜索，其中奖励函数和探索策略都起着关键作用。
tldr: The paper introduces EGRL-SR, a reinforcement learning framework for symbolic regression that uses experience replay and a goal-conditioned approach to guide the search for mathematical expressions, outperforming traditional error-driven methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于强化学习的符号回归框架EGRL-SR，该框架利用经验回放和目标条件方法来指导数学表达式的搜索，优于传统的基于误差驱动的方法。

title: HCVR Scene Generation: High Compatibility Virtual Reality Environment Generation for Extended Redirected Walking
summary: Natural walking enhances immersion in virtual environments (VEs), but physical space limitations and obstacles hinder exploration, especially in large virtual scenes. Redirected Walking (RDW) techniques mitigate this by subtly manipulating the virtual camera to guide users away from physical collisions within pre-defined VEs. However, RDW efficacy diminishes significantly when substantial geometric divergence exists between the physical and virtual environments, leading to unavoidable collisions. Existing scene generation methods primarily focus on object relationships or layout aesthetics, often neglecting the crucial aspect of physical compatibility required for effective RDW. To address this, we introduce HCVR (High Compatibility Virtual Reality Environment Generation), a novel framework that generates virtual scenes inherently optimized for alignment-based RDW controllers. HCVR first employs ENI++, a novel, boundary-sensitive metric to evaluate the incompatibility between physical and virtual spaces by comparing rotation-sensitive visibility polygons. Guided by the ENI++ compatibility map and user prompts, HCVR utilizes a Large Language Model (LLM) for context-aware 3D asset retrieval and initial layout generation. The framework then strategically adjusts object selection, scaling, and placement to maximize coverage of virtually incompatible regions, effectively guiding users towards RDW-feasible paths. User studies evaluating physical collisions and layout quality demonstrate HCVR's effectiveness with HCVR-generated scenes, resulting in 22.78 times fewer physical collisions and received 35.89\% less on ENI++ score compared to LLM-based generation with RDW, while also receiving 12.5\% higher scores on user feedback to layout design.
summary_zh: 自然行走可以增强在虚拟环境（VEs）中的沉浸感，但物理空间限制和障碍物会阻碍探索，尤其是在大型虚拟场景中。重定向行走（RDW）技术通过巧妙地操纵虚拟摄像机，引导用户避开预定义虚拟环境中的物理碰撞，从而缓解这一问题。然而，当物理环境和虚拟环境之间存在显著的几何差异时，RDW 的有效性会显著降低，导致不可避免的碰撞。现有的场景生成方法主要关注对象关系或布局美学，常常忽略了有效 RDW 所需的关键方面——物理兼容性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 HCVR（高兼容性虚拟现实环境生成），这是一个新颖的框架，用于生成本质上针对基于对齐的 RDW 控制器进行优化的虚拟场景。HCVR 首先采用 ENI++，一种新颖的、对边界敏感的指标，通过比较旋转敏感的可见多边形来评估物理空间和虚拟空间之间的不兼容性。在 ENI++ 兼容性图和用户提示的指导下，HCVR 利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行上下文感知的 3D 资产检索和初始布局生成。然后，该框架策略性地调整对象选择、缩放和放置，以最大限度地覆盖虚拟不兼容区域，从而有效地引导用户走向 RDW 可行的路径。评估物理碰撞和布局质量的用户研究表明，HCVR 对于 HCVR 生成的场景是有效的，与基于 LLM 的 RDW 生成方法相比，物理碰撞次数减少了 22.78 倍，ENI++ 分数降低了 35.89％，同时用户对布局设计的反馈得分也提高了 12.5％。
tldr: The paper introduces HCVR, a framework using LLMs and a novel incompatibility metric (ENI++) to generate VR scenes that are highly compatible with Redirected Walking (RDW) techniques, reducing physical collisions and improving user experience over LLM-based generated scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍HCVR，一个利用LLM和新型不兼容性度量标准(ENI++)生成与重定向行走(RDW)技术高度兼容的VR场景的框架，与基于LLM生成的场景相比，减少了物理碰撞并改善了用户体验。

title: HyperNet-Adaptation for Diffusion-Based Test Case Generation
summary: The increasing deployment of deep learning systems requires systematic evaluation of their reliability in real-world scenarios. Traditional gradient-based adversarial attacks introduce small perturbations that rarely correspond to realistic failures and mainly assess robustness rather than functional behavior. Generative test generation methods offer an alternative but are often limited to simple datasets or constrained input domains. Although diffusion models enable high-fidelity image synthesis, their computational cost and limited controllability restrict their applicability to large-scale testing. We present HyNeA, a generative testing method that enables direct and efficient control over diffusion-based generation. HyNeA provides dataset-free controllability through hypernetworks, allowing targeted manipulation of the generative process without relying on architecture-specific conditioning mechanisms or dataset-driven adaptations such as fine-tuning. HyNeA employs a distinct training strategy that supports instance-level tuning to identify failure-inducing test cases without requiring datasets that explicitly contain examples of similar failures. This approach enables the targeted generation of realistic failure cases at substantially lower computational cost than search-based methods. Experimental results show that HyNeA improves controllability and test diversity compared to existing generative test generators and generalizes to domains where failure-labeled training data is unavailable.
summary_zh: 深度学习系统日益广泛的部署要求对其在真实场景中的可靠性进行系统评估。传统的基于梯度的对抗性攻击引入的微小扰动很少对应于实际故障，并且主要评估鲁棒性而非功能行为。生成式测试生成方法提供了一种替代方案，但通常仅限于简单数据集或受限输入域。虽然扩散模型能够实现高保真图像合成，但其计算成本和有限的可控性限制了其在大规模测试中的适用性。我们提出HyNeA，一种生成式测试方法，可直接且高效地控制基于扩散的生成过程。HyNeA通过超网络提供无数据集的可控性，允许对生成过程进行有针对性的操纵，而无需依赖于特定于架构的条件机制或数据集驱动的自适应（如微调）。HyNeA采用独特的训练策略，支持实例级别的调整，以识别导致故障的测试用例，而不需要明确包含类似故障示例的数据集。与基于搜索的方法相比，这种方法能够以显著更低的计算成本有针对性地生成真实的故障用例。实验结果表明，与现有的生成式测试生成器相比，HyNeA提高了可控性和测试多样性，并且可以推广到缺乏故障标记训练数据的领域。
tldr: The paper introduces HyNeA, a hypernetwork-based method for controllable and efficient test case generation using diffusion models, enabling targeted failure identification in deep learning systems without reliance on specific datasets or architecture adaptations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于超网络的 HyNeA 方法，用于使用扩散模型进行可控且高效的测试用例生成，从而能够在深度学习系统中进行有针对性的故障识别，而无需依赖特定的数据集或架构调整。

title: Influence of Operator Expertise on Robot Supervision and Intervention
summary: With increasing levels of robot autonomy, robots are increasingly being supervised by users with varying levels of robotics expertise. As the diversity of the user population increases, it is important to understand how users with different expertise levels approach the supervision task and how this impacts performance of the human-robot team. This exploratory study investigates how operators with varying expertise levels perceive information and make intervention decisions when supervising a remote robot. We conducted a user study (N=27) where participants supervised a robot autonomously exploring four unknown tunnel environments in a simulator, and provided waypoints to intervene when they believed the robot had encountered difficulties. By analyzing the interaction data and questionnaire responses, we identify differing patterns in intervention timing and decision-making strategies across novice, intermediate, and expert users.
summary_zh: 随着机器人自主程度的不断提高，越来越多的机器人受到具有不同机器人专业知识水平用户的监督。随着用户群体多样性的增加，重要的是了解不同专业知识水平的用户如何处理监督任务，以及这如何影响人机团队的绩效。本探索性研究调查了具有不同专业知识水平的操作员在监督远程机器人时，如何感知信息并做出干预决策。我们进行了一项用户研究（N=27），参与者在一个模拟器中监督一个自主探索四个未知隧道环境的机器人，并在他们认为机器人遇到困难时提供航路点进行干预。通过分析交互数据和问卷调查回复，我们发现了新手、中级和专家用户在干预时机和决策策略上的不同模式。
tldr: This study explores how different levels of user expertise affect remote robot supervision and intervention strategies in simulated tunnel exploration, revealing differences in intervention timing and decision-making among novice, intermediate, and expert users.
tldr_zh: 该研究探讨了不同专业水平的用户如何影响远程机器人监控和干预策略，在模拟隧道探索中，揭示了新手、中级和专家用户在干预时间和决策方面的差异。

title: Systematic Evaluation of Hip Exoskeleton Assistance Parameters for Enhancing Gait Stability During Ground Slip Perturbations
summary: Falls are the leading cause of injury related hospitalization and mortality among older adults. Consequently, mitigating age-related declines in gait stability and reducing fall risk during walking is a critical goal for assistive devices. Lower-limb exoskeletons have the potential to support users in maintaining stability during walking. However, most exoskeleton controllers are optimized to reduce the energetic cost of walking rather than to improve stability. While some studies report stability benefits with assistance, the effects of specific parameters, such as assistance magnitude and duration, remain unexplored. To address this gap, we systematically modulated the magnitude and duration of torque provided by a bilateral hip exoskeleton during slip perturbations in eight healthy adults, quantifying stability using whole-body angular momentum (WBAM). WBAM responses were governed by a significant interaction between assistance magnitude and duration, with duration determining whether exoskeleton assistance was stabilizing or destabilizing relative to not wearing the exoskeleton device. Compared to an existing energy-optimized controller, experimentally identified stability-optimal parameters reduced WBAM range by 25.7% on average. Notably, substantial inter-subject variability was observed in the parameter combinations that minimized WBAM during perturbations. We found that optimizing exoskeleton assistance for energetic outcomes alone is insufficient for improving reactive stability during gait perturbations. Stability-focused exoskeleton control should prioritize temporal assistance parameters and include user-specific personalization. This study represents an important step toward personalized, stability-focused exoskeleton control, with direct implications for improving stability and reducing fall risk in older adults.
summary_zh: 跌倒是老年人因受伤住院和死亡的主要原因。因此，减轻与年龄相关的步态稳定性下降并降低行走过程中的跌倒风险是辅助设备的关键目标。下肢外骨骼有潜力帮助使用者在行走过程中保持稳定。然而，大多数外骨骼控制器都经过优化，以降低行走的能量消耗，而不是提高稳定性。虽然一些研究报告了辅助带来的稳定性益处，但诸如辅助幅度和持续时间等特定参数的影响仍未得到探索。为了弥补这一差距，我们系统地调节了双侧髋关节外骨骼在滑倒扰动期间提供的扭矩幅度和持续时间，并在八名健康成年人身上使用全身角动量 (WBAM) 来量化稳定性。WBAM 响应取决于辅助幅度和持续时间之间的显著交互作用，其中持续时间决定了相对于不穿戴外骨骼设备，外骨骼辅助是稳定的还是不稳定的。与现有的能量优化控制器相比，实验确定的稳定性最优参数平均降低了 25.7% 的 WBAM 范围。值得注意的是，在扰动期间最小化 WBAM 的参数组合中观察到显著的个体间差异。我们发现，仅针对能量消耗优化外骨骼辅助不足以改善步态扰动期间的反应性稳定性。以稳定性为中心的外骨骼控制应优先考虑时间辅助参数，并包含用户特定的个性化。这项研究代表了朝着个性化的、以稳定性为中心的外骨骼控制迈出的重要一步，对提高老年人的稳定性和降低跌倒风险具有直接影响。
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates hip exoskeleton assistance parameters (magnitude and duration) to enhance gait stability during slip perturbations, finding that temporally optimized and personalized assistance reduces instability better than energy-optimized assistance, highlighting the need for stability-focused exoskeleton control.
tldr_zh: 本文系统地评估了髋关节外骨骼辅助参数（幅度和持续时间）以增强滑倒扰动期间的步态稳定性，发现时间优化和个性化的辅助比能量优化辅助更能减少不稳定性，强调了对外骨骼进行稳定性聚焦控制的需求。

title: DWPP: Dynamic Window Pure Pursuit Considering Velocity and Acceleration Constraints
summary: Pure pursuit and its variants are widely used for mobile robot path tracking owing to their simplicity and computational efficiency. However, many conventional approaches do not explicitly account for velocity and acceleration constraints, resulting in discrepancies between commanded and actual velocities that result in overshoot and degraded tracking performance. To address this problem, this paper proposes dynamic window pure pursuit (DWPP), which fundamentally reformulates the command velocity computation process to explicitly incorporate velocity and acceleration constraints. Specifically, DWPP formulates command velocity computation in the velocity space (the $v$-$ω$ plane) and selects the command velocity as the point within the dynamic window that is closest to the line $ω= κv$. Experimental results demonstrate that DWPP avoids constraint-violating commands and achieves superior path-tracking accuracy compared with conventional pure pursuit methods. The proposed method has been integrated into the official Nav2 repository and is publicly available (https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2).
summary_zh: 纯粹跟踪及其变体因其简单性和计算效率而被广泛应用于移动机器人路径跟踪。然而，许多传统方法没有明确考虑速度和加速度约束，导致指令速度与实际速度之间存在差异，从而导致过冲和跟踪性能下降。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种动态窗口纯粹跟踪（DWPP）算法，该算法从根本上重新制定了指令速度计算过程，以明确地纳入速度和加速度约束。具体而言，DWPP在速度空间（$v$-$ω$平面）中建立指令速度计算，并将指令速度选择为动态窗口内最接近直线$ω= κv$的点。实验结果表明，与传统的纯粹跟踪方法相比，DWPP避免了违反约束的指令，并实现了卓越的路径跟踪精度。所提出的方法已集成到官方Nav2存储库中，并可公开获取（https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2）。
tldr: The paper introduces Dynamic Window Pure Pursuit (DWPP), a path tracking algorithm for mobile robots that incorporates velocity and acceleration constraints, leading to improved tracking accuracy. The algorithm has been integrated into the Nav2 repository.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了动态窗口纯粹追踪（DWPP）算法，这是一种用于移动机器人路径跟踪的算法，它考虑了速度和加速度约束，从而提高了跟踪精度。该算法已集成到Nav2存储库中。

title: Implementing Knowledge Representation and Reasoning with Object Oriented Design
summary: This paper introduces KRROOD, a framework designed to bridge the integration gap between modern software engineering and Knowledge Representation & Reasoning (KR&R) systems. While Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is the standard for developing complex applications, existing KR&R frameworks often rely on external ontologies and specialized languages that are difficult to integrate with imperative code. KRROOD addresses this by treating knowledge as a first-class programming abstraction using native class structures, bridging the gap between the logic programming and OOP paradigms. We evaluate the system on the OWL2Bench benchmark and a human-robot task learning scenario. Experimental results show that KRROOD achieves strong performance while supporting the expressive reasoning required for real-world autonomous systems.
summary_zh: 本文介绍KRROOD，一种旨在弥合现代软件工程与知识表示与推理（KR&R）系统之间集成鸿沟的框架。虽然面向对象编程（OOP）是开发复杂应用程序的标准，但现有的KR&R框架通常依赖于外部本体和专用语言，这些语言难以与命令式代码集成。KRROOD通过使用原生类结构将知识视为一流的编程抽象来解决这个问题，从而弥合了逻辑编程和OOP范式之间的差距。我们在OWL2Bench基准测试和人机任务学习场景中评估了该系统。实验结果表明，KRROOD在支持现实世界自主系统所需的富有表现力的推理的同时，也实现了强大的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces KRROOD, a framework integrating Knowledge Representation & Reasoning with Object-Oriented Programming by treating knowledge as native class structures, demonstrating strong performance in OWL2Bench and human-robot task learning. This aims to close the integration gap between KR&R systems and modern software engineering.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 KRROOD 框架，通过将知识视为原生类结构，将知识表示与推理和面向对象编程集成在一起，并在 OWL2Bench 和人机任务学习中表现出强大的性能。这旨在弥合 KR&R 系统与现代软件工程之间的集成差距。

title: Robust Haptic Rendering Using a Nonlinear Impedance Matching Approach (NIMA) for Robotic Laparoscopic Surgery
summary: Background: The integration of haptic feedback into robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) has long been limited by challenges in accurately rendering forces and ensuring system safety. The need for robust, high-fidelity haptic systems is critical for enhancing the precision and reliability of teleoperated surgical tools. Methods: In this study, we present a Nonlinear Impedance Matching Approach (NIMA) designed to improve force rendering by accurately modelling complex tool-tissue interactions. Based on our previously validated Impedance Matching Approach (IMA), our novel NIMA method includes nonlinear dynamics to capture and render tool-tissue forces effectively. Results: NIMA improves force feedback accuracy with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.01 (SD 0.02) N, achieving a 95% reduction in MAE compared to IMA. Furthermore, NIMA effectively eliminates haptic "kickback" by ensuring no force is applied by the haptic device to the user's hand when they release the handle, enhancing both patient safety and user comfort. Conclusion: NIMA's ability to account for nonlinearities in tool-tissue interactions provides an improvement in force fidelity, responsiveness, and precision across various surgical conditions. Our findings promote the advancement of haptic feedback systems for robotic surgery, offering a realistic and reliable interface for robot-assisted surgical procedures.
summary_zh: 背景：触觉反馈集成到机器人辅助微创手术（RAMIS）中长期以来受到精确渲染力和确保系统安全性的挑战限制。对于增强远程操作手术工具的精确性和可靠性而言，稳健、高保真的触觉系统至关重要。方法：在本研究中，我们提出了一种非线性阻抗匹配方法（NIMA），旨在通过精确建模复杂的工具-组织相互作用来提高力渲染能力。基于我们先前验证的阻抗匹配方法（IMA），我们新的NIMA方法包含非线性动力学以有效捕捉和渲染工具-组织力。结果：NIMA提高了力反馈精度，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.01（SD 0.02） N，与IMA相比，MAE降低了95%。此外，NIMA通过确保用户松开手柄时触觉设备不对用户的手施加任何力，有效地消除了触觉“反冲”，从而提高了患者安全性和用户舒适度。结论：NIMA能够考虑工具-组织相互作用中的非线性，从而在各种手术条件下改进了力的保真度、响应性和精度。我们的发现促进了机器人手术触觉反馈系统的进步，为机器人辅助手术程序提供了一个真实可靠的界面。
tldr: The paper introduces a Nonlinear Impedance Matching Approach (NIMA) for haptic rendering in robotic laparoscopic surgery, demonstrating significant improvements in force feedback accuracy and eliminating haptic "kickback" compared to previous methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于机器人腹腔镜手术中触觉渲染的非线性阻抗匹配方法（NIMA），与以往方法相比，该方法在力反馈精度方面有显著提高，并消除了触觉“反冲”。

title: Real-Time Wildfire Localization on the NASA Autonomous Modular Sensor using Deep Learning
summary:
High-altitude, multi-spectral, aerial imagery is scarce and expensive to acquire, yet it is necessary for algorithmic advances and application of machine learning models to high-impact problems such as wildfire detection. We introduce a human-annotated dataset from the NASA Autonomous Modular Sensor (AMS) using 12-channel, medium to high altitude (3 - 50 km) aerial wildfire images similar to those used in current US wildfire missions. Our dataset combines spectral data from 12 different channels, including infrared (IR), short-wave IR (SWIR), and thermal. We take imagery from 20 wildfire missions and randomly sample small patches to generate over 4000 images with high variability, including occlusions by smoke/clouds, easily-confused false positives, and nighttime imagery.
  We demonstrate results from a deep-learning model to automate the human-intensive process of fire perimeter determination. We train two deep neural networks, one for image classification and the other for pixel-level segmentation. The networks are combined into a unique real-time segmentation model to efficiently localize active wildfire on an incoming image feed. Our model achieves 96% classification accuracy, 74% Intersection-over-Union(IoU), and 84% recall surpassing past methods, including models trained on satellite data and classical color-rule algorithms. By leveraging a multi-spectral dataset, our model is able to detect active wildfire at nighttime and behind clouds, while distinguishing between false positives. We find that data from the SWIR, IR, and thermal bands is the most important to distinguish fire perimeters. Our code and dataset can be found here: https://github.com/nasa/Autonomous-Modular-Sensor-Wildfire-Segmentation/tree/main and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-u4vs9rqwkwgdeeeoUhftCxrfe_4QPTn?=usp=drive_link
summary_zh:
高空、多光谱航空影像的获取成本高昂且稀缺，但对于算法进步以及机器学习模型应用于诸如野火探测等高影响力问题至关重要。我们引入了一个由人工标注的数据集，该数据集来自 NASA 自主模块化传感器（AMS），使用 12 通道、中高空（3-50 公里）的航空野火图像，这些图像与当前美国野火任务中使用的图像相似。我们的数据集结合了来自 12 个不同通道的光谱数据，包括红外（IR）、短波红外（SWIR）和热红外。我们选取了来自 20 个野火任务的影像，并随机采样小块以生成超过 4000 张具有高度变异性的图像，其中包括烟雾/云层的遮挡、容易混淆的假阳性以及夜间图像。

我们展示了一个深度学习模型的结果，该模型旨在自动执行人工密集型的火 perimeter 确定过程。我们训练了两个深度神经网络，一个用于图像分类，另一个用于像素级分割。这两个网络被组合成一个独特的实时分割模型，以有效地定位传入图像馈送中的活跃野火。我们的模型达到了 96% 的分类准确率、74% 的交并比（IoU）和 84% 的召回率，超越了过去的方法，包括在卫星数据和经典颜色规则算法上训练的模型。通过利用多光谱数据集，我们的模型能够在夜间和云层后方检测到活跃野火，同时区分假阳性。我们发现来自 SWIR、IR 和热红外波段的数据对于区分火perimeter最为重要。我们的代码和数据集可以在以下位置找到：https://github.com/nasa/Autonomous-Modular-Sensor-Wildfire-Segmentation/tree/main 和 https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-u4vs9rqwkwgdeeeoUhftCxrfe_4QPTn?=usp=drive_link
tldr: This paper introduces a new multi-spectral wildfire dataset from NASA's Autonomous Modular Sensor and presents a deep learning model for real-time wildfire localization, achieving high accuracy in challenging conditions like nighttime and cloud cover.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个来自NASA自主模块化传感器的新的多光谱野火数据集，并提出了一个用于实时野火定位的深度学习模型，该模型在夜间和云层覆盖等具有挑战性的条件下实现了高精度。

title: Pb4U-GNet: Resolution-Adaptive Garment Simulation via Propagation-before-Update Graph Network
summary: Garment simulation is fundamental to various applications in computer vision and graphics, from virtual try-on to digital human modelling. However, conventional physics-based methods remain computationally expensive, hindering their application in time-sensitive scenarios. While graph neural networks (GNNs) offer promising acceleration, existing approaches exhibit poor cross-resolution generalisation, demonstrating significant performance degradation on higher-resolution meshes beyond the training distribution. This stems from two key factors: (1) existing GNNs employ fixed message-passing depth that fails to adapt information aggregation to mesh density variation, and (2) vertex-wise displacement magnitudes are inherently resolution-dependent in garment simulation. To address these issues, we introduce Propagation-before-Update Graph Network (Pb4U-GNet), a resolution-adaptive framework that decouples message propagation from feature updates. Pb4U-GNet incorporates two key mechanisms: (1) dynamic propagation depth control, adjusting message-passing iterations based on mesh resolution, and (2) geometry-aware update scaling, which scales predictions according to local mesh characteristics. Extensive experiments show that even trained solely on low-resolution meshes, Pb4U-GNet exhibits strong generalisability across diverse mesh resolutions, addressing a fundamental challenge in neural garment simulation.
summary_zh: 服装模拟是计算机视觉和图形学中诸多应用的基础，从虚拟试穿到数字人体建模皆需用到。然而，传统的基于物理的方法计算成本仍然很高，阻碍了它们在时间敏感场景中的应用。虽然图神经网络（GNNs）提供了有希望的加速方案，但现有的方法表现出较差的跨分辨率泛化能力，在高分辨率网格上的性能显著下降，超出了训练分布。这源于两个关键因素：（1）现有GNNs采用固定的消息传递深度，无法使信息聚合适应网格密度的变化，以及（2）逐顶点位移幅度在服装模拟中固有地依赖于分辨率。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了“先传播后更新图网络”（Pb4U-GNet），这是一个解耦消息传播和特征更新的分辨率自适应框架。 Pb4U-GNet包含两个关键机制：（1）动态传播深度控制，根据网格分辨率调整消息传递迭代次数，以及（2）几何感知更新缩放，根据局部网格特征缩放预测结果。 大量实验表明，即使仅在低分辨率网格上训练，Pb4U-GNet也展现出强大的跨多种网格分辨率的泛化能力，解决了神经服装模拟中的一项根本性挑战。
tldr: The paper introduces Pb4U-GNet, a graph neural network for garment simulation that adapts to varying mesh resolutions, improving generalization and computational efficiency compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Pb4U-GNet的图神经网络，用于服装模拟，它可以适应不同的网格分辨率，与现有方法相比，提高了泛化能力和计算效率。

title: UBATrack: Spatio-Temporal State Space Model for General Multi-Modal Tracking
summary: Multi-modal object tracking has attracted considerable attention by integrating multiple complementary inputs (e.g., thermal, depth, and event data) to achieve outstanding performance. Although current general-purpose multi-modal trackers primarily unify various modal tracking tasks (i.e., RGB-Thermal infrared, RGB-Depth or RGB-Event tracking) through prompt learning, they still overlook the effective capture of spatio-temporal cues. In this work, we introduce a novel multi-modal tracking framework based on a mamba-style state space model, termed UBATrack. Our UBATrack comprises two simple yet effective modules: a Spatio-temporal Mamba Adapter (STMA) and a Dynamic Multi-modal Feature Mixer. The former leverages Mamba's long-sequence modeling capability to jointly model cross-modal dependencies and spatio-temporal visual cues in an adapter-tuning manner. The latter further enhances multi-modal representation capacity across multiple feature dimensions to improve tracking robustness. In this way, UBATrack eliminates the need for costly full-parameter fine-tuning, thereby improving the training efficiency of multi-modal tracking algorithms. Experiments show that UBATrack outperforms state-of-the-art methods on RGB-T, RGB-D, and RGB-E tracking benchmarks, achieving outstanding results on the LasHeR, RGBT234, RGBT210, DepthTrack, VOT-RGBD22, and VisEvent datasets.
summary_zh: 多模态目标跟踪通过整合多种互补输入（例如，热成像、深度和事件数据）以实现卓越性能，引起了广泛关注。尽管当前通用的多模态跟踪器主要通过提示学习统一各种模态跟踪任务（即，RGB-热红外、RGB-深度或RGB-事件跟踪），但它们仍然忽略了时空线索的有效捕获。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种基于Mamba风格状态空间模型的新型多模态跟踪框架，称为UBATrack。我们的UBATrack包含两个简单而有效的模块：时空Mamba适配器（STMA）和动态多模态特征混合器。前者利用Mamba的长序列建模能力，以适配器调优的方式联合建模跨模态依赖性和时空视觉线索。后者进一步增强了跨多个特征维度的多模态表示能力，以提高跟踪鲁棒性。通过这种方式，UBATrack消除了对昂贵的完整参数微调的需求，从而提高了多模态跟踪算法的训练效率。实验表明，UBATrack在RGB-T、RGB-D和RGB-E跟踪基准上优于最先进的方法，在LasHeR、RGBT234、RGBT210、DepthTrack、VOT-RGBD22和VisEvent数据集上取得了出色的结果。
tldr: The paper introduces UBATrack, a novel multi-modal object tracking framework based on a Mamba-style state space model, achieving state-of-the-art performance on RGB-T, RGB-D, and RGB-E tracking benchmarks with improved training efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 UBATrack，一个基于 Mamba 风格状态空间模型的新型多模态对象跟踪框架，在 RGB-T、RGB-D 和 RGB-E 跟踪基准上实现了最先进的性能，并提高了训练效率。

title: Motion 3-to-4: 3D Motion Reconstruction for 4D Synthesis
summary: We present Motion 3-to-4, a feed-forward framework for synthesising high-quality 4D dynamic objects from a single monocular video and an optional 3D reference mesh. While recent advances have significantly improved 2D, video, and 3D content generation, 4D synthesis remains difficult due to limited training data and the inherent ambiguity of recovering geometry and motion from a monocular viewpoint. Motion 3-to-4 addresses these challenges by decomposing 4D synthesis into static 3D shape generation and motion reconstruction. Using a canonical reference mesh, our model learns a compact motion latent representation and predicts per-frame vertex trajectories to recover complete, temporally coherent geometry. A scalable frame-wise transformer further enables robustness to varying sequence lengths. Evaluations on both standard benchmarks and a new dataset with accurate ground-truth geometry show that Motion 3-to-4 delivers superior fidelity and spatial consistency compared to prior work. Project page is available at https://motion3-to-4.github.io/.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Motion 3-to-4，一个前馈框架，用于从单目视频和一个可选的3D参考网格合成高质量的4D动态物体。尽管最近的进展显著改进了2D、视频和3D内容生成，但由于有限的训练数据以及从单目视角恢复几何和运动的固有模糊性，4D合成仍然很困难。Motion 3-to-4通过将4D合成分解为静态3D形状生成和运动重建来应对这些挑战。使用规范参考网格，我们的模型学习了一种紧凑的运动潜在表示，并预测每帧顶点轨迹以恢复完整的、时间上连贯的几何体。一个可扩展的逐帧transformer进一步实现了对不同序列长度的鲁棒性。在标准的基准测试以及包含精确地面真值几何体的新数据集上的评估表明，与先前的工作相比，Motion 3-to-4提供了更高的保真度和空间一致性。项目主页位于https://motion3-to-4.github.io/。
tldr: Motion 3-to-4 uses a feed-forward network to generate 4D dynamic objects from monocular video input and a reference 3D mesh, achieving improved fidelity and spatial consistency by decoupling shape generation and motion reconstruction.
tldr_zh: Motion 3-to-4 提出了一种前馈框架，可以从单目视频输入和参考3D网格生成高质量的4D动态对象，通过解耦形状生成和运动重建，实现了更高的保真度和空间一致性。

title: Communication-Efficient Multi-Modal Edge Inference via Uncertainty-Aware Distributed Learning
summary: Semantic communication is emerging as a key enabler for distributed edge intelligence due to its capability to convey task-relevant meaning. However, achieving communication-efficient training and robust inference over wireless links remains challenging. This challenge is further exacerbated for multi-modal edge inference (MMEI) by two factors: 1) prohibitive communication overhead for distributed learning over bandwidth-limited wireless links, due to the \emph{multi-modal} nature of the system; and 2) limited robustness under varying channels and noisy multi-modal inputs. In this paper, we propose a three-stage communication-aware distributed learning framework to improve training and inference efficiency while maintaining robustness over wireless channels. In Stage~I, devices perform local multi-modal self-supervised learning to obtain shared and modality-specific encoders without device--server exchange, thereby reducing the communication cost. In Stage~II, distributed fine-tuning with centralized evidential fusion calibrates per-modality uncertainty and reliably aggregates features distorted by noise or channel fading. In Stage~III, an uncertainty-guided feedback mechanism selectively requests additional features for uncertain samples, optimizing the communication--accuracy tradeoff in the distributed setting. Experiments on RGB--depth indoor scene classification show that the proposed framework attains higher accuracy with far fewer training communication rounds and remains robust to modality degradation or channel variation, outperforming existing self-supervised and fully supervised baselines.
summary_zh: 语义通信正成为分布式边缘智能的关键推动因素，因为它能够传递与任务相关的含义。然而，要实现通信高效的训练和在无线链路上的鲁棒推理仍然充满挑战。对于多模态边缘推理（MMEI）而言，这一挑战因以下两个因素而进一步加剧：1）由于系统的\emph{多模态}性质，在带宽受限的无线链路上的分布式学习会产生令人望而却步的通信开销；2）在变化的信道和噪声多模态输入下鲁棒性有限。在本文中，我们提出了一种三阶段的通信感知分布式学习框架，以提高训练和推理的效率，同时保持在无线信道上的鲁棒性。在第一阶段，设备执行本地多模态自监督学习，以获得共享的和模态特定的编码器，无需设备与服务器之间的交换，从而降低通信成本。在第二阶段，采用集中式证据融合的分布式微调校准每种模态的不确定性，并可靠地聚合因噪声或信道衰落而失真的特征。在第三阶段，一种不确定性引导的反馈机制选择性地请求不确定样本的额外特征，从而在分布式环境中优化通信与准确性的权衡。在RGB-深度室内场景分类上的实验表明，所提出的框架以更少的训练通信轮次达到了更高的准确率，并且对模态退化或信道变化保持鲁棒性，优于现有的自监督和完全监督基线。
tldr: This paper introduces a communication-efficient distributed learning framework for multi-modal edge inference, using self-supervised learning, evidential fusion, and uncertainty-guided feedback to improve accuracy and robustness over bandwidth-limited wireless channels.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通信高效的分布式学习框架，用于多模态边缘推理。该框架利用自监督学习、证据融合和不确定性引导的反馈机制，以提高在带宽受限的无线信道上的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Differentiated Pickup Point Offering for Emission Reduction in Last-Mile Delivery
summary: Pickup points are widely recognized as a sustainable alternative to home delivery, as consolidating orders at pickup locations can shorten delivery routes and improve first-attempt success rates. However, these benefits may be negated when customers drive to pick up their orders. This study proposes a Differentiated Pickup Point Offering (DPO) policy that aims to jointly reduce emissions from delivery truck routes and customer travel. Under DPO, each arriving customer is offered a single recommended pickup point, rather than an unrestricted choice among all locations, while retaining the option of home delivery. We study this problem in a dynamic and stochastic setting, where the pickup point offered to each customer depends on previously realized customer locations and delivery choices. To design effective DPO policies, we adopt a reinforcement learning-based approach that accounts for spatial relationships between customers and pickup points and their implications for future route consolidation. Computational experiments show that differentiated pickup point offerings can substantially reduce total carbon emissions. The proposed policies reduce total emissions by up to 9% relative to home-only delivery and by 2% on average compared with alternative policies, including unrestricted pickup point choice and nearest pickup point assignment. Differentiated offerings are particularly effective in dense urban settings with many pickup points and short inter-location distances. Moreover, explicitly accounting for the dynamic nature of customer arrivals and choices is especially important when customers are less inclined to choose pickup point delivery over home delivery.
summary_zh: 取货点被广泛认为是家庭配送的一种可持续替代方案，因为在取货点整合订单可以缩短配送路线并提高首次尝试成功率。然而，当客户开车去取货时，这些优势可能会被抵消。本研究提出了一种差异化取货点提供（DPO）策略，旨在共同减少来自送货卡车路线和客户出行的排放。在DPO下，每个到达的客户都会被推荐一个取货点，而不是在所有地点中不受限制地选择，同时保留家庭配送的选项。我们研究了一个动态和随机环境下的这个问题，其中提供给每个客户的取货点取决于先前实现的客户位置和配送选择。为了设计有效的DPO策略，我们采用了一种基于强化学习的方法，该方法考虑了客户和取货点之间的空间关系及其对未来路线整合的影响。计算实验表明，差异化的取货点提供可以显著减少总碳排放量。相对于仅提供家庭配送，所提出的策略可将总排放量减少多达9%，并且与包括不受限制的取货点选择和最近取货点分配在内的其他策略相比，平均减少2%。差异化提供在取货点多且位置间距离短的密集城市环境中尤其有效。此外，当客户不太倾向于选择取货点配送而不是家庭配送时，明确考虑客户到达和选择的动态特性尤为重要。
tldr: The paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based approach to optimize pickup point offerings for last-mile delivery, aiming to reduce carbon emissions by strategically guiding customers towards specific pickup locations rather than offering unrestricted choice. Results showcase emission reductions compared to home-only delivery and other pickup point strategies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的方法，优化最后一英里配送的取货点方案，旨在通过策略性地引导顾客选择特定的取货点而非提供无限制的选择来减少碳排放。结果表明，与仅送货上门和其他取货点策略相比，碳排放有所降低。

title: From Observation to Prediction: LSTM for Vehicle Lane Change Forecasting on Highway On/Off-Ramps
summary: On and off-ramps are understudied road sections even though they introduce a higher level of variation in highway interactions. Predicting vehicles' behavior in these areas can decrease the impact of uncertainty and increase road safety. In this paper, the difference between this Area of Interest (AoI) and a straight highway section is studied. Multi-layered LSTM architecture to train the AoI model with ExiD drone dataset is utilized. In the process, different prediction horizons and different models' workflow are tested. The results show great promise on horizons up to 4 seconds with prediction accuracy starting from about 76% for the AoI and 94% for the general highway scenarios on the maximum horizon.
summary_zh: 匝道是道路交通中变化性更大的路段，但却鲜有研究。预测车辆在这些区域的行为可以降低不确定性的影响并提高道路安全。本文研究了该兴趣区域（AoI）与直线路段高速公路之间的差异。采用了多层LSTM架构，利用ExiD无人机数据集训练AoI模型。在此过程中，测试了不同的预测范围和不同的模型工作流程。结果表明，在最长预测范围为4秒的情况下，AoI预测精度约为76%，而一般高速公路场景的预测精度约为94%，该方法具有良好的前景。
tldr: This paper uses LSTMs to predict vehicle lane changes near highway on/off-ramps, showing promising accuracy (76% up to 4s horizon) for this understudied area using the ExiD drone dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用LSTM预测高速公路匝道附近车辆的变道行为，使用ExiD无人机数据集，在该研究不足的区域展现了有希望的准确率（在4秒预测范围内达到76%）。

title: Preparation and Motion Study of Magnetically Driven Micro Soft Robot Mimicking the Cownose Ray
summary: In narrow, unstructured underwater environments such as environmental monitoring and minimally invasive medical procedures, micro soft robots exhibit unique advantages due to their flexible movement capabilities and small size. At the same time, applying bionic technology to the structural design of micro soft robots can significantly improve their swimming performance. However, limited by their miniaturization, these robots are difficult to power internally and usually adopt a wireless power supply method. This study designs and fabricates a magnetically responsive, cownose ray-inspired micro soft robot based on the swimming principle of the cownose ray. The robot is made of a certain proportion of NdFeB and PDMS. Then, a three-dimensional Helmholtz coil is used to generate an oscillating harmonic magnetic field to conduct swimming experiments on the robot, exploring the influence of magnetic field parameters on the robot's swimming performance. The experimental results show that the swimming speed is the fastest at B = 5 mT and f = 11 Hz, reaching 5.25 mm/s, which is about 0.5 body lengths per second. In addition, by adjusting the current direction and frequency of the coil, the robot can perform different swimming modes such as straight swimming, turning swimming, and directional swimming. By employing a stepwise adjustment method, the impact of response errors on the robot's trajectory can be effectively reduced. This study demonstrates a method for magnetically driven micro soft robots, laying a foundation for the application of wireless-driven robots in underwater narrow spaces.
summary_zh: 在狭窄、非结构化的水下环境中，例如环境监测和微创医疗手术，微型软体机器人因其灵活的运动能力和小型尺寸而展现出独特的优势。同时，将仿生技术应用于微型软体机器人的结构设计可以显著提高其游泳性能。然而，受限于其小型化，这些机器人难以进行内部供电，通常采用无线供电方式。本研究基于燕魟的游泳原理，设计并制造了一种磁响应的、仿燕魟微型软体机器人。该机器人由一定比例的钕铁硼（NdFeB）和聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）制成。然后，使用三维亥姆霍兹线圈产生振荡谐波磁场，对机器人进行游泳实验，探索磁场参数对机器人游泳性能的影响。实验结果表明，在B=5 mT和f=11 Hz时游泳速度最快，达到5.25 mm/s，约为每秒0.5个体长。此外，通过调整线圈的电流方向和频率，机器人可以执行不同的游泳模式，如直线游泳、转弯游泳和定向游泳。通过采用逐步调整法，可以有效降低响应误差对机器人轨迹的影响。本研究展示了一种磁驱动的微型软体机器人方法，为无线驱动机器人在水下狭窄空间的应用奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper presents a magnetically driven, cownose ray-inspired micro soft robot made of NdFeB and PDMS, demonstrating controlled swimming in a magnetic field with speeds up to 0.5 body lengths per second and demonstrating various swimming modes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种磁驱动的、以牛鼻鲼为灵感的微型软体机器人，该机器人由钕铁硼和PDMS制成。实验证明，该机器人在磁场中能以高达每秒0.5个体长的速度进行可控游泳，并展示了不同的游泳模式。

title: Towards Bound Consistency for the No-Overlap Constraint Using MDDs
summary: Achieving bound consistency for the no-overlap constraint is known to be NP-complete. Therefore, several polynomial-time tightening techniques, such as edge finding, not-first-not-last reasoning, and energetic reasoning, have been introduced for this constraint. In this work, we derive the first bound-consistent algorithm for the no-overlap constraint. By building on the no-overlap MDD defined by Ciré and van Hoeve, we extract bounds of the time window of the jobs, allowing us to tighten start and end times in time polynomial in the number of nodes of the MDD. Similarly, to bound the size and time-complexity, we limit the width of the MDD to a threshold, creating a relaxed MDD that can also be used to relax the bound-consistent filtering. Through experiments on a sequencing problem with time windows and a just-in-time objective ($1 \mid r_j, d_j, \bar{d}_j \mid \sum E_j + \sum T_j$), we observe that the proposed filtering, even with a threshold on the width, achieves a stronger reduction in the number of nodes visited in the search tree compared to the previously proposed precedence-detection algorithm of Ciré and van Hoeve. The new filtering also appears to be complementary to classical propagation methods for the no-overlap constraint, allowing a substantial reduction in both the number of nodes and the solving time on several instances.
summary_zh: 求解无重叠约束的边界一致性问题已知是NP完全问题。因此，针对该约束引入了几种多项式时间复杂度收紧技术，如边寻找、非首非尾推理和能量推理。在本工作中，我们推导出首个无重叠约束的边界一致性算法。通过构建Ciré和van Hoeve定义的无重叠MDD（多值决策图），我们提取作业时间窗口的边界，从而能够以MDD节点数量的多项式时间复杂度收紧开始时间和结束时间。类似地，为了限制大小和时间复杂度，我们将MDD的宽度限制在一个阈值内，创建一个松弛的MDD，该MDD也可用于松弛边界一致性过滤。通过在带有时间窗口和准时制目标($1 \mid r_j, d_j, \bar{d}_j \mid \sum E_j + \sum T_j$)的排序问题上的实验，我们观察到，即使对宽度设置阈值，所提出的过滤方法与先前提出的Ciré和van Hoeve的优先关系检测算法相比，也能在搜索树中访问的节点数量方面实现更强的缩减效果。新的过滤方法似乎也与无重叠约束的经典传播方法互补，从而能够大幅减少多个实例中的节点数量和求解时间。
tldr: This paper presents a bound-consistent algorithm for the no-overlap constraint, utilizing MDDs to tighten job start and end times, and demonstrates improved performance compared to existing methods on a sequencing problem.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对无重叠约束的边界一致算法，利用 MDD 来收紧作业的开始和结束时间，并证明在排序问题上比现有方法有更好的性能。

title: High-Fidelity 3D Tooth Reconstruction by Fusing Intraoral Scans and CBCT Data via a Deep Implicit Representation
summary: High-fidelity 3D tooth models are essential for digital dentistry, but must capture both the detailed crown and the complete root. Clinical imaging modalities are limited: Cone-Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) captures the root but has a noisy, low-resolution crown, while Intraoral Scanners (IOS) provide a high-fidelity crown but no root information. A naive fusion of these sources results in unnatural seams and artifacts. We propose a novel, fully-automated pipeline that fuses CBCT and IOS data using a deep implicit representation. Our method first segments and robustly registers the tooth instances, then creates a hybrid proxy mesh combining the IOS crown and the CBCT root. The core of our approach is to use this noisy proxy to guide a class-specific DeepSDF network. This optimization process projects the input onto a learned manifold of ideal tooth shapes, generating a seamless, watertight, and anatomically coherent model. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations show our method uniquely preserves both the high-fidelity crown from IOS and the patient-specific root morphology from CBCT, overcoming the limitations of each modality and naive stitching.
summary_zh: 高保真3D牙齿模型对于数字化牙科至关重要，但必须捕捉到牙冠的细节和完整的牙根。临床成像方式存在局限性：锥束计算机断层扫描(CBCT)可以捕捉到牙根，但牙冠部分噪声大、分辨率低；而口内扫描仪(IOS)可以提供高保真牙冠，但没有牙根信息。简单地融合这些数据源会导致不自然的裂缝和伪影。我们提出了一种新颖的全自动流程，该流程使用深度隐式表示融合CBCT和IOS数据。我们的方法首先分割并稳健地配准牙齿实例，然后创建一个混合代理网格，结合IOS牙冠和CBCT牙根。我们方法的核心是使用这个带噪声的代理网格来引导类特定的DeepSDF网络。这个优化过程将输入投影到学习到的理想牙齿形状流形上，生成一个无缝的、水密的和在解剖学上连贯的模型。定性和定量评估表明，我们的方法独特地保留了来自IOS的高保真牙冠和来自CBCT的患者特定牙根形态，克服了每种模态的局限性以及简单拼接的问题。
tldr: This paper introduces a deep implicit representation method for fusing intraoral scans (IOS) and cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) data to generate high-fidelity 3D tooth models, preserving both crown and root details.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用深度隐式表示方法融合口内扫描 (IOS) 和锥形束计算机断层扫描 (CBCT) 数据以生成高保真 3D 牙齿模型的技术，能够同时保留牙冠和牙根的细节。

title: RegFreeNet: A Registration-Free Network for CBCT-based 3D Dental Implant Planning
summary: As the commercial surgical guide design software usually does not support the export of implant position for pre-implantation data, existing methods have to scan the post-implantation data and map the implant to pre-implantation space to get the label of implant position for training. Such a process is time-consuming and heavily relies on the accuracy of registration algorithm. Moreover, not all hospitals have paired CBCT data, limitting the construction of multi-center dataset. Inspired by the way dentists determine the implant position based on the neighboring tooth texture, we found that even if the implant area is masked, it will not affect the determination of the implant position. Therefore, we propose to mask the implants in the post-implantation data so that any CBCT containing the implants can be used as training data. This paradigm enables us to discard the registration process and makes it possible to construct a large-scale multi-center implant dataset. On this basis, we proposes ImplantFairy, a comprehensive, publicly accessible dental implant dataset with voxel-level 3D annotations of 1622 CBCT data. Furthermore, according to the area variation characteristics of the tooth's spatial structure and the slope information of the implant, we designed a slope-aware implant position prediction network. Specifically, a neighboring distance perception (NDP) module is designed to adaptively extract tooth area variation features, and an implant slope prediction branch assists the network in learning more robust features through additional implant supervision information. Extensive experiments conducted on ImplantFairy and two public dataset demonstrate that the proposed RegFreeNet achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
summary_zh: 由于商业手术导板设计软件通常不支持导出种植体植入前数据中种植体的位置信息，现有方法必须扫描植入后数据并将种植体映射到植入前空间，以获得用于训练的种植体位置标签。这一过程耗时且严重依赖于配准算法的精度。此外，并非所有医院都拥有配对的 CBCT 数据，限制了多中心数据集的构建。受到牙医根据相邻牙齿纹理确定种植体位置的方式的启发，我们发现即使种植区域被遮蔽，也不会影响种植体位置的确定。因此，我们提出在植入后数据中遮蔽种植体，以便任何包含种植体的 CBCT 都可以用作训练数据。这种方案能够让我们舍弃配准过程，并使构建大规模多中心种植体数据集成为可能。在此基础上，我们提出了 ImplantFairy，一个全面的、可公开访问的牙科种植体数据集，包含 1622 个 CBCT 数据的体素级 3D 注释。此外，根据牙齿空间结构的区域变化特征和种植体的斜度信息，我们设计了一个斜度感知种植体位置预测网络。具体而言，设计了一个邻近距离感知 (NDP) 模块，用于自适应地提取牙齿区域变化特征，而种植体斜度预测分支则通过额外的种植体监督信息，辅助网络学习更鲁棒的特征。在 ImplantFairy 和两个公共数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们提出的 RegFreeNet 实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces RegFreeNet and the ImplantFairy dataset for registration-free 3D dental implant planning using CBCT data, achieving state-of-the-art performance by masking implants in post-implantation data and employing a slope-aware prediction network.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RegFreeNet和ImplantFairy数据集，用于无配准的基于CBCT的3D牙科种植体规划。通过屏蔽植入后数据中的种植体并采用坡度感知预测网络，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Rig-Aware 3D Reconstruction of Vehicle Undercarriages using Gaussian Splatting
summary: Inspecting the undercarriage of used vehicles is a labor-intensive task that requires inspectors to crouch or crawl underneath each vehicle to thoroughly examine it. Additionally, online buyers rarely see undercarriage photos. We present an end-to-end pipeline that utilizes a three-camera rig to capture videos of the undercarriage as the vehicle drives over it, and produces an interactive 3D model of the undercarriage. The 3D model enables inspectors and customers to rotate, zoom, and slice through the undercarriage, allowing them to detect rust, leaks, or impact damage in seconds, thereby improving both workplace safety and buyer confidence. Our primary contribution is a rig-aware Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipeline specifically designed to overcome the challenges of wide-angle lens distortion and low-parallax scenes. Our method overcomes the challenges of wide-angle lens distortion and low-parallax scenes by integrating precise camera calibration, synchronized video streams, and strong geometric priors from the camera rig. We use a constrained matching strategy with learned components, the DISK feature extractor, and the attention-based LightGlue matcher to generate high-quality sparse point clouds that are often unattainable with standard SfM pipelines. These point clouds seed the Gaussian splatting process to generate photorealistic undercarriage models that render in real-time. Our experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that our design choices are essential to achieve state-of-the-art quality.
summary_zh: 检查二手车辆底盘是一项劳动密集型任务，需要检查员蹲伏或爬行到每辆车下进行彻底检查。此外，在线买家很少看到底盘照片。我们提出一个端到端的流程，该流程利用一个三摄像头装置来捕获车辆驶过时底盘的视频，并生成底盘的交互式3D模型。该3D模型使检查员和客户能够旋转、缩放和切片查看底盘，从而在数秒内检测到锈蚀、泄漏或冲击损坏，从而提高工作场所安全性和买家信心。 我们的主要贡献是一个装置感知的运动结构重建（SfM）流程，专门用于克服广角镜头畸变和低视差场景的挑战。我们的方法通过集成精确的相机校准、同步的视频流和来自相机装置的强几何先验，克服了广角镜头畸变和低视差场景的挑战。我们使用具有学习到的组件、DISK特征提取器和基于注意力的LightGlue匹配器的约束匹配策略，以生成高质量的稀疏点云，这些点云通常使用标准SfM流程无法获得。这些点云为高斯溅射过程提供种子，以生成实时渲染的逼真底盘模型。我们的实验和消融研究表明，我们的设计选择对于实现最先进的质量至关重要。
tldr: This paper presents a rig-aware Structure-from-Motion pipeline using Gaussian splatting to generate interactive 3D models of vehicle undercarriages, improving inspection efficiency and buyer confidence.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高斯溅射的、配合相机支架的 Structure-from-Motion 流程，用于生成交互式的车辆底盘3D模型，从而提高检查效率和买家信心。

title: Stabilizing autoregressive forecasts in chaotic systems via multi-rate latent recurrence
summary: Long-horizon autoregressive forecasting of chaotic dynamical systems remains challenging due to rapid error amplification and distribution shift: small one-step inaccuracies compound into physically inconsistent rollouts and collapse of large-scale statistics. We introduce MSR-HINE, a hierarchical implicit forecaster that augments multiscale latent priors with multi-rate recurrent modules operating at distinct temporal scales. At each step, coarse-to-fine recurrent states generate latent priors, an implicit one-step predictor refines the state with multiscale latent injections, and a gated fusion with posterior latents enforces scale-consistent updates; a lightweight hidden-state correction further aligns recurrent memories with fused latents. The resulting architecture maintains long-term context on slow manifolds while preserving fast-scale variability, mitigating error accumulation in chaotic rollouts. Across two canonical benchmarks, MSR-HINE yields substantial gains over a U-Net autoregressive baseline: on Kuramoto-Sivashinsky it reduces end-horizon RMSE by 62.8% at H=400 and improves end-horizon ACC by +0.983 (from -0.155 to 0.828), extending the ACC >= 0.5 predictability horizon from 241 to 400 steps; on Lorenz-96 it reduces RMSE by 27.0% at H=100 and improves end horizon ACC by +0.402 (from 0.144 to 0.545), extending the ACC >= 0.5 horizon from 58 to 100 steps.
summary_zh: 混沌动力系统的长程自回归预测仍然具有挑战性，这是由于误差的快速放大和分布偏移：微小的单步误差会累积成物理上不一致的展开，并导致大规模统计量的崩溃。我们引入了MSR-HINE，一种分层隐式预测器，它使用以不同时间尺度运行的多速率循环模块来增强多尺度潜在先验。在每一步中，由粗到精的循环状态生成潜在先验，一个隐式单步预测器通过多尺度潜在注入来细化状态，并通过与后验潜在变量的门控融合来强制执行尺度一致的更新；一个轻量级的隐藏状态校正进一步将循环记忆与融合的潜在变量对齐。由此产生的架构在保持慢流形上的长期上下文的同时，保留了快速尺度的可变性，从而减轻了混沌展开中的误差累积。在两个典型的基准测试中，MSR-HINE相对于U-Net自回归基线产生了显著的增益：在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky问题上，它在H=400时将最终视界RMSE降低了62.8%，并将最终视界ACC提高了+0.983（从-0.155到0.828），将ACC >= 0.5的可预测性视界从241步扩展到400步；在Lorenz-96问题上，它在H=100时将RMSE降低了27.0%，并将最终视界ACC提高了+0.402（从0.144到0.545），将ACC >= 0.5的视界从58步扩展到100步。
tldr: The paper introduces MSR-HINE, a novel hierarchical implicit forecaster that uses multi-rate recurrent modules and latent priors to stabilize long-horizon autoregressive forecasting in chaotic dynamical systems, demonstrating significant improvements on Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Lorenz-96 benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 MSR-HINE 的新型分层隐式预测器，它利用多速率循环模块和隐变量先验来稳定混沌动力系统中的长程自回归预测，并在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 和 Lorenz-96 基准上取得了显著改进。

title: Landing-Induced Viscoelastic Changes in an Anthropomimetic Foot Joint Structure are Modulated by Foot Structure and Posture
summary: Cadaveric studies have provided important insights into the mechanics of the human foot arch and plantar fascia. However, repeatedly probing posture-dependent viscoelastic responses immediately after landing impact is difficult in biological specimens, leaving the contribution of skeletal architecture to landing dynamics incompletely understood. In this study, we developed an anthropomimetic foot joint structure aimed at replicating the skeletal geometry of the human foot. Using a vertical drop apparatus that simulates landing and a viscoelastic system-identification model, we investigated how skeletal structure and posture modulate the apparent post-impact viscoelastic response. The results show that the multi-jointed anthropomimetic structure exhibited a higher damping ratio than simplified flat and rigid feet. Moreover, ankle dorsiflexion and toe extension systematically shifted the identified parameters, reducing the damping ratio under the tested conditions. Taken together, these findings indicate that an arch-like, multi-jointed skeletal architecture can enhance impact attenuation in an anthropomimetic mechanical foot, and that morphology and passive posture alone can tune the trade-off between attenuation and rebound. The observed posture-dependent trends are qualitatively consistent with reported differences in human landing strategies, suggesting that skeletal architecture may partly account for the modulation. Furthermore, these results highlight the engineering advantage of anatomically informed skeletal replication for achieving human-like apparent viscoelastic behavior through postural adjustment during landing.
summary_zh: 对尸体的研究为理解人足弓和足底筋膜的力学性能提供了重要的见解。然而，生物标本在着陆冲击后立即重复探测姿势相关的粘弹性响应是困难的，导致骨骼结构对落地动力学的贡献未能得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们开发了一种拟人化的足部关节结构，旨在复制人足部的骨骼几何形状。使用模拟着陆的垂直跌落装置和一个粘弹性系统辨识模型，我们研究了骨骼结构和姿势如何调节明显的冲击后粘弹性响应。结果表明，多关节的拟人化结构比简化的扁平刚性足表现出更高的阻尼比。此外，踝背屈和脚趾伸展系统地改变了辨识出的参数，降低了在测试条件下的阻尼比。综上所述，这些发现表明，拱形、多关节的骨骼结构可以增强拟人化机械足的冲击衰减能力，并且仅仅形态和被动姿势就可以调节衰减和回弹之间的平衡。观察到的姿势相关趋势与已报道的人类着陆策略的差异在质量上一致，表明骨骼结构可能部分解释了这种调节。此外，这些结果突出了在着陆过程中，通过姿势调整来实现类人的明显粘弹性行为时，解剖学指导下的骨骼复制所具有的工程优势。
tldr: This study creates an anthropomimetic foot to study how skeletal structure and posture affect landing impact, finding that arch-like structures and posture influence impact attenuation and rebound.
tldr_zh: 这项研究创建了一个拟人化的足部结构，以研究骨骼结构和姿势如何影响着陆冲击。研究发现，拱形结构和姿势会影响冲击衰减和回弹。

title: Scalable Knee-Point Guided Activity Group Selection in Multi-Tree Genetic Programming for Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
summary: The dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problem is a challenging scheduling problem that requires making decisions on both the execution order of activities and their corresponding execution modes. Genetic programming has been widely applied as a hyper-heuristic to evolve priority rules that guide the selection of activity-mode pairs from the current eligible set. Recently, an activity group selection strategy has been proposed to select a subset of activities rather than a single activity at each decision point, allowing for more effective scheduling by considering the interdependence between activities. Although effective in small-scale instances, this strategy suffers from scalability issues when applied to larger problems. In this work, we enhance the scalability of the group selection strategy by introducing a knee-point-based selection mechanism to identify a promising subset of activities before evaluating their combinations. An activity ordering rule is first used to rank all eligible activity-mode pairs, followed by a knee point selection to find the promising pairs. Then, a group selection rule selects the best activity combination. We develop a multi-tree GP framework to evolve both types of rules simultaneously. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach scales well to large instances and outperforms GP with sequential decision-making in most scenarios.
summary_zh: 动态多模式资源约束项目调度问题是一个极具挑战性的调度问题，它需要在活动执行顺序及其对应的执行模式上做出决策。遗传程序设计已被广泛应用作为一种超启发式方法，以进化出优先规则，从而指导从当前合格集合中选择活动-模式对。最近，一种活动组选择策略被提出，它在每个决策点选择一个活动子集，而非单个活动，从而通过考虑活动之间的相互依赖性来实现更有效的调度。尽管在小规模实例中有效，但该策略在应用于更大规模问题时面临可扩展性问题。在这项工作中，我们通过引入基于拐点的选择机制来增强组选择策略的可扩展性，该机制在评估活动组合之前识别出一个有希望的活动子集。首先使用一个活动排序规则对所有合格的活动-模式对进行排序，然后使用拐点选择来找到有希望的配对。之后，一个组选择规则选择最佳的活动组合。我们开发了一个多树GP框架，同时进化这两种类型的规则。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够很好地扩展到大型实例，并且在大多数情况下优于采用顺序决策的GP。
tldr: The paper introduces a scalable knee-point guided activity group selection method within a multi-tree Genetic Programming framework for solving dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problems, outperforming traditional GP on large instances.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的膝点引导活动组选择方法，在多树遗传编程框架内解决动态多模式资源受限项目调度问题，并在大型实例上优于传统遗传编程。

title: Rethinking Video Generation Model for the Embodied World
summary: Video generation models have significantly advanced embodied intelligence, unlocking new possibilities for generating diverse robot data that capture perception, reasoning, and action in the physical world. However, synthesizing high-quality videos that accurately reflect real-world robotic interactions remains challenging, and the lack of a standardized benchmark limits fair comparisons and progress. To address this gap, we introduce a comprehensive robotics benchmark, RBench, designed to evaluate robot-oriented video generation across five task domains and four distinct embodiments. It assesses both task-level correctness and visual fidelity through reproducible sub-metrics, including structural consistency, physical plausibility, and action completeness. Evaluation of 25 representative models highlights significant deficiencies in generating physically realistic robot behaviors. Furthermore, the benchmark achieves a Spearman correlation coefficient of 0.96 with human evaluations, validating its effectiveness. While RBench provides the necessary lens to identify these deficiencies, achieving physical realism requires moving beyond evaluation to address the critical shortage of high-quality training data. Driven by these insights, we introduce a refined four-stage data pipeline, resulting in RoVid-X, the largest open-source robotic dataset for video generation with 4 million annotated video clips, covering thousands of tasks and enriched with comprehensive physical property annotations. Collectively, this synergistic ecosystem of evaluation and data establishes a robust foundation for rigorous assessment and scalable training of video models, accelerating the evolution of embodied AI toward general intelligence.
summary_zh: 视频生成模型显著推动了具身智能的发展，为生成捕捉物理世界中的感知、推理和动作的多种机器人数据解锁了新的可能性。然而，合成高质量且准确反映真实机器人交互的视频仍然具有挑战性，并且缺乏标准化基准限制了公平比较和进步。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了一个全面的机器人基准测试，RBench，旨在评估以机器人为导向的视频生成，涵盖五个任务领域和四种不同的具身形态。它通过可复现的子指标评估任务层面的正确性和视觉保真度，包括结构一致性、物理合理性和动作完整性。对25个代表性模型的评估突出了在生成物理上真实的机器人行为方面的显著缺陷。此外，该基准测试与人类评估实现了0.96的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数，验证了其有效性。虽然RBench提供了识别这些缺陷的必要视角，但实现物理真实感需要超越评估，以解决高质量训练数据的严重短缺问题。在这些见解的推动下，我们引入了一个改进的四阶段数据管道，产生了RoVid-X，这是最大的开源机器人视频生成数据集，包含400万个带注释的视频片段，涵盖数千个任务，并富含全面的物理属性注释。总而言之，这个评估和数据的协同生态系统为视频模型的严格评估和可扩展训练奠定了坚实的基础，加速了具身人工智能向通用智能的演进。
tldr: This paper introduces RBench, a robotics benchmark for video generation models, and RoVid-X, a large-scale robotic dataset, to address the lack of standardized evaluation and training data in embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了RBench，一个用于视频生成模型的机器人基准测试，以及RoVid-X，一个大规模机器人数据集，旨在解决具身智能中缺乏标准化评估和训练数据的问题。

title: PhysicsMind: Sim and Real Mechanics Benchmarking for Physical Reasoning and Prediction in Foundational VLMs and World Models
summary: Modern foundational Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and video world models have advanced significantly in mathematical, common-sense, and visual reasoning, but their grasp of the underlying physics remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks attempting to measure this matter rely on synthetic, Visual Question Answer templates or focus on perceptual video quality that is tangential to measuring how well the video abides by physical laws. To address this fragmentation, we introduce PhysicsMind, a unified benchmark with both real and simulation environments that evaluates law-consistent reasoning and generation over three canonical principles: Center of Mass, Lever Equilibrium, and Newton's First Law. PhysicsMind comprises two main tasks: i) VQA tasks, testing whether models can reason and determine physical quantities and values from images or short videos, and ii) Video Generation(VG) tasks, evaluating if predicted motion trajectories obey the same center-of-mass, torque, and inertial constraints as the ground truth. A broad range of recent models and video generation models is evaluated on PhysicsMind and found to rely on appearance heuristics while often violating basic mechanics. These gaps indicate that current scaling and training are still insufficient for robust physical understanding, underscoring PhysicsMind as a focused testbed for physics-aware multimodal models. Our data will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 现代基础性多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）和视频世界模型在数学、常识和视觉推理方面取得了显著进展，但它们对潜在物理学的掌握程度仍未得到充分探索。现有的尝试衡量此点的基准测试依赖于合成的、视觉问答模板，或侧重于与衡量视频是否符合物理定律无关的感知视频质量。为了解决这种碎片化，我们引入了PhysicsMind，一个统一的基准测试，包含真实和模拟环境，用于评估基于三个典型原理的守恒推理和生成：质心、杠杆平衡和牛顿第一定律。PhysicsMind包含两个主要任务：i) 视觉问答（VQA）任务，测试模型是否能够推理并从图像或短视频中确定物理量和数值；以及ii) 视频生成（VG）任务，评估预测的运动轨迹是否符合与真实情况相同的质心、扭矩和惯性约束。在PhysicsMind上评估了大量最新的模型和视频生成模型，发现它们依赖于表观启发式方法，同时经常违反基本力学原理。这些差距表明，当前的规模和训练对于鲁棒的物理理解仍然不足，突显了PhysicsMind作为物理感知多模态模型的集中测试平台的作用。我们的数据将在接收后发布。
tldr: The paper introduces PhysicsMind, a new benchmark to evaluate the ability of MLLMs and world models to understand and apply physics principles, finding that current models often fail at basic mechanics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PhysicsMind，一个新的基准，用于评估MLLM和世界模型理解和应用物理原理的能力，发现当前模型在基本力学方面经常失败。

title: From Passive Metric to Active Signal: The Evolving Role of Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable capabilities, their unreliability remains a critical barrier to deployment in high-stakes domains. This survey charts a functional evolution in addressing this challenge: the evolution of uncertainty from a passive diagnostic metric to an active control signal guiding real-time model behavior. We demonstrate how uncertainty is leveraged as an active control signal across three frontiers: in \textbf{advanced reasoning} to optimize computation and trigger self-correction; in \textbf{autonomous agents} to govern metacognitive decisions about tool use and information seeking; and in \textbf{reinforcement learning} to mitigate reward hacking and enable self-improvement via intrinsic rewards. By grounding these advancements in emerging theoretical frameworks like Bayesian methods and Conformal Prediction, we provide a unified perspective on this transformative trend. This survey provides a comprehensive overview, critical analysis, and practical design patterns, arguing that mastering the new trend of uncertainty is essential for building the next generation of scalable, reliable, and trustworthy AI.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)展现出卓越的能力，但其不可靠性仍然是在高风险领域部署的关键障碍。本综述描绘了解决这一挑战的功能演变：不确定性从一种被动的诊断指标演变为一种主动的控制信号，用于指导实时的模型行为。我们展示了如何将不确定性作为一种主动的控制信号应用于三个前沿领域：在\textbf{高级推理}中，优化计算并触发自我修正；在\textbf{自主智能体}中，管理关于工具使用和信息检索的元认知决策；以及在\textbf{强化学习}中，缓解奖励入侵并实现通过内在奖励的自我提升。通过将这些进展置于诸如贝叶斯方法和保形预测等新兴理论框架中，我们为这种变革趋势提供了一个统一的视角。本综述提供了全面的概述、批判性分析和实践设计模式，并认为掌握不确定性的新趋势对于构建下一代可扩展、可靠和值得信赖的人工智能至关重要。
tldr: This survey paper discusses the evolving role of uncertainty quantification in LLMs, transitioning from a passive metric to an active control signal for improving reasoning, agent behavior, and reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该综述文章讨论了不确定性量化在大型语言模型中不断演变的角色，从被动度量转变为主动控制信号，以改善推理、代理行为和强化学习。

title: From Generative Engines to Actionable Simulators: The Imperative of Physical Grounding in World Models
summary: A world model is an AI system that simulates how an environment evolves under actions, enabling planning through imagined futures rather than reactive perception. Current world models, however, suffer from visual conflation: the mistaken assumption that high-fidelity video generation implies an understanding of physical and causal dynamics. We show that while modern models excel at predicting pixels, they frequently violate invariant constraints, fail under intervention, and break down in safety-critical decision-making. This survey argues that visual realism is an unreliable proxy for world understanding. Instead, effective world models must encode causal structure, respect domain-specific constraints, and remain stable over long horizons. We propose a reframing of world models as actionable simulators rather than visual engines, emphasizing structured 4D interfaces, constraint-aware dynamics, and closed-loop evaluation. Using medical decision-making as an epistemic stress test, where trial-and-error is impossible and errors are irreversible, we demonstrate that a world model's value is determined not by how realistic its rollouts appear, but by its ability to support counterfactual reasoning, intervention planning, and robust long-horizon foresight.
summary_zh: 世界模型是一种人工智能系统，它模拟环境如何在行动下演化，从而能够通过想象的未来进行规划，而不是做出反应式感知。然而，当前的世界模型存在视觉混淆问题：错误地认为高保真视频生成意味着对物理和因果动态的理解。我们表明，虽然现代模型擅长预测像素，但它们经常违反不变约束，在干预下失效，并在安全攸关的决策中崩溃。本综述认为，视觉真实感是世界理解的一个不可靠的代理。相反，有效的世界模型必须编码因果结构、尊重特定领域的约束，并在长时程内保持稳定。我们建议将世界模型重新定义为可操作的模拟器，而不是视觉引擎，强调结构化的 4D 接口、具有约束意识的动力学以及闭环评估。我们将医疗决策作为一种认知压力测试——在其中试错是不可能的，而错误是不可逆的——以此证明了世界模型的价值并非取决于其回滚结果有多逼真，而是取决于其支持反事实推理、干预规划和稳健的长时程预测的能力。
tldr: This paper argues that current world models prioritize visual realism over physical grounding, leading to failures in crucial tasks. It proposes reframing world models as actionable simulators that prioritize causal structure, constraint awareness, and closed-loop evaluation for reliable decision-making.
tldr_zh: 本文认为，目前的世界模型过于注重视觉逼真度而忽略了物理基础，导致其在关键任务中失败。文章建议将世界模型重新定义为可行动的模拟器，该模拟器优先考虑因果结构、约束感知和闭环评估，以实现可靠的决策。

title: DTP: A Simple yet Effective Distracting Token Pruning Framework for Vision-Language Action Models
summary: Vision-Language Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress in robotic manipulation by leveraging the powerful perception abilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to understand environments and directly output actions. However, by default, VLA models may overly attend to image tokens in the task-irrelevant region, which we describe as 'distracting tokens'. This behavior can disturb the model from the generation of the desired action tokens in each step, affecting the success rate of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a simple yet effective plug-and-play Distracting Token Pruning (DTP) framework, which dynamically detects and prunes these distracting image tokens. By correcting the model's visual attention patterns, we aim to improve the task success rate, as well as exploring the performance upper boundaries of the model without altering its original architecture or adding additional inputs. Experiments on the SIMPLER Benchmark (Li et al., 2024) show that our method consistently achieving relative improvements in task success rates across different types of novel VLA models, demonstrating generalizability to transformer-based VLAs. Further analysis reveals a negative correlation between the task success rate and the amount of attentions in the task-irrelevant region for all models tested, highlighting a common phenomenon of VLA models that could guide future research. We also publish our code at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CBD3.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）强大的感知能力来理解环境并直接输出动作，在机器人操作领域展现了显著的进展。然而，在默认情况下，VLA模型可能过度关注任务无关区域的图像令牌，我们将其描述为“干扰令牌”。这种行为可能会干扰模型生成每一步所需的动作令牌，从而影响任务的成功率。在本文中，我们介绍了一种简单而有效的即插即用干扰令牌剪枝（DTP）框架，该框架可以动态地检测和剪除这些干扰图像令牌。通过纠正模型的视觉注意力模式，我们的目标是提高任务成功率，并探索模型在不改变其原始架构或添加额外输入的情况下的性能上限。在SIMPLER基准测试（Li et al., 2024）上的实验表明，我们的方法在不同类型的新型VLA模型中始终如一地实现了任务成功率的相对提升，证明了其对基于Transformer的VLA的通用性。进一步的分析揭示了所有测试模型的任务成功率与任务无关区域的注意力量之间的负相关关系，突出了VLA模型的一个共同现象，可以指导未来的研究。我们的代码也已发布在：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CBD3。
tldr: This paper introduces a Distracting Token Pruning (DTP) framework for Vision-Language Action models to improve task success rates by dynamically detecting and pruning task-irrelevant image tokens, demonstrating generalizability across various VLA models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于视觉-语言行动模型的干扰Token剪枝 (DTP) 框架，通过动态检测和剪除与任务无关的图像Token来提高任务成功率，并证明了其在各种VLA模型中的通用性。

title: DextER: Language-driven Dexterous Grasp Generation with Embodied Reasoning
summary: Language-driven dexterous grasp generation requires the models to understand task semantics, 3D geometry, and complex hand-object interactions. While vision-language models have been applied to this problem, existing approaches directly map observations to grasp parameters without intermediate reasoning about physical interactions. We present DextER, Dexterous Grasp Generation with Embodied Reasoning, which introduces contact-based embodied reasoning for multi-finger manipulation. Our key insight is that predicting which hand links contact where on the object surface provides an embodiment-aware intermediate representation bridging task semantics with physical constraints. DextER autoregressively generates embodied contact tokens specifying which finger links contact where on the object surface, followed by grasp tokens encoding the hand configuration. On DexGYS, DextER achieves 67.14% success rate, outperforming state-of-the-art by 3.83%p with 96.4% improvement in intention alignment. We also demonstrate steerable generation through partial contact specification, providing fine-grained control over grasp synthesis.
summary_zh: 基于语言驱动的灵巧抓取生成需要模型理解任务语义、3D几何以及复杂的手-物交互。虽然视觉-语言模型已被应用于此问题，但现有方法直接将观测映射到抓取参数，而没有对物理交互进行中间推理。我们提出了DextER，即通过具身推理进行灵巧抓取生成，它引入了基于接触的具身推理用于多指操控。我们的关键洞见是：预测哪些手部连杆与物体的哪个表面接触，可以提供一个具身感知的中间表示，将任务语义与物理约束联系起来。DextER自回归地生成具身接触令牌，指定哪个手指连杆与物体的哪个表面接触，然后生成编码手部构型的抓取令牌。在DexGYS数据集上，DextER达到了67.14%的成功率，优于最先进水平3.83个百分点，并且意图对齐方面提高了96.4%。我们还通过部分接触规范展示了可导向的生成能力，从而为抓取合成提供了精细的控制。
tldr: The paper introduces DextER, a language-driven dexterous grasp generation method that uses embodied contact reasoning to predict hand-object contacts and generate grasps, achieving state-of-the-art performance on DexGYS.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DextER，一种语言驱动的灵巧抓取生成方法，它使用具身接触推理来预测手-物体的接触并生成抓取姿势，在DexGYS上实现了最先进的性能。

title: Collision-Free Humanoid Traversal in Cluttered Indoor Scenes
summary: We study the problem of collision-free humanoid traversal in cluttered indoor scenes, such as hurdling over objects scattered on the floor, crouching under low-hanging obstacles, or squeezing through narrow passages. To achieve this goal, the humanoid needs to map its perception of surrounding obstacles with diverse spatial layouts and geometries to the corresponding traversal skills. However, the lack of an effective representation that captures humanoid-obstacle relationships during collision avoidance makes directly learning such mappings difficult. We therefore propose Humanoid Potential Field (HumanoidPF), which encodes these relationships as collision-free motion directions, significantly facilitating RL-based traversal skill learning. We also find that HumanoidPF exhibits a surprisingly negligible sim-to-real gap as a perceptual representation. To further enable generalizable traversal skills through diverse and challenging cluttered indoor scenes, we further propose a hybrid scene generation method, incorporating crops of realistic 3D indoor scenes and procedurally synthesized obstacles. We successfully transfer our policy to the real world and develop a teleoperation system where users could command the humanoid to traverse in cluttered indoor scenes with just a single click. Extensive experiments are conducted in both simulation and the real world to validate the effectiveness of our method. Demos and code can be found in our website: https://axian12138.github.io/CAT/.
summary_zh: 我们研究了在杂乱室内场景中实现人形机器人无碰撞穿越的问题，例如跨越散落在地板上的物体、蹲伏于低矮障碍物之下或挤过狭窄通道。为了实现这一目标，人形机器人需要将其对周围障碍物（具有不同的空间布局和几何形状）的感知映射到相应的穿越技能。然而，由于缺乏能够捕捉人形机器人与障碍物之间在避碰过程中关系的有效表示，直接学习这种映射非常困难。因此，我们提出了人形机器人势场（HumanoidPF），它将这些关系编码为无碰撞的运动方向，从而显著促进了基于强化学习的穿越技能学习。我们还发现，作为一种感知表示，HumanoidPF表现出令人惊讶的极小仿真到现实差距。为了进一步实现通过各种具有挑战性的杂乱室内场景的可泛化穿越技能，我们还提出了一种混合场景生成方法，融合了真实的3D室内场景片段和程序合成的障碍物。我们成功地将我们的策略转移到现实世界，并开发了一个遥操作系统，用户只需单击一下即可命令人形机器人在杂乱的室内场景中穿越。我们进行了大量的模拟和现实世界实验，以验证我们方法的有效性。演示和代码可在我们的网站上找到：https://axian12138.github.io/CAT/。
tldr: This paper introduces Humanoid Potential Field (HumanoidPF) for collision-free humanoid traversal in cluttered indoor environments, enabling successful sim-to-real transfer and teleoperation control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于在杂乱室内环境中实现无人驾驶碰撞自由穿越的Humanoid Potential Field (HumanoidPF) 方法，从而能够成功地进行模拟到现实的转移和遥控操作。

title: Keyframe-Based Feed-Forward Visual Odometry
summary: The emergence of visual foundation models has revolutionized visual odometry~(VO) and SLAM, enabling pose estimation and dense reconstruction within a single feed-forward network. However, unlike traditional pipelines that leverage keyframe methods to enhance efficiency and accuracy, current foundation model based methods, such as VGGT-Long, typically process raw image sequences indiscriminately. This leads to computational redundancy and degraded performance caused by low inter-frame parallax, which provides limited contextual stereo information. Integrating traditional geometric heuristics into these methods is non-trivial, as their performance depends on high-dimensional latent representations rather than explicit geometric metrics. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel keyframe-based feed-forward VO. Instead of relying on hand-crafted rules, our approach employs reinforcement learning to derive an adaptive keyframe policy in a data-driven manner, aligning selection with the intrinsic characteristics of the underlying foundation model. We train our agent on TartanAir dataset and conduct extensive evaluations across several real-world datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistent and substantial improvements over state-of-the-art feed-forward VO methods.
summary_zh: 视觉基础模型的出现彻底改变了视觉里程计（VO）和SLAM，使得仅通过一个前馈网络即可实现位姿估计和稠密重建。然而，与利用关键帧方法来提高效率和精度的传统流程不同，当前基于基础模型的方法，如VGGT-Long，通常无差别地处理原始图像序列。这导致了计算冗余和因帧间视差小而引起的性能下降，因为低视差提供的上下文立体信息有限。将传统的几何启发式方法集成到这些方法中并非易事，因为它们的性能依赖于高维潜在表示，而不是显式的几何度量。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种新颖的基于关键帧的前馈VO。我们的方法没有依赖手工设计的规则，而是采用强化学习以数据驱动的方式推导出一个自适应的关键帧策略，从而使选择与底层基础模型的内在特征相一致。我们在TartanAir数据集上训练了我们的代理，并在多个真实世界数据集上进行了广泛的评估。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在最先进的前馈VO方法上取得了持续且显著的改进。
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning approach to select keyframes for feed-forward visual odometry based on visual foundation models, improving performance by reducing computational redundancy and addressing the lack of geometric awareness in existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的关键帧选择方法，用于基于视觉基础模型的feed-forward视觉里程计，通过减少计算冗余并解决现有方法缺乏几何感知的问题，从而提高系统性能。

title: PUMA: Perception-driven Unified Foothold Prior for Mobility Augmented Quadruped Parkour
summary: Parkour tasks for quadrupeds have emerged as a promising benchmark for agile locomotion. While human athletes can effectively perceive environmental characteristics to select appropriate footholds for obstacle traversal, endowing legged robots with similar perceptual reasoning remains a significant challenge. Existing methods often rely on hierarchical controllers that follow pre-computed footholds, thereby constraining the robot's real-time adaptability and the exploratory potential of reinforcement learning. To overcome these challenges, we present PUMA, an end-to-end learning framework that integrates visual perception and foothold priors into a single-stage training process. This approach leverages terrain features to estimate egocentric polar foothold priors, composed of relative distance and heading, guiding the robot in active posture adaptation for parkour tasks. Extensive experiments conducted in simulation and real-world environments across various discrete complex terrains, demonstrate PUMA's exceptional agility and robustness in challenging scenarios.
summary_zh: 四足机器人的跑酷任务已成为敏捷运动的一个极具前景的基准。虽然人类运动员能够有效地感知环境特征，从而选择合适的落脚点来跨越障碍，但赋予腿足机器人类似感知推理的能力仍然是一个重大的挑战。现有方法通常依赖于遵循预先计算的落脚点的分层控制器，从而限制了机器人的实时适应性和强化学习的探索潜力。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了PUMA，一个端到端的学习框架，它将视觉感知和落脚点先验知识集成到一个单阶段训练过程中。这种方法利用地形特征来估计以自我为中心的极坐标落脚点先验，由相对距离和朝向组成，引导机器人在跑酷任务中进行主动的姿态调整。在仿真和真实环境中，对各种离散复杂地形进行的广泛实验表明，PUMA在具有挑战性的场景中表现出卓越的敏捷性和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces PUMA, an end-to-end learning framework that integrates visual perception and foothold priors for quadruped parkour, demonstrating improved agility and robustness in complex terrains.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PUMA，一个端到端的学习框架，它整合了视觉感知和立足点先验，用于四足机器人跑酷，并在复杂地形中展示了改进的敏捷性和稳健性。

title: TeNet: Text-to-Network for Compact Policy Synthesis
summary: Robots that follow natural-language instructions often either plan at a high level using hand-designed interfaces or rely on large end-to-end models that are difficult to deploy for real-time control. We propose TeNet (Text-to-Network), a framework for instantiating compact, task-specific robot policies directly from natural language descriptions. TeNet conditions a hypernetwork on text embeddings produced by a pretrained large language model (LLM) to generate a fully executable policy, which then operates solely on low-dimensional state inputs at high control frequencies. By using the language only once at the policy instantiation time, TeNet inherits the general knowledge and paraphrasing robustness of pretrained LLMs while remaining lightweight and efficient at execution time. To improve generalization, we optionally ground language in behavior during training by aligning text embeddings with demonstrated actions, while requiring no demonstrations at inference time. Experiments on MuJoCo and Meta-World benchmarks show that TeNet produces policies that are orders of magnitude smaller than sequence-based baselines, while achieving strong performance in both multi-task and meta-learning settings and supporting high-frequency control. These results show that text-conditioned hypernetworks offer a practical way to build compact, language-driven controllers for ressource-constrained robot control tasks with real-time requirements.
summary_zh: 遵循自然语言指令的机器人通常要么使用手工设计的接口进行高层次规划，要么依赖于难以部署于实时控制的大型端到端模型。我们提出了TeNet（文本到网络），一种直接从自然语言描述实例化紧凑、特定于任务的机器人策略的框架。TeNet将超网络以文本嵌入为条件，文本嵌入由预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）生成，以生成一个完全可执行的策略，然后该策略仅在高控制频率下对低维状态输入进行操作。通过仅在策略实例化时使用一次语言，TeNet继承了预训练LLM的通用知识和释义鲁棒性，同时在执行时保持轻量和高效。为了提高泛化能力，我们可选择在训练期间通过将文本嵌入与演示动作对齐来将语言与行为联系起来，同时在推理时不需要任何演示。在MuJoCo和Meta-World基准测试上的实验表明，TeNet生成的策略比基于序列的基线小几个数量级，同时在多任务和元学习中都取得了强大的性能，并支持高频控制。这些结果表明，文本条件超网络提供了一种实用的方法，可以为具有实时要求且资源受限的机器人控制任务构建紧凑的、语言驱动的控制器。
tldr: TeNet uses text-conditioned hypernetworks to generate compact, task-specific robot policies from natural language, achieving strong performance on MuJoCo and Meta-World benchmarks while maintaining real-time control capabilities.
tldr_zh: TeNet利用文本条件超网络从自然语言生成紧凑的、特定任务的机器人策略，在MuJoCo和Meta-World基准测试中表现出色，同时保持实时控制能力。

title: AION: Aerial Indoor Object-Goal Navigation Using Dual-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: Object-Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) requires an agent to autonomously explore an unknown environment and navigate toward target objects specified by a semantic label. While prior work has primarily studied zero-shot ObjectNav under 2D locomotion, extending it to aerial platforms with 3D locomotion capability remains underexplored. Aerial robots offer superior maneuverability and search efficiency, but they also introduce new challenges in spatial perception, dynamic control, and safety assurance. In this paper, we propose AION for vision-based aerial ObjectNav without relying on external localization or global maps. AION is an end-to-end dual-policy reinforcement learning (RL) framework that decouples exploration and goal-reaching behaviors into two specialized policies. We evaluate AION on the AI2-THOR benchmark and further assess its real-time performance in IsaacSim using high-fidelity drone models. Experimental results show that AION achieves superior performance across comprehensive evaluation metrics in exploration, navigation efficiency, and safety. The video can be found at https://youtu.be/TgsUm6bb7zg.
summary_zh: 目标导向导航 (ObjectNav) 要求智能体自主探索未知环境，并导航到由语义标签指定的目标物体。先前的工作主要研究了二维运动下的零样本 ObjectNav，而将其扩展到具有三维运动能力的空中平台仍未得到充分探索。空中机器人具有更强的机动性和搜索效率，但也带来了空间感知、动态控制和安全保证方面的新挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为 AION 的方法，用于基于视觉的空中 ObjectNav，且不依赖于外部定位或全局地图。AION 是一个端到端的双策略强化学习 (RL) 框架，它将探索和目标到达行为解耦为两个专门的策略。我们在 AI2-THOR 基准测试中评估了 AION，并使用高保真无人机模型在 IsaacSim 中进一步评估了其实时性能。实验结果表明，AION 在探索、导航效率和安全性等综合评估指标中均取得了优异的性能。相关视频请见 https://youtu.be/TgsUm6bb7zg。
tldr: The paper introduces AION, a dual-policy reinforcement learning framework for vision-based aerial object navigation, demonstrating improved performance in exploration, navigation efficiency, and safety in simulated environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 AION，一个基于视觉的空中物体导航的双策略强化学习框架，并在模拟环境中展示了在探索、导航效率和安全性方面的改进性能。

title: CompliantVLA-adaptor: VLM-Guided Variable Impedance Action for Safe Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: We propose a CompliantVLA-adaptor that augments the state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with vision-language model (VLM)-informed context-aware variable impedance control (VIC) to improve the safety and effectiveness of contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks. Existing VLA systems (e.g., RDT, Pi0, OpenVLA-oft) typically output position, but lack force-aware adaptation, leading to unsafe or failed interactions in physical tasks involving contact, compliance, or uncertainty. In the proposed CompliantVLA-adaptor, a VLM interprets task context from images and natural language to adapt the stiffness and damping parameters of a VIC controller.
