summary_zh: 自动化患者定位在优化扫描流程和提高患者吞吐量方面起着重要作用。利用RGB-D相机捕获的深度信息为估计体内器官位置提供了一种有前景的方法，从而能够实现更精确和高效的定位。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于学习的框架，可以直接从身体表面的单张2D深度图像中预测多个体内器官的3D位置和形状。通过利用大规模全身MRI扫描数据集，我们合成与相应解剖分割配对的深度图像，以训练统一的卷积神经网络架构。我们的方法能够精确定位各种解剖结构，包括骨骼和软组织，而无需显式的表面重建。实验结果表明，将深度传感器集成到放射科工作流程中具有潜力，可以通过自动化患者定位来简化扫描流程并改善患者体验。
tldr: This paper proposes a deep learning framework to predict 3D locations of internal organs from 2D depth images, enabling automated patient positioning using RGB-D cameras.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种深度学习框架，通过2D深度图像预测内部器官的3D位置，从而使用RGB-D相机实现自动患者定位。

title: Analysis of Control Bellman Residual Minimization for Markov Decision Problem
summary: Markov decision problems are most commonly solved via dynamic programming. Another approach is Bellman residual minimization, which directly minimizes the squared Bellman residual objective function. However, compared to dynamic programming, this approach has received relatively less attention, mainly because it is often less efficient in practice and can be more difficult to extend to model-free settings such as reinforcement learning. Nonetheless, Bellman residual minimization has several advantages that make it worth investigating, such as more stable convergence with function approximation for value functions. While Bellman residual methods for policy evaluation have been widely studied, methods for policy optimization (control tasks) have been scarcely explored. In this paper, we establish foundational results for the control Bellman residual minimization for policy optimization.
summary_zh: 马尔可夫决策问题最常见的解决方法是动态规划。另一种方法是贝尔曼残差最小化，它直接最小化平方贝尔曼残差目标函数。然而，与动态规划相比，这种方法受到的关注相对较少，主要是因为它在实践中效率往往较低，并且更难以扩展到诸如强化学习之类的无模型设置。尽管如此，贝尔曼残差最小化具有若干优势，使其值得研究，例如，对于价值函数，在使用函数逼近时具有更稳定的收敛性。尽管用于策略评估的贝尔曼残差方法已被广泛研究，但是用于策略优化（控制任务）的方法却鲜有探索。在本文中，我们建立了用于策略优化的控制贝尔曼残差最小化的基础性结果。
tldr: This paper presents foundational results for Bellman residual minimization in policy optimization (control tasks) within Markov Decision Processes, an area less explored compared to policy evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了马尔可夫决策过程的策略优化（控制任务）中 Bellman 残差最小化的基础性成果，与策略评估相比，这个领域的研究较少。

title: Scaling Effects and Uncertainty Quantification in Neural Actor Critic Algorithms
summary: We investigate the neural Actor Critic algorithm using shallow neural networks for both the Actor and Critic models. The focus of this work is twofold: first, to compare the convergence properties of the network outputs under various scaling schemes as the network width and the number of training steps tend to infinity; and second, to provide precise control of the approximation error associated with each scaling regime. Previous work has shown convergence to ordinary differential equations with random initial conditions under inverse square root scaling in the network width. In this work, we shift the focus from convergence speed alone to a more comprehensive statistical characterization of the algorithm's output, with the goal of quantifying uncertainty in neural Actor Critic methods. Specifically, we study a general inverse polynomial scaling in the network width, with an exponent treated as a tunable hyperparameter taking values strictly between one half and one. We derive an asymptotic expansion of the network outputs, interpreted as statistical estimators, in order to clarify their structure. To leading order, we show that the variance decays as a power of the network width, with an exponent equal to one half minus the scaling parameter, implying improved statistical robustness as the scaling parameter approaches one. Numerical experiments support this behavior and further suggest faster convergence for this choice of scaling. Finally, our analysis yields concrete guidelines for selecting algorithmic hyperparameters, including learning rates and exploration rates, as functions of the network width and the scaling parameter, ensuring provably favorable statistical behavior.
summary_zh: 我们研究了使用浅层神经网络作为Actor和Critic模型的神经Actor-Critic算法。 本文的重点有两个方面：首先，比较在不同的缩放方案下，当网络 шири，即网络宽度和训练步数趋于无穷时，网络输出的收敛特性； 其次，精确控制与每种缩放机制相关的近似误差。 先前的工作表明，网络宽度采用平方根倒数缩放时，算法会收敛到具有随机初始条件的常微分方程。 在这项工作中，我们不再只关注收敛速度，而是更全面地统计表征算法的输出，目标是量化神经Actor-Critic方法中的不确定性。 具体来说，我们研究了一种通用的网络宽度倒数多项式缩放，其指数被视为一个可调的超参数，取值严格介于二分之一和一之间。 我们推导了网络输出的渐近展开，将其解释为统计估计量，以阐明其结构。 在主导阶下，我们表明方差随着网络宽度的幂律衰减，其指数等于二分之一减去缩放参数，这意味着随着缩放参数接近一，统计稳健性得到改善。 数值实验支持这种行为，并进一步表明了对此缩放选择更快的收敛速度。 最后，我们的分析为选择算法超参数（包括学习率和探索率）提供了具体的指导，这些超参数是网络宽度和缩放参数的函数，从而确保了可证明的有利统计行为。
tldr: This paper analyzes the convergence and uncertainty quantification of neural Actor-Critic algorithms with different scaling schemes, providing guidelines for hyperparameter selection to improve statistical robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了神经Actor-Critic算法在不同缩放方案下的收敛性和不确定性量化，并为超参数选择提供了指导，以提高统计稳健性。

title: Low Cost, High Efficiency: LiDAR Place Recognition in Vineyards with Matryoshka Representation Learning
summary: Localization in agricultural environments is challenging due to their unstructured nature and lack of distinctive landmarks. Although agricultural settings have been studied in the context of object classification and segmentation, the place recognition task for mobile robots is not trivial in the current state of the art. In this study, we propose MinkUNeXt-VINE, a lightweight, deep-learning-based method that surpasses state-of-the-art methods in vineyard environments thanks to its pre-processing and Matryoshka Representation Learning multi-loss approach. Our method prioritizes enhanced performance with low-cost, sparse LiDAR inputs and lower-dimensionality outputs to ensure high efficiency in real-time scenarios. Additionally, we present a comprehensive ablation study of the results on various evaluation cases and two extensive long-term vineyard datasets employing different LiDAR sensors. The results demonstrate the efficiency of the trade-off output produced by this approach, as well as its robust performance on low-cost and low-resolution input data. The code is publicly available for reproduction.
summary_zh: 农业环境的非结构化特性和缺乏显著地标使得在其中进行定位极具挑战性。尽管已经有针对农业环境的对象分类和分割研究，但在当前技术水平下，移动机器人的地点识别任务仍然很困难。在本研究中，我们提出了一种轻量级的基于深度学习的方法MinkUNeXt-VINE，该方法凭借其预处理和Matryoshka Representation Learning多损失方法，在葡萄园环境中超越了最先进的方法。我们的方法优先考虑使用低成本的稀疏激光雷达输入和低维输出以增强性能，从而确保在实时场景中的高效率。此外，我们还对不同评估案例和两个使用不同激光雷达传感器的广泛长期葡萄园数据集上的结果进行了全面的消融研究。结果表明了该方法产生的权衡输出的效率，以及其在低成本和低分辨率输入数据上的稳健性能。代码已公开提供，以便复现。
tldr: This paper introduces MinkUNeXt-VINE, a lightweight LiDAR-based place recognition method for vineyards utilizing Matryoshka Representation Learning, achieving state-of-the-art performance with low-cost sensors and efficient computation. The code and data are publicly available.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为MinkUNeXt-VINE的轻量级LiDAR定位方法，该方法利用Matryoshka表示学习，在葡萄园环境中实现了最先进的性能，且成本低、效率高。代码和数据已公开。

title: Attention-Based Neural-Augmented Kalman Filter for Legged Robot State Estimation
summary: In this letter, we propose an Attention-Based Neural-Augmented Kalman Filter (AttenNKF) for state estimation in legged robots. Foot slip is a major source of estimation error: when slip occurs, kinematic measurements violate the no-slip assumption and inject bias during the update step. Our objective is to estimate this slip-induced error and compensate for it. To this end, we augment an Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (InEKF) with a neural compensator that uses an attention mechanism to infer error conditioned on foot-slip severity and then applies this estimate as a post-update compensation to the InEKF state (i.e., after the filter update). The compensator is trained in a latent space, which aims to reduce sensitivity to raw input scales and encourages structured slip-conditioned compensations, while preserving the InEKF recursion. Experiments demonstrate improved performance compared to existing legged-robot state estimators, particularly under slip-prone conditions.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于注意力机制的神经增强卡尔曼滤波器（AttenNKF），用于腿式机器人的状态估计。足部滑动是估计误差的主要来源：当发生滑动时，运动学测量违反了无滑移假设，并在更新步骤中引入偏差。我们的目标是估计这种由滑动引起的误差并对其进行补偿。为此，我们使用神经补偿器增强了不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器（InEKF），该神经补偿器利用注意力机制推断出以足部滑动严重程度为条件的误差，然后将该估计作为后更新补偿应用于InEKF状态（即，在滤波器更新之后）。补偿器在潜在空间中进行训练，旨在降低对原始输入尺度的敏感性，并鼓励结构化的、以滑动为条件的补偿，同时保留InEKF递归。实验表明，与现有的腿式机器人状态估计器相比，尤其是在易滑条件下，性能得到了提升。
tldr: The paper introduces an Attention-Based Neural-Augmented Kalman Filter (AttenNKF) to improve state estimation in legged robots by compensating for foot slip errors, outperforming existing methods, particularly in slip-prone conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于注意力机制的神经增强卡尔曼滤波器（AttenNKF），通过补偿足部滑移误差来提高腿足机器人的状态估计，尤其在易滑条件下，性能优于现有方法。

title: SKETCH: Semantic Key-Point Conditioning for Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory Prediction
summary: Accurate long-horizon vessel trajectory prediction remains challenging due to compounded uncertainty from complex navigation behaviors and environmental factors. Existing methods often struggle to maintain global directional consistency, leading to drifting or implausible trajectories when extrapolated over long time horizons. To address this issue, we propose a semantic-key-point-conditioned trajectory modeling framework, in which future trajectories are predicted by conditioning on a high-level Next Key Point (NKP) that captures navigational intent. This formulation decomposes long-horizon prediction into global semantic decision-making and local motion modeling, effectively restricting the support of future trajectories to semantically feasible subsets. To efficiently estimate the NKP prior from historical observations, we adopt a pretrain-finetune strategy. Extensive experiments on real-world AIS data demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, particularly for long travel durations, directional accuracy, and fine-grained trajectory prediction.
summary_zh: 由于复杂导航行为和环境因素带来的复合不确定性，准确的长时程船舶轨迹预测仍然充满挑战。现有方法通常难以维持全局方向一致性，导致在长时间范围外推时出现漂移或不合理轨迹。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于语义关键点条件的轨迹建模框架，其中未来的轨迹预测以捕获导航意图的高级下一个关键点（NKP）为条件。这种方案将长时程预测分解为全局语义决策和局部运动建模，有效地将未来轨迹的支持限制在语义上可行的子集中。为了从历史观测中有效估计NKP先验，我们采用了一种预训练-微调策略。在真实世界AIS数据上进行的大量实验表明，所提出的方法始终优于最先进的方法，尤其是在长途行驶时间、方向精度和细粒度轨迹预测方面。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel trajectory prediction framework for vessels that conditions on 'Next Key Points' (NKPs) to improve long-horizon directional consistency and accuracy, demonstrably outperforming existing methods on real-world AIS data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的船舶轨迹预测框架，该框架以“下一个关键点”（NKPs）为条件，以提高长时域方向一致性和准确性，并在真实世界AIS数据上证明优于现有方法。

title: Quest2ROS2: A ROS 2 Framework for Bi-manual VR Teleoperation
summary: Quest2ROS2 is an open-source ROS2 framework for bi-manual teleoperation designed to scale robot data collection. Extending Quest2ROS, it overcomes workspace limitations via relative motion-based control, calculating robot movement from VR controller pose changes to enable intuitive, pose-independent operation. The framework integrates essential usability and safety features, including real-time RViz visualization, streamlined gripper control, and a pause-and-reset function for smooth transitions. We detail a modular architecture that supports "Side-by-Side" and "Mirror" control modes to optimize operator experience across diverse platforms. Code is available at: https://github.com/Taokt/Quest2ROS2.
summary_zh: Quest2ROS2是一个开源的ROS2框架，专为双臂遥操作而设计，旨在扩展机器人数据采集规模。它扩展了Quest2ROS，通过基于相对运动的控制克服了工作空间限制，即通过VR控制器姿态变化计算机器人运动，从而实现直观且姿态无关的操作。该框架集成了关键的可用性和安全性功能，包括实时RViz可视化、简化的夹爪控制，以及用于平滑过渡的暂停和重置功能。我们详细介绍了一个模块化架构，该架构支持“并排”和“镜像”控制模式，以优化操作员在各种平台上的体验。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Taokt/Quest2ROS2。
tldr: Quest2ROS2 is an open-source ROS2 framework that extends Quest2ROS for bi-manual VR teleoperation with features like relative motion control and safety mechanisms, facilitating easier robot data collection and intuitive operation.
tldr_zh: Quest2ROS2是一个开源的ROS2框架，它扩展了Quest2ROS，用于双手动VR遥操作，具有相对运动控制和安全机制等功能，从而方便了机器人数据收集和直观操作。

title: Learning long term climate-resilient transport adaptation pathways under direct and indirect flood impacts using reinforcement learning
summary: Climate change is expected to intensify rainfall and other hazards, increasing disruptions in urban transportation systems. Designing effective adaptation strategies is challenging due to the long-term, sequential nature of infrastructure investments, deep uncertainty, and complex cross-sector interactions. We propose a generic decision-support framework that couples an integrated assessment model (IAM) with reinforcement learning (RL) to learn adaptive, multi-decade investment pathways under uncertainty. The framework combines long-term climate projections (e.g., IPCC scenario pathways) with models that map projected extreme-weather drivers (e.g. rain) into hazard likelihoods (e.g. flooding), propagate hazards into urban infrastructure impacts (e.g. transport disruption), and value direct and indirect consequences for service performance and societal costs. Embedded in a reinforcement-learning loop, it learns adaptive climate adaptation policies that trade off investment and maintenance expenditures against avoided impacts. In collaboration with Copenhagen Municipality, we demonstrate the approach on pluvial flooding in the inner city for the horizon of 2024 to 2100. The learned strategies yield coordinated spatial-temporal pathways and improved robustness relative to conventional optimization baselines, namely inaction and random action, illustrating the framework's transferability to other hazards and cities.
summary_zh: 预计气候变化将加剧降雨和其他灾害，进而增加城市交通系统的中断。由于基础设施投资的长期性、序列性，以及深度不确定性和复杂的跨部门交互，设计有效的适应策略极具挑战。我们提出了一种通用的决策支持框架，将综合评估模型（IAM）与强化学习（RL）相结合，以学习不确定性下的自适应、跨越数十年的投资路径。该框架结合了长期气候预测（例如，IPCC情景路径）与模型，这些模型将预测的极端天气驱动因素（例如，降雨）映射到灾害可能性（例如，洪水），将灾害传播到城市基础设施的影响（例如，交通中断），并评估服务绩效和社会成本的直接和间接后果。嵌入强化学习循环中，该框架学习自适应气候适应政策，权衡投资和维护支出与避免的影响。我们与哥本哈根市政府合作，演示了该方法在2024年至2100年期间内城地区暴雨洪涝中的应用。与传统的优化基线（即不作为和随机行动）相比，所学习的策略产生了协调的时空路径并提高了稳健性，从而证明了该框架对其他灾害和城市的可转移性。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for learning climate-resilient transport adaptation pathways under flood impacts, demonstrating its effectiveness in a Copenhagen case study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个强化学习框架，用于学习气候适应性交通运输适应路径，以应对洪水影响，并在哥本哈根的案例研究中验证了其有效性。

title: Emergent Cooperation in Quantum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Using Communication
summary: Emergent cooperation in classical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning has gained significant attention, particularly in the context of Sequential Social Dilemmas (SSDs). While classical reinforcement learning approaches have demonstrated capability for emergent cooperation, research on extending these methods to Quantum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning remains limited, particularly through communication. In this paper, we apply communication approaches to quantum Q-Learning agents: the Mutual Acknowledgment Token Exchange (MATE) protocol, its extension Mutually Endorsed Distributed Incentive Acknowledgment Token Exchange (MEDIATE), the peer rewarding mechanism Gifting, and Reinforced Inter-Agent Learning (RIAL). We evaluate these approaches in three SSDs: the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, Iterated Stag Hunt, and Iterated Game of Chicken. Our experimental results show that approaches using MATE with temporal-difference measure (MATE\textsubscript{TD}), AutoMATE, MEDIATE-I, and MEDIATE-S achieved high cooperation levels across all dilemmas, demonstrating that communication is a viable mechanism for fostering emergent cooperation in Quantum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning.
summary_zh: 经典多智能体强化学习中涌现出的合作行为已受到广泛关注，尤其是在序贯社会困境（SSDs）的背景下。虽然经典强化学习方法已展现出涌现合作的能力，但将这些方法扩展到量子多智能体强化学习的研究仍然有限，特别是通过通信实现扩展。在本文中，我们将通信方法应用于量子Q-学习智能体：互认可令牌交换（MATE）协议及其扩展互认可分布式激励确认令牌交换（MEDIATE）、同伴奖励机制Gifting以及强化智能体间学习（RIAL）。我们在三种SSDs中评估了这些方法：迭代囚徒困境、迭代猎鹿博弈和迭代胆小鬼博弈。我们的实验结果表明，使用时间差度量（MATE\textsubscript{TD}）的MATE、AutoMATE、MEDIATE-I和MEDIATE-S方法在所有困境中都实现了高水平的合作，证明了通信是促进量子多智能体强化学习中涌现合作的可行机制。
tldr: This paper explores the use of communication protocols (MATE, MEDIATE, Gifting, RIAL) to foster cooperation in Quantum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning within Sequential Social Dilemmas, demonstrating the viability of communication for emergent cooperation. The paper's title showcases the core idea that communication aids cooperation in Quantum MARL.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在量子多智能体强化学习中，使用通信协议（MATE, MEDIATE, Gifting, RIAL）来促进合作，特别是在序贯社会困境中，证明了通信对于涌现合作的可行性。论文标题强调了通信在量子多智能体强化学习中促进合作的核心思想。

title: Co-PLNet: A Collaborative Point-Line Network for Prompt-Guided Wireframe Parsing
summary: Wireframe parsing aims to recover line segments and their junctions to form a structured geometric representation useful for downstream tasks such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Existing methods predict lines and junctions separately and reconcile them post-hoc, causing mismatches and reduced robustness. We present Co-PLNet, a point-line collaborative framework that exchanges spatial cues between the two tasks, where early detections are converted into spatial prompts via a Point-Line Prompt Encoder (PLP-Encoder), which encodes geometric attributes into compact and spatially aligned maps. A Cross-Guidance Line Decoder (CGL-Decoder) then refines predictions with sparse attention conditioned on complementary prompts, enforcing point-line consistency and efficiency. Experiments on Wireframe and YorkUrban show consistent improvements in accuracy and robustness, together with favorable real-time efficiency, demonstrating our effectiveness for structured geometry perception.
summary_zh: 线框解析旨在恢复线段及其交点，以形成一种结构化的几何表示，该表示对诸如同步定位与地图构建(SLAM)等下游任务有用。现有方法分别预测线段和交点，并在事后进行协调，导致不匹配和鲁棒性降低。我们提出了Co-PLNet，一种点-线协作框架，可在两个任务之间交换空间线索，其中早期检测结果通过点-线提示编码器(PLP-Encoder)转化为空间提示，该编码器将几何属性编码成紧凑且空间对齐的特征图。然后，交叉引导线段解码器(CGL-Decoder)在互补提示的条件下，通过稀疏注意力机制细化预测结果，增强点-线一致性和效率。在Wireframe和YorkUrban数据集上的实验表明，准确性和鲁棒性均得到持续提升，同时具有良好的实时效率，证明了我们方法在结构化几何感知方面的有效性。
tldr: Co-PLNet introduces a novel point-line collaborative framework for wireframe parsing, using spatial prompts and cross-guidance to improve accuracy and robustness. It demonstrates real-time efficiency for structured geometry perception.
tldr_zh: Co-PLNet 提出了一种新颖的点线协作框架，用于线框解析，通过利用空间提示和交叉指导来提高准确性和鲁棒性。它展示了结构化几何感知的实时效率。

title: Deadline-Aware, Energy-Efficient Control of Domestic Immersion Hot Water Heaters
summary: Typical domestic immersion water heater systems are often operated continuously during winter, heating quickly rather than efficiently and ignoring predictable demand windows and ambient losses. We study deadline-aware control, where the aim is to reach a target temperature at a specified time while minimising energy consumption. We introduce an efficient Gymnasium environment that models an immersion hot water heater with first-order thermal losses and discrete on and off actions of 0 W and 6000 W applied every 120 seconds. Methods include a time-optimal bang-bang baseline, a zero-shot Monte Carlo Tree Search planner, and a Proximal Policy Optimisation policy. We report total energy consumption in watt-hours under identical physical dynamics. Across sweeps of initial temperature from 10 to 30 degrees Celsius, deadline from 30 to 90 steps, and target temperature from 40 to 80 degrees Celsius, PPO achieves the most energy-efficient performance at a 60-step horizon of 2 hours, using 3.23 kilowatt-hours, compared to 4.37 to 10.45 kilowatt-hours for bang-bang control and 4.18 to 6.46 kilowatt-hours for MCTS. This corresponds to energy savings of 26 percent at 30 steps and 69 percent at 90 steps. In a representative trajectory with a 50 kg water mass, 20 degrees Celsius ambient temperature, and a 60 degrees Celsius target, PPO consumes 54 percent less energy than bang-bang control and 33 percent less than MCTS. These results show that learned deadline-aware control reduces energy consumption under identical physical assumptions, while planners provide partial savings without training and learned policies offer near-zero inference cost once trained.
summary_zh: 典型的家用浸入式热水器系统在冬季通常持续运行，加热速度快但效率不高，并且忽略了可预测的需求窗口和环境损耗。我们研究了期限意识控制，其目标是在指定的时间达到目标温度，同时最大限度地减少能源消耗。我们引入了一个高效的Gymnasium环境，该环境对浸入式热水器进行建模，具有一阶热损耗，并且每120秒应用0W和6000W的离散开关动作。方法包括一个时间最优的bang-bang基线策略、一个零样本蒙特卡洛树搜索规划器和一个近端策略优化(PPO)策略。我们报告了在相同物理动力学条件下，以瓦时为单位的总能源消耗。在初始温度从10到30摄氏度、期限从30到90步、目标温度从40到80摄氏度的扫描范围内，PPO在60步（2小时）的范围内获得了最节能的性能，消耗3.23千瓦时，而bang-bang控制消耗4.37至10.45千瓦时，MCTS消耗4.18至6.46千瓦时。这相当于在30步时节省26%的能源，在90步时节省69%的能源。在一个具有代表性的轨迹中，水质量为50公斤，环境温度为20摄氏度，目标温度为60摄氏度，PPO的能耗比bang-bang控制低54%，比MCTS低33%。这些结果表明，在相同的物理假设下，学习到的期限意识控制可以降低能源消耗，而规划器可以在不进行训练的情况下提供部分节能效果，并且学习到的策略在训练完成后提供接近于零的推理成本。
tldr: The paper presents a reinforcement learning approach (PPO) for deadline-aware control of domestic hot water heaters, demonstrating significant energy savings compared to baseline and MCTS methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于家用热水器截止期限感知控制的强化学习方法（PPO），与基线和MCTS方法相比，该方法在节能方面表现出显著的优势。

title: Splat-Portrait: Generalizing Talking Heads with Gaussian Splatting
summary: Talking Head Generation aims at synthesizing natural-looking talking videos from speech and a single portrait image. Previous 3D talking head generation methods have relied on domain-specific heuristics such as warping-based facial motion representation priors to animate talking motions, yet still produce inaccurate 3D avatar reconstructions, thus undermining the realism of generated animations. We introduce Splat-Portrait, a Gaussian-splatting-based method that addresses the challenges of 3D head reconstruction and lip motion synthesis. Our approach automatically learns to disentangle a single portrait image into a static 3D reconstruction represented as static Gaussian Splatting, and a predicted whole-image 2D background. It then generates natural lip motion conditioned on input audio, without any motion driven priors. Training is driven purely by 2D reconstruction and score-distillation losses, without 3D supervision nor landmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that Splat-Portrait exhibits superior performance on talking head generation and novel view synthesis, achieving better visual quality compared to previous works. Our project code and supplementary documents are public available at https://github.com/stonewalking/Splat-portrait.
summary_zh: 说话头生成旨在从语音和单张肖像图像合成看起来自然的说话视频。以往的3D说话头生成方法依赖于特定领域的启发式方法，例如基于形变的 facial motion representation priors 来驱动说话动作，但仍然会产生不准确的3D头像重建，从而削弱了生成动画的真实感。我们介绍了一种基于高斯溅射 (Gaussian Splatting) 的方法 Splat-Portrait，以解决 3D 头部重建和唇部运动合成的挑战。我们的方法自动学习将单张肖像图像解耦成一个由静态高斯溅射表示的静态 3D 重建，以及一个预测的整幅图像 2D 背景。 然后，它在没有任何运动驱动先验的情况下，根据输入音频生成自然的唇部运动。训练仅由 2D 重建和 score-distillation 损失驱动，无需 3D 监督或地标 (landmarks)。实验结果表明，Splat-Portrait 在说话头生成和新视角合成方面表现出卓越性能，与以往工作相比实现了更好的视觉质量。我们的项目代码和补充文档可在 https://github.com/stonewalking/Splat-portrait 公开获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Splat-Portrait, a Gaussian-splatting-based method for generating realistic talking head videos from a single portrait and audio input, achieving superior visual quality compared to previous approaches without relying on 3D supervision or motion priors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Splat-Portrait，一种基于高斯溅射的方法，用于从单张肖像和音频输入生成逼真的说话头像视频，与以前的方法相比，在不需要3D监督或运动先验的情况下实现了卓越的视觉质量。

title: EFSI-DETR: Efficient Frequency-Semantic Integration for Real-Time Small Object Detection in UAV Imagery
summary: Real-time small object detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery remains challenging due to limited feature representation and ineffective multi-scale fusion. Existing methods underutilize frequency information and rely on static convolutional operations, which constrain the capacity to obtain rich feature representations and hinder the effective exploitation of deep semantic features. To address these issues, we propose EFSI-DETR, a novel detection framework that integrates efficient semantic feature enhancement with dynamic frequency-spatial guidance. EFSI-DETR comprises two main components: (1) a Dynamic Frequency-Spatial Unified Synergy Network (DyFusNet) that jointly exploits frequency and spatial cues for robust multi-scale feature fusion, (2) an Efficient Semantic Feature Concentrator (ESFC) that enables deep semantic extraction with minimal computational cost. Furthermore, a Fine-grained Feature Retention (FFR) strategy is adopted to incorporate spatially rich shallow features during fusion to preserve fine-grained details, crucial for small object detection in UAV imagery. Extensive experiments on VisDrone and CODrone benchmarks demonstrate that our EFSI-DETR achieves the state-of-the-art performance with real-time efficiency, yielding improvement of \textbf{1.6}\% and \textbf{5.8}\% in AP and AP$_{s}$ on VisDrone, while obtaining \textbf{188} FPS inference speed on a single RTX 4090 GPU.
summary_zh: 无人机(UAV)图像中的实时小目标检测由于有限的特征表示和无效的多尺度融合仍然具有挑战性。现有方法未能充分利用频率信息，并且依赖于静态卷积操作，这限制了获取丰富特征表示的能力，并阻碍了深度语义特征的有效利用。为了解决这些问题，我们提出EFSI-DETR，一种新型检测框架，它集成了高效的语义特征增强与动态频率-空间引导。EFSI-DETR包含两个主要组成部分：（1）动态频率-空间统一协同网络（DyFusNet），它联合利用频率和空间线索，实现鲁棒的多尺度特征融合；（2）高效语义特征集中器（ESFC），它能够以最小的计算成本实现深度语义提取。此外，采用了一种细粒度特征保留（FFR）策略，在融合过程中结合空间丰富的浅层特征，以保留细粒度细节，这对于无人机图像中的小目标检测至关重要。在 VisDrone 和 CODrone 基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的 EFSI-DETR 实现了最先进的性能和实时效率，在VisDrone上的AP和AP$_{s}$分别提高了\textbf{1.6}\%和\textbf{5.8}\%，同时在单个 RTX 4090 GPU 上获得了\textbf{188} FPS的推理速度。
tldr: The paper introduces EFSI-DETR, a real-time small object detection framework for UAV imagery, which integrates frequency-semantic information and achieves state-of-the-art performance with high FPS on VisDrone and CODrone benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EFSI-DETR，一个用于无人机图像的实时小目标检测框架，它集成了频率-语义信息，并在VisDrone和CODrone基准测试中实现了最先进的性能以及高FPS。

title: Contextual Range-View Projection for 3D LiDAR Point Clouds
summary: Range-view projection provides an efficient method for transforming 3D LiDAR point clouds into 2D range image representations, enabling effective processing with 2D deep learning models. However, a major challenge in this projection is the many-to-one conflict, where multiple 3D points are mapped onto the same pixel in the range image, requiring a selection strategy. Existing approaches typically retain the point with the smallest depth (closest to the LiDAR), disregarding semantic relevance and object structure, which leads to the loss of important contextual information. In this paper, we extend the depth-based selection rule by incorporating contextual information from both instance centers and class labels, introducing two mechanisms: \textit{Centerness-Aware Projection (CAP)} and \textit{Class-Weighted-Aware Projection (CWAP)}. In CAP, point depths are adjusted according to their distance from the instance center, thereby prioritizing central instance points over noisy boundary and background points. In CWAP, object classes are prioritized through user-defined weights, offering flexibility in the projection strategy. Our evaluations on the SemanticKITTI dataset show that CAP preserves more instance points during projection, achieving up to a 3.1\% mIoU improvement compared to the baseline. Furthermore, CWAP enhances the performance of targeted classes while having a negligible impact on the performance of other classes
summary_zh: 范围视图投影提供了一种将3D激光雷达点云高效转换为2D距离图像表示的方法，从而能够有效地使用2D深度学习模型进行处理。然而，这种投影的一个主要挑战是多对一冲突，即多个3D点被映射到距离图像中的同一像素，这需要一种选择策略。现有的方法通常保留深度最小的点（离激光雷达最近），忽略了语义相关性和对象结构，从而导致重要上下文信息的丢失。在本文中，我们通过整合来自实例中心和类别标签的上下文信息，扩展了基于深度的选择规则，引入了两种机制：\textit{中心性感知投影 (CAP)} 和 \textit{类别加权感知投影 (CWAP)}。在 CAP 中，点深度根据其与实例中心的距离进行调整，从而优先考虑中心实例点，而非噪声边界和背景点。在 CWAP 中，通过用户定义的权重来优先考虑对象类别，从而在投影策略中提供灵活性。我们在 SemanticKITTI 数据集上的评估表明，CAP 在投影过程中保留了更多的实例点，与基线相比，mIoU 提高了高达 3.1\%。此外，CWAP 增强了目标类别的性能，同时对其他类别的性能影响可忽略不计。
tldr: This paper introduces Centerness-Aware Projection (CAP) and Class-Weighted-Aware Projection (CWAP) to improve range-view projection of LiDAR point clouds by incorporating contextual information, leading to better performance on SemanticKITTI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了中心感知投影 (CAP) 和类加权感知投影 (CWAP)，通过结合上下文信息来改进 LiDAR 点云的 Range-view 投影，从而在 SemanticKITTI 数据集上获得更好的性能。

title: HomoFM: Deep Homography Estimation with Flow Matching
summary: Deep homography estimation has broad applications in computer vision and robotics. Remarkable progresses have been achieved while the existing methods typically treat it as a direct regression or iterative refinement problem and often struggling to capture complex geometric transformations or generalize across different domains. In this work, we propose HomoFM, a new framework that introduces the flow matching technique from generative modeling into the homography estimation task for the first time. Unlike the existing methods, we formulate homography estimation problem as a velocity field learning problem. By modeling a continuous and point-wise velocity field that transforms noisy distributions into registered coordinates, the proposed network recovers high-precision transformations through a conditional flow trajectory. Furthermore, to address the challenge of domain shifts issue, e.g., the cases of multimodal matching or varying illumination scenarios, we integrate a gradient reversal layer (GRL) into the feature extraction backbone. This domain adaptation strategy explicitly constrains the encoder to learn domain-invariant representations, significantly enhancing the network's robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, showing that HomoFM outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both estimation accuracy and robustness on standard benchmarks. Code and data resource are available at https://github.com/hmf21/HomoFM.
summary_zh: 深度单应性估计在计算机视觉和机器人学中有着广泛的应用。尽管现有方法取得了显著进展，但它们通常将其视为直接回归或迭代细化问题，并且常常难以捕捉复杂的几何变换或在不同领域进行泛化。在这项工作中，我们提出了HomoFM，这是一个新的框架，首次将生成建模中的流匹配技术引入到单应性估计任务中。与现有方法不同，我们将单应性估计问题表述为一个速度场学习问题。通过建模一个连续的逐点速度场，将噪声分布转换为配准坐标，所提出的网络通过条件流轨迹恢复高精度变换。此外，为了解决领域偏移问题，例如多模态匹配或变化光照场景，我们将梯度反转层（GRL）集成到特征提取骨干网络中。这种领域自适应策略明确地约束编码器学习领域不变的表示，从而显著增强了网络的鲁棒性。大量实验证明了所提出方法的有效性，表明HomoFM在标准基准测试中，在估计精度和鲁棒性方面均优于最先进的方法。代码和数据资源可在https://github.com/hmf21/HomoFM获取。
tldr: The paper introduces HomoFM, a new framework for deep homography estimation using flow matching, which learns a continuous velocity field to transform noisy distributions and incorporates a gradient reversal layer for domain adaptation, outperforming existing methods in accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 HomoFM，一个使用流匹配进行深度单应性估计的新框架。该框架学习一个连续的速度场来转换噪声分布，并结合梯度反转层进行领域自适应，在准确性和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法。

title: TempDiffReg: Temporal Diffusion Model for Non-Rigid 2D-3D Vascular Registration
summary: Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a preferred treatment option for hepatocellular carcinoma and other liver malignancies, yet it remains a highly challenging procedure due to complex intra-operative vascular navigation and anatomical variability. Accurate and robust 2D-3D vessel registration is essential to guide microcatheter and instruments during TACE, enabling precise localization of vascular structures and optimal therapeutic targeting. To tackle this issue, we develop a coarse-to-fine registration strategy. First, we introduce a global alignment module, structure-aware perspective n-point (SA-PnP), to establish correspondence between 2D and 3D vessel structures. Second, we propose TempDiffReg, a temporal diffusion model that performs vessel deformation iteratively by leveraging temporal context to capture complex anatomical variations and local structural changes. We collected data from 23 patients and constructed 626 paired multi-frame samples for comprehensive evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in both accuracy and anatomical plausibility. Specifically, our method achieves a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.63 mm and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.51 mm in registration accuracy, representing 66.7\% lower MSE and 17.7\% lower MAE compared to the most competitive existing approaches. It has the potential to assist less-experienced clinicians in safely and efficiently performing complex TACE procedures, ultimately enhancing both surgical outcomes and patient care. Code and data are available at: \textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/LZH970328/TempDiffReg.git}
summary_zh: 经动脉化疗栓塞术 (TACE) 是治疗肝细胞癌和其他肝脏恶性肿瘤的首选方案，但由于复杂的手术中血管导航和解剖变异性，它仍然是一项极具挑战性的手术。准确且稳健的2D-3D血管配准对于在TACE过程中引导微导管和器械至关重要，能够精确定位血管结构并实现最佳的治疗靶向。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种由粗到精的配准策略。首先，我们引入了一个全局对齐模块，即结构感知透视n点 (SA-PnP)，以建立2D和3D血管结构之间的对应关系。其次，我们提出TempDiffReg，一种时间扩散模型，它通过利用时间上下文来捕捉复杂的解剖变异和局部结构变化，迭代地执行血管变形。我们收集了来自23位患者的数据，并构建了626个配对的多帧样本以进行全面评估。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在准确性和解剖合理性方面均始终优于最先进 (SOTA) 的方法。具体而言，我们的方法在配准准确性方面实现了0.63毫米的均方误差 (MSE) 和0.51毫米的平均绝对误差 (MAE)，与最具竞争力的现有方法相比，MSE降低了66.7％，MAE降低了17.7％。它有潜力帮助经验不足的临床医生安全有效地执行复杂的TACE手术，最终提高手术效果和患者护理。代码和数据可在以下网址获得：\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/LZH970328/TempDiffReg.git}
tldr: The paper introduces TempDiffReg, a temporal diffusion model for 2D-3D vascular registration in TACE procedures, demonstrating significant improvements in accuracy and anatomical plausibility compared to SOTA methods. It has potential in improving TACE procedure outcomes by assisting less experienced clinicians.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为TempDiffReg的时间扩散模型，用于TACE手术中的2D-3D血管配准，与现有方法相比，在准确性和解剖学合理性方面均有显著提高。该方法有潜力通过辅助经验不足的临床医生来改善TACE手术的预后。

title: Strip-Fusion: Spatiotemporal Fusion for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection
summary: Pedestrian detection is a critical task in robot perception. Multispectral modalities (visible light and thermal) can boost pedestrian detection performance by providing complementary visual information. Several gaps remain with multispectral pedestrian detection methods. First, existing approaches primarily focus on spatial fusion and often neglect temporal information. Second, RGB and thermal image pairs in multispectral benchmarks may not always be perfectly aligned. Pedestrians are also challenging to detect due to varying lighting conditions, occlusion, etc. This work proposes Strip-Fusion, a spatial-temporal fusion network that is robust to misalignment in input images, as well as varying lighting conditions and heavy occlusions. The Strip-Fusion pipeline integrates temporally adaptive convolutions to dynamically weigh spatial-temporal features, enabling our model to better capture pedestrian motion and context over time. A novel Kullback-Leibler divergence loss was designed to mitigate modality imbalance between visible and thermal inputs, guiding feature alignment toward the more informative modality during training. Furthermore, a novel post-processing algorithm was developed to reduce false positives. Extensive experimental results show that our method performs competitively for both the KAIST and the CVC-14 benchmarks. We also observed significant improvements compared to previous state-of-the-art on challenging conditions such as heavy occlusion and misalignment.
summary_zh: 行人检测是机器人感知中的一项关键任务。多光谱模态（可见光和热红外）能够通过提供互补的视觉信息来提升行人检测的性能。多光谱行人检测方法仍然存在几个缺口。首先，现有的方法主要关注空间融合，而常常忽略时间信息。其次，多光谱基准测试中的RGB和热红外图像对可能并不总是完美对齐的。此外，由于光照条件的多变、遮挡等因素，行人检测也面临挑战。本研究提出了一种条带融合（Strip-Fusion）网络，它是一种对输入图像中的未对齐现象具有鲁棒性的时空融合网络，并且能够适应多变的光照条件和严重的遮挡。Strip-Fusion流程集成了时间自适应卷积来动态地加权时空特征，使我们的模型能够更好地捕捉行人随时间推移的运动和上下文信息。我们设计了一种新颖的Kullback-Leibler散度损失来缓解可见光和热红外输入之间的模态不平衡，引导特征对齐到训练期间更具信息的模态。此外，还开发了一种新的后处理算法来减少误报。大量的实验结果表明，我们的方法在KAIST和CVC-14基准测试中均表现出竞争力。我们还观察到，与之前的最先进方法相比，在诸如严重遮挡和未对齐等具有挑战性的情况下，性能得到了显著提升。
tldr: The paper introduces Strip-Fusion, a spatial-temporal fusion network for multispectral pedestrian detection that addresses misalignment, varying lighting conditions, and occlusions by using temporally adaptive convolutions and a novel KL divergence loss for modality alignment, achieving competitive results on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Strip-Fusion，一个用于多光谱行人检测的时空融合网络。该网络通过使用时间自适应卷积和一种新颖的KL散度损失进行模态对齐，解决了输入图像不对齐、光照变化和遮挡问题，并在标准基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的结果。

title: Constraint-Aware Discrete-Time PID Gain Optimization for Robotic Joint Control Under Actuator Saturation
summary: The precise regulation of rotary actuation is fundamental in autonomous robotics, yet practical PID loops deviate from continuous-time theory due to discrete-time execution, actuator saturation, and small delays and measurement imperfections. We present an implementation-aware analysis and tuning workflow for saturated discrete-time joint control. We (i) derive PI stability regions under Euler and exact zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretizations using the Jury criterion, (ii) evaluate a discrete back-calculation anti-windup realization under saturation-dominant regimes, and (iii) propose a hybrid-certified Bayesian optimization workflow that screens analytically unstable candidates and behaviorally unsafe transients while optimizing a robust IAE objective with soft penalties on overshoot and saturation duty. Baseline sweeps ($τ=1.0$~s, $Δt=0.01$~s, $u\in[-10,10]$) quantify rise/settle trends for P/PI/PID. Under a randomized model family emulating uncertainty, delay, noise, quantization, and tighter saturation, robustness-oriented tuning improves median IAE from $0.843$ to $0.430$ while keeping median overshoot below $2\%$. In simulation-only tuning, the certification screen rejects $11.6\%$ of randomly sampled gains within bounds before full robust evaluation, improving sample efficiency without hardware experiments.
summary_zh: 旋转驱动的精确调节是自主机器人技术的基础，然而，实际的PID回路由于离散时间执行、执行器饱和以及微小延迟和测量缺陷而偏离连续时间理论。我们提出了一种面向实现的饱和离散时间关节控制分析和整定流程。我们（i）使用Jury判据推导出Euler和精确零阶保持（ZOH）离散化下的PI稳定区域；（ii）在饱和主导状态下评估了一种离散反算式抗饱和实现；（iii）提出了一种混合认证的贝叶斯优化流程，该流程在优化具有过冲和饱和占空比软惩罚的鲁棒IAE目标时，筛选出解析不稳定的候选者和行为上不安全的瞬态。在基线扫描（$τ=1.0$~s, $Δt=0.01$~s, $u\in[-10,10]$）下，量化了P/PI/PID的上升/稳定趋势。在模拟不确定性、延迟、噪声、量化和更严格的饱和度的随机模型族下，面向鲁棒性的整定将中值IAE从$0.843$改善至$0.430$，同时保持中值过冲低于$2\%$。在仅通过仿真的整定中，认证筛选在完全鲁棒评估之前拒绝了$11.6\%$的随机采样增益（在界限内），提高了样本效率，而无需硬件实验。
tldr: This paper presents a constraint-aware PID gain optimization workflow for robotic joint control under actuator saturation, using Bayesian optimization with a certification screen for unstable candidates, and demonstrates improved robustness in simulated environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种约束感知 PID 增益优化工作流程，用于执行器饱和情况下的机器人关节控制。该方法使用贝叶斯优化，并通过认证筛选器来检测不稳定候选者，并在仿真环境中展示了其鲁棒性的提升。

title: Analytic Incremental Learning For Sound Source Localization With Imbalance Rectification
summary: Sound source localization (SSL) demonstrates remarkable results in controlled settings but struggles in real-world deployment due to dual imbalance challenges: intra-task imbalance arising from long-tailed direction-of-arrival (DoA) distributions, and inter-task imbalance induced by cross-task skews and overlaps. These often lead to catastrophic forgetting, significantly degrading the localization accuracy. To mitigate these issues, we propose a unified framework with two key innovations. Specifically, we design a GCC-PHAT-based data augmentation (GDA) method that leverages peak characteristics to alleviate intra-task distribution skews. We also propose an Analytic dynamic imbalance rectifier (ADIR) with task-adaption regularization, which enables analytic updates that adapt to inter-task dynamics. On the SSLR benchmark, our proposal achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) results of 89.0% accuracy, 5.3° mean absolute error, and 1.6 backward transfer, demonstrating robustness to evolving imbalances without exemplar storage.
summary_zh: 声源定位（SSL）在受控环境中表现出显著的成果，但在实际部署中由于双重不平衡挑战而举步维艰：即由到达方向（DoA）长尾分布引起的任务内不平衡，以及由跨任务偏差和重叠引起的任务间不平衡。这些通常会导致灾难性遗忘，从而显著降低定位精度。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出一个包含两项关键创新的统一框架。具体而言，我们设计了一种基于GCC-PHAT的数据增强（GDA）方法，该方法利用峰值特性来缓解任务内分布偏差。 我们还提出了一个具有任务自适应正则化的解析动态不平衡校正器（ADIR），它能够进行适应任务间动态的解析更新。在SSLR基准测试中，我们的方案实现了最先进（SoTA）的结果，准确率达到89.0%，平均绝对误差为5.3°，反向迁移为1.6，证明了其对不断演变的不平衡的鲁棒性，且无需范例存储。
tldr: This paper addresses the problem of sound source localization (SSL) in real-world scenarios with imbalanced data distributions through a novel data augmentation technique and an analytic dynamic imbalance rectifier, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SSLR benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过一种新颖的数据增强技术和分析动态不平衡校正器解决了现实场景中不平衡数据分布下的声源定位 (SSL) 问题，并在 SSLR 基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: Diffusion Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Version Age of Information Scheduling: Average and Tail-Risk-Sensitive Control
summary: Ensuring timely and semantically accurate information delivery is critical in real-time wireless systems. While Age of Information (AoI) quantifies temporal freshness, Version Age of Information (VAoI) captures semantic staleness by accounting for version evolution between transmitters and receivers. Existing VAoI scheduling approaches primarily focus on minimizing average VAoI, overlooking rare but severe staleness events that can compromise reliability under stochastic packet arrivals and unreliable channels. This paper investigates both average-oriented and tail-risk-sensitive VAoI scheduling in a multi-user status update system with long-term transmission cost constraints. We first formulate the average VAoI minimization problem as a constrained Markov decision process and introduce a deep diffusion-based Soft Actor-Critic (D2SAC) algorithm. By generating actions through a diffusion-based denoising process, D2SAC enhances policy expressiveness and establishes a strong baseline for mean performance. Building on this foundation, we put forth RS-D3SAC, a risk-sensitive deep distributional diffusion-based Soft Actor-Critic algorithm. RS-D3SAC integrates a diffusion-based actor with a quantile-based distributional critic, explicitly modeling the full VAoI return distribution. This enables principled tail-risk optimization via Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) while satisfying long-term transmission cost constraints. Extensive simulations show that, while D2SAC reduces average VAoI, RS-D3SAC consistently achieves substantial reductions in CVaR without sacrificing mean performance. The dominant gain in tail-risk reduction stems from the distributional critic, with the diffusion-based actor providing complementary refinement to stabilize and enrich policy decisions, highlighting their effectiveness for robust and risk-aware VAoI scheduling in multi-user wireless systems.
summary_zh: 确保及时且语义准确的信息传递在实时无线系统中至关重要。信息年龄（AoI）量化了时间新鲜度，而版本信息年龄（VAoI）通过考虑发射机和接收机之间的版本演化来捕获语义陈旧性。现有的VAoI调度方法主要侧重于最小化平均VAoI，忽略了在随机分组到达和不可靠信道下可能损害可靠性的罕见但严重的陈旧性事件。本文研究了具有长期传输成本约束的多用户状态更新系统中面向平均和注重尾部风险的VAoI调度。我们首先将平均VAoI最小化问题 формулировкой 为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并引入了一种基于深度扩散的软Actor-Critic (D2SAC) 算法。通过基于扩散的去噪过程生成动作，D2SAC增强了策略的表达能力，并为平均性能建立了强大的基线。在此基础上，我们提出了RS-D3SAC，一种风险敏感的深度分布扩散软Actor-Critic算法。RS-D3SAC集成了基于扩散的Actor和基于分位数的分布Critic，显式地建模了完整的VAoI回报分布。这使得在满足长期传输成本约束的同时，可以通过条件风险价值（CVaR）进行有原则的尾部风险优化。广泛的仿真表明，虽然D2SAC降低了平均VAoI，但RS-D3SAC始终在不牺牲平均性能的情况下显着降低了CVaR。尾部风险降低的主要增益源于分布Critic，而基于扩散的Actor提供了补充的细化，以稳定和丰富策略决策，突出了它们在多用户无线系统中用于鲁棒且具有风险意识的VAoI调度的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces diffusion model-based reinforcement learning algorithms (D2SAC and RS-D3SAC) for version age of information (VAoI) scheduling in multi-user wireless systems, focusing on both average VAoI and tail-risk-sensitive control. RS-D3SAC, with a distributional critic, significantly reduces CVaR without sacrificing mean performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了基于扩散模型的强化学习算法（D2SAC和RS-D3SAC），用于多用户无线系统中的版本信息时效性（VAoI）调度，重点关注平均VAoI和尾部风险敏感控制。RS-D3SAC具有分布式的评论器，在不牺牲平均性能的情况下，显著降低了条件风险价值（CVaR）。

title: REMAC: Reference-Based Martian Asymmetrical Image Compression
summary: To expedite space exploration on Mars, it is indispensable to develop an efficient Martian image compression method for transmitting images through the constrained Mars-to-Earth communication channel. Although the existing learned compression methods have achieved promising results for natural images from earth, there remain two critical issues that hinder their effectiveness for Martian image compression: 1) They overlook the highly-limited computational resources on Mars; 2) They do not utilize the strong \textit{inter-image} similarities across Martian images to advance image compression performance. Motivated by our empirical analysis of the strong \textit{intra-} and \textit{inter-image} similarities from the perspective of texture, color, and semantics, we propose a reference-based Martian asymmetrical image compression (REMAC) approach, which shifts computational complexity from the encoder to the resource-rich decoder and simultaneously improves compression performance. To leverage \textit{inter-image} similarities, we propose a reference-guided entropy module and a ref-decoder that utilize useful information from reference images, reducing redundant operations at the encoder and achieving superior compression performance. To exploit \textit{intra-image} similarities, the ref-decoder adopts a deep, multi-scale architecture with enlarged receptive field size to model long-range spatial dependencies. Additionally, we develop a latent feature recycling mechanism to further alleviate the extreme computational constraints on Mars. Experimental results show that REMAC reduces encoder complexity by 43.51\% compared to the state-of-the-art method, while achieving a BD-PSNR gain of 0.2664 dB.
summary_zh: 为了加速火星空间探索，开发一种高效的火星图像压缩方法，以便通过受限的火星-地球通信信道传输图像至关重要。 尽管现有的基于学习的压缩方法在地球自然图像上取得了可喜的成果，但仍存在两个关键问题阻碍了其在火星图像压缩中的有效性：1) 它们忽略了火星上高度受限的计算资源；2) 它们没有利用火星图像之间强大的\textit{图像间}相似性来提高图像压缩性能。 受我们对纹理、颜色和语义角度的强大\textit{图像内}和\textit{图像间}相似性的经验分析的启发，我们提出了一种基于参考的火星非对称图像压缩 (REMAC) 方法，该方法将计算复杂度从编码器转移到资源丰富的解码器，同时提高压缩性能。 为了利用\textit{图像间}相似性，我们提出了一种参考引导的熵模块和一个 ref-decoder，它们利用来自参考图像的有用信息，减少了编码器处的冗余操作，并实现了卓越的压缩性能。 为了利用\textit{图像内}相似性，ref-decoder 采用了一个具有扩大感受野尺寸的深度、多尺度架构来建模长距离空间依赖性。 此外，我们还开发了一种潜在特征回收机制，以进一步缓解火星上极其严苛的计算约束。 实验结果表明，与最先进的方法相比，REMAC 将编码器复杂度降低了 43.51\%，同时实现了 0.2664 dB 的 BD-PSNR 增益。
tldr: The paper introduces REMAC, a reference-based asymmetrical image compression method designed for Martian images, optimizing for limited computational resources on Mars and leveraging inter-image similarities to improve compression performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为REMAC的基于参考的非对称图像压缩方法，专为火星图像设计，优化了火星上有限的计算资源，并利用图像间的相似性来提高压缩性能。

title: SelfieAvatar: Real-time Head Avatar reenactment from a Selfie Video
summary: Head avatar reenactment focuses on creating animatable personal avatars from monocular videos, serving as a foundational element for applications like social signal understanding, gaming, human-machine interaction, and computer vision. Recent advances in 3D Morphable Model (3DMM)-based facial reconstruction methods have achieved remarkable high-fidelity face estimation. However, on the one hand, they struggle to capture the entire head, including non-facial regions and background details in real time, which is an essential aspect for producing realistic, high-fidelity head avatars. On the other hand, recent approaches leveraging generative adversarial networks (GANs) for head avatar generation from videos can achieve high-quality reenactments but encounter limitations in reproducing fine-grained head details, such as wrinkles and hair textures. In addition, existing methods generally rely on a large amount of training data, and rarely focus on using only a simple selfie video to achieve avatar reenactment. To address these challenges, this study introduces a method for detailed head avatar reenactment using a selfie video. The approach combines 3DMMs with a StyleGAN-based generator. A detailed reconstruction model is proposed, incorporating mixed loss functions for foreground reconstruction and avatar image generation during adversarial training to recover high-frequency details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations on self-reenactment and cross-reenactment tasks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior head avatar reconstruction with rich and intricate textures compared to existing approaches.
summary_zh: 头部头像重演专注于从单目视频创建可动画的个人头像，是诸如社交信号理解、游戏、人机交互和计算机视觉等应用的基础要素。 近来基于3D形变模型(3DMM)的面部重建方法的进展已经实现了卓越的高保真面部估计。 然而，一方面，它们难以实时捕捉包括非面部区域和背景细节在内的整个头部，而这对于产生逼真的高保真头部头像至关重要。 另一方面，最近利用生成对抗网络(GANs)从视频生成头部头像的方法虽然可以实现高质量的重演，但在再现精细的头部细节（例如皱纹和头发纹理）方面遇到了局限性。 此外，现有方法通常依赖于大量的训练数据，很少关注仅使用简单的自拍视频来实现头像重演。 为了解决这些挑战，本研究提出了一种使用自拍视频进行详细头部头像重演的方法。 该方法结合了3DMM与基于StyleGAN的生成器。 提出了一种详细的重建模型，该模型在对抗训练期间结合了用于前景重建和头像图像生成的混合损失函数，以恢复高频细节。 在自重演和交叉重演任务上的定性和定量评估表明，与现有方法相比，所提出的方法实现了具有丰富而复杂纹理的卓越头部头像重建。
tldr: This paper presents a method for creating detailed, animatable head avatars from selfie videos by combining 3DMMs with StyleGANs, addressing limitations of existing methods in capturing fine-grained details and requiring extensive training data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过结合3DMM和StyleGAN，利用自拍视频创建细节丰富的、可动画的头部虚拟化身的方法。该方法旨在解决现有方法在捕捉精细细节和需要大量训练数据方面的局限性。

title: LoD-Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting for Streaming Video Reconstruction
summary: Free-Viewpoint Video (FVV) reconstruction enables photorealistic and interactive 3D scene visualization; however, real-time streaming is often bottlenecked by sparse-view inputs, prohibitive training costs, and bandwidth constraints. While recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced FVV due to its superior rendering speed, Streaming Free-Viewpoint Video (SFVV) introduces additional demands for rapid optimization, high-fidelity reconstruction under sparse constraints, and minimal storage footprints. To bridge this gap, we propose StreamLoD-GS, an LoD-based Gaussian Splatting framework designed specifically for SFVV. Our approach integrates three core innovations: 1) an Anchor- and Octree-based LoD-structured 3DGS with a hierarchical Gaussian dropout technique to ensure efficient and stable optimization while maintaining high-quality rendering; 2) a GMM-based motion partitioning mechanism that separates dynamic and static content, refining dynamic regions while preserving background stability; and 3) a quantized residual refinement framework that significantly reduces storage requirements without compromising visual fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StreamLoD-GS achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance in terms of quality, efficiency, and storage.
summary_zh: 自由视点视频（FVV）重建能够实现逼真的交互式3D场景可视化；然而，实时流传输常常受到稀疏视角输入、高昂的训练成本以及带宽限制的瓶颈。虽然最近出现的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）由于其卓越的渲染速度而推动了FVV的发展，但流式自由视点视频（SFVV）对快速优化、稀疏约束下的高保真重建以及最小的存储占用提出了额外的需求。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了StreamLoD-GS，一个专为SFVV设计的基于LoD的高斯溅射框架。我们的方法整合了三个核心创新点：1) 一种基于锚点和八叉树的LoD结构3DGS，具有分层高斯dropout技术，以确保持高效且稳定的优化，同时保持高质量的渲染；2) 一种基于GMM的运动分割机制，用于分离动态和静态内容，细化动态区域，同时保持背景稳定性；以及3) 一个量化残差细化框架，可以在不影响视觉保真度的情况下显著降低存储需求。大量实验表明，StreamLoD-GS在质量、效率和存储方面都达到了有竞争力的或最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces StreamLoD-GS, a novel Level-of-Detail (LoD) structured 3D Gaussian Splatting framework to address the challenges of streaming free-viewpoint video, including sparse-view inputs, training costs, and bandwidth constraints. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in quality, efficiency, and storage.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为StreamLoD-GS的新型LoD结构3D高斯溅射框架，旨在解决自由视点视频流的挑战，包括稀疏视图输入、训练成本和带宽限制。它在质量、效率和存储方面实现了最先进的性能。

title: Fusion of Spatio-Temporal and Multi-Scale Frequency Features for Dry Electrodes MI-EEG Decoding
summary: Dry-electrode Motor Imagery Electroencephalography (MI-EEG) enables fast, comfortable, real-world Brain Computer Interface by eliminating gels and shortening setup for at-home and wearable use.However, dry recordings pose three main issues: lower Signal-to-Noise Ratio with more baseline drift and sudden transients; weaker and noisier data with poor phase alignment across trials; and bigger variances between sessions. These drawbacks lead to larger data distribution shift, making features less stable for MI-EEG tasks.To address these problems, we introduce STGMFM, a tri-branch framework tailored for dry-electrode MI-EEG, which models complementary spatio-temporal dependencies via dual graph orders, and captures robust envelope dynamics with a multi-scale frequency mixing branch, motivated by the observation that amplitude envelopes are less sensitive to contact variability than instantaneous waveforms. Physiologically meaningful connectivity priors guide learning, and decision-level fusion consolidates a noise-tolerant consensus. On our collected dry-electrode MI-EEG, STGMFM consistently surpasses competitive CNN/Transformer/graph baselines. Codes are available at https://github.com/Tianyi-325/STGMFM.
summary_zh: 干电极运动想象脑电(MI-EEG)通过消除凝胶并缩短家庭和可穿戴设备的设置时间，实现了快速、舒适、真实的脑机接口。然而，干电极记录存在三个主要问题：信噪比较低，基线漂移和突发瞬变更多；数据更弱且噪声更大，试验间的相位对齐较差；以及会话间的方差更大。 这些缺点导致更大的数据分布偏移，使MI-EEG任务的特征稳定性降低。为了解决这些问题，我们介绍了一种针对干电极MI-EEG量身定制的三分支框架STGMFM，该框架通过双重图阶数对互补的时空依赖性进行建模，并通过多尺度频率混合分支捕获鲁棒的包络动态，其灵感来自于幅度包络对接触变异性的敏感度低于瞬时波形的观察。生理上有意义的连接先验指导学习，而决策层融合巩固了一种容错共识。在我们收集的干电极MI-EEG数据上，STGMFM始终超越具有竞争力的CNN/Transformer/图基线模型。代码可在https://github.com/Tianyi-325/STGMFM获取。
tldr: The paper presents STGMFM, a tri-branch framework designed for decoding dry-electrode MI-EEG data by fusing spatio-temporal dependencies and multi-scale frequency features to achieve robust performance despite the inherent noise in dry recordings. It outperforms CNN/Transformer/graph baselines on their collected dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为STGMFM的三分支框架，旨在通过融合时空依赖性和多尺度频率特征来解码干电极MI-EEG数据，即使在干电极记录的固有噪声下也能实现稳健的性能。在他们收集的数据集上，该方法优于CNN/Transformer/graph基线。

title: Estimating Dense-Packed Zone Height in Liquid-Liquid Separation: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach
summary: Separating liquid-liquid dispersions in gravity settlers is critical in chemical, pharmaceutical, and recycling processes. The dense-packed zone height is an important performance and safety indicator but it is often expensive and impractical to measure due to optical limitations. We propose to estimate phase heights using only inexpensive volume flow measurements. To this end, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) is first pretrained on synthetic data and physics equations derived from a low-fidelity (approximate) mechanistic model to reduce the need for extensive experimental data. While the mechanistic model is used to generate synthetic training data, only volume balance equations are used in the PINN, since the integration of submodels describing droplet coalescence and sedimentation into the PINN would be computationally prohibitive. The pretrained PINN is then fine-tuned with scarce experimental data to capture the actual dynamics of the separator. We then employ the differentiable PINN as a predictive model in an Extended Kalman Filter inspired state estimation framework, enabling the phase heights to be tracked and updated from flow-rate measurements. We first test the two-stage trained PINN by forward simulation from a known initial state against the mechanistic model and a non-pretrained PINN. We then evaluate phase height estimation performance with the filter, comparing the two-stage trained PINN with a two-stage trained purely data-driven neural network. All model types are trained and evaluated using ensembles to account for model parameter uncertainty. In all evaluations, the two-stage trained PINN yields the most accurate phase-height estimates.
summary_zh: 重力沉降器中分离液-液分散体系在化工、制药和回收过程中至关重要。密堆积区高度是一个重要的性能和安全指标，但由于光学限制，测量通常既昂贵又不切实际。我们提出仅使用廉价的体积流量测量来估计相高度。为此，首先在合成数据和源自低保真度（近似）机理模型的物理方程上对物理信息神经网络（PINN）进行预训练，以减少对大量实验数据的需求。虽然机理模型用于生成合成训练数据，但PINN中仅使用体量平衡方程，因为将描述液滴聚结和沉降的子模型集成到PINN中会产生巨大的计算成本。然后，使用稀少的实验数据对预训练的PINN进行微调，以捕获分离器的实际动态特性。随后，我们在受扩展卡尔曼滤波器启发的状态估计框架中，将可微分PINN用作预测模型，从而能够根据流量测量值跟踪和更新相高度。我们首先通过从已知初始状态进行正向模拟，针对机理模型和未经预训练的PINN测试两阶段训练的PINN。然后，我们评估使用滤波器的相高度估计性能，将两阶段训练的PINN与两阶段训练的纯数据驱动的神经网络进行比较。所有模型类型都使用集成进行训练和评估，以考虑模型参数的不确定性。在所有评估中，两阶段训练的PINN产生了最准确的相高度估计。
tldr: The paper presents a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach for estimating dense-packed zone height in liquid-liquid separation processes, using flow rate measurements, which is crucial for performance and safety. The PINN is pretrained on synthetic data and fine-tuned with experimental data, demonstrating superior performance compared to data-driven methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息的神经网络 (PINN) 方法，用于估算液-液分离过程中致密堆积区域的高度，该高度对性能和安全性至关重要，利用流量测量数据进行估算。PINN 首先在合成数据上进行预训练，然后用实验数据进行微调，与数据驱动方法相比表现出卓越的性能。

title: Convex Chance-Constrained Stochastic Control under Uncertain Specifications with Application to Learning-Based Hybrid Powertrain Control
summary: This paper presents a strictly convex chance-constrained stochastic control framework that accounts for uncertainty in control specifications such as reference trajectories and operational constraints. By jointly optimizing control inputs and risk allocation under general (possibly non-Gaussian) uncertainties, the proposed method guarantees probabilistic constraint satisfaction while ensuring strict convexity, leading to uniqueness and continuity of the optimal solution. The formulation is further extended to nonlinear model-based control using exactly linearizable models identified through machine learning. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through model predictive control applied to a hybrid powertrain system.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种严格凸的机会约束随机控制框架，该框架考虑了控制规范中的不确定性，例如参考轨迹和运行约束。通过在一般（可能非高斯）不确定性下联合优化控制输入和风险分配，所提出的方法保证了概率约束的满足，同时确保了严格凸性，从而保证了最优解的唯一性和连续性。该公式进一步扩展到使用通过机器学习识别的精确线性化模型进行基于非线性模型的控制。通过应用于混合动力总成系统的模型预测控制，验证了所提出方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a convex chance-constrained stochastic control framework that handles uncertainty in control specifications, guarantees probabilistic constraint satisfaction, and is applied to hybrid powertrain control using machine learning for model identification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种凸机会约束随机控制框架，用于处理控制规范中的不确定性，保证概率约束满足，并利用机器学习进行模型辨识，应用于混合动力总成控制。

title: XGuardian: Towards Explainable and Generalized AI Anti-Cheat on FPS Games
summary: Aim-assist cheats are the most prevalent and infamous form of cheating in First-Person Shooter (FPS) games, which help cheaters illegally reveal the opponent's location and auto-aim and shoot, and thereby pose significant threats to the game industry. Although a considerable research effort has been made to automatically detect aim-assist cheats, existing works suffer from unreliable frameworks, limited generalizability, high overhead, low detection performance, and a lack of explainability of detection results. In this paper, we propose XGuardian, a server-side generalized and explainable system for detecting aim-assist cheats to overcome these limitations. It requires only two raw data inputs, pitch and yaw, which are all FPS games' must-haves, to construct novel temporal features and describe aim trajectories, which are essential for distinguishing cheaters and normal players. XGuardian is evaluated with the latest mainstream FPS game CS2, and validates its generalizability with another two different games. It achieves high detection performance and low overhead compared to prior works across different games with real-world and large-scale datasets, demonstrating wide generalizability and high effectiveness. It is able to justify its predictions and thereby shorten the ban cycle. We make XGuardian as well as our datasets publicly available.
summary_zh: 目标辅助作弊是第一人称射击 (FPS) 游戏中最为普遍和臭名昭著的作弊形式，它能帮助作弊者非法获取对手位置并进行自动瞄准和射击，从而对游戏产业构成重大威胁。 尽管已经投入了大量的研究工作来自动检测目标辅助作弊，但现有工作存在框架不可靠、泛化能力有限、开销高、检测性能低以及缺乏检测结果可解释性等问题。 为了克服这些局限性，本文提出了一种服务端通用且可解释的目标辅助作弊检测系统 XGuardian。 它仅需两个原始数据输入，俯仰角和偏航角，这是所有 FPS 游戏必备的数据，用于构建新的时间特征并描述瞄准轨迹，这对于区分作弊者和正常玩家至关重要。 XGuardian 通过最新的主流 FPS 游戏 CS2 进行了评估，并利用另外两款不同的游戏验证了其泛化能力。 与先前的工作相比，它在不同游戏中使用真实世界的大规模数据集实现了更高的检测性能和更低的开销，展示了广泛的通用性和高效性。 它能够证明其预测的合理性，从而缩短封禁周期。 我们公开了 XGuardian 以及我们的数据集。
tldr: The paper introduces XGuardian, a server-side system for detecting aim-assist cheats in FPS games using only pitch and yaw data, demonstrating high detection performance, generalizability, explainability, and low overhead across multiple games.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了XGuardian，一个服务器端的系统，用于检测第一人称射击游戏中的瞄准辅助作弊，仅使用俯仰角和偏航角数据，在多个游戏中展示了高检测性能、泛化性、可解释性和低开销。

title: Multimodal Machine Learning for Soft High-k Elastomers under Data Scarcity
summary: Dielectric materials are critical building blocks for modern electronics such as sensors, actuators, and transistors. With the rapid recent advance in soft and stretchable electronics for emerging human- and robot-interfacing applications, there is a surging need for high-performance dielectric elastomers. However, it remains a grand challenge to develop soft elastomers that simultaneously possess high dielectric constants (k, related to energy storage capacity) and low Young's moduli (E, related to mechanical flexibility). While some new elastomer designs have been reported in individual (mostly one-off) studies, almost no structured dataset is currently available for dielectric elastomers that systematically encompasses their molecular sequence, dielectric, and mechanical properties. Within this context, we curate a compact, high-quality dataset of acrylate-based dielectric elastomers, one of the most widely explored elastomer backbones due to its versatile chemistry and molecular design flexibility, by screening and aggregating experimental results from the literature over the past 10 years. Building on this dataset, we propose a multimodal learning framework that leverages large-scale pretrained polymer representations from graph- and sequence-based encoders. These pretrained embeddings transfer rich chemical and structural knowledge from vast polymer corpora, enabling accurate few-shot prediction of both dielectric and mechanical properties from molecular sequences. Our results represent a new paradigm for transferring knowledge from pretrained multimodal models to overcome severe data scarcity, which can be readily translated to other polymer backbones (e.g., silicones, urethanes) and thus accelerate data-efficient discovery of soft high-k dielectric elastomers. Our source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/HySonLab/Polymers
summary_zh: 介电材料是现代电子设备(如传感器、执行器和晶体管)的关键组成部分。随着近年来用于新兴人机和机器人交互应用的柔性和可拉伸电子设备的快速发展，对高性能介电弹性体的需求激增。然而，开发同时具有高介电常数（k，与储能容量相关）和低杨氏模量（E，与机械灵活性相关）的软弹性体仍然是一个巨大的挑战。尽管在个别（主要是单次）研究中已经报道了一些新的弹性体设计，但目前几乎没有结构化的介电弹性体数据集能够系统地涵盖其分子序列、介电和机械性能。在此背景下，我们筛选并汇总了过去10年文献中的实验结果，整理了一个紧凑、高质量的丙烯酸酯基介电弹性体数据集，这是由于其通用的化学性质和分子设计灵活性而被广泛探索的弹性体骨架之一。基于这个数据集，我们提出了一个多模态学习框架，该框架利用来自基于图和序列的编码器的大规模预训练聚合物表示。这些预训练的嵌入传递了来自庞大聚合物语料库的丰富的化学和结构知识，从而能够从分子序列中准确地进行介电和机械性能的少样本预测。我们的研究结果代表了一种新的范例，即将知识从预训练的多模态模型转移，以克服严重的数据稀缺问题，这可以很容易地转化为其他聚合物骨架(如硅酮、聚氨酯)，从而加速软高k介电弹性体的数据高效发现。我们的源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/HySonLab/Polymers公开获取。
tldr: The paper introduces a multimodal machine learning framework to predict dielectric and mechanical properties of soft elastomers from molecular sequences, addressing data scarcity by leveraging pretrained polymer representations. This approach accelerates the discovery of soft high-k dielectric elastomers.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种多模态机器学习框架，用于预测软弹性体的介电和机械性能，通过利用预训练的聚合物表示来解决数据稀缺问题。这种方法加速了软高介电常数弹性体的发现。

title: Discriminability-Driven Spatial-Channel Selection with Gradient Norm for Drone Signal OOD Detection
summary: We propose a drone signal out-of-distribution (OOD) detection algorithm based on discriminability-driven spatial-channel selection with a gradient norm. Time-frequency image features are adaptively weighted along both spatial and channel dimensions by quantifying inter-class similarity and variance based on protocol-specific time-frequency characteristics. Subsequently, a gradient-norm metric is introduced to measure perturbation sensitivity for capturing the inherent instability of OOD samples, which is then fused with energy-based scores for joint inference. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm provides superior discriminative power and robust performance via SNR and various drone types.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于可区分性驱动空间-通道选择的梯度范数无人机信号异常检测算法。 通过量化协议特定的时频特性，自适应地加权时频图像特征的空间和通道维度间的类间相似性和方差。 随后，引入梯度范数度量来测量扰动敏感性，从而捕获异常样本的固有不稳定性，并将其与基于能量的分数融合进行联合推理。 仿真结果表明，所提出的算法通过信噪比和各种无人机类型，提供了卓越的区分能力和稳健的性能。
tldr: This paper presents a drone signal out-of-distribution detection algorithm by adaptively weighting time-frequency image features and using a gradient-norm metric to identify OOD samples, showing superior performance in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于可辨别性驱动的空间-通道选择和梯度范数的无人机信号异常检测算法。通过自适应地加权时频图像特征，并结合梯度范数来识别异常样本，仿真结果表明该算法具有优越的性能。

title: AC^2-VLA: Action-Context-Aware Adaptive Computation in Vision-Language-Action Models for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in robotic manipulation, yet their closed-loop deployment is hindered by the high latency and compute cost of repeatedly running large vision-language backbones at every timestep. We observe that VLA inference exhibits structured redundancies across temporal, spatial, and depth dimensions, and that most existing efficiency methods ignore action context, despite its central role in embodied tasks. To address this gap, we propose Action-Context-aware Adaptive Computation for VLA models (AC^2-VLA), a unified framework that conditions computation on current visual observations, language instructions, and previous action states. Based on this action-centric context, AC^2-VLA adaptively performs cognition reuse across timesteps, token pruning, and selective execution of model components within a unified mechanism. To train the adaptive policy, we introduce an action-guided self-distillation scheme that preserves the behavior of the dense VLA policy while enabling structured sparsification that transfers across tasks and settings. Extensive experiments on robotic manipulation benchmarks show that AC^2-VLA achieves up to a 1.79\times speedup while reducing FLOPs to 29.4% of the dense baseline, with comparable task success.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中表现出强大的性能，但它们在闭环部署中受到高延迟和计算成本的阻碍，因为需要在每个时间步重复运行大型视觉-语言骨干网络。我们观察到VLA推理在时间、空间和深度维度上都表现出结构化的冗余，并且大多数现有的效率方法忽略了动作上下文，尽管它在具身任务中起着核心作用。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了面向VLA模型的动作-上下文感知自适应计算（AC^2-VLA），这是一个统一的框架，将计算与当前视觉观察、语言指令和先前的动作状态相关联。基于这种以动作为中心的上下文，AC^2-VLA在一个统一的机制中自适应地执行跨时间步的认知复用、令牌剪枝和模型组件的选择性执行。为了训练自适应策略，我们引入了一种动作引导的自蒸馏方案，该方案在保持密集VLA策略行为的同时，实现了跨任务和设置传递的结构化稀疏化。在机器人操作基准上的大量实验表明，AC^2-VLA实现了高达1.79倍的加速，同时将FLOPS降低到密集基线的29.4%，并且具有相当的任务成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces AC^2-VLA, a framework for efficient robotic manipulation using vision-language-action models, which adaptively reduces computation based on action context through cognition reuse, token pruning, and selective execution. It achieves significant speedups and FLOPs reduction with comparable task success.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AC^2-VLA，一个用于高效机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型框架，它基于动作上下文自适应地减少计算，通过认知重用、令牌修剪和选择性执行。该模型在保持任务成功率的同时，实现了显著的加速和FLOPs减少。

title: DeFM: Learning Foundation Representations from Depth for Robotics
summary: Depth sensors are widely deployed across robotic platforms, and advances in fast, high-fidelity depth simulation have enabled robotic policies trained on depth observations to achieve robust sim-to-real transfer for a wide range of tasks. Despite this, representation learning for depth modality remains underexplored compared to RGB, where large-scale foundation models now define the state of the art. To address this gap, we present DeFM, a self-supervised foundation model trained entirely on depth images for robotic applications. Using a DINO-style self-distillation objective on a curated dataset of 60M depth images, DeFM learns geometric and semantic representations that generalize to diverse environments, tasks, and sensors. To retain metric awareness across multiple scales, we introduce a novel input normalization strategy. We further distill DeFM into compact models suitable for resource-constrained robotic systems. When evaluated on depth-based classification, segmentation, navigation, locomotion, and manipulation benchmarks, DeFM achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong generalization from simulation to real-world environments. We release all our pretrained models, which can be adopted off-the-shelf for depth-based robotic learning without task-specific fine-tuning. Webpage: https://de-fm.github.io/
summary_zh: 深度传感器在各种机器人平台上得到广泛应用，而快速、高保真深度仿真的进步使得在深度观测上训练的机器人策略能够实现稳健的从仿真到现实的迁移，从而胜任各种任务。尽管如此，与RGB相比，深度模态的表征学习仍有待进一步探索，而大规模基础模型现在已经定义了RGB领域的最新技术水平。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了DeFM，这是一个完全在深度图像上训练的，用于机器人应用的自监督基础模型。通过在精心挑选的6000万张深度图像数据集上使用DINO风格的自蒸馏目标，DeFM学习了几何和语义表示，这些表示可以推广到不同的环境、任务和传感器。为了保持跨多个尺度的度量感知，我们引入了一种新颖的输入归一化策略。我们进一步将DeFM提炼成适用于资源受限的机器人系统的紧凑模型。在基于深度的分类、分割、导航、运动和操纵基准测试中进行评估时，DeFM实现了最先进的性能，并展示了从仿真到真实环境的强大泛化能力。我们发布了所有预训练模型，这些模型可以直接用于基于深度的机器人学习，而无需进行特定于任务的微调。网页：https://de-fm.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces DeFM, a self-supervised foundation model trained entirely on depth images for robotic applications, achieving SOTA performance across diverse robotic tasks and demonstrating strong sim-to-real generalization without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了DeFM，一个完全基于深度图像训练的机器人应用自监督基础模型，在各种机器人任务中实现了SOTA性能，并展示了强大的从仿真到现实的泛化能力，无需针对特定任务进行微调。

title: Visual Generation Unlocks Human-Like Reasoning through Multimodal World Models
summary: Humans construct internal world models and reason by manipulating the concepts within these models. Recent advances in AI, particularly chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, approximate such human cognitive abilities, where world models are believed to be embedded within large language models. Expert-level performance in formal and abstract domains such as mathematics and programming has been achieved in current systems by relying predominantly on verbal reasoning. However, they still lag far behind humans in domains like physical and spatial intelligence, which require richer representations and prior knowledge. The emergence of unified multimodal models (UMMs) capable of both verbal and visual generation has therefore sparked interest in more human-like reasoning grounded in complementary multimodal pathways, though their benefits remain unclear. From a world-model perspective, this paper presents the first principled study of when and how visual generation benefits reasoning. Our key position is the visual superiority hypothesis: for certain tasks--particularly those grounded in the physical world--visual generation more naturally serves as world models, whereas purely verbal world models encounter bottlenecks arising from representational limitations or insufficient prior knowledge. Theoretically, we formalize internal world modeling as a core component of CoT reasoning and analyze distinctions among different forms of world models. Empirically, we identify tasks that necessitate interleaved visual-verbal CoT reasoning, constructing a new evaluation suite, VisWorld-Eval. Controlled experiments on a state-of-the-art UMM show that interleaved CoT significantly outperforms purely verbal CoT on tasks that favor visual world modeling, but offers no clear advantage otherwise. Together, this work clarifies the potential of multimodal world modeling for more powerful, human-like multimodal AI.
summary_zh: 人类构建内部世界模型，并通过操纵这些模型中的概念进行推理。人工智能领域的最新进展，特别是思维链 (CoT) 推理，近似于这种人类认知能力，人们认为世界模型嵌入在大型语言模型中。目前，在数学和编程等形式化和抽象领域，通过主要依赖于语言推理，现有系统已经取得了专家级别的性能。然而，在需要更丰富的表示和先验知识的物理和空间智能等领域，它们仍然远远落后于人类。因此，能够进行语言和视觉生成的统一多模态模型 (UMMs) 的出现，引发了人们对基于互补多模态途径、更像人类的推理能力的兴趣，尽管其益处尚不清楚。从世界模型的角度来看，本文首次对视觉生成何时以及如何有益于推理进行了原则性研究。我们的核心观点是视觉优势假设：对于某些任务，特别是那些基于物理世界的任务，视觉生成更自然地充当世界模型，而纯粹的语言世界模型则面临着由表示限制或先验知识不足引起的瓶颈。在理论上，我们将内部世界建模形式化为 CoT 推理的核心组成部分，并分析了不同形式世界模型之间的区别。在经验上，我们识别出需要交错式视觉-语言 CoT 推理的任务，并构建了一个新的评估套件 VisWorld-Eval。在一流的 UMM 上进行的受控实验表明，交错式 CoT 在有利于视觉世界建模的任务上明显优于纯粹的语言 CoT，但在其他情况下没有明显的优势。总而言之，这项工作阐明了多模态世界建模在实现更强大、更像人类的多模态人工智能方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces VisWorld-Eval, a benchmark for evaluating interleaved visual-verbal reasoning, and demonstrates that visual generation in multimodal models improves performance on tasks requiring physical and spatial intelligence compared to purely verbal reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了VisWorld-Eval，一个用于评估交错视觉-语言推理的基准，并表明在多模态模型中，视觉生成能够提高对需要物理和空间智能的任务的性能，优于纯语言推理。

title: ScenePilot-Bench: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Evaluation of Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: In this paper, we introduce ScenePilot-Bench, a large-scale first-person driving benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) in autonomous driving scenarios. ScenePilot-Bench is built upon ScenePilot-4K, a diverse dataset comprising 3,847 hours of driving videos, annotated with multi-granularity information including scene descriptions, risk assessments, key participant identification, ego trajectories, and camera parameters. The benchmark features a four-axis evaluation suite that assesses VLM capabilities in scene understanding, spatial perception, motion planning, and GPT-Score, with safety-aware metrics and cross-region generalization settings. We benchmark representative VLMs on ScenePilot-Bench, providing empirical analyses that clarify current performance boundaries and identify gaps for driving-oriented reasoning. ScenePilot-Bench offers a comprehensive framework for evaluating and advancing VLMs in safety-critical autonomous driving contexts.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了ScenePilot-Bench，这是一个大规模的第一人称视角驾驶基准，旨在评估视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶场景中的表现。ScenePilot-Bench构建于ScenePilot-4K之上，这是一个包含3,847小时驾驶视频的多样化数据集，并标注了多粒度信息，包括场景描述、风险评估、关键参与者识别、自我车辆轨迹和相机参数。该基准包含一个四轴评估套件，用于评估VLM在场景理解、空间感知、运动规划和GPT-Score方面的能力，并具有安全意识指标和跨区域泛化设置。我们在ScenePilot-Bench上对具有代表性的VLM进行了基准测试，提供了经验分析，阐明了当前的性能边界，并识别了面向驾驶推理方面的差距。ScenePilot-Bench为在安全攸关的自动驾驶环境中评估和改进VLM提供了一个全面的框架。
tldr: The paper introduces ScenePilot-Bench, a large-scale autonomous driving benchmark with diverse annotations for evaluating vision-language models across scene understanding, spatial perception, motion planning, and safety.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ScenePilot-Bench，一个大规模自动驾驶基准，具有多样化的标注，用于评估视觉-语言模型在场景理解、空间感知、运动规划和安全性方面的能力。

title: HARMONI: Multimodal Personalization of Multi-User Human-Robot Interactions with LLMs
summary: Existing human-robot interaction systems often lack mechanisms for sustained personalization and dynamic adaptation in multi-user environments, limiting their effectiveness in real-world deployments. We present HARMONI, a multimodal personalization framework that leverages large language models to enable socially assistive robots to manage long-term multi-user interactions. The framework integrates four key modules: (i) a perception module that identifies active speakers and extracts multimodal input; (ii) a world modeling module that maintains representations of the environment and short-term conversational context; (iii) a user modeling module that updates long-term speaker-specific profiles; and (iv) a generation module that produces contextually grounded and ethically informed responses. Through extensive evaluation and ablation studies on four datasets, as well as a real-world scenario-driven user-study in a nursing home environment, we demonstrate that HARMONI supports robust speaker identification, online memory updating, and ethically aligned personalization, outperforming baseline LLM-driven approaches in user modeling accuracy, personalization quality, and user satisfaction.
summary_zh: 现有的人机交互系统通常缺乏在多用户环境中持续个性化和动态适应的机制，从而限制了其在实际部署中的有效性。我们提出了HARMONI，一个多模态个性化框架，它利用大型语言模型来使社会辅助机器人能够管理长期的多用户交互。该框架集成了四个关键模块：（i）一个感知模块，用于识别活跃说话者并提取多模态输入；（ii）一个世界建模模块，用于维护环境和短期对话上下文的表示；（iii）一个用户建模模块，用于更新长期的、针对特定说话者的用户画像；以及（iv）一个生成模块，用于生成上下文相关的且符合伦理规范的回复。通过对四个数据集进行的大量评估和消融研究，以及在养老院环境中进行的真实场景驱动的用户研究，我们证明HARMONI支持稳健的说话者识别、在线记忆更新和伦理对齐的个性化，在用户建模准确性、个性化质量和用户满意度方面优于基于基线LLM的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces HARMONI, a framework that uses LLMs for multimodal personalization in multi-user human-robot interactions, demonstrating improved user experience and ethical alignment in a real-world nursing home setting.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HARMONI框架，它使用大型语言模型来实现多用户人机交互中的多模态个性化，并在真实的养老院环境中展示了改进的用户体验和伦理对齐。

title: Unsupervised Learning of Efficient Exploration: Pre-training Adaptive Policies via Self-Imposed Goals
summary: Unsupervised pre-training can equip reinforcement learning agents with prior knowledge and accelerate learning in downstream tasks. A promising direction, grounded in human development, investigates agents that learn by setting and pursuing their own goals. The core challenge lies in how to effectively generate, select, and learn from such goals. Our focus is on broad distributions of downstream tasks where solving every task zero-shot is infeasible. Such settings naturally arise when the target tasks lie outside of the pre-training distribution or when their identities are unknown to the agent. In this work, we (i) optimize for efficient multi-episode exploration and adaptation within a meta-learning framework, and (ii) guide the training curriculum with evolving estimates of the agent's post-adaptation performance. We present ULEE, an unsupervised meta-learning method that combines an in-context learner with an adversarial goal-generation strategy that maintains training at the frontier of the agent's capabilities. On XLand-MiniGrid benchmarks, ULEE pre-training yields improved exploration and adaptation abilities that generalize to novel objectives, environment dynamics, and map structures. The resulting policy attains improved zero-shot and few-shot performance, and provides a strong initialization for longer fine-tuning processes. It outperforms learning from scratch, DIAYN pre-training, and alternative curricula.
summary_zh: 无监督预训练能够为强化学习智能体提供先验知识，并加速下游任务的学习。一个有前景的方向，植根于人类发展，研究通过设定和追求自身目标来学习的智能体。核心挑战在于如何有效地生成、选择以及从这些目标中学习。我们的重点是广泛的下游任务分布，在这种分布中，零样本解决每个任务是不可行的。当目标任务位于预训练分布之外，或者它们的身份对智能体未知时，这种设置自然会出现。在这项工作中，我们 (i) 在元学习框架内优化高效的多情节探索和适应，以及 (ii) 利用智能体适应后性能的动态估计来指导训练课程。我们提出了ULEE，一种无监督元学习方法，它结合了一个上下文学习器和一个对抗性目标生成策略，该策略使训练保持在智能体能力的前沿。在 XLand-MiniGrid 基准测试中，ULEE 预训练产生了改进的探索和适应能力，这些能力可以推广到新的目标、环境动态和地图结构。由此产生的策略获得了改进的零样本和少样本性能，并为更长的微调过程提供了强大的初始化。它优于从头开始学习、DIAYN 预训练和替代课程。
tldr: The paper introduces ULEE, an unsupervised meta-learning method for efficient exploration and adaptation in reinforcement learning, demonstrating improved zero-shot and few-shot performance on XLand-MiniGrid benchmarks compared to other pre-training methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ULEE的无监督元学习方法，用于在强化学习中实现高效的探索和适应。在XLand-MiniGrid基准测试中，与其它预训练方法相比，该方法表现出更好的零样本和少样本性能。

title: Scalable Exploration for High-Dimensional Continuous Control via Value-Guided Flow
summary: Controlling high-dimensional systems in biological and robotic applications is challenging due to expansive state-action spaces, where effective exploration is critical. Commonly used exploration strategies in reinforcement learning are largely undirected with sharp degradation as action dimensionality grows. Many existing methods resort to dimensionality reduction, which constrains policy expressiveness and forfeits system flexibility. We introduce Q-guided Flow Exploration (Qflex), a scalable reinforcement learning method that conducts exploration directly in the native high-dimensional action space. During training, Qflex traverses actions from a learnable source distribution along a probability flow induced by the learned value function, aligning exploration with task-relevant gradients rather than isotropic noise. Our proposed method substantially outperforms representative online reinforcement learning baselines across diverse high-dimensional continuous-control benchmarks. Qflex also successfully controls a full-body human musculoskeletal model to perform agile, complex movements, demonstrating superior scalability and sample efficiency in very high-dimensional settings. Our results indicate that value-guided flows offer a principled and practical route to exploration at scale.
summary_zh: 控制生物和机器人应用中的高维系统极具挑战性，因为其状态-动作空间十分庞大，有效的探索至关重要。强化学习中常用的探索策略大多是无方向性的，并且会随着动作维度的增加而急剧退化。许多现有方法诉诸于降维，这限制了策略的表达能力并丧失了系统的灵活性。我们提出了Q导向流动探索（Qflex），这是一种可扩展的强化学习方法，可以直接在原生高维动作空间中进行探索。在训练期间，Qflex沿着由学习到的价值函数引起的概率流，从可学习的源分布遍历动作，使探索与任务相关的梯度对齐，而不是各向同性噪声。在各种高维连续控制基准测试中，我们提出的方法明显优于具有代表性的在线强化学习基线。Qflex还成功地控制了全身人体肌肉骨骼模型，以执行敏捷、复杂的运动，展示了在极高维度设置中的卓越可扩展性和样本效率。我们的结果表明，价值导向的流动为大规模探索提供了一条可行且实用的途径。
tldr: This paper introduces Qflex, a novel reinforcement learning method for high-dimensional continuous control that uses value-guided flows for efficient exploration, outperforming existing methods in complex robotic tasks and human musculoskeletal models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Qflex的新型强化学习方法，用于高维连续控制，该方法使用价值引导流进行高效探索，在复杂的机器人任务和人体肌肉骨骼模型中优于现有方法。

title: Safe Exploration via Policy Priors
summary: Safe exploration is a key requirement for reinforcement learning (RL) agents to learn and adapt online, beyond controlled (e.g. simulated) environments. In this work, we tackle this challenge by utilizing suboptimal yet conservative policies (e.g., obtained from offline data or simulators) as priors. Our approach, SOOPER, uses probabilistic dynamics models to optimistically explore, yet pessimistically fall back to the conservative policy prior if needed. We prove that SOOPER guarantees safety throughout learning, and establish convergence to an optimal policy by bounding its cumulative regret.
