Extensive experiments on key safe RL benchmarks and real-world hardware demonstrate that SOOPER is scalable, outperforms the state-of-the-art and validate our theoretical guarantees in practice.
summary_zh: 安全探索是强化学习（RL）智能体在线学习和适应的关键要求，尤其是在受控环境（例如，模拟环境）之外。在这项工作中，我们通过利用次优但保守的策略（例如，从离线数据或模拟器获得）作为先验来应对这一挑战。我们的方法 SOOPER 使用概率动力学模型进行乐观探索，但如果需要，则悲观地回退到保守策略先验。我们证明了 SOOPER 保证了整个学习过程中的安全性，并通过限制其累积遗憾来确立其收敛到最优策略。在关键的安全强化学习基准和真实世界硬件上的大量实验表明，SOOPER 具有可扩展性，优于最先进的方法，并在实践中验证了我们的理论保证。
tldr: The paper introduces SOOPER, a safe reinforcement learning approach that uses suboptimal conservative policies as priors and probabilistic dynamics models for optimistic exploration with pessimistic fallbacks, guaranteeing safety and convergence, validated on benchmarks and hardware.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SOOPER，一种安全的强化学习方法，它使用次优的保守策略作为先验，并使用概率动力学模型进行乐观探索和悲观回退，保证了安全性和收敛性，并在基准测试和硬件上进行了验证。

title: PALM: Enhanced Generalizability for Local Visuomotor Policies via Perception Alignment
summary: Generalizing beyond the training domain in image-based behavior cloning remains challenging. Existing methods address individual axes of generalization, workspace shifts, viewpoint changes, and cross-embodiment transfer, yet they are typically developed in isolation and often rely on complex pipelines. We introduce PALM (Perception Alignment for Local Manipulation), which leverages the invariance of local action distributions between out-of-distribution (OOD) and demonstrated domains to address these OOD shifts concurrently, without additional input modalities, model changes, or data collection. PALM modularizes the manipulation policy into coarse global components and a local policy for fine-grained actions. We reduce the discrepancy between in-domain and OOD inputs at the local policy level by enforcing local visual focus and consistent proprioceptive representation, allowing the policy to retrieve invariant local actions under OOD conditions. Experiments show that PALM limits OOD performance drops to 8% in simulation and 24% in the real world, compared to 45% and 77% for baselines.
summary_zh: 基于图像的行为克隆在训练域之外的泛化仍然具有挑战性。现有方法分别解决泛化中的各个维度，包括工作空间变换、视角变化和跨具身迁移，但它们通常是孤立开发的，并且常常依赖于复杂的流程。我们引入 PALM (用于局部操作的感知对齐)，它利用分布外 (OOD) 和演示域之间局部动作分布的不变性来同时解决这些 OOD 变换，无需额外的输入模态、模型更改或数据收集。PALM 将操作策略模块化为粗略的全局组件和用于精细动作的局部策略。我们通过强制局部视觉聚焦和一致的本体感受表示来减少局部策略层面上的域内和 OOD 输入之间的差异，从而使策略能够在 OOD 条件下检索不变的局部动作。实验表明，与基线模型相比，PALM 将 OOD 性能下降限制在模拟环境中的 8% 和真实世界中的 24%，而基线模型分别为 45% 和 77%。
tldr: The paper introduces PALM, a method that enhances the generalizability of visuomotor policies to out-of-distribution scenarios by aligning local visual and proprioceptive representations, demonstrating improved performance in simulation and real-world experiments compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PALM，一种通过对齐局部视觉和本体感受表征来增强视觉运动策略对分布外场景的泛化能力的方法。实验表明，与基线相比，该方法在模拟和真实世界实验中都表现出更好的性能。

title: ALRM: Agentic LLM for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently empowered agentic frameworks to exhibit advanced reasoning and planning capabilities. However, their integration in robotic control pipelines remains limited in two aspects: (1) prior \ac{llm}-based approaches often lack modular, agentic execution mechanisms, limiting their ability to plan, reflect on outcomes, and revise actions in a closed-loop manner; and (2) existing benchmarks for manipulation tasks focus on low-level control and do not systematically evaluate multistep reasoning and linguistic variation. In this paper, we propose Agentic LLM for Robot Manipulation (ALRM), an LLM-driven agentic framework for robotic manipulation. ALRM integrates policy generation with agentic execution through a ReAct-style reasoning loop, supporting two complementary modes: Code-asPolicy (CaP) for direct executable control code generation, and Tool-as-Policy (TaP) for iterative planning and tool-based action execution. To enable systematic evaluation, we also introduce a novel simulation benchmark comprising 56 tasks across multiple environments, capturing linguistically diverse instructions. Experiments with ten LLMs demonstrate that ALRM provides a scalable, interpretable, and modular approach for bridging natural language reasoning with reliable robotic execution. Results reveal Claude-4.1-Opus as the top closed-source model and Falcon-H1-7B as the top open-source model under CaP.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近赋能了代理框架，使其展现出先进的推理和规划能力。然而，它们在机器人控制流程中的集成依然受限于两个方面：（1）先前的基于\ac{llm}的方法通常缺乏模块化的、代理式的执行机制，限制了它们以闭环方式进行规划、反思结果和修改动作的能力；（2）现有的操作任务基准侧重于低级控制，且未能系统地评估多步骤推理和语言变异。在本文中，我们提出了机器人操作的代理式LLM (ALRM)，这是一个用于机器人操作的LLM驱动的代理框架。ALRM 通过 ReAct 风格的推理循环将策略生成与代理式执行集成，支持两种互补模式：代码即策略（CaP），用于直接生成可执行的控制代码；工具即策略（TaP），用于迭代规划和基于工具的动作执行。为了实现系统评估，我们还引入了一种新的模拟基准，包含跨多个环境的 56 个任务，涵盖了语言上多样化的指令。对十个 LLM 的实验表明，ALRM 为将自然语言推理与可靠的机器人执行联系起来提供了一种可扩展、可解释且模块化的方法。结果显示，Claude-4.1-Opus 是 CaP 下性能最佳的闭源模型，而 Falcon-H1-7B 是性能最佳的开源模型。
tldr: The paper introduces ALRM, an agentic LLM framework for robotic manipulation that integrates policy generation with agentic execution using a ReAct-style loop. It also includes a new benchmark to evaluate multistep reasoning and linguistic variation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ALRM，一个用于机器人操作的Agentic LLM框架，它集成了策略生成和Agentic执行，使用了ReAct风格的循环。它还包含一个新的基准，用于评估多步骤推理和语言变化。

title: Sim-and-Human Co-training for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Synthetic simulation data and real-world human data provide scalable alternatives to circumvent the prohibitive costs of robot data collection. However, these sources suffer from the sim-to-real visual gap and the human-to-robot embodiment gap, respectively, which limits the policy's generalization to real-world scenarios. In this work, we identify a natural yet underexplored complementarity between these sources: simulation offers the robot action that human data lacks, while human data provides the real-world observation that simulation struggles to render. Motivated by this insight, we present SimHum, a co-training framework to simultaneously extract kinematic prior from simulated robot actions and visual prior from real-world human observations. Based on the two complementary priors, we achieve data-efficient and generalizable robotic manipulation in real-world tasks. Empirically, SimHum outperforms the baseline by up to $\mathbf{40\%}$ under the same data collection budget, and achieves a $\mathbf{62.5\%}$ OOD success with only 80 real data, outperforming the real only baseline by $7.1\times$. Videos and additional information can be found at \href{https://kaipengfang.github.io/sim-and-human}{project website}.
summary_zh: 合成仿真数据和真实世界的人类数据为规避机器人数据采集的高昂成本提供了可扩展的替代方案。然而，这些数据源分别受到仿真到真实的视觉差异以及人类到机器人的具身差异的影响，这限制了策略对真实世界场景的泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们识别出这些数据源之间一种自然但未被充分利用的互补性：仿真提供了人类数据所缺乏的机器人动作，而人类数据提供了仿真难以渲染的真实世界观察。受此启发，我们提出了SimHum，一种协同训练框架，用于同时从模拟机器人动作中提取运动学先验，并从真实世界人类观察中提取视觉先验。基于这两个互补的先验，我们在真实世界的任务中实现了数据高效且可泛化的机器人操作。实验结果表明，在相同的数据采集预算下，SimHum的性能优于基线方法高达$\mathbf{40\%}$，并且仅使用80个真实数据就实现了$\mathbf{62.5\%}$的分布外（OOD）成功率，优于纯真实数据基线方法的$7.1\times$。视频和其他附加信息可以在\href{https://kaipengfang.github.io/sim-and-human}{项目网站}找到。
tldr: SimHum is a co-training framework that leverages both simulated robot actions and real-world human observations to achieve data-efficient and generalizable robotic manipulation by extracting kinematic and visual priors, respectively.
tldr_zh: SimHum是一个协同训练框架，它利用模拟的机器人动作和真实世界的人类观察来提取运动学和视觉先验，从而实现数据高效且可泛化的机器人操作。

title: Self-Supervised Path Planning in Unstructured Environments via Global-Guided Differentiable Hard Constraint Projection
summary: Deploying deep learning agents for autonomous navigation in unstructured environments faces critical challenges regarding safety, data scarcity, and limited computational resources. Traditional solvers often suffer from high latency, while emerging learning-based approaches struggle to ensure deterministic feasibility. To bridge the gap from embodied to embedded intelligence, we propose a self-supervised framework incorporating a differentiable hard constraint projection layer for runtime assurance. To mitigate data scarcity, we construct a Global-Guided Artificial Potential Field (G-APF), which provides dense supervision signals without manual labeling. To enforce actuator limitations and geometric constraints efficiently, we employ an adaptive neural projection layer, which iteratively rectifies the coarse network output onto the feasible manifold. Extensive benchmarks on a test set of 20,000 scenarios demonstrate an 88.75\% success rate, substantiating the enhanced operational safety. Closed-loop experiments in CARLA further validate the physical realizability of the planned paths under dynamic constraints. Furthermore, deployment verification on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX confirms an inference latency of 94 ms, showing real-time feasibility on resource-constrained embedded hardware. This framework offers a generalized paradigm for embedding physical laws into neural architectures, providing a viable direction for solving constrained optimization in mechatronics. Source code is available at: https://github.com/wzq-13/SSHC.git.
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中部署深度学习智能体进行自主导航面临着关于安全性、数据稀缺和有限计算资源的关键挑战。 传统的求解器通常具有高延迟，而新兴的基于学习的方法难以确保确定性的可行性。 为了弥合实体智能和嵌入式智能之间的差距，我们提出了一种自监督框架，该框架结合了一个可微分的硬约束投影层，用于运行时保证。 为了缓解数据稀缺问题，我们构建了一个全局引导的人工势场（G-APF），它提供密集的监督信号而无需手动标记。 为了高效地实施执行器限制和几何约束，我们采用了一个自适应神经投影层，该层将粗略的网络输出迭代地校正到可行流形上。 在包含 20,000 个场景的测试集上的大量基准测试表明，成功率为 88.75％，证实了增强的运行安全性。 在 CARLA 中的闭环实验进一步验证了在动态约束下规划路径的物理可实现性。 此外，在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上的部署验证确认了 94 毫秒的推理延迟，表明在资源受限的嵌入式硬件上具有实时可行性。 该框架为将物理定律嵌入到神经架构中提供了一个通用的范例，为解决机电一体化中的约束优化问题提供了一个可行的方向。 源代码可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/wzq-13/SSHC.git。
tldr: This paper introduces a self-supervised path planning framework for autonomous navigation in unstructured environments, using a differentiable hard constraint projection layer and a Global-Guided Artificial Potential Field to ensure safety and real-time feasibility on embedded systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于非结构化环境中自主导航的自监督路径规划框架，该框架采用可微硬约束投影层和全局引导人工势场，以确保嵌入式系统上的安全性和实时可行性。

title: Perception-to-Pursuit: Track-Centric Temporal Reasoning for Open-World Drone Detection and Autonomous Chasing
summary: Autonomous drone pursuit requires not only detecting drones but also predicting their trajectories in a manner that enables kinematically feasible interception. Existing tracking methods optimize for prediction accuracy but ignore pursuit feasibility, resulting in trajectories that are physically impossible to intercept 99.9% of the time. We propose Perception-to-Pursuit (P2P), a track-centric temporal reasoning framework that bridges detection and actionable pursuit planning. Our method represents drone motion as compact 8-dimensional tokens capturing velocity, acceleration, scale, and smoothness, enabling a 12-frame causal transformer to reason about future behavior. We introduce the Intercept Success Rate (ISR) metric to measure pursuit feasibility under realistic interceptor constraints. Evaluated on the Anti-UAV-RGBT dataset with 226 real drone sequences, P2P achieves 28.12 pixel average displacement error and 0.597 ISR, representing a 77% improvement in trajectory prediction and 597x improvement in pursuit feasibility over tracking-only baselines, while maintaining perfect drone classification accuracy (100%). Our work demonstrates that temporal reasoning over motion patterns enables both accurate prediction and actionable pursuit planning.
summary_zh: 自主无人机追逐不仅需要检测无人机，还需要以能够实现运动学可行的拦截方式预测其轨迹。现有的跟踪方法优化了预测精度，但忽略了追逐的可行性，导致轨迹在99.9%的时间内实际上是不可能拦截的。我们提出了一种感知到追逐（P2P）的、以轨迹为中心的时序推理框架，该框架桥接了检测和可操作的追逐规划。我们的方法将无人机运动表示为紧凑的8维 tokens，捕捉速度、加速度、尺度和平滑度，从而使12帧的因果Transformer能够推理未来的行为。我们引入了拦截成功率（ISR）指标来衡量在现实拦截器约束下的追逐可行性。在包含226个真实无人机序列的Anti-UAV-RGBT数据集上进行评估，P2P实现了28.12像素的平均位移误差和0.597的拦截成功率，与仅跟踪的基线相比，在轨迹预测方面提高了77%，在追逐可行性方面提高了597倍，同时保持了完美的无人机分类精度（100%）。我们的工作表明，基于运动模式的时序推理能够实现准确的预测和可操作的追逐规划。
tldr: The paper introduces Perception-to-Pursuit (P2P), a track-centric temporal reasoning framework for autonomous drone chasing, which significantly improves pursuit feasibility while maintaining high prediction accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了感知到追踪（P2P）的方法，这是一种以轨迹为中心的时序推理框架，用于自主无人机追踪，在保持高预测精度的同时，显著提高了追踪的可行性。

title: iFAN Ecosystem: A Unified AI, Digital Twin, Cyber-Physical Security, and Robotics Environment for Advanced Nuclear Simulation and Operations
summary: As nuclear facilities experience digital transformation and advanced reactor development, AI integration, cyber-physical security, and other emerging technologies such as autonomous robot operations are increasingly developed. However, evaluation and deployment is challenged by the lack of dedicated virtual testbeds. The Immersive Framework for Advanced Nuclear (iFAN) ecosystem is developed, a comprehensive digital twin framework with a realistic 3D environment with physics-based simulations. The iFAN ecosystem serves as a high-fidelity virtual testbed for plant operation, cybersecurity, physical security, and robotic operation, as it provides real-time data exchange for pre-deployment verification. Core features include virtual reality, reinforcement learning, radiation simulation, and cyber-physical security. In addition, the paper investigates various applications through potential operational scenarios. The iFAN ecosystem provides a versatile and secure architecture for validating the next generation of autonomous and cyber-resilient nuclear operations.
summary_zh: 随着核设施经历数字化转型和先进反应堆开发，人工智能集成、信息物理安全以及自主机器人操作等新兴技术正日益发展。然而，缺乏专门的虚拟测试平台给评估和部署带来了挑战。我们开发了先进核能沉浸式框架（iFAN）生态系统，它是一个具有逼真3D环境和基于物理仿真的综合数字孪生框架。iFAN生态系统可作为工厂运行、网络安全、物理安全和机器人操作的高保真虚拟测试平台，因为它为部署前验证提供实时数据交换。核心功能包括虚拟现实、强化学习、辐射模拟和信息物理安全。此外，本文还通过潜在的运行场景探讨了各种应用。iFAN生态系统为验证下一代自主和网络弹性核运行提供了一个通用且安全的架构。
tldr: The paper introduces iFAN, a comprehensive digital twin ecosystem for advanced nuclear simulation and operations, integrating AI, robotics, and cyber-physical security for pre-deployment verification.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了iFAN，一个用于高级核模拟和运营的综合数字孪生生态系统，集成了人工智能、机器人和网络物理安全，用于预部署验证。

title: Goal-oriented Communication for Fast and Robust Robotic Fault Detection and Recovery
summary: Autonomous robotic systems are widely deployed in smart factories and operate in dynamic, uncertain, and human-involved environments that require low-latency and robust fault detection and recovery (FDR). However, existing FDR frameworks exhibit various limitations, such as significant delays in communication and computation, and unreliability in robot motion/trajectory generation, mainly because the communication-computation-control (3C) loop is designed without considering the downstream FDR goal. To address this, we propose a novel Goal-oriented Communication (GoC) framework that jointly designs the 3C loop tailored for fast and robust robotic FDR, with the goal of minimising the FDR time while maximising the robotic task (e.g., workpiece sorting) success rate. For fault detection, our GoC framework innovatively defines and extracts the 3D scene graph (3D-SG) as the semantic representation via our designed representation extractor, and detects faults by monitoring spatial relationship changes in the 3D-SG. For fault recovery, we fine-tune a small language model (SLM) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and enhance its reasoning and generalization capabilities via knowledge distillation to generate recovery motions for robots. We also design a lightweight goal-oriented digital twin reconstruction module to refine the recovery motions generated by the SLM when fine-grained robotic control is required, using only task-relevant object contours for digital twin reconstruction. Extensive simulations demonstrate that our GoC framework reduces the FDR time by up to 82.6% and improves the task success rate by up to 76%, compared to the state-of-the-art frameworks that rely on vision language models for fault detection and large language models for fault recovery.
summary_zh: 自主机器人系统广泛部署于智能工厂中，并在动态、不确定且涉及人的环境中运行，这需要低延迟、鲁棒的故障检测与恢复（FDR）。然而，现有的FDR框架表现出各种局限性，例如通信和计算中的显著延迟，以及机器人运动/轨迹生成中的不可靠性，这主要是因为通信-计算-控制（3C）环路的设计没有考虑到下游的FDR目标。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的面向目标的通信（GoC）框架，该框架联合设计专为快速且鲁棒的机器人FDR定制的3C环路，目标是最小化FDR时间，同时最大化机器人任务（例如，工件分拣）的成功率。对于故障检测，我们的GoC框架创新性地定义并提取3D场景图（3D-SG）作为语义表示，并通过我们设计的表示提取器，并通过监控3D-SG中的空间关系变化来检测故障。对于故障恢复，我们通过低秩自适应（LoRA）微调一个小语言模型（SLM），并通过知识蒸馏增强其推理和泛化能力，从而为机器人生成恢复动作。我们还设计了一个轻量级的面向目标的数字孪生重建模块，当需要细粒度的机器人控制时，仅使用与任务相关的对象轮廓进行数字孪生重建，以细化SLM生成的恢复动作。大量的模拟表明，与依赖于视觉语言模型进行故障检测和大型语言模型进行故障恢复的最新框架相比，我们的GoC框架最多可将FDR时间减少82.6%，并将任务成功率提高76%。
tldr: This paper proposes a Goal-oriented Communication (GoC) framework for fast and robust robotic fault detection and recovery (FDR) by jointly designing the communication, computation, and control loop. It uses 3D scene graphs for fault detection and fine-tuned SLMs for fault recovery, demonstrating significant improvements in FDR time and task success rate compared to SOTA methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向目标的通信(GoC)框架，通过联合设计通信、计算和控制回路，实现快速、鲁棒的机器人故障检测与恢复(FDR)。它采用3D场景图进行故障检测，并使用微调的小型语言模型(SLM)进行故障恢复，与当前最先进的方法相比，在FDR时间和任务成功率方面均有显著提升。

title: LVLMs and Humans Ground Differently in Referential Communication
summary: For generative AI agents to partner effectively with human users, the ability to accurately predict human intent is critical. But this ability to collaborate remains limited by a critical deficit: an inability to model common ground. Here, we present a referential communication experiment with a factorial design involving director-matcher pairs (human-human, human-AI, AI-human, and AI-AI) that interact with multiple turns in repeated rounds to match pictures of objects not associated with any obvious lexicalized labels. We release the online pipeline for data collection, the tools and analyses for accuracy, efficiency, and lexical overlap, and a corpus of 356 dialogues (89 pairs over 4 rounds each) that unmasks LVLMs' limitations in interactively resolving referring expressions, a crucial skill that underlies human language use.
summary_zh: 为了使生成式人工智能代理能够有效地与人类用户合作，准确预测人类意图的能力至关重要。但这种协作能力仍然受到一个关键缺陷的限制：缺乏对共同基础进行建模的能力。在此，我们展示了一项参照交流实验，该实验采用析因设计，涉及导演-匹配者对（人-人、人-人工智能、人工智能-人、以及人工智能-人工智能），他们在重复的回合中进行多轮互动，以匹配那些与任何明显的词汇化标签无关的物体图片。我们发布了用于数据收集的在线流程、用于准确性、效率和词汇重叠的工具和分析，以及一个包含 356 段对话（每个 89 对，持续 4 轮）的语料库，该语料库揭示了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在交互式地解决指代表达方面的局限性，而这是一种支撑人类语言使用的关键技能。
tldr: This paper presents a referential communication experiment showing that LVLMs struggle with interactive reference resolution compared to humans, using a newly released dataset of human-human, human-AI, AI-human, and AI-AI dialogues.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个指称交流实验，表明 LVLMs 在交互式指称消解方面不如人类，并发布了一个包含人-人、人-AI、AI-人 和 AI-AI 对话的新数据集。

title: Agentic Design Patterns: A System-Theoretic Framework
summary: With the development of foundation model (FM), agentic AI systems are getting more attention, yet their inherent issues like hallucination and poor reasoning, coupled with the frequent ad-hoc nature of system design, lead to unreliable and brittle applications. Existing efforts to characterise agentic design patterns often lack a rigorous systems-theoretic foundation, resulting in high-level or convenience-based taxonomies that are difficult to implement. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a principled methodology for engineering robust AI agents. We propose two primary contributions: first, a novel system-theoretic framework that deconstructs an agentic AI system into five core, interacting functional subsystems: Reasoning & World Model, Perception & Grounding, Action Execution, Learning & Adaptation, and Inter-Agent Communication. Second, derived from this architecture and directly mapped to a comprehensive taxonomy of agentic challenges, we present a collection of 12 agentic design patterns. These patterns - categorised as Foundational, Cognitive & Decisional, Execution & Interaction, and Adaptive & Learning - offer reusable, structural solutions to recurring problems in agent design. The utility of the framework is demonstrated by a case study on the ReAct framework, showing how the proposed patterns can rectify systemic architectural deficiencies. This work provides a foundational language and a structured methodology to standardise agentic design communication among researchers and engineers, leading to more modular, understandable, and reliable autonomous systems.
summary_zh: 随着基础模型（FM）的发展，代理式人工智能系统越来越受到关注，然而其固有的幻觉和推理能力不足等问题，加上系统设计中频繁出现的临时性特征，导致了不可靠且脆弱的应用。目前用于描述代理式设计模式的方法通常缺乏严格的系统理论基础，导致产生高级别或基于便利性的分类，这些分类难以实施。本文旨在弥补这一差距，提出了一种用于构建鲁棒人工智能代理的原则性方法。我们提出了两个主要贡献：首先，一个新颖的系统理论框架，将代理式人工智能系统解构为五个核心、相互作用的功能子系统：推理与世界模型、感知与接地、行动执行、学习与适应以及代理间通信。其次，从这个架构派生并直接映射到一个全面的代理式挑战分类，我们提出了一组12个代理式设计模式。这些模式——被分为基础性、认知与决策性、执行与交互性以及适应与学习性——为代理设计中经常出现的问题提供了可重用的结构性解决方案。通过对ReAct框架的案例研究，展示了该框架的效用，表明所提出的模式如何纠正系统性的架构缺陷。这项工作提供了一种基础语言和结构化方法，以标准化研究人员和工程师之间的代理式设计沟通，从而促成更模块化、更易理解和更可靠的自主系统。
tldr: This paper proposes a system-theoretic framework for agentic AI, decomposing agent systems into functional subsystems and presenting 12 design patterns to address common challenges, aiming for more reliable and modular autonomous systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个针对Agentic AI的系统理论框架，将Agent系统分解为功能子系统，并提出了12种设计模式来解决常见挑战，旨在实现更可靠、更模块化的自主系统。

title: R^3: Replay, Reflection, and Ranking Rewards for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) aim to solve diverse and complex problems through structured reasoning. Recent advances in group-based policy optimization methods have shown promise in enabling stable advantage estimation without reliance on process-level annotations. However, these methods rely on advantage gaps induced by high-quality samples within the same batch, which makes the training process fragile and inefficient when intra-group advantages collapse under challenging tasks. To address these problems, we propose a reinforcement learning mechanism named \emph{\textbf{R^3}} that along three directions: (1) a \emph{cross-context \underline{\textbf{R}}eplay} strategy that maintains the intra-group advantage by recalling valuable examples from historical trajectories of the same query, (2) an \emph{in-context self-\underline{\textbf{R}}eflection} mechanism enabling models to refine outputs by leveraging past failures, and (3) a \emph{structural entropy \underline{\textbf{R}}anking reward}, which assigns relative rewards to truncated or failed samples by ranking responses based on token-level entropy patterns, capturing both local exploration and global stability. We implement our method on Deepseek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and train it on the DeepscaleR-40k in the math domain. Experiments demonstrate our method achieves SoTA performance on several math benchmarks, representing significant improvements and fewer reasoning tokens over the base models. Code and model will be released.
summary_zh: 大型推理模型(LRM)旨在通过结构化推理解决多样且复杂的问题。最近，基于群体的策略优化方法的进展表明，在无需依赖过程级标注的情况下，实现稳定的优势估计是有希望的。然而，这些方法依赖于同一批次内高质量样本所带来的优势差距，这使得训练过程在组内优势在高难度任务下崩溃时变得脆弱且低效。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为\emph{\textbf{R^3}}的强化学习机制，它从三个方向入手：（1）一个\emph{跨上下文\underline{\textbf{R}}eplay}策略，通过回忆同一查询的历史轨迹中的有价值的例子来维持组内优势，（2）一个\emph{上下文自\underline{\textbf{R}}eflection}机制，使模型能够通过利用过去的失败来改进输出，以及（3）一个\emph{结构熵\underline{\textbf{R}}anking reward}，它通过基于Token级别熵模式对响应进行排序，来为被截断或失败的样本分配相对奖励，从而捕捉局部探索和全局稳定性。我们在Deepseek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B上实现了我们的方法，并在数学领域的DeepscaleR-40k上对其进行了训练。实验表明，我们的方法在多个数学基准测试中实现了SoTA性能，与基础模型相比，在推理Token数量上有了显著改进。代码和模型将会发布。
tldr: This paper introduces R^3, a novel reinforcement learning mechanism for large reasoning models utilizing replay, reflection, and ranking rewards to address instability in advantage estimation and improve performance on math benchmarks. It achieves SoTA performance with fewer reasoning tokens.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了R^3，一种新颖的大型推理模型强化学习机制，它利用回放、反思和排序奖励来解决优势估计中的不稳定性，并提高在数学基准测试中的表现。它以更少的推理 token 实现了 SoTA 性能。

title: ComAgent: Multi-LLM based Agentic AI Empowered Intelligent Wireless Networks
summary: Emerging 6G networks rely on complex cross-layer optimization, yet manually translating high-level intents into mathematical formulations remains a bottleneck. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promise, monolithic approaches often lack sufficient domain grounding, constraint awareness, and verification capabilities. To address this, we present ComAgent, a multi-LLM agentic AI framework. ComAgent employs a closed-loop Perception-Planning-Action-Reflection cycle, coordinating specialized agents for literature search, coding, and scoring to autonomously generate solver-ready formulations and reproducible simulations. By iteratively decomposing problems and self-correcting errors, the framework effectively bridges the gap between user intent and execution. Evaluations demonstrate that ComAgent achieves expert-comparable performance in complex beamforming optimization and outperforms monolithic LLMs across diverse wireless tasks, highlighting its potential for automating design in emerging wireless networks.
summary_zh: 新兴的6G网络依赖于复杂的跨层优化，然而，将高层意图手动转换为数学公式仍然是瓶颈。虽然大型语言模型(LLMs)展现出潜力，但单体式方法通常缺乏足够的领域基础，约束感知和验证能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ComAgent，一个多LLM的Agentic AI框架。ComAgent采用闭环的感知-规划-行动-反思循环，协调专门的Agent进行文献搜索、编码和评分，以自主生成即可用于求解器的公式和可复现的仿真。通过迭代分解问题和自我纠正错误，该框架有效地弥合了用户意图和执行之间的差距。评估表明，ComAgent在复杂的波束成形优化中达到了可与专家媲美的性能，并且在各种无线任务中优于单体式LLM，突显了其在新兴无线网络中自动化设计的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces ComAgent, a multi-LLM framework that automates the process of translating high-level user intents into mathematical formulations and executable simulations for wireless network optimization, achieving performance comparable to experts.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ComAgent，一个多LLM框架，可以自动将高级用户意图转化为数学公式和可执行的无线网络优化模拟，其性能与专家相当。

title: APC-RL: Exceeding Data-Driven Behavior Priors with Adaptive Policy Composition
summary: Incorporating demonstration data into reinforcement learning (RL) can greatly accelerate learning, but existing approaches often assume demonstrations are optimal and fully aligned with the target task. In practice, demonstrations are frequently sparse, suboptimal, or misaligned, which can degrade performance when these demonstrations are integrated into RL. We propose Adaptive Policy Composition (APC), a hierarchical model that adaptively composes multiple data-driven Normalizing Flow (NF) priors. Instead of enforcing strict adherence to the priors, APC estimates each prior's applicability to the target task while leveraging them for exploration. Moreover, APC either refines useful priors, or sidesteps misaligned ones when necessary to optimize downstream reward. Across diverse benchmarks, APC accelerates learning when demonstrations are aligned, remains robust under severe misalignment, and leverages suboptimal demonstrations to bootstrap exploration while avoiding performance degradation caused by overly strict adherence to suboptimal demonstrations.
summary_zh: 将示范数据融入强化学习（RL）可以显著加速学习过程，但现有方法通常假设示范是最优的且与目标任务完全对齐。在实践中，示范数据常常是稀疏的、次优的或错位的，当这些示范被整合到RL中时，会导致性能下降。我们提出了一种自适应策略组合（APC），这是一种层级模型，它能够自适应地组合多个数据驱动的标准化流（NF）先验。APC并非强制严格遵守这些先验，而是评估每个先验对目标任务的适用性，同时利用它们进行探索。此外，APC既可以精炼有用的先验，也可以在必要时绕过错位的先验，以优化下游奖励。在广泛的基准测试中，APC在示范对齐的情况下能够加速学习，在严重错位的情况下保持稳健性，并能利用次优示范来引导探索，同时避免因过度严格地遵循次优示范而导致的性能下降。
tldr: The paper introduces Adaptive Policy Composition (APC-RL), a hierarchical reinforcement learning approach that adaptively combines multiple data-driven priors (using Normalizing Flows) for faster learning and robustness to suboptimal or misaligned demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了自适应策略组合（APC-RL），这是一种分层强化学习方法，它自适应地组合多个数据驱动的先验（使用正态化流）以实现更快的学习并对次优或未对齐的演示具有鲁棒性。

title: RPO:Reinforcement Fine-Tuning with Partial Reasoning Optimization
summary: Within the domain of large language models, reinforcement fine-tuning algorithms necessitate the generation of a complete reasoning trajectory beginning from the input query, which incurs significant computational overhead during the rollout phase of training. To address this issue, we analyze the impact of different segments of the reasoning path on the correctness of the final result and, based on these insights, propose Reinforcement Fine-Tuning with Partial Reasoning Optimization (RPO), a plug-and-play reinforcement fine-tuning algorithm. Unlike traditional reinforcement fine-tuning algorithms that generate full reasoning paths, RPO trains the model by generating suffixes of the reasoning path using experience cache. During the rollout phase of training, RPO reduces token generation in this phase by approximately 95%, greatly lowering the theoretical time overhead. Compared with full-path reinforcement fine-tuning algorithms, RPO reduces the training time of the 1.5B model by 90% and the 7B model by 72%. At the same time, it can be integrated with typical algorithms such as GRPO and DAPO, enabling them to achieve training acceleration while maintaining performance comparable to the original algorithms. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/yhz5613813/RPO.
summary_zh: 在大语言模型领域，强化微调算法需要生成从输入查询开始的完整推理轨迹，这在训练的 rollout 阶段会产生巨大的计算开销。为了解决这个问题，我们分析了推理路径的不同片段对最终结果正确性的影响，并基于这些洞见，提出了一种即插即用的强化微调算法——基于部分推理优化的强化微调 (RPO)。与生成完整推理路径的传统强化微调算法不同，RPO 使用经验缓存生成推理路径的后缀来训练模型。在训练的 rollout 阶段，RPO 将 token 生成量减少了约 95%，大大降低了理论时间开销。与全路径强化微调算法相比，RPO 将 1.5B 模型的训练时间减少了 90%，将 7B 模型的训练时间减少了 72%。同时，RPO 可以与 GRPO 和 DAPO 等典型算法集成，使它们能够在实现训练加速的同时，保持与原始算法相当的性能。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/yhz5613813/RPO 上开源。
tldr: The paper introduces RPO, a reinforcement fine-tuning algorithm for LLMs that significantly reduces computational overhead by training on partial reasoning paths, achieving substantial speedups while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍RPO，一种用于大型语言模型的强化微调算法，通过对部分推理路径进行训练，显著降低了计算开销，在保持性能的同时实现了显著的加速。

title: From Observations to Events: Event-Aware World Model for Reinforcement Learning
summary: While model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) improves sample efficiency by learning world models from raw observations, existing methods struggle to generalize across structurally similar scenes and remain vulnerable to spurious variations such as textures or color shifts. From a cognitive science perspective, humans segment continuous sensory streams into discrete events and rely on these key events for decision-making. Motivated by this principle, we propose the Event-Aware World Model (EAWM), a general framework that learns event-aware representations to streamline policy learning without requiring handcrafted labels. EAWM employs an automated event generator to derive events from raw observations and introduces a Generic Event Segmentor (GES) to identify event boundaries, which mark the start and end time of event segments. Through event prediction, the representation space is shaped to capture meaningful spatio-temporal transitions. Beyond this, we present a unified formulation of seemingly distinct world model architectures and show the broad applicability of our methods. Experiments on Atari 100K, Craftax 1M, and DeepMind Control 500K, DMC-GB2 500K demonstrate that EAWM consistently boosts the performance of strong MBRL baselines by 10%-45%, setting new state-of-the-art results across benchmarks. Our code is released at https://github.com/MarquisDarwin/EAWM.
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习 (MBRL) 通过从原始观测中学习世界模型来提高样本效率，但现有方法难以在结构相似的场景中泛化，并且仍然容易受到诸如纹理或颜色偏移等虚假变化的影响。从认知科学的角度来看，人类将连续的感官流分割成离散的事件，并依靠这些关键事件进行决策。受此原则的启发，我们提出了事件感知世界模型 (EAWM)，这是一个通用框架，可以学习事件感知表征，从而简化策略学习，而无需手工制作标签。EAWM 采用自动事件生成器从原始观测中导出事件，并引入通用事件分割器 (GES) 来识别事件边界，事件边界标记事件片段的开始和结束时间。通过事件预测，表征空间被塑造成捕获有意义的时空转换。除此之外，我们提出了一个看似不同的世界模型架构的统一公式，并展示了我们方法的广泛适用性。在 Atari 100K、Craftax 1M 和 DeepMind Control 500K、DMC-GB2 500K 上的实验表明，EAWM 持续提高了强大 MBRL 基线的性能 10%-45%，在各项基准测试中创造了新的最先进结果。我们的代码已发布在 https://github.com/MarquisDarwin/EAWM。
tldr: The paper introduces an Event-Aware World Model (EAWM) for reinforcement learning, which learns event-aware representations to improve sample efficiency and generalization by segmenting observations into discrete events. It achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种事件感知世界模型（EAWM）用于强化学习，它通过将观察结果分割成离散事件来学习事件感知的表征，从而提高样本效率和泛化能力。该模型在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: Balancing Sustainability And Performance: The Role Of Small-Scale Llms In Agentic Artificial Intelligence Systems
summary: As large language models become integral to agentic artificial intelligence systems, their energy demands during inference may pose significant sustainability challenges. This study investigates whether deploying smaller-scale language models can reduce energy consumption without compromising responsiveness and output quality in a multi-agent, real-world environments. We conduct a comparative analysis across language models of varying scales to quantify trade-offs between efficiency and performance. Results show that smaller open-weights models can lower energy usage while preserving task quality. Building on these findings, we propose practical guidelines for sustainable artificial intelligence design, including optimal batch size configuration and computation resource allocation. These insights offer actionable strategies for developing scalable, environmentally responsible artificial intelligence systems.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型正逐渐成为代理式人工智能系统的组成部分，其在推理过程中的能源需求可能会带来重大的可持续性挑战。本研究调查了在多智能体、真实世界环境中部署较小规模的语言模型，是否能在不影响响应速度和输出质量的前提下，降低能源消耗。我们对不同规模的语言模型进行了比较分析，以量化效率和性能之间的权衡。结果表明，较小的开源权重模型可以在保持任务质量的同时降低能源使用。基于这些发现，我们提出了可持续人工智能设计的实用指南，包括最佳批处理大小配置和计算资源分配。这些见解为开发可扩展的、对环境负责的人工智能系统提供了可操作的策略。
tldr: This paper explores the trade-offs between energy consumption and performance in agentic AI systems by using smaller language models. The findings suggest that smaller models can reduce energy usage while maintaining task quality, offering guidelines for sustainable AI design.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在智能代理系统中，使用较小规模的语言模型在能耗和性能之间的权衡。 研究结果表明，较小的模型可以在保持任务质量的同时降低能耗，并为可持续的人工智能设计提供了指导。

title: Group Distributionally Robust Optimization-Driven Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
summary:
Recent progress in Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning is increasingly driven by the refinement of post-training loss functions and alignment strategies. However, standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) remain constrained by static uniformity: uniform prompt sampling and a fixed number of rollouts per prompt. For heterogeneous, heavy-tailed reasoning data, this creates structural inefficiencies that waste compute on already-solved patterns while under-training the long tail of hard problems. To address this, we propose Multi-Adversary Group Distributionally Robust Optimization (GDRO), an optimization-first framework that moves beyond uniform reasoning models by dynamically adapting the training distribution.
  We introduce an Online Difficulty Classifier that partitions prompts into dynamic pass@k difficulty groups. We then propose two independent GDRO games for post-training: (1) Prompt-GDRO, which employs an EMA-debiased multiplicative-weights bandit sampler to target the intensive difficulty margin and upweight persistently hard groups without frequency bias; and (2) Rollout-GDRO, which uses a shadow-price controller to reallocate rollouts across groups, maximizing gradient variance reduction on hard tasks under a fixed mean budget (compute-neutral). We provide no-regret guarantees for both controllers and additionally a variance-proxy analysis motivating a square-root optimal rollout allocation for Rollout-GDRO. We validate our framework on the DAPO 14.1k dataset using Qwen3-Base models. Prompt-GDRO and Rollout-GDRO achieve average relative gains of +10.6% and +10.1%, respectively, in pass@8 accuracy across 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales compared to the GRPO baseline. Qualitative analysis shows an emergent curriculum: the adversaries shift resources to the evolving reasoning frontier, enhancing the reasoning model's performance.
summary_zh:
大型语言模型（LLM）推理的最新进展日益依赖于对后训练损失函数和对齐策略的改进。然而，诸如群体相对策略优化（GRPO）等标准强化学习（RL）范式仍然受到静态均匀性的限制：均匀的提示采样和每个提示固定数量的rollout。对于异构、重尾的推理数据，这会造成结构性低效，既浪费了已解决模式的计算资源，又降低了难题长尾的训练效果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了多对抗群体分布鲁棒优化（GDRO），这是一种立足于优化的框架，通过动态调整训练分布，超越了均匀推理模型。

我们引入了一个在线难度分类器，将提示划分为动态的pass@k难度组。然后，我们为后训练提出了两个独立的GDRO博弈：（1）Prompt-GDRO，它采用EMA去偏乘性权重bandit采样器来针对密集难度margin，并在没有频率偏差的情况下提升持续难题组的权重；（2）Rollout-GDRO，它使用影子价格控制器在各组之间重新分配rollout，在固定的平均预算（计算量不变）下最大化难题上的梯度方差减少。我们为两个控制器提供了无后悔保证，并额外提供了一个方差代理分析，论证了Rollout-GDRO的平方根最优rollout分配。我们使用Qwen3-Base模型在DAPO 14.1k数据集上验证了我们的框架。与GRPO基线相比，Prompt-GDRO和Rollout-GDRO在1.7B、4B和8B规模上分别实现了+10.6%和+10.1%的平均相对pass@8准确率提升。定性分析显示了一种涌现的课程学习现象：对抗者将资源转移到不断发展的推理前沿，从而提高推理模型的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Multi-Adversary Group Distributionally Robust Optimization (GDRO) to improve LLM reasoning by dynamically adapting the training distribution using an Online Difficulty Classifier for prompt partitioning and two GDRO games (Prompt-GDRO and Rollout-GDRO) for post-training, achieving significant gains in pass@8 accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了多对抗组分布鲁棒优化（GDRO），通过使用在线难度分类器进行提示划分以及两个GDRO游戏（Prompt-GDRO和Rollout-GDRO）进行后训练，动态调整训练分布，从而提高LLM的推理能力，并在pass@8准确率方面取得了显著提升。

title: GhostUI: Unveiling Hidden Interactions in Mobile UI
summary: Modern mobile applications rely on hidden interactions--gestures without visual cues like long presses and swipes--to provide functionality without cluttering interfaces. While experienced users may discover these interactions through prior use or onboarding tutorials, their implicit nature makes them difficult for most users to uncover. Similarly, mobile agents--systems designed to automate tasks on mobile user interfaces, powered by vision language models (VLMs)--struggle to detect veiled interactions or determine actions for completing tasks. To address this challenge, we present GhostUI, a new dataset designed to enable the detection of hidden interactions in mobile applications. GhostUI provides before-and-after screenshots, simplified view hierarchies, gesture metadata, and task descriptions, allowing VLMs to better recognize concealed gestures and anticipate post-interaction states. Quantitative evaluations with VLMs show that models fine-tuned on GhostUI outperform baseline VLMs, particularly in predicting hidden interactions and inferring post-interaction screens, underscoring GhostUI's potential as a foundation for advancing mobile task automation.
summary_zh: 现代移动应用依赖于隐藏交互——诸如长按和滑动等没有视觉提示的手势——来提供功能，同时避免界面杂乱。尽管经验丰富的用户可能通过先前使用或引导教程来发现这些交互，但它们的隐式性质使得大多数用户难以发现。类似地，移动代理——旨在自动化移动用户界面上的任务，并由视觉语言模型（VLMs）驱动的系统——难以检测到隐蔽的交互或确定用于完成任务的行动。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了GhostUI，一个旨在支持移动应用中隐藏交互检测的新数据集。GhostUI提供交互前后的截图、简化的视图层级结构、手势元数据以及任务描述，从而使VLMs能够更好地识别隐藏的手势并预测交互后的状态。对VLMs的定量评估表明，在GhostUI上微调的模型优于基线VLMs，尤其是在预测隐藏交互和推断交互后屏幕方面，这突显了GhostUI作为推进移动任务自动化的基础的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces GhostUI, a new dataset designed to improve VLM performance in detecting and predicting hidden UI interactions in mobile applications, demonstrating improved results after fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GhostUI，一个新的数据集，旨在提高VLM在移动应用程序中检测和预测隐藏UI交互的表现，并在微调后展示了改进的结果。

title: GLOVE: Global Verifier for LLM Memory-Environment Realignment
summary: Most existing memory-enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) approaches implicitly assume that memory validity can be established either through external evaluators that provide task-specific success signals or through internal model cognition, such as reflection, for editing memory entries. However, these assumptions often break down in practical environments with dynamic drifts. We propose the Global Verifier (GLOVE), a framework that introduces a new design dimension for LLM memory systems by establishing a relative notion of truth. Through active probing to detect inconsistencies between retrieved memories and fresh observations, GLOVE enables memory-environment realignment by verifying and updating memory without access to ground-truth supervision or strong reliance on model introspection. We evaluate GLOVE on diverse benchmarks spanning web navigation, planning, and control, augmented with controlled environmental drifts that introduce non-stationarity beyond the original benchmark settings. Our results show that GLOVE substantially improves agent success rates, suggesting a robust pathway to cognitive agents capable of self-evolving.
summary_zh: 大多数现有的记忆增强型大型语言模型（LLM）方法隐式地假设记忆有效性可以通过提供任务特定成功信号的外部评估器或通过内部模型认知（例如反思）来建立，以便编辑记忆条目。然而，这些假设在具有动态漂移的实际环境中通常会失效。我们提出了全局验证器（GLOVE），一个通过建立真理的相对概念为 LLM 记忆系统引入新设计维度的框架。通过主动探测以检测检索到的记忆与新鲜观测之间的不一致性，GLOVE 能够在无需访问真实标签监督或强烈依赖模型内省的情况下，通过验证和更新记忆来实现记忆-环境重新对齐。我们在涵盖网络导航、规划和控制的各种基准上评估了 GLOVE，并使用受控的环境漂移进行了增强，这些环境漂移引入了超出原始基准设置的非平稳性。我们的结果表明，GLOVE 大幅提高了智能体的成功率，为能够自我演化的认知智能体提供了一条稳健的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces GLOVE, a framework that improves LLM memory systems by actively probing for inconsistencies between memories and fresh observations, enabling memory-environment realignment without ground-truth supervision.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GLOVE，一个通过主动探测记忆和新观测之间不一致性的框架，从而改进LLM记忆系统，无需ground-truth监督即可实现记忆-环境的重新对齐。

title: UniPCB: A Unified Vision-Language Benchmark for Open-Ended PCB Quality Inspection
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promise for general industrial quality inspection, but fall short in complex scenarios, such as Printed Circuit Board (PCB) inspection. PCB inspection poses unique challenges due to densely packed components, complex wiring structures, and subtle defect patterns that require specialized domain expertise. However, a high-quality, unified vision-language benchmark for quantitatively evaluating MLLMs across PCB inspection tasks remains absent, stemming not only from limited data availability but also from fragmented datasets and inconsistent standardization. To fill this gap, we propose UniPCB, the first unified vision-language benchmark for open-ended PCB quality inspection. UniPCB is built via a systematic pipeline that curates and standardizes data from disparate sources across three annotated scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce PCB-GPT, an MLLM trained on a new instruction dataset generated by this pipeline, utilizing a novel progressive curriculum that mimics the learning process of human experts. Evaluations on the UniPCB benchmark show that while existing MLLMs falter on domain-specific tasks, PCB-GPT establishes a new baseline. Notably, it more than doubles the performance on fine-grained defect localization compared to the strongest competitors, with significant advantages in localization and analysis. We will release the instruction data, benchmark, and model to facilitate future research.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在通用工业质量检测中展现出潜力，但在诸如印刷电路板（PCB）检测等复杂场景中表现不足。PCB检测由于组件密集、布线结构复杂以及需要专业领域知识的细微缺陷模式，带来了独特的挑战。然而，目前缺乏一个高质量、统一的视觉-语言基准来定量评估MLLMs在PCB检测任务中的表现，这不仅源于有限的数据可用性，还源于分散的数据集和不一致的标准化。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了UniPCB，这是首个用于开放式PCB质量检测的统一视觉-语言基准。UniPCB通过一个系统的流程构建，该流程整合并标准化了来自三个标注场景的不同来源的数据。此外，我们引入了PCB-GPT，一个MLLM，它基于由该流程生成的新指令数据集进行训练，利用了一种新颖的渐进式课程，模仿了人类专家的学习过程。在UniPCB基准上的评估表明，虽然现有的MLLMs在特定领域任务上表现不佳，但PCB-GPT确立了一个新的基线。值得注意的是，与最强大的竞争对手相比，它在细粒度缺陷定位方面的性能提高了一倍以上，在定位和分析方面具有显著优势。我们将发布指令数据、基准和模型，以促进未来的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces UniPCB, a unified vision-language benchmark for PCB quality inspection, and PCB-GPT, an MLLM trained on this benchmark, demonstrating improved performance on fine-grained defect localization compared to existing MLLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了UniPCB，一个用于PCB质量检测的统一视觉-语言基准，以及PCB-GPT，一个在此基准上训练的多模态大语言模型。实验表明，相比现有模型，PCB-GPT在精细的缺陷定位方面表现更佳。

title: MATA: A Trainable Hierarchical Automaton System for Multi-Agent Visual Reasoning
summary: Recent vision-language models have strong perceptual ability but their implicit reasoning is hard to explain and easily generates hallucinations on complex queries. Compositional methods improve interpretability, but most rely on a single agent or hand-crafted pipeline and cannot decide when to collaborate across complementary agents or compete among overlapping ones. We introduce MATA (Multi-Agent hierarchical Trainable Automaton), a multi-agent system presented as a hierarchical finite-state automaton for visual reasoning whose top-level transitions are chosen by a trainable hyper agent. Each agent corresponds to a state in the hyper automaton, and runs a small rule-based sub-automaton for reliable micro-control. All agents read and write a shared memory, yielding transparent execution history. To supervise the hyper agent's transition policy, we build transition-trajectory trees and transform to memory-to-next-state pairs, forming the MATA-SFT-90K dataset for supervised finetuning (SFT). The finetuned LLM as the transition policy understands the query and the capacity of agents, and it can efficiently choose the optimal agent to solve the task. Across multiple visual reasoning benchmarks, MATA achieves the state-of-the-art results compared with monolithic and compositional baselines. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/MATA.
summary_zh: 近期视觉-语言模型具有很强的感知能力，但其隐式推理难以解释，并且容易在复杂查询上产生幻觉。组合方法提高了可解释性，但大多数依赖于单一代理或手工构建的流水线，无法决定何时在互补的代理之间进行协作，或在重叠的代理之间进行竞争。我们引入了MATA（多代理分层可训练自动机），这是一个多代理系统，表现为一个分层有限状态自动机，用于视觉推理，其顶层转换由一个可训练的超代理选择。每个代理对应于超自动机中的一个状态，并运行一个小的基于规则的子自动机，以实现可靠的微观控制。所有代理都读取和写入共享内存，从而产生透明的执行历史。为了监督超代理的转换策略，我们构建了转换轨迹树，并将其转换为内存到下一状态的对，从而形成了用于监督式微调（SFT）的MATA-SFT-90K数据集。经过微调的LLM作为转换策略，能够理解查询和代理的能力，并可以有效地选择最佳代理来解决任务。在多个视觉推理基准测试中，与单体和组合基线相比，MATA取得了最先进的结果。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/ControlNet/MATA 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces MATA, a multi-agent hierarchical automaton system for visual reasoning, which uses a trainable hyper-agent to coordinate specialized agents and achieves state-of-the-art results on visual reasoning tasks. A new dataset, MATA-SFT-90K, is also introduced to supervise the hyper agent's transition policy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了MATA，一种用于视觉推理的多智能体分层自动机系统。该系统使用一个可训练的超智能体来协调多个专业智能体，并在视觉推理任务上取得了最新的成果。同时还引入了一个新的数据集MATA-SFT-90K，用于监督超智能体的转移策略。

title: MAGNET: Towards Adaptive GUI Agents with Memory-Driven Knowledge Evolution
summary: Mobile GUI agents powered by large foundation models enable autonomous task execution, but frequent updates altering UI appearance and reorganizing workflows cause agents trained on historical data to fail. Despite surface changes, functional semantics and task intents remain fundamentally stable. Building on this insight, we introduce MAGNET, a memory-driven adaptive agent framework with dual-level memory: stationary memory linking diverse visual features to stable functional semantics for robust action grounding and procedural memory capturing stable task intents across varying workflows. We propose a dynamic memory evolution mechanism that continuously refines both memories by prioritizing frequently accessed knowledge. Online benchmark AndroidWorld evaluations show substantial improvements over baselines, while offline benchmarks confirm consistent gains under distribution shifts. These results validate that leveraging stable structures across interface changes improves agent performance and generalization in evolving software environments.
summary_zh:
摘要：
移动图形用户界面代理由大型基础模型驱动，能够实现自主任务执行，但频繁的更新会改变 UI 外观并重组工作流程，导致在历史数据上训练的代理失效。尽管表面变化，但功能语义和任务意图在根本上保持稳定。基于此洞察，我们提出了 MAGNET，一个具有双层记忆的记忆驱动自适应代理框架：固定记忆将不同的视觉特征与稳定的功能语义相连接，以实现稳健的动作推理；程序记忆捕捉跨不同工作流程的稳定任务意图。我们提出了一种动态记忆演化机制，通过优先处理频繁访问的知识来不断优化两种记忆。在线基准 AndroidWorld 评估显示出相对于基线的显著改进，而离线基准确认了在分布偏移下的持续收益。这些结果验证了利用跨界面变化的稳定结构能够提高代理在不断发展的软件环境中的性能和泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces MAGNET, an adaptive GUI agent framework with a memory-driven knowledge evolution mechanism that leverages stable functional semantics and task intents to improve performance in evolving software environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MAGNET的自适应GUI代理框架，它具有记忆驱动的知识演化机制，利用稳定的功能语义和任务意图来提高在不断发展的软件环境中的性能。

title: Exploring Weaknesses in Function Call Models via Reinforcement Learning: An Adversarial Data Augmentation Approach
summary: Function call capabilities have become crucial for Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling them to interact more effectively with external tools and APIs. Existing methods for improving the function call capabilities of LLMs rely on data obtained either through manual annotation or automated generation by models, and use this data to finetune the LLMs. However, these methods often lack targeted design and are constrained by fixed patterns and data distributions, which limits their effectiveness in enhancing the generalization and robustness of function call LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose a novel adversarial data augmentation method that employs reinforcement learning to systematically identify and target the weaknesses of function call LLMs. Our training framework introduces a query model trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to generate adversarial queries that are specifically designed to challenge function call (FC) models. This approach adopts a zero sum game formulation, where the query model and the FC model engage in iterative alternating training. Overall, our method advances the development of more robust FC models and provides a systematic way to identify and correct weaknesses in the ability of LLMs to interact with external tools.
summary_zh: 函数调用能力对于大型语言模型（LLM）来说已变得至关重要，使其能够更有效地与外部工具和API进行交互。目前改进LLM函数调用能力的方法依赖于通过人工标注或模型自动生成获得的数据，并利用这些数据对LLM进行微调。然而，这些方法通常缺乏针对性的设计，且受限于固定的模式和数据分布，这限制了它们在增强函数调用LLM的泛化性和鲁棒性方面的有效性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的对抗性数据增强方法，该方法采用强化学习来系统地识别并针对函数调用LLM的弱点。我们的训练框架引入了一个使用强化学习（RL）训练的查询模型，以生成专门用于挑战函数调用（FC）模型的对抗性查询。该方法采用零和博弈的公式，其中查询模型和FC模型进行迭代交替训练。总而言之，我们的方法推进了更强大的FC模型的开发，并提供了一种系统化的方法来识别和纠正LLM与外部工具交互能力中的弱点。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning based adversarial data augmentation method to improve and test the robustness of large language models in executing function calls, focusing on targeted identification and correction of weaknesses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的对抗性数据增强方法，用于改进和测试大型语言模型在执行函数调用方面的鲁棒性，重点在于有针对性地识别和纠正弱点。

title: m2sv: A Scalable Benchmark for Map-to-Street-View Spatial Reasoning
summary:
Vision--language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on many multimodal benchmarks but remain brittle on spatial reasoning tasks that require aligning abstract overhead representations with egocentric views. We introduce m2sv, a scalable benchmark for map-to-street-view spatial reasoning that asks models to infer camera viewing direction by aligning a north-up overhead map with a Street View image captured at the same real-world intersection. We release m2sv-20k, a geographically diverse benchmark with controlled ambiguity, along with m2sv-sft-11k, a curated set of structured reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning.
  Despite strong performance on existing multimodal benchmarks, the best evaluated VLM achieves only 65.2% accuracy on m2sv, far below the human baseline of 95%. While supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning yield consistent gains, cross-benchmark evaluations reveal limited transfer. Beyond aggregate accuracy, we systematically analyze difficulty in map-to-street-view reasoning using both structural signals and human effort, and conduct an extensive failure analysis of adapted open models. Our findings highlight persistent gaps in geometric alignment, evidence aggregation, and reasoning consistency, motivating future work on grounded spatial reasoning across viewpoints.
summary_zh:
视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在许多多模态基准测试中都取得了优异的性能，但在空间推理任务中仍然显得脆弱，这类任务要求将抽象的俯视表示与以自我为中心的视角对齐。我们引入了m2sv，这是一个可扩展的地图到街景的空间推理基准测试，要求模型通过将朝北的俯视地图与在同一真实世界交叉口拍摄的街景图像对齐来推断相机的观看方向。我们发布了m2sv-20k，这是一个地理位置多样的，且具有可控歧义性的基准测试，以及m2sv-sft-11k，一套用于监督式微调的精心设计的结构化推理轨迹。
   尽管在现有的多模态基准测试中表现出色，但经过评估的最佳VLM在m2sv上的准确率仅为65.2%，远低于95%的人类基线。 虽然监督式微调和强化学习带来了一致的提升，但跨基准测试的评估显示迁移能力有限。除了总体准确率之外，我们还使用结构化信号和人类努力系统地分析了地图到街景推理的难度，并对经过调整的开放模型进行了广泛的失败分析。我们的研究结果突出了在几何对齐、证据聚合和推理一致性方面的持续差距，从而推动了未来在跨视点的具身空间推理方面的工作。
tldr: The paper introduces m2sv, a new benchmark for map-to-street-view spatial reasoning, highlighting the limitations of current VLMs in aligning different viewpoints and suggesting avenues for future research in grounded spatial reasoning. It includes a 20k dataset and a 11k curated fine-tuning set.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了m2sv，一个新的地图到街景空间推理基准，强调了当前VLMs在对齐不同视角方面的局限性，并为未来基于地面的空间推理研究提出了方向。其中包含一个2万数据集和一个1.1万的精选微调集。

title: More at Stake: How Payoff and Language Shape LLM Agent Strategies in Cooperation Dilemmas
summary: As LLMs increasingly act as autonomous agents in interactive and multi-agent settings, understanding their strategic behavior is critical for safety, coordination, and AI-driven social and economic systems. We investigate how payoff magnitude and linguistic context shape LLM strategies in repeated social dilemmas, using a payoff-scaled Prisoner's Dilemma to isolate sensitivity to incentive strength. Across models and languages, we observe consistent behavioral patterns, including incentive-sensitive conditional strategies and cross-linguistic divergence. To interpret these dynamics, we train supervised classifiers on canonical repeated-game strategies and apply them to LLM decisions, revealing systematic, model- and language-dependent behavioral intentions, with linguistic framing sometimes matching or exceeding architectural effects. Our results provide a unified framework for auditing LLMs as strategic agents and highlight cooperation biases with direct implications for AI governance and multi-agent system design.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在交互式和多智能体环境中越来越多地扮演自主智能体的角色，理解其战略行为对于安全性、协调性以及人工智能驱动的社会和经济系统至关重要。我们研究了在重复社会困境中，收益大小和语言环境如何塑造LLM的策略，并使用收益缩放的囚徒困境来分离对激励强度的敏感性。在不同的模型和语言中，我们观察到一致的行为模式，包括对激励敏感的条件策略以及跨语言的差异。为了解释这些动态，我们对典型的重复博弈策略训练了监督分类器，并将其应用于LLM的决策中，从而揭示了系统性的、依赖于模型和语言的行为意图，其中语言框架有时匹配甚至超过了架构的影响。我们的研究结果为审计LLM作为战略智能体提供了一个统一的框架，并强调了在人工智能治理和多智能体系统设计中具有直接影响的合作偏差。
tldr: This paper investigates how payoff and linguistic context influence LLM strategies in repeated social dilemmas like the Prisoner's Dilemma, revealing incentive-sensitive behaviors and cross-linguistic variations with implications for AI governance.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在重复的囚徒困境等社会困境中，收益和语言环境如何影响LLM的策略，揭示了激励敏感的行为和跨语言的差异，对人工智能治理具有影响。

title: Pixel-Grounded Retrieval for Knowledgeable Large Multimodal Models
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) often requires coupling fine-grained perception with factual knowledge beyond the input image. Prior multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) systems improve factual grounding but lack an internal policy for when and how to retrieve. We propose PixSearch, the first end-to-end Segmenting Large Multimodal Model (LMM) that unifies region-level perception and retrieval-augmented reasoning. During encoding, PixSearch emits <search> tokens to trigger retrieval, selects query modalities (text, image, or region), and generates pixel-level masks that directly serve as visual queries, eliminating the reliance on modular pipelines (detectors, segmenters, captioners, etc.). A two-stage supervised fine-tuning regimen with search-interleaved supervision teaches retrieval timing and query selection while preserving segmentation ability. On egocentric and entity-centric VQA benchmarks, PixSearch substantially improves factual consistency and generalization, yielding a 19.7% relative gain in accuracy on CRAG-MM compared to whole image retrieval, while retaining competitive reasoning performance on various VQA and text-only QA tasks.
summary_zh: 视觉问答 (VQA) 通常需要在精细的感知与超出输入图像范围的事实知识之间进行耦合。先前的多模态检索增强生成 (MM-RAG) 系统改善了事实基础，但缺乏何时以及如何检索的内部策略。我们提出了 PixSearch，这是第一个端到端的分割大型多模态模型 (LMM)，它统一了区域级感知和检索增强推理。在编码期间，PixSearch 发射 <search> 令牌以触发检索，选择查询模态（文本、图像或区域），并生成像素级掩码，这些掩码直接用作视觉查询，从而消除了对模块化管道（检测器、分割器、字幕生成器等）的依赖。一个具有交错搜索监督的两阶段监督微调方案，在保留分割能力的同时，教授检索时序和查询选择。在以自我为中心和以实体为中心的 VQA 基准测试中，PixSearch 显著提高了事实一致性和泛化能力，与整图检索相比，在 CRAG-MM 上的准确率相对提高了 19.7%，同时在各种 VQA 和纯文本 QA 任务上保持了具有竞争力的推理性能。
tldr: The paper introduces PixSearch, an end-to-end Large Multimodal Model that uses pixel-level masks as visual queries for retrieval-augmented VQA, improving factual consistency and generalization compared to whole-image retrieval methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PixSearch，一个端到端的LLM模型，通过使用像素级别的掩码作为视觉查询进行检索增强的VQA，与整图检索方法相比，提高了事实一致性和泛化能力。

title: Reuse your FLOPs: Scaling RL on Hard Problems by Conditioning on Very Off-Policy Prefixes
summary: Typical reinforcement learning (RL) methods for LLM reasoning waste compute on hard problems, where correct on-policy traces are rare, policy gradients vanish, and learning stalls. To bootstrap more efficient RL, we consider reusing old sampling FLOPs (from prior inference or RL training) in the form of off-policy traces. Standard off-policy methods supervise against off-policy data, causing instabilities during RL optimization. We introduce PrefixRL, where we condition on the prefix of successful off-policy traces and run on-policy RL to complete them, side-stepping off-policy instabilities. PrefixRL boosts the learning signal on hard problems by modulating the difficulty of the problem through the off-policy prefix length. We prove that the PrefixRL objective is not only consistent with the standard RL objective but also more sample efficient. Empirically, we discover back-generalization: training only on prefixed problems generalizes to out-of-distribution unprefixed performance, with learned strategies often differing from those in the prefix. In our experiments, we source the off-policy traces by rejection sampling with the base model, creating a self-improvement loop. On hard reasoning problems, PrefixRL reaches the same training reward 2x faster than the strongest baseline (SFT on off-policy data then RL), even after accounting for the compute spent on the initial rejection sampling, and increases the final reward by 3x. The gains transfer to held-out benchmarks, and PrefixRL is still effective when off-policy traces are derived from a different model family, validating its flexibility in practical settings.
summary_zh: 用于大型语言模型推理的典型强化学习(RL)方法在难题上浪费计算资源，因为在难题中，正确的在策略轨迹非常罕见，策略梯度消失，导致学习停滞。为了引导更高效的强化学习，我们考虑以离策略轨迹的形式重用旧的采样浮点运算（来自先前的推理或RL训练）。标准的离策略方法监督离策略数据，导致RL优化过程中的不稳定性。我们引入PrefixRL，我们以成功的离策略轨迹的前缀为条件，并运行在策略RL来完成它们，从而避免了离策略的不稳定性。 PrefixRL通过调节问题难度（通过离策略前缀长度）来提升难题上的学习信号。我们证明了PrefixRL目标不仅与标准RL目标一致，而且更具样本效率。在实验上，我们发现了反向泛化：仅在带有前缀的问题上进行训练可以泛化到分布外的无前缀性能，学习到的策略通常与前缀中的策略不同。在我们的实验中，我们通过使用基础模型的拒绝采样来获得离策略轨迹，从而创建一个自我改进循环。在难题的推理问题上，即使在考虑了用于初始拒绝采样所花费的计算资源后，PrefixRL达到相同的训练奖励的速度也比最强的基线（对离策略数据进行SFT，然后进行RL）快2倍，并且最终奖励增加了3倍。收益转移到保留的基准测试中，并且当离策略轨迹来自不同的模型家族时，PrefixRL仍然有效，这验证了其在实际环境中的灵活性。
tldr: The paper introduces PrefixRL, a method for scaling RL on hard reasoning problems by conditioning on successful off-policy prefixes, leading to faster training and higher final reward, even outperforming standard RL and SFT baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PrefixRL，一种通过在成功的离策略前缀上进行条件反射来扩展在困难推理问题上的强化学习的方法，从而实现更快的训练和更高的最终奖励，甚至优于标准强化学习和SFT基线。

title: POPE: Learning to Reason on Hard Problems via Privileged On-Policy Exploration
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has improved the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), yet state-of-the-art methods still fail to learn on many training problems. On hard problems, on-policy RL rarely explores even a single correct rollout, yielding zero reward and no learning signal for driving improvement. We find that natural solutions to remedy this exploration problem from classical RL, such as entropy bonuses, more permissive clipping of the importance ratio, or direct optimization of pass@k objectives, do not resolve this issue and often destabilize optimization without improving solvability. A natural alternative is to leverage transfer from easier problems. However, we show that mixing easy and hard problems during RL training is counterproductive due to ray interference, where optimization focuses on already-solvable problems in a way that actively inhibits progress on harder ones. To address this challenge, we introduce Privileged On-Policy Exploration (POPE), an approach that leverages human- or other oracle solutions as privileged information to guide exploration on hard problems, unlike methods that use oracle solutions as training targets (e.g., off-policy RL methods or warmstarting from SFT). POPE augments hard problems with prefixes of oracle solutions, enabling RL to obtain non-zero rewards during guided rollouts. Crucially, the resulting behaviors transfer back to the original, unguided problems through a synergy between instruction-following and reasoning. Empirically, POPE expands the set of solvable problems and substantially improves performance on challenging reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已提升大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，但当前最先进的方法在许多训练问题上仍无法学习。在困难问题上，在策略强化学习（on-policy RL）很少探索到哪怕一次正确的完整轨迹，导致零奖励和没有学习信号来驱动改进。我们发现，来自经典强化学习中用于解决此探索问题的自然方法，如熵奖励、更宽松的置信域裁剪或直接优化pass@k目标，都无法解决这个问题，并且通常会破坏优化稳定性，同时没有提高可解性。一个自然的替代方案是利用从更简单的问题中获得的迁移学习。然而，我们表明在强化学习训练期间混合简单和困难问题会适得其反，因为存在射线干涉（ray interference），优化会专注于已经可解的问题，从而积极地抑制了在更困难问题上的进展。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了特权在策略探索（Privileged On-Policy Exploration, POPE），这是一种利用人类或其他预言机（oracle）解决方案作为特权信息来引导困难问题上的探索的方法，这与使用预言机解决方案作为训练目标的方法（例如，离策略强化学习方法或使用SFT进行预热）不同。POPE通过预言机解决方案的前缀来扩充困难问题，使强化学习能够在引导的轨迹中获得非零奖励。至关重要的是，由此产生的行为通过指令遵循和推理之间的协同作用迁移回原始的、无引导的问题。在经验上，POPE扩展了可解问题的集合，并显着提高了在具有挑战性的推理基准上的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Privileged On-Policy Exploration (POPE), a reinforcement learning method that uses oracle solutions to guide exploration on hard reasoning problems, improving performance by leveraging a synergy between instruction-following and reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了特权On-Policy探索（POPE）方法，该方法利用oracle解决方案来指导解决复杂的推理问题，并通过指令跟随和推理之间的协同作用来提高性能。

title: $α^3$-SecBench: A Large-Scale Evaluation Suite of Security, Resilience, and Trust for LLM-based UAV Agents over 6G Networks
summary:
Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical, networked environments where they must operate reliably in the presence of malicious adversaries. While recent benchmarks have evaluated large language model (LLM)-based UAV agents in reasoning, navigation, and efficiency, systematic assessment of security, resilience, and trust under adversarial conditions remains largely unexplored, particularly in emerging 6G-enabled settings.
  We introduce $α^{3}$-SecBench, the first large-scale evaluation suite for assessing the security-aware autonomy of LLM-based UAV agents under realistic adversarial interference. Building on multi-turn conversational UAV missions from $α^{3}$-Bench, the framework augments benign episodes with 20,000 validated security overlay attack scenarios targeting seven autonomy layers, including sensing, perception, planning, control, communication, edge/cloud infrastructure, and LLM reasoning. $α^{3}$-SecBench evaluates agents across three orthogonal dimensions: security (attack detection and vulnerability attribution), resilience (safe degradation behavior), and trust (policy-compliant tool usage).
  We evaluate 23 state-of-the-art LLMs from major industrial providers and leading AI labs using thousands of adversarially augmented UAV episodes sampled from a corpus of 113,475 missions spanning 175 threat types. While many models reliably detect anomalous behavior, effective mitigation, vulnerability attribution, and trustworthy control actions remain inconsistent. Normalized overall scores range from 12.9% to 57.1%, highlighting a significant gap between anomaly detection and security-aware autonomous decision-making. We release $α^{3}$-SecBench on GitHub: https://github.com/maferrag/AlphaSecBench
summary_zh:
自主无人机（UAV）系统越来越多地部署在安全关键的、网络化的环境中，在这些环境中，它们必须在恶意对手存在的情况下可靠地运行。虽然最近的基准测试已经评估了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的UAV代理在推理、导航和效率方面的能力，但在对抗性条件下对安全性、韧性和信任度的系统评估仍然很大程度上未被探索，尤其是在新兴的6G使能的场景中。

我们引入了$α^{3}$-SecBench，这是第一个大规模评估套件，用于评估基于LLM的UAV代理在现实对抗性干扰下的安全感知自主性。在$α^{3}$-Bench的多轮对话式的UAV任务基础上，该框架用20,000个经过验证的安全叠加攻击场景增强了良性 эпизоды，这些场景针对七个自主层，包括传感、感知、规划、控制、通信、边缘/云基础设施和LLM推理。$α^{3}$-SecBench 从三个正交维度评估代理：安全性（攻击检测和漏洞归因）、韧性（安全降级行为）和信任（符合策略的工具使用）。

我们使用从包含175种威胁类型的113,475个任务语料库中抽样的数千个对抗增强的UAV эпизоды，评估了来自主要工业提供商和领先AI实验室的23个最先进的LLM。虽然许多模型可以可靠地检测到异常行为，但有效的缓解、漏洞归因和值得信赖的控制动作仍然是不一致的。归一化的总体分数范围从12.9%到57.1%，突出了异常检测和安全感知自主决策之间存在的显著差距。我们已在GitHub上发布$α^{3}$-SecBench：https://github.com/maferrag/AlphaSecBench
tldr: The paper introduces α³-SecBench, a large-scale evaluation suite to assess the security, resilience, and trust of LLM-based UAV agents under adversarial conditions, revealing a significant gap in security-aware autonomous decision-making.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了α³-SecBench，这是一个大规模评估套件，用于评估LLM驱动的无人机智能体在对抗性条件下的安全性、韧性和可信度，揭示了安全感知自主决策方面存在的显著差距。

title: Trust, Don't Trust, or Flip: Robust Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Expert Feedback
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PBRL) offers a promising alternative to explicit reward engineering by learning from pairwise trajectory comparisons. However, real-world preference data often comes from heterogeneous annotators with varying reliability; some accurate, some noisy, and some systematically adversarial. Existing PBRL methods either treat all feedback equally or attempt to filter out unreliable sources, but both approaches fail when faced with adversarial annotators who systematically provide incorrect preferences. We introduce TriTrust-PBRL (TTP), a unified framework that jointly learns a shared reward model and expert-specific trust parameters from multi-expert preference feedback. The key insight is that trust parameters naturally evolve during gradient-based optimization to be positive (trust), near zero (ignore), or negative (flip), enabling the model to automatically invert adversarial preferences and recover useful signal rather than merely discarding corrupted feedback. We provide theoretical analysis establishing identifiability guarantees and detailed gradient analysis that explains how expert separation emerges naturally during training without explicit supervision. Empirically, we evaluate TTP on four diverse domains spanning manipulation tasks (MetaWorld) and locomotion (DM Control) under various corruption scenarios. TTP achieves state-of-the-art robustness, maintaining near-oracle performance under adversarial corruption while standard PBRL methods fail catastrophically. Notably, TTP outperforms existing baselines by successfully learning from mixed expert pools containing both reliable and adversarial annotators, all while requiring no expert features beyond identification indices and integrating seamlessly with existing PBRL pipelines.
summary_zh: 基于偏好的强化学习(PBRL)通过学习成对轨迹的比较结果，为显式奖励工程提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，现实世界的偏好数据通常来自具有不同可靠性的异构标注者；有些准确，有些嘈杂，有些则具有系统性的对抗性。现有的PBRL方法要么平等对待所有反馈，要么试图过滤掉不可靠的来源，但当面对系统性地提供不正确偏好的对抗性标注者时，这两种方法都会失败。我们引入了TriTrust-PBRL（TTP），这是一个统一的框架，可以从多专家偏好反馈中联合学习共享奖励模型和专家特定的信任参数。关键的见解是，信任参数在基于梯度的优化过程中自然演化为正（信任）、接近零（忽略）或负（翻转），使模型能够自动反转对抗性偏好并恢复有用的信号，而不是仅仅丢弃损坏的反馈。我们提供了理论分析，建立了可识别性保证，并进行了详细的梯度分析，解释了专家分离如何在没有显式监督的情况下在训练过程中自然出现。在经验上，我们在跨越操作任务（MetaWorld）和运动（DM Control）的四个不同领域，在各种损坏场景下评估了TTP。TTP实现了最先进的鲁棒性，在对抗性损坏下保持了接近最优的性能，而标准的PBRL方法则彻底失败。值得注意的是，TTP通过成功地从包含可靠和对抗性标注者的混合专家池中学习来超越现有的基线，同时不需要超出识别索引的专家特征，并且与现有的PBRL流程无缝集成。
tldr: This paper introduces TriTrust-PBRL (TTP), a novel preference-based reinforcement learning framework that robustly learns from multi-expert feedback, even when some experts are adversarial, by adaptively trusting, ignoring, or flipping their preferences during training.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为TriTrust-PBRL (TTP) 的新型基于偏好的强化学习框架，它可以通过自适应地信任、忽略或反转专家的偏好，从多专家反馈中稳健地学习，即使某些专家具有对抗性。

title: Video-KTR: Reinforcing Video Reasoning via Key Token Attribution
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong potential for enhancing reasoning in multimodal large language models, yet existing video reasoning methods often rely on coarse sequence-level rewards or single-factor token selection, neglecting fine-grained links among visual inputs, temporal dynamics, and linguistic outputs, limiting both accuracy and interpretability. We propose Video-KTR, a modality-aware policy shaping framework that performs selective, token-level RL by combining three attribution signals: (1) visual-aware tokens identified via counterfactual masking to reveal perceptual dependence; (2) temporal-aware tokens detected through frame shuffling to expose temporal sensitivity; and (3) high-entropy tokens signaling predictive uncertainty. By reinforcing only these key tokens, Video-KTR focuses learning on semantically informative, modality-sensitive content while filtering out low-value tokens. Across five challenging benchmarks, Video-KTR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results, achieving 42.7\% on Video-Holmes (surpassing GPT-4o) with consistent gains on both reasoning and general video understanding tasks. Ablation studies verify the complementary roles of the attribution signals and the robustness of targeted token-level updates. Overall, Video-KTR improves accuracy and interpretability, offering a simple, drop-in extension to RL for complex video reasoning. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/zywang0104/Video-KTR.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）在增强多模态大型语言模型的推理能力方面展现出强大的潜力，然而，现有的视频推理方法通常依赖于粗粒度的序列级别奖励或单因素的令牌选择，忽略了视觉输入、时间动态和语言输出之间细粒度的联系，从而限制了准确性和可解释性。我们提出Video-KTR，一个模态感知策略塑造框架，通过结合三种属性信号进行选择性的令牌级别RL：（1）通过反事实掩码识别的视觉感知令牌，以揭示感知依赖性；（2）通过帧随机洗牌检测到的时间感知令牌，以暴露时间敏感性；（3）指示预测不确定性的高熵令牌。通过仅强化这些关键令牌，Video-KTR将学习重点放在语义信息丰富、模态敏感的内容上，同时过滤掉低价值的令牌。在五个具有挑战性的基准测试中，Video-KTR实现了最先进或高度竞争性的结果，在Video-Holmes上获得了42.7%的准确率（超过GPT-4o），并在推理和通用视频理解任务上均取得了持续的提升。消融研究验证了属性信号的互补作用以及目标令牌级别更新的稳健性。总的来说，Video-KTR提高了准确性和可解释性，为复杂视频推理的RL提供了一个简单、即插即用的扩展。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/zywang0104/Video-KTR 获得。
tldr: Video-KTR enhances video reasoning in multimodal LLMs by using reinforcement learning with token-level attribution signals (visual, temporal, and uncertainty) to focus learning on semantically informative content, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Video-KTR 通过强化学习和token级别的属性信号（视觉、时间、不确定性）来增强多模态LLM中的视频推理能力，将学习重点放在语义信息丰富的内容上，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: Dynamic Worlds, Dynamic Humans: Generating Virtual Human-Scene Interaction Motion in Dynamic Scenes
summary: Scenes are continuously undergoing dynamic changes in the real world. However, existing human-scene interaction generation methods typically treat the scene as static, which deviates from reality. Inspired by world models, we introduce Dyn-HSI, the first cognitive architecture for dynamic human-scene interaction, which endows virtual humans with three humanoid components. (1)Vision (human eyes): we equip the virtual human with a Dynamic Scene-Aware Navigation, which continuously perceives changes in the surrounding environment and adaptively predicts the next waypoint. (2)Memory (human brain): we equip the virtual human with a Hierarchical Experience Memory, which stores and updates experiential data accumulated during training. This allows the model to leverage prior knowledge during inference for context-aware motion priming, thereby enhancing both motion quality and generalization. (3) Control (human body): we equip the virtual human with Human-Scene Interaction Diffusion Model, which generates high-fidelity interaction motions conditioned on multimodal inputs. To evaluate performance in dynamic scenes, we extend the existing static human-scene interaction datasets to construct a dynamic benchmark, Dyn-Scenes. We conduct extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments to validate Dyn-HSI, showing that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches and generates high-quality human-scene interaction motions in both static and dynamic settings.
summary_zh: 现实世界中的场景持续经历着动态变化。然而，现有的肢体动作生成方法通常将场景视为静态的，这与现实相悖。受到世界模型的启发，我们引入 Dyn-HSI，这是首个用于动态人景交互的认知架构，它赋予虚拟人三个类人组件。(1)视觉（人眼）：我们为虚拟人配备了动态场景感知导航，它可以持续感知周围环境的变化并自适应地预测下一个航点。(2)记忆（人脑）：我们为虚拟人配备了分层经验记忆，用于存储和更新训练过程中积累的经验数据。这使得模型能够在推理期间利用先验知识进行上下文感知运动启动，从而提高运动质量和泛化能力。(3)控制（人体）：我们为虚拟人配备了人景交互扩散模型，用于生成以多模态输入为条件的高保真交互动作。为了评估在动态场景中的性能，我们扩展了现有的静态人景交互数据集，构建了一个动态基准 Dyn-Scenes。我们进行了广泛的定性和定量实验来验证 Dyn-HSI，表明我们的方法始终优于现有方法，并在静态和动态环境中生成高质量的人景交互动作。
tldr: The paper introduces Dyn-HSI, a novel cognitive architecture for generating virtual human-scene interaction motions in dynamic scenes, incorporating vision, memory, and control components to handle environmental changes. They also introduce a new dynamic benchmark dataset, Dyn-Scenes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Dyn-HSI，一种用于在动态场景中生成虚拟人-场景互动的新型认知架构，它结合了视觉、记忆和控制组件来处理环境变化。他们还引入了一个新的动态基准数据集Dyn-Scenes。

title: Glance and Focus Reinforcement for Pan-cancer Screening
summary: Pan-cancer screening in large-scale CT scans remains challenging for existing AI methods, primarily due to the difficulty of localizing diverse types of tiny lesions in large CT volumes. The extreme foreground-background imbalance significantly hinders models from focusing on diseased regions, while redundant focus on healthy regions not only decreases the efficiency but also increases false positives. Inspired by radiologists' glance and focus diagnostic strategy, we introduce GF-Screen, a Glance and Focus reinforcement learning framework for pan-cancer screening. GF-Screen employs a Glance model to localize the diseased regions and a Focus model to precisely segment the lesions, where segmentation results of the Focus model are leveraged to reward the Glance model via Reinforcement Learning (RL). Specifically, the Glance model crops a group of sub-volumes from the entire CT volume and learns to select the sub-volumes with lesions for the Focus model to segment. Given that the selecting operation is non-differentiable for segmentation training, we propose to employ the segmentation results to reward the Glance model. To optimize the Glance model, we introduce a novel group relative learning paradigm, which employs group relative comparison to prioritize high-advantage predictions and discard low-advantage predictions within sub-volume groups, not only improving efficiency but also reducing false positives. In this way, for the first time, we effectively extend cutting-edge RL techniques to tackle the specific challenges in pan-cancer screening. Extensive experiments on 16 internal and 7 external datasets across 9 lesion types demonstrated the effectiveness of GF-Screen. Notably, GF-Screen leads the public validation leaderboard of MICCAI FLARE25 pan-cancer challenge, surpassing the FLARE24 champion solution by a large margin (+25.6% DSC and +28.2% NSD).
summary_zh: 在大型CT扫描中进行泛癌筛查对于现有的AI方法仍然具有挑战性，这主要是由于难以在大型CT体积中定位各种类型的微小病灶。 极端的正负样本不平衡严重阻碍了模型专注于病变区域，而对健康区域的冗余关注不仅降低了效率，还会增加假阳性。受到放射科医生快速浏览和重点关注诊断策略的启发，我们引入了GF-Screen，一种用于泛癌筛查的快速浏览和重点关注强化学习框架。 GF-Screen采用快速浏览模型来定位病变区域，并采用重点关注模型来精确分割病灶，其中重点关注模型的分割结果通过强化学习（RL）被用来奖励快速浏览模型。 具体而言，快速浏览模型从整个CT体积中裁剪出一组子体积，并学习选择具有病灶的子体积，以供重点关注模型进行分割。 鉴于选择操作对于分割训练是不可微的，我们提出利用分割结果来奖励快速浏览模型。 为了优化快速浏览模型，我们引入了一种新的组相对学习范式，该范式采用组相对比较来优先考虑高优势预测，并舍弃子体积组内的低优势预测，这不仅提高了效率，还减少了假阳性。 通过这种方式，我们首次有效地扩展了前沿的RL技术，以解决泛癌筛查中的特定挑战。 在包含9种病灶类型的16个内部数据集和7个外部数据集上进行的大量实验证明了GF-Screen的有效性。 值得注意的是，GF-Screen在MICCAI FLARE25泛癌挑战赛的公开验证排行榜上名列前茅，大幅超越了FLARE24冠军解决方案（+25.6% DSC和+28.2% NSD）。
tldr: The paper introduces GF-Screen, a reinforcement learning framework inspired by radiologists' diagnostic strategy for pan-cancer screening in CT scans, using a Glance model for region localization and a Focus model for segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为GF-Screen的强化学习框架，该框架灵感来自放射科医生的诊断策略，用于CT扫描中的泛癌筛查。它使用Glance模型进行区域定位和Focus模型进行分割，并在多个数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: NuiWorld: Exploring a Scalable Framework for End-to-End Controllable World Generation
summary: World generation is a fundamental capability for applications like video games, simulation, and robotics. However, existing approaches face three main obstacles: controllability, scalability, and efficiency. End-to-end scene generation models have been limited by data scarcity. While object-centric generation approaches rely on fixed resolution representations, degrading fidelity for larger scenes. Training-free approaches, while flexible, are often slow and computationally expensive at inference time. We present NuiWorld, a framework that attempts to address these challenges. To overcome data scarcity, we propose a generative bootstrapping strategy that starts from a few input images. Leveraging recent 3D reconstruction and expandable scene generation techniques, we synthesize scenes of varying sizes and layouts, producing enough data to train an end-to-end model. Furthermore, our framework enables controllability through pseudo sketch labels, and demonstrates a degree of generalization to previously unseen sketches. Our approach represents scenes as a collection of variable scene chunks, which are compressed into a flattened vector-set representation. This significantly reduces the token length for large scenes, enabling consistent geometric fidelity across scenes sizes while improving training and inference efficiency.
summary_zh: 世界生成是视频游戏、模拟和机器人等应用的一项基本能力。然而，现有方法面临三个主要障碍：可控性、可扩展性和效率。端到端场景生成模型受到数据稀缺性的限制。虽然以对象为中心的生成方法依赖于固定分辨率表示，但这会降低较大场景的保真度。无训练方法虽然灵活，但在推理时通常速度慢且计算成本高。我们提出了 NuiWorld，一个旨在解决这些挑战的框架。为了克服数据稀缺性，我们提出了一种生成式引导策略，从少量输入图像开始。利用最新的 3D 重建和可扩展场景生成技术，我们合成具有不同大小和布局的场景，从而产生足够的数据来训练端到端模型。此外，我们的框架通过伪草图标签实现可控性，并展示了对先前未见草图的一定程度的泛化能力。我们的方法将场景表示为变量场景块的集合，这些场景块被压缩为扁平化的向量集表示。这显著减少了大型场景的 token 长度，从而在不同场景大小中实现一致的几何保真度，同时提高训练和推理效率。
tldr: NuiWorld addresses controllability, scalability, and efficiency challenges in world generation by using a generative bootstrapping strategy from limited data, and variable scene chunk representation for large scene consistency.
tldr_zh: NuiWorld通过从有限数据中使用生成式引导策略，并采用可变场景块表示来实现大型场景的一致性，从而解决了世界生成中可控性、可扩展性和效率方面的挑战。

title: Improving Policy Exploitation in Online Reinforcement Learning with Instant Retrospect Action
summary: Existing value-based online reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms suffer from slow policy exploitation due to ineffective exploration and delayed policy updates. To address these challenges, we propose an algorithm called Instant Retrospect Action (IRA). Specifically, we propose Q-Representation Discrepancy Evolution (RDE) to facilitate Q-network representation learning, enabling discriminative representations for neighboring state-action pairs. In addition, we adopt an explicit method to policy constraints by enabling Greedy Action Guidance (GAG). This is achieved through backtracking historical actions, which effectively enhances the policy update process. Our proposed method relies on providing the learning algorithm with accurate $k$-nearest-neighbor action value estimates and learning to design a fast-adaptable policy through policy constraints. We further propose the Instant Policy Update (IPU) mechanism, which enhances policy exploitation by systematically increasing the frequency of policy updates. We further discover that the early-stage training conservatism of the IRA method can alleviate the overestimation bias problem in value-based RL. Experimental results show that IRA can significantly improve the learning efficiency and final performance of online RL algorithms on eight MuJoCo continuous control tasks.
summary_zh: 现有基于价值的在线强化学习（RL）算法由于低效的探索和延迟的策略更新而导致策略利用速度缓慢。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出一种名为即时回顾动作（IRA）的算法。具体来说，我们提出Q-表征差异演化（RDE）来促进Q网络表征学习，从而为相邻状态-动作对实现可区分的表征。此外，我们采用显式方法通过启用贪婪动作指导（GAG）来施加策略约束。这是通过回溯历史动作来实现的，从而有效地增强了策略更新过程。我们提出的方法依赖于为学习算法提供准确的k近邻动作价值估计，并通过策略约束学习设计一种快速适应的策略。我们进一步提出即时策略更新（IPU）机制，通过系统性地增加策略更新的频率来增强策略利用。我们进一步发现，IRA方法在训练早期阶段的保守性可以缓解基于价值的RL中的过度估计偏差问题。实验结果表明，在八个MuJoCo连续控制任务上，IRA可以显著提高在线RL算法的学习效率和最终性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Instant Retrospect Action (IRA), a new online RL algorithm that improves policy exploitation through enhanced Q-network representation learning, policy constraints using historical actions, and increased policy update frequency; it achieves significantly better performance on MuJoCo tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的在线强化学习算法，名为即时回顾动作（IRA），该算法通过增强Q网络表示学习、使用历史动作的策略约束和增加策略更新频率来提高策略利用率；并在MuJoCo任务上实现了显着更好的性能。

title: Implicit Q-Learning and SARSA: Liberating Policy Control from Step-Size Calibration
summary: Q-learning and SARSA are foundational reinforcement learning algorithms whose practical success depends critically on step-size calibration. Step-sizes that are too large can cause numerical instability, while step-sizes that are too small can lead to slow progress. We propose implicit variants of Q-learning and SARSA that reformulate their iterative updates as fixed-point equations. This yields an adaptive step-size adjustment that scales inversely with feature norms, providing automatic regularization without manual tuning. Our non-asymptotic analyses demonstrate that implicit methods maintain stability over significantly broader step-size ranges. Under favorable conditions, it permits arbitrarily large step-sizes while achieving comparable convergence rates.
