Empirical validation across benchmark environments spanning discrete and continuous state spaces shows that implicit Q-learning and SARSA exhibit substantially reduced sensitivity to step-size selection, achieving stable performance with step-sizes that would cause standard methods to fail.
summary_zh: Q-learning 和 SARSA 是基础的强化学习算法，它们的实际成功在很大程度上取决于步长的校准。过大的步长可能导致数值不稳定，而过小的步长可能导致进展缓慢。我们提出了 Q-learning 和 SARSA 的隐式变体，将它们的迭代更新重构为不动点方程。这产生了一种自适应步长调整，该调整与特征范数成反比地缩放，从而提供自动正则化而无需手动调整。我们的非渐近分析表明，隐式方法在明显更宽的步长范围内保持稳定性。在有利条件下，它允许任意大的步长，同时实现相当的收敛速度。跨越离散和连续状态空间的基准环境的实证验证表明，隐式 Q-learning 和 SARSA 表现出对步长选择的敏感性显著降低，使用会导致标准方法失败的步长也能实现稳定的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces implicit Q-learning and SARSA, which reformulate update rules as fixed-point equations, enabling adaptive step-size adjustment and reducing sensitivity to step-size selection, thus improving stability and performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了隐式 Q-learning 和 SARSA，它将更新规则重新定义为不动点方程，从而实现自适应步长调整并降低对步长选择的敏感性，从而提高稳定性和性能。

title: Teaching Models to Teach Themselves: Reasoning at the Edge of Learnability
summary: Can a model learn to escape its own learning plateau? Reinforcement learning methods for finetuning large reasoning models stall on datasets with low initial success rates, and thus little training signal. We investigate a fundamental question: Can a pretrained LLM leverage latent knowledge to generate an automated curriculum for problems it cannot solve? To explore this, we design SOAR: A self-improvement framework designed to surface these pedagogical signals through meta-RL. A teacher copy of the model proposes synthetic problems for a student copy, and is rewarded with its improvement on a small subset of hard problems. Critically, SOAR grounds the curriculum in measured student progress rather than intrinsic proxy rewards. Our study on the hardest subsets of mathematical benchmarks (0/128 success) reveals three core findings. First, we show that it is possible to realize bi-level meta-RL that unlocks learning under sparse, binary rewards by sharpening a latent capacity of pretrained models to generate useful stepping stones. Second, grounded rewards outperform intrinsic reward schemes used in prior LLM self-play, reliably avoiding the instability and diversity collapse modes they typically exhibit. Third, analyzing the generated questions reveals that structural quality and well-posedness are more critical for learning progress than solution correctness. Our results suggest that the ability to generate useful stepping stones does not require the preexisting ability to actually solve the hard problems, paving a principled path to escape reasoning plateaus without additional curated data.
summary_zh: 模型能否学会摆脱自身的学习高原？用于微调大型推理模型的强化学习方法在初始成功率低、训练信号弱的数据集上停滞不前。我们研究一个根本性问题：预训练的大型语言模型是否能够利用潜在知识，为其无法解决的问题生成自动化的课程？为了探索这个问题，我们设计了SOAR：一个旨在通过元强化学习挖掘这些教学信号的自我提升框架。模型的教师副本为学生的副本提出合成问题，并因学生在少量难题子集上的改进而获得奖励。关键是，SOAR将课程建立在已测量的学生进步上，而不是内在的代理奖励上。我们在数学基准测试的最难子集（成功率为0/128）上的研究揭示了三个核心发现。首先，我们表明，通过锐化预训练模型生成有用垫脚石的潜在能力，有可能在稀疏的二元奖励下实现双层元强化学习，从而开启学习之路。其次，基于学生进步的奖励优于先前大型语言模型自我对弈中使用的内在奖励方案，可靠地避免了它们通常表现出的不稳定和多样性崩溃模式。第三，对生成问题的分析表明，结构质量和适定性比解决方案的正确性对学习进度更为关键。我们的结果表明，生成有用垫脚石的能力不需要事先具备解决难题的实际能力，从而为在没有额外精选数据的情况下摆脱推理高原提供了一条有原则的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces SOAR, a meta-RL framework where an LLM teaches itself to solve hard math problems by generating its own curriculum and using improvement as a reward signal, enabling learning from sparse binary rewards.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SOAR的元强化学习框架，其中大型语言模型通过生成自己的课程并使用进步作为奖励信号来教自己解决困难的数学问题，从而能够从稀疏的二元奖励中学习。

title: How Does Delegation in Social Interaction Evolve Over Time? Navigation with a Robot for Blind People
summary: Autonomy and independent navigation are vital to daily life but remain challenging for individuals with blindness. Robotic systems can enhance mobility and confidence by providing intelligent navigation assistance. However, fully autonomous systems may reduce users' sense of control, even when they wish to remain actively involved. Although collaboration between user and robot has been recognized as important, little is known about how perceptions of this relationship change with repeated use. We present a repeated exposure study with six blind participants who interacted with a navigation-assistive robot in a real-world museum. Participants completed tasks such as navigating crowds, approaching lines, and encountering obstacles. Findings show that participants refined their strategies over time, developing clearer preferences about when to rely on the robot versus act independently. This work provides insights into how strategies and preferences evolve with repeated interaction and offers design implications for robots that adapt to user needs over time.
summary_zh: 自主性和独立导航对日常生活至关重要，但对盲人而言仍然充满挑战。 机器人系统可以通过提供智能导航辅助来增强移动性和信心。 然而，完全自主的系统可能会降低用户的控制感，即使他们希望保持积极参与。 尽管用户与机器人之间的协作已被认为很重要，但对于这种关系的认知如何随着重复使用而变化，我们知之甚少。 我们展示了一项重复暴露研究，六名盲人参与者在一个真实的博物馆中与导航辅助机器人互动。 参与者完成了诸如穿越人群、接近队列以及避开障碍物等任务。 研究结果表明，参与者随着时间的推移改进了他们的策略，并对何时依赖机器人与何时独立行动形成了更清晰的偏好。 这项工作深入了解了策略和偏好如何随着重复互动而演变，并为根据用户需求随时间进行调整的机器人提供了设计启示。
tldr: This paper investigates how blind users' delegation strategies and preferences evolve when repeatedly using a navigation-assistive robot in a museum setting, providing design implications for adaptive robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了盲人用户在博物馆环境中重复使用导航辅助机器人时，其委托策略和偏好如何演变，并为自适应机器人设计提供了启示。

title: Information-Theoretic Detection of Bimanual Interactions for Dual-Arm Robot Plan Generation
summary: Programming by demonstration is a strategy to simplify the robot programming process for non-experts via human demonstrations. However, its adoption for bimanual tasks is an underexplored problem due to the complexity of hand coordination, which also hinders data recording. This paper presents a novel one-shot method for processing a single RGB video of a bimanual task demonstration to generate an execution plan for a dual-arm robotic system. To detect hand coordination policies, we apply Shannon's information theory to analyze the information flow between scene elements and leverage scene graph properties. The generated plan is a modular behavior tree that assumes different structures based on the desired arms coordination. We validated the effectiveness of this framework through multiple subject video demonstrations, which we collected and made open-source, and exploiting data from an external, publicly available dataset. Comparisons with existing methods revealed significant improvements in generating a centralized execution plan for coordinating two-arm systems.
summary_zh: 通过示教编程是一种简化非专业人员机器人编程过程的策略，它通过人类演示实现。然而，由于手部协调的复杂性，及其对数据记录的阻碍，将其应用于双臂任务仍是一个未被充分探索的问题。本文提出了一种新颖的单样本方法，用于处理双臂任务演示的单个 RGB 视频，从而为双臂机器人系统生成执行计划。为了检测手部协调策略，我们应用香农信息论分析场景元素之间的信息流，并利用场景图的属性。生成的计划是一个模块化的行为树，它基于期望的手臂协调方式而假定不同的结构。我们通过多个受试者的视频演示验证了该框架的有效性，这些演示是我们收集并开源的，并且利用了来自外部公开数据集的数据。与现有方法的比较表明，在生成用于协调双臂系统的集中式执行计划方面，该方法有显著的改进。
tldr: This paper introduces a one-shot method using information theory and scene graphs to generate dual-arm robot execution plans from single RGB videos of bimanual task demonstrations, showing improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种单样本方法，利用信息论和场景图，从双手动任务演示的RGB视频中生成双臂机器人执行计划，并显示出比现有方法更好的改进。

title: Reimagining Social Robots as Recommender Systems: Foundations, Framework, and Applications
summary: Personalization in social robots refers to the ability of the robot to meet the needs and/or preferences of an individual user. Existing approaches typically rely on large language models (LLMs) to generate context-aware responses based on user metadata and historical interactions or on adaptive methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) to learn from users' immediate reactions in real time. However, these approaches fall short of comprehensively capturing user preferences-including long-term, short-term, and fine-grained aspects-, and of using them to rank and select actions, proactively personalize interactions, and ensure ethically responsible adaptations. To address the limitations, we propose drawing on recommender systems (RSs), which specialize in modeling user preferences and providing personalized recommendations. To ensure the integration of RS techniques is well-grounded and seamless throughout the social robot pipeline, we (i) align the paradigms underlying social robots and RSs, (ii) identify key techniques that can enhance personalization in social robots, and (iii) design them as modular, plug-and-play components. This work not only establishes a framework for integrating RS techniques into social robots but also opens a pathway for deep collaboration between the RS and HRI communities, accelerating innovation in both fields.
summary_zh: 社交机器人中的个性化指的是机器人满足个体用户的需求和/或偏好的能力。现有的方法通常依赖于大型语言模型（LLMs），以基于用户元数据和历史交互生成上下文感知的响应，或依赖于强化学习（RL）等自适应方法，以从用户的实时即时反应中学习。然而，这些方法不足以全面捕捉用户偏好——包括长期、短期和细粒度等方面——以及利用这些偏好来排序和选择动作、主动个性化交互并确保符合伦理规范的自适应。为了解决这些局限性，我们建议借鉴推荐系统（RSs），该系统专门用于建模用户偏好并提供个性化推荐。为了确保RS技术的集成在整个社交机器人流程中得到充分的理论基础并能无缝衔接，我们（i）对齐了社交机器人和RS的底层范式，（ii）确定了可以增强社交机器人个性化的关键技术，以及（iii）将它们设计为模块化的、即插即用的组件。这项工作不仅为将RS技术集成到社交机器人中建立了一个框架，还为RS和人机交互（HRI）社区之间的深度合作开辟了道路，从而加速这两个领域的创新。
tldr: This paper proposes integrating recommender system techniques into social robots to improve personalization by better capturing user preferences and enabling more proactive and ethical adaptations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出将推荐系统技术集成到社交机器人中，通过更好地捕捉用户偏好，并实现更主动和符合伦理的适应性，来提高个性化水平。

title: Reinforcement Learning Goal-Reaching Control with Guaranteed Lyapunov-Like Stabilizer for Mobile Robots
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can be highly effective at learning goal-reaching policies, but it typically does not provide formal guarantees that the goal will always be reached. A common approach to provide formal goal-reaching guarantees is to introduce a shielding mechanism that restricts the agent to actions that satisfy predefined safety constraints. The main challenge here is integrating this mechanism with RL so that learning and exploration remain effective without becoming overly conservative. Hence, this paper proposes an RL-based control framework that provides formal goal-reaching guarantees for wheeled mobile robots operating in unstructured environments. We first design a real-time RL policy with a set of 15 carefully defined reward terms. These rewards encourage the robot to reach both static and dynamic goals while generating sufficiently smooth command signals that comply with predefined safety specifications, which is critical in practice. Second, a Lyapunov-like stabilizer layer is integrated into the benchmark RL framework as a policy supervisor to formally strengthen the goal-reaching control while preserving meaningful exploration of the state action space. The proposed framework is suitable for real-time deployment in challenging environments, as it provides a formal guarantee of convergence to the intended goal states and compensates for uncertainties by generating real-time control signals based on the current state, while respecting real-world motion constraints. The experimental results show that the proposed Lyapunov-like stabilizer consistently improves the benchmark RL policies, boosting the goal-reaching rate from 84.6% to 99.0%, sharply reducing failures, and improving efficiency.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）在学习目标达成策略方面非常有效，但通常无法提供正式的目标始终能达成的保证。一种提供正式目标达成保证的常用方法是引入屏蔽机制，将智能体的行动限制在满足预定义安全约束的范围内。这里的主要挑战是将该机制与强化学习相结合，从而使学习和探索保持有效，而又不至于过于保守。因此，本文提出了一种基于强化学习的控制框架，为在非结构化环境中运行的轮式移动机器人提供正式的目标达成保证。我们首先设计了一个实时的强化学习策略，其中包含一组15个精心定义的奖励项。这些奖励鼓励机器人达到静态和动态目标，同时生成足够平滑的控制指令信号，以符合预定义的安全规范，这在实践中至关重要。其次，将一个类李雅普诺夫稳定器层作为策略监督器集成到基准强化学习框架中，以正式加强目标达成控制，同时保留状态-动作空间的有意义的探索。所提出的框架适用于在具有挑战性的环境中进行实时部署，因为它提供了一个正式的收敛到预期目标状态的保证，并通过基于当前状态生成实时控制信号来补偿不确定性，同时尊重真实世界的运动约束。实验结果表明，所提出的类李雅普诺夫稳定器始终改善基准强化学习策略，将目标达成率从84.6%提高到99.0%，大幅减少失败，并提高效率。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning framework for mobile robots that combines RL with a Lyapunov-like stabilizer to guarantee goal reaching while maintaining effective exploration, demonstrating improved goal-reaching rates in experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于移动机器人的强化学习框架，它将强化学习与类Lyapunov稳定器相结合，以保证目标实现，同时保持有效的探索，实验表明提高了目标实现率。

title: Task-Centric Policy Optimization from Misaligned Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid control often leverages motion priors from human demonstrations to encourage natural behaviors. However, such demonstrations are frequently suboptimal or misaligned with robotic tasks due to embodiment differences, retargeting errors, and task-irrelevant variations, causing naïve imitation to degrade task performance. Conversely, task-only reinforcement learning admits many task-optimal solutions, often resulting in unnatural or unstable motions. This exposes a fundamental limitation of linear reward mixing in adversarial imitation learning. We propose \emph{Task-Centric Motion Priors} (TCMP), a task-priority adversarial imitation framework that treats imitation as a conditional regularizer rather than a co-equal objective. TCMP maximizes task improvement while incorporating imitation signals only when they are compatible with task progress, yielding an adaptive, geometry-aware update that preserves task-feasible descent and suppresses harmful imitation under misalignment. We provide theoretical analysis of gradient conflict and task-priority stationary points, and validate our claims through humanoid control experiments demonstrating robust task performance with consistent motion style under noisy demonstrations.
summary_zh: 人形机器人控制通常利用人类示范中的运动先验来鼓励自然行为。然而，由于身体差异、重定向误差以及与任务无关的变异，这些示范常常是次优的或与机器人任务不对齐，导致朴素的模仿会降低任务性能。相反，仅使用任务奖励的强化学习允许许多任务最优解，但通常导致不自然或不稳定的运动。这暴露了对抗模仿学习中线性奖励混合的一个根本局限性。我们提出 \emph{以任务为中心的运动先验} (TCMP)，这是一个任务优先的对抗模仿框架，它将模仿视为一种条件正则化器，而不是一个对等的目标。TCMP 在最大化任务提升的同时，仅当模仿信号与任务进度兼容时才将其纳入，从而产生自适应的、几何感知的更新，该更新能保持任务可行的下降并抑制对齐不良时的有害模仿。我们提供了梯度冲突和任务优先驻点的理论分析，并通过人形机器人控制实验验证了我们的主张，该实验展示了在噪声示范下具有一致运动风格的稳健任务性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Task-Centric Motion Priors (TCMP), an adversarial imitation learning framework which prioritizes task progress over potentially misaligned motion priors in humanoid control, demonstrating improved task performance and motion style.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了任务中心运动先验（TCMP），一种对抗模仿学习框架，在人形机器人控制中优先考虑任务进度，而不是潜在的不对齐运动先验，从而提高了任务性能和运动风格。

title: Tactile Memory with Soft Robot: Robust Object Insertion via Masked Encoding and Soft Wrist
summary: Tactile memory, the ability to store and retrieve touch-based experience, is critical for contact-rich tasks such as key insertion under uncertainty. To replicate this capability, we introduce Tactile Memory with Soft Robot (TaMeSo-bot), a system that integrates a soft wrist with tactile retrieval-based control to enable safe and robust manipulation. The soft wrist allows safe contact exploration during data collection, while tactile memory reuses past demonstrations via retrieval for flexible adaptation to unseen scenarios. The core of this system is the Masked Tactile Trajectory Transformer (MAT$^\text{3}$), which jointly models spatiotemporal interactions between robot actions, distributed tactile feedback, force-torque measurements, and proprioceptive signals. Through masked-token prediction, MAT$^\text{3}$ learns rich spatiotemporal representations by inferring missing sensory information from context, autonomously extracting task-relevant features without explicit subtask segmentation. We validate our approach on peg-in-hole tasks with diverse pegs and conditions in real-robot experiments. Our extensive evaluation demonstrates that MAT$^\text{3}$ achieves higher success rates than the baselines over all conditions and shows remarkable capability to adapt to unseen pegs and conditions.
summary_zh: 触觉记忆，即存储和检索基于触摸的经验的能力，对于不确定性下的钥匙插入等接触密集型任务至关重要。为了复现这种能力，我们引入了带有软体机器人的触觉记忆（TaMeSo-bot）系统，该系统集成了软体腕部和基于触觉检索的控制，以实现安全且鲁棒的操控。软体腕部允许在数据收集期间进行安全的接触探索，而触觉记忆通过检索重用过去的演示，从而灵活地适应未见场景。该系统的核心是掩码触觉轨迹Transformer（MAT$^\text{3}$），它可以联合建模机器人动作、分布式触觉反馈、力矩测量和本体感受信号之间的时空交互。通过掩码token预测，MAT$^\text{3}$ 通过从上下文中推断缺失的感知信息来学习丰富的时空表示，从而在没有显式子任务分割的情况下自主提取任务相关的特征。我们在真实机器人实验中，以不同的销钉和条件验证了我们的方法在销钉插入孔任务中的有效性。我们广泛的评估表明，在所有条件下，MAT$^\text{3}$ 比基线方法实现了更高的成功率，并表现出适应未见销钉和条件的卓越能力。
tldr: This paper introduces TaMeSo-bot, a soft robot system with tactile memory, utilizing a Masked Tactile Trajectory Transformer (MAT$^	ext{3}$) for robust object insertion in peg-in-hole tasks, demonstrating improved performance over baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种带有触觉记忆的软体机器人系统TaMeSo-bot，它利用掩码触觉轨迹转换器（MAT$^	ext{3}$）在插孔任务中实现稳健的物体插入，并表现出比基线更好的性能。

title: Fauna Sprout: A lightweight, approachable, developer-ready humanoid robot
summary: Recent advances in learned control, large-scale simulation, and generative models have accelerated progress toward general-purpose robotic controllers, yet the field still lacks platforms suitable for safe, expressive, long-term deployment in human environments. Most existing humanoids are either closed industrial systems or academic prototypes that are difficult to deploy and operate around people, limiting progress in robotics. We introduce Sprout, a developer platform designed to address these limitations through an emphasis on safety, expressivity, and developer accessibility. Sprout adopts a lightweight form factor with compliant control, limited joint torques, and soft exteriors to support safe operation in shared human spaces. The platform integrates whole-body control, manipulation with integrated grippers, and virtual-reality-based teleoperation within a unified hardware-software stack. An expressive head further enables social interaction -- a domain that remains underexplored on most utilitarian humanoids. By lowering physical and technical barriers to deployment, Sprout expands access to capable humanoid platforms and provides a practical basis for developing embodied intelligence in real human environments.
summary_zh: 在学习控制、大规模仿真和生成模型领域的最新进展加速了通用机器人控制器的发展，但该领域仍然缺乏适用于在人类环境中安全、富有表现力地进行长期部署的平台。目前大多数人形机器人要么是封闭的工业系统，要么是难以在人群周围部署和操作的学院原型，这限制了机器人技术的发展。我们推出了Sprout，一个旨在通过强调安全性、表现力和开发者可访问性来解决这些限制的开发者平台。Sprout采用轻量化的外形设计，结合顺应性控制、有限的关节扭矩和柔软的外部结构，以支持在共享的人类空间中安全运行。该平台在一个统一的软硬件堆栈中集成了全身控制、带集成夹具的操纵以及基于虚拟现实的遥操作。一个富有表现力的头部进一步实现了社交互动——这仍然是大多数功能性人形机器人上未被充分探索的领域。通过降低物理和技术部署障碍，Sprout扩展了对强大人形机器人平台的访问，并为在真实人类环境中开发具身智能提供了实践基础。
tldr: The paper introduces Sprout, a new lightweight and developer-friendly humanoid robot designed for safe and expressive deployment in human environments, aiming to lower barriers to embodied intelligence research.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型的轻量级且对开发者友好的拟人机器人Sprout，旨在安全且富有表现力地部署在人类环境中，从而降低具体化智能研究的门槛。

title: Toward Learning POMDPs Beyond Full-Rank Actions and State Observability
summary: We are interested in enabling autonomous agents to learn and reason about systems with hidden states, such as furniture with hidden locking mechanisms. We cast this problem as learning the parameters of a discrete Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). The agent begins with knowledge of the POMDP's actions and observation spaces, but not its state space, transitions, or observation models. These properties must be constructed from action-observation sequences. Spectral approaches to learning models of partially observable domains, such as learning Predictive State Representations (PSRs), are known to directly estimate the number of hidden states. These methods cannot, however, yield direct estimates of transition and observation likelihoods, which are important for many downstream reasoning tasks. Other approaches leverage tensor decompositions to estimate transition and observation likelihoods but often assume full state observability and full-rank transition matrices for all actions. To relax these assumptions, we study how PSRs learn transition and observation matrices up to a similarity transform, which may be estimated via tensor methods. Our method learns observation matrices and transition matrices up to a partition of states, where the states in a single partition have the same observation distributions corresponding to actions whose transition matrices are full-rank. Our experiments suggest that these partition-level transition models learned by our method, with a sufficient amount of data, meets the performance of PSRs as models to be used by standard sampling-based POMDP solvers. Furthermore, the explicit observation and transition likelihoods can be leveraged to specify planner behavior after the model has been learned.
summary_zh: 我们致力于使自主智能体能够学习和推理具有隐藏状态的系统，例如带有隐藏锁定机制的家具。我们将此问题建模为学习离散部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的参数。智能体拥有POMDP的动作和观测空间知识，但没有状态空间、转换或观测模型的知识。这些属性必须从动作-观测序列中构建。用于学习部分可观测域模型的光谱方法，例如学习预测状态表示（PSR），已知能直接估计隐藏状态的数量。然而，这些方法无法直接估计转换和观测似然性，这对于许多下游推理任务很重要。其他方法利用张量分解来估计转换和观测似然性，但通常假设完全状态可观测性和所有动作的满秩转换矩阵。为放宽这些假设，我们研究PSR如何学习直到相似变换的转换和观测矩阵，该相似变换可以通过张量方法估计。我们的方法学习直到状态划分的观测矩阵和转换矩阵，其中单个划分中的状态具有相同的观测分布，该分布对应于其转换矩阵为满秩的动作。我们的实验表明，通过我们的方法学习的这些划分级别转换模型，在拥有足够的数据的情况下，能够满足标准基于采样的POMDP求解器使用的PSR模型的性能要求。此外，显式的观测和转换似然性可被用于在模型学习完成后指定规划器的行为。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for learning POMDPs that relaxes the restrictive assumptions of full-rank actions and full state observability, enabling explicit estimation of transition and observation likelihoods for downstream reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种学习POMDP的方法，放宽了全秩动作和全状态可观测性的限制性假设，从而能够显式估计转换和观测似然性，以用于下游推理任务。

title: Learning the Pareto Space of Multi-Objective Autonomous Driving: A Modular, Data-Driven Approach
summary:
Balancing safety, efficiency, and interaction is fundamental to designing autonomous driving agents and to understanding autonomous vehicle (AV) behavior in real-world operation. This study introduces an empirical learning framework that derives these trade-offs directly from naturalistic trajectory data. A unified objective space represents each AV timestep through composite scores of safety, efficiency, and interaction. Pareto dominance is applied to identify non-dominated states, forming an empirical frontier that defines the attainable region of balanced performance.
  The proposed framework was demonstrated using the Third Generation Simulation (TGSIM) datasets from Foggy Bottom and I-395. Results showed that only 0.23\% of AV driving instances were Pareto-optimal, underscoring the rarity of simultaneous optimization across objectives. Pareto-optimal states showed notably higher mean scores for safety, efficiency, and interaction compared to non-optimal cases, with interaction showing the greatest potential for improvement.
  This minimally invasive and modular framework, which requires only kinematic and positional data, can be directly applied beyond the scope of this study to derive and visualize multi-objective learning surfaces
summary_zh:
平衡安全性、效率和交互性是设计自动驾驶代理以及理解自动驾驶车辆 (AV) 在真实世界运行中的行为的基础所在。本研究引入了一个经验学习框架，可以直接从自然驾驶轨迹数据中推导出这些权衡关系。一个统一的目标空间通过安全性、效率和交互性的综合得分来表示每个AV的时间步。使用帕累托支配来识别非支配状态，从而形成一个经验前沿，定义了平衡性能的可实现区域。

该框架使用雾谷和I-395的第三代模拟（TGSIM）数据集进行了演示。结果表明，只有0.23%的AV驾驶实例是帕累托最优的，突显了在多个目标之间同时优化的稀有性。与非最优情况相比，帕累托最优状态在安全性、效率和交互性方面表现出明显更高的平均得分，其中交互性表现出最大的改进潜力。

该最小侵入性和模块化框架仅需要运动学和位置数据，可以超出本研究的范围直接应用，以推导和可视化多目标学习曲面。
tldr: This paper introduces a data-driven framework for learning the Pareto space of multi-objective autonomous driving, balancing safety, efficiency, and interaction, using naturalistic trajectory data and demonstrated on the TGSIM dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种数据驱动的框架，用于学习多目标自动驾驶的帕累托空间，平衡安全性、效率和交互，使用自然轨迹数据并在TGSIM数据集上进行了演示。

title: Tracking Drift: Variation-Aware Entropy Scheduling for Non-Stationary Reinforcement Learning
summary: Real-world reinforcement learning often faces environment drift, but most existing methods rely on static entropy coefficients/target entropy, causing over-exploration during stable periods and under-exploration after drift (thus slow recovery), and leaving unanswered the principled question of how exploration intensity should scale with drift magnitude. We prove that entropy scheduling under non-stationarity can be reduced to a one-dimensional, round-by-round trade-off, faster tracking of the optimal solution after drift vs. avoiding gratuitous randomness when the environment is stable, so exploration strength can be driven by measurable online drift signals. Building on this, we propose AES (Adaptive Entropy Scheduling), which adaptively adjusts the entropy coefficient/temperature online using observable drift proxies during training, requiring almost no structural changes and incurring minimal overhead. Across 4 algorithm variants, 12 tasks, and 4 drift modes, AES significantly reduces the fraction of performance degradation caused by drift and accelerates recovery after abrupt changes.
summary_zh: 真实世界的强化学习常常面临环境漂移的问题，但大多数现有方法依赖于静态的熵系数/目标熵，导致在稳定时期过度探索，以及在漂移后探索不足（从而减缓恢复），并且未能解答探索强度应如何随漂移幅度变化这一根本性问题。我们证明了非平稳性下的熵调度可以简化为一维的、逐轮权衡：漂移后更快地跟踪最优解与避免环境稳定时的无谓随机性，因此探索强度可以由可测量的在线漂移信号驱动。基于此，我们提出了AES（自适应熵调度），它在线使用可观察的漂移代理在训练期间自适应地调整熵系数/温度，几乎不需要结构性改变，并且仅产生极少的开销。在4种算法变体、12个任务和4种漂移模式中，AES显著降低了由漂移引起的性能下降比例，并加速了突变后的恢复。
tldr: The paper introduces Adaptive Entropy Scheduling (AES), a method for dynamically adjusting exploration intensity in reinforcement learning based on measurable drift, which improves robustness and recovery speed in non-stationary environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了自适应熵调度（AES），一种基于可测量漂移动态调整强化学习中探索强度的方法，从而提高非平稳环境中的鲁棒性和恢复速度。

title: Algorithmic Prompt-Augmentation for Efficient LLM-Based Heuristic Design for A* Search
summary: Heuristic functions are essential to the performance of tree search algorithms such as A*, where their accuracy and efficiency directly impact search outcomes. Traditionally, such heuristics are handcrafted, requiring significant expertise. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and evolutionary frameworks have opened the door to automating heuristic design. In this paper, we extend the Evolution of Heuristics (EoH) framework to investigate the automated generation of guiding heuristics for A* search. We introduce a novel domain-agnostic prompt augmentation strategy that includes the A* code into the prompt to leverage in-context learning, named Algorithmic - Contextual EoH (A-CEoH). To evaluate the effectiveness of A-CeoH, we study two problem domains: the Unit-Load Pre-Marshalling Problem (UPMP), a niche problem from warehouse logistics, and the classical sliding puzzle problem (SPP). Our computational experiments show that A-CEoH can significantly improve the quality of the generated heuristics and even outperform expert-designed heuristics.
summary_zh: 启发式函数对于诸如A*等树搜索算法的性能至关重要，其准确性和效率直接影响搜索结果。传统上，这些启发式函数是由人工精心设计的，需要大量的专业知识。大型语言模型（LLMs）和进化框架的最新进展为自动化启发式设计打开了大门。在本文中，我们扩展了启发式进化（EoH）框架，以研究A*搜索的引导启发式函数的自动化生成。我们引入了一种新颖的领域无关提示增强策略，该策略将A*代码包含在提示中，以利用上下文学习，命名为算法-上下文 EoH (A-CEoH)。为了评估A-CEoH的有效性，我们研究了两个问题领域：单元负载预编组问题（UPMP），这是一个来自仓库物流的利基问题，以及经典的滑动拼图问题（SPP）。我们的计算实验表明，A-CEoH可以显著提高生成的启发式函数的质量，甚至优于专家设计的启发式函数。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel prompt augmentation strategy, A-CEoH, that incorporates A* code into LLM prompts for automated heuristic generation, achieving results that outperform expert-designed heuristics in specific domains.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的提示增强策略A-CEoH，该策略将A*代码纳入LLM提示中，以实现启发式规则的自动生成，并在特定领域取得了优于专家设计的启发式规则的结果。

title: LLM-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term User Satisfaction in Interactive Recommendation
summary: Interactive recommender systems can dynamically adapt to user feedback, but often suffer from content homogeneity and filter bubble effects due to overfitting short-term user preferences. While recent efforts aim to improve content diversity, they predominantly operate in static or one-shot settings, neglecting the long-term evolution of user interests. Reinforcement learning provides a principled framework for optimizing long-term user satisfaction by modeling sequential decision-making processes. However, its application in recommendation is hindered by sparse, long-tailed user-item interactions and limited semantic planning capabilities. In this work, we propose LLM-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning (LERL), a novel hierarchical recommendation framework that integrates the semantic planning power of LLM with the fine-grained adaptability of RL. LERL consists of a high-level LLM-based planner that selects semantically diverse content categories, and a low-level RL policy that recommends personalized items within the selected semantic space. This hierarchical design narrows the action space, enhances planning efficiency, and mitigates overexposure to redundant content. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that LERL significantly improves long-term user satisfaction when compared with state-of-the-art baselines. The implementation of LERL is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code3-18D3/.
summary_zh: 交互式推荐系统能够动态适应用户反馈，但由于过度拟合短期用户偏好，往往遭受内容同质化和信息茧房效应的困扰。虽然近期的工作旨在提升内容多样性，但它们主要在静态或一次性场景下运行，忽略了用户兴趣的长期演变。强化学习提供了一个通过建模序列决策过程来优化长期用户满意度的原则性框架。然而，其在推荐中的应用受到稀疏、长尾的用户-物品交互以及有限的语义规划能力的阻碍。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于LLM增强的强化学习（LERL），这是一个新颖的分层推荐框架，它将LLM的语义规划能力与RL的精细适应性相结合。LERL由一个基于LLM的高层规划器和一个低层RL策略组成，前者选择语义上多样的内容类别，后者在所选语义空间内推荐个性化物品。这种分层设计缩小了行动空间，提高了规划效率，并减轻了对冗余内容的过度曝光。在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，LERL显著提高了长期用户满意度。LERL的实现代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code3-18D3/获取。
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical recommendation framework, LERL, that combines LLMs for high-level semantic planning with RL for low-level personalized item recommendation, improving long-term user satisfaction. LERL addresses the content homogeneity and filter bubble issues in interactive recommendation systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种分层推荐框架LERL，它结合了LLM进行高层次语义规划和RL进行低层次个性化项目推荐，从而提高用户的长期满意度。LERL解决了交互式推荐系统中内容同质化和过滤气泡的问题。

title: Mocap Anywhere: Towards Pairwise-Distance based Motion Capture in the Wild (for the Wild)
summary: We introduce a novel motion capture system that reconstructs full-body 3D motion using only sparse pairwise distance (PWD) measurements from body-mounted(UWB) sensors. Using time-of-flight ranging between wireless nodes, our method eliminates the need for external cameras, enabling robust operation in uncontrolled and outdoor environments. Unlike traditional optical or inertial systems, our approach is shape-invariant and resilient to environmental constraints such as lighting and magnetic interference. At the core of our system is Wild-Poser (WiP for short), a compact, real-time Transformer-based architecture that directly predicts 3D joint positions from noisy or corrupted PWD measurements, which can later be used for joint rotation reconstruction via learned methods. WiP generalizes across subjects of varying morphologies, including non-human species, without requiring individual body measurements or shape fitting. Operating in real time, WiP achieves low joint position error and demonstrates accurate 3D motion reconstruction for both human and animal subjects in-the-wild. Our empirical analysis highlights its potential for scalable, low-cost, and general purpose motion capture in real-world settings.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了一种新型的动作捕捉系统，该系统仅使用来自身体佩戴的 (UWB) 传感器的稀疏的成对距离 (PWD) 测量值来重建全身 3D 运动。通过使用无线节点之间的飞行时间测距，我们的方法无需外部摄像头，从而能够在不受控制的室外环境中稳健运行。与传统的光学或惯性系统不同，我们的方法不受形状影响，并能抵抗照明和磁干扰等环境限制。我们系统的核心是 Wild-Poser (简称 WiP) ，一个紧凑的、基于 Transformer 的实时架构，可以直接从嘈杂或损坏的 PWD 测量值中预测 3D 关节位置，这些关节位置随后可以通过学习方法用于关节旋转重建。WiP 可以推广到不同形态的个体，包括非人类物种，而无需单独的身体测量或形状拟合。WiP 实时运行，实现了低关节位置误差，并展示了人类和动物在野外环境下精确的 3D 运动重建。我们的实证分析突显了其在现实环境中进行可扩展、低成本和通用动作捕捉的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel motion capture system, WiP, using pairwise distance measurements from body-mounted sensors, enabling real-time, shape-invariant 3D motion reconstruction for humans and animals in uncontrolled environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新颖的运动捕捉系统WiP，它使用来自身体安装传感器的成对距离测量，从而能够在不受控制的环境中为人类和动物进行实时、形状不变的3D运动重建。

title: Curiosity Driven Knowledge Retrieval for Mobile Agents
summary: Mobile agents have made progress toward reliable smartphone automation, yet performance in complex applications remains limited by incomplete knowledge and weak generalization to unseen environments. We introduce a curiosity driven knowledge retrieval framework that formalizes uncertainty during execution as a curiosity score. When this score exceeds a threshold, the system retrieves external information from documentation, code repositories, and historical trajectories. Retrieved content is organized into structured AppCards, which encode functional semantics, parameter conventions, interface mappings, and interaction patterns. During execution, an enhanced agent selectively integrates relevant AppCards into its reasoning process, thereby compensating for knowledge blind spots and improving planning reliability. Evaluation on the AndroidWorld benchmark shows consistent improvements across backbones, with an average gain of six percentage points and a new state of the art success rate of 88.8\% when combined with GPT-5. Analysis indicates that AppCards are particularly effective for multi step and cross application tasks, while improvements depend on the backbone model. Case studies further confirm that AppCards reduce ambiguity, shorten exploration, and support stable execution trajectories. Task trajectories are publicly available at https://lisalsj.github.io/Droidrun-appcard/.
summary_zh: 移动代理在实现可靠的智能手机自动化方面取得了进展，但复杂应用程序中的性能仍受限于不完整的知识和对未见环境的弱泛化能力。我们引入了一种由好奇心驱动的知识检索框架，该框架将执行过程中的不确定性形式化为好奇心评分。当该评分超过阈值时，系统将从文档、代码仓库和历史轨迹中检索外部信息。检索到的内容被组织成结构化的AppCards，其中编码了功能语义、参数约定、接口映射和交互模式。在执行过程中，增强的代理选择性地将相关的AppCards整合到其推理过程中，从而弥补知识盲点并提高规划可靠性。在AndroidWorld基准测试中的评估显示，在各种骨干网络上均实现了持续改进，与GPT-5结合使用时，平均增益为六个百分点，且产生了88.8%的最新成功率。分析表明，AppCards在多步骤和跨应用程序任务中特别有效，而改进程度取决于骨干模型。案例研究进一步证实，AppCards减少了歧义、缩短了探索时间并支持稳定的执行轨迹。任务轨迹可在https://lisalsj.github.io/Droidrun-appcard/公开获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a curiosity-driven framework using external knowledge retrieval to improve mobile agent performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on the AndroidWorld benchmark by integrating retrieved knowledge into structured AppCards.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个好奇心驱动的框架，通过检索外部知识来提高移动代理的性能，并通过将检索到的知识整合到结构化的 AppCards 中，在 AndroidWorld 基准测试上实现了最先进的结果。

title: NeuroAI and Beyond
summary: Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence (AI) have made significant progress in the past few years but have only been loosely inter-connected. Based on a workshop held in August 2025, we identify current and future areas of synergism between these two fields. We focus on the subareas of embodiment, language and communication, robotics, learning in humans and machines and Neuromorphic engineering to take stock of the progress made so far, and possible promising new future avenues. Overall, we advocate for the development of NeuroAI, a type of Neuroscience-informed Artificial Intelligence that, we argue, has the potential for significantly improving the scope and efficiency of AI algorithms while simultaneously changing the way we understand biological neural computations. We include personal statements from several leading researchers on their diverse views of NeuroAI. Two Strength-Weakness-Opportunities-Threat (SWOT) analyses by researchers and trainees are appended that describe the benefits and risks offered by NeuroAI.
summary_zh: 神经科学和人工智能（AI）在过去几年中取得了显著进展，但彼此之间的联系仍然不够紧密。基于2025年8月举办的一次研讨会，我们确定了这两个领域目前和未来潜在的协同增效领域。我们重点关注具身性、语言和交流、机器人学、人类和机器中的学习以及神经形态工程等子领域，以评估迄今为止取得的进展，以及可能的有前景的新未来方向。总体而言，我们提倡发展神经人工智能（NeuroAI），这是一种受神经科学启发的智能型人工智能，我们认为它有潜力显著提高人工智能算法的范围和效率，同时改变我们理解生物神经计算的方式。我们收录了多位顶尖研究人员关于NeuroAI多样化观点的个人陈述。附录由研究人员和培训生提供的两份优势-劣势-机会-威胁（SWOT）分析，描述了NeuroAI带来的益处和风险。
tldr: This paper summarizes a workshop advocating for NeuroAI, a neuroscience-informed AI approach, highlighting potential synergies in embodiment, language, robotics, learning, and neuromorphic engineering, with perspectives and SWOT analyses from researchers.
tldr_zh: 本文总结了一场研讨会，提倡神经科学驱动的人工智能（NeuroAI）方法，强调了具身智能、语言、机器人、学习和神经形态工程等领域的潜在协同作用，并包含了研究人员的观点和SWOT分析。

title: A Unifying View of Coverage in Linear Off-Policy Evaluation
summary:
Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is a fundamental task in reinforcement learning (RL). In the classic setting of linear OPE, finite-sample guarantees often take the form $$ \textrm{Evaluation error} \le \textrm{poly}(C^π, d, 1/n,\log(1/δ)), $$ where $d$ is the dimension of the features and $C^π$ is a coverage parameter that characterizes the degree to which the visited features lie in the span of the data distribution. While such guarantees are well-understood for several popular algorithms under stronger assumptions (e.g. Bellman completeness), the understanding is lacking and fragmented in the minimal setting where only the target value function is linearly realizable in the features. Despite recent interest in tight characterizations of the statistical rate in this setting, the right notion of coverage remains unclear, and candidate definitions from prior analyses have undesirable properties and are starkly disconnected from more standard definitions in the literature.
  We provide a novel finite-sample analysis of a canonical algorithm for this setting, LSTDQ. Inspired by an instrumental-variable view, we develop error bounds that depend on a novel coverage parameter, the feature-dynamics coverage, which can be interpreted as linear coverage in an induced dynamical system for feature evolution. With further assumptions -- such as Bellman-completeness -- our definition successfully recovers the coverage parameters specialized to those settings, finally yielding a unified understanding for coverage in linear OPE.
summary_zh:
离线策略评估（OPE）是强化学习（RL）中的一项基本任务。在线性OPE的经典设置中，有限样本保证通常采用以下形式： $$ \textrm{评估误差} \le \textrm{poly}(C^π, d, 1/n,\log(1/δ)), $$ 其中$d$是特征的维度，$C^π$是一个覆盖参数，用于表征访问的特征在数据分布张成空间中的程度。虽然对于在更强的假设（例如，Bellman完备性）下的几种流行算法，这种保证已被充分理解，但在只有目标价值函数在线性可实现于特征的最小设置中，理解尚不足且分散。尽管最近对该设置中统计速率的紧致描述感兴趣，但正确的覆盖概念仍不清楚，并且先前分析中的候选定义具有不良的性质，并且与文献中更标准的定义截然不同。

我们对该设置下的一种规范算法LSTDQ提供了一种新的有限样本分析。受到工具变量观点的启发，我们开发了依赖于一种新的覆盖参数的误差界限，即特征-动态覆盖，它可以解释为特征演化的诱导动力系统中的线性覆盖。在进一步的假设（例如，Bellman完备性）下，我们的定义成功地恢复了专门针对这些设置的覆盖参数，最终为线性OPE中的覆盖问题提供了一个统一的理解。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel 'feature-dynamics coverage' parameter for linear off-policy evaluation (OPE) that unifies various existing coverage definitions and provides tighter error bounds for LSTDQ, especially in the minimal setting where only the target value function is linearly realizable.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的线性策略外评估（OPE）的“特征动态覆盖”参数，统一了现有的各种覆盖定义，并为LSTDQ提供了更严格的误差界限，尤其是在只有目标价值函数可以线性实现的最小设置中。

title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Tactical Decision Making for Trucks in Highway Traffic
summary: Balancing safety, efficiency, and operational costs in highway driving poses a challenging decision-making problem for heavy-duty vehicles. A central difficulty is that conventional scalar reward formulations, obtained by aggregating these competing objectives, often obscure the structure of their trade-offs. We present a Proximal Policy Optimization based multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that learns a continuous set of policies explicitly representing these trade-offs and evaluates it on a scalable simulation platform for tactical decision making in trucks. The proposed approach learns a continuous set of Pareto-optimal policies that capture the trade-offs among three conflicting objectives: safety, quantified in terms of collisions and successful completion; energy efficiency and time efficiency, quantified using energy cost and driver cost, respectively. The resulting Pareto frontier is smooth and interpretable, enabling flexibility in choosing driving behavior along different conflicting objectives. This framework allows seamless transitions between different driving policies without retraining, yielding a robust and adaptive decision-making strategy for autonomous trucking applications.
summary_zh: 在高速公路驾驶中，对于重型车辆而言，如何在安全性、效率和运营成本之间取得平衡构成了一个具有挑战性的决策问题。一个主要的难点在于，传统的标量奖励函数，通过聚合这些相互竞争的目标获得，常常掩盖了它们权衡取舍的结构。我们提出了一种基于近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization）的多目标强化学习框架，该框架学习一系列连续的策略，显式地表示这些权衡取舍，并在一个用于卡车战术决策的可扩展仿真平台上对其进行评估。提出的方法学习了一组连续的帕累托最优策略，这些策略捕获了三个冲突目标之间的权衡：安全性，以碰撞和成功完成度来量化；能源效率和时间效率，分别使用能源成本和驾驶员成本来量化。生成的帕累托前沿是平滑且可解释的，从而能够在不同的冲突目标之间灵活地选择驾驶行为。该框架允许在不同的驾驶策略之间无缝过渡，而无需重新训练，从而为自动驾驶卡车应用提供了一种鲁棒且自适应的决策策略。
tldr: This paper presents a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework using Proximal Policy Optimization to learn a Pareto-optimal set of policies for tactical decision making in autonomous trucks, balancing safety, efficiency, and operational costs. The method enables seamless policy transitions without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization）的多目标强化学习框架，用于学习自动驾驶卡车战术决策的帕累托最优策略集，平衡安全、效率和运营成本。该方法能够实现不同策略之间的无缝转换而无需重新训练。

title: EgoHandICL: Egocentric 3D Hand Reconstruction with In-Context Learning
summary: Robust 3D hand reconstruction in egocentric vision is challenging due to depth ambiguity, self-occlusion, and complex hand-object interactions. Prior methods mitigate these issues by scaling training data or adding auxiliary cues, but they often struggle in unseen contexts. We present EgoHandICL, the first in-context learning (ICL) framework for 3D hand reconstruction that improves semantic alignment, visual consistency, and robustness under challenging egocentric conditions. EgoHandICL introduces complementary exemplar retrieval guided by vision-language models (VLMs), an ICL-tailored tokenizer for multimodal context, and a masked autoencoder (MAE)-based architecture trained with hand-guided geometric and perceptual objectives. Experiments on ARCTIC and EgoExo4D show consistent gains over state-of-the-art methods. We also demonstrate real-world generalization and improve EgoVLM hand-object interaction reasoning by using reconstructed hands as visual prompts. Code and data: https://github.com/Nicous20/EgoHandICL
summary_zh: 在以自我为中心的视觉中，鲁棒的3D手部重建具有挑战性，原因包括深度歧义、自遮挡以及复杂的手部-物体交互。以往的方法通过缩放训练数据或添加辅助线索来缓解这些问题，但它们通常在未见过的场景中表现不佳。我们提出了EgoHandICL，这是第一个用于3D手部重建的上下文学习（ICL）框架，它在具有挑战性的以自我为中心条件下，能够改善语义对齐、视觉一致性和鲁棒性。EgoHandICL引入了由视觉-语言模型（VLMs）引导的互补的范例检索，一个为多模态上下文量身定制的ICL分词器，以及一个基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的架构，该架构采用手工指导的几何和感知目标进行训练。在ARCTIC和EgoExo4D上的实验表明，该方法相比于最先进的方法，性能得到了持续提升。我们还验证了其在真实世界中的泛化能力，并通过使用重建的手作为视觉提示，改进了EgoVLM的手部-物体交互推理能力。代码和数据：https://github.com/Nicous20/EgoHandICL
tldr: EgoHandICL introduces an in-context learning framework for robust 3D hand reconstruction in egocentric vision, leveraging VLMs and a tailored architecture for improved accuracy and generalization in challenging scenarios, demonstrating gains over SOTA methods.
tldr_zh: EgoHandICL 提出了一个用于在以自我为中心的视觉中进行鲁棒的 3D 手部重建的上下文学习框架，利用 VLM 和定制架构来提高在具有挑战性的场景中的准确性和泛化能力，并展示了相对于 SOTA 方法的优势。

title: Towards Governance-Oriented Low-Altitude Intelligence: A Management-Centric Multi-Modal Benchmark With Implicitly Coordinated Vision-Language Reasoning Framework
summary: Low-altitude vision systems are becoming a critical infrastructure for smart city governance. However, existing object-centric perception paradigms and loosely coupled vision-language pipelines are still difficult to support management-oriented anomaly understanding required in real-world urban governance. To bridge this gap, we introduce GovLA-10K, the first management-oriented multi-modal benchmark for low-altitude intelligence, along with GovLA-Reasoner, a unified vision-language reasoning framework tailored for governance-aware aerial perception. Unlike existing studies that aim to exhaustively annotate all visible objects, GovLA-10K is deliberately designed around functionally salient targets that directly correspond to practical management needs, and further provides actionable management suggestions grounded in these observations. To effectively coordinate the fine-grained visual grounding with high-level contextual language reasoning, GovLA-Reasoner introduces an efficient feature adapter that implicitly coordinates discriminative representation sharing between the visual detector and the large language model (LLM). Extensive experiments show that our method significantly improves performance while avoiding the need of fine-tuning for any task-specific individual components. We believe our work offers a new perspective and foundation for future studies on management-aware low-altitude vision-language systems.
summary_zh: 低空视觉系统正日益成为智慧城市治理的关键基础设施。然而，现有的以物体为中心的感知范式和松耦合的视觉-语言管道仍然难以支持现实城市治理所需的面向管理的异常理解。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了 GovLA-10K，这是首个面向管理的低空智能多模态基准，以及 GovLA-Reasoner，一个为治理感知空中感知定制的统一视觉-语言推理框架。与旨在穷尽式标注所有可见物体的现有研究不同，GovLA-10K 有意围绕功能上显著的目标设计，这些目标直接对应于实际的管理需求，并进一步提供基于这些观察结果的可操作的管理建议。为了有效地协调细粒度的视觉定位与高层次的上下文语言推理，GovLA-Reasoner 引入了一个高效的特征适配器，该适配器隐式地协调视觉检测器和大型语言模型（LLM）之间具有区分性的表征共享。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了性能，同时避免了对任何特定任务的个别组件进行微调的需要。我们相信我们的工作为未来面向管理的低空视觉-语言系统的研究提供了一个新的视角和基础。
tldr: The paper introduces GovLA-10K, a new management-oriented multi-modal benchmark for low-altitude intelligence, along with GovLA-Reasoner, a unified vision-language reasoning framework for governance-aware aerial perception without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GovLA-10K，这是一个新的面向管理的低空智能多模态基准，以及GovLA-Reasoner，一个用于治理感知空中感知的统一视觉-语言推理框架，无需针对特定任务进行微调。

title: TIGaussian: Disentangle Gaussians for Spatial-Awared Text-Image-3D Alignment
summary: While visual-language models have profoundly linked features between texts and images, the incorporation of 3D modality data, such as point clouds and 3D Gaussians, further enables pretraining for 3D-related tasks, e.g., cross-modal retrieval, zero-shot classification, and scene recognition. As challenges remain in extracting 3D modal features and bridging the gap between different modalities, we propose TIGaussian, a framework that harnesses 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) characteristics to strengthen cross-modality alignment through multi-branch 3DGS tokenizer and modality-specific 3D feature alignment strategies. Specifically, our multi-branch 3DGS tokenizer decouples the intrinsic properties of 3DGS structures into compact latent representations, enabling more generalizable feature extraction. To further bridge the modality gap, we develop a bidirectional cross-modal alignment strategies: a multi-view feature fusion mechanism that leverages diffusion priors to resolve perspective ambiguity in image-3D alignment, while a text-3D projection module adaptively maps 3D features to text embedding space for better text-3D alignment. Extensive experiments on various datasets demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of TIGaussian in multiple tasks.
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言模型已经深刻地连接了文本和图像的特征，但是诸如点云和3D高斯等3D模态数据的引入，进一步实现了针对3D相关任务（如跨模态检索、零样本分类和场景识别）的预训练。由于在提取3D模态特征以及弥合不同模态之间的差距方面仍然存在挑战，我们提出了TIGaussian，一个利用3D高斯溅射(3DGS)特性的框架，通过多分支3DGS令牌器和模态特定的3D特征对齐策略来加强跨模态对齐。具体来说，我们的多分支3DGS令牌器将3DGS结构的内在属性解耦为紧凑的潜在表示，从而实现更具泛化性的特征提取。为了进一步弥合模态差距，我们开发了一种双向跨模态对齐策略：一种利用扩散先验来解决图像-3D对齐中透视歧义的多视角特征融合机制，以及一个自适应地将3D特征映射到文本嵌入空间的文本-3D投影模块，以实现更好的文本-3D对齐。在各种数据集上的大量实验表明，TIGaussian在多个任务中都取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: TIGaussian enhances text-image-3D alignment by disentangling 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) features and using modality-specific alignment strategies, achieving state-of-the-art performance on various tasks.
tldr_zh: TIGaussian通过解耦3D高斯溅射（3DGS）特征并使用特定于模态的对齐策略来增强文本-图像-3D对齐，在各种任务中实现了最先进的性能。

title: On the Role of Depth in Surgical Vision Foundation Models: An Empirical Study of RGB-D Pre-training
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) have emerged as powerful tools for surgical scene understanding. However, current approaches predominantly rely on unimodal RGB pre-training, overlooking the complex 3D geometry inherent to surgical environments. Although several architectures support multimodal or geometry-aware inputs in general computer vision, the benefits of incorporating depth information in surgical settings remain underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study comparing eight ViT-based VFMs that differ in pre-training domain, learning objective, and input modality (RGB vs. RGB-D). For pre-training, we use a curated dataset of 1.4 million robotic surgical images paired with depth maps generated from an off-the-shelf network. We evaluate these models under both frozen-backbone and end-to-end fine-tuning protocols across eight surgical datasets spanning object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, and pose estimation. Our experiments yield several consistent findings. Models incorporating explicit geometric tokenization, such as MultiMAE, substantially outperform unimodal baselines across all tasks. Notably, geometric-aware pre-training enables remarkable data efficiency: models fine-tuned on just 25% of labeled data consistently surpass RGB-only models trained on the full dataset. Importantly, these gains require no architectural or runtime changes at inference; depth is used only during pre-training, making adoption straightforward. These findings suggest that multimodal pre-training offers a viable path towards building more capable surgical vision systems.
summary_zh: 视觉基础模型（VFMs）已成为理解手术场景的强大工具。然而，目前的方法主要依赖于单模态RGB预训练，忽略了手术环境中固有的复杂3D几何结构。虽然一些架构在通用计算机视觉中支持多模态或几何感知输入，但在手术环境中融入深度信息的优势仍未得到充分探索。我们进行了一项大规模的实证研究，比较了八种基于ViT的VFMs，这些模型在预训练领域、学习目标和输入模态（RGB vs. RGB-D）方面有所不同。对于预训练，我们使用了一个精心策划的包含140万张机器人手术图像的数据集，这些图像与使用现成网络生成的深度图配对。我们在八个手术数据集上，通过冻结backbone和端到端微调两种协议来评估这些模型，这些数据集涵盖了目标检测、分割、深度估计和姿态估计。我们的实验得出了一些一致的结论。包含显式几何标记化的模型，例如MultiMAE，在所有任务上都显著优于单模态基线模型。值得注意的是，几何感知预训练实现了卓越的数据效率：在仅用25%的标注数据进行微调的模型始终超越了在完整数据集上训练的仅RGB模型。重要的是，这些优势无需在推理时进行架构或运行时更改；深度仅在预训练期间使用，使得采用变得直接。这些发现表明，多模态预训练为构建更强大的手术视觉系统提供了一条可行的途径。
tldr: This paper explores the benefit of incorporating depth information during pre-training of surgical vision foundation models, demonstrating improved performance and data efficiency compared to RGB-only pre-training across various surgical tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文探讨了在手术视觉基础模型的预训练过程中加入深度信息的益处，结果表明，与仅使用RGB图像进行预训练相比，在各种手术任务中，性能和数据效率都得到了提高。

title: Component-Aware Pruning Framework for Neural Network Controllers via Gradient-Based Importance Estimation
summary: The transition from monolithic to multi-component neural architectures in advanced neural network controllers poses substantial challenges due to the high computational complexity of the latter. Conventional model compression techniques for complexity reduction, such as structured pruning based on norm-based metrics to estimate the relative importance of distinct parameter groups, often fail to capture functional significance. This paper introduces a component-aware pruning framework that utilizes gradient information to compute three distinct importance metrics during training: Gradient Accumulation, Fisher Information, and Bayesian Uncertainty. Experimental results with an autoencoder and a TD-MPC agent demonstrate that the proposed framework reveals critical structural dependencies and dynamic shifts in importance that static heuristics often miss, supporting more informed compression decisions.
summary_zh: 高级神经网络控制器中从单体神经架构向多组件神经架构的过渡，由于后者计算复杂度极高，带来了重大挑战。传统的用于降低复杂度的模型压缩技术，例如基于范数度量来估计不同参数组相对重要性的结构化剪枝，往往无法捕捉功能重要性。本文介绍了一种组件感知剪枝框架，该框架利用梯度信息在训练期间计算三个不同的重要性度量：梯度累积、费舍尔信息和贝叶斯不确定性。通过自动编码器和TD-MPC智能体的实验结果表明，所提出的框架揭示了静态启发式方法通常遗漏的关键结构依赖性和重要性的动态变化，从而支持更明智的压缩决策。
tldr: This paper introduces a component-aware pruning framework for neural network controllers that uses gradient information to improve model compression, showing benefits in autoencoders and TD-MPC agents. This framework aims to more accurately determine the importance of different parameters and components within the controller.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种组件感知的神经网络控制器剪枝框架，该框架利用梯度信息来改进模型压缩，并在自编码器和TD-MPC智能体中展示了优势。该框架旨在更准确地确定控制器中不同参数和组件的重要性。

title: Vector-Valued Distributional Reinforcement Learning Policy Evaluation: A Hilbert Space Embedding Approach
summary: We propose an (offline) multi-dimensional distributional reinforcement learning framework (KE-DRL) that leverages Hilbert space mappings to estimate the kernel mean embedding of the multi-dimensional value distribution under a proposed target policy. In our setting, the state-action variables are multi-dimensional and continuous. By mapping probability measures into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space via kernel mean embeddings, our method replaces Wasserstein metrics with an integral probability metric. This enables efficient estimation in multi-dimensional state-action spaces and reward settings, where direct computation of Wasserstein distances is computationally challenging. Theoretically, we establish contraction properties of the distributional Bellman operator under our proposed metric involving the Matern family of kernels and provide uniform convergence guarantees. Simulations and empirical results demonstrate robust off-policy evaluation and recovery of the kernel mean embedding under mild assumptions, namely, Lipschitz continuity and boundedness of the kernels, highlighting the potential of embedding-based approaches in complex real-world decision-making scenarios and risk evaluation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种（离线）多维分布强化学习框架（KE-DRL），该框架利用希尔伯特空间映射来估计提议的目标策略下多维值分布的核均值嵌入。在我们的设定中，状态-动作变量是多维且连续的。通过核均值嵌入将概率测度映射到再生核希尔伯特空间，我们的方法用积分概率度量代替了Wasserstein度量。这使得在多维状态-动作空间和奖励环境中能够进行有效的估计，而在这些环境中直接计算Wasserstein距离在计算上具有挑战性。理论上，我们建立了在包含Matern核族的我们提出的度量下，分布贝尔曼算子的收缩性质，并提供了均匀收敛保证。模拟和实验结果表明，在温和的假设下，即核的Lipschitz连续性和有界性，能够进行稳健的离策略评估并恢复核均值嵌入，突出了基于嵌入的方法在复杂的现实世界决策场景和风险评估中的潜力。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel offline multi-dimensional distributional reinforcement learning framework (KE-DRL) that uses Hilbert space mappings to estimate the value distribution, demonstrating robust off-policy evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的离线多维分布强化学习框架 (KE-DRL)，该框架利用希尔伯特空间映射来估计价值分布，展示了强大的离策略评估能力。

title: The S3LI Vulcano Dataset: A Dataset for Multi-Modal SLAM in Unstructured Planetary Environments
summary: We release the S3LI Vulcano dataset, a multi-modal dataset towards development and benchmarking of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) and place recognition algorithms that rely on visual and LiDAR modalities. Several sequences are recorded on the volcanic island of Vulcano, from the Aeolian Islands in Sicily, Italy. The sequences provide users with data from a variety of environments, textures and terrains, including basaltic or iron-rich rocks, geological formations from old lava channels, as well as dry vegetation and water. The data (rmc.dlr.de/s3li_dataset) is accompanied by an open source toolkit (github.com/DLR-RM/s3li-toolkit) providing tools for generating ground truth poses as well as preparation of labelled samples for place recognition tasks.
summary_zh: 我们发布了S3LI Vulcano数据集，这是一个多模态数据集，旨在促进依赖视觉和激光雷达模态的同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）和地点识别算法的开发与基准测试。我们于意大利西西里岛的埃奥利群岛中的火山岛武尔卡诺上记录了多个序列。 这些序列为用户提供了来自各种环境、纹理和地形的数据，包括玄武岩或富含铁的岩石、来自旧熔岩通道的地质构造，以及干燥的植被和水。数据集（rmc.dlr.de/s3li_dataset）附带一个开源工具包（github.com/DLR-RM/s3li-toolkit），该工具包提供了生成地面真值位姿以及为地点识别任务准备带标签样本的工具。
tldr: The paper introduces the S3LI Vulcano dataset, a multi-modal dataset for SLAM and place recognition in unstructured planetary environments, utilizing visual and LiDAR data collected on Vulcano island, Italy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了S3LI Vulcano数据集，这是一个用于在非结构化行星环境中进行SLAM和地点识别的多模态数据集，使用了在意大利武尔卡诺岛上收集的视觉和LiDAR数据。

title: Teaching Machine Learning Fundamentals with LEGO Robotics
summary: This paper presents the web-based platform Machine Learning with Bricks and an accompanying two-day course designed to teach machine learning concepts to students aged 12 to 17 through programming-free robotics activities. Machine Learning with Bricks is an open source platform and combines interactive visualizations with LEGO robotics to teach three core algorithms: KNN, linear regression, and Q-learning. Students learn by collecting data, training models, and interacting with robots via a web-based interface. Pre- and post-surveys with 14 students demonstrate significant improvements in conceptual understanding of machine learning algorithms, positive shifts in AI perception, high platform usability, and increased motivation for continued learning. This work demonstrates that tangible, visualization-based approaches can make machine learning concepts accessible and engaging for young learners while maintaining technical depth. The platform is freely available at https://learning-and-dynamics.github.io/ml-with-bricks/, with video tutorials guiding students through the experiments at https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLx1grFu4zAcwfKKJZ1Ux4LwRqaePCOA2J.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为“积木机器学习”的基于Web的平台，以及一个为期两天的配套课程，旨在通过免编程的机器人活动向12至17岁的学生教授机器学习概念。“积木机器学习”是一个开源平台，它将交互式可视化与乐高机器人相结合，以教授三个核心算法：KNN（K近邻算法）、线性回归和Q学习。学生通过收集数据、训练模型以及通过基于Web的界面与机器人交互来进行学习。对14名学生进行的前后问卷调查表明，学生对机器学习算法的概念理解显著提高，对人工智能的认知发生了积极转变，平台的可用性很高，并且学习的动力也增强了。这项工作表明，有形的、基于可视化的方法可以使机器学习概念对于年轻学习者来说易于理解和参与，同时保持了技术深度。该平台可在https://learning-and-dynamics.github.io/ml-with-bricks/ 上免费获取，视频教程指导学生完成实验，网址为 https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLx1grFu4zAcwfKKJZ1Ux4LwRqaePCOA2J.
tldr: This paper introduces a web-based platform called Machine Learning with Bricks using LEGO robotics to teach ML fundamentals (KNN, linear regression, Q-learning) to students aged 12-17, showing improved understanding and increased motivation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为“积木机器学习”的网页平台，该平台利用乐高机器人向12-17岁的学生教授机器学习基础知识（KNN、线性回归、Q学习），结果表明学生的理解能力有所提高，学习动力也有所增强。

title: SimTO: A simulation-based topology optimization framework for bespoke soft robotic grippers
summary: Soft robotic grippers are essential for grasping delicate, geometrically complex objects in manufacturing, healthcare and agriculture. However, existing grippers struggle to grasp feature-rich objects with high topological variability, including gears with sharp tooth profiles on automotive assembly lines, corals with fragile protrusions, or vegetables with irregular branching structures like broccoli. Unlike simple geometric primitives such as cubes or spheres, feature-rich objects lack a clear "optimal" contact surface, making them both difficult to grasp and susceptible to damage when grasped by existing gripper designs. Safe handling of such objects therefore requires specialized soft grippers whose morphology is tailored to the object's features. Topology optimization offers a promising approach for producing specialized grippers, but its utility is limited by the requirement for pre-defined load cases. For soft grippers interacting with feature-rich objects, these loads arise from hundreds of unpredictable gripper-object contact forces during grasping and are unknown a priori. To address this problem, we introduce SimTO, a framework that enables high-resolution topology optimization by automatically extracting load cases from a contact-based physics simulator, eliminating the need for manual load specification. Given an arbitrary feature-rich object, SimTO produces highly customized soft grippers with fine-grained morphological features tailored to the object geometry. Numerical results show our designs are not only highly specialized to feature-rich objects, but also generalize to unseen objects.
summary_zh: 软体机器人夹爪对于在制造、医疗保健和农业领域抓取精细且几何结构复杂的物体至关重要。然而，现有的夹爪难以抓取具有丰富特征和高度拓扑变异性的物体，包括汽车装配线上具有锋利齿廓的齿轮、具有脆弱突起的珊瑚或具有不规则分支结构的蔬菜（如西兰花）。与简单的几何图元（如立方体或球体）不同，具有丰富特征的物体缺乏明确的“最佳”接触面，这使得它们难以抓取，并且容易因现有夹爪设计而受到损坏。因此，安全处理此类物体需要专门的软体夹爪，其形态需针对物体的特征进行定制。拓扑优化为生产专用夹爪提供了一种有前景的方法，但其效用受到预先定义的载荷工况的限制。对于与具有丰富特征的物体相互作用的软体夹爪，这些载荷来自抓取过程中数百个不可预测的夹爪-物体接触力，并且是先验未知的。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 SimTO，这是一个框架，它可以通过自动从基于接触的物理模拟器中提取载荷工况来实现高分辨率的拓扑优化，从而消除了手动指定载荷的需要。给定任意具有丰富特征的物体，SimTO 能够生成高度定制的软体夹爪，其具有针对物体几何形状量身定制的精细形态特征。数值结果表明，我们的设计不仅高度专用于具有丰富特征的物体，而且还可以推广到未见过的物体。
tldr: The paper introduces SimTO, a simulation-based topology optimization framework that automatically extracts load cases from a physics simulator to design customized soft robotic grippers for grasping feature-rich objects, eliminating the need for manual load specification.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 SimTO 的基于仿真的拓扑优化框架，该框架通过物理模拟器自动提取负载案例，从而设计用于抓取富含特征物体的定制软体机器人夹爪，从而无需手动指定负载。

title: Neuromorphic BrailleNet: Accurate and Generalizable Braille Reading Beyond Single Characters through Event-Based Optical Tactile Sensing
summary: Conventional robotic Braille readers typically rely on discrete, character-by-character scanning, limiting reading speed and disrupting natural flow. Vision-based alternatives often require substantial computation, introduce latency, and degrade in real-world conditions. In this work, we present a high accuracy, real-time pipeline for continuous Braille recognition using Evetac, an open-source neuromorphic event-based tactile sensor. Unlike frame-based vision systems, the neuromorphic tactile modality directly encodes dynamic contact events during continuous sliding, closely emulating human finger-scanning strategies. Our approach combines spatiotemporal segmentation with a lightweight ResNet-based classifier to process sparse event streams, enabling robust character recognition across varying indentation depths and scanning speeds. The proposed system achieves near-perfect accuracy (>=98%) at standard depths, generalizes across multiple Braille board layouts, and maintains strong performance under fast scanning. On a physical Braille board containing daily-living vocabulary, the system attains over 90% word-level accuracy, demonstrating robustness to temporal compression effects that challenge conventional methods. These results position neuromorphic tactile sensing as a scalable, low latency solution for robotic Braille reading, with broader implications for tactile perception in assistive and robotic applications.
summary_zh: 传统机器人盲文阅读器通常依赖于离散的字符扫描，限制了阅读速度并破坏了自然的阅读流畅性。基于视觉的替代方案往往需要大量的计算，引入延迟，并且在实际环境中性能下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种高精度、实时的连续盲文识别流程，该流程使用了Evetac，一种开源的神经形态事件式触觉传感器。与基于帧的视觉系统不同，神经形态触觉模式直接编码连续滑动过程中的动态接触事件，密切地模拟了人类的手指扫描策略。我们的方法结合了时空分割和基于轻量级 ResNet 的分类器来处理稀疏事件流，从而能够在不同的凹痕深度和扫描速度下实现稳健的字符识别。所提出的系统在标准深度下达到了接近完美的准确率（>=98%），可以推广到多种盲文板布局，并在快速扫描下保持强大的性能。在一个包含日常生活词汇的物理盲文板上，该系统获得了超过 90% 的单词级准确率，表明其对挑战传统方法的时间压缩效应具有鲁棒性。这些结果表明，神经形态触觉传感是一种可扩展、低延迟的机器人盲文阅读解决方案，并对辅助和机器人应用中的触觉感知具有更广泛的意义。
tldr: This paper introduces a neuromorphic Braille reader using event-based tactile sensing, achieving high accuracy and generalization in continuous Braille recognition, offering a low-latency alternative to traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种使用基于事件的触觉传感的神经形态盲文阅读器，可在连续盲文识别中实现高精度和泛化，为传统方法提供了一种低延迟的替代方案。

title: Bridging Visual and Wireless Sensing: A Unified Radiation Field for 3D Radio Map Construction
summary: The emerging applications of next-generation wireless networks (e.g., immersive 3D communication, low-altitude networks, and integrated sensing and communication) necessitate high-fidelity environmental intelligence. 3D radio maps have emerged as a critical tool for this purpose, enabling spectrum-aware planning and environment-aware sensing by bridging the gap between physical environments and electromagnetic signal propagation. However, constructing accurate 3D radio maps requires fine-grained 3D geometric information and a profound understanding of electromagnetic wave propagation. Existing approaches typically treat optical and wireless knowledge as distinct modalities, failing to exploit the fundamental physical principles governing both light and electromagnetic propagation. To bridge this gap, we propose URF-GS, a unified radio-optical radiation field representation framework for accurate and generalizable 3D radio map construction based on 3D Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) and inverse rendering. By fusing visual and wireless sensing observations, URF-GS recovers scene geometry and material properties while accurately predicting radio signal behavior at arbitrary transmitter-receiver (Tx-Rx) configurations. Experimental results demonstrate that URF-GS achieves up to a 24.7% improvement in spatial spectrum prediction accuracy and a 10x increase in sample efficiency for 3D radio map construction compared with neural radiance field (NeRF)-based methods. This work establishes a foundation for next-generation wireless networks by integrating perception, interaction, and communication through holistic radiation field reconstruction.
summary_zh: 新一代无线网络（例如，沉浸式3D通信、低空网络和集成感知与通信）的涌现应用对高保真环境智能提出了迫切需求。3D无线电地图已成为实现此目的的关键工具，它通过弥合物理环境和电磁信号传播之间的差距，从而支持频谱感知规划和环境感知。然而，构建精确的3D无线电地图需要精细的3D几何信息以及对电磁波传播的深刻理解。现有的方法通常将光学和无线知识视为不同的模态，未能充分利用控制光和电磁传播的基本物理原理。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了URF-GS，一个统一的射频-光学辐射场表示框架，用于基于3D高斯溅射（3D-GS）和逆渲染构建精确且可泛化的3D无线电地图。通过融合视觉和无线传感观测，URF-GS恢复场景几何和材料属性，同时准确预测任意收发机（Tx-Rx）配置下的无线电信号行为。实验结果表明，与基于神经辐射场（NeRF）的方法相比，URF-GS在空间频谱预测精度方面提高了高达24.7%，在3D无线电地图构建的样本效率方面提高了10倍。这项工作通过整体辐射场重建集成感知、交互和通信，为下一代无线网络奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper presents URF-GS, a unified framework using 3D Gaussian splatting and inverse rendering to construct accurate 3D radio maps by fusing visual and wireless sensing, achieving better accuracy and sample efficiency than NeRF-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种统一的框架URF-GS，该框架使用3D高斯溅射和逆渲染，通过融合视觉和无线传感来构建精确的3D无线电地图，与基于NeRF的方法相比，实现了更高的精度和样本效率。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Technology
summary: Many challenges arising in Quantum Technology can be successfully addressed using a set of machine learning algorithms collectively known as reinforcement learning (RL), based on adaptive decision-making through interaction with the quantum device. After a concise and intuitive introduction to RL aimed at a broad physics readership, we discuss the key ideas and core concepts in reinforcement learning with a particular focus on quantum systems. We then survey recent progress in RL in all relevant areas. We discuss state preparation in few- and many-body quantum systems, the design and optimization of high-fidelity quantum gates, and the automated construction of quantum circuits, including applications to variational quantum eigensolvers and architecture search. We further highlight the interactive capabilities of RL agents, emphasizing recent progress in quantum feedback control and quantum error correction, and briefly discuss quantum reinforcement learning as well as applications to quantum metrology. The review concludes with a discussion of open challenges -- such as scalability, interpretability, and integration with experimental platforms -- and outlines promising directions for future research. Throughout, we highlight experimental implementations that exemplify the increasing role of reinforcement learning in shaping the development of quantum technologies.
summary_zh:
摘要：
量子技术中出现的许多挑战可以通过一组机器学习算法成功解决，这些算法统称为强化学习（RL），其基于通过与量子设备的交互进行自适应决策。在针对广大物理学读者对强化学习进行简明而直观的介绍后，我们讨论了强化学习的关键思想和核心概念，并特别关注量子系统。然后，我们综述了强化学习在所有相关领域的最新进展。我们讨论了少体和多体量子系统中的态制备，高保真量子门的设计和优化，以及量子电路的自动构建，包括在变分量子本征求解器和架构搜索中的应用。我们进一步强调了强化学习代理的交互能力，重点介绍了量子反馈控制和量子纠错方面的最新进展，并简要讨论了量子强化学习以及在量子计量学中的应用。该综述最后讨论了开放性挑战——例如可扩展性、可解释性以及与实验平台的集成——并概述了未来研究的有希望的方向。贯穿全文，我们强调了实验实现，这些实现例证了强化学习在塑造量子技术发展中的日益重要的作用。
tldr: This paper reviews recent progress of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Quantum Technology, covering state preparation, gate design, circuit construction, feedback control, error correction, and metrology while also outlining open challenges and future research directions.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了强化学习（RL）在量子技术中的最新进展，涵盖量子态制备、量子门设计、量子电路构建、反馈控制、纠错和计量等方面，同时也概述了开放性挑战和未来的研究方向。

title: MaDiS: Taming Masked Diffusion Language Models for Sign Language Generation
summary: Sign language generation (SLG) aims to translate written texts into expressive sign motions, bridging communication barriers for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing communities. Recent studies formulate SLG within the language modeling framework using autoregressive language models, which suffer from unidirectional context modeling and slow token-by-token inference. To address these limitations, we present MaDiS, a masked-diffusion-based language model for SLG that captures bidirectional dependencies and supports efficient parallel multi-token generation. We further introduce a tri-level cross-modal pretraining scheme that jointly learns from token-, latent-, and 3D physical-space objectives, leading to richer and more grounded sign representations. To accelerate model convergence in the fine-tuning stage, we design a novel unmasking strategy with temporal checkpoints, reducing the combinatorial complexity of unmasking orders by over $10^{41}$ times. In addition, a mixture-of-parts embedding layer is developed to effectively fuse information stored in different part-wise sign tokens through learnable gates and well-optimized codebooks. Extensive experiments on CSL-Daily, Phoenix-2014T, and How2Sign demonstrate that MaDiS achieves superior performance across multiple metrics, including DTW error and two newly introduced metrics, SiBLEU and SiCLIP, while reducing inference latency by nearly 30%. Code and models will be released on our project page.
summary_zh: 手语生成（SLG）旨在将书面文本翻译成富有表现力的手语动作，从而为聋人和重听人群架起沟通的桥梁。最近的研究采用自回归语言模型，在语言建模框架内构建SLG，但这种方法存在单向上下文建模和逐个token推断速度慢的问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了MaDiS，一种基于掩码扩散的SLG语言模型，它可以捕获双向依赖关系并支持高效的并行多token生成。我们进一步引入了一种三级跨模态预训练方案，该方案联合学习token级、潜在级和3D物理空间目标，从而产生更丰富、更具依据的手语表征。为了加速微调阶段的模型收敛，我们设计了一种新颖的带有时间检查点的解掩码策略，将解掩码顺序的组合复杂度降低了超过$10^{41}$倍。此外，我们开发了一种混合部件嵌入层，通过可学习的门控和经过良好优化的码本，有效地融合存储在不同部分手语token中的信息。在CSL-Daily、Phoenix-2014T和How2Sign上的大量实验表明，MaDiS在多个指标（包括DTW误差和两个新引入的指标SiBLEU和SiCLIP）上均实现了卓越的性能，同时将推理延迟降低了近30%。代码和模型将在我们的项目页面上发布。
tldr: The paper introduces MaDiS, a masked-diffusion-based language model for sign language generation, which addresses limitations of autoregressive models through bidirectional context modeling, parallel generation, and a novel pretraining scheme. It achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved inference speed.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于手语生成的新型模型 MaDiS，它基于掩码扩散语言模型，通过双向上下文建模、并行生成和一种新颖的预训练方案，克服了自回归模型的局限性。它实现了最先进的性能，并提高了推理速度。

title: SEAFormer: A Spatial Proximity and Edge-Aware Transformer for Real-World Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: Real-world Vehicle Routing Problems (RWVRPs) require solving complex, sequence-dependent challenges at scale with constraints such as delivery time window, replenishment or recharging stops, asymmetric travel cost, etc. While recent neural methods achieve strong results on large-scale classical VRP benchmarks, they struggle to address RWVRPs because their strategies overlook sequence dependencies and underutilize edge-level information, which are precisely the characteristics that define the complexity of RWVRPs. We present SEAFormer, a novel transformer that incorporates both node-level and edge-level information in decision-making through two key innovations. First, our Clustered Proximity Attention (CPA) exploits locality-aware clustering to reduce the complexity of attention from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ while preserving global perspective, allowing SEAFormer to efficiently train on large instances. Second, our lightweight edge-aware module captures pairwise features through residual fusion, enabling effective incorporation of edge-based information and faster convergence. Extensive experiments across four RWVRP variants with various scales demonstrate that SEAFormer achieves superior results over state-of-the-art methods. Notably, SEAFormer is the first neural method to solve 1,000+ node RWVRPs effectively, while also achieving superior performance on classic VRPs, making it a versatile solution for both research benchmarks and real-world applications.
summary_zh: 现实世界车辆路径问题（RWVRPs）需要在大规模场景下解决复杂的、序列相关的挑战，并具有诸如交付时间窗口、补货或充电站点、非对称旅行成本等约束。尽管最近的神经方法在大型经典VRP基准测试中取得了优异的成果，但它们难以解决RWVRPs，因为它们的策略忽略了序列依赖性并低估了边级别信息的作用，而这些因素恰恰定义了RWVRPs的复杂性。我们提出了SEAFormer，一种新型transformer，通过两个关键创新将节点级别和边级别信息纳入决策过程中。首先，我们的聚类邻近注意力（CPA）利用局部感知的聚类将注意力机制的复杂度从$O(n^2)$降低到$O(n)$，同时保留了全局视角，使SEAFormer能够高效地训练大型实例。其次，我们的轻量级边感知模块通过残差融合捕获成对特征，从而能够有效地整合基于边的信息并加速收敛。在具有不同规模的四种RWVRP变体上进行的大量实验表明，SEAFormer优于最先进的方法。值得注意的是，SEAFormer是第一个有效解决1000+节点RWVRPs的神经方法，同时在经典VRP上也有着卓越的表现，使其成为研究基准和实际应用的通用解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces SEAFormer, a novel transformer architecture for solving real-world vehicle routing problems (RWVRPs). It uses clustered proximity attention and an edge-aware module to efficiently handle large-scale instances and complex constraints, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SEAFormer，一种用于解决真实世界车辆路径问题（RWVRPs）的新型Transformer架构。它使用聚类近邻注意力机制和边缘感知模块，高效地处理大规模实例和复杂约束，并取得了最先进的结果。

title: CHEHAB RL: Learning to Optimize Fully Homomorphic Encryption Computations
summary: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computations directly on encrypted data, but its high computational cost remains a significant barrier. Writing efficient FHE code is a complex task requiring cryptographic expertise, and finding the optimal sequence of program transformations is often intractable. In this paper, we propose CHEHAB RL, a novel framework that leverages deep reinforcement learning (RL) to automate FHE code optimization. Instead of relying on predefined heuristics or combinatorial search, our method trains an RL agent to learn an effective policy for applying a sequence of rewriting rules to automatically vectorize scalar FHE code while reducing instruction latency and noise growth. The proposed approach supports the optimization of both structured and unstructured code. To train the agent, we synthesize a diverse dataset of computations using a large language model (LLM). We integrate our proposed approach into the CHEHAB FHE compiler and evaluate it on a suite of benchmarks, comparing its performance against Coyote, a state-of-the-art vectorizing FHE compiler. The results show that our approach generates code that is $5.3\times$ faster in execution, accumulates $2.54\times$ less noise, while the compilation process itself is $27.9\times$ faster than Coyote (geometric means).
summary_zh: 全同态加密(FHE)支持直接在加密数据上进行计算，但其高昂的计算成本仍然是一个显著的障碍。编写高效的FHE代码是一项复杂的任务，需要密码学专业知识，并且找到最优的程序转换序列通常是难以处理的。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为CHEHAB RL的新型框架，该框架利用深度强化学习(RL)来自动化FHE代码优化。我们的方法不是依赖于预定义的启发式方法或组合搜索，而是训练一个RL代理来学习一种有效的策略，以应用一系列重写规则来自动向量化标量FHE代码，同时减少指令延迟和噪声增长。所提出的方法支持结构化和非结构化代码的优化。为了训练该代理，我们使用大型语言模型(LLM)合成了一个多样化的计算数据集。我们将提出的方法集成到CHEHAB FHE编译器中，并在一组基准测试上对其进行评估，将其性能与最先进的向量化FHE编译器Coyote进行比较。结果表明，我们的方法生成的代码执行速度快$5.3\times$，累积的噪声少$2.54\times$，而编译过程本身比Coyote快$27.9\times$（几何平均值）。
tldr: This paper introduces CHEHAB RL, a deep reinforcement learning framework for optimizing Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) code, achieving significant speedups and noise reduction compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了CHEHAB RL，一个用于优化全同态加密（FHE）代码的深度强化学习框架，与最先进的方法相比，实现了显著的加速和噪音降低。

title: Model-Free Output Feedback Stabilization via Policy Gradient Methods
summary: Stabilizing a dynamical system is a fundamental problem that serves as a cornerstone for many complex tasks in the field of control systems. The problem becomes challenging when the system model is unknown. Among the Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms that have been successfully applied to solve problems pertaining to unknown linear dynamical systems, the policy gradient (PG) method stands out due to its ease of implementation and can solve the problem in a model-free manner. However, most of the existing works on PG methods for unknown linear dynamical systems assume full-state feedback. In this paper, we take a step towards model-free learning for partially observable linear dynamical systems with output feedback and focus on the fundamental stabilization problem of the system. We propose an algorithmic framework that stretches the boundary of PG methods to the problem without global convergence guarantees. We show that by leveraging zeroth-order PG update based on system trajectories and its convergence to stationary points, the proposed algorithms return a stabilizing output feedback policy for discrete-time linear dynamical systems. We also explicitly characterize the sample complexity of our algorithm and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm using numerical examples.
summary_zh: 稳定一个动力系统是控制系统领域中的一个基本问题，也是许多复杂任务的基石。当系统模型未知时，问题变得具有挑战性。在已成功应用于解决与未知线性动力系统相关问题的强化学习（RL）算法中，策略梯度（PG）方法因其易于实现且能以无模型方式解决问题而脱颖而出。然而，大多数关于未知线性动力系统PG方法的现有工作都假设完全状态反馈。在本文中，我们朝着具有输出反馈的部分可观测线性动力系统的无模型学习迈出一步，并专注于系统的基本稳定问题。我们提出了一种算法框架，将PG方法的边界扩展到该问题，但没有全局收敛保证。我们证明，通过利用基于系统轨迹的零阶PG更新及其到驻点的收敛性，所提出的算法为离散时间线性动力系统返回一个稳定的输出反馈策略。我们还明确地刻画了我们算法的样本复杂度，并通过数值例子验证了算法的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a policy gradient method for stabilizing partially observable linear dynamical systems with output feedback in a model-free manner, providing sample complexity analysis and numerical verification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种策略梯度方法，用于以无模型的方式稳定具有输出反馈的部分可观测线性动力系统，并提供了样本复杂度分析和数值验证。

title: SCOPE: Smooth Convex Optimization for Planned Evolution of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: We present SCOPE, a fast and efficient framework for modeling and manipulating deformable linear objects (DLOs). Unlike conventional energy-based approaches, SCOPE leverages convex approximations to significantly reduce computational cost while maintaining smooth and physically plausible deformations. This trade-off between speed and accuracy makes the method particularly suitable for applications requiring real-time or near-real-time response. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through comprehensive simulation experiments, highlighting its ability to generate smooth shape trajectories under geometric and length constraints.
summary_zh: 我们提出了SCOPE，一个快速高效的框架，用于建模和操作可变形线性物体（DLOs）。与传统的基于能量的方法不同，SCOPE利用凸近似来显著降低计算成本，同时保持平滑且物理上合理的形变。速度和精度之间的这种权衡使得该方法特别适用于需要实时或近实时响应的应用。通过全面的仿真实验证明了所提出框架的有效性，突显了其在几何和长度约束下生成平滑形状轨迹的能力。
tldr: The paper introduces SCOPE, a computationally efficient convex optimization framework for simulating and manipulating deformable linear objects in real-time, achieving a trade-off between speed and physical accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种高效的凸优化框架SCOPE，用于实时仿真和操作可变形线性物体，实现了速度和物理精度之间的平衡。

title: Enhancing Worker Safety in Harbors Using Quadruped Robots
summary: Infrastructure inspection is becoming increasingly relevant in the field of robotics due to its significant impact on ensuring workers' safety. The harbor environment presents various challenges in designing a robotic solution for inspection, given the complexity of daily operations. This work introduces an initial phase to identify critical areas within the port environment. Following this, a preliminary solution using a quadruped robot for inspecting these critical areas is analyzed.
summary_zh: 基础设施巡检在机器人领域变得日益重要，因为它对确保工人安全具有重大影响。鉴于日常运营的复杂性，港口环境为设计用于巡检的机器人解决方案带来了各种挑战。本研究介绍了识别港口环境中关键区域的初始阶段。在此基础上，分析了使用四足机器人巡检这些关键区域的初步解决方案。
tldr: This paper explores using a quadruped robot to inspect critical areas in harbors to enhance worker safety. It presents an initial phase focused on identifying these critical areas and a preliminary robotic solution.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用四足机器人检查港口关键区域以提高工人安全性的问题。它提出了一个初始阶段，专注于识别这些关键区域，并提出了初步的机器人解决方案。

title: Enhancing Inverse Perspective Mapping for Automatic Vectorized Road Map Generation
summary: In this study, we present a low-cost and unified framework for vectorized road mapping leveraging enhanced inverse perspective mapping (IPM). In this framework, Catmull-Rom splines are utilized to characterize lane lines, and all the other ground markings are depicted using polygons uniformly. The results from instance segmentation serve as references to refine the three-dimensional position of spline control points and polygon corner points. In conjunction with this process, the homography matrix of IPM and vehicle poses are optimized simultaneously. Our proposed framework significantly reduces the mapping errors associated with IPM. It also improves the accuracy of the initial IPM homography matrix and the predicted vehicle poses. Furthermore, it addresses the limitations imposed by the coplanarity assumption in IPM. These enhancements enable IPM to be effectively applied to vectorized road mapping, which serves a cost-effective solution with enhanced accuracy. In addition, our framework generalizes road map elements to include all common ground markings and lane lines. The proposed framework is evaluated in two different practical scenarios, and the test results show that our method can automatically generate high-precision maps with near-centimeter-level accuracy. Importantly, the optimized IPM matrix achieves an accuracy comparable to that of manual calibration, while the accuracy of vehicle poses is also significantly improved.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种低成本且统一的矢量化道路地图构建框架，该框架利用了增强型逆透视变换 (IPM)。在该框架中，Catmull-Rom样条被用于表征车道线，而所有其他地面标记都使用多边形统一描绘。实例分割的结果作为参考，用于精细化样条控制点和多边形角点的三维位置。与此过程相结合，IPM的单应性矩阵和车辆位姿会被同时优化。我们提出的框架显著降低了与IPM相关的地图构建误差，并提高了初始IPM单应性矩阵和预测车辆位姿的准确性。此外，它还解决了IPM中共面性假设带来的局限性。这些增强功能使得IPM能够有效地应用于矢量化道路地图构建，从而提供了一种具有增强精度的低成本解决方案。此外，我们的框架可以将道路地图元素推广到包括所有常见的地面标记和车道线。所提出的框架在两种不同的实际场景中进行了评估，测试结果表明我们的方法可以自动生成具有接近厘米级精度的高精度地图。重要的是，优化后的IPM矩阵实现了与手动校准相当的精度，同时车辆位姿的精度也得到了显著提高。
