tldr: This paper presents a cost-effective framework for automatic vectorized road map generation using enhanced inverse perspective mapping (IPM), achieving near-centimeter-level accuracy and addressing limitations of traditional IPM.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种低成本的自动矢量化道路地图生成框架，该框架使用增强的逆透视映射（IPM），实现了近厘米级的精度，并解决了传统IPM的局限性。

title: Rhombot: Rhombus-shaped Modular Robots for Stable, Medium-Independent Reconfiguration Motion
summary: In this paper, we present Rhombot, a novel deformable planar lattice modular self-reconfigurable robot (MSRR) with a rhombus shaped module. Each module consists of a parallelogram skeleton with a single centrally mounted actuator that enables folding and unfolding along its diagonal. The core design philosophy is to achieve essential MSRR functionalities such as morphing, docking, and locomotion with minimal control complexity. This enables a continuous and stable reconfiguration process that is independent of the surrounding medium, allowing the system to reliably form various configurations in diverse environments. To leverage the unique kinematics of Rhombot, we introduce morphpivoting, a novel motion primitive for reconfiguration that differs from advanced MSRR systems, and propose a strategy for its continuous execution. Finally, a series of physical experiments validate the module's stable reconfiguration ability, as well as its positional and docking accuracy.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 Rhombot 的新型可变形平面晶格模块化自重构机器人（MSRR），其模块呈菱形。每个模块由一个平行四边形骨架和一个中央安装的致动器组成，该致动器能够沿其对角线进行折叠和展开。 该核心设计理念在于以最小的控制复杂度实现 MSRR 的基本功能，如变形、对接和运动。 这使得能够进行连续且稳定的重构过程，且该过程独立于周围介质，从而使系统能够在不同环境中可靠地形成各种配置。 为了利用 Rhombot 的独特运动学特性，我们引入了 morphpivoting，这是一种不同于高级 MSRR 系统的用于重构的新型运动基元，并提出了其连续执行的策略。 最后，一系列物理实验验证了模块的稳定重构能力以及其位置和对接精度。
tldr: The paper introduces Rhombot, a rhombus-shaped modular robot designed for stable reconfiguration in various environments through a novel motion primitive called morphpivoting, validated by physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型菱形模块化机器人 Rhombot，其设计目标是在各种环境中实现稳定的重构。该机器人采用了一种名为 morphpivoting 的新型运动原语，并通过物理实验验证了其性能。

title: Self-Reconfiguration Planning for Deformable Quadrilateral Modular Robots
summary: For lattice modular self-reconfigurable robots (MSRRs), maintaining stable connections during reconfiguration is crucial for physical feasibility and deployability. This letter presents a novel self-reconfiguration planning algorithm for deformable quadrilateral MSRRs that guarantees stable connection. The method first constructs feasible connect/disconnect actions using a virtual graph representation, and then organizes these actions into a valid execution sequence through a Dependence-based Reverse Tree (DRTree) that resolves interdependencies. We also prove that reconfiguration sequences satisfying motion characteristics exist for any pair of configurations with seven or more modules (excluding linear topologies). Finally, comparisons with a modified BiRRT algorithm highlight the superior efficiency and stability of our approach, while deployment on a physical robotic platform confirms its practical feasibility.
summary_zh: 对于晶格模块化自重构机器人（MSRR），在重构期间维持稳定的连接对于物理可行性和可部署性至关重要。本文提出了一种新型的变形四边形MSRR自重构规划算法，该算法保证了稳定的连接。该方法首先使用虚拟图表示构建可行的连接/断开动作，然后通过基于依赖性的反向树（DRTree）将这些动作组织成有效的执行序列，从而解决相互依赖性。我们还证明，对于任何具有七个或更多模块的配置（不包括线性拓扑结构），都存在满足运动特性的重构序列。最后，与改进的BiRRT算法的比较突出了我们方法的卓越效率和稳定性，而在物理机器人平台上的部署证实了其在实践中的可行性。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel self-reconfiguration planning algorithm for deformable quadrilateral modular robots, ensuring stable connections during reconfiguration. They demonstrate efficiency and practical feasibility compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于可变形四边形模块化机器人的新型自重构规划算法，该算法确保重构过程中连接的稳定性。与现有方法相比，该算法展示了效率和实际可行性。

title: Physical Human-Robot Interaction: A Critical Review of Safety Constraints
summary: This paper aims to provide a clear and rigorous understanding of commonly recognized safety constraints in physical human-robot interaction, i.e. ISO/TS 15066, by examining how they are obtained and which assumptions support them. We clarify the interpretation and practical impact of key simplifying assumptions, show how these modeling choices affect both safety and performance across the system, and indicate specific design parameters that can be adjusted in safety-critical control implementations. Numerical examples are provided to quantify performance degradation induced by common approximations and simplifying design choices. Furthermore, the fundamental role of energy in safety assessment is emphasized, and focused insights are offered on the existing body of work concerning energy-based safety methodologies.
summary_zh: 本文旨在通过考察物理人机交互中公认的安全约束（即 ISO/TS 15066）的获取方式及其背后的假设，对其进行清晰而严谨的理解。我们阐明了关键简化假设的解释和实际影响，展示了这些建模选择如何影响整个系统的安全性和性能，并指出了可以在安全关键控制实现中调整的特定设计参数。通过数值算例，我们量化了常见近似和简化设计选择所导致的性能退化。此外，本文还强调了能量在安全评估中的根本作用，并对现有基于能量的安全方法论研究成果提供了深入见解。
tldr: This paper reviews safety constraints in physical human-robot interaction (pHRI), particularly ISO/TS 15066, analyzing the underlying assumptions and their impact on both safety and performance, highlighting the role of energy-based safety methodologies.
tldr_zh: 本文回顾了人机物理交互（pHRI）中的安全约束，特别是ISO/TS 15066，分析了其基本假设及其对安全和性能的影响，并强调了基于能量的安全方法的作用。

title: Towards Gold-Standard Depth Estimation for Tree Branches in UAV Forestry: Benchmarking Deep Stereo Matching Methods
summary: Autonomous UAV forestry operations require robust depth estimation with strong cross-domain generalization, yet existing evaluations focus on urban and indoor scenarios, leaving a critical gap for vegetation-dense environments. We present the first systematic zero-shot evaluation of eight stereo methods spanning iterative refinement, foundation model, diffusion-based, and 3D CNN paradigms. All methods use officially released pretrained weights (trained on Scene Flow) and are evaluated on four standard benchmarks (ETH3D, KITTI 2012/2015, Middlebury) plus a novel 5,313-pair Canterbury Tree Branches dataset ($1920 \times 1080$). Results reveal scene-dependent patterns: foundation models excel on structured scenes (BridgeDepth: 0.23 px on ETH3D; DEFOM: 4.65 px on Middlebury), while iterative methods show variable cross-benchmark performance (IGEV++: 0.36 px on ETH3D but 6.77 px on Middlebury; IGEV: 0.33 px on ETH3D but 4.99 px on Middlebury). Qualitative evaluation on the Tree Branches dataset establishes DEFOM as the gold-standard baseline for vegetation depth estimation, with superior cross-domain consistency (consistently ranking 1st-2nd across benchmarks, average rank 1.75). DEFOM predictions will serve as pseudo-ground-truth for future benchmarking.
summary_zh: 自主无人机林业作业需要具有强大跨域泛化能力的鲁棒深度估计，然而，现有评估侧重于城市和室内场景，导致植被密集环境存在关键缺口。我们首次对八种涵盖迭代优化、基础模型、基于扩散和3D CNN范式的立体视觉方法进行了系统性的零样本评估。所有方法均使用官方发布的预训练权重（在Scene Flow上训练），并在四个标准基准（ETH3D、KITTI 2012/2015、Middlebury）以及一个包含5,313对图像的新型坎特伯雷树枝数据集（$1920 \times 1080$）上进行了评估。结果揭示了场景相关的模式：基础模型在结构化场景中表现出色（BridgeDepth：ETH3D上为0.23像素；DEFOM：Middlebury上为4.65像素），而迭代方法表现出不同的跨基准性能（IGEV++：ETH3D上为0.36像素，但在Middlebury上为6.77像素；IGEV：ETH3D上为0.33像素，但在Middlebury上为4.99像素）。在树枝数据集上的定性评估确立了DEFOM作为植被深度估计的金标准基线，具有卓越的跨域一致性（在基准测试中始终排名第1-2位，平均排名1.75）。DEFOM预测将作为未来基准测试的伪真值。
tldr: This paper presents a zero-shot evaluation of eight stereo depth estimation methods on standard benchmarks and a novel tree branches dataset, identifying DEFOM as a potential gold standard for vegetation depth estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文对八种立体深度估计方法进行了零样本评估，评估使用了标准基准数据集和一个新的树枝数据集，并将DEFOM确定为植被深度估计的潜在黄金标准。

title: Judgelight: Trajectory-Level Post-Optimization for Multi-Agent Path Finding via Closed-Subwalk Collapsing
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is an NP-hard problem with applications in warehouse automation and multi-robot coordination. Learning-based MAPF solvers offer fast and scalable planning but often produce feasible trajectories that contain unnecessary or oscillatory movements. We propose Judgelight, a post-optimization layer that improves trajectory quality after a MAPF solver generates a feasible schedule. Judgelight collapses closed subwalks in agents' trajectories to remove redundant movements while preserving all feasibility constraints. We formalize this process as MAPF-Collapse, prove that it is NP-hard, and present an exact optimization approach by formulating it as integer linear programming (ILP) problem. Experimental results show Judgelight consistently reduces solution cost by around 20%, particularly for learning-based solvers, producing trajectories that are better suited for real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是一个 NP 难问题，在仓库自动化和多机器人协同领域有着广泛的应用。基于学习的 MAPF 求解器能够提供快速且可扩展的规划方案，但通常会产生包含不必要或振荡运动的可行轨迹。我们提出 Judgelight，一个后优化层，能够在 MAPF 求解器生成可行调度后提高轨迹质量。Judgelight 通过坍缩智能体轨迹中的闭合子路径来移除冗余运动，同时保留所有可行性约束。我们将该过程形式化为 MAPF-Collapse 问题，证明它是 NP 难的，并通过将其形式化为整数线性规划（ILP）问题来提出一种精确的优化方法。实验结果表明，Judgelight 能够稳定地降低约 20% 的解决方案成本，尤其对于基于学习的求解器，从而产生更适合实际部署的轨迹。
tldr: The paper introduces Judgelight, a post-optimization layer for MAPF that removes redundant movements by collapsing closed subwalks, improving trajectory quality for learning-based MAPF solvers.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Judgelight，一个用于多智能体路径规划的后优化层，通过塌陷闭合子路径来消除冗余运动，从而提高基于学习的MAPF求解器的轨迹质量。

title: Agree to Disagree: Consensus-Free Flocking under Constraints
summary: Robots sometimes have to work together with a mixture of partially-aligned or conflicting goals. Flocking - coordinated motion through cohesion, alignment, and separation - traditionally assumes uniform desired inter-agent distances. Many practical applications demand greater flexibility, as the diversity of types and configurations grows with the popularity of multi-agent systems in society. Moreover, agents often operate without guarantees of trust or secure communication. Motivated by these challenges we update well-established frameworks by relaxing this assumption of shared inter-agent distances and constraints. Through a new form of constrained collective potential function, we introduce a solution that permits negotiation of these parameters. In the spirit of the traditional flocking control canon, this negotiation is achieved purely through local observations and does not require any global information or inter-agent communication. The approach is robust to semi-trust scenarios, where neighbouring agents pursue conflicting goals. We validate the effectiveness of the approach through a series of simulations.
summary_zh: 机器人有时需要协同工作，这些工作可能包含部分一致或冲突的目标。群集行为——通过凝聚、对齐和分离实现的协同运动——传统上假定一致的期望个体间距离。随着多智能体系统在社会中的普及，类型和配置的多样性日益增长，许多实际应用需要更高的灵活性。此外，智能体通常在缺乏信任或安全通信保障的情况下运行。受到这些挑战的驱动，我们通过放宽共享个体间距离和约束的假设，更新了已有的成熟框架。通过一种新的约束集体势函数形式，我们引入了一个允许协商这些参数的解决方案。秉承传统群集控制的思想，这种协商纯粹通过局部观察实现，不需要任何全局信息或智能体间通信。该方法对半信任场景具有鲁棒性，在这些场景中邻近智能体追求着冲突的目标。我们通过一系列仿真验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces a new flocking control method that allows agents with differing desired inter-agent distances to coordinate movement using only local observations, without communication or global information.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的集群控制方法，允许具有不同期望的agent间距离的agent仅使用本地观察来协调运动，无需通信或全局信息。

title: HumanoidTurk: Expanding VR Haptics with Humanoids for Driving Simulations
summary: We explore how humanoid robots can be repurposed as haptic media, extending beyond their conventional role as social, assistive, collaborative agents. To illustrate this approach, we implemented HumanoidTurk, taking a first step toward a humanoid-based haptic system that translates in-game g-force signals into synchronized motion feedback in VR driving. A pilot study involving six participants compared two synthesis methods, leading us to adopt a filter-based approach for smoother and more realistic feedback. A subsequent study with sixteen participants evaluated four conditions: no-feedback, controller, humanoid+controller, and human+controller. Results showed that humanoid feedback enhanced immersion, realism, and enjoyment, while introducing moderate costs in terms of comfort and simulation sickness. Interviews further highlighted the robot's consistency and predictability in contrast to the adaptability of human feedback. From these findings, we identify fidelity, adaptability, and versatility as emerging themes, positioning humanoids as a distinct haptic modality for immersive VR.
summary_zh: 我们探索如何重新定义人形机器人的用途，使其作为触觉媒介超越其作为社交、辅助、协作代理的传统角色。为了说明这种方法，我们实现了HumanoidTurk，朝着基于人形机器人的触觉系统迈出了第一步，该系统将游戏中的重力信号转化为VR驾驶中的同步运动反馈。一项包含六名参与者的初步研究比较了两种合成方法，从而使我们采用基于滤波的方法，以获得更平滑、更真实的反馈。随后的研究涉及十六名参与者，评估了四种情况：无反馈、控制器、人形机器人+控制器和人类+控制器。结果表明，人形机器人反馈增强了沉浸感、真实感和乐趣，同时也引入了舒适度和模拟晕动症方面的适度代价。访谈进一步突出了机器人的一致性和可预测性，与人类反馈的适应性形成对比。从这些发现中，我们确定了保真度、适应性和多功能性作为新兴主题，将人形机器人定位为沉浸式VR的一种独特的触觉方式。
tldr: The paper introduces HumanoidTurk, a system repurposing humanoid robots as haptic feedback devices in VR driving simulations, demonstrating enhanced immersion and realism compared to controller-based feedback.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了HumanoidTurk，一个将人形机器人重新用作VR驾驶模拟中触觉反馈设备的系统，与基于控制器的反馈相比，该系统展示了增强的沉浸感和真实感。

title: Cross-Session Decoding of Neural Spiking Data via Task-Conditioned Latent Alignment
summary: Cross-session nonstationarity in neural activity recorded by implanted electrodes is a major challenge for invasive Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), as decoders trained on data from one session often fail to generalize to subsequent sessions. This issue is further exacerbated in practice, as retraining or adapting decoders becomes particularly challenging when only limited data are available from a new session. To address this challenge, we propose a Task-Conditioned Latent Alignment framework (TCLA) for cross-session neural decoding. Building upon an autoencoder architecture, TCLA first learns a low-dimensional representation of neural dynamics from a source session with sufficient data. For target sessions with limited data, TCLA then aligns target latent representations to the source in a task-conditioned manner, enabling effective transfer of learned neural dynamics. We evaluate TCLA on the macaque motor and oculomotor center-out dataset. Compared to baseline methods trained solely on target-session data, TCLA consistently improves decoding performance across datasets and decoding settings, with gains in the coefficient of determination of up to 0.386 for y coordinate velocity decoding in a motor dataset. These results suggest that TCLA provides an effective strategy for transferring knowledge from source to target sessions, enabling more robust neural decoding under conditions with limited data.
summary_zh: 植入电极记录的神经活动中的跨会话非平稳性是侵入式脑机接口 (BCI) 的主要挑战，因为在一次会话数据上训练的解码器通常无法推广到后续会话。在实践中，这个问题会进一步恶化，因为当只能从新会话获取有限数据时，重新训练或调整解码器会变得特别困难。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于跨会话神经解码的任务条件潜在对齐框架 (TCLA)。TCLA 基于自编码器架构，首先从具有足够数据的源会话中学习神经动力学的低维表示。对于数据有限的目标会话，TCLA 以任务条件的方式将目标潜在表示与源对齐，从而能够有效地传递已学习的神经动力学。我们在猕猴运动和眼动中心外数据集上评估 TCLA。与仅在目标会话数据上训练的基线方法相比，TCLA 在数据集和解码设置中始终提高解码性能，在运动数据集中，Y坐标速度解码的决定系数提高高达 0.386。这些结果表明，TCLA 提供了一种有效的策略，可以将知识从源会话传递到目标会话，从而在数据有限的情况下实现更稳健的神经解码。
tldr: The paper introduces a Task-Conditioned Latent Alignment (TCLA) framework to improve cross-session neural decoding in BCIs, particularly when data in the target session is limited, achieving improved decoding performance compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种任务条件潜在对齐（TCLA）框架，用于改进BCI中的跨会话神经解码，特别是在目标会话数据有限的情况下，与基线方法相比，实现了更高的解码性能。

title: SETA: Statistical Fault Attribution for Compound AI Systems
summary: Modern AI systems increasingly comprise multiple interconnected neural networks to tackle complex inference tasks. Testing such systems for robustness and safety entails significant challenges. Current state-of-the-art robustness testing techniques, whether black-box or white-box, have been proposed and implemented for single-network models and do not scale well to multi-network pipelines. We propose a modular robustness testing framework that applies a given set of perturbations to test data. Our testing framework supports (1) a component-wise system analysis to isolate errors and (2) reasoning about error propagation across the neural network modules. The testing framework is architecture and modality agnostic and can be applied across domains. We apply the framework to a real-world autonomous rail inspection system composed of multiple deep networks and successfully demonstrate how our approach enables fine-grained robustness analysis beyond conventional end-to-end metrics.
summary_zh: 现代人工智能系统越来越多地包含多个互连的神经网络，以应对复杂的推理任务。测试此类系统的稳健性和安全性带来了重大挑战。目前最先进的稳健性测试技术，无论是黑盒还是白盒，都已针对单网络模型提出和实施，但无法很好地扩展到多网络流水线。我们提出了一种模块化的稳健性测试框架，该框架应用一组给定的扰动来测试数据。我们的测试框架支持（1）组件式系统分析，以隔离错误，以及（2）跨神经网络模块的错误传播推理。该测试框架与架构和模态无关，可以应用于多个领域。我们将该框架应用于一个由多个深度网络组成的真实世界自主铁路检测系统，并成功地展示了我们的方法如何实现超出传统端到端指标的细粒度稳健性分析。
tldr: The paper introduces a modular robustness testing framework (SETA) for multi-network AI systems, enabling component-wise error analysis and error propagation reasoning, demonstrated on an autonomous rail inspection system.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个针对多网络AI系统的模块化鲁棒性测试框架(SETA)，该框架能够进行组件级错误分析和错误传播推理，并在一个自动铁路检测系统上进行了演示。

title: Localized Latent Editing for Dose-Response Modeling in Botulinum Toxin Injection Planning
summary: Botulinum toxin (Botox) injections are the gold standard for managing facial asymmetry and aesthetic rejuvenation, yet determining the optimal dosage remains largely intuitive, often leading to suboptimal outcomes. We propose a localized latent editing framework that simulates Botulinum Toxin injection effects for injection planning through dose-response modeling. Our key contribution is a Region-Specific Latent Axis Discovery method that learns localized muscle relaxation trajectories in StyleGAN2's latent space, enabling precise control over specific facial regions without global side effects. By correlating these localized latent trajectories with injected toxin units, we learn a predictive dose-response model. We rigorously compare two approaches: direct metric regression versus image-based generative simulation on a clinical dataset of N=360 images from 46 patients. On a hold-out test set, our framework demonstrates moderate-to-strong structural correlations for geometric asymmetry metrics, confirming that the generative model correctly captures the direction of morphological changes. While biological variability limits absolute precision, we introduce a hybrid "Human-in-the-Loop" workflow where clinicians interactively refine simulations, bridging the gap between pathological reconstruction and cosmetic planning.
summary_zh: 肉毒杆菌毒素（Botox）注射是治疗面部不对称和美容嫩肤的金标准，然而，确定最佳剂量在很大程度上仍然是直觉性的，往往导致次优的结果。我们提出了一种局部潜在编辑框架，通过剂量-反应建模模拟肉毒杆菌毒素注射效果，用于注射规划。我们主要的贡献是一种区域特异性潜在轴发现方法，该方法学习StyleGAN2潜在空间中局部肌肉放松轨迹，从而能够在不产生全局副作用的情况下精确控制特定面部区域。通过将这些局部潜在轨迹与注射的毒素单位相关联，我们学习了一种预测性的剂量-反应模型。我们严格比较了两种方法：直接指标回归与基于图像的生成式模拟，所使用的数据集是来自46名患者的N=360幅临床图像。在保留测试集上，我们的框架展示了对几何不对称指标的中等到强的结构相关性，证实了生成模型正确捕捉了形态变化的趋势。虽然生物变异性限制了绝对精度，但我们引入了一种混合的“人机交互”工作流程，临床医生可以在其中交互式地完善模拟，从而弥合了病理重建和美容规划之间的差距。
tldr: The paper introduces a localized latent editing framework using StyleGAN2 to simulate and predict the effects of botulinum toxin injections for personalized treatment planning, focusing on region-specific muscle relaxation and dose-response modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用 StyleGAN2 的局部潜在编辑框架，用于模拟和预测肉毒杆菌毒素注射效果，以进行个性化治疗计划，重点关注特定区域的肌肉放松和剂量反应建模。

title: QuaMo: Quaternion Motions for Vision-based 3D Human Kinematics Capture
summary: Vision-based 3D human motion capture from videos remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional 3D pose estimation approaches often ignore the temporal consistency between frames, causing implausible and jittery motion. The emerging field of kinematics-based 3D motion capture addresses these issues by estimating the temporal transitioning between poses instead. A major drawback in current kinematics approaches is their reliance on Euler angles. Despite their simplicity, Euler angles suffer from discontinuity that leads to unstable motion reconstructions, especially in online settings where trajectory refinement is unavailable. Contrarily, quaternions have no discontinuity and can produce continuous transitions between poses. In this paper, we propose QuaMo, a novel Quaternion Motions method using quaternion differential equations (QDE) for human kinematics capture. We utilize the state-space model, an effective system for describing real-time kinematics estimations, with quaternion state and the QDE describing quaternion velocity. The corresponding angular acceleration is computed from a meta-PD controller with a novel acceleration enhancement that adaptively regulates the control signals as the human quickly changes to a new pose. Unlike previous work, our QDE is solved under the quaternion unit-sphere constraint that results in more accurate estimations. Experimental results show that our novel formulation of the QDE with acceleration enhancement accurately estimates 3D human kinematics with no discontinuity and minimal implausibilities. QuaMo outperforms comparable state-of-the-art methods on multiple datasets, namely Human3.6M, Fit3D, SportsPose and AIST. The code is available at https://github.com/cuongle1206/QuaMo
summary_zh: 基于视觉的视频三维人体运动捕获仍然是计算机视觉领域的一大挑战。传统的三维姿态估计方法通常忽略帧间的时间一致性，导致不合理和抖动的运动。新兴的基于运动学的三维运动捕获通过估计姿态之间的时序过渡来解决这些问题。当前运动学方法的一个主要缺点是它们对欧拉角的依赖。尽管欧拉角很简单，但它们存在不连续性，导致不稳定的运动重建，尤其是在无法进行轨迹优化的在线环境中。相反，四元数没有不连续性，可以产生姿态间的连续过渡。在本文中，我们提出 QuaMo，一种新颖的使用四元数微分方程（QDE）进行人体运动学捕获的四元数运动方法。我们利用状态空间模型，这是一个描述实时运动学估计的有效系统，其状态为四元数，并且QDE描述了四元数速度。对应的角加速度由一个具有新型加速度增强的元-PD控制器计算得出，该加速度增强能够自适应地调节控制信号，以适应人体快速变换到新姿态的情况。与以往工作不同的是，我们的QDE是在四元数单位球约束下求解的，从而产生更准确的估计。实验结果表明，我们提出的具有加速度增强的 QDE 新型公式能够准确地估计三维人体运动学，且不存在不连续性和最小的不合理性。QuaMo 在多个数据集（包括 Human3.6M、Fit3D、SportsPose 和 AIST）上优于同类最先进的方法。 代码可在 https://github.com/cuongle1206/QuaMo 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces QuaMo, a novel method for vision-based 3D human kinematics capture that uses quaternion differential equations and a meta-PD controller to achieve continuous and accurate motion estimation, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 QuaMo 的新方法，用于基于视觉的 3D 人体运动学捕捉。该方法使用四元数微分方程和元 PD 控制器来实现连续且准确的运动估计，优于现有的最先进方法。

title: A Non-Invasive 3D Gait Analysis Framework for Quantifying Psychomotor Retardation in Major Depressive Disorder
summary:
Predicting the status of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) from objective, non-invasive methods is an active research field. Yet, extracting automatically objective, interpretable features for a detailed analysis of the patient state remains largely unexplored.
  Among MDD's symptoms, Psychomotor retardation (PMR) is a core item, yet its clinical assessment remains largely subjective. While 3D motion capture offers an objective alternative, its reliance on specialized hardware often precludes routine clinical use. In this paper, we propose a non-invasive computational framework that transforms monocular RGB video into clinically relevant 3D gait kinematics. Our pipeline uses Gravity-View Coordinates along with a novel trajectory-correction algorithm that leverages the closed-loop topology of our adapted Timed Up and Go (TUG) protocol to mitigate monocular depth errors. This novel pipeline enables the extraction of 297 explicit gait biomechanical biomarkers from a single camera capture.
  To address the challenges of small clinical datasets, we introduce a stability-based machine learning framework that identifies robust motor signatures while preventing overfitting. Validated on the CALYPSO dataset, our method achieves an 83.3% accuracy in detecting PMR and explains 64% of the variance in overall depression severity (R^2=0.64). Notably, our study reveals a strong link between reduced ankle propulsion and restricted pelvic mobility to the depressive motor phenotype. These results demonstrate that physical movement serves as a robust proxy for the cognitive state, offering a transparent and scalable tool for the objective monitoring of depression in standard clinical environments.
summary_zh:
预测重度抑郁症 (MDD) 的状态，采用客观、非侵入性方法是一个活跃的研究领域。然而，自动提取客观、可解释的特征，以进行患者状态的详细分析，在很大程度上仍未被探索。

在 MDD 的症状中，精神运动迟缓 (PMR) 是一个核心条目，但其临床评估在很大程度上仍然是主观的。虽然 3D 动作捕捉提供了一种客观的替代方案，但它对专用硬件的依赖常常妨碍了常规临床使用。在本文中，我们提出了一种非侵入性的计算框架，该框架将单目 RGB 视频转化为临床相关的 3D 步态运动学。我们的流水线使用重力坐标系，以及一种利用我们改编的计时起立行走 (TUG) 协议的闭环拓扑来缓解单目深度误差的新型轨迹校正算法。这种新颖的流水线能够从单次相机捕获中提取 297 个显式步态生物力学生物标志物。

为了应对小型临床数据集的挑战，我们引入了一个基于稳定性的机器学习框架，该框架可以识别稳健的运动特征，同时防止过拟合。在 CALYPSO 数据集上验证表明，我们的方法在检测 PMR 方面实现了 83.3% 的准确率，并解释了总体抑郁症严重程度 64% 的方差 (R^2=0.64)。值得注意的是，我们的研究揭示了踝关节推进力降低和骨盆活动受限与抑郁运动表型之间存在很强的联系。这些结果表明，身体运动可以作为认知状态的可靠代理，为在标准临床环境中客观监测抑郁症提供了一种透明且可扩展的工具。
tldr: This paper presents a non-invasive 3D gait analysis framework using monocular RGB video to objectively quantify psychomotor retardation (PMR) in patients with Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), achieving 83.3% accuracy in detecting PMR.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个非侵入性的3D步态分析框架，利用单目RGB视频客观地量化重度抑郁症（MDD）患者的精神运动迟缓（PMR），并在检测PMR方面实现了83.3%的准确率。

title: HEATACO: Heatmap-Guided Ant Colony Decoding for Large-Scale Travelling Salesman Problems
summary: Heatmap-based non-autoregressive solvers for large-scale Travelling Salesman Problems output dense edge-probability scores, yet final performance largely hinges on the decoder that must satisfy degree-2 constraints and form a single Hamiltonian tour. Greedy commitment can cascade into irreparable mistakes at large $N$, whereas MCTS-guided local search is accurate but compute-heavy and highly engineered. We instead treat the heatmap as a soft edge prior and cast decoding as probabilistic tour construction under feasibility constraints, where the key is to correct local mis-rankings via inexpensive global coordination. Based on this view, we introduce HeatACO, a plug-and-play Max-Min Ant System decoder whose transition policy is softly biased by the heatmap while pheromone updates provide lightweight, instance-specific feedback to resolve global conflicts; optional 2-opt/3-opt post-processing further improves tour quality. On TSP500/1K/10K, using heatmaps produced by four pretrained predictors, HeatACO+2opt achieves gaps down to 0.11%/0.23%/1.15% with seconds-to-minutes CPU decoding for fixed heatmaps, offering a better quality--time trade-off than greedy decoding and published MCTS-based decoders. Finally, we find the gains track heatmap reliability: under distribution shift, miscalibration and confidence collapse bound decoding improvements, suggesting heatmap generalisation is a primary lever for further progress.
summary_zh: 基于热图的非自回归求解器用于解决大规模旅行商问题时，会输出密集的边概率评分，但最终性能很大程度上取决于解码器，该解码器必须满足度为2的约束条件并形成单个哈密顿回路。贪婪提交可能会在较大的N值时导致不可弥补的错误，而基于MCTS引导的局部搜索是准确的，但计算量大且需要高度工程化。我们另辟蹊径，将热图视为软边先验，并将解码视为在可行性约束下进行的概率回路构建，其中的关键是通过廉价的全局协调来纠正局部错误的排序。基于此观点，我们引入了HeatACO，一个即插即用的最大-最小蚁群系统解码器，其转移策略受到热图的软偏置，而信息素更新则提供轻量级的、特定于实例的反馈来解决全局冲突；可选的2-opt/3-opt后处理进一步提高了回路质量。在TSP500/1K/10K上，使用由四个预训练预测器生成的热图，HeatACO+2opt实现了低至0.11%/0.23%/1.15%的间隙，对于固定热图，CPU解码时间为几秒到几分钟，与贪婪解码和已发表的基于MCTS的解码器相比，提供了更好的质量-时间权衡。最后，我们发现收益与热图可靠性相关：在分布偏移下，错误校准和置信度坍塌会限制解码改进，这表明热图泛化是进一步取得进展的主要手段。
tldr: The paper introduces HeatACO, a heatmap-guided Ant Colony Optimization decoder for solving large-scale Traveling Salesman Problems, achieving a better quality-time trade-off than existing methods by using heatmaps as soft edge priors and pheromone updates for global coordination.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为HeatACO的热图引导的蚁群优化解码器，用于解决大规模旅行商问题。通过将热图作为软边缘先验和信息素更新用于全局协调，该方法实现了比现有方法更好的质量-时间权衡。

title: Whether We Care, How We Reason: The Dual Role of Anthropomorphism and Moral Foundations in Robot Abuse
summary: As robots become increasingly integrated into daily life, understanding responses to robot mistreatment carries important ethical and design implications. This mixed-methods study (N = 201) examined how anthropomorphic levels and moral foundations shape reactions to robot abuse. Participants viewed videos depicting physical mistreatment of robots varying in humanness (Spider, Twofoot, Humanoid) and completed measures assessing moral foundations, anger, and social distance. Results revealed that anthropomorphism determines whether people extend moral consideration to robots, while moral foundations shape how they reason about such consideration. Qualitative analysis revealed distinct reasoning patterns: low-progressivism individuals employed character-based judgments, while high-progressivism individuals engaged in future-oriented moral deliberation. Findings offer implications for robot design and policy communication.
summary_zh: 随着机器人日益融入日常生活，理解人们对机器人虐待的反应具有重要的伦理和设计意义。本混合方法研究（N = 201）考察了拟人化程度和道德基础如何影响对机器人虐待的反应。参与者观看了描述不同人化程度（蜘蛛型、双足型、人形）机器人遭受身体虐待的视频，并完成了评估道德基础、愤怒和社会距离的量表。结果表明，拟人化程度决定了人们是否会将道德考量扩展到机器人身上，而道德基础则影响着他们如何进行此类考量的推理。定性分析揭示了不同的推理模式：低进步主义者采用基于人物的判断，而高进步主义者则进行面向未来的道德审议。研究结果为机器人设计和政策沟通提供了启示。
tldr: This study investigates how anthropomorphism and moral foundations influence people's reactions to robot abuse, revealing that anthropomorphism dictates moral consideration while moral foundations shape the reasoning behind it.
tldr_zh: 本研究调查了拟人化和道德基础如何影响人们对虐待机器人的反应，揭示了拟人化决定了道德考量，而道德基础塑造了其背后的推理。

title: A DVL Aided Loosely Coupled Inertial Navigation Strategy for AUVs with Attitude Error Modeling and Variance Propagation
summary: In underwater navigation systems, strap-down inertial navigation system/Doppler velocity log (SINS/DVL)-based loosely coupled architectures are widely adopted. Conventional approaches project DVL velocities from the body coordinate system to the navigation coordinate system using SINS-derived attitude; however, accumulated attitude estimation errors introduce biases into velocity projection and degrade navigation performance during long-term operation. To address this issue, two complementary improvements are introduced. First, a vehicle attitude error-aware DVL velocity transformation model is formulated by incorporating attitude error terms into the observation equation to reduce projection-induced velocity bias. Second, a covariance matrix-based variance propagation method is developed to transform DVL measurement uncertainty across coordinate systems, introducing an expectation-based attitude error compensation term to achieve statistically consistent noise modeling. Simulation and field experiment results demonstrate that both improvements individually enhance navigation accuracy and confirm that accumulated attitude errors affect both projected velocity measurements and their associated uncertainty. When jointly applied, long-term error divergence is effectively suppressed. Field experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves a 78.3% improvement in 3D position RMSE and a 71.8% reduction in the maximum component-wise position error compared with the baseline IMU+DVL method, providing a robust solution for improving long-term SINS/DVL navigation performance.
summary_zh:
摘要：
在水下导航系统中，基于捷联惯性导航系统/多普勒计程仪（SINS/DVL）的松耦合架构被广泛采用。传统方法利用SINS解算得到的姿态将DVL速度从载体坐标系投影到导航坐标系；然而，累积的姿态估计误差会引入速度投影偏差，并在长期运行中降低导航性能。为了解决这个问题，引入了两个互补的改进。首先，通过在观测方程中引入姿态误差项，构建了一种车辆姿态误差感知的DVL速度转换模型，以减少投影引起的速度偏差。其次，开发了一种基于协方差矩阵的方差传播方法，用于在坐标系之间转换DVL测量不确定性。该方法引入了一种基于期望的姿态误差补偿项，以实现统计上一致的噪声建模。仿真和实地实验结果表明，这两项改进都能单独提高导航精度，并证实了累积的姿态误差会影响投影的速度测量值及其相关的不确定性。当联合应用时，长期误差发散得到有效抑制。实地实验结果表明，与基准IMU+DVL方法相比，所提出的方法在三维位置均方根误差（RMSE）上实现了78.3%的改进，并在最大分量位置误差上实现了71.8%的降低，为提高长期SINS/DVL导航性能提供了一种稳健的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces an improved SINS/DVL navigation strategy for AUVs by addressing attitude error-induced biases in velocity projection and uncertainty modeling, achieving significant improvements in long-term navigation accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种改进的SINS/DVL水下导航策略，解决了AUV中姿态误差引起的Velocities投影偏差和不确定性建模问题，从而显著提高了长期导航精度。

title: Robust Out-of-Order Retrieval for Grid-Based Storage at Maximum Capacity
summary: This paper proposes a framework for improving the operational efficiency of automated storage systems under uncertainty. It considers a 2D grid-based storage for uniform-sized loads (e.g., containers, pallets, or totes), which are moved by a robot (or other manipulator) along a collision-free path in the grid. The loads are labeled (i.e., unique) and must be stored in a given sequence, and later be retrieved in a different sequence -- an operational pattern that arises in logistics applications, such as last-mile distribution centers and shipyards. The objective is to minimize the load relocations to ensure efficient retrieval. A previous result guarantees a zero-relocation solution for known storage and retrieval sequences, even for storage at full capacity, provided that the side of the grid through which loads are stored/retrieved is at least 3 cells wide. However, in practice, the retrieval sequence can change after the storage phase. To address such uncertainty, this work investigates \emph{$k$-bounded perturbations} during retrieval, under which any two loads may depart out of order if they are originally at most $k$ positions apart. We prove that a $Θ(k)$ grid width is necessary and sufficient for eliminating relocations at maximum capacity. We also provide an efficient solver for computing a storage arrangement that is robust to such perturbations. To address the higher-uncertainty case where perturbations exceed $k$, a strategy is introduced to effectively minimize relocations. Extensive experiments show that, for $k$ up to half the grid width, the proposed storage-retrieval framework essentially eliminates relocations. For $k$ values up to the full grid width, relocations are reduced by $50\%+$.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种框架，旨在提高不确定性条件下自动化存储系统的运营效率。该框架考虑了一种基于二维网格的存储系统，用于存储尺寸统一的负载（例如，集装箱、托盘或手提箱），这些负载由机器人（或其他机械手）沿网格中无碰撞路径移动。负载被标记（即唯一），并且必须按照给定的顺序存储，随后按照不同的顺序检索——这是一种在物流应用中出现的运营模式，例如最后一英里配送中心和造船厂。目标是最小化负载重定位，以确保高效检索。先前的一项结果保证了对于已知的存储和检索序列，即使在满载容量下存储，也能实现零重定位解决方案，前提是负载存储/检索所在的网格侧面至少有 3 个单元格宽。然而，在实践中，检索序列可能会在存储阶段后发生变化。为了解决这种不确定性，本文研究了检索期间的 \emph{$k$有界扰动} ，即最初相隔最多 $k$ 个位置的任何两个负载可能会乱序出发。我们证明了 $Θ(k)$ 的网格宽度对于消除最大容量下的重定位是必要和充分的。我们还提供了一种高效的求解器，用于计算对这种扰动具有鲁棒性的存储安排。为了解决扰动超过 $k$ 的更高不确定性情况，本文引入了一种用于有效最小化重定位的策略。大量的实验表明，对于 $k$ 值高达网格宽度的一半时，所提出的存储-检索框架基本上消除了重定位。对于 $k$ 值高达整个网格宽度时，重定位减少了 50% 以上。
tldr: The paper presents a relocation-free storage and retrieval framework for grid-based automated storage systems that is robust to out-of-order retrieval requests within a bounded perturbation, achieving significant relocation reduction even for larger perturbations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对网格型自动化存储系统的无需重新定位的存储和检索框架，该框架对于有界扰动范围内的乱序检索请求具有鲁棒性，并且即使对于更大的扰动，也能显著减少重新定位。

title: A Switching Nonlinear Model Predictive Control Strategy for Safe Collision Handling by an Underwater Vehicle-Manipulator System
summary: For active intervention tasks in underwater environments, the use of autonomous vehicles is just now emerging as an active area of research. During operation, for various reasons, the robot might find itself on a collision course with an obstacle in its environment. In this paper, a switching Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) strategy is proposed to safely handle collisions for an Underwater Vehicle-Manipulator System (UVMS). When avoiding the collision is impossible, the control algorithm takes advantage of the manipulator, using it to push against the obstacle, and deflect away from the collision. Virtual experiments are performed to demonstrate the algorithm's capability to successfully detect collisions and either avoid them, or use the manipulator to handle them appropriately without damaging sensitive areas of the vehicle.
summary_zh: 在水下环境中进行主动干预任务时，自主车辆的使用正逐渐成为一个活跃的研究领域。在操作过程中，出于各种原因，机器人可能会发现自身处于与环境中障碍物碰撞的航向上。本文提出了一种切换式非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）策略，用于安全地处理水下车辆-机械臂系统（UVMS）的碰撞。当无法避免碰撞时，控制算法会利用机械臂，通过用其推抵障碍物来偏转并远离碰撞。通过虚拟实验来验证该算法能够成功检测碰撞，并能够避免碰撞，或利用机械臂适当地处理碰撞，而不会损坏车辆的敏感区域。
tldr: This paper proposes a switching Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) strategy for underwater vehicle-manipulator systems (UVMS) to safely handle collisions, either by avoiding them or by using the manipulator to push against obstacles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种切换非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）策略，用于水下车辆-机械臂系统（UVMS），以安全地处理碰撞，可以通过避开碰撞或使用机械臂推开障碍物来实现。

title: Fuzzy expert system for the process of collecting and purifying acidic water: a digital twin approach
summary: Purifying sour water is essential for reducing emissions, minimizing corrosion risks, enabling the reuse of treated water in industrial or domestic applications, and ultimately lowering operational costs. Moreover, automating the purification process helps reduce the risk of worker harm by limiting human involvement. Crude oil contains acidic components such as hydrogen sulfide, carbon dioxide, and other chemical compounds. During processing, these substances are partially released into sour water. If not properly treated, sour water poses serious environmental threats and accelerates the corrosion of pipelines and equipment. This paper presents a fuzzy expert system, combined with a custom-generated digital twin, developed from a documented industrial process to maintain key parameters at desired levels by mimicking human reasoning. The control strategy is designed to be simple and intuitive, allowing junior or non-expert personnel to interact with the system effectively. The digital twin was developed using Honeywell UniSim Design R492 to simulate real industrial behavior accurately. Valve dynamics were modeled through system identification in MATLAB, and real-time data exchange between the simulator and controller was established using OPC DA. The fuzzy controller applies split-range control to two valves and was tested under 21 different initial pressure conditions using five distinct defuzzification strategies, resulting in a total of 105 unique test scenarios. System performance was evaluated using both error-based metrics (MSE, RMSE, MAE, IAE, ISE, ITAE) and dynamic response metrics, including overshoot, undershoot, rise time, fall time, settling time, and steady-state error. A web-based simulation interface was developed in Python using the Streamlit framework. Although demonstrated here for sour water treatment, the proposed fuzzy expert system is general-purpose.
summary_zh: 净化酸性水对于减少排放、降低腐蚀风险、使处理后的水能够在工业或家庭应用中重复使用，并最终降低运营成本至关重要。此外，净化过程的自动化通过限制人为干预来帮助降低工人受伤的风险。原油含有酸性成分，如硫化氢、二氧化碳和其他化学化合物。在加工过程中，这些物质会部分释放到酸性水中。如果未得到适当处理，酸性水将对环境构成严重威胁，并加速管道和设备的腐蚀。本文提出了一种模糊专家系统，该系统结合了从记录在案的工业过程中定制生成的数字孪生模型，通过模仿人类推理来将关键参数维持在所需的水平。该控制策略被设计为简单直观，允许经验不足或非专业人员有效地与系统交互。数字孪生模型使用霍尼韦尔UniSim Design R492开发，以准确模拟真实的工业行为。阀门动力学通过MATLAB中的系统辨识进行建模，并使用OPC DA建立模拟器和控制器之间的实时数据交换。模糊控制器对两个阀门应用分程控制，并在21种不同的初始压力条件下使用五种不同的去模糊化策略进行测试，总共产生105种独特的测试场景。系统性能使用基于误差的指标（MSE、RMSE、MAE、IAE、ISE、ITAE）和动态响应指标进行评估，包括超调、欠调、上升时间、下降时间、稳定时间和稳态误差。使用Streamlit框架，在Python中开发了一个基于Web的仿真界面。虽然本文主要针对酸性水处理进行展示，但所提出的模糊专家系统具有通用性。
tldr: The paper presents a fuzzy expert system combined with a digital twin for sour water purification, aiming to automate and optimize the process while enabling operation by non-experts. They create a web-based interface using Python's Streamlit.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种模糊专家系统，结合数字孪生技术，用于酸性水净化，旨在自动化和优化处理过程，并使非专业人员也能操作。 他们使用 Python 的 Streamlit 创建了一个基于 Web 的界面。

title: Instance-Guided Radar Depth Estimation for 3D Object Detection
summary: Accurate depth estimation is fundamental to 3D perception in autonomous driving, supporting tasks such as detection, tracking, and motion planning. However, monocular camera-based 3D detection suffers from depth ambiguity and reduced robustness under challenging conditions. Radar provides complementary advantages such as resilience to poor lighting and adverse weather, but its sparsity and low resolution limit its direct use in detection frameworks. This motivates the need for effective Radar-camera fusion with improved preprocessing and depth estimation strategies. We propose an end-to-end framework that enhances monocular 3D object detection through two key components. First, we introduce InstaRadar, an instance segmentation-guided expansion method that leverages pre-trained segmentation masks to enhance Radar density and semantic alignment, producing a more structured representation. InstaRadar achieves state-of-the-art results in Radar-guided depth estimation, showing its effectiveness in generating high-quality depth features. Second, we integrate the pre-trained RCDPT into the BEVDepth framework as a replacement for its depth module. With InstaRadar-enhanced inputs, the RCDPT integration consistently improves 3D detection performance. Overall, these components yield steady gains over the baseline BEVDepth model, demonstrating the effectiveness of InstaRadar and the advantage of explicit depth supervision in 3D object detection. Although the framework lags behind Radar-camera fusion models that directly extract BEV features, since Radar serves only as guidance rather than an independent feature stream, this limitation highlights potential for improvement. Future work will extend InstaRadar to point cloud-like representations and integrate a dedicated Radar branch with temporal cues for enhanced BEV fusion.
summary_zh: 精确的深度估计是自动驾驶中3D感知的基础，支撑着诸如检测、跟踪和运动规划等任务。然而，基于单目相机的3D检测受到深度歧义以及在具有挑战性的条件下鲁棒性降低的影响。雷达具有互补优势，例如对弱光和恶劣天气的适应性，但其稀疏性和低分辨率限制了其在检测框架中的直接应用。这激发了对有效雷达-相机融合的需求，并要求改进预处理和深度估计策略。我们提出了一个端到端的框架，通过两个关键组件来增强单目3D目标检测。首先，我们引入了InstaRadar，一种实例分割引导的扩展方法，它利用预训练的分割掩码来增强雷达密度和语义对齐，从而产生更结构化的表示。InstaRadar在雷达引导的深度估计方面取得了最先进的结果，展示了其在生成高质量深度特征方面的有效性。其次，我们将预训练的RCDPT集成到BEVDepth框架中，以替代其深度模块。借助InstaRadar增强的输入，RCDPT集成能够持续提升3D检测性能。总的来说，这些组件在基线BEVDepth模型上产生了稳定的增益，证明了InstaRadar的有效性以及在3D目标检测中显式深度监督的优势。尽管该框架落后于直接提取BEV特征的雷达-相机融合模型，因为雷达仅作为指导而非独立的特征流，但这种局限性突出了改进的潜力。未来的工作将把InstaRadar扩展到类似点云的表示，并集成一个带有时间线索的专用雷达分支，以增强BEV融合。
tldr: This paper introduces InstaRadar, an instance segmentation-guided method to enhance radar depth estimation for improved 3D object detection within a camera-radar fusion framework, demonstrating performance gains over the BEVDepth baseline.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了InstaRadar，一种实例分割引导的方法，用于增强雷达深度估计，从而改进相机-雷达融合框架中的3D物体检测，并展示了相对于BEVDepth基线的性能提升。

title: Dynamic Cogeneration of Bug Reproduction Test in Agentic Program Repair
summary: Bug Reproduction Tests (BRTs) have been used in many agentic Automated Program Repair (APR) systems, primarily for validating promising fixes and aiding fix generation. In practice, when developers submit a patch, they often implement the BRT alongside the fix. Our experience deploying agentic APR reveals that developers similarly desire a BRT within AI-generated patches to increase their confidence. However, canonical APR systems tend to generate BRTs and fixes separately, or focus on producing only the fix in the final patch. In this paper, we study agentic APR in the context of cogeneration, where the APR agent is instructed to generate both a fix and a BRT in the same patch. We evaluate the effectiveness of different cogeneration strategies on 120 human-reported bugs at Google and characterize different cogeneration strategies by their influence on APR agent behavior. We develop and evaluate patch selectors that account for test change information to select patches with plausible fixes (and plausible BRTs). Finally, we analyze the root causes of failed cogeneration trajectories. Importantly, we show that cogeneration allows the APR agent to generate BRTs for at least as many bugs as a dedicated BRT agent, without compromising the generation rate of plausible fixes, thereby reducing engineering effort in maintaining and coordinating separate generation pipelines for fix and BRT at scale.
summary_zh: 错误复现测试（BRT）已被广泛应用于多个自主式自动化程序修复（APR）系统中，主要用于验证有前景的修复并辅助生成修复。在实践中，当开发者提交补丁时，他们通常会伴随修复实现 BRT。我们在部署自主式 APR 方面的经验表明，开发者同样希望在 AI 生成的补丁中使用 BRT，以提高他们的信心。然而，典型的 APR 系统倾向于分别生成 BRT 和修复，或者专注于在最终补丁中仅生成修复。在本文中，我们研究了在协同生成环境下的自主式 APR，即指示 APR 代理在同一个补丁中同时生成修复和 BRT。我们评估了不同协同生成策略在 Google 报告的 120 个人工修复漏洞上的有效性，并根据它们对 APR 代理行为的影响来描述不同的协同生成策略。我们开发并评估了考虑测试变更信息的补丁选择器，以选择具有合理修复（和合理 BRT）的补丁。最后，我们分析了协同生成轨迹失败的根本原因。重要的是，我们证明了协同生成允许 APR 代理至少为与专用 BRT 代理一样多的漏洞生成 BRT，而不会影响合理修复的生成率，从而减少了大规模维护和协调修复和 BRT 的单独生成管道的工程工作量。
tldr: This paper explores a 'cogeneration' approach in agentic Automated Program Repair (APR), where the APR agent generates both a code fix and a bug reproduction test (BRT) simultaneously. It shows that this method can be as effective as dedicated BRT generation without sacrificing fix generation rates.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了一种代理自动程序修复（APR）中的“协同生成”方法，其中 APR 代理同时生成代码修复和错误重现测试（BRT）。结果表明，该方法与专门的 BRT 生成一样有效，且不影响修复生成率。

title: When Does Adaptation Win? Scaling Laws for Meta-Learning in Quantum Control
summary: Quantum hardware suffers from intrinsic device heterogeneity and environmental drift, forcing practitioners to choose between suboptimal non-adaptive controllers or costly per-device recalibration. We derive a scaling law lower bound for meta-learning showing that the adaptation gain (expected fidelity improvement from task-specific gradient steps) saturates exponentially with gradient steps and scales linearly with task variance, providing a quantitative criterion for when adaptation justifies its overhead. Validation on quantum gate calibration shows negligible benefits for low-variance tasks but $>40\%$ fidelity gains on two-qubit gates under extreme out-of-distribution conditions (10$\times$ the training noise), with implications for reducing per-device calibration time on cloud quantum processors. Further validation on classical linear-quadratic control confirms these laws emerge from general optimization geometry rather than quantum-specific physics. Together, these results offer a transferable framework for decision-making in adaptive control.
summary_zh: 量子硬件受到内在器件异质性和环境漂移的影响，迫使从业者在次优的非自适应控制器或代价高昂的设备级重新校准之间做出选择。我们推导出一个元学习的缩放律下界，表明适应增益（来自特定任务梯度步长的预期保真度提升）随着梯度步数呈指数饱和，并与任务方差呈线性比例关系，从而为适应何时能抵消其开销提供了一个定量标准。在量子门校准上的验证表明，对于低方差任务而言，收益微不足道，但在极端分布外条件下（训练噪声的 10 倍），双量子比特门上的保真度增益 >40%，这对减少云量子处理器上的设备级校准时间具有重要意义。在线性二次型经典控制上的进一步验证证实，这些定律源于一般的优化几何，而非特定于量子的物理。总而言之，这些结果提供了一个可转移的框架，用于自适应控制中的决策。
tldr: This paper derives scaling laws for meta-learning in quantum control, providing a criterion for when adaptation is beneficial and demonstrating significant fidelity gains on quantum gate calibration under noisy conditions.
tldr_zh: 该论文推导了量子控制中元学习的缩放定律，为判断何时进行自适应有益提供了一个标准，并在噪声条件下展示了量子门校准方面的显著保真度增益。

title: WaterClear-GS: Optical-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Underwater Reconstruction and Restoration
summary: Underwater 3D reconstruction and appearance restoration are hindered by the complex optical properties of water, such as wavelength-dependent attenuation and scattering. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based methods struggle with slow rendering speeds and suboptimal color restoration, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) inherently lacks the capability to model complex volumetric scattering effects. To address these issues, we introduce WaterClear-GS, the first pure 3DGS-based framework that explicitly integrates underwater optical properties of local attenuation and scattering into Gaussian primitives, eliminating the need for an auxiliary medium network. Our method employs a dual-branch optimization strategy to ensure underwater photometric consistency while naturally recovering water-free appearances. This strategy is enhanced by depth-guided geometry regularization and perception-driven image loss, together with exposure constraints, spatially-adaptive regularization, and physically guided spectral regularization, which collectively enforce local 3D coherence and maintain natural visual perception. Experiments on standard benchmarks and our newly collected dataset demonstrate that WaterClear-GS achieves outstanding performance on both novel view synthesis (NVS) and underwater image restoration (UIR) tasks, while maintaining real-time rendering. The code will be available at https://buaaxrzhang.github.io/WaterClear-GS/.
summary_zh: 水下三维重建和外观恢复受到水中复杂光学特性的限制，例如波长相关的衰减和散射。现有的基于神经辐射场（NeRF）的方法在渲染速度慢和颜色恢复次优方面存在困难，而3D高斯溅射（3DGS）本质上缺乏建模复杂体积散射效应的能力。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了WaterClear-GS，这是第一个完全基于3DGS的框架，它将局部衰减和散射的水下光学特性显式地集成到高斯基元中，从而消除了对辅助介质网络的需求。我们的方法采用双分支优化策略，以确保水下光度一致性，同时自然地恢复无水外观。该策略通过深度引导的几何正则化和感知驱动的图像损失来增强，并结合曝光约束、空间自适应正则化和物理引导的光谱正则化，这些方法共同增强了局部三维一致性并保持了自然的视觉感知。在标准基准测试和我们新收集的数据集上的实验表明，WaterClear-GS在新的视角合成（NVS）和水下图像恢复（UIR）任务上都取得了出色的性能，同时保持了实时的渲染速度。代码将在https://buaaxrzhang.github.io/WaterClear-GS/上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces WaterClear-GS, a novel 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that integrates underwater optical properties for underwater 3D reconstruction and restoration, achieving state-of-the-art performance with real-time rendering.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 WaterClear-GS，一种新的 3D 高斯溅射框架，它集成了水下光学特性，用于水下 3D 重建和恢复，实现了最先进的性能和实时渲染。

title: OSIRIS: Bridging Analog Circuit Design and Machine Learning with Scalable Dataset Generation
summary: The automation of analog integrated circuit (IC) design remains a longstanding challenge, primarily due to the intricate interdependencies among physical layout, parasitic effects, and circuit-level performance. These interactions impose complex constraints that are difficult to accurately capture and optimize using conventional design methodologies. Although recent advances in machine learning (ML) have shown promise in automating specific stages of the analog design flow, the development of holistic, end-to-end frameworks that integrate these stages and iteratively refine layouts using post-layout, parasitic-aware performance feedback is still in its early stages. Furthermore, progress in this direction is hindered by the limited availability of open, high-quality datasets tailored to the analog domain, restricting both the benchmarking and the generalizability of ML-based techniques. To address these limitations, we present OSIRIS, a scalable dataset generation pipeline for analog IC design. OSIRIS systematically explores the design space of analog circuits while producing comprehensive performance metrics and metadata, thereby enabling ML-driven research in electronic design automation (EDA). In addition, we release a dataset consisting of 87,100 circuit variations generated with OSIRIS, accompanied by a reinforcement learning (RL)-based baseline method that exploits OSIRIS for analog design optimization.
summary_zh: 模拟集成电路 (IC) 设计的自动化仍然是一个长期存在的挑战，这主要是由于物理布局、寄生效应和电路级性能之间复杂的相互依赖关系。这些相互作用引入了复杂的约束，难以使用传统的的设计方法准确捕获和优化。尽管机器学习 (ML) 近期的进展已显示出在自动化模拟设计流程的特定阶段的希望，但整合这些阶段并使用后布局、寄生效应感知的性能反馈迭代优化布局的整体、端到端框架的开发仍处于早期阶段。此外，这一方向的进展受到专为模拟领域定制的开放、高质量数据集可用性有限的阻碍，限制了基于 ML 的技术的基准测试和泛化能力。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 OSIRIS，一个用于模拟 IC 设计的可扩展数据集生成流水线。OSIRIS 系统地探索了模拟电路的设计空间，同时生成了全面的性能指标和元数据，从而支持电子设计自动化 (EDA) 中 ML 驱动的研究。此外，我们发布了一个由 OSIRIS 生成的 87,100 个电路变体的组成的数据集，以及一个利用 OSIRIS 进行模拟设计优化的基于强化学习 (RL) 的基准方法。
tldr: The paper introduces OSIRIS, a scalable dataset generation pipeline for analog IC design, addressing the lack of high-quality datasets and providing a reinforcement learning baseline for analog design optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OSIRIS，一个可扩展的模拟集成电路设计数据集生成流程，旨在解决高质量数据集的缺乏问题，并为模拟设计优化提供了一个强化学习基准方法。

title: Queue Length Regret Bounds for Contextual Queueing Bandits
summary: We introduce contextual queueing bandits, a new context-aware framework for scheduling while simultaneously learning unknown service rates. Individual jobs carry heterogeneous contextual features, based on which the agent chooses a job and matches it with a server to maximize the departure rate. The service/departure rate is governed by a logistic model of the contextual feature with an unknown server-specific parameter. To evaluate the performance of a policy, we consider queue length regret, defined as the difference in queue length between the policy and the optimal policy. The main challenge in the analysis is that the lists of remaining job features in the queue may differ under our policy versus the optimal policy for a given time step, since they may process jobs in different orders. To address this, we propose the idea of policy-switching queues equipped with a sophisticated coupling argument. This leads to a novel queue length regret decomposition framework, allowing us to understand the short-term effect of choosing a suboptimal job-server pair and its long-term effect on queue state differences. We show that our algorithm, CQB-$\varepsilon$, achieves a regret upper bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1/4})$. We also consider the setting of adversarially chosen contexts, for which our second algorithm, CQB-Opt, achieves a regret upper bound of $\mathcal{O}(\log^2 T)$. Lastly, we provide experimental results that validate our theoretical findings.
summary_zh: 我们引入了上下文排队赌博机，一种新的上下文感知框架，用于在调度的同时学习未知的服务速率。每个任务都带有异构的上下文特征，基于这些特征，智能体选择一个任务并将其与服务器匹配，以最大化离开速率。服务/离开速率由上下文特征的 Logistic 模型控制，该模型具有未知的服务器特定参数。为了评估策略的性能，我们考虑了队列长度遗憾，定义为策略和最优策略之间的队列长度差异。分析中的主要挑战在于，在给定的时间步，我们的策略和最优策略下的剩余任务特征列表可能不同，因为它们可能以不同的顺序处理任务。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了配备复杂耦合论证的策略切换队列的思想。这引出了一种新的队列长度遗憾分解框架，使我们能够理解选择次优任务-服务器对的短期影响及其对队列状态差异的长期影响。我们证明了我们的算法 CQB-$\varepsilon$ 实现了 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1/4})$ 的遗憾上界。我们还考虑了对抗性选择上下文的设置，为此我们的第二个算法 CQB-Opt 实现了 $\mathcal{O}(\log^2 T)$ 的遗憾上界。最后，我们提供了实验结果，验证了我们的理论发现。
tldr: The paper introduces a contextual queueing bandit framework for scheduling jobs with unknown service rates, providing algorithms with regret bounds for stochastic and adversarial contexts. It develops a novel queue length regret decomposition framework using policy-switching queues.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个上下文排队bandit框架，用于在服务速率未知的情况下调度任务，并为随机和对抗性上下文提供了具有遗憾界限的算法。它开发了一种新颖的队列长度遗憾分解框架，使用了策略切换队列。

title: Towards Self-Optimizing Electron Microscope: Robust Tuning of Aberration Coefficients via Physics-Aware Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
summary: Realizing high-throughput aberration-corrected Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) exploration of atomic structures requires rapid tuning of multipole probe correctors while compensating for the inevitable drift of the optical column. While automated alignment routines exist, conventional approaches rely on serial, gradient-free searches (e.g., Nelder-Mead) that are sample-inefficient and struggle to correct multiple interacting parameters simultaneously. Conversely, emerging deep learning methods offer speed but often lack the flexibility to adapt to varying sample conditions without extensive retraining. Here, we introduce a Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization (MOBO) framework for rapid, data-efficient aberration correction. Importantly, this framework does not prescribe a single notion of image quality; instead, it enables user-defined, physically motivated reward formulations (e.g., symmetry-induced objectives) and uses Pareto fronts to expose the resulting trade-offs between competing experimental priorities. By using Gaussian Process regression to model the aberration landscape probabilistically, our workflow actively selects the most informative lens settings to evaluate next, rather than performing an exhaustive blind search. We demonstrate that this active learning loop is more robust than traditional optimization algorithms and effectively tunes focus, astigmatism, and higher-order aberrations. By balancing competing objectives, this approach enables "self-optimizing" microscopy by dynamically sustaining optimal performance during experiments.
summary_zh: 实现原子结构的高通量像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜(STEM)探索，需要快速调整多极探头校正器，同时补偿光学柱不可避免的漂移。虽然存在自动校准程序，但传统方法依赖于串行的、无梯度搜索(例如，Nelder-Mead算法)，其样本效率低下，并且难以同时校正多个相互作用的参数。相反，新兴的深度学习方法速度很快，但通常缺乏灵活性，无法在没有大量重新训练的情况下适应不同的样品条件。在此，我们引入了一种多目标贝叶斯优化(MOBO)框架，用于快速、数据高效的像差校正。重要的是，该框架不规定单一的图像质量概念；相反，它支持用户定义的、基于物理的奖励公式（例如，对称性诱导的目标），并使用帕累托前沿来揭示竞争性实验优先级之间的权衡。通过使用高斯过程回归来对像差形貌进行概率建模，我们的工作流程主动选择下一个要评估的最具信息量的镜头设置，而不是执行详尽的盲搜索。我们证明，这种主动学习循环比传统的优化算法更稳健，并且能有效地调整聚焦、像散和高阶像差。通过平衡竞争性目标，这种方法实现了“自优化”显微镜，从而在实验过程中动态地维持最佳性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization (MOBO) framework to automate and improve the aberration correction process in scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), enabling robust and efficient tuning of microscope lens settings by balancing competing objectives and adapting to varying sample conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个多目标贝叶斯优化 (MOBO) 框架，旨在自动化并改进扫描透射电子显微镜 (STEM) 中的像差校正过程。该框架通过平衡竞争目标并适应不同的样本条件，从而实现显微镜透镜设置的稳健而高效的调整。

title: Non-Invasive 3D Wound Measurement with RGB-D Imaging
summary: Chronic wound monitoring and management require accurate and efficient wound measurement methods. This paper presents a fast, non-invasive 3D wound measurement algorithm based on RGB-D imaging. The method combines RGB-D odometry with B-spline surface reconstruction to generate detailed 3D wound meshes, enabling automatic computation of clinically relevant wound measurements such as perimeter, surface area, and dimensions. We evaluated our system on realistic silicone wound phantoms and measured sub-millimetre 3D reconstruction accuracy compared with high-resolution ground-truth scans. The extracted measurements demonstrated low variability across repeated captures and strong agreement with manual assessments. The proposed pipeline also outperformed a state-of-the-art object-centric RGB-D reconstruction method while maintaining runtimes suitable for real-time clinical deployment. Our approach offers a promising tool for automated wound assessment in both clinical and remote healthcare settings.
summary_zh: 慢性伤口监测与管理需要准确高效的伤口测量方法。本文提出了一种基于RGB-D成像的快速、非侵入式3D伤口测量算法。该方法结合RGB-D里程计与B样条曲面重建，生成详细的3D伤口网格，从而可自动计算临床相关的伤口测量指标，如周长、表面积和尺寸。我们在逼真的硅胶伤口模型上评估了我们的系统，与高分辨率真值扫描相比，测量表明3D重建精度达到亚毫米级。提取的测量数据在重复捕获中表现出较低的变异性，并且与人工评估高度一致。所提出的流程也优于一种最先进的以目标为中心的RGB-D重建方法，同时保持了适用于实时临床部署的运行时间。我们的方法为临床和远程医疗环境下的自动化伤口评估提供了一种有前景的工具。
tldr: This paper presents a fast, non-invasive RGB-D imaging method for 3D wound measurement, offering automated computation of clinically relevant metrics with sub-millimeter accuracy and real-time performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于RGB-D成像的快速、非侵入式3D伤口测量方法，能够自动计算临床相关的伤口指标，且具有亚毫米级精度和实时性能。

title: OmegaUse: Building a General-Purpose GUI Agent for Autonomous Task Execution
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents show great potential for enabling foundation models to complete real-world tasks, revolutionizing human-computer interaction and improving human productivity. In this report, we present OmegaUse, a general-purpose GUI agent model for autonomous task execution on both mobile and desktop platforms, supporting computer-use and phone-use scenarios. Building an effective GUI agent model relies on two factors: (1) high-quality data and (2) effective training methods. To address these, we introduce a carefully engineered data-construction pipeline and a decoupled training paradigm. For data construction, we leverage rigorously curated open-source datasets and introduce a novel automated synthesis framework that integrates bottom-up autonomous exploration with top-down taxonomy-guided generation to create high-fidelity synthetic data. For training, to better leverage these data, we adopt a two-stage strategy: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to establish fundamental interaction syntax, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve spatial grounding and sequential planning. To balance computational efficiency with agentic reasoning capacity, OmegaUse is built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone. To evaluate cross-terminal capabilities in an offline setting, we introduce OS-Nav, a benchmark suite spanning multiple operating systems: ChiM-Nav, targeting Chinese Android mobile environments, and Ubu-Nav, focusing on routine desktop interactions on Ubuntu. Extensive experiments show that OmegaUse is highly competitive across established GUI benchmarks, achieving a state-of-the-art (SOTA) score of 96.3% on ScreenSpot-V2 and a leading 79.1% step success rate on AndroidControl. OmegaUse also performs strongly on OS-Nav, reaching 74.24% step success on ChiM-Nav and 55.9% average success on Ubu-Nav.
summary_zh: 图形用户界面 (GUI) 交互代理在使基础模型完成实际任务方面显示出巨大潜力，从而彻底改变人机交互并提高人类生产力。在本报告中，我们介绍OmegaUse，一种通用的GUI交互代理模型，用于在移动和桌面平台上的自主任务执行，支持计算机使用和手机使用场景。构建高效的GUI交互代理模型依赖两个因素：（1）高质量的数据和（2）有效的训练方法。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了一个精心设计的数据构建流程和一个解耦的训练范式。在数据构建方面，我们利用严格管理的高质量开源数据集，并引入了一种新颖的自动化合成框架，该框架集成了自下而上的自主探索和自上而下的分类法引导生成，以创建高保真度的合成数据。在训练方面，为了更好地利用这些数据，我们采用两阶段策略：首先进行监督微调 (SFT) 以建立基本的交互语法，然后进行分组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 以改善空间定位和顺序规划。为了平衡计算效率与代理推理能力，OmegaUse构建在混合专家 (MoE) 主干网络之上。为了在离线环境中评估跨终端能力，我们引入了OS-Nav，这是一套跨多个操作系统的基准测试套件：ChiM-Nav，以中国Android移动环境为目标，以及Ubu-Nav，侧重于Ubuntu上的日常桌面交互。大量实验表明，OmegaUse在已建立的GUI基准测试中具有很强的竞争力，在ScreenSpot-V2上实现了96.3%的最先进 (SOTA) 分数，并在AndroidControl上实现了领先的79.1%步成功率。OmegaUse在OS-Nav上也有出色的表现，在ChiM-Nav上达到了74.24%的步成功率，在Ubu-Nav上达到了55.9%的平均成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces OmegaUse, a general-purpose GUI agent leveraging a novel data construction pipeline and a decoupled training paradigm (SFT+GRPO) with a MoE backbone, achieving SOTA results on various GUI benchmarks and a newly proposed cross-terminal benchmark OS-Nav.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了OmegaUse，一种通用的GUI代理，它利用新颖的数据构建流程和解耦的训练模式（SFT+GRPO），并使用MoE骨干网络，在各种GUI基准测试和新提出的跨终端基准测试OS-Nav上实现了SOTA结果。

title: Advancing Open-source World Models
summary: We present LingBot-World, an open-sourced world simulator stemming from video generation. Positioned as a top-tier world model, LingBot-World offers the following features. (1) It maintains high fidelity and robust dynamics in a broad spectrum of environments, including realism, scientific contexts, cartoon styles, and beyond. (2) It enables a minute-level horizon while preserving contextual consistency over time, which is also known as "long-term memory". (3) It supports real-time interactivity, achieving a latency of under 1 second when producing 16 frames per second. We provide public access to the code and model in an effort to narrow the divide between open-source and closed-source technologies. We believe our release will empower the community with practical applications across areas like content creation, gaming, and robot learning.
summary_zh: 我们提出了LingBot-World，一个源于视频生成的开源世界模拟器。 LingBot-World定位为顶级的世界模型，具有以下特性。(1) 它在广泛的环境中保持高保真度和鲁棒的动力学特性，包括现实环境、科学情境、卡通风格及其他。(2) 它支持分钟级的时间跨度，同时保持上下文在时间上的一致性，即所谓的“长期记忆”。(3) 它支持实时交互，在每秒生成16帧的情况下，延迟低于1秒。 我们公开提供代码和模型，旨在缩小开源和闭源技术之间的差距。 我们相信我们的发布将为社区赋能，使其在内容创作、游戏和机器人学习等领域实现实践应用。
tldr: LingBot-World, an open-sourced world model built upon video generation, offers high fidelity, long-term contextual consistency, and real-time interactivity across diverse environments, aiming to bridge the gap between open and closed-source technologies.
tldr_zh: LingBot-World是一个开源的世界模型，基于视频生成技术，在多种环境中提供高保真度、长期上下文一致性和实时交互性，旨在弥合开源和闭源技术之间的差距。

title: One Step Is Enough: Dispersive MeanFlow Policy Optimization
summary:
Real-time robotic control demands fast action generation. However, existing generative policies based on diffusion and flow matching require multi-step
  sampling, fundamentally limiting deployment in time-critical scenarios. We propose Dispersive MeanFlow Policy Optimization (DMPO), a unified framework that
  enables true one-step generation through three key components: MeanFlow for mathematically-derived single-step inference without knowledge distillation,
  dispersive regularization to prevent representation collapse, and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning to surpass expert demonstrations. Experiments
  across RoboMimic manipulation and OpenAI Gym locomotion benchmarks demonstrate competitive or superior performance compared to multi-step baselines. With
  our lightweight model architecture and the three key algorithmic components working in synergy, DMPO exceeds real-time control requirements (>120Hz) with
  5-20x inference speedup, reaching hundreds of Hertz on high-performance GPUs. Physical deployment on a Franka-Emika-Panda robot validates real-world
  applicability.
summary_zh: 实时机器人控制需要快速的动作生成。然而，现有的基于扩散和流匹配的生成策略需要多步采样，从根本上限制了其在时间关键型场景中的部署。我们提出了离散平均流策略优化（DMPO），一种统一框架，可以通过三个关键组件实现真正的单步生成：用于数学推导的单步推理且无需知识蒸馏的平均流，防止表征崩溃的离散正则化，以及超越专家演示的强化学习（RL）微调。在RoboMimic操作和OpenAI Gym运动基准测试中的实验表明，与多步基线相比，该方法具有竞争力或更优越的性能。凭借我们轻量级的模型架构以及协同工作的三大关键算法组件，DMPO超越了实时控制的要求(>120Hz)，实现了5-20倍的推理加速，在高性能GPU上达到了数百赫兹。在Franka-Emika-Panda机器人上的物理部署验证了其在现实世界中的适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces Dispersive MeanFlow Policy Optimization (DMPO), a novel one-step generation method for real-time robotic control using reinforcement learning, achieving significant speedups compared to multi-step approaches and demonstrating real-world applicability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为分散均值流策略优化(DMPO)的新型单步生成方法，该方法利用强化学习进行实时机器人控制，与多步方法相比，实现了显著的加速，并展示了实际应用。

title: MeCo: Enhancing LLM-Empowered Multi-Robot Collaboration via Similar Task Memoization
summary: Multi-robot systems have been widely deployed in real-world applications, providing significant improvements in efficiency and reductions in labor costs. However, most existing multi-robot collaboration methods rely on extensive task-specific training, which limits their adaptability to new or diverse scenarios. Recent research leverages the language understanding and reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to enable more flexible collaboration without specialized training. Yet, current LLM-empowered approaches remain inefficient: when confronted with identical or similar tasks, they must replan from scratch because they omit task-level similarities. To address this limitation, we propose MeCo, a similarity-aware multi-robot collaboration framework that applies the principle of ``cache and reuse'' (a.k.a., memoization) to reduce redundant computation. Unlike simple task repetition, identifying and reusing solutions for similar but not identical tasks is far more challenging, particularly in multi-robot settings. To this end, MeCo introduces a new similarity testing method that retrieves previously solved tasks with high relevance, enabling effective plan reuse without re-invoking LLMs. Furthermore, we present MeCoBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate performance on similar-task collaboration scenarios. Experimental results show that MeCo substantially reduces planning costs and improves success rates compared with state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统已广泛部署于实际应用中，在效率提升和劳动力成本降低方面带来了显著改善。然而，现有的大多数多机器人协作方法依赖于大量的特定任务训练，这限制了它们对新场景或多样化场景的适应性。最近的研究利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 的语言理解和推理能力，从而能够在无需专门训练的情况下实现更灵活的协作。然而，目前基于LLM的方法仍然效率低下：当面临相同或相似的任务时，它们必须从头开始重新规划，因为它们忽略了任务层面的相似性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种相似性感知的多机器人协作框架 MeCo，该框架应用“缓存和重用”（又称备忘录化）的原则来减少冗余计算。与简单的任务重复不同，识别和重用相似但不完全相同的任务的解决方案更具挑战性，尤其是在多机器人环境中。为此，MeCo 引入了一种新的相似性测试方法，可以检索先前解决且具有高度相关性的任务，从而无需重新调用 LLM 即可实现有效的方案重用。此外，我们提出了 MeCoBench，这是第一个旨在评估类似任务协作场景性能的基准。实验结果表明，与最先进的方法相比，MeCo 显著降低了规划成本并提高了成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces MeCo, a framework that enhances LLM-empowered multi-robot collaboration by memoizing and reusing solutions for similar tasks, improving efficiency and success rates. It also introduces MeCoBench for evaluating similar-task collaboration.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MeCo，一个通过记忆和重用相似任务的解决方案来增强LLM赋能的多机器人协作框架，从而提高效率和成功率。它还介绍了用于评估类似任务协作的MeCoBench。

title: Vibro-Sense: Robust Vibration-based Impulse Response Localization and Trajectory Tracking for Robotic Hands
summary: Rich contact perception is crucial for robotic manipulation, yet traditional tactile skins remain expensive and complex to integrate. This paper presents a scalable alternative: high-accuracy whole-body touch localization via vibro-acoustic sensing. By equipping a robotic hand with seven low-cost piezoelectric microphones and leveraging an Audio Spectrogram Transformer, we decode the vibrational signatures generated during physical interaction. Extensive evaluation across stationary and dynamic tasks reveals a localization error of under 5 mm in static conditions. Furthermore, our analysis highlights the distinct influence of material properties: stiff materials (e.g., metal) excel in impulse response localization due to sharp, high-bandwidth responses, whereas textured materials (e.g., wood) provide superior friction-based features for trajectory tracking. The system demonstrates robustness to the robot's own motion, maintaining effective tracking even during active operation. Our primary contribution is demonstrating that complex physical contact dynamics can be effectively decoded from simple vibrational signals, offering a viable pathway to widespread, affordable contact perception in robotics. To accelerate research, we provide our full datasets, models, and experimental setups as open-source resources.
summary_zh: 丰富的触觉感知对于机器人操作至关重要，然而传统的触觉皮肤仍然价格昂贵且集成复杂。本文提出了一种可扩展的替代方案：通过振动声学传感实现高精度全身触摸定位。我们通过在机械手上装备七个低成本压电麦克风，并利用音频频谱图转换器解码物理交互过程中产生的振动特征。在静态和动态任务中的广泛评估表明，在静态条件下定位误差小于5毫米。 此外，我们的分析突出了材料属性的独特影响：刚性材料（例如，金属）由于其尖锐、高带宽的响应，在冲击响应定位方面表现出色；而纹理材料（例如，木材）为轨迹跟踪提供了卓越的基于摩擦力的特征。该系统对机器人自身的运动具有鲁棒性，即使在主动操作期间也能保持有效的跟踪。 我们的主要贡献是证明了可以从简单的振动信号中有效地解码复杂的物理接触动力学，为机器人技术中广泛、经济的触觉感知提供了一条可行的途径。为了加速研究，我们将完整的 datasets, models 和实验装置作为开源资源提供。
tldr: The paper presents a low-cost, high-accuracy vibro-acoustic sensing system for robotic hands that enables touch localization and trajectory tracking by decoding vibrational signatures. They open-source their datasets, models, and setups.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种低成本、高精度的机器人手振动声学传感系统，通过解码振动信号实现触摸定位和轨迹跟踪。他们开源了他们的数据集、模型和实验装置。

title: STORM: Slot-based Task-aware Object-centric Representation for robotic Manipulation
summary: Visual foundation models provide strong perceptual features for robotics, but their dense representations lack explicit object-level structure, limiting robustness and contractility in manipulation tasks. We propose STORM (Slot-based Task-aware Object-centric Representation for robotic Manipulation), a lightweight object-centric adaptation module that augments frozen visual foundation models with a small set of semantic-aware slots for robotic manipulation. Rather than retraining large backbones, STORM employs a multi-phase training strategy: object-centric slots are first stabilized through visual--semantic pretraining using language embeddings, then jointly adapted with a downstream manipulation policy. This staged learning prevents degenerate slot formation and preserves semantic consistency while aligning perception with task objectives. Experiments on object discovery benchmarks and simulated manipulation tasks show that STORM improves generalization to visual distractors, and control performance compared to directly using frozen foundation model features or training object-centric representations end-to-end. Our results highlight multi-phase adaptation as an efficient mechanism for transforming generic foundation model features into task-aware object-centric representations for robotic control.
summary_zh: 视觉基础模型为机器人技术提供了强大的感知特征，但其密集表示缺乏明确的物体级别结构，限制了操作任务中的鲁棒性和可控性。我们提出了STORM (基于槽位的任务感知、以物体为中心的机器人操作表示)，这是一个轻量级的物体中心适配模块，它通过一小部分语义感知的槽位来增强冻结的视觉基础模型，用于机器人操作。STORM没有重新训练大型骨干网络，而是采用了一种多阶段训练策略：首先通过使用语言嵌入的视觉-语义预训练来稳定物体中心槽位，然后将其与下游操作策略联合适配。这种分阶段的学习方法可以防止退化的槽位形成，并保持语义一致性，同时将感知与任务目标对齐。在物体发现基准和模拟操作任务上的实验表明，与直接使用冻结的基础模型特征或端到端训练以物体为中心的表示相比，STORM提高了对视觉干扰的泛化能力，并提升了控制性能。我们的结果表明，多阶段适配是一种有效的机制，可以将通用基础模型特征转化为用于机器人控制的任务感知、以物体为中心的表示。
tldr: The paper introduces STORM, a lightweight module that adapts frozen visual foundation models into task-aware, object-centric representations using a multi-phase training strategy for improved robotic manipulation and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为STORM的轻量级模块，该模块使用多阶段训练策略将冻结的视觉基础模型调整为具有任务意识、以对象为中心的表示，从而改进机器人操作和泛化能力。

title: Demonstration-Free Robotic Control via LLM Agents
summary: Robotic manipulation has increasingly adopted vision-language-action (VLA) models, which achieve strong performance but typically require task-specific demonstrations and fine-tuning, and often generalize poorly under domain shift. We investigate whether general-purpose large language model (LLM) agent frameworks, originally developed for software engineering, can serve as an alternative control paradigm for embodied manipulation. We introduce FAEA (Frontier Agent as Embodied Agent), which applies an LLM agent framework directly to embodied manipulation without modification. Using the same iterative reasoning that enables software agents to debug code, FAEA enables embodied agents to reason through manipulation strategies. We evaluate an unmodified frontier agent, Claude Agent SDK, across the LIBERO, ManiSkill3, and MetaWorld benchmarks. With privileged environment state access, FAEA achieves success rates of 84.9%, 85.7%, and 96%, respectively. This level of task success approaches that of VLA models trained with less than 100 demonstrations per task, without requiring demonstrations or fine-tuning. With one round of human feedback as an optional optimization, performance increases to 88.2% on LIBERO. This demonstration-free capability has immediate practical value: FAEA can autonomously explore novel scenarios in simulation and generate successful trajectories for training data augmentation in embodied learning. Our results indicate that general-purpose agents are sufficient for a class of manipulation tasks dominated by deliberative, task-level planning. This opens a path for robotics systems to leverage actively maintained agent infrastructure and benefit directly from ongoing advances in frontier models. Code is available at https://github.com/robiemusketeer/faea-sim
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人操作越来越多地采用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，这些模型表现出色，但通常需要特定于任务的演示和微调，并且在领域迁移下泛化能力较差。我们研究了最初为软件工程开发的通用大型语言模型（LLM）代理框架，是否可以作为具身操作的替代控制范式。我们引入了FAEA（基于前沿代理的具身代理），它将LLM代理框架直接应用于具身操作而无需修改。利用与软件代理调试代码相同的迭代推理能力，FAEA使具身代理能够推理操作策略。我们使用未经修改的前沿代理，Claude Agent SDK，在LIBERO、ManiSkill3和MetaWorld基准测试中进行了评估。在具备特权环境状态访问权限的情况下，FAEA分别实现了84.9%、85.7%和96%的成功率。这种任务成功水平接近于使用每个任务少于100个演示训练的VLA模型，而无需演示或微调。通过一轮人工反馈作为可选优化，LIBERO上的性能提高到88.2%。这种无需演示的能力具有直接的实用价值：FAEA能够自主探索模拟中的新场景，并生成成功的轨迹，用于具身学习中的训练数据增强。我们的结果表明，通用代理足以胜任一类由深思熟虑的、任务级规划主导的操作任务。这为机器人系统开辟了一条道路，使其能够利用积极维护的代理基础设施，并直接受益于前沿模型的持续进步。代码可在https://github.com/robiemusketeer/faea-sim获取。
tldr: This paper introduces FAEA, an LLM agent framework for robotic manipulation that achieves comparable performance to VLA models, without requiring task-specific demonstrations or fine-tuning, and suggests using it for autonomous exploration and training data augmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 FAEA，一个用于机器人操作的 LLM 代理框架，它在不需要特定任务演示或微调的情况下，实现了与 VLA 模型相当的性能，并建议将其用于自主探索和训练数据增强。

title: Tactile-Force Alignment in Vision-Language-Action Models for Force-aware Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as powerful generalists for robotic manipulation. However, due to their predominant reliance on visual modalities, they fundamentally lack the physical intuition required for contact-rich tasks that require precise force regulation and physical reasoning. Existing attempts to incorporate vision-based tactile sensing into VLA models typically treat tactile inputs as auxiliary visual textures, thereby overlooking the underlying correlation between surface deformation and interaction dynamics. To bridge this gap, we propose a paradigm shift from tactile-vision alignment to tactile-force alignment. Here, we introduce TaF-VLA, a framework that explicitly grounds high-dimensional tactile observations in physical interaction forces. To facilitate this, we develop an automated tactile-force data acquisition device and curate the TaF-Dataset, comprising over 10 million synchronized tactile observations, 6-axis force/torque, and matrix force map. To align sequential tactile observations with interaction forces, the central component of our approach is the Tactile-Force Adapter (TaF-Adapter), a tactile sensor encoder that extracts discretized latent information for encoding tactile observations. This mechanism ensures that the learned representations capture history-dependent, noise-insensitive physical dynamics rather than static visual textures. Finally, we integrate this force-aligned encoder into a VLA backbone. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that TaF-VLA policy significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tactile-vision-aligned and vision-only baselines on contact-rich tasks, verifying its ability to achieve robust, force-aware manipulation through cross-modal physical reasoning.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近作为机器人操作的强大通用模型涌现。然而，由于它们主要依赖视觉模态，因此从根本上缺乏需要精确力调节和物理推理的富接触任务所需的物理直觉。现有将基于视觉的触觉传感整合到VLA模型中的尝试通常将触觉输入视为辅助视觉纹理，从而忽略了表面形变和交互动力学之间的潜在关联。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种范式转变，即从触觉-视觉对齐到触觉-力对齐。在此，我们引入TaF-VLA，这是一个将高维触觉观察显式地与物理交互力关联的框架。为了实现这一点，我们开发了一种自动化触觉-力数据采集设备，并构建了TaF-数据集，其中包含超过1000万个同步的触觉观察、六轴力/力矩和矩阵力图。为了将连续的触觉观察与交互力对齐，我们方法的核心组件是触觉-力适配器（TaF-Adapter），这是一个触觉传感器编码器，用于提取离散化的潜在信息以编码触觉观察。这种机制确保了学习到的表征能够捕捉到历史依赖的、噪声不敏感的物理动力学，而非静态的视觉纹理。最后，我们将这种力对齐编码器集成到VLA骨干网络中。大量的真实世界实验表明，TaF-VLA策略在富接触任务上显著优于最先进的触觉-视觉对齐和纯视觉基线，验证了其通过跨模态物理推理实现稳健的、力感知的操作能力。
tldr: The paper introduces TaF-VLA, a framework for force-aware robotic manipulation that bridges the gap between tactile sensing and physical interaction forces by aligning tactile observations with force data and integrating it into a VLA model, demonstrating improved performance on contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TaF-VLA，一个用于力感知的机器人操作框架，通过将触觉观察与力数据对齐并将其集成到VLA模型中，弥合了触觉传感和物理交互力之间的差距，并在接触丰富的任务中展示了更高的性能。

title: Shallow-π: Knowledge Distillation for Flow-based VLAs
summary: The growing demand for real-time robotic deployment necessitates fast and on-device inference for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Within the VLA literature, efficiency has been extensively studied at the token level, such as visual token pruning. In contrast, systematic transformer layer reduction has received limited attention and, to the best of our knowledge, has not been explored for flow-based VLA models under knowledge distillation. In this work, we propose Shallow-pi, a principled knowledge distillation framework that aggressively reduces the transformer depth of both the VLM backbone and the flow-based action head, compressing the model from 18 to 6 layers. Shallow-pi achieves over two times faster inference with less than one percent absolute drop in success rate on standard manipulation benchmarks, establishing state-of-the-art performance among reduced VLA models. Crucially, we validate our approach through industrial-scale real-world experiments on Jetson Orin and Jetson Thor across multiple robot platforms, including humanoid systems, in complex and dynamic manipulation scenarios.
summary_zh: 对于视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，实时机器人部署的需求日益增长，这要求快速且在设备端进行推理。在VLA文献中，效率已在token层面得到了广泛研究，例如视觉token剪枝。相比之下，系统性的Transformer层缩减受到的关注有限，并且据我们所知，尚未在基于流的VLA模型中，通过知识蒸馏进行探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了Shallow-pi，一个有原则的知识蒸馏框架，可以大幅减少VLM骨干网络和基于流的动作头的Transformer深度，从而将模型从18层压缩到6层。Shallow-pi在标准操作基准测试上，以小于百分之一的绝对成功率下降，实现了超过两倍的推理速度，从而在精简VLA模型中建立了最先进的性能。至关重要的是，我们在Jetson Orin和Jetson Thor上，跨多个机器人平台（包括人形机器人系统）进行了工业规模的真实世界实验，验证了我们方法在复杂和动态操作场景中的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces Shallow-pi, a knowledge distillation framework for compressing flow-based VLA models, achieving faster inference speeds with minimal performance loss and tested on real-world robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Shallow-pi，一个用于压缩基于流的 VLA 模型的知识蒸馏框架，在实际机器人平台上测试，实现了更快的推理速度，且性能损失最小。

title: TouchGuide: Inference-Time Steering of Visuomotor Policies via Touch Guidance
summary: Fine-grained and contact-rich manipulation remain challenging for robots, largely due to the underutilization of tactile feedback. To address this, we introduce TouchGuide, a novel cross-policy visuo-tactile fusion paradigm that fuses modalities within a low-dimensional action space. Specifically, TouchGuide operates in two stages to guide a pre-trained diffusion or flow-matching visuomotor policy at inference time. First, the policy produces a coarse, visually-plausible action using only visual inputs during early sampling. Second, a task-specific Contact Physical Model (CPM) provides tactile guidance to steer and refine the action, ensuring it aligns with realistic physical contact conditions. Trained through contrastive learning on limited expert demonstrations, the CPM provides a tactile-informed feasibility score to steer the sampling process toward refined actions that satisfy physical contact constraints. Furthermore, to facilitate TouchGuide training with high-quality and cost-effective data, we introduce TacUMI, a data collection system. TacUMI achieves a favorable trade-off between precision and affordability; by leveraging rigid fingertips, it obtains direct tactile feedback, thereby enabling the collection of reliable tactile data. Extensive experiments on five challenging contact-rich tasks, such as shoe lacing and chip handover, show that TouchGuide consistently and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art visuo-tactile policies.
