In this work, we focus on estimating the objective function coefficients of a combinatorial optimization problem. Our study demonstrates that fluctuations in perturbation intensity occurring during the learning phase can lead to ineffective training, by establishing a theoretical link to the notion of solution stability in combinatorial optimization. We propose addressing this issue by introducing a regularization of the estimated cost vectors which improves the robustness and reliability of the learning process, as demonstrated by extensive numerical experiments.
summary_zh: 决策导向学习通过训练模型以直接提升决策质量，而非仅关注预测准确率，来整合预测建模和组合优化。在组合优化问题中进行微分运算是一个核心挑战，而最近的方法通过引入基于扰动的近似来解决这一难题。在这项工作中，我们专注于估计组合优化问题的目标函数系数。我们的研究表明，学习阶段中扰动强度的波动可能导致无效训练，这可以通过建立与组合优化中解的稳定性概念的理论联系来解释。 我们提出通过对估计的成本向量进行正则化来解决这个问题，这可以提高学习过程的鲁棒性和可靠性，并通过大量的数值实验得到验证。
tldr: This paper addresses instability in decision-focused learning caused by perturbation intensity fluctuations and proposes a cost regularization method to improve robustness. The application domain is combinatorial optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文解决了决策导向学习中由扰动强度波动引起的不稳定性问题，并提出了一种成本正则化方法来提高鲁棒性。应用领域是组合优化。

title: Differentiable Knapsack and Top-k Operators via Dynamic Programming
summary: Knapsack and Top-k operators are useful for selecting discrete subsets of variables. However, their integration into neural networks is challenging as they are piecewise constant, yielding gradients that are zero almost everywhere. In this paper, we propose a unified framework casting these operators as dynamic programs, and derive differentiable relaxations by smoothing the underlying recursions. On the algorithmic side, we develop efficient parallel algorithms supporting both deterministic and stochastic forward passes, and vector-Jacobian products for the backward pass. On the theoretical side, we prove that Shannon entropy is the unique regularization choice yielding permutation-equivariant operators, and characterize regularizers inducing sparse selections. Finally, on the experimental side, we demonstrate our framework on a decision-focused learning benchmark, a constrained dynamic assortment RL problem, and an extension of discrete VAEs.
summary_zh: 背包和前k个算子对于选择变量的离散子集非常有用。然而，由于它们是分段常数函数，导致几乎处处梯度为零，因此将它们集成到神经网络中具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一个统一的框架，将这些算子建模为动态规划，并通过平滑底层递归来推导可微的松弛表示。在算法方面，我们开发了高效的并行算法，支持确定性和随机的前向传播，以及用于反向传播的向量-雅可比积。在理论方面，我们证明了香农熵是产生置换等变算子的唯一正则化选择，并刻画了诱导稀疏选择的正则化项。最后，在实验方面，我们在一个以决策为中心的学习基准、一个约束动态分类强化学习问题以及离散VAE的扩展上展示了我们的框架。
tldr: This paper introduces differentiable relaxations of Knapsack and Top-k operators using dynamic programming, enabling their integration into neural networks and demonstrating applications in decision-focused learning, constrained RL, and discrete VAEs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用动态规划实现Knapsack和Top-k算子的可微松弛方法，使其能够集成到神经网络中，并在决策导向学习、约束强化学习和离散VAE等领域展示了应用。

title: Mixed-Precision Training and Compilation for RRAM-based Computing-in-Memory Accelerators
summary: Computing-in-Memory (CIM) accelerators are a promising solution for accelerating Machine Learning (ML) workloads, as they perform Matrix-Vector Multiplications (MVMs) on crossbar arrays directly in memory. Although the bit widths of the crossbar inputs and cells are very limited, most CIM compilers do not support quantization below 8 bit. As a result, a single MVM requires many compute cycles, and weights cannot be efficiently stored in a single crossbar cell. To address this problem, we propose a mixed-precision training and compilation framework for CIM architectures. The biggest challenge is the massive search space, that makes it difficult to find good quantization parameters. This is why we introduce a reinforcement learning-based strategy to find suitable quantization configurations that balance latency and accuracy. In the best case, our approach achieves up to a 2.48x speedup over existing state-of-the-art solutions, with an accuracy loss of only 0.086 %.
summary_zh: 存储器内计算(CIM)加速器是一种很有前景的机器学习(ML)工作负载加速解决方案，因为它们直接在内存中的交叉开关阵列上执行矩阵-向量乘法(MVM)。尽管交叉开关输入和单元的位宽非常有限，但大多数CIM编译器不支持低于8位的量化。因此，单个MVM需要许多计算周期，并且权重无法有效地存储在单个交叉开关单元中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种针对CIM架构的混合精度训练和编译框架。最大的挑战是庞大的搜索空间，这使得找到良好的量化参数变得困难。因此，我们引入了一种基于强化学习的策略来寻找适合的量化配置，从而平衡延迟和准确性。在最佳情况下，我们的方法比现有的最先进解决方案实现了高达2.48倍的加速，而准确度损失仅为0.086％。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning-based mixed-precision training and compilation framework for Computing-in-Memory (CIM) accelerators, achieving significant speedups with minimal accuracy loss.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的混合精度训练和编译框架，用于内存计算（CIM）加速器，实现了显著的加速效果，同时保持了极低的精度损失。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Composition of Quantum Circuit Optimisation Passes
summary: Many quantum software development kits provide a suite of circuit optimisation passes. These passes have been highly optimised and tested in isolation. However, the order in which they are applied is left to the user, or else defined in general-purpose default pass sequences. While general-purpose sequences miss opportunities for optimisation which are particular to individual circuits, designing pass sequences bespoke to particular circuits requires exceptional knowledge about quantum circuit design and optimisation. Here we propose and demonstrate training a reinforcement learning agent to compose optimisation-pass sequences. In particular the agent's action space consists of passes for two-qubit gate count reduction used in default PyTKET pass sequences. For the circuits in our diverse test set, the (mean, median) fraction of two-qubit gates removed by the agent is $(57.7\%, \ 56.7 \%)$, compared to $(41.8 \%, \ 50.0 \%)$ for the next best default pass sequence.
summary_zh: 许多量子软件开发工具包提供了一套电路优化流程。这些流程经过高度优化，并在隔离环境中进行了测试。然而，它们的应用顺序通常留给用户自行选择，或者在通用的默认流程序列中定义。虽然通用序列会错过针对特定电路的优化机会，但为特定电路设计定制的流程序列需要量子电路设计和优化方面的专业知识。在此，我们提出并演示训练一个强化学习代理来组合优化流程序列。特别地，该代理的动作空间由PyTKET默认流程序列中使用的用于减少双量子比特门数量的流程组成。对于我们多样化的测试集中的电路，该代理移除的双量子比特门的(平均值，中位数)百分比为 $(57.7\%, \ 56.7 \%)$，而次优的默认流程序列的对应值为 $(41.8 \%, \ 50.0\%)$。
tldr: This paper uses reinforcement learning to create custom sequences of quantum circuit optimization passes, achieving better two-qubit gate reduction than default methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用强化学习来创建定制的量子电路优化序列，实现了比默认方法更好的双量子比特门减少效果。

title: Cascaded Transfer: Learning Many Tasks under Budget Constraints
summary: Many-Task Learning refers to the setting where a large number of related tasks need to be learned, the exact relationships between tasks are not known. We introduce the Cascaded Transfer Learning, a novel many-task transfer learning paradigm where information (e.g. model parameters) cascades hierarchically through tasks that are learned by individual models of the same class, while respecting given budget constraints. The cascade is organized as a rooted tree that specifies the order in which tasks are learned and refined. We design a cascaded transfer mechanism deployed over a minimum spanning tree structure that connects the tasks according to a suitable distance measure, and allocates the available training budget along its branches. Experiments on synthetic and real many-task settings show that the resulting method enables more accurate and cost effective adaptation across large task collections compared to alternative approaches.
summary_zh: 多任务学习指的是一种需要学习大量相关任务的设定，但任务之间的确切关系未知。我们引入了级联迁移学习，这是一种新颖的多任务迁移学习范式，其中信息（例如模型参数）在相同类别各个模型学习的任务之间以分层方式级联传递，同时遵守给定的预算约束。该级联被组织成一个有根树，该树指定了任务的学习和精炼顺序。我们设计了一种部署在最小生成树结构上的级联传递机制，该结构根据合适的距离度量标准连接任务，并沿其分支分配可用的训练预算。在合成和真实多任务设置下的实验表明，与替代方法相比，该方法能够在大规模任务集合中实现更准确且更具成本效益的自适应。
tldr: The paper introduces Cascaded Transfer Learning, a novel approach for many-task learning under budget constraints, using a hierarchical tree structure to transfer information between tasks. Experiments show improved accuracy and cost-effectiveness compared to other methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为级联迁移学习的新方法，用于在预算约束下进行多任务学习，使用分层树结构在任务之间传输信息。实验表明，与其它方法相比，该方法提高了准确性和成本效益。

title: Learning to Optimize Job Shop Scheduling Under Structural Uncertainty
summary: The Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP), under various forms of manufacturing uncertainty, has recently attracted considerable research attention. Most existing studies focus on parameter uncertainty, such as variable processing times, and typically adopt the actor-critic framework. In this paper, we explore a different but prevalent form of uncertainty in JSSP: structural uncertainty. Structural uncertainty arises when a job may follow one of several routing paths, and the selection is determined not by policy, but by situational factors (e.g., the quality of intermediate products) that cannot be known in advance. Existing methods struggle to address this challenge due to incorrect credit assignment: a high-quality action may be unfairly penalized if it is followed by a time-consuming path. To address this problem, we propose a novel method named UP-AAC. In contrast to conventional actor-critic methods, UP-AAC employs an asymmetric architecture. While its actor receives a standard stochastic state, the critic is crucially provided with a deterministic state reconstructed in hindsight. This design allows the critic to learn a more accurate value function, which in turn provides a lower-variance policy gradient to the actor, leading to more stable learning. In addition, we design an attention-based Uncertainty Perception Model (UPM) to enhance the actor's scheduling decisions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in reducing makespan on benchmark instances.
summary_zh: 在各种制造不确定性的形式下，车间调度问题（JSSP）最近引起了相当多的研究关注。大多数现有研究集中于参数不确定性，例如可变的处理时间，并且通常采用 Actor-Critic 框架。在本文中，我们探讨了 JSSP 中一种不同但普遍存在的不确定性形式：结构不确定性。当作业可能遵循多个路由路径之一时，就会出现结构不确定性，并且选择不是由策略决定，而是由情境因素（例如，中间产品的质量）决定，这些因素无法提前知晓。现有的方法难以应对这一挑战，因为错误的信用分配：如果一个高质量的动作后跟一条耗时的路径，它可能会受到不公平的惩罚。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为 UP-AAC 的新方法。与传统的 Actor-Critic 方法相比，UP-AAC 采用了一种非对称架构。虽然其 Actor 接收标准的随机状态，但至关重要的是，Critic 被提供了事后重建的确定性状态。这种设计使 Critic 能够学习更准确的价值函数，进而为 Actor 提供更低方差的策略梯度，从而实现更稳定的学习。此外，我们设计了一个基于注意力机制的不确定性感知模型（UPM），以增强 Actor 的调度决策。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在基准实例上减少完工时间方面优于现有方法。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel asymmetric actor-critic method (UP-AAC) with an uncertainty perception model (UPM) to address job-shop scheduling problems under structural uncertainty, outperforming existing approaches in reducing makespan.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的非对称Actor-Critic方法（UP-AAC），带有不确定性感知模型（UPM），旨在解决结构不确定性下的Job-Shop调度问题，并在缩短完工时间方面优于现有方法。

title: Expected Improvement via Gradient Norms
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a principled approach for optimizing expensive black-box functions, with Expected Improvement (EI) being one of the most widely used acquisition functions. Despite its empirical success, EI is known to be overly exploitative and can converge to suboptimal stationary points. We propose Expected Improvement via Gradient Norms (EI-GN), a novel acquisition function that applies the improvement principle to a gradient-aware auxiliary objective, thereby promoting sampling in regions that are both high-performing and approaching first-order stationarity. EI-GN relies on gradient observations used to learn gradient-enhanced surrogate models that enable principled gradient inference from function evaluations. We derive a tractable closed-form expression for EI-GN that allows efficient optimization and show that the proposed acquisition is consistent with the improvement-based acquisition framework. Empirical evaluations on standard BO benchmarks demonstrate that EI-GN yields consistent improvements against standard baselines. We further demonstrate applicability of EI-GN to control policy learning problems.
summary_zh:
以下是翻译结果：

贝叶斯优化 (BO) 是一种优化昂贵的黑盒函数的原则性方法，其中期望改善 (EI) 是最广泛使用的采集函数之一。尽管 EI 在实践中取得了成功，但已知其过度利用，并且可能收敛到次优驻点。 我们提出基于梯度范数的期望改善 (EI-GN)，这是一种新颖的采集函数，它将改善原则应用于感知梯度的辅助目标，从而促进在高性能且接近一阶平稳区域中的采样。EI-GN 依赖于用于学习梯度增强代理模型的梯度观测，从而能够从函数评估中进行基于原则的梯度推断。我们推导出了 EI-GN 的易处理的闭式表达式，从而可以进行高效优化，并表明所提出的采集与基于改善的采集框架一致。 在标准 BO 基准上的经验评估表明，EI-GN 针对标准基线产生了一致的改进。 我们进一步证明了 EI-GN 在控制策略学习问题中的适用性。
tldr: The paper proposes Expected Improvement via Gradient Norms (EI-GN), a novel Bayesian Optimization acquisition function that uses gradient information to improve exploration and avoid suboptimal solutions. It demonstrates improvements over standard BO benchmarks and control policy learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为梯度范数期望提升 (EI-GN) 的新型贝叶斯优化采集函数，该函数利用梯度信息来改善探索并避免次优解。结果表明，它在标准 BO 基准和控制策略学习方面有所改进。

title: PHDME: Physics-Informed Diffusion Models without Explicit Governing Equations
summary: Diffusion models provide expressive priors for forecasting trajectories of dynamical systems, but are typically unreliable in the sparse data regime. Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) improves reliability in such settings; however, most methods require \emph{explicit governing equations} during training, which are often only partially known due to complex and nonlinear dynamics. We introduce \textbf{PHDME}, a port-Hamiltonian diffusion framework designed for \emph{sparse observations} and \emph{incomplete physics}. PHDME leverages port-Hamiltonian structural prior but does not require full knowledge of the closed-form governing equations. Our approach first trains a Gaussian process distributed Port-Hamiltonian system (GP-dPHS) on limited observations to capture an energy-based representation of the dynamics. The GP-dPHS is then used to generate a physically consistent artificial dataset for diffusion training, and to inform the diffusion model with a structured physics residual loss. After training, the diffusion model acts as an amortized sampler and forecaster for fast trajectory generation. Finally, we apply split conformal calibration to provide uncertainty statements for the generated predictions. Experiments on PDE benchmarks and a real-world spring system show improved accuracy and physical consistency under data scarcity.
summary_zh: 扩散模型为动力系统轨迹预测提供了富有表现力的先验，但通常在稀疏数据情况下不可靠。物理信息机器学习 (PIML) 改善了此类场景中的可靠性；然而，大多数方法需要在训练期间使用\emph{显式控制方程}，而由于复杂和非线性动力学，这些方程通常只是部分已知。我们引入了 \textbf{PHDME}，一个为\emph{稀疏观测}和\emph{不完整物理}设计的端口-哈密顿扩散框架。 PHDME 利用端口-哈密顿结构先验，但不需要完全了解闭式控制方程。我们的方法首先在有限的观测数据上训练一个高斯过程分布式端口-哈密顿系统 (GP-dPHS)，以捕获动力学的基于能量的表示。然后，GP-dPHS 用于生成一个物理一致的人工数据集，用于扩散训练，并使用结构化的物理残差损失来通知扩散模型。训练后，扩散模型充当摊销采样器和预测器，用于快速轨迹生成。最后，我们应用分裂共形校准，为生成的预测提供不确定性声明。在偏微分方程基准和真实世界的弹簧系统上的实验表明，在数据稀缺的情况下，准确性和物理一致性均得到了改善。
tldr: The paper introduces PHDME, a physics-informed diffusion model that leverages a port-Hamiltonian structural prior without requiring explicit governing equations, improving trajectory forecasting accuracy and physical consistency in sparse data regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PHDME，一种物理信息扩散模型，它利用port-Hamiltonian结构先验，无需显式控制方程，从而提高了稀疏数据情况下轨迹预测的准确性和物理一致性。

title: Macro-Scale Electrostatic Origami Motor
summary: Foldable robots have been an active area of robotics research due to their high volume-to-mass ratio, easy packability, and shape adaptability. For locomotion, previously developed foldable robots have either embedded linear actuators in, or attached non-folding rotary motors to, their structure. Further, those actuators directly embedded in the structure of the folding medium all contributed to linear or folding motion, not to continuous rotary motion. On the macro-scale there has not yet been a folding continuous rotary actuator. This paper details the development and testing of the first macro-scale origami rotary motor that can be folded flat, and then unfurled to operate. Using corona discharge for torque production, the prototype motor achieved an expansion ratio of 2.5:1, reached a top speed of 1440 rpm when driven at -29 kV, and exhibited a maximum output torque over 0.15 mN m with an active component torque density of 0.04 Nm/kg.
summary_zh: 可折叠机器人因其高体积质量比、易于包装和形状适应性，一直是机器人研究的热点领域。在运动方面，此前开发的可折叠机器人要么在其结构中嵌入线性致动器，要么在其结构上连接非折叠旋转电机。而且，那些直接嵌入折叠介质结构中的致动器都用于产生线性或折叠运动，而不是连续旋转运动。在宏观尺度上，尚未出现可折叠的连续旋转致动器。本文详细介绍了首个宏观尺度折纸旋转电机的开发和测试，该电机可以折叠成扁平状，然后展开以运行。该原型电机利用电晕放电产生扭矩，实现了2.5:1的膨胀比，在-29 kV的电压下达到最高1440 rpm的转速，并表现出超过0.15 mN m的最大输出扭矩，其有源部件扭矩密度为0.04 Nm/kg。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel macro-scale, foldable origami rotary motor powered by corona discharge, capable of continuous rotation, unlike previous foldable robots with linear or non-folding rotary actuators.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型的宏观尺度可折叠折纸旋转电机，该电机由电晕放电驱动，能够连续旋转。与之前采用线性或非折叠旋转执行器的可折叠机器人不同，该电机具有创新性。

title: GAZELOAD A Multimodal Eye-Tracking Dataset for Mental Workload in Industrial Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This article describes GAZELOAD, a multimodal dataset for mental workload estimation in industrial human-robot collaboration. The data were collected in a laboratory assembly testbed where 26 participants interacted with two collaborative robots (UR5 and Franka Emika Panda) while wearing Meta ARIA smart glasses. The dataset time-synchronizes eye-tracking signals (pupil diameter, fixations, saccades, eye gaze, gaze transition entropy, fixation dispersion index) with environmental real-time and continuous measurements (illuminance) and task and robot context (bench, task block, induced faults), under controlled manipulations of task difficulty and ambient conditions. For each participant and workload-graded task block, we provide CSV files with ocular metrics aggregated into 250 ms windows, environmental logs, and self-reported mental workload ratings on a 1-10 Likert scale, organized in participant-specific folders alongside documentation. These data can be used to develop and benchmark algorithms for mental workload estimation, feature extraction, and temporal modeling in realistic industrial HRC scenarios, and to investigate the influence of environmental factors such as lighting on eye-based workload markers.
summary_zh: 本文描述了 GAZELOAD，一个用于工业人机协作中精神负荷估计的多模态数据集。数据收集于一个实验室装配测试平台，其中 26 名参与者佩戴 Meta ARIA 智能眼镜与两台协作机器人（UR5 和 Franka Emika Panda）进行交互。该数据集对眼动追踪信号（瞳孔直径、注视、扫视、眼睛注视、注视转移熵、注视离散度指数）与环境实时和连续测量值（照度）以及任务和机器人上下文（工作台、任务块、诱发故障）进行时间同步，并对任务难度和环境条件进行受控操作。对于每位参与者和工作负荷分级的任务块，我们提供 CSV 文件，其中包含汇总到 250 毫秒窗口中的眼部指标、环境日志以及关于 1-10 Likert 量表的自我报告的精神负荷评级，这些数据组织在参与者特定的文件夹中，并附带文档。这些数据可用于开发和评估用于在现实工业 HRC 场景中进行精神负荷估计、特征提取和时间建模的算法，并用于研究照明等环境因素对基于眼睛的工作负荷指标的影响。
tldr: The paper introduces GAZELOAD, a multimodal eye-tracking dataset for mental workload estimation in human-robot collaboration, incorporating eye-tracking, environmental data, and task context.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GAZELOAD，一个用于人机协作中精神负荷估计的多模态眼动追踪数据集，包含眼动追踪、环境数据和任务背景。

title: Singularity-Free Lie Group Integration and Geometrically Consistent Evaluation of Multibody System Models Described in Terms of Standard Absolute Coordinates
summary: A classical approach to the multibody systems (MBS) modeling is to use absolute coordinates, i.e., a set of (possibly redundant) coordinates that describe the absolute position and orientation of the individual bodies with respect to an inertial frame (IFR). A well-known problem for the time integration of the equations of motion (EOM) is the lack of a singularity-free parameterization of spatial motions, which is usually tackled by using unit quaternions. Lie group integration methods were proposed as an alternative approach to the singularity-free time integration. At the same time, Lie group formulations of EOM naturally respect the geometry of spatial motions during integration. Lie group integration methods, operating directly on the configuration space Lie group, are incompatible with standard formulations of the EOM, and cannot be implemented in existing MBS simulation codes without a major restructuring. The contribution of this paper is twofold: (1) A framework for interfacing Lie group integrators to standard EOM formulations is presented. It allows describing MBS in terms of various absolute coordinates and at the same using Lie group integration schemes. (2) A method for consistently incorporating the geometry of rigid body motions into the evaluation of EOM in absolute coordinates integrated with standard vector space integration schemes. The direct product group and the semidirect product group SO(3)xR3 and the semidirect product group SE(3) are used for representing rigid body motions. The key element is the local-global transitions (LGT) transition map, which facilitates the update of (global) absolute coordinates in terms of the (local) coordinates on the Lie group. This LGT map is specific to the absolute coordinates, the local coordinates on the Lie group, and the Lie group used to represent rigid body configurations.
summary_zh: 多体系统(MBS)建模的经典方法是使用绝对坐标，即一组（可能是冗余的）坐标，用于描述各个刚体相对于惯性坐标系（IFR）的绝对位置和姿态。运动方程（EOM）进行时间积分的一个众所周知的问题是缺乏空间运动的无奇异参数化，通常通过使用单位四元数来解决。李群积分方法被提出作为无奇异时间积分的替代方法。同时，EOM的李群公式在积分过程中自然地尊重空间运动的几何结构。直接在位形空间李群上运算的李群积分方法与EOM的标准公式不兼容，并且如果不进行重大的重构，就无法在现有的MBS模拟代码中实现。本文的贡献有两方面：（1）提出了一种将李群积分器连接到标准EOM公式的框架。它允许使用各种绝对坐标来描述MBS，同时使用李群积分方案。(2)提出了一种将刚体运动的几何结构一致地纳入到绝对坐标下EOM评估的方法，该方法使用标准向量空间积分方案进行积分。直接积群和半直积群SO(3)xR3以及半直积群SE(3)用于表示刚体运动。关键要素是局部-全局转换（LGT）过渡映射，它有助于根据李群上的（局部）坐标更新（全局）绝对坐标。此LGT映射特定于绝对坐标，李群上的局部坐标以及用于表示刚体位形的李群。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for Lie group integration in multibody system modeling using absolute coordinates, enabling singularity-free and geometrically consistent simulations without major code restructuring. It also provides a method for incorporating rigid body motion geometry into standard vector space integration schemes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个在多体系统建模中使用绝对坐标的李群积分框架，实现了无奇异且几何一致的仿真，无需进行重大代码重构。它还提供了一种将刚体运动几何结构纳入标准向量空间积分方案的方法。

title: Disturbance-Aware Flight Control of Robotic Gliding Blimp via Moving Mass Actuation
summary: Robotic blimps, as lighter-than-air (LTA) aerial systems, offer long endurance and inherently safe operation but remain highly susceptible to wind disturbances. Building on recent advances in moving mass actuation, this paper addresses the lack of disturbance-aware control frameworks for LTA platforms by explicitly modeling and compensating for wind-induced effects. A moving horizon estimator (MHE) infers real-time wind perturbations and provides these estimates to a model predictive controller (MPC), enabling robust trajectory and heading regulation under varying wind conditions. The proposed approach leverages a two-degree-of-freedom (2-DoF) moving-mass mechanism to generate both inertial and aerodynamic moments for attitude and heading control, thereby enhancing flight stability in disturbance-prone environments. Extensive flight experiments under headwind and crosswind conditions show that the integrated MHE-MPC framework significantly outperforms baseline PID control, demonstrating its effectiveness for disturbance-aware LTA flight.
summary_zh: 机器人飞艇作为一种轻于空气（LTA）的空中系统，具有续航时间长和固有的安全操作等优点，但仍然极易受到风力干扰。本文基于移动质量驱动器的最新进展，通过显式地建模和补偿风力诱导效应，旨在解决LTA平台缺乏具有干扰感知能力的控制框架的问题。本文采用移动视界估计器（MHE）来推断实时风力扰动，并将这些估计值提供给模型预测控制器（MPC），从而实现在不同风力条件下鲁棒的轨迹和航向控制。所提出的方法利用一个两自由度（2-自由度）的移动质量机制，产生惯性力矩和气动动量，用于姿态和航向控制，从而增强了扰动敏感环境下的飞行稳定性。在顶风和侧风条件下进行的大量飞行实验表明，集成的MHE-MPC框架明显优于基线PID控制，证明了其在具有干扰感知能力的LTA飞行中的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a disturbance-aware control framework for robotic blimps using moving mass actuation, combining Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) for wind disturbance estimation and Model Predictive Control (MPC) for robust flight control, validated through flight experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于移动质量驱动的机器人飞艇抗扰控制框架，结合移动水平估计 (MHE) 进行风扰动估计和模型预测控制 (MPC) 实现鲁棒飞行控制，并通过飞行实验验证。

title: The Energy Impact of Domain Model Design in Classical Planning
summary: AI research has traditionally prioritised algorithmic performance, such as optimising accuracy in machine learning or runtime in automated planning. The emerging paradigm of Green AI challenges this by recognising energy consumption as a critical performance dimension. Despite the high computational demands of automated planning, its energy efficiency has received little attention. This gap is particularly salient given the modular planning structure, in which domain models are specified independently of algorithms. On the other hand, this separation also enables systematic analysis of energy usage through domain model design. We empirically investigate how domain model characteristics affect the energy consumption of classical planners. We introduce a domain model configuration framework that enables controlled variation of features, such as element ordering, action arity, and dead-end states. Using five benchmark domains and five state-of-the-art planners, we analyse energy and runtime impacts across 32 domain variants per benchmark. Results demonstrate that domain-level modifications produce measurable energy differences across planners, with energy consumption not always correlating with runtime.
summary_zh: 人工智能研究传统上优先考虑算法性能，例如优化机器学习中的准确性或自动化规划中的运行时间。新兴的绿色人工智能范式对此提出了挑战，它将能源消耗视为一个关键的性能维度。尽管自动化规划对计算要求很高，但其能源效率却鲜少受到关注。鉴于模块化的规划结构，即领域模型独立于算法进行指定，这一差距尤为突出。另一方面，这种分离也使得通过领域模型设计对能源使用进行系统分析成为可能。我们实证研究了领域模型特征如何影响经典规划器的能源消耗。我们引入了一个领域模型配置框架，该框架能够对诸如元素排序、动作元数和死胡同状态等特征进行受控变化。使用五个基准领域和五个最先进的规划器，我们分析了每个基准领域32个领域变体的能源和运行时间影响。结果表明，领域层面的修改会在规划器之间产生可测量的能源差异，且能源消耗并不总是与运行时间相关。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of domain model design on the energy consumption of classical planning algorithms, revealing that domain-level modifications can produce measurable energy differences across planners, which don't always correlate with runtime.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了领域模型设计对经典规划算法能耗的影响，揭示了领域层面的修改可以显著改变规划器的能耗，且能耗并不总是与运行时间相关。

title: Synthetic-to-Real Domain Bridging for Single-View 3D Reconstruction of Ships for Maritime Monitoring
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of ships is an important part of maritime monitoring, allowing improved visualization, inspection, and decision-making in real-world monitoring environments. However, most state-ofthe-art 3D reconstruction methods require multi-view supervision, annotated 3D ground truth, or are computationally intensive, making them impractical for real-time maritime deployment. In this work, we present an efficient pipeline for single-view 3D reconstruction of real ships by training entirely on synthetic data and requiring only a single view at inference. Our approach uses the Splatter Image network, which represents objects as sparse sets of 3D Gaussians for rapid and accurate reconstruction from single images. The model is first fine-tuned on synthetic ShapeNet vessels and further refined with a diverse custom dataset of 3D ships, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world imagery. We integrate a state-of-the-art segmentation module based on YOLOv8 and custom preprocessing to ensure compatibility with the reconstruction network. Postprocessing steps include real-world scaling, centering, and orientation alignment, followed by georeferenced placement on an interactive web map using AIS metadata and homography-based mapping. Quantitative evaluation on synthetic validation data demonstrates strong reconstruction fidelity, while qualitative results on real maritime images from the ShipSG dataset confirm the potential for transfer to operational maritime settings. The final system provides interactive 3D inspection of real ships without requiring real-world 3D annotations. This pipeline provides an efficient, scalable solution for maritime monitoring and highlights a path toward real-time 3D ship visualization in practical applications. Interactive demo: https://dlr-mi.github.io/ship3d-demo/.
summary_zh: 船舶的三维(3D)重建是海事监控的重要组成部分，能够在实际监控环境中改进可视化、检查和决策。然而，大多数最先进的3D重建方法需要多视角监督、标注的3D真实数据或计算密集型操作，使其在实时海事部署中不切实际。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种高效的单视角真实船舶3D重建流程，完全基于合成数据进行训练，并且在推理时仅需要单视角。我们的方法使用了 Splatter Image 网络，该网络将物体表示为3D高斯的稀疏集合，从而实现从单张图像快速而精确的重建。该模型首先在合成的ShapeNet船舶上进行微调，然后使用多样化的定制3D船舶数据集进一步优化，从而弥合了合成图像和真实世界图像之间的领域差距。我们集成了一个基于YOLOv8的最先进的分割模块和定制的预处理步骤，以确保与重建网络的兼容性。后处理步骤包括真实比例缩放、中心化和方向对齐，然后使用AIS元数据和基于单应性的映射将地理参考位置放置在交互式web地图上。在合成验证数据上的定量评估表明重建保真度良好，而来自 ShipSG 数据集的真实海事图像的定性结果证实了转移到操作性海事环境的潜力。最终系统提供了真实船舶的交互式3D检查，而无需真实世界的3D标注。该流程为海事监控提供了一个高效、可扩展的解决方案，并突出了在实际应用中实现实时3D船舶可视化的途径。交互式演示：https://dlr-mi.github.io/ship3d-demo/。
tldr: This paper presents a synthetic-to-real domain bridging approach for single-view 3D reconstruction of ships using Splatter Image networks, demonstrating potential for interactive maritime monitoring without real-world 3D annotations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种合成到真实的域桥接方法，使用 Splatter Image 网络从单视图进行船舶的 3D 重建，展示了在无需真实世界 3D 注释的情况下进行交互式海上监控的潜力。

title: The Epistemic Planning Domain Definition Language: Official Guideline
summary: Epistemic planning extends (multi-agent) automated planning by making agents' knowledge and beliefs first-class aspects of the planning formalism. One of the most well-known frameworks for epistemic planning is Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL), which offers an rich and natural semantics for modelling problems in this setting. The high expressive power provided by DEL make DEL-based epistemic planning a challenging problem to tackle both theoretically, and in practical implementations. As a result, existing epistemic planners often target different DEL fragments, and typically rely on ad hoc languages to represent benchmarks, and sometimes no language at all. This fragmentation hampers comparison, reuse, and systematic benchmark development. We address these issues by introducing the Epistemic Planning Domain Definition Language (EPDDL). EPDDL provides a unique PDDL-like representation that captures the entire DEL semantics, enabling uniform specification of epistemic planning tasks. Our contributions are threefold: 1. A formal development of abstract event models, a novel representation for epistemic actions used to define the semantics of our language; 2. A formal specification of EPDDL's syntax and semantics grounded in DEL with abstract event models; 3. A demonstration of EPDDL's practical applicability: we identify useful fragments amenable to current planners and show how they can be represented in EPDDL. Through examples of representative benchmarks, we illustrate how EPDDL facilitates interoperability, reproducible evaluation, and future advances in epistemic planning.
summary_zh: 知识规划通过将智能体的知识和信念作为规划形式体系中的一等公民，扩展了（多智能体）自动规划。 动态认知逻辑 (DEL) 是最著名的知识规划框架之一，它为建模此类问题提供了丰富而自然的语义。DEL 提供的高度表达能力使得基于 DEL 的知识规划在理论上和实际实现上都是一个极具挑战性的问题。 因此，现有的知识规划器通常针对不同的 DEL 片段，并且通常依赖于特定的临时语言来表示基准，有时甚至根本没有语言。 这种碎片化阻碍了比较、重用和系统基准开发。 我们通过引入知识规划领域定义语言 (EPDDL) 来解决这些问题。 EPDDL 提供了一种独特的类似 PDDL 的表示方法，它捕捉了整个 DEL 语义，从而能够统一地指定知识规划任务。 我们的贡献有三个方面：1. 抽象事件模型的正式开发，这是一种用于定义我们语言语义的知识动作的新颖表示；2. 基于带有抽象事件模型的 DEL 的 EPDDL 语法和语义的正式规范；3. EPDDL 实际适用性的演示：我们识别出适用于当前规划器的有用片段，并展示如何在 EPDDL 中表示它们。 通过代表性基准的示例，我们说明了 EPDDL 如何促进互操作性、可重复的评估以及知识规划的未来发展。
tldr: The paper introduces the Epistemic Planning Domain Definition Language (EPDDL) to standardize the representation of epistemic planning tasks, aiming to improve comparison, reuse, and benchmark development within the Dynamic Epistemic Logic framework.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了知识规划领域定义语言（EPDDL），旨在标准化知识规划任务的表示，从而改进动态知识逻辑框架内的比较、重用和基准开发。

title: Urban Neural Surface Reconstruction from Constrained Sparse Aerial Imagery with 3D SAR Fusion
summary: Neural surface reconstruction (NSR) has recently shown strong potential for urban 3D reconstruction from multi-view aerial imagery. However, existing NSR methods often suffer from geometric ambiguity and instability, particularly under sparse-view conditions. This issue is critical in large-scale urban remote sensing, where aerial image acquisition is limited by flight paths, terrain, and cost. To address this challenge, we present the first urban NSR framework that fuses 3D synthetic aperture radar (SAR) point clouds with aerial imagery for high-fidelity reconstruction under constrained, sparse-view settings. 3D SAR can efficiently capture large-scale geometry even from a single side-looking flight path, providing robust priors that complement photometric cues from images. Our framework integrates radar-derived spatial constraints into an SDF-based NSR backbone, guiding structure-aware ray selection and adaptive sampling for stable and efficient optimization. We also construct the first benchmark dataset with co-registered 3D SAR point clouds and aerial imagery, facilitating systematic evaluation of cross-modal 3D reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that incorporating 3D SAR markedly enhances reconstruction accuracy, completeness, and robustness compared with single-modality baselines under highly sparse and oblique-view conditions, highlighting a viable route toward scalable high-fidelity urban reconstruction with advanced airborne and spaceborne optical-SAR sensing.
summary_zh: 神经表面重建（NSR）近来在基于多视点航空影像的城市三维重建中展现出强大的潜力。然而，现有的NSR方法常常遭受几何模糊性和不稳定的困扰，尤其是在稀疏视点条件下。这个问题在大型城市遥感中至关重要，因为航空影像的获取受到飞行路径、地形和成本的限制。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了第一个城市NSR框架，该框架融合了三维合成孔径雷达（SAR）点云和航空影像，从而在受限的稀疏视点设置下实现高保真重建。三维SAR能够即使从单侧视飞行路径也能高效地捕捉大规模几何结构，提供稳健的先验信息，补充图像的光度线索。我们的框架将雷达导出的空间约束集成到基于SDF的NSR主干网络中，引导结构感知的光线选择和自适应采样，从而实现稳定而高效的优化。我们还构建了首个具有共配准三维SAR点云和航空影像的基准数据集，为跨模态三维重建的系统评估提供了便利。大量实验表明，在高度稀疏和倾斜视角的条件下，与单模态基线方法相比，结合三维SAR显著提高了重建的精度、完整性和鲁棒性，突显了一条利用先进的机载和星载光学-SAR传感实现可扩展的高保真城市重建的可行途径。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel neural surface reconstruction framework that fuses 3D SAR point clouds with aerial imagery to improve urban 3D reconstruction, especially in sparse-view scenarios, and provides a new benchmark dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的神经表面重建框架，该框架融合了3D SAR点云和航空影像，以提高城市3D重建的质量，尤其是在稀疏视图场景下，并提供了一个新的基准数据集。

title: Learning Geometrically-Grounded 3D Visual Representations for View-Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Real-world robotic manipulation demands visuomotor policies capable of robust spatial scene understanding and strong generalization across diverse camera viewpoints. While recent advances in 3D-aware visual representations have shown promise, they still suffer from several key limitations, including reliance on multi-view observations during inference which is impractical in single-view restricted scenarios, incomplete scene modeling that fails to capture holistic and fine-grained geometric structures essential for precise manipulation, and lack of effective policy training strategies to retain and exploit the acquired 3D knowledge. To address these challenges, we present MethodName, a unified representation-policy learning framework for view-generalizable robotic manipulation. MethodName introduces a single-view 3D pretraining paradigm that leverages point cloud reconstruction and feed-forward gaussian splatting under multi-view supervision to learn holistic geometric representations. During policy learning, MethodName performs multi-step distillation to preserve the pretrained geometric understanding and effectively transfer it to manipulation skills. We conduct experiments on 12 RLBench tasks, where our approach outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method by 12.7% in average success rate. Further evaluation on six representative tasks demonstrates strong zero-shot view generalization, with success rate drops of only 22.0% and 29.7% under moderate and large viewpoint shifts respectively, whereas the state-of-the-art method suffers larger decreases of 41.6% and 51.5%.
summary_zh: 真实世界的机器人操作需要具备鲁棒空间场景理解能力和在不同相机视角下强大泛化能力的视觉运动策略。尽管近期三维感知视觉表征取得了显著进展，但它们仍然面临着一些关键的局限性，包括依赖推理过程中的多视角观测（这在单视角受限场景中是不切实际的）、无法捕捉整体和精细几何结构（这对精确操作至关重要）的不完整场景建模，以及缺乏有效的策略训练策略来保留和利用所获得的三维知识。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MethodName，一个用于视角泛化机器人操作的统一的表征-策略学习框架。MethodName引入了单视角三维预训练范式，该范式利用点云重建和前馈高斯溅射在多视角监督下学习整体几何表征。在策略学习过程中，MethodName执行多步蒸馏，以保留预训练的几何理解并有效地将其转移到操作技能中。我们在12个RLBench任务上进行了实验，我们的方法在平均成功率方面比先前的最先进方法提高了12.7%。在六个代表性任务上的进一步评估表明了强大的零样本视角泛化能力，在中等和大幅度视角偏移下，成功率分别仅下降了22.0%和29.7%，而最先进方法则经历了更大的下降，分别为41.6%和51.5%。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel representation-policy learning framework that uses single-view 3D pretraining with point cloud reconstruction and gaussian splatting to learn geometric representations for view-generalizable robotic manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art results on RLBench and strong zero-shot view generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新颖的表示-策略学习框架，该框架使用单视图3D预训练、点云重建和高斯溅射来学习几何表示，从而实现视角泛化机器人操作，并在RLBench上取得最佳结果，并具有强大的zero-shot视角泛化能力。

title: DynamicVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
summary: Manipulating dynamic objects remains an open challenge for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which, despite strong generalization in static manipulation, struggle in dynamic scenarios requiring rapid perception, temporal anticipation, and continuous control. We present DynamicVLA, a framework for dynamic object manipulation that integrates temporal reasoning and closed-loop adaptation through three key designs: 1) a compact 0.4B VLA using a convolutional vision encoder for spatially efficient, structurally faithful encoding, enabling fast multimodal inference; 2) Continuous Inference, enabling overlapping reasoning and execution for lower latency and timely adaptation to object motion; and 3) Latent-aware Action Streaming, which bridges the perception-execution gap by enforcing temporally aligned action execution. To fill the missing foundation of dynamic manipulation data, we introduce the Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, built from scratch with an auto data collection pipeline that efficiently gathers 200K synthetic episodes across 2.8K scenes and 206 objects, and enables fast collection of 2K real-world episodes without teleoperation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate remarkable improvements in response speed, perception, and generalization, positioning DynamicVLA as a unified framework for general dynamic object manipulation across embodiments.
summary_zh: 操纵动态物体对于视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型而言仍然是一个公开的挑战。尽管 VLA 模型在静态操纵中表现出强大的泛化能力，但在需要快速感知、时间预测和持续控制的动态场景中却表现不佳。我们提出了 DynamicVLA，一个用于动态物体操纵的框架，它通过三个关键设计整合了时间推理和闭环适应：1）一个紧凑的 0.4B VLA，使用卷积视觉编码器进行空间高效、结构保真的编码，从而实现快速的多模态推理；2）连续推理，实现重叠的推理和执行，以降低延迟并及时适应物体运动；3）潜在空间感知动作流，通过强制时间对齐的动作执行来弥合感知-执行的差距。为了填补动态操纵数据缺失的基础，我们引入了动态物体操纵 (DOM) 基准测试，该基准测试完全从零开始构建，并采用自动数据收集流程，该流程能够跨 2.8K 个场景和 206 个物体高效收集 20 万个合成片段，并能够在无需遥操作的情况下快速收集 2K 个真实世界片段。广泛的评估表明，DynamicVLA 在响应速度、感知和泛化方面都有显著改进，使其成为跨embodiment的通用动态物体操纵的统一框架。
tldr: The paper introduces DynamicVLA, a Vision-Language-Action model designed for dynamic object manipulation, featuring a compact architecture, continuous inference, and latent-aware action streaming. They also introduce a new Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark with synthetic and real-world data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DynamicVLA，一个为动态物体操作设计的视觉-语言-动作模型，具有紧凑的架构、连续推理和潜在感知动作流。他们还引入了一种新的动态对象操作（DOM）基准，其中包含合成和真实世界的数据。

title: Temporally Coherent Imitation Learning via Latent Action Flow Matching for Robotic Manipulation
summary:
Learning long-horizon robotic manipulation requires jointly achieving expressive behavior modeling, real-time inference, and stable execution, which remains challenging for existing generative policies. Diffusion-based approaches provide strong modeling capacity but typically incur high inference latency, while flow matching enables fast one-step generation yet often leads to unstable execution when applied directly in the raw action space.
  We propose LG-Flow Policy, a trajectory-level imitation learning framework that performs flow matching in a continuous latent action space. By encoding action sequences into temporally regularized latent trajectories and learning an explicit latent-space flow, the proposed approach decouples global motion structure from low-level control noise, resulting in smooth and reliable long-horizon execution.
  LG-Flow Policy further incorporates geometry-aware point cloud conditioning and execution-time multimodal modulation, with visual cues evaluated as a representative modality in real-world settings. Experimental results in simulation and on physical robot platforms demonstrate that LG-Flow Policy achieves near single-step inference, substantially improves trajectory smoothness and task success over flow-based baselines operating in the raw action space, and remains significantly more efficient than diffusion-based policies.
summary_zh:
学习长时程机器人操作需要联合实现富有表现力的行为建模、实时推理和稳定执行，这对现有的生成策略来说仍然具有挑战性。基于扩散的方法提供了强大的建模能力，但通常会导致较高的推理延迟，而流匹配能够实现快速的单步生成，但如果直接应用于原始动作空间，往往会导致不稳定的执行。

我们提出了LG-Flow Policy，一种轨迹级别的模仿学习框架，在连续潜在动作空间中执行流匹配。通过将动作序列编码为时间正则化的潜在轨迹，并学习显式的潜在空间流，该方法将全局运动结构与低级控制噪声分离，从而实现平滑且可靠的长时程执行。

LG-Flow Policy进一步结合了几何感知的点云条件和执行时的多模态调制，其中视觉线索被评估为真实场景中的代表性模态。在模拟和物理机器人平台上的实验结果表明，LG-Flow Policy实现了接近单步的推理速度，相较于在原始动作空间中运行的基于流的基线方法，显著提高了轨迹平滑度和任务成功率，并且比基于扩散的策略更有效率。
tldr: The paper introduces LG-Flow Policy, a flow-matching based imitation learning framework that operates in a latent action space for smooth and stable long-horizon robotic manipulation, showing improved performance over raw action space flow-based methods and better efficiency than diffusion-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LG-Flow Policy，一种基于流匹配的模仿学习框架，在潜在动作空间中运行，以实现平稳稳定的长时程机器人操作。实验表明，与原始动作空间的基于流的方法相比，该方法性能有所提高，并且比基于扩散的方法效率更高。

title: Robust and Generalized Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Learning a general humanoid whole-body controller is challenging because practical reference motions can exhibit noise and inconsistencies after being transferred to the robot domain, and local defects may be amplified by closed-loop execution, causing drift or failure in highly dynamic and contact-rich behaviors. We propose a dynamics-conditioned command aggregation framework that uses a causal temporal encoder to summarize recent proprioception and a multi-head cross-attention command encoder to selectively aggregate a context window based on the current dynamics. We further integrate a fall recovery curriculum with random unstable initialization and an annealed upward assistance force to improve robustness and disturbance rejection. The resulting policy requires only about 3.5 hours of motion data and supports single-stage end-to-end training without distillation. The proposed method is evaluated under diverse reference inputs and challenging motion regimes, demonstrating zero-shot transfer to unseen motions as well as robust sim-to-real transfer on a physical humanoid robot.
summary_zh: 学习通用人形机器人全身控制器极具挑战，因为实际参考运动在转移到机器人领域后可能表现出噪声和不一致性，并且局部缺陷可能会被闭环执行放大，导致高度动态和接触丰富的行为中出现漂移或失败。我们提出了一种动力学条件下的指令聚合框架，该框架使用因果时间编码器来概括最近的本体感觉，并使用多头交叉注意力指令编码器来基于当前动力学选择性地聚合上下文窗口。我们进一步整合了包含随机不稳定初始化和退火向上辅助力的跌倒恢复课程，以提高鲁棒性和抗扰动能力。由此产生的策略仅需要大约3.5小时的运动数据，并支持无需蒸馏的单阶段端到端训练。所提出的方法在各种参考输入和具有挑战性的运动体制下进行了评估，展示了对未见运动的零样本迁移以及在物理人形机器人上强大的仿真到真实迁移能力。
tldr: This paper presents a dynamics-conditioned command aggregation framework for humanoid whole-body control, achieving robust zero-shot and sim-to-real transfer with limited motion data by incorporating a fall recovery curriculum.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个动力学条件下的命令聚合框架，用于人形机器人全身控制，通过结合跌倒恢复课程，实现了鲁棒的零样本和从模拟到现实的迁移，且只需要有限的运动数据。

title: Self-Imitated Diffusion Policy for Efficient and Robust Visual Navigation
summary: Diffusion policies (DP) have demonstrated significant potential in visual navigation by capturing diverse multi-modal trajectory distributions. However, standard imitation learning (IL), which most DP methods rely on for training, often inherits sub-optimality and redundancy from expert demonstrations, thereby necessitating a computationally intensive "generate-then-filter" pipeline that relies on auxiliary selectors during inference. To address these challenges, we propose Self-Imitated Diffusion Policy (SIDP), a novel framework that learns improved planning by selectively imitating a set of trajectories sampled from itself. Specifically, SIDP introduces a reward-guided self-imitation mechanism that encourages the policy to consistently produce high-quality trajectories efficiently, rather than outputs of inconsistent quality, thereby reducing reliance on extensive sampling and post-filtering. During training, we employ a reward-driven curriculum learning paradigm to mitigate inefficient data utility, and goal-agnostic exploration for trajectory augmentation to improve planning robustness. Extensive evaluations on a comprehensive simulation benchmark show that SIDP significantly outperforms previous methods, with real-world experiments confirming its effectiveness across multiple robotic platforms. On Jetson Orin Nano, SIDP delivers a 2.5$\times$ faster inference than the baseline NavDP, i.e., 110ms VS 273ms, enabling efficient real-time deployment.
summary_zh: 扩散策略(DP)通过捕捉多模态轨迹分布，在视觉导航中展现出巨大的潜力。然而，大多数DP方法依赖的标准模仿学习(IL)常常继承专家演示中的次优性和冗余性，因此需要一个计算密集型的“生成-然后-过滤”流程，该流程在推理过程中依赖于辅助选择器。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出自模仿扩散策略(SIDP)，这是一种新颖的框架，通过选择性地模仿从自身采样的一组轨迹来学习改进的规划。具体而言，SIDP引入了一种奖励引导的自模仿机制，该机制鼓励策略持续高效地产生高质量的轨迹，而非质量不一致的输出，从而减少对大量采样和后处理的依赖。在训练过程中，我们采用奖励驱动的课程学习范式来缓解低效的数据利用率，并采用目标无关的探索来进行轨迹扩充，以提高规划的鲁棒性。在全面的模拟基准测试中进行的大量评估表明，SIDP明显优于先前的方法，真实的实验证实了其在多种机器人平台上的有效性。在Jetson Orin Nano上，SIDP的推理速度比基线NavDP快2.5倍，即110毫秒对273毫秒，从而实现了高效的实时部署。
tldr: The paper introduces Self-Imitated Diffusion Policy (SIDP), a method for visual navigation that improves planning efficiency and robustness by self-imitating high-quality trajectories, reducing reliance on extensive sampling and post-filtering, and achieving faster inference times on resource-constrained hardware.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为自模仿扩散策略(SIDP)的视觉导航方法，该方法通过自模仿高质量轨迹来提高规划效率和鲁棒性，减少对大量采样和后处理的依赖，并在计算资源有限的硬件上实现更快的推理速度。

title: MTDrive: Multi-turn Interactive Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Trajectory planning is a core task in autonomous driving, requiring the prediction of safe and comfortable paths across diverse scenarios. Integrating Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown promise in addressing "long-tail" scenarios. However, existing methods are constrained to single-turn reasoning, limiting their ability to handle complex tasks requiring iterative refinement. To overcome this limitation, we present MTDrive, a multi-turn framework that enables MLLMs to iteratively refine trajectories based on environmental feedback. MTDrive introduces Multi-Turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (mtGRPO), which mitigates reward sparsity by computing relative advantages across turns. We further construct an interactive trajectory understanding dataset from closed-loop simulation to support multi-turn training. Experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark demonstrate superior performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness of our multi-turn reasoning paradigm. Additionally, we implement system-level optimizations to reduce data transfer overhead caused by high-resolution images and multi-turn sequences, achieving 2.5x training throughput. Our data, models, and code will be made available soon.
summary_zh: 轨迹规划是自动驾驶的核心任务，需要在各种场景中预测安全舒适的路径。将多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）与强化学习（RL）相结合，在解决“长尾”场景方面展现出潜力。然而，现有方法局限于单轮推理，限制了它们处理需要迭代优化的复杂任务的能力。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了MTDrive，一个多轮框架，使MLLM能够根据环境反馈迭代优化轨迹。MTDrive引入了多轮组相对策略优化（mtGRPO），通过计算各轮之间的相对优势来缓解奖励稀疏性。我们进一步构建了一个来自闭环仿真的交互式轨迹理解数据集，以支持多轮训练。在NAVSIM基准测试上的实验表明，相比于现有方法，本方法表现出更优越的性能，验证了我们多轮推理范式的有效性。此外，我们实现了系统级优化，以减少由高分辨率图像和多轮序列引起的数据传输开销，实现了2.5倍的训练吞吐量。我们的数据、模型和代码即将开源。
tldr: MTDrive introduces a multi-turn interactive reinforcement learning framework for autonomous driving, enabling iterative trajectory refinement using MLLMs and a novel multi-turn group relative policy optimization method, demonstrating superior performance and training throughput.
tldr_zh: MTDrive 引入了一个用于自动驾驶的多轮交互式强化学习框架，通过使用 MLLM 和一种新的多轮组相对策略优化方法来实现迭代轨迹优化，展示了卓越的性能和训练吞吐量。

title: A Comparative Evaluation of Large Vision-Language Models for 2D Object Detection under SOTIF Conditions
summary: Reliable environmental perception remains one of the main obstacles for safe operation of automated vehicles. Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) concerns safety risks from perception insufficiencies, particularly under adverse conditions where conventional detectors often falter. While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate promising semantic reasoning, their quantitative effectiveness for safety-critical 2D object detection is underexplored. This paper presents a systematic evaluation of ten representative LVLMs using the PeSOTIF dataset, a benchmark specifically curated for long-tail traffic scenarios and environmental degradations. Performance is quantitatively compared against the classical perception approach, a YOLO-based detector. Experimental results reveal a critical trade-off: top-performing LVLMs (e.g., Gemini 3, Doubao) surpass the YOLO baseline in recall by over 25% in complex natural scenarios, exhibiting superior robustness to visual degradation. Conversely, the baseline retains an advantage in geometric precision for synthetic perturbations. These findings highlight the complementary strengths of semantic reasoning versus geometric regression, supporting the use of LVLMs as high-level safety validators in SOTIF-oriented automated driving systems.
summary_zh: 可靠的环境感知仍然是自动驾驶汽车安全运行的主要障碍之一。预期功能安全（SOTIF）关注感知不足带来的安全风险，尤其是在传统检测器经常失效的恶劣条件下。虽然大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）展现出令人鼓舞的语义推理能力，但其在安全关键型二维目标检测中的定量有效性尚未得到充分探索。本文使用PeSOTIF数据集（一个专门为长尾交通场景和环境退化而设计的基准）对十个具有代表性的LVLM进行了系统评估。性能与基于YOLO的经典感知方法进行了定量比较。实验结果揭示了一个关键的权衡：性能最佳的LVLM（例如，Gemini 3、豆包）在复杂的自然场景中，与YOLO基线相比，召回率高出25%以上，表现出对视觉退化的卓越鲁棒性。相反，该基线在合成扰动的几何精度方面保持优势。这些发现突出了语义推理与几何回归的互补优势，支持将LVLM用作面向SOTIF的自动驾驶系统中的高级安全验证器。
tldr: This paper evaluates the performance of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) for 2D object detection in automated driving, specifically under Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) conditions, finding a trade-off between LVLM's recall in complex scenarios and traditional detectors' geometric precision.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在自动驾驶中2D物体检测方面的性能，尤其是在预期功能安全（SOTIF）条件下，发现LVLMs在复杂场景中的召回率与传统检测器几何精度之间存在权衡。

title: Adapting Reinforcement Learning for Path Planning in Constrained Parking Scenarios
summary: Real-time path planning in constrained environments remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. Traditional classical planners, while effective under perfect perception assumptions, are often sensitive to real-world perception constraints and rely on online search procedures that incur high computational costs. In complex surroundings, this renders real-time deployment prohibitive. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for real-time path planning in parking scenarios. In particular, we focus on challenging scenes with tight spaces that require a high number of reversal maneuvers and adjustments. Unlike classical planners, our solution does not require ideal and structured perception, and in principle, could avoid the need for additional modules such as localization and tracking, resulting in a simpler and more practical implementation. Also, at test time, the policy generates actions through a single forward pass at each step, which is lightweight enough for real-time deployment. The task is formulated as a sequential decision-making problem grounded in a bicycle model dynamics, enabling the agent to directly learn navigation policies that respect vehicle kinematics and environmental constraints in the closed-loop setting. A new benchmark is developed to support both training and evaluation, capturing diverse and challenging scenarios. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art success rates and efficiency, surpassing classical planner baselines by +96% in success rate and +52% in efficiency. Furthermore, we release our benchmark as an open-source resource for the community to foster future research in autonomous systems. The benchmark and accompanying tools are available at https://github.com/dqm5rtfg9b-collab/Constrained_Parking_Scenarios.
summary_zh: 在受限环境中进行实时路径规划仍然是自主系统面临的一项根本性挑战。传统的经典规划器虽然在完美的感知假设下有效，但通常对现实世界的感知约束很敏感，并且依赖于产生高计算成本的在线搜索过程。在复杂环境中，这使得实时部署变得难以实现。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的框架，用于停车场场景中的实时路径规划。特别地，我们关注需要多次倒车和调整的狭小空间等具有挑战性的场景。与经典规划器不同，我们的解决方案不需要理想且结构化的感知，并且原则上可以避免对定位和跟踪等额外模块的需求，从而实现更简单和更实用的实现方案。此外，在测试阶段，策略在每一步通过单个前向传递生成动作，其计算量足够轻量化，可以进行实时部署。该任务被表述为一个基于自行车模型动力学的序列决策问题，使智能体能够直接学习尊重车辆运动学和环境约束的闭环导航策略。我们开发了一个新的基准，以支持训练和评估，捕捉了多样且具有挑战性的场景。我们的方法实现了最先进的成功率和效率，其成功率和效率分别比经典规划器基线高出+96%和+52%。此外，我们以开源资源的形式发布了我们的基准，以促进社区对自主系统未来的研究。该基准和配套工具可在https://github.com/dqm5rtfg9b-collab/Constrained_Parking_Scenarios 获得。
tldr: This paper introduces a Deep Reinforcement Learning framework for real-time path planning in constrained parking scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared to classical planners and releasing a new benchmark for the community.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于约束停车场景中实时路径规划的深度强化学习框架，与传统的经典规划器相比，实现了最先进的性能，并为社区发布了一个新的基准。

title: CARE: Multi-Task Pretraining for Latent Continuous Action Representation in Robot Control
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise for robot control, but their dependence on action supervision limits scalability and generalization. To address this challenge, we introduce CARE, a novel framework designed to train VLA models for robotic task execution. Unlike existing methods that depend on action annotations during pretraining, CARE eliminates the need for explicit action labels by leveraging only video-text pairs. These weakly aligned data sources enable the model to learn continuous latent action representations through a newly designed multi-task pretraining objective. During fine-tuning, a small set of labeled data is used to train the action head for control. Experimental results across various simulation tasks demonstrate CARE's superior success rate, semantic interpretability, and ability to avoid shortcut learning. These results underscore CARE's scalability, interpretability, and effectiveness in robotic control with weak supervision.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型近期的进展在机器人控制方面展现出潜力，但其对动作监督的依赖限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 CARE，一种旨在训练用于机器人任务执行的 VLA 模型的新型框架。与依赖于预训练期间的动作标注的现有方法不同，CARE 通过仅利用视频-文本对消除了对显式动作标签的需求。这些弱对齐的数据源使模型能够通过新设计的多任务预训练目标学习连续潜在动作表示。在微调期间，使用少量标记数据来训练用于控制的动作头。在各种模拟任务上的实验结果表明，CARE 具有更高的成功率、语义可解释性，以及避免捷径学习的能力。这些结果突显了 CARE 在弱监督机器人控制中的可扩展性、可解释性和有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces CARE, a VLA model training framework that learns continuous latent action representations from video-text pairs using a multi-task pretraining objective, eliminating the need for action labels during pretraining, and demonstrating superior performance in robotic control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CARE，一个VLA模型训练框架，它使用多任务预训练目标，从视频文本对中学习连续的潜在动作表示，从而消除了在预训练期间对动作标签的需求，并在机器人控制中展示了卓越的性能。

title: PoSafeNet: Safe Learning with Poset-Structured Neural Nets
summary: Safe learning is essential for deploying learningbased controllers in safety-critical robotic systems, yet existing approaches often enforce multiple safety constraints uniformly or via fixed priority orders, leading to infeasibility and brittle behavior. In practice, safety requirements are heterogeneous and admit only partial priority relations, where some constraints are comparable while others are inherently incomparable. We formalize this setting as poset-structured safety, modeling safety constraints as a partially ordered set and treating safety composition as a structural property of the policy class. Building on this formulation, we propose PoSafeNet, a differentiable neural safety layer that enforces safety via sequential closed-form projection under poset-consistent constraint orderings, enabling adaptive selection or mixing of valid safety executions while preserving priority semantics by construction. Experiments on multi-obstacle navigation, constrained robot manipulation, and vision-based autonomous driving demonstrate improved feasibility, robustness, and scalability over unstructured and differentiable quadratic program-based safety layers.
summary_zh: 安全学习对于在安全攸关型机器人系统中部署基于学习的控制器至关重要，然而现有方法常以统一方式或通过固定优先级顺序来实施多个安全约束，导致不可行和脆弱的行为。在实践中，安全需求是异构的，并且仅允许部分优先级关系，其中一些约束是可比较的，而另一些约束本质上是不可比较的。我们将此设定形式化为偏序集结构安全，将安全约束建模为偏序集，并将安全组合视为策略类的结构属性。在此形式化的基础上，我们提出 PoSafeNet，这是一个可微分的神经安全层，它通过在偏序集一致的约束排序下进行顺序闭式投影来强制执行安全性，从而能够在保持优先级语义的同时自适应地选择或混合有效的安全执行。在多障碍物导航、约束机器人操作和基于视觉的自动驾驶方面的实验表明，与非结构化和基于可微分二次规划的安全层相比，该方法在可行性、鲁棒性和可扩展性方面有所改进。
tldr: The paper introduces PoSafeNet, a neural safety layer that enforces safety in robotic systems with partially ordered constraints, improving feasibility and robustness over existing safety layer methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PoSafeNet，一种神经安全层，用于在具有部分排序约束的机器人系统中强制安全，与现有的安全层方法相比，提高了可行性和鲁棒性。

title: Guided by Trajectories: Repairing and Rewarding Tool-Use Trajectories for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools, yet existing approaches depend on high-quality synthesized trajectories selected by scoring functions and sparse outcome-based rewards, providing limited and biased supervision for learning TIR. To address these challenges, in this paper, we propose AutoTraj, a two-stage framework that automatically learns TIR by repairing and rewarding tool-use trajectories. Specifically, in the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, AutoTraj generates multiple candidate tool-use trajectories for each query and evaluates them along multiple dimensions. High-quality trajectories are directly retained, while low-quality ones are repaired using a LLM (i.e., LLM-as-Repairer). The resulting repaired and high-quality trajectories form a synthetic SFT dataset, while each repaired trajectory paired with its original low-quality counterpart constitutes a dataset for trajectory preference modeling. In the reinforcement learning (RL) stage, based on the preference dataset, we train a trajectory-level reward model to assess the quality of reasoning paths and combine it with outcome and format rewards, thereby explicitly guiding the optimization toward reliable TIR behaviors. Experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of AutoTraj in TIR.
summary_zh: 工具集成推理（TIR）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够通过与外部工具交互来解决复杂任务，然而现有方法依赖于由评分函数选择的高质量合成轨迹和稀疏的基于结果的奖励，为学习TIR提供有限且有偏差的监督。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种两阶段框架AutoTraj，它通过修复和奖励工具使用轨迹来自动学习TIR。具体而言，在监督微调（SFT）阶段，AutoTraj为每个查询生成多个候选工具使用轨迹，并从多个维度评估它们。高质量的轨迹被直接保留，而低质量的轨迹则使用LLM（即LLM作为修复器）进行修复。最终生成的修复轨迹和高质量轨迹构成一个合成SFT数据集，而每个修复过的轨迹与其原始低质量对应项构成一个用于轨迹偏好建模的数据集。在强化学习（RL）阶段，基于偏好数据集，我们训练一个轨迹级别的奖励模型来评估推理路径的质量，并将其与结果奖励和格式奖励相结合，从而明确地引导优化朝着可靠的TIR行为发展。在真实世界基准测试上的实验表明了AutoTraj在TIR中的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces AutoTraj, a two-stage framework that improves Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) in LLMs by repairing low-quality tool-use trajectories and training a trajectory-level reward model to guide optimization towards reliable reasoning behaviors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为AutoTraj的两阶段框架，通过修复低质量的工具使用轨迹，并训练轨迹级别的奖励模型来指导优化，从而提高LLM中的工具集成推理(TIR)能力。

title: Alignment among Language, Vision and Action Representations
summary: A fundamental question in cognitive science and AI concerns whether different learning modalities: language, vision, and action, give rise to distinct or shared internal representations. Traditional views assume that models trained on different data types develop specialized, non-transferable representations. However, recent evidence suggests unexpected convergence: models optimized for distinct tasks may develop similar representational geometries. We investigate whether this convergence extends to embodied action learning by training a transformer-based agent to execute goal-directed behaviors in response to natural language instructions. Using behavioral cloning on the BabyAI platform, we generated action-grounded language embeddings shaped exclusively by sensorimotor control requirements. We then compared these representations with those extracted from state-of-the-art large language models (LLaMA, Qwen, DeepSeek, BERT) and vision-language models (CLIP, BLIP). Despite substantial differences in training data, modality, and objectives, we observed robust cross-modal alignment. Action representations aligned strongly with decoder-only language models and BLIP (precision@15: 0.70-0.73), approaching the alignment observed among language models themselves. Alignment with CLIP and BERT was significantly weaker. These findings indicate that linguistic, visual, and action representations converge toward partially shared semantic structures, supporting modality-independent semantic organization and highlighting potential for cross-domain transfer in embodied AI systems.
summary_zh: 认知科学和人工智能领域的一个基本问题在于，不同的学习模态：语言、视觉和行动，是否会产生截然不同或共享的内部表征。传统观点认为，在不同类型的数据上训练的模型会发展出专门化、不可迁移的表征。然而，最近的证据表明存在出乎意料的收敛：为不同任务优化的模型可能发展出相似的表征几何。我们通过训练一个基于Transformer的智能体，使其响应自然语言指令执行目标导向的行为，来研究这种收敛是否延伸到具身行动学习中。利用BabyAI平台上的行为克隆，我们生成了完全由感觉运动控制需求塑造的行动基础语言嵌入。然后，我们将这些表征与从最先进的大型语言模型（LLaMA、Qwen、DeepSeek、BERT）和视觉-语言模型（CLIP、BLIP）中提取的表征进行比较。尽管在训练数据、模态和目标方面存在显著差异，但我们观察到了稳健的跨模态对齐。行动表征与仅使用解码器的语言模型和BLIP高度对齐（precision@15：0.70-0.73），接近于语言模型自身之间的对齐程度。与CLIP和BERT的对齐程度明显较弱。这些发现表明，语言、视觉和行动表征收敛于部分共享的语义结构，支持模态独立的语义组织，并突出了具身人工智能系统中跨领域迁移的潜力。
tldr: This paper explores the alignment between language, vision, and action representations, finding a surprising convergence between action representations (trained via behavioral cloning) and language models, suggesting shared semantic structures across modalities.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了语言、视觉和动作表征之间的对齐关系，发现动作表征（通过行为克隆训练）与语言模型之间存在令人惊讶的收敛，表明跨模态之间存在共享的语义结构。

title: MulFeRL: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning with Verbal Feedback in a Multi-turn Loop
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in multiple domains, yet outcome-only scalar rewards are often sparse and uninformative, especially on failed samples, where they merely indicate failure and provide no insight into why the reasoning fails. In this paper, we investigate how to leverage richer verbal feedback to guide RLVR training on failed samples, and how to convert such feedback into a trainable learning signal. Specifically, we propose a multi-turn feedback-guided reinforcement learning framework. It builds on three mechanisms: (1) dynamic multi-turn regeneration guided by feedback, triggered only on failed samples, (2) two complementary learning signals for within-turn and cross-turn optimization, and (3) structured feedback injection into the model's reasoning process. Trained on sampled OpenR1-Math, the approach outperforms supervised fine-tuning and RLVR baselines in-domain and generalizes well out-of-domain.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被广泛应用于提升多个领域的推理能力，但是，仅依赖结果的标量奖励往往是稀疏且缺乏信息的，尤其是在失败的样本上，这些奖励仅仅表明失败，而未能提供关于推理为何失败的洞察。在本文中，我们研究了如何利用更丰富的口头反馈来指导RLVR对失败样本的训练，以及如何将此类反馈转化为可训练的学习信号。具体而言，我们提出了一种多轮反馈引导的强化学习框架。该框架构建于三种机制之上：（1）仅在失败样本上触发的，由反馈引导的动态多轮再生，（2）用于轮内和跨轮优化的两种互补学习信号，以及（3）结构化的反馈注入到模型的推理过程中。在采样的OpenR1-Math上进行训练后，该方法在领域内优于监督式微调和RLVR基线，并且在领域外具有良好的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces MulFeRL, a multi-turn feedback-guided reinforcement learning framework that uses verbal feedback on failed samples to improve reasoning, particularly in mathematical problem-solving, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多轮反馈引导的强化学习框架MulFeRL，该框架利用失败样本上的口头反馈来改进推理，尤其是在数学问题解决方面，其性能优于现有方法。

title: Game-Theoretic Co-Evolution for LLM-Based Heuristic Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled rapid progress in automatic heuristic discovery (AHD), yet most existing methods are predominantly limited by static evaluation against fixed instance distributions, leading to potential overfitting and poor generalization under distributional shifts. We propose Algorithm Space Response Oracles (ASRO), a game-theoretic framework that reframes heuristic discovery as a program level co-evolution between solver and instance generator. ASRO models their interaction as a two-player zero-sum game, maintains growing strategy pools on both sides, and iteratively expands them via LLM-based best-response oracles against mixed opponent meta-strategies, thereby replacing static evaluation with an adaptive, self-generated curriculum. Across multiple combinatorial optimization domains, ASRO consistently outperforms static-training AHD baselines built on the same program search mechanisms, achieving substantially improved generalization and robustness on diverse and out-of-distribution instances.
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLMs）推动了自动启发式发现（AHD）的快速发展，然而，现有的大多数方法主要局限于针对固定实例分布的静态评估，导致潜在的过拟合和分布偏移下的泛化能力不足。我们提出了算法空间响应预言机（ASRO），这是一个博弈论框架，它将启发式发现重新定义为求解器和实例生成器之间的程序级协同进化。ASRO将它们的交互建模为一个双人零和博弈，维护双方不断增长的策略池，并通过基于LLM的最佳响应预言机，针对混合对手元策略迭代地扩展它们，从而用自适应、自生成的课程取代静态评估。在多个组合优化领域，ASRO始终优于基于相同程序搜索机制构建的静态训练AHD基线，在各种和超出分布的实例上实现了显著改进的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces Algorithm Space Response Oracles (ASRO), a game-theoretic co-evolution framework using LLMs to improve automatic heuristic discovery by iteratively co-evolving solvers and instance generators, leading to better generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了算法空间响应预言机（ASRO），这是一个博弈论的协同进化框架，利用大型语言模型（LLM）通过迭代地协同进化求解器和实例生成器来改进自动启发式发现，从而实现更好的泛化。

title: Learning with Challenges: Adaptive Difficulty-Aware Data Generation for Mobile GUI Agent Training
summary: Large-scale, high-quality interaction trajectories are essential for advancing mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents. While existing methods typically rely on labor-intensive human demonstrations or automated model exploration to generate GUI trajectories, they lack fine-grained control over task difficulty. This fundamentally restricts learning effectiveness due to the mismatch between the training difficulty and the agent's capabilities. Inspired by how humans acquire skills through progressively challenging tasks, we propose MobileGen, a novel data generation framework that adaptively aligns training difficulty with the GUI agent's capability frontier. Specifically, MobileGen explicitly decouples task difficulty into structural (e.g., trajectory length) and semantic (e.g., task goal) dimensions. It then iteratively evaluates the agent on a curated prior dataset to construct a systematic profile of its capability frontier across these two dimensions. With this profile, the probability distribution of task difficulty is adaptively computed, from which the target difficulty for the next round of training can be sampled. Guided by the sampled difficulty, a multi-agent controllable generator is finally used to synthesize high-quality interaction trajectories along with corresponding task instructions. Extensive experiments show that MobileGen consistently outperforms existing data generation methods by improving the average performance of GUI agents by 1.57 times across multiple challenging benchmarks. This highlights the importance of capability-aligned data generation for effective mobile GUI agent training.
summary_zh: 大规模、高质量的交互轨迹对于推进移动图形用户界面（GUI）智能体至关重要。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于劳动密集型的人工演示或自动模型探索来生成GUI轨迹，但它们缺乏对任务难度的细粒度控制。这从根本上限制了学习效果，原因是训练难度与智能体的能力不匹配。受人类通过渐进性挑战任务习得技能的启发，我们提出了MobileGen，一种新颖的数据生成框架，该框架自适应地将训练难度与GUI智能体的能力边界对齐。具体来说，MobileGen将任务难度显式地解耦为结构（例如，轨迹长度）和语义（例如，任务目标）维度。然后，它在精选的先验数据集上迭代评估智能体，以构建其在这两个维度上的能力边界的系统性轮廓。基于此轮廓，自适应地计算任务难度的概率分布，从中可以采样下一轮训练的目标难度。在采样的难度指导下，最终使用一种多智能体可控生成器来合成高质量的交互轨迹以及相应的任务指令。大量实验表明，MobileGen在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中，通过将GUI智能体的平均性能提高1.57倍，始终优于现有的数据生成方法。这突出了能力对齐的数据生成对于有效的移动GUI智能体训练的重要性。
tldr: The paper introduces MobileGen, a framework for adaptively generating GUI interaction trajectories for agent training by aligning task difficulty with the agent's capabilities, leading to improved performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MobileGen，一个通过将任务难度与智能体的能力对齐，自适应生成 GUI 交互轨迹以训练智能体的框架，从而提高了性能。

title: TSPO: Breaking the Double Homogenization Dilemma in Multi-turn Search Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks through iterative information retrieval. However, current reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks for search-augmented reasoning predominantly rely on sparse outcome-level rewards, leading to a "Double Homogenization Dilemma." This manifests as (1) Process homogenization, where the thinking, reasoning, and tooling involved in generation are ignored. (2) Intra-group homogenization, coarse-grained outcome rewards often lead to inefficiencies in intra-group advantage estimation with methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) during sampling. To address this, we propose Turn-level Stage-aware Policy Optimization (TSPO). TSPO introduces the First-Occurrence Latent Reward (FOLR) mechanism, allocating partial rewards to the step where the ground-truth answer first appears, thereby preserving process-level signals and increasing reward variance within groups without requiring external reward models or any annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TSPO significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving average performance gains of 24% and 13.6% on Qwen2.5-3B and 7B models, respectively.
summary_zh: 多轮工具集成推理使得大型语言模型（LLMs）能够通过迭代式信息检索解决复杂任务。然而，当前用于搜索增强推理的强化学习（RL）框架主要依赖于稀疏的结果级奖励，导致了“双重同质化困境”。这表现为（1）过程同质化，即忽略了生成过程中的思考、推理和工具使用。（2）组内同质化，粗粒度的结果奖励通常导致在使用诸如组相对策略优化（GRPO）等方法进行抽样时，组内优势估计的效率低下。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了回合级阶段感知策略优化（TSPO）。TSPO引入了首次出现潜在奖励（FOLR）机制，将部分奖励分配给首次出现真实答案的步骤，从而保留过程级信号并提高组内奖励方差，而无需外部奖励模型或任何标注。大量实验表明，TSPO显著优于最先进的基线方法，在Qwen2.5-3B和7B模型上分别实现了平均24%和13.6%的性能提升。
tldr: The paper introduces TSPO, a reinforcement learning method that tackles the 'Double Homogenization Dilemma' in multi-turn search policy optimization for LLMs by using a First-Occurrence Latent Reward mechanism. It shows significant performance gains over existing baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TSPO，一种强化学习方法，通过使用首次出现潜在奖励机制来解决LLM多轮搜索策略优化中的“双重同质化困境”。实验表明，该方法比现有基线方法有显著的性能提升。

title: AutoRefine: From Trajectories to Reusable Expertise for Continual LLM Agent Refinement
summary: Large language model agents often fail to accumulate knowledge from experience, treating each task as an independent challenge. Recent methods extract experience as flattened textual knowledge, which cannot capture procedural logic of complex subtasks. They also lack maintenance mechanisms, causing repository degradation as experience accumulates. We introduce AutoRefine, a framework that extracts and maintains dual-form Experience Patterns from agent execution histories. For procedural subtasks, we extract specialized subagents with independent reasoning and memory. For static knowledge, we extract skill patterns as guidelines or code snippets. A continuous maintenance mechanism scores, prunes, and merges patterns to prevent repository degradation. Evaluated on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and TravelPlanner, AutoRefine achieves 98.4%, 70.4%, and 27.1% respectively, with 20-73% step reductions. On TravelPlanner, automatic extraction exceeds manually designed systems (27.1% vs 12.1%), demonstrating its ability to capture procedural coordination.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型智能体往往无法从经验中积累知识，而是将每个任务视为独立的挑战。最近的方法将经验提取为扁平化的文本知识，无法捕捉复杂子任务的程序性逻辑。它们也缺乏维护机制，导致经验积累时知识库退化。我们引入了AutoRefine，一个从智能体执行历史中提取并维护双形式经验模式的框架。对于程序性子任务，我们提取具有独立推理和记忆的专业化子智能体。对于静态知识，我们提取技能模式作为指导或代码片段。一个连续维护机制对模式进行评分、修剪和合并，以防止知识库退化。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和TravelPlanner上的评估表明，AutoRefine分别取得了98.4%、70.4%和27.1%的成功率，并减少了20-73%的步骤。在TravelPlanner上，自动提取超越了手动设计的系统（27.1% vs 12.1%），证明了其捕捉程序性协调的能力。
tldr: AutoRefine extracts and maintains reusable expertise from LLM agent execution histories in the form of specialized subagents and skill patterns, demonstrating improved performance and efficiency across several tasks.
tldr_zh: AutoRefine从LLM智能体的执行历史中提取并维护可重用的专业知识，以专业化的子智能体和技能模式的形式呈现，在多个任务中表现出更高的性能和效率。

title: A Step Back: Prefix Importance Ratio Stabilizes Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has increasingly demonstrated strong ability to elicit reasoning behaviors in large language models (LLMs). For training efficiency, rollouts are typically generated in an off-policy manner using an older sampling policy and then used to update the current target policy. To correct the resulting discrepancy between the sampling and target policies, most existing RL objectives rely on a token-level importance sampling ratio, primarily due to its computational simplicity and numerical stability. However, we observe that token-level correction often leads to unstable training dynamics when the degree of off-policyness is large. In this paper, we revisit LLM policy optimization under off-policy conditions and show that the theoretically rigorous correction term is the prefix importance ratio, and that relaxing it to a token-level approximation can induce instability in RL post-training. To stabilize LLM optimization under large off-policy drift, we propose a simple yet effective objective, Minimum Prefix Ratio (MinPRO). MinPRO replaces the unstable cumulative prefix ratio with a non-cumulative surrogate based on the minimum token-level ratio observed in the preceding prefix. Extensive experiments on both dense and mixture-of-experts LLMs, across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrate that MinPRO substantially improves training stability and peak performance in off-policy regimes.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练已逐渐展现出激发大型语言模型（LLM）推理行为的强大能力。为了训练效率，通常以离线方式使用较旧的抽样策略生成轨迹，然后用于更新当前的target策略。为了纠正抽样策略和target策略之间由此产生的差异，大多数现有的RL目标都依赖于token级别的重要性抽样比率，这主要是因为其计算简单和数值稳定性。然而，我们观察到，当策略偏移程度较大时，token级别的校正通常会导致不稳定的训练动态。在本文中，我们重新审视了离线条件下的LLM策略优化，并表明理论上严谨的校正项是前缀重要性比率，而将其放宽为token级别的近似会诱导RL后训练中的不稳定性。为了在大的策略偏移下稳定LLM优化，我们提出了一种简单而有效的目标函数，即最小前缀比率（MinPRO）。MinPRO用一个基于先前前缀中观察到的最小token级别比率的非累积代理项来代替不稳定的累积前缀比率。在多个数学推理基准测试中，对密集和混合专家LLM的大量实验表明，MinPRO在离线状态下显著提高了训练稳定性和峰值性能。
tldr: The paper identifies instability issues with token-level importance sampling in off-policy RL fine-tuning of LLMs and proposes MinPRO, a more stable training objective using a minimum prefix ratio to improve performance on mathematical reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文指出在LLM的离策略强化学习微调中，token级别的重要性采样存在不稳定性问题，并提出了MinPRO方法。MinPRO使用最小前缀比率，作为更稳定的训练目标，从而提高了在数学推理任务上的性能。

title: Vision-Language Models Unlock Task-Centric Latent Actions
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) have rapidly gained traction as an important component in the pre-training pipelines of leading Vision-Language-Action models. However, they fail when observations contain action-correlated distractors, often encoding noise instead of meaningful latent actions. Humans, on the other hand, can effortlessly distinguish task-relevant motions from irrelevant details in any video given only a brief task description. In this work, we propose to utilize the common-sense reasoning abilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to provide promptable representations, effectively separating controllable changes from the noise in unsupervised way. We use these representations as targets during LAM training and benchmark a wide variety of popular VLMs, revealing substantial variation in the quality of promptable representations as well as their robustness to different prompts and hyperparameters. Interestingly, we find that more recent VLMs may perform worse than older ones. Finally, we show that simply asking VLMs to ignore distractors can substantially improve latent action quality, yielding up to a six-fold increase in downstream success rates on Distracting MetaWorld.
summary_zh: 潜在动作模型 (LAM) 作为领先视觉-语言-动作模型预训练流程中的重要组成部分，已迅速获得关注。然而，当观测包含与动作相关的干扰因素时，它们会失效，常常编码噪声而非有意义的潜在动作。另一方面，人类只需简短的任务描述，就能轻松区分任何视频中与任务相关的运动和不相关的细节。在这项工作中，我们建议利用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的常识推理能力来提供可提示的表征，从而以无监督的方式有效地将可控变化与噪声分离。我们使用这些表征作为 LAM 训练期间的目标，并对各种流行的 VLM 进行基准测试，揭示了可提示表征质量的显著差异，以及它们对不同提示和超参数的鲁棒性。有趣的是，我们发现较新的 VLM 可能比旧的 VLM 表现更差。最后，我们表明，仅仅要求 VLM 忽略干扰因素就能显著提高潜在动作的质量，在 Distracting MetaWorld 上使下游成功率提高高达六倍。
tldr: This paper proposes using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to improve Latent Action Models (LAMs) by providing promptable representations that filter out action-correlated distractors, leading to significant performance gains in robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出利用视觉语言模型 (VLMs) 通过提供可提示的表达来改进潜在动作模型 (LAMs)，过滤掉与动作相关的干扰因素，从而显著提高机器人任务的性能。

title: Best-of-Q: Improving VLM agents with Q-function Action Ranking at Inference
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have become powerful backbones for agents to autonomously operate in digital environments like the web and operating systems. However, these models suffer from inadaptability to fast-changing environments like the web, which can be alleviated by fine-tuning requiring expansive model training and data collection. In this work, we introduce a novel paradigm for enhancing agentic VLM policies at inference without policy retraining. Fundamentally, our approach decouples the VLM's role as a high-capacity action proposer from the final action selection mechanism. We keep the VLM policy frozen and use it to generate a set of candidate actions for a given state. Then, a lightweight, offline-trained Q-function reranks these candidates, and the agent executes the action with the highest estimated value. The main contribution is to apply the Q-function directly during inference for immediate policy improvement, and not offline to relabel data for policy retraining. We demonstrate on the academic WebVoyager benchmark that our method significantly boosts agent success rates, improving a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent from 38.8% to 55.7% and a proprietary GPT-4.1 agent from 82.4% to 88.8%.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已成为强大的骨干网络，用于智能体在数字环境中自主运行，例如网络和操作系统。然而，这些模型难以适应快速变化的环境（如网络），而微调可以缓解这一问题，但需要大量的模型训练和数据收集。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的范式，用于在推理时增强智能体VLM策略，而无需重新训练策略。从根本上说，我们的方法将VLM作为高容量动作提议者的角色与最终动作选择机制解耦。我们保持VLM策略冻结，并用它为给定状态生成一组候选动作。然后，一个轻量级的、离线训练的Q函数对这些候选动作进行重新排序，智能体执行具有最高估计值的动作。主要的贡献是将Q函数直接应用于推理，以实现即时策略改进，而不是离线地重新标记数据以进行策略再训练。我们在学术WebVoyager基准测试中证明，我们的方法显著提高了智能体的成功率，将Qwen2.5-VL-7B智能体的成功率从38.8%提高到55.7%，并将专有的GPT-4.1智能体的成功率从82.4%提高到88.8%。
tldr: The paper introduces a method, Best-of-Q, for improving VLM agent performance in dynamic environments by using a Q-function to rerank candidate actions generated by a frozen VLM policy at inference time, demonstrating significant improvements on the WebVoyager benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 Best-of-Q 的方法，通过在推理时使用 Q 函数对冻结的 VLM 策略生成的候选动作进行重新排序，从而提高 VLM 代理在动态环境中的性能，并在 WebVoyager 基准测试中展示了显著的改进。

title: Test-Time Mixture of World Models for Embodied Agents in Dynamic Environments
summary: Language model (LM)-based embodied agents are increasingly deployed in real-world settings. Yet, their adaptability remains limited in dynamic environments, where constructing accurate and flexible world models is crucial for effective reasoning and decision-making. To address this challenge, we extend the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to embodied agents. While conventional MoE architectures modularize knowledge into expert components with pre-trained routing, they remain rigid once deployed, making them less effective for adapting to unseen domains in dynamic environments. We therefore propose Test-time Mixture of World Models (TMoW), a framework that enhances adaptability to unseen and evolving domains. TMoW updates its routing function over world models at test time, unlike conventional MoE where the function remains fixed, enabling agents to recombine existing models and integrate new ones for continual adaptation. It achieves this through (i) multi-granular prototype-based routing, which adapts mixtures across object- to scene-level similarities, (ii) test-time refinement that aligns unseen domain features with prototypes during inference, and (iii) distilled mixture-based augmentation, which efficiently constructs new models from few-shot data and existing prototypes. We evaluate TMoW on VirtualHome, ALFWorld, and RLBench benchmarks, demonstrating strong performance in both zero-shot adaptation and few-shot expansion scenarios, and showing that it enables embodied agents to operate effectively in dynamic environments.
summary_zh: 基于语言模型（LM）的具身智能体正越来越多地部署在现实世界环境中。然而，它们在动态环境中的适应性仍然有限，在这些环境中，构建准确且灵活的世界模型对于有效的推理和决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战，我们将混合专家（MoE）范式扩展到具身智能体。虽然传统的MoE架构将知识模块化为具有预训练路由的专家组件，但它们一旦部署就变得僵化，使得它们在适应动态环境中未见领域时效果较差。因此，我们提出了测试时世界模型混合（TMoW），一个增强对未见和演化领域适应性的框架。与传统MoE中函数保持固定不同，TMoW在测试时更新其世界模型上的路由函数，使智能体能够重新组合现有模型并集成新模型以进行持续适应。它通过以下方式实现：（i）多粒度原型路由，根据从对象到场景级别的相似性调整混合；（ii）测试时细化，在推理过程中将未见领域的特征与原型对齐；以及（iii）基于混合的蒸馏增强，从少样本数据和现有原型中高效地构建新模型。我们在 VirtualHome、ALFWorld 和 RLBench 基准上评估了 TMoW，证明其在零样本适应和少样本扩展场景中都表现出色，并表明它使具身智能体能够在动态环境中有效运行。
tldr: The paper introduces TMoW, a framework that extends the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm for embodied agents, enabling them to adapt to dynamic environments by updating the routing function over world models at test time, demonstrating strong zero-shot and few-shot adaptation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TMoW，一个扩展了基于语言模型的具身智能体中混合专家范式的框架，通过在测试时更新世界模型的路由函数，使它们能够适应动态环境，并在零样本和少样本自适应方面表现出色。

title: SYMPHONY: Synergistic Multi-agent Planning with Heterogeneous Language Model Assembly
summary: Recent advancements have increasingly focused on leveraging large language models (LLMs) to construct autonomous agents for complex problem-solving tasks.
