However, existing approaches predominantly employ a single-agent framework to generate search branches and estimate rewards during Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) planning. This single-agent paradigm inherently limits exploration capabilities, often resulting in insufficient diversity among generated branches and suboptimal planning performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose Synergistic Multi-agent Planning with Heterogeneous langauge model assembly (SYMPHONY), a novel multi-agent planning framework that integrates a pool of heterogeneous language model-based agents. By leveraging diverse reasoning patterns across agents, SYMPHONY enhances rollout diversity and facilitates more effective exploration. Empirical results across multiple benchmark tasks show that SYMPHONY achieves strong performance even when instantiated with open-source LLMs deployable on consumer-grade hardware. When enhanced with cloud-based LLMs accessible via API, SYMPHONY demonstrates further improvements, outperforming existing state-of-the-art baselines and underscoring the effectiveness of heterogeneous multi-agent coordination in planning tasks.
summary_zh: 近期进展越来越关注利用大型语言模型（LLM）构建自主 Agent，用于解决复杂的任务问题。然而，现有方法主要采用单 Agent 框架，在蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）规划期间生成搜索分支并估计奖励。这种单 Agent 范式固有地限制了探索能力，通常导致生成分支间的多样性不足和次优的规划性能。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种名为异构语言模型组装的协同多 Agent 规划（SYMPHONY）的新型多 Agent 规划框架，该框架集成了基于异构语言模型的 Agent 池。通过利用不同 Agent 之间的多样化推理模式，SYMPHONY 提高了 rollout 多样性，并促进了更有效的探索。在多个基准任务上的实验结果表明，即使使用部署在消费级硬件上的开源 LLM 进行实例化，SYMPHONY 也能实现强大的性能。当通过 API 访问的云端 LLM 增强时，SYMPHONY 表现出进一步的改进，超越了现有的最先进基线，并突出了异构多 Agent 协同在规划任务中的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces SYMPHONY, a multi-agent planning framework using a diverse pool of LLMs to enhance exploration and improve performance in complex tasks, achieving strong results with both open-source and cloud-based models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SYMPHONY，一个使用多样化LLM池的多智能体规划框架，旨在提升探索能力并改善复杂任务中的性能，在使用开源和云端模型时均取得了良好效果。

title: From Self-Evolving Synthetic Data to Verifiable-Reward RL: Post-Training Multi-turn Interactive Tool-Using Agents
summary: Interactive tool-using agents must solve real-world tasks via multi-turn interaction with both humans and external environments, requiring dialogue state tracking, multi-step tool execution, while following complex instructions. Post-training such agents is challenging because synthesis for high-quality multi-turn tool-use data is difficult to scale, and reinforcement learning (RL) could face noisy signals caused by user simulation, leading to degraded training efficiency. We propose a unified framework that combines a self-evolving data agent with verifier-based RL. Our system, EigenData, is a hierarchical multi-agent engine that synthesizes tool-grounded dialogues together with executable per-instance checkers, and improves generation reliability via closed-loop self-evolving process that updates prompts and workflow. Building on the synthetic data, we develop an RL recipe that first fine-tunes the user model and then applies GRPO-style training with trajectory-level group-relative advantages and dynamic filtering, yielding consistent improvements beyond SFT. Evaluated on tau^2-bench, our best model reaches 73.0% pass^1 on Airline and 98.3% pass^1 on Telecom, matching or exceeding frontier models. Overall, our results suggest a scalable pathway for bootstrapping complex tool-using behaviors without expensive human annotation.
summary_zh: 交互式工具使用智能体必须通过与人类和外部环境的多轮交互来解决真实世界的任务，这需要对话状态跟踪、多步骤工具执行以及遵循复杂指令。对这类智能体进行后训练颇具挑战性，因为高质量多轮工具使用数据的合成难以规模化，并且强化学习（RL）可能会面临由用户模拟导致的噪声信号，从而降低训练效率。我们提出了一种统一框架，将自演化数据智能体与基于验证器的强化学习相结合。我们的系统EigenData是一个分层多智能体引擎，它可以合成工具导向的对话，并带有可执行的每实例检查器，并通过闭环自演化过程（更新提示和工作流）来提高生成可靠性。在合成数据的基础上，我们开发了一种强化学习配方，该配方首先对用户模型进行微调，然后应用GRPO风格的训练，同时使用轨迹级别的组相对优势和动态过滤，从而在监督式微调（SFT）的基础上实现持续改进。在tau^2-bench上的评估表明，我们最好的模型在Airline任务上达到了73.0%的通过率（pass^1），在Telecom任务上达到了98.3%的通过率（pass^1），达到或超过了最先进的模型。总而言之，我们的结果表明在无需昂贵的人工标注的情况下，我们可以找到一条可扩展的途径来引导出复杂的工具使用行为。
tldr: The paper introduces EigenData, a framework using self-evolving synthetic data and verifier-based Reinforcement Learning to train tool-using agents, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multi-turn interactive tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为EigenData的框架，它结合了自演进合成数据和基于验证器的强化学习来训练工具使用代理，并在多轮交互式任务中取得了最先进的性能。

title: Learn More with Less: Uncertainty Consistency Guided Query Selection for RLVR
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently improved mathematical reasoning through Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR). However, existing RLVR algorithms require large query budgets, making annotation costly. We investigate whether fewer but more informative queries can yield similar or superior performance, introducing active learning (AL) into RLVR. We identify that classic AL sampling strategies fail to outperform random selection in this setting, due to ignoring objective uncertainty when only selecting by subjective uncertainty. This work proposes an uncertainty consistency metric to evaluate how well subjective uncertainty aligns with objective uncertainty. In the offline setting, this alignment is measured using the Point-Biserial Correlation Coefficient (PBC). For online training, because of limited sampling and dynamically shifting output distributions, PBC estimation is difficult. Therefore, we introduce a new online variant, computed from normalized advantage and subjective uncertainty. Theoretically, we prove that the online variant is strictly negatively correlated with offline PBC and supports better sample selection. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms random and classic AL baselines, achieving full-dataset performance while training on only 30% of the data, effectively reducing the cost of RLVR for reasoning tasks.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近通过带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提高了数学推理能力。然而，现有的RLVR算法需要大量的查询预算，使得标注成本高昂。我们研究了数量较少但信息量更大的查询是否能够产生相似或更优越的性能，并将主动学习（AL）引入到RLVR中。我们发现，经典的AL采样策略在这种设置下无法胜过随机选择，这是因为在仅通过主观不确定性进行选择时，忽略了目标不确定性。本文提出了一种不确定性一致性度量，以评估主观不确定性与目标不确定性的一致程度。在离线设置中，这种一致性使用点二列相关系数（PBC）衡量。对于在线训练，由于采样有限和输出分布动态变化，PBC估计具有挑战性。因此，我们引入了一种新的在线变体，该变体通过归一化的优势函数和主观不确定性计算得出。从理论上讲，我们证明了在线变体与离线PBC严格负相关，并支持更好的样本选择。实验表明，我们的方法始终优于随机和经典的AL基线，在仅使用30%的数据进行训练的情况下实现了完整数据集的性能，从而有效地降低了RLVR在推理任务中的成本。
tldr: This paper introduces an uncertainty consistency metric to improve active learning for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR), enabling similar performance with significantly less data by addressing the shortcomings of traditional AL sampling strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种不确定性一致性指标，用于改进基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中的主动学习，通过解决传统主动学习采样策略的不足，以显着更少的数据实现相似的性能。

title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Video Large Language Models via Spatiotemporal-Semantic Contrastive Decoding
summary: Although Video Large Language Models perform remarkably well across tasks such as video understanding, question answering, and reasoning, they still suffer from the problem of hallucination, which refers to generating outputs that are inconsistent with explicit video content or factual evidence. However, existing decoding methods for mitigating video hallucinations, while considering the spatiotemporal characteristics of videos, mostly rely on heuristic designs. As a result, they fail to precisely capture the root causes of hallucinations and their fine-grained temporal and semantic correlations, leading to limited robustness and generalization in complex scenarios. To more effectively mitigate video hallucinations, we propose a novel decoding strategy termed Spatiotemporal-Semantic Contrastive Decoding. This strategy constructs negative features by deliberately disrupting the spatiotemporal consistency and semantic associations of video features, and suppresses video hallucinations through contrastive decoding against the original video features during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method not only effectively mitigates the occurrence of hallucinations, but also preserves the general video understanding and reasoning capabilities of the model.
summary_zh: 虽然视频大语言模型在视频理解、问答和推理等任务中表现出色，但它们仍然存在幻觉问题，即生成与明确的视频内容或事实证据不一致的输出。然而，现有的缓解视频幻觉的解码方法，虽然考虑了视频的时空特征，但大多依赖于启发式设计。因此，它们无法精确地捕捉幻觉的根本原因及其细粒度的时间和语义相关性，导致在复杂场景中鲁棒性和泛化性有限。为了更有效地缓解视频幻觉，我们提出了一种新的解码策略，称为时空-语义对比解码。该策略通过故意破坏视频特征的时空一致性和语义关联来构建负特征，并在推理过程中通过与原始视频特征的对比解码来抑制视频幻觉。大量实验表明，我们的方法不仅能有效缓解幻觉的发生，而且还能保留模型的一般视频理解和推理能力。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel decoding strategy, Spatiotemporal-Semantic Contrastive Decoding, to mitigate hallucinations in Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) by contrasting original video features with deliberately disrupted negative features. It claims improved robustness and generalization compared to existing heuristic methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的解码策略，即时空语义对比解码，通过将原始视频特征与故意扰动的负特征进行对比，来减轻视频大型语言模型（VLLM）中的幻觉。 与现有的启发式方法相比，它声称具有更高的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: PerfGuard: A Performance-Aware Agent for Visual Content Generation
summary: The advancement of Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents has enabled automated task processing through reasoning and tool invocation capabilities. However, existing frameworks often operate under the idealized assumption that tool executions are invariably successful, relying solely on textual descriptions that fail to distinguish precise performance boundaries and cannot adapt to iterative tool updates. This gap introduces uncertainty in planning and execution, particularly in domains like visual content generation (AIGC), where nuanced tool performance significantly impacts outcomes. To address this, we propose PerfGuard, a performance-aware agent framework for visual content generation that systematically models tool performance boundaries and integrates them into task planning and scheduling. Our framework introduces three core mechanisms: (1) Performance-Aware Selection Modeling (PASM), which replaces generic tool descriptions with a multi-dimensional scoring system based on fine-grained performance evaluations; (2) Adaptive Preference Update (APU), which dynamically optimizes tool selection by comparing theoretical rankings with actual execution rankings; and (3) Capability-Aligned Planning Optimization (CAPO), which guides the planner to generate subtasks aligned with performance-aware strategies. Experimental comparisons against state-of-the-art methods demonstrate PerfGuard's advantages in tool selection accuracy, execution reliability, and alignment with user intent, validating its robustness and practical utility for complex AIGC tasks. The project code is available at https://github.com/FelixChan9527/PerfGuard.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的代理的进步，使得通过推理和工具调用能力实现自动化任务处理成为可能。然而，现有框架通常在工具执行总是成功这种理想化假设下运行，仅仅依赖于无法区分精确性能边界且无法适应迭代式工具更新的文本描述。这种差距在规划和执行中引入了不确定性，尤其是在视觉内容生成 (AIGC) 等领域，细微的工具性能会显著影响结果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PerfGuard，一种用于视觉内容生成的性能感知代理框架，它系统地建模工具性能边界，并将它们集成到任务规划和调度中。我们的框架引入了三个核心机制：（1）性能感知选择建模 (PASM)，它用基于细粒度性能评估的多维评分系统取代了通用的工具描述；（2）自适应偏好更新 (APU)，它通过比较理论排名与实际执行排名，动态地优化工具选择；以及（3）能力对齐规划优化 (CAPO)，它引导规划器生成与性能感知策略对齐的子任务。与最先进方法的实验比较表明，PerfGuard 在工具选择准确性、执行可靠性以及与用户意图的对齐方面具有优势，验证了其在复杂 AIGC 任务中的鲁棒性和实用性。项目代码可在 https://github.com/FelixChan9527/PerfGuard 获取。
tldr: PerfGuard is a performance-aware agent framework for visual content generation that models tool performance boundaries and integrates them into task planning, demonstrating improved tool selection accuracy and execution reliability.
tldr_zh: PerfGuard是一个性能感知的视觉内容生成代理框架，它对工具性能边界进行建模，并将其集成到任务规划中，展示了更高的工具选择准确性和执行可靠性。

title: Darwinian Memory: A Training-Free Self-Regulating Memory System for GUI Agent Evolution
summary: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) agents facilitate Graphical User Interface (GUI) automation but struggle with long-horizon, cross-application tasks due to limited context windows. While memory systems provide a viable solution, existing paradigms struggle to adapt to dynamic GUI environments, suffering from a granularity mismatch between high-level intent and low-level execution, and context pollution where the static accumulation of outdated experiences drives agents into hallucination. To address these bottlenecks, we propose the Darwinian Memory System (DMS), a self-evolving architecture that constructs memory as a dynamic ecosystem governed by the law of survival of the fittest. DMS decomposes complex trajectories into independent, reusable units for compositional flexibility, and implements Utility-driven Natural Selection to track survival value, actively pruning suboptimal paths and inhibiting high-risk plans. This evolutionary pressure compels the agent to derive superior strategies. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-app benchmarks validate that DMS boosts general-purpose MLLMs without training costs or architectural overhead, achieving average gains of 18.0% in success rate and 33.9% in execution stability, while reducing task latency, establishing it as an effective self-evolving memory system for GUI tasks.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 智能体促进了图形用户界面 (GUI) 自动化，但由于上下文窗口的限制，它们在长时程、跨应用程序的任务中表现不佳。虽然记忆系统提供了一个可行的解决方案，但现有的范式难以适应动态的 GUI 环境，遭受着高层意图和低层执行之间的粒度不匹配，以及静态积累的过时经验导致智能体产生幻觉的上下文污染。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了达尔文记忆系统 (DMS)，这是一种自我进化的架构，它将记忆构建为一个由适者生存法则所支配的动态生态系统。DMS 将复杂的轨迹分解为独立的、可重用的单元，以实现组合灵活性，并实施效用驱动的自然选择来追踪生存价值，主动剪除次优路径并抑制高风险计划。这种进化压力促使智能体推导出更优的策略。在真实世界的多元应用基准测试中的大量实验验证了 DMS 可以提升通用 MLLM 的性能，而无需训练成本或架构开销，在成功率方面平均提升 18.0%，在执行稳定性方面平均提升 33.9%，同时降低了任务延迟，从而确立了其作为 GUI 任务的有效自我进化记忆系统的地位。
tldr: The paper proposes a Darwinian Memory System (DMS) for GUI automation agents that dynamically adapts to GUI environments by pruning suboptimal plans and promoting superior strategies, improving success rates and stability without training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于GUI自动化代理的达尔文记忆系统（DMS），该系统通过剪除次优计划并促进卓越策略来动态适应GUI环境，从而在无需训练的情况下提高成功率和稳定性。

title: Recoverability Has a Law: The ERR Measure for Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: Language model agents often appear capable of self-recovery after failing tool call executions, yet this behavior lacks a formal explanation. We present a predictive theory that resolves this gap by showing that recoverability follows a measurable law. To elaborate, we formalize recoverability through Expected Recovery Regret (ERR), which quantifies the deviation of a recovery policy from the optimal one under stochastic execution noise, and derive a first-order relationship between ERR and an empirical observable quantity, the Efficiency Score (ES). This yields a falsifiable first-order quantitative law of recovery dynamics in tool-using agents. We empirically validate the law across five tool-use benchmarks spanning controlled perturbations, diagnostic reasoning, and real-world APIs. Across model scales, perturbation regimes, and recovery horizons, predicted regret under the ERR-ES law closely matched observed post-failure regret measured from Monte Carlo rollouts, within delta less than or equal to 0.05. Our results reveal that recoverability is not an artifact of model scale or architecture, but a governed property of interaction dynamics, providing a theoretical foundation for execution-level robustness in language agents.
summary_zh: 语言模型智能体在工具调用执行失败后通常表现出自我恢复的能力，但这种行为缺乏正式的解释。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了一种预测理论，表明可恢复性遵循一个可测量的定律。具体来说，我们通过期望恢复遗憾（ERR）来形式化可恢复性，它量化了在随机执行噪声下恢复策略与最优策略之间的偏差，并推导了ERR与一个可观察的经验指标——效率得分（ES）之间的一阶关系。这产生了一个可证伪的关于工具使用型智能体中恢复动态的一阶定量定律。我们在五个工具使用基准上，通过受控扰动、诊断推理和真实世界API，对该定律进行了经验验证。在不同的模型规模、扰动机制和恢复范围内，根据ERR-ES定律预测的遗憾与从蒙特卡洛展开中测得的失败后观察到的遗憾相似度很高，差异小于等于0.05。我们的结果表明，可恢复性不是模型规模或架构的人为产物，而是交互动态的一个受支配的属性，为语言智能体中的执行层鲁棒性提供了理论基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a formal measure (ERR) and an empirical observable (ES) to quantify and predict the recoverability of tool-augmented language agents after failed tool calls, demonstrating its validity across various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种形式化的度量 (ERR) 和一个经验可观察量 (ES)，用于量化和预测工具增强型语言智能体在工具调用失败后的可恢复性，并在各种基准测试中验证了其有效性。

title: Why Reasoning Fails to Plan: A Planning-Centric Analysis of Long-Horizon Decision Making in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents exhibit strong step-by-step reasoning capabilities over short horizons, yet often fail to sustain coherent behavior over long planning horizons. We argue that this failure reflects a fundamental mismatch: step-wise reasoning induces a form of step-wise greedy policy that is adequate for short horizons but fails in long-horizon planning, where early actions must account for delayed consequences. From this planning-centric perspective, we study LLM-based agents in deterministic, fully structured environments with explicit state transitions and evaluation signals. Our analysis reveals a core failure mode of reasoning-based policies: locally optimal choices induced by step-wise scoring lead to early myopic commitments that are systematically amplified over time and difficult to recover from. We introduce FLARE (Future-aware Lookahead with Reward Estimation) as a minimal instantiation of future-aware planning to enforce explicit lookahead, value propagation, and limited commitment in a single model, allowing downstream outcomes to influence early decisions. Across multiple benchmarks, agent frameworks, and LLM backbones, FLARE consistently improves task performance and planning-level behavior, frequently allowing LLaMA-8B with FLARE to outperform GPT-4o with standard step-by-step reasoning. These results establish a clear distinction between reasoning and planning.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在短时间内展现出强大的逐步推理能力，但往往无法在长程规划中维持连贯的行为。我们认为这种失败反映了一个根本性的不匹配：逐步推理产生了一种短视的贪婪策略，这种策略足以应对短程场景，但在长程规划中却失效，因为早期行动必须考虑到延迟的影响。从这个以规划为中心的角度出发，我们在具有显式状态转移和评估信号的、确定性的、完全结构化的环境中研究了基于LLM的智能体。我们的分析揭示了基于推理的策略的一个核心失效模式：由逐步评分导致的局部最优选择会导致早期的短视承诺，这些承诺会随着时间的推移被系统性地放大，并且难以挽回。我们引入了FLARE（具有奖励估计的未来感知前瞻），作为未来感知型规划的一个最小实例化，以便在单个模型中强制执行显式的前瞻、价值传播和有限承诺，从而允许下游结果影响早期决策。在多个基准测试、智能体框架和LLM骨干网络中，FLARE始终如一地提高了任务性能和规划层面的行为，经常使得配备FLARE的LLaMA-8B胜过具有标准逐步推理的GPT-4o。这些结果确立了推理和规划之间的一个明确区别。
tldr: The paper identifies a mismatch between step-wise reasoning in LLMs and long-horizon planning, proposes FLARE for future-aware planning, and demonstrates its effectiveness in improving task performance across diverse benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文指出LLM中逐步推理与长程规划之间的不匹配，提出了FLARE用于未来感知的规划，并证明了其在提高各种基准测试中的任务性能方面的有效性。

title: Exploring Reasoning Reward Model for Agents
summary: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) has achieved notable success in enabling agents to perform complex reasoning and tool use. However, most methods still relies on sparse outcome-based reward for training. Such feedback fails to differentiate intermediate reasoning quality, leading to suboptimal training results. In this paper, we introduce Agent Reasoning Reward Model (Agent-RRM), a multi-faceted reward model that produces structured feedback for agentic trajectories, including (1) an explicit reasoning trace , (2) a focused critique that provides refinement guidance by highlighting reasoning flaws, and (3) an overall score that evaluates process performance. Leveraging these signals, we systematically investigate three integration strategies: Reagent-C (text-augmented refinement), Reagent-R (reward-augmented guidance), and Reagent-U (unified feedback integration). Extensive evaluations across 12 diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Reagent-U yields substantial performance leaps, achieving 43.7% on GAIA and 46.2% on WebWalkerQA, validating the effectiveness of our reasoning reward model and training schemes. Code, models, and datasets are all released to facilitate future research.
summary_zh: 主动式强化学习（Agentic RL）已在使智能体执行复杂推理和工具使用方面取得了显著成功。然而，大多数方法仍然依赖于基于稀疏结果的奖励进行训练。这种反馈无法区分中间推理质量，导致次优的训练结果。在本文中，我们引入了智能体推理奖励模型（Agent-RRM），这是一个多方面的奖励模型，为主动式轨迹生成结构化反馈，包括（1）显式推理轨迹，（2）通过突出推理缺陷提供改进指导的重点评论，以及（3）评估过程性能的总体评分。利用这些信号，我们系统地研究了三种集成策略：Reagent-C（文本增强型改进）、Reagent-R（奖励增强型指导）和Reagent-U（统一反馈集成）。在12个不同的基准测试中进行的大量评估表明，Reagent-U产生了显著的性能飞跃，在GAIA上实现了43.7%的提升，在WebWalkerQA上实现了46.2%的提升，验证了我们的推理奖励模型和训练方案的有效性。代码、模型和数据集均已发布，以促进未来的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces Agent-RRM, a multi-faceted reward model for agentic RL that provides structured feedback including reasoning traces, critiques, and scores. It demonstrates significant performance improvements on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 Agent-RRM，一种用于智能体强化学习的多方面奖励模型，它提供结构化的反馈，包括推理轨迹、评论和分数。它在各种基准测试中表现出显著的性能提升。

title: DynaWeb: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning of Web Agents
summary: The development of autonomous web agents, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) and reinforcement learning (RL), represents a significant step towards general-purpose AI assistants. However, training these agents is severely hampered by the challenges of interacting with the live internet, which is inefficient, costly, and fraught with risks. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) offers a promising solution by learning a world model of the environment to enable simulated interaction. This paper introduces DynaWeb, a novel MBRL framework that trains web agents through interacting with a web world model trained to predict naturalistic web page representations given agent actions. This model serves as a synthetic web environment where an agent policy can dream by generating vast quantities of rollout action trajectories for efficient online reinforcement learning. Beyond free policy rollouts, DynaWeb incorporates real expert trajectories from training data, which are randomly interleaved with on-policy rollouts during training to improve stability and sample efficiency. Experiments conducted on the challenging WebArena and WebVoyager benchmarks demonstrate that DynaWeb consistently and significantly improves the performance of state-of-the-art open-source web agent models. Our findings establish the viability of training web agents through imagination, offering a scalable and efficient way to scale up online agentic RL.
summary_zh:
摘要：
由大型语言模型 (LLM) 和强化学习 (RL) 驱动的自主网络代理的开发，代表着迈向通用人工智能助手的重要一步。然而，训练这些代理严重受到与实时互联网交互所带来的挑战的阻碍，这既低效又昂贵，且充满风险。基于模型的强化学习 (MBRL) 通过学习环境的世界模型来实现模拟交互，提供了一个有前景的解决方案。本文介绍了一种新型 MBRL 框架 DynaWeb，它通过与网络世界模型交互来训练网络代理，该模型旨在根据代理行为预测自然的网络页面表示。该模型充当了一个合成网络环境，代理策略可以通过生成大量的 rollout 行为轨迹来梦想，从而实现高效的在线强化学习。除了自由策略 rollout 之外，DynaWeb 还整合了来自训练数据的真实专家轨迹，这些轨迹在训练期间与 on-policy rollout 随机交织，以提高稳定性和样本效率。在具有挑战性的 WebArena 和 WebVoyager 基准测试中进行的实验表明，DynaWeb 持续且显著地提高了最先进的开源网络代理模型的性能。我们的研究结果确立了通过想象训练网络代理的可行性，从而提供了一种可扩展且高效的方式来扩大在线代理 RL。
tldr: DynaWeb is a novel model-based RL framework using a learned world model to train web agents with improved efficiency and stability, achieving strong performance on WebArena and WebVoyager benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DynaWeb 是一种新颖的基于模型的强化学习框架，它使用学习到的世界模型来训练 Web 代理，从而提高效率和稳定性，并在 WebArena 和 WebVoyager 基准测试中实现了强大的性能。

title: Triage: Hierarchical Visual Budgeting for Efficient Video Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face significant computational challenges in video processing due to massive data redundancy, which creates prohibitively long token sequences. To address this, we introduce Triage, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that reframes video reasoning as a resource allocation problem via hierarchical visual budgeting. Its first stage, Frame-Level Budgeting, identifies keyframes by evaluating their visual dynamics and relevance, generating a strategic prior based on their importance scores. Guided by this prior, the second stage, Token-Level Budgeting, allocates tokens in two phases: it first secures high-relevance Core Tokens, followed by diverse Context Tokens selected with an efficient batched Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Triage improves inference speed and reduces memory footprint, while maintaining or surpassing the performance of baselines and other methods on various video reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在视频处理中面临着巨大的计算挑战，这是由于大量的数据冗余导致了过长的token序列。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了Triage，一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，它通过分层视觉预算将视频推理重新定义为一个资源分配问题。它的第一阶段，帧级别预算，通过评估关键帧的视觉动态和相关性来识别关键帧，从而基于其重要性得分生成一个战略先验。在这一先验的指导下，第二阶段，token级别预算，分两个阶段分配token：首先确保高相关性的核心Token，然后使用高效的批量最大边缘相关性（MMR）算法选择多样化的上下文Token。大量的实验表明，Triage提高了推理速度并减少了内存占用，同时在各种视频推理基准测试中保持或超过了基线和其他方法的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Triage, a training-free framework for efficient video reasoning in VLMs via hierarchical visual budgeting, improving speed and reducing memory while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Triage，一个免训练的框架，通过分层视觉预算来实现VLM中高效的视频推理，从而提高速度并减少内存，同时保持性能。

title: VisionTrim: Unified Vision Token Compression for Training-Free MLLM Acceleration
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) suffer from high computational costs due to excessive visual tokens, particularly in high-resolution and video-based scenarios. Existing token reduction methods typically focus on isolated pipeline components and often neglect textual alignment, leading to performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VisionTrim, a unified framework for training-free MLLM acceleration, integrating two effective plug-and-play modules: 1) the Dominant Vision Token Selection (DVTS) module, which preserves essential visual tokens via a global-local view, and 2) the Text-Guided Vision Complement (TGVC) module, which facilitates context-aware token merging guided by textual cues. Extensive experiments across diverse image and video multimodal benchmarks demonstrate the performance superiority of our VisionTrim, advancing practical MLLM deployment in real-world applications. The code is available at: https://github.com/hanxunyu/VisionTrim.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）由于过多的视觉tokens而面临高计算成本，尤其是在高分辨率和基于视频的场景中。现有的token缩减方法通常侧重于孤立的pipeline组件，并且常常忽视文本对齐，导致性能下降。本文提出VisionTrim，一个用于无需训练的MLLM加速的统一框架，集成了两个有效的即插即用模块：1）主导视觉Token 选择（DVTS）模块，通过全局-局部视角保留必要的视觉tokens；2）文本引导的视觉补充（TGVC）模块，有助于在文本线索指导下进行上下文感知的token合并。在各种图像和视频多模态基准上的大量实验证明了我们VisionTrim的性能优势，推动了MLLM在实际应用中的部署。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/hanxunyu/VisionTrim。
tldr: The paper introduces VisionTrim, a training-free framework for accelerating MLLMs by intelligently compressing visual tokens through dominant token selection and text-guided merging, achieving superior performance on multimodal benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VisionTrim，一个无需训练的框架，通过智能地压缩视觉令牌来加速MLLM，通过主导令牌选择和文本引导的合并，在多模态基准测试中实现了优异的性能。

title: PhoStream: Benchmarking Real-World Streaming for Omnimodal Assistants in Mobile Scenarios
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models excel at offline audio-visual understanding, but their ability to serve as mobile assistants in continuous real-world streams remains underexplored. In daily phone use, mobile assistants must track streaming audio-visual inputs and respond at the right time, yet existing benchmarks are often restricted to multiple-choice questions or use shorter videos. In this paper, we introduce PhoStream, the first mobile-centric streaming benchmark that unifies on-screen and off-screen scenarios to evaluate video, audio, and temporal reasoning. PhoStream contains 5,572 open-ended QA pairs from 578 videos across 4 scenarios and 10 capabilities. We build it with an Automated Generative Pipeline backed by rigorous human verification, and evaluate models using a realistic Online Inference Pipeline and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation for open-ended responses. Experiments reveal a temporal asymmetry in LLM-judged scores (0-100): models perform well on Instant and Backward tasks (Gemini 3 Pro exceeds 80), but drop sharply on Forward tasks (16.40), largely due to early responses before the required visual and audio cues appear. This highlights a fundamental limitation: current MLLMs struggle to decide when to speak, not just what to say. Code and datasets used in this work will be made publicly accessible at https://github.com/Lucky-Lance/PhoStream.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型擅长离线音视频理解，但它们在持续真实世界流中作为移动助手的能力仍未得到充分探索。在日常手机使用中，移动助手必须跟踪流式音视频输入并在正确的时间做出响应，然而现有的基准测试通常局限于多项选择题或使用较短的视频。在本文中，我们推出了PhoStream，这是第一个以移动为中心的流式基准测试，它统一了屏幕上和屏幕外的场景以评估视频、音频和时间推理。PhoStream包含来自578个视频的5572个开放式问答对，涵盖4个场景和10项能力。我们通过一个由严格的人工验证支持的自动化生成流程构建了它，并使用一个真实的在线推理流程和LLM-as-a-Judge评估方法来评估模型的开放式回答。实验揭示了LLM评分（0-100）中的时间不对称性：模型在即时和回溯任务中表现良好（Gemini 3 Pro超过80），但在前瞻任务中急剧下降（16.40），这主要是由于在所需的视觉和音频提示出现之前就进行了早期响应。这突显了一个根本性的局限：当前的MLLM难以决定何时说话，而不仅仅是说什么。本工作中使用的代码和数据集将在https://github.com/Lucky-Lance/PhoStream上公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces PhoStream, a new mobile-centric streaming benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs in real-world mobile assistant scenarios, highlighting the difficulty current models have in determining *when* to respond to streaming audio-visual inputs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PhoStream，这是一个新的以移动设备为中心的流媒体基准，用于评估多模态LLM在现实移动助手场景中的表现，强调了当前模型在确定*何时*响应流式音视频输入方面存在的困难。

title: From Absolute to Relative: Rethinking Reward Shaping in Group-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a cornerstone for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models, where group-based approaches such as GRPO have emerged as efficient paradigms that optimize policies by leveraging intra-group performance differences. However, these methods typically rely on absolute numerical rewards, introducing intrinsic limitations. In verifiable tasks, identical group evaluations often result in sparse supervision, while in open-ended scenarios, the score range instability of reward models undermines advantage estimation based on group means. To address these limitations, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Relative Rewards (RLRR), a framework that shifts reward shaping from absolute scoring to relative ranking. Complementing this framework, we introduce the Ranking Reward Model, a listwise preference model tailored for group-based optimization to directly generate relative rankings. By transforming raw evaluations into robust relative signals, RLRR effectively mitigates signal sparsity and reward instability. Experimental results demonstrate that RLRR yields consistent performance improvements over standard group-based baselines across reasoning benchmarks and open-ended generation tasks.
summary_zh: 强化学习已成为增强大型语言模型推理能力的重要基石，其中 GRPO 等基于群体的方法已成为高效的范式，通过利用群体内部的性能差异来优化策略。然而，这些方法通常依赖于绝对数值奖励，从而引入了内在的局限性。在可验证的任务中，相同的群体评估通常导致稀疏的监督信号；而在开放式场景中，奖励模型的评分范围不稳定会破坏基于群体均值的优势估计。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了基于相对奖励的强化学习 (RLRR)，该框架将奖励塑造从绝对评分转变为相对排名。作为该框架的补充，我们引入了排名奖励模型 (Ranking Reward Model)，这是一种为基于群体的优化量身定制的列表式偏好模型，用于直接生成相对排名。通过将原始评估转化为稳健的相对信号，RLRR 有效地缓解了信号稀疏性和奖励不稳定性。实验结果表明，在推理基准测试和开放式生成任务中，RLRR 相对于标准基于群体的基线方法，均能产生持续的性能提升。
tldr: The paper introduces Reinforcement Learning with Relative Rewards (RLRR), a framework that uses relative ranking instead of absolute rewards in group-based RL, addressing signal sparsity and reward instability issues, and demonstrating performance improvements in reasoning and generation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了具有相对奖励的强化学习（RLRR）框架，该框架在基于群体的强化学习中使用相对排序而不是绝对奖励，解决了信号稀疏性和奖励不稳定性问题，并在推理和生成任务中展示了性能改进。

title: Divide-and-Conquer CoT: RL for Reducing Latency via Parallel Reasoning
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning (Long CoT) is now fundamental to state-of-the-art LLMs, especially in mathematical reasoning. However, LLM generation is highly sequential, and long CoTs lead to a high latency. We propose to train Divide-and-Conquer CoT (DC-CoT) to reduce the latency. With DC-CoT, the model can act as a director that identifies distinct subtasks that can be performed in parallel in its reasoning process, and then spawns workers to execute the subtasks. Our goal is to achieve high accuracy, with a low longest path length, which is a theoretical measure of the latency needed for the response. We start with a long CoT base model (DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview), and first use SFT with a small curated demonstration set to initialize its ability to spawn workers in a certain format. Because SFT degrades the accuracy significantly, we design a multi-stage RL algorithm, with various data filtering strategies, to recover the accuracy while decreasing the longest path length. Across several benchmarks including AIME 2024 and HMMT 2025, DC-CoT achieves similar accuracy as DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview while decreasing longest path length by 35-40%. Our code, SFT dataset and models are publicly available at https://github.com/amahankali10/DC_CoT_RL_for_Low_Latency_CoT_with_Parallel_Reasoning.
summary_zh: 长程思维链推理（Long CoT）现在是先进大型语言模型（LLM）的基础，尤其是在数学推理方面。然而，LLM的生成过程高度序列化，而长CoT会导致高延迟。我们提出训练分而治之CoT（DC-CoT）来降低延迟。使用DC-CoT，模型可以充当指导者，识别推理过程中可以并行执行的不同子任务，然后生成工作者来执行这些子任务。我们的目标是在保持高准确率的同时，降低最长路径长度，这是响应所需延迟的理论度量。我们从一个长CoT基础模型（DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview）开始，首先使用SFT和一个小的精选演示集来初始化其以特定格式生成工作者的能力。由于SFT会显著降低准确率，我们设计了一个多阶段RL算法，结合各种数据过滤策略，以在降低最长路径长度的同时恢复准确率。在包括AIME 2024和HMMT 2025在内的多个基准测试中，DC-CoT实现了与DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview相似的准确率，同时最长路径长度降低了35-40%。我们的代码、SFT数据集和模型已在https://github.com/amahankali10/DC_CoT_RL_for_Low_Latency_CoT_with_Parallel_Reasoning上公开。
tldr: The paper introduces Divide-and-Conquer CoT (DC-CoT), a reinforcement learning approach to reduce the latency of long chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs by parallelizing subtasks, achieving comparable accuracy to the base model with significantly reduced longest path length.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Divide-and-Conquer CoT (DC-CoT)，一种通过并行化子任务来减少LLM中长链式思考推理延迟的强化学习方法，在实现与基础模型相当的准确率的同时，显著降低了最长路径长度。

title: Mem-T: Densifying Rewards for Long-Horizon Memory Agents
summary: Memory agents, which depart from predefined memory-processing pipelines by endogenously managing the processing, storage, and retrieval of memories, have garnered increasing attention for their autonomy and adaptability. However, existing training paradigms remain constrained: agents often traverse long-horizon sequences of memory operations before receiving sparse and delayed rewards, which hinders truly end-to-end optimization of memory management policies. To address this limitation, we introduce Mem-T, an autonomous memory agent that interfaces with a lightweight hierarchical memory database to perform dynamic updates and multi-turn retrieval over streaming inputs. To effectively train long-horizon memory management capabilities, we further propose MoT-GRPO, a tree-guided reinforcement learning framework that transforms sparse terminal feedback into dense, step-wise supervision via memory operation tree backpropagation and hindsight credit assignment, thereby enabling the joint optimization of memory construction and retrieval. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Mem-T is (1) high-performing, surpassing frameworks such as A-Mem and Mem0 by up to $14.92\%$, and (2) economical, operating on a favorable accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier and reducing inference tokens per query by $\sim24.45\%$ relative to GAM without sacrificing performance.
summary_zh: 记忆代理，凭借其自主性和适应性，越来越受到关注，这类代理摆脱了预定义的记忆处理流程，能够内生地管理记忆的处理、存储和检索。然而，现有的训练范式仍然存在局限：代理通常在收到稀疏且延迟的回报之前，需要遍历长期的记忆操作序列，这阻碍了记忆管理策略的真正端到端优化。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了Mem-T，一种自主记忆代理，它与一个轻量级的分层记忆数据库交互，以对流式输入执行动态更新和多轮检索。为了有效地训练长期的记忆管理能力，我们进一步提出了MoT-GRPO，一种树引导的强化学习框架，该框架通过记忆操作树反向传播和后见之明信用分配，将稀疏的终端反馈转化为密集的逐步监督，从而实现记忆构建和检索的联合优化。大量的实验表明，Mem-T具有以下优点：（1）高性能，超越了A-Mem和Mem0等框架，最高提升达到14.92%；（2）经济性，运作在有利的准确率-效率帕累托前沿，并且相对于GAM，在不牺牲性能的前提下，每次查询减少约24.45%的推理tokens。
tldr: The paper introduces Mem-T, an autonomous memory agent trained with a novel tree-guided reinforcement learning framework (MoT-GRPO) to improve long-horizon memory management, demonstrating superior performance and efficiency compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Mem-T，一种自主记忆代理，通过一种新的树引导强化学习框架(MoT-GRPO)进行训练，以改进长时程记忆管理。实验表明，与现有方法相比，该方法具有更优越的性能和效率。

title: PlatoLTL: Learning to Generalize Across Symbols in LTL Instructions for Multi-Task RL
summary: A central challenge in multi-task reinforcement learning (RL) is to train generalist policies capable of performing tasks not seen during training. To facilitate such generalization, linear temporal logic (LTL) has recently emerged as a powerful formalism for specifying structured, temporally extended tasks to RL agents. While existing approaches to LTL-guided multi-task RL demonstrate successful generalization across LTL specifications, they are unable to generalize to unseen vocabularies of propositions (or "symbols"), which describe high-level events in LTL. We present PlatoLTL, a novel approach that enables policies to zero-shot generalize not only compositionally across LTL formula structures, but also parametrically across propositions. We achieve this by treating propositions as instances of parameterized predicates rather than discrete symbols, allowing policies to learn shared structure across related propositions. We propose a novel architecture that embeds and composes predicates to represent LTL specifications, and demonstrate successful zero-shot generalization to novel propositions and tasks across challenging environments.
summary_zh: 多任务强化学习（RL）的核心挑战是训练能够执行训练过程中未见任务的通用策略。为促进这种泛化，线性时序逻辑（LTL）最近作为一种强大的形式化方法出现，用于向RL智能体指定结构化、时间扩展的任务。虽然现有的LTL引导的多任务RL方法在LTL规范中展示了成功的泛化能力，但它们无法泛化到未见的命题词汇表（或“符号”），这些符号描述了LTL中的高级事件。我们提出了PlatoLTL，一种新颖的方法，使策略不仅可以在LTL公式结构中进行组合泛化，还可以在命题中进行参数泛化，从而实现零样本泛化。我们通过将命题视为参数化谓词的实例而不是离散符号来实现这一点，从而允许策略学习相关命题之间的共享结构。我们提出了一种新颖的架构，该架构嵌入并组合谓词以表示LTL规范，并在具有挑战性的环境中展示了对新命题和任务的成功零样本泛化。
tldr: The paper introduces PlatoLTL, an RL method that enables zero-shot generalization across both LTL formula structures and unseen vocabularies of propositions by treating propositions as parameterized predicates and learning shared structure.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PlatoLTL，一种RL方法，它通过将命题视为参数化谓词并学习共享结构，实现了在LTL公式结构和未见过的命题词汇表上的零样本泛化。

title: HeaPA: Difficulty-Aware Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: RLVR is now a standard way to train LLMs on reasoning tasks with verifiable outcomes, but when rollout generation dominates the cost, efficiency depends heavily on which prompts you sample and when. In practice, prompt pools are often static or only loosely tied to the model's learning progress, so uniform sampling can't keep up with the shifting capability frontier and ends up wasting rollouts on prompts that are already solved or still out of reach. Existing approaches improve efficiency through filtering, curricula, adaptive rollout allocation, or teacher guidance, but they typically assume a fixed pool-which makes it hard to support stable on-policy pool growth-or they add extra teacher cost and latency. We introduce HeaPA (Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation), which maintains a bounded, evolving pool, tracks the frontier using heap-based boundary sampling, expands the pool via on-policy augmentation with lightweight asynchronous validation, and stabilizes correlated queries through topology-aware re-estimation of pool statistics and controlled reinsertion. Across two training corpora, two training recipes, and seven benchmarks, HeaPA consistently improves accuracy and reaches target performance with fewer computations while keeping wall-clock time comparable. Our analyses suggest these gains come from frontier-focused sampling and on-policy pool growth, with the benefits becoming larger as model scale increases. Our code is available at https://github.com/horizon-rl/HeaPA.
summary_zh: RLVR现在是训练LLM解决具有可验证结果的推理任务的标准方法。然而，当rollout生成占据主要成本时，效率会高度依赖于你采样的提示以及采样的时间。在实践中，提示池通常是静态的，或仅与模型的学习进度松散关联，因此均匀采样无法跟上不断变化的能力前沿，最终导致rollout被浪费在已解决或仍无法触及的提示上。现有方法通过过滤、课程、自适应rollout分配或教师指导来提高效率，但它们通常假设一个固定的池——这使得难以支持稳定的on-policy池增长——或者它们会增加额外的教师成本和延迟。我们引入了HeaPA (Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation，堆采样和On-Policy查询增强)，它维护一个有界、可演化的池，使用基于堆的边界采样来跟踪前沿，通过带有轻量级异步验证的on-policy增强来扩展池，并通过拓扑感知的池统计信息重新估计和受控的重新插入来稳定相关查询。在两个训练语料库、两种训练方案和七个基准测试中，HeaPA始终如一地提高准确性，并以更少的计算量达到目标性能，同时保持相近的挂钟时间。我们的分析表明，这些收益来自于以frontier为中心的采样和on-policy池增长，并且随着模型规模的增加，收益会变得更大。我们的代码可在https://github.com/horizon-rl/HeaPA获取。
tldr: The paper introduces HeaPA, a method for efficient LLM reinforcement learning that uses heap-based sampling and on-policy query augmentation to focus rollouts on prompts at the learning frontier, improving accuracy and computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HeaPA，一种高效的LLM强化学习方法，通过堆式抽样和在线策略查询增强，集中rollout在学习前沿的提示上，从而提高准确性和计算效率。

title: SAIR: Cost-Efficient Multi-Stage ML Pipeline Autoscaling via In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-stage ML inference pipelines are difficult to autoscale due to heterogeneous resources, cross-stage coupling, and dynamic bottleneck migration. We present SAIR, an autoscaling framework that uses an LLM as an in-context reinforcement learning controller, improving its policy online from reward-labeled interaction histories without gradient updates. SAIR combines Pareto-dominance reward shaping with a provable separation margin, surprisal-guided experience retrieval for context efficiency, and fine-grained GPU rate control via user-space CUDA interception. We provide regret analysis decomposing error into retrieval coverage and LLM selection components. On four ML serving pipelines under three workload patterns, SAIR achieves the best or tied-best P99 latency and effective resource cost among deployed baselines, improving P99 by up to 50% and reducing effective cost by up to 97% (under GPU rate-control assumptions), with 86% bottleneck detection accuracy and no offline training.
summary_zh: 多阶段机器学习推理流水线由于异构资源、跨阶段耦合和动态瓶颈迁移而难以自动伸缩。我们提出了SAIR，一个使用LLM作为上下文强化学习控制器的自动伸缩框架，通过从奖励标记的交互历史记录中在线改进其策略，而无需梯度更新。SAIR结合了帕累托支配奖励塑造与可证明的分离裕度、用于上下文效率的惊奇度引导的经验检索，以及通过用户空间CUDA拦截实现的细粒度GPU速率控制。我们提供了遗憾分析，将误差分解为检索覆盖率和LLM选择两个组成部分。在三种工作负载模式下的四个ML服务流水线上，SAIR实现了已部署基线中最佳或并列最佳的P99延迟和有效资源成本，在P99延迟上提升高达50%，在有效成本上降低高达97%（在GPU速率控制假设下），并且具有86%的瓶颈检测准确率，无需离线训练。
tldr: The paper introduces SAIR, an autoscaling framework using an LLM as an in-context reinforcement learning controller for multi-stage ML inference pipelines, demonstrating significant improvements in latency and resource cost without offline training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAIR，一个使用LLM作为上下文强化学习控制器，用于多阶段ML推理流水线的自动缩放框架。它在延迟和资源成本方面表现出显著的改进，且不需要离线训练。

title: Failing to Explore: Language Models on Interactive Tasks
summary: We evaluate language models on their ability to explore interactive environments under a limited interaction budget. We introduce three parametric tasks with controllable exploration difficulty, spanning continuous and discrete environments. Across state-of-the-art models, we find systematic under-exploration and suboptimal solutions, with performance often significantly worse than simple explore--exploit heuristic baselines and scaling weakly as the budget increases. Finally, we study two lightweight interventions: splitting a fixed budget into parallel executions, which surprisingly improves performance despite a no-gain theoretical result for our tasks, and periodically summarizing the interaction history, which preserves key discoveries and further improves exploration.
summary_zh: 我们评估了语言模型在有限交互预算下探索交互式环境的能力。我们引入了三种参数化任务，其探索难度可控，涵盖连续和离散环境。在最先进的模型中，我们发现了系统性的探索不足和次优解，其性能通常明显低于简单的探索-利用启发式基线，并且随着预算的增加而扩展性较弱。最后，我们研究了两种轻量级干预手段：将固定预算拆分为并行执行，令人惊讶的是，尽管我们的任务在理论上没有收益，但它提高了性能；以及定期总结交互历史，这保留了关键发现并进一步改善了探索。
tldr: This paper evaluates the exploration abilities of language models in interactive environments, finding they systematically under-explore and perform worse than simple heuristics. Simple interventions like parallel execution and periodic summarization improve exploration.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了语言模型在交互式环境中探索的能力，发现它们系统性地探索不足，并且表现不如简单的启发式方法。 简单的干预措施，如并行执行和定期总结，可以提高探索能力。

title: RN-D: Discretized Categorical Actors with Regularized Networks for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: On-policy deep reinforcement learning remains a dominant paradigm for continuous control, yet standard implementations rely on Gaussian actors and relatively shallow MLP policies, often leading to brittle optimization when gradients are noisy and policy updates must be conservative. In this paper, we revisit policy representation as a first-class design choice for on-policy optimization. We study discretized categorical actors that represent each action dimension with a distribution over bins, yielding a policy objective that resembles a cross-entropy loss. Building on architectural advances from supervised learning, we further propose regularized actor networks, while keeping critic design fixed. Our results show that simply replacing the standard actor network with our discretized regularized actor yields consistent gains and achieve the state-of-the-art performance across diverse continuous-control benchmarks.
summary_zh: 在连续控制领域，同策略深度强化学习仍然是主流范式，然而，标准的实现依赖于高斯动作器和相对浅层的多层感知机策略，这通常会导致在梯度噪声较大且策略更新必须保守时出现脆弱的优化。在本文中，我们重新审视了策略表示，将其作为同策略优化的首要设计选择。我们研究了离散化的分类动作器，它使用关于区间的分布来表示每个动作维度，从而产生一个类似于交叉熵损失的策略目标。在监督学习的架构进步的基础上，我们进一步提出了正则化的动作器网络，同时保持了批评器设计的固定。我们的结果表明，简单地用我们离散化的正则化动作器替换标准动作器网络，就能在各种连续控制基准测试中获得一致的增益并达到最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel on-policy RL approach using discretized categorical actors with regularized networks, achieving state-of-the-art performance on continuous control benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的on-policy强化学习方法，该方法使用离散化的分类actor和正则化网络，在连续控制基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: MOSAIC: Modular Scalable Autonomy for Intelligent Coordination of Heterogeneous Robotic Teams
summary: Mobile robots have become indispensable for exploring hostile environments, such as in space or disaster relief scenarios, but often remain limited to teleoperation by a human operator. This restricts the deployment scale and requires near-continuous low-latency communication between the operator and the robot. We present MOSAIC: a scalable autonomy framework for multi-robot scientific exploration using a unified mission abstraction based on Points of Interest (POIs) and multiple layers of autonomy, enabling supervision by a single operator. The framework dynamically allocates exploration and measurement tasks based on each robot's capabilities, leveraging team-level redundancy and specialization to enable continuous operation. We validated the framework in a space-analog field experiment emulating a lunar prospecting scenario, involving a heterogeneous team of five robots and a single operator. Despite the complete failure of one robot during the mission, the team completed 82.3% of assigned tasks at an Autonomy Ratio of 86%, while the operator workload remained at only 78.2%. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables robust, scalable multi-robot scientific exploration with limited operator intervention. We further derive practical lessons learned in robot interoperability, networking architecture, team composition, and operator workload management to inform future multi-robot exploration missions.
summary_zh: 移动机器人已成为探索恶劣环境（如太空或灾难救援场景）不可或缺的工具，但通常仍局限于人工遥控。这限制了部署规模，并且需要在操作员和机器人之间进行近乎连续的低延迟通信。我们提出了MOSAIC：一个可扩展的自主框架，用于基于兴趣点（POI）的统一任务抽象和多层自主性实现的多机器人科学探索，从而能够由单个操作员进行监督。该框架根据每个机器人的能力动态分配探索和测量任务，利用团队层面的冗余和专业化来实现连续运行。我们在一个模拟月球勘探场景的空间模拟外场实验中验证了该框架，实验包括一个由五个机器人和一名操作员组成的异构团队。尽管在任务期间一台机器人完全失效，但该团队仍以86%的自主率完成了82.3%的分配任务，同时操作员的工作量仅为78.2%。这些结果表明，所提出的框架能够以有限的操作员干预实现稳健、可扩展的多机器人科学探索。我们进一步得出在机器人互操作性、网络架构、团队组成和操作员工作量管理方面的实践经验教训，为未来的多机器人探索任务提供参考。
tldr: The paper presents MOSAIC, a scalable autonomy framework for heterogeneous robot teams performing scientific exploration, demonstrated in a lunar prospecting analog with high autonomy and task completion rates despite robot failure.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 MOSAIC，一个可扩展的自主框架，用于异构机器人团队执行科学探索任务。该框架在一个模拟月球勘探的实验中得到验证，即使在机器人发生故障的情况下，也能实现高自主性和任务完成率。

title: Robust Rigid Body Assembly via Contact-Implicit Optimal Control with Exact Second-Order Derivatives
summary: Efficient planning of assembly motions is a long standing challenge in the field of robotics that has been primarily tackled with reinforcement learning and sampling-based methods by using extensive physics simulations. This paper proposes a sample-efficient robust optimal control approach for the determination of assembly motions, which requires significantly less physics simulation steps during planning through the efficient use of derivative information. To this end, a differentiable physics simulation is constructed that provides second-order analytic derivatives to the numerical solver and allows one to traverse seamlessly from informative derivatives to accurate contact simulation. The solution of the physics simulation problem is made differentiable by using smoothing inspired by interior-point methods applied to both the collision detection as well as the contact resolution problem. We propose a modified variant of an optimization-based formulation of collision detection formulated as a linear program and present an efficient implementation for the nominal evaluation and corresponding first- and second-order derivatives. Moreover, a multi-scenario-based trajectory optimization problem that ensures robustness with respect to sim-to-real mismatches is derived. The capability of the considered formulation is illustrated by results where over 99\% successful executions are achieved in real-world experiments. Thereby, we carefully investigate the effect of smooth approximations of the contact dynamics and robust modeling on the success rates. Furthermore, the method's capability is tested on different peg-in-hole problems in simulation to show the benefit of using exact Hessians over commonly used Hessian approximations.
summary_zh: 高效的装配运动规划一直是机器人领域一个长期存在的挑战，主要通过强化学习和基于采样的算法，并借助大量的物理仿真来解决。本文提出了一种采样高效的鲁棒最优控制方法，用于确定装配运动，该方法通过高效利用导数信息，在规划过程中显著减少了物理仿真步骤。为此，构建了一个可微的物理仿真器，它为数值求解器提供二阶解析导数，并允许从信息丰富的导数无缝过渡到精确的接触仿真。通过使用受内点法启发的平滑策略，将其应用于碰撞检测和接触求解问题，使物理仿真问题的求解过程可微。我们提出了一种改进的基于优化的碰撞检测公式，将其表示成线性规划问题，并展示了名义评估以及相应的一阶和二阶导数的有效实现。此外，还推导出了一个基于多场景的轨迹优化问题，以确保对sim-to-real差异的鲁棒性。所考虑的公式的能力通过真实世界实验中超过99%的成功执行率来验证。在此，我们仔细研究了接触动力学平滑近似和鲁棒建模对成功率的影响。此外，该方法的能力还在不同的孔轴配合问题仿真中进行了测试，以展示使用精确Hessian矩阵相对于常用的Hessian矩阵近似的优势。
tldr: This paper introduces a sample-efficient, robust optimal control approach for robotic assembly, leveraging differentiable physics and exact second-order derivatives to achieve high success rates in real-world peg-in-hole experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人装配的高效、鲁棒的最优控制方法，利用可微分物理和精确的二阶导数，在真实的插孔实验中实现了很高的成功率。

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning of High-Quality Behaviors Under Robust Style Alignment
summary: We study offline reinforcement learning of style-conditioned policies using explicit style supervision via subtrajectory labeling functions. In this setting, aligning style with high task performance is particularly challenging due to distribution shift and inherent conflicts between style and reward. Existing methods, despite introducing numerous definitions of style, often fail to reconcile these objectives effectively. To address these challenges, we propose a unified definition of behavior style and instantiate it into a practical framework. Building on this, we introduce Style-Conditioned Implicit Q-Learning (SCIQL), which leverages offline goal-conditioned RL techniques, such as hindsight relabeling and value learning, and combine it with a new Gated Advantage Weighted Regression mechanism to efficiently optimize task performance while preserving style alignment. Experiments demonstrate that SCIQL achieves superior performance on both objectives compared to prior offline methods. Code, datasets and visuals are available in: https://sciql-iclr-2026.github.io/.
summary_zh: 我们研究了使用子轨迹标注函数进行显式风格监督的离线强化学习风格条件策略。在这种情况下，由于分布偏移以及风格和奖励之间的内在冲突，使风格与高任务性能对齐尤其具有挑战性。尽管现有方法引入了大量的风格定义，但往往无法有效地协调这些目标。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种统一的行为风格定义，并将其实例化为一个实用的框架。在此基础上，我们引入了风格条件隐式Q学习（SCIQL），它利用离线目标条件强化学习技术，例如后见之明重标记和价值学习，并将其与一种新的门控优势加权回归机制相结合，以在保持风格对齐的同时有效地优化任务性能。实验表明，与之前的离线方法相比，SCIQL在两个目标上都取得了更优越的性能。代码、数据集和可视化效果可在以下网址获得：https://sciql-iclr-2026.github.io/。
tldr: This paper introduces Style-Conditioned Implicit Q-Learning (SCIQL) for offline reinforcement learning of style-conditioned policies, addressing the challenge of aligning style with task performance by combining goal-conditioned RL techniques with a gated advantage-weighted regression mechanism. Experiments show improved performance over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了风格条件隐式Q学习（SCIQL），用于离线强化学习风格条件策略，通过结合目标条件强化学习技术和门控优势加权回归机制，解决了风格与任务性能对齐的挑战。实验表明，与现有方法相比，该方法表现出更优越的性能。

title: FlyAware: Inertia-Aware Aerial Manipulation via Vision-Based Estimation and Post-Grasp Adaptation
summary: Aerial manipulators (AMs) are gaining increasing attention in automated transportation and emergency services due to their superior dexterity compared to conventional multirotor drones. However, their practical deployment is challenged by the complexity of time-varying inertial parameters, which are highly sensitive to payload variations and manipulator configurations. Inspired by human strategies for interacting with unknown objects, this letter presents a novel onboard framework for robust aerial manipulation. The proposed system integrates a vision-based pre-grasp inertia estimation module with a post-grasp adaptation mechanism, enabling real-time estimation and adaptation of inertial dynamics. For control, we develop an inertia-aware adaptive control strategy based on gain scheduling, and assess its robustness via frequency-domain system identification. Our study provides new insights into post-grasp control for AMs, and real-world experiments validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed framework.
summary_zh: 空中操作臂（AMs）因其相比传统多旋翼无人机的卓越灵活性，在自动化运输和应急服务领域正受到越来越多的关注。然而，其实际部署面临着时变惯性参数复杂性的挑战，这些参数对有效载荷变化和操作臂构型高度敏感。受人类与未知物体交互策略的启发，本文提出了一种用于稳健空中操作的新型机载框架。所提出的系统集成了基于视觉的预抓取惯性估计模块和抓取后自适应机制，实现了惯性动力学的实时估计和自适应调整。在控制方面，我们开发了一种基于增益调度的惯性感知自适应控制策略，并通过频域系统辨识评估其鲁棒性。我们的研究为空中操作臂的抓取后控制提供了新的见解，并且真实的实验验证了所提出框架的有效性和可行性。
tldr: This paper introduces an onboard framework for aerial manipulators that uses vision-based inertia estimation and post-grasp adaptation to handle the challenges caused by time-varying inertial parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种机载空中机械臂框架，该框架利用基于视觉的惯性估计和抓取后自适应来应对时变惯性参数带来的挑战。

title: Exo-Plore: Exploring Exoskeleton Control Space through Human-aligned Simulation
summary: Exoskeletons show great promise for enhancing mobility, but providing appropriate assistance remains challenging due to the complexity of human adaptation to external forces. Current state-of-the-art approaches for optimizing exoskeleton controllers require extensive human experiments in which participants must walk for hours, creating a paradox: those who could benefit most from exoskeleton assistance, such as individuals with mobility impairments, are rarely able to participate in such demanding procedures. We present Exo-plore, a simulation framework that combines neuromechanical simulation with deep reinforcement learning to optimize hip exoskeleton assistance without requiring real human experiments. Exo-plore can (1) generate realistic gait data that captures human adaptation to assistive forces, (2) produce reliable optimization results despite the stochastic nature of human gait, and (3) generalize to pathological gaits, showing strong linear relationships between pathology severity and optimal assistance.
summary_zh: 外骨骼在增强行动能力方面展现出巨大的潜力，但由于人体对外力的适应具有复杂性，提供适当的辅助仍然具有挑战性。目前最先进的外骨骼控制器优化方法需要大量的人体实验，参与者必须步行数小时，这造成了一个悖论：那些最能从外骨骼辅助中获益的人，例如行动障碍者，却很少能够参与到如此高要求的程序中。我们提出了Exo-plore，一个将神经-机械仿真与深度强化学习相结合的仿真框架，无需真实人体实验即可优化髋部外骨骼的辅助。Exo-plore能够（1）生成能够捕捉人体对辅助力适应的逼真步态数据，（2）在人体步态的随机性下产生可靠的优化结果，以及（3）推广到病态步态，显示出病理严重程度与最佳辅助之间的强线性关系。
tldr: The paper introduces Exo-plore, a simulation framework using neuromechanical simulation and deep reinforcement learning to optimize hip exoskeleton assistance, reducing the need for extensive human experiments and enabling personalization for pathological gaits.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为Exo-plore的仿真框架，该框架结合了神经机械模拟和深度强化学习来优化髋关节外骨骼的辅助，减少了对大量人体实验的需求，并实现了对病态步态的个性化定制。

title: RoboStriker: Hierarchical Decision-Making for Autonomous Humanoid Boxing
summary: Achieving human-level competitive intelligence and physical agility in humanoid robots remains a major challenge, particularly in contact-rich and highly dynamic tasks such as boxing. While Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) offers a principled framework for strategic interaction, its direct application to humanoid control is hindered by high-dimensional contact dynamics and the absence of strong physical motion priors. We propose RoboStriker, a hierarchical three-stage framework that enables fully autonomous humanoid boxing by decoupling high-level strategic reasoning from low-level physical execution. The framework first learns a comprehensive repertoire of boxing skills by training a single-agent motion tracker on human motion capture data. These skills are subsequently distilled into a structured latent manifold, regularized by projecting the Gaussian-parameterized distribution onto a unit hypersphere. This topological constraint effectively confines exploration to the subspace of physically plausible motions. In the final stage, we introduce Latent-Space Neural Fictitious Self-Play (LS-NFSP), where competing agents learn competitive tactics by interacting within the latent action space rather than the raw motor space, significantly stabilizing multi-agent training. Experimental results demonstrate that RoboStriker achieves superior competitive performance in simulation and exhibits sim-to-real transfer. Our website is available at RoboStriker.
summary_zh: 在人形机器人中实现人类水平的竞争智能和身体敏捷性仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在诸如拳击等接触频繁且高度动态的任务中。虽然多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 为战略互动提供了一个有原则的框架，但由于高维接触动力学和缺乏强大的物理运动先验知识，它直接应用于人形机器人控制受到阻碍。我们提出了 RoboStriker，一个分层三阶段框架，通过将高层战略推理与低层物理执行分离，实现完全自主的人形拳击。该框架首先通过在人类运动捕捉数据上训练单智能体运动跟踪器来学习全面的拳击技能库。随后，这些技能被提炼成一个结构化的潜在流形，通过将高斯参数化分布投影到单位超球面上来对其进行正则化。这种拓扑约束有效地将探索限制在物理上合理的运动子空间内。在最后阶段，我们引入了 Latent-Space Neural Fictitious Self-Play (LS-NFSP)，其中竞争智能体通过在潜在动作空间而非原始电机空间内进行交互来学习竞争策略，从而显著稳定多智能体训练。实验结果表明，RoboStriker 在模拟中实现了卓越的竞争性能，并表现出从模拟到真实的迁移能力。我们的网站可在 RoboStriker 上访问。
tldr: RoboStriker introduces a hierarchical RL framework for autonomous humanoid boxing, leveraging motion capture data and latent space learning to achieve stable multi-agent training and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: RoboStriker 提出了一个用于自主人形机器人拳击的分层强化学习框架，利用运动捕捉数据和潜在空间学习来实现稳定的多智能体训练和从仿真到现实的迁移。

title: High-Definition 5MP Stereo Vision Sensing for Robotics
summary: High-resolution (5MP+) stereo vision systems are essential for advancing robotic capabilities, enabling operation over longer ranges and generating significantly denser and accurate 3D point clouds. However, realizing the full potential of high-angular-resolution sensors requires a commensurately higher level of calibration accuracy and faster processing -- requirements often unmet by conventional methods. This study addresses that critical gap by processing 5MP camera imagery using a novel, advanced frame-to-frame calibration and stereo matching methodology designed to achieve both high accuracy and speed. Furthermore, we introduce a new approach to evaluate real-time performance by comparing real-time disparity maps with ground-truth disparity maps derived from more computationally intensive stereo matching algorithms. Crucially, the research demonstrates that high-pixel-count cameras yield high-quality point clouds only through the implementation of high-accuracy calibration.
summary_zh: 高分辨率（5MP+）立体视觉系统对于提升机器人性能至关重要，能够实现更远距离的操作并生成密度更高、精度更高的3D点云。 然而，要充分发挥高角分辨率传感器的潜力，必须达到相应更高的校准精度和更快的处理速度——而传统方法通常无法满足这些要求。 本研究通过采用一种新颖的、先进的逐帧校准和立体匹配方法处理5MP相机图像，旨在实现高精度和高速度，从而弥补了这一关键差距。 此外，我们引入了一种新方法来评估实时性能，通过将实时视差图与从计算密集型立体匹配算法获得的真实视差图进行比较。 关键在于，该研究表明，只有通过实施高精度校准，高像素相机才能产生高质量的点云。
tldr: This paper presents a novel calibration and stereo matching method for high-resolution (5MP) stereo vision systems, demonstrating that high-accuracy calibration is crucial for generating high-quality 3D point clouds from high-pixel-count cameras and proposes a way to evaluate real-time performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于高分辨率 (5MP) 立体视觉系统的新型校准和立体匹配方法，证明了高精度校准对于从高像素相机生成高质量 3D 点云至关重要，并提出了一种评估实时性能的方法。

title: mjlab: A Lightweight Framework for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
summary: We present mjlab, a lightweight, open-source framework for robot learning that combines GPU-accelerated simulation with composable environments and minimal setup friction. mjlab adopts the manager-based API introduced by Isaac Lab, where users compose modular building blocks for observations, rewards, and events, and pairs it with MuJoCo Warp for GPU-accelerated physics. The result is a framework installable with a single command, requiring minimal dependencies, and providing direct access to native MuJoCo data structures. mjlab ships with reference implementations of velocity tracking, motion imitation, and manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 我们提出了mjlab，一个轻量级、开源的机器人学习框架，它将GPU加速仿真与可组合环境和最小化设置摩擦相结合。 mjlab 采用了 Isaac Lab 引入的基于管理器（manager）的 API，用户通过组合模块化的构建块来实现观察、奖励和事件，并将其与 MuJoCo Warp 配对以实现 GPU 加速物理。 最终形成一个可以通过单个命令安装、所需依赖项最低且能够直接访问原生 MuJoCo 数据结构的框架。 mjlab 附带了速度跟踪、运动模仿和操作任务的参考实现。
tldr: mjlab is a lightweight, open-source robot learning framework leveraging GPU-accelerated MuJoCo through a modular, manager-based API, designed for easy installation and use.
tldr_zh: mjlab是一个轻量级的开源机器人学习框架，通过模块化的、基于管理器的API利用GPU加速的MuJoCo，旨在易于安装和使用。

title: Automatic Constraint Policy Optimization based on Continuous Constraint Interpolation Framework for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) relies on policy constraints to mitigate extrapolation error, where both the constraint form and constraint strength critically shape performance. However, most existing methods commit to a single constraint family: weighted behavior cloning, density regularization, or support constraints, without a unified principle that explains their connections or trade-offs. In this work, we propose Continuous Constraint Interpolation (CCI), a unified optimization framework in which these three constraint families arise as special cases along a common constraint spectrum. The CCI framework introduces a single interpolation parameter that enables smooth transitions and principled combinations across constraint types. Building on CCI, we develop Automatic Constraint Policy Optimization (ACPO), a practical primal--dual algorithm that adapts the interpolation parameter via a Lagrangian dual update. Moreover, we establish a maximum-entropy performance difference lemma and derive performance lower bounds for both the closed-form optimal policy and its parametric projection. Experiments on D4RL and NeoRL2 demonstrate robust gains across diverse domains, achieving state-of-the-art performance overall.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习（RL）依赖于策略约束来缓解外推误差，其中约束的形式和约束强度对性能起着至关重要的作用。然而，大多数现有方法都致力于单一的约束族：加权行为克隆、密度正则化或支撑约束，而缺乏一个统一的原则来解释它们之间的联系或权衡。在这项工作中，我们提出了连续约束插值（CCI），一个统一的优化框架，其中这三个约束族都作为通用约束谱上的特例出现。CCI框架引入了一个单一的插值参数，该参数能够实现跨约束类型的平滑过渡和原则性组合。基于CCI，我们开发了自动约束策略优化（ACPO），一种实用的原始-对偶算法，通过拉格朗日对偶更新来调整插值参数。此外，我们建立了最大熵性能差异引理，并推导了闭式最优策略及其参数化投影的性能下界。在D4RL和NeoRL2上的实验表明，在不同领域都取得了稳健的提升，实现了总体上的最先进性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified framework, Continuous Constraint Interpolation (CCI), for offline reinforcement learning constraints, allowing for smooth transitions between different constraint types and demonstrating state-of-the-art performance using Automatic Constraint Policy Optimization (ACPO).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个统一的离线强化学习约束框架，即连续约束插值（CCI），允许在不同约束类型之间平滑过渡，并使用自动约束策略优化（ACPO）展示了最先进的性能。

title: TriCEGAR: A Trace-Driven Abstraction Mechanism for Agentic AI
summary: Agentic AI systems act through tools and evolve their behavior over long, stochastic interaction traces. This setting complicates assurance, because behavior depends on nondeterministic environments and probabilistic model outputs. Prior work introduced runtime verification for agentic AI via Dynamic Probabilistic Assurance (DPA), learning an MDP online and model checking quantitative properties. A key limitation is that developers must manually define the state abstraction, which couples verification to application-specific heuristics and increases adoption friction. This paper proposes TriCEGAR, a trace-driven abstraction mechanism that automates state construction from execution logs and supports online construction of an agent behavioral MDP. TriCEGAR represents abstractions as predicate trees learned from traces and refined using counterexamples. We describe a framework-native implementation that (i) captures typed agent lifecycle events, (ii) builds abstractions from traces, (iii) constructs an MDP, and (iv) performs probabilistic model checking to compute bounds such as Pmax(success) and Pmin(failure). We also show how run likelihoods enable anomaly detection as a guardrailing signal.
summary_zh: 智能体人工智能系统通过工具行动，并在漫长的、随机的交互轨迹中演化其行为。这种设定使得保障变得复杂，因为行为依赖于非确定性的环境和概率模型输出。 之前的研究引入了通过动态概率保障(DPA)对智能体人工智能进行运行时验证的方法，该方法在线学习一个MDP并进行定量属性的模型检查。一个关键限制是，开发者必须手动定义状态抽象，这使得验证与特定于应用的启发式方法相耦合，并增加了采用摩擦。 本文提出了一种由轨迹驱动的抽象机制TriCEGAR，该机制自动化了从执行日志中构建状态的过程，并支持在线构建智能体行为MDP。 TriCEGAR将抽象表示为从轨迹中学习并使用反例细化的谓词树。 我们描述了一个框架原生实现，它(i)捕获类型化的智能体生命周期事件，(ii)从轨迹构建抽象，(iii)构建一个MDP，以及(iv)执行概率模型检查以计算诸如Pmax(成功)和Pmin(失败)之类的界限。我们还展示了运行似然性如何实现异常检测作为一种防护信号。
tldr: The paper introduces TriCEGAR, a trace-driven abstraction mechanism to automate state construction for runtime verification in agentic AI systems, enabling probabilistic model checking and anomaly detection.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TriCEGAR，一种基于跟踪的抽象机制，用于自动构建智能体AI系统中运行时验证的状态，从而实现概率模型检测和异常检测。

title: Why Your Deep Research Agent Fails? On Hallucination Evaluation in Full Research Trajectory
summary: Diagnosing the failure mechanisms of Deep Research Agents (DRAs) remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks predominantly rely on end-to-end evaluation, obscuring critical intermediate hallucinations, such as flawed planning, that accumulate throughout the research trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose a shift from outcome-based to process-aware evaluation by auditing the full research trajectory. We introduce the PIES Taxonomy to categorize hallucinations along functional components (Planning vs. Summarization) and error properties (Explicit vs. Implicit). We instantiate this taxonomy into a fine-grained evaluation framework that decomposes the trajectory to rigorously quantify these hallucinations. Leveraging this framework to isolate 100 distinctively hallucination-prone tasks including adversarial scenarios, we curate DeepHalluBench. Experiments on six state-of-theart DRAs reveal that no system achieves robust reliability. Furthermore, our diagnostic analysis traces the etiology of these failures to systemic deficits, specifically hallucination propagation and cognitive biases, providing foundational insights to guide future architectural optimization. Data and code are available at https://github.com/yuhao-zhan/DeepHalluBench.
summary_zh: 诊断深度研究代理（DRAs）的失效机制仍然是一项关键挑战。现有的基准测试主要依赖于端到端评估，掩盖了贯穿整个研究轨迹的严重中间幻觉，例如有缺陷的规划。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出从基于结果的评估转变为过程感知的评估，通过审计完整的研究轨迹来实现。我们引入了PIES分类法，以根据功能组件（规划 vs. 总结）和错误属性（显式 vs. 隐式）对幻觉进行分类。 我们将此分类法实例化为一个细粒度的评估框架，该框架分解研究轨迹以严格量化这些幻觉。利用此框架来隔离100项独特的易于产生幻觉的任务，包括对抗性场景，我们策划了DeepHalluBench。在六种最先进的DRAs上的实验表明，没有一个系统能够实现稳健的可靠性。此外，我们的诊断分析将这些失败的病因追溯到系统性缺陷，特别是幻觉传播和认知偏差，从而提供了指导未来架构优化的基础性见解。数据和代码可在https://github.com/yuhao-zhan/DeepHalluBench获得。
tldr: This paper introduces a new benchmark, DeepHalluBench, and a taxonomy (PIES) for evaluating hallucinations in Deep Research Agents (DRAs) by auditing their full research trajectory, revealing significant reliability issues and failure patterns in state-of-the-art DRAs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个新的基准测试DeepHalluBench和一个分类法(PIES)，通过审计深度研究Agent（DRA）的完整研究轨迹来评估其幻觉，揭示了现有DRA在可靠性方面的重要问题和失败模式。

title: Stabilizing the Q-Gradient Field for Policy Smoothness in Actor-Critic
summary: Policies learned via continuous actor-critic methods often exhibit erratic, high-frequency oscillations, making them unsuitable for physical deployment. Current approaches attempt to enforce smoothness by directly regularizing the policy's output. We argue that this approach treats the symptom rather than the cause. In this work, we theoretically establish that policy non-smoothness is fundamentally governed by the differential geometry of the critic. By applying implicit differentiation to the actor-critic objective, we prove that the sensitivity of the optimal policy is bounded by the ratio of the Q-function's mixed-partial derivative (noise sensitivity) to its action-space curvature (signal distinctness). To empirically validate this theoretical insight, we introduce PAVE (Policy-Aware Value-field Equalization), a critic-centric regularization framework that treats the critic as a scalar field and stabilizes its induced action-gradient field. PAVE rectifies the learning signal by minimizing the Q-gradient volatility while preserving local curvature. Experimental results demonstrate that PAVE achieves smoothness and robustness comparable to policy-side smoothness regularization methods, while maintaining competitive task performance, without modifying the actor.
summary_zh: 通过连续行动者-评论家方法学习到的策略通常表现出不稳定、高频振荡，使其不适用于物理部署。目前的做法试图通过直接正则化策略的输出来强制平滑。我们认为这种方法治标不治本。在这项工作中，我们从理论上证明策略的非平滑性从根本上由评论家的微分几何性质决定。通过对行动者-评论家目标函数应用隐式微分，我们证明了最优策略的敏感度受Q函数的混合偏导数（噪声敏感度）与其动作空间曲率（信号区分度）之比的约束。为了通过实验验证这一理论见解，我们引入了PAVE（策略感知值域均衡），这是一个以评论家为中心的正则化框架，它将评论家视为标量场，并稳定其诱导的动作梯度场。PAVE通过最小化Q梯度的波动性同时保持局部曲率来纠正学习信号。实验结果表明，PAVE实现了与策略侧平滑正则化方法相当的平滑性和鲁棒性，同时保持了具有竞争力的任务性能，而无需修改行动者。
tldr: This paper addresses the problem of policy oscillations in actor-critic methods by theoretically analyzing the Q-gradient field and introducing a critic-centric regularization framework (PAVE) to stabilize it, achieving smooth policies without actor modifications.
tldr_zh: 本文通过理论分析Q梯度场，并引入一种以评论家为中心的正则化框架(PAVE)来稳定它，从而解决actor-critic方法中策略振荡的问题，在不修改actor的情况下实现平滑的策略。

title: DiffuSpeech: Silent Thought, Spoken Answer via Unified Speech-Text Diffusion
summary: Current speech language models generate responses directly without explicit reasoning, leading to errors that cannot be corrected once audio is produced. We introduce \textbf{``Silent Thought, Spoken Answer''} -- a paradigm where speech LLMs generate internal text reasoning alongside spoken responses, with thinking traces informing speech quality. To realize this, we present \method{}, the first diffusion-based speech-text language model supporting both understanding and generation, unifying discrete text and tokenized speech under a single masked diffusion framework. Unlike autoregressive approaches, \method{} jointly generates reasoning traces and speech tokens through iterative denoising, with modality-specific masking schedules. We also construct \dataset{}, the first speech QA dataset with paired text reasoning traces, containing 26K samples totaling 319 hours. Experiments show \method{} achieves state-of-the-art speech-to-speech QA accuracy, outperforming the best baseline by up to 9 points, while attaining the best TTS quality among generative models (6.2\% WER) and preserving language understanding (66.2\% MMLU). Ablations confirm that both the diffusion architecture and thinking traces contribute to these gains.
summary_zh: 当前语音语言模型直接生成回复，缺乏显式推理，导致一旦生成音频就无法纠正错误。我们引入了一个称为“**静默思考，语音回答**”的范式，其中语音LLM在生成语音回复的同时生成内部文本推理，思考轨迹能够提升语音质量。为了实现这一点，我们提出了\method{}，这是第一个基于扩散的语音-文本语言模型，支持理解和生成，在单个掩码扩散框架下统一了离散文本和令牌化语音。与自回归方法不同，\method{}通过迭代去噪联合生成推理轨迹和语音令牌，并采用特定于模态的掩码策略。我们还构建了\dataset{}，这是第一个带有配对文本推理轨迹的语音问答数据集，包含2.6万个样本，总计319小时。实验表明，\method{}实现了最先进的语音到语音问答准确率，优于最佳基线高达9个百分点，同时在生成模型中达到了最佳的TTS质量（6.2%的WER），并保持了语言理解能力（66.2%的MMLU）。消融实验证实，扩散架构和思考轨迹都对这些提升有所贡献。
tldr: The paper introduces DiffuSpeech, a diffusion-based speech-text language model capable of generating both speech responses and internal text reasoning traces, achieving state-of-the-art performance on speech-to-speech QA.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DiffuSpeech，一个基于扩散的语音-文本语言模型，能够生成语音回复和内部文本推理轨迹，在语音到语音的问答方面取得了最先进的性能。

title: Procedural Knowledge Extraction from Industrial Troubleshooting Guides Using Vision Language Models
summary: Industrial troubleshooting guides encode diagnostic procedures in flowchart-like diagrams where spatial layout and technical language jointly convey meaning. To integrate this knowledge into operator support systems, which assist shop-floor personnel in diagnosing and resolving equipment issues, the information must first be extracted and structured for machine interpretation. However, when performed manually, this extraction is labor-intensive and error-prone. Vision Language Models offer potential to automate this process by jointly interpreting visual and textual meaning, yet their performance on such guides remains underexplored. This paper evaluates two VLMs on extracting structured knowledge, comparing two prompting strategies: standard instruction-guided versus an augmented approach that cues troubleshooting layout patterns. Results reveal model-specific trade-offs between layout sensitivity and semantic robustness, informing practical deployment decisions.
summary_zh: 工业故障排除指南将诊断程序编码成类似于流程图的图表，其中空间布局和技术语言共同传达意义。为了将这些知识集成到操作员支持系统中（该系统旨在协助车间人员诊断和解决设备问题），必须首先提取信息并将其结构化，以便机器能够理解。然而，如果手动执行，此提取过程既费力又容易出错。视觉语言模型有望通过共同解释视觉和文本含义来自动化此过程，但它们在这些指南上的性能仍有待探索。本文评估了两个视觉语言模型在提取结构化知识方面的表现，并比较了两种提示策略：标准的指令引导方法与提示故障排除布局模式的增强方法。结果揭示了模型之间在布局敏感性和语义稳健性方面的特定权衡，为实际部署决策提供了依据。
tldr: This paper explores the use of Vision Language Models (VLMs) to automate the extraction of structured knowledge from industrial troubleshooting guides, comparing different prompting strategies to optimize performance.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 自动化从工业故障排除指南中提取结构化知识的方法，并比较了不同的提示策略以优化性能。

title: MC-GRPO: Median-Centered Group Relative Policy Optimization for Small-Rollout Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group-relative policy optimization methods train language models by generating multiple rollouts per prompt and normalizing rewards with a shared mean reward baseline. In resource-constrained settings where the rollout budget is small, accuracy often degrades. We find that noise in the shared baseline induces advantage sign flips, where some rollouts receive an incorrect advantage sign, and the update direction is reversed. To address this, we propose Median-Centered Group Relative Policy Optimization (MC-GRPO), a simple and effective solution for small-rollout training. Our main idea is to replace the mean baseline with a median baseline: the median is far less sensitive to outlier rewards than the mean, mitigating the sign flips under small rollout size (G). We generate one additional rollout for median reference (G+1), and compute advantages by using the group median. With an odd-sized group, exactly one completion is the median and receives zero advantage, we exclude this pivot rollout from backpropagation so the number of gradient-contributing samples per prompt remains G, preserving the core update cost of standard G-rollout training. Across various GRPO-family methods and a wide range of models and scales, this median-centered training consistently improves stability and final accuracy in the low-rollout regime, reducing the gap between G=2 and G=8 to within 1%. Code is available at https://github.com/lotusroot-kim/MC-GRPO
summary_zh: 基于群体相对策略优化的方法通过为每个提示生成多个轨迹，并使用共享的均值奖励基线对奖励进行归一化来训练语言模型。在资源受限、轨迹预算较小的环境中，准确率通常会下降。我们发现共享基线中的噪声会引起优势符号翻转，其中一些轨迹会获得错误的优势符号，导致更新方向反转。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了中值中心群体相对策略优化(MC-GRPO)，这是一种简单有效的适用于小轨迹训练的解决方案。我们的主要思想是用中值基线取代均值基线：与均值相比，中值对异常值奖励的敏感度远低于均值，从而减轻了小轨迹大小(G)下的符号翻转。我们额外生成一个轨迹用于中值参考(G+1)，并通过使用群体中值来计算优势。由于奇数大小的群体中恰好有一个生成结果是中值并获得零优势，我们将从反向传播中排除这个中心轨迹，因此每个提示的梯度贡献样本数量仍然为G，从而保留了标准G轨迹训练的核心更新成本。 在各种GRPO系列方法以及各种模型和规模上，这种以中值为中心的训练始终如一地提高了低轨迹情况下的稳定性和最终准确率，将G=2和G=8之间的差距缩小到1%以内。代码可在 https://github.com/lotusroot-kim/MC-GRPO 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces Median-Centered Group Relative Policy Optimization (MC-GRPO), which replaces the mean reward baseline with a median baseline in group-relative policy optimization methods to improve training stability and accuracy in small-rollout reinforcement learning settings.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了中心化中位数群组相对策略优化（MC-GRPO），该方法在群组相对策略优化方法中使用中位数基线替代均值奖励基线，从而提高小样本强化学习设置中的训练稳定性和准确性。

title: Demystifying Design Choices of Reinforcement Fine-tuning: A Batched Contextual Bandit Learning Perspective
summary: The reinforcement fine-tuning area is undergoing an explosion papers largely on optimizing design choices. Though performance gains are often claimed, inconsistent conclusions also arise from time to time, making the progress illusive. Reflecting on this illusion, we still lack principled answers to two fundamental questions: 1) what is the role of each design choice? 2) which ones are critical? This paper aims to shed light on them. The underlying challenge is that design choices are entangled together, making their contribution to learning and generalization difficult to attribute. To address this challenge, we first construct a minimalist baseline for disentangling factors: one rollout per query in each round, the outcome reward serving as the training signal without any advantage trick, and a batch size of thirty-two. This baseline connects to batched contextual bandit learning, which facilitates experimental analysis. Centering around this baseline, we design an experiment pipeline, examining the marginal gains of factors like advantage, number of rollouts, etc. Experiments on three base models and two datasets, not only reveal new understanding on the role of various design choices on learning and generalization dynamics, but also identify critical ones that deserve more effort.
summary_zh: 强化精调领域正经历着论文数量的爆发式增长，其中大部分关注优化设计选择。尽管经常声称有性能提升，但有时也会出现不一致的结论，使得进展显得虚幻。反思这种幻觉，我们仍然缺乏对两个基本问题的有原则的回答：1) 每种设计选择的作用是什么？2) 哪些是关键的？本文旨在阐明这些问题。根本挑战在于设计选择相互纠缠在一起，使得它们对学习和泛化的贡献难以归因。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先构建了一个极简基线来解耦因素：每轮查询一次 rollout，结果奖励作为训练信号，不使用任何优势技巧，批大小为三十二。这个基线与批量上下文赌博机学习相关联，这有助于实验分析。围绕这个基线，我们设计了一个实验流程，考察了诸如优势函数、rollout 数量等因素的边际收益。在三种基础模型和两个数据集上的实验，不仅揭示了对各种设计选择在学习和泛化动态中的作用的新理解，而且还识别出了值得付出更多努力的关键因素。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of various design choices in reinforcement fine-tuning by framing the problem as batched contextual bandit learning, aiming to identify critical factors for improved learning and generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将强化微调问题框架化为批量上下文bandit学习，研究了其中各种设计选择的影响，旨在识别对于改进学习和泛化能力的关键因素。

title: Enhancing TableQA through Verifiable Reasoning Trace Reward
summary: A major challenge in training TableQA agents, compared to standard text- and image-based agents, is that answers cannot be inferred from a static input but must be reasoned through stepwise transformations of the table state, introducing multi-step reasoning complexity and environmental interaction. This leads to a research question: Can explicit feedback on table transformation action improve model reasoning capability? In this work, we introduce RE-Tab, a plug-and-play framework that architecturally enhances trajectory search via lightweight, training-free reward modeling by formulating the problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process. We demonstrate that providing explicit verifiable rewards during State Transition (``What is the best action?'') and Simulative Reasoning (``Am I sure about the output?'') is crucial to steer the agent's navigation in table states. By enforcing stepwise reasoning with reward feedback in table transformations, RE-Tab achieves state-of-the-art performance in TableQA with almost 25\% drop in inference cost. Furthermore, a direct plug-and-play implementation of RE-Tab brings up to 41.77% improvement in QA accuracy and 33.33% drop in test-time inference samples for consistent answer. Consistent improvement pattern across various LLMs and state-of-the-art benchmarks further confirms RE-Tab's generalisability. The repository is available at https://github.com/ThomasK1018/RE_Tab .
summary_zh: 与标准的基于文本和图像的智能体相比，训练表格问答 (TableQA) 智能体的一个主要挑战在于，答案不能从静态输入中推断出来，而必须通过表格状态的逐步转换进行推理，从而引入了多步推理复杂性和环境交互。这就引出了一个研究问题：关于表格转换动作的显式反馈能否提高模型的推理能力？在这项工作中，我们引入了 RE-Tab，这是一个即插即用的框架，通过将问题形式化为一个部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程，利用轻量级的、无需训练的奖励建模，在架构上增强了轨迹搜索。我们证明，在状态转移（“什么是最佳动作？”）和模拟推理（“我确定输出结果吗？”）期间提供可验证的显式奖励对于引导智能体在表格状态中导航至关重要。通过在表格转换中利用奖励反馈强制执行逐步推理，RE-Tab 在 TableQA 中实现了最先进的性能，同时推理成本降低了近 25%。此外，直接即插即用的 RE-Tab 实现可在 QA 准确率方面提高高达 41.77%，并在测试时推理样本方面减少 33.33%，以获得一致的答案。RE-Tab 在各种大型语言模型 (LLM) 和最先进的基准测试中表现出一致的改进模式，进一步证实了其通用性。代码仓库位于 https://github.com/ThomasK1018/RE_Tab 。
tldr: The paper introduces RE-Tab, a training-free framework that uses explicit, verifiable rewards during table transformation to improve TableQA agent reasoning, achieving state-of-the-art performance with reduced inference costs and plug-and-play improvements across various LLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为RE-Tab的免训练框架，它通过在表格转换过程中使用显式的、可验证的奖励来提高 TableQA 代理的推理能力，在降低推理成本的同时，实现了最先进的性能，并且可以在各种大型语言模型中即插即用。

title: Action-Sufficient Goal Representations
summary: Hierarchical policies in offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) addresses long-horizon tasks by decomposing control into high-level subgoal planning and low-level action execution.
