A critical design choice in such architectures is the goal representation-the compressed encoding of goals that serves as the interface between these levels. Existing approaches commonly derive goal representations while learning value functions, implicitly assuming that preserving information sufficient for value estimation is adequate for optimal control. We show that this assumption can fail, even when the value estimation is exact, as such representations may collapse goal states that need to be differentiated for action learning. To address this, we introduce an information-theoretic framework that defines action sufficiency, a condition on goal representations necessary for optimal action selection. We prove that value sufficiency does not imply action sufficiency and empirically verify that the latter is more strongly associated with control success in a discrete environment. We further demonstrate that standard log-loss training of low-level policies naturally induces action-sufficient representations. Our experimental results a popular benchmark demonstrate that our actor-derived representations consistently outperform representations learned via value estimation.
summary_zh: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中的分层策略通过将控制分解为高层子目标规划和低层动作执行来处理长程任务。这种架构中的一个关键设计选择是目标表征——目标的压缩编码，它作为这些层之间的接口。现有的方法通常在学习价值函数的同时推导出目标表征，隐式地假设保留足以进行价值估计的信息足以实现最优控制。我们表明，即使在价值估计精确的情况下，这种假设也可能失效，因为这种表征可能会坍缩需要区分以进行动作学习的目标状态。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个信息论框架，该框架定义了动作充分性，这是目标表征对最优动作选择的必要条件。我们证明价值充分性并不意味着动作充分性，并且通过实验验证后者与离散环境中的控制成功更密切相关。我们进一步证明，低层策略的标准对数损失训练自然会诱导动作充分的表征。我们在一个流行的基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们基于Actor推导的表征始终优于通过价值估计学习的表征。
tldr: This paper introduces an information-theoretic framework for learning action-sufficient goal representations in hierarchical offline GCRL, showing that value-sufficient representations are not always action-sufficient and that actor-derived representations perform better.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个信息论框架，用于在分层离线GCRL中学习行动充分的目标表示，表明价值充分的表示并不总是行动充分的，并且actor导出的表示效果更好。

title: Controllable Information Production
summary: Intrinsic Motivation (IM) is a paradigm for generating intelligent behavior without external utilities. The existing information-theoretic methods for IM are predominantly based on information transmission, which explicitly depends on the designer's choice of which random variables engage in transmission. In this work, we introduce a novel IM principle, Controllable Information Production (CIP), that avoids both external utilities and designer-specified variables. We derive the CIP objective from Optimal Control, showing a connection between extrinsic and intrinsic behaviors. CIP appears as the gap between open-loop and closed-loop Kolmogorov-Sinai entropies, which simultaneously rewards the pursuit and regulation of chaos. We establish key theoretical properties of CIP and demonstrate its effectiveness on standard IM benchmarks.
summary_zh: 内在动机 (IM) 是一种无需外部效用函数即可生成智能行为的范式。现有的基于信息论的内在动机方法主要基于信息传递，这明确地依赖于设计者选择哪些随机变量参与传递。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种新的内在动机原则，即可控信息产生 (CIP)，它避免了外部效用函数和设计者指定的变量。我们从最优控制中推导出 CIP 目标，展示了外在行为和内在行为之间的联系。CIP 表现为开环 Kolmogorov-Sinai 熵和闭环 Kolmogorov-Sinai 熵之间的差距，这同时奖励了对混沌的追求和调控。我们确立了 CIP 的关键理论性质，并在标准的 IM 基准测试上证明了其有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces Controllable Information Production (CIP), a novel intrinsic motivation principle derived from optimal control that rewards both the pursuit and regulation of chaos, demonstrating its effectiveness on standard benchmarks without relying on external utilities or designer-specified variables.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为可控信息产生(CIP)的新型内在动机原则，该原则源于最优控制，奖励对混沌的追求和调节，并在标准基准上展示了其有效性，而无需依赖外部效用或设计者指定的变量。

title: Learning Policy Representations for Steerable Behavior Synthesis
summary: Given a Markov decision process (MDP), we seek to learn representations for a range of policies to facilitate behavior steering at test time. As policies of an MDP are uniquely determined by their occupancy measures, we propose modeling policy representations as expectations of state-action feature maps with respect to occupancy measures. We show that these representations can be approximated uniformly for a range of policies using a set-based architecture. Our model encodes a set of state-action samples into a latent embedding, from which we decode both the policy and its value functions corresponding to multiple rewards. We use variational generative approach to induce a smooth latent space, and further shape it with contrastive learning so that latent distances align with differences in value functions. This geometry permits gradient-based optimization directly in the latent space. Leveraging this capability, we solve a novel behavior synthesis task, where policies are steered to satisfy previously unseen value function constraints without additional training.
summary_zh: 给定一个马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，我们力求学习一系列策略的表示，以便于在测试时进行行为引导。由于 MDP 的策略由其占用测度唯一确定，我们提出将策略表示建模为状态-动作特征图关于占用测度的期望。我们表明，可以使用基于集合的架构对一系列策略统一近似这些表示。 我们的模型将一组状态-动作样本编码到潜在嵌入中，从中解码对应于多个奖励的策略及其价值函数。 我们使用变分生成方法来诱导一个平滑的潜在空间，并进一步通过对比学习来塑造它，使得潜在距离与价值函数的差异对齐。 这种几何性质允许直接在潜在空间中进行基于梯度的优化。 利用这种能力，我们解决了一个新的行为合成任务，其中策略被引导以满足先前未见的价值函数约束，而无需额外的训练。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for learning policy representations in MDPs that allows for steering behavior at test time by optimizing in a latent space conditioned on value function constraints, enabling behavior synthesis without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在MDP中学习策略表达的方法，该方法允许通过在潜在空间中基于价值函数约束进行优化来在测试时控制行为，从而无需重新训练即可实现行为合成。

title: StepShield: When, Not Whether to Intervene on Rogue Agents
summary: Existing agent safety benchmarks report binary accuracy, conflating early intervention with post-mortem analysis. A detector that flags a violation at step 8 enables intervention; one that reports it at step 48 provides only forensic value. This distinction is critical, yet current benchmarks cannot measure it. We introduce StepShield, the first benchmark to evaluate when violations are detected, not just whether. StepShield contains 9,213 code agent trajectories, including 1,278 meticulously annotated training pairs and a 7,935-trajectory test set with a realistic 8.1% rogue rate. Rogue behaviors are grounded in real-world security incidents across six categories. We propose three novel temporal metrics: Early Intervention Rate (EIR), Intervention Gap, and Tokens Saved. Surprisingly, our evaluation reveals that an LLM-based judge achieves 59% EIR while a static analyzer achieves only 26%, a 2.3x performance gap that is entirely invisible to standard accuracy metrics. We further show that early detection has direct economic benefits: our cascaded HybridGuard detector reduces monitoring costs by 75% and projects to $108M in cumulative savings over five years at enterprise scale. By shifting the focus of evaluation from whether to when, StepShield provides a new foundation for building safer and more economically viable AI agents. The code and data are released under an Apache 2.0 license.
summary_zh: 现有智能体安全基准测试报告二元准确率，混淆了早期干预和事后分析。一个在第8步标记违规行为的检测器能够实现干预；而一个在第48步报告违规行为的检测器仅提供取证价值。这种区别至关重要，但当前的基准测试无法衡量它。我们引入了StepShield，这是第一个评估违规行为何时被检测到的基准测试，而不仅仅是是否检测到。StepShield包含9,213个代码智能体轨迹，其中包括1,278个精心标注的训练对和一个包含7,935个轨迹的测试集，其真实违规率（rogue rate）为8.1%。违规行为基于真实世界的安全事件，涵盖六个类别。我们提出了三个新的时间指标：早期干预率（EIR）、干预差距和节省的Token数量。令人惊讶的是，我们的评估表明，基于LLM的judge实现了59%的EIR，而静态分析器仅实现了26%，这种2.3倍的性能差距在标准的准确率指标中完全不可见。我们进一步表明，早期检测具有直接的经济效益：我们级联的HybridGuard检测器将监控成本降低了75%，并预计在五年内为企业规模节省累计1.08亿美元。通过将评估的重点从“是否”转移到“何时”，StepShield为构建更安全、更经济可行的AI智能体提供了新的基础。代码和数据以Apache 2.0许可证发布。
tldr: The paper introduces StepShield, a new benchmark for evaluating the temporal aspect of agent safety violations, focusing on *when* violations are detected rather than merely *whether* they occur, and demonstrates its value with an LLM-based judge and a HybridGuard detector.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了StepShield，一个用于评估代理安全违规行为时序方面的新基准，重点关注违规行为*何时*被检测到，而不仅仅是*是否*发生违规行为，并通过基于LLM的判断器和HybridGuard检测器展示了其价值。

title: Q-Hawkeye: Reliable Visual Policy Optimization for Image Quality Assessment
summary: Image Quality Assessment (IQA) predicts perceptual quality scores consistent with human judgments. Recent RL-based IQA methods built on MLLMs focus on generating visual quality descriptions and scores, ignoring two key reliability limitations: (i) although the model's prediction stability varies significantly across training samples, existing GRPO-based methods apply uniform advantage weighting, thereby amplifying noisy signals from unstable samples in gradient updates; (ii) most works emphasize text-grounded reasoning over images while overlooking the model's visual perception ability of image content. In this paper, we propose Q-Hawkeye, an RL-based reliable visual policy optimization framework that redesigns the learning signal through unified Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Optimization and Perception-Aware Optimization. Q-Hawkeye estimates predictive uncertainty using the variance of predicted scores across multiple rollouts and leverages this uncertainty to reweight each sample's update strength, stabilizing policy optimization. To strengthen perceptual reliability, we construct paired inputs of degraded images and their original images and introduce an Implicit Perception Loss that constrains the model to ground its quality judgments in genuine visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-Hawkeye outperforms state-of-the-art methods and generalizes better across multiple datasets. The code and models will be made available.
summary_zh: 图像质量评估（IQA）旨在预测与人类主观判断一致的感知质量分数。近年来，基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的强化学习（RL）图像质量评估方法侧重于生成视觉质量描述和评分，却忽略了两个关键的可靠性限制：（i）尽管模型对不同训练样本的预测稳定性差异显著，但现有的基于广义策略优化（GRPO）的方法采用统一优势权重，从而在梯度更新中放大了来自不稳定样本的噪声信号；（ii）大多数工作强调文本引导的推理胜过图像，却忽视了模型对图像内容的视觉感知能力。在本文中，我们提出了Q-Hawkeye，一个基于强化学习的可靠视觉策略优化框架，该框架通过统一的不确定性感知动态优化和感知感知优化来重新设计学习信号。Q-Hawkeye通过多次展开（rollout）中预测分数的方差来估计预测的不确定性，并利用该不确定性来重新加权每个样本的更新强度，从而稳定策略优化。为了加强感知可靠性，我们构建了退化图像及其原始图像的配对输入，并引入了隐式感知损失，以约束模型将其质量判断建立在真实的视觉证据之上。大量的实验表明，Q-Hawkeye优于最先进的方法，并且在多个数据集上具有更好的泛化能力。代码和模型将会公开。
tldr: The paper introduces Q-Hawkeye, a reinforcement learning-based framework for Image Quality Assessment that improves reliability by addressing unstable training samples and strengthening visual perception capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Q-Hawkeye，一个基于强化学习的图像质量评估框架，通过解决不稳定的训练样本和加强视觉感知能力来提高可靠性。

title: StreamSense: Streaming Social Task Detection with Selective Vision-Language Model Routing
summary: Live streaming platforms require real-time monitoring and reaction to social signals, utilizing partial and asynchronous evidence from video, text, and audio. We propose StreamSense, a streaming detector that couples a lightweight streaming encoder with selective routing to a Vision-Language Model (VLM) expert. StreamSense handles most timestamps with the lightweight streaming encoder, escalates hard/ambiguous cases to the VLM, and defers decisions when context is insufficient. The encoder is trained using (i) a cross-modal contrastive term to align visual/audio cues with textual signals, and (ii) an IoU-weighted loss that down-weights poorly overlapping target segments, mitigating label interference across segment boundaries. We evaluate StreamSense on multiple social streaming detection tasks (e.g., sentiment classification and hate content moderation), and the results show that StreamSense achieves higher accuracy than VLM-only streaming while only occasionally invoking the VLM, thereby reducing average latency and compute. Our results indicate that selective escalation and deferral are effective primitives for understanding streaming social tasks. Code is publicly available on GitHub.
summary_zh: 直播平台需要对社会信号进行实时监控和响应，利用来自视频、文本和音频的部分和异步证据。我们提出StreamSense，一种流式检测器，它将轻量级流式编码器与选择性路由耦合到视觉-语言模型（VLM）专家。StreamSense使用轻量级流式编码器处理大多数时间戳，将困难/模糊的情况升级到VLM，并在上下文信息不足时推迟决策。该编码器通过以下方式进行训练：（i）跨模态对比项，使视觉/音频线索与文本信号对齐；以及（ii）IoU加权损失，降低不良重叠目标片段的权重，从而减轻片段边界上的标签干扰。我们在多个社会流式检测任务（例如，情感分类和仇恨内容审核）上评估了StreamSense，结果表明，StreamSense实现了比仅VLM流式更高的准确率，同时只偶尔调用VLM，从而降低了平均延迟和计算量。我们的结果表明，选择性升级和延迟是理解流式社会任务的有效原语。代码已在GitHub上公开提供。
tldr: StreamSense is proposed to monitor live streams using a lightweight encoder with selective routing to a VLM, improving accuracy and reducing latency for social task detection, especially around challenges such as sentiment analysis and content moderation.
tldr_zh: StreamSense 旨在通过轻量级编码器和选择性路由到 VLM 来监控直播流，从而提高社会任务检测的准确性并降低延迟，尤其是在诸如情感分析和内容审核等挑战方面。

title: Stabilizing Consistency Training: A Flow Map Analysis and Self-Distillation
summary: Consistency models have been proposed for fast generative modeling, achieving results competitive with diffusion and flow models. However, these methods exhibit inherent instability and limited reproducibility when training from scratch, motivating subsequent work to explain and stabilize these issues. While these efforts have provided valuable insights, the explanations remain fragmented, and the theoretical relationships remain unclear. In this work, we provide a theoretical examination of consistency models by analyzing them from a flow map-based perspective. This joint analysis clarifies how training stability and convergence behavior can give rise to degenerate solutions. Building on these insights, we revisit self-distillation as a practical remedy for certain forms of suboptimal convergence and reformulate it to avoid excessive gradient norms for stable optimization. We further demonstrate that our strategy extends beyond image generation to diffusion-based policy learning, without reliance on a pretrained diffusion model for initialization, thereby illustrating its broader applicability.
summary_zh: 一致性模型已被提出用于快速生成建模，其成果可与扩散模型和流模型相媲美。然而，这些方法在从头训练时表现出内在的不稳定性和有限的可复现性，这促使后续工作解释和稳定这些问题。尽管这些努力提供了宝贵的见解，但解释仍然是零散的，并且理论关系仍不明确。在这项工作中，我们通过从基于流映射的视角分析一致性模型，从而对其进行理论考察。这种联合分析阐明了训练稳定性和收敛行为如何导致退化解。基于这些见解，我们重新审视自蒸馏作为某些次优收敛形式的实用补救措施，并对其进行重新调整，以避免过度梯度范数从而实现稳定优化。我们进一步证明，我们的策略可以扩展到基于扩散的策略学习，而无需依赖预训练的扩散模型进行初始化，从而证明了其更广泛的适用性。
tldr: This paper analyzes the instability of consistency models using a flow map perspective, proposes a self-distillation based stabilization method, and demonstrates its applicability in both image generation and diffusion-based policy learning.
tldr_zh: 本文通过流图视角分析了一致性模型的不稳定性，提出一种基于自蒸馏的稳定方法，并展示了其在图像生成和基于扩散的策略学习中的适用性。

title: SHED Light on Segmentation for Dense Prediction
summary: Dense prediction infers per-pixel values from a single image and is fundamental to 3D perception and robotics. Although real-world scenes exhibit strong structure, existing methods treat it as an independent pixel-wise prediction, often resulting in structural inconsistencies. We propose SHED, a novel encoder-decoder architecture that enforces geometric prior explicitly by incorporating segmentation into dense prediction. By bidirectional hierarchical reasoning, segment tokens are hierarchically pooled in the encoder and unpooled in the decoder to reverse the hierarchy. The model is supervised only at the final output, allowing the segment hierarchy to emerge without explicit segmentation supervision. SHED improves depth boundary sharpness and segment coherence, while demonstrating strong cross-domain generalization from synthetic to the real-world environments. Its hierarchy-aware decoder better captures global 3D scene layouts, leading to improved semantic segmentation performance. Moreover, SHED enhances 3D reconstruction quality and reveals interpretable part-level structures that are often missed by conventional pixel-wise methods.
summary_zh: 密集预测从单张图像推断每个像素的值，是3D感知和机器人学的基石。尽管真实世界场景展现出很强的结构性，但现有方法将其视为独立的像素级预测，往往导致结构上的不一致性。我们提出了一种新颖的编码器-解码器架构SHED，它通过将分割纳入密集预测来显式地强制执行几何先验。通过双向分层推理，分割令牌在编码器中进行分层池化，并在解码器中进行反池化，以逆转层级结构。该模型仅在最终输出处进行监督，从而允许分割层级在没有显式分割监督的情况下涌现。SHED提高了深度边界的清晰度和分割一致性，同时展示了从合成到真实世界环境的强大跨域泛化能力。其具有层级感知能力的解码器能更好地捕捉全局3D场景布局，从而提高了语义分割性能。此外，SHED增强了3D重建质量，并揭示了传统像素级方法经常遗漏的可解释的部分级结构。
tldr: The paper introduces SHED, an encoder-decoder architecture that incorporates segmentation into dense prediction tasks, improving depth boundary sharpness, segment coherence, and cross-domain generalization without explicit segmentation supervision.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SHED，一种将分割融入密集预测任务的编码器-解码器架构，提高了深度边界清晰度、分割一致性和跨域泛化能力，且无需显式分割监督。

title: FlexMap: Generalized HD Map Construction from Flexible Camera Configurations
summary: High-definition (HD) maps provide essential semantic information of road structures for autonomous driving systems, yet current HD map construction methods require calibrated multi-camera setups and either implicit or explicit 2D-to-BEV transformations, making them fragile when sensors fail or camera configurations vary across vehicle fleets. We introduce FlexMap, unlike prior methods that are fixed to a specific N-camera rig, our approach adapts to variable camera configurations without any architectural changes or per-configuration retraining. Our key innovation eliminates explicit geometric projections by using a geometry-aware foundation model with cross-frame attention to implicitly encode 3D scene understanding in feature space. FlexMap features two core components: a spatial-temporal enhancement module that separates cross-view spatial reasoning from temporal dynamics, and a camera-aware decoder with latent camera tokens, enabling view-adaptive attention without the need for projection matrices. Experiments demonstrate that FlexMap outperforms existing methods across multiple configurations while maintaining robustness to missing views and sensor variations, enabling more practical real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 高清（HD）地图为自动驾驶系统提供道路结构的基本语义信息，然而，当前的HD地图构建方法需要校准的多相机设置，以及隐式或显式的2D到BEV的转换，这使得它们在传感器故障或车辆群体的相机配置变化时显得脆弱。我们引入了FlexMap，与固定于特定N相机平台的先前方法不同，我们的方法能够适应可变的相机配置，而无需任何架构更改或针对每种配置的重新训练。我们的关键创新在于消除了显式几何投影，通过使用具备几何感知能力的基模型，利用跨帧注意力隐式地在特征空间中编码3D场景理解。FlexMap包含两个核心组件：一个空间-时间增强模块，将跨视图的空间推理与时间动态分离；以及一个带有潜在相机令牌的相机感知解码器，无需投影矩阵即可实现视图自适应的注意力机制。实验表明，FlexMap在多种配置下优于现有方法，同时保持对缺失视图和传感器变化的鲁棒性，从而实现更实用的真实场景部署。
tldr: FlexMap constructs HD maps from flexible camera configurations using a geometry-aware foundation model and camera-aware decoder, eliminating the need for explicit geometric projections and per-configuration retraining. It demonstrates robustness to missing views and sensor variations, leading to more practical real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: FlexMap利用几何感知基础模型和相机感知解码器，从灵活的相机配置构建高清地图，无需显式几何投影和每次配置的重新训练。它对缺失视图和传感器变化具有鲁棒性，从而实现更实际的真实世界部署。

title: Coarse-to-Real: Generative Rendering for Populated Dynamic Scenes
summary: Traditional rendering pipelines rely on complex assets, accurate materials and lighting, and substantial computational resources to produce realistic imagery, yet they still face challenges in scalability and realism for populated dynamic scenes. We present C2R (Coarse-to-Real), a generative rendering framework that synthesizes real-style urban crowd videos from coarse 3D simulations. Our approach uses coarse 3D renderings to explicitly control scene layout, camera motion, and human trajectories, while a learned neural renderer generates realistic appearance, lighting, and fine-scale dynamics guided by text prompts. To overcome the lack of paired training data between coarse simulations and real videos, we adopt a two-phase mixed CG-real training strategy that learns a strong generative prior from large-scale real footage and introduces controllability through shared implicit spatio-temporal features across domains. The resulting system supports coarse-to-fine control, generalizes across diverse CG and game inputs, and produces temporally consistent, controllable, and realistic urban scene videos from minimal 3D input. We will release the model and project webpage at https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real/.
summary_zh: 传统的渲染管线依赖于复杂的资产、精确的材质和光照以及大量的计算资源来生成逼真的图像，然而，它们在人口稠密的动态场景的可扩展性和真实感方面仍然面临挑战。我们提出了C2R（Coarse-to-Real），一个从粗糙的3D模拟中合成真实风格城市人群视频的生成渲染框架。我们的方法使用粗糙的3D渲染来显式地控制场景布局、相机运动和人体轨迹，同时，一个学习到的神经渲染器生成逼真的外观、光照和细粒度动态，并由文本提示引导。为了克服粗糙模拟和真实视频之间缺乏配对训练数据的问题，我们采用了一种两阶段混合CG-真实训练策略，该策略从大规模真实视频中学习强大的生成先验，并通过跨域共享的隐式时空特征引入可控性。最终系统支持粗到细的控制，可以推广到各种CG和游戏输入，并从最少的3D输入产生时间一致、可控和逼真的城市场景视频。我们将在https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real/ 上发布模型和项目网页。
tldr: The paper introduces C2R, a generative rendering framework that synthesizes realistic urban crowd videos from coarse 3D simulations using a two-phase mixed CG-real training strategy and text prompts to control appearance and dynamics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了C2R，一个生成式渲染框架，它利用粗糙的3D模拟，通过两阶段混合CG-真实训练策略和文本提示来合成逼真的城市人群视频，从而控制外观和动态。

title: EditYourself: Audio-Driven Generation and Manipulation of Talking Head Videos with Diffusion Transformers
summary: Current generative video models excel at producing novel content from text and image prompts, but leave a critical gap in editing existing pre-recorded videos, where minor alterations to the spoken script require preserving motion, temporal coherence, speaker identity, and accurate lip synchronization. We introduce EditYourself, a DiT-based framework for audio-driven video-to-video (V2V) editing that enables transcript-based modification of talking head videos, including the seamless addition, removal, and retiming of visually spoken content. Building on a general-purpose video diffusion model, EditYourself augments its V2V capabilities with audio conditioning and region-aware, edit-focused training extensions. This enables precise lip synchronization and temporally coherent restructuring of existing performances via spatiotemporal inpainting, including the synthesis of realistic human motion in newly added segments, while maintaining visual fidelity and identity consistency over long durations. This work represents a foundational step toward generative video models as practical tools for professional video post-production.
summary_zh: 目前，生成式视频模型擅长根据文本和图像提示生成新内容，但忽略了一个关键缺口：编辑现有预录视频。在现有视频中，对口语脚本的微小改动需要保持动作、时间连贯性、说话者身份和准确的唇音同步。我们介绍 EditYourself，这是一个基于 DiT 的音频驱动视频到视频 (V2V) 编辑框架，能够基于文本转录修改人物对话视频，包括对视觉口语内容进行无缝添加、删除和重新定时。EditYourself 基于通用视频扩散模型，通过音频条件化和区域感知、以编辑为中心的训练扩展，增强了其 V2V 能力。这使得可以通过时空修复技术实现对现有表演的精确唇音同步和时间连贯性重构，包括在新添加片段中合成逼真的人体运动，同时在长时间内保持视觉保真度和身份一致性。这项工作代表了生成式视频模型朝着成为专业视频后期制作的实用工具迈出的基础性一步。
tldr: The paper introduces "EditYourself," a diffusion transformer-based framework for editing talking head videos via transcript-based modification, enabling seamless content addition, removal, and retiming while maintaining visual fidelity and lip synchronization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“EditYourself”的框架，它基于扩散变换器，通过基于文本的修改来编辑人物对话视频，从而实现无缝的内容添加、删除和重新定时，同时保持视觉保真度和唇部同步。

title: Continual Policy Distillation from Distributed Reinforcement Learning Teachers
summary: Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) aims to develop lifelong learning agents to continuously acquire knowledge across diverse tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. This requires efficiently managing the stability-plasticity dilemma and leveraging prior experience to rapidly generalize to novel tasks. While various enhancement strategies for both aspects have been proposed, achieving scalable performance by directly applying RL to sequential task streams remains challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel teacher-student framework that decouples CRL into two independent processes: training single-task teacher models through distributed RL and continually distilling them into a central generalist model. This design is motivated by the observation that RL excels at solving single tasks, while policy distillation -- a relatively stable supervised learning process -- is well aligned with large foundation models and multi-task learning. Moreover, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and a replay-based approach are employed to enhance the plasticity and stability of the continual policy distillation process. Extensive experiments on the Meta-World benchmark demonstrate that our framework enables efficient continual RL, recovering over 85% of teacher performance while constraining task-wise forgetting to within 10%.
summary_zh: 持续强化学习 (CRL) 旨在开发终身学习智能体，使其能够持续地跨越不同的任务获取知识，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。这需要有效地管理稳定性和可塑性之间的矛盾，并利用先前的经验来快速泛化到新的任务。虽然针对这两个方面已经提出了各种增强策略，但直接应用强化学习到顺序任务流来实现可扩展的性能仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的师生框架，将 CRL 解耦为两个独立的过程：通过分布式强化学习训练单任务教师模型，并将它们持续地提炼到一个中心化的通用模型中。这种设计是受到以下观察结果的启发：强化学习擅长解决单个任务，而策略蒸馏——一种相对稳定的监督学习过程——与大型基础模型和多任务学习非常契合。此外，我们采用了混合专家 (MoE) 架构和基于回放的方法来增强持续策略蒸馏过程的可塑性和稳定性。在 Meta-World 基准上的大量实验表明，我们的框架能够实现高效的持续强化学习，在将任务遗忘限制在 10% 以内的同时，恢复超过 85% 的教师模型性能。
tldr: The paper proposes a teacher-student framework for continual reinforcement learning, using distributed RL to train single-task teachers and then distilling their knowledge into a central generalist model, achieving good performance and mitigating forgetting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于持续强化学习的师生框架。该框架使用分布式强化学习训练单任务的教师模型，然后将它们的知识提炼成一个中心化的通用模型，实现了良好的性能并减少了遗忘。

title: Learning Reward Functions for Cooperative Resilience in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems often operate in dynamic and uncertain environments, where agents must not only pursue individual goals but also safeguard collective functionality. This challenge is especially acute in mixed-motive multi-agent systems. This work focuses on cooperative resilience, the ability of agents to anticipate, resist, recover, and transform in the face of disruptions, a critical yet underexplored property in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning. We study how reward function design influences resilience in mixed-motive settings and introduce a novel framework that learns reward functions from ranked trajectories, guided by a cooperative resilience metric. Agents are trained in a suite of social dilemma environments using three reward strategies: i) traditional individual reward; ii) resilience-inferred reward; and iii) hybrid that balance both. We explore three reward parameterizations-linear models, hand-crafted features, and neural networks, and employ two preference-based learning algorithms to infer rewards from behavioral rankings. Our results demonstrate that hybrid strategy significantly improve robustness under disruptions without degrading task performance and reduce catastrophic outcomes like resource overuse. These findings underscore the importance of reward design in fostering resilient cooperation, and represent a step toward developing robust multi-agent systems capable of sustaining cooperation in uncertain environments.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统通常运行在动态和不确定的环境中，智能体不仅要追求个体目标，还要保障集体功能。这种挑战在混合动机的多智能体系统中尤为突出。本工作侧重于合作韧性，即智能体面对干扰时进行预测、抵抗、恢复和转型的能力，这是多智能体强化学习中一种至关重要但未被充分探索的特性。我们研究了奖励函数设计如何影响混合动机环境中的韧性，并引入了一种新颖的框架，该框架基于合作韧性指标，从排序后的轨迹中学习奖励函数。智能体在一系列社会困境环境中使用三种奖励策略进行训练：i) 传统的个体奖励；ii) 韧性推导的奖励；iii) 平衡两者的混合奖励。我们探索了三种奖励参数化方法——线性模型、手工设计的特征和神经网络，并采用两种基于偏好的学习算法从行为排序中推断奖励。我们的结果表明，混合策略显著提高了干扰下的鲁棒性，且没有降低任务性能，并减少了资源过度使用等灾难性结果。这些发现强调了奖励设计在培养具有弹性的合作中的重要性，并代表着开发能够维持不确定环境中合作的鲁棒多智能体系统迈出了一步。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for learning reward functions that promote cooperative resilience in multi-agent systems, particularly in mixed-motive scenarios, demonstrating improved robustness against disruptions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种学习奖励函数的框架，该框架旨在提高多智能体系统中的合作弹性，尤其是在混合动机场景中，并展示了其在面对中断时的增强的鲁棒性。

title: Latent Spherical Flow Policy for Reinforcement Learning with Combinatorial Actions
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with combinatorial action spaces remains challenging because feasible action sets are exponentially large and governed by complex feasibility constraints, making direct policy parameterization impractical. Existing approaches embed task-specific value functions into constrained optimization programs or learn deterministic structured policies, sacrificing generality and policy expressiveness. We propose a solver-induced \emph{latent spherical flow policy} that brings the expressiveness of modern generative policies to combinatorial RL while guaranteeing feasibility by design. Our method, LSFlow, learns a \emph{stochastic} policy in a compact continuous latent space via spherical flow matching, and delegates feasibility to a combinatorial optimization solver that maps each latent sample to a valid structured action. To improve efficiency, we train the value network directly in the latent space, avoiding repeated solver calls during policy optimization. To address the piecewise-constant and discontinuous value landscape induced by solver-based action selection, we introduce a smoothed Bellman operator that yields stable, well-defined learning targets. Empirically, our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by an average of 20.6\% across a range of challenging combinatorial RL tasks.
summary_zh: 组合动作空间的强化学习（RL）仍然具有挑战性，因为可行动作集呈指数级增长，且受限于复杂的约束条件，导致直接策略参数化不切实际。现有方法将特定任务的价值函数嵌入到约束优化程序中，或学习确定性的结构化策略，牺牲了通用性和策略表达能力。我们提出了一种求解器诱导的\emph{隐空间球面流策略}，将现代生成策略的表达能力带入组合RL，同时通过设计保证可行性。我们的方法，LSFlow，通过球面流匹配，在紧凑的连续隐空间中学习一种\emph{随机}策略，并将可行性问题委托给组合优化求解器，该求解器将每个隐空间样本映射到一个有效的结构化动作。为了提高效率，我们直接在隐空间中训练价值网络，避免在策略优化过程中重复调用求解器。为了解决基于求解器的动作选择所导致的片状常数和不连续的价值图景，我们引入了一种平滑的贝尔曼算子，从而产生稳定、明确的学习目标。在经验上，我们的方法在多个具有挑战性的组合RL任务中，比最先进的基线方法平均提高了20.6%。
tldr: This paper introduces LSFlow, a novel reinforcement learning method for combinatorial action spaces that uses a latent spherical flow policy to guarantee feasibility and improve policy expressiveness, outperforming existing baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为LSFlow的新型强化学习方法，用于解决组合动作空间问题。该方法使用潜在球形流策略来保证可行性并提高策略表达能力，优于现有基线。

title: Boosting CVaR Policy Optimization with Quantile Gradients
summary: Optimizing Conditional Value-at-risk (CVaR) using policy gradient (a.k.a CVaR-PG) faces significant challenges of sample inefficiency. This inefficiency stems from the fact that it focuses on tail-end performance and overlooks many sampled trajectories. We address this problem by augmenting CVaR with an expected quantile term. Quantile optimization admits a dynamic programming formulation that leverages all sampled data, thus improves sample efficiency. This does not alter the CVaR objective since CVaR corresponds to the expectation of quantile over the tail. Empirical results in domains with verifiable risk-averse behavior show that our algorithm within the Markovian policy class substantially improves upon CVaR-PG and consistently outperforms other existing methods.
summary_zh: 使用策略梯度优化条件风险价值 (CVaR) （也称为 CVaR-PG）面临着样本效率低下的重大挑战。这种低效率源于它专注于尾端表现，而忽略了许多采样的轨迹。我们通过用一个期望分位数项来增强 CVaR 来解决这个问题。分位数优化容许动态规划公式，可以利用所有采样数据，从而提高样本效率。由于 CVaR 对应于尾端分位数的期望，因此这不会改变 CVaR 目标。在具有可验证风险规避行为的领域中的经验结果表明，我们的算法在马尔可夫策略类中显著优于 CVaR-PG，并且始终优于其他现有方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to improve the sample efficiency of CVaR policy optimization by augmenting it with an expected quantile term, leading to better risk-averse performance in Markovian policy classes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过使用期望分位数项来增强 CVaR 策略优化，提高其样本效率的方法，从而提升马尔可夫策略类的风险规避性能。

title: Causal Imitation Learning Under Measurement Error and Distribution Shift
summary: We study offline imitation learning (IL) when part of the decision-relevant state is observed only through noisy measurements and the distribution may change between training and deployment. Such settings induce spurious state-action correlations, so standard behavioral cloning (BC) -- whether conditioning on raw measurements or ignoring them -- can converge to systematically biased policies under distribution shift. We propose a general framework for IL under measurement error, inspired by explicitly modeling the causal relationships among the variables, yielding a target that retains a causal interpretation and is robust to distribution shift. Building on ideas from proximal causal inference, we introduce \texttt{CausIL}, which treats noisy state observations as proxy variables, and we provide identification conditions under which the target policy is recoverable from demonstrations without rewards or interactive expert queries. We develop estimators for both discrete and continuous state spaces; for continuous settings, we use an adversarial procedure over RKHS function classes to learn the required parameters. We evaluate \texttt{CausIL} on semi-simulated longitudinal data from the PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019 cohort and demonstrate improved robustness to distribution shift compared to BC baselines.
summary_zh: 我们研究了离线模仿学习 (IL)，在该场景下，部分与决策相关的状态只能通过带噪声的测量值观察到，且训练和部署之间分布可能发生变化。这种设置会引起虚假的状态-动作相关性，因此标准的行为克隆 (BC)——无论是条件作用于原始测量值还是忽略它们——可能在分布偏移下收敛到系统性偏差的策略。我们提出了一个在测量误差下进行 IL 的通用框架，其灵感来自于显式地建模变量之间的因果关系，从而产生一个保留因果解释且对分布偏移具有鲁棒性的目标。在近端因果推断的思想基础上，我们引入了 \texttt{CausIL}，它将带噪声的状态观测视为代理变量，并提供了识别条件，在这些条件下，目标策略可以从演示中恢复，而无需奖励或交互式的专家查询。我们为离散和连续状态空间开发了估计器；对于连续设置，我们使用基于 RKHS 函数类的对抗过程来学习所需的参数。我们在来自 PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019 队列的半模拟纵向数据上评估了 \texttt{CausIL}，并证明了与 BC 基线相比，其对分布偏移具有更高的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes a causal imitation learning framework (	exttt{CausIL}) to address the issue of spurious state-action correlations caused by noisy state measurements and distribution shifts in offline imitation learning, demonstrating improved robustness compared to behavioral cloning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种因果模仿学习框架 (	exttt{CausIL})，旨在解决离线模仿学习中由噪声状态测量和分布漂移引起的虚假状态-动作相关性问题，并证明与行为克隆相比，其鲁棒性有所提高。

title: Toward Fully Autonomous Driving: AI, Challenges, Opportunities, and Needs
summary: Automated driving (AD) is promising, but the transition to fully autonomous driving is, among other things, subject to the real, ever-changing open world and the resulting challenges. However, research in the field of AD demonstrates the ability of artificial intelligence (AI) to outperform classical approaches, handle higher complexities, and reach a new level of autonomy. At the same time, the use of AI raises further questions of safety and transferability. To identify the challenges and opportunities arising from AI concerning autonomous driving functionalities, we have analyzed the current state of AD, outlined limitations, and identified foreseeable technological possibilities. Thereby, various further challenges are examined in the context of prospective developments. In this way, this article reconsiders fully autonomous driving with respect to advancements in the field of AI and carves out the respective needs and resulting research questions.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶（AD）前景广阔，但向完全自动驾驶的过渡，除其他因素外，受制于真实、不断变化的开放世界以及由此带来的挑战。然而，自动驾驶领域的研究表明，人工智能（AI）有能力超越传统方法，处理更高的复杂性，并达到新的自主水平。与此同时，人工智能的使用也引发了关于安全性和可迁移性的进一步问题。为了识别人工智能在自动驾驶功能方面带来的挑战和机遇，我们分析了自动驾驶的现状，概述了局限性，并确定了可预见的技术可能性。在此过程中，在未来发展背景下考察了各种进一步的挑战。通过这种方式，本文结合人工智能领域的进展重新审视了完全自动驾驶，并剖析了相应的需求和由此产生的研究问题。
tldr: This paper analyzes the current state of autonomous driving, focusing on the challenges and opportunities presented by AI, particularly concerning safety and transferability, and identifies research needs for achieving full autonomy.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了自动驾驶的现状，重点关注人工智能带来的挑战和机遇，尤其是在安全性和可迁移性方面，并确定了实现完全自动驾驶的研究需求。

title: ReloPush-BOSS: Optimization-guided Nonmonotone Rearrangement Planning for a Car-like Robot Pusher
summary: We focus on multi-object rearrangement planning in densely cluttered environments using a car-like robot pusher. The combination of kinematic, geometric and physics constraints underlying this domain results in challenging nonmonotone problem instances which demand breaking each manipulation action into multiple parts to achieve a desired object rearrangement. Prior work tackles such instances by planning prerelocations, temporary object displacements that enable constraint satisfaction, but deciding where to prerelocate remains difficult due to local minima leading to infeasible or high-cost paths. Our key insight is that these minima can be avoided by steering a prerelocation optimization toward low-cost regions informed by Dubins path classification. These optimized prerelocations are integrated into an object traversability graph that encodes kinematic, geometric, and pushing constraints. Searching this graph in a depth-first fashion results in efficient, feasible rearrangement sequences. Across a series of densely cluttered scenarios with up to 13 objects, our framework, ReloPush-BOSS, exhibits consistently highest success rates and shortest pushing paths compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Hardware experiments on a 1/10 car-like pusher demonstrate the robustness of our approach. Code and footage from our experiments can be found at: https://fluentrobotics.com/relopushboss.
summary_zh: 我们专注于使用类汽车机器人推杆，在密集杂乱环境中进行多目标重排列规划。该领域中运动学、几何和物理约束的结合导致了具有挑战性的非单调问题实例，这需要将每个操作动作分解成多个部分才能实现期望的对象重排列。先前的工作通过规划预重定位（一种临时的对象位移，以实现约束满足）来解决这些实例，但由于局部最小值导致不可行或高成本路径，因此决定预重定位的位置仍然很困难。我们的关键洞察是，通过将预重定位优化引导至由Dubins路径分类告知的低成本区域，可以避免这些最小值。这些优化的预重定位被整合到一个对象可遍历性图中，该图编码了运动学、几何和推动约束。以深度优先的方式搜索该图可以产生高效、可行的重排列序列。在一系列最多包含13个对象的密集杂乱场景中，我们的框架 ReloPush-BOSS与最先进的基准相比，始终表现出最高的成功率和最短的推动路径。在1/10类汽车推杆上的硬件实验证明了我们方法的稳健性。我们实验的代码和视频可以在以下网址找到：https://fluentrobotics.com/relopushboss。
tldr: The paper presents ReloPush-BOSS, a novel framework for multi-object rearrangement planning in cluttered environments using a car-like robot pusher, achieving high success rates and shorter paths through optimization-guided prerelocations, demonstrated in both simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍 ReloPush-BOSS，一个新颖的框架，用于使用类似汽车的机器人推手在杂乱环境中进行多目标重排规划。通过优化引导的预重定位，该框架实现了高成功率和更短的路径，并在仿真和硬件中得到了演示。

title: Aligning Microscopic Vehicle and Macroscopic Traffic Statistics: Reconstructing Driving Behavior from Partial Data
summary: A driving algorithm that aligns with good human driving practices, or at the very least collaborates effectively with human drivers, is crucial for developing safe and efficient autonomous vehicles. In practice, two main approaches are commonly adopted: (i) supervised or imitation learning, which requires comprehensive naturalistic driving data capturing all states that influence a vehicle's decisions and corresponding actions, and (ii) reinforcement learning (RL), where the simulated driving environment either matches or is intentionally more challenging than real-world conditions. Both methods depend on high-quality observations of real-world driving behavior, which are often difficult and costly to obtain. State-of-the-art sensors on individual vehicles can gather microscopic data, but they lack context about the surrounding conditions. Conversely, roadside sensors can capture traffic flow and other macroscopic characteristics, but they cannot associate this information with individual vehicles on a microscopic level. Motivated by this complementarity, we propose a framework that reconstructs unobserved microscopic states from macroscopic observations, using microscopic data to anchor observed vehicle behaviors, and learns a shared policy whose behavior is microscopically consistent with the partially observed trajectories and actions and macroscopically aligned with target traffic statistics when deployed population-wide. Such constrained and regularized policies promote realistic flow patterns and safe coordination with human drivers at scale.
summary_zh: 一种符合良好人类驾驶习惯，或者至少能与人类驾驶员有效协作的驾驶算法，对于开发安全高效的自动驾驶汽车至关重要。 在实践中，通常采用两种主要方法：（i）监督学习或模仿学习，这需要全面的自然驾驶数据，以捕获所有影响车辆决策的状态以及相应的动作；以及（ii）强化学习（RL），其中模拟驾驶环境匹配或者有意比真实世界条件更具挑战性。 这两种方法都依赖于对真实世界驾驶行为的高质量观察，而这些观察通常难以获得且成本高昂。 单个车辆上的最先进传感器可以收集微观数据，但它们缺乏关于周围环境的背景信息。 相反，路边传感器可以捕获交通流量和其他宏观特征，但它们无法将此信息与微观层面的单个车辆相关联。 受这种互补性的启发，我们提出了一种框架，该框架利用微观数据来锚定观察到的车辆行为，从而从宏观观察中重建未观察到的微观状态，并且学习一种共享策略，该策略的行为在微观上与部分观察到的轨迹和动作一致，在宏观上与大规模部署时的目标交通统计数据对齐。 这种受约束和正则化的策略促进了现实的交通流模式，并实现了与人类驾驶员的大规模安全协调。
tldr: The paper proposes a framework to reconstruct microscopic vehicle states from macroscopic traffic observations, aiming to learn driving policies that align with real-world traffic statistics for autonomous vehicle development.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种从宏观交通观测重建微观车辆状态的框架，旨在学习与真实交通统计数据对齐的驾驶策略，以用于自动驾驶汽车的开发。

title: EvoClinician: A Self-Evolving Agent for Multi-Turn Medical Diagnosis via Test-Time Evolutionary Learning
summary: Prevailing medical AI operates on an unrealistic ''one-shot'' model, diagnosing from a complete patient file. However, real-world diagnosis is an iterative inquiry where Clinicians sequentially ask questions and order tests to strategically gather information while managing cost and time. To address this, we first propose Med-Inquire, a new benchmark designed to evaluate an agent's ability to perform multi-turn diagnosis. Built upon a dataset of real-world clinical cases, Med-Inquire simulates the diagnostic process by hiding a complete patient file behind specialized Patient and Examination agents. They force the agent to proactively ask questions and order tests to gather information piece by piece. To tackle the challenges posed by Med-Inquire, we then introduce EvoClinician, a self-evolving agent that learns efficient diagnostic strategies at test time. Its core is a ''Diagnose-Grade-Evolve'' loop: an Actor agent attempts a diagnosis; a Process Grader agent performs credit assignment by evaluating each action for both clinical yield and resource efficiency; finally, an Evolver agent uses this feedback to update the Actor's strategy by evolving its prompt and memory. Our experiments show EvoClinician outperforms continual learning baselines and other self-evolving agents like memory agents. The code is available at https://github.com/yf-he/EvoClinician
summary_zh: 当前主流的医学人工智能运行在一个不切实际的“一次性”模型上，即从一个完整的患者档案进行诊断。然而，现实世界的诊断是一个迭代式的探究过程，临床医生按顺序提问和进行检查，以策略性地收集信息，同时管理成本和时间。为了解决这个问题，我们首先提出了Med-Inquire，一个新的基准，旨在评估智能体执行多轮诊断的能力。Med-Inquire建立在真实临床病例的数据集之上，通过隐藏在一个专门的患者和检查智能体背后的完整患者档案来模拟诊断过程。它们迫使智能体主动提问和进行检查，以逐片地收集信息。为了应对Med-Inquire带来的挑战，我们随后引入了EvoClinician，一种自主进化的智能体，它可以在测试时学习高效的诊断策略。它的核心是一个“诊断-评估-进化”循环：一个行动者智能体尝试诊断；一个过程评估者智能体通过评估每个行动的临床效益和资源效率来进行信用分配；最后，一个进化者智能体利用这个反馈，通过进化其提示和记忆来更新行动者的策略。我们的实验表明，EvoClinician的性能优于持续学习基线和其他自进化智能体，例如记忆智能体。代码可在https://github.com/yf-he/EvoClinician 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Med-Inquire, a new benchmark for multi-turn medical diagnosis with sequential information gathering, and EvoClinician, a test-time evolving agent that outperforms baselines by iteratively diagnosing, grading, and evolving its strategy.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了Med-Inquire，一个新的多轮医疗诊断基准，侧重于序列信息收集；并介绍了EvoClinician，一个测试时进化的智能体，通过迭代诊断、评估和改进其策略，优于其他基线方法。

title: Defining Operational Conditions for Safety-Critical AI-Based Systems from Data
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been on the rise in many domains, including numerous safety-critical applications. However, for complex systems found in the real world, or when data already exist, defining the underlying environmental conditions is extremely challenging. This often results in an incomplete description of the environment in which the AI-based system must operate. Nevertheless, this description, called the Operational Design Domain (ODD), is required in many domains for the certification of AI-based systems. Traditionally, the ODD is created in the early stages of the development process, drawing on sophisticated expert knowledge and related standards. This paper presents a novel Safety-by-Design method to a posteriori define the ODD from previously collected data using a multi-dimensional kernel-based representation. This approach is validated through both Monte Carlo methods and a real-world aviation use case for a future safety-critical collision-avoidance system. Moreover, by defining under what conditions two ODDs are equal, the paper shows that the data-driven ODD can equal the original, underlying hidden ODD of the data. Utilizing the novel, Safe-by-Design kernel-based ODD enables future certification of data-driven, safety-critical AI-based systems.
summary_zh: 人工智能(AI)已在众多领域蓬勃发展，包括大量安全攸关的应用。然而，对于现实世界中存在的复杂系统，或者当数据已经存在时，定义底层的环境条件极具挑战性。这常常导致对AI系统必须运行的环境描述不完整。尽管如此，这种被称为运行设计域(ODD)的描述，在许多领域对于AI系统认证而言是必需的。传统上，ODD是在开发过程的早期阶段创建的，借鉴了精深的专家知识和相关标准。本文提出了一种新颖的安全设计方法，通过多维度的基于核的表示，根据先前收集的数据事后定义ODD。该方法通过蒙特卡洛方法和针对未来安全攸关的防撞系统的真实世界航空用例进行了验证。此外，通过定义两个ODD在何种条件下相等，本文表明数据驱动的ODD可以等于数据的原始、底层的隐藏ODD。利用这种新颖的、安全设计的、基于核的ODD，能够实现未来数据驱动的、安全攸关的AI系统的认证。
tldr: This paper presents a novel, Safety-by-Design method for defining the Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-critical AI systems from existing data using a multi-dimensional kernel-based representation, validated with Monte Carlo methods and an aviation use case. It aims to enable future certification of such systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的安全设计方法，使用多维核表示从现有数据中定义安全关键型人工智能系统的操作设计域（ODD），并通过蒙特卡罗方法和航空用例进行验证。旨在为未来此类系统的认证提供支持。

title: EAG-PT: Emission-Aware Gaussians and Path Tracing for Indoor Scene Reconstruction and Editing
summary: Recent reconstruction methods based on radiance field such as NeRF and 3DGS reproduce indoor scenes with high visual fidelity, but break down under scene editing due to baked illumination and the lack of explicit light transport. In contrast, physically based inverse rendering relies on mesh representations and path tracing, which enforce correct light transport but place strong requirements on geometric fidelity, becoming a practical bottleneck for real indoor scenes. In this work, we propose Emission-Aware Gaussians and Path Tracing (EAG-PT), aiming for physically based light transport with a unified 2D Gaussian representation. Our design is based on three cores: (1) using 2D Gaussians as a unified scene representation and transport-friendly geometry proxy that avoids reconstructed mesh, (2) explicitly separating emissive and non-emissive components during reconstruction for further scene editing, and (3) decoupling reconstruction from final rendering by using efficient single-bounce optimization and high-quality multi-bounce path tracing after scene editing. Experiments on synthetic and real indoor scenes show that EAG-PT produces more natural and physically consistent renders after editing than radiant scene reconstructions, while preserving finer geometric detail and avoiding mesh-induced artifacts compared to mesh-based inverse path tracing. These results suggest promising directions for future use in interior design, XR content creation, and embodied AI.
summary_zh: 基于辐射场的最新重建方法，例如NeRF和3DGS，能够以高视觉保真度再现室内场景，但由于烘焙光照和缺乏显式光照传输，在场景编辑下会失效。相比之下，基于物理的逆渲染依赖于网格表示和路径追踪，这可以保证正确的光照传输，但对几何保真度要求很高，成为真实室内场景的一个实际瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们提出了发射感知高斯和路径追踪（EAG-PT），旨在利用统一的2D高斯表示实现基于物理的光照传输。我们的设计基于三个核心：（1）使用2D高斯作为统一的场景表示和方便传输的几何代理，从而避免重建网格；（2）在重建过程中显式地分离发射和非发射分量，以便进一步进行场景编辑；（3）通过使用高效的单次反弹优化和场景编辑后高质量的多次反弹路径追踪，将重建与最终渲染解耦。在合成和真实室内场景上的实验表明，与辐射场景重建相比，EAG-PT在编辑后产生了更自然和物理上一致的渲染结果，同时保留了更精细的几何细节，并且避免了基于网格的逆向路径追踪带来的网格伪影。这些结果为室内设计、XR内容创作和具身人工智能的未来应用提供了有希望的方向。
tldr: EAG-PT introduces a novel approach for indoor scene reconstruction and editing by using Emission-Aware Gaussians and path tracing, achieving physically consistent renders after editing with finer geometric details compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: EAG-PT提出了一种新颖的室内场景重建和编辑方法，该方法采用发射感知高斯函数和路径追踪，与现有方法相比，在编辑后实现了物理上一致的渲染效果，并具有更精细的几何细节。

title: Value-at-Risk Constrained Policy Optimization
summary: We introduce the Value-at-Risk Constrained Policy Optimization algorithm (VaR-CPO), a sample efficient and conservative method designed to optimize Value-at-Risk (VaR) constraints directly. Empirically, we demonstrate that VaR-CPO is capable of safe exploration, achieving zero constraint violations during training in feasible environments, a critical property that baseline methods fail to uphold. To overcome the inherent non-differentiability of the VaR constraint, we employ the one-sided Chebyshev inequality to obtain a tractable surrogate based on the first two moments of the cost return. Additionally, by extending the trust-region framework of the Constrained Policy Optimization (CPO) method, we provide rigorous worst-case bounds for both policy improvement and constraint violation during the training process.
summary_zh: 我们引入了风险价值约束策略优化算法（VaR-CPO），这是一种样本高效且保守的方法，旨在直接优化风险价值（VaR）约束。实验表明，VaR-CPO能够进行安全探索，在可行环境中训练期间实现零约束违规，这是基线方法无法维持的关键特性。为了克服VaR约束固有的不可微性，我们采用单侧切比雪夫不等式来获得一个基于成本回报的一阶和二阶矩的可处理替代。此外，通过扩展约束策略优化（CPO）方法的信任区域框架，我们为训练过程中策略改进和约束违规提供了严格的最坏情况界限。
tldr: The paper introduces VaR-CPO, a sample-efficient and conservative reinforcement learning algorithm that directly optimizes Value-at-Risk (VaR) constraints using a trust-region framework, achieving zero constraint violations during training.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为VaR-CPO的强化学习算法，该算法具有样本高效性和保守性，它使用信任域框架直接优化风险价值（VaR）约束，并在训练过程中实现零约束违规。

title: Detect and Act: Automated Dynamic Optimizer through Meta-Black-Box Optimization
summary: Dynamic Optimization Problems (DOPs) are challenging to address due to their complex nature, i.e., dynamic environment variation. Evolutionary Computation methods are generally advantaged in solving DOPs since they resemble dynamic biological evolution. However, existing evolutionary dynamic optimization methods rely heavily on human-crafted adaptive strategy to detect environment variation in DOPs, and then adapt the searching strategy accordingly. These hand-crafted strategies may perform ineffectively at out-of-box scenarios. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning-assisted approach to enable automated variation detection and self-adaption in evolutionary algorithms. This is achieved by borrowing the bi-level learning-to-optimize idea from recent Meta-Black-Box Optimization works. We use a deep Q-network as optimization dynamics detector and searching strategy adapter: It is fed as input with current-step optimization state and then dictates desired control parameters to underlying evolutionary algorithms for next-step optimization. The learning objective is to maximize the expected performance gain across a problem distribution. Once trained, our approach could generalize toward unseen DOPs with automated environment variation detection and self-adaption. To facilitate comprehensive validation, we further construct an easy-to-difficult DOPs testbed with diverse synthetic instances. Extensive benchmark results demonstrate flexible searching behavior and superior performance of our approach in solving DOPs, compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 动态优化问题（DOPs）因其复杂性，即动态环境变化，而难以解决。进化计算方法通常在解决DOPs方面具有优势，因为它们类似于动态生物进化。然而，现有的进化动态优化方法严重依赖于人工设计的自适应策略来检测DOPs中的环境变化，然后相应地调整搜索策略。这些手工设计的策略可能在开箱即用的场景中表现不佳。在本文中，我们提出了一种强化学习辅助的方法，以实现进化算法中的自动变异检测和自适应。这通过借鉴最近的元黑盒优化工作中的双层学习优化思想来实现。我们使用深度Q网络作为优化动态检测器和搜索策略适配器：它以当前步骤的优化状态作为输入，然后将所需的控制参数指示给底层进化算法以进行下一步优化。学习目标是最大化整个问题分布的预期性能增益。一旦训练完成，我们的方法就可以推广到具有自动环境变异检测和自适应的未知DOP。为了便于全面验证，我们进一步构建了一个由易到难的DOPs测试平台，其中包含各种合成实例。大量的基准测试结果表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，我们的方法在解决DOPs方面具有灵活的搜索行为和卓越的性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-assisted evolutionary algorithm for dynamic optimization problems, using a deep Q-network for automated variation detection and self-adaptation of search strategies, demonstrating superior performance on a newly constructed DOPs testbed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的进化算法来解决动态优化问题。该方法利用深度Q网络自动检测环境变化并自适应调整搜索策略，并在新建的DOPs测试平台上展示了优越的性能。

title: DRL-Enabled Trajectory Planing for UAV-Assisted VLC: Optimal Altitude and Reward Design
summary: Recently, the integration of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and visible light communication (VLC) technologies has emerged as a promising solution to offer flexible communication and efficient lighting. This letter investigates the three-dimensional trajectory planning in a UAV-assisted VLC system, where a UAV is dispatched to collect data from ground users (GUs). The core objective is to develop a trajectory planning framework that minimizes UAV flight distance, which is equivalent to maximizing the data collection efficiency. This issue is formulated as a challenging mixed-integer non-convex optimization problem. To tackle it, we first derive a closed-form optimal flight altitude under specific VLC channel gain threshold. Subsequently, we optimize the UAV horizontal trajectory by integrating a novel pheromone-driven reward mechanism with the twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, which enables adaptive UAV motion strategy in complex environments. Simulation results validate that the derived optimal altitude effectively reduces the flight distance by up to 35% compared to baseline methods. Additionally, the proposed reward mechanism significantly shortens the convergence steps by approximately 50%, demonstrating notable efficiency gains in the context of UAV-assisted VLC data collection.
summary_zh: 近期，无人机(UAV)和可见光通信(VLC)技术的融合已成为一种有前景的解决方案，可提供灵活的通信和高效的照明。本文研究了无人机辅助VLC系统中的三维轨迹规划，其中派遣无人机从地面用户(GU)收集数据。核心目标是开发一种轨迹规划框架，以最小化无人机飞行距离，这等同于最大化数据采集效率。该问题被表述为一个具有挑战性的混合整数非凸优化问题。为了解决这个问题，我们首先推导出在特定VLC信道增益阈值下的闭式最优飞行高度。随后，我们通过将一种新型的信息素驱动奖励机制与双延迟深度确定性策略梯度算法相结合，来优化无人机的水平轨迹，从而在复杂环境中实现自适应的无人机运动策略。仿真结果表明，与基线方法相比，所推导出的最优高度有效地将飞行距离减少了高达35%。此外，所提出的奖励机制将收敛步骤显著缩短了约50%，展示了在无人机辅助VLC数据收集方面显著的效率提升。
tldr: This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for UAV trajectory planning in VLC systems, aiming to minimize flight distance by optimizing altitude and horizontal trajectory with a pheromone-driven reward mechanism. Simulation results show improved flight distance and convergence speed compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的可见光通信（VLC）系统中无人机轨迹规划框架，旨在通过优化高度和水平轨迹，并结合信息素驱动的奖励机制来最小化飞行距离。仿真结果表明，与基线方法相比，飞行距离和收敛速度均有所提升。

title: Gaussian Process Bandit Optimization with Machine Learning Predictions and Application to Hypothesis Generation
summary: Many real-world optimization problems involve an expensive ground-truth oracle (e.g., human evaluation, physical experiments) and a cheap, low-fidelity prediction oracle (e.g., machine learning models, simulations). Meanwhile, abundant offline data (e.g., past experiments and predictions) are often available and can be used to pretrain powerful predictive models, as well as to provide an informative prior. We propose Prediction-Augmented Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (PA-GP-UCB), a novel Bayesian optimization algorithm that leverages both oracles and offline data to achieve provable gains in sample efficiency for the ground-truth oracle queries. PA-GP-UCB employs a control-variates estimator derived from a joint Gaussian process posterior to correct prediction bias and reduce uncertainty. We prove that PA-GP-UCB preserves the standard regret rate of GP-UCB while achieving a strictly smaller leading constant that is explicitly controlled by prediction quality and offline data coverage. Empirically, PA-GP-UCB converges faster than Vanilla GP-UCB and naive prediction-augmented GP-UCB baselines on synthetic benchmarks and on a real-world hypothesis evaluation task grounded in human behavioral data, where predictions are provided by large language models. These results establish PA-GP-UCB as a general and sample-efficient framework for hypothesis generation under expensive feedback.
summary_zh: 许多现实世界的优化问题都涉及昂贵的真值预言机（例如，人工评估、物理实验）和一个廉价的、低保真度的预测预言机（例如，机器学习模型、模拟）。同时，大量的离线数据（例如，过去的实验和预测）通常是可用的，并且可以用来预训练强大的预测模型，以及提供信息丰富的先验知识。我们提出了预测增强的高斯过程上置信界（PA-GP-UCB），一种新颖的贝叶斯优化算法，它利用这两种预言机和离线数据来在真值预言机查询的采样效率上实现可证明的提升。PA-GP-UCB采用从联合高斯过程后验导出的控制变量估计器来校正预测偏差并降低不确定性。我们证明了PA-GP-UCB保留了GP-UCB的标准遗憾率，同时实现了严格较小的首项常数，该常数由预测质量和离线数据覆盖率显式控制。在经验上，PA-GP-UCB在合成基准测试和基于人类行为数据的真实假设评估任务上，比Vanilla GP-UCB和朴素的预测增强GP-UCB基线收敛更快，其中预测由大型语言模型提供。这些结果将PA-GP-UCB确立为在高成本反馈下进行假设生成的一种通用且采样高效的框架。
tldr: The paper introduces Prediction-Augmented Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (PA-GP-UCB), a Bayesian optimization algorithm that utilizes both expensive ground-truth oracles and cheap prediction oracles along with offline data to improve sample efficiency, particularly for hypothesis generation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种预测增强高斯过程上置信界 (PA-GP-UCB) 算法，该算法利用昂贵的真实数据源和廉价的预测数据源以及离线数据来提高样本效率，尤其适用于假设生成任务。

title: SMOG: Scalable Meta-Learning for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
summary: Multi-objective optimization aims to solve problems with competing objectives, often with only black-box access to a problem and a limited budget of measurements. In many applications, historical data from related optimization tasks is available, creating an opportunity for meta-learning to accelerate the optimization. Bayesian optimization, as a promising technique for black-box optimization, has been extended to meta-learning and multi-objective optimization independently, but methods that simultaneously address both settings - meta-learned priors for multi-objective Bayesian optimization - remain largely unexplored. We propose SMOG, a scalable and modular meta-learning model based on a multi-output Gaussian process that explicitly learns correlations between objectives. SMOG builds a structured joint Gaussian process prior across meta- and target tasks and, after conditioning on metadata, yields a closed-form target-task prior augmented by a flexible residual multi-output kernel. This construction propagates metadata uncertainty into the target surrogate in a principled way. SMOG supports hierarchical, parallel training: meta-task Gaussian processes are fit once and then cached, achieving linear scaling with the number of meta-tasks. The resulting surrogate integrates seamlessly with standard multi-objective Bayesian optimization acquisition functions.
summary_zh: 多目标优化旨在解决具有相互竞争目标的问题，通常只能通过黑盒方式访问问题，且测量预算有限。在许多应用中，可以获得来自相关优化任务的历史数据，从而为元学习创造机会以加速优化。贝叶斯优化作为一种有前景的黑盒优化技术，已被独立地扩展到元学习和多目标优化，但同时解决这两种情况的方法——多目标贝叶斯优化的元学习先验——仍然在很大程度上未被探索。我们提出了SMOG，一种可扩展且模块化的元学习模型，该模型基于多输出高斯过程，显式地学习目标之间的相关性。SMOG构建了一个跨元任务和目标任务的结构化联合高斯过程先验，并在根据元数据进行条件化后，产生一个封闭形式的目标任务先验，并由一个灵活的残差多输出核增强。这种构造以一种原则性的方式将元数据的不确定性传播到目标代理模型中。SMOG支持分层、并行训练：元任务高斯过程只需拟合一次然后缓存，从而实现与元任务数量的线性缩放。由此产生的代理模型可以无缝集成到标准的多目标贝叶斯优化采集函数中。
tldr: The paper introduces SMOG, a scalable meta-learning model for multi-objective Bayesian Optimization that leverages a multi-output Gaussian process to learn correlations between objectives, enabling faster optimization in black-box scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SMOG，一种可扩展的元学习模型，用于多目标贝叶斯优化。该模型利用多输出高斯过程学习目标之间的相关性，从而在黑盒场景中实现更快的优化。

title: About an Automating Annotation Method for Robot Markers
summary: Factory automation has become increasingly important due to labor shortages, leading to the introduction of autonomous mobile robots for tasks such as material transportation. Markers are commonly used for robot self-localization and object identification. In the RoboCup Logistics League (RCLL), ArUco markers are employed both for robot localization and for identifying processing modules. Conventional recognition relies on OpenCV-based image processing, which detects black-and-white marker patterns. However, these methods often fail under noise, motion blur, defocus, or varying illumination conditions. Deep-learning-based recognition offers improved robustness under such conditions, but requires large amounts of annotated data. Annotation must typically be done manually, as the type and position of objects cannot be detected automatically, making dataset preparation a major bottleneck. In contrast, ArUco markers include built-in recognition modules that provide both ID and positional information, enabling automatic annotation. This paper proposes an automated annotation method for training deep-learning models on ArUco marker images. By leveraging marker detection results obtained from the ArUco module, the proposed approach eliminates the need for manual labeling. A YOLO-based model is trained using the automatically annotated dataset, and its performance is evaluated under various conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves recognition performance compared with conventional image-processing techniques, particularly for images affected by blur or defocus. Automatic annotation also reduces human effort and ensures consistent labeling quality. Future work will investigate the relationship between confidence thresholds and recognition performance.
summary_zh: 工厂自动化由于劳动力短缺而变得日益重要，从而促进了自主移动机器人在物料运输等任务中的应用。标记常被用于机器人自定位和物体识别。在RoboCup物流联赛（RCLL）中，ArUco标记被同时用于机器人定位和识别处理模块。传统的识别依赖于基于OpenCV的图像处理，该处理检测黑白标记图案。然而，这些方法在噪声、运动模糊、散焦或变化的照明条件下通常会失效。基于深度学习的识别在这些条件下提供了更高的鲁棒性，但需要大量的标注数据。由于物体的类型和位置无法自动检测，通常必须手动完成标注，这使得数据集准备成为主要的瓶颈。相比之下，ArUco标记包含内置的识别模块，可以提供ID和位置信息，从而实现自动标注。本文提出了一种自动标注方法，用于在ArUco标记图像上训练深度学习模型。通过利用从ArUco模块获得的标记检测结果，所提出的方法消除了手动标注的需求。使用自动标注的数据集训练了一个基于YOLO的模型，并在各种条件下评估了其性能。实验结果表明，与传统的图像处理技术相比，该方法提高了识别性能，尤其是在受模糊或散焦影响的图像中。自动标注还减少了人力投入，并确保了一致的标注质量。未来的工作将研究置信度阈值与识别性能之间的关系。
tldr: This paper proposes an automated annotation method for training deep-learning models to recognize ArUco markers, leveraging the markers' built-in recognition to avoid manual labeling and improving robustness compared to traditional OpenCV methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自动标注方法，用于训练深度学习模型以识别 ArUco 标记。该方法利用标记内置的识别功能来避免手动标注，并提高了相对于传统 OpenCV 方法的鲁棒性。

title: Assistive Robots and Reasonable Work Assignment Reduce Perceived Stigma toward Persons with Disabilities
summary: Robots are becoming more prominent in assisting persons with disabilities (PwD). Whilst there is broad consensus that robots can assist in mitigating physical impairments, the extent to which they can facilitate social inclusion remains equivocal. In fact, the exposed status of assisted workers could likewise lead to reduced or increased perceived stigma by other workers. We present a vignette study on the perceived cognitive and behavioral stigma toward PwD in the workplace. We designed four experimental conditions depicting a coworker with an impairment in work scenarios: overburdened work, suitable work, and robot-assisted work only for the coworker, and an offer of robot-assisted work for everyone. Our results show that cognitive stigma is significantly reduced when the work task is adapted to the person's abilities or augmented by an assistive robot. In addition, offering robot-assisted work for everyone, in the sense of universal design, further reduces perceived cognitive stigma. Thus, we conclude that assistive robots reduce perceived cognitive stigma, thereby supporting the use of collaborative robots in work scenarios involving PwDs.
summary_zh: 机器人正日益显著地协助残疾人士（PwD）。虽然在机器人能够缓解身体障碍方面存在广泛共识，但它们在多大程度上能够促进社会融合仍不确定。实际上，受助工人的暴露状态同样可能导致其他工人对其感知到的污名增加或减少。我们提出了一项关于工作场所中对残疾人士的认知和行为污名感知的实验情景研究。我们设计了四种实验条件，描绘了一名有工作障碍的同事在工作场景中的情况：工作负担过重、适合的工作、仅为该同事提供的机器人辅助工作，以及为所有人提供机器人辅助工作的提议。我们的结果表明，当工作任务适应个人的能力或通过辅助机器人增强时，认知污名会显著降低。此外，从通用设计的角度来看，为所有人提供机器人辅助工作会进一步降低感知的认知污名。因此，我们得出结论，辅助机器人可以减少感知的认知污名，从而支持在涉及残疾人士的工作场景中使用协作机器人。
tldr: This paper investigates how assistive robots and appropriate work assignments impact perceived stigma towards persons with disabilities (PwD), finding that both robot assistance and suitable tasks reduce cognitive stigma, especially when robot assistance is offered universally.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了辅助机器人和合理的工作分配如何影响对残疾人（PwD）的刻板印象，发现机器人辅助和合适的任务都能减少认知上的歧视，尤其是在普遍提供机器人辅助的情况下。

title: Postural Virtual Fixtures for Ergonomic Physical Interactions with Supernumerary Robotic Bodies
summary: Conjoined collaborative robots, functioning as supernumerary robotic bodies (SRBs), can enhance human load tolerance abilities. However, in tasks involving physical interaction with humans, users may still adopt awkward, non-ergonomic postures, which can lead to discomfort or injury over time. In this paper, we propose a novel control framework that provides kinesthetic feedback to SRB users when a non-ergonomic posture is detected, offering resistance to discourage such behaviors. This approach aims to foster long-term learning of ergonomic habits and promote proper posture during physical interactions. To achieve this, a virtual fixture method is developed, integrated with a continuous, online ergonomic posture assessment framework. Additionally, to improve coordination between the operator and the SRB, which consists of a robotic arm mounted on a floating base, the position of the floating base is adjusted as needed. Experimental results demonstrate the functionality and efficacy of the ergonomics-driven control framework, including two user studies involving practical loco-manipulation tasks with 14 subjects, comparing the proposed framework with a baseline control framework that does not account for human ergonomics.
summary_zh:
摘要：
作为超常机器人肢体（SRBs）运行的联合协作机器人可以增强人体负重能力。然而，在涉及与人体物理交互的任务中，用户可能仍然会采用笨拙、不符合人体工学的姿势，长期下来可能导致不适或受伤。在本文中，我们提出了一种新型控制框架，当检测到非人体工学姿势时，该框架向SRB用户提供动觉反馈，提供阻力以抑制此类行为。该方法旨在培养长期的人体工学习惯，并在物理交互过程中促进正确的姿势。为了实现这一目标，开发了一种虚拟夹具方法，并将其与连续的在线人体工学姿势评估框架相结合。此外，为了改善操作员和由安装在浮动底座上的机械臂组成的SRB之间的协调，根据需要调整浮动底座的位置。实验结果证明了以人体工程学驱动的控制框架的功能和有效性，包括两项涉及实际定位操作任务的用户研究，共有14名受试者参与，并将所提出的框架与不考虑人体工程学的基线控制框架进行了比较。
tldr: This paper presents a control framework using virtual fixtures to provide kinesthetic feedback to users of supernumerary robotic bodies (SRBs) to encourage ergonomic postures and improve human-robot coordination, validated with user studies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种控制框架，该框架利用虚拟夹具向辅助机器人（SRB）的用户提供动觉反馈，以鼓励符合人体工程学的姿势并改善人机协调，并通过用户研究进行了验证。

title: Accurate Pedestrian Tracking in Urban Canyons: A Multi-Modal Fusion Approach
summary: The contribution describes a pedestrian navigation approach designed to improve localization accuracy in urban environments where GNSS performance is degraded, a problem that is especially critical for blind or low-vision users who depend on precise guidance such as identifying the correct side of a street. To address GNSS limitations and the impracticality of camera-based visual positioning, the work proposes a particle filter based fusion of GNSS and inertial data that incorporates spatial priors from maps, such as impassable buildings and unlikely walking areas, functioning as a probabilistic form of map matching. Inertial localization is provided by the RoNIN machine learning method, and fusion with GNSS is achieved by weighting particles based on their consistency with GNSS estimates and uncertainty. The system was evaluated on six challenging walking routes in downtown San Francisco using three metrics related to sidewalk correctness and localization error. Results show that the fused approach (GNSS+RoNIN+PF) significantly outperforms GNSS only localization on most metrics, while inertial-only localization with particle filtering also surpasses GNSS alone for critical measures such as sidewalk assignment and across street error.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种行人导航方法，旨在提高城市环境中定位精度，特别是在GNSS性能下降的情况下。这个问题对于依赖精确引导的盲人或低视力用户尤为关键，例如识别街道的正确侧面。为了解决GNSS局限性和基于相机的视觉定位的不实用性，本文提出了一种基于粒子滤波的GNSS和惯性数据融合方法，该方法结合了来自地图的空间先验信息，例如无法通行的建筑物和不太可能的步行区域，可以作为一种概率形式的地图匹配。惯性定位由RoNIN机器学习方法提供，并且通过根据粒子与GNSS估计值和不确定性的一致性来加权粒子，实现与GNSS的融合。该系统在旧金山市中心的六条具有挑战性的步行路线上进行了评估，使用了与人行道正确性和定位误差相关的三个指标。结果表明，融合方法（GNSS+RoNIN+PF）在大多数指标上显着优于仅GNSS定位，而仅惯性定位与粒子滤波相比，在关键指标（例如人行道分配和跨街道误差）方面也优于单独的GNSS。
tldr: This paper presents a pedestrian navigation system fusing GNSS, inertial data (using RoNIN), and map priors within a particle filter to improve localization accuracy, particularly for visually impaired users in urban canyons. Results indicate significant improvement over GNSS-only and inertial-only approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种行人导航系统，该系统融合了GNSS、惯性数据（使用RoNIN）和地图先验，并在粒子滤波器中进行处理，以提高定位精度，尤其是在城市峡谷中为视力受损的用户提供服务。结果表明，该系统相对于仅使用GNSS和仅使用惯性的方法有了显著改进。

title: Lantern: A Minimalist Robotic Object Platform
summary: Robotic objects are simple actuated systems that subtly blend into human environments. We design and introduce Lantern, a minimalist robotic object platform to enable building simple robotic artifacts. We conducted in-depth design and engineering iterations of Lantern's mechatronic architecture to meet specific design goals while maintaining a low build cost (~40 USD). As an extendable, open-source platform, Lantern aims to enable exploration of a range of HRI scenarios by leveraging human tendency to assign social meaning to simple forms. To evaluate Lantern's potential for HRI, we conducted a series of explorations: 1) a co-design workshop, 2) a sensory room case study, 3) distribution to external HRI labs, 4) integration into a graduate-level HRI course, and 5) public exhibitions with older adults and children. Our findings show that Lantern effectively evokes engagement, can support versatile applications ranging from emotion regulation to focused work, and serves as a viable platform for lowering barriers to HRI as a field.
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人物体是能够巧妙融入人类环境的简单驱动系统。我们设计并推出了Lantern，这是一个极简的机器人物体平台，旨在实现构建简单机器人制品的可能性。我们对Lantern的机电一体化架构进行了深入的设计和工程迭代，以满足特定的设计目标，同时保持较低的构建成本（约40美元）。作为一个可扩展的开源平台，Lantern旨在通过利用人类将社会意义赋予简单形式的倾向，从而实现对一系列人机交互（HRI）场景的探索。为了评估Lantern在人机交互方面的潜力，我们进行了一系列探索：1）协同设计工作坊，2）感官室案例研究，3）向外部人机交互实验室分发，4）集成到研究生级别的人机交互课程中，以及5）面向老年人和儿童的公开展览。我们的研究结果表明，Lantern能够有效地激发参与感，可以支持从情绪调节到专注工作等多种应用，并且作为一个可行的平台，能够降低人机交互作为一个领域的准入门槛。
tldr: The paper introduces Lantern, a low-cost, open-source robotic object platform designed to facilitate HRI research, demonstrating its effectiveness in evoking engagement and supporting diverse applications through various exploratory studies.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为Lantern的低成本开源机器人物体平台，旨在促进人机交互（HRI）研究。通过多种探索性研究表明，该平台能有效激发互动，并支持各种应用。

title: ReactEMG Stroke: Healthy-to-Stroke Few-shot Adaptation for sEMG-Based Intent Detection
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a promising control signal for assist-as-needed hand rehabilitation after stroke, but detecting intent from paretic muscles often requires lengthy, subject-specific calibration and remains brittle to variability. We propose a healthy-to-stroke adaptation pipeline that initializes an intent detector from a model pretrained on large-scale able-bodied sEMG, then fine-tunes it for each stroke participant using only a small amount of subject-specific data. Using a newly collected dataset from three individuals with chronic stroke, we compare adaptation strategies (head-only tuning, parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, and full end-to-end fine-tuning) and evaluate on held-out test sets that include realistic distribution shifts such as within-session drift, posture changes, and armband repositioning. Across conditions, healthy-pretrained adaptation consistently improves stroke intent detection relative to both zero-shot transfer and stroke-only training under the same data budget; the best adaptation methods improve average transition accuracy from 0.42 to 0.61 and raw accuracy from 0.69 to 0.78. These results suggest that transferring a reusable healthy-domain EMG representation can reduce calibration burden while improving robustness for real-time post-stroke intent detection.
summary_zh: 表面肌电图（sEMG）是一种颇具前景的辅助需求型卒中后手部康复控制信号，但从瘫痪肌肉中检测意图通常需要耗时的、针对特定个体的校准，并且对变异性仍然很敏感。我们提出了一种健康的到卒中的自适应流程，该流程首先利用在大规模健全人sEMG数据上预训练的模型初始化意图检测器，然后仅使用少量特定于卒中参与者的数据对其进行微调。利用从三名慢性卒中患者处收集的新数据集，我们比较了自适应策略（仅头部调整、参数高效的LoRA适配器和完整的端到端微调），并在包含真实分布偏移（如会话内漂移、姿势变化和臂带重新定位）的保留测试集上进行评估。在各种条件下，与在相同数据预算下的零样本迁移和仅卒中训练相比，健康预训练自适应始终能提高卒中意图检测的效果；最佳的自适应方法将平均转换准确率从0.42提高到0.61，将原始准确率从0.69提高到0.78。这些结果表明，转移可重用的健康领域EMG表示可以减轻校准负担，同时提高卒中后实时意图检测的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper presents a healthy-to-stroke adaptation pipeline for sEMG-based intent detection, using pretraining on healthy subjects and fine-tuning on stroke patient data, achieving improved accuracy and robustness with limited subject-specific calibration data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于表面肌电信号的健康-中风适应性意图检测流程，通过在健康受试者数据上进行预训练，并在中风患者数据上进行微调，从而在减少患者特定校准数据需求的同时，提高了准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Leveraging Convolutional Sparse Autoencoders for Robust Movement Classification from Low-Density sEMG
summary: Reliable control of myoelectric prostheses is often hindered by high inter-subject variability and the clinical impracticality of high-density sensor arrays. This study proposes a deep learning framework for accurate gesture recognition using only two surface electromyography (sEMG) channels. The method employs a Convolutional Sparse Autoencoder (CSAE) to extract temporal feature representations directly from raw signals, eliminating the need for heuristic feature engineering. On a 6-class gesture set, our model achieved a multi-subject F1-score of 94.3% $\pm$ 0.3%. To address subject-specific differences, we present a few-shot transfer learning protocol that improved performance on unseen subjects from a baseline of 35.1% $\pm$ 3.1% to 92.3% $\pm$ 0.9% with minimal calibration data. Furthermore, the system supports functional extensibility through an incremental learning strategy, allowing for expansion to a 10-class set with a 90.0% $\pm$ 0.2% F1-score without full model retraining. By combining high precision with minimal computational and sensor overhead, this framework provides a scalable and efficient approach for the next generation of affordable and adaptive prosthetic systems.
summary_zh: 肌电假肢的可靠控制常常受到个体间高度差异和高密度传感器阵列临床应用局限性的阻碍。本研究提出了一种深度学习框架，仅使用两个表面肌电（sEMG）通道即可实现精确的手势识别。该方法采用卷积稀疏自编码器（CSAE）直接从原始信号中提取时间特征表示，无需启发式特征工程。在一个包含 6 类手势的数据集上，我们的模型实现了 94.3% $\pm$ 0.3% 的多被试 F1 值。为了解决被试特定差异，我们提出了一种小样本迁移学习协议，该协议通过最少的校准数据，将未见被试的性能从 35.1% $\pm$ 3.1% 的基线提高到 92.3% $\pm$ 0.9%。此外，该系统通过增量学习策略支持功能扩展，无需完全重新训练模型即可扩展到包含 10 类的数据集，并达到 90.0% $\pm$ 0.2% 的 F1 值。通过将高精度与最小的计算和传感器开销相结合，该框架为下一代经济实惠且自适应的假肢系统提供了一种可扩展且高效的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces a deep learning framework using Convolutional Sparse Autoencoders (CSAE) for robust gesture recognition from low-density sEMG signals, achieving high accuracy and adaptability for prosthetic control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种深度学习框架，使用卷积稀疏自编码器（CSAE）从低密度sEMG信号中进行鲁棒的手势识别，为假肢控制实现了高精度和适应性。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Co-Design and Operation of Chiller and Thermal Energy Storage for Cost-Optimal HVAC Systems
summary: We study the joint operation and sizing of cooling infrastructure for commercial HVAC systems using reinforcement learning, with the objective of minimizing life-cycle cost over a 30-year horizon. The cooling system consists of a fixed-capacity electric chiller and a thermal energy storage (TES) unit, jointly operated to meet stochastic hourly cooling demands under time-varying electricity prices. The life-cycle cost accounts for both capital expenditure and discounted operating cost, including electricity consumption and maintenance. A key challenge arises from the strong asymmetry in capital costs: increasing chiller capacity by one unit is far more expensive than an equivalent increase in TES capacity. As a result, identifying the right combination of chiller and TES sizes, while ensuring zero loss-of-cooling-load under optimal operation, is a non-trivial co-design problem. To address this, we formulate the chiller operation problem for a fixed infrastructure configuration as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP), in which the control action is the chiller part-load ratio (PLR). The MDP is solved using a Deep Q Network (DQN) with a constrained action space. The learned DQN RL policy minimizes electricity cost over historical traces of cooling demand and electricity prices. For each candidate chiller-TES sizing configuration, the trained policy is evaluated. We then restrict attention to configurations that fully satisfy the cooling demand and perform a life-cycle cost minimization over this feasible set to identify the cost-optimal infrastructure design. Using this approach, we determine the optimal chiller and thermal energy storage capacities to be 700 and 1500, respectively.
summary_zh: 我们研究了商业暖通空调系统冷却基础设施的联合运行和容量确定，采用强化学习方法，目标是在30年时间内最小化全寿命周期成本。冷却系统由一台固定容量的电动冷水机组和一个蓄冷（TES）单元组成，二者联合运行以满足随时间变化的电价下的随机小时冷却需求。全寿命周期成本包括资本支出和折现运营成本，包括电力消耗和维护。一个关键挑战来自于资本成本的强烈不对称性：将冷水机组容量增加一个单位比等效地增加TES容量昂贵得多。因此，在确保最优运行下零冷却负荷损失的前提下，识别冷水机组和TES容量的正确组合是一个重要的协同设计问题。为了解决这个问题，我们将固定基础设施配置下的冷水机组运行问题建模为一个有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中控制动作是冷水机组的部分负荷率（PLR）。该MDP使用具有约束动作空间的深度Q网络（DQN）求解。学习到的DQN RL策略在冷却需求和电价的历史轨迹上最小化电力成本。对于每个候选的冷水机组-TES容量配置，评估经过训练的策略。然后，我们只关注完全满足冷却需求的配置，并在这个可行集上执行全寿命周期成本最小化，以识别成本最优的基础设施设计。使用这种方法，我们确定最佳的冷水机组和蓄冷容量分别为700和1500。
tldr: This paper uses reinforcement learning (DQN) to optimize the co-design and operation of chiller and thermal energy storage systems for commercial HVAC, minimizing life-cycle costs.
tldr_zh: 本文利用强化学习 (DQN) 优化商用 HVAC 系统的冷却器和热能存储系统的协同设计和运行，以最大限度地降低生命周期成本。

title: Keep Rehearsing and Refining: Lifelong Learning Vehicle Routing under Continually Drifting Tasks
summary: Existing neural solvers for vehicle routing problems (VRPs) are typically trained either in a one-off manner on a fixed set of pre-defined tasks or in a lifelong manner on several tasks arriving sequentially, assuming sufficient training on each task. Both settings overlook a common real-world property: problem patterns may drift continually over time, yielding massive tasks sequentially arising while offering only limited training resources per task. In this paper, we study a novel lifelong learning paradigm for neural VRP solvers under continually drifting tasks over learning time steps, where sufficient training for any given task at any time is not available. We propose Dual Replay with Experience Enhancement (DREE), a general framework to improve learning efficiency and mitigate catastrophic forgetting under such drift. Extensive experiments show that, under such continual drift, DREE effectively learns new tasks, preserves prior knowledge, improves generalization to unseen tasks, and can be applied to diverse existing neural solvers.
summary_zh: 针对车辆路径问题（VRP）的现有神经求解器通常采取一次性方式在预定义的固定任务集上进行训练，或者以终身学习的方式在多个按顺序到达的任务上进行训练，并假设每个任务都经过了充分的训练。这两种设置都忽略了一个常见的现实世界属性：问题模式可能随着时间推移而持续漂移，导致大量的任务按顺序出现，而每个任务仅提供有限的训练资源。在本文中，我们研究了一种新型的神经VRP求解器终身学习范式，该范式在学习时间步长内处理持续漂移的任务，其中任何给定任务在任何时间都无法获得充分的训练。我们提出了一种基于经验增强的双重回放（DREE）方法，这是一个通用的框架，用于提高学习效率并缓解在此类漂移下的灾难性遗忘。大量的实验表明，在这种持续漂移的情况下，DREE能够有效地学习新任务，保留先验知识，提高对未见任务的泛化能力，并且可以应用于各种现有的神经求解器。
tldr: This paper introduces a lifelong learning framework (DREE) for neural Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) solvers that addresses the challenge of continually drifting tasks with limited training resources, showing improvements in learning efficiency and mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于神经车辆路径问题（VRP）求解器的终身学习框架（DREE），该框架解决了训练资源有限的情况下不断漂移的任务带来的挑战，并在学习效率和减轻灾难性遗忘方面表现出改进。

title: RulePlanner: All-in-One Reinforcement Learner for Unifying Design Rules in 3D Floorplanning
summary: Floorplanning determines the coordinate and shape of each module in Integrated Circuits. With the scaling of technology nodes, in floorplanning stage especially 3D scenarios with multiple stacked layers, it has become increasingly challenging to adhere to complex hardware design rules. Current methods are only capable of handling specific and limited design rules, while violations of other rules require manual and meticulous adjustment. This leads to labor-intensive and time-consuming post-processing for expert engineers. In this paper, we propose an all-in-one deep reinforcement learning-based approach to tackle these challenges, and design novel representations for real-world IC design rules that have not been addressed by previous approaches. Specifically, the processing of various hardware design rules is unified into a single framework with three key components: 1) novel matrix representations to model the design rules, 2) constraints on the action space to filter out invalid actions that cause rule violations, and 3) quantitative analysis of constraint satisfaction as reward signals. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and validity of our approach. Furthermore, transferability is well demonstrated on unseen circuits. Our framework is extensible to accommodate new design rules, thus providing flexibility to address emerging challenges in future chip design. Code will be available at: https://github.com/Thinklab-SJTU/EDA-AI
summary_zh: 布局规划决定了每个模块在集成电路中的坐标和形状。随着技术节点的缩小，在布局规划阶段，尤其是在具有多个堆叠层的3D场景中，遵循复杂的硬件设计规则变得越来越具有挑战性。当前的方法只能处理特定且有限的设计规则，而其他规则的违反则需要人工和细致的调整。这导致专家工程师需要进行劳动密集型且耗时的后处理。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于深度强化学习的通用方法来解决这些挑战，并为先前方法未解决的真实集成电路设计规则设计了新颖的表示方法。具体来说，各种硬件设计规则的处理被统一到一个包含三个关键组件的框架中：1）用于建模设计规则的新型矩阵表示；2）对动作空间的约束，以过滤掉导致规则违反的无效动作；3）约束满足的定量分析作为奖励信号。在公共基准上的实验证明了我们方法的有效性和正确性。此外，在未见过的电路上的可迁移性也得到了很好的验证。我们的框架具有可扩展性，可以适应新的设计规则，从而为应对未来芯片设计中出现的新挑战提供了灵活性。代码将在以下网址提供：https://github.com/Thinklab-SJTU/EDA-AI
tldr: The paper introduces RulePlanner, a deep reinforcement learning approach that unifies the handling of various hardware design rules in 3D IC floorplanning, using novel matrix representations and constraint-aware actions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为RulePlanner的深度强化学习方法，它统一处理3D集成电路布局规划中的各种硬件设计规则，采用新颖的矩阵表示和感知约束的动作。

title: Learning Provably Correct Distributed Protocols Without Human Knowledge
summary: Provably correct distributed protocols, which are a critical component of modern distributed systems, are highly challenging to design and have often required decades of human effort. These protocols allow multiple agents to coordinate to come to a common agreement in an environment with uncertainty and failures. We formulate protocol design as a search problem over strategies in a game with imperfect information, and the desired correctness conditions are specified in Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT).
