However, standard methods for solving multi-agent games fail to learn correct protocols in this setting, even when the number of agents is small. We propose a learning framework, GGMS, which integrates a specialized variant of Monte Carlo Tree Search with a transformer-based action encoder, a global depth-first search to break out of local minima, and repeated feedback from a model checker. Protocols output by GGMS are verified correct via exhaustive model checking for all executions within the bounded setting. We further prove that, under mild assumptions, the search process is complete: if a correct protocol exists, GGMS will eventually find it. In experiments, we show that GGMS can learn correct protocols for larger settings than existing methods.
summary_zh: 经过验证的正确分布式协议是现代分布式系统的关键组成部分，但其设计极具挑战性，往往需要数十年的努力。这些协议允许多个代理在存在不确定性和故障的环境中协调，以达成共识。我们将协议设计形式化为具有不完全信息博弈中的策略搜索问题，并通过基于可满足性模理论 (SMT) 的方式指定所需的正确性条件。然而，即便代理数量很小，用于解决多代理博弈的标准方法也无法在这种情况下学习到正确的协议。我们提出了一个学习框架 GGMS，它集成了蒙特卡洛树搜索的专用变体、基于 Transformer 的动作编码器、用于摆脱局部最小值的全局深度优先搜索，以及来自模型检查器的重复反馈。GGMS 输出的协议通过在有界设置下的所有执行路径进行穷举模型检查来验证其正确性。我们进一步证明，在温和假设下，搜索过程是完备的：如果存在正确的协议，GGMS 最终会找到它。在实验中，我们表明 GGMS 能够为比现有方法更大的规模学习正确的协议。
tldr: The paper introduces GGMS, a learning framework that combines Monte Carlo Tree Search, transformer-based encoding, depth-first search, and model checking to automatically learn provably correct distributed protocols, exceeding the capabilities of existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GGMS的学习框架，它结合了蒙特卡洛树搜索、基于Transformer的编码、深度优先搜索和模型检查，以自动学习可证明正确的分布式协议，超越了现有方法的能力。

title: Learning to Recommend Multi-Agent Subgraphs from Calling Trees
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly solve complex tasks by orchestrating agents and tools selected from rapidly growing marketplaces. As these marketplaces expand, many candidates become functionally overlapping, making selection not just a retrieval problem: beyond filtering relevant agents, an orchestrator must choose options that are reliable, compatible with the current execution context, and able to cooperate with other selected agents. Existing recommender systems -- largely built for item-level ranking from flat user-item logs -- do not directly address the structured, sequential, and interaction-dependent nature of agent orchestration. We address this gap by \textbf{formulating agent recommendation in MAS as a constrained decision problem} and introducing a generic \textbf{constrained recommendation framework} that first uses retrieval to build a compact candidate set conditioned on the current subtask and context, and then performs \textbf{utility optimization} within this feasible set using a learned scorer that accounts for relevance, reliability, and interaction effects. We ground both the formulation and learning signals in \textbf{historical calling trees}, which capture the execution structure of MAS (parent-child calls, branching dependencies, and local cooperation patterns) beyond what flat logs provide. The framework supports two complementary settings: \textbf{agent-level recommendation} (select the next agent/tool) and \textbf{system-level recommendation} (select a small, connected agent team/subgraph for coordinated execution). To enable systematic evaluation, we construct a unified calling-tree benchmark by normalizing invocation logs from eight heterogeneous multi-agent corpora into a shared structured representation.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）越来越多地通过编排从快速增长的市场中选择的智能体和工具来解决复杂任务。随着这些市场扩展，许多候选者在功能上变得重叠，使得选择不仅仅是一个检索问题：除了过滤相关智能体之外，编排器还必须选择可靠的、与当前执行上下文兼容的、并且能够与其他选定智能体合作的选项。现有的推荐系统——主要为基于扁平用户-物品日志的物品级别排序而构建——不能直接解决智能体编排的结构化、序列化和交互依赖性。我们通过\textbf{将MAS中的智能体推荐表述为一个约束决策问题}并引入一个通用的\textbf{约束推荐框架}来解决这一差距，该框架首先使用检索来构建一个基于当前子任务和上下文的紧凑候选集，然后在此可行集中使用一个学习到的评分器执行\textbf{效用优化}，该评分器考虑了相关性、可靠性和交互作用。我们将表述和学习信号都基于\textbf{历史调用树}，这些调用树捕获了MAS的执行结构（父子调用、分支依赖性和局部合作模式），超越了扁平日志所能提供的内容。该框架支持两个互补的设置：\textbf{智能体级别推荐}(选择下一个智能体/工具)和\textbf{系统级别推荐}(选择一个小的、连接的智能体团队/子图以进行协调执行)。为了实现系统评估，我们通过将来自八个异构多智能体语料库的调用日志标准化为共享的结构化表示，从而构建了一个统一的调用树基准。
tldr: The paper introduces a constrained recommendation framework for selecting agents/tools in multi-agent systems, leveraging historical calling trees to optimize for relevance, reliability, and interaction effects at both agent and system levels.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个受约束的推荐框架，用于在多智能体系统中选择智能体/工具，利用历史调用树来优化相关性、可靠性和交互效应，从而支持智能体级别和系统级别的推荐。

title: Development of Domain-Invariant Visual Enhancement and Restoration (DIVER) Approach for Underwater Images
summary: Underwater images suffer severe degradation due to wavelength-dependent attenuation, scattering, and illumination non-uniformity that vary across water types and depths. We propose an unsupervised Domain-Invariant Visual Enhancement and Restoration (DIVER) framework that integrates empirical correction with physics-guided modeling for robust underwater image enhancement. DIVER first applies either IlluminateNet for adaptive luminance enhancement or a Spectral Equalization Filter for spectral normalization. An Adaptive Optical Correction Module then refines hue and contrast using channel-adaptive filtering, while Hydro-OpticNet employs physics-constrained learning to compensate for backscatter and wavelength-dependent attenuation. The parameters of IlluminateNet and Hydro-OpticNet are optimized via unsupervised learning using a composite loss function. DIVER is evaluated on eight diverse datasets covering shallow, deep, and highly turbid environments, including both naturally low-light and artificially illuminated scenes, using reference and non-reference metrics. While state-of-the-art methods such as WaterNet, UDNet, and Phaseformer perform reasonably in shallow water, their performance degrades in deep, unevenly illuminated, or artificially lit conditions. In contrast, DIVER consistently achieves best or near-best performance across all datasets, demonstrating strong domain-invariant capability. DIVER yields at least a 9% improvement over SOTA methods in UCIQE. On the low-light SeaThru dataset, where color-palette references enable direct evaluation of color restoration, DIVER achieves at least a 4.9% reduction in GPMAE compared to existing methods. Beyond visual quality, DIVER also improves robotic perception by enhancing ORB-based keypoint repeatability and matching performance, confirming its robustness across diverse underwater environments.
summary_zh: 水下图像由于波长相关的衰减、散射以及随水域类型和深度而变化的光照不均匀性而遭受严重的降质影响。我们提出了一种无监督的域不变视觉增强与恢复（DIVER）框架，该框架集成了经验校正与物理引导建模，以实现鲁棒的水下图像增强。DIVER首先应用IlluminateNet进行自适应亮度增强或应用光谱均衡滤波器进行光谱归一化。然后，自适应光学校正模块使用通道自适应滤波来精细化色调和对比度，而Hydro-OpticNet采用物理约束学习来补偿后向散射和波长相关的衰减。IlluminateNet和Hydro-OpticNet的参数通过使用复合损失函数的无监督学习进行优化。DIVER在涵盖浅水、深水和高度浑浊环境的八个多样化数据集上进行了评估，这些数据集包括自然光照不足和人工照明场景，并使用了参考和非参考指标。虽然WaterNet、UDNet和Phaseformer等最先进的方法在浅水中表现良好，但它们在深度、光照不均或人工照明条件下的性能会下降。与之相反，DIVER在所有数据集上始终如一地实现最佳或接近最佳的性能，展示了强大的域不变能力。DIVER在UCIQE上至少比SOTA方法提高了9%。在低光照SeaThru数据集上，颜色调色板参考允许对颜色恢复进行直接评估，DIVER比现有方法在GPMAE上至少降低了4.9%。除了视觉质量外，DIVER还通过增强基于ORB的关键点可重复性和匹配性能来改善机器人感知，证实了其在各种水下环境中的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces DIVER, an unsupervised domain-invariant underwater image enhancement and restoration framework leveraging empirical correction and physics-guided modeling, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse underwater datasets and improving robotic perception.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DIVER的无监督域不变水下图像增强和恢复框架，该框架利用经验校正和物理引导建模，在各种水下数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并提高了机器人感知能力。

title: Under-Canopy Terrain Reconstruction in Dense Forests Using RGB Imaging and Neural 3D Reconstruction
summary:
Mapping the terrain and understory hidden beneath dense forest canopies is of great interest for numerous applications such as search and rescue, trail mapping, forest inventory tasks, and more. Existing solutions rely on specialized sensors: either heavy, costly airborne LiDAR, or Airborne Optical Sectioning (AOS), which uses thermal synthetic aperture photography and is tailored for person detection.
  We introduce a novel approach for the reconstruction of canopy-free, photorealistic ground views using only conventional RGB images. Our solution is based on the celebrated Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), a recent 3D reconstruction method. Additionally, we include specific image capture considerations, which dictate the needed illumination to successfully expose the scene beneath the canopy. To better cope with the poorly lit understory, we employ a low light loss. Finally, we propose two complementary approaches to remove occluding canopy elements by controlling per-ray integration procedure.
  To validate the value of our approach, we present two possible downstream tasks. For the task of search and rescue (SAR), we demonstrate that our method enables person detection which achieves promising results compared to thermal AOS (using only RGB images). Additionally, we show the potential of our approach for forest inventory tasks like tree counting. These results position our approach as a cost-effective, high-resolution alternative to specialized sensors for SAR, trail mapping, and forest-inventory tasks.
summary_zh:
绘制隐藏在茂密森林冠层下的地形和林下植被对于包括搜索和救援、路径绘制、森林资源清查等在内的众多应用具有重要意义。现有的解决方案依赖于专门的传感器：要么是沉重且昂贵的机载激光雷达，要么是机载光学切片(AOS)，后者使用热合成孔径摄影，专为人员检测而设计。

我们介绍了一种新颖的方法，仅使用传统的RGB图像即可重建无冠层的逼真地面视图。我们的解决方案基于著名的神经辐射场(NeRF)，这是一种新兴的3D重建方法。此外，我们加入了特定的图像采集考量，即确定成功曝光冠层下方场景所需的照明。为了更好地应对光线不足的林下空间，我们采用了低光损耗。最后，我们提出了两种互补的方法，通过控制每条光线的积分过程来移除遮挡的冠层元素。

为了验证我们方法的价值，我们展示了两个可能的下游任务。对于搜索和救援(SAR)任务，我们证明了我们的方法能够进行人员检测，与热成像AOS相比（仅使用RGB图像）取得了可喜的成果。此外，我们展示了我们的方法在森林资源清查任务（如树木计数）中的潜力。这些结果将我们的方法定位为一种经济高效、高分辨率的替代方案，取代用于SAR、路径绘制和森林资源清查任务的专用传感器。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel RGB-based approach using NeRFs to reconstruct terrain under dense forest canopies, validated through person detection for SAR and forest inventory tasks, offering a cost-effective alternative to LiDAR or AOS.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于RGB图像和NeRF的森林冠层下地形重建方法，通过人员检测（用于搜救）和森林盘点任务验证了其有效性，为LiDAR或AOS提供了一种经济高效的替代方案。

title: Neural Clothing Tryer: Customized Virtual Try-On via Semantic Enhancement and Controlling Diffusion Model
summary: This work aims to address a novel Customized Virtual Try-ON (Cu-VTON) task, enabling the superimposition of a specified garment onto a model that can be customized in terms of appearance, posture, and additional attributes. Compared with traditional VTON task, it enables users to tailor digital avatars to their individual preferences, thereby enhancing the virtual fitting experience with greater flexibility and engagement. To address this task, we introduce a Neural Clothing Tryer (NCT) framework, which exploits the advanced diffusion models equipped with semantic enhancement and controlling modules to better preserve semantic characterization and textural details of the garment and meanwhile facilitating the flexible editing of the model's postures and appearances. Specifically, NCT introduces a semantic-enhanced module to take semantic descriptions of garments and utilizes a visual-language encoder to learn aligned features across modalities. The aligned features are served as condition input to the diffusion model to enhance the preservation of the garment's semantics. Then, a semantic controlling module is designed to take the garment image, tailored posture image, and semantic description as input to maintain garment details while simultaneously editing model postures, expressions, and various attributes. Extensive experiments on the open available benchmark demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed NCT framework.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在解决一种新型的定制化虚拟试穿（Cu-VTON）任务，该任务能够将指定的服装叠加到外观、姿势和附加属性均可定制的模型上。与传统的VTON任务相比，它允许用户根据个人偏好定制数字虚拟形象，从而通过更大的灵活性和参与度来增强虚拟试穿体验。为了解决这一任务，我们引入了一个神经服装试穿器（NCT）框架，该框架利用配备了语义增强和控制模块的先进扩散模型，从而更好地保留服装的语义特征和纹理细节，同时促进模型姿势和外观的灵活编辑。具体而言，NCT引入了一个语义增强模块来获取服装的语义描述，并利用视觉-语言编码器来学习跨模态的对齐特征。这些对齐特征作为扩散模型的条件输入，以增强服装语义的保留。然后，设计了一个语义控制模块，它将服装图像、定制的姿势图像和语义描述作为输入，在保持服装细节的同时，编辑模型的姿势、表情和各种属性。在公开基准数据集上进行的大量实验证明了所提出的NCT框架的优越性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Neural Clothing Tryer (NCT), a framework utilizing diffusion models with semantic enhancement and controlling modules for customized virtual try-on, allowing users to tailor avatars and garments with greater flexibility.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为神经服装试穿器（NCT）的框架，该框架利用具有语义增强和控制模块的扩散模型来实现定制化的虚拟试穿，使用户能够更灵活地定制头像和服装。

title: Active Learning-Driven Lightweight YOLOv9: Enhancing Efficiency in Smart Agriculture
summary: This study addresses the demand for real-time detection of tomatoes and tomato flowers by agricultural robots deployed on edge devices in greenhouse environments. Under practical imaging conditions, object detection systems often face challenges such as large scale variations caused by varying camera distances, severe occlusion from plant structures, and highly imbalanced class distributions. These factors make conventional object detection approaches that rely on fully annotated datasets difficult to simultaneously achieve high detection accuracy and deployment efficiency. To overcome these limitations, this research proposes an active learning driven lightweight object detection framework, integrating data analysis, model design, and training strategy. First, the size distribution of objects in raw agricultural images is analyzed to redefine an operational target range, thereby improving learning stability under real-world conditions. Second, an efficient feature extraction module is incorporated to reduce computational cost, while a lightweight attention mechanism is introduced to enhance feature representation under multi-scale and occluded scenarios. Finally, an active learning strategy is employed to iteratively select high-information samples for annotation and training under a limited labeling budget, effectively improving the recognition performance of minority and small-object categories. Experimental results demonstrate that, while maintaining a low parameter count and inference cost suitable for edge-device deployment, the proposed method effectively improves the detection performance of tomatoes and tomato flowers in raw images. Under limited annotation conditions, the framework achieves an overall detection accuracy of 67.8% mAP, validating its practicality and feasibility for intelligent agricultural applications.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在解决温室环境下农业机器人对边缘设备上部署的番茄和番茄花卉进行实时检测的需求。在实际成像条件下，目标检测系统常面临诸如因相机距离变化引起的大尺度变化、植物结构导致的严重遮挡以及高度不平衡的类别分布等挑战。这些因素使得依赖完全标注数据集的传统目标检测方法难以同时实现高检测精度和部署效率。为克服这些局限，本研究提出一种主动学习驱动的轻量级目标检测框架，整合了数据分析、模型设计和训练策略。首先，分析原始农业图像中目标的大小分布，重新定义操作目标范围，从而提高真实世界条件下的学习稳定性。其次，引入高效的特征提取模块以降低计算成本，同时引入轻量级注意力机制以增强多尺度和遮挡场景下的特征表示。最后，采用主动学习策略，在有限的标注预算下迭代地选择高信息量的样本进行标注和训练，有效地提高了少数类别和小目标类别的识别性能。实验结果表明，该方法在保持适合边缘设备部署的低参数量和推理成本的同时，有效提高了原始图像中番茄和番茄花卉的检测性能。在有限标注条件下，该框架实现了67.8%的平均精度均值 (mAP) 的整体检测精度，验证了其在智能农业应用中的实用性和可行性。
tldr: This paper presents an active learning-driven lightweight YOLOv9 framework for real-time detection of tomatoes and tomato flowers in challenging greenhouse environments, achieving 67.8% mAP under limited annotation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于主动学习的轻量级YOLOv9框架，用于在具有挑战性的温室环境中实时检测番茄和番茄花，在有限的标注条件下实现了67.8%的mAP。

title: GaussianOcc3D: A Gaussian-Based Adaptive Multi-modal 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is a pivotal task in autonomous driving, providing a dense and fine-grained understanding of the surrounding environment, yet single-modality methods face trade-offs between camera semantics and LiDAR geometry. Existing multi-modal frameworks often struggle with modality heterogeneity, spatial misalignment, and the representation crisis--where voxels are computationally heavy and BEV alternatives are lossy. We present GaussianOcc3D, a multi-modal framework bridging camera and LiDAR through a memory-efficient, continuous 3D Gaussian representation. We introduce four modules: (1) LiDAR Depth Feature Aggregation (LDFA), using depth-wise deformable sampling to lift sparse signals onto Gaussian primitives; (2) Entropy-Based Feature Smoothing (EBFS) to mitigate domain noise; (3) Adaptive Camera-LiDAR Fusion (ACLF) with uncertainty-aware reweighting for sensor reliability; and (4) a Gauss-Mamba Head leveraging Selective State Space Models for global context with linear complexity. Evaluations on Occ3D, SurroundOcc, and SemanticKITTI benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving mIoU scores of 49.4%, 28.9%, and 25.2% respectively. GaussianOcc3D exhibits superior robustness across challenging rainy and nighttime conditions.
summary_zh: 三维语义占据预测是自动驾驶中一项关键任务，它提供了对周围环境的密集和精细理解，但单模态方法面临着相机语义和激光雷达几何结构之间的权衡。现有的多模态框架通常难以应对模态异质性、空间错位以及表示危机——体素计算量大，而BEV替代方案则是有损的。我们提出了GaussianOcc3D，一个通过内存高效的连续三维高斯表示来桥接相机和激光雷达的多模态框架。我们引入了四个模块：（1）激光雷达深度特征聚合（LDFA），使用深度方向可变形采样将稀疏信号提升到高斯基元上；（2）基于熵的特征平滑（EBFS），以减轻领域噪声；（3）自适应相机-激光雷达融合（ACLF），采用不确定性感知重加权来实现传感器可靠性；以及（4）一个高斯-Mamba头部，利用选择性状态空间模型以线性复杂度获取全局上下文。在Occ3D、SurroundOcc和SemanticKITTI基准测试上的评估表明，该方法具有最先进的性能，分别实现了49.4%、28.9%和25.2%的mIoU分数。GaussianOcc3D在具有挑战性的雨天和夜间条件下表现出卓越的鲁棒性。
tldr: GaussianOcc3D is a novel multi-modal 3D occupancy prediction framework utilizing Gaussian primitives and a Mamba-based head to achieve SOTA performance on various benchmarks, improving robustness in challenging conditions.
tldr_zh: GaussianOcc3D是一个新颖的多模态3D occupancy预测框架，它利用高斯基元和基于Mamba的网络头，在各种基准测试上实现了SOTA性能，并提高了在具有挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。

title: UniGeo: A Unified 3D Indoor Object Detection Framework Integrating Geometry-Aware Learning and Dynamic Channel Gating
summary: The growing adoption of robotics and augmented reality in real-world applications has driven considerable research interest in 3D object detection based on point clouds. While previous methods address unified training across multiple datasets, they fail to model geometric relationships in sparse point cloud scenes and ignore the feature distribution in significant areas, which ultimately restricts their performance. To deal with this issue, a unified 3D indoor detection framework, called UniGeo, is proposed. To model geometric relations in scenes, we first propose a geometry-aware learning module that establishes a learnable mapping from spatial relationships to feature weights, which enabes explicit geometric feature enhancement. Then, to further enhance point cloud feature representation, we propose a dynamic channel gating mechanism that leverages learnable channel-wise weighting. This mechanism adaptively optimizes features generated by the sparse 3D U-Net network, significantly enhancing key geometric information. Extensive experiments on six different indoor scene datasets clearly validate the superior performance of our method.
summary_zh:
以下是一个可能的翻译：

机器人和增强现实在现实世界应用中日益普及，推动了对基于点云的3D目标检测的极大研究兴趣。尽管先前的方法致力于跨多个数据集的统一训练，但它们未能对稀疏点云场景中的几何关系进行建模，并且忽略了重要区域中的特征分布，这最终限制了它们的性能。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种统一的3D室内检测框架，称为UniGeo。为了建模场景中的几何关系，我们首先提出了一个几何感知学习模块，该模块建立了从空间关系到特征权重的可学习映射，从而实现了显式的几何特征增强。然后，为了进一步增强点云特征表示，我们提出了一种动态通道门控机制，该机制利用可学习的通道级权重。这种机制自适应地优化了稀疏3D U-Net网络生成的特征，显著增强了关键的几何信息。在六个不同的室内场景数据集上进行的大量实验清楚地验证了我们方法的优越性能。
tldr: The paper introduces UniGeo, a unified 3D indoor object detection framework using geometry-aware learning and dynamic channel gating to improve performance on sparse point cloud data across multiple datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了UniGeo，一个统一的3D室内物体检测框架，它使用几何感知学习和动态通道门控来提高在多个数据集上稀疏点云数据的性能。

title: TTSA3R: Training-Free Temporal-Spatial Adaptive Persistent State for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming recurrent models enable efficient 3D reconstruction by maintaining persistent state representations. However, they suffer from catastrophic memory forgetting over long sequences due to balancing historical information with new observations. Recent methods alleviate this by deriving adaptive signals from attention perspective, but they operate on single dimensions without considering temporal and spatial consistency. To this end, we propose a training-free framework termed TTSA3R that leverages both temporal state evolution and spatial observation quality for adaptive state updates in 3D reconstruction. In particular, we devise a Temporal Adaptive Update Module that regulates update magnitude by analyzing temporal state evolution patterns. Then, a Spatial Contextual Update Module is introduced to localize spatial regions that require updates through observation-state alignment and scene dynamics. These complementary signals are finally fused to determine the state updating strategies. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TTSA3R in diverse 3D tasks. Moreover, our method exhibits only 15% error increase compared to over 200% degradation in baseline models on extended sequences, significantly improving long-term reconstruction stability. Our codes will be available soon.
summary_zh: 流式循环模型通过维护持久的状态表示来实现高效的3D重建。然而，由于需要在历史信息和新观测之间进行平衡，它们在长序列中会遭受灾难性的记忆遗忘。最近的方法通过从注意力角度导出自适应信号来缓解这个问题，但它们在单个维度上操作，而没有考虑时间和空间一致性。为此，我们提出了一种名为TTSA3R的免训练框架，该框架利用时间状态演化和空间观测质量来进行3D重建中的自适应状态更新。具体而言，我们设计了一个时间自适应更新模块，通过分析时间状态演化模式来调节更新幅度。然后，引入一个空间上下文更新模块，通过观测-状态对齐和场景动态来定位需要更新的空间区域。这些互补的信号最终被融合起来，以决定状态更新策略。大量实验证明了TTSA3R在各种3D任务中的有效性。此外，我们的方法在扩展序列上仅表现出15%的误差增长，而基线模型的降级超过200%，显著提高了长期重建的稳定性。我们的代码即将开源。
tldr: The paper proposes a training-free framework (TTSA3R) for streaming 3D reconstruction that adaptively updates the persistent state by considering both temporal state evolution and spatial observation quality, significantly improving long-term reconstruction stability. It outperforms baseline models on extended sequences.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于流式3D重建的免训练框架（TTSA3R），它通过考虑时间状态演化和空间观测质量自适应地更新持久状态，从而显著提高长期重建的稳定性。在扩展序列上，该方法优于基线模型。

title: Hybrid Cross-Device Localization via Neural Metric Learning and Feature Fusion
summary: We present a hybrid cross-device localization pipeline developed for the CroCoDL 2025 Challenge. Our approach integrates a shared retrieval encoder and two complementary localization branches: a classical geometric branch using feature fusion and PnP, and a neural feed-forward branch (MapAnything) for metric localization conditioned on geometric inputs. A neural-guided candidate pruning strategy further filters unreliable map frames based on translation consistency, while depth-conditioned localization refines metric scale and translation precision on Spot scenes. These components jointly lead to significant improvements in recall and accuracy across both HYDRO and SUCCU benchmarks. Our method achieved a final score of 92.62 (R@0.5m, 5°) during the challenge.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种为 CroCoDL 2025 挑战赛开发的混合跨设备定位流程。 我们的方法整合了一个共享检索编码器和两个互补的定位分支：一个使用特征融合和 PnP 的经典几何分支，以及一个用于度量定位的神经前馈分支（MapAnything），其以几何输入为条件。 基于平移一致性的神经引导候选剪枝策略进一步过滤掉不可靠的地图帧，而深度条件定位则优化了 Spot 场景上的度量尺度和平移精度。 这些组件共同显著提高了 HYDRO 和 SUCCU 基准测试上的召回率和准确率。 在挑战赛期间，我们的方法获得了 92.62 (R@0.5m, 5°) 的最终得分。
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid cross-device localization pipeline using neural metric learning and feature fusion, achieving strong performance in the CroCoDL 2025 Challenge.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合跨设备定位管道，使用神经度量学习和特征融合，在 CroCoDL 2025 挑战赛中取得了优异的成绩。

title: EndoCaver: Handling Fog, Blur and Glare in Endoscopic Images via Joint Deblurring-Segmentation
summary: Endoscopic image analysis is vital for colorectal cancer screening, yet real-world conditions often suffer from lens fogging, motion blur, and specular highlights, which severely compromise automated polyp detection. We propose EndoCaver, a lightweight transformer with a unidirectional-guided dual-decoder architecture, enabling joint multi-task capability for image deblurring and segmentation while significantly reducing computational complexity and model parameters. Specifically, it integrates a Global Attention Module (GAM) for cross-scale aggregation, a Deblurring-Segmentation Aligner (DSA) to transfer restoration cues, and a cosine-based scheduler (LoCoS) for stable multi-task optimisation. Experiments on the Kvasir-SEG dataset show that EndoCaver achieves 0.922 Dice on clean data and 0.889 under severe image degradation, surpassing state-of-the-art methods while reducing model parameters by 90%. These results demonstrate its efficiency and robustness, making it well-suited for on-device clinical deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/ReaganWu/EndoCaver.
summary_zh: 内窥镜图像分析对于结直肠癌筛查至关重要，但真实环境下的图像常受镜头起雾、运动模糊和镜面反射等问题影响，严重损害了息肉自动检测的性能。我们提出了一种轻量级的Transformer模型EndoCaver，它采用单向引导的双解码器架构，能够实现图像去模糊和分割的联合多任务能力，同时显著降低计算复杂度和模型参数量。具体而言，它集成了用于跨尺度聚合的全局注意力模块（GAM）、用于传递复原线索的去模糊-分割对齐器（DSA）以及用于稳定多任务优化的基于余弦的调度器（LoCoS）。在Kvasir-SEG数据集上的实验表明，EndoCaver在清晰数据上获得了0.922的Dice系数，在严重图像退化情况下获得了0.889的Dice系数，超越了现有最先进的方法，同时模型参数量减少了90%。这些结果表明了其效率和鲁棒性，使其非常适合在设备上进行临床部署。代码可在https://github.com/ReaganWu/EndoCaver上获取。
tldr: EndoCaver is a lightweight transformer-based model for joint deblurring and segmentation of endoscopic images, achieving state-of-the-art performance on degraded images with significantly fewer parameters, making it suitable for on-device clinical applications.
tldr_zh: EndoCaver是一个轻量级的基于Transformer的模型，用于内窥镜图像的联合去模糊和分割。它在低质量图像上实现了最先进的性能，且模型参数显著减少，使其适用于设备端的临床应用。

title: SplineFlow: Flow Matching for Dynamical Systems with B-Spline Interpolants
summary: Flow matching is a scalable generative framework for characterizing continuous normalizing flows with wide-range applications. However, current state-of-the-art methods are not well-suited for modeling dynamical systems, as they construct conditional paths using linear interpolants that may not capture the underlying state evolution, especially when learning higher-order dynamics from irregular sampled observations. Constructing unified paths that satisfy multi-marginal constraints across observations is challenging, since naïve higher-order polynomials tend to be unstable and oscillatory. We introduce SplineFlow, a theoretically grounded flow matching algorithm that jointly models conditional paths across observations via B-spline interpolation. Specifically, SplineFlow exploits the smoothness and stability of B-spline bases to learn the complex underlying dynamics in a structured manner while ensuring the multi-marginal requirements are met. Comprehensive experiments across various deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems of varying complexity, as well as on cellular trajectory inference tasks, demonstrate the strong improvement of SplineFlow over existing baselines. Our code is available at: https://github.com/santanurathod/SplineFlow.
summary_zh: 流匹配是一种可扩展的生成框架，用于表征具有广泛应用的连续归一化流。然而，目前最先进的方法不太适合建模动力系统，因为它们使用线性插值构造条件路径，而线性插值可能无法捕捉到潜在的状态演化，尤其是在从不规则采样的观测数据中学习高阶动力学时。构造满足跨观测数据的多边缘约束的统一路径具有挑战性，因为朴素的高阶多项式往往不稳定并具有振荡性。我们引入了 SplineFlow，这是一种理论上可靠的流匹配算法，它通过 B 样条插值联合建模跨观测数据的条件路径。具体而言，SplineFlow 利用 B 样条基的平滑性和稳定性，以结构化的方式学习复杂的潜在动力学，同时确保满足多边缘要求。在各种不同复杂度的确定性和随机动力系统以及细胞轨迹推断任务中的综合实验表明，SplineFlow 相对于现有基线有显著改进。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/santanurathod/SplineFlow。
tldr: SplineFlow introduces a novel flow matching algorithm using B-spline interpolation for modeling complex dynamical systems, outperforming existing methods in capturing higher-order dynamics and handling irregular sampling.
tldr_zh: SplineFlow 提出了一种新的流匹配算法，该算法使用 B 样条插值来建模复杂的动力系统，优于现有方法，能够捕获高阶动力学并处理不规则采样。

title: FIRE: Multi-fidelity Regression with Distribution-conditioned In-context Learning using Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Multi-fidelity (MF) regression often operates in regimes of extreme data imbalance, where the commonly-used Gaussian-process (GP) surrogates struggle with cubic scaling costs and overfit to sparse high-fidelity observations, limiting efficiency and generalization in real-world applications. We introduce FIRE, a training-free MF framework that couples tabular foundation models (TFMs) to perform zero-shot in-context Bayesian inference via a high-fidelity correction model conditioned on the low-fidelity model's posterior predictive distributions. This cross-fidelity information transfer via distributional summaries captures heteroscedastic errors, enabling robust residual learning without model retraining. Across 31 benchmark problems spanning synthetic and real-world tasks (e.g., DrivAerNet, LCBench), FIRE delivers a stronger performance-time trade-off than seven state-of-the-art GP-based or deep learning MF regression methods, ranking highest in accuracy and uncertainty quantification with runtime advantages. Limitations include context window constraints and dependence on the quality of the pre-trained TFM's.
summary_zh: 多精度（MF）回归通常在极端数据不平衡的情况运行，此时常用的高斯过程（GP）代理模型面临着立方缩放的计算成本，并过度拟合稀疏的高精度观测数据，从而限制了在实际应用中的效率和泛化能力。我们引入了FIRE，一种无训练的MF框架，它将表格化基础模型（TFMs）耦合在一起，通过一个基于低精度模型后验预测分布条件下的高精度校正模型，执行零样本的上下文贝叶斯推断。这种通过分布概括进行的跨精度信息传递捕捉了异方差误差，从而实现稳健的残差学习，而无需模型重训练。在涵盖合成和真实世界任务的31个基准问题（例如，DrivAerNet、LCBench）中，FIRE提供了比七种最先进的基于GP或深度学习的MF回归方法更强的性能-时间权衡，在准确性和不确定性量化方面排名最高，并具有运行时间的优势。其局限性包括上下文窗口约束以及对预训练TFM质量的依赖。
tldr: The paper introduces FIRE, a training-free multi-fidelity regression framework leveraging tabular foundation models for zero-shot in-context Bayesian inference, demonstrating superior performance and runtime compared to existing methods across various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为FIRE的免训练多精度回归框架，利用表格基础模型进行零样本上下文贝叶斯推理，并在多个基准测试中展示了优于现有方法的性能和运行时间。

title: Quantum-Inspired Reinforcement Learning for Secure and Sustainable AIoT-Driven Supply Chain Systems
summary: Modern supply chains must balance high-speed logistics with environmental impact and security constraints, prompting a surge of interest in AI-enabled Internet of Things (AIoT) solutions for global commerce. However, conventional supply chain optimization models often overlook crucial sustainability goals and cyber vulnerabilities, leaving systems susceptible to both ecological harm and malicious attacks. To tackle these challenges simultaneously, this work integrates a quantum-inspired reinforcement learning framework that unifies carbon footprint reduction, inventory management, and cryptographic-like security measures. We design a quantum-inspired reinforcement learning framework that couples a controllable spin-chain analogy with real-time AIoT signals and optimizes a multi-objective reward unifying fidelity, security, and carbon costs. The approach learns robust policies with stabilized training via value-based and ensemble updates, supported by window-normalized reward components to ensure commensurate scaling. In simulation, the method exhibits smooth convergence, strong late-episode performance, and graceful degradation under representative noise channels, outperforming standard learned and model-based references, highlighting its robust handling of real-time sustainability and risk demands. These findings reinforce the potential for quantum-inspired AIoT frameworks to drive secure, eco-conscious supply chain operations at scale, laying the groundwork for globally connected infrastructures that responsibly meet both consumer and environmental needs.
summary_zh: 现代供应链必须在高速度物流、环境影响和安全约束之间取得平衡，这促使人们对用于全球商务的 AI赋能物联网 (AIoT) 解决方案的兴趣激增。然而，传统的供应链优化模型往往忽视了关键的可持续发展目标和网络漏洞，导致系统容易受到生态破坏和恶意攻击。为了同时应对这些挑战，本研究集成了一个量子启发强化学习框架，该框架统一了碳足迹降低、库存管理和类密码学安全措施。我们设计了一个量子启发强化学习框架，该框架将可控自旋链类比与实时 AIoT 信号相结合，并优化了一个多目标奖励函数，该函数统一了保真度、安全性和碳成本。该方法通过基于价值和集成更新的稳定训练来学习稳健的策略，并由窗口归一化的奖励分量支持，以确保适当的缩放。在仿真中，该方法表现出平滑的收敛性、强大的后期性能以及在代表性噪声通道下的优雅降级，优于标准的学习型和基于模型的参考方法，突出了其对实时可持续性和风险需求的稳健处理能力。这些发现强化了量子启发 AIoT 框架在推动大规模安全、具有生态意识的供应链运营方面的潜力，为负责任地满足消费者和环境需求的全球互联基础设施奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a quantum-inspired reinforcement learning framework for optimizing supply chains by balancing carbon footprint reduction, inventory management, and security, demonstrating improved performance compared to standard methods in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种量子启发的强化学习框架，通过平衡碳足迹减少、库存管理和安全性来优化供应链，并在模拟中展示了优于标准方法的性能。

title: FlowSymm: Physics Aware, Symmetry Preserving Graph Attention for Network Flow Completion
summary: Recovering missing flows on the edges of a network, while exactly respecting local conservation laws, is a fundamental inverse problem that arises in many systems such as transportation, energy, and mobility. We introduce FlowSymm, a novel architecture that combines (i) a group-action on divergence-free flows, (ii) a graph-attention encoder to learn feature-conditioned weights over these symmetry-preserving actions, and (iii) a lightweight Tikhonov refinement solved via implicit bilevel optimization. The method first anchors the given observation on a minimum-norm divergence-free completion. We then compute an orthonormal basis for all admissible group actions that leave the observed flows invariant and parameterize the valid solution subspace, which shows an Abelian group structure under vector addition. A stack of GATv2 layers then encodes the graph and its edge features into per-edge embeddings, which are pooled over the missing edges and produce per-basis attention weights. This attention-guided process selects a set of physics-aware group actions that preserve the observed flows. Finally, a scalar Tikhonov penalty refines the missing entries via a convex least-squares solver, with gradients propagated implicitly through Cholesky factorization. Across three real-world flow benchmarks (traffic, power, bike), FlowSymm outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in RMSE, MAE and correlation metrics.
summary_zh: 在精确遵循局部守恒定律的前提下，恢复网络边缘上缺失的流量是一个基础的逆问题，出现在诸多系统中，例如交通运输、能源和移动出行。我们提出了一种名为FlowSymm的新型架构，它结合了：（i）对无散度流量的群作用，（ii）一个图注意力编码器，用于学习在这些保持对称性的作用之上的、特征条件化的权重，以及（iii）一个通过隐式双层优化解决的轻量级吉洪诺夫正则化。该方法首先将给定的观测锚定在一个最小范数的无散度补全上。然后，我们计算所有容许的群作用的正交基，这些群作用保持观测流量不变，并参数化有效的解子空间，该子空间在向量加法下呈现阿贝尔群结构。之后，一堆GATv2层将图及其边缘特征编码为按边缘嵌入，这些嵌入在缺失边缘上进行池化，并产生按基 attention 权重。这个 attention 引导的过程选择一组保持观测流量的、具有物理意识的群作用。最后，一个标量吉洪诺夫惩罚通过一个凸最小二乘求解器来细化缺失条目，梯度通过 Cholesky 分解进行隐式传播。在三个真实世界的流量基准（交通、电力、自行车）上，FlowSymm 在 RMSE、MAE 和相关性指标方面优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces FlowSymm, a novel graph attention architecture for network flow completion that respects local conservation laws and outperforms existing methods on real-world benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FlowSymm，一种新颖的图注意力结构，用于网络流量补全，该结构尊重局部守恒定律，并且在真实世界的基准测试中优于现有方法。

title: Degradation-Aware Frequency Regulation of a Heterogeneous Battery Fleet via Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Battery energy storage systems are increasingly deployed as fast-responding resources for grid balancing services such as frequency regulation and for mitigating renewable generation uncertainty. However, repeated charging and discharging induces cycling degradation and reduces battery lifetime. This paper studies the real-time scheduling of a heterogeneous battery fleet that collectively tracks a stochastic balancing signal subject to per-battery ramp-rate and capacity constraints, while minimizing long-term cycling degradation.
  Cycling degradation is fundamentally path-dependent: it is determined by charge-discharge cycles formed by the state-of-charge (SoC) trajectory and is commonly quantified via rainflow cycle counting. This non-Markovian structure makes it difficult to express degradation as an additive per-time-step cost, complicating classical dynamic programming approaches. We address this challenge by formulating the fleet scheduling problem as a Markov decision process (MDP) with constrained action space and designing a dense proxy reward that provides informative feedback at each time step while remaining aligned with long-term cycle-depth reduction.
  To scale learning to large state-action spaces induced by fine-grained SoC discretization and asymmetric per-battery constraints, we develop a function-approximation reinforcement learning method using an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) as a random nonlinear feature map combined with linear temporal-difference learning. We evaluate the proposed approach on a toy Markovian signal model and on a Markovian model trained from real-world regulation signal traces obtained from the University of Delaware, and demonstrate consistent reductions in cycle-depth occurrence and degradation metrics compared to baseline scheduling policies.
summary_zh:
电池储能系统越来越多地被部署为快速响应资源，用于诸如频率调节等电网平衡服务，并用于缓解可再生能源发电的不确定性。然而，重复的充放电会引起循环衰退并降低电池寿命。本文研究了异构电池组的实时调度，该电池组共同跟踪随机平衡信号，并受每个电池的爬坡速率和容量约束，同时最小化长期循环衰退。

循环衰退本质上是路径依赖的：它由荷电状态 (SoC) 轨迹形成的充放电循环决定，并通常通过雨流计数法进行量化。这种非马尔可夫结构使得难以将衰退表示为每时步可加的成本，从而复杂化了经典的动态规划方法。我们通过将电池组调度问题表述为具有约束动作空间的马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 来解决这一挑战，并设计了一个密集代理奖励，该奖励在每个时间步提供信息丰富的反馈，同时与长期循环深度减少保持一致。

为了将学习扩展到由细粒度 SoC 离散化和非对称单电池约束引起的大型状态-动作空间，我们开发了一种函数逼近强化学习方法，该方法使用极限学习机 (ELM) 作为随机非线性特征映射，并结合线性时序差分学习。我们在一个玩具马尔可夫信号模型和一个从特拉华大学获得的真实世界调节信号轨迹训练的马尔可夫模型上评估了所提出的方法，并证明与基线调度策略相比，循环深度发生率和衰退指标均有持续降低。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach to schedule a heterogeneous battery fleet for frequency regulation, aiming to minimize battery degradation by using a dense proxy reward and an ELM-based function approximation to handle large state-action spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种强化学习方法来调度异构电池组进行频率调节，旨在通过使用密集代理奖励和基于ELM的函数逼近来处理大型状态-动作空间，从而最大限度地减少电池的衰减。

title: AI-Enabled Waste Classification as a Data-Driven Decision Support Tool for Circular Economy and Urban Sustainability
summary: Efficient waste sorting is crucial for enabling circular-economy practices and resource recovery in smart cities. This paper evaluates both traditional machine-learning (Random Forest, SVM, AdaBoost) and deep-learning techniques including custom CNNs, VGG16, ResNet50, and three transfer-learning models (DenseNet121, EfficientNetB0, InceptionV3) for binary classification of 25 077 waste images (80/20 train/test split, augmented and resized to 150x150 px). The paper assesses the impact of Principal Component Analysis for dimensionality reduction on traditional models. DenseNet121 achieved the highest accuracy (91 %) and ROC-AUC (0.98), outperforming the best traditional classifier by 20 pp. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) showed negligible benefit for classical methods, whereas transfer learning substantially improved performance under limited-data conditions. Finally, we outline how these models integrate into a real-time Data-Driven Decision Support System for automated waste sorting, highlighting potential reductions in landfill use and lifecycle environmental impacts.)
summary_zh: 高效的垃圾分类对于在智慧城市中实现循环经济实践和资源回收至关重要。本文评估了传统机器学习方法（随机森林、支持向量机、AdaBoost）和深度学习技术，包括自定义卷积神经网络（CNN）、VGG16、ResNet50和三种迁移学习模型（DenseNet121、EfficientNetB0、InceptionV3），用于25077张垃圾图像的二元分类（训练集/测试集比例为80/20，数据增强并调整大小至150x150像素）。本文还评估了主成分分析法对传统模型进行降维的影响。DenseNet121实现了最高的准确率（91%）和ROC-AUC（0.98），比最佳的传统分类器高出20个百分点。主成分分析（PCA）对传统方法几乎没有带来益处，而迁移学习在数据有限的情况下显著提高了性能。最后，我们概述了这些模型如何集成到用于自动化垃圾分类的实时数据驱动决策支持系统中，强调了潜在的填埋场使用量减少和生命周期环境影响降低。
tldr: This paper explores AI-based waste classification using machine learning and deep learning models, with DenseNet121 achieving the highest accuracy for binary waste classification, demonstrating potential for real-time waste sorting and reduced environmental impact.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了基于人工智能的垃圾分类，使用了机器学习和深度学习模型。其中，DenseNet121在二元垃圾分类任务中实现了最高的准确率，展示了实时垃圾分类和减少环境影响的潜力。

title: Deep in the Jungle: Towards Automating Chimpanzee Population Estimation
summary: The estimation of abundance and density in unmarked populations of great apes relies on statistical frameworks that require animal-to-camera distance measurements. In practice, acquiring these distances depends on labour-intensive manual interpretation of animal observations across large camera trap video corpora. This study introduces and evaluates an only sparsely explored alternative: the integration of computer vision-based monocular depth estimation (MDE) pipelines directly into ecological camera trap workflows for great ape conservation. Using a real-world dataset of 220 camera trap videos documenting a wild chimpanzee population, we combine two MDE models, Dense Prediction Transformers and Depth Anything, with multiple distance sampling strategies. These components are used to generate detection distance estimates, from which population density and abundance are inferred. Comparative analysis against manually derived ground-truth distances shows that calibrated DPT consistently outperforms Depth Anything. This advantage is observed in both distance estimation accuracy and downstream density and abundance inference. Nevertheless, both models exhibit systematic biases. We show that, given complex forest environments, they tend to overestimate detection distances and consequently underestimate density and abundance relative to conventional manual approaches. We further find that failures in animal detection across distance ranges are a primary factor limiting estimation accuracy. Overall, this work provides a case study that shows MDE-driven camera trap distance sampling is a viable and practical alternative to manual distance estimation. The proposed approach yields population estimates within 22% of those obtained using traditional methods.
summary_zh: 对未标记的大猿种群丰度和密度的估计依赖于需要动物到相机距离测量的统计框架。在实践中，获取这些距离取决于对大量相机陷阱视频语料库中动物观测结果进行劳动密集型的人工解读。本研究介绍并评估了一种仅被少量探索的替代方案：将基于计算机视觉的单目深度估计 (MDE) 流程直接集成到大猿保护的生态相机陷阱工作流程中。我们使用一个包含 220 个文档记录了一只野生黑猩猩种群的真实世界相机陷阱视频数据集，将两个 MDE 模型（密集预测 Transformer 和 Depth Anything）与多种距离抽样策略相结合。这些组件用于生成检测距离估计，从中推断种群密度和丰度。与人工推导的真实距离进行的比较分析表明，经过校准的 DPT 一致优于 Depth Anything。这种优势在距离估计精度以及下游密度和丰度推断中都有体现。然而，两种模型都表现出系统性偏差。我们表明，鉴于复杂的森林环境，它们往往会高估检测距离，从而相对于传统的的手动方法低估密度和丰度。我们进一步发现，距离范围内动物检测的失败是限制估计精度的主要因素。总的来说，这项工作提供了一个案例研究，表明 MDE 驱动的相机陷阱距离抽样是一种可行且实用的手动距离估计替代方案。所提出的方法产生的种群估计值与使用传统方法获得的估计值相差不到22%。
tldr: This paper explores using monocular depth estimation (MDE) with camera traps for automating chimpanzee population estimation, demonstrating its viability while noting systematic biases and limitations in forested environments.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用单目深度估计（MDE）和相机陷阱来自动进行黑猩猩种群数量估计，证明了其可行性，但也指出其在森林环境中的系统性偏差和局限性。

title: EMBC Special Issue: Calibrated Uncertainty for Trustworthy Clinical Gait Analysis Using Probabilistic Multiview Markerless Motion Capture
summary: Video-based human movement analysis holds potential for movement assessment in clinical practice and research. However, the clinical implementation and trust of multi-view markerless motion capture (MMMC) require that, in addition to being accurate, these systems produce reliable confidence intervals to indicate how accurate they are for any individual. Building on our prior work utilizing variational inference to estimate joint angle posterior distributions, this study evaluates the calibration and reliability of a probabilistic MMMC method. We analyzed data from 68 participants across two institutions, validating the model against an instrumented walkway and standard marker-based motion capture. We measured the calibration of the confidence intervals using the Expected Calibration Error (ECE). The model demonstrated reliable calibration, yielding ECE values generally < 0.1 for both step and stride length and bias-corrected gait kinematics. We observed a median step and stride length error of ~16 mm and ~12 mm respectively, with median bias-corrected kinematic errors ranging from 1.5 to 3.8 degrees across lower extremity joints. Consistent with the calibrated ECE, the magnitude of the model's predicted uncertainty correlated strongly with observed error measures. These findings indicate that, as designed, the probabilistic model reconstruction quantifies epistemic uncertainty, allowing it to identify unreliable outputs without the need for concurrent ground-truth instrumentation.
summary_zh: 基于视频的人体运动分析在临床实践和研究中具有运动评估的潜力。然而，多视角无标记动作捕捉（MMMC）的临床应用和信任，不仅要求系统准确，还要求能够产生可靠的置信区间，以表明其对任何个体的准确程度。基于我们之前利用变分推断来估计关节角度后验分布的工作，本研究评估了一种概率MMMC方法的校准性和可靠性。我们分析了来自两个机构的68名参与者的数据，并使用仪器化步道和标准的基于标记点的动作捕捉对模型进行了验证。我们采用期望校准误差（ECE）来衡量置信区间的校准程度。该模型表现出可靠的校准性，对于步长和步幅以及偏差校正后的步态运动学，ECE值通常小于0.1。我们观察到步长和步幅的中位数误差分别为约16毫米和约12毫米，偏差校正后的运动学中位数误差在下肢关节上介于1.5到3.8度之间。与校准的ECE一致，该模型预测的不确定性幅度与观察到的误差指标密切相关。这些发现表明，按照设计，该概率模型重建量化了认知不确定性，使其能够识别不可靠的输出，而无需并发的真实值仪器设备。
tldr: This paper presents a probabilistic multi-view markerless motion capture method with calibrated uncertainty, validated on gait analysis, showing reliable confidence intervals and good correlation between predicted uncertainty and observed error.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种概率多视角无标记运动捕捉方法，具有校准的不确定性，并在步态分析中进行了验证，显示出可靠的置信区间，以及预测的不确定性与观察到的误差之间良好的相关性。

title: An Efficient Algorithm for Thresholding Monte Carlo Tree Search
summary: We introduce the Thresholding Monte Carlo Tree Search problem, in which, given a tree $\mathcal{T}$ and a threshold $θ$, a player must answer whether the root node value of $\mathcal{T}$ is at least $θ$ or not. In the given tree, `MAX' or `MIN' is labeled on each internal node, and the value of a `MAX'-labeled (`MIN'-labeled) internal node is the maximum (minimum) of its child values. The value of a leaf node is the mean reward of an unknown distribution, from which the player can sample rewards. For this problem, we develop a $δ$-correct sequential sampling algorithm based on the Track-and-Stop strategy that has asymptotically optimal sample complexity. We show that a ratio-based modification of the D-Tracking arm-pulling strategy leads to a substantial improvement in empirical sample complexity, as well as reducing the per-round computational cost from linear to logarithmic in the number of arms.
summary_zh: 我们引入了阈值蒙特卡洛树搜索问题。在该问题中，给定一棵树 $\mathcal{T}$ 和一个阈值 $θ$，玩家必须回答 $\mathcal{T}$ 的根节点的值是否至少为 $θ$。在给定的树中，每个内部节点都标记为“最大（MAX）”或“最小（MIN）”，而一个标记为“最大” ("MAX")（“最小（MIN）”）的内部节点的值是其子节点值的最大值（最小值）。叶节点的值是从一个未知分布中采样的奖励的均值，玩家可以从该分布中采样奖励。针对这个问题，我们开发了一种基于追踪与停止策略的$δ$-正确的序列采样算法，该算法具有渐近最优的样本复杂度。我们表明，对D-追踪臂拉取策略进行基于比率的修改可以显著改进经验样本复杂度，并将每轮计算成本从臂数量的线性复杂度降低到对数复杂度。
tldr: This paper introduces a new algorithm for solving the Thresholding Monte Carlo Tree Search problem with provably optimal sample complexity and empirically improved performance via a ratio-based D-Tracking strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的算法，用于解决阈值蒙特卡罗树搜索问题，该算法具有可证明的最佳样本复杂性，并通过基于比率的 D-Tracking 策略在经验上提高了性能。

title: Spatially-Adaptive Conformal Graph Transformer for Indoor Localization in Wi-Fi Driven Networks
summary: Indoor localization is a critical enabler for a wide range of location-based services in smart environments, including navigation, asset tracking, and safety-critical applications. Recent graph-based models leverage spatial relationships between Wire-less Fidelity (Wi-Fi) Access Points (APs) and devices, offering finer localization granularity, but fall short in quantifying prediction uncertainty, a key requirement for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose Spatially-Adaptive Conformal Graph Transformer (SAC-GT), a framework for accurate and reliable indoor localization. SAC-GT integrates a Graph Transformer (GT) model that captures network's spatial topology and signal strength dynamics, with a novel Spatially-Adaptive Conformal Prediction (SACP) method that provides region-specific uncertainty estimates. This allows SAC-GT to produce not only precise two-dimensional (2D) location predictions but also statistically valid confidence regions tailored to varying environmental conditions. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale real-world dataset demonstrate that the proposed SAC-GT solution achieves state-of-the-art localization accuracy while delivering robust and spatially adaptive reliability guarantees.
summary_zh: 室内定位是智慧环境中各种基于位置服务的关键使能技术，包括导航、资产跟踪和安全攸关的应用。最近基于图的模型利用无线保真（Wi-Fi）接入点（AP）与设备之间的空间关系，提供更精细的定位粒度，但未能量化预测不确定性，这对于实际部署至关重要。在本文中，我们提出一种空间自适应共形图变换器（SAC-GT），这是一种用于精确和可靠的室内定位的框架。SAC-GT集成了图变换器（GT）模型，该模型捕获网络的空间拓扑和信号强度动态，以及一种新颖的空间自适应共形预测（SACP）方法，该方法提供特定区域的不确定性估计。这使得SAC-GT不仅能够产生精确的二维（2D）位置预测，还能生成针对不同环境条件量身定制的具有统计有效性的置信区域。在大型真实数据集上的广泛评估表明，所提出的SAC-GT解决方案实现了最先进的定位精度，同时提供了稳健且空间自适应的可靠性保证。
tldr: The paper introduces Spatially-Adaptive Conformal Graph Transformer (SAC-GT) for indoor localization, combining a Graph Transformer with Spatially-Adaptive Conformal Prediction to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy and spatially adaptive reliability guarantees.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于室内定位的空间自适应一致图变换器(SAC-GT)，它结合了图变换器和空间自适应一致预测，以实现最先进的精度和空间自适应可靠性保证。

title: Privacy-Preserving Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition for Low-Resource Healthcare Using Classical Machine Learning
summary: Limited access to medical infrastructure forces elderly and vulnerable patients to rely on home-based care, often leading to neglect and poor adherence to therapeutic exercises such as yoga or physiotherapy. To address this gap, we propose a low-cost and automated human activity recognition (HAR) framework based on wearable inertial sensors and machine learning. Activity data, including walking, walking upstairs, walking downstairs, sitting, standing, and lying, were collected using accelerometer and gyroscope measurements. Four classical classifiers, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), were evaluated and compared with the proposed Support Tensor Machine (STM). Experimental results show that SVM achieved an accuracy of 93.33 percent, while Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and k-NN achieved 91.11 percent. In contrast, STM significantly outperformed these models, achieving a test accuracy of 96.67 percent and the highest cross-validation accuracy of 98.50 percent. Unlike conventional methods, STM leverages tensor representations to preserve spatio-temporal motion dynamics, resulting in robust classification across diverse activities. The proposed framework demonstrates strong potential for remote healthcare, elderly assistance, child activity monitoring, yoga feedback, and smart home wellness, offering a scalable solution for low-resource and rural healthcare settings.
summary_zh: 有限的医疗基础设施使得老年人和弱势患者不得不依赖家庭护理，这常常导致疏忽和对诸如瑜伽或物理治疗等治疗性锻炼的依从性差。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种基于可穿戴惯性传感器和机器学习的低成本、自动化的活动识别 (HAR) 框架。利用加速度计和陀螺仪测量，收集了包括行走、上楼、下楼、坐、站立和躺卧等活动数据。评估了四种经典分类器：逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机 (SVM) 和 k 近邻 (k-NN)，并将其与我们提出的支持张量机 (STM) 进行了比较。实验结果表明，SVM 的准确率达到了 93.33%，而逻辑回归、随机森林和 k-NN 的准确率达到了 91.11%。相比之下，STM 显著优于这些模型，测试准确率达到了 96.67%，交叉验证准确率最高，达到了 98.50%。与传统方法不同，STM 利用张量表示来保留时空运动动力学，从而在各种活动中实现稳健的分类。所提出的框架在远程医疗、老年人辅助、儿童活动监测、瑜伽反馈和智能家居健康方面展现出强大的潜力，为低资源和农村医疗环境提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: The paper proposes a sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) framework using wearable inertial sensors and classical machine learning, with a novel Support Tensor Machine (STM) achieving superior accuracy compared to traditional methods for remote healthcare applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）框架，该框架使用可穿戴惯性传感器和经典机器学习，其中一种新型支持张量机（STM）与传统的远程医疗应用方法相比，具有更高的精度。

title: Physics Informed Reconstruction of Four-Dimensional Atmospheric Wind Fields Using Multi-UAS Swarm Observations in a Synthetic Turbulent Environment
summary: Accurate reconstruction of atmospheric wind fields is essential for applications such as weather forecasting, hazard prediction, and wind energy assessment, yet conventional instruments leave spatio-temporal gaps within the lower atmospheric boundary layer. Unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) provide flexible in situ measurements, but individual platforms sample wind only along their flight trajectories, limiting full wind-field recovery. This study presents a framework for reconstructing four-dimensional atmospheric wind fields using measurements obtained from a coordinated UAS swarm. A synthetic turbulence environment and high-fidelity multirotor simulation are used to generate training and evaluation data. Local wind components are estimated from UAS dynamics using a bidirectional long short-term memory network (Bi-LSTM) and assimilated into a physics-informed neural network (PINN) to reconstruct a continuous wind field in space and time. For local wind estimation, the bidirectional LSTM achieves root-mean-square errors (RMSE) of 0.064 and 0.062 m/s for the north and east components in low-wind conditions, increasing to 0.122 to 0.129 m/s under moderate winds and 0.271 to 0.273 m/s in high-wind conditions, while the vertical component exhibits higher error, with RMSE values of 0.029 to 0.091 m/s. The physics-informed reconstruction recovers the dominant spatial and temporal structure of the wind field up to 1000 m altitude while preserving mean flow direction and vertical shear. Under moderate wind conditions, the reconstructed mean wind field achieves an overall RMSE between 0.118 and 0.154 m/s across evaluated UAS configurations, with the lowest error obtained using a five-UAS swarm. These results demonstrate that coordinated UAS measurements enable accurate and scalable four-dimensional wind-field reconstruction without dedicated wind sensors or fixed infrastructure.
summary_zh: 大气风场的精确重构对于天气预报、灾害预测和风能评估等应用至关重要，但传统仪器在低层大气边界层内存在时空缺口。无人机系统 (UAS) 提供了灵活的原位测量，但单个平台仅沿其飞行轨迹采样风，限制了完整风场的恢复。本研究提出了一种框架，用于使用来自协同UAS集群的测量数据重构四维大气风场。 使用合成湍流环境和高保真多旋翼仿真来生成训练和评估数据。 利用双向长短期记忆网络 (Bi-LSTM) 从 UAS 动力学中估计局部风分量，并将其同化到物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 中，以重构连续的时空风场。 在局部风估计方面，双向 LSTM 在低风条件下，南北和东西分量的均方根误差 (RMSE) 分别为 0.064 和 0.062 m/s，在中等风力条件下增加到 0.122 至 0.129 m/s，在高风力条件下增加到 0.271 至 0.273 m/s，而垂直分量表现出更高的误差，RMSE 值为 0.029 至 0.091 m/s。物理信息重构恢复了高达 1000 米高度的风场主要时空结构，同时保留了平均流向和垂直切变。 在中等风力条件下，重构的平均风场在评估的 UAS 配置中实现了 0.118 至 0.154 m/s 的总体 RMSE，使用五个 UAS 集群获得的误差最低。 这些结果表明，协同 UAS 测量能够实现精确且可扩展的四维风场重构，无需专用测风传感器或固定基础设施。
tldr: This paper presents a method for reconstructing 4D atmospheric wind fields using UAS swarm data and a physics-informed neural network (PINN), demonstrating accurate wind field recovery in a synthetic turbulent environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用无人机集群数据和物理信息神经网络（PINN）重建四维大气风场的方法，并在合成湍流环境中展示了准确的风场恢复。

title: Plant-Inspired Robot Design Metaphors for Ambient HRI
summary: Plants offer a paradoxical model for interaction: they are ambient, low-demand presences that nonetheless shape atmosphere, routines, and relationships through temporal rhythms and subtle expressions. In contrast, most human-robot interaction (HRI) has been grounded in anthropomorphic and zoomorphic paradigms, producing overt, high-demand forms of engagement. Using a Research through Design (RtD) methodology, we explore plants as metaphoric inspiration for HRI; we conducted iterative cycles of ideation, prototyping, and reflection to investigate what design primitives emerge from plant metaphors and morphologies, and how these primitives can be combined into expressive robotic forms. We present a suite of speculative, open-source prototypes that help probe plant-inspired presence, temporality, form, and gestures. We deepened our learnings from design and prototyping through prototype-centered workshops that explored people's perceptions and imaginaries of plant-inspired robots. This work contributes: (1) Set of plant-inspired robotic artifacts; (2) Designerly insights on how people perceive plant-inspired robots; and (3) Design consideration to inform how to use plant metaphors to reshape HRI.
summary_zh: 植物为交互提供了一个悖论式的模型：它们是环境的、低需求的呈现，但仍通过时间节奏和精妙的表达来塑造氛围、日常活动和人际关系。与此相反，大多数人机交互 (HRI) 都以拟人化和拟动物化范式为基础，产生了显性的、高需求的参与形式。我们采用基于设计的科研 (RtD) 方法，探索以植物作为人机交互的隐喻灵感；我们进行了迭代的构思、原型设计和反思循环，以研究从植物隐喻和形态中涌现出的设计基元，以及如何将这些基元组合成富有表现力的机器人形态。我们展示了一系列推测性的、开源原型，这些原型有助于探索植物启发的存在、时间性、形态和姿态。我们通过以原型为中心的研讨会，加深了从设计和原型设计中获得的知识，这些研讨会探索了人们对植物启发的机器人的感知和想象。这项工作贡献了：（1）一套植物启发的机器人制品；（2）关于人们如何感知植物启发的机器人的设计洞察；以及（3）设计考量，以指导如何使用植物隐喻来重塑人机交互。
tldr: This paper explores plant-inspired metaphors in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), presenting speculative robotic prototypes and design considerations to shift HRI from anthropomorphic paradigms towards ambient and subtle forms of engagement.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了植物启发式隐喻在人机交互（HRI）中的应用，提出了推测性的机器人原型和设计考量，旨在将 HRI 从拟人化范式转变为环境化和微妙的互动形式。
